text: śamo bahuvidhākāraḥ sūkṣma uktaḥ pitāmaha । na ca me hṛdaye śāntirasti kṛtvedamīdṛśam ॥1॥
html:
śamo bahuvidhākāraḥ sūkṣma uktaḥ pitāmaha ।
na ca me hṛdaye śāntirasti kṛtvedamīdṛśam ॥1॥
slp1: Samo bahuviDAkAraH sUkzma uktaH pitAmaha । na ca me hfdaye SAntirasti kftvedamIdfSam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: asminnarthe bahuvidhā śāntiruktā tvayānagha । svakṛte kā nu śāntiḥ syācchamādbahuvidhādapi ॥2॥
html:
asminnarthe bahuvidhā śāntiruktā tvayānagha ।
svakṛte kā nu śāntiḥ syācchamādbahuvidhādapi ॥2॥
slp1: asminnarTe bahuviDA SAntiruktA tvayAnaGa । svakfte kA nu SAntiH syAcCamAdbahuviDAdapi ॥2॥

text: śarācitaśarīraṃ hi tīvravraṇamudīkṣya ca । śamaṃ nopalabhe vīra duṣkṛtānyeva cintayan ॥3॥
html:
śarācitaśarīraṃ hi tīvravraṇamudīkṣya ca ।
śamaṃ nopalabhe vīra duṣkṛtānyeva cintayan ॥3॥
slp1: SarAcitaSarIraM hi tIvravraRamudIkzya ca । SamaM nopalaBe vIra duzkftAnyeva cintayan ॥3॥

text: rudhireṇāvasiktāṅgaṃ prasravantaṃ yathācalam । tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣavyāghra sīde varṣāsvivāmbujam ॥4॥
html:
rudhireṇāvasiktāṅgaṃ prasravantaṃ yathācalam ।
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣavyāghra sīde varṣāsvivāmbujam ॥4॥
slp1: ruDireRAvasiktANgaM prasravantaM yaTAcalam । tvAM dfzwvA puruzavyAGra sIde varzAsvivAmbujam ॥4॥

text: ataḥ kaṣṭataraṃ kiṃ nu matkṛte yatpitāmahaḥ । imāmavasthāṃ gamitaḥ pratyamitrai raṇājire । tathaivānye nṛpatayaḥ sahaputrāḥ sabāndhavāḥ ॥5॥
html:
ataḥ kaṣṭataraṃ kiṃ nu matkṛte yatpitāmahaḥ ।
imāmavasthāṃ gamitaḥ pratyamitrai raṇājire ।
tathaivānye nṛpatayaḥ sahaputrāḥ sabāndhavāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: ataH kazwataraM kiM nu matkfte yatpitAmahaH । imAmavasTAM gamitaH pratyamitrE raRAjire । taTEvAnye nfpatayaH sahaputrAH sabAnDavAH ॥5॥

text: vayaṃ hi dhārtarāṣṭrāśca kālamanyuvaśānugāḥ । kṛtvedaṃ ninditaṃ karma prāpsyāmaḥ kāṃ gatiṃ nṛpa ॥6॥
html:
vayaṃ hi dhārtarāṣṭrāśca kālamanyuvaśānugāḥ ।
kṛtvedaṃ ninditaṃ karma prāpsyāmaḥ kāṃ gatiṃ nṛpa ॥6॥
slp1: vayaM hi DArtarAzwrASca kAlamanyuvaSAnugAH । kftvedaM ninditaM karma prApsyAmaH kAM gatiM nfpa ॥6॥

text: ahaṃ tava hyantakaraḥ suhṛdvadhakarastathā । na śāntimadhigacchāmi paśyaṃstvāṃ duḥkhitaṃ kṣitau ॥7॥
html:
ahaṃ tava hyantakaraḥ suhṛdvadhakarastathā ।
na śāntimadhigacchāmi paśyaṃstvāṃ duḥkhitaṃ kṣitau ॥7॥
slp1: ahaM tava hyantakaraH suhfdvaDakarastaTA । na SAntimaDigacCAmi paSyaMstvAM duHKitaM kzitO ॥7॥

text: paratantraṃ kathaṃ hetumātmānamanupaśyasi । karmaṇyasminmahābhāga sūkṣmaṃ hyetadatīndriyam ॥8॥
html:
paratantraṃ kathaṃ hetumātmānamanupaśyasi ।
karmaṇyasminmahābhāga sūkṣmaṃ hyetadatīndriyam ॥8॥
slp1: paratantraM kaTaM hetumAtmAnamanupaSyasi । karmaRyasminmahABAga sUkzmaM hyetadatIndriyam ॥8॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । saṃvādaṃ mṛtyugautamyoḥ kālalubdhakapannagaiḥ ॥9॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
saṃvādaṃ mṛtyugautamyoḥ kālalubdhakapannagaiḥ ॥9॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । saMvAdaM mftyugOtamyoH kAlalubDakapannagEH ॥9॥

text: gautamī nāma kaunteya sthavirā śamasaṃyutā । sarpeṇa daṣṭaṃ svaṃ putramapaśyadgatacetanam ॥10॥
html:
gautamī nāma kaunteya sthavirā śamasaṃyutā ।
sarpeṇa daṣṭaṃ svaṃ putramapaśyadgatacetanam ॥10॥
slp1: gOtamI nAma kOnteya sTavirA SamasaMyutA । sarpeRa dazwaM svaM putramapaSyadgatacetanam ॥10॥

text: atha taṃ snāyupāśena baddhvā sarpamamarṣitaḥ । lubdhako'rjunako nāma gautamyāḥ samupānayat ॥11॥
html:
atha taṃ snāyupāśena baddhvā sarpamamarṣitaḥ ।
lubdhako'rjunako nāma gautamyāḥ samupānayat ॥11॥
slp1: aTa taM snAyupASena badDvA sarpamamarzitaH । lubDako'rjunako nAma gOtamyAH samupAnayat ॥11॥

text: tāṃ cābravīdayaṃ te sa putrahā pannagādhamaḥ । brūhi kṣipraṃ mahābhāge vadhyatāṃ kena hetunā ॥12॥
html:
tāṃ cābravīdayaṃ te sa putrahā pannagādhamaḥ ।
brūhi kṣipraṃ mahābhāge vadhyatāṃ kena hetunā ॥12॥
slp1: tAM cAbravIdayaM te sa putrahA pannagADamaH । brUhi kzipraM mahABAge vaDyatAM kena hetunA ॥12॥

text: agnau prakṣipyatāmeṣa cchidyatāṃ khaṇḍaśo'pi vā । na hyayaṃ bālahā pāpaściraṃ jīvitumarhati ॥13॥
html:
agnau prakṣipyatāmeṣa cchidyatāṃ khaṇḍaśo'pi vā ।
na hyayaṃ bālahā pāpaściraṃ jīvitumarhati ॥13॥
slp1: agnO prakzipyatAmeza cCidyatAM KaRqaSo'pi vA । na hyayaM bAlahA pApaSciraM jIvitumarhati ॥13॥

text: visṛjainamabuddhistvaṃ na vadhyo'rjunaka tvayā । ko hyātmānaṃ guruṃ kuryātprāptavye sati cintayan ॥14॥
html:
visṛjainamabuddhistvaṃ na vadhyo'rjunaka tvayā ।
ko hyātmānaṃ guruṃ kuryātprāptavye sati cintayan ॥14॥
slp1: visfjEnamabudDistvaM na vaDyo'rjunaka tvayA । ko hyAtmAnaM guruM kuryAtprAptavye sati cintayan ॥14॥
author: gautamyuvāca ।

text: plavante dharmalaghavo loke'mbhasi yathā plavāḥ । majjanti pāpaguravaḥ śastraṃ skannamivodake ॥15॥
html:
plavante dharmalaghavo loke'mbhasi yathā plavāḥ ।
majjanti pāpaguravaḥ śastraṃ skannamivodake ॥15॥
slp1: plavante DarmalaGavo loke'mBasi yaTA plavAH । majjanti pApaguravaH SastraM skannamivodake ॥15॥

text: na cāmṛtyurbhavitā vai hate'sminko vātyayaḥ syādahate'smiñjanasya । asyotsarge prāṇayuktasya jantormṛtyorlokaṃ ko nu gacchedanantam ॥16॥
html:
na cāmṛtyurbhavitā vai hate'sminko vātyayaḥ syādahate'smiñjanasya ।
asyotsarge prāṇayuktasya jantormṛtyorlokaṃ ko nu gacchedanantam ॥16॥
slp1: na cAmftyurBavitA vE hate'sminko vAtyayaH syAdahate'smiYjanasya । asyotsarge prARayuktasya jantormftyorlokaM ko nu gacCedanantam ॥16॥

text: jānāmyevaṃ neha guṇāguṇajñāḥ sarve niyuktā guravo vai bhavanti । svasthasyaite tūpadeśā bhavanti tasmātkṣudraṃ sarpamenaṃ haniṣye ॥17॥
html:
jānāmyevaṃ neha guṇāguṇajñāḥ sarve niyuktā guravo vai bhavanti ।
svasthasyaite tūpadeśā bhavanti tasmātkṣudraṃ sarpamenaṃ haniṣye ॥17॥
slp1: jAnAmyevaM neha guRAguRajYAH sarve niyuktA guravo vE Bavanti । svasTasyEte tUpadeSA Bavanti tasmAtkzudraM sarpamenaM hanizye ॥17॥
author: lubdhaka uvāca ।

text: samīpsantaḥ kālayogaṃ tyajanti sadyaḥ śucaṃ tvarthavidastyajanti । śreyaḥ kṣayaḥ śocatāṃ nityaśo hi tasmāttyājyaṃ jahi śokaṃ hate'smin ॥18॥
html:
samīpsantaḥ kālayogaṃ tyajanti sadyaḥ śucaṃ tvarthavidastyajanti ।
śreyaḥ kṣayaḥ śocatāṃ nityaśo hi tasmāttyājyaṃ jahi śokaṃ hate'smin ॥18॥
slp1: samIpsantaH kAlayogaM tyajanti sadyaH SucaM tvarTavidastyajanti । SreyaH kzayaH SocatAM nityaSo hi tasmAttyAjyaM jahi SokaM hate'smin ॥18॥

text: na caivārtirvidyate'smadvidhānāṃ dharmārāmaḥ satataṃ sajjano hi । nityāyasto bālajano na cāsti dharmo hyeṣa prabhavāmyasya nāham ॥19॥
html:
na caivārtirvidyate'smadvidhānāṃ dharmārāmaḥ satataṃ sajjano hi ।
nityāyasto bālajano na cāsti dharmo hyeṣa prabhavāmyasya nāham ॥19॥
slp1: na cEvArtirvidyate'smadviDAnAM DarmArAmaH satataM sajjano hi । nityAyasto bAlajano na cAsti Darmo hyeza praBavAmyasya nAham ॥19॥
author: gautamyuvāca ।

text: na brāhmaṇānāṃ kopo'sti kutaḥ kopācca yātanā । mārdavātkṣamyatāṃ sādho mucyatāmeṣa pannagaḥ ॥20॥
html:
na brāhmaṇānāṃ kopo'sti kutaḥ kopācca yātanā ।
mārdavātkṣamyatāṃ sādho mucyatāmeṣa pannagaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: na brAhmaRAnAM kopo'sti kutaH kopAcca yAtanA । mArdavAtkzamyatAM sADo mucyatAmeza pannagaH ॥20॥

text: hatvā lābhaḥ śreya evāvyayaṃ syātsadyo lābho balavadbhiḥ praśastaḥ । kālāllābho yastu sadyo bhaveta hate śreyaḥ kutsite tvīdṛśe syāt ॥21॥
html:
hatvā lābhaḥ śreya evāvyayaṃ syātsadyo lābho balavadbhiḥ praśastaḥ ।
kālāllābho yastu sadyo bhaveta hate śreyaḥ kutsite tvīdṛśe syāt ॥21॥
slp1: hatvA lABaH Sreya evAvyayaM syAtsadyo lABo balavadBiH praSastaH । kAlAllABo yastu sadyo Baveta hate SreyaH kutsite tvIdfSe syAt ॥21॥
author: lubdhaka uvāca ।

text: kārthaprāptirgṛhya śatruṃ nihatya kā vā śāntiḥ prāpya śatruṃ namuktvā । kasmātsaumya bhujage na kṣameyaṃ mokṣaṃ vā kiṃ kāraṇaṃ nāsya kuryām ॥22॥
html:
kārthaprāptirgṛhya śatruṃ nihatya kā vā śāntiḥ prāpya śatruṃ namuktvā ।
kasmātsaumya bhujage na kṣameyaṃ mokṣaṃ vā kiṃ kāraṇaṃ nāsya kuryām ॥22॥
slp1: kArTaprAptirgfhya SatruM nihatya kA vA SAntiH prApya SatruM namuktvA । kasmAtsOmya Bujage na kzameyaM mokzaM vA kiM kAraRaM nAsya kuryAm ॥22॥
author: gautamyuvāca ।

text: asmādekasmādbahavo rakṣitavyā naiko bahubhyo gautami rakṣitavyaḥ । kṛtāgasaṃ dharmavidastyajanti sarīsṛpaṃ pāpamimaṃ jahi tvam ॥23॥
html:
asmādekasmādbahavo rakṣitavyā naiko bahubhyo gautami rakṣitavyaḥ ।
kṛtāgasaṃ dharmavidastyajanti sarīsṛpaṃ pāpamimaṃ jahi tvam ॥23॥
slp1: asmAdekasmAdbahavo rakzitavyA nEko bahuByo gOtami rakzitavyaH । kftAgasaM Darmavidastyajanti sarIsfpaM pApamimaM jahi tvam ॥23॥
author: lubdhaka uvāca ।

text: nāsminhate pannage putrako me samprāpsyate lubdhaka jīvitaṃ vai । guṇaṃ cānyaṃ nāsya vadhe prapaśye tasmātsarpaṃ lubdhaka muñca jīvam ॥24॥
html:
nāsminhate pannage putrako me samprāpsyate lubdhaka jīvitaṃ vai ।
guṇaṃ cānyaṃ nāsya vadhe prapaśye tasmātsarpaṃ lubdhaka muñca jīvam ॥24॥
slp1: nAsminhate pannage putrako me samprApsyate lubDaka jIvitaM vE । guRaM cAnyaM nAsya vaDe prapaSye tasmAtsarpaM lubDaka muYca jIvam ॥24॥
author: gautamyuvāca ।

text: vṛtraṃ hatvā devarāṭśreṣṭhabhāgvai yajñaṃ hatvā bhāgamavāpa caiva । śūlī devo devavṛttaṃ kuru tvaṃ kṣipraṃ sarpaṃ jahi mā bhūdviśaṅkā ॥25॥
html:
vṛtraṃ hatvā devarāṭśreṣṭhabhāgvai yajñaṃ hatvā bhāgamavāpa caiva ।
śūlī devo devavṛttaṃ kuru tvaṃ kṣipraṃ sarpaṃ jahi mā bhūdviśaṅkā ॥25॥
slp1: vftraM hatvA devarAwSrezWaBAgvE yajYaM hatvA BAgamavApa cEva । SUlI devo devavfttaM kuru tvaM kzipraM sarpaM jahi mA BUdviSaNkA ॥25॥
author: lubdhaka uvāca ।

text: asakṛtprocyamānāpi gautamī bhujagaṃ prati । lubdhakena mahābhāgā pāpe naivākaronmatim ॥26॥
html:
asakṛtprocyamānāpi gautamī bhujagaṃ prati ।
lubdhakena mahābhāgā pāpe naivākaronmatim ॥26॥
slp1: asakftprocyamAnApi gOtamI BujagaM prati । lubDakena mahABAgA pApe nEvAkaronmatim ॥26॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: īṣaducchvasamānastu kṛcchrātsaṃstabhya pannagaḥ । utsasarja giraṃ mandāṃ mānuṣīṃ pāśapīḍitaḥ ॥27॥
html:
īṣaducchvasamānastu kṛcchrātsaṃstabhya pannagaḥ ।
utsasarja giraṃ mandāṃ mānuṣīṃ pāśapīḍitaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: IzaducCvasamAnastu kfcCrAtsaMstaBya pannagaH । utsasarja giraM mandAM mAnuzIM pASapIqitaH ॥27॥

text: ko nvarjunaka doṣo'tra vidyate mama bāliśa । asvatantraṃ hi māṃ mṛtyurvivaśaṃ yadacūcudat ॥28॥
html:
ko nvarjunaka doṣo'tra vidyate mama bāliśa ।
asvatantraṃ hi māṃ mṛtyurvivaśaṃ yadacūcudat ॥28॥
slp1: ko nvarjunaka dozo'tra vidyate mama bAliSa । asvatantraM hi mAM mftyurvivaSaM yadacUcudat ॥28॥

text: tasyāyaṃ vacanāddaṣṭo na kopena na kāmyayā । tasya tatkilbiṣaṃ lubdha vidyate yadi kilbiṣam ॥29॥
html:
tasyāyaṃ vacanāddaṣṭo na kopena na kāmyayā ।
tasya tatkilbiṣaṃ lubdha vidyate yadi kilbiṣam ॥29॥
slp1: tasyAyaM vacanAddazwo na kopena na kAmyayA । tasya tatkilbizaM lubDa vidyate yadi kilbizam ॥29॥

text: yadyanyavaśagenedaṃ kṛtaṃ te pannagāśubham । kāraṇaṃ vai tvamapyatra tasmāttvamapi kilbiṣī ॥30॥
html:
yadyanyavaśagenedaṃ kṛtaṃ te pannagāśubham ।
kāraṇaṃ vai tvamapyatra tasmāttvamapi kilbiṣī ॥30॥
slp1: yadyanyavaSagenedaM kftaM te pannagASuBam । kAraRaM vE tvamapyatra tasmAttvamapi kilbizI ॥30॥
author: lubdhaka uvāca ।

text: mṛtpātrasya kriyāyāṃ hi daṇḍacakrādayo yathā । kāraṇatve prakalpyante tathā tvamapi pannaga ॥31॥
html:
mṛtpātrasya kriyāyāṃ hi daṇḍacakrādayo yathā ।
kāraṇatve prakalpyante tathā tvamapi pannaga ॥31॥
slp1: mftpAtrasya kriyAyAM hi daRqacakrAdayo yaTA । kAraRatve prakalpyante taTA tvamapi pannaga ॥31॥

text: kilbiṣī cāpi me vadhyaḥ kilbiṣī cāsi pannaga । ātmānaṃ kāraṇaṃ hyatra tvamākhyāsi bhujaṅgama ॥32॥
html:
kilbiṣī cāpi me vadhyaḥ kilbiṣī cāsi pannaga ।
ātmānaṃ kāraṇaṃ hyatra tvamākhyāsi bhujaṅgama ॥32॥
slp1: kilbizI cApi me vaDyaH kilbizI cAsi pannaga । AtmAnaM kAraRaM hyatra tvamAKyAsi BujaNgama ॥32॥

text: sarva ete hyasvavaśā daṇḍacakrādayo yathā । tathāhamapi tasmānme naiṣa heturmatastava ॥33॥
html:
sarva ete hyasvavaśā daṇḍacakrādayo yathā ।
tathāhamapi tasmānme naiṣa heturmatastava ॥33॥
slp1: sarva ete hyasvavaSA daRqacakrAdayo yaTA । taTAhamapi tasmAnme nEza heturmatastava ॥33॥
author: sarpa uvāca ।

text: atha vā matametatte te'pyanyonyaprayojakāḥ । kāryakāraṇasandeho bhavatyanyonyacodanāt ॥34॥
html:
atha vā matametatte te'pyanyonyaprayojakāḥ ।
kāryakāraṇasandeho bhavatyanyonyacodanāt ॥34॥
slp1: aTa vA matametatte te'pyanyonyaprayojakAH । kAryakAraRasandeho BavatyanyonyacodanAt ॥34॥

text: evaṃ sati na doṣo me nāsmi vadhyo na kilbiṣī । kilbiṣaṃ samavāye syānmanyase yadi kilbiṣam ॥35॥
html:
evaṃ sati na doṣo me nāsmi vadhyo na kilbiṣī ।
kilbiṣaṃ samavāye syānmanyase yadi kilbiṣam ॥35॥
slp1: evaM sati na dozo me nAsmi vaDyo na kilbizI । kilbizaM samavAye syAnmanyase yadi kilbizam ॥35॥

text: kāraṇaṃ yadi na syādvai na kartā syāstvamapyuta । vināśe kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ ca tasmādvadhyo'si me mataḥ ॥36॥
html:
kāraṇaṃ yadi na syādvai na kartā syāstvamapyuta ।
vināśe kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ ca tasmādvadhyo'si me mataḥ ॥36॥
slp1: kAraRaM yadi na syAdvE na kartA syAstvamapyuta । vinASe kAraRaM tvaM ca tasmAdvaDyo'si me mataH ॥36॥
author: lubdhaka uvāca ।

text: asatyapi kṛte kārye neha pannaga lipyate । tasmānnātraiva hetuḥ syādvadhyaḥ kiṃ bahu bhāṣase ॥37॥
html:
asatyapi kṛte kārye neha pannaga lipyate ।
tasmānnātraiva hetuḥ syādvadhyaḥ kiṃ bahu bhāṣase ॥37॥
slp1: asatyapi kfte kArye neha pannaga lipyate । tasmAnnAtrEva hetuH syAdvaDyaH kiM bahu BAzase ॥37॥

text: kāryābhāve kriyā na syātsatyasatyapi kāraṇe । tasmāttvamasminhetau me vācyo heturviśeṣataḥ ॥38॥
html:
kāryābhāve kriyā na syātsatyasatyapi kāraṇe ।
tasmāttvamasminhetau me vācyo heturviśeṣataḥ ॥38॥
slp1: kAryABAve kriyA na syAtsatyasatyapi kAraRe । tasmAttvamasminhetO me vAcyo heturviSezataH ॥38॥
author: sarpa uvāca ।

text: yadyahaṃ kāraṇatvena mato lubdhaka tattvataḥ । anyaḥ prayoge syādatra kilbiṣī jantunāśane ॥39॥
html:
yadyahaṃ kāraṇatvena mato lubdhaka tattvataḥ ।
anyaḥ prayoge syādatra kilbiṣī jantunāśane ॥39॥
slp1: yadyahaM kAraRatvena mato lubDaka tattvataH । anyaH prayoge syAdatra kilbizI jantunASane ॥39॥

text: vadhyastvaṃ mama durbuddhe bālaghātī nṛśaṃsakṛt । bhāṣase kiṃ bahu punarvadhyaḥ sanpannagādhama ॥40॥
html:
vadhyastvaṃ mama durbuddhe bālaghātī nṛśaṃsakṛt ।
bhāṣase kiṃ bahu punarvadhyaḥ sanpannagādhama ॥40॥
slp1: vaDyastvaM mama durbudDe bAlaGAtI nfSaMsakft । BAzase kiM bahu punarvaDyaH sanpannagADama ॥40॥
author: lubdhaka uvāca ।

text: yathā havīṃṣi juhvānā makhe vai lubdhakartvijaḥ । na phalaṃ prāpnuvantyatra paraloke tathā hyaham ॥41॥
html:
yathā havīṃṣi juhvānā makhe vai lubdhakartvijaḥ ।
na phalaṃ prāpnuvantyatra paraloke tathā hyaham ॥41॥
slp1: yaTA havIMzi juhvAnA maKe vE lubDakartvijaH । na PalaM prApnuvantyatra paraloke taTA hyaham ॥41॥
author: sarpa uvāca ।

text: tathā bruvati tasmiṃstu pannage mṛtyucodite । ājagāma tato mṛtyuḥ pannagaṃ cābravīdidam ॥42॥
html:
tathā bruvati tasmiṃstu pannage mṛtyucodite ।
ājagāma tato mṛtyuḥ pannagaṃ cābravīdidam ॥42॥
slp1: taTA bruvati tasmiMstu pannage mftyucodite । AjagAma tato mftyuH pannagaM cAbravIdidam ॥42॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kālenāhaṃ praṇuditaḥ pannaga tvāmacūcudam । vināśaheturnāsya tvamahaṃ vā prāṇinaḥ śiśoḥ ॥43॥
html:
kālenāhaṃ praṇuditaḥ pannaga tvāmacūcudam ।
vināśaheturnāsya tvamahaṃ vā prāṇinaḥ śiśoḥ ॥43॥
slp1: kAlenAhaM praRuditaH pannaga tvAmacUcudam । vinASaheturnAsya tvamahaM vA prARinaH SiSoH ॥43॥

text: yathā vāyurjaladharānvikarṣati tatastataḥ । tadvajjaladavatsarpa kālasyāhaṃ vaśānugaḥ ॥44॥
html:
yathā vāyurjaladharānvikarṣati tatastataḥ ।
tadvajjaladavatsarpa kālasyāhaṃ vaśānugaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: yaTA vAyurjalaDarAnvikarzati tatastataH । tadvajjaladavatsarpa kAlasyAhaM vaSAnugaH ॥44॥

text: sāttvikā rājasāścaiva tāmasā ye ca kecana । bhāvāḥ kālātmakāḥ sarve pravartante hi jantuṣu ॥45॥
html:
sāttvikā rājasāścaiva tāmasā ye ca kecana ।
bhāvāḥ kālātmakāḥ sarve pravartante hi jantuṣu ॥45॥
slp1: sAttvikA rAjasAScEva tAmasA ye ca kecana । BAvAH kAlAtmakAH sarve pravartante hi jantuzu ॥45॥

text: jaṅgamāḥ sthāvarāścaiva divi vā yadi vā bhuvi । sarve kālātmakāḥ sarpa kālātmakamidaṃ jagat ॥46॥
html:
jaṅgamāḥ sthāvarāścaiva divi vā yadi vā bhuvi ।
sarve kālātmakāḥ sarpa kālātmakamidaṃ jagat ॥46॥
slp1: jaNgamAH sTAvarAScEva divi vA yadi vA Buvi । sarve kAlAtmakAH sarpa kAlAtmakamidaM jagat ॥46॥

text: pravṛttayaśca yā loke tathaiva ca nivṛttayaḥ । tāsāṃ vikṛtayo yāśca sarvaṃ kālātmakaṃ smṛtam ॥47॥
html:
pravṛttayaśca yā loke tathaiva ca nivṛttayaḥ ।
tāsāṃ vikṛtayo yāśca sarvaṃ kālātmakaṃ smṛtam ॥47॥
slp1: pravfttayaSca yA loke taTEva ca nivfttayaH । tAsAM vikftayo yASca sarvaM kAlAtmakaM smftam ॥47॥

text: ādityaścandramā viṣṇurāpo vāyuḥ śatakratuḥ । agniḥ khaṃ pṛthivī mitra oṣadhyo vasavastathā ॥48॥
html:
ādityaścandramā viṣṇurāpo vāyuḥ śatakratuḥ ।
agniḥ khaṃ pṛthivī mitra oṣadhyo vasavastathā ॥48॥
slp1: AdityaScandramA vizRurApo vAyuH SatakratuH । agniH KaM pfTivI mitra ozaDyo vasavastaTA ॥48॥

text: saritaḥ sāgarāścaiva bhāvābhāvau ca pannaga । sarve kālena sṛjyante hriyante ca tathā punaḥ ॥49॥
html:
saritaḥ sāgarāścaiva bhāvābhāvau ca pannaga ।
sarve kālena sṛjyante hriyante ca tathā punaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: saritaH sAgarAScEva BAvABAvO ca pannaga । sarve kAlena sfjyante hriyante ca taTA punaH ॥49॥

text: evaṃ jñātvā kathaṃ māṃ tvaṃ sadoṣaṃ sarpa manyase । atha caivaṅgate doṣo mayi tvamapi doṣavān ॥50॥
html:
evaṃ jñātvā kathaṃ māṃ tvaṃ sadoṣaṃ sarpa manyase ।
atha caivaṅgate doṣo mayi tvamapi doṣavān ॥50॥
slp1: evaM jYAtvA kaTaM mAM tvaM sadozaM sarpa manyase । aTa cEvaNgate dozo mayi tvamapi dozavAn ॥50॥

text: nirdoṣaṃ doṣavantaṃ vā na tvā mṛtyo bravīmyaham । tvayāhaṃ codita iti bravīmyetāvadeva tu ॥51॥
html:
nirdoṣaṃ doṣavantaṃ vā na tvā mṛtyo bravīmyaham ।
tvayāhaṃ codita iti bravīmyetāvadeva tu ॥51॥
slp1: nirdozaM dozavantaM vA na tvA mftyo bravImyaham । tvayAhaM codita iti bravImyetAvadeva tu ॥51॥
author: sarpa uvāca ।

text: yadi kāle tu doṣo'sti yadi tatrāpi neṣyate । doṣo naiva parīkṣyo me na hyatrādhikṛtā vayam ॥52॥
html:
yadi kāle tu doṣo'sti yadi tatrāpi neṣyate ।
doṣo naiva parīkṣyo me na hyatrādhikṛtā vayam ॥52॥
slp1: yadi kAle tu dozo'sti yadi tatrApi nezyate । dozo nEva parIkzyo me na hyatrADikftA vayam ॥52॥

text: nirmokṣastvasya doṣasya mayā kāryo yathā tathā । mṛtyo vidoṣaḥ syāmeva yathā tanme prayojanam ॥53॥
html:
nirmokṣastvasya doṣasya mayā kāryo yathā tathā ।
mṛtyo vidoṣaḥ syāmeva yathā tanme prayojanam ॥53॥
slp1: nirmokzastvasya dozasya mayA kAryo yaTA taTA । mftyo vidozaH syAmeva yaTA tanme prayojanam ॥53॥

text: sarpo'thārjunakaṃ prāha śrutaṃ te mṛtyubhāṣitam । nānāgasaṃ māṃ pāśena santāpayitumarhasi ॥54॥
html:
sarpo'thārjunakaṃ prāha śrutaṃ te mṛtyubhāṣitam ।
nānāgasaṃ māṃ pāśena santāpayitumarhasi ॥54॥
slp1: sarpo'TArjunakaM prAha SrutaM te mftyuBAzitam । nAnAgasaM mAM pASena santApayitumarhasi ॥54॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: mṛtyoḥ śrutaṃ me vacanaṃ tava caiva bhujaṅgama । naiva tāvadvidoṣatvaṃ bhavati tvayi pannaga ॥55॥
html:
mṛtyoḥ śrutaṃ me vacanaṃ tava caiva bhujaṅgama ।
naiva tāvadvidoṣatvaṃ bhavati tvayi pannaga ॥55॥
slp1: mftyoH SrutaM me vacanaM tava cEva BujaNgama । nEva tAvadvidozatvaM Bavati tvayi pannaga ॥55॥
author: lubdhaka uvāca ।

text: mṛtyustvaṃ caiva heturhi jantorasya vināśane । ubhayaṃ kāraṇaṃ manye na kāraṇamakāraṇam ॥56॥
html:
mṛtyustvaṃ caiva heturhi jantorasya vināśane ।
ubhayaṃ kāraṇaṃ manye na kāraṇamakāraṇam ॥56॥
slp1: mftyustvaM cEva heturhi jantorasya vinASane । uBayaM kAraRaM manye na kAraRamakAraRam ॥56॥

text: dhiṅmṛtyuṃ ca durātmānaṃ krūraṃ duḥkhakaraṃ satām । tvāṃ caivāhaṃ vadhiṣyāmi pāpaṃ pāpasya kāraṇam ॥57॥
html:
dhiṅmṛtyuṃ ca durātmānaṃ krūraṃ duḥkhakaraṃ satām ।
tvāṃ caivāhaṃ vadhiṣyāmi pāpaṃ pāpasya kāraṇam ॥57॥
slp1: DiNmftyuM ca durAtmAnaM krUraM duHKakaraM satAm । tvAM cEvAhaM vaDizyAmi pApaM pApasya kAraRam ॥57॥

text: vivaśau kālavaśagāvāvāṃ taddiṣṭakāriṇau । nāvāṃ doṣeṇa gantavyau yadi samyakprapaśyasi ॥58॥
html:
vivaśau kālavaśagāvāvāṃ taddiṣṭakāriṇau ।
nāvāṃ doṣeṇa gantavyau yadi samyakprapaśyasi ॥58॥
slp1: vivaSO kAlavaSagAvAvAM taddizwakAriRO । nAvAM dozeRa gantavyO yadi samyakprapaSyasi ॥58॥
author: mṛtyuruvāca ।

text: yuvāmubhau kālavaśau yadi vai mṛtyupannagau । harṣakrodhau kathaṃ syātāmetadicchāmi veditum ॥59॥
html:
yuvāmubhau kālavaśau yadi vai mṛtyupannagau ।
harṣakrodhau kathaṃ syātāmetadicchāmi veditum ॥59॥
slp1: yuvAmuBO kAlavaSO yadi vE mftyupannagO । harzakroDO kaTaM syAtAmetadicCAmi veditum ॥59॥
author: lubdhaka uvāca ।

text: yāḥ kāścidiha ceṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvāḥ kālapracoditāḥ । pūrvamevaitaduktaṃ hi mayā lubdhaka kālataḥ ॥60॥
html:
yāḥ kāścidiha ceṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvāḥ kālapracoditāḥ ।
pūrvamevaitaduktaṃ hi mayā lubdhaka kālataḥ ॥60॥
slp1: yAH kAScidiha cezwAH syuH sarvAH kAlapracoditAH । pUrvamevEtaduktaM hi mayA lubDaka kAlataH ॥60॥
author: mṛtyuruvāca ।

text: tasmādubhau kālavaśāvāvāṃ taddiṣṭakāriṇau । nāvāṃ doṣeṇa gantavyau tvayā lubdhaka karhicit ॥61॥
html:
tasmādubhau kālavaśāvāvāṃ taddiṣṭakāriṇau ।
nāvāṃ doṣeṇa gantavyau tvayā lubdhaka karhicit ॥61॥
slp1: tasmAduBO kAlavaSAvAvAM taddizwakAriRO । nAvAM dozeRa gantavyO tvayA lubDaka karhicit ॥61॥

text: athopagamya kālastu tasmindharmārthasaṃśaye । abravītpannagaṃ mṛtyuṃ lubdhamarjunakaṃ ca tam ॥62॥
html:
athopagamya kālastu tasmindharmārthasaṃśaye ।
abravītpannagaṃ mṛtyuṃ lubdhamarjunakaṃ ca tam ॥62॥
slp1: aTopagamya kAlastu tasminDarmArTasaMSaye । abravItpannagaM mftyuM lubDamarjunakaM ca tam ॥62॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: naivāhaṃ nāpyayaṃ mṛtyurnāyaṃ lubdhaka pannagaḥ । kilbiṣī jantumaraṇe na vayaṃ hi prayojakāḥ ॥63॥
html:
naivāhaṃ nāpyayaṃ mṛtyurnāyaṃ lubdhaka pannagaḥ ।
kilbiṣī jantumaraṇe na vayaṃ hi prayojakāḥ ॥63॥
slp1: nEvAhaM nApyayaM mftyurnAyaM lubDaka pannagaH । kilbizI jantumaraRe na vayaM hi prayojakAH ॥63॥
author: kāla uvāca ।

text: akarodyadayaṃ karma tanno'rjunaka codakam । praṇāśaheturnānyo'sya vadhyate'yaṃ svakarmaṇā ॥64॥
html:
akarodyadayaṃ karma tanno'rjunaka codakam ।
praṇāśaheturnānyo'sya vadhyate'yaṃ svakarmaṇā ॥64॥
slp1: akarodyadayaM karma tanno'rjunaka codakam । praRASaheturnAnyo'sya vaDyate'yaM svakarmaRA ॥64॥

text: yadanena kṛtaṃ karma tenāyaṃ nidhanaṃ gataḥ । vināśahetuḥ karmāsya sarve karmavaśā vayam ॥65॥
html:
yadanena kṛtaṃ karma tenāyaṃ nidhanaṃ gataḥ ।
vināśahetuḥ karmāsya sarve karmavaśā vayam ॥65॥
slp1: yadanena kftaM karma tenAyaM niDanaM gataH । vinASahetuH karmAsya sarve karmavaSA vayam ॥65॥

text: karmadāyādavāṁllokaḥ karmasambandhalakṣaṇaḥ । karmāṇi codayantīha yathānyonyaṃ tathā vayam ॥66॥
html:
karmadāyādavāṁllokaḥ karmasambandhalakṣaṇaḥ ।
karmāṇi codayantīha yathānyonyaṃ tathā vayam ॥66॥
slp1: karmadAyAdavAṁllokaH karmasambanDalakzaRaH । karmARi codayantIha yaTAnyonyaM taTA vayam ॥66॥

text: yathā mṛtpiṇḍataḥ kartā kurute yadyadicchati । evamātmakṛtaṃ karma mānavaḥ pratipadyate ॥67॥
html:
yathā mṛtpiṇḍataḥ kartā kurute yadyadicchati ।
evamātmakṛtaṃ karma mānavaḥ pratipadyate ॥67॥
slp1: yaTA mftpiRqataH kartA kurute yadyadicCati । evamAtmakftaM karma mAnavaH pratipadyate ॥67॥

text: yathā chāyātapau nityaṃ susambaddhau nirantaram । tathā karma ca kartā ca sambaddhāvātmakarmabhiḥ ॥68॥
html:
yathā chāyātapau nityaṃ susambaddhau nirantaram ।
tathā karma ca kartā ca sambaddhāvātmakarmabhiḥ ॥68॥
slp1: yaTA CAyAtapO nityaM susambadDO nirantaram । taTA karma ca kartA ca sambadDAvAtmakarmaBiH ॥68॥

text: evaṃ nāhaṃ na vai mṛtyurna sarpo na tathā bhavān । na ceyaṃ brāhmaṇī vṛddhā śiśurevātra kāraṇam ॥69॥
html:
evaṃ nāhaṃ na vai mṛtyurna sarpo na tathā bhavān ।
na ceyaṃ brāhmaṇī vṛddhā śiśurevātra kāraṇam ॥69॥
slp1: evaM nAhaM na vE mftyurna sarpo na taTA BavAn । na ceyaM brAhmaRI vfdDA SiSurevAtra kAraRam ॥69॥

text: tasmiṃstathā bruvāṇe tu brāhmaṇī gautamī nṛpa । svakarmapratyayāṁllokānmatvārjunakamabravīt ॥70॥
html:
tasmiṃstathā bruvāṇe tu brāhmaṇī gautamī nṛpa ।
svakarmapratyayāṁllokānmatvārjunakamabravīt ॥70॥
slp1: tasmiMstaTA bruvARe tu brAhmaRI gOtamI nfpa । svakarmapratyayAṁllokAnmatvArjunakamabravIt ॥70॥

text: naiva kālo na bhujago na mṛtyuriha kāraṇam । svakarmabhirayaṃ bālaḥ kālena nidhanaṃ gataḥ ॥71॥
html:
naiva kālo na bhujago na mṛtyuriha kāraṇam ।
svakarmabhirayaṃ bālaḥ kālena nidhanaṃ gataḥ ॥71॥
slp1: nEva kAlo na Bujago na mftyuriha kAraRam । svakarmaBirayaM bAlaH kAlena niDanaM gataH ॥71॥

text: mayā ca tatkṛtaṃ karma yenāyaṃ me mṛtaḥ sutaḥ । yātu kālastathā mṛtyurmuñcārjunaka pannagam ॥72॥
html:
mayā ca tatkṛtaṃ karma yenāyaṃ me mṛtaḥ sutaḥ ।
yātu kālastathā mṛtyurmuñcārjunaka pannagam ॥72॥
slp1: mayA ca tatkftaM karma yenAyaM me mftaH sutaH । yAtu kAlastaTA mftyurmuYcArjunaka pannagam ॥72॥

text: tato yathāgataṃ jagmurmṛtyuḥ kālo'tha pannagaḥ । abhūdviroṣo'rjunako viśokā caiva gautamī ॥73॥
html:
tato yathāgataṃ jagmurmṛtyuḥ kālo'tha pannagaḥ ।
abhūdviroṣo'rjunako viśokā caiva gautamī ॥73॥
slp1: tato yaTAgataM jagmurmftyuH kAlo'Ta pannagaH । aBUdvirozo'rjunako viSokA cEva gOtamI ॥73॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: etacchrutvā śamaṃ gaccha mā bhūścintāparo nṛpa । svakarmapratyayāṁllokāṃstrīnviddhi manujarṣabha ॥74॥
html:
etacchrutvā śamaṃ gaccha mā bhūścintāparo nṛpa ।
svakarmapratyayāṁllokāṃstrīnviddhi manujarṣabha ॥74॥
slp1: etacCrutvA SamaM gacCa mA BUScintAparo nfpa । svakarmapratyayAṁllokAMstrInvidDi manujarzaBa ॥74॥

text: na tu tvayā kṛtaṃ pārtha nāpi duryodhanena vai । kālena tatkṛtaṃ viddhi vihatā yena pārthivāḥ ॥75॥
html:
na tu tvayā kṛtaṃ pārtha nāpi duryodhanena vai ।
kālena tatkṛtaṃ viddhi vihatā yena pārthivāḥ ॥75॥
slp1: na tu tvayA kftaM pArTa nApi duryoDanena vE । kAlena tatkftaM vidDi vihatA yena pArTivAH ॥75॥

text: ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā babhūva vigatajvaraḥ । yudhiṣṭhiro mahātejāḥ papracchedaṃ ca dharmavit] ॥76॥
html:
ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā babhūva vigatajvaraḥ ।
yudhiṣṭhiro mahātejāḥ papracchedaṃ ca dharmavit] ॥76॥
slp1: ityetadvacanaM SrutvA baBUva vigatajvaraH । yuDizWiro mahAtejAH papracCedaM ca Darmavit] ॥76॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada । śrutaṃ me mahadākhyānamidaṃ matimatāṃ vara ॥1॥
html:
pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada ।
śrutaṃ me mahadākhyānamidaṃ matimatāṃ vara ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmaha mahAprAjYa sarvaSAstraviSArada । SrutaM me mahadAKyAnamidaM matimatAM vara ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: bhūyastu śrotumicchāmi dharmārthasahitaṃ nṛpa । kathyamānaṃ tvayā kiñcittanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥2॥
html:
bhūyastu śrotumicchāmi dharmārthasahitaṃ nṛpa ।
kathyamānaṃ tvayā kiñcittanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥2॥
slp1: BUyastu SrotumicCAmi DarmArTasahitaM nfpa । kaTyamAnaM tvayA kiYcittanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥2॥

text: kena mṛtyurgṛhasthena dharmamāśritya nirjitaḥ । ityetatsarvamācakṣva tattvena mama pārthiva ॥3॥
html:
kena mṛtyurgṛhasthena dharmamāśritya nirjitaḥ ।
ityetatsarvamācakṣva tattvena mama pārthiva ॥3॥
slp1: kena mftyurgfhasTena DarmamASritya nirjitaH । ityetatsarvamAcakzva tattvena mama pArTiva ॥3॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । yathā mṛtyurgṛhasthena dharmamāśritya nirjitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
yathā mṛtyurgṛhasthena dharmamāśritya nirjitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । yaTA mftyurgfhasTena DarmamASritya nirjitaH ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: manoḥ prajāpate rājannikṣvākurabhavatsutaḥ । tasya putraśataṃ jajñe nṛpateḥ sūryavarcasaḥ ॥5॥
html:
manoḥ prajāpate rājannikṣvākurabhavatsutaḥ ।
tasya putraśataṃ jajñe nṛpateḥ sūryavarcasaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: manoH prajApate rAjannikzvAkuraBavatsutaH । tasya putraSataM jajYe nfpateH sUryavarcasaH ॥5॥

text: daśamastasya putrastu daśāśvo nāma bhārata । māhiṣmatyāmabhūdrājā dharmātmā satyavikramaḥ ॥6॥
html:
daśamastasya putrastu daśāśvo nāma bhārata ।
māhiṣmatyāmabhūdrājā dharmātmā satyavikramaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: daSamastasya putrastu daSASvo nAma BArata । mAhizmatyAmaBUdrAjA DarmAtmA satyavikramaH ॥6॥

text: daśāśvasya sutastvāsīdrājā paramadhārmikaḥ । satye tapasi dāne ca yasya nityaṃ rataṃ manaḥ ॥7॥
html:
daśāśvasya sutastvāsīdrājā paramadhārmikaḥ ।
satye tapasi dāne ca yasya nityaṃ rataṃ manaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: daSASvasya sutastvAsIdrAjA paramaDArmikaH । satye tapasi dAne ca yasya nityaM rataM manaH ॥7॥

text: madirāśva iti khyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ । dhanurvede ca vede ca nirato yo'bhavatsadā ॥8॥
html:
madirāśva iti khyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ ।
dhanurvede ca vede ca nirato yo'bhavatsadā ॥8॥
slp1: madirASva iti KyAtaH pfTivyAM pfTivIpatiH । Danurvede ca vede ca nirato yo'BavatsadA ॥8॥

text: madirāśvasya putrastu dyutimānnāma pārthivaḥ । mahābhāgo mahātejā mahāsattvo mahābalaḥ ॥9॥
html:
madirāśvasya putrastu dyutimānnāma pārthivaḥ ।
mahābhāgo mahātejā mahāsattvo mahābalaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: madirASvasya putrastu dyutimAnnAma pArTivaH । mahABAgo mahAtejA mahAsattvo mahAbalaH ॥9॥

text: putro dyutimatastvāsītsuvīro nāma pārthivaḥ । dharmātmā kośavāṃścāpi devarāja ivāparaḥ ॥10॥
html:
putro dyutimatastvāsītsuvīro nāma pārthivaḥ ।
dharmātmā kośavāṃścāpi devarāja ivāparaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: putro dyutimatastvAsItsuvIro nAma pArTivaH । DarmAtmA koSavAMScApi devarAja ivAparaH ॥10॥

text: suvīrasya tu putro'bhūtsarvasaṅgrāmadurjayaḥ । durjayetyabhivikhyātaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ॥11॥
html:
suvīrasya tu putro'bhūtsarvasaṅgrāmadurjayaḥ ।
durjayetyabhivikhyātaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: suvIrasya tu putro'BUtsarvasaNgrAmadurjayaH । durjayetyaBiviKyAtaH sarvaSAstraviSAradaH ॥11॥

text: durjayasyendravapuṣaḥ putro'gnisadṛśadyutiḥ । duryodhano nāma mahānrājāsīdrājasattama ॥12॥
html:
durjayasyendravapuṣaḥ putro'gnisadṛśadyutiḥ ।
duryodhano nāma mahānrājāsīdrājasattama ॥12॥
slp1: durjayasyendravapuzaH putro'gnisadfSadyutiH । duryoDano nAma mahAnrAjAsIdrAjasattama ॥12॥

text: tasyendrasamavīryasya saṅgrāmeṣvanivartinaḥ । viṣayaśca prabhāvaśca tulyamevābhyavartata ॥13॥
html:
tasyendrasamavīryasya saṅgrāmeṣvanivartinaḥ ।
viṣayaśca prabhāvaśca tulyamevābhyavartata ॥13॥
slp1: tasyendrasamavIryasya saNgrAmezvanivartinaH । vizayaSca praBAvaSca tulyamevAByavartata ॥13॥

text: ratnairdhanaiśca paśubhiḥ sasyaiścāpi pṛthagvidhaiḥ । nagaraṃ viṣayaścāsya pratipūrṇaṃ tadābhavat ॥14॥
html:
ratnairdhanaiśca paśubhiḥ sasyaiścāpi pṛthagvidhaiḥ ।
nagaraṃ viṣayaścāsya pratipūrṇaṃ tadābhavat ॥14॥
slp1: ratnErDanESca paSuBiH sasyEScApi pfTagviDEH । nagaraM vizayaScAsya pratipUrRaM tadABavat ॥14॥

text: na tasya viṣaye cābhūtkṛpaṇo nāpi durgataḥ । vyādhito vā kṛśo vāpi tasminnābhūnnaraḥ kvacit ॥15॥
html:
na tasya viṣaye cābhūtkṛpaṇo nāpi durgataḥ ।
vyādhito vā kṛśo vāpi tasminnābhūnnaraḥ kvacit ॥15॥
slp1: na tasya vizaye cABUtkfpaRo nApi durgataH । vyADito vA kfSo vApi tasminnABUnnaraH kvacit ॥15॥

text: sudakṣiṇo madhuravāganasūyurjitendriyaḥ । dharmātmā cānṛśaṃsaśca vikrānto'thāvikatthanaḥ ॥16॥
html:
sudakṣiṇo madhuravāganasūyurjitendriyaḥ ।
dharmātmā cānṛśaṃsaśca vikrānto'thāvikatthanaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: sudakziRo maDuravAganasUyurjitendriyaH । DarmAtmA cAnfSaMsaSca vikrAnto'TAvikatTanaH ॥16॥

text: yajvā vadānyo medhāvī brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ । na cāvamantā dātā ca vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ॥17॥
html:
yajvā vadānyo medhāvī brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ ।
na cāvamantā dātā ca vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: yajvA vadAnyo meDAvI brahmaRyaH satyasaNgaraH । na cAvamantA dAtA ca vedavedANgapAragaH ॥17॥

text: taṃ narmadā devanadī puṇyā śītajalā śivā । cakame puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ svena bhāvena bhārata ॥18॥
html:
taṃ narmadā devanadī puṇyā śītajalā śivā ।
cakame puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ svena bhāvena bhārata ॥18॥
slp1: taM narmadA devanadI puRyA SItajalA SivA । cakame puruzaSrezWaM svena BAvena BArata ॥18॥

text: tasya jajñe tadā nadyāṃ kanyā rājīvalocanā । nāmnā sudarśanā rājanrūpeṇa ca sudarśanā ॥19॥
html:
tasya jajñe tadā nadyāṃ kanyā rājīvalocanā ।
nāmnā sudarśanā rājanrūpeṇa ca sudarśanā ॥19॥
slp1: tasya jajYe tadA nadyAM kanyA rAjIvalocanA । nAmnA sudarSanA rAjanrUpeRa ca sudarSanA ॥19॥

text: tādṛgrūpā na nārīṣu bhūtapūrvā yudhiṣṭhira । duryodhanasutā yādṛgabhavadvaravarṇinī ॥20॥
html:
tādṛgrūpā na nārīṣu bhūtapūrvā yudhiṣṭhira ।
duryodhanasutā yādṛgabhavadvaravarṇinī ॥20॥
slp1: tAdfgrUpA na nArIzu BUtapUrvA yuDizWira । duryoDanasutA yAdfgaBavadvaravarRinI ॥20॥

text: tāmagniścakame sākṣādrājakanyāṃ sudarśanām । bhūtvā ca brāhmaṇaḥ sākṣādvarayāmāsa taṃ nṛpam ॥21॥
html:
tāmagniścakame sākṣādrājakanyāṃ sudarśanām ।
bhūtvā ca brāhmaṇaḥ sākṣādvarayāmāsa taṃ nṛpam ॥21॥
slp1: tAmagniScakame sAkzAdrAjakanyAM sudarSanAm । BUtvA ca brAhmaRaH sAkzAdvarayAmAsa taM nfpam ॥21॥

text: daridraścāsavarṇaśca mamāyamiti pārthivaḥ । na ditsati sutāṃ tasmai tāṃ viprāya sudarśanām ॥22॥
html:
daridraścāsavarṇaśca mamāyamiti pārthivaḥ ।
na ditsati sutāṃ tasmai tāṃ viprāya sudarśanām ॥22॥
slp1: daridraScAsavarRaSca mamAyamiti pArTivaH । na ditsati sutAM tasmE tAM viprAya sudarSanAm ॥22॥

text: tato'sya vitate yajñe naṣṭo'bhūddhavyavāhanaḥ । tato duryodhano rājā vākyamāhartvijastadā ॥23॥
html:
tato'sya vitate yajñe naṣṭo'bhūddhavyavāhanaḥ ।
tato duryodhano rājā vākyamāhartvijastadā ॥23॥
slp1: tato'sya vitate yajYe nazwo'BUdDavyavAhanaH । tato duryoDano rAjA vAkyamAhartvijastadA ॥23॥

text: duṣkṛtaṃ mama kiṃ nu syādbhavatāṃ vā dvijarṣabhāḥ । yena nāśaṃ jagāmāgniḥ kṛtaṃ kupuruṣeṣviva ॥24॥
html:
duṣkṛtaṃ mama kiṃ nu syādbhavatāṃ vā dvijarṣabhāḥ ।
yena nāśaṃ jagāmāgniḥ kṛtaṃ kupuruṣeṣviva ॥24॥
slp1: duzkftaM mama kiM nu syAdBavatAM vA dvijarzaBAH । yena nASaM jagAmAgniH kftaM kupuruzezviva ॥24॥

text: na hyalpaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ no'sti yenāgnirnāśamāgataḥ । bhavatāṃ vātha vā mahyaṃ tattvenaitadvimṛśyatām ॥25॥
html:
na hyalpaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ no'sti yenāgnirnāśamāgataḥ ।
bhavatāṃ vātha vā mahyaṃ tattvenaitadvimṛśyatām ॥25॥
slp1: na hyalpaM duzkftaM no'sti yenAgnirnASamAgataH । BavatAM vATa vA mahyaM tattvenEtadvimfSyatAm ॥25॥

text: etadrājño vacaḥ śrutvā viprāste bharatarṣabha । niyatā vāgyatāścaiva pāvakaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ॥26॥
html:
etadrājño vacaḥ śrutvā viprāste bharatarṣabha ।
niyatā vāgyatāścaiva pāvakaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ॥26॥
slp1: etadrAjYo vacaH SrutvA viprAste BaratarzaBa । niyatA vAgyatAScEva pAvakaM SaraRaM yayuH ॥26॥

text: tāndarśayāmāsa tadā bhagavānhavyavāhanaḥ । svaṃ rūpaṃ dīptimatkṛtvā śaradarkasamadyutiḥ ॥27॥
html:
tāndarśayāmāsa tadā bhagavānhavyavāhanaḥ ।
svaṃ rūpaṃ dīptimatkṛtvā śaradarkasamadyutiḥ ॥27॥
slp1: tAndarSayAmAsa tadA BagavAnhavyavAhanaH । svaM rUpaM dIptimatkftvA SaradarkasamadyutiH ॥27॥

text: tato mahātmā tānāha dahano brāhmaṇarṣabhān । varayāmyātmano'rthāya duryodhanasutāmiti ॥28॥
html:
tato mahātmā tānāha dahano brāhmaṇarṣabhān ।
varayāmyātmano'rthāya duryodhanasutāmiti ॥28॥
slp1: tato mahAtmA tAnAha dahano brAhmaRarzaBAn । varayAmyAtmano'rTAya duryoDanasutAmiti ॥28॥

text: tataste kālyamutthāya tasmai rājñe nyavedayan । brāhmaṇā vismitāḥ sarve yaduktaṃ citrabhānunā ॥29॥
html:
tataste kālyamutthāya tasmai rājñe nyavedayan ।
brāhmaṇā vismitāḥ sarve yaduktaṃ citrabhānunā ॥29॥
slp1: tataste kAlyamutTAya tasmE rAjYe nyavedayan । brAhmaRA vismitAH sarve yaduktaM citraBAnunA ॥29॥

text: tataḥ sa rājā tacchrutvā vacanaṃ brahmavādinām । avāpya paramaṃ harṣaṃ tatheti prāha buddhimān ॥30॥
html:
tataḥ sa rājā tacchrutvā vacanaṃ brahmavādinām ।
avāpya paramaṃ harṣaṃ tatheti prāha buddhimān ॥30॥
slp1: tataH sa rAjA tacCrutvA vacanaM brahmavAdinAm । avApya paramaM harzaM taTeti prAha budDimAn ॥30॥

text: prāyācata nṛpaḥ śulkaṃ bhagavantaṃ vibhāvasum । nityaṃ sānnidhyamiha te citrabhāno bhavediti । tamāha bhagavānagnirevamastviti pārthivam ॥31॥
html:
prāyācata nṛpaḥ śulkaṃ bhagavantaṃ vibhāvasum ।
nityaṃ sānnidhyamiha te citrabhāno bhavediti ।
tamāha bhagavānagnirevamastviti pārthivam ॥31॥
slp1: prAyAcata nfpaH SulkaM BagavantaM viBAvasum । nityaM sAnniDyamiha te citraBAno Bavediti । tamAha BagavAnagnirevamastviti pArTivam ॥31॥

text: tataḥ sānnidhyamadhyāpi māhiṣmatyāṃ vibhāvasoḥ । dṛṣṭaṃ hi sahadevena diśo vijayatā tadā ॥32॥
html:
tataḥ sānnidhyamadhyāpi māhiṣmatyāṃ vibhāvasoḥ ।
dṛṣṭaṃ hi sahadevena diśo vijayatā tadā ॥32॥
slp1: tataH sAnniDyamaDyApi mAhizmatyAM viBAvasoH । dfzwaM hi sahadevena diSo vijayatA tadA ॥32॥

text: tatastāṃ samalaṅkṛtya kanyāmahatavāsasam । dadau duryodhano rājā pāvakāya mahātmane ॥33॥
html:
tatastāṃ samalaṅkṛtya kanyāmahatavāsasam ।
dadau duryodhano rājā pāvakāya mahātmane ॥33॥
slp1: tatastAM samalaNkftya kanyAmahatavAsasam । dadO duryoDano rAjA pAvakAya mahAtmane ॥33॥

text: pratijagrāha cāgnistāṃ rājaputrīṃ sudarśanām । vidhinā vedadṛṣṭena vasordhārāmivādhvare ॥34॥
html:
pratijagrāha cāgnistāṃ rājaputrīṃ sudarśanām ।
vidhinā vedadṛṣṭena vasordhārāmivādhvare ॥34॥
slp1: pratijagrAha cAgnistAM rAjaputrIM sudarSanAm । viDinA vedadfzwena vasorDArAmivADvare ॥34॥

text: tasyā rūpeṇa śīlena kulena vapuṣā śriyā । abhavatprītimānagnirgarbhaṃ tasyāṃ samādadhe ॥35॥
html:
tasyā rūpeṇa śīlena kulena vapuṣā śriyā ।
abhavatprītimānagnirgarbhaṃ tasyāṃ samādadhe ॥35॥
slp1: tasyA rUpeRa SIlena kulena vapuzA SriyA । aBavatprItimAnagnirgarBaM tasyAM samAdaDe ॥35॥

text: tasyāṃ samabhavatputro nāmnāgneyaḥ sudarśanaḥ । śiśurevādhyagātsarvaṃ sa ca brahma sanātanam ॥36॥
html:
tasyāṃ samabhavatputro nāmnāgneyaḥ sudarśanaḥ ।
śiśurevādhyagātsarvaṃ sa ca brahma sanātanam ॥36॥
slp1: tasyAM samaBavatputro nAmnAgneyaH sudarSanaH । SiSurevADyagAtsarvaM sa ca brahma sanAtanam ॥36॥

text: athaughavānnāma nṛpo nṛgasyāsītpitāmahaḥ । tasyāpyoghavatī kanyā putraścaugharatho'bhavat ॥37॥
html:
athaughavānnāma nṛpo nṛgasyāsītpitāmahaḥ ।
tasyāpyoghavatī kanyā putraścaugharatho'bhavat ॥37॥
slp1: aTOGavAnnAma nfpo nfgasyAsItpitAmahaH । tasyApyoGavatI kanyA putraScOGaraTo'Bavat ॥37॥

text: tāmoghavāndadau tasmai svayamoghavatīṃ sutām । sudarśanāya viduṣe bhāryārthe devarūpiṇīm ॥38॥
html:
tāmoghavāndadau tasmai svayamoghavatīṃ sutām ।
sudarśanāya viduṣe bhāryārthe devarūpiṇīm ॥38॥
slp1: tAmoGavAndadO tasmE svayamoGavatIM sutAm । sudarSanAya viduze BAryArTe devarUpiRIm ॥38॥

text: sa gṛhasthāśramaratastayā saha sudarśanaḥ । kurukṣetre'vasadrājannoghavatyā samanvitaḥ ॥39॥
html:
sa gṛhasthāśramaratastayā saha sudarśanaḥ ।
kurukṣetre'vasadrājannoghavatyā samanvitaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: sa gfhasTASramaratastayA saha sudarSanaH । kurukzetre'vasadrAjannoGavatyA samanvitaH ॥39॥

text: gṛhasthaścāvajeṣyāmi mṛtyumityeva sa prabho । pratijñāmakaroddhīmāndīptatejā viśāṃ pate ॥40॥
html:
gṛhasthaścāvajeṣyāmi mṛtyumityeva sa prabho ।
pratijñāmakaroddhīmāndīptatejā viśāṃ pate ॥40॥
slp1: gfhasTaScAvajezyAmi mftyumityeva sa praBo । pratijYAmakarodDImAndIptatejA viSAM pate ॥40॥

text: tāmathaughavatīṃ rājansa pāvakasuto'bravīt । atitheḥ pratikūlaṃ te na kartavyaṃ kathañcana ॥41॥
html:
tāmathaughavatīṃ rājansa pāvakasuto'bravīt ।
atitheḥ pratikūlaṃ te na kartavyaṃ kathañcana ॥41॥
slp1: tAmaTOGavatIM rAjansa pAvakasuto'bravIt । atiTeH pratikUlaM te na kartavyaM kaTaYcana ॥41॥

text: yena yena ca tuṣyeta nityameva tvayātithiḥ । apyātmanaḥ pradānena na te kāryā vicāraṇā ॥42॥
html:
yena yena ca tuṣyeta nityameva tvayātithiḥ ।
apyātmanaḥ pradānena na te kāryā vicāraṇā ॥42॥
slp1: yena yena ca tuzyeta nityameva tvayAtiTiH । apyAtmanaH pradAnena na te kAryA vicAraRA ॥42॥

text: etadvrataṃ mama sadā hṛdi samparivartate । gṛhasthānāṃ hi suśroṇi nātithervidyate param ॥43॥
html:
etadvrataṃ mama sadā hṛdi samparivartate ।
gṛhasthānāṃ hi suśroṇi nātithervidyate param ॥43॥
slp1: etadvrataM mama sadA hfdi samparivartate । gfhasTAnAM hi suSroRi nAtiTervidyate param ॥43॥

text: pramāṇaṃ yadi vāmoru vacaste mama śobhane । idaṃ vacanamavyagrā hṛdi tvaṃ dhārayeḥ sadā ॥44॥
html:
pramāṇaṃ yadi vāmoru vacaste mama śobhane ।
idaṃ vacanamavyagrā hṛdi tvaṃ dhārayeḥ sadā ॥44॥
slp1: pramARaM yadi vAmoru vacaste mama SoBane । idaM vacanamavyagrA hfdi tvaM DArayeH sadA ॥44॥

text: niṣkrānte mayi kalyāṇi tathā sannihite'naghe । nātithiste'vamantavyaḥ pramāṇaṃ yadyahaṃ tava ॥45॥
html:
niṣkrānte mayi kalyāṇi tathā sannihite'naghe ।
nātithiste'vamantavyaḥ pramāṇaṃ yadyahaṃ tava ॥45॥
slp1: nizkrAnte mayi kalyARi taTA sannihite'naGe । nAtiTiste'vamantavyaH pramARaM yadyahaM tava ॥45॥

text: tamabravīdoghavatī yatā mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥ । na me tvadvacanātkiñcidakartavyaṃ kathañcana ॥46॥
html:
tamabravīdoghavatī yatā mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥ ।
na me tvadvacanātkiñcidakartavyaṃ kathañcana ॥46॥
slp1: tamabravIdoGavatI yatA mUrDni kftAYjaliH । na me tvadvacanAtkiYcidakartavyaM kaTaYcana ॥46॥

text: jigīṣamāṇaṃ tu gṛhe tadā mṛtyuḥ sudarśanam । pṛṣṭhato'nvagamadrājanrandhrānveṣī tadā sadā ॥47॥
html:
jigīṣamāṇaṃ tu gṛhe tadā mṛtyuḥ sudarśanam ।
pṛṣṭhato'nvagamadrājanrandhrānveṣī tadā sadā ॥47॥
slp1: jigIzamARaM tu gfhe tadA mftyuH sudarSanam । pfzWato'nvagamadrAjanranDrAnvezI tadA sadA ॥47॥

text: idhmārthaṃ tu gate tasminnagniputre sudarśane । atithirbrāhmaṇaḥ śrīmāṃstāmāhaughavatīṃ tadā ॥48॥
html:
idhmārthaṃ tu gate tasminnagniputre sudarśane ।
atithirbrāhmaṇaḥ śrīmāṃstāmāhaughavatīṃ tadā ॥48॥
slp1: iDmArTaM tu gate tasminnagniputre sudarSane । atiTirbrAhmaRaH SrImAMstAmAhOGavatIM tadA ॥48॥

text: ātithyaṃ dattamicchāmi tvayādya varavarṇini । pramāṇaṃ yadi dharmaste gṛhasthāśramasammataḥ ॥49॥
html:
ātithyaṃ dattamicchāmi tvayādya varavarṇini ।
pramāṇaṃ yadi dharmaste gṛhasthāśramasammataḥ ॥49॥
slp1: AtiTyaM dattamicCAmi tvayAdya varavarRini । pramARaM yadi Darmaste gfhasTASramasammataH ॥49॥

text: ityuktā tena vipreṇa rājaputrī yaśasvinī । vidhinā pratijagrāha vedoktena viśāṃ pate ॥50॥
html:
ityuktā tena vipreṇa rājaputrī yaśasvinī ।
vidhinā pratijagrāha vedoktena viśāṃ pate ॥50॥
slp1: ityuktA tena vipreRa rAjaputrI yaSasvinI । viDinA pratijagrAha vedoktena viSAM pate ॥50॥

text: āsanaṃ caiva pādyaṃ ca tasmai dattvā dvijātaye । provācaughavatī vipraṃ kenārthaḥ kiṃ dadāmi te ॥51॥
html:
āsanaṃ caiva pādyaṃ ca tasmai dattvā dvijātaye ।
provācaughavatī vipraṃ kenārthaḥ kiṃ dadāmi te ॥51॥
slp1: AsanaM cEva pAdyaM ca tasmE dattvA dvijAtaye । provAcOGavatI vipraM kenArTaH kiM dadAmi te ॥51॥

text: tāmabravīttato vipro rājaputrīṃ sudarśanām । tvayā mamārthaḥ kalyāṇi nirviśaṅke tadācara ॥52॥
html:
tāmabravīttato vipro rājaputrīṃ sudarśanām ।
tvayā mamārthaḥ kalyāṇi nirviśaṅke tadācara ॥52॥
slp1: tAmabravIttato vipro rAjaputrIM sudarSanAm । tvayA mamArTaH kalyARi nirviSaNke tadAcara ॥52॥

text: yadi pramāṇaṃ dharmaste gṛhasthāśramasammataḥ । pradānenātmano rājñi kartumarhasi me priyam ॥53॥
html:
yadi pramāṇaṃ dharmaste gṛhasthāśramasammataḥ ।
pradānenātmano rājñi kartumarhasi me priyam ॥53॥
slp1: yadi pramARaM Darmaste gfhasTASramasammataH । pradAnenAtmano rAjYi kartumarhasi me priyam ॥53॥

text: tathā sañchandyamāno'nyairīpsitairnṛpakanyayā । nānyamātmapradānātsa tasyā vavre varaṃ dvijaḥ ॥54॥
html:
tathā sañchandyamāno'nyairīpsitairnṛpakanyayā ।
nānyamātmapradānātsa tasyā vavre varaṃ dvijaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: taTA saYCandyamAno'nyErIpsitErnfpakanyayA । nAnyamAtmapradAnAtsa tasyA vavre varaM dvijaH ॥54॥

text: sā tu rājasutā smṛtvā bharturvacanamāditaḥ । tatheti lajjamānā sā tamuvāca dvijarṣabham ॥55॥
html:
sā tu rājasutā smṛtvā bharturvacanamāditaḥ ।
tatheti lajjamānā sā tamuvāca dvijarṣabham ॥55॥
slp1: sA tu rAjasutA smftvA BarturvacanamAditaH । taTeti lajjamAnA sA tamuvAca dvijarzaBam ॥55॥

text: tato rahaḥ sa viprarṣiḥ sā caivopaviveśa ha । saṃsmṛtya bharturvacanaṃ gṛhasthāśramakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥56॥
html:
tato rahaḥ sa viprarṣiḥ sā caivopaviveśa ha ।
saṃsmṛtya bharturvacanaṃ gṛhasthāśramakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: tato rahaH sa viprarziH sA cEvopaviveSa ha । saMsmftya BarturvacanaM gfhasTASramakANkziRaH ॥56॥

text: athedhmānsamupādāya sa pāvakirupāgamat । mṛtyunā raudrabhāvena nityaṃ bandhurivānvitaḥ ॥57॥
html:
athedhmānsamupādāya sa pāvakirupāgamat ।
mṛtyunā raudrabhāvena nityaṃ bandhurivānvitaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: aTeDmAnsamupAdAya sa pAvakirupAgamat । mftyunA rOdraBAvena nityaM banDurivAnvitaH ॥57॥

text: tatastvāśramamāgamya sa pāvakasutastadā । tāmājuhāvaughavatīṃ kvāsi yāteti cāsakṛt ॥58॥
html:
tatastvāśramamāgamya sa pāvakasutastadā ।
tāmājuhāvaughavatīṃ kvāsi yāteti cāsakṛt ॥58॥
slp1: tatastvASramamAgamya sa pAvakasutastadA । tAmAjuhAvOGavatIM kvAsi yAteti cAsakft ॥58॥

text: tasmai prativacaḥ sā tu bhartre na pradadau tadā । karābhyāṃ tena vipreṇa spṛṣṭā bhartṛvratā satī ॥59॥
html:
tasmai prativacaḥ sā tu bhartre na pradadau tadā ।
karābhyāṃ tena vipreṇa spṛṣṭā bhartṛvratā satī ॥59॥
slp1: tasmE prativacaH sA tu Bartre na pradadO tadA । karAByAM tena vipreRa spfzwA BartfvratA satI ॥59॥

text: ucchiṣṭāsmīti manvānā lajjitā bhartureva ca । tūṣṇīmbhūtābhavatsādhvī na covācātha kiñcana ॥60॥
html:
ucchiṣṭāsmīti manvānā lajjitā bhartureva ca ।
tūṣṇīmbhūtābhavatsādhvī na covācātha kiñcana ॥60॥
slp1: ucCizwAsmIti manvAnA lajjitA Bartureva ca । tUzRImBUtABavatsADvI na covAcATa kiYcana ॥60॥

text: atha tāṃ punarevedaṃ provāca sa sudarśanaḥ । kva sā sādhvī kva sā yātā garīyaḥ kimato mama ॥61॥
html:
atha tāṃ punarevedaṃ provāca sa sudarśanaḥ ।
kva sā sādhvī kva sā yātā garīyaḥ kimato mama ॥61॥
slp1: aTa tAM punarevedaM provAca sa sudarSanaH । kva sA sADvI kva sA yAtA garIyaH kimato mama ॥61॥

text: pativratā satyaśīlā nityaṃ caivārjave ratā । kathaṃ na pratyudetyadya smayamānā yathā purā ॥62॥
html:
pativratā satyaśīlā nityaṃ caivārjave ratā ।
kathaṃ na pratyudetyadya smayamānā yathā purā ॥62॥
slp1: pativratA satyaSIlA nityaM cEvArjave ratA । kaTaM na pratyudetyadya smayamAnA yaTA purA ॥62॥

text: uṭajasthastu taṃ vipraḥ pratyuvāca sudarśanam । atithiṃ viddhi samprāptaṃ pāvake brāhmaṇaṃ ca mām ॥63॥
html:
uṭajasthastu taṃ vipraḥ pratyuvāca sudarśanam ।
atithiṃ viddhi samprāptaṃ pāvake brāhmaṇaṃ ca mām ॥63॥
slp1: uwajasTastu taM vipraH pratyuvAca sudarSanam । atiTiM vidDi samprAptaM pAvake brAhmaRaM ca mAm ॥63॥

text: anayā chandyamāno'haṃ bhāryayā tava sattama । taistairatithisatkārairārjave'syā dṛḍhaṃ manaḥ ॥64॥
html:
anayā chandyamāno'haṃ bhāryayā tava sattama ।
taistairatithisatkārairārjave'syā dṛḍhaṃ manaḥ ॥64॥
slp1: anayA CandyamAno'haM BAryayA tava sattama । tEstEratiTisatkArErArjave'syA dfQaM manaH ॥64॥

text: anena vidhinā seyaṃ māmarcati śubhānanā । anurūpaṃ yadatrādya tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥65॥
html:
anena vidhinā seyaṃ māmarcati śubhānanā ।
anurūpaṃ yadatrādya tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥65॥
slp1: anena viDinA seyaM mAmarcati SuBAnanA । anurUpaM yadatrAdya tadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥65॥

text: kūṭamudgarahastastu mṛtyustaṃ vai samanvayāt । hīnapratijñamatrainaṃ vadhiṣyāmīti cintayan ॥66॥
html:
kūṭamudgarahastastu mṛtyustaṃ vai samanvayāt ।
hīnapratijñamatrainaṃ vadhiṣyāmīti cintayan ॥66॥
slp1: kUwamudgarahastastu mftyustaM vE samanvayAt । hInapratijYamatrEnaM vaDizyAmIti cintayan ॥66॥

text: sudarśanastu manasā karmaṇā cakṣuṣā girā । tyakterṣyastyaktamanyuśca smayamāno'bravīdidam ॥67॥
html:
sudarśanastu manasā karmaṇā cakṣuṣā girā ।
tyakterṣyastyaktamanyuśca smayamāno'bravīdidam ॥67॥
slp1: sudarSanastu manasA karmaRA cakzuzA girA । tyakterzyastyaktamanyuSca smayamAno'bravIdidam ॥67॥

text: surataṃ te'stu viprāgrya prītirhi paramā mama । gṛhasthasya hi dharmo'gryaḥ samprāptātithipūjanam ॥68॥
html:
surataṃ te'stu viprāgrya prītirhi paramā mama ।
gṛhasthasya hi dharmo'gryaḥ samprāptātithipūjanam ॥68॥
slp1: surataM te'stu viprAgrya prItirhi paramA mama । gfhasTasya hi Darmo'gryaH samprAptAtiTipUjanam ॥68॥

text: atithiḥ pūjito yasya gṛhasthasya tu gacchati । nānyastasmātparo dharma iti prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥69॥
html:
atithiḥ pūjito yasya gṛhasthasya tu gacchati ।
nānyastasmātparo dharma iti prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥69॥
slp1: atiTiH pUjito yasya gfhasTasya tu gacCati । nAnyastasmAtparo Darma iti prAhurmanIziRaH ॥69॥

text: prāṇā hi mama dārāśca yaccānyadvidyate vasu । atithibhyo mayā deyamiti me vratamāhitam ॥70॥
html:
prāṇā hi mama dārāśca yaccānyadvidyate vasu ।
atithibhyo mayā deyamiti me vratamāhitam ॥70॥
slp1: prARA hi mama dArASca yaccAnyadvidyate vasu । atiTiByo mayA deyamiti me vratamAhitam ॥70॥

text: niḥsandigdhaṃ mayā vākyametatte samudāhṛtam । tenāhaṃ vipra satyena svayamātmānamālabhe ॥71॥
html:
niḥsandigdhaṃ mayā vākyametatte samudāhṛtam ।
tenāhaṃ vipra satyena svayamātmānamālabhe ॥71॥
slp1: niHsandigDaM mayA vAkyametatte samudAhftam । tenAhaM vipra satyena svayamAtmAnamAlaBe ॥71॥

text: pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam । buddhirātmā manaḥ kālo diśaścaiva guṇā daśa ॥72॥
html:
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam ।
buddhirātmā manaḥ kālo diśaścaiva guṇā daśa ॥72॥
slp1: pfTivI vAyurAkASamApo jyotiSca paYcamam । budDirAtmA manaH kAlo diSaScEva guRA daSa ॥72॥

text: nityamete hi paśyanti dehināṃ dehasaṃśritāḥ । sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cāpi karma dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥73॥
html:
nityamete hi paśyanti dehināṃ dehasaṃśritāḥ ।
sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cāpi karma dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥73॥
slp1: nityamete hi paSyanti dehinAM dehasaMSritAH । sukftaM duzkftaM cApi karma DarmaBftAM vara ॥73॥

text: yathaiṣā nānṛtā vāṇī mayādya samudāhṛtā । tena satyena māṃ devāḥ pālayantu dahantu vā ॥74॥
html:
yathaiṣā nānṛtā vāṇī mayādya samudāhṛtā ।
tena satyena māṃ devāḥ pālayantu dahantu vā ॥74॥
slp1: yaTEzA nAnftA vARI mayAdya samudAhftA । tena satyena mAM devAH pAlayantu dahantu vA ॥74॥

text: tato nādaḥ samabhavaddikṣu sarvāsu bhārata । asakṛtsatyamityeva naitanmithyeti sarvaśaḥ ॥75॥
html:
tato nādaḥ samabhavaddikṣu sarvāsu bhārata ।
asakṛtsatyamityeva naitanmithyeti sarvaśaḥ ॥75॥
slp1: tato nAdaH samaBavaddikzu sarvAsu BArata । asakftsatyamityeva nEtanmiTyeti sarvaSaH ॥75॥

text: uṭajāttu tatastasmānniścakrāma sa vai dvijaḥ । vapuṣā khaṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca vyāpya vāyurivodyataḥ ॥76॥
html:
uṭajāttu tatastasmānniścakrāma sa vai dvijaḥ ।
vapuṣā khaṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca vyāpya vāyurivodyataḥ ॥76॥
slp1: uwajAttu tatastasmAnniScakrAma sa vE dvijaH । vapuzA KaM ca BUmiM ca vyApya vAyurivodyataH ॥76॥

text: svareṇa vipraḥ śaikṣeṇa trīṁllokānanunādayan । uvāca cainaṃ dharmajñaṃ pūrvamāmantrya nāmataḥ ॥77॥
html:
svareṇa vipraḥ śaikṣeṇa trīṁllokānanunādayan ।
uvāca cainaṃ dharmajñaṃ pūrvamāmantrya nāmataḥ ॥77॥
slp1: svareRa vipraH SEkzeRa trIṁllokAnanunAdayan । uvAca cEnaM DarmajYaM pUrvamAmantrya nAmataH ॥77॥

text: dharmo'hamasmi bhadraṃ te jijñāsārthaṃ tavānagha । prāptaḥ satyaṃ ca te jñātvā prītirme paramā tvayi ॥78॥
html:
dharmo'hamasmi bhadraṃ te jijñāsārthaṃ tavānagha ।
prāptaḥ satyaṃ ca te jñātvā prītirme paramā tvayi ॥78॥
slp1: Darmo'hamasmi BadraM te jijYAsArTaM tavAnaGa । prAptaH satyaM ca te jYAtvA prItirme paramA tvayi ॥78॥

text: vijitaśca tvayā mṛtyuryo'yaṃ tvāmanugacchati । randhrānveṣī tava sadā tvayā dhṛtyā vaśīkṛtaḥ ॥79॥
html:
vijitaśca tvayā mṛtyuryo'yaṃ tvāmanugacchati ।
randhrānveṣī tava sadā tvayā dhṛtyā vaśīkṛtaḥ ॥79॥
slp1: vijitaSca tvayA mftyuryo'yaM tvAmanugacCati । ranDrAnvezI tava sadA tvayA DftyA vaSIkftaH ॥79॥

text: na cāsti śaktistrailokye kasyacitpuruṣottama । pativratāmimāṃ sādhvīṃ tavodvīkṣitumapyuta ॥80॥
html:
na cāsti śaktistrailokye kasyacitpuruṣottama ।
pativratāmimāṃ sādhvīṃ tavodvīkṣitumapyuta ॥80॥
slp1: na cAsti SaktistrElokye kasyacitpuruzottama । pativratAmimAM sADvIM tavodvIkzitumapyuta ॥80॥

text: rakṣitā tvadguṇaireṣā pativrataguṇaistathā । adhṛṣyā yadiyaṃ brūyāttathā tannānyathā bhavet ॥81॥
html:
rakṣitā tvadguṇaireṣā pativrataguṇaistathā ।
adhṛṣyā yadiyaṃ brūyāttathā tannānyathā bhavet ॥81॥
slp1: rakzitA tvadguRErezA pativrataguREstaTA । aDfzyA yadiyaM brUyAttaTA tannAnyaTA Bavet ॥81॥

text: eṣā hi tapasā svena saṃyuktā brahmavādinī । pāvanārthaṃ ca lokasya saricchreṣṭhā bhaviṣyati ॥82॥
html:
eṣā hi tapasā svena saṃyuktā brahmavādinī ।
pāvanārthaṃ ca lokasya saricchreṣṭhā bhaviṣyati ॥82॥
slp1: ezA hi tapasA svena saMyuktA brahmavAdinI । pAvanArTaM ca lokasya saricCrezWA Bavizyati ॥82॥

text: ardhenaughavatī nāma tvāmardhenānuyāsyati । śarīreṇa mahābhāgā yogo hyasyā vaśe sthitaḥ ॥83॥
html:
ardhenaughavatī nāma tvāmardhenānuyāsyati ।
śarīreṇa mahābhāgā yogo hyasyā vaśe sthitaḥ ॥83॥
slp1: arDenOGavatI nAma tvAmarDenAnuyAsyati । SarIreRa mahABAgA yogo hyasyA vaSe sTitaH ॥83॥

text: anayā saha lokāṃśca gantāsi tapasārjitān । yatra nāvṛttimabhyeti śāśvatāṃstānsanātanān ॥84॥
html:
anayā saha lokāṃśca gantāsi tapasārjitān ।
yatra nāvṛttimabhyeti śāśvatāṃstānsanātanān ॥84॥
slp1: anayA saha lokAMSca gantAsi tapasArjitAn । yatra nAvfttimaByeti SASvatAMstAnsanAtanAn ॥84॥

text: anena caiva dehena lokāṃstvamabhipatsyase । nirjitaśca tvayā mṛtyuraiśvaryaṃ ca tavottamam ॥85॥
html:
anena caiva dehena lokāṃstvamabhipatsyase ।
nirjitaśca tvayā mṛtyuraiśvaryaṃ ca tavottamam ॥85॥
slp1: anena cEva dehena lokAMstvamaBipatsyase । nirjitaSca tvayA mftyurESvaryaM ca tavottamam ॥85॥

text: pañca bhūtānyatikrāntaḥ svavīryācca manobhavaḥ । gṛhasthadharmeṇānena kāmakrodhau ca te jitau ॥86॥
html:
pañca bhūtānyatikrāntaḥ svavīryācca manobhavaḥ ।
gṛhasthadharmeṇānena kāmakrodhau ca te jitau ॥86॥
slp1: paYca BUtAnyatikrAntaH svavIryAcca manoBavaH । gfhasTaDarmeRAnena kAmakroDO ca te jitO ॥86॥

text: sneho rāgaśca tandrī ca moho drohaśca kevalaḥ । tava śuśrūṣayā rājanrājaputryā vinirjitāḥ ॥87॥
html:
sneho rāgaśca tandrī ca moho drohaśca kevalaḥ ।
tava śuśrūṣayā rājanrājaputryā vinirjitāḥ ॥87॥
slp1: sneho rAgaSca tandrI ca moho drohaSca kevalaH । tava SuSrUzayA rAjanrAjaputryA vinirjitAH ॥87॥

text: śuklānāṃ tu sahasreṇa vājināṃ rathamuttamam । yuktaṃ pragṛhya bhagavānvyavasāyo jagāma tam ॥88॥
html:
śuklānāṃ tu sahasreṇa vājināṃ rathamuttamam ।
yuktaṃ pragṛhya bhagavānvyavasāyo jagāma tam ॥88॥
slp1: SuklAnAM tu sahasreRa vAjinAM raTamuttamam । yuktaM pragfhya BagavAnvyavasAyo jagAma tam ॥88॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: mṛtyurātmā ca lokāśca jitā bhūtāni pañca ca । buddhiḥ kālo mano vyoma kāmakrodhau tathaiva ca ॥89॥
html:
mṛtyurātmā ca lokāśca jitā bhūtāni pañca ca ।
buddhiḥ kālo mano vyoma kāmakrodhau tathaiva ca ॥89॥
slp1: mftyurAtmA ca lokASca jitA BUtAni paYca ca । budDiH kAlo mano vyoma kAmakroDO taTEva ca ॥89॥

text: tasmādgṛhāśramasthasya nānyaddaivatamasti vai । ṛte'tithiṃ naravyāghra manasaitadvicāraya ॥90॥
html:
tasmādgṛhāśramasthasya nānyaddaivatamasti vai ।
ṛte'tithiṃ naravyāghra manasaitadvicāraya ॥90॥
slp1: tasmAdgfhASramasTasya nAnyaddEvatamasti vE । fte'tiTiM naravyAGra manasEtadvicAraya ॥90॥

text: atithiḥ pūjito yasya dhyāyate manasā śubham । na tatkratuśatenāpi tulyamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥91॥
html:
atithiḥ pūjito yasya dhyāyate manasā śubham ।
na tatkratuśatenāpi tulyamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥91॥
slp1: atiTiH pUjito yasya DyAyate manasA SuBam । na tatkratuSatenApi tulyamAhurmanIziRaH ॥91॥

text: pātraṃ tvatithimāsādya śīlāḍhyaṃ yo na pūjayet । sa dattvā sukṛtaṃ tasya kṣapayeta hyanarcitaḥ ॥92॥
html:
pātraṃ tvatithimāsādya śīlāḍhyaṃ yo na pūjayet ।
sa dattvā sukṛtaṃ tasya kṣapayeta hyanarcitaḥ ॥92॥
slp1: pAtraM tvatiTimAsAdya SIlAQyaM yo na pUjayet । sa dattvA sukftaM tasya kzapayeta hyanarcitaH ॥92॥

text: etatte kathitaṃ putra mayākhyānamanuttamam । yathā hi vijito mṛtyurgṛhasthena purābhavat ॥93॥
html:
etatte kathitaṃ putra mayākhyānamanuttamam ।
yathā hi vijito mṛtyurgṛhasthena purābhavat ॥93॥
slp1: etatte kaTitaM putra mayAKyAnamanuttamam । yaTA hi vijito mftyurgfhasTena purABavat ॥93॥

text: dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamidamākhyānamuttamam । bubhūṣatābhimantavyaṃ sarvaduścaritāpaham ॥94॥
html:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamidamākhyānamuttamam ।
bubhūṣatābhimantavyaṃ sarvaduścaritāpaham ॥94॥
slp1: DanyaM yaSasyamAyuzyamidamAKyAnamuttamam । buBUzatABimantavyaM sarvaduScaritApaham ॥94॥

text: ya idaṃ kathayedvidvānahanyahani bhārata । sudarśanasya caritaṃ puṇyāṁllokānavāpnuyāt] ॥95॥
html:
ya idaṃ kathayedvidvānahanyahani bhārata ।
sudarśanasya caritaṃ puṇyāṁllokānavāpnuyāt] ॥95॥
slp1: ya idaM kaTayedvidvAnahanyahani BArata । sudarSanasya caritaM puRyAṁllokAnavApnuyAt] ॥95॥

text: brāhmaṇyaṃ yadi duṣprāpaṃ tribhirvarṇairnarādhipa । kathaṃ prāptaṃ mahārāja kṣatriyeṇa mahātmanā ॥1॥
html:
brāhmaṇyaṃ yadi duṣprāpaṃ tribhirvarṇairnarādhipa ।
kathaṃ prāptaṃ mahārāja kṣatriyeṇa mahātmanā ॥1॥
slp1: brAhmaRyaM yadi duzprApaM triBirvarRErnarADipa । kaTaM prAptaM mahArAja kzatriyeRa mahAtmanA ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: viśvāmitreṇa dharmātmanbrāhmaṇatvaṃ nararṣabha । śrotumicchāmi tattvena tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
viśvāmitreṇa dharmātmanbrāhmaṇatvaṃ nararṣabha ।
śrotumicchāmi tattvena tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: viSvAmitreRa DarmAtmanbrAhmaRatvaM nararzaBa । SrotumicCAmi tattvena tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: tena hyamitavīryeṇa vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ । hataṃ putraśataṃ sadyastapasā prapitāmaha ॥3॥
html:
tena hyamitavīryeṇa vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ।
hataṃ putraśataṃ sadyastapasā prapitāmaha ॥3॥
slp1: tena hyamitavIryeRa vasizWasya mahAtmanaH । hataM putraSataM sadyastapasA prapitAmaha ॥3॥

text: yātudhānāśca bahavo rākṣasāstigmatejasaḥ । manyunāviṣṭadehena sṛṣṭāḥ kālāntakopamāḥ ॥4॥
html:
yātudhānāśca bahavo rākṣasāstigmatejasaḥ ।
manyunāviṣṭadehena sṛṣṭāḥ kālāntakopamāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: yAtuDAnASca bahavo rAkzasAstigmatejasaH । manyunAvizwadehena sfzwAH kAlAntakopamAH ॥4॥

text: mahānkuśikavaṃśaśca brahmarṣiśatasaṅkulaḥ । sthāpito naraloke'sminvidvānbrāhmaṇasaṃstutaḥ ॥5॥
html:
mahānkuśikavaṃśaśca brahmarṣiśatasaṅkulaḥ ।
sthāpito naraloke'sminvidvānbrāhmaṇasaṃstutaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: mahAnkuSikavaMSaSca brahmarziSatasaNkulaH । sTApito naraloke'sminvidvAnbrAhmaRasaMstutaH ॥5॥

text: ṛcīkasyātmajaścaiva śunaḥśepo mahātapāḥ । vimokṣito mahāsatrātpaśutāmabhyupāgataḥ ॥6॥
html:
ṛcīkasyātmajaścaiva śunaḥśepo mahātapāḥ ।
vimokṣito mahāsatrātpaśutāmabhyupāgataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: fcIkasyAtmajaScEva SunaHSepo mahAtapAH । vimokzito mahAsatrAtpaSutAmaByupAgataH ॥6॥

text: hariścandrakratau devāṃstoṣayitvātmatejasā । putratāmanusamprāpto viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ ॥7॥
html:
hariścandrakratau devāṃstoṣayitvātmatejasā ।
putratāmanusamprāpto viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ ॥7॥
slp1: hariScandrakratO devAMstozayitvAtmatejasA । putratAmanusamprApto viSvAmitrasya DImataH ॥7॥

text: nābhivādayate jyeṣṭhaṃ devarātaṃ narādhipa । putrāḥ pañcaśatāścāpi śaptāḥ śvapacatāṃ gatāḥ ॥8॥
html:
nābhivādayate jyeṣṭhaṃ devarātaṃ narādhipa ।
putrāḥ pañcaśatāścāpi śaptāḥ śvapacatāṃ gatāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: nABivAdayate jyezWaM devarAtaM narADipa । putrAH paYcaSatAScApi SaptAH SvapacatAM gatAH ॥8॥

text: triśaṅkurbandhusantyakta ikṣvākuḥ prītipūrvakam । avākśirā divaṃ nīto dakṣiṇāmāśrito diśam ॥9॥
html:
triśaṅkurbandhusantyakta ikṣvākuḥ prītipūrvakam ।
avākśirā divaṃ nīto dakṣiṇāmāśrito diśam ॥9॥
slp1: triSaNkurbanDusantyakta ikzvAkuH prItipUrvakam । avAkSirA divaM nIto dakziRAmASrito diSam ॥9॥

text: viśvāmitrasya vipulā nadī rājarṣisevitā । kauśikīti śivā puṇyā brahmarṣigaṇasevitā ॥10॥
html:
viśvāmitrasya vipulā nadī rājarṣisevitā ।
kauśikīti śivā puṇyā brahmarṣigaṇasevitā ॥10॥
slp1: viSvAmitrasya vipulA nadI rAjarzisevitA । kOSikIti SivA puRyA brahmarzigaRasevitA ॥10॥

text: tapovighnakarī caiva pañcacūḍā susammatā । rambhā nāmāpsarāḥ śāpādyasya śailatvamāgatā ॥11॥
html:
tapovighnakarī caiva pañcacūḍā susammatā ।
rambhā nāmāpsarāḥ śāpādyasya śailatvamāgatā ॥11॥
slp1: tapoviGnakarI cEva paYcacUqA susammatA । ramBA nAmApsarAH SApAdyasya SElatvamAgatA ॥11॥

text: tathaivāsya bhayādbaddhvā vasiṣṭhaḥ salile purā । ātmānaṃ majjayāmāsa vipāśaḥ punarutthitaḥ ॥12॥
html:
tathaivāsya bhayādbaddhvā vasiṣṭhaḥ salile purā ।
ātmānaṃ majjayāmāsa vipāśaḥ punarutthitaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: taTEvAsya BayAdbadDvA vasizWaH salile purA । AtmAnaM majjayAmAsa vipASaH punarutTitaH ॥12॥

text: tadāprabhṛti puṇyā hi vipāśābhūnmahānadī । vikhyātā karmaṇā tena vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ॥13॥
html:
tadāprabhṛti puṇyā hi vipāśābhūnmahānadī ।
vikhyātā karmaṇā tena vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: tadApraBfti puRyA hi vipASABUnmahAnadI । viKyAtA karmaRA tena vasizWasya mahAtmanaH ॥13॥

text: vāgbhiśca bhagavānyena devasenāgragaḥ prabhuḥ । stutaḥ prītamanāścāsīcchāpāccainamamocayat ॥14॥
html:
vāgbhiśca bhagavānyena devasenāgragaḥ prabhuḥ ।
stutaḥ prītamanāścāsīcchāpāccainamamocayat ॥14॥
slp1: vAgBiSca BagavAnyena devasenAgragaH praBuH । stutaH prItamanAScAsIcCApAccEnamamocayat ॥14॥

text: dhruvasyauttānapādasya brahmarṣīṇāṃ tathaiva ca । madhye jvalati yo nityamudīcīmāśrito diśam ॥15॥
html:
dhruvasyauttānapādasya brahmarṣīṇāṃ tathaiva ca ।
madhye jvalati yo nityamudīcīmāśrito diśam ॥15॥
slp1: DruvasyOttAnapAdasya brahmarzIRAM taTEva ca । maDye jvalati yo nityamudIcImASrito diSam ॥15॥

text: tasyaitāni ca karmāṇi tathānyāni ca kaurava । kṣatriyasyetyato jātamidaṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ॥16॥
html:
tasyaitāni ca karmāṇi tathānyāni ca kaurava ।
kṣatriyasyetyato jātamidaṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ॥16॥
slp1: tasyEtAni ca karmARi taTAnyAni ca kOrava । kzatriyasyetyato jAtamidaM kOtUhalaM mama ॥16॥

text: kimetaditi tattvena prabrūhi bharatarṣabha । dehāntaramanāsādya kathaṃ sa brāhmaṇo'bhavat ॥17॥
html:
kimetaditi tattvena prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ।
dehāntaramanāsādya kathaṃ sa brāhmaṇo'bhavat ॥17॥
slp1: kimetaditi tattvena prabrUhi BaratarzaBa । dehAntaramanAsAdya kaTaM sa brAhmaRo'Bavat ॥17॥

text: etattattvena me rājansarvamākhyātumarhasi । mataṅgasya yathātattvaṃ tathaivaitadbravīhi me ॥18॥
html:
etattattvena me rājansarvamākhyātumarhasi ।
mataṅgasya yathātattvaṃ tathaivaitadbravīhi me ॥18॥
slp1: etattattvena me rAjansarvamAKyAtumarhasi । mataNgasya yaTAtattvaM taTEvEtadbravIhi me ॥18॥

text: sthāne mataṅgo brāhmaṇyaṃ nālabhadbharatarṣabha । caṇḍālayonau jāto hi kathaṃ brāhmaṇyamāpnuyāt] ॥19॥
html:
sthāne mataṅgo brāhmaṇyaṃ nālabhadbharatarṣabha ।
caṇḍālayonau jāto hi kathaṃ brāhmaṇyamāpnuyāt] ॥19॥
slp1: sTAne mataNgo brAhmaRyaM nAlaBadBaratarzaBa । caRqAlayonO jAto hi kaTaM brAhmaRyamApnuyAt] ॥19॥

text: śrūyatāṃ pārtha tattvena viśvāmitro yathā purā । brāhmaṇatvaṃ gatastāta brahmarṣitvaṃ tathaiva ca ॥1॥
html:
śrūyatāṃ pārtha tattvena viśvāmitro yathā purā ।
brāhmaṇatvaṃ gatastāta brahmarṣitvaṃ tathaiva ca ॥1॥
slp1: SrUyatAM pArTa tattvena viSvAmitro yaTA purA । brAhmaRatvaM gatastAta brahmarzitvaM taTEva ca ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bharatasyānvaye caivājamīḍho nāma pārthivaḥ । babhūva bharataśreṣṭha yajvā dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ॥2॥
html:
bharatasyānvaye caivājamīḍho nāma pārthivaḥ ।
babhūva bharataśreṣṭha yajvā dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: BaratasyAnvaye cEvAjamIQo nAma pArTivaH । baBUva BarataSrezWa yajvA DarmaBftAM varaH ॥2॥

text: tasya putro mahānāsījjahnurnāma nareśvaraḥ । duhitṛtvamanuprāptā gaṅgā yasya mahātmanaḥ ॥3॥
html:
tasya putro mahānāsījjahnurnāma nareśvaraḥ ।
duhitṛtvamanuprāptā gaṅgā yasya mahātmanaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: tasya putro mahAnAsIjjahnurnAma nareSvaraH । duhitftvamanuprAptA gaNgA yasya mahAtmanaH ॥3॥

text: tasyātmajastulyaguṇaḥ sindhudvīpo mahāyaśāḥ । sindhudvīpācca rājarṣirbalākāśvo mahābalaḥ ॥4॥
html:
tasyātmajastulyaguṇaḥ sindhudvīpo mahāyaśāḥ ।
sindhudvīpācca rājarṣirbalākāśvo mahābalaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tasyAtmajastulyaguRaH sinDudvIpo mahAyaSAH । sinDudvIpAcca rAjarzirbalAkASvo mahAbalaH ॥4॥

text: vallabhastasya tanayaḥ sākṣāddharma ivāparaḥ । kuśikastasya tanayaḥ sahasrākṣasamadyutiḥ ॥5॥
html:
vallabhastasya tanayaḥ sākṣāddharma ivāparaḥ ।
kuśikastasya tanayaḥ sahasrākṣasamadyutiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: vallaBastasya tanayaH sAkzAdDarma ivAparaH । kuSikastasya tanayaH sahasrAkzasamadyutiH ॥5॥

text: kuśikasyātmajaḥ śrīmāngādhirnāma janeśvaraḥ । aputraḥ sa mahābāhurvanavāsamudāvasat ॥6॥
html:
kuśikasyātmajaḥ śrīmāngādhirnāma janeśvaraḥ ।
aputraḥ sa mahābāhurvanavāsamudāvasat ॥6॥
slp1: kuSikasyAtmajaH SrImAngADirnAma janeSvaraH । aputraH sa mahAbAhurvanavAsamudAvasat ॥6॥

text: kanyā jajñe sutā tasya vane nivasataḥ sataḥ । nāmnā satyavatī nāma rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi ॥7॥
html:
kanyā jajñe sutā tasya vane nivasataḥ sataḥ ।
nāmnā satyavatī nāma rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi ॥7॥
slp1: kanyA jajYe sutA tasya vane nivasataH sataH । nAmnA satyavatI nAma rUpeRApratimA Buvi ॥7॥

text: tāṃ vavre bhārgavaḥ śrīmāṃścyavanasyātmajaḥ prabhuḥ । ṛcīka iti vikhyāto vipule tapasi sthitaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tāṃ vavre bhārgavaḥ śrīmāṃścyavanasyātmajaḥ prabhuḥ ।
ṛcīka iti vikhyāto vipule tapasi sthitaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tAM vavre BArgavaH SrImAMScyavanasyAtmajaH praBuH । fcIka iti viKyAto vipule tapasi sTitaH ॥8॥

text: sa tāṃ na pradadau tasmai ṛcīkāya mahātmane । daridra iti matvā vai gādhiḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ ॥9॥
html:
sa tāṃ na pradadau tasmai ṛcīkāya mahātmane ।
daridra iti matvā vai gādhiḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sa tAM na pradadO tasmE fcIkAya mahAtmane । daridra iti matvA vE gADiH SatrunibarhaRaH ॥9॥

text: pratyākhyāya punaryāntamabravīdrājasattamaḥ । śulkaṃ pradīyatāṃ mahyaṃ tato vetsyasi me sutām ॥10॥
html:
pratyākhyāya punaryāntamabravīdrājasattamaḥ ।
śulkaṃ pradīyatāṃ mahyaṃ tato vetsyasi me sutām ॥10॥
slp1: pratyAKyAya punaryAntamabravIdrAjasattamaH । SulkaM pradIyatAM mahyaM tato vetsyasi me sutAm ॥10॥

text: kiṃ prayacchāmi rājendra tubhyaṃ śulkamahaṃ nṛpa । duhiturbrūhyasaṃsakto mātrābhūtte vicāraṇā ॥11॥
html:
kiṃ prayacchāmi rājendra tubhyaṃ śulkamahaṃ nṛpa ।
duhiturbrūhyasaṃsakto mātrābhūtte vicāraṇā ॥11॥
slp1: kiM prayacCAmi rAjendra tuByaM SulkamahaM nfpa । duhiturbrUhyasaMsakto mAtrABUtte vicAraRA ॥11॥
author: ṛcīka uvāca ।

text: candraraśmiprakāśānāṃ hayānāṃ vātaraṃhasām । ekataḥ śyāmakarṇānāṃ sahasraṃ dehi bhārgava ॥12॥
html:
candraraśmiprakāśānāṃ hayānāṃ vātaraṃhasām ।
ekataḥ śyāmakarṇānāṃ sahasraṃ dehi bhārgava ॥12॥
slp1: candraraSmiprakASAnAM hayAnAM vAtaraMhasAm । ekataH SyAmakarRAnAM sahasraM dehi BArgava ॥12॥
author: gādhiruvāca ।

text: tataḥ sa bhṛguśārdūlaścyavanasyātmajaḥ prabhuḥ । abravīdvaruṇaṃ devamādityaṃ patimambhasām ॥13॥
html:
tataḥ sa bhṛguśārdūlaścyavanasyātmajaḥ prabhuḥ ।
abravīdvaruṇaṃ devamādityaṃ patimambhasām ॥13॥
slp1: tataH sa BfguSArdUlaScyavanasyAtmajaH praBuH । abravIdvaruRaM devamAdityaM patimamBasAm ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ekataḥ śyāmakarṇānāṃ hayānāṃ candravarcasām । sahasraṃ vātavegānāṃ bhikṣe tvāṃ devasattama ॥14॥
html:
ekataḥ śyāmakarṇānāṃ hayānāṃ candravarcasām ।
sahasraṃ vātavegānāṃ bhikṣe tvāṃ devasattama ॥14॥
slp1: ekataH SyAmakarRAnAM hayAnAM candravarcasAm । sahasraM vAtavegAnAM Bikze tvAM devasattama ॥14॥

text: tatheti varuṇo deva ādityo bhṛgusattamam । uvāca yatra te chandastatrotthāsyanti vājinaḥ ॥15॥
html:
tatheti varuṇo deva ādityo bhṛgusattamam ।
uvāca yatra te chandastatrotthāsyanti vājinaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: taTeti varuRo deva Adityo Bfgusattamam । uvAca yatra te CandastatrotTAsyanti vAjinaH ॥15॥

text: dhyātamātre ṛcīkena hayānāṃ candravarcasām । gaṅgājalātsamuttasthau sahasraṃ vipulaujasām ॥16॥
html:
dhyātamātre ṛcīkena hayānāṃ candravarcasām ।
gaṅgājalātsamuttasthau sahasraṃ vipulaujasām ॥16॥
slp1: DyAtamAtre fcIkena hayAnAM candravarcasAm । gaNgAjalAtsamuttasTO sahasraM vipulOjasAm ॥16॥

text: adūre kanyakubjasya gaṅgāyāstīramuttamam । aśvatīrthaṃ tadadyāpi mānavāḥ paricakṣate ॥17॥
html:
adūre kanyakubjasya gaṅgāyāstīramuttamam ।
aśvatīrthaṃ tadadyāpi mānavāḥ paricakṣate ॥17॥
slp1: adUre kanyakubjasya gaNgAyAstIramuttamam । aSvatIrTaM tadadyApi mAnavAH paricakzate ॥17॥

text: tattadā gādhaye tāta sahasraṃ vājināṃ śubham । ṛcīkaḥ pradadau prītaḥ śulkārthaṃ japatāṃ varaḥ ॥18॥
html:
tattadā gādhaye tāta sahasraṃ vājināṃ śubham ।
ṛcīkaḥ pradadau prītaḥ śulkārthaṃ japatāṃ varaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tattadA gADaye tAta sahasraM vAjinAM SuBam । fcIkaH pradadO prItaH SulkArTaM japatAM varaH ॥18॥

text: tataḥ sa vismito rājā gādhiḥ śāpabhayena ca । dadau tāṃ samalaṅkṛtya kanyāṃ bhṛgusutāya vai ॥19॥
html:
tataḥ sa vismito rājā gādhiḥ śāpabhayena ca ।
dadau tāṃ samalaṅkṛtya kanyāṃ bhṛgusutāya vai ॥19॥
slp1: tataH sa vismito rAjA gADiH SApaBayena ca । dadO tAM samalaNkftya kanyAM BfgusutAya vE ॥19॥

text: jagrāha pāṇiṃ vidhinā tasya brahmarṣisattamaḥ । sā ca taṃ patimāsādya paraṃ harṣamavāpa ha ॥20॥
html:
jagrāha pāṇiṃ vidhinā tasya brahmarṣisattamaḥ ।
sā ca taṃ patimāsādya paraṃ harṣamavāpa ha ॥20॥
slp1: jagrAha pARiM viDinA tasya brahmarzisattamaH । sA ca taM patimAsAdya paraM harzamavApa ha ॥20॥

text: sa tutoṣa ca viprarṣistasyā vṛttena bhārata । chandayāmāsa caivaināṃ vareṇa varavarṇinīm ॥21॥
html:
sa tutoṣa ca viprarṣistasyā vṛttena bhārata ।
chandayāmāsa caivaināṃ vareṇa varavarṇinīm ॥21॥
slp1: sa tutoza ca viprarzistasyA vfttena BArata । CandayAmAsa cEvEnAM vareRa varavarRinIm ॥21॥

text: mātre tatsarvamācakhyau sā kanyā rājasattamam । atha tāmabravīnmātā sutāṃ kiñcidavāṅmukhīm ॥22॥
html:
mātre tatsarvamācakhyau sā kanyā rājasattamam ।
atha tāmabravīnmātā sutāṃ kiñcidavāṅmukhīm ॥22॥
slp1: mAtre tatsarvamAcaKyO sA kanyA rAjasattamam । aTa tAmabravInmAtA sutAM kiYcidavANmuKIm ॥22॥

text: mamāpi putri bhartā te prasādaṃ kartumarhati । apatyasya pradānena samarthaḥ sa mahātapāḥ ॥23॥
html:
mamāpi putri bhartā te prasādaṃ kartumarhati ।
apatyasya pradānena samarthaḥ sa mahātapāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: mamApi putri BartA te prasAdaM kartumarhati । apatyasya pradAnena samarTaH sa mahAtapAH ॥23॥

text: tataḥ sā tvaritaṃ gatvā tatsarvaṃ pratyavedayat । mātuścikīrṣitaṃ rājannṛcīkastāmathābravīt ॥24॥
html:
tataḥ sā tvaritaṃ gatvā tatsarvaṃ pratyavedayat ।
mātuścikīrṣitaṃ rājannṛcīkastāmathābravīt ॥24॥
slp1: tataH sA tvaritaM gatvA tatsarvaM pratyavedayat । mAtuScikIrzitaM rAjannfcIkastAmaTAbravIt ॥24॥

text: guṇavantamapatyaṃ vai tvaṃ ca sā janayiṣyathaḥ । jananyāstava kalyāṇi mā bhūdvai praṇayo'nyathā ॥25॥
html:
guṇavantamapatyaṃ vai tvaṃ ca sā janayiṣyathaḥ ।
jananyāstava kalyāṇi mā bhūdvai praṇayo'nyathā ॥25॥
slp1: guRavantamapatyaM vE tvaM ca sA janayizyaTaH । jananyAstava kalyARi mA BUdvE praRayo'nyaTA ॥25॥

text: tava caiva guṇaślāghī putra utpatsyate śubhe । asmadvaṃśakaraḥ śrīmāṃstava bhrātā ca vaṃśakṛt ॥26॥
html:
tava caiva guṇaślāghī putra utpatsyate śubhe ।
asmadvaṃśakaraḥ śrīmāṃstava bhrātā ca vaṃśakṛt ॥26॥
slp1: tava cEva guRaSlAGI putra utpatsyate SuBe । asmadvaMSakaraH SrImAMstava BrAtA ca vaMSakft ॥26॥

text: ṛtusnātā ca sāśvatthaṃ tvaṃ ca vṛkṣamudumbaram । pariṣvajethāḥ kalyāṇi tata iṣṭamavāpsyathaḥ ॥27॥
html:
ṛtusnātā ca sāśvatthaṃ tvaṃ ca vṛkṣamudumbaram ।
pariṣvajethāḥ kalyāṇi tata iṣṭamavāpsyathaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: ftusnAtA ca sASvatTaM tvaM ca vfkzamudumbaram । parizvajeTAH kalyARi tata izwamavApsyaTaH ॥27॥

text: carudvayamidaṃ caiva mantrapūtaṃ śucismite । tvaṃ ca sā copayuñjīthāṃ tataḥ putrāvavāpsyathaḥ ॥28॥
html:
carudvayamidaṃ caiva mantrapūtaṃ śucismite ।
tvaṃ ca sā copayuñjīthāṃ tataḥ putrāvavāpsyathaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: carudvayamidaM cEva mantrapUtaM Sucismite । tvaM ca sA copayuYjITAM tataH putrAvavApsyaTaH ॥28॥

text: tataḥ satyavatī hṛṣṭā mātaraṃ pratyabhāṣata । yadṛcīkena kathitaṃ taccācakhyau carudvayam ॥29॥
html:
tataḥ satyavatī hṛṣṭā mātaraṃ pratyabhāṣata ।
yadṛcīkena kathitaṃ taccācakhyau carudvayam ॥29॥
slp1: tataH satyavatI hfzwA mAtaraM pratyaBAzata । yadfcIkena kaTitaM taccAcaKyO carudvayam ॥29॥

text: tāmuvāca tato mātā sutāṃ satyavatīṃ tadā । putri mūrdhnā prapannāyāḥ kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama ॥30॥
html:
tāmuvāca tato mātā sutāṃ satyavatīṃ tadā ।
putri mūrdhnā prapannāyāḥ kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama ॥30॥
slp1: tAmuvAca tato mAtA sutAM satyavatIM tadA । putri mUrDnA prapannAyAH kuruzva vacanaM mama ॥30॥

text: bhartrā ya eṣa dattaste carurmantrapuraskṛtaḥ । etaṃ prayaccha mahyaṃ tvaṃ madīyaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ॥31॥
html:
bhartrā ya eṣa dattaste carurmantrapuraskṛtaḥ ।
etaṃ prayaccha mahyaṃ tvaṃ madīyaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ॥31॥
slp1: BartrA ya eza dattaste carurmantrapuraskftaH । etaM prayacCa mahyaM tvaM madIyaM tvaM gfhARa ca ॥31॥

text: vyatyāsaṃ vṛkṣayoścāpi karavāva śucismite । yadi pramāṇaṃ vacanaṃ mama māturanindite ॥32॥
html:
vyatyāsaṃ vṛkṣayoścāpi karavāva śucismite ।
yadi pramāṇaṃ vacanaṃ mama māturanindite ॥32॥
slp1: vyatyAsaM vfkzayoScApi karavAva Sucismite । yadi pramARaM vacanaM mama mAturanindite ॥32॥

text: vyaktaṃ bhagavatā cātra kṛtamevaṃ bhaviṣyati । tato me tvaccarau bhāvaḥ pādape ca sumadhyame । kathaṃ viśiṣṭo bhrātā te bhavedityeva cintaya ॥33॥
html:
vyaktaṃ bhagavatā cātra kṛtamevaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
tato me tvaccarau bhāvaḥ pādape ca sumadhyame ।
kathaṃ viśiṣṭo bhrātā te bhavedityeva cintaya ॥33॥
slp1: vyaktaM BagavatA cAtra kftamevaM Bavizyati । tato me tvaccarO BAvaH pAdape ca sumaDyame । kaTaM viSizwo BrAtA te Bavedityeva cintaya ॥33॥

text: tathā ca kṛtavatyau te mātā satyavatī ca sā । atha garbhāvanuprāpte ubhe te vai yudhiṣṭhira ॥34॥
html:
tathā ca kṛtavatyau te mātā satyavatī ca sā ।
atha garbhāvanuprāpte ubhe te vai yudhiṣṭhira ॥34॥
slp1: taTA ca kftavatyO te mAtA satyavatI ca sA । aTa garBAvanuprApte uBe te vE yuDizWira ॥34॥

text: dṛṣṭvā garbhamanuprāptāṃ bhāryāṃ sa ca mahānṛṣiḥ । uvāca tāṃ satyavatīṃ durmanā bhṛgusattamaḥ ॥35॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā garbhamanuprāptāṃ bhāryāṃ sa ca mahānṛṣiḥ ।
uvāca tāṃ satyavatīṃ durmanā bhṛgusattamaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: dfzwvA garBamanuprAptAM BAryAM sa ca mahAnfziH । uvAca tAM satyavatIM durmanA BfgusattamaH ॥35॥

text: vyatyāsenopayuktaste carurvyaktaṃ bhaviṣyati । vyatyāsaḥ pādape cāpi suvyaktaṃ te kṛtaḥ śubhe ॥36॥
html:
vyatyāsenopayuktaste carurvyaktaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
vyatyāsaḥ pādape cāpi suvyaktaṃ te kṛtaḥ śubhe ॥36॥
slp1: vyatyAsenopayuktaste carurvyaktaM Bavizyati । vyatyAsaH pAdape cApi suvyaktaM te kftaH SuBe ॥36॥

text: mayā hi viśvaṃ yadbrahma tvaccarau sanniveśitam । kṣatravīryaṃ ca sakalaṃ carau tasyā niveśitam ॥37॥
html:
mayā hi viśvaṃ yadbrahma tvaccarau sanniveśitam ।
kṣatravīryaṃ ca sakalaṃ carau tasyā niveśitam ॥37॥
slp1: mayA hi viSvaM yadbrahma tvaccarO sanniveSitam । kzatravIryaM ca sakalaM carO tasyA niveSitam ॥37॥

text: trilokavikhyātaguṇaṃ tvaṃ vipraṃ janayiṣyasi । sā ca kṣatraṃ viśiṣṭaṃ vai tata etatkṛtaṃ mayā ॥38॥
html:
trilokavikhyātaguṇaṃ tvaṃ vipraṃ janayiṣyasi ।
sā ca kṣatraṃ viśiṣṭaṃ vai tata etatkṛtaṃ mayā ॥38॥
slp1: trilokaviKyAtaguRaM tvaM vipraM janayizyasi । sA ca kzatraM viSizwaM vE tata etatkftaM mayA ॥38॥

text: vyatyāsastu kṛto yasmāttvayā mātrā tathaiva ca । tasmātsā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ mātā te janayiṣyati ॥39॥
html:
vyatyāsastu kṛto yasmāttvayā mātrā tathaiva ca ।
tasmātsā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ mātā te janayiṣyati ॥39॥
slp1: vyatyAsastu kfto yasmAttvayA mAtrA taTEva ca । tasmAtsA brAhmaRaSrezWaM mAtA te janayizyati ॥39॥

text: kṣatriyaṃ tūgrakarmāṇaṃ tvaṃ bhadre janayiṣyasi । na hi te tatkṛtaṃ sādhu mātṛsnehena bhāmini ॥40॥
html:
kṣatriyaṃ tūgrakarmāṇaṃ tvaṃ bhadre janayiṣyasi ।
na hi te tatkṛtaṃ sādhu mātṛsnehena bhāmini ॥40॥
slp1: kzatriyaM tUgrakarmARaM tvaM Badre janayizyasi । na hi te tatkftaM sADu mAtfsnehena BAmini ॥40॥

text: sā śrutvā śokasantaptā papāta varavarṇinī । bhūmau satyavatī rājaṃśchinneva rucirā latā ॥41॥
html:
sā śrutvā śokasantaptā papāta varavarṇinī ।
bhūmau satyavatī rājaṃśchinneva rucirā latā ॥41॥
slp1: sA SrutvA SokasantaptA papAta varavarRinI । BUmO satyavatI rAjaMSCinneva rucirA latA ॥41॥

text: pratilabhya ca sā sañjñāṃ śirasā praṇipatya ca । uvāca bhāryā bhartāraṃ gādheyī brāhmaṇarṣabham ॥42॥
html:
pratilabhya ca sā sañjñāṃ śirasā praṇipatya ca ।
uvāca bhāryā bhartāraṃ gādheyī brāhmaṇarṣabham ॥42॥
slp1: pratilaBya ca sA saYjYAM SirasA praRipatya ca । uvAca BAryA BartAraM gADeyI brAhmaRarzaBam ॥42॥

text: prasādayantyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ mayi brahmavidāṃ vara । prasādaṃ kuru viprarṣe na me syātkṣatriyaḥ sutaḥ ॥43॥
html:
prasādayantyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ mayi brahmavidāṃ vara ।
prasādaṃ kuru viprarṣe na me syātkṣatriyaḥ sutaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: prasAdayantyAM BAryAyAM mayi brahmavidAM vara । prasAdaM kuru viprarze na me syAtkzatriyaH sutaH ॥43॥

text: kāmaṃ mamograkarmā vai pautro bhavitumarhati । na tu me syātsuto brahmanneṣa me dīyatāṃ varaḥ ॥44॥
html:
kāmaṃ mamograkarmā vai pautro bhavitumarhati ।
na tu me syātsuto brahmanneṣa me dīyatāṃ varaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: kAmaM mamograkarmA vE pOtro Bavitumarhati । na tu me syAtsuto brahmanneza me dIyatAM varaH ॥44॥

text: evamastviti hovāca svāṃ bhāryāṃ sumahātapāḥ । tataḥ sā janayāmāsa jamadagniṃ sutaṃ śubham ॥45॥
html:
evamastviti hovāca svāṃ bhāryāṃ sumahātapāḥ ।
tataḥ sā janayāmāsa jamadagniṃ sutaṃ śubham ॥45॥
slp1: evamastviti hovAca svAM BAryAM sumahAtapAH । tataH sA janayAmAsa jamadagniM sutaM SuBam ॥45॥

text: viśvāmitraṃ cājanayadgādherbhāryā yaśasvinī । ṛṣeḥ prabhāvādrājendra brahmarṣiṃ brahmavādinam ॥46॥
html:
viśvāmitraṃ cājanayadgādherbhāryā yaśasvinī ।
ṛṣeḥ prabhāvādrājendra brahmarṣiṃ brahmavādinam ॥46॥
slp1: viSvAmitraM cAjanayadgADerBAryA yaSasvinI । fzeH praBAvAdrAjendra brahmarziM brahmavAdinam ॥46॥

text: tato brāhmaṇatāṃ yāto viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ । kṣatriyaḥ so'pyatha tathā brahmavaṃśasya kārakaḥ ॥47॥
html:
tato brāhmaṇatāṃ yāto viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ ।
kṣatriyaḥ so'pyatha tathā brahmavaṃśasya kārakaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: tato brAhmaRatAM yAto viSvAmitro mahAtapAH । kzatriyaH so'pyaTa taTA brahmavaMSasya kArakaH ॥47॥

text: tasya putrā mahātmāno brahmavaṃśavivardhanāḥ । tapasvino brahmavido gotrakartāra eva ca ॥48॥
html:
tasya putrā mahātmāno brahmavaṃśavivardhanāḥ ।
tapasvino brahmavido gotrakartāra eva ca ॥48॥
slp1: tasya putrA mahAtmAno brahmavaMSavivarDanAH । tapasvino brahmavido gotrakartAra eva ca ॥48॥

text: madhucchandaśca bhagavāndevarātaśca vīryavān । akṣīṇaśca śakuntaśca babhruḥ kālapathastathā ॥49॥
html:
madhucchandaśca bhagavāndevarātaśca vīryavān ।
akṣīṇaśca śakuntaśca babhruḥ kālapathastathā ॥49॥
slp1: maDucCandaSca BagavAndevarAtaSca vIryavAn । akzIRaSca SakuntaSca baBruH kAlapaTastaTA ॥49॥

text: yājñavalkyaśca vikhyātastathā sthūṇo mahāvrataḥ । ulūko yamadūtaśca tatharṣiḥ saindhavāyanaḥ ॥50॥
html:
yājñavalkyaśca vikhyātastathā sthūṇo mahāvrataḥ ।
ulūko yamadūtaśca tatharṣiḥ saindhavāyanaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: yAjYavalkyaSca viKyAtastaTA sTURo mahAvrataH । ulUko yamadUtaSca taTarziH sEnDavAyanaH ॥50॥

text: karṇajaṅghaśca bhagavāngālavaśca mahānṛṣiḥ । ṛṣirvajrastathākhyātaḥ śālaṅkāyana eva ca ॥51॥
html:
karṇajaṅghaśca bhagavāngālavaśca mahānṛṣiḥ ।
ṛṣirvajrastathākhyātaḥ śālaṅkāyana eva ca ॥51॥
slp1: karRajaNGaSca BagavAngAlavaSca mahAnfziH । fzirvajrastaTAKyAtaH SAlaNkAyana eva ca ॥51॥

text: lālāṭyo nāradaścaiva tathā kūrcamukhaḥ smṛtaḥ । vādulirmusalaścaiva rakṣogrīvastathaiva ca ॥52॥
html:
lālāṭyo nāradaścaiva tathā kūrcamukhaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
vādulirmusalaścaiva rakṣogrīvastathaiva ca ॥52॥
slp1: lAlAwyo nAradaScEva taTA kUrcamuKaH smftaH । vAdulirmusalaScEva rakzogrIvastaTEva ca ॥52॥

text: aṅghriko naikabhṛccaiva śilāyūpaḥ sitaḥ śuciḥ । cakrako mārutantavyo vātaghno'thāśvalāyanaḥ ॥53॥
html:
aṅghriko naikabhṛccaiva śilāyūpaḥ sitaḥ śuciḥ ।
cakrako mārutantavyo vātaghno'thāśvalāyanaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: aNGriko nEkaBfccEva SilAyUpaH sitaH SuciH । cakrako mArutantavyo vAtaGno'TASvalAyanaH ॥53॥

text: śyāmāyano'tha gārgyaśca jābāliḥ suśrutastathā । kārīṣiratha saṃśrutyaḥ parapauravatantavaḥ ॥54॥
html:
śyāmāyano'tha gārgyaśca jābāliḥ suśrutastathā ।
kārīṣiratha saṃśrutyaḥ parapauravatantavaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: SyAmAyano'Ta gArgyaSca jAbAliH suSrutastaTA । kArIziraTa saMSrutyaH parapOravatantavaH ॥54॥

text: mahānṛṣiśca kapilastatharṣistārakāyanaḥ । tathaiva copagahanastatharṣiścārjunāyanaḥ ॥55॥
html:
mahānṛṣiśca kapilastatharṣistārakāyanaḥ ।
tathaiva copagahanastatharṣiścārjunāyanaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: mahAnfziSca kapilastaTarzistArakAyanaH । taTEva copagahanastaTarziScArjunAyanaH ॥55॥

text: mārgamitrirhiraṇyākṣo jaṅghārirbabhruvāhanaḥ । sūtirvibhūtiḥ sūtaśca suraṅgaśca tathaiva hi ॥56॥
html:
mārgamitrirhiraṇyākṣo jaṅghārirbabhruvāhanaḥ ।
sūtirvibhūtiḥ sūtaśca suraṅgaśca tathaiva hi ॥56॥
slp1: mArgamitrirhiraRyAkzo jaNGArirbaBruvAhanaH । sUtirviBUtiH sUtaSca suraNgaSca taTEva hi ॥56॥

text: ārāddhirnāmayaścaiva cāmpeyojjayanau tathā । navatanturbakanakhaḥ śayonaratireva ca ॥57॥
html:
ārāddhirnāmayaścaiva cāmpeyojjayanau tathā ।
navatanturbakanakhaḥ śayonaratireva ca ॥57॥
slp1: ArAdDirnAmayaScEva cAmpeyojjayanO taTA । navatanturbakanaKaH Sayonaratireva ca ॥57॥

text: śayoruhaścārumatsyaḥ śirīṣī cātha gārdabhiḥ । ujjayoniradāpekṣī nāradī ca mahānṛṣiḥ । viśvāmitrātmajāḥ sarve munayo brahmavādinaḥ ॥58॥
html:
śayoruhaścārumatsyaḥ śirīṣī cātha gārdabhiḥ ।
ujjayoniradāpekṣī nāradī ca mahānṛṣiḥ ।
viśvāmitrātmajāḥ sarve munayo brahmavādinaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: SayoruhaScArumatsyaH SirIzI cATa gArdaBiH । ujjayoniradApekzI nAradI ca mahAnfziH । viSvAmitrAtmajAH sarve munayo brahmavAdinaH ॥58॥

text: tannaiṣa kṣatriyo rājanviśvāmitro mahātapāḥ । ṛcīkenāhitaṃ brahma parametadyudhiṣṭhira ॥59॥
html:
tannaiṣa kṣatriyo rājanviśvāmitro mahātapāḥ ।
ṛcīkenāhitaṃ brahma parametadyudhiṣṭhira ॥59॥
slp1: tannEza kzatriyo rAjanviSvAmitro mahAtapAH । fcIkenAhitaM brahma parametadyuDizWira ॥59॥

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ tattvena bharatarṣabha । viśvāmitrasya vai janma somasūryāgnitejasaḥ ॥60॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ tattvena bharatarṣabha ।
viśvāmitrasya vai janma somasūryāgnitejasaḥ ॥60॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM tattvena BaratarzaBa । viSvAmitrasya vE janma somasUryAgnitejasaH ॥60॥

text: yatra yatra ca sandeho bhūyaste rājasattama । tatra tatra ca māṃ brūhi cchettāsmi tava saṃśayān] ॥61॥
html:
yatra yatra ca sandeho bhūyaste rājasattama ।
tatra tatra ca māṃ brūhi cchettāsmi tava saṃśayān] ॥61॥
slp1: yatra yatra ca sandeho BUyaste rAjasattama । tatra tatra ca mAM brUhi cCettAsmi tava saMSayAn] ॥61॥

text: ānṛśaṃsasya dharmasya guṇānbhaktajanasya ca । śrotumicchāmi kārtsnyena tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
ānṛśaṃsasya dharmasya guṇānbhaktajanasya ca ।
śrotumicchāmi kārtsnyena tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: AnfSaMsasya Darmasya guRAnBaktajanasya ca । SrotumicCAmi kArtsnyena tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: viṣaye kāśirājasya grāmānniṣkramya lubdhakaḥ । saviṣaṃ kāṇḍamādāya mṛgayāmāsa vai mṛgam ॥2॥
html:
viṣaye kāśirājasya grāmānniṣkramya lubdhakaḥ ।
saviṣaṃ kāṇḍamādāya mṛgayāmāsa vai mṛgam ॥2॥
slp1: vizaye kASirAjasya grAmAnnizkramya lubDakaH । savizaM kARqamAdAya mfgayAmAsa vE mfgam ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tatra cāmiṣalubdhena lubdhakena mahāvane । avidūre mṛgaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṇaḥ pratisamāhitaḥ ॥3॥
html:
tatra cāmiṣalubdhena lubdhakena mahāvane ।
avidūre mṛgaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṇaḥ pratisamāhitaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: tatra cAmizalubDena lubDakena mahAvane । avidUre mfgaM dfzwvA bARaH pratisamAhitaH ॥3॥

text: tena durvāritāstreṇa nimittacapaleṣuṇā । mahānvanatarurviddho mṛgaṃ tatra jighāṃsatā ॥4॥
html:
tena durvāritāstreṇa nimittacapaleṣuṇā ।
mahānvanatarurviddho mṛgaṃ tatra jighāṃsatā ॥4॥
slp1: tena durvAritAstreRa nimittacapalezuRA । mahAnvanatarurvidDo mfgaM tatra jiGAMsatA ॥4॥

text: sa tīkṣṇaviṣadigdhena śareṇātibalātkṛtaḥ । utsṛjya phalapatrāṇi pādapaḥ śoṣamāgataḥ ॥5॥
html:
sa tīkṣṇaviṣadigdhena śareṇātibalātkṛtaḥ ।
