utsṛjya phalapatrāṇi pādapaḥ śoṣamāgataḥ ॥5॥
slp1: sa tIkzRavizadigDena SareRAtibalAtkftaH । utsfjya PalapatrARi pAdapaH SozamAgataH ॥5॥

text: tasminvṛkṣe tathābhūte koṭareṣu ciroṣitaḥ । na jahāti śuko vāsaṃ tasya bhaktyā vanaspateḥ ॥6॥
html:
tasminvṛkṣe tathābhūte koṭareṣu ciroṣitaḥ ।
na jahāti śuko vāsaṃ tasya bhaktyā vanaspateḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tasminvfkze taTABUte kowarezu cirozitaH । na jahAti Suko vAsaM tasya BaktyA vanaspateH ॥6॥

text: niṣpracāro nirāhāro glānaḥ śithilavāgapi । kṛtajñaḥ saha vṛkṣeṇa dharmātmā sa vyaśuṣyata ॥7॥
html:
niṣpracāro nirāhāro glānaḥ śithilavāgapi ।
kṛtajñaḥ saha vṛkṣeṇa dharmātmā sa vyaśuṣyata ॥7॥
slp1: nizpracAro nirAhAro glAnaH SiTilavAgapi । kftajYaH saha vfkzeRa DarmAtmA sa vyaSuzyata ॥7॥

text: tamudāraṃ mahāsattvamatimānuṣaceṣṭitam । samaduḥkhasukhaṃ jñātvā vismitaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tamudāraṃ mahāsattvamatimānuṣaceṣṭitam ।
samaduḥkhasukhaṃ jñātvā vismitaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tamudAraM mahAsattvamatimAnuzacezwitam । samaduHKasuKaM jYAtvA vismitaH pAkaSAsanaH ॥8॥

text: tataścintāmupagataḥ śakraḥ kathamayaṃ dvijaḥ । tiryagyonāvasambhāvyamānṛśaṃsyaṃ samāsthitaḥ ॥9॥
html:
tataścintāmupagataḥ śakraḥ kathamayaṃ dvijaḥ ।
tiryagyonāvasambhāvyamānṛśaṃsyaṃ samāsthitaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tataScintAmupagataH SakraH kaTamayaM dvijaH । tiryagyonAvasamBAvyamAnfSaMsyaM samAsTitaH ॥9॥

text: atha vā nātra citraṃ hītyabhavadvāsavasya tu । prāṇināmiha sarveṣāṃ sarvaṃ sarvatra dṛśyate ॥10॥
html:
atha vā nātra citraṃ hītyabhavadvāsavasya tu ।
prāṇināmiha sarveṣāṃ sarvaṃ sarvatra dṛśyate ॥10॥
slp1: aTa vA nAtra citraM hItyaBavadvAsavasya tu । prARinAmiha sarvezAM sarvaM sarvatra dfSyate ॥10॥

text: tato brāhmaṇaveṣeṇa mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ । avatīrya mahīṃ śakrastaṃ pakṣiṇamuvāca ha ॥11॥
html:
tato brāhmaṇaveṣeṇa mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ ।
avatīrya mahīṃ śakrastaṃ pakṣiṇamuvāca ha ॥11॥
slp1: tato brAhmaRavezeRa mAnuzaM rUpamAsTitaH । avatIrya mahIM SakrastaM pakziRamuvAca ha ॥11॥

text: śuka bhoḥ pakṣiṇāṃ śreṣṭha dākṣeyī suprajāstvayā । pṛcche tvā śuṣkametaṃ vai kasmānna tyajasi drumam ॥12॥
html:
śuka bhoḥ pakṣiṇāṃ śreṣṭha dākṣeyī suprajāstvayā ।
pṛcche tvā śuṣkametaṃ vai kasmānna tyajasi drumam ॥12॥
slp1: Suka BoH pakziRAM SrezWa dAkzeyI suprajAstvayA । pfcCe tvA SuzkametaM vE kasmAnna tyajasi drumam ॥12॥

text: atha pṛṣṭaḥ śukaḥ prāha mūrdhnā samabhivādya tam । svāgataṃ devarājāya vijñātastapasā mayā ॥13॥
html:
atha pṛṣṭaḥ śukaḥ prāha mūrdhnā samabhivādya tam ।
svāgataṃ devarājāya vijñātastapasā mayā ॥13॥
slp1: aTa pfzwaH SukaH prAha mUrDnA samaBivAdya tam । svAgataM devarAjAya vijYAtastapasA mayA ॥13॥

text: tato daśaśatākṣeṇa sādhu sādhviti bhāṣitam । aho vijñānamityevaṃ tapasā pūjitastataḥ ॥14॥
html:
tato daśaśatākṣeṇa sādhu sādhviti bhāṣitam ।
aho vijñānamityevaṃ tapasā pūjitastataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tato daSaSatAkzeRa sADu sADviti BAzitam । aho vijYAnamityevaM tapasA pUjitastataH ॥14॥

text: tamevaṃ śubhakarmāṇaṃ śukaṃ paramadhārmikam । vijānannapi tāṃ prāptiṃ papraccha balasūdanaḥ ॥15॥
html:
tamevaṃ śubhakarmāṇaṃ śukaṃ paramadhārmikam ।
vijānannapi tāṃ prāptiṃ papraccha balasūdanaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tamevaM SuBakarmARaM SukaM paramaDArmikam । vijAnannapi tAM prAptiM papracCa balasUdanaH ॥15॥

text: niṣpatramaphalaṃ śuṣkamaśaraṇyaṃ patatriṇām । kimarthaṃ sevase vṛkṣaṃ yadā mahadidaṃ vanam ॥16॥
html:
niṣpatramaphalaṃ śuṣkamaśaraṇyaṃ patatriṇām ।
kimarthaṃ sevase vṛkṣaṃ yadā mahadidaṃ vanam ॥16॥
slp1: nizpatramaPalaM SuzkamaSaraRyaM patatriRAm । kimarTaM sevase vfkzaM yadA mahadidaM vanam ॥16॥

text: anye'pi bahavo vṛkṣāḥ patrasañchannakoṭarāḥ । śubhāḥ paryāptasañcārā vidyante'sminmahāvane ॥17॥
html:
anye'pi bahavo vṛkṣāḥ patrasañchannakoṭarāḥ ।
śubhāḥ paryāptasañcārā vidyante'sminmahāvane ॥17॥
slp1: anye'pi bahavo vfkzAH patrasaYCannakowarAH । SuBAH paryAptasaYcArA vidyante'sminmahAvane ॥17॥

text: gatāyuṣamasāmarthyaṃ kṣīṇasāraṃ hataśriyam । vimṛśya prajñayā dhīra jahīmaṃ hyasthiraṃ drumam ॥18॥
html:
gatāyuṣamasāmarthyaṃ kṣīṇasāraṃ hataśriyam ।
vimṛśya prajñayā dhīra jahīmaṃ hyasthiraṃ drumam ॥18॥
slp1: gatAyuzamasAmarTyaM kzIRasAraM hataSriyam । vimfSya prajYayA DIra jahImaM hyasTiraM drumam ॥18॥

text: tadupaśrutya dharmātmā śukaḥ śakreṇa bhāṣitam । sudīrghamabhiniḥśvasya dīno vākyamuvāca ha ॥19॥
html:
tadupaśrutya dharmātmā śukaḥ śakreṇa bhāṣitam ।
sudīrghamabhiniḥśvasya dīno vākyamuvāca ha ॥19॥
slp1: tadupaSrutya DarmAtmA SukaH SakreRa BAzitam । sudIrGamaBiniHSvasya dIno vAkyamuvAca ha ॥19॥

text: anatikramaṇīyāni daivatāni śacīpate । yatrābhavastatra bhavastannibodha surādhipa ॥20॥
html:
anatikramaṇīyāni daivatāni śacīpate ।
yatrābhavastatra bhavastannibodha surādhipa ॥20॥
slp1: anatikramaRIyAni dEvatAni SacIpate । yatrABavastatra BavastanniboDa surADipa ॥20॥

text: asminnahaṃ drume jātaḥ sādhubhiśca guṇairyutaḥ । bālabhāve ca saṅguptaḥ śatrubhiśca na dharṣitaḥ ॥21॥
html:
asminnahaṃ drume jātaḥ sādhubhiśca guṇairyutaḥ ।
bālabhāve ca saṅguptaḥ śatrubhiśca na dharṣitaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: asminnahaM drume jAtaH sADuBiSca guREryutaH । bAlaBAve ca saNguptaH SatruBiSca na DarzitaH ॥21॥

text: kimanukrośavaiphalyamutpādayasi me'nagha । ānṛśaṃsye'nuraktasya bhaktasyānugatasya ca ॥22॥
html:
kimanukrośavaiphalyamutpādayasi me'nagha ।
ānṛśaṃsye'nuraktasya bhaktasyānugatasya ca ॥22॥
slp1: kimanukroSavEPalyamutpAdayasi me'naGa । AnfSaMsye'nuraktasya BaktasyAnugatasya ca ॥22॥

text: anukrośo hi sādhūnāṃ sumahaddharmalakṣaṇam । anukrośaśca sādhūnāṃ sadā prītiṃ prayacchati ॥23॥
html:
anukrośo hi sādhūnāṃ sumahaddharmalakṣaṇam ।
anukrośaśca sādhūnāṃ sadā prītiṃ prayacchati ॥23॥
slp1: anukroSo hi sADUnAM sumahadDarmalakzaRam । anukroSaSca sADUnAM sadA prItiM prayacCati ॥23॥

text: tvameva daivataiḥ sarvaiḥ pṛcchyase dharmasaṃśayān । atastvaṃ deva devānāmādhipatye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
tvameva daivataiḥ sarvaiḥ pṛcchyase dharmasaṃśayān ।
atastvaṃ deva devānāmādhipatye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tvameva dEvatEH sarvEH pfcCyase DarmasaMSayAn । atastvaM deva devAnAmADipatye pratizWitaH ॥24॥

text: nārhasi tvaṃ sahasrākṣa tyājayitveha bhaktitaḥ । samarthamupajīvyemaṃ tyajeyaṃ kathamadya vai ॥25॥
html:
nārhasi tvaṃ sahasrākṣa tyājayitveha bhaktitaḥ ।
samarthamupajīvyemaṃ tyajeyaṃ kathamadya vai ॥25॥
slp1: nArhasi tvaM sahasrAkza tyAjayitveha BaktitaH । samarTamupajIvyemaM tyajeyaM kaTamadya vE ॥25॥

text: tasya vākyena saumyena harṣitaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ । śukaṃ provāca dharmajñamānṛśaṃsyena toṣitaḥ ॥26॥
html:
tasya vākyena saumyena harṣitaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ।
śukaṃ provāca dharmajñamānṛśaṃsyena toṣitaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tasya vAkyena sOmyena harzitaH pAkaSAsanaH । SukaM provAca DarmajYamAnfSaMsyena tozitaH ॥26॥

text: varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti tadā sa ca vavre varaṃ śukaḥ । ānṛśaṃsyaparo nityaṃ tasya vṛkṣasya sambhavam ॥27॥
html:
varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti tadā sa ca vavre varaṃ śukaḥ ।
ānṛśaṃsyaparo nityaṃ tasya vṛkṣasya sambhavam ॥27॥
slp1: varaM vfRIzveti tadA sa ca vavre varaM SukaH । AnfSaMsyaparo nityaM tasya vfkzasya samBavam ॥27॥

text: viditvā ca dṛḍhāṃ śakrastāṃ śuke śīlasampadam । prītaḥ kṣipramatho vṛkṣamamṛtenāvasiktavān ॥28॥
html:
viditvā ca dṛḍhāṃ śakrastāṃ śuke śīlasampadam ।
prītaḥ kṣipramatho vṛkṣamamṛtenāvasiktavān ॥28॥
slp1: viditvA ca dfQAM SakrastAM Suke SIlasampadam । prItaH kzipramaTo vfkzamamftenAvasiktavAn ॥28॥

text: tataḥ phalāni patrāṇi śākhāścāpi manoramāḥ । śukasya dṛḍhabhaktitvācchrīmattvaṃ cāpa sa drumaḥ ॥29॥
html:
tataḥ phalāni patrāṇi śākhāścāpi manoramāḥ ।
śukasya dṛḍhabhaktitvācchrīmattvaṃ cāpa sa drumaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: tataH PalAni patrARi SAKAScApi manoramAH । Sukasya dfQaBaktitvAcCrImattvaM cApa sa drumaH ॥29॥

text: śukaśca karmaṇā tena ānṛśaṃsyakṛtena ha । āyuṣo'nte mahārāja prāpa śakrasalokatām ॥30॥
html:
śukaśca karmaṇā tena ānṛśaṃsyakṛtena ha ।
āyuṣo'nte mahārāja prāpa śakrasalokatām ॥30॥
slp1: SukaSca karmaRA tena AnfSaMsyakftena ha । Ayuzo'nte mahArAja prApa SakrasalokatAm ॥30॥

text: evameva manuṣyendra bhaktimantaṃ samāśritaḥ । sarvārthasiddhiṃ labhate śukaṃ prāpya yathā drumaḥ] ॥31॥
html:
evameva manuṣyendra bhaktimantaṃ samāśritaḥ ।
sarvārthasiddhiṃ labhate śukaṃ prāpya yathā drumaḥ] ॥31॥
slp1: evameva manuzyendra BaktimantaM samASritaH । sarvArTasidDiM laBate SukaM prApya yaTA drumaH] ॥31॥

text: pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada । daive puruṣakāre ca kiṃ svicchreṣṭhataraṃ bhavet ॥1॥
html:
pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada ।
daive puruṣakāre ca kiṃ svicchreṣṭhataraṃ bhavet ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmaha mahAprAjYa sarvaSAstraviSArada । dEve puruzakAre ca kiM svicCrezWataraM Bavet ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । vasiṣṭhasya ca saṃvādaṃ brahmaṇaśca yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
vasiṣṭhasya ca saṃvādaṃ brahmaṇaśca yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । vasizWasya ca saMvAdaM brahmaRaSca yuDizWira ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: daivamānuṣayoḥ kiṃ svitkarmaṇoḥ śreṣṭhamityuta । purā vasiṣṭho bhagavānpitāmahamapṛcchata ॥3॥
html:
daivamānuṣayoḥ kiṃ svitkarmaṇoḥ śreṣṭhamityuta ।
purā vasiṣṭho bhagavānpitāmahamapṛcchata ॥3॥
slp1: dEvamAnuzayoH kiM svitkarmaRoH SrezWamityuta । purA vasizWo BagavAnpitAmahamapfcCata ॥3॥

text: tataḥ padmodbhavo rājandevadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ । uvāca madhuraṃ vākyamarthavaddhetubhūṣitam ॥4॥
html:
tataḥ padmodbhavo rājandevadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ ।
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyamarthavaddhetubhūṣitam ॥4॥
slp1: tataH padmodBavo rAjandevadevaH pitAmahaH । uvAca maDuraM vAkyamarTavadDetuBUzitam ॥4॥

text: nābījaṃ jāyate kiñcinna bījena vinā phalam । bījādbījaṃ prabhavati bījādeva phalaṃ smṛtam ॥5॥
html:
nābījaṃ jāyate kiñcinna bījena vinā phalam ।
bījādbījaṃ prabhavati bījādeva phalaṃ smṛtam ॥5॥
slp1: nAbIjaM jAyate kiYcinna bIjena vinA Palam । bIjAdbIjaM praBavati bIjAdeva PalaM smftam ॥5॥

text: yādṛśaṃ vapate bījaṃ kṣetramāsādya karṣakaḥ । sukṛte duṣkṛte vāpi tādṛśaṃ labhate phalam ॥6॥
html:
yādṛśaṃ vapate bījaṃ kṣetramāsādya karṣakaḥ ।
sukṛte duṣkṛte vāpi tādṛśaṃ labhate phalam ॥6॥
slp1: yAdfSaM vapate bIjaM kzetramAsAdya karzakaH । sukfte duzkfte vApi tAdfSaM laBate Palam ॥6॥

text: yathā bījaṃ vinā kṣetramuptaṃ bhavati niṣphalam । tathā puruṣakāreṇa vinā daivaṃ na sidhyati ॥7॥
html:
yathā bījaṃ vinā kṣetramuptaṃ bhavati niṣphalam ।
tathā puruṣakāreṇa vinā daivaṃ na sidhyati ॥7॥
slp1: yaTA bIjaM vinA kzetramuptaM Bavati nizPalam । taTA puruzakAreRa vinA dEvaM na siDyati ॥7॥

text: kṣetraṃ puruṣakārastu daivaṃ bījamudāhṛtam । kṣetrabījasamāyogāttataḥ sasyaṃ samṛdhyate ॥8॥
html:
kṣetraṃ puruṣakārastu daivaṃ bījamudāhṛtam ।
kṣetrabījasamāyogāttataḥ sasyaṃ samṛdhyate ॥8॥
slp1: kzetraM puruzakArastu dEvaM bIjamudAhftam । kzetrabIjasamAyogAttataH sasyaM samfDyate ॥8॥

text: karmaṇaḥ phalanirvṛttiṃ svayamaśnāti kārakaḥ । pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate loke kṛtasyāpyakṛtasya ca ॥9॥
html:
karmaṇaḥ phalanirvṛttiṃ svayamaśnāti kārakaḥ ।
pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate loke kṛtasyāpyakṛtasya ca ॥9॥
slp1: karmaRaH PalanirvfttiM svayamaSnAti kArakaH । pratyakzaM dfSyate loke kftasyApyakftasya ca ॥9॥

text: śubhena karmaṇā saukhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ pāpena karmaṇā । kṛtaṃ sarvatra labhate nākṛtaṃ bhujyate kvacit ॥10॥
html:
śubhena karmaṇā saukhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ pāpena karmaṇā ।
kṛtaṃ sarvatra labhate nākṛtaṃ bhujyate kvacit ॥10॥
slp1: SuBena karmaRA sOKyaM duHKaM pApena karmaRA । kftaM sarvatra laBate nAkftaM Bujyate kvacit ॥10॥

text: kṛtī sarvatra labhate pratiṣṭhāṃ bhāgyavikṣataḥ । akṛtī labhate bhraṣṭaḥ kṣate kṣārāvasecanam ॥11॥
html:
kṛtī sarvatra labhate pratiṣṭhāṃ bhāgyavikṣataḥ ।
akṛtī labhate bhraṣṭaḥ kṣate kṣārāvasecanam ॥11॥
slp1: kftI sarvatra laBate pratizWAM BAgyavikzataH । akftI laBate BrazwaH kzate kzArAvasecanam ॥11॥

text: tapasā rūpasaubhāgyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca । prāpyate karmaṇā sarvaṃ na daivādakṛtātmanā ॥12॥
html:
tapasā rūpasaubhāgyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca ।
prāpyate karmaṇā sarvaṃ na daivādakṛtātmanā ॥12॥
slp1: tapasA rUpasOBAgyaM ratnAni viviDAni ca । prApyate karmaRA sarvaM na dEvAdakftAtmanA ॥12॥

text: tathā svargaśca bhogaśca niṣṭhā yā ca manīṣitā । sarvaṃ puruṣakāreṇa kṛtenehopapadyate ॥13॥
html:
tathā svargaśca bhogaśca niṣṭhā yā ca manīṣitā ।
sarvaṃ puruṣakāreṇa kṛtenehopapadyate ॥13॥
slp1: taTA svargaSca BogaSca nizWA yA ca manIzitA । sarvaM puruzakAreRa kftenehopapadyate ॥13॥

text: jyotīṃṣi tridaśā nāgā yakṣāścandrārkamārutāḥ । sarve puruṣakāreṇa mānuṣyāddevatāṃ gatāḥ ॥14॥
html:
jyotīṃṣi tridaśā nāgā yakṣāścandrārkamārutāḥ ।
sarve puruṣakāreṇa mānuṣyāddevatāṃ gatāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: jyotIMzi tridaSA nAgA yakzAScandrArkamArutAH । sarve puruzakAreRa mAnuzyAddevatAM gatAH ॥14॥

text: artho vā mitravargo vā aiśvaryaṃ vā kulānvitam । śrīścāpi durlabhā bhoktuṃ tathaivākṛtakarmabhiḥ ॥15॥
html:
artho vā mitravargo vā aiśvaryaṃ vā kulānvitam ।
śrīścāpi durlabhā bhoktuṃ tathaivākṛtakarmabhiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: arTo vA mitravargo vA ESvaryaM vA kulAnvitam । SrIScApi durlaBA BoktuM taTEvAkftakarmaBiH ॥15॥

text: śaucena labhate vipraḥ kṣatriyo vikrameṇa ca । vaiśyaḥ puruṣakāreṇa śūdraḥ śuśrūṣayā śriyam ॥16॥
html:
śaucena labhate vipraḥ kṣatriyo vikrameṇa ca ।
vaiśyaḥ puruṣakāreṇa śūdraḥ śuśrūṣayā śriyam ॥16॥
slp1: SOcena laBate vipraH kzatriyo vikrameRa ca । vESyaH puruzakAreRa SUdraH SuSrUzayA Sriyam ॥16॥

text: nādātāraṃ bhajantyarthā na klībaṃ nāpi niṣkriyam । nākarmaśīlaṃ nāśūraṃ tathā naivātapasvinam ॥17॥
html:
nādātāraṃ bhajantyarthā na klībaṃ nāpi niṣkriyam ।
nākarmaśīlaṃ nāśūraṃ tathā naivātapasvinam ॥17॥
slp1: nAdAtAraM BajantyarTA na klIbaM nApi nizkriyam । nAkarmaSIlaM nASUraM taTA nEvAtapasvinam ॥17॥

text: yena lokāstrayaḥ sṛṣṭā daityāḥ sarvāśca devatāḥ । sa eṣa bhagavānviṣṇuḥ samudre tapyate tapaḥ ॥18॥
html:
yena lokāstrayaḥ sṛṣṭā daityāḥ sarvāśca devatāḥ ।
sa eṣa bhagavānviṣṇuḥ samudre tapyate tapaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: yena lokAstrayaH sfzwA dEtyAH sarvASca devatAH । sa eza BagavAnvizRuH samudre tapyate tapaH ॥18॥

text: svaṃ cetkarmaphalaṃ na syātsarvamevāphalaṃ bhavet । loko daivaṃ samālambya udāsīno bhavenna tu ॥19॥
html:
svaṃ cetkarmaphalaṃ na syātsarvamevāphalaṃ bhavet ।
loko daivaṃ samālambya udāsīno bhavenna tu ॥19॥
slp1: svaM cetkarmaPalaM na syAtsarvamevAPalaM Bavet । loko dEvaM samAlambya udAsIno Bavenna tu ॥19॥

text: akṛtvā mānuṣaṃ karma yo daivamanuvartate । vṛthā śrāmyati samprāpya patiṃ klībamivāṅganā ॥20॥
html:
akṛtvā mānuṣaṃ karma yo daivamanuvartate ।
vṛthā śrāmyati samprāpya patiṃ klībamivāṅganā ॥20॥
slp1: akftvA mAnuzaM karma yo dEvamanuvartate । vfTA SrAmyati samprApya patiM klIbamivANganA ॥20॥

text: na tathā mānuṣe loke bhayamasti śubhāśubhe । yathā tridaśaloke hi bhayamalpena jāyate ॥21॥
html:
na tathā mānuṣe loke bhayamasti śubhāśubhe ।
yathā tridaśaloke hi bhayamalpena jāyate ॥21॥
slp1: na taTA mAnuze loke Bayamasti SuBASuBe । yaTA tridaSaloke hi Bayamalpena jAyate ॥21॥

text: kṛtaḥ puruṣakārastu daivamevānuvartate । na daivamakṛte kiñcitkasyaciddātumarhati ॥22॥
html:
kṛtaḥ puruṣakārastu daivamevānuvartate ।
na daivamakṛte kiñcitkasyaciddātumarhati ॥22॥
slp1: kftaH puruzakArastu dEvamevAnuvartate । na dEvamakfte kiYcitkasyaciddAtumarhati ॥22॥

text: yadā sthānānyanityāni dṛśyante daivateṣvapi । kathaṃ karma vinā daivaṃ sthāsyate sthāpayiṣyati ॥23॥
html:
yadā sthānānyanityāni dṛśyante daivateṣvapi ।
kathaṃ karma vinā daivaṃ sthāsyate sthāpayiṣyati ॥23॥
slp1: yadA sTAnAnyanityAni dfSyante dEvatezvapi । kaTaM karma vinA dEvaM sTAsyate sTApayizyati ॥23॥

text: na daivatāni loke'sminvyāpāraṃ yānti kasyacit । vyāsaṅgaṃ janayantyugramātmābhibhavaśaṅkayā ॥24॥
html:
na daivatāni loke'sminvyāpāraṃ yānti kasyacit ।
vyāsaṅgaṃ janayantyugramātmābhibhavaśaṅkayā ॥24॥
slp1: na dEvatAni loke'sminvyApAraM yAnti kasyacit । vyAsaNgaM janayantyugramAtmABiBavaSaNkayA ॥24॥

text: ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca sadā bhavati vigrahaḥ । kasya vācā hyadaivaṃ syādyato daivaṃ pravartate ॥25॥
html:
ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca sadā bhavati vigrahaḥ ।
kasya vācā hyadaivaṃ syādyato daivaṃ pravartate ॥25॥
slp1: fzIRAM devatAnAM ca sadA Bavati vigrahaH । kasya vAcA hyadEvaM syAdyato dEvaM pravartate ॥25॥

text: kathaṃ cāsya samutpattiryathā daivaṃ pravartate । evaṃ tridaśaloke'pi prāpyante bahavaśchalāḥ ॥26॥
html:
kathaṃ cāsya samutpattiryathā daivaṃ pravartate ।
evaṃ tridaśaloke'pi prāpyante bahavaśchalāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: kaTaM cAsya samutpattiryaTA dEvaM pravartate । evaM tridaSaloke'pi prApyante bahavaSCalAH ॥26॥

text: ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ । ātmaiva cātmanaḥ sākṣī kṛtasyāpyakṛtasya ca ॥27॥
html:
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ ।
ātmaiva cātmanaḥ sākṣī kṛtasyāpyakṛtasya ca ॥27॥
slp1: AtmEva hyAtmano banDurAtmEva ripurAtmanaH । AtmEva cAtmanaH sAkzI kftasyApyakftasya ca ॥27॥

text: kṛtaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ kiñcitkṛte karmaṇi sidhyati । sukṛte duṣkṛtaṃ karma na yathārthaṃ prapadyate ॥28॥
html:
kṛtaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ kiñcitkṛte karmaṇi sidhyati ।
sukṛte duṣkṛtaṃ karma na yathārthaṃ prapadyate ॥28॥
slp1: kftaM ca vikftaM kiYcitkfte karmaRi siDyati । sukfte duzkftaM karma na yaTArTaM prapadyate ॥28॥

text: devānāṃ śaraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyairavāpyate । puṇyaśīlaṃ naraṃ prāpya kiṃ daivaṃ prakariṣyati ॥29॥
html:
devānāṃ śaraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyairavāpyate ।
puṇyaśīlaṃ naraṃ prāpya kiṃ daivaṃ prakariṣyati ॥29॥
slp1: devAnAM SaraRaM puRyaM sarvaM puRyEravApyate । puRyaSIlaM naraM prApya kiM dEvaM prakarizyati ॥29॥

text: purā yayātirvibhraṣṭaścyāvitaḥ patitaḥ kṣitau । punarāropitaḥ svargaṃ dauhitraiḥ puṇyakarmabhiḥ ॥30॥
html:
purā yayātirvibhraṣṭaścyāvitaḥ patitaḥ kṣitau ।
punarāropitaḥ svargaṃ dauhitraiḥ puṇyakarmabhiḥ ॥30॥
slp1: purA yayAtirviBrazwaScyAvitaH patitaH kzitO । punarAropitaH svargaM dOhitrEH puRyakarmaBiH ॥30॥

text: purūravāśca rājarṣirdvijairabhihitaḥ purā । aila ityabhivikhyātaḥ svargaṃ prāpto mahīpatiḥ ॥31॥
html:
purūravāśca rājarṣirdvijairabhihitaḥ purā ।
aila ityabhivikhyātaḥ svargaṃ prāpto mahīpatiḥ ॥31॥
slp1: purUravASca rAjarzirdvijEraBihitaH purA । Ela ityaBiviKyAtaH svargaM prApto mahIpatiH ॥31॥

text: aśvamedhādibhiryajñaiḥ satkṛtaḥ kosalādhipaḥ । maharṣiśāpātsaudāsaḥ puruṣādatvamāgataḥ ॥32॥
html:
aśvamedhādibhiryajñaiḥ satkṛtaḥ kosalādhipaḥ ।
maharṣiśāpātsaudāsaḥ puruṣādatvamāgataḥ ॥32॥
slp1: aSvameDAdiBiryajYEH satkftaH kosalADipaH । maharziSApAtsOdAsaH puruzAdatvamAgataH ॥32॥

text: aśvatthāmā ca rāmaśca muniputrau dhanurdharau । na gacchataḥ svargalokaṃ sukṛteneha karmaṇā ॥33॥
html:
aśvatthāmā ca rāmaśca muniputrau dhanurdharau ।
na gacchataḥ svargalokaṃ sukṛteneha karmaṇā ॥33॥
slp1: aSvatTAmA ca rAmaSca muniputrO DanurDarO । na gacCataH svargalokaM sukfteneha karmaRA ॥33॥

text: vasuryajñaśatairiṣṭvā dvitīya iva vāsavaḥ । mithyābhidhānenaikena rasātalatalaṃ gataḥ ॥34॥
html:
vasuryajñaśatairiṣṭvā dvitīya iva vāsavaḥ ।
mithyābhidhānenaikena rasātalatalaṃ gataḥ ॥34॥
slp1: vasuryajYaSatErizwvA dvitIya iva vAsavaH । miTyABiDAnenEkena rasAtalatalaM gataH ॥34॥

text: balirvairocanirbaddho dharmapāśena daivataiḥ । viṣṇoḥ puruṣakāreṇa pātālaśayanaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥35॥
html:
balirvairocanirbaddho dharmapāśena daivataiḥ ।
viṣṇoḥ puruṣakāreṇa pātālaśayanaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: balirvErocanirbadDo DarmapASena dEvatEH । vizRoH puruzakAreRa pAtAlaSayanaH kftaH ॥35॥

text: śakrasyodasya caraṇaṃ prasthito janamejayaḥ । dvijastrīṇāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ daivena na vāritaḥ ॥36॥
html:
śakrasyodasya caraṇaṃ prasthito janamejayaḥ ।
dvijastrīṇāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ daivena na vāritaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: Sakrasyodasya caraRaM prasTito janamejayaH । dvijastrIRAM vaDaM kftvA kiM dEvena na vAritaH ॥36॥

text: ajñānādbrāhmaṇaṃ hatvā spṛṣṭo bālavadhena ca । vaiśampāyanaviprarṣiḥ kiṃ daivena nivāritaḥ ॥37॥
html:
ajñānādbrāhmaṇaṃ hatvā spṛṣṭo bālavadhena ca ।
vaiśampāyanaviprarṣiḥ kiṃ daivena nivāritaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: ajYAnAdbrAhmaRaM hatvA spfzwo bAlavaDena ca । vESampAyanaviprarziH kiM dEvena nivAritaH ॥37॥

text: gopradānena mithyā ca brāhmaṇebhyo mahāmakhe । purā nṛgaśca rājarṣiḥ kṛkalāsatvamāgataḥ ॥38॥
html:
gopradānena mithyā ca brāhmaṇebhyo mahāmakhe ।
purā nṛgaśca rājarṣiḥ kṛkalāsatvamāgataḥ ॥38॥
slp1: gopradAnena miTyA ca brAhmaReByo mahAmaKe । purA nfgaSca rAjarziH kfkalAsatvamAgataH ॥38॥

text: dhundhumāraśca rājarṣiḥ satreṣveva jarāṃ gataḥ । prītidāyaṃ parityajya suṣvāpa sa girivraje ॥39॥
html:
dhundhumāraśca rājarṣiḥ satreṣveva jarāṃ gataḥ ।
prītidāyaṃ parityajya suṣvāpa sa girivraje ॥39॥
slp1: DunDumAraSca rAjarziH satrezveva jarAM gataH । prItidAyaM parityajya suzvApa sa girivraje ॥39॥

text: pāṇḍavānāṃ hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrairmahābalaiḥ । punaḥ pratyāhṛtaṃ caiva na daivādbhujasaṃśrayāt ॥40॥
html:
pāṇḍavānāṃ hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrairmahābalaiḥ ।
punaḥ pratyāhṛtaṃ caiva na daivādbhujasaṃśrayāt ॥40॥
slp1: pARqavAnAM hftaM rAjyaM DArtarAzwrErmahAbalEH । punaH pratyAhftaM cEva na dEvAdBujasaMSrayAt ॥40॥

text: taponiyamasaṃyuktā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ । kiṃ te daivabalācchāpamutsṛjante na karmaṇā ॥41॥
html:
taponiyamasaṃyuktā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ।
kiṃ te daivabalācchāpamutsṛjante na karmaṇā ॥41॥
slp1: taponiyamasaMyuktA munayaH saMSitavratAH । kiM te dEvabalAcCApamutsfjante na karmaRA ॥41॥

text: pāpamutsṛjate loke sarvaṃ prāpya sudurlabham । lobhamohasamāpannaṃ na daivaṃ trāyate naram ॥42॥
html:
pāpamutsṛjate loke sarvaṃ prāpya sudurlabham ।
lobhamohasamāpannaṃ na daivaṃ trāyate naram ॥42॥
slp1: pApamutsfjate loke sarvaM prApya sudurlaBam । loBamohasamApannaM na dEvaM trAyate naram ॥42॥

text: yathāgniḥ pavanoddhūtaḥ sūkṣmo'pi bhavate mahān । tathā karmasamāyuktaṃ daivaṃ sādhu vivardhate ॥43॥
html:
yathāgniḥ pavanoddhūtaḥ sūkṣmo'pi bhavate mahān ।
tathā karmasamāyuktaṃ daivaṃ sādhu vivardhate ॥43॥
slp1: yaTAgniH pavanodDUtaH sUkzmo'pi Bavate mahAn । taTA karmasamAyuktaM dEvaM sADu vivarDate ॥43॥

text: yathā tailakṣayāddīpaḥ pramlānimupagacchati । tathā karmakṣayāddaivaṃ pramlānimupagacchati ॥44॥
html:
yathā tailakṣayāddīpaḥ pramlānimupagacchati ।
tathā karmakṣayāddaivaṃ pramlānimupagacchati ॥44॥
slp1: yaTA tElakzayAddIpaH pramlAnimupagacCati । taTA karmakzayAddEvaM pramlAnimupagacCati ॥44॥

text: vipulamapi dhanaughaṃ prāpya bhogānstriyo vā puruṣa iha na śaktaḥ karmahīno'pi bhoktum । sunihitamapi cārthaṃ daivatai rakṣyamāṇaṃ vyayaguṇamapi sādhuṃ karmaṇā saṃśrayante ॥45॥
html:
vipulamapi dhanaughaṃ prāpya bhogānstriyo vā puruṣa iha na śaktaḥ karmahīno'pi bhoktum ।
sunihitamapi cārthaṃ daivatai rakṣyamāṇaṃ vyayaguṇamapi sādhuṃ karmaṇā saṃśrayante ॥45॥
slp1: vipulamapi DanOGaM prApya BogAnstriyo vA puruza iha na SaktaH karmahIno'pi Boktum । sunihitamapi cArTaM dEvatE rakzyamARaM vyayaguRamapi sADuM karmaRA saMSrayante ॥45॥

text: bhavati manujalokāddevaloko viśiṣṭo bahutarasusamṛddhyā mānuṣāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi । pitṛvanabhavanābhaṃ dṛśyate cāmarāṇāṃ na ca phalati vikarmā jīvalokena daivam ॥46॥
html:
bhavati manujalokāddevaloko viśiṣṭo bahutarasusamṛddhyā mānuṣāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ।
pitṛvanabhavanābhaṃ dṛśyate cāmarāṇāṃ na ca phalati vikarmā jīvalokena daivam ॥46॥
slp1: Bavati manujalokAddevaloko viSizwo bahutarasusamfdDyA mAnuzARAM gfhARi । pitfvanaBavanABaM dfSyate cAmarARAM na ca Palati vikarmA jIvalokena dEvam ॥46॥

text: vyapanayati vimārgaṃ nāsti daive prabhutvaṃ gurumiva kṛtamagryaṃ karma saṃyāti daivam । anupahatamadīnaṃ kāmakāreṇa daivaṃ nayati puruṣakāraḥ sañcitastatra tatra ॥47॥
html:
vyapanayati vimārgaṃ nāsti daive prabhutvaṃ gurumiva kṛtamagryaṃ karma saṃyāti daivam ।
anupahatamadīnaṃ kāmakāreṇa daivaṃ nayati puruṣakāraḥ sañcitastatra tatra ॥47॥
slp1: vyapanayati vimArgaM nAsti dEve praButvaM gurumiva kftamagryaM karma saMyAti dEvam । anupahatamadInaM kAmakAreRa dEvaM nayati puruzakAraH saYcitastatra tatra ॥47॥

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā vai munisattama । phalaṃ puruṣakārasya sadā sandṛśya tattvataḥ ॥48॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā vai munisattama ।
phalaṃ puruṣakārasya sadā sandṛśya tattvataḥ ॥48॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM mayA vE munisattama । PalaM puruzakArasya sadA sandfSya tattvataH ॥48॥

text: abhyutthānena daivasya samārabdhena karmaṇā । vidhinā karmaṇā caiva svargamārgamavāpnuyāt] ॥49॥
html:
abhyutthānena daivasya samārabdhena karmaṇā ।
vidhinā karmaṇā caiva svargamārgamavāpnuyāt] ॥49॥
slp1: aByutTAnena dEvasya samArabDena karmaRA । viDinA karmaRA cEva svargamArgamavApnuyAt] ॥49॥

text: karmaṇāṃ me samastānāṃ śubhānāṃ bharatarṣabha । phalāni mahatāṃ śreṣṭha prabrūhi paripṛcchataḥ ॥1॥
html:
karmaṇāṃ me samastānāṃ śubhānāṃ bharatarṣabha ।
phalāni mahatāṃ śreṣṭha prabrūhi paripṛcchataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: karmaRAM me samastAnAM SuBAnAM BaratarzaBa । PalAni mahatAM SrezWa prabrUhi paripfcCataH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: rahasyaṃ yadṛṣīṇāṃ tu tacchṛṇuṣva yudhiṣṭhira । yā gatiḥ prāpyate yena pretyabhāve cirepsitā ॥2॥
html:
rahasyaṃ yadṛṣīṇāṃ tu tacchṛṇuṣva yudhiṣṭhira ।
yā gatiḥ prāpyate yena pretyabhāve cirepsitā ॥2॥
slp1: rahasyaM yadfzIRAM tu tacCfRuzva yuDizWira । yA gatiH prApyate yena pretyaBAve cirepsitA ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yena yena śarīreṇa yadyatkarma karoti yaḥ । tena tena śarīreṇa tattatphalamupāśnute ॥3॥
html:
yena yena śarīreṇa yadyatkarma karoti yaḥ ।
tena tena śarīreṇa tattatphalamupāśnute ॥3॥
slp1: yena yena SarIreRa yadyatkarma karoti yaH । tena tena SarIreRa tattatPalamupASnute ॥3॥

text: yasyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yatkaroti śubhāśubham । tasyāṃ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ bhuṅkte janmani janmani ॥4॥
html:
yasyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yatkaroti śubhāśubham ।
tasyāṃ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ bhuṅkte janmani janmani ॥4॥
slp1: yasyAM yasyAmavasTAyAM yatkaroti SuBASuBam । tasyAM tasyAmavasTAyAM BuNkte janmani janmani ॥4॥

text: na naśyati kṛtaṃ karma sadā pañcendriyairiha । te hyasya sākṣiṇo nityaṃ ṣaṣṭha ātmā tathaiva ca ॥5॥
html:
na naśyati kṛtaṃ karma sadā pañcendriyairiha ।
te hyasya sākṣiṇo nityaṃ ṣaṣṭha ātmā tathaiva ca ॥5॥
slp1: na naSyati kftaM karma sadA paYcendriyEriha । te hyasya sAkziRo nityaM zazWa AtmA taTEva ca ॥5॥

text: cakṣurdadyānmano dadyādvācaṃ dadyācca sūnṛtām । anuvrajedupāsīta sa yajñaḥ pañcadakṣiṇaḥ ॥6॥
html:
cakṣurdadyānmano dadyādvācaṃ dadyācca sūnṛtām ।
anuvrajedupāsīta sa yajñaḥ pañcadakṣiṇaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: cakzurdadyAnmano dadyAdvAcaM dadyAcca sUnftAm । anuvrajedupAsIta sa yajYaH paYcadakziRaH ॥6॥

text: yo dadyādaparikliṣṭamannamadhvani vartate । śrāntāyādṛṣṭapūrvāya tasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ॥7॥
html:
yo dadyādaparikliṣṭamannamadhvani vartate ।
śrāntāyādṛṣṭapūrvāya tasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ॥7॥
slp1: yo dadyAdapariklizwamannamaDvani vartate । SrAntAyAdfzwapUrvAya tasya puRyaPalaM mahat ॥7॥

text: sthaṇḍile śayamānānāṃ gṛhāṇi śayanāni ca । cīravalkalasaṃvīte vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ॥8॥
html:
sthaṇḍile śayamānānāṃ gṛhāṇi śayanāni ca ।
cīravalkalasaṃvīte vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ॥8॥
slp1: sTaRqile SayamAnAnAM gfhARi SayanAni ca । cIravalkalasaMvIte vAsAMsyABaraRAni ca ॥8॥

text: vāhanāsanayānāni yogātmani tapodhane । agnīnupaśayānasya rājapauruṣamucyate ॥9॥
html:
vāhanāsanayānāni yogātmani tapodhane ।
agnīnupaśayānasya rājapauruṣamucyate ॥9॥
slp1: vAhanAsanayAnAni yogAtmani tapoDane । agnInupaSayAnasya rAjapOruzamucyate ॥9॥

text: rasānāṃ pratisaṃhāre saubhāgyamanugacchati । āmiṣapratisaṃhāre paśūnputrāṃśca vindati ॥10॥
html:
rasānāṃ pratisaṃhāre saubhāgyamanugacchati ।
āmiṣapratisaṃhāre paśūnputrāṃśca vindati ॥10॥
slp1: rasAnAM pratisaMhAre sOBAgyamanugacCati । AmizapratisaMhAre paSUnputrAMSca vindati ॥10॥

text: avākśirāstu yo lambedudavāsaṃ ca yo vaset । satataṃ caikaśāyī yaḥ sa labhetepsitāṃ gatim ॥11॥
html:
avākśirāstu yo lambedudavāsaṃ ca yo vaset ।
satataṃ caikaśāyī yaḥ sa labhetepsitāṃ gatim ॥11॥
slp1: avAkSirAstu yo lambedudavAsaM ca yo vaset । satataM cEkaSAyI yaH sa laBetepsitAM gatim ॥11॥

text: pādyamāsanamevātha dīpamannaṃ pratiśrayam । dadyādatithipūjārthaṃ sa yajñaḥ pañcadakṣiṇaḥ ॥12॥
html:
pādyamāsanamevātha dīpamannaṃ pratiśrayam ।
dadyādatithipūjārthaṃ sa yajñaḥ pañcadakṣiṇaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: pAdyamAsanamevATa dIpamannaM pratiSrayam । dadyAdatiTipUjArTaM sa yajYaH paYcadakziRaH ॥12॥

text: vīrāsanaṃ vīraśayyāṃ vīrasthānamupāsataḥ । akṣayāstasya vai lokāḥ sarvakāmagamāstathā ॥13॥
html:
vīrāsanaṃ vīraśayyāṃ vīrasthānamupāsataḥ ।
akṣayāstasya vai lokāḥ sarvakāmagamāstathā ॥13॥
slp1: vIrAsanaM vIraSayyAM vIrasTAnamupAsataH । akzayAstasya vE lokAH sarvakAmagamAstaTA ॥13॥

text: dhanaṃ labheta dānena maunenājñāṃ viśāṃ pate । upabhogāṃśca tapasā brahmacaryeṇa jīvitam ॥14॥
html:
dhanaṃ labheta dānena maunenājñāṃ viśāṃ pate ।
upabhogāṃśca tapasā brahmacaryeṇa jīvitam ॥14॥
slp1: DanaM laBeta dAnena mOnenAjYAM viSAM pate । upaBogAMSca tapasA brahmacaryeRa jIvitam ॥14॥

text: rūpamaiśvaryamārogyamahiṃsāphalamaśnute । phalamūlāśināṃ rājyaṃ svargaḥ parṇāśināṃ tathā ॥15॥
html:
rūpamaiśvaryamārogyamahiṃsāphalamaśnute ।
phalamūlāśināṃ rājyaṃ svargaḥ parṇāśināṃ tathā ॥15॥
slp1: rUpamESvaryamArogyamahiMsAPalamaSnute । PalamUlASinAM rAjyaM svargaH parRASinAM taTA ॥15॥

text: prāyopaveśanādrājyaṃ sarvatra sukhamucyate । svargaṃ satyena labhate dīkṣayā kulamuttamam ॥16॥
html:
prāyopaveśanādrājyaṃ sarvatra sukhamucyate ।
svargaṃ satyena labhate dīkṣayā kulamuttamam ॥16॥
slp1: prAyopaveSanAdrAjyaM sarvatra suKamucyate । svargaM satyena laBate dIkzayA kulamuttamam ॥16॥

text: gavāḍhyaḥ śākadīkṣāyāṃ svargagāmī tṛṇāśanaḥ । striyastriṣavaṇaṃ snātvā vāyuṃ pītvā kratuṃ labhet ॥17॥
html:
gavāḍhyaḥ śākadīkṣāyāṃ svargagāmī tṛṇāśanaḥ ।
striyastriṣavaṇaṃ snātvā vāyuṃ pītvā kratuṃ labhet ॥17॥
slp1: gavAQyaH SAkadIkzAyAM svargagAmI tfRASanaH । striyastrizavaRaM snAtvA vAyuM pItvA kratuM laBet ॥17॥

text: salilāśī bhavedyaśca sadāgniḥ saṃskṛto dvijaḥ । maruṃ sādhayato rājyaṃ nākapṛṣṭhamanāśake ॥18॥
html:
salilāśī bhavedyaśca sadāgniḥ saṃskṛto dvijaḥ ।
maruṃ sādhayato rājyaṃ nākapṛṣṭhamanāśake ॥18॥
slp1: salilASI BavedyaSca sadAgniH saMskfto dvijaH । maruM sADayato rAjyaM nAkapfzWamanASake ॥18॥

text: upavāsaṃ ca dīkṣāṃ ca abhiṣekaṃ ca pārthiva । kṛtvā dvādaśavarṣāṇi vīrasthānādviśiṣyate ॥19॥
html:
upavāsaṃ ca dīkṣāṃ ca abhiṣekaṃ ca pārthiva ।
kṛtvā dvādaśavarṣāṇi vīrasthānādviśiṣyate ॥19॥
slp1: upavAsaM ca dIkzAM ca aBizekaM ca pArTiva । kftvA dvAdaSavarzARi vIrasTAnAdviSizyate ॥19॥

text: adhītya sarvavedānvai sadyo duḥkhātpramucyate । mānasaṃ hi carandharmaṃ svargalokamavāpnuyāt ॥20॥
html:
adhītya sarvavedānvai sadyo duḥkhātpramucyate ।
mānasaṃ hi carandharmaṃ svargalokamavāpnuyāt ॥20॥
slp1: aDItya sarvavedAnvE sadyo duHKAtpramucyate । mAnasaM hi caranDarmaM svargalokamavApnuyAt ॥20॥

text: yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ । yo'sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham ॥21॥
html:
yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ ।
yo'sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham ॥21॥
slp1: yA dustyajA durmatiBiryA na jIryati jIryataH । yo'sO prARAntiko rogastAM tfzRAM tyajataH suKam ॥21॥

text: yathā dhenusahasreṣu vatso vindati mātaram । evaṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ karma kartāramanugacchati ॥22॥
html:
yathā dhenusahasreṣu vatso vindati mātaram ।
evaṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ karma kartāramanugacchati ॥22॥
slp1: yaTA Denusahasrezu vatso vindati mAtaram । evaM pUrvakftaM karma kartAramanugacCati ॥22॥

text: acodyamānāni yathā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca । svakālaṃ nātivartante tathā karma purākṛtam ॥23॥
html:
acodyamānāni yathā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ।
svakālaṃ nātivartante tathā karma purākṛtam ॥23॥
slp1: acodyamAnAni yaTA puzpARi ca PalAni ca । svakAlaM nAtivartante taTA karma purAkftam ॥23॥

text: jīryanti jīryataḥ keśā dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ । cakṣuḥśrotre ca jīryete tṛṣṇaikā tu na jīryate ॥24॥
html:
jīryanti jīryataḥ keśā dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ ।
cakṣuḥśrotre ca jīryete tṛṣṇaikā tu na jīryate ॥24॥
slp1: jIryanti jIryataH keSA dantA jIryanti jIryataH । cakzuHSrotre ca jIryete tfzREkA tu na jIryate ॥24॥

text: yena prīṇāti pitaraṃ tena prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ । prīṇāti mātaraṃ yena pṛthivī tena pūjitā । yena prīṇātyupādhyāyaṃ tena syādbrahma pūjitam ॥25॥
html:
yena prīṇāti pitaraṃ tena prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।
prīṇāti mātaraṃ yena pṛthivī tena pūjitā ।
yena prīṇātyupādhyāyaṃ tena syādbrahma pūjitam ॥25॥
slp1: yena prIRAti pitaraM tena prItaH prajApatiH । prIRAti mAtaraM yena pfTivI tena pUjitA । yena prIRAtyupADyAyaM tena syAdbrahma pUjitam ॥25॥

text: sarve tasyādṛtā dharmā yasyaite traya ādṛtāḥ । anādṛtāstu yasyaite sarvāstasyāphalāḥ kriyāḥ ॥26॥
html:
sarve tasyādṛtā dharmā yasyaite traya ādṛtāḥ ।
anādṛtāstu yasyaite sarvāstasyāphalāḥ kriyāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: sarve tasyAdftA DarmA yasyEte traya AdftAH । anAdftAstu yasyEte sarvAstasyAPalAH kriyAH ॥26॥

text: bhīṣmasya tadvacaḥ śrutvā vismitāḥ kurupuṅgavāḥ । āsanprahṛṣṭamanasaḥ prītimanto'bhavaṃstadā ॥27॥
html:
bhīṣmasya tadvacaḥ śrutvā vismitāḥ kurupuṅgavāḥ ।
āsanprahṛṣṭamanasaḥ prītimanto'bhavaṃstadā ॥27॥
slp1: BIzmasya tadvacaH SrutvA vismitAH kurupuNgavAH । AsanprahfzwamanasaH prItimanto'BavaMstadA ॥27॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: yanmantre bhavati vṛthā prayujyamāne yatsome bhavati vṛthābhiṣūyamāṇe । yaccāgnau bhavati vṛthābhihūyamāne tatsarvaṃ bhavati vṛthābhidhīyamāne ॥28॥
html:
yanmantre bhavati vṛthā prayujyamāne yatsome bhavati vṛthābhiṣūyamāṇe ।
yaccāgnau bhavati vṛthābhihūyamāne tatsarvaṃ bhavati vṛthābhidhīyamāne ॥28॥
slp1: yanmantre Bavati vfTA prayujyamAne yatsome Bavati vfTABizUyamARe । yaccAgnO Bavati vfTABihUyamAne tatsarvaM Bavati vfTABiDIyamAne ॥28॥

text: ityetadṛṣiṇā proktamuktavānasmi yadvibho । śubhāśubhaphalaprāptau kimataḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥29॥
html:
ityetadṛṣiṇā proktamuktavānasmi yadvibho ।
śubhāśubhaphalaprāptau kimataḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥29॥
slp1: ityetadfziRA proktamuktavAnasmi yadviBo । SuBASuBaPalaprAptO kimataH SrotumicCasi] ॥29॥

text: ke pūjyāḥ ke namaskāryāḥ kānnamasyasi bhārata । etanme sarvamācakṣva yeṣāṃ spṛhayase nṛpa ॥1॥
html:
ke pūjyāḥ ke namaskāryāḥ kānnamasyasi bhārata ।
etanme sarvamācakṣva yeṣāṃ spṛhayase nṛpa ॥1॥
slp1: ke pUjyAH ke namaskAryAH kAnnamasyasi BArata । etanme sarvamAcakzva yezAM spfhayase nfpa ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: uttamāpadgatasyāpi yatra te vartate manaḥ । manuṣyaloke sarvasminyadamutreha cāpyuta ॥2॥
html:
uttamāpadgatasyāpi yatra te vartate manaḥ ।
manuṣyaloke sarvasminyadamutreha cāpyuta ॥2॥
slp1: uttamApadgatasyApi yatra te vartate manaH । manuzyaloke sarvasminyadamutreha cApyuta ॥2॥

text: spṛhayāmi dvijātīnāṃ yeṣāṃ brahma paraṃ dhanam । yeṣāṃ svapratyayaḥ svargastapaḥsvādhyāyasādhanaḥ ॥3॥
html:
spṛhayāmi dvijātīnāṃ yeṣāṃ brahma paraṃ dhanam ।
yeṣāṃ svapratyayaḥ svargastapaḥsvādhyāyasādhanaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: spfhayAmi dvijAtInAM yezAM brahma paraM Danam । yezAM svapratyayaH svargastapaHsvADyAyasADanaH ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yeṣāṃ vṛddhāśca bālāśca pitṛpaitāmahīṃ dhuram । udvahanti na sīdanti teṣāṃ vai spṛhayāmyaham ॥4॥
html:
yeṣāṃ vṛddhāśca bālāśca pitṛpaitāmahīṃ dhuram ।
udvahanti na sīdanti teṣāṃ vai spṛhayāmyaham ॥4॥
slp1: yezAM vfdDASca bAlASca pitfpEtAmahIM Duram । udvahanti na sIdanti tezAM vE spfhayAmyaham ॥4॥

text: vidyāsvabhivinītānāṃ dāntānāṃ mṛdubhāṣiṇām । śrutavṛttopapannānāṃ sadākṣaravidāṃ satām ॥5॥
html:
vidyāsvabhivinītānāṃ dāntānāṃ mṛdubhāṣiṇām ।
śrutavṛttopapannānāṃ sadākṣaravidāṃ satām ॥5॥
slp1: vidyAsvaBivinItAnAM dAntAnAM mfduBAziRAm । SrutavfttopapannAnAM sadAkzaravidAM satAm ॥5॥

text: saṃsatsu vadatāṃ yeṣāṃ haṃsānāmiva saṅghaśaḥ । maṅgalyarūpā rucirā divyajīmūtaniḥsvanāḥ ॥6॥
html:
saṃsatsu vadatāṃ yeṣāṃ haṃsānāmiva saṅghaśaḥ ।
maṅgalyarūpā rucirā divyajīmūtaniḥsvanāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: saMsatsu vadatAM yezAM haMsAnAmiva saNGaSaH । maNgalyarUpA rucirA divyajImUtaniHsvanAH ॥6॥

text: samyaguccāritā vācaḥ śrūyante hi yudhiṣṭhira । śuśrūṣamāṇe nṛpatau pretya ceha sukhāvahāḥ ॥7॥
html:
samyaguccāritā vācaḥ śrūyante hi yudhiṣṭhira ।
śuśrūṣamāṇe nṛpatau pretya ceha sukhāvahāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: samyaguccAritA vAcaH SrUyante hi yuDizWira । SuSrUzamARe nfpatO pretya ceha suKAvahAH ॥7॥

text: ye cāpi teṣāṃ śrotāraḥ sadā sadasi sammatāḥ । vijñānaguṇasampannāsteṣāṃ ca spṛhayāmyaham ॥8॥
html:
ye cāpi teṣāṃ śrotāraḥ sadā sadasi sammatāḥ ।
vijñānaguṇasampannāsteṣāṃ ca spṛhayāmyaham ॥8॥
slp1: ye cApi tezAM SrotAraH sadA sadasi sammatAH । vijYAnaguRasampannAstezAM ca spfhayAmyaham ॥8॥

text: susaṃskṛtāni prayatāḥ śucīni guṇavanti ca । dadatyannāni tṛptyarthaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira । ye cāpi satataṃ rājaṃsteṣāṃ ca spṛhayāmyaham ॥9॥
html:
susaṃskṛtāni prayatāḥ śucīni guṇavanti ca ।
dadatyannāni tṛptyarthaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira ।
ye cāpi satataṃ rājaṃsteṣāṃ ca spṛhayāmyaham ॥9॥
slp1: susaMskftAni prayatAH SucIni guRavanti ca । dadatyannAni tfptyarTaM brAhmaReByo yuDizWira । ye cApi satataM rAjaMstezAM ca spfhayAmyaham ॥9॥

text: śakyaṃ hyevāhave yoddhuṃ na dātumanasūyitam । śūrā vīrāśca śataśaḥ santi loke yudhiṣṭhira । teṣāṃ saṅkhyāyamānānāṃ dānaśūro viśiṣyate ॥10॥
html:
śakyaṃ hyevāhave yoddhuṃ na dātumanasūyitam ।
śūrā vīrāśca śataśaḥ santi loke yudhiṣṭhira ।
teṣāṃ saṅkhyāyamānānāṃ dānaśūro viśiṣyate ॥10॥
slp1: SakyaM hyevAhave yodDuM na dAtumanasUyitam । SUrA vIrASca SataSaH santi loke yuDizWira । tezAM saNKyAyamAnAnAM dAnaSUro viSizyate ॥10॥

text: dhanyaḥ syāṃ yadyahaṃ bhūyaḥ saumya brāhmaṇako'pi vā । kule jāto dharmagatistapovidyāparāyaṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
dhanyaḥ syāṃ yadyahaṃ bhūyaḥ saumya brāhmaṇako'pi vā ।
kule jāto dharmagatistapovidyāparāyaṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: DanyaH syAM yadyahaM BUyaH sOmya brAhmaRako'pi vA । kule jAto DarmagatistapovidyAparAyaRaH ॥11॥

text: na me tvattaḥ priyataro loke'sminpāṇḍunandana । tvattaśca me priyatarā brāhmaṇā bharatarṣabha ॥12॥
html:
na me tvattaḥ priyataro loke'sminpāṇḍunandana ।
tvattaśca me priyatarā brāhmaṇā bharatarṣabha ॥12॥
slp1: na me tvattaH priyataro loke'sminpARqunandana । tvattaSca me priyatarA brAhmaRA BaratarzaBa ॥12॥

text: yathā mama priyatarāstvatto viprāḥ kurūdvaha । tena satyena gaccheyaṃ lokānyatra sa śantanuḥ ॥13॥
html:
yathā mama priyatarāstvatto viprāḥ kurūdvaha ।
tena satyena gaccheyaṃ lokānyatra sa śantanuḥ ॥13॥
slp1: yaTA mama priyatarAstvatto viprAH kurUdvaha । tena satyena gacCeyaM lokAnyatra sa SantanuH ॥13॥

text: na me pitā priyataro brāhmaṇebhyastathābhavat । na me pituḥ pitā vāpi ye cānye'pi suhṛjjanāḥ ॥14॥
html:
na me pitā priyataro brāhmaṇebhyastathābhavat ।
na me pituḥ pitā vāpi ye cānye'pi suhṛjjanāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: na me pitA priyataro brAhmaReByastaTABavat । na me pituH pitA vApi ye cAnye'pi suhfjjanAH ॥14॥

text: na hi me vṛjinaṃ kiñcidvidyate brāhmaṇeṣviha । aṇu vā yadi vā sthūlaṃ viditaṃ sādhukarmabhiḥ ॥15॥
html:
na hi me vṛjinaṃ kiñcidvidyate brāhmaṇeṣviha ।
aṇu vā yadi vā sthūlaṃ viditaṃ sādhukarmabhiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: na hi me vfjinaM kiYcidvidyate brAhmaRezviha । aRu vA yadi vA sTUlaM viditaM sADukarmaBiH ॥15॥

text: karmaṇā manasā vāpi vācā vāpi parantapa । yanme kṛtaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu tenādya na tapāmyaham ॥16॥
html:
karmaṇā manasā vāpi vācā vāpi parantapa ।
yanme kṛtaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu tenādya na tapāmyaham ॥16॥
slp1: karmaRA manasA vApi vAcA vApi parantapa । yanme kftaM brAhmaRezu tenAdya na tapAmyaham ॥16॥

text: brahmaṇya iti māmāhustayā vācāsmi toṣitaḥ । etadeva pavitrebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ paramaṃ smṛtam ॥17॥
html:
brahmaṇya iti māmāhustayā vācāsmi toṣitaḥ ।
etadeva pavitrebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ paramaṃ smṛtam ॥17॥
slp1: brahmaRya iti mAmAhustayA vAcAsmi tozitaH । etadeva pavitreByaH sarveByaH paramaM smftam ॥17॥

text: paśyāmi lokānamalāñchucīnbrāhmaṇayāyinaḥ । teṣu me tāta gantavyamahnāya ca cirāya ca ॥18॥
html:
paśyāmi lokānamalāñchucīnbrāhmaṇayāyinaḥ ।
teṣu me tāta gantavyamahnāya ca cirāya ca ॥18॥
slp1: paSyAmi lokAnamalAYCucInbrAhmaRayAyinaH । tezu me tAta gantavyamahnAya ca cirAya ca ॥18॥

text: yathā patyāśrayo dharmaḥ strīṇāṃ loke yudhiṣṭhira । sa devaḥ sā gatirnānyā kṣatriyasya tathā dvijāḥ ॥19॥
html:
yathā patyāśrayo dharmaḥ strīṇāṃ loke yudhiṣṭhira ।
sa devaḥ sā gatirnānyā kṣatriyasya tathā dvijāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: yaTA patyASrayo DarmaH strIRAM loke yuDizWira । sa devaH sA gatirnAnyA kzatriyasya taTA dvijAH ॥19॥

text: kṣatriyaḥ śatavarṣī ca daśavarṣī ca brāhmaṇaḥ । pitāputrau ca vijñeyau tayorhi brāhmaṇaḥ pitā ॥20॥
html:
kṣatriyaḥ śatavarṣī ca daśavarṣī ca brāhmaṇaḥ ।
pitāputrau ca vijñeyau tayorhi brāhmaṇaḥ pitā ॥20॥
slp1: kzatriyaH SatavarzI ca daSavarzI ca brAhmaRaH । pitAputrO ca vijYeyO tayorhi brAhmaRaH pitA ॥20॥

text: nārī tu patyabhāve vai devaraṃ kurute patim । pṛthivī brāhmaṇālābhe kṣatriyaṃ kurute patim ॥21॥
html:
nārī tu patyabhāve vai devaraṃ kurute patim ।
pṛthivī brāhmaṇālābhe kṣatriyaṃ kurute patim ॥21॥
slp1: nArI tu patyaBAve vE devaraM kurute patim । pfTivI brAhmaRAlABe kzatriyaM kurute patim ॥21॥

text: putravacca tato rakṣyā upāsyā guruvacca te । agnivaccopacaryā vai brāhmaṇāḥ kurusattama ॥22॥
html:
putravacca tato rakṣyā upāsyā guruvacca te ।
agnivaccopacaryā vai brāhmaṇāḥ kurusattama ॥22॥
slp1: putravacca tato rakzyA upAsyA guruvacca te । agnivaccopacaryA vE brAhmaRAH kurusattama ॥22॥

text: ṛjūnsataḥ satyaśīlānsarvabhūtahite ratān । āśīviṣāniva kruddhāndvijānupacaretsadā ॥23॥
html:
ṛjūnsataḥ satyaśīlānsarvabhūtahite ratān ।
āśīviṣāniva kruddhāndvijānupacaretsadā ॥23॥
slp1: fjUnsataH satyaSIlAnsarvaBUtahite ratAn । ASIvizAniva krudDAndvijAnupacaretsadA ॥23॥

text: tejasastapasaścaiva nityaṃ bibhyedyudhiṣṭhira । ubhe caite parityājye tejaścaiva tapastathā ॥24॥
html:
tejasastapasaścaiva nityaṃ bibhyedyudhiṣṭhira ।
ubhe caite parityājye tejaścaiva tapastathā ॥24॥
slp1: tejasastapasaScEva nityaM biByedyuDizWira । uBe cEte parityAjye tejaScEva tapastaTA ॥24॥

text: vyavasāyastayoḥ śīghramubhayoreva vidyate । hanyuḥ kruddhā mahārāja brāhmaṇā ye tapasvinaḥ ॥25॥
html:
vyavasāyastayoḥ śīghramubhayoreva vidyate ।
hanyuḥ kruddhā mahārāja brāhmaṇā ye tapasvinaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: vyavasAyastayoH SIGramuBayoreva vidyate । hanyuH krudDA mahArAja brAhmaRA ye tapasvinaH ॥25॥

text: bhūyaḥ syādubhayaṃ dattaṃ brāhmaṇādyadakopanāt । kuryādubhayataḥśeṣaṃ dattaśeṣaṃ na śeṣayet ॥26॥
html:
bhūyaḥ syādubhayaṃ dattaṃ brāhmaṇādyadakopanāt ।
kuryādubhayataḥśeṣaṃ dattaśeṣaṃ na śeṣayet ॥26॥
slp1: BUyaH syAduBayaM dattaM brAhmaRAdyadakopanAt । kuryAduBayataHSezaM dattaSezaM na Sezayet ॥26॥

text: daṇḍapāṇiryathā goṣu pālo nityaṃ sthiro bhavet । brāhmaṇānbrahma ca tathā kṣatriyaḥ paripālayet ॥27॥
html:
daṇḍapāṇiryathā goṣu pālo nityaṃ sthiro bhavet ।
brāhmaṇānbrahma ca tathā kṣatriyaḥ paripālayet ॥27॥
slp1: daRqapARiryaTA gozu pAlo nityaM sTiro Bavet । brAhmaRAnbrahma ca taTA kzatriyaH paripAlayet ॥27॥

text: piteva putrānrakṣethā brāhmaṇānbrahmatejasaḥ । gṛhe caiṣāmavekṣethāḥ kaccidastīha jīvanam] ॥28॥
html:
piteva putrānrakṣethā brāhmaṇānbrahmatejasaḥ ।
gṛhe caiṣāmavekṣethāḥ kaccidastīha jīvanam] ॥28॥
slp1: piteva putrAnrakzeTA brAhmaRAnbrahmatejasaH । gfhe cEzAmavekzeTAH kaccidastIha jIvanam] ॥28॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ tu ye loke pratiśrutya pitāmaha । na prayacchanti mohātte ke bhavanti mahāmate ॥1॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ tu ye loke pratiśrutya pitāmaha ।
na prayacchanti mohātte ke bhavanti mahāmate ॥1॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM tu ye loke pratiSrutya pitAmaha । na prayacCanti mohAtte ke Bavanti mahAmate ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: etanme tattvato brūhi dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara । pratiśrutya durātmāno na prayacchanti ye narāḥ ॥2॥
html:
etanme tattvato brūhi dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ।
pratiśrutya durātmāno na prayacchanti ye narāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: etanme tattvato brUhi DarmaM DarmaBftAM vara । pratiSrutya durAtmAno na prayacCanti ye narAH ॥2॥

text: yo na dadyātpratiśrutya svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu । āśāstasya hatāḥ sarvāḥ klībasyeva prajāphalam ॥3॥
html:
yo na dadyātpratiśrutya svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu ।
āśāstasya hatāḥ sarvāḥ klībasyeva prajāphalam ॥3॥
slp1: yo na dadyAtpratiSrutya svalpaM vA yadi vA bahu । ASAstasya hatAH sarvAH klIbasyeva prajAPalam ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yāṃ rātriṃ jāyate pāpo yāṃ ca rātriṃ vinaśyati । etasminnantare yadyatsukṛtaṃ tasya bhārata । yacca tasya hutaṃ kiñcitsarvaṃ tasyopahanyate ॥4॥
html:
yāṃ rātriṃ jāyate pāpo yāṃ ca rātriṃ vinaśyati ।
etasminnantare yadyatsukṛtaṃ tasya bhārata ।
yacca tasya hutaṃ kiñcitsarvaṃ tasyopahanyate ॥4॥
slp1: yAM rAtriM jAyate pApo yAM ca rAtriM vinaSyati । etasminnantare yadyatsukftaM tasya BArata । yacca tasya hutaM kiYcitsarvaM tasyopahanyate ॥4॥

text: atraitadvacanaṃ prāhurdharmaśāstravido janāḥ । niśamya bharataśreṣṭha buddhyā paramayuktayā ॥5॥
html:
atraitadvacanaṃ prāhurdharmaśāstravido janāḥ ।
niśamya bharataśreṣṭha buddhyā paramayuktayā ॥5॥
slp1: atrEtadvacanaM prAhurDarmaSAstravido janAH । niSamya BarataSrezWa budDyA paramayuktayA ॥5॥

text: api codāharantīmaṃ dharmaśāstravido janāḥ । aśvānāṃ śyāmakarṇānāṃ sahasreṇa sa mucyate ॥6॥
html:
api codāharantīmaṃ dharmaśāstravido janāḥ ।
aśvānāṃ śyāmakarṇānāṃ sahasreṇa sa mucyate ॥6॥
slp1: api codAharantImaM DarmaSAstravido janAH । aSvAnAM SyAmakarRAnAM sahasreRa sa mucyate ॥6॥

text: atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । sṛgālasya ca saṃvādaṃ vānarasya ca bhārata ॥7॥
html:
atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
sṛgālasya ca saṃvādaṃ vānarasya ca bhārata ॥7॥
slp1: atrEvodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । sfgAlasya ca saMvAdaM vAnarasya ca BArata ॥7॥

text: tau sakhāyau purā hyāstāṃ mānuṣatve parantapa । anyāṃ yoniṃ samāpannau sārgālīṃ vānarīṃ tathā ॥8॥
html:
tau sakhāyau purā hyāstāṃ mānuṣatve parantapa ।
anyāṃ yoniṃ samāpannau sārgālīṃ vānarīṃ tathā ॥8॥
slp1: tO saKAyO purA hyAstAM mAnuzatve parantapa । anyAM yoniM samApannO sArgAlIM vAnarIM taTA ॥8॥

text: tataḥ parāsūnkhādantaṃ sṛgālaṃ vānaro'bravīt । śmaśānamadhye samprekṣya pūrvajātimanusmaran ॥9॥
html:
tataḥ parāsūnkhādantaṃ sṛgālaṃ vānaro'bravīt ।
śmaśānamadhye samprekṣya pūrvajātimanusmaran ॥9॥
slp1: tataH parAsUnKAdantaM sfgAlaM vAnaro'bravIt । SmaSAnamaDye samprekzya pUrvajAtimanusmaran ॥9॥

text: kiṃ tvayā pāpakaṃ karma kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ sudāruṇam । yastvaṃ śmaśāne mṛtakānpūtikānatsi kutsitān ॥10॥
html:
kiṃ tvayā pāpakaṃ karma kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ sudāruṇam ।
yastvaṃ śmaśāne mṛtakānpūtikānatsi kutsitān ॥10॥
slp1: kiM tvayA pApakaM karma kftaM pUrvaM sudAruRam । yastvaM SmaSAne mftakAnpUtikAnatsi kutsitAn ॥10॥

text: evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca sṛgālo vānaraṃ tadā । brāhmaṇasya pratiśrutya na mayā tadupākṛtam ॥11॥
html:
evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca sṛgālo vānaraṃ tadā ।
brāhmaṇasya pratiśrutya na mayā tadupākṛtam ॥11॥
slp1: evamuktaH pratyuvAca sfgAlo vAnaraM tadA । brAhmaRasya pratiSrutya na mayA tadupAkftam ॥11॥

text: tatkṛte pāpikāṃ yonimāpanno'smi plavaṅgama । tasmādevaṃvidhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayāmi bubhukṣitaḥ ॥12॥
html:
tatkṛte pāpikāṃ yonimāpanno'smi plavaṅgama ।
tasmādevaṃvidhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayāmi bubhukṣitaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tatkfte pApikAM yonimApanno'smi plavaNgama । tasmAdevaMviDaM BakzyaM BakzayAmi buBukzitaH ॥12॥

text: ityetadbruvato rājanbrāhmaṇasya mayā śrutam । kathāṃ kathayataḥ puṇyāṃ dharmajñasya purātanīm ॥13॥
html:
ityetadbruvato rājanbrāhmaṇasya mayā śrutam ।
kathāṃ kathayataḥ puṇyāṃ dharmajñasya purātanīm ॥13॥
slp1: ityetadbruvato rAjanbrAhmaRasya mayA Srutam । kaTAM kaTayataH puRyAM DarmajYasya purAtanIm ॥13॥

text: śrutaṃ cāpi mayā bhūyaḥ kṛṣṇasyāpi viśāṃ pate । kathāṃ kathayataḥ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati pāṇḍava ॥14॥
html:
śrutaṃ cāpi mayā bhūyaḥ kṛṣṇasyāpi viśāṃ pate ।
kathāṃ kathayataḥ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati pāṇḍava ॥14॥
slp1: SrutaM cApi mayA BUyaH kfzRasyApi viSAM pate । kaTAM kaTayataH pUrvaM brAhmaRaM prati pARqava ॥14॥

text: evameva ca māṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sandiśanti vai । pratiśrutya bhaveddeyaṃ nāśā kāryā hi brāhmaṇaiḥ ॥15॥
html:
evameva ca māṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sandiśanti vai ।
pratiśrutya bhaveddeyaṃ nāśā kāryā hi brāhmaṇaiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: evameva ca mAM nityaM brAhmaRAH sandiSanti vE । pratiSrutya BaveddeyaM nASA kAryA hi brAhmaREH ॥15॥

text: brāhmaṇo hyāśayā pūrvaṃ kṛtayā pṛthivīpate । susamiddho yathā dīptaḥ pāvakastadvidhaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥16॥
html:
brāhmaṇo hyāśayā pūrvaṃ kṛtayā pṛthivīpate ।
susamiddho yathā dīptaḥ pāvakastadvidhaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: brAhmaRo hyASayA pUrvaM kftayA pfTivIpate । susamidDo yaTA dIptaH pAvakastadviDaH smftaH ॥16॥

text: yaṃ nirīkṣeta saṅkruddha āśayā pūrvajātayā । pradaheta hi taṃ rājankakṣamakṣayyabhugyathā ॥17॥
html:
yaṃ nirīkṣeta saṅkruddha āśayā pūrvajātayā ।
pradaheta hi taṃ rājankakṣamakṣayyabhugyathā ॥17॥
slp1: yaM nirIkzeta saNkrudDa ASayA pUrvajAtayA । pradaheta hi taM rAjankakzamakzayyaBugyaTA ॥17॥

text: sa eva hi yadā tuṣṭo vacasā pratinandati । bhavatyagadasaṅkāśo viṣaye tasya bhārata ॥18॥
html:
sa eva hi yadā tuṣṭo vacasā pratinandati ।
bhavatyagadasaṅkāśo viṣaye tasya bhārata ॥18॥
slp1: sa eva hi yadA tuzwo vacasA pratinandati । BavatyagadasaNkASo vizaye tasya BArata ॥18॥

text: putrānpautrānpaśūṃścaiva bāndhavānsacivāṃstathā । puraṃ janapadaṃ caiva śāntiriṣṭeva puṣyati ॥19॥
html:
putrānpautrānpaśūṃścaiva bāndhavānsacivāṃstathā ।
puraṃ janapadaṃ caiva śāntiriṣṭeva puṣyati ॥19॥
slp1: putrAnpOtrAnpaSUMScEva bAnDavAnsacivAMstaTA । puraM janapadaM cEva SAntirizweva puzyati ॥19॥

text: etaddhi paramaṃ tejo brāhmaṇasyeha dṛśyate । sahasrakiraṇasyeva saviturdharaṇītale ॥20॥
html:
etaddhi paramaṃ tejo brāhmaṇasyeha dṛśyate ।
sahasrakiraṇasyeva saviturdharaṇītale ॥20॥
slp1: etadDi paramaM tejo brAhmaRasyeha dfSyate । sahasrakiraRasyeva saviturDaraRItale ॥20॥

text: tasmāddātavyameveha pratiśrutya yudhiṣṭhira । yadīcchecchobhanāṃ jātiṃ prāptuṃ bharatasattama ॥21॥
html:
tasmāddātavyameveha pratiśrutya yudhiṣṭhira ।
yadīcchecchobhanāṃ jātiṃ prāptuṃ bharatasattama ॥21॥
slp1: tasmAddAtavyameveha pratiSrutya yuDizWira । yadIcCecCoBanAM jAtiM prAptuM Baratasattama ॥21॥

text: brāhmaṇasya hi dattena dhruvaṃ svargo hyanuttamaḥ । śakyaṃ prāptuṃ viśeṣeṇa dānaṃ hi mahatī kriyā ॥22॥
html:
brāhmaṇasya hi dattena dhruvaṃ svargo hyanuttamaḥ ।
śakyaṃ prāptuṃ viśeṣeṇa dānaṃ hi mahatī kriyā ॥22॥
slp1: brAhmaRasya hi dattena DruvaM svargo hyanuttamaH । SakyaM prAptuM viSezeRa dAnaM hi mahatI kriyA ॥22॥

text: ito dattena jīvanti devatāḥ pitarastathā । tasmāddānāni deyāni brāhmaṇebhyo vijānatā ॥23॥
html:
ito dattena jīvanti devatāḥ pitarastathā ।
tasmāddānāni deyāni brāhmaṇebhyo vijānatā ॥23॥
slp1: ito dattena jIvanti devatAH pitarastaTA । tasmAddAnAni deyAni brAhmaReByo vijAnatA ॥23॥

text: mahaddhi bharataśreṣṭha brāhmaṇastīrthamucyate । velāyāṃ na tu kasyāñcidgacchedvipro hyapūjitaḥ] ॥24॥
html:
mahaddhi bharataśreṣṭha brāhmaṇastīrthamucyate ।
velāyāṃ na tu kasyāñcidgacchedvipro hyapūjitaḥ] ॥24॥
slp1: mahadDi BarataSrezWa brAhmaRastIrTamucyate । velAyAM na tu kasyAYcidgacCedvipro hyapUjitaH] ॥24॥

text: mitrasauhṛdabhāvena upadeśaṃ karoti yaḥ । jātyāvarasya rājarṣe doṣastasya bhavenna vā ॥1॥
html:
mitrasauhṛdabhāvena upadeśaṃ karoti yaḥ ।
jātyāvarasya rājarṣe doṣastasya bhavenna vā ॥1॥
slp1: mitrasOhfdaBAvena upadeSaM karoti yaH । jAtyAvarasya rAjarze dozastasya Bavenna vA ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: etadicchāmi tattvena vyākhyātuṃ vai pitāmaha । sūkṣmā gatirhi dharmasya yatra muhyanti mānavāḥ ॥2॥
html:
etadicchāmi tattvena vyākhyātuṃ vai pitāmaha ।
sūkṣmā gatirhi dharmasya yatra muhyanti mānavāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: etadicCAmi tattvena vyAKyAtuM vE pitAmaha । sUkzmA gatirhi Darmasya yatra muhyanti mAnavAH ॥2॥

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi śṛṇu rājanyathāgamam । ṛṣīṇāṃ vadatāṃ pūrvaṃ śrutamāsīdyathā mayā ॥3॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi śṛṇu rājanyathāgamam ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ vadatāṃ pūrvaṃ śrutamāsīdyathā mayā ॥3॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi SfRu rAjanyaTAgamam । fzIRAM vadatAM pUrvaM SrutamAsIdyaTA mayA ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: upadeśo na kartavyo jātihīnasya kasyacit । upadeśe mahāndoṣa upādhyāyasya bhāṣyate ॥4॥
html:
upadeśo na kartavyo jātihīnasya kasyacit ।
upadeśe mahāndoṣa upādhyāyasya bhāṣyate ॥4॥
slp1: upadeSo na kartavyo jAtihInasya kasyacit । upadeSe mahAndoza upADyAyasya BAzyate ॥4॥

text: nidarśanamidaṃ rājañśṛṇu me bharatarṣabha । duruktavacane rājanyathā pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । brahmāśramapade vṛttaṃ pārśve himavataḥ śubhe ॥5॥
html:
nidarśanamidaṃ rājañśṛṇu me bharatarṣabha ।
duruktavacane rājanyathā pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
brahmāśramapade vṛttaṃ pārśve himavataḥ śubhe ॥5॥
slp1: nidarSanamidaM rAjaYSfRu me BaratarzaBa । duruktavacane rAjanyaTA pUrvaM yuDizWira । brahmASramapade vfttaM pArSve himavataH SuBe ॥5॥

text: tatrāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ nānāvṛkṣagaṇāyutam । bahugulmalatākīrṇaṃ mṛgadvijaniṣevitam ॥6॥
html:
tatrāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ nānāvṛkṣagaṇāyutam ।
bahugulmalatākīrṇaṃ mṛgadvijaniṣevitam ॥6॥
slp1: tatrASramapadaM puRyaM nAnAvfkzagaRAyutam । bahugulmalatAkIrRaM mfgadvijanizevitam ॥6॥

text: siddhacāraṇasaṅghuṣṭaṃ ramyaṃ puṣpitakānanam । vratibhirbahubhiḥ kīrṇaṃ tāpasairupaśobhitam ॥7॥
html:
siddhacāraṇasaṅghuṣṭaṃ ramyaṃ puṣpitakānanam ।
vratibhirbahubhiḥ kīrṇaṃ tāpasairupaśobhitam ॥7॥
slp1: sidDacAraRasaNGuzwaM ramyaM puzpitakAnanam । vratiBirbahuBiH kIrRaM tApasErupaSoBitam ॥7॥

text: brāhmaṇaiśca mahābhāgaiḥ sūryajvalanasannibhaiḥ । niyamavratasampannaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ tapasvibhiḥ । dīkṣitairbharataśreṣṭha yatāhāraiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥8॥
html:
brāhmaṇaiśca mahābhāgaiḥ sūryajvalanasannibhaiḥ ।
niyamavratasampannaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ tapasvibhiḥ ।
dīkṣitairbharataśreṣṭha yatāhāraiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: brAhmaRESca mahABAgEH sUryajvalanasanniBEH । niyamavratasampannEH samAkIrRaM tapasviBiH । dIkzitErBarataSrezWa yatAhArEH kftAtmaBiH ॥8॥

text: vedādhyayanaghoṣaiśca nāditaṃ bharatarṣabha । vālakhilyaiśca bahubhiryatibhiśca niṣevitam ॥9॥
html:
vedādhyayanaghoṣaiśca nāditaṃ bharatarṣabha ।
vālakhilyaiśca bahubhiryatibhiśca niṣevitam ॥9॥
slp1: vedADyayanaGozESca nAditaM BaratarzaBa । vAlaKilyESca bahuBiryatiBiSca nizevitam ॥9॥

text: tatra kaścitsamutsāhaṃ kṛtvā śūdro dayānvitaḥ । āgato hyāśramapadaṃ pūjitaśca tapasvibhiḥ ॥10॥
html:
tatra kaścitsamutsāhaṃ kṛtvā śūdro dayānvitaḥ ।
āgato hyāśramapadaṃ pūjitaśca tapasvibhiḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tatra kaScitsamutsAhaM kftvA SUdro dayAnvitaH । Agato hyASramapadaM pUjitaSca tapasviBiH ॥10॥

text: tāṃstu dṛṣṭvā munigaṇāndevakalpānmahaujasaḥ । vahato vividhā dīkṣāḥ samprahṛṣyata bhārata ॥11॥
html:
tāṃstu dṛṣṭvā munigaṇāndevakalpānmahaujasaḥ ।
vahato vividhā dīkṣāḥ samprahṛṣyata bhārata ॥11॥
slp1: tAMstu dfzwvA munigaRAndevakalpAnmahOjasaH । vahato viviDA dIkzAH samprahfzyata BArata ॥11॥

text: athāsya buddhirabhavattapasye bharatarṣabha । tato'bravītkulapatiṃ pādau saṅgṛhya bhārata ॥12॥
html:
athāsya buddhirabhavattapasye bharatarṣabha ।
tato'bravītkulapatiṃ pādau saṅgṛhya bhārata ॥12॥
slp1: aTAsya budDiraBavattapasye BaratarzaBa । tato'bravItkulapatiM pAdO saNgfhya BArata ॥12॥

text: bhavatprasādādicchāmi dharmaṃ cartuṃ dvijarṣabha । tanmāṃ tvaṃ bhagavanvaktuṃ pravrājayitumarhasi ॥13॥
html:
bhavatprasādādicchāmi dharmaṃ cartuṃ dvijarṣabha ।
tanmāṃ tvaṃ bhagavanvaktuṃ pravrājayitumarhasi ॥13॥
slp1: BavatprasAdAdicCAmi DarmaM cartuM dvijarzaBa । tanmAM tvaM BagavanvaktuM pravrAjayitumarhasi ॥13॥

text: varṇāvaro'haṃ bhagavañśūdro jātyāsmi sattama । śuśrūṣāṃ kartumicchāmi prapannāya prasīda me ॥14॥
html:
varṇāvaro'haṃ bhagavañśūdro jātyāsmi sattama ।
śuśrūṣāṃ kartumicchāmi prapannāya prasīda me ॥14॥
slp1: varRAvaro'haM BagavaYSUdro jAtyAsmi sattama । SuSrUzAM kartumicCAmi prapannAya prasIda me ॥14॥

text: na śakyamiha śūdreṇa liṅgamāśritya vartitum । āsyatāṃ yadi te buddhiḥ śuśrūṣānirato bhava ॥15॥
html:
na śakyamiha śūdreṇa liṅgamāśritya vartitum ।
āsyatāṃ yadi te buddhiḥ śuśrūṣānirato bhava ॥15॥
slp1: na Sakyamiha SUdreRa liNgamASritya vartitum । AsyatAM yadi te budDiH SuSrUzAnirato Bava ॥15॥
author: kulapatiruvāca ।

text: evamuktastu muninā sa śūdro'cintayannṛpa । kathamatra mayā kāryaṃ śraddhā dharme parā ca me । vijñātamevaṃ bhavatu kariṣye priyamātmanaḥ ॥16॥
html:
evamuktastu muninā sa śūdro'cintayannṛpa ।
kathamatra mayā kāryaṃ śraddhā dharme parā ca me ।
vijñātamevaṃ bhavatu kariṣye priyamātmanaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: evamuktastu muninA sa SUdro'cintayannfpa । kaTamatra mayA kAryaM SradDA Darme parA ca me । vijYAtamevaM Bavatu karizye priyamAtmanaH ॥16॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: gatvāśramapadāddūramuṭajaṃ kṛtavāṃstu saḥ । tatra vediṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca devatāyatanāni ca । niveśya bharataśreṣṭha niyamastho'bhavatsukham ॥17॥
html:
gatvāśramapadāddūramuṭajaṃ kṛtavāṃstu saḥ ।
tatra vediṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca devatāyatanāni ca ।
niveśya bharataśreṣṭha niyamastho'bhavatsukham ॥17॥
slp1: gatvASramapadAddUramuwajaM kftavAMstu saH । tatra vediM ca BUmiM ca devatAyatanAni ca । niveSya BarataSrezWa niyamasTo'BavatsuKam ॥17॥

text: abhiṣekāṃśca niyamāndevatāyataneṣu ca । baliṃ ca kṛtvā hutvā ca devatāṃ cāpyapūjayat ॥18॥
html:
abhiṣekāṃśca niyamāndevatāyataneṣu ca ।
baliṃ ca kṛtvā hutvā ca devatāṃ cāpyapūjayat ॥18॥
slp1: aBizekAMSca niyamAndevatAyatanezu ca । baliM ca kftvA hutvA ca devatAM cApyapUjayat ॥18॥

text: saṅkalpaniyamopetaḥ phalāhāro jitendriyaḥ । nityaṃ sannihitābhiśca oṣadhībhiḥ phalaistathā ॥19॥
html:
saṅkalpaniyamopetaḥ phalāhāro jitendriyaḥ ।
nityaṃ sannihitābhiśca oṣadhībhiḥ phalaistathā ॥19॥
slp1: saNkalpaniyamopetaH PalAhAro jitendriyaH । nityaM sannihitABiSca ozaDIBiH PalEstaTA ॥19॥

text: atithīnpūjayāmāsa yathāvatsamupāgatān । evaṃ hi sumahānkālo vyatyakrāmatsa tasya vai ॥20॥
html:
atithīnpūjayāmāsa yathāvatsamupāgatān ।
evaṃ hi sumahānkālo vyatyakrāmatsa tasya vai ॥20॥
slp1: atiTInpUjayAmAsa yaTAvatsamupAgatAn । evaM hi sumahAnkAlo vyatyakrAmatsa tasya vE ॥20॥

text: athāsya munirāgacchatsaṅgatyā vai tamāśramam । sampūjya svāgatenarṣiṃ vidhivatparyatoṣayat ॥21॥
html:
athāsya munirāgacchatsaṅgatyā vai tamāśramam ।
sampūjya svāgatenarṣiṃ vidhivatparyatoṣayat ॥21॥
slp1: aTAsya munirAgacCatsaNgatyA vE tamASramam । sampUjya svAgatenarziM viDivatparyatozayat ॥21॥

text: anukūlāḥ kathāḥ kṛtvā yathāvatparyapṛcchata । ṛṣiḥ paramatejasvī dharmātmā saṃyatendriyaḥ ॥22॥
html:
anukūlāḥ kathāḥ kṛtvā yathāvatparyapṛcchata ।
ṛṣiḥ paramatejasvī dharmātmā saṃyatendriyaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: anukUlAH kaTAH kftvA yaTAvatparyapfcCata । fziH paramatejasvI DarmAtmA saMyatendriyaH ॥22॥

text: evaṃ sa bahuśastasya śūdrasya bharatarṣabha । so'gacchadāśramamṛṣiḥ śūdraṃ draṣṭuṃ nararṣabha ॥23॥
html:
evaṃ sa bahuśastasya śūdrasya bharatarṣabha ।
so'gacchadāśramamṛṣiḥ śūdraṃ draṣṭuṃ nararṣabha ॥23॥
slp1: evaM sa bahuSastasya SUdrasya BaratarzaBa । so'gacCadASramamfziH SUdraM drazwuM nararzaBa ॥23॥

text: atha taṃ tāpasaṃ śūdraḥ so'bravīdbharatarṣabha । pitṛkāryaṃ kariṣyāmi tatra me'nugrahaṃ kuru ॥24॥
html:
atha taṃ tāpasaṃ śūdraḥ so'bravīdbharatarṣabha ।
pitṛkāryaṃ kariṣyāmi tatra me'nugrahaṃ kuru ॥24॥
slp1: aTa taM tApasaM SUdraH so'bravIdBaratarzaBa । pitfkAryaM karizyAmi tatra me'nugrahaM kuru ॥24॥

text: bāḍhamityeva taṃ vipra uvāca bharatarṣabha । śucirbhūtvā sa śūdrastu tasyarṣeḥ pādyamānayat ॥25॥
html:
bāḍhamityeva taṃ vipra uvāca bharatarṣabha ।
śucirbhūtvā sa śūdrastu tasyarṣeḥ pādyamānayat ॥25॥
slp1: bAQamityeva taM vipra uvAca BaratarzaBa । SucirBUtvA sa SUdrastu tasyarzeH pAdyamAnayat ॥25॥

text: atha darbhāṃśca vanyāśca oṣadhīrbharatarṣabha । pavitramāsanaṃ caiva bṛsīṃ ca samupānayat ॥26॥
html:
atha darbhāṃśca vanyāśca oṣadhīrbharatarṣabha ।
pavitramāsanaṃ caiva bṛsīṃ ca samupānayat ॥26॥
slp1: aTa darBAMSca vanyASca ozaDIrBaratarzaBa । pavitramAsanaM cEva bfsIM ca samupAnayat ॥26॥

text: atha dakṣiṇamāvṛtya bṛsīṃ paramaśīrṣikām । kṛtāmanyāyato dṛṣṭvā tatastamṛṣirabravīt ॥27॥
html:
atha dakṣiṇamāvṛtya bṛsīṃ paramaśīrṣikām ।
kṛtāmanyāyato dṛṣṭvā tatastamṛṣirabravīt ॥27॥
slp1: aTa dakziRamAvftya bfsIM paramaSIrzikAm । kftAmanyAyato dfzwvA tatastamfzirabravIt ॥27॥

text: kuruṣvaitāṃ pūrvaśīrṣāṃ bhava codaṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ । sa ca tatkṛtavāñśūdraḥ sarvaṃ yadṛṣirabravīt ॥28॥
html:
kuruṣvaitāṃ pūrvaśīrṣāṃ bhava codaṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ ।
sa ca tatkṛtavāñśūdraḥ sarvaṃ yadṛṣirabravīt ॥28॥
slp1: kuruzvEtAM pUrvaSIrzAM Bava codaNmuKaH SuciH । sa ca tatkftavAYSUdraH sarvaM yadfzirabravIt ॥28॥

text: yathopadiṣṭaṃ medhāvī darbhādīṃstānyathātatham । havyakavyavidhiṃ kṛtsnamuktaṃ tena tapasvinā ॥29॥
html:
yathopadiṣṭaṃ medhāvī darbhādīṃstānyathātatham ।
havyakavyavidhiṃ kṛtsnamuktaṃ tena tapasvinā ॥29॥
slp1: yaTopadizwaM meDAvI darBAdIMstAnyaTAtaTam । havyakavyaviDiM kftsnamuktaM tena tapasvinA ॥29॥

text: ṛṣiṇā pitṛkārye ca sa ca dharmapathe sthitaḥ । pitṛkārye kṛte cāpi visṛṣṭaḥ sa jagāma ha ॥30॥
html:
ṛṣiṇā pitṛkārye ca sa ca dharmapathe sthitaḥ ।
pitṛkārye kṛte cāpi visṛṣṭaḥ sa jagāma ha ॥30॥
slp1: fziRA pitfkArye ca sa ca DarmapaTe sTitaH । pitfkArye kfte cApi visfzwaH sa jagAma ha ॥30॥

text: atha dīrghasya kālasya sa tapyañśūdratāpasaḥ । vane pañcatvamagamatsukṛtena ca tena vai । ajāyata mahārājarājavaṃśe mahādyutiḥ ॥31॥
html:
atha dīrghasya kālasya sa tapyañśūdratāpasaḥ ।
vane pañcatvamagamatsukṛtena ca tena vai ।
ajāyata mahārājarājavaṃśe mahādyutiḥ ॥31॥
slp1: aTa dIrGasya kAlasya sa tapyaYSUdratApasaH । vane paYcatvamagamatsukftena ca tena vE । ajAyata mahArAjarAjavaMSe mahAdyutiH ॥31॥

text: tathaiva sa ṛṣistāta kāladharmamavāpya ha । purohitakule vipra ājāto bharatarṣabha ॥32॥
html:
tathaiva sa ṛṣistāta kāladharmamavāpya ha ।
purohitakule vipra ājāto bharatarṣabha ॥32॥
slp1: taTEva sa fzistAta kAlaDarmamavApya ha । purohitakule vipra AjAto BaratarzaBa ॥32॥

text: evaṃ tau tatra sambhūtāvubhau śūdramunī tadā । krameṇa vardhitau cāpi vidyāsu kuśalāvubhau ॥33॥
html:
evaṃ tau tatra sambhūtāvubhau śūdramunī tadā ।
krameṇa vardhitau cāpi vidyāsu kuśalāvubhau ॥33॥
slp1: evaM tO tatra samBUtAvuBO SUdramunI tadA । krameRa varDitO cApi vidyAsu kuSalAvuBO ॥33॥

text: atharvavede vede ca babhūvarṣiḥ suniścitaḥ । kalpaprayoge cotpanne jyotiṣe ca paraṃ gataḥ । sakhye cāpi parā prītistayoścāpi vyavardhata ॥34॥
html:
atharvavede vede ca babhūvarṣiḥ suniścitaḥ ।
kalpaprayoge cotpanne jyotiṣe ca paraṃ gataḥ ।
sakhye cāpi parā prītistayoścāpi vyavardhata ॥34॥
slp1: aTarvavede vede ca baBUvarziH suniScitaH । kalpaprayoge cotpanne jyotize ca paraM gataH । saKye cApi parA prItistayoScApi vyavarData ॥34॥

text: pitaryuparate cāpi kṛtaśaucaḥ sa bhārata । abhiṣiktaḥ prakṛtibhī rājaputraḥ sa pārthivaḥ । abhiṣiktena sa ṛṣirabhiṣiktaḥ purohitaḥ ॥35॥
html:
pitaryuparate cāpi kṛtaśaucaḥ sa bhārata ।
abhiṣiktaḥ prakṛtibhī rājaputraḥ sa pārthivaḥ ।
abhiṣiktena sa ṛṣirabhiṣiktaḥ purohitaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: pitaryuparate cApi kftaSOcaH sa BArata । aBiziktaH prakftiBI rAjaputraH sa pArTivaH । aBiziktena sa fziraBiziktaH purohitaH ॥35॥

text: sa taṃ purodhāya sukhamavasadbharatarṣabha । rājyaṃ śaśāsa dharmeṇa prajāśca paripālayan ॥36॥
html:
sa taṃ purodhāya sukhamavasadbharatarṣabha ।
rājyaṃ śaśāsa dharmeṇa prajāśca paripālayan ॥36॥
slp1: sa taM puroDAya suKamavasadBaratarzaBa । rAjyaM SaSAsa DarmeRa prajASca paripAlayan ॥36॥

text: puṇyāhavācane nityaṃ dharmakāryeṣu cāsakṛt । utsmayanprāhasaccāpi dṛṣṭvā rājā purohitam । evaṃ sa bahuśo rājanpurodhasamupāhasat ॥37॥
html:
puṇyāhavācane nityaṃ dharmakāryeṣu cāsakṛt ।
utsmayanprāhasaccāpi dṛṣṭvā rājā purohitam ।
evaṃ sa bahuśo rājanpurodhasamupāhasat ॥37॥
slp1: puRyAhavAcane nityaM DarmakAryezu cAsakft । utsmayanprAhasaccApi dfzwvA rAjA purohitam । evaM sa bahuSo rAjanpuroDasamupAhasat ॥37॥

text: lakṣayitvā purodhāstu bahuśastaṃ narādhipam । utsmayantaṃ ca satataṃ dṛṣṭvāsau manyumānabhūt ॥38॥
html:
lakṣayitvā purodhāstu bahuśastaṃ narādhipam ।
utsmayantaṃ ca satataṃ dṛṣṭvāsau manyumānabhūt ॥38॥
slp1: lakzayitvA puroDAstu bahuSastaM narADipam । utsmayantaM ca satataM dfzwvAsO manyumAnaBUt ॥38॥

text: atha śūnye purodhāstu saha rājñā samāgataḥ । kathābhiranukūlābhī rājānamabhirāmayat ॥39॥
html:
atha śūnye purodhāstu saha rājñā samāgataḥ ।
kathābhiranukūlābhī rājānamabhirāmayat ॥39॥
slp1: aTa SUnye puroDAstu saha rAjYA samAgataH । kaTABiranukUlABI rAjAnamaBirAmayat ॥39॥

text: tato'bravīnnarendraṃ sa purodhā bharatarṣabha । varamicchāmyahaṃ tvekaṃ tvayā dattaṃ mahādyute ॥40॥
html:
tato'bravīnnarendraṃ sa purodhā bharatarṣabha ।
varamicchāmyahaṃ tvekaṃ tvayā dattaṃ mahādyute ॥40॥
slp1: tato'bravInnarendraM sa puroDA BaratarzaBa । varamicCAmyahaM tvekaM tvayA dattaM mahAdyute ॥40॥

text: varāṇāṃ te śataṃ dadyāṃ kimutaikaṃ dvijottama । snehācca bahumānācca nāstyadeyaṃ hi me tava ॥41॥
html:
varāṇāṃ te śataṃ dadyāṃ kimutaikaṃ dvijottama ।
snehācca bahumānācca nāstyadeyaṃ hi me tava ॥41॥
slp1: varARAM te SataM dadyAM kimutEkaM dvijottama । snehAcca bahumAnAcca nAstyadeyaM hi me tava ॥41॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: ekaṃ vai varamicchāmi yadi tuṣṭo'si pārthiva । yaddadāsi mahārāja satyaṃ tadvada mānṛtam ॥42॥
html:
ekaṃ vai varamicchāmi yadi tuṣṭo'si pārthiva ।
yaddadāsi mahārāja satyaṃ tadvada mānṛtam ॥42॥
slp1: ekaM vE varamicCAmi yadi tuzwo'si pArTiva । yaddadAsi mahArAja satyaM tadvada mAnftam ॥42॥
author: purohita uvāca ।

text: bāḍhamityeva taṃ rājā pratyuvāca yudhiṣṭhira । yadi jñāsyāmi vakṣyāmi ajānanna tu saṃvade ॥43॥
html:
bāḍhamityeva taṃ rājā pratyuvāca yudhiṣṭhira ।
yadi jñāsyāmi vakṣyāmi ajānanna tu saṃvade ॥43॥
slp1: bAQamityeva taM rAjA pratyuvAca yuDizWira । yadi jYAsyAmi vakzyAmi ajAnanna tu saMvade ॥43॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: puṇyāhavācane nityaṃ dharmakṛtyeṣu cāsakṛt । śāntihomeṣu ca sadā kiṃ tvaṃ hasasi vīkṣya mām ॥44॥
html:
puṇyāhavācane nityaṃ dharmakṛtyeṣu cāsakṛt ।
śāntihomeṣu ca sadā kiṃ tvaṃ hasasi vīkṣya mām ॥44॥
slp1: puRyAhavAcane nityaM Darmakftyezu cAsakft । SAntihomezu ca sadA kiM tvaM hasasi vIkzya mAm ॥44॥
author: purohita uvāca ।

text: savrīḍaṃ vai bhavati hi mano me hasatā tvayā । kāmayā śāpito rājannānyathā vaktumarhasi ॥45॥
html:
savrīḍaṃ vai bhavati hi mano me hasatā tvayā ।
kāmayā śāpito rājannānyathā vaktumarhasi ॥45॥
slp1: savrIqaM vE Bavati hi mano me hasatA tvayA । kAmayA SApito rAjannAnyaTA vaktumarhasi ॥45॥

text: bhāvyaṃ hi kāraṇenātra na te hāsyamakāraṇam । kautūhalaṃ me subhṛśaṃ tattvena kathayasva me ॥46॥
html:
bhāvyaṃ hi kāraṇenātra na te hāsyamakāraṇam ।

śaileṣu goṣṭheṣu tathā vaneṣu saraḥsu phullotpalapaṅkajeṣu ।
nadīṣu haṃsasvananāditāsu krauñcāvaghuṣṭasvaraśobhitāsu ॥15॥

text: vistīrṇakūlahradaśobhitāsu tapasvisiddhadvijasevitāsu । vasāmi nityaṃ subahūdakāsu siṃhairgajaiścākulitodakāsu । matte gaje govṛṣabhe narendre siṃhāsane satpuruṣe ca nityam ॥16॥

text: yasmingṛhe hūyate havyavāho gobrāhmaṇaścārcyate devatāśca । kāle ca puṣpairbalayaḥ kriyante tasmingṛhe nityamupaimi vāsam ॥17॥
html:

text: svādhyāyanityeṣu dvijeṣu nityaṃ kṣatre ca dharmābhirate sadaiva । vaiśye ca kṛṣyābhirate vasāmi śūdre ca śuśrūṣaṇanityayukte ॥18॥
html:

vaiśye ca kṛṣyābhirate vasāmi śūdre ca śuśrūṣaṇanityayukte ॥18॥

text: nārāyaṇe tvekamanā vasāmi sarveṇa bhāvena śarīrabhūtā । tasminhi dharmaḥ sumahānniviṣṭo brahmaṇyatā cātra tathā priyatvam ॥19॥

nārāyaṇe tvekamanā vasāmi sarveṇa bhāvena śarīrabhūtā ।
tasminhi dharmaḥ sumahānniviṣṭo brahmaṇyatā cātra tathā priyatvam ॥19॥
slp1: nArAyaRe tvekamanA vasAmi sarveRa BAvena SarIraBUtA । tasminhi DarmaH sumahAnnivizwo brahmaRyatA cAtra taTA priyatvam ॥19॥

text: nāhaṃ śarīreṇa vasāmi devi naivaṃ mayā śakyamihābhidhātum । yasmiṃstu bhāvena vasāmi puṃsi sa vardhate dharmayaśorthakāmaiḥ] ॥20॥

text: strīpuṃsayoḥ samprayoge sparśaḥ kasyādhiko bhavet । etanme saṃśayaṃ rājanyathāvadvaktumarhasi ॥1॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । bhaṅgāśvanena śakrasya yathā vairamabhūtpurā ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
bhaṅgāśvanena śakrasya yathā vairamabhūtpurā ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । BaNgASvanena Sakrasya yaTA vEramaBUtpurA ॥2॥

text: purā bhaṅgāśvano nāma rājarṣiratidhārmikaḥ । aputraḥ sa naravyāghra putrārthaṃ yajñamāharat ॥3॥
html:
purā bhaṅgāśvano nāma rājarṣiratidhārmikaḥ ।
aputraḥ sa naravyāghra putrārthaṃ yajñamāharat ॥3॥
slp1: purA BaNgASvano nAma rAjarziratiDArmikaH । aputraH sa naravyAGra putrArTaM yajYamAharat ॥3॥

text: agniṣṭuṃ nāma rājarṣirindradviṣṭaṃ mahābalaḥ । prāyaścitteṣu martyānāṃ putrakāmasya ceṣyate ॥4॥
html:
agniṣṭuṃ nāma rājarṣirindradviṣṭaṃ mahābalaḥ ।
prāyaścitteṣu martyānāṃ putrakāmasya ceṣyate ॥4॥
slp1: agnizwuM nAma rAjarzirindradvizwaM mahAbalaH । prAyaScittezu martyAnAM putrakAmasya cezyate ॥4॥

text: indro jñātvā tu taṃ yajñaṃ mahābhāgaḥ sureśvaraḥ । antaraṃ tasya rājarṣeranvicchanniyatātmanaḥ ॥5॥
html:
indro jñātvā tu taṃ yajñaṃ mahābhāgaḥ sureśvaraḥ ।
antaraṃ tasya rājarṣeranvicchanniyatātmanaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: indro jYAtvA tu taM yajYaM mahABAgaH sureSvaraH । antaraM tasya rAjarzeranvicCanniyatAtmanaH ॥5॥

text: kasyacittvatha kālasya mṛgayāmaṭato nṛpa । idamantaramityeva śakro nṛpamamohayat ॥6॥
html:
kasyacittvatha kālasya mṛgayāmaṭato nṛpa ।
idamantaramityeva śakro nṛpamamohayat ॥6॥
slp1: kasyacittvaTa kAlasya mfgayAmawato nfpa । idamantaramityeva Sakro nfpamamohayat ॥6॥

text: ekāśvena ca rājarṣirbhrānta indreṇa mohitaḥ । na diśo'vindata nṛpaḥ kṣutpipāsārditastadā ॥7॥
html:
ekāśvena ca rājarṣirbhrānta indreṇa mohitaḥ ।
na diśo'vindata nṛpaḥ kṣutpipāsārditastadā ॥7॥
slp1: ekASvena ca rAjarzirBrAnta indreRa mohitaH । na diSo'vindata nfpaH kzutpipAsArditastadA ॥7॥

text: itaścetaśca vai dhāvañśramatṛṣṇārdito nṛpaḥ । saro'paśyatsuruciraṃ pūrṇaṃ paramavāriṇā । so'vagāhya sarastāta pāyayāmāsa vājinam ॥8॥
html:
itaścetaśca vai dhāvañśramatṛṣṇārdito nṛpaḥ ।
saro'paśyatsuruciraṃ pūrṇaṃ paramavāriṇā ।
so'vagāhya sarastāta pāyayāmāsa vājinam ॥8॥
slp1: itaScetaSca vE DAvaYSramatfzRArdito nfpaH । saro'paSyatsuruciraM pUrRaM paramavAriRA । so'vagAhya sarastAta pAyayAmAsa vAjinam ॥8॥

text: atha pītodakaṃ so'śvaṃ vṛkṣe baddhvā nṛpottamaḥ । avagāhya tataḥ snāto rājā strītvamavāpa ha ॥9॥
html:
atha pītodakaṃ so'śvaṃ vṛkṣe baddhvā nṛpottamaḥ ।
avagāhya tataḥ snāto rājā strītvamavāpa ha ॥9॥
slp1: aTa pItodakaM so'SvaM vfkze badDvA nfpottamaH । avagAhya tataH snAto rAjA strItvamavApa ha ॥9॥

text: ātmānaṃ strīkṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā vrīḍito nṛpasattamaḥ । cintānugatasarvātmā vyākulendriyacetanaḥ ॥10॥
html:
ātmānaṃ strīkṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā vrīḍito nṛpasattamaḥ ।
cintānugatasarvātmā vyākulendriyacetanaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: AtmAnaM strIkftaM dfzwvA vrIqito nfpasattamaH । cintAnugatasarvAtmA vyAkulendriyacetanaH ॥10॥

text: ārohiṣye kathaṃ tvaśvaṃ kathaṃ yāsyāmi vai puram । agniṣṭuṃ nāma iṣṭaṃ me putrāṇāṃ śatamaurasam ॥11॥
html:
ārohiṣye kathaṃ tvaśvaṃ kathaṃ yāsyāmi vai puram ।
agniṣṭuṃ nāma iṣṭaṃ me putrāṇāṃ śatamaurasam ॥11॥
slp1: Arohizye kaTaM tvaSvaM kaTaM yAsyAmi vE puram । agnizwuM nAma izwaM me putrARAM SatamOrasam ॥11॥

text: jātaṃ mahābalānāṃ vai tānpravakṣyāmi kiṃ tvaham । dāreṣu cāsmadīyeṣu paurajānapadeṣu ca ॥12॥
html:
jātaṃ mahābalānāṃ vai tānpravakṣyāmi kiṃ tvaham ।
dāreṣu cāsmadīyeṣu paurajānapadeṣu ca ॥12॥
slp1: jAtaM mahAbalAnAM vE tAnpravakzyAmi kiM tvaham । dArezu cAsmadIyezu pOrajAnapadezu ca ॥12॥

text: mṛdutvaṃ ca tanutvaṃ ca viklavatvaṃ tathaiva ca । strīguṇā ṛṣibhiḥ proktā dharmatattvārthadarśibhiḥ । vyāyāmaḥ karkaśatvaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca puruṣe guṇāḥ ॥13॥
html:
mṛdutvaṃ ca tanutvaṃ ca viklavatvaṃ tathaiva ca ।
strīguṇā ṛṣibhiḥ proktā dharmatattvārthadarśibhiḥ ।
vyāyāmaḥ karkaśatvaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca puruṣe guṇāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: mfdutvaM ca tanutvaM ca viklavatvaM taTEva ca । strIguRA fziBiH proktA DarmatattvArTadarSiBiH । vyAyAmaH karkaSatvaM ca vIryaM ca puruze guRAH ॥13॥

text: pauruṣaṃ vipranaṣṭaṃ me strītvaṃ kenāpi me'bhavat । strībhāvātkathamaśvaṃ tu punarāroḍhumutsahe ॥14॥
html:
pauruṣaṃ vipranaṣṭaṃ me strītvaṃ kenāpi me'bhavat ।

text: mahatā tvatha khedena āruhyāśvaṃ narādhipaḥ । punarāyātpuraṃ tāta strībhūto nṛpasattama ॥15॥

mahatā tvatha khedena āruhyāśvaṃ narādhipaḥ ।

text: putrā dārāśca bhṛtyāśca paurajānapadāśca te । kiṃ nvidaṃ tviti vijñāya vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ॥16॥
html:

text: athovāca sa rājarṣiḥ strībhūto vadatāṃ varaḥ । mṛgayāmasmi niryāto balaiḥ parivṛto dṛḍham । udbhrāntaḥ prāviśaṃ ghorāmaṭavīṃ daivamohitaḥ ॥17॥
html:

mṛgayāmasmi niryāto balaiḥ parivṛto dṛḍham ।
udbhrāntaḥ prāviśaṃ ghorāmaṭavīṃ daivamohitaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: aTovAca sa rAjarziH strIBUto vadatAM varaH । mfgayAmasmi niryAto balEH parivfto dfQam । udBrAntaH prAviSaM GorAmawavIM dEvamohitaH ॥17॥

text: aṭavyāṃ ca sughorāyāṃ tṛṣṇārto naṣṭacetanaḥ । saraḥ suruciraprakhyamapaśyaṃ pakṣibhirvṛtam ॥18॥
html:
aṭavyāṃ ca sughorāyāṃ tṛṣṇārto naṣṭacetanaḥ ।
saraḥ suruciraprakhyamapaśyaṃ pakṣibhirvṛtam ॥18॥

text: tatrāvagāḍhaḥ strībhūto vyaktaṃ daivānna saṃśayaḥ । atṛpta iva putrāṇāṃ dārāṇāṃ ca dhanasya ca ॥19॥
html:
tatrāvagāḍhaḥ strībhūto vyaktaṃ daivānna saṃśayaḥ ।
atṛpta iva putrāṇāṃ dārāṇāṃ ca dhanasya ca ॥19॥

text: uvāca putrāṃśca tataḥ strībhūtaḥ pārthivottamaḥ । samprītyā bhujyatāṃ rājyaṃ vanaṃ yāsyāmi putrakāḥ । abhiṣicya sa putrāṇāṃ śataṃ rājā vanaṃ gataḥ ॥20॥
html:
uvāca putrāṃśca tataḥ strībhūtaḥ pārthivottamaḥ ।
samprītyā bhujyatāṃ rājyaṃ vanaṃ yāsyāmi putrakāḥ ।
abhiṣicya sa putrāṇāṃ śataṃ rājā vanaṃ gataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: uvAca putrAMSca tataH strIBUtaH pArTivottamaH । samprItyA BujyatAM rAjyaM vanaM yAsyAmi putrakAH । aBizicya sa putrARAM SataM rAjA vanaM gataH ॥20॥

text: tāmāśrame striyaṃ tāta tāpaso'bhyavapadyata । tāpasenāsya putrāṇāmāśrame'pyabhavacchatam ॥21॥

text: atha sā tānsutāngṛhya pūrvaputrānabhāṣata । puruṣatve sutā yūyaṃ strītve ceme śataṃ sutāḥ ॥22॥
html:
atha sā tānsutāngṛhya pūrvaputrānabhāṣata ।

html:
tāndṛṣṭvā bhrātṛbhāvena bhuñjānānrājyamuttamam ।
cintayāmāsa devendro manyunābhipariplutaḥ ।

text: tato brāhmaṇarūpeṇa devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ । bhedayāmāsa tāngatvā nagaraṃ vai nṛpātmajān ॥25॥
html:
tato brāhmaṇarūpeṇa devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ ।
bhedayāmāsa tāngatvā nagaraṃ vai nṛpātmajān ॥25॥

text: bhrātṝṇāṃ nāsti saubhrātraṃ ye'pyekasya pituḥ sutāḥ । rājyahetorvivaditāḥ kaśyapasya surāsurāḥ ॥26॥
html:

html:

text: indreṇa bheditāste tu yuddhe'nyonyamapātayan । tacchrutvā tāpasī cāpi santaptā praruroda ha ॥28॥

html:
brāhmaṇacchadmanābhyetya tāmindro'thānvapṛcchata ।

html:
brāhmaṇaṃ tu tato dṛṣṭvā sā strī karuṇamabravīt ।
