html:
ahaṃ rājābhavaṃ vipra tatra putraśataṃ mayā ।
samutpannaṃ surūpāṇāṃ vikrāntānāṃ dvijottama ॥31॥
slp1: ahaM rAjABavaM vipra tatra putraSataM mayA । samutpannaM surUpARAM vikrAntAnAM dvijottama ॥31॥

text: kadācinmṛgayāṃ yāta udbhrānto gahane vane । avagāḍhaśca sarasi strībhūto brāhmaṇottama । putrānrājye pratiṣṭhāpya vanamasmi tato gataḥ ॥32॥
html:
kadācinmṛgayāṃ yāta udbhrānto gahane vane ।
avagāḍhaśca sarasi strībhūto brāhmaṇottama ।
putrānrājye pratiṣṭhāpya vanamasmi tato gataḥ ॥32॥
slp1: kadAcinmfgayAM yAta udBrAnto gahane vane । avagAQaSca sarasi strIBUto brAhmaRottama । putrAnrAjye pratizWApya vanamasmi tato gataH ॥32॥

text: striyāśca me putraśataṃ tāpasena mahātmanā । āśrame janitaṃ brahmannītāste nagaraṃ mayā ॥33॥
html:
striyāśca me putraśataṃ tāpasena mahātmanā ।
āśrame janitaṃ brahmannītāste nagaraṃ mayā ॥33॥
slp1: striyASca me putraSataM tApasena mahAtmanA । ASrame janitaM brahmannItAste nagaraM mayA ॥33॥

text: teṣāṃ ca vairamutpannaṃ kālayogena vai dvija । etacchocāmi viprendra daivenābhipariplutā ॥34॥
html:
teṣāṃ ca vairamutpannaṃ kālayogena vai dvija ।
etacchocāmi viprendra daivenābhipariplutā ॥34॥
slp1: tezAM ca vEramutpannaM kAlayogena vE dvija । etacCocAmi viprendra dEvenABipariplutA ॥34॥

text: indrastāṃ duḥkhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā abravītparuṣaṃ vacaḥ । purā suduḥsahaṃ bhadre mama duḥkhaṃ tvayā kṛtam ॥35॥
html:
indrastāṃ duḥkhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā abravītparuṣaṃ vacaḥ ।
purā suduḥsahaṃ bhadre mama duḥkhaṃ tvayā kṛtam ॥35॥
slp1: indrastAM duHKitAM dfzwvA abravItparuzaM vacaH । purA suduHsahaM Badre mama duHKaM tvayA kftam ॥35॥

text: indradviṣṭena yajatā māmanādṛtya durmate । indro'hamasmi durbuddhe vairaṃ te yātitaṃ mayā ॥36॥
html:
indradviṣṭena yajatā māmanādṛtya durmate ।
indro'hamasmi durbuddhe vairaṃ te yātitaṃ mayā ॥36॥
slp1: indradvizwena yajatA mAmanAdftya durmate । indro'hamasmi durbudDe vEraM te yAtitaM mayA ॥36॥

text: indraṃ tu dṛṣṭvā rājarṣiḥ pādayoḥ śirasā gataḥ । prasīda tridaśaśreṣṭha putrakāmena sa kratuḥ । iṣṭastridaśaśārdūla tatra me kṣantumarhasi ॥37॥
html:
indraṃ tu dṛṣṭvā rājarṣiḥ pādayoḥ śirasā gataḥ ।
prasīda tridaśaśreṣṭha putrakāmena sa kratuḥ ।
iṣṭastridaśaśārdūla tatra me kṣantumarhasi ॥37॥
slp1: indraM tu dfzwvA rAjarziH pAdayoH SirasA gataH । prasIda tridaSaSrezWa putrakAmena sa kratuH । izwastridaSaSArdUla tatra me kzantumarhasi ॥37॥

text: praṇipātena tasyendraḥ parituṣṭo varaṃ dadau । putrā vai katame rājañjīvantu tava śaṃsa me । strībhūtasya hi ye jātāḥ puruṣasyātha ye'bhavan ॥38॥
html:
praṇipātena tasyendraḥ parituṣṭo varaṃ dadau ।
putrā vai katame rājañjīvantu tava śaṃsa me ।
strībhūtasya hi ye jātāḥ puruṣasyātha ye'bhavan ॥38॥
slp1: praRipAtena tasyendraH parituzwo varaM dadO । putrA vE katame rAjaYjIvantu tava SaMsa me । strIBUtasya hi ye jAtAH puruzasyATa ye'Bavan ॥38॥

text: tāpasī tu tataḥ śakramuvāca prayatāñjaliḥ । strībhūtasya hi ye jātāste me jīvantu vāsava ॥39॥
html:
tāpasī tu tataḥ śakramuvāca prayatāñjaliḥ ।
strībhūtasya hi ye jātāste me jīvantu vāsava ॥39॥
slp1: tApasI tu tataH SakramuvAca prayatAYjaliH । strIBUtasya hi ye jAtAste me jIvantu vAsava ॥39॥

text: indrastu vismito hṛṣṭaḥ striyaṃ papraccha tāṃ punaḥ । puruṣotpāditā ye te kathaṃ dveṣyāḥ sutāstava ॥40॥
html:
indrastu vismito hṛṣṭaḥ striyaṃ papraccha tāṃ punaḥ ।
puruṣotpāditā ye te kathaṃ dveṣyāḥ sutāstava ॥40॥
slp1: indrastu vismito hfzwaH striyaM papracCa tAM punaH । puruzotpAditA ye te kaTaM dvezyAH sutAstava ॥40॥

text: strībhūtasya hi ye jātāḥ snehastebhyo'dhikaḥ katham । kāraṇaṃ śrotumicchāmi tanme vaktumihārhasi ॥41॥
html:
strībhūtasya hi ye jātāḥ snehastebhyo'dhikaḥ katham ।
kāraṇaṃ śrotumicchāmi tanme vaktumihārhasi ॥41॥
slp1: strIBUtasya hi ye jAtAH snehasteByo'DikaH kaTam । kAraRaM SrotumicCAmi tanme vaktumihArhasi ॥41॥

text: striyāstvabhyadhikaḥ sneho na tathā puruṣasya vai । tasmātte śakra jīvantu ye jātāḥ strīkṛtasya vai ॥42॥
html:
striyāstvabhyadhikaḥ sneho na tathā puruṣasya vai ।
tasmātte śakra jīvantu ye jātāḥ strīkṛtasya vai ॥42॥
slp1: striyAstvaByaDikaH sneho na taTA puruzasya vE । tasmAtte Sakra jIvantu ye jAtAH strIkftasya vE ॥42॥
author: stryuvāca ।

text: evamukte tatastvindraḥ prīto vākyamuvāca ha । sarva eveha jīvantu putrāste satyavādini ॥43॥
html:
evamukte tatastvindraḥ prīto vākyamuvāca ha ।
sarva eveha jīvantu putrāste satyavādini ॥43॥
slp1: evamukte tatastvindraH prIto vAkyamuvAca ha । sarva eveha jIvantu putrAste satyavAdini ॥43॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: varaṃ ca vṛṇu rājendra yaṃ tvamicchasi suvrata । puruṣatvamatha strītvaṃ matto yadabhikāṅkṣasi ॥44॥
html:
varaṃ ca vṛṇu rājendra yaṃ tvamicchasi suvrata ।
puruṣatvamatha strītvaṃ matto yadabhikāṅkṣasi ॥44॥
slp1: varaM ca vfRu rAjendra yaM tvamicCasi suvrata । puruzatvamaTa strItvaM matto yadaBikANkzasi ॥44॥

text: strītvameva vṛṇe śakra prasanne tvayi vāsava ॥45॥
html: strītvameva vṛṇe śakra prasanne tvayi vāsava ॥45॥
slp1: strItvameva vfRe Sakra prasanne tvayi vAsava ॥45॥
author: stryuvāca ।

text: evamuktastu devendrastāṃ striyaṃ pratyuvāca ha । puruṣatvaṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā strītvaṃ rocayase vibho ॥46॥
html:
evamuktastu devendrastāṃ striyaṃ pratyuvāca ha ।
puruṣatvaṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā strītvaṃ rocayase vibho ॥46॥
slp1: evamuktastu devendrastAM striyaM pratyuvAca ha । puruzatvaM kaTaM tyaktvA strItvaM rocayase viBo ॥46॥

text: evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca strībhūto rājasattamaḥ । striyāḥ puruṣasaṃyoge prītirabhyadhikā sadā । etasmātkāraṇācchakra strītvameva vṛṇomyaham ॥47॥
html:
evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca strībhūto rājasattamaḥ ।
striyāḥ puruṣasaṃyoge prītirabhyadhikā sadā ।
etasmātkāraṇācchakra strītvameva vṛṇomyaham ॥47॥
slp1: evamuktaH pratyuvAca strIBUto rAjasattamaH । striyAH puruzasaMyoge prItiraByaDikA sadA । etasmAtkAraRAcCakra strItvameva vfRomyaham ॥47॥

text: rame caivādhikaṃ strītve satyaṃ vai devasattama । strībhāvena hi tuṣṭo'smi gamyatāṃ tridaśādhipa ॥48॥
html:
rame caivādhikaṃ strītve satyaṃ vai devasattama ।
strībhāvena hi tuṣṭo'smi gamyatāṃ tridaśādhipa ॥48॥
slp1: rame cEvADikaM strItve satyaM vE devasattama । strIBAvena hi tuzwo'smi gamyatAM tridaSADipa ॥48॥

text: evamastviti coktvā tāmāpṛcchya tridivaṃ gataḥ । evaṃ striyā mahārāja adhikā prītirucyate] ॥49॥
html:
evamastviti coktvā tāmāpṛcchya tridivaṃ gataḥ ।
evaṃ striyā mahārāja adhikā prītirucyate] ॥49॥
slp1: evamastviti coktvA tAmApfcCya tridivaM gataH । evaM striyA mahArAja aDikA prItirucyate] ॥49॥

text: kiṃ kartavyaṃ manuṣyeṇa lokayātrāhitārthinā । kathaṃ vai lokayātrāṃ tu kiṃśīlaśca samācaret ॥1॥
html:
kiṃ kartavyaṃ manuṣyeṇa lokayātrāhitārthinā ।
kathaṃ vai lokayātrāṃ tu kiṃśīlaśca samācaret ॥1॥
slp1: kiM kartavyaM manuzyeRa lokayAtrAhitArTinA । kaTaM vE lokayAtrAM tu kiMSIlaSca samAcaret ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kāyena trividhaṃ karma vācā cāpi caturvidham । manasā trividhaṃ caiva daśa karmapathāṃstyajet ॥2॥
html:
kāyena trividhaṃ karma vācā cāpi caturvidham ।
manasā trividhaṃ caiva daśa karmapathāṃstyajet ॥2॥
slp1: kAyena triviDaM karma vAcA cApi caturviDam । manasA triviDaM cEva daSa karmapaTAMstyajet ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prāṇātipātaṃ stainyaṃ ca paradāramathāpi ca । trīṇi pāpāni kāyena sarvataḥ parivarjayet ॥3॥
html:
prāṇātipātaṃ stainyaṃ ca paradāramathāpi ca ।
trīṇi pāpāni kāyena sarvataḥ parivarjayet ॥3॥
slp1: prARAtipAtaM stEnyaM ca paradAramaTApi ca । trIRi pApAni kAyena sarvataH parivarjayet ॥3॥

text: asatpralāpaṃ pāruṣyaṃ paiśunyamanṛtaṃ tathā । catvāri vācā rājendra na jalpennānucintayet ॥4॥
html:
asatpralāpaṃ pāruṣyaṃ paiśunyamanṛtaṃ tathā ।
catvāri vācā rājendra na jalpennānucintayet ॥4॥
slp1: asatpralApaM pAruzyaM pESunyamanftaM taTA । catvAri vAcA rAjendra na jalpennAnucintayet ॥4॥

text: anabhidhyā parasveṣu sarvasattveṣu sauhṛdam । karmaṇāṃ phalamastīti trividhaṃ manasā caret ॥5॥
html:
anabhidhyā parasveṣu sarvasattveṣu sauhṛdam ।
karmaṇāṃ phalamastīti trividhaṃ manasā caret ॥5॥
slp1: anaBiDyA parasvezu sarvasattvezu sOhfdam । karmaRAM PalamastIti triviDaM manasA caret ॥5॥

text: tasmādvākkāyamanasā nācaredaśubhaṃ naraḥ । śubhāśubhānyācaranhi tasya tasyāśnute phalam] ॥6॥
html:
tasmādvākkāyamanasā nācaredaśubhaṃ naraḥ ।
śubhāśubhānyācaranhi tasya tasyāśnute phalam] ॥6॥
slp1: tasmAdvAkkAyamanasA nAcaredaSuBaM naraH । SuBASuBAnyAcaranhi tasya tasyASnute Palam] ॥6॥

text: pitāmaheśāya vibho nāmānyācakṣva śambhave । babhrave viśvamāyāya mahābhāgyaṃ ca tattvataḥ ॥1॥
html:
pitāmaheśāya vibho nāmānyācakṣva śambhave ।
babhrave viśvamāyāya mahābhāgyaṃ ca tattvataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmaheSAya viBo nAmAnyAcakzva SamBave । baBrave viSvamAyAya mahABAgyaM ca tattvataH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: surāsuraguro deva viṣṇo tvaṃ vaktumarhasi । śivāya viśvarūpāya yanmāṃ pṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥2॥
html:
surāsuraguro deva viṣṇo tvaṃ vaktumarhasi ।
śivāya viśvarūpāya yanmāṃ pṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥2॥
slp1: surAsuraguro deva vizRo tvaM vaktumarhasi । SivAya viSvarUpAya yanmAM pfcCadyuDizWiraH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ devasya taṇḍinā brahmayoninā । niveditaṃ brahmaloke brahmaṇo yatpurābhavat ॥3॥
html:
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ devasya taṇḍinā brahmayoninā ।
niveditaṃ brahmaloke brahmaṇo yatpurābhavat ॥3॥
slp1: nAmnAM sahasraM devasya taRqinA brahmayoninA । niveditaM brahmaloke brahmaRo yatpurABavat ॥3॥

text: dvaipāyanaprabhṛtayastathaiveme tapodhanāḥ । ṛṣayaḥ suvratā dāntāḥ śṛṇvantu gadatastava ॥4॥
html:
dvaipāyanaprabhṛtayastathaiveme tapodhanāḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ suvratā dāntāḥ śṛṇvantu gadatastava ॥4॥
slp1: dvEpAyanapraBftayastaTEveme tapoDanAH । fzayaH suvratA dAntAH SfRvantu gadatastava ॥4॥

text: dhruvāya nandine hotre goptre viśvasṛje'gnaye । mahābhāgyaṃ vibho brūhi muṇḍine'tha kapardine ॥5॥
html:
dhruvāya nandine hotre goptre viśvasṛje'gnaye ।
mahābhāgyaṃ vibho brūhi muṇḍine'tha kapardine ॥5॥
slp1: DruvAya nandine hotre goptre viSvasfje'gnaye । mahABAgyaM viBo brUhi muRqine'Ta kapardine ॥5॥

text: na gatiḥ karmaṇāṃ śakyā vettumīśasya tattvataḥ ॥6॥
html: na gatiḥ karmaṇāṃ śakyā vettumīśasya tattvataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: na gatiH karmaRAM SakyA vettumISasya tattvataH ॥6॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: hiraṇyagarbhapramukhā devāḥ sendrā maharṣayaḥ । na viduryasya nidhanamādiṃ vā sūkṣmadarśinaḥ । sa kathaṃ naramātreṇa śakyo jñātuṃ satāṃ gatiḥ ॥7॥
html:
hiraṇyagarbhapramukhā devāḥ sendrā maharṣayaḥ ।
na viduryasya nidhanamādiṃ vā sūkṣmadarśinaḥ ।
sa kathaṃ naramātreṇa śakyo jñātuṃ satāṃ gatiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: hiraRyagarBapramuKA devAH sendrA maharzayaH । na viduryasya niDanamAdiM vA sUkzmadarSinaH । sa kaTaM naramAtreRa Sakyo jYAtuM satAM gatiH ॥7॥

text: tasyāhamasuraghnasya kāṃścidbhagavato guṇān । bhavatāṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi vrateśāya yathātatham ॥8॥
html:
tasyāhamasuraghnasya kāṃścidbhagavato guṇān ।
bhavatāṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi vrateśāya yathātatham ॥8॥
slp1: tasyAhamasuraGnasya kAMScidBagavato guRAn । BavatAM kIrtayizyAmi vrateSAya yaTAtaTam ॥8॥

text: evamuktvā tu bhagavānguṇāṃstasya mahātmanaḥ । upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā kathayāmāsa dhīmataḥ ॥9॥
html:
evamuktvā tu bhagavānguṇāṃstasya mahātmanaḥ ।
upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā kathayāmāsa dhīmataḥ ॥9॥
slp1: evamuktvA tu BagavAnguRAMstasya mahAtmanaH । upaspfSya SucirBUtvA kaTayAmAsa DImataH ॥9॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: śuśrūṣadhvaṃ brāhmaṇendrāstvaṃ ca tāta yudhiṣṭhira । tvaṃ cāpageya nāmāni niśāmaya jagatpateḥ ॥10॥
html:
śuśrūṣadhvaṃ brāhmaṇendrāstvaṃ ca tāta yudhiṣṭhira ।
tvaṃ cāpageya nāmāni niśāmaya jagatpateḥ ॥10॥
slp1: SuSrUzaDvaM brAhmaRendrAstvaM ca tAta yuDizWira । tvaM cApageya nAmAni niSAmaya jagatpateH ॥10॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: yadavāptaṃ ca me pūrvaṃ sāmbahetoḥ suduṣkaram । yathā ca bhagavāndṛṣṭo mayā pūrvaṃ samādhinā ॥11॥
html:
yadavāptaṃ ca me pūrvaṃ sāmbahetoḥ suduṣkaram ।
yathā ca bhagavāndṛṣṭo mayā pūrvaṃ samādhinā ॥11॥
slp1: yadavAptaM ca me pUrvaM sAmbahetoH suduzkaram । yaTA ca BagavAndfzwo mayA pUrvaM samADinA ॥11॥

text: śambare nihate pūrvaṃ raukmiṇeyena dhīmatā । atīte dvādaśe varṣe jāmbavatyabravīddhi mām ॥12॥
html:
śambare nihate pūrvaṃ raukmiṇeyena dhīmatā ।
atīte dvādaśe varṣe jāmbavatyabravīddhi mām ॥12॥
slp1: Sambare nihate pUrvaM rOkmiReyena DImatA । atIte dvAdaSe varze jAmbavatyabravIdDi mAm ॥12॥

text: pradyumnacārudeṣṇādīnrukmiṇyā vīkṣya putrakān । putrārthinī māmupetya vākyamāha yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
html:
pradyumnacārudeṣṇādīnrukmiṇyā vīkṣya putrakān ।
putrārthinī māmupetya vākyamāha yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
slp1: pradyumnacArudezRAdInrukmiRyA vIkzya putrakAn । putrArTinI mAmupetya vAkyamAha yuDizWira ॥13॥

text: śūraṃ balavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kāntarūpamakalmaṣam । ātmatulyaṃ mama sutaṃ prayacchācyuta māciram ॥14॥
html:
śūraṃ balavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kāntarūpamakalmaṣam ।
ātmatulyaṃ mama sutaṃ prayacchācyuta māciram ॥14॥
slp1: SUraM balavatAM SrezWaM kAntarUpamakalmazam । AtmatulyaM mama sutaM prayacCAcyuta mAciram ॥14॥

text: na hi te'prāpyamastīha triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana । lokānsṛjestvamaparānicchanyadukulodvaha ॥15॥
html:
na hi te'prāpyamastīha triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana ।
lokānsṛjestvamaparānicchanyadukulodvaha ॥15॥
slp1: na hi te'prApyamastIha trizu lokezu kiYcana । lokAnsfjestvamaparAnicCanyadukulodvaha ॥15॥

text: tvayā dvādaśa varṣāṇi vāyubhūtena śuṣyatā । ārādhya paśubhartāraṃ rukmiṇyā janitāḥ sutāḥ ॥16॥
html:
tvayā dvādaśa varṣāṇi vāyubhūtena śuṣyatā ।
ārādhya paśubhartāraṃ rukmiṇyā janitāḥ sutāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: tvayA dvAdaSa varzARi vAyuBUtena SuzyatA । ArADya paSuBartAraM rukmiRyA janitAH sutAH ॥16॥

text: cārudeṣṇaḥ sucāruśca cāruveṣo yaśodharaḥ । cāruśravāścāruyaśāḥ pradyumnaḥ śambhureva ca ॥17॥
html:
cārudeṣṇaḥ sucāruśca cāruveṣo yaśodharaḥ ।
cāruśravāścāruyaśāḥ pradyumnaḥ śambhureva ca ॥17॥
slp1: cArudezRaH sucAruSca cAruvezo yaSoDaraH । cAruSravAScAruyaSAH pradyumnaH SamBureva ca ॥17॥

text: yathā te janitāḥ putrā rukmiṇyāścāruvikramāḥ । tathā mamāpi tanayaṃ prayaccha balaśālinam ॥18॥
html:
yathā te janitāḥ putrā rukmiṇyāścāruvikramāḥ ।
tathā mamāpi tanayaṃ prayaccha balaśālinam ॥18॥
slp1: yaTA te janitAH putrA rukmiRyAScAruvikramAH । taTA mamApi tanayaM prayacCa balaSAlinam ॥18॥

text: ityevaṃ codito devyā tāmavocaṃ sumadhyamām । anujānīhi māṃ rājñi kariṣye vacanaṃ tava । sā ca māmabravīdgaccha vijayāya śivāya ca ॥19॥
html:
ityevaṃ codito devyā tāmavocaṃ sumadhyamām ।
anujānīhi māṃ rājñi kariṣye vacanaṃ tava ।
sā ca māmabravīdgaccha vijayāya śivāya ca ॥19॥
slp1: ityevaM codito devyA tAmavocaM sumaDyamAm । anujAnIhi mAM rAjYi karizye vacanaM tava । sA ca mAmabravIdgacCa vijayAya SivAya ca ॥19॥

text: brahmā śivaḥ kāśyapaśca nadyo devā manonugāḥ । kṣetrauṣadhyo yajñavāhācchandāṃsyṛṣigaṇā dharā ॥20॥
html:
brahmā śivaḥ kāśyapaśca nadyo devā manonugāḥ ।
kṣetrauṣadhyo yajñavāhācchandāṃsyṛṣigaṇā dharā ॥20॥
slp1: brahmA SivaH kASyapaSca nadyo devA manonugAH । kzetrOzaDyo yajYavAhAcCandAMsyfzigaRA DarA ॥20॥

text: samudrā dakṣiṇā stobhā ṛkṣāṇi pitaro grahāḥ । devapatnyo devakanyā devamātara eva ca ॥21॥
html:
samudrā dakṣiṇā stobhā ṛkṣāṇi pitaro grahāḥ ।
devapatnyo devakanyā devamātara eva ca ॥21॥
slp1: samudrA dakziRA stoBA fkzARi pitaro grahAH । devapatnyo devakanyA devamAtara eva ca ॥21॥

text: manvantarāṇi gāvaśca candramāḥ savitā hariḥ । sāvitrī brahmavidyā ca ṛtavo vatsarāḥ kṣapāḥ ॥22॥
html:
manvantarāṇi gāvaśca candramāḥ savitā hariḥ ।
sāvitrī brahmavidyā ca ṛtavo vatsarāḥ kṣapāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: manvantarARi gAvaSca candramAH savitA hariH । sAvitrI brahmavidyA ca ftavo vatsarAH kzapAH ॥22॥

text: kṣaṇā lavā muhūrtāśca nimeṣā yugaparyayāḥ । rakṣantu sarvatra gataṃ tvāṃ yādava sukhāvaham । ariṣṭaṃ gaccha panthānamapramatto bhavānagha ॥23॥
html:
kṣaṇā lavā muhūrtāśca nimeṣā yugaparyayāḥ ।
rakṣantu sarvatra gataṃ tvāṃ yādava sukhāvaham ।
ariṣṭaṃ gaccha panthānamapramatto bhavānagha ॥23॥
slp1: kzaRA lavA muhUrtASca nimezA yugaparyayAH । rakzantu sarvatra gataM tvAM yAdava suKAvaham । arizwaM gacCa panTAnamapramatto BavAnaGa ॥23॥

text: evaṃ kṛtasvastyayanastayāhaṃ tāmabhyanujñāya kapīndraputrīm । pituḥ samīpe narasattamasya mātuśca rājñaśca tathāhukasya ॥24॥
html:
evaṃ kṛtasvastyayanastayāhaṃ tāmabhyanujñāya kapīndraputrīm ।
pituḥ samīpe narasattamasya mātuśca rājñaśca tathāhukasya ॥24॥
slp1: evaM kftasvastyayanastayAhaM tAmaByanujYAya kapIndraputrIm । pituH samIpe narasattamasya mAtuSca rAjYaSca taTAhukasya ॥24॥

text: tamarthamāvedya yadabravīnmāṃ vidyādharendrasya sutā bhṛśārtā । tānabhyanujñāya tadātiduḥkhādgadaṃ tathaivātibalaṃ ca rāmam ॥25॥
html:
tamarthamāvedya yadabravīnmāṃ vidyādharendrasya sutā bhṛśārtā ।
tānabhyanujñāya tadātiduḥkhādgadaṃ tathaivātibalaṃ ca rāmam ॥25॥
slp1: tamarTamAvedya yadabravInmAM vidyADarendrasya sutA BfSArtA । tAnaByanujYAya tadAtiduHKAdgadaM taTEvAtibalaM ca rAmam ॥25॥

text: prāpyānujñāṃ gurujanādahaṃ tārkṣyamacintayam । so'vahaddhimavantaṃ māṃ prāpya cainaṃ vyasarjayam ॥26॥
html:
prāpyānujñāṃ gurujanādahaṃ tārkṣyamacintayam ।
so'vahaddhimavantaṃ māṃ prāpya cainaṃ vyasarjayam ॥26॥
slp1: prApyAnujYAM gurujanAdahaM tArkzyamacintayam । so'vahadDimavantaM mAM prApya cEnaM vyasarjayam ॥26॥

text: tatrāhamadbhutānbhāvānapaśyaṃ girisattame । kṣetraṃ ca tapasāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paśyāmyāśramamuttamam ॥27॥
html:
tatrāhamadbhutānbhāvānapaśyaṃ girisattame ।
kṣetraṃ ca tapasāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paśyāmyāśramamuttamam ॥27॥
slp1: tatrAhamadButAnBAvAnapaSyaM girisattame । kzetraM ca tapasAM SrezWaM paSyAmyASramamuttamam ॥27॥

text: divyaṃ vaiyāghrapadyasya upamanyormahātmanaḥ । pūjitaṃ devagandharvairbrāhmyā lakṣmyā samanvitam ॥28॥
html:
divyaṃ vaiyāghrapadyasya upamanyormahātmanaḥ ।
pūjitaṃ devagandharvairbrāhmyā lakṣmyā samanvitam ॥28॥
slp1: divyaM vEyAGrapadyasya upamanyormahAtmanaH । pUjitaM devaganDarvErbrAhmyA lakzmyA samanvitam ॥28॥

text: dhavakakubhakadambanārikelaiḥ kurabakaketakajambupāṭalābhiḥ । vaṭavaruṇakavatsanābhabilvaiḥ saralakapitthapriyālasālatālaiḥ ॥29॥
html:
dhavakakubhakadambanārikelaiḥ kurabakaketakajambupāṭalābhiḥ ।
vaṭavaruṇakavatsanābhabilvaiḥ saralakapitthapriyālasālatālaiḥ ॥29॥
slp1: DavakakuBakadambanArikelEH kurabakaketakajambupAwalABiH । vawavaruRakavatsanABabilvEH saralakapitTapriyAlasAlatAlEH ॥29॥

text: badarīkundapunnāgairaśokāmrātimuktakaiḥ । bhallātakairmadhūkaiśca campakaiḥ panasaistathā ॥30॥
html:
badarīkundapunnāgairaśokāmrātimuktakaiḥ ।
bhallātakairmadhūkaiśca campakaiḥ panasaistathā ॥30॥
slp1: badarIkundapunnAgEraSokAmrAtimuktakEH । BallAtakErmaDUkESca campakEH panasEstaTA ॥30॥

text: vanyairbahuvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ phalapuṣpapradairyutam । puṣpagulmalatākīrṇaṃ kadalīṣaṇḍaśobhitam ॥31॥
html:
vanyairbahuvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ phalapuṣpapradairyutam ।
puṣpagulmalatākīrṇaṃ kadalīṣaṇḍaśobhitam ॥31॥
slp1: vanyErbahuviDErvfkzEH PalapuzpapradEryutam । puzpagulmalatAkIrRaM kadalIzaRqaSoBitam ॥31॥

text: nānāśakunisambhojyaiḥ phalairvṛkṣairalaṅkṛtam । yathāsthānavinikṣiptairbhūṣitaṃ vanarājibhiḥ ॥32॥
html:
nānāśakunisambhojyaiḥ phalairvṛkṣairalaṅkṛtam ।
yathāsthānavinikṣiptairbhūṣitaṃ vanarājibhiḥ ॥32॥
slp1: nAnASakunisamBojyEH PalErvfkzEralaNkftam । yaTAsTAnavinikziptErBUzitaM vanarAjiBiH ॥32॥

text: ruruvāraṇaśārdūlasiṃhadvīpisamākulam । kuraṅgabarhiṇākīrṇaṃ mārjārabhujagāvṛtam । pūgaiśca mṛgajātīnāṃ mahiṣarkṣaniṣevitam ॥33॥
html:
ruruvāraṇaśārdūlasiṃhadvīpisamākulam ।
kuraṅgabarhiṇākīrṇaṃ mārjārabhujagāvṛtam ।
pūgaiśca mṛgajātīnāṃ mahiṣarkṣaniṣevitam ॥33॥
slp1: ruruvAraRaSArdUlasiMhadvIpisamAkulam । kuraNgabarhiRAkIrRaM mArjAraBujagAvftam । pUgESca mfgajAtInAM mahizarkzanizevitam ॥33॥

text: nānāpuṣparajomiśro gajadānādhivāsitaḥ । divyastrīgītabahulo māruto'tra sukho vavau ॥34॥
html:
nānāpuṣparajomiśro gajadānādhivāsitaḥ ।
divyastrīgītabahulo māruto'tra sukho vavau ॥34॥
slp1: nAnApuzparajomiSro gajadAnADivAsitaH । divyastrIgItabahulo mAruto'tra suKo vavO ॥34॥

text: dhārāninādairvihagapraṇādaiḥ śubhaistathā bṛṃhitaiḥ kuñjarāṇām । gītaistathā kinnarāṇāmudāraiḥ śubhaiḥ svanaiḥ sāmagānāṃ ca vīra ॥35॥
html:
dhārāninādairvihagapraṇādaiḥ śubhaistathā bṛṃhitaiḥ kuñjarāṇām ।
gītaistathā kinnarāṇāmudāraiḥ śubhaiḥ svanaiḥ sāmagānāṃ ca vīra ॥35॥
slp1: DArAninAdErvihagapraRAdEH SuBEstaTA bfMhitEH kuYjarARAm । gItEstaTA kinnarARAmudArEH SuBEH svanEH sAmagAnAM ca vIra ॥35॥

text: acintyaṃ manasāpyanyaiḥ sarobhiḥ samalaṅkṛtam । viśālaiścāgniśaraṇairbhūṣitaṃ kuśasaṃvṛtam ॥36॥
html:
acintyaṃ manasāpyanyaiḥ sarobhiḥ samalaṅkṛtam ।
viśālaiścāgniśaraṇairbhūṣitaṃ kuśasaṃvṛtam ॥36॥
slp1: acintyaM manasApyanyEH saroBiH samalaNkftam । viSAlEScAgniSaraRErBUzitaM kuSasaMvftam ॥36॥

text: vibhūṣitaṃ puṇyapavitratoyayā sadā ca juṣṭaṃ nṛpa jahnukanyayā । mahātmabhirdharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhairmaharṣibhirbhūṣitamagnikalpaiḥ ॥37॥
html:
vibhūṣitaṃ puṇyapavitratoyayā sadā ca juṣṭaṃ nṛpa jahnukanyayā ।
mahātmabhirdharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhairmaharṣibhirbhūṣitamagnikalpaiḥ ॥37॥
slp1: viBUzitaM puRyapavitratoyayA sadA ca juzwaM nfpa jahnukanyayA । mahAtmaBirDarmaBftAM varizWErmaharziBirBUzitamagnikalpEH ॥37॥

text: vāyvāhārairambupairjapyanityaiḥ samprakṣālairyatibhirdhyānanityaiḥ । dhūmāśanairūṣmapaiḥ kṣīrapaiśca vibhūṣitaṃ brāhmaṇendraiḥ samantāt ॥38॥
html:
vāyvāhārairambupairjapyanityaiḥ samprakṣālairyatibhirdhyānanityaiḥ ।
dhūmāśanairūṣmapaiḥ kṣīrapaiśca vibhūṣitaṃ brāhmaṇendraiḥ samantāt ॥38॥
slp1: vAyvAhArErambupErjapyanityEH samprakzAlEryatiBirDyAnanityEH । DUmASanErUzmapEH kzIrapESca viBUzitaM brAhmaRendrEH samantAt ॥38॥

text: gocāriṇo'thāśmakuṭṭā dantolūkhalinastathā । marīcipāḥ phenapāśca tathaiva mṛgacāriṇaḥ ॥39॥
html:
gocāriṇo'thāśmakuṭṭā dantolūkhalinastathā ।
marīcipāḥ phenapāśca tathaiva mṛgacāriṇaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: gocAriRo'TASmakuwwA dantolUKalinastaTA । marIcipAH PenapASca taTEva mfgacAriRaH ॥39॥

text: suduḥkhānniyamāṃstāṃstānvahataḥ sutaponvitān । paśyannutphullanayanaḥ praveṣṭumupacakrame ॥40॥
html:
suduḥkhānniyamāṃstāṃstānvahataḥ sutaponvitān ।
paśyannutphullanayanaḥ praveṣṭumupacakrame ॥40॥
slp1: suduHKAnniyamAMstAMstAnvahataH sutaponvitAn । paSyannutPullanayanaH pravezwumupacakrame ॥40॥

text: supūjitaṃ devagaṇairmahātmabhiḥ śivādibhirbhārata puṇyakarmabhiḥ । rarāja taccāśramamaṇḍalaṃ sadā divīva rājanravimaṇḍalaṃ yathā ॥41॥
html:
supūjitaṃ devagaṇairmahātmabhiḥ śivādibhirbhārata puṇyakarmabhiḥ ।
rarāja taccāśramamaṇḍalaṃ sadā divīva rājanravimaṇḍalaṃ yathā ॥41॥
slp1: supUjitaM devagaRErmahAtmaBiH SivAdiBirBArata puRyakarmaBiH । rarAja taccASramamaRqalaM sadA divIva rAjanravimaRqalaM yaTA ॥41॥

text: krīḍanti sarpairnakulā mṛgairvyāghrāśca mitravat । prabhāvāddīptatapasaḥ sannikarṣaguṇānvitāḥ ॥42॥
html:
krīḍanti sarpairnakulā mṛgairvyāghrāśca mitravat ।
prabhāvāddīptatapasaḥ sannikarṣaguṇānvitāḥ ॥42॥
slp1: krIqanti sarpErnakulA mfgErvyAGrASca mitravat । praBAvAddIptatapasaH sannikarzaguRAnvitAH ॥42॥

text: tatrāśramapade śreṣṭhe sarvabhūtamanorame । sevite dvijaśārdūlairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ ॥43॥
html:
tatrāśramapade śreṣṭhe sarvabhūtamanorame ।
sevite dvijaśārdūlairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ ॥43॥
slp1: tatrASramapade SrezWe sarvaBUtamanorame । sevite dvijaSArdUlErvedavedANgapAragEH ॥43॥

text: nānāniyamavikhyātairṛṣibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ । praviśanneva cāpaśyaṃ jaṭācīradharaṃ prabhum ॥44॥
html:
nānāniyamavikhyātairṛṣibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ ।
praviśanneva cāpaśyaṃ jaṭācīradharaṃ prabhum ॥44॥
slp1: nAnAniyamaviKyAtErfziBiSca mahAtmaBiH । praviSanneva cApaSyaM jawAcIraDaraM praBum ॥44॥

text: tejasā tapasā caiva dīpyamānaṃ yathānalam । śiṣyamadhyagataṃ śāntaṃ yuvānaṃ brāhmaṇarṣabham । śirasā vandamānaṃ māmupamanyurabhāṣata ॥45॥
html:
tejasā tapasā caiva dīpyamānaṃ yathānalam ।
śiṣyamadhyagataṃ śāntaṃ yuvānaṃ brāhmaṇarṣabham ।
śirasā vandamānaṃ māmupamanyurabhāṣata ॥45॥
slp1: tejasA tapasA cEva dIpyamAnaM yaTAnalam । SizyamaDyagataM SAntaM yuvAnaM brAhmaRarzaBam । SirasA vandamAnaM mAmupamanyuraBAzata ॥45॥

text: svāgataṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa saphalāni tapāṃsi naḥ । yatpūjyaḥ pūjayasi no draṣṭavyo draṣṭumicchasi ॥46॥
html:
svāgataṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa saphalāni tapāṃsi naḥ ।
yatpūjyaḥ pūjayasi no draṣṭavyo draṣṭumicchasi ॥46॥
slp1: svAgataM puRqarIkAkza saPalAni tapAMsi naH । yatpUjyaH pUjayasi no drazwavyo drazwumicCasi ॥46॥

text: tamahaṃ prāñjalirbhūtvā mṛgapakṣiṣvathāgniṣu । dharme ca śiṣyavarge ca samapṛcchamanāmayam ॥47॥
html:
tamahaṃ prāñjalirbhūtvā mṛgapakṣiṣvathāgniṣu ।
dharme ca śiṣyavarge ca samapṛcchamanāmayam ॥47॥
slp1: tamahaM prAYjalirBUtvA mfgapakzizvaTAgnizu । Darme ca Sizyavarge ca samapfcCamanAmayam ॥47॥

text: tato māṃ bhagavānāha sāmnā paramavalgunā । lapsyase tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa ātmatulyamasaṃśayam ॥48॥
html:
tato māṃ bhagavānāha sāmnā paramavalgunā ।
lapsyase tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa ātmatulyamasaṃśayam ॥48॥
slp1: tato mAM BagavAnAha sAmnA paramavalgunA । lapsyase tanayaM kfzRa AtmatulyamasaMSayam ॥48॥

text: tapaḥ sumahadāsthāya toṣayeśānamīśvaram । iha devaḥ sapatnīkaḥ samākrīḍatyadhokṣaja ॥49॥
html:
tapaḥ sumahadāsthāya toṣayeśānamīśvaram ।
iha devaḥ sapatnīkaḥ samākrīḍatyadhokṣaja ॥49॥
slp1: tapaH sumahadAsTAya tozayeSAnamISvaram । iha devaH sapatnIkaH samAkrIqatyaDokzaja ॥49॥

text: ihaiva devatāśreṣṭhaṃ devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ purā । tapasā brahmacaryeṇa satyena ca damena ca । toṣayitvā śubhānkāmānprāpnuvaṃste janārdana ॥50॥
html:
ihaiva devatāśreṣṭhaṃ devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ purā ।
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa satyena ca damena ca ।
toṣayitvā śubhānkāmānprāpnuvaṃste janārdana ॥50॥
slp1: ihEva devatASrezWaM devAH sarzigaRAH purA । tapasA brahmacaryeRa satyena ca damena ca । tozayitvA SuBAnkAmAnprApnuvaMste janArdana ॥50॥

text: tejasāṃ tapasāṃ caiva nidhiḥ sa bhagavāniha । śubhāśubhānvitānbhāvānvisṛjansaṅkṣipannapi । āste devyā sahācintyo yaṃ prārthayasi śatruhan ॥51॥
html:
tejasāṃ tapasāṃ caiva nidhiḥ sa bhagavāniha ।
śubhāśubhānvitānbhāvānvisṛjansaṅkṣipannapi ।
āste devyā sahācintyo yaṃ prārthayasi śatruhan ॥51॥
slp1: tejasAM tapasAM cEva niDiH sa BagavAniha । SuBASuBAnvitAnBAvAnvisfjansaNkzipannapi । Aste devyA sahAcintyo yaM prArTayasi Satruhan ॥51॥

text: hiraṇyakaśipuryo'bhūddānavo merukampanaḥ । tena sarvāmaraiśvaryaṃ śarvātprāptaṃ samārbudam ॥52॥
html:
hiraṇyakaśipuryo'bhūddānavo merukampanaḥ ।
tena sarvāmaraiśvaryaṃ śarvātprāptaṃ samārbudam ॥52॥
slp1: hiraRyakaSipuryo'BUddAnavo merukampanaH । tena sarvAmarESvaryaM SarvAtprAptaM samArbudam ॥52॥

text: tasyaiva putrapravaro mandaro nāma viśrutaḥ । mahādevavarācchakraṃ varṣārbudamayodhayat ॥53॥
html:
tasyaiva putrapravaro mandaro nāma viśrutaḥ ।
mahādevavarācchakraṃ varṣārbudamayodhayat ॥53॥
slp1: tasyEva putrapravaro mandaro nAma viSrutaH । mahAdevavarAcCakraM varzArbudamayoDayat ॥53॥

text: viṣṇoścakraṃ ca tadghoraṃ vajramākhaṇḍalasya ca । śīrṇaṃ purābhavattāta grahasyāṅgeṣu keśava ॥54॥
html:
viṣṇoścakraṃ ca tadghoraṃ vajramākhaṇḍalasya ca ।
śīrṇaṃ purābhavattāta grahasyāṅgeṣu keśava ॥54॥
slp1: vizRoScakraM ca tadGoraM vajramAKaRqalasya ca । SIrRaM purABavattAta grahasyANgezu keSava ॥54॥

text: ardyamānāśca vibudhā graheṇa subalīyasā । śivadattavarāñjaghnurasurendrānsurā bhṛśam ॥55॥
html:
ardyamānāśca vibudhā graheṇa subalīyasā ।
śivadattavarāñjaghnurasurendrānsurā bhṛśam ॥55॥
slp1: ardyamAnASca vibuDA graheRa subalIyasA । SivadattavarAYjaGnurasurendrAnsurA BfSam ॥55॥

text: tuṣṭo vidyutprabhasyāpi trilokeśvaratāmadāt । śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ sarvalokeśvaro'bhavat । mamaivānucaro nityaṃ bhavitāsīti cābravīt ॥56॥
html:
tuṣṭo vidyutprabhasyāpi trilokeśvaratāmadāt ।
śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ sarvalokeśvaro'bhavat ।
mamaivānucaro nityaṃ bhavitāsīti cābravīt ॥56॥
slp1: tuzwo vidyutpraBasyApi trilokeSvaratAmadAt । SataM varzasahasrARAM sarvalokeSvaro'Bavat । mamEvAnucaro nityaM BavitAsIti cAbravIt ॥56॥

text: tathā putrasahasrāṇāmayutaṃ ca dadau prabhuḥ । kuśadvīpaṃ ca sa dadau rājyena bhagavānajaḥ ॥57॥
html:
tathā putrasahasrāṇāmayutaṃ ca dadau prabhuḥ ।
kuśadvīpaṃ ca sa dadau rājyena bhagavānajaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: taTA putrasahasrARAmayutaM ca dadO praBuH । kuSadvIpaM ca sa dadO rAjyena BagavAnajaH ॥57॥

text: tathā śatamukho nāma dhātrā sṛṣṭo mahāsuraḥ । yena varṣaśataṃ sāgramātmamāṃsairhuto'nalaḥ । taṃ prāha bhagavāṃstuṣṭaḥ kiṃ karomīti śaṅkaraḥ ॥58॥
html:
tathā śatamukho nāma dhātrā sṛṣṭo mahāsuraḥ ।
yena varṣaśataṃ sāgramātmamāṃsairhuto'nalaḥ ।
taṃ prāha bhagavāṃstuṣṭaḥ kiṃ karomīti śaṅkaraḥ ॥58॥
slp1: taTA SatamuKo nAma DAtrA sfzwo mahAsuraH । yena varzaSataM sAgramAtmamAMsErhuto'nalaH । taM prAha BagavAMstuzwaH kiM karomIti SaNkaraH ॥58॥

text: taṃ vai śatamukhaḥ prāha yogo bhavatu me'dbhutaḥ । balaṃ ca daivataśreṣṭha śāśvataṃ samprayaccha me ॥59॥
html:
taṃ vai śatamukhaḥ prāha yogo bhavatu me'dbhutaḥ ।
balaṃ ca daivataśreṣṭha śāśvataṃ samprayaccha me ॥59॥
slp1: taM vE SatamuKaH prAha yogo Bavatu me'dButaH । balaM ca dEvataSrezWa SASvataM samprayacCa me ॥59॥

text: svāyambhuvaḥ kratuścāpi putrārthamabhavatpurā । āviśya yogenātmānaṃ trīṇi varṣaśatānyapi ॥60॥
html:
svāyambhuvaḥ kratuścāpi putrārthamabhavatpurā ।
āviśya yogenātmānaṃ trīṇi varṣaśatānyapi ॥60॥
slp1: svAyamBuvaH kratuScApi putrArTamaBavatpurA । AviSya yogenAtmAnaM trIRi varzaSatAnyapi ॥60॥

text: tasya devo'dadatputrānsahasraṃ kratusammitān । yogeśvaraṃ devagītaṃ vettha kṛṣṇa na saṃśayaḥ ॥61॥
html:
tasya devo'dadatputrānsahasraṃ kratusammitān ।
yogeśvaraṃ devagītaṃ vettha kṛṣṇa na saṃśayaḥ ॥61॥
slp1: tasya devo'dadatputrAnsahasraM kratusammitAn । yogeSvaraM devagItaM vetTa kfzRa na saMSayaH ॥61॥

text: vālakhilyā maghavatā avajñātāḥ purā kila । taiḥ kruddhairbhagavānrudrastapasā toṣito hyabhūt ॥62॥
html:
vālakhilyā maghavatā avajñātāḥ purā kila ।
taiḥ kruddhairbhagavānrudrastapasā toṣito hyabhūt ॥62॥
slp1: vAlaKilyA maGavatA avajYAtAH purA kila । tEH krudDErBagavAnrudrastapasA tozito hyaBUt ॥62॥

text: tāṃścāpi daivataśreṣṭhaḥ prāha prīto jagatpatiḥ । suparṇaṃ somahartāraṃ tapasotpādayiṣyatha ॥63॥
html:
tāṃścāpi daivataśreṣṭhaḥ prāha prīto jagatpatiḥ ।
suparṇaṃ somahartāraṃ tapasotpādayiṣyatha ॥63॥
slp1: tAMScApi dEvataSrezWaH prAha prIto jagatpatiH । suparRaM somahartAraM tapasotpAdayizyaTa ॥63॥

text: mahādevasya roṣācca āpo naṣṭāḥ purābhavan । tāśca saptakapālena devairanyāḥ pravartitāḥ ॥64॥
html:
mahādevasya roṣācca āpo naṣṭāḥ purābhavan ।
tāśca saptakapālena devairanyāḥ pravartitāḥ ॥64॥
slp1: mahAdevasya rozAcca Apo nazwAH purABavan । tASca saptakapAlena devEranyAH pravartitAH ॥64॥

text: atrerbhāryāpi bhartāraṃ santyajya brahmavādinī । nāhaṃ tasya munerbhūyo vaśagā syāṃ kathañcana । ityuktvā sā mahādevamagacchaccharaṇaṃ kila ॥65॥
html:
atrerbhāryāpi bhartāraṃ santyajya brahmavādinī ।
nāhaṃ tasya munerbhūyo vaśagā syāṃ kathañcana ।
ityuktvā sā mahādevamagacchaccharaṇaṃ kila ॥65॥
slp1: atrerBAryApi BartAraM santyajya brahmavAdinI । nAhaM tasya munerBUyo vaSagA syAM kaTaYcana । ityuktvA sA mahAdevamagacCacCaraRaM kila ॥65॥

text: nirāhārā bhayādatrestrīṇi varṣaśatānyapi । aśeta musaleṣveva prasādārthaṃ bhavasya sā ॥66॥
html:
nirāhārā bhayādatrestrīṇi varṣaśatānyapi ।
aśeta musaleṣveva prasādārthaṃ bhavasya sā ॥66॥
slp1: nirAhArA BayAdatrestrIRi varzaSatAnyapi । aSeta musalezveva prasAdArTaM Bavasya sA ॥66॥

text: tāmabravīddhasandevo bhavitā vai sutastava । vaṃśe tavaiva nāmnā tu khyātiṃ yāsyati cepsitām ॥67॥
html:
tāmabravīddhasandevo bhavitā vai sutastava ।
vaṃśe tavaiva nāmnā tu khyātiṃ yāsyati cepsitām ॥67॥
slp1: tAmabravIdDasandevo BavitA vE sutastava । vaMSe tavEva nAmnA tu KyAtiM yAsyati cepsitAm ॥67॥

text: śākalyaḥ saṃśitātmā vai nava varṣaśatānyapi । ārādhayāmāsa bhavaṃ manoyajñena keśava ॥68॥
html:
śākalyaḥ saṃśitātmā vai nava varṣaśatānyapi ।
ārādhayāmāsa bhavaṃ manoyajñena keśava ॥68॥
slp1: SAkalyaH saMSitAtmA vE nava varzaSatAnyapi । ArADayAmAsa BavaM manoyajYena keSava ॥68॥

text: taṃ cāha bhagavāṃstuṣṭo granthakāro bhaviṣyasi । vatsākṣayā ca te kīrtistrailokye vai bhaviṣyati । akṣayaṃ ca kulaṃ te'stu maharṣibhiralaṅkṛtam ॥69॥
html:
taṃ cāha bhagavāṃstuṣṭo granthakāro bhaviṣyasi ।
vatsākṣayā ca te kīrtistrailokye vai bhaviṣyati ।
akṣayaṃ ca kulaṃ te'stu maharṣibhiralaṅkṛtam ॥69॥
slp1: taM cAha BagavAMstuzwo granTakAro Bavizyasi । vatsAkzayA ca te kIrtistrElokye vE Bavizyati । akzayaM ca kulaM te'stu maharziBiralaNkftam ॥69॥

text: sāvarṇiścāpi vikhyāta ṛṣirāsītkṛte yuge । iha tena tapastaptaṃ ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣaśatānyatha ॥70॥
html:
sāvarṇiścāpi vikhyāta ṛṣirāsītkṛte yuge ।
iha tena tapastaptaṃ ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣaśatānyatha ॥70॥
slp1: sAvarRiScApi viKyAta fzirAsItkfte yuge । iha tena tapastaptaM zazwiM varzaSatAnyaTa ॥70॥

text: tamāha bhagavānrudraḥ sākṣāttuṣṭo'smi te'nagha । granthakṛllokavikhyāto bhavitāsyajarāmaraḥ ॥71॥
html:
tamāha bhagavānrudraḥ sākṣāttuṣṭo'smi te'nagha ।
granthakṛllokavikhyāto bhavitāsyajarāmaraḥ ॥71॥
slp1: tamAha BagavAnrudraH sAkzAttuzwo'smi te'naGa । granTakfllokaviKyAto BavitAsyajarAmaraH ॥71॥

text: mayāpi ca yathā dṛṣṭo devadevaḥ purā vibhuḥ । sākṣātpaśupatistāta taccāpi śṛṇu mādhava ॥72॥
html:
mayāpi ca yathā dṛṣṭo devadevaḥ purā vibhuḥ ।
sākṣātpaśupatistāta taccāpi śṛṇu mādhava ॥72॥
slp1: mayApi ca yaTA dfzwo devadevaH purA viBuH । sAkzAtpaSupatistAta taccApi SfRu mADava ॥72॥

text: yadarthaṃ ca mahādevaḥ prayatena mayā purā । ārādhito mahātejāstaccāpi śṛṇu vistaram ॥73॥
html:
yadarthaṃ ca mahādevaḥ prayatena mayā purā ।
ārādhito mahātejāstaccāpi śṛṇu vistaram ॥73॥
slp1: yadarTaM ca mahAdevaH prayatena mayA purA । ArADito mahAtejAstaccApi SfRu vistaram ॥73॥

text: yadavāptaṃ ca me pūrvaṃ devadevānmaheśvarāt । tatsarvamakhilenādya kathayiṣyāmi te'nagha ॥74॥
html:
yadavāptaṃ ca me pūrvaṃ devadevānmaheśvarāt ।
tatsarvamakhilenādya kathayiṣyāmi te'nagha ॥74॥
slp1: yadavAptaM ca me pUrvaM devadevAnmaheSvarAt । tatsarvamaKilenAdya kaTayizyAmi te'naGa ॥74॥

text: purā kṛtayuge tāta ṛṣirāsīnmahāyaśāḥ । vyāghrapāda iti khyāto vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ । tasyāhamabhavaṃ putro dhaumyaścāpi mamānujaḥ ॥75॥
html:
purā kṛtayuge tāta ṛṣirāsīnmahāyaśāḥ ।
vyāghrapāda iti khyāto vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ।
tasyāhamabhavaṃ putro dhaumyaścāpi mamānujaḥ ॥75॥
slp1: purA kftayuge tAta fzirAsInmahAyaSAH । vyAGrapAda iti KyAto vedavedANgapAragaH । tasyAhamaBavaM putro DOmyaScApi mamAnujaH ॥75॥

text: kasyacittvatha kālasya dhaumyena saha mādhava । āgacchamāśramaṃ krīḍanmunīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ॥76॥
html:
kasyacittvatha kālasya dhaumyena saha mādhava ।
āgacchamāśramaṃ krīḍanmunīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ॥76॥
slp1: kasyacittvaTa kAlasya DOmyena saha mADava । AgacCamASramaM krIqanmunInAM BAvitAtmanAm ॥76॥

text: tatrāpi ca mayā dṛṣṭā duhyamānā payasvinī । lakṣitaṃ ca mayā kṣīraṃ svāduto hyamṛtopamam ॥77॥
html:
tatrāpi ca mayā dṛṣṭā duhyamānā payasvinī ।
lakṣitaṃ ca mayā kṣīraṃ svāduto hyamṛtopamam ॥77॥
slp1: tatrApi ca mayA dfzwA duhyamAnA payasvinI । lakzitaM ca mayA kzIraM svAduto hyamftopamam ॥77॥

text: tataḥ piṣṭaṃ samāloḍya toyena saha mādhava । āvayoḥ kṣīramityeva pānārthamupanīyate ॥78॥
html:
tataḥ piṣṭaṃ samāloḍya toyena saha mādhava ।
āvayoḥ kṣīramityeva pānārthamupanīyate ॥78॥
slp1: tataH pizwaM samAloqya toyena saha mADava । AvayoH kzIramityeva pAnArTamupanIyate ॥78॥

text: atha gavyaṃ payastāta kadācitprāśitaṃ mayā । tataḥ piṣṭarasaṃ tāta na me prītimudāvahat ॥79॥
html:
atha gavyaṃ payastāta kadācitprāśitaṃ mayā ।
tataḥ piṣṭarasaṃ tāta na me prītimudāvahat ॥79॥
slp1: aTa gavyaM payastAta kadAcitprASitaM mayA । tataH pizwarasaM tAta na me prItimudAvahat ॥79॥

text: tato'hamabruvaṃ bālyājjananīmātmanastadā । kṣīrodanasamāyuktaṃ bhojanaṃ ca prayaccha me ॥80॥
html:
tato'hamabruvaṃ bālyājjananīmātmanastadā ।
kṣīrodanasamāyuktaṃ bhojanaṃ ca prayaccha me ॥80॥
slp1: tato'hamabruvaM bAlyAjjananImAtmanastadA । kzIrodanasamAyuktaM BojanaM ca prayacCa me ॥80॥

text: tato māmabravīnmātā duḥkhaśokasamanvitā । putrasnehātpariṣvajya mūrdhni cāghrāya mādhava ॥81॥
html:
tato māmabravīnmātā duḥkhaśokasamanvitā ।
putrasnehātpariṣvajya mūrdhni cāghrāya mādhava ॥81॥
slp1: tato mAmabravInmAtA duHKaSokasamanvitA । putrasnehAtparizvajya mUrDni cAGrAya mADava ॥81॥

text: kutaḥ kṣīrodanaṃ vatsa munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām । vane nivasatāṃ nityaṃ kandamūlaphalāśinām ॥82॥
html:
kutaḥ kṣīrodanaṃ vatsa munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ।
vane nivasatāṃ nityaṃ kandamūlaphalāśinām ॥82॥
slp1: kutaH kzIrodanaM vatsa munInAM BAvitAtmanAm । vane nivasatAM nityaM kandamUlaPalASinAm ॥82॥

text: aprasādya virūpākṣaṃ varadaṃ sthāṇumavyayam । kutaḥ kṣīrodanaṃ vatsa sukhāni vasanāni ca ॥83॥
html:
aprasādya virūpākṣaṃ varadaṃ sthāṇumavyayam ।
kutaḥ kṣīrodanaṃ vatsa sukhāni vasanāni ca ॥83॥
slp1: aprasAdya virUpAkzaM varadaM sTARumavyayam । kutaH kzIrodanaM vatsa suKAni vasanAni ca ॥83॥

text: taṃ prapadya sadā vatsa sarvabhāvena śaṅkaram । tatprasādācca kāmebhyaḥ phalaṃ prāpsyasi putraka ॥84॥
html:
taṃ prapadya sadā vatsa sarvabhāvena śaṅkaram ।
tatprasādācca kāmebhyaḥ phalaṃ prāpsyasi putraka ॥84॥
slp1: taM prapadya sadA vatsa sarvaBAvena SaNkaram । tatprasAdAcca kAmeByaH PalaM prApsyasi putraka ॥84॥

text: jananyāstadvacaḥ śrutvā tadāprabhṛti śatruhan । mama bhaktirmahādeve naiṣṭhikī samapadyata ॥85॥
html:
jananyāstadvacaḥ śrutvā tadāprabhṛti śatruhan ।
mama bhaktirmahādeve naiṣṭhikī samapadyata ॥85॥
slp1: jananyAstadvacaH SrutvA tadApraBfti Satruhan । mama BaktirmahAdeve nEzWikI samapadyata ॥85॥

text: tato'haṃ tapa āsthāya toṣayāmāsa śaṅkaram । divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu pādāṅguṣṭhāgraviṣṭhitaḥ ॥86॥
html:
tato'haṃ tapa āsthāya toṣayāmāsa śaṅkaram ।
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu pādāṅguṣṭhāgraviṣṭhitaḥ ॥86॥
slp1: tato'haM tapa AsTAya tozayAmAsa SaNkaram । divyaM varzasahasraM tu pAdANguzWAgravizWitaH ॥86॥

text: ekaṃ varṣaśataṃ caiva phalāhārastadābhavam । dvitīyaṃ śīrṇaparṇāśī tṛtīyaṃ cāmbubhojanaḥ । śatāni sapta caivāhaṃ vāyubhakṣastadābhavam ॥87॥
html:
ekaṃ varṣaśataṃ caiva phalāhārastadābhavam ।
dvitīyaṃ śīrṇaparṇāśī tṛtīyaṃ cāmbubhojanaḥ ।
śatāni sapta caivāhaṃ vāyubhakṣastadābhavam ॥87॥
slp1: ekaM varzaSataM cEva PalAhArastadABavam । dvitIyaM SIrRaparRASI tftIyaM cAmbuBojanaH । SatAni sapta cEvAhaM vAyuBakzastadABavam ॥87॥

text: tataḥ prīto mahādevaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ । śakrarūpaṃ sa kṛtvā tu sarvairdevagaṇairvṛtaḥ । sahasrākṣastadā bhūtvā vajrapāṇirmahāyaśāḥ ॥88॥
html:
tataḥ prīto mahādevaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
śakrarūpaṃ sa kṛtvā tu sarvairdevagaṇairvṛtaḥ ।
sahasrākṣastadā bhūtvā vajrapāṇirmahāyaśāḥ ॥88॥
slp1: tataH prIto mahAdevaH sarvalokeSvaraH praBuH । SakrarUpaM sa kftvA tu sarvErdevagaRErvftaH । sahasrAkzastadA BUtvA vajrapARirmahAyaSAH ॥88॥

text: sudhāvadātaṃ raktākṣaṃ stabdhakarṇaṃ madotkaṭam । āveṣṭitakaraṃ raudraṃ caturdaṃṣṭraṃ mahāgajam ॥89॥
html:
sudhāvadātaṃ raktākṣaṃ stabdhakarṇaṃ madotkaṭam ।
āveṣṭitakaraṃ raudraṃ caturdaṃṣṭraṃ mahāgajam ॥89॥
slp1: suDAvadAtaM raktAkzaM stabDakarRaM madotkawam । AvezwitakaraM rOdraM caturdaMzwraM mahAgajam ॥89॥

text: samāsthitaśca bhagavāndīpyamānaḥ svatejasā । ājagāma kirīṭī tu hārakeyūrabhūṣitaḥ ॥90॥
html:
samāsthitaśca bhagavāndīpyamānaḥ svatejasā ।
ājagāma kirīṭī tu hārakeyūrabhūṣitaḥ ॥90॥
slp1: samAsTitaSca BagavAndIpyamAnaH svatejasA । AjagAma kirIwI tu hArakeyUraBUzitaH ॥90॥

text: pāṇḍureṇātapatreṇa dhriyamāṇena mūrdhani । sevyamāno'psarobhiśca divyagandharvanāditaḥ ॥91॥
html:
pāṇḍureṇātapatreṇa dhriyamāṇena mūrdhani ।
sevyamāno'psarobhiśca divyagandharvanāditaḥ ॥91॥
slp1: pARqureRAtapatreRa DriyamARena mUrDani । sevyamAno'psaroBiSca divyaganDarvanAditaH ॥91॥

text: tato māmāha devendraḥ prītaste'haṃ dvijottama । varaṃ vṛṇīṣva mattastvaṃ yatte manasi vartate ॥92॥
html:
tato māmāha devendraḥ prītaste'haṃ dvijottama ।
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva mattastvaṃ yatte manasi vartate ॥92॥
slp1: tato mAmAha devendraH prItaste'haM dvijottama । varaM vfRIzva mattastvaM yatte manasi vartate ॥92॥

text: śakrasya tu vacaḥ śrutvā nāhaṃ prītamanābhavam । abruvaṃ ca tadā kṛṣṇa devarājamidaṃ vacaḥ ॥93॥
html:
śakrasya tu vacaḥ śrutvā nāhaṃ prītamanābhavam ।
abruvaṃ ca tadā kṛṣṇa devarājamidaṃ vacaḥ ॥93॥
slp1: Sakrasya tu vacaH SrutvA nAhaM prItamanABavam । abruvaM ca tadA kfzRa devarAjamidaM vacaH ॥93॥

text: nāhaṃ tvatto varaṃ kāṅkṣe nānyasmādapi daivatāt । mahādevādṛte saumya satyametadbravīmi te ॥94॥
html:
nāhaṃ tvatto varaṃ kāṅkṣe nānyasmādapi daivatāt ।
mahādevādṛte saumya satyametadbravīmi te ॥94॥
slp1: nAhaM tvatto varaM kANkze nAnyasmAdapi dEvatAt । mahAdevAdfte sOmya satyametadbravImi te ॥94॥

text: paśupativacanādbhavāmi sadyaḥ kṛmiratha vā tarurapyanekaśākhaḥ । apaśupativaraprasādajā me tribhuvanarājyavibhūtirapyaniṣṭā ॥95॥
html:
paśupativacanādbhavāmi sadyaḥ kṛmiratha vā tarurapyanekaśākhaḥ ।
apaśupativaraprasādajā me tribhuvanarājyavibhūtirapyaniṣṭā ॥95॥
slp1: paSupativacanAdBavAmi sadyaH kfmiraTa vA tarurapyanekaSAKaH । apaSupativaraprasAdajA me triBuvanarAjyaviBUtirapyanizwA ॥95॥

text: api kīṭaḥ pataṅgo vā bhaveyaṃ śaṅkarājñayā । na tu śakra tvayā dattaṃ trailokyamapi kāmaye ॥96॥
html:
api kīṭaḥ pataṅgo vā bhaveyaṃ śaṅkarājñayā ।
na tu śakra tvayā dattaṃ trailokyamapi kāmaye ॥96॥
slp1: api kIwaH pataNgo vA BaveyaM SaNkarAjYayA । na tu Sakra tvayA dattaM trElokyamapi kAmaye ॥96॥

text: yāvacchaśāṅkaśakalāmalabaddhamaulirna prīyate paśupatirbhagavānmameśaḥ । tāvajjarāmaraṇajanmaśatābhighātairduḥkhāni dehavihitāni samudvahāmi ॥97॥
html:
yāvacchaśāṅkaśakalāmalabaddhamaulirna prīyate paśupatirbhagavānmameśaḥ ।
tāvajjarāmaraṇajanmaśatābhighātairduḥkhāni dehavihitāni samudvahāmi ॥97॥
slp1: yAvacCaSANkaSakalAmalabadDamOlirna prIyate paSupatirBagavAnmameSaH । tAvajjarAmaraRajanmaSatABiGAtErduHKAni dehavihitAni samudvahAmi ॥97॥

text: divasakaraśaśāṅkavahnidīptaṃ tribhuvanasāramapāramādyamekam । ajaramamaramaprasādya rudraṃ jagati pumāniha ko labheta śāntim ॥98॥
html:
divasakaraśaśāṅkavahnidīptaṃ tribhuvanasāramapāramādyamekam ।
ajaramamaramaprasādya rudraṃ jagati pumāniha ko labheta śāntim ॥98॥
slp1: divasakaraSaSANkavahnidIptaM triBuvanasAramapAramAdyamekam । ajaramamaramaprasAdya rudraM jagati pumAniha ko laBeta SAntim ॥98॥

text: kaḥ punastava heturvai īśe kāraṇakāraṇe । yena devādṛte'nyasmātprasādaṃ nābhikāṅkṣasi ॥99॥
html:
kaḥ punastava heturvai īśe kāraṇakāraṇe ।
yena devādṛte'nyasmātprasādaṃ nābhikāṅkṣasi ॥99॥
slp1: kaH punastava heturvE ISe kAraRakAraRe । yena devAdfte'nyasmAtprasAdaM nABikANkzasi ॥99॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: hetubhirvā kimanyaiste īśaḥ kāraṇakāraṇam । na śuśruma yadanyasya liṅgamabhyarcyate suraiḥ ॥100॥
html:
hetubhirvā kimanyaiste īśaḥ kāraṇakāraṇam ।
na śuśruma yadanyasya liṅgamabhyarcyate suraiḥ ॥100॥
slp1: hetuBirvA kimanyEste ISaH kAraRakAraRam । na SuSruma yadanyasya liNgamaByarcyate surEH ॥100॥
author: upamanyuruvāca ।

text: kasyānyasya suraiḥ sarvairliṅgaṃ muktvā maheśvaram । arcyate'rcitapūrvaṃ vā brūhi yadyasti te śrutiḥ ॥101॥
html:
kasyānyasya suraiḥ sarvairliṅgaṃ muktvā maheśvaram ।
arcyate'rcitapūrvaṃ vā brūhi yadyasti te śrutiḥ ॥101॥
slp1: kasyAnyasya surEH sarvErliNgaM muktvA maheSvaram । arcyate'rcitapUrvaM vA brUhi yadyasti te SrutiH ॥101॥

text: yasya brahmā ca viṣṇuśca tvaṃ cāpi saha daivataiḥ । arcayadhvaṃ sadā liṅgaṃ tasmācchreṣṭhatamo hi saḥ ॥102॥
html:
yasya brahmā ca viṣṇuśca tvaṃ cāpi saha daivataiḥ ।
arcayadhvaṃ sadā liṅgaṃ tasmācchreṣṭhatamo hi saḥ ॥102॥
slp1: yasya brahmA ca vizRuSca tvaM cApi saha dEvatEH । arcayaDvaM sadA liNgaM tasmAcCrezWatamo hi saH ॥102॥

text: tasmādvaramahaṃ kāṅkṣe nidhanaṃ vāpi kauśika । gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā śakra yatheṣṭaṃ balasūdana ॥103॥
html:
tasmādvaramahaṃ kāṅkṣe nidhanaṃ vāpi kauśika ।
gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā śakra yatheṣṭaṃ balasūdana ॥103॥
slp1: tasmAdvaramahaM kANkze niDanaM vApi kOSika । gacCa vA tizWa vA Sakra yaTezwaM balasUdana ॥103॥

text: kāmameṣa varo me'stu śāpo vāpi maheśvarāt । na cānyāṃ devatāṃ kāṅkṣe sarvakāmaphalānyapi ॥104॥
html:
kāmameṣa varo me'stu śāpo vāpi maheśvarāt ।
na cānyāṃ devatāṃ kāṅkṣe sarvakāmaphalānyapi ॥104॥
slp1: kAmameza varo me'stu SApo vApi maheSvarAt । na cAnyAM devatAM kANkze sarvakAmaPalAnyapi ॥104॥

text: evamuktvā tu devendraṃ duḥkhādākulitendriyaḥ । na prasīdati me rudraḥ kimetaditi cintayan । athāpaśyaṃ kṣaṇenaiva tamevairāvataṃ punaḥ ॥105॥
html:
evamuktvā tu devendraṃ duḥkhādākulitendriyaḥ ।
na prasīdati me rudraḥ kimetaditi cintayan ।
athāpaśyaṃ kṣaṇenaiva tamevairāvataṃ punaḥ ॥105॥
slp1: evamuktvA tu devendraM duHKAdAkulitendriyaH । na prasIdati me rudraH kimetaditi cintayan । aTApaSyaM kzaRenEva tamevErAvataM punaH ॥105॥

text: haṃsakundendusadṛśaṃ mṛṇālakumudaprabham । vṛṣarūpadharaṃ sākṣātkṣīrodamiva sāgaram ॥106॥
html:
haṃsakundendusadṛśaṃ mṛṇālakumudaprabham ।
vṛṣarūpadharaṃ sākṣātkṣīrodamiva sāgaram ॥106॥
slp1: haMsakundendusadfSaM mfRAlakumudapraBam । vfzarUpaDaraM sAkzAtkzIrodamiva sAgaram ॥106॥

text: kṛṣṇapucchaṃ mahākāyaṃ madhupiṅgalalocanam । jāmbūnadena dāmnā ca sarvataḥ samalaṅkṛtam ॥107॥
html:
kṛṣṇapucchaṃ mahākāyaṃ madhupiṅgalalocanam ।
jāmbūnadena dāmnā ca sarvataḥ samalaṅkṛtam ॥107॥
slp1: kfzRapucCaM mahAkAyaM maDupiNgalalocanam । jAmbUnadena dAmnA ca sarvataH samalaNkftam ॥107॥

text: raktākṣaṃ sumahānāsaṃ sukarṇaṃ sukaṭītaṭam । supārśvaṃ vipulaskandhaṃ surūpaṃ cārudarśanam ॥108॥
html:
raktākṣaṃ sumahānāsaṃ sukarṇaṃ sukaṭītaṭam ।
supārśvaṃ vipulaskandhaṃ surūpaṃ cārudarśanam ॥108॥
slp1: raktAkzaM sumahAnAsaM sukarRaM sukawItawam । supArSvaM vipulaskanDaM surUpaM cArudarSanam ॥108॥

text: kakudaṃ tasya cābhāti skandhamāpūrya viṣṭhitam । tuṣāragirikūṭābhaṃ sitābhraśikharopamam ॥109॥
html:
kakudaṃ tasya cābhāti skandhamāpūrya viṣṭhitam ।
tuṣāragirikūṭābhaṃ sitābhraśikharopamam ॥109॥
slp1: kakudaM tasya cABAti skanDamApUrya vizWitam । tuzAragirikUwABaM sitABraSiKaropamam ॥109॥

text: tamāsthitaśca bhagavāndevadevaḥ sahomayā । aśobhata mahādevaḥ paurṇamāsyāmivoḍurāṭ ॥110॥
html:
tamāsthitaśca bhagavāndevadevaḥ sahomayā ।
aśobhata mahādevaḥ paurṇamāsyāmivoḍurāṭ ॥110॥
slp1: tamAsTitaSca BagavAndevadevaH sahomayA । aSoBata mahAdevaH pOrRamAsyAmivoqurAw ॥110॥

text: tasya tejobhavo vahniḥ sameghaḥ stanayitnumān । sahasramiva sūryāṇāṃ sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ॥111॥
html:
tasya tejobhavo vahniḥ sameghaḥ stanayitnumān ।
sahasramiva sūryāṇāṃ sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ॥111॥
slp1: tasya tejoBavo vahniH sameGaH stanayitnumAn । sahasramiva sUryARAM sarvamAvftya tizWati ॥111॥

text: īśvaraḥ sumahātejāḥ saṃvartaka ivānalaḥ । yugānte sarvabhūtāni didhakṣuriva codyataḥ ॥112॥
html:
īśvaraḥ sumahātejāḥ saṃvartaka ivānalaḥ ।
yugānte sarvabhūtāni didhakṣuriva codyataḥ ॥112॥
slp1: ISvaraH sumahAtejAH saMvartaka ivAnalaH । yugAnte sarvaBUtAni diDakzuriva codyataH ॥112॥

text: tejasā tu tadā vyāpte durnirīkṣye samantataḥ । punarudvignahṛdayaḥ kimetaditi cintayam ॥113॥
html:
tejasā tu tadā vyāpte durnirīkṣye samantataḥ ।
punarudvignahṛdayaḥ kimetaditi cintayam ॥113॥
slp1: tejasA tu tadA vyApte durnirIkzye samantataH । punarudvignahfdayaH kimetaditi cintayam ॥113॥

text: muhūrtamiva tattejo vyāpya sarvā diśo daśa । praśāntaṃ ca kṣaṇenaiva devadevasya māyayā ॥114॥
html:
muhūrtamiva tattejo vyāpya sarvā diśo daśa ।
praśāntaṃ ca kṣaṇenaiva devadevasya māyayā ॥114॥
slp1: muhUrtamiva tattejo vyApya sarvA diSo daSa । praSAntaM ca kzaRenEva devadevasya mAyayA ॥114॥

text: athāpaśyaṃ sthitaṃ sthāṇuṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaram । saurabheyagataṃ saumyaṃ vidhūmamiva pāvakam । sahitaṃ cārusarvāṅgyā pārvatyā parameśvaram ॥115॥
html:
athāpaśyaṃ sthitaṃ sthāṇuṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaram ।
saurabheyagataṃ saumyaṃ vidhūmamiva pāvakam ।
sahitaṃ cārusarvāṅgyā pārvatyā parameśvaram ॥115॥
slp1: aTApaSyaM sTitaM sTARuM BagavantaM maheSvaram । sOraBeyagataM sOmyaM viDUmamiva pAvakam । sahitaM cArusarvANgyA pArvatyA parameSvaram ॥115॥

text: nīlakaṇṭhaṃ mahātmānamasaktaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim । aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ sthāṇuṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ॥116॥
html:
nīlakaṇṭhaṃ mahātmānamasaktaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim ।
aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ sthāṇuṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ॥116॥
slp1: nIlakaRWaM mahAtmAnamasaktaM tejasAM niDim । azwAdaSaBujaM sTARuM sarvABaraRaBUzitam ॥116॥

text: śuklāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ śuklamālyānulepanam । śukladhvajamanādhṛṣyaṃ śuklayajñopavītinam ॥117॥
html:
śuklāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ śuklamālyānulepanam ।
śukladhvajamanādhṛṣyaṃ śuklayajñopavītinam ॥117॥
slp1: SuklAmbaraDaraM devaM SuklamAlyAnulepanam । SuklaDvajamanADfzyaM SuklayajYopavItinam ॥117॥

text: gāyadbhirnṛtyamānaiśca utpatadbhiritastataḥ । vṛtaṃ pāriṣadairdivyairātmatulyaparākramaiḥ ॥118॥
html:
gāyadbhirnṛtyamānaiśca utpatadbhiritastataḥ ।
vṛtaṃ pāriṣadairdivyairātmatulyaparākramaiḥ ॥118॥
slp1: gAyadBirnftyamAnESca utpatadBiritastataH । vftaM pArizadErdivyErAtmatulyaparAkramEH ॥118॥

text: bālendumukuṭaṃ pāṇḍuṃ śaraccandramivoditam । tribhirnetraiḥ kṛtoddyotaṃ tribhiḥ sūryairivoditaiḥ ॥119॥
html:
bālendumukuṭaṃ pāṇḍuṃ śaraccandramivoditam ।
tribhirnetraiḥ kṛtoddyotaṃ tribhiḥ sūryairivoditaiḥ ॥119॥
slp1: bAlendumukuwaM pARquM Saraccandramivoditam । triBirnetrEH kftoddyotaM triBiH sUryErivoditEH ॥119॥

text: aśobhata ca devasya mālā gātre sitaprabhe । jātarūpamayaiḥ padmairgrathitā ratnabhūṣitā ॥120॥
html:
aśobhata ca devasya mālā gātre sitaprabhe ।
jātarūpamayaiḥ padmairgrathitā ratnabhūṣitā ॥120॥
slp1: aSoBata ca devasya mAlA gAtre sitapraBe । jAtarUpamayEH padmErgraTitA ratnaBUzitA ॥120॥

text: mūrtimanti tathāstrāṇi sarvatejomayāni ca । mayā dṛṣṭāni govinda bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ ॥121॥
html:
mūrtimanti tathāstrāṇi sarvatejomayāni ca ।
mayā dṛṣṭāni govinda bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ ॥121॥
slp1: mUrtimanti taTAstrARi sarvatejomayAni ca । mayA dfzwAni govinda BavasyAmitatejasaH ॥121॥

text: indrāyudhasahasrābhaṃ dhanustasya mahātmanaḥ । pinākamiti vikhyātaṃ sa ca vai pannago mahān ॥122॥
html:
indrāyudhasahasrābhaṃ dhanustasya mahātmanaḥ ।
pinākamiti vikhyātaṃ sa ca vai pannago mahān ॥122॥
slp1: indrAyuDasahasrABaM Danustasya mahAtmanaH । pinAkamiti viKyAtaM sa ca vE pannago mahAn ॥122॥

text: saptaśīrṣo mahākāyastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro viṣolbaṇaḥ । jyāveṣṭitamahāgrīvaḥ sthitaḥ puruṣavigrahaḥ ॥123॥
html:
saptaśīrṣo mahākāyastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro viṣolbaṇaḥ ।
jyāveṣṭitamahāgrīvaḥ sthitaḥ puruṣavigrahaḥ ॥123॥
slp1: saptaSIrzo mahAkAyastIkzRadaMzwro vizolbaRaH । jyAvezwitamahAgrIvaH sTitaH puruzavigrahaH ॥123॥

text: śaraśca sūryasaṅkāśaḥ kālānalasamadyutiḥ । yattadastraṃ mahāghoraṃ divyaṃ pāśupataṃ mahat ॥124॥
html:
śaraśca sūryasaṅkāśaḥ kālānalasamadyutiḥ ।
yattadastraṃ mahāghoraṃ divyaṃ pāśupataṃ mahat ॥124॥
slp1: SaraSca sUryasaNkASaH kAlAnalasamadyutiH । yattadastraM mahAGoraM divyaM pASupataM mahat ॥124॥

text: advitīyamanirdeśyaṃ sarvabhūtabhayāvaham । sasphuliṅgaṃ mahākāyaṃ visṛjantamivānalam ॥125॥
html:
advitīyamanirdeśyaṃ sarvabhūtabhayāvaham ।
sasphuliṅgaṃ mahākāyaṃ visṛjantamivānalam ॥125॥
slp1: advitIyamanirdeSyaM sarvaBUtaBayAvaham । sasPuliNgaM mahAkAyaM visfjantamivAnalam ॥125॥

html:
ekapādaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ sahasraśirasodaram ।
sahasrabhujajihvākṣamudgirantamivānalam ॥126॥
slp1: ekapAdaM mahAdaMzwraM sahasraSirasodaram । sahasraBujajihvAkzamudgirantamivAnalam ॥126॥

text: brāhmānnārāyaṇādaindrādāgneyādapi vāruṇāt । yadviśiṣṭaṃ mahābāho sarvaśastravighātanam ॥127॥
html:
brāhmānnārāyaṇādaindrādāgneyādapi vāruṇāt ।
yadviśiṣṭaṃ mahābāho sarvaśastravighātanam ॥127॥
slp1: brAhmAnnArAyaRAdEndrAdAgneyAdapi vAruRAt । yadviSizwaM mahAbAho sarvaSastraviGAtanam ॥127॥

html:
yena tattripuraṃ dagdhvā kṣaṇādbhasmīkṛtaṃ purā ।
śareṇaikena govinda mahādevena līlayā ॥128॥
slp1: yena tattripuraM dagDvA kzaRAdBasmIkftaM purA । SareREkena govinda mahAdevena lIlayA ॥128॥

text: nirdadāha jagatkṛtsnaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram । maheśvarabhujotsṛṣṭaṃ nimeṣārdhānna saṃśayaḥ ॥129॥
html:
nirdadāha jagatkṛtsnaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ।
maheśvarabhujotsṛṣṭaṃ nimeṣārdhānna saṃśayaḥ ॥129॥
slp1: nirdadAha jagatkftsnaM trElokyaM sacarAcaram । maheSvaraBujotsfzwaM nimezArDAnna saMSayaH ॥129॥

text: nāvadhyo yasya loke'sminbrahmaviṣṇusureṣvapi । tadahaṃ dṛṣṭavāṃstāta āścaryādbhutamuttamam ॥130॥
html:
nāvadhyo yasya loke'sminbrahmaviṣṇusureṣvapi ।

slp1: nAvaDyo yasya loke'sminbrahmavizRusurezvapi । tadahaM dfzwavAMstAta AScaryAdButamuttamam ॥130॥
