html:
guhyamastraṃ paraṃ cāpi tattulyādhikameva vā ।
yattacchūlamiti khyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu śūlinaḥ ॥131॥
slp1: guhyamastraM paraM cApi tattulyADikameva vA । yattacCUlamiti KyAtaM sarvalokezu SUlinaH ॥131॥

text: dārayedyanmahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ śoṣayedvā mahodadhim । saṃharedvā jagatkṛtsnaṃ visṛṣṭaṃ śūlapāṇinā ॥132॥
html:
dārayedyanmahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ śoṣayedvā mahodadhim ।
saṃharedvā jagatkṛtsnaṃ visṛṣṭaṃ śūlapāṇinā ॥132॥
slp1: dArayedyanmahIM kftsnAM SozayedvA mahodaDim । saMharedvA jagatkftsnaM visfzwaM SUlapARinA ॥132॥

text: yauvanāśvo hato yena māndhātā sabalaḥ purā । cakravartī mahātejāstrilokavijayī nṛpaḥ ॥133॥
html:
yauvanāśvo hato yena māndhātā sabalaḥ purā ।
cakravartī mahātejāstrilokavijayī nṛpaḥ ॥133॥
slp1: yOvanASvo hato yena mAnDAtA sabalaH purA । cakravartI mahAtejAstrilokavijayI nfpaH ॥133॥

text: mahābalo mahāvīryaḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ । karasthenaiva govinda lavaṇasyeha rakṣasaḥ ॥134॥
html:
mahābalo mahāvīryaḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ ।
karasthenaiva govinda lavaṇasyeha rakṣasaḥ ॥134॥
slp1: mahAbalo mahAvIryaH SakratulyaparAkramaH । karasTenEva govinda lavaRasyeha rakzasaH ॥134॥

text: tacchūlamatitīkṣṇāgraṃ subhīmaṃ lomaharṣaṇam । triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭīṃ kṛtvā tarjamānamiva sthitam ॥135॥
html:
tacchūlamatitīkṣṇāgraṃ subhīmaṃ lomaharṣaṇam ।
triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭīṃ kṛtvā tarjamānamiva sthitam ॥135॥
slp1: tacCUlamatitIkzRAgraM suBImaM lomaharzaRam । triSiKAM BrukuwIM kftvA tarjamAnamiva sTitam ॥135॥

text: vidhūmaṃ sārciṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kālasūryamivoditam । sarpahastamanirdeśyaṃ pāśahastamivāntakam । dṛṣṭavānasmi govinda tadastraṃ rudrasannidhau ॥136॥
html:
vidhūmaṃ sārciṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kālasūryamivoditam ।
sarpahastamanirdeśyaṃ pāśahastamivāntakam ।
dṛṣṭavānasmi govinda tadastraṃ rudrasannidhau ॥136॥
slp1: viDUmaM sArcizaM kfzRaM kAlasUryamivoditam । sarpahastamanirdeSyaM pASahastamivAntakam । dfzwavAnasmi govinda tadastraM rudrasanniDO ॥136॥

text: paraśustīkṣṇadhāraśca datto rāmasya yaḥ purā । mahādevena tuṣṭena kṣatriyāṇāṃ kṣayaṅkaraḥ । kārtavīryo hato yena cakravartī mahāmṛdhe ॥137॥
html:
paraśustīkṣṇadhāraśca datto rāmasya yaḥ purā ।
mahādevena tuṣṭena kṣatriyāṇāṃ kṣayaṅkaraḥ ।
kārtavīryo hato yena cakravartī mahāmṛdhe ॥137॥
slp1: paraSustIkzRaDAraSca datto rAmasya yaH purA । mahAdevena tuzwena kzatriyARAM kzayaNkaraH । kArtavIryo hato yena cakravartI mahAmfDe ॥137॥

text: triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī yena niḥkṣatriyā kṛtā । jāmadagnyena govinda rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ॥138॥
html:
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī yena niḥkṣatriyā kṛtā ।
jāmadagnyena govinda rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ॥138॥
slp1: triHsaptakftvaH pfTivI yena niHkzatriyA kftA । jAmadagnyena govinda rAmeRAklizwakarmaRA ॥138॥

text: dīptadhāraḥ suraudrāsyaḥ sarpakaṇṭhāgraveṣṭitaḥ । abhavacchūlino'bhyāśe dīptavahniśikhopamaḥ ॥139॥
html:
dīptadhāraḥ suraudrāsyaḥ sarpakaṇṭhāgraveṣṭitaḥ ।
abhavacchūlino'bhyāśe dīptavahniśikhopamaḥ ॥139॥
slp1: dIptaDAraH surOdrAsyaH sarpakaRWAgravezwitaH । aBavacCUlino'ByASe dIptavahniSiKopamaH ॥139॥

text: asaṅkhyeyāni cāstrāṇi tasya divyāni dhīmataḥ । prādhānyato mayaitāni kīrtitāni tavānagha ॥140॥
html:
asaṅkhyeyāni cāstrāṇi tasya divyāni dhīmataḥ ।
prādhānyato mayaitāni kīrtitāni tavānagha ॥140॥
slp1: asaNKyeyAni cAstrARi tasya divyAni DImataH । prADAnyato mayEtAni kIrtitAni tavAnaGa ॥140॥

text: savyadeśe tu devasya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ । divyaṃ vimānamāsthāya haṃsayuktaṃ manojavam ॥141॥
html:
savyadeśe tu devasya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।
divyaṃ vimānamāsthāya haṃsayuktaṃ manojavam ॥141॥
slp1: savyadeSe tu devasya brahmA lokapitAmahaH । divyaM vimAnamAsTAya haMsayuktaM manojavam ॥141॥

text: vāmapārśvagataścaiva tathā nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ । vainateyaṃ samāsthāya śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ ॥142॥
html:
vāmapārśvagataścaiva tathā nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ ।
vainateyaṃ samāsthāya śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ ॥142॥
slp1: vAmapArSvagataScEva taTA nArAyaRaH sTitaH । vEnateyaM samAsTAya SaNKacakragadADaraH ॥142॥

text: skando mayūramāsthāya sthito devyāḥ samīpataḥ । śaktiṃ kaṇṭhe samādāya dvitīya iva pāvakaḥ ॥143॥
html:
skando mayūramāsthāya sthito devyāḥ samīpataḥ ।
śaktiṃ kaṇṭhe samādāya dvitīya iva pāvakaḥ ॥143॥
slp1: skando mayUramAsTAya sTito devyAH samIpataH । SaktiM kaRWe samAdAya dvitIya iva pAvakaH ॥143॥

text: purastāccaiva devasya nandiṃ paśyāmyavasthitam । śūlaṃ viṣṭabhya tiṣṭhantaṃ dvitīyamiva śaṅkaram ॥144॥
html:
purastāccaiva devasya nandiṃ paśyāmyavasthitam ।
śūlaṃ viṣṭabhya tiṣṭhantaṃ dvitīyamiva śaṅkaram ॥144॥
slp1: purastAccEva devasya nandiM paSyAmyavasTitam । SUlaM vizwaBya tizWantaM dvitIyamiva SaNkaram ॥144॥

text: svāyambhuvādyā manavo bhṛgvādyā ṛṣayastathā । śakrādyā devatāścaiva sarva eva samabhyayuḥ ॥145॥
html:
svāyambhuvādyā manavo bhṛgvādyā ṛṣayastathā ।
śakrādyā devatāścaiva sarva eva samabhyayuḥ ॥145॥
slp1: svAyamBuvAdyA manavo BfgvAdyA fzayastaTA । SakrAdyA devatAScEva sarva eva samaByayuH ॥145॥

text: te'bhivādya mahātmānaṃ parivārya samantataḥ । astuvanvividhaiḥ stotrairmahādevaṃ surāstadā ॥146॥
html:
te'bhivādya mahātmānaṃ parivārya samantataḥ ।
astuvanvividhaiḥ stotrairmahādevaṃ surāstadā ॥146॥
slp1: te'BivAdya mahAtmAnaM parivArya samantataH । astuvanviviDEH stotrErmahAdevaM surAstadA ॥146॥

text: brahmā bhavaṃ tadā stunvanrathantaramudīrayan । jyeṣṭhasāmnā ca deveśaṃ jagau nārāyaṇastadā । gṛṇañśakraḥ paraṃ brahma śatarudrīyamuttamam ॥147॥
html:
brahmā bhavaṃ tadā stunvanrathantaramudīrayan ।
jyeṣṭhasāmnā ca deveśaṃ jagau nārāyaṇastadā ।
gṛṇañśakraḥ paraṃ brahma śatarudrīyamuttamam ॥147॥
slp1: brahmA BavaM tadA stunvanraTantaramudIrayan । jyezWasAmnA ca deveSaM jagO nArAyaRastadA । gfRaYSakraH paraM brahma SatarudrIyamuttamam ॥147॥

text: brahmā nārāyaṇaścaiva devarājaśca kauśikaḥ । aśobhanta mahātmānastrayastraya ivāgnayaḥ ॥148॥
html:
brahmā nārāyaṇaścaiva devarājaśca kauśikaḥ ।
aśobhanta mahātmānastrayastraya ivāgnayaḥ ॥148॥
slp1: brahmA nArAyaRaScEva devarAjaSca kOSikaH । aSoBanta mahAtmAnastrayastraya ivAgnayaH ॥148॥

text: teṣāṃ madhyagato devo rarāja bhagavāñśivaḥ । śaradghanavinirmuktaḥ pariviṣṭa ivāṃśumān । tato'hamastuvaṃ devaṃ stavenānena suvratam ॥149॥
html:
teṣāṃ madhyagato devo rarāja bhagavāñśivaḥ ।
śaradghanavinirmuktaḥ pariviṣṭa ivāṃśumān ।
tato'hamastuvaṃ devaṃ stavenānena suvratam ॥149॥
slp1: tezAM maDyagato devo rarAja BagavAYSivaH । SaradGanavinirmuktaH parivizwa ivAMSumAn । tato'hamastuvaM devaM stavenAnena suvratam ॥149॥

text: namo devādhidevāya mahādevāya vai namaḥ । śakrāya śakrarūpāya śakraveṣadharāya ca ॥150॥
html:
namo devādhidevāya mahādevāya vai namaḥ ।
śakrāya śakrarūpāya śakraveṣadharāya ca ॥150॥
slp1: namo devADidevAya mahAdevAya vE namaH । SakrAya SakrarUpAya SakravezaDarAya ca ॥150॥

text: namaste vajrahastāya piṅgalāyāruṇāya ca । pinākapāṇaye nityaṃ khaḍgaśūladharāya ca ॥151॥
html:
namaste vajrahastāya piṅgalāyāruṇāya ca ।
pinākapāṇaye nityaṃ khaḍgaśūladharāya ca ॥151॥
slp1: namaste vajrahastAya piNgalAyAruRAya ca । pinAkapARaye nityaM KaqgaSUlaDarAya ca ॥151॥

text: namaste kṛṣṇavāsāya kṛṣṇakuñcitamūrdhaje । kṛṣṇājinottarīyāya kṛṣṇāṣṭamiratāya ca ॥152॥
html:
namaste kṛṣṇavāsāya kṛṣṇakuñcitamūrdhaje ।
kṛṣṇājinottarīyāya kṛṣṇāṣṭamiratāya ca ॥152॥
slp1: namaste kfzRavAsAya kfzRakuYcitamUrDaje । kfzRAjinottarIyAya kfzRAzwamiratAya ca ॥152॥

text: śuklavarṇāya śuklāya śuklāmbaradharāya ca । śuklabhasmāvaliptāya śuklakarmaratāya ca ॥153॥
html:
śuklavarṇāya śuklāya śuklāmbaradharāya ca ।
śuklabhasmāvaliptāya śuklakarmaratāya ca ॥153॥
slp1: SuklavarRAya SuklAya SuklAmbaraDarAya ca । SuklaBasmAvaliptAya SuklakarmaratAya ca ॥153॥

text: tvaṃ brahmā sarvadevānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ nīlalohitaḥ । ātmā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ sāṅkhye puruṣa ucyase ॥154॥
html:
tvaṃ brahmā sarvadevānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ nīlalohitaḥ ।
ātmā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ sāṅkhye puruṣa ucyase ॥154॥
slp1: tvaM brahmA sarvadevAnAM rudrARAM nIlalohitaH । AtmA ca sarvaBUtAnAM sANKye puruza ucyase ॥154॥

text: ṛṣabhastvaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ yogināṃ niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ । āśramāṇāṃ gṛhasthastvamīśvarāṇāṃ maheśvaraḥ । kuberaḥ sarvayakṣāṇāṃ kratūnāṃ viṣṇurucyase ॥155॥
html:
ṛṣabhastvaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ yogināṃ niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ ।
āśramāṇāṃ gṛhasthastvamīśvarāṇāṃ maheśvaraḥ ।
kuberaḥ sarvayakṣāṇāṃ kratūnāṃ viṣṇurucyase ॥155॥
slp1: fzaBastvaM pavitrARAM yoginAM nizkalaH SivaH । ASramARAM gfhasTastvamISvarARAM maheSvaraH । kuberaH sarvayakzARAM kratUnAM vizRurucyase ॥155॥

text: parvatānāṃ mahāmerurnakṣatrāṇāṃ ca candramāḥ । vasiṣṭhastvamṛṣīṇāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ sūrya ucyase ॥156॥
html:
parvatānāṃ mahāmerurnakṣatrāṇāṃ ca candramāḥ ।
vasiṣṭhastvamṛṣīṇāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ sūrya ucyase ॥156॥
slp1: parvatAnAM mahAmerurnakzatrARAM ca candramAH । vasizWastvamfzIRAM ca grahARAM sUrya ucyase ॥156॥

text: āraṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca siṃhastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ । grāmyāṇāṃ govṛṣaścāsi bhagavāṁllokapūjitaḥ ॥157॥
html:
āraṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca siṃhastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ ।
grāmyāṇāṃ govṛṣaścāsi bhagavāṁllokapūjitaḥ ॥157॥
slp1: AraRyAnAM paSUnAM ca siMhastvaM parameSvaraH । grAmyARAM govfzaScAsi BagavAṁllokapUjitaH ॥157॥

text: ādityānāṃ bhavānviṣṇurvasūnāṃ caiva pāvakaḥ । pakṣiṇāṃ vainateyaśca ananto bhujageṣu ca ॥158॥
html:
ādityānāṃ bhavānviṣṇurvasūnāṃ caiva pāvakaḥ ।
pakṣiṇāṃ vainateyaśca ananto bhujageṣu ca ॥158॥
slp1: AdityAnAM BavAnvizRurvasUnAM cEva pAvakaH । pakziRAM vEnateyaSca ananto Bujagezu ca ॥158॥

text: sāmavedaśca vedānāṃ yajuṣāṃ śatarudriyam । sanatkumāro yogīnāṃ sāṅkhyānāṃ kapilo hyasi ॥159॥
html:
sāmavedaśca vedānāṃ yajuṣāṃ śatarudriyam ।
sanatkumāro yogīnāṃ sāṅkhyānāṃ kapilo hyasi ॥159॥
slp1: sAmavedaSca vedAnAM yajuzAM Satarudriyam । sanatkumAro yogInAM sANKyAnAM kapilo hyasi ॥159॥

text: śakro'si marutāṃ deva pitṝṇāṃ dharmarāḍasi । brahmalokaśca lokānāṃ gatīnāṃ mokṣa ucyase ॥160॥
html:
śakro'si marutāṃ deva pitṝṇāṃ dharmarāḍasi ।
brahmalokaśca lokānāṃ gatīnāṃ mokṣa ucyase ॥160॥
slp1: Sakro'si marutAM deva pitFRAM DarmarAqasi । brahmalokaSca lokAnAM gatInAM mokza ucyase ॥160॥

text: kṣīrodaḥ sāgarāṇāṃ ca śailānāṃ himavāngiriḥ । varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇaścāsi viprāṇāṃ dīkṣito dvijaḥ । ādistvamasi lokānāṃ saṃhartā kāla eva ca ॥161॥
html:
kṣīrodaḥ sāgarāṇāṃ ca śailānāṃ himavāngiriḥ ।
varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇaścāsi viprāṇāṃ dīkṣito dvijaḥ ।
ādistvamasi lokānāṃ saṃhartā kāla eva ca ॥161॥
slp1: kzIrodaH sAgarARAM ca SElAnAM himavAngiriH । varRAnAM brAhmaRaScAsi viprARAM dIkzito dvijaH । Adistvamasi lokAnAM saMhartA kAla eva ca ॥161॥

text: yaccānyadapi lokeṣu sattvaṃ tejodhikaṃ smṛtam । tatsarvaṃ bhagavāneva iti me niścitā matiḥ ॥162॥
html:
yaccānyadapi lokeṣu sattvaṃ tejodhikaṃ smṛtam ।
tatsarvaṃ bhagavāneva iti me niścitā matiḥ ॥162॥
slp1: yaccAnyadapi lokezu sattvaM tejoDikaM smftam । tatsarvaM BagavAneva iti me niScitA matiH ॥162॥

text: namaste bhagavandeva namaste bhaktavatsala । yogeśvara namaste'stu namaste viśvasambhava ॥163॥
html:
namaste bhagavandeva namaste bhaktavatsala ।
yogeśvara namaste'stu namaste viśvasambhava ॥163॥
slp1: namaste Bagavandeva namaste Baktavatsala । yogeSvara namaste'stu namaste viSvasamBava ॥163॥

text: prasīda mama bhaktasya dīnasya kṛpaṇasya ca । anaiśvaryeṇa yuktasya gatirbhava sanātana ॥164॥
html:
prasīda mama bhaktasya dīnasya kṛpaṇasya ca ।
anaiśvaryeṇa yuktasya gatirbhava sanātana ॥164॥
slp1: prasIda mama Baktasya dInasya kfpaRasya ca । anESvaryeRa yuktasya gatirBava sanAtana ॥164॥

text: yaṃ cāparādhaṃ kṛtavānajñānātparameśvara । madbhakta iti deveśa tatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhasi ॥165॥
html:
yaṃ cāparādhaṃ kṛtavānajñānātparameśvara ।
madbhakta iti deveśa tatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhasi ॥165॥
slp1: yaM cAparADaM kftavAnajYAnAtparameSvara । madBakta iti deveSa tatsarvaM kzantumarhasi ॥165॥

text: mohitaścāsmi deveśa tubhyaṃ rūpaviparyayāt । tena nārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ pādyaṃ cāpi sureśvara ॥166॥
html:
mohitaścāsmi deveśa tubhyaṃ rūpaviparyayāt ।
tena nārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ pādyaṃ cāpi sureśvara ॥166॥
slp1: mohitaScAsmi deveSa tuByaM rUpaviparyayAt । tena nArGyaM mayA dattaM pAdyaM cApi sureSvara ॥166॥

text: evaṃ stutvāhamīśānaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ । kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā sarvaṃ tasmai nyavedayam ॥167॥
html:
evaṃ stutvāhamīśānaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ ।
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā sarvaṃ tasmai nyavedayam ॥167॥
slp1: evaM stutvAhamISAnaM pAdyamarGyaM ca BaktitaH । kftAYjalipuwo BUtvA sarvaM tasmE nyavedayam ॥167॥

text: tataḥ śītāmbusaṃyuktā divyagandhasamanvitā । puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ śubhā tāta papāta mama mūrdhani ॥168॥
html:
tataḥ śītāmbusaṃyuktā divyagandhasamanvitā ।
puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ śubhā tāta papāta mama mūrdhani ॥168॥
slp1: tataH SItAmbusaMyuktA divyaganDasamanvitA । puzpavfzwiH SuBA tAta papAta mama mUrDani ॥168॥

text: dundubhiśca tato divyastāḍito devakiṅkaraiḥ । vavau ca mārutaḥ puṇyaḥ śucigandhaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ॥169॥
html:
dundubhiśca tato divyastāḍito devakiṅkaraiḥ ।
vavau ca mārutaḥ puṇyaḥ śucigandhaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ॥169॥
slp1: dunduBiSca tato divyastAqito devakiNkarEH । vavO ca mArutaH puRyaH SuciganDaH suKAvahaH ॥169॥

text: tataḥ prīto mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ । abravīttridaśāṃstatra harṣayanniva māṃ tadā ॥170॥
html:
tataḥ prīto mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ ।
abravīttridaśāṃstatra harṣayanniva māṃ tadā ॥170॥
slp1: tataH prIto mahAdevaH sapatnIko vfzaDvajaH । abravIttridaSAMstatra harzayanniva mAM tadA ॥170॥

text: paśyadhvaṃ tridaśāḥ sarve upamanyormahātmanaḥ । mayi bhaktiṃ parāṃ divyāmekabhāvādavasthitām ॥171॥
html:
paśyadhvaṃ tridaśāḥ sarve upamanyormahātmanaḥ ।
mayi bhaktiṃ parāṃ divyāmekabhāvādavasthitām ॥171॥
slp1: paSyaDvaM tridaSAH sarve upamanyormahAtmanaH । mayi BaktiM parAM divyAmekaBAvAdavasTitAm ॥171॥

text: evamuktāstataḥ kṛṣṇa surāste śūlapāṇinā । ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve namaskṛtvā vṛṣadhvajam ॥172॥
html:
evamuktāstataḥ kṛṣṇa surāste śūlapāṇinā ।
ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve namaskṛtvā vṛṣadhvajam ॥172॥
slp1: evamuktAstataH kfzRa surAste SUlapARinA । UcuH prAYjalayaH sarve namaskftvA vfzaDvajam ॥172॥

text: bhagavandevadeveśa lokanātha jagatpate । labhatāṃ sarvakāmebhyaḥ phalaṃ tvatto dvijottamaḥ ॥173॥
html:
bhagavandevadeveśa lokanātha jagatpate ।
labhatāṃ sarvakāmebhyaḥ phalaṃ tvatto dvijottamaḥ ॥173॥
slp1: BagavandevadeveSa lokanATa jagatpate । laBatAM sarvakAmeByaH PalaM tvatto dvijottamaH ॥173॥

text: evamuktastataḥ śarvaḥ surairbrahmādibhistathā । āha māṃ bhagavānīśaḥ prahasanniva śaṅkaraḥ ॥174॥
html:
evamuktastataḥ śarvaḥ surairbrahmādibhistathā ।
āha māṃ bhagavānīśaḥ prahasanniva śaṅkaraḥ ॥174॥
slp1: evamuktastataH SarvaH surErbrahmAdiBistaTA । Aha mAM BagavAnISaH prahasanniva SaNkaraH ॥174॥

text: vatsopamanyo prīto'smi paśya māṃ munipuṅgava । dṛḍhabhakto'si viprarṣe mayā jijñāsito hyasi ॥175॥
html:
vatsopamanyo prīto'smi paśya māṃ munipuṅgava ।
dṛḍhabhakto'si viprarṣe mayā jijñāsito hyasi ॥175॥
slp1: vatsopamanyo prIto'smi paSya mAM munipuNgava । dfQaBakto'si viprarze mayA jijYAsito hyasi ॥175॥

text: anayā caiva bhaktyā te atyarthaṃ prītimānaham । tasmātsarvāndadāmyadya kāmāṃstava yathepśitān ॥176॥
html:
anayā caiva bhaktyā te atyarthaṃ prītimānaham ।
tasmātsarvāndadāmyadya kāmāṃstava yathepśitān ॥176॥
slp1: anayA cEva BaktyA te atyarTaM prItimAnaham । tasmAtsarvAndadAmyadya kAmAMstava yaTepSitAn ॥176॥

text: evamuktasya caivātha mahādevena me vibho । harṣādaśrūṇyavartanta lomaharṣaśca jāyate ॥177॥
html:
evamuktasya caivātha mahādevena me vibho ।
harṣādaśrūṇyavartanta lomaharṣaśca jāyate ॥177॥
slp1: evamuktasya cEvATa mahAdevena me viBo । harzAdaSrURyavartanta lomaharzaSca jAyate ॥177॥

text: abruvaṃ ca tadā devaṃ harṣagadgadayā girā । jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥178॥
html:
abruvaṃ ca tadā devaṃ harṣagadgadayā girā ।
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥178॥
slp1: abruvaM ca tadA devaM harzagadgadayA girA । jAnuByAmavaniM gatvA praRamya ca punaH punaH ॥178॥

text: adya jāto hyahaṃ deva adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ । yanme sākṣānmahādevaḥ prasannastiṣṭhate'grataḥ ॥179॥
html:
adya jāto hyahaṃ deva adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ ।
yanme sākṣānmahādevaḥ prasannastiṣṭhate'grataḥ ॥179॥
slp1: adya jAto hyahaM deva adya me saPalaM tapaH । yanme sAkzAnmahAdevaH prasannastizWate'grataH ॥179॥

text: yaṃ na paśyanti cārādhya devā hyamitavikramam । tamahaṃ dṛṣṭavāndevaṃ ko'nyo dhanyataro mayā ॥180॥
html:
yaṃ na paśyanti cārādhya devā hyamitavikramam ।
tamahaṃ dṛṣṭavāndevaṃ ko'nyo dhanyataro mayā ॥180॥
slp1: yaM na paSyanti cArADya devA hyamitavikramam । tamahaM dfzwavAndevaM ko'nyo Danyataro mayA ॥180॥

text: evaṃ dhyāyanti vidvāṃsaḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ sanātanam । ṣaḍviṃśakamiti khyātaṃ yatparātparamakṣaram ॥181॥
html:
evaṃ dhyāyanti vidvāṃsaḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ sanātanam ।
ṣaḍviṃśakamiti khyātaṃ yatparātparamakṣaram ॥181॥
slp1: evaM DyAyanti vidvAMsaH paraM tattvaM sanAtanam । zaqviMSakamiti KyAtaM yatparAtparamakzaram ॥181॥

text: sa eṣa bhagavāndevaḥ sarvatattvādiravyayaḥ । sarvatattvavidhānajñaḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ ॥182॥
html:
sa eṣa bhagavāndevaḥ sarvatattvādiravyayaḥ ।
sarvatattvavidhānajñaḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ ॥182॥
slp1: sa eza BagavAndevaH sarvatattvAdiravyayaH । sarvatattvaviDAnajYaH praDAnapuruzeSvaraH ॥182॥

text: yo'sṛjaddakṣiṇādaṅgādbrahmāṇaṃ lokasambhavam । vāmapārśvāttathā viṣṇuṃ lokarakṣārthamīśvaraḥ । yugānte caiva samprāpte rudramaṅgātsṛjatprabhuḥ ॥183॥
html:
yo'sṛjaddakṣiṇādaṅgādbrahmāṇaṃ lokasambhavam ।
vāmapārśvāttathā viṣṇuṃ lokarakṣārthamīśvaraḥ ।
yugānte caiva samprāpte rudramaṅgātsṛjatprabhuḥ ॥183॥
slp1: yo'sfjaddakziRAdaNgAdbrahmARaM lokasamBavam । vAmapArSvAttaTA vizRuM lokarakzArTamISvaraH । yugAnte cEva samprApte rudramaNgAtsfjatpraBuH ॥183॥

text: sa rudraḥ saṃharankṛtsnaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam । kālo bhūtvā mahātejāḥ saṃvartaka ivānalaḥ ॥184॥
html:
sa rudraḥ saṃharankṛtsnaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam ।
kālo bhūtvā mahātejāḥ saṃvartaka ivānalaḥ ॥184॥
slp1: sa rudraH saMharankftsnaM jagatsTAvarajaNgamam । kAlo BUtvA mahAtejAH saMvartaka ivAnalaH ॥184॥

text: eṣa devo mahādevo jagatsṛṣṭvā carācaram । kalpānte caiva sarveṣāṃ smṛtimākṣipya tiṣṭhati ॥185॥
html:
eṣa devo mahādevo jagatsṛṣṭvā carācaram ।
kalpānte caiva sarveṣāṃ smṛtimākṣipya tiṣṭhati ॥185॥
slp1: eza devo mahAdevo jagatsfzwvA carAcaram । kalpAnte cEva sarvezAM smftimAkzipya tizWati ॥185॥

text: sarvagaḥ sarvabhūtātmā sarvabhūtabhavodbhavaḥ । āste sarvagato nityamadṛśyaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ ॥186॥
html:
sarvagaḥ sarvabhūtātmā sarvabhūtabhavodbhavaḥ ।
āste sarvagato nityamadṛśyaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ ॥186॥
slp1: sarvagaH sarvaBUtAtmA sarvaBUtaBavodBavaH । Aste sarvagato nityamadfSyaH sarvadEvatEH ॥186॥

text: yadi deyo varo mahyaṃ yadi tuṣṭaśca me prabhuḥ । bhaktirbhavatu me nityaṃ śāśvatī tvayi śaṅkara ॥187॥
html:
yadi deyo varo mahyaṃ yadi tuṣṭaśca me prabhuḥ ।
bhaktirbhavatu me nityaṃ śāśvatī tvayi śaṅkara ॥187॥
slp1: yadi deyo varo mahyaM yadi tuzwaSca me praBuH । BaktirBavatu me nityaM SASvatI tvayi SaNkara ॥187॥

text: atītānāgataṃ caiva vartamānaṃ ca yadvibho । jānīyāmiti me buddhistvatprasādātsurottama ॥188॥
html:
atītānāgataṃ caiva vartamānaṃ ca yadvibho ।
jānīyāmiti me buddhistvatprasādātsurottama ॥188॥
slp1: atItAnAgataM cEva vartamAnaM ca yadviBo । jAnIyAmiti me budDistvatprasAdAtsurottama ॥188॥

text: kṣīrodanaṃ ca bhuñjīyāmakṣayaṃ saha bāndhavaiḥ । āśrame ca sadā mahyaṃ sānnidhyaṃ paramastu te ॥189॥
html:
kṣīrodanaṃ ca bhuñjīyāmakṣayaṃ saha bāndhavaiḥ ।
āśrame ca sadā mahyaṃ sānnidhyaṃ paramastu te ॥189॥
slp1: kzIrodanaM ca BuYjIyAmakzayaM saha bAnDavEH । ASrame ca sadA mahyaM sAnniDyaM paramastu te ॥189॥

text: evamuktaḥ sa māṃ prāha bhagavāṁllokapūjitaḥ । maheśvaro mahātejāścarācaraguruḥ prabhuḥ ॥190॥
html:
evamuktaḥ sa māṃ prāha bhagavāṁllokapūjitaḥ ।
maheśvaro mahātejāścarācaraguruḥ prabhuḥ ॥190॥
slp1: evamuktaH sa mAM prAha BagavAṁllokapUjitaH । maheSvaro mahAtejAScarAcaraguruH praBuH ॥190॥

text: ajaraścāmaraścaiva bhava duḥkhavivarjitaḥ । śīlavānguṇasampannaḥ sarvajñaḥ priyadarśanaḥ ॥191॥
html:
ajaraścāmaraścaiva bhava duḥkhavivarjitaḥ ।
śīlavānguṇasampannaḥ sarvajñaḥ priyadarśanaḥ ॥191॥
slp1: ajaraScAmaraScEva Bava duHKavivarjitaH । SIlavAnguRasampannaH sarvajYaH priyadarSanaH ॥191॥

text: akṣayaṃ yauvanaṃ te'stu tejaścaivānalopamam । kṣīrodaḥ sāgaraścaiva yatra yatrecchase mune ॥192॥
html:
akṣayaṃ yauvanaṃ te'stu tejaścaivānalopamam ।
kṣīrodaḥ sāgaraścaiva yatra yatrecchase mune ॥192॥
slp1: akzayaM yOvanaM te'stu tejaScEvAnalopamam । kzIrodaH sAgaraScEva yatra yatrecCase mune ॥192॥

text: tatra te bhavitā kāmaṃ sānnidhyaṃ payaso nidheḥ । kṣīrodanaṃ ca bhuṅkṣva tvamamṛtena samanvitam ॥193॥
html:
tatra te bhavitā kāmaṃ sānnidhyaṃ payaso nidheḥ ।
kṣīrodanaṃ ca bhuṅkṣva tvamamṛtena samanvitam ॥193॥
slp1: tatra te BavitA kAmaM sAnniDyaM payaso niDeH । kzIrodanaM ca BuNkzva tvamamftena samanvitam ॥193॥

text: bandhubhiḥ sahitaḥ kalpaṃ tato māmupayāsyasi । sānnidhyamāśrame nityaṃ kariṣyāmi dvijottama ॥194॥
html:
bandhubhiḥ sahitaḥ kalpaṃ tato māmupayāsyasi ।
sānnidhyamāśrame nityaṃ kariṣyāmi dvijottama ॥194॥
slp1: banDuBiH sahitaH kalpaM tato mAmupayAsyasi । sAnniDyamASrame nityaM karizyAmi dvijottama ॥194॥

text: tiṣṭha vatsa yathākāmaṃ notkaṇṭhāṃ kartumarhasi । smṛtaḥ smṛtaśca te vipra sadā dāsyāmi darśanam ॥195॥
html:
tiṣṭha vatsa yathākāmaṃ notkaṇṭhāṃ kartumarhasi ।
smṛtaḥ smṛtaśca te vipra sadā dāsyāmi darśanam ॥195॥
slp1: tizWa vatsa yaTAkAmaM notkaRWAM kartumarhasi । smftaH smftaSca te vipra sadA dAsyAmi darSanam ॥195॥

text: evamuktvā sa bhagavānsūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ । mameśāno varaṃ dattvā tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥196॥
html:
evamuktvā sa bhagavānsūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ ।
mameśāno varaṃ dattvā tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥196॥
slp1: evamuktvA sa BagavAnsUryakowisamapraBaH । mameSAno varaM dattvA tatrEvAntaraDIyata ॥196॥

text: evaṃ dṛṣṭo mayā kṛṣṇa devadevaḥ samādhinā । tadavāptaṃ ca me sarvaṃ yaduktaṃ tena dhīmatā ॥197॥
html:
evaṃ dṛṣṭo mayā kṛṣṇa devadevaḥ samādhinā ।
tadavāptaṃ ca me sarvaṃ yaduktaṃ tena dhīmatā ॥197॥
slp1: evaM dfzwo mayA kfzRa devadevaH samADinA । tadavAptaM ca me sarvaM yaduktaM tena DImatA ॥197॥

text: pratyakṣaṃ caiva te kṛṣṇa paśya siddhānvyavasthitān । ṛṣīnvidyādharānyakṣāngandharvāpsarasastathā ॥198॥
html:
pratyakṣaṃ caiva te kṛṣṇa paśya siddhānvyavasthitān ।
ṛṣīnvidyādharānyakṣāngandharvāpsarasastathā ॥198॥
slp1: pratyakzaM cEva te kfzRa paSya sidDAnvyavasTitAn । fzInvidyADarAnyakzAnganDarvApsarasastaTA ॥198॥

text: paśya vṛkṣānmanoramyānsadā puṣpaphalānvitān । sarvartukusumairyuktānsnigdhapatrānsuśākhinaḥ । sarvametanmahābāho divyabhāvasamanvitam] ॥199॥
html:
paśya vṛkṣānmanoramyānsadā puṣpaphalānvitān ।
sarvartukusumairyuktānsnigdhapatrānsuśākhinaḥ ।
sarvametanmahābāho divyabhāvasamanvitam] ॥199॥
slp1: paSya vfkzAnmanoramyAnsadA puzpaPalAnvitAn । sarvartukusumEryuktAnsnigDapatrAnsuSAKinaH । sarvametanmahAbAho divyaBAvasamanvitam] ॥199॥

text: etānsahasraśaścānyānsamanudhyātavānharaḥ । kasmātprasādaṃ bhagavānna kuryāttava mādhava ॥1॥
html:
etānsahasraśaścānyānsamanudhyātavānharaḥ ।
kasmātprasādaṃ bhagavānna kuryāttava mādhava ॥1॥
slp1: etAnsahasraSaScAnyAnsamanuDyAtavAnharaH । kasmAtprasAdaM BagavAnna kuryAttava mADava ॥1॥
author: upamanyuruvāca ।

text: tvādṛśena hi devānāṃ ślāghanīyaḥ samāgamaḥ । brahmaṇyenānṛśaṃsena śraddadhānena cāpyuta । japyaṃ ca te pradāsyāmi yena drakṣyasi śaṅkaram ॥2॥
html:
tvādṛśena hi devānāṃ ślāghanīyaḥ samāgamaḥ ।
brahmaṇyenānṛśaṃsena śraddadhānena cāpyuta ।
japyaṃ ca te pradāsyāmi yena drakṣyasi śaṅkaram ॥2॥
slp1: tvAdfSena hi devAnAM SlAGanIyaH samAgamaH । brahmaRyenAnfSaMsena SraddaDAnena cApyuta । japyaM ca te pradAsyAmi yena drakzyasi SaNkaram ॥2॥

text: abruvaṃ tamahaṃ brahmaṃstvatprasādānmahāmune । drakṣye ditijasaṅghānāṃ mardanaṃ tridaśeśvaram ॥3॥
html:
abruvaṃ tamahaṃ brahmaṃstvatprasādānmahāmune ।
drakṣye ditijasaṅghānāṃ mardanaṃ tridaśeśvaram ॥3॥
slp1: abruvaM tamahaM brahmaMstvatprasAdAnmahAmune । drakzye ditijasaNGAnAM mardanaM tridaSeSvaram ॥3॥
author: kṛṣṇa uvāca ।

text: dine'ṣṭame ca vipreṇa dīkṣito'haṃ yathāvidhi । daṇḍī muṇḍī kuśī cīrī ghṛtākto mekhalī tathā ॥4॥
html:
dine'ṣṭame ca vipreṇa dīkṣito'haṃ yathāvidhi ।
daṇḍī muṇḍī kuśī cīrī ghṛtākto mekhalī tathā ॥4॥
slp1: dine'zwame ca vipreRa dIkzito'haM yaTAviDi । daRqI muRqI kuSI cIrI GftAkto meKalI taTA ॥4॥

text: māsamekaṃ phalāhāro dvitīyaṃ salilāśanaḥ । tṛtīyaṃ ca caturthaṃ ca pañcamaṃ cānilāśanaḥ ॥5॥
html:
māsamekaṃ phalāhāro dvitīyaṃ salilāśanaḥ ।
tṛtīyaṃ ca caturthaṃ ca pañcamaṃ cānilāśanaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: mAsamekaM PalAhAro dvitIyaM salilASanaH । tftIyaM ca caturTaM ca paYcamaM cAnilASanaH ॥5॥

text: ekapādena tiṣṭhaṃśca ūrdhvabāhuratandritaḥ । tejaḥ sūryasahasrasya apaśyaṃ divi bhārata ॥6॥
html:
ekapādena tiṣṭhaṃśca ūrdhvabāhuratandritaḥ ।
tejaḥ sūryasahasrasya apaśyaṃ divi bhārata ॥6॥
slp1: ekapAdena tizWaMSca UrDvabAhuratandritaH । tejaH sUryasahasrasya apaSyaM divi BArata ॥6॥

text: tasya madhyagataṃ cāpi tejasaḥ pāṇḍunandana । indrāyudhapinaddhāṅgaṃ vidyunmālāgavākṣakam । nīlaśailacayaprakhyaṃ balākābhūṣitaṃ ghanam ॥7॥
html:
tasya madhyagataṃ cāpi tejasaḥ pāṇḍunandana ।
indrāyudhapinaddhāṅgaṃ vidyunmālāgavākṣakam ।
nīlaśailacayaprakhyaṃ balākābhūṣitaṃ ghanam ॥7॥
slp1: tasya maDyagataM cApi tejasaH pARqunandana । indrAyuDapinadDANgaM vidyunmAlAgavAkzakam । nIlaSElacayapraKyaM balAkABUzitaM Ganam ॥7॥

text: tamāsthitaśca bhagavāndevyā saha mahādyutiḥ । tapasā tejasā kāntyā dīptayā saha bhāryayā ॥8॥
html:
tamāsthitaśca bhagavāndevyā saha mahādyutiḥ ।
tapasā tejasā kāntyā dīptayā saha bhāryayā ॥8॥
slp1: tamAsTitaSca BagavAndevyA saha mahAdyutiH । tapasA tejasA kAntyA dIptayA saha BAryayA ॥8॥

text: rarāja bhagavāṃstatra devyā saha maheśvaraḥ । somena sahitaḥ sūryo yathā meghasthitastathā ॥9॥
html:
rarāja bhagavāṃstatra devyā saha maheśvaraḥ ।
somena sahitaḥ sūryo yathā meghasthitastathā ॥9॥
slp1: rarAja BagavAMstatra devyA saha maheSvaraH । somena sahitaH sUryo yaTA meGasTitastaTA ॥9॥

text: saṃhṛṣṭaromā kaunteya vismayotphullalocanaḥ । apaśyaṃ devasaṅghānāṃ gatimārtiharaṃ haram ॥10॥
html:
saṃhṛṣṭaromā kaunteya vismayotphullalocanaḥ ।
apaśyaṃ devasaṅghānāṃ gatimārtiharaṃ haram ॥10॥
slp1: saMhfzwaromA kOnteya vismayotPullalocanaH । apaSyaM devasaNGAnAM gatimArtiharaM haram ॥10॥

text: kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ vyāghrājinaṃ jaṭilaṃ daṇḍapāṇim । pinākinaṃ vajriṇaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ śubhāṅgadaṃ vyālayajñopavītam ॥11॥
html:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ vyāghrājinaṃ jaṭilaṃ daṇḍapāṇim ।
pinākinaṃ vajriṇaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ śubhāṅgadaṃ vyālayajñopavītam ॥11॥
slp1: kirIwinaM gadinaM SUlapARiM vyAGrAjinaM jawilaM daRqapARim । pinAkinaM vajriRaM tIkzRadaMzwraM SuBANgadaM vyAlayajYopavItam ॥11॥

text: divyāṃ mālāmurasānekavarṇāṃ samudvahantaṃ gulphadeśāvalambām । candraṃ yathā pariviṣṭaṃ sasandhyaṃ varṣātyaye tadvadapaśyamenam ॥12॥
html:
divyāṃ mālāmurasānekavarṇāṃ samudvahantaṃ gulphadeśāvalambām ।
candraṃ yathā pariviṣṭaṃ sasandhyaṃ varṣātyaye tadvadapaśyamenam ॥12॥
slp1: divyAM mAlAmurasAnekavarRAM samudvahantaM gulPadeSAvalambAm । candraM yaTA parivizwaM sasanDyaM varzAtyaye tadvadapaSyamenam ॥12॥

text: pramathānāṃ gaṇaiścaiva samantātparivāritam । śaradīva suduṣprekṣyaṃ pariviṣṭaṃ divākaram ॥13॥
html:
pramathānāṃ gaṇaiścaiva samantātparivāritam ।
śaradīva suduṣprekṣyaṃ pariviṣṭaṃ divākaram ॥13॥
slp1: pramaTAnAM gaREScEva samantAtparivAritam । SaradIva suduzprekzyaM parivizwaM divAkaram ॥13॥

text: ekādaśa tathā cainaṃ rudrāṇāṃ vṛṣavāhanam । astuvanniyatātmānaḥ karmabhiḥ śubhakarmiṇam ॥14॥
html:
ekādaśa tathā cainaṃ rudrāṇāṃ vṛṣavāhanam ।
astuvanniyatātmānaḥ karmabhiḥ śubhakarmiṇam ॥14॥
slp1: ekAdaSa taTA cEnaM rudrARAM vfzavAhanam । astuvanniyatAtmAnaH karmaBiH SuBakarmiRam ॥14॥

text: ādityā vasavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāstathāśvinau । viśvābhiḥ stutibhirdevaṃ viśvadevaṃ samastuvan ॥15॥
html:
ādityā vasavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāstathāśvinau ।
viśvābhiḥ stutibhirdevaṃ viśvadevaṃ samastuvan ॥15॥
slp1: AdityA vasavaH sADyA viSvedevAstaTASvinO । viSvABiH stutiBirdevaM viSvadevaM samastuvan ॥15॥

text: śatakratuśca bhagavānviṣṇuścāditinandanau । brahmā rathantaraṃ sāma īrayanti bhavāntike ॥16॥
html:
śatakratuśca bhagavānviṣṇuścāditinandanau ।
brahmā rathantaraṃ sāma īrayanti bhavāntike ॥16॥
slp1: SatakratuSca BagavAnvizRuScAditinandanO । brahmA raTantaraM sAma Irayanti BavAntike ॥16॥

text: yogīśvarāḥ subahavo yogadaṃ pitaraṃ gurum । brahmarṣayaśca sasutāstathā devarṣayaśca vai ॥17॥
html:
yogīśvarāḥ subahavo yogadaṃ pitaraṃ gurum ।
brahmarṣayaśca sasutāstathā devarṣayaśca vai ॥17॥
slp1: yogISvarAH subahavo yogadaM pitaraM gurum । brahmarzayaSca sasutAstaTA devarzayaSca vE ॥17॥

text: pṛthivī cāntarikṣaṃ ca nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā । māsārdhamāsā ṛtavo rātryaḥ saṃvatsarāḥ kṣaṇāḥ ॥18॥
html:
pṛthivī cāntarikṣaṃ ca nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā ।
māsārdhamāsā ṛtavo rātryaḥ saṃvatsarāḥ kṣaṇāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: pfTivI cAntarikzaM ca nakzatrARi grahAstaTA । mAsArDamAsA ftavo rAtryaH saMvatsarAH kzaRAH ॥18॥

text: muhūrtāśca nimeṣāśca tathaiva yugaparyayāḥ । divyā rājannamasyanti vidyāḥ sarvā diśastathā ॥19॥
html:
muhūrtāśca nimeṣāśca tathaiva yugaparyayāḥ ।
divyā rājannamasyanti vidyāḥ sarvā diśastathā ॥19॥
slp1: muhUrtASca nimezASca taTEva yugaparyayAH । divyA rAjannamasyanti vidyAH sarvA diSastaTA ॥19॥

text: sanatkumāro vedāśca itihāsāstathaiva ca । marīciraṅgirā atriḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ॥20॥
html:
sanatkumāro vedāśca itihāsāstathaiva ca ।
marīciraṅgirā atriḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ॥20॥
slp1: sanatkumAro vedASca itihAsAstaTEva ca । marIciraNgirA atriH pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH ॥20॥

text: manavaḥ saptasomaśca atharvā sabṛhaspatiḥ । bhṛgurdakṣaḥ kaśyapaśca vasiṣṭhaḥ kāśya eva ca ॥21॥
html:
manavaḥ saptasomaśca atharvā sabṛhaspatiḥ ।
bhṛgurdakṣaḥ kaśyapaśca vasiṣṭhaḥ kāśya eva ca ॥21॥
slp1: manavaH saptasomaSca aTarvA sabfhaspatiH । BfgurdakzaH kaSyapaSca vasizWaH kASya eva ca ॥21॥

text: chandāṃsi dīkṣā yajñāśca dakṣiṇāḥ pāvako haviḥ । yajñopagāni dravyāṇi mūrtimanti yudhiṣṭhira ॥22॥
html:
chandāṃsi dīkṣā yajñāśca dakṣiṇāḥ pāvako haviḥ ।
yajñopagāni dravyāṇi mūrtimanti yudhiṣṭhira ॥22॥
slp1: CandAMsi dIkzA yajYASca dakziRAH pAvako haviH । yajYopagAni dravyARi mUrtimanti yuDizWira ॥22॥

text: prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve saritaḥ pannagā nagāḥ । devānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvā devapatnyaḥ sakanyakāḥ ॥23॥
html:
prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve saritaḥ pannagā nagāḥ ।
devānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvā devapatnyaḥ sakanyakāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: prajAnAM patayaH sarve saritaH pannagA nagAH । devAnAM mAtaraH sarvA devapatnyaH sakanyakAH ॥23॥

text: sahasrāṇi munīnāṃ ca ayutānyarbudāni ca । namasyanti prabhuṃ śāntaṃ parvatāḥ sāgarā diśaḥ ॥24॥
html:
sahasrāṇi munīnāṃ ca ayutānyarbudāni ca ।
namasyanti prabhuṃ śāntaṃ parvatāḥ sāgarā diśaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: sahasrARi munInAM ca ayutAnyarbudAni ca । namasyanti praBuM SAntaM parvatAH sAgarA diSaH ॥24॥

text: gandharvāpsarasaścaiva gītavāditrakovidāḥ । divyatānena gāyantaḥ stuvanti bhavamadbhutam । vidyādharā dānavāśca guhyakā rākṣasāstathā ॥25॥
html:
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva gītavāditrakovidāḥ ।
divyatānena gāyantaḥ stuvanti bhavamadbhutam ।
vidyādharā dānavāśca guhyakā rākṣasāstathā ॥25॥
slp1: ganDarvApsarasaScEva gItavAditrakovidAH । divyatAnena gAyantaH stuvanti BavamadButam । vidyADarA dAnavASca guhyakA rAkzasAstaTA ॥25॥

text: sarvāṇi caiva bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca । namasyanti mahārāja vāṅmanaḥkarmabhirvibhum । purastādviṣṭhitaḥ śarvo mamāsīttridaśeśvaraḥ ॥26॥
html:
sarvāṇi caiva bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ।
namasyanti mahārāja vāṅmanaḥkarmabhirvibhum ।
purastādviṣṭhitaḥ śarvo mamāsīttridaśeśvaraḥ ॥26॥
slp1: sarvARi cEva BUtAni sTAvarARi carARi ca । namasyanti mahArAja vANmanaHkarmaBirviBum । purastAdvizWitaH Sarvo mamAsIttridaSeSvaraH ॥26॥

text: purastādviṣṭhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mameśānaṃ ca bhārata । saprajāpatiśakrāntaṃ jaganmāmabhyudaikṣata ॥27॥
html:
purastādviṣṭhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mameśānaṃ ca bhārata ।
saprajāpatiśakrāntaṃ jaganmāmabhyudaikṣata ॥27॥
slp1: purastAdvizWitaM dfzwvA mameSAnaM ca BArata । saprajApatiSakrAntaM jaganmAmaByudEkzata ॥27॥

text: īkṣituṃ ca mahādevaṃ na me śaktirabhūttadā । tato māmabravīddevaḥ paśya kṛṣṇa vadasva ca ॥28॥
html:
īkṣituṃ ca mahādevaṃ na me śaktirabhūttadā ।
tato māmabravīddevaḥ paśya kṛṣṇa vadasva ca ॥28॥
slp1: IkzituM ca mahAdevaM na me SaktiraBUttadA । tato mAmabravIddevaH paSya kfzRa vadasva ca ॥28॥

text: śirasā vandite deve devī prītā umābhavat । tato'hamastuvaṃ sthāṇuṃ stutaṃ brahmādibhiḥ suraiḥ ॥29॥
html:
śirasā vandite deve devī prītā umābhavat ।
tato'hamastuvaṃ sthāṇuṃ stutaṃ brahmādibhiḥ suraiḥ ॥29॥
slp1: SirasA vandite deve devI prItA umABavat । tato'hamastuvaM sTARuM stutaM brahmAdiBiH surEH ॥29॥

text: namo'stu te śāśvata sarvayone brahmādhipaṃ tvāmṛṣayo vadanti । tapaśca sattvaṃ ca rajastamaśca tvāmeva satyaṃ ca vadanti santaḥ ॥30॥
html:
namo'stu te śāśvata sarvayone brahmādhipaṃ tvāmṛṣayo vadanti ।
tapaśca sattvaṃ ca rajastamaśca tvāmeva satyaṃ ca vadanti santaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: namo'stu te SASvata sarvayone brahmADipaM tvAmfzayo vadanti । tapaSca sattvaM ca rajastamaSca tvAmeva satyaM ca vadanti santaH ॥30॥

text: tvaṃ vai brahmā ca rudraśca varuṇo'gnirmanurbhavaḥ । dhātā tvaṣṭā vidhātā ca tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvatomukhaḥ ॥31॥
html:
tvaṃ vai brahmā ca rudraśca varuṇo'gnirmanurbhavaḥ ।
dhātā tvaṣṭā vidhātā ca tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvatomukhaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tvaM vE brahmA ca rudraSca varuRo'gnirmanurBavaH । DAtA tvazwA viDAtA ca tvaM praBuH sarvatomuKaH ॥31॥

text: tvatto jātāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca । tvamādiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃhāraśca tvameva hi ॥32॥
html:
tvatto jātāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ।
tvamādiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃhāraśca tvameva hi ॥32॥
slp1: tvatto jAtAni BUtAni sTAvarARi carARi ca । tvamAdiH sarvaBUtAnAM saMhAraSca tvameva hi ॥32॥

text: ye cendriyārthāśca manaśca kṛtsnaṃ ye vāyavaḥ sapta tathaiva cāgniḥ । ye vā divisthā devatāścāpi puṃsāṃ tasmātparaṃ tvāmṛṣayo vadanti ॥33॥
html:
ye cendriyārthāśca manaśca kṛtsnaṃ ye vāyavaḥ sapta tathaiva cāgniḥ ।
ye vā divisthā devatāścāpi puṃsāṃ tasmātparaṃ tvāmṛṣayo vadanti ॥33॥
slp1: ye cendriyArTASca manaSca kftsnaM ye vAyavaH sapta taTEva cAgniH । ye vA divisTA devatAScApi puMsAM tasmAtparaM tvAmfzayo vadanti ॥33॥

text: vedā yajñāśca somaśca dakṣiṇā pāvako haviḥ । yajñopagaṃ ca yatkiñcidbhagavāṃstadasaṃśayam ॥34॥
html:
vedā yajñāśca somaśca dakṣiṇā pāvako haviḥ ।
yajñopagaṃ ca yatkiñcidbhagavāṃstadasaṃśayam ॥34॥
slp1: vedA yajYASca somaSca dakziRA pAvako haviH । yajYopagaM ca yatkiYcidBagavAMstadasaMSayam ॥34॥

text: iṣṭaṃ dattamadhītaṃ ca vratāni niyamāśca ye । hrīḥ kīrtiḥ śrīrdyutistuṣṭiḥ siddhiścaiva tvadarpaṇā ॥35॥
html:
iṣṭaṃ dattamadhītaṃ ca vratāni niyamāśca ye ।
hrīḥ kīrtiḥ śrīrdyutistuṣṭiḥ siddhiścaiva tvadarpaṇā ॥35॥
slp1: izwaM dattamaDItaM ca vratAni niyamASca ye । hrIH kIrtiH SrIrdyutistuzwiH sidDiScEva tvadarpaRA ॥35॥

text: kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṃ lobho madaḥ stambho'tha matsaraḥ । ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva bhagavaṃstanayāstava ॥36॥
html:
kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṃ lobho madaḥ stambho'tha matsaraḥ ।
ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva bhagavaṃstanayāstava ॥36॥
slp1: kAmaH kroDo BayaM loBo madaH stamBo'Ta matsaraH । ADayo vyADayaScEva BagavaMstanayAstava ॥36॥

text: kṛtirvikāraḥ pralayaḥ pradhānaṃ prabhavo'vyayaḥ । manasaḥ paramā yoniḥ svabhāvaścāpi śāśvataḥ । avyaktaḥ pāvana vibho sahasrāṃśo hiraṇmayaḥ ॥37॥
html:
kṛtirvikāraḥ pralayaḥ pradhānaṃ prabhavo'vyayaḥ ।
manasaḥ paramā yoniḥ svabhāvaścāpi śāśvataḥ ।
avyaktaḥ pāvana vibho sahasrāṃśo hiraṇmayaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: kftirvikAraH pralayaH praDAnaM praBavo'vyayaH । manasaH paramA yoniH svaBAvaScApi SASvataH । avyaktaH pAvana viBo sahasrAMSo hiraRmayaH ॥37॥

text: ādirguṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhavānvai jīvanāśrayaḥ । mahānātmā matirbrahmā viśvaḥ śambhuḥ svayambhuvaḥ ॥38॥
html:
ādirguṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhavānvai jīvanāśrayaḥ ।
mahānātmā matirbrahmā viśvaḥ śambhuḥ svayambhuvaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: AdirguRAnAM sarvezAM BavAnvE jIvanASrayaH । mahAnAtmA matirbrahmA viSvaH SamBuH svayamBuvaH ॥38॥

text: buddhiḥ prajñopalabdhiśca saṃvitkhyātirdhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ । paryāyavācakaiḥ śabdairmahānātmā vibhāvyase ॥39॥
html:
buddhiḥ prajñopalabdhiśca saṃvitkhyātirdhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ ।
paryāyavācakaiḥ śabdairmahānātmā vibhāvyase ॥39॥
slp1: budDiH prajYopalabDiSca saMvitKyAtirDftiH smftiH । paryAyavAcakEH SabdErmahAnAtmA viBAvyase ॥39॥

text: tvāṃ buddhvā brāhmaṇo vidvānna pramohaṃ nigacchati । hṛdayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kṣetrajñastvamṛṣiṣṭutaḥ ॥40॥
html:
tvāṃ buddhvā brāhmaṇo vidvānna pramohaṃ nigacchati ।
hṛdayaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kṣetrajñastvamṛṣiṣṭutaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: tvAM budDvA brAhmaRo vidvAnna pramohaM nigacCati । hfdayaM sarvaBUtAnAM kzetrajYastvamfzizwutaH ॥40॥

text: sarvataḥpāṇipādastvaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ । sarvataḥśrutimāṁlloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhasi ॥41॥
html:
sarvataḥpāṇipādastvaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ ।
sarvataḥśrutimāṁlloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhasi ॥41॥
slp1: sarvataHpARipAdastvaM sarvatokziSiromuKaH । sarvataHSrutimAṁlloke sarvamAvftya tizWasi ॥41॥

text: phalaṃ tvamasi tigmāṃśo nimeṣādiṣu karmasu । tvaṃ vai prabhārciḥ puruṣaḥ sarvasya hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ । aṇimā laghimā prāptirīśāno jyotiravyayaḥ ॥42॥
html:
phalaṃ tvamasi tigmāṃśo nimeṣādiṣu karmasu ।
tvaṃ vai prabhārciḥ puruṣaḥ sarvasya hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ ।
aṇimā laghimā prāptirīśāno jyotiravyayaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: PalaM tvamasi tigmAMSo nimezAdizu karmasu । tvaM vE praBArciH puruzaH sarvasya hfdi saMsTitaH । aRimA laGimA prAptirISAno jyotiravyayaH ॥42॥

text: tvayi buddhirmatirlokāḥ prapannāḥ saṃśritāśca ye । dhyānino nityayogāśca satyasandhā jitendriyāḥ ॥43॥
html:
tvayi buddhirmatirlokāḥ prapannāḥ saṃśritāśca ye ।
dhyānino nityayogāśca satyasandhā jitendriyāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: tvayi budDirmatirlokAH prapannAH saMSritASca ye । DyAnino nityayogASca satyasanDA jitendriyAH ॥43॥

text: yastvāṃ dhruvaṃ vedayate guhāśayaṃ prabhuṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ viśvarūpam । hiraṇmayaṃ buddhimatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ sa buddhimānbuddhimatītya tiṣṭhati ॥44॥
html:
yastvāṃ dhruvaṃ vedayate guhāśayaṃ prabhuṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ viśvarūpam ।
hiraṇmayaṃ buddhimatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ sa buddhimānbuddhimatītya tiṣṭhati ॥44॥
slp1: yastvAM DruvaM vedayate guhASayaM praBuM purARaM puruzaM viSvarUpam । hiraRmayaM budDimatAM parAM gatiM sa budDimAnbudDimatItya tizWati ॥44॥

text: viditvā sapta sūkṣmāṇi ṣaḍaṅgaṃ tvāṃ ca mūrtitaḥ । pradhānavidhiyogasthastvāmeva viśate budhaḥ ॥45॥
html:
viditvā sapta sūkṣmāṇi ṣaḍaṅgaṃ tvāṃ ca mūrtitaḥ ।
pradhānavidhiyogasthastvāmeva viśate budhaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: viditvA sapta sUkzmARi zaqaNgaM tvAM ca mUrtitaH । praDAnaviDiyogasTastvAmeva viSate buDaH ॥45॥

text: evamukte mayā pārtha bhave cārtivināśane । carācaraṃ jagatsarvaṃ siṃhanādamathākarot ॥46॥
html:
evamukte mayā pārtha bhave cārtivināśane ।
carācaraṃ jagatsarvaṃ siṃhanādamathākarot ॥46॥
slp1: evamukte mayA pArTa Bave cArtivinASane । carAcaraM jagatsarvaM siMhanAdamaTAkarot ॥46॥

text: saviprasaṅghāśca surāsurāśca nāgāḥ piśācāḥ pitaro vayāṃsi । rakṣogaṇā bhūtagaṇāśca sarve maharṣayaścaiva tathā praṇemuḥ ॥47॥
html:
saviprasaṅghāśca surāsurāśca nāgāḥ piśācāḥ pitaro vayāṃsi ।
rakṣogaṇā bhūtagaṇāśca sarve maharṣayaścaiva tathā praṇemuḥ ॥47॥
slp1: saviprasaNGASca surAsurASca nAgAH piSAcAH pitaro vayAMsi । rakzogaRA BUtagaRASca sarve maharzayaScEva taTA praRemuH ॥47॥

text: mama mūrdhni ca divyānāṃ kusumānāṃ sugandhinām । rāśayo nipatanti sma vāyuśca susukho vavau ॥48॥
html:
mama mūrdhni ca divyānāṃ kusumānāṃ sugandhinām ।
rāśayo nipatanti sma vāyuśca susukho vavau ॥48॥
slp1: mama mUrDni ca divyAnAM kusumAnAM suganDinAm । rASayo nipatanti sma vAyuSca susuKo vavO ॥48॥

text: nirīkṣya bhagavāndevīmumāṃ māṃ ca jagaddhitaḥ । śatakratuṃ cābhivīkṣya svayaṃ māmāha śaṅkaraḥ ॥49॥
html:
nirīkṣya bhagavāndevīmumāṃ māṃ ca jagaddhitaḥ ।
śatakratuṃ cābhivīkṣya svayaṃ māmāha śaṅkaraḥ ॥49॥
slp1: nirIkzya BagavAndevImumAM mAM ca jagadDitaH । SatakratuM cABivIkzya svayaM mAmAha SaNkaraH ॥49॥

text: vidmaḥ kṛṣṇa parāṃ bhaktimasmāsu tava śatruhan । kriyatāmātmanaḥ śreyaḥ prītirhi paramā tvayi ॥50॥
html:
vidmaḥ kṛṣṇa parāṃ bhaktimasmāsu tava śatruhan ।
kriyatāmātmanaḥ śreyaḥ prītirhi paramā tvayi ॥50॥
slp1: vidmaH kfzRa parAM BaktimasmAsu tava Satruhan । kriyatAmAtmanaH SreyaH prItirhi paramA tvayi ॥50॥

text: vṛṇīṣvāṣṭau varānkṛṣṇa dātāsmi tava sattama । brūhi yādavaśārdūla yānicchasi sudurlabhān] ॥51॥
html:
vṛṇīṣvāṣṭau varānkṛṣṇa dātāsmi tava sattama ।
brūhi yādavaśārdūla yānicchasi sudurlabhān] ॥51॥
slp1: vfRIzvAzwO varAnkfzRa dAtAsmi tava sattama । brUhi yAdavaSArdUla yAnicCasi sudurlaBAn] ॥51॥

text: mūrdhnā nipatya niyatastejaḥsannicaye tataḥ । paramaṃ harṣamāgamya bhagavantamathābruvam ॥1॥
html:
mūrdhnā nipatya niyatastejaḥsannicaye tataḥ ।
paramaṃ harṣamāgamya bhagavantamathābruvam ॥1॥
slp1: mUrDnA nipatya niyatastejaHsannicaye tataH । paramaM harzamAgamya BagavantamaTAbruvam ॥1॥
author: kṛṣṇa uvāca ।

text: dharme dṛḍhatvaṃ yudhi śatrughātaṃ yaśastathāgryaṃ paramaṃ balaṃ ca । yogapriyatvaṃ tava sannikarṣaṃ vṛṇe sutānāṃ ca śataṃ śatāni ॥2॥
html:
dharme dṛḍhatvaṃ yudhi śatrughātaṃ yaśastathāgryaṃ paramaṃ balaṃ ca ।
yogapriyatvaṃ tava sannikarṣaṃ vṛṇe sutānāṃ ca śataṃ śatāni ॥2॥
slp1: Darme dfQatvaM yuDi SatruGAtaM yaSastaTAgryaM paramaM balaM ca । yogapriyatvaM tava sannikarzaM vfRe sutAnAM ca SataM SatAni ॥2॥

text: evamastviti tadvākyaṃ mayoktaḥ prāha śaṅkaraḥ ॥3॥
html: evamastviti tadvākyaṃ mayoktaḥ prāha śaṅkaraḥ ॥3॥
slp1: evamastviti tadvAkyaM mayoktaH prAha SaNkaraH ॥3॥

text: tato māṃ jagato mātā dharaṇī sarvapāvanī । uvācomā praṇihitā śarvāṇī tapasāṃ nidhiḥ ॥4॥
html:
tato māṃ jagato mātā dharaṇī sarvapāvanī ।
uvācomā praṇihitā śarvāṇī tapasāṃ nidhiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tato mAM jagato mAtA DaraRI sarvapAvanI । uvAcomA praRihitA SarvARI tapasAM niDiH ॥4॥

text: datto bhagavatā putraḥ sāmbo nāma tavānagha । matto'pyaṣṭau varāniṣṭāngṛhāṇa tvaṃ dadāmi te । praṇamya śirasā sā ca mayoktā pāṇḍunandana ॥5॥
html:
datto bhagavatā putraḥ sāmbo nāma tavānagha ।
matto'pyaṣṭau varāniṣṭāngṛhāṇa tvaṃ dadāmi te ।
praṇamya śirasā sā ca mayoktā pāṇḍunandana ॥5॥
slp1: datto BagavatA putraH sAmbo nAma tavAnaGa । matto'pyazwO varAnizwAngfhARa tvaM dadAmi te । praRamya SirasA sA ca mayoktA pARqunandana ॥5॥

text: dvijeṣvakopaṃ pitṛtaḥ prasādaṃ śataṃ sutānāmupabhogaṃ paraṃ ca । kule prītiṃ mātṛtaśca prasādaṃ śamaprāptiṃ pravṛṇe cāpi dākṣyam ॥6॥
html:
dvijeṣvakopaṃ pitṛtaḥ prasādaṃ śataṃ sutānāmupabhogaṃ paraṃ ca ।
kule prītiṃ mātṛtaśca prasādaṃ śamaprāptiṃ pravṛṇe cāpi dākṣyam ॥6॥
slp1: dvijezvakopaM pitftaH prasAdaM SataM sutAnAmupaBogaM paraM ca । kule prItiM mAtftaSca prasAdaM SamaprAptiM pravfRe cApi dAkzyam ॥6॥

text: evaṃ bhaviṣyatyamaraprabhāva nāhaṃ mṛṣā jātu vade kadācit । bhāryāsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśaiva tāsu priyatvaṃ ca tathākṣayatvam ॥7॥
html:
evaṃ bhaviṣyatyamaraprabhāva nāhaṃ mṛṣā jātu vade kadācit ।
bhāryāsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśaiva tāsu priyatvaṃ ca tathākṣayatvam ॥7॥
slp1: evaM BavizyatyamarapraBAva nAhaM mfzA jAtu vade kadAcit । BAryAsahasrARi ca zoqaSEva tAsu priyatvaM ca taTAkzayatvam ॥7॥
author: devyuvāca ।

text: prītiṃ cāgryāṃ bāndhavānāṃ sakāśāddadāmi te vapuṣaḥ kāmyatāṃ ca । bhokṣyante vai saptatirvai śatāni gṛhe tubhyamatithīnāṃ ca nityam ॥8॥
html:
prītiṃ cāgryāṃ bāndhavānāṃ sakāśāddadāmi te vapuṣaḥ kāmyatāṃ ca ।
bhokṣyante vai saptatirvai śatāni gṛhe tubhyamatithīnāṃ ca nityam ॥8॥
slp1: prItiM cAgryAM bAnDavAnAM sakASAddadAmi te vapuzaH kAmyatAM ca । Bokzyante vE saptatirvE SatAni gfhe tuByamatiTInAM ca nityam ॥8॥

text: evaṃ dattvā varāndevo mama devī ca bhārata । antarhitaḥ kṣaṇe tasminsagaṇo bhīmapūrvaja ॥9॥
html:
evaṃ dattvā varāndevo mama devī ca bhārata ।
antarhitaḥ kṣaṇe tasminsagaṇo bhīmapūrvaja ॥9॥
slp1: evaM dattvA varAndevo mama devI ca BArata । antarhitaH kzaRe tasminsagaRo BImapUrvaja ॥9॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: etadatyadbhutaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇāyātitejase । upamanyave mayā kṛtsnamākhyātaṃ kauravottama ॥10॥
html:
etadatyadbhutaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇāyātitejase ।
upamanyave mayā kṛtsnamākhyātaṃ kauravottama ॥10॥
slp1: etadatyadButaM sarvaM brAhmaRAyAtitejase । upamanyave mayA kftsnamAKyAtaM kOravottama ॥10॥

text: namaskṛtvā tu sa prāha devadevāya suvrata । nāsti śarvasamo dāne nāsti śarvasamo raṇe । nāsti śarvasamo devo nāsti śarvasamā gatiḥ ॥11॥
html:
namaskṛtvā tu sa prāha devadevāya suvrata ।
nāsti śarvasamo dāne nāsti śarvasamo raṇe ।
nāsti śarvasamo devo nāsti śarvasamā gatiḥ ॥11॥
slp1: namaskftvA tu sa prAha devadevAya suvrata । nAsti Sarvasamo dAne nAsti Sarvasamo raRe । nAsti Sarvasamo devo nAsti SarvasamA gatiH ॥11॥

text: ṛṣirāsītkṛte tāta taṇḍirityeva viśrutaḥ । daśa varṣasahasrāṇi tena devaḥ samādhinā । ārādhito'bhūdbhaktena tasyodarkaṃ niśāmaya ॥12॥
html:
ṛṣirāsītkṛte tāta taṇḍirityeva viśrutaḥ ।
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi tena devaḥ samādhinā ।
ārādhito'bhūdbhaktena tasyodarkaṃ niśāmaya ॥12॥
slp1: fzirAsItkfte tAta taRqirityeva viSrutaH । daSa varzasahasrARi tena devaH samADinA । ArADito'BUdBaktena tasyodarkaM niSAmaya ॥12॥

text: sa dṛṣṭavānmahādevamastauṣīcca stavairvibhum । pavitrāṇāṃ pavitrastvaṃ gatirgatimatāṃ vara । atyugraṃ tejasāṃ tejastapasāṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ॥13॥
html:
sa dṛṣṭavānmahādevamastauṣīcca stavairvibhum ।
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitrastvaṃ gatirgatimatāṃ vara ।
atyugraṃ tejasāṃ tejastapasāṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: sa dfzwavAnmahAdevamastOzIcca stavErviBum । pavitrARAM pavitrastvaM gatirgatimatAM vara । atyugraM tejasAM tejastapasAM paramaM tapaH ॥13॥

text: viśvāvasuhiraṇyākṣapuruhūtanamaskṛta । bhūrikalyāṇada vibho purusatya namo'stu te ॥14॥
html:
viśvāvasuhiraṇyākṣapuruhūtanamaskṛta ।
bhūrikalyāṇada vibho purusatya namo'stu te ॥14॥
slp1: viSvAvasuhiraRyAkzapuruhUtanamaskfta । BUrikalyARada viBo purusatya namo'stu te ॥14॥

text: jātīmaraṇabhīrūṇāṃ yatīnāṃ yatatāṃ vibho । nirvāṇada sahasrāṃśo namaste'stu sukhāśraya ॥15॥
html:
jātīmaraṇabhīrūṇāṃ yatīnāṃ yatatāṃ vibho ।
nirvāṇada sahasrāṃśo namaste'stu sukhāśraya ॥15॥
slp1: jAtImaraRaBIrURAM yatInAM yatatAM viBo । nirvARada sahasrAMSo namaste'stu suKASraya ॥15॥

text: brahmā śatakraturviṣṇurviśvedevā maharṣayaḥ । na vidustvāṃ tu tattvena kuto vetsyāmahe vayam ॥16॥
html:
brahmā śatakraturviṣṇurviśvedevā maharṣayaḥ ।
na vidustvāṃ tu tattvena kuto vetsyāmahe vayam ॥16॥
slp1: brahmA SatakraturvizRurviSvedevA maharzayaH । na vidustvAM tu tattvena kuto vetsyAmahe vayam ॥16॥

text: tvattaḥ pravartate kālastvayi kālaśca līyate । kālākhyaḥ puruṣākhyaśca brahmākhyaśca tvameva hi ॥17॥
html:
tvattaḥ pravartate kālastvayi kālaśca līyate ।
kālākhyaḥ puruṣākhyaśca brahmākhyaśca tvameva hi ॥17॥
slp1: tvattaH pravartate kAlastvayi kAlaSca lIyate । kAlAKyaH puruzAKyaSca brahmAKyaSca tvameva hi ॥17॥

text: tanavaste smṛtāstisraḥ purāṇajñaiḥ surarṣibhiḥ । adhipauruṣamadhyātmamadhibhūtādhidaivatam । adhilokyādhivijñānamadhiyajñastvameva hi ॥18॥
html:
tanavaste smṛtāstisraḥ purāṇajñaiḥ surarṣibhiḥ ।
adhipauruṣamadhyātmamadhibhūtādhidaivatam ।
adhilokyādhivijñānamadhiyajñastvameva hi ॥18॥
slp1: tanavaste smftAstisraH purARajYEH surarziBiH । aDipOruzamaDyAtmamaDiBUtADidEvatam । aDilokyADivijYAnamaDiyajYastvameva hi ॥18॥

text: tvāṃ viditvātmadehasthaṃ durvidaṃ daivatairapi । vidvāṃso yānti nirmuktāḥ paraṃ bhāvamanāmayam ॥19॥
html:
tvāṃ viditvātmadehasthaṃ durvidaṃ daivatairapi ।
vidvāṃso yānti nirmuktāḥ paraṃ bhāvamanāmayam ॥19॥
slp1: tvAM viditvAtmadehasTaM durvidaM dEvatErapi । vidvAMso yAnti nirmuktAH paraM BAvamanAmayam ॥19॥

text: anicchatastava vibho janmamṛtyuranekataḥ । dvāraṃ tvaṃ svargamokṣāṇāmākṣeptā tvaṃ dadāsi ca ॥20॥
html:
anicchatastava vibho janmamṛtyuranekataḥ ।
dvāraṃ tvaṃ svargamokṣāṇāmākṣeptā tvaṃ dadāsi ca ॥20॥
slp1: anicCatastava viBo janmamftyuranekataH । dvAraM tvaM svargamokzARAmAkzeptA tvaM dadAsi ca ॥20॥

text: tvameva mokṣaḥ svargaśca kāmaḥ krodhastvameva hi । sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva adhaścordhvaṃ tvameva hi ॥21॥
html:
tvameva mokṣaḥ svargaśca kāmaḥ krodhastvameva hi ।
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva adhaścordhvaṃ tvameva hi ॥21॥
slp1: tvameva mokzaH svargaSca kAmaH kroDastvameva hi । sattvaM rajastamaScEva aDaScorDvaM tvameva hi ॥21॥

text: brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca skandendrau savitā yamaḥ । varuṇendū manurdhātā vidhātā tvaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ ॥22॥
html:
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca skandendrau savitā yamaḥ ।
varuṇendū manurdhātā vidhātā tvaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ ॥22॥
slp1: brahmA vizRuSca rudraSca skandendrO savitA yamaH । varuRendU manurDAtA viDAtA tvaM DaneSvaraH ॥22॥

text: bhūrvāyurjyotirāpaśca vāgbuddhistvaṃ matirmanaḥ । karma satyānṛte cobhe tvamevāsti ca nāsti ca ॥23॥
html:
bhūrvāyurjyotirāpaśca vāgbuddhistvaṃ matirmanaḥ ।
karma satyānṛte cobhe tvamevāsti ca nāsti ca ॥23॥
slp1: BUrvAyurjyotirApaSca vAgbudDistvaM matirmanaH । karma satyAnfte coBe tvamevAsti ca nAsti ca ॥23॥

text: indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca tatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam । viśvāviśvaparo bhāvaścintyācintyastvameva hi ॥24॥
html:
indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca tatparaṃ prakṛterdhruvam ।
viśvāviśvaparo bhāvaścintyācintyastvameva hi ॥24॥
slp1: indriyARIndriyArTASca tatparaM prakfterDruvam । viSvAviSvaparo BAvaScintyAcintyastvameva hi ॥24॥

text: yaccaitatparamaṃ brahma yacca tatparamaṃ padam । yā gatiḥ sāṅkhyayogānāṃ sa bhavānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥25॥
html:
yaccaitatparamaṃ brahma yacca tatparamaṃ padam ।
yā gatiḥ sāṅkhyayogānāṃ sa bhavānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: yaccEtatparamaM brahma yacca tatparamaM padam । yA gatiH sANKyayogAnAM sa BavAnnAtra saMSayaH ॥25॥

text: nūnamadya kṛtārthāḥ sma nūnaṃ prāptāḥ satāṃ gatim । yāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuvantīha jñānanirmalabuddhayaḥ ॥26॥
html:
nūnamadya kṛtārthāḥ sma nūnaṃ prāptāḥ satāṃ gatim ।
yāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuvantīha jñānanirmalabuddhayaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: nUnamadya kftArTAH sma nUnaM prAptAH satAM gatim । yAM gatiM prApnuvantIha jYAnanirmalabudDayaH ॥26॥

text: aho mūḍhāḥ sma suciramimaṃ kālamacetasaḥ । yanna vidmaḥ paraṃ devaṃ śāśvataṃ yaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ॥27॥
html:
aho mūḍhāḥ sma suciramimaṃ kālamacetasaḥ ।
yanna vidmaḥ paraṃ devaṃ śāśvataṃ yaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: aho mUQAH sma suciramimaM kAlamacetasaH । yanna vidmaH paraM devaM SASvataM yaM vidurbuDAH ॥27॥

text: so'yamāsāditaḥ sākṣādbahubhirjanmabhirmayā । bhaktānugrahakṛddevo yaṃ jñātvāmṛtamaśnute ॥28॥
html:
so'yamāsāditaḥ sākṣādbahubhirjanmabhirmayā ।
bhaktānugrahakṛddevo yaṃ jñātvāmṛtamaśnute ॥28॥
slp1: so'yamAsAditaH sAkzAdbahuBirjanmaBirmayA । BaktAnugrahakfddevo yaM jYAtvAmftamaSnute ॥28॥

text: devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ yacca guhyaṃ sanātanam । guhāyāṃ nihitaṃ brahma durvijñeyaṃ surairapi ॥29॥
html:
devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ yacca guhyaṃ sanātanam ।
guhāyāṃ nihitaṃ brahma durvijñeyaṃ surairapi ॥29॥
slp1: devAsuramanuzyARAM yacca guhyaM sanAtanam । guhAyAM nihitaM brahma durvijYeyaM surErapi ॥29॥

text: sa eṣa bhagavāndevaḥ sarvakṛtsarvatomukhaḥ । sarvātmā sarvadarśī ca sarvagaḥ sarvaveditā ॥30॥
html:
sa eṣa bhagavāndevaḥ sarvakṛtsarvatomukhaḥ ।
sarvātmā sarvadarśī ca sarvagaḥ sarvaveditā ॥30॥
slp1: sa eza BagavAndevaH sarvakftsarvatomuKaH । sarvAtmA sarvadarSI ca sarvagaH sarvaveditA ॥30॥

text: prāṇakṛtprāṇabhṛtprāṇī prāṇadaḥ prāṇināṃ gatiḥ । dehakṛddehabhṛddehī dehabhugdehināṃ gatiḥ ॥31॥
html:
prāṇakṛtprāṇabhṛtprāṇī prāṇadaḥ prāṇināṃ gatiḥ ।
dehakṛddehabhṛddehī dehabhugdehināṃ gatiḥ ॥31॥
slp1: prARakftprARaBftprARI prARadaH prARinAM gatiH । dehakfddehaBfddehI dehaBugdehinAM gatiH ॥31॥

text: adhyātmagatiniṣṭhānāṃ dhyānināmātmavedinām । apunarmārakāmānāṃ yā gatiḥ so'yamīśvaraḥ ॥32॥
html:
adhyātmagatiniṣṭhānāṃ dhyānināmātmavedinām ।
apunarmārakāmānāṃ yā gatiḥ so'yamīśvaraḥ ॥32॥
slp1: aDyAtmagatinizWAnAM DyAninAmAtmavedinAm । apunarmArakAmAnAM yA gatiH so'yamISvaraH ॥32॥

text: ayaṃ ca sarvabhūtānāṃ śubhāśubhagatipradaḥ । ayaṃ ca janmamaraṇe vidadhyātsarvajantuṣu ॥33॥
html:
ayaṃ ca sarvabhūtānāṃ śubhāśubhagatipradaḥ ।
ayaṃ ca janmamaraṇe vidadhyātsarvajantuṣu ॥33॥
slp1: ayaM ca sarvaBUtAnAM SuBASuBagatipradaH । ayaM ca janmamaraRe vidaDyAtsarvajantuzu ॥33॥

text: ayaṃ ca siddhikāmānāmṛṣīṇāṃ siddhidaḥ prabhuḥ । ayaṃ ca mokṣakāmānāṃ dvijānāṃ mokṣadaḥ prabhuḥ ॥34॥
html:
ayaṃ ca siddhikāmānāmṛṣīṇāṃ siddhidaḥ prabhuḥ ।
ayaṃ ca mokṣakāmānāṃ dvijānāṃ mokṣadaḥ prabhuḥ ॥34॥
slp1: ayaM ca sidDikAmAnAmfzIRAM sidDidaH praBuH । ayaM ca mokzakAmAnAM dvijAnAM mokzadaH praBuH ॥34॥

text: bhūrādyānsarvabhuvanānutpādya sadivaukasaḥ । vibharti devastanubhiraṣṭābhiśca dadāti ca ॥35॥
html:
bhūrādyānsarvabhuvanānutpādya sadivaukasaḥ ।
vibharti devastanubhiraṣṭābhiśca dadāti ca ॥35॥
slp1: BUrAdyAnsarvaBuvanAnutpAdya sadivOkasaH । viBarti devastanuBirazwABiSca dadAti ca ॥35॥

text: ataḥ pravartate sarvamasminsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam । asmiṃśca pralayaṃ yāti ayamekaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥36॥
html:
ataḥ pravartate sarvamasminsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।
asmiṃśca pralayaṃ yāti ayamekaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: ataH pravartate sarvamasminsarvaM pratizWitam । asmiMSca pralayaM yAti ayamekaH sanAtanaH ॥36॥

text: ayaṃ sa satyakāmānāṃ satyalokaḥ paraḥ satām । apavargaśca muktānāṃ kaivalyaṃ cātmavādinām ॥37॥
html:
ayaṃ sa satyakāmānāṃ satyalokaḥ paraḥ satām ।
apavargaśca muktānāṃ kaivalyaṃ cātmavādinām ॥37॥
slp1: ayaM sa satyakAmAnAM satyalokaH paraH satAm । apavargaSca muktAnAM kEvalyaM cAtmavAdinAm ॥37॥

text: ayaṃ brahmādibhiḥ siddhairguhāyāṃ gopitaḥ prabhuḥ । devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ na prakāśo bhavediti ॥38॥
html:
ayaṃ brahmādibhiḥ siddhairguhāyāṃ gopitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ na prakāśo bhavediti ॥38॥
slp1: ayaM brahmAdiBiH sidDErguhAyAM gopitaH praBuH । devAsuramanuzyARAM na prakASo Bavediti ॥38॥

text: taṃ tvāṃ devāsuranarāstattvena na vidurbhavam । mohitāḥ khalvanenaiva hṛcchayena praveśitāḥ ॥39॥
html:
taṃ tvāṃ devāsuranarāstattvena na vidurbhavam ।
mohitāḥ khalvanenaiva hṛcchayena praveśitāḥ ॥39॥
slp1: taM tvAM devAsuranarAstattvena na vidurBavam । mohitAH KalvanenEva hfcCayena praveSitAH ॥39॥

text: ye cainaṃ samprapadyante bhaktiyogena bhārata । teṣāmevātmanātmānaṃ darśayatyeṣa hṛcchayaḥ ॥40॥
html:
ye cainaṃ samprapadyante bhaktiyogena bhārata ।
teṣāmevātmanātmānaṃ darśayatyeṣa hṛcchayaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: ye cEnaM samprapadyante Baktiyogena BArata । tezAmevAtmanAtmAnaM darSayatyeza hfcCayaH ॥40॥

text: yaṃ jñātvā na punarjanma maraṇaṃ cāpi vidyate । yaṃ viditvā paraṃ vedyaṃ veditavyaṃ na vidyate ॥41॥
html:
yaṃ jñātvā na punarjanma maraṇaṃ cāpi vidyate ।
yaṃ viditvā paraṃ vedyaṃ veditavyaṃ na vidyate ॥41॥
slp1: yaM jYAtvA na punarjanma maraRaM cApi vidyate । yaM viditvA paraM vedyaM veditavyaM na vidyate ॥41॥

text: yaṃ labdhvā paramaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ punaḥ । prāṇasūkṣmāṃ parāṃ prāptimāgacchatyakṣayāvahām ॥42॥
html:
yaṃ labdhvā paramaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ punaḥ ।
prāṇasūkṣmāṃ parāṃ prāptimāgacchatyakṣayāvahām ॥42॥
slp1: yaM labDvA paramaM lABaM manyate nADikaM punaH । prARasUkzmAM parAM prAptimAgacCatyakzayAvahAm ॥42॥

text: yaṃ sāṅkhyā guṇatattvajñāḥ sāṅkhyaśāstraviśāradāḥ । sūkṣmajñānaratāḥ pūrvaṃ jñātvā mucyanti bandhanaiḥ ॥43॥
html:
yaṃ sāṅkhyā guṇatattvajñāḥ sāṅkhyaśāstraviśāradāḥ ।
sūkṣmajñānaratāḥ pūrvaṃ jñātvā mucyanti bandhanaiḥ ॥43॥
slp1: yaM sANKyA guRatattvajYAH sANKyaSAstraviSAradAH । sUkzmajYAnaratAH pUrvaM jYAtvA mucyanti banDanEH ॥43॥

text: yaṃ ca vedavido vedyaṃ vedānteṣu pratiṣṭhitam । prāṇāyāmaparā nityaṃ yaṃ viśanti japanti ca ॥44॥
html:
yaṃ ca vedavido vedyaṃ vedānteṣu pratiṣṭhitam ।
prāṇāyāmaparā nityaṃ yaṃ viśanti japanti ca ॥44॥
slp1: yaM ca vedavido vedyaM vedAntezu pratizWitam । prARAyAmaparA nityaM yaM viSanti japanti ca ॥44॥

text: ayaṃ sa devayānānāmādityo dvāramucyate । ayaṃ ca pitṛyānānāṃ candramā dvāramucyate ॥45॥
html:
ayaṃ sa devayānānāmādityo dvāramucyate ।
ayaṃ ca pitṛyānānāṃ candramā dvāramucyate ॥45॥
slp1: ayaM sa devayAnAnAmAdityo dvAramucyate । ayaM ca pitfyAnAnAM candramA dvAramucyate ॥45॥

text: eṣa kālagatiścitrā saṃvatsarayugādiṣu । bhāvābhāvau tadātve ca ayane dakṣiṇottare ॥46॥
html:
eṣa kālagatiścitrā saṃvatsarayugādiṣu ।
bhāvābhāvau tadātve ca ayane dakṣiṇottare ॥46॥
slp1: eza kAlagatiScitrA saMvatsarayugAdizu । BAvABAvO tadAtve ca ayane dakziRottare ॥46॥

text: evaṃ prajāpatiḥ pūrvamārādhya bahubhiḥ stavaiḥ । varayāmāsa putratve nīlalohitasañjñitam ॥47॥
html:
evaṃ prajāpatiḥ pūrvamārādhya bahubhiḥ stavaiḥ ।
varayāmāsa putratve nīlalohitasañjñitam ॥47॥
slp1: evaM prajApatiH pUrvamArADya bahuBiH stavEH । varayAmAsa putratve nIlalohitasaYjYitam ॥47॥

text: ṛgbhiryamanuśaṃsanti tantre karmaṇi bahvṛcaḥ । yajurbhiryaṃ tridhā vedyaṃ juhvatyadhvaryavo'dhvare ॥48॥
html:
ṛgbhiryamanuśaṃsanti tantre karmaṇi bahvṛcaḥ ।
yajurbhiryaṃ tridhā vedyaṃ juhvatyadhvaryavo'dhvare ॥48॥
slp1: fgBiryamanuSaMsanti tantre karmaRi bahvfcaH । yajurBiryaM triDA vedyaM juhvatyaDvaryavo'Dvare ॥48॥

text: sāmabhiryaṃ ca gāyanti sāmagāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ । yajñasya paramā yoniḥ patiścāyaṃ paraḥ smṛtaḥ ॥49॥
html:
sāmabhiryaṃ ca gāyanti sāmagāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ ।
yajñasya paramā yoniḥ patiścāyaṃ paraḥ smṛtaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: sAmaBiryaM ca gAyanti sAmagAH SudDabudDayaH । yajYasya paramA yoniH patiScAyaM paraH smftaH ॥49॥

text: rātryahaḥśrotranayanaḥ pakṣamāsaśirobhujaḥ । ṛtuvīryastapodhairyo hyabdaguhyorupādavān ॥50॥
html:
rātryahaḥśrotranayanaḥ pakṣamāsaśirobhujaḥ ।
ṛtuvīryastapodhairyo hyabdaguhyorupādavān ॥50॥
slp1: rAtryahaHSrotranayanaH pakzamAsaSiroBujaH । ftuvIryastapoDEryo hyabdaguhyorupAdavAn ॥50॥

text: mṛtyuryamo hutāśaśca kālaḥ saṃhāravegavān । kālasya paramā yoniḥ kālaścāyaṃ sanātanaḥ ॥51॥
html:
mṛtyuryamo hutāśaśca kālaḥ saṃhāravegavān ।
kālasya paramā yoniḥ kālaścāyaṃ sanātanaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: mftyuryamo hutASaSca kAlaH saMhAravegavAn । kAlasya paramA yoniH kAlaScAyaM sanAtanaH ॥51॥

text: candrādityau sanakṣatrau sagrahau saha vāyunā । dhruvaḥ saptarṣayaścaiva bhuvanāḥ sapta eva ca ॥52॥
html:
candrādityau sanakṣatrau sagrahau saha vāyunā ।
dhruvaḥ saptarṣayaścaiva bhuvanāḥ sapta eva ca ॥52॥
slp1: candrAdityO sanakzatrO sagrahO saha vAyunA । DruvaH saptarzayaScEva BuvanAH sapta eva ca ॥52॥

text: pradhānaṃ mahadavyaktaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ savaikṛtam । brahmādi stambaparyantaṃ bhūtādi sadasacca yat ॥53॥
html:
pradhānaṃ mahadavyaktaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ savaikṛtam ।
brahmādi stambaparyantaṃ bhūtādi sadasacca yat ॥53॥
slp1: praDAnaM mahadavyaktaM viSezAntaM savEkftam । brahmAdi stambaparyantaM BUtAdi sadasacca yat ॥53॥

text: aṣṭau prakṛtayaścaiva prakṛtibhyaśca yatparam । asya devasya yadbhāgaṃ kṛtsnaṃ samparivartate ॥54॥
html:
aṣṭau prakṛtayaścaiva prakṛtibhyaśca yatparam ।
asya devasya yadbhāgaṃ kṛtsnaṃ samparivartate ॥54॥
slp1: azwO prakftayaScEva prakftiByaSca yatparam । asya devasya yadBAgaM kftsnaM samparivartate ॥54॥

text: etatparamamānandaṃ yattacchāśvatameva ca । eṣā gatirviraktānāmeṣa bhāvaḥ paraḥ satām ॥55॥
html:
etatparamamānandaṃ yattacchāśvatameva ca ।
eṣā gatirviraktānāmeṣa bhāvaḥ paraḥ satām ॥55॥
slp1: etatparamamAnandaM yattacCASvatameva ca । ezA gatirviraktAnAmeza BAvaH paraH satAm ॥55॥

text: etatpadamanudvignametadbrahma sanātanam । śāstravedāṅgaviduṣāmetaddhyānaṃ paraṃ padam ॥56॥
html:
etatpadamanudvignametadbrahma sanātanam ।
śāstravedāṅgaviduṣāmetaddhyānaṃ paraṃ padam ॥56॥
slp1: etatpadamanudvignametadbrahma sanAtanam । SAstravedANgaviduzAmetadDyAnaM paraM padam ॥56॥

text: iyaṃ sā paramā kāṣṭhā iyaṃ sā paramā kalā । iyaṃ sā paramā siddhiriyaṃ sā paramā gatiḥ ॥57॥
html:
iyaṃ sā paramā kāṣṭhā iyaṃ sā paramā kalā ।
iyaṃ sā paramā siddhiriyaṃ sā paramā gatiḥ ॥57॥
slp1: iyaM sA paramA kAzWA iyaM sA paramA kalA । iyaM sA paramA sidDiriyaM sA paramA gatiH ॥57॥

text: iyaṃ sā paramā śāntiriyaṃ sā nirvṛtiḥ parā । yaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyāḥ sma ityamanyanta vedhasaḥ ॥58॥
html:
iyaṃ sā paramā śāntiriyaṃ sā nirvṛtiḥ parā ।
yaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyāḥ sma ityamanyanta vedhasaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: iyaM sA paramA SAntiriyaM sA nirvftiH parA । yaM prApya kftakftyAH sma ityamanyanta veDasaH ॥58॥

text: iyaṃ tuṣṭiriyaṃ siddhiriyaṃ śrutiriyaṃ smṛtiḥ । adhyātmagatiniṣṭhānāṃ viduṣāṃ prāptiravyayā ॥59॥
html:
iyaṃ tuṣṭiriyaṃ siddhiriyaṃ śrutiriyaṃ smṛtiḥ ।
adhyātmagatiniṣṭhānāṃ viduṣāṃ prāptiravyayā ॥59॥
slp1: iyaM tuzwiriyaM sidDiriyaM SrutiriyaM smftiH । aDyAtmagatinizWAnAM viduzAM prAptiravyayA ॥59॥

text: yajatāṃ yajñakāmānāṃ yajñairvipuladakṣiṇaiḥ । yā gatirdaivatairdivyā sā gatistvaṃ sanātana ॥60॥
html:
yajatāṃ yajñakāmānāṃ yajñairvipuladakṣiṇaiḥ ।
yā gatirdaivatairdivyā sā gatistvaṃ sanātana ॥60॥
slp1: yajatAM yajYakAmAnAM yajYErvipuladakziREH । yA gatirdEvatErdivyA sA gatistvaM sanAtana ॥60॥

text: japyahomavrataiḥ kṛcchrairniyamairdehapātanaiḥ । tapyatāṃ yā gatirdeva vairāje sā gatirbhavān ॥61॥
html:
japyahomavrataiḥ kṛcchrairniyamairdehapātanaiḥ ।
tapyatāṃ yā gatirdeva vairāje sā gatirbhavān ॥61॥
slp1: japyahomavratEH kfcCrErniyamErdehapAtanEH । tapyatAM yA gatirdeva vErAje sA gatirBavAn ॥61॥

text: karmanyāsakṛtānāṃ ca viraktānāṃ tatastataḥ । yā gatirbrahmabhavane sā gatistvaṃ sanātana ॥62॥
html:
karmanyāsakṛtānāṃ ca viraktānāṃ tatastataḥ ।
yā gatirbrahmabhavane sā gatistvaṃ sanātana ॥62॥
slp1: karmanyAsakftAnAM ca viraktAnAM tatastataH । yA gatirbrahmaBavane sA gatistvaM sanAtana ॥62॥

text: apunarmārakāmānāṃ vairāgye vartatāṃ pare । vikṛtīnāṃ layānāṃ ca sā gatistvaṃ sanātana ॥63॥
html:
apunarmārakāmānāṃ vairāgye vartatāṃ pare ।
vikṛtīnāṃ layānāṃ ca sā gatistvaṃ sanātana ॥63॥
slp1: apunarmArakAmAnAM vErAgye vartatAM pare । vikftInAM layAnAM ca sA gatistvaM sanAtana ॥63॥

text: jñānavijñānaniṣṭhānāṃ nirupākhyā nirañjanā । kaivalyā yā gatirdeva paramā sā gatirbhavān ॥64॥
html:
jñānavijñānaniṣṭhānāṃ nirupākhyā nirañjanā ।
kaivalyā yā gatirdeva paramā sā gatirbhavān ॥64॥
slp1: jYAnavijYAnanizWAnAM nirupAKyA niraYjanA । kEvalyA yA gatirdeva paramA sA gatirBavAn ॥64॥

text: vedaśāstrapurāṇoktāḥ pañcaitā gatayaḥ smṛtāḥ । tvatprasādāddhi labhyante na labhyante'nyathā vibho ॥65॥
html:
vedaśāstrapurāṇoktāḥ pañcaitā gatayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।
tvatprasādāddhi labhyante na labhyante'nyathā vibho ॥65॥
slp1: vedaSAstrapurARoktAH paYcEtA gatayaH smftAH । tvatprasAdAdDi laByante na laByante'nyaTA viBo ॥65॥

text: iti taṇḍistapoyogāttuṣṭāveśānamavyayam । jagau ca paramaṃ brahma yatpurā lokakṛjjagau ॥66॥
html:
iti taṇḍistapoyogāttuṣṭāveśānamavyayam ।
jagau ca paramaṃ brahma yatpurā lokakṛjjagau ॥66॥
slp1: iti taRqistapoyogAttuzwAveSAnamavyayam । jagO ca paramaM brahma yatpurA lokakfjjagO ॥66॥

text: brahmā śatakraturviṣṇurviśvedevā maharṣayaḥ । na vidustvāmiti tatastuṣṭaḥ provāca taṃ śivaḥ ॥67॥
html:
brahmā śatakraturviṣṇurviśvedevā maharṣayaḥ ।
na vidustvāmiti tatastuṣṭaḥ provāca taṃ śivaḥ ॥67॥
slp1: brahmA SatakraturvizRurviSvedevA maharzayaH । na vidustvAmiti tatastuzwaH provAca taM SivaH ॥67॥

text: akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva bhavitā duḥkhavarjitaḥ । yaśasvī tejasā yukto divyajñānasamanvitaḥ ॥68॥
html:
akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva bhavitā duḥkhavarjitaḥ ।
yaśasvī tejasā yukto divyajñānasamanvitaḥ ॥68॥
slp1: akzayaScAvyayaScEva BavitA duHKavarjitaH । yaSasvI tejasA yukto divyajYAnasamanvitaH ॥68॥

text: ṛṣīṇāmabhigamyaśca sūtrakartā sutastava । matprasādāddvijaśreṣṭha bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ॥69॥
html:
ṛṣīṇāmabhigamyaśca sūtrakartā sutastava ।
matprasādāddvijaśreṣṭha bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ॥69॥
slp1: fzIRAmaBigamyaSca sUtrakartA sutastava । matprasAdAddvijaSrezWa Bavizyati na saMSayaH ॥69॥

text: kaṃ vā kāmaṃ dadāmyadya brūhi yadvatsa kāṅkṣase । prāñjaliḥ sa uvācedaṃ tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhāstu me ॥70॥
html:
kaṃ vā kāmaṃ dadāmyadya brūhi yadvatsa kāṅkṣase ।
prāñjaliḥ sa uvācedaṃ tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhāstu me ॥70॥
slp1: kaM vA kAmaM dadAmyadya brUhi yadvatsa kANkzase । prAYjaliH sa uvAcedaM tvayi BaktirdfQAstu me ॥70॥

text: evaṃ dattvā varaṃ devo vandyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ । stūyamānaśca vibudhaistatraivāntaradhīyata ॥71॥
html:
evaṃ dattvā varaṃ devo vandyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ ।
stūyamānaśca vibudhaistatraivāntaradhīyata ॥71॥
slp1: evaM dattvA varaM devo vandyamAnaH surarziBiH । stUyamAnaSca vibuDEstatrEvAntaraDIyata ॥71॥

text: antarhite bhagavati sānuge yādaveśvara । ṛṣirāśramamāgamya mamaitatproktavāniha ॥72॥
html:
antarhite bhagavati sānuge yādaveśvara ।
ṛṣirāśramamāgamya mamaitatproktavāniha ॥72॥
slp1: antarhite Bagavati sAnuge yAdaveSvara । fzirASramamAgamya mamEtatproktavAniha ॥72॥

text: yāni ca prathitānyādau taṇḍirākhyātavānmama । nāmāni mānavaśreṣṭha tāni tvaṃ śṛṇu siddhaye ॥73॥
html:
yāni ca prathitānyādau taṇḍirākhyātavānmama ।
nāmāni mānavaśreṣṭha tāni tvaṃ śṛṇu siddhaye ॥73॥
slp1: yAni ca praTitAnyAdO taRqirAKyAtavAnmama । nAmAni mAnavaSrezWa tAni tvaM SfRu sidDaye ॥73॥

text: daśa nāmasahasrāṇi vedeṣvāha pitāmahaḥ । śarvasya śāstreṣu tathā daśa nāmaśatāni vai ॥74॥
html:
daśa nāmasahasrāṇi vedeṣvāha pitāmahaḥ ।
śarvasya śāstreṣu tathā daśa nāmaśatāni vai ॥74॥
slp1: daSa nAmasahasrARi vedezvAha pitAmahaH । Sarvasya SAstrezu taTA daSa nAmaSatAni vE ॥74॥

text: guhyānīmāni nāmāni taṇḍirbhagavato'cyuta । devaprasādāddeveśa purā prāha mahātmane] ॥75॥
html:
guhyānīmāni nāmāni taṇḍirbhagavato'cyuta ।
devaprasādāddeveśa purā prāha mahātmane] ॥75॥
slp1: guhyAnImAni nAmAni taRqirBagavato'cyuta । devaprasAdAddeveSa purA prAha mahAtmane] ॥75॥

text: tataḥ sa prayato bhūtvā mama tāta yudhiṣṭhira । prāñjaliḥ prāha viprarṣirnāmasaṃhāramāditaḥ ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ sa prayato bhūtvā mama tāta yudhiṣṭhira ।
prāñjaliḥ prāha viprarṣirnāmasaṃhāramāditaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: tataH sa prayato BUtvA mama tAta yuDizWira । prAYjaliH prAha viprarzirnAmasaMhAramAditaH ॥1॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: brahmaproktairṛṣiproktairvedavedāṅgasambhavaiḥ । sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaiḥ sthāṇuṃ stoṣyāmi nāmabhiḥ ॥2॥
html:
brahmaproktairṛṣiproktairvedavedāṅgasambhavaiḥ ।
sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaiḥ sthāṇuṃ stoṣyāmi nāmabhiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: brahmaproktErfziproktErvedavedANgasamBavEH । sarvalokezu viKyAtEH sTARuM stozyAmi nAmaBiH ॥2॥
author: upamanyuruvāca ।

text: mahadbhirvihitaiḥ satyaiḥ siddhaiḥ sarvārthasādhakaiḥ । ṛṣiṇā taṇḍinā bhaktyā kṛtairdevakṛtātmanā ॥3॥
html:
mahadbhirvihitaiḥ satyaiḥ siddhaiḥ sarvārthasādhakaiḥ ।
ṛṣiṇā taṇḍinā bhaktyā kṛtairdevakṛtātmanā ॥3॥
slp1: mahadBirvihitEH satyEH sidDEH sarvArTasADakEH । fziRA taRqinA BaktyA kftErdevakftAtmanA ॥3॥

text: yathoktairlokavikhyātairmunibhistattvadarśibhiḥ । pravaraṃ prathamaṃ svargyaṃ sarvabhūtahitaṃ śubham । śrutaiḥ sarvatra jagati brahmalokāvatāritaiḥ ॥4॥
html:
yathoktairlokavikhyātairmunibhistattvadarśibhiḥ ।
pravaraṃ prathamaṃ svargyaṃ sarvabhūtahitaṃ śubham ।
śrutaiḥ sarvatra jagati brahmalokāvatāritaiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: yaToktErlokaviKyAtErmuniBistattvadarSiBiH । pravaraM praTamaM svargyaM sarvaBUtahitaM SuBam । SrutEH sarvatra jagati brahmalokAvatAritEH ॥4॥

text: yattadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ brahmaproktaṃ sanātanam । vakṣye yadukulaśreṣṭha śṛṇuṣvāvahito mama ॥5॥
html:
yattadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ brahmaproktaṃ sanātanam ।
vakṣye yadukulaśreṣṭha śṛṇuṣvāvahito mama ॥5॥
slp1: yattadrahasyaM paramaM brahmaproktaM sanAtanam । vakzye yadukulaSrezWa SfRuzvAvahito mama ॥5॥

text: paratvena bhavaṃ devaṃ bhaktastvaṃ parameśvaram । tena te śrāvayiṣyāmi yattadbrahma sanātanam ॥6॥
html:
paratvena bhavaṃ devaṃ bhaktastvaṃ parameśvaram ।
tena te śrāvayiṣyāmi yattadbrahma sanātanam ॥6॥
slp1: paratvena BavaM devaM BaktastvaM parameSvaram । tena te SrAvayizyAmi yattadbrahma sanAtanam ॥6॥

text: na śakyaṃ vistarātkṛtsnaṃ vaktuṃ śarvasya kenacit । yuktenāpi vibhūtīnāmapi varṣaśatairapi ॥7॥
html:
na śakyaṃ vistarātkṛtsnaṃ vaktuṃ śarvasya kenacit ।
yuktenāpi vibhūtīnāmapi varṣaśatairapi ॥7॥
slp1: na SakyaM vistarAtkftsnaM vaktuM Sarvasya kenacit । yuktenApi viBUtInAmapi varzaSatErapi ॥7॥

text: yasyādirmadhyamantaśca surairapi na gamyate । kastasya śaknuyādvaktuṃ guṇānkārtsnyena mādhava ॥8॥
html:
yasyādirmadhyamantaśca surairapi na gamyate ।
kastasya śaknuyādvaktuṃ guṇānkārtsnyena mādhava ॥8॥
slp1: yasyAdirmaDyamantaSca surErapi na gamyate । kastasya SaknuyAdvaktuM guRAnkArtsnyena mADava ॥8॥

text: kiṃ tu devasya mahataḥ saṅkṣiptārthapadākṣaram । śaktitaścaritaṃ vakṣye prasādāttasya caiva hi ॥9॥
html:
kiṃ tu devasya mahataḥ saṅkṣiptārthapadākṣaram ।
śaktitaścaritaṃ vakṣye prasādāttasya caiva hi ॥9॥
slp1: kiM tu devasya mahataH saNkziptArTapadAkzaram । SaktitaScaritaM vakzye prasAdAttasya cEva hi ॥9॥

text: aprāpyeha tato'nujñāṃ na śakyaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ । yadā tenābhyanujñātaḥ stuvatyeva sadā bhavam ॥10॥
html:
aprāpyeha tato'nujñāṃ na śakyaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ ।
yadā tenābhyanujñātaḥ stuvatyeva sadā bhavam ॥10॥
slp1: aprApyeha tato'nujYAM na SakyaH stotumISvaraH । yadA tenAByanujYAtaH stuvatyeva sadA Bavam ॥10॥

text: anādinidhanasyāhaṃ sarvayonermahātmanaḥ । nāmnāṃ kañcitsamuddeśaṃ vakṣye hyavyaktayoninaḥ ॥11॥
html:
anādinidhanasyāhaṃ sarvayonermahātmanaḥ ।
nāmnāṃ kañcitsamuddeśaṃ vakṣye hyavyaktayoninaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: anAdiniDanasyAhaM sarvayonermahAtmanaH । nAmnAM kaYcitsamuddeSaM vakzye hyavyaktayoninaH ॥11॥

text: varadasya vareṇyasya viśvarūpasya dhīmataḥ । śṛṇu nāmasamuddeśaṃ yaduktaṃ padmayoninā ॥12॥
html:
varadasya vareṇyasya viśvarūpasya dhīmataḥ ।
śṛṇu nāmasamuddeśaṃ yaduktaṃ padmayoninā ॥12॥
slp1: varadasya vareRyasya viSvarUpasya DImataH । SfRu nAmasamuddeSaM yaduktaM padmayoninA ॥12॥

text: daśa nāmasahasrāṇi yānyāha prapitāmahaḥ । tāni nirmathya manasā dadhno ghṛtamivoddhṛtam ॥13॥
html:
daśa nāmasahasrāṇi yānyāha prapitāmahaḥ ।
tāni nirmathya manasā dadhno ghṛtamivoddhṛtam ॥13॥
slp1: daSa nAmasahasrARi yAnyAha prapitAmahaH । tAni nirmaTya manasA daDno GftamivodDftam ॥13॥

text: gireḥ sāraṃ yathā hema puṣpātsāraṃ yathā madhu । ghṛtātsāraṃ yathā maṇḍastathaitatsāramuddhṛtam ॥14॥
html:
gireḥ sāraṃ yathā hema puṣpātsāraṃ yathā madhu ।
ghṛtātsāraṃ yathā maṇḍastathaitatsāramuddhṛtam ॥14॥
slp1: gireH sAraM yaTA hema puzpAtsAraM yaTA maDu । GftAtsAraM yaTA maRqastaTEtatsAramudDftam ॥14॥

text: sarvapāpmāpahamidaṃ caturvedasamanvitam । prayatnenādhigantavyaṃ dhāryaṃ ca prayatātmanā । śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva rakṣoghnaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat ॥15॥
html:
sarvapāpmāpahamidaṃ caturvedasamanvitam ।
prayatnenādhigantavyaṃ dhāryaṃ ca prayatātmanā ।
śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva rakṣoghnaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat ॥15॥
slp1: sarvapApmApahamidaM caturvedasamanvitam । prayatnenADigantavyaM DAryaM ca prayatAtmanA । SAntikaM pOzwikaM cEva rakzoGnaM pAvanaM mahat ॥15॥

text: idaṃ bhaktāya dātavyaṃ śraddadhānāstikāya ca । nāśraddadhānarūpāya nāstikāyājitātmane ॥16॥
html:
idaṃ bhaktāya dātavyaṃ śraddadhānāstikāya ca ।
nāśraddadhānarūpāya nāstikāyājitātmane ॥16॥
slp1: idaM BaktAya dAtavyaM SraddaDAnAstikAya ca । nASraddaDAnarUpAya nAstikAyAjitAtmane ॥16॥

text: yaścābhyasūyate devaṃ bhūtātmānaṃ pinākinam । sa kṛṣṇa narakaṃ yāti saha pūrvaiḥ sahānugaiḥ ॥17॥
html:
yaścābhyasūyate devaṃ bhūtātmānaṃ pinākinam ।
sa kṛṣṇa narakaṃ yāti saha pūrvaiḥ sahānugaiḥ ॥17॥
slp1: yaScAByasUyate devaM BUtAtmAnaM pinAkinam । sa kfzRa narakaM yAti saha pUrvEH sahAnugEH ॥17॥

text: idaṃ dhyānamidaṃ yogamidaṃ dhyeyamanuttamam । idaṃ japyamidaṃ jñānaṃ rahasyamidamuttamam । idaṃ jñātvāntakāle'pi gaccheddhi paramāṃ gatim ॥18॥
html:
idaṃ dhyānamidaṃ yogamidaṃ dhyeyamanuttamam ।
idaṃ japyamidaṃ jñānaṃ rahasyamidamuttamam ।
idaṃ jñātvāntakāle'pi gaccheddhi paramāṃ gatim ॥18॥
slp1: idaM DyAnamidaM yogamidaM Dyeyamanuttamam । idaM japyamidaM jYAnaM rahasyamidamuttamam । idaM jYAtvAntakAle'pi gacCedDi paramAM gatim ॥18॥

text: pavitraṃ maṅgalaṃ puṇyaṃ kalyāṇamidamuttamam । nigadiṣye mahābāho stavānāmuttamaṃ stavam ॥19॥
html:
pavitraṃ maṅgalaṃ puṇyaṃ kalyāṇamidamuttamam ।
nigadiṣye mahābāho stavānāmuttamaṃ stavam ॥19॥
slp1: pavitraM maNgalaM puRyaM kalyARamidamuttamam । nigadizye mahAbAho stavAnAmuttamaM stavam ॥19॥

text: idaṃ brahmā purā kṛtvā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ । sarvastavānāṃ divyānāṃ rājatve samakalpayat ॥20॥
html:
idaṃ brahmā purā kṛtvā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ ।
sarvastavānāṃ divyānāṃ rājatve samakalpayat ॥20॥
slp1: idaM brahmA purA kftvA sarvalokapitAmahaH । sarvastavAnAM divyAnAM rAjatve samakalpayat ॥20॥

text: tadāprabhṛti caivāyamīśvarasya mahātmanaḥ । stavarājeti vikhyāto jagatyamarapūjitaḥ । brahmalokādayaṃ caiva stavarājo'vatāritaḥ ॥21॥
html:
tadāprabhṛti caivāyamīśvarasya mahātmanaḥ ।
stavarājeti vikhyāto jagatyamarapūjitaḥ ।
brahmalokādayaṃ caiva stavarājo'vatāritaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tadApraBfti cEvAyamISvarasya mahAtmanaH । stavarAjeti viKyAto jagatyamarapUjitaH । brahmalokAdayaM cEva stavarAjo'vatAritaH ॥21॥

text: yasmāttaṇḍiḥ purā prāha tena taṇḍikṛto'bhavat । svargāccaivātra bhūlokaṃ taṇḍinā hyavatāritaḥ ॥22॥
html:
yasmāttaṇḍiḥ purā prāha tena taṇḍikṛto'bhavat ।
svargāccaivātra bhūlokaṃ taṇḍinā hyavatāritaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: yasmAttaRqiH purA prAha tena taRqikfto'Bavat । svargAccEvAtra BUlokaM taRqinA hyavatAritaH ॥22॥

text: sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam । nigadiṣye mahābāho stavānāmuttamaṃ stavam ॥23॥
html:
sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।
nigadiṣye mahābāho stavānāmuttamaṃ stavam ॥23॥
slp1: sarvamaNgalamaNgalyaM sarvapApapraRASanam । nigadizye mahAbAho stavAnAmuttamaM stavam ॥23॥

text: brahmaṇāmapi yadbrahma parāṇāmapi yatparam । tejasāmapi yattejastapasāmapi yattapaḥ ॥24॥
html:
brahmaṇāmapi yadbrahma parāṇāmapi yatparam ।
tejasāmapi yattejastapasāmapi yattapaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: brahmaRAmapi yadbrahma parARAmapi yatparam । tejasAmapi yattejastapasAmapi yattapaH ॥24॥

text: śāntīnāmapi yā śāntirdyutīnāmapi yā dyutiḥ । dāntānāmapi yo dānto dhīmatāmapi yā ca dhīḥ ॥25॥
html:
śāntīnāmapi yā śāntirdyutīnāmapi yā dyutiḥ ।
dāntānāmapi yo dānto dhīmatāmapi yā ca dhīḥ ॥25॥
slp1: SAntInAmapi yA SAntirdyutInAmapi yA dyutiH । dAntAnAmapi yo dAnto DImatAmapi yA ca DIH ॥25॥

text: devānāmapi yo devo munīnāmapi yo muniḥ । yajñānāmapi yo yajñaḥ śivānāmapi yaḥ śivaḥ ॥26॥
html:
devānāmapi yo devo munīnāmapi yo muniḥ ।
yajñānāmapi yo yajñaḥ śivānāmapi yaḥ śivaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: devAnAmapi yo devo munInAmapi yo muniH । yajYAnAmapi yo yajYaH SivAnAmapi yaH SivaH ॥26॥

text: rudrāṇāmapi yo rudraḥ prabhuḥ prabhavatāmapi । yogināmapi yo yogī kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam ॥27॥
html:
rudrāṇāmapi yo rudraḥ prabhuḥ prabhavatāmapi ।
yogināmapi yo yogī kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam ॥27॥
slp1: rudrARAmapi yo rudraH praBuH praBavatAmapi । yoginAmapi yo yogI kAraRAnAM ca kAraRam ॥27॥

text: yato lokāḥ sambhavanti na bhavanti yataḥ punaḥ । sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya harasyāmitatejasaḥ ॥28॥
html:
yato lokāḥ sambhavanti na bhavanti yataḥ punaḥ ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya harasyāmitatejasaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: yato lokAH samBavanti na Bavanti yataH punaH । sarvaBUtAtmaBUtasya harasyAmitatejasaH ॥28॥

text: aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu nāmnāṃ śarvasya me śṛṇu । yacchrutvā manujaśreṣṭha sarvānkāmānavāpsyasi ॥29॥
html:
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu nāmnāṃ śarvasya me śṛṇu ।
yacchrutvā manujaśreṣṭha sarvānkāmānavāpsyasi ॥29॥
slp1: azwottarasahasraM tu nAmnAM Sarvasya me SfRu । yacCrutvA manujaSrezWa sarvAnkAmAnavApsyasi ॥29॥

text: sthiraḥ sthāṇuḥ prabhurbhānuḥ pravaro varado varaḥ । sarvātmā sarvavikhyātaḥ sarvaḥ sarvakaro bhavaḥ ॥30॥
html:
sthiraḥ sthāṇuḥ prabhurbhānuḥ pravaro varado varaḥ ।
sarvātmā sarvavikhyātaḥ sarvaḥ sarvakaro bhavaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: sTiraH sTARuH praBurBAnuH pravaro varado varaH । sarvAtmA sarvaviKyAtaH sarvaH sarvakaro BavaH ॥30॥

text: jaṭī carmī śikhaṇḍī ca sarvāṅgaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ । hariśca hariṇākṣaśca sarvabhūtaharaḥ prabhuḥ ॥31॥
html:
jaṭī carmī śikhaṇḍī ca sarvāṅgaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ ।
hariśca hariṇākṣaśca sarvabhūtaharaḥ prabhuḥ ॥31॥
slp1: jawI carmI SiKaRqI ca sarvANgaH sarvaBAvanaH । hariSca hariRAkzaSca sarvaBUtaharaH praBuH ॥31॥

text: pravṛttiśca nivṛttiśca niyataḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ । śmaśānacārī bhagavānkhacaro gocaro'rdanaḥ ॥32॥
html:
pravṛttiśca nivṛttiśca niyataḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ ।
śmaśānacārī bhagavānkhacaro gocaro'rdanaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: pravfttiSca nivfttiSca niyataH SASvato DruvaH । SmaSAnacArI BagavAnKacaro gocaro'rdanaH ॥32॥

text: abhivādyo mahākarmā tapasvī bhūtabhāvanaḥ । unmattaveśapracchannaḥ sarvalokaprajāpatiḥ ॥33॥
html:
abhivādyo mahākarmā tapasvī bhūtabhāvanaḥ ।
unmattaveśapracchannaḥ sarvalokaprajāpatiḥ ॥33॥
slp1: aBivAdyo mahAkarmA tapasvI BUtaBAvanaH । unmattaveSapracCannaH sarvalokaprajApatiH ॥33॥

text: mahārūpo mahākāyaḥ sarvarūpo mahāyaśāḥ । mahātmā sarvabhūtaśca virūpo vāmano manuḥ ॥34॥
html:
mahārūpo mahākāyaḥ sarvarūpo mahāyaśāḥ ।
mahātmā sarvabhūtaśca virūpo vāmano manuḥ ॥34॥
slp1: mahArUpo mahAkAyaH sarvarUpo mahAyaSAH । mahAtmA sarvaBUtaSca virUpo vAmano manuH ॥34॥

text: lokapālo'ntarhitātmā prasādo hayagardabhiḥ । pavitraśca mahāṃścaiva niyamo niyamāśrayaḥ ॥35॥
html:
lokapālo'ntarhitātmā prasādo hayagardabhiḥ ।
pavitraśca mahāṃścaiva niyamo niyamāśrayaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: lokapAlo'ntarhitAtmA prasAdo hayagardaBiH । pavitraSca mahAMScEva niyamo niyamASrayaH ॥35॥

text: sarvakarmā svayambhūśca ādirādikaro nidhiḥ । sahasrākṣo virūpākṣaḥ somo nakṣatrasādhakaḥ ॥36॥
html:
sarvakarmā svayambhūśca ādirādikaro nidhiḥ ।
sahasrākṣo virūpākṣaḥ somo nakṣatrasādhakaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: sarvakarmA svayamBUSca AdirAdikaro niDiH । sahasrAkzo virUpAkzaH somo nakzatrasADakaH ॥36॥

text: candrasūryagatiḥ keturgraho grahapatirvaraḥ । adriradryālayaḥ kartā mṛgabāṇārpaṇo'naghaḥ ॥37॥
html:
candrasūryagatiḥ keturgraho grahapatirvaraḥ ।
adriradryālayaḥ kartā mṛgabāṇārpaṇo'naghaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: candrasUryagatiH keturgraho grahapatirvaraH । adriradryAlayaH kartA mfgabARArpaRo'naGaH ॥37॥

text: mahātapā ghoratapā adīno dīnasādhakaḥ । saṃvatsarakaro mantraḥ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ॥38॥
html:
mahātapā ghoratapā adīno dīnasādhakaḥ ।
saṃvatsarakaro mantraḥ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: mahAtapA GoratapA adIno dInasADakaH । saMvatsarakaro mantraH pramARaM paramaM tapaH ॥38॥

text: yogī yojyo mahābījo mahāretā mahātapāḥ । suvarṇaretāḥ sarvajñaḥ subījo vṛṣavāhanaḥ ॥39॥
html:
yogī yojyo mahābījo mahāretā mahātapāḥ ।
suvarṇaretāḥ sarvajñaḥ subījo vṛṣavāhanaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: yogI yojyo mahAbIjo mahAretA mahAtapAH । suvarRaretAH sarvajYaH subIjo vfzavAhanaH ॥39॥

text: daśabāhustvanimiṣo nīlakaṇṭha umāpatiḥ । viśvarūpaḥ svayaṃśreṣṭho balavīro balo gaṇaḥ ॥40॥
html:
daśabāhustvanimiṣo nīlakaṇṭha umāpatiḥ ।
viśvarūpaḥ svayaṃśreṣṭho balavīro balo gaṇaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: daSabAhustvanimizo nIlakaRWa umApatiH । viSvarUpaH svayaMSrezWo balavIro balo gaRaH ॥40॥

text: gaṇakartā gaṇapatirdigvāsāḥ kāmya eva ca । pavitraṃ paramaṃ mantraḥ sarvabhāvakaro haraḥ ॥41॥
html:
gaṇakartā gaṇapatirdigvāsāḥ kāmya eva ca ।
pavitraṃ paramaṃ mantraḥ sarvabhāvakaro haraḥ ॥41॥
slp1: gaRakartA gaRapatirdigvAsAH kAmya eva ca । pavitraM paramaM mantraH sarvaBAvakaro haraH ॥41॥

text: kamaṇḍaludharo dhanvī bāṇahastaḥ kapālavān । aśanī śataghnī khaḍgī paṭṭiśī cāyudhī mahān ॥42॥
html:
kamaṇḍaludharo dhanvī bāṇahastaḥ kapālavān ।
aśanī śataghnī khaḍgī paṭṭiśī cāyudhī mahān ॥42॥
slp1: kamaRqaluDaro DanvI bARahastaH kapAlavAn । aSanI SataGnI KaqgI pawwiSI cAyuDI mahAn ॥42॥

text: sruvahastaḥ surūpaśca tejastejaskaro nidhiḥ । uṣṇīṣī ca suvaktraśca udagro vinatastathā ॥43॥
html:
sruvahastaḥ surūpaśca tejastejaskaro nidhiḥ ।
uṣṇīṣī ca suvaktraśca udagro vinatastathā ॥43॥
slp1: sruvahastaH surUpaSca tejastejaskaro niDiH । uzRIzI ca suvaktraSca udagro vinatastaTA ॥43॥

text: dīrghaśca harikeśaśca sutīrthaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca । sṛgālarūpaḥ sarvārtho muṇḍaḥ kuṇḍī kamaṇḍaluḥ ॥44॥
html:
dīrghaśca harikeśaśca sutīrthaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca ।
sṛgālarūpaḥ sarvārtho muṇḍaḥ kuṇḍī kamaṇḍaluḥ ॥44॥
slp1: dIrGaSca harikeSaSca sutIrTaH kfzRa eva ca । sfgAlarUpaH sarvArTo muRqaH kuRqI kamaRqaluH ॥44॥

text: ajaśca mṛgarūpaśca gandhadhārī kapardyapi । ūrdhvaretā ūrdhvaliṅga ūrdhvaśāyī nabhastalaḥ ॥45॥
html:
ajaśca mṛgarūpaśca gandhadhārī kapardyapi ।
ūrdhvaretā ūrdhvaliṅga ūrdhvaśāyī nabhastalaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: ajaSca mfgarUpaSca ganDaDArI kapardyapi । UrDvaretA UrDvaliNga UrDvaSAyI naBastalaH ॥45॥

text: trijaṭaścīravāsāśca rudraḥ senāpatirvibhuḥ । ahaścaro'tha naktaṃ ca tigmamanyuḥ suvarcasaḥ ॥46॥
html:
trijaṭaścīravāsāśca rudraḥ senāpatirvibhuḥ ।
ahaścaro'tha naktaṃ ca tigmamanyuḥ suvarcasaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: trijawaScIravAsASca rudraH senApatirviBuH । ahaScaro'Ta naktaM ca tigmamanyuH suvarcasaH ॥46॥

text: gajahā daityahā loko lokadhātā guṇākaraḥ । siṃhaśārdūlarūpaśca ārdracarmāmbarāvṛtaḥ ॥47॥
html:
gajahā daityahā loko lokadhātā guṇākaraḥ ।
siṃhaśārdūlarūpaśca ārdracarmāmbarāvṛtaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: gajahA dEtyahA loko lokaDAtA guRAkaraH । siMhaSArdUlarUpaSca ArdracarmAmbarAvftaH ॥47॥

text: kālayogī mahānādaḥ sarvavāsaścatuṣpathaḥ । niśācaraḥ pretacārī bhūtacārī maheśvaraḥ ॥48॥
html:
kālayogī mahānādaḥ sarvavāsaścatuṣpathaḥ ।
niśācaraḥ pretacārī bhūtacārī maheśvaraḥ ॥48॥
slp1: kAlayogI mahAnAdaH sarvavAsaScatuzpaTaH । niSAcaraH pretacArI BUtacArI maheSvaraH ॥48॥

text: bahubhūto bahudhanaḥ sarvādhāro'mito gatiḥ । nṛtyapriyo nityanarto nartakaḥ sarvalāsakaḥ ॥49॥
html:
bahubhūto bahudhanaḥ sarvādhāro'mito gatiḥ ।
nṛtyapriyo nityanarto nartakaḥ sarvalāsakaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: bahuBUto bahuDanaH sarvADAro'mito gatiH । nftyapriyo nityanarto nartakaH sarvalAsakaH ॥49॥

text: ghoro mahātapāḥ pāśo nityo giricaro nabhaḥ । sahasrahasto vijayo vyavasāyo hyaninditaḥ ॥50॥
html:
ghoro mahātapāḥ pāśo nityo giricaro nabhaḥ ।
sahasrahasto vijayo vyavasāyo hyaninditaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: Goro mahAtapAH pASo nityo giricaro naBaH । sahasrahasto vijayo vyavasAyo hyaninditaH ॥50॥

text: amarṣaṇo marṣaṇātmā yajñahā kāmanāśanaḥ । dakṣayajñāpahārī ca susaho madhyamastathā ॥51॥
html:
amarṣaṇo marṣaṇātmā yajñahā kāmanāśanaḥ ।
dakṣayajñāpahārī ca susaho madhyamastathā ॥51॥
slp1: amarzaRo marzaRAtmA yajYahA kAmanASanaH । dakzayajYApahArI ca susaho maDyamastaTA ॥51॥

text: tejopahārī balahā mudito'rtho jito varaḥ । gambhīraghoṣo gambhīro gambhīrabalavāhanaḥ ॥52॥
html:
tejopahārī balahā mudito'rtho jito varaḥ ।
gambhīraghoṣo gambhīro gambhīrabalavāhanaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: tejopahArI balahA mudito'rTo jito varaH । gamBIraGozo gamBIro gamBIrabalavAhanaH ॥52॥

text: nyagrodharūpo nyagrodho vṛkṣakarṇasthitirvibhuḥ । tīkṣṇatāpaśca haryaśvaḥ sahāyaḥ karmakālavit ॥53॥
html:
nyagrodharūpo nyagrodho vṛkṣakarṇasthitirvibhuḥ ।
tīkṣṇatāpaśca haryaśvaḥ sahāyaḥ karmakālavit ॥53॥
slp1: nyagroDarUpo nyagroDo vfkzakarRasTitirviBuH । tIkzRatApaSca haryaSvaH sahAyaH karmakAlavit ॥53॥

text: viṣṇuprasādito yajñaḥ samudro vaḍavāmukhaḥ । hutāśanasahāyaśca praśāntātmā hutāśanaḥ ॥54॥
html:
viṣṇuprasādito yajñaḥ samudro vaḍavāmukhaḥ ।

slp1: vizRuprasAdito yajYaH samudro vaqavAmuKaH । hutASanasahAyaSca praSAntAtmA hutASanaH ॥54॥

text: ugratejā mahātejā jayo vijayakālavit । jyotiṣāmayanaṃ siddhiḥ sandhirvigraha eva ca ॥55॥
html:
ugratejā mahātejā jayo vijayakālavit ।
