slp1: ugratejA mahAtejA jayo vijayakAlavit । jyotizAmayanaM sidDiH sanDirvigraha eva ca ॥55॥

text: śikhī daṇḍī jaṭī jvālī mūrtijo mūrdhago balī । vaiṇavī paṇavī tālī kālaḥ kālakaṭaṅkaṭaḥ ॥56॥
html:
śikhī daṇḍī jaṭī jvālī mūrtijo mūrdhago balī ।
vaiṇavī paṇavī tālī kālaḥ kālakaṭaṅkaṭaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: SiKI daRqI jawI jvAlI mUrtijo mUrDago balI । vERavI paRavI tAlI kAlaH kAlakawaNkawaH ॥56॥

text: nakṣatravigrahavidhirguṇavṛddhirlayo'gamaḥ । prajāpatirdiśābāhurvibhāgaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ ॥57॥
html:
nakṣatravigrahavidhirguṇavṛddhirlayo'gamaḥ ।

slp1: nakzatravigrahaviDirguRavfdDirlayo'gamaH । prajApatirdiSAbAhurviBAgaH sarvatomuKaH ॥57॥

text: vimocanaḥ suragaṇo hiraṇyakavacodbhavaḥ । meḍhrajo balacārī ca mahācārī stutastathā ॥58॥
html:
vimocanaḥ suragaṇo hiraṇyakavacodbhavaḥ ।

slp1: vimocanaH suragaRo hiraRyakavacodBavaH । meQrajo balacArI ca mahAcArI stutastaTA ॥58॥

text: sarvatūryaninādī ca sarvavādyaparigrahaḥ । vyālarūpo bilāvāsī hemamālī taraṅgavit ॥59॥
html:
sarvatūryaninādī ca sarvavādyaparigrahaḥ ।
vyālarūpo bilāvāsī hemamālī taraṅgavit ॥59॥
slp1: sarvatUryaninAdI ca sarvavAdyaparigrahaH । vyAlarUpo bilAvAsI hemamAlI taraNgavit ॥59॥

text: tridaśastrikāladhṛkkarmasarvabandhavimocanaḥ । bandhanastvasurendrāṇāṃ yudhi śatruvināśanaḥ ॥60॥
html:
tridaśastrikāladhṛkkarmasarvabandhavimocanaḥ ।

slp1: tridaSastrikAlaDfkkarmasarvabanDavimocanaH । banDanastvasurendrARAM yuDi SatruvinASanaH ॥60॥

text: sāṅkhyaprasādo durvāsāḥ sarvasādhuniṣevitaḥ । praskandano vibhāgaśca atulyo yajñabhāgavit ॥61॥
html:
sāṅkhyaprasādo durvāsāḥ sarvasādhuniṣevitaḥ ।
praskandano vibhāgaśca atulyo yajñabhāgavit ॥61॥
slp1: sANKyaprasAdo durvAsAH sarvasADunizevitaH । praskandano viBAgaSca atulyo yajYaBAgavit ॥61॥

text: sarvāvāsaḥ sarvacārī durvāsā vāsavo'maraḥ । hemo hemakaro yajñaḥ sarvadhārī dharottamaḥ ॥62॥
html:
sarvāvāsaḥ sarvacārī durvāsā vāsavo'maraḥ ।
hemo hemakaro yajñaḥ sarvadhārī dharottamaḥ ॥62॥
slp1: sarvAvAsaH sarvacArI durvAsA vAsavo'maraH । hemo hemakaro yajYaH sarvaDArI DarottamaH ॥62॥

text: lohitākṣo mahākṣaśca vijayākṣo viśāradaḥ । saṅgraho nigrahaḥ kartā sarpacīranivāsanaḥ ॥63॥
html:
lohitākṣo mahākṣaśca vijayākṣo viśāradaḥ ।

slp1: lohitAkzo mahAkzaSca vijayAkzo viSAradaH । saNgraho nigrahaH kartA sarpacIranivAsanaH ॥63॥

text: mukhyo'mukhyaśca dehaśca deharddhiḥ sarvakāmadaḥ । sarvakālaprasādaśca subalo balarūpadhṛk ॥64॥
html:

text: ākāśanidhirūpaśca nipātī uragaḥ khagaḥ । raudrarūpoṃ'śurādityo vasuraśmiḥ suvarcasī ॥65॥
html:
ākāśanidhirūpaśca nipātī uragaḥ khagaḥ ।
raudrarūpoṃ'śurādityo vasuraśmiḥ suvarcasī ॥65॥
slp1: AkASaniDirUpaSca nipAtI uragaH KagaH । rOdrarUpoM'SurAdityo vasuraSmiH suvarcasI ॥65॥

text: vasuvego mahāvego manovego niśācaraḥ । sarvāvāsī śriyāvāsī upadeśakaro haraḥ ॥66॥
html:
vasuvego mahāvego manovego niśācaraḥ ।

slp1: vasuvego mahAvego manovego niSAcaraH । sarvAvAsI SriyAvAsI upadeSakaro haraH ॥66॥

text: munirātmapatirloke sambhojyaśca sahasradaḥ । pakṣī ca pakṣirūpī ca atidīpto viśāṃ patiḥ ॥67॥

munirātmapatirloke sambhojyaśca sahasradaḥ ।

html:
unmādo madanākāro arthārthakararomaśaḥ ।
vāmadevaśca vāmaśca prāgdakṣiṇyaśca vāmanaḥ ॥68॥
slp1: unmAdo madanAkAro arTArTakararomaSaH । vAmadevaSca vAmaSca prAgdakziRyaSca vAmanaH ॥68॥

text: siddhayogāpahārī ca siddhaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ । bhikṣuśca bhikṣurūpaśca viṣāṇī mṛduravyayaḥ ॥69॥
html:
siddhayogāpahārī ca siddhaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ ।
bhikṣuśca bhikṣurūpaśca viṣāṇī mṛduravyayaḥ ॥69॥
slp1: sidDayogApahArI ca sidDaH sarvArTasADakaH । BikzuSca BikzurUpaSca vizARI mfduravyayaH ॥69॥

text: mahāseno viśākhaśca ṣaṣṭibhāgo gavāṃ patiḥ । vajrahastaśca viṣkambhī camūstambhana eva ca ॥70॥
html:
mahāseno viśākhaśca ṣaṣṭibhāgo gavāṃ patiḥ ।

slp1: mahAseno viSAKaSca zazwiBAgo gavAM patiH । vajrahastaSca vizkamBI camUstamBana eva ca ॥70॥

text: ṛturṛtukaraḥ kālo madhurmadhukaro'calaḥ । vānaspatyo vājaseno nityamāśramapūjitaḥ ॥71॥
html:
ṛturṛtukaraḥ kālo madhurmadhukaro'calaḥ ।

slp1: fturftukaraH kAlo maDurmaDukaro'calaH । vAnaspatyo vAjaseno nityamASramapUjitaH ॥71॥

text: caturmukho mahāliṅgaścāruliṅgastathaiva ca । liṅgādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣo lokādhyakṣo yugāvahaḥ ॥74॥

paraśvadhāyudho deva arthakārī subāndhavaḥ ।
tumbavīṇī mahākopa ūrdhvaretā jaleśayaḥ ॥96॥
slp1: paraSvaDAyuDo deva arTakArI subAnDavaH । tumbavIRI mahAkopa UrDvaretA jaleSayaH ॥96॥

text: ugro vaṃśakaro vaṃśo vaṃśanādo hyaninditaḥ । sarvāṅgarūpo māyāvī suhṛdo hyanilo'nalaḥ ॥97॥
html:
ugro vaṃśakaro vaṃśo vaṃśanādo hyaninditaḥ ।
sarvāṅgarūpo māyāvī suhṛdo hyanilo'nalaḥ ॥97॥
slp1: ugro vaMSakaro vaMSo vaMSanAdo hyaninditaH । sarvANgarUpo mAyAvI suhfdo hyanilo'nalaH ॥97॥

text: bandhano bandhakartā ca subandhanavimocanaḥ । sa yajñāriḥ sa kāmārirmahādaṃṣṭro mahāyudhaḥ ॥98॥
html:
bandhano bandhakartā ca subandhanavimocanaḥ ।
sa yajñāriḥ sa kāmārirmahādaṃṣṭro mahāyudhaḥ ॥98॥
slp1: banDano banDakartA ca subanDanavimocanaH । sa yajYAriH sa kAmArirmahAdaMzwro mahAyuDaH ॥98॥

text: bāhustvaninditaḥ śarvaḥ śaṅkaraḥ śaṅkaro'dhanaḥ । amareśo mahādevo viśvadevaḥ surārihā ॥99॥
html:
bāhustvaninditaḥ śarvaḥ śaṅkaraḥ śaṅkaro'dhanaḥ ।
amareśo mahādevo viśvadevaḥ surārihā ॥99॥
slp1: bAhustvaninditaH SarvaH SaNkaraH SaNkaro'DanaH । amareSo mahAdevo viSvadevaH surArihA ॥99॥

text: ahirbudhno nirṛtiśca cekitāno haristathā । ajaikapācca kāpālī triśaṅkurajitaḥ śivaḥ ॥100॥
html:
ahirbudhno nirṛtiśca cekitāno haristathā ।
ajaikapācca kāpālī triśaṅkurajitaḥ śivaḥ ॥100॥
slp1: ahirbuDno nirftiSca cekitAno haristaTA । ajEkapAcca kApAlI triSaNkurajitaH SivaH ॥100॥

text: dhanvantarirdhūmaketuḥ skando vaiśravaṇastathā । dhātā śakraśca viṣṇuśca mitrastvaṣṭā dhruvo dharaḥ ॥101॥
html:
dhanvantarirdhūmaketuḥ skando vaiśravaṇastathā ।
dhātā śakraśca viṣṇuśca mitrastvaṣṭā dhruvo dharaḥ ॥101॥
slp1: DanvantarirDUmaketuH skando vESravaRastaTA । DAtA SakraSca vizRuSca mitrastvazwA Druvo DaraH ॥101॥

text: prabhāvaḥ sarvago vāyuraryamā savitā raviḥ । udagraśca vidhātā ca māndhātā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ॥102॥
html:
prabhāvaḥ sarvago vāyuraryamā savitā raviḥ ।
udagraśca vidhātā ca māndhātā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ॥102॥
slp1: praBAvaH sarvago vAyuraryamA savitA raviH । udagraSca viDAtA ca mAnDAtA BUtaBAvanaH ॥102॥

text: ratitīrthaśca vāgmī ca sarvakāmaguṇāvahaḥ । padmagarbho mahāgarbhaścandravaktro manoramaḥ ॥103॥
html:
ratitīrthaśca vāgmī ca sarvakāmaguṇāvahaḥ ।
padmagarbho mahāgarbhaścandravaktro manoramaḥ ॥103॥
slp1: ratitIrTaSca vAgmI ca sarvakAmaguRAvahaH । padmagarBo mahAgarBaScandravaktro manoramaH ॥103॥

text: balavāṃścopaśāntaśca purāṇaḥ puṇyacañcurī । kurukartā kālarūpī kurubhūto maheśvaraḥ ॥104॥
html:
balavāṃścopaśāntaśca purāṇaḥ puṇyacañcurī ।
kurukartā kālarūpī kurubhūto maheśvaraḥ ॥104॥
slp1: balavAMScopaSAntaSca purARaH puRyacaYcurI । kurukartA kAlarUpI kuruBUto maheSvaraH ॥104॥

text: sarvāśayo darbhaśāyī sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ patiḥ । devadevamukho'saktaḥ sadasatsarvaratnavit ॥105॥
html:
sarvāśayo darbhaśāyī sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ patiḥ ।
devadevamukho'saktaḥ sadasatsarvaratnavit ॥105॥
slp1: sarvASayo darBaSAyI sarvezAM prARinAM patiH । devadevamuKo'saktaH sadasatsarvaratnavit ॥105॥

text: kailāsaśikharāvāsī himavadgirisaṃśrayaḥ । kūlahārī kūlakartā bahuvidyo bahupradaḥ ॥106॥
html:
kailāsaśikharāvāsī himavadgirisaṃśrayaḥ ।
kūlahārī kūlakartā bahuvidyo bahupradaḥ ॥106॥
slp1: kElAsaSiKarAvAsI himavadgirisaMSrayaH । kUlahArI kUlakartA bahuvidyo bahupradaH ॥106॥

text: vaṇijo vardhano vṛkṣo nakulaścandanaśchadaḥ । sāragrīvo mahājatruralolaśca mahauṣadhaḥ ॥107॥
html:
vaṇijo vardhano vṛkṣo nakulaścandanaśchadaḥ ।
sāragrīvo mahājatruralolaśca mahauṣadhaḥ ॥107॥
slp1: vaRijo varDano vfkzo nakulaScandanaSCadaH । sAragrIvo mahAjatruralolaSca mahOzaDaH ॥107॥

text: siddhārthakārī siddhārthaśchandovyākaraṇottaraḥ । siṃhanādaḥ siṃhadaṃṣṭraḥ siṃhagaḥ siṃhavāhanaḥ ॥108॥
html:
siddhārthakārī siddhārthaśchandovyākaraṇottaraḥ ।
siṃhanādaḥ siṃhadaṃṣṭraḥ siṃhagaḥ siṃhavāhanaḥ ॥108॥
slp1: sidDArTakArI sidDArTaSCandovyAkaraRottaraH । siMhanAdaH siMhadaMzwraH siMhagaH siMhavAhanaH ॥108॥

text: prabhāvātmā jagatkālastālo lokahitastaruḥ । sāraṅgo navacakrāṅgaḥ ketumālī sabhāvanaḥ ॥109॥
html:
prabhāvātmā jagatkālastālo lokahitastaruḥ ।
sāraṅgo navacakrāṅgaḥ ketumālī sabhāvanaḥ ॥109॥
slp1: praBAvAtmA jagatkAlastAlo lokahitastaruH । sAraNgo navacakrANgaH ketumAlI saBAvanaH ॥109॥

text: bhūtālayo bhūtapatirahorātramaninditaḥ । vāhitā sarvabhūtānāṃ nilayaśca vibhurbhavaḥ ॥110॥
html:
bhūtālayo bhūtapatirahorātramaninditaḥ ।
vāhitā sarvabhūtānāṃ nilayaśca vibhurbhavaḥ ॥110॥
slp1: BUtAlayo BUtapatirahorAtramaninditaH । vAhitA sarvaBUtAnAM nilayaSca viBurBavaH ॥110॥

text: amoghaḥ saṃyato hyaśvo bhojanaḥ prāṇadhāraṇaḥ । dhṛtimānmatimāndakṣaḥ satkṛtaśca yugādhipaḥ ॥111॥
html:
amoghaḥ saṃyato hyaśvo bhojanaḥ prāṇadhāraṇaḥ ।
dhṛtimānmatimāndakṣaḥ satkṛtaśca yugādhipaḥ ॥111॥
slp1: amoGaH saMyato hyaSvo BojanaH prARaDAraRaH । DftimAnmatimAndakzaH satkftaSca yugADipaH ॥111॥

text: gopālirgopatirgrāmo gocarmavasano haraḥ । hiraṇyabāhuśca tathā guhāpālaḥ praveśinām ॥112॥
html:
gopālirgopatirgrāmo gocarmavasano haraḥ ।
hiraṇyabāhuśca tathā guhāpālaḥ praveśinām ॥112॥
slp1: gopAlirgopatirgrAmo gocarmavasano haraH । hiraRyabAhuSca taTA guhApAlaH praveSinAm ॥112॥

text: pratiṣṭhāyī mahāharṣo jitakāmo jitendriyaḥ । gandhāraśca surālaśca tapaḥkarmaratirdhanuḥ ॥113॥
html:
pratiṣṭhāyī mahāharṣo jitakāmo jitendriyaḥ ।
gandhāraśca surālaśca tapaḥkarmaratirdhanuḥ ॥113॥
slp1: pratizWAyI mahAharzo jitakAmo jitendriyaH । ganDAraSca surAlaSca tapaHkarmaratirDanuH ॥113॥

text: mahāgīto mahānṛtto hyapsarogaṇasevitaḥ । mahāketurdhanurdhāturnaikasānucaraścalaḥ ॥114॥
html:
mahāgīto mahānṛtto hyapsarogaṇasevitaḥ ।
mahāketurdhanurdhāturnaikasānucaraścalaḥ ॥114॥
slp1: mahAgIto mahAnftto hyapsarogaRasevitaH । mahAketurDanurDAturnEkasAnucaraScalaH ॥114॥

text: āvedanīya āveśaḥ sarvagandhasukhāvahaḥ । toraṇastāraṇo vāyuḥ paridhāvati caikataḥ ॥115॥
html:
āvedanīya āveśaḥ sarvagandhasukhāvahaḥ ।
toraṇastāraṇo vāyuḥ paridhāvati caikataḥ ॥115॥
slp1: AvedanIya AveSaH sarvaganDasuKAvahaH । toraRastAraRo vAyuH pariDAvati cEkataH ॥115॥

text: saṃyogo vardhano vṛddho mahāvṛddho gaṇādhipaḥ । nitya ātmasahāyaśca devāsurapatiḥ patiḥ ॥116॥
html:
saṃyogo vardhano vṛddho mahāvṛddho gaṇādhipaḥ ।
nitya ātmasahāyaśca devāsurapatiḥ patiḥ ॥116॥
slp1: saMyogo varDano vfdDo mahAvfdDo gaRADipaH । nitya AtmasahAyaSca devAsurapatiH patiH ॥116॥

text: yuktaśca yuktabāhuśca dvividhaśca suparvaṇaḥ । āṣāḍhaśca suṣāḍhaśca dhruvo harihaṇo haraḥ ॥117॥
html:
yuktaśca yuktabāhuśca dvividhaśca suparvaṇaḥ ।
āṣāḍhaśca suṣāḍhaśca dhruvo harihaṇo haraḥ ॥117॥
slp1: yuktaSca yuktabAhuSca dviviDaSca suparvaRaH । AzAQaSca suzAQaSca Druvo harihaRo haraH ॥117॥

text: vapurāvartamānebhyo vasuśreṣṭho mahāpathaḥ । śirohārī vimarṣaśca sarvalakṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ॥118॥
html:
vapurāvartamānebhyo vasuśreṣṭho mahāpathaḥ ।
śirohārī vimarṣaśca sarvalakṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ॥118॥
slp1: vapurAvartamAneByo vasuSrezWo mahApaTaH । SirohArI vimarzaSca sarvalakzaRaBUzitaH ॥118॥

text: akṣaśca rathayogī ca sarvayogī mahābalaḥ । samāmnāyo'samāmnāyastīrthadevo mahārathaḥ ॥119॥
html:
akṣaśca rathayogī ca sarvayogī mahābalaḥ ।
samāmnāyo'samāmnāyastīrthadevo mahārathaḥ ॥119॥
slp1: akzaSca raTayogI ca sarvayogI mahAbalaH । samAmnAyo'samAmnAyastIrTadevo mahAraTaH ॥119॥

text: nirjīvo jīvano mantraḥ śubhākṣo bahukarkaśaḥ । ratnaprabhūto raktāṅgo mahārṇavanipānavit ॥120॥
html:
nirjīvo jīvano mantraḥ śubhākṣo bahukarkaśaḥ ।
ratnaprabhūto raktāṅgo mahārṇavanipānavit ॥120॥
slp1: nirjIvo jIvano mantraH SuBAkzo bahukarkaSaH । ratnapraBUto raktANgo mahArRavanipAnavit ॥120॥

text: mūlo viśālo hyamṛto vyaktāvyaktastaponidhiḥ । ārohaṇo nirohaśca śailahārī mahātapāḥ ॥121॥
html:
mūlo viśālo hyamṛto vyaktāvyaktastaponidhiḥ ।
ārohaṇo nirohaśca śailahārī mahātapāḥ ॥121॥
slp1: mUlo viSAlo hyamfto vyaktAvyaktastaponiDiH । ArohaRo nirohaSca SElahArI mahAtapAH ॥121॥

text: senākalpo mahākalpo yugāyugakaro hariḥ । yugarūpo mahārūpaḥ pavano gahano nagaḥ ॥122॥
html:
senākalpo mahākalpo yugāyugakaro hariḥ ।
yugarūpo mahārūpaḥ pavano gahano nagaḥ ॥122॥
slp1: senAkalpo mahAkalpo yugAyugakaro hariH । yugarUpo mahArUpaH pavano gahano nagaH ॥122॥

text: nyāyanirvāpaṇaḥ pādaḥ paṇḍito hyacalopamaḥ । bahumālo mahāmālaḥ sumālo bahulocanaḥ ॥123॥
html:
nyāyanirvāpaṇaḥ pādaḥ paṇḍito hyacalopamaḥ ।
bahumālo mahāmālaḥ sumālo bahulocanaḥ ॥123॥
slp1: nyAyanirvApaRaH pAdaH paRqito hyacalopamaH । bahumAlo mahAmAlaH sumAlo bahulocanaH ॥123॥

text: vistāro lavaṇaḥ kūpaḥ kusumaḥ saphalodayaḥ । vṛṣabho vṛṣabhāṅkāṅgo maṇibilvo jaṭādharaḥ ॥124॥
html:
vistāro lavaṇaḥ kūpaḥ kusumaḥ saphalodayaḥ ।
vṛṣabho vṛṣabhāṅkāṅgo maṇibilvo jaṭādharaḥ ॥124॥
slp1: vistAro lavaRaH kUpaH kusumaH saPalodayaH । vfzaBo vfzaBANkANgo maRibilvo jawADaraH ॥124॥

text: indurvisargaḥ sumukhaḥ suraḥ sarvāyudhaḥ sahaḥ । nivedanaḥ sudhājātaḥ sugandhāro mahādhanuḥ ॥125॥
html:
indurvisargaḥ sumukhaḥ suraḥ sarvāyudhaḥ sahaḥ ।
nivedanaḥ sudhājātaḥ sugandhāro mahādhanuḥ ॥125॥
slp1: indurvisargaH sumuKaH suraH sarvAyuDaH sahaH । nivedanaH suDAjAtaH suganDAro mahADanuH ॥125॥

text: gandhamālī ca bhagavānutthānaḥ sarvakarmaṇām । manthāno bahulo bāhuḥ sakalaḥ sarvalocanaḥ ॥126॥
html:
gandhamālī ca bhagavānutthānaḥ sarvakarmaṇām ।
manthāno bahulo bāhuḥ sakalaḥ sarvalocanaḥ ॥126॥
slp1: ganDamAlI ca BagavAnutTAnaH sarvakarmaRAm । manTAno bahulo bAhuH sakalaH sarvalocanaH ॥126॥

text: tarastālī karastālī ūrdhvasaṃhanano vahaḥ । chatraṃ succhatro vikhyātaḥ sarvalokāśrayo mahān ॥127॥
html:
tarastālī karastālī ūrdhvasaṃhanano vahaḥ ।
chatraṃ succhatro vikhyātaḥ sarvalokāśrayo mahān ॥127॥
slp1: tarastAlI karastAlI UrDvasaMhanano vahaH । CatraM sucCatro viKyAtaH sarvalokASrayo mahAn ॥127॥

text: muṇḍo virūpo vikṛto daṇḍimuṇḍo vikurvaṇaḥ । haryakṣaḥ kakubho vajrī dīptajihvaḥ sahasrapāt ॥128॥
html:
muṇḍo virūpo vikṛto daṇḍimuṇḍo vikurvaṇaḥ ।
haryakṣaḥ kakubho vajrī dīptajihvaḥ sahasrapāt ॥128॥
slp1: muRqo virUpo vikfto daRqimuRqo vikurvaRaH । haryakzaH kakuBo vajrI dIptajihvaH sahasrapAt ॥128॥

text: sahasramūrdhā devendraḥ sarvadevamayo guruḥ । sahasrabāhuḥ sarvāṅgaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokakṛt ॥129॥
html:
sahasramūrdhā devendraḥ sarvadevamayo guruḥ ।
sahasrabāhuḥ sarvāṅgaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokakṛt ॥129॥
slp1: sahasramUrDA devendraH sarvadevamayo guruH । sahasrabAhuH sarvANgaH SaraRyaH sarvalokakft ॥129॥

text: pavitraṃ trimadhurmantraḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ । brahmadaṇḍavinirmātā śataghnī śatapāśadhṛk ॥130॥
html:
pavitraṃ trimadhurmantraḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ ।
brahmadaṇḍavinirmātā śataghnī śatapāśadhṛk ॥130॥
slp1: pavitraM trimaDurmantraH kanizWaH kfzRapiNgalaH । brahmadaRqavinirmAtA SataGnI SatapASaDfk ॥130॥

text: padmagarbho mahāgarbho brahmagarbho jalodbhavaḥ । gabhastirbrahmakṛdbrahmā brahmavidbrāhmaṇo gatiḥ ॥131॥
html:
padmagarbho mahāgarbho brahmagarbho jalodbhavaḥ ।
gabhastirbrahmakṛdbrahmā brahmavidbrāhmaṇo gatiḥ ॥131॥
slp1: padmagarBo mahAgarBo brahmagarBo jalodBavaH । gaBastirbrahmakfdbrahmA brahmavidbrAhmaRo gatiH ॥131॥

text: anantarūpo naikātmā tigmatejāḥ svayambhuvaḥ । ūrdhvagātmā paśupatirvātaraṃhā manojavaḥ ॥132॥
html:
anantarūpo naikātmā tigmatejāḥ svayambhuvaḥ ।
ūrdhvagātmā paśupatirvātaraṃhā manojavaḥ ॥132॥
slp1: anantarUpo nEkAtmA tigmatejAH svayamBuvaH । UrDvagAtmA paSupatirvAtaraMhA manojavaH ॥132॥

text: candanī padmamālāgryaḥ surabhyuttaraṇo naraḥ । karṇikāramahāsragvī nīlamauliḥ pinākadhṛk ॥133॥
html:
candanī padmamālāgryaḥ surabhyuttaraṇo naraḥ ।
karṇikāramahāsragvī nīlamauliḥ pinākadhṛk ॥133॥
slp1: candanI padmamAlAgryaH suraByuttaraRo naraH । karRikAramahAsragvI nIlamOliH pinAkaDfk ॥133॥

text: umāpatirumākānto jāhnavīdhṛgumādhavaḥ । varo varāho varado vareśaḥ sumahāsvanaḥ ॥134॥
html:
umāpatirumākānto jāhnavīdhṛgumādhavaḥ ।
varo varāho varado vareśaḥ sumahāsvanaḥ ॥134॥
slp1: umApatirumAkAnto jAhnavIDfgumADavaH । varo varAho varado vareSaH sumahAsvanaH ॥134॥

text: mahāprasādo damanaḥ śatruhā śvetapiṅgalaḥ । prītātmā prayatātmā ca saṃyatātmā pradhānadhṛk ॥135॥
html:
mahāprasādo damanaḥ śatruhā śvetapiṅgalaḥ ।
prītātmā prayatātmā ca saṃyatātmā pradhānadhṛk ॥135॥
slp1: mahAprasAdo damanaH SatruhA SvetapiNgalaH । prItAtmA prayatAtmA ca saMyatAtmA praDAnaDfk ॥135॥

text: sarvapārśvasutastārkṣyo dharmasādhāraṇo varaḥ । carācarātmā sūkṣmātmā suvṛṣo govṛṣeśvaraḥ ॥136॥
html:
sarvapārśvasutastārkṣyo dharmasādhāraṇo varaḥ ।
carācarātmā sūkṣmātmā suvṛṣo govṛṣeśvaraḥ ॥136॥
slp1: sarvapArSvasutastArkzyo DarmasADAraRo varaH । carAcarAtmA sUkzmAtmA suvfzo govfzeSvaraH ॥136॥

text: sādhyarṣirvasurādityo vivasvānsavitā mṛḍaḥ । vyāsaḥ sarvasya saṅkṣepo vistaraḥ paryayo nayaḥ ॥137॥
html:
sādhyarṣirvasurādityo vivasvānsavitā mṛḍaḥ ।
vyāsaḥ sarvasya saṅkṣepo vistaraḥ paryayo nayaḥ ॥137॥
slp1: sADyarzirvasurAdityo vivasvAnsavitA mfqaH । vyAsaH sarvasya saNkzepo vistaraH paryayo nayaH ॥137॥

text: ṛtuḥ saṃvatsaro māsaḥ pakṣaḥ saṅkhyāsamāpanaḥ । kalā kāṣṭhā lavo mātrā muhūrto'haḥ kṣapāḥ kṣaṇāḥ ॥138॥
html:
ṛtuḥ saṃvatsaro māsaḥ pakṣaḥ saṅkhyāsamāpanaḥ ।
kalā kāṣṭhā lavo mātrā muhūrto'haḥ kṣapāḥ kṣaṇāḥ ॥138॥
slp1: ftuH saMvatsaro mAsaH pakzaH saNKyAsamApanaH । kalA kAzWA lavo mAtrA muhUrto'haH kzapAH kzaRAH ॥138॥

text: viśvakṣetraṃ prajābījaṃ liṅgamādyastvaninditaḥ । sadasadvyaktamavyaktaṃ pitā mātā pitāmahaḥ ॥139॥
html:
viśvakṣetraṃ prajābījaṃ liṅgamādyastvaninditaḥ ।
sadasadvyaktamavyaktaṃ pitā mātā pitāmahaḥ ॥139॥
slp1: viSvakzetraM prajAbIjaM liNgamAdyastvaninditaH । sadasadvyaktamavyaktaM pitA mAtA pitAmahaH ॥139॥

text: svargadvāraṃ prajādvāraṃ mokṣadvāraṃ triviṣṭapam । nirvāṇaṃ hlādanaṃ caiva brahmalokaḥ parā gatiḥ ॥140॥
html:
svargadvāraṃ prajādvāraṃ mokṣadvāraṃ triviṣṭapam ।
nirvāṇaṃ hlādanaṃ caiva brahmalokaḥ parā gatiḥ ॥140॥
slp1: svargadvAraM prajAdvAraM mokzadvAraM trivizwapam । nirvARaM hlAdanaM cEva brahmalokaH parA gatiH ॥140॥

text: devāsuravinirmātā devāsuraparāyaṇaḥ । devāsuragururdevo devāsuranamaskṛtaḥ ॥141॥
html:
devāsuravinirmātā devāsuraparāyaṇaḥ ।
devāsuragururdevo devāsuranamaskṛtaḥ ॥141॥
slp1: devAsuravinirmAtA devAsuraparAyaRaH । devAsuragururdevo devAsuranamaskftaH ॥141॥

text: devāsuramahāmātro devāsuragaṇāśrayaḥ । devāsuragaṇādhyakṣo devāsuragaṇāgraṇīḥ ॥142॥
html:
devāsuramahāmātro devāsuragaṇāśrayaḥ ।
devāsuragaṇādhyakṣo devāsuragaṇāgraṇīḥ ॥142॥
slp1: devAsuramahAmAtro devAsuragaRASrayaH । devAsuragaRADyakzo devAsuragaRAgraRIH ॥142॥

text: devātidevo devarṣirdevāsuravarapradaḥ । devāsureśvaro devo devāsuramaheśvaraḥ ॥143॥
html:
devātidevo devarṣirdevāsuravarapradaḥ ।
devāsureśvaro devo devāsuramaheśvaraḥ ॥143॥
slp1: devAtidevo devarzirdevAsuravarapradaH । devAsureSvaro devo devAsuramaheSvaraH ॥143॥

text: sarvadevamayo'cintyo devatātmātmasambhavaḥ । udbhidastrikramo vaidyo virajo virajombaraḥ ॥144॥
html:
sarvadevamayo'cintyo devatātmātmasambhavaḥ ।
udbhidastrikramo vaidyo virajo virajombaraḥ ॥144॥
slp1: sarvadevamayo'cintyo devatAtmAtmasamBavaH । udBidastrikramo vEdyo virajo virajombaraH ॥144॥

text: īḍyo hastī suravyāghro devasiṃho nararṣabhaḥ । vibudhāgravaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadevottamottamaḥ ॥145॥
html:
īḍyo hastī suravyāghro devasiṃho nararṣabhaḥ ।
vibudhāgravaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadevottamottamaḥ ॥145॥
slp1: Iqyo hastI suravyAGro devasiMho nararzaBaH । vibuDAgravaraH SrezWaH sarvadevottamottamaH ॥145॥

text: prayuktaḥ śobhano vajra īśānaḥ prabhuravyayaḥ । guruḥ kānto nijaḥ sargaḥ pavitraḥ sarvavāhanaḥ ॥146॥
html:
prayuktaḥ śobhano vajra īśānaḥ prabhuravyayaḥ ।
guruḥ kānto nijaḥ sargaḥ pavitraḥ sarvavāhanaḥ ॥146॥
slp1: prayuktaH SoBano vajra ISAnaH praBuravyayaH । guruH kAnto nijaH sargaH pavitraH sarvavAhanaH ॥146॥

text: śṛṅgī śṛṅgapriyo babhrū rājarājo nirāmayaḥ । abhirāmaḥ suragaṇo virāmaḥ sarvasādhanaḥ ॥147॥
html:
śṛṅgī śṛṅgapriyo babhrū rājarājo nirāmayaḥ ।
abhirāmaḥ suragaṇo virāmaḥ sarvasādhanaḥ ॥147॥
slp1: SfNgI SfNgapriyo baBrU rAjarAjo nirAmayaH । aBirAmaH suragaRo virAmaH sarvasADanaH ॥147॥

text: lalāṭākṣo viśvadeho hariṇo brahmavarcasaḥ । sthāvarāṇāṃ patiścaiva niyamendriyavardhanaḥ ॥148॥
html:
lalāṭākṣo viśvadeho hariṇo brahmavarcasaḥ ।
sthāvarāṇāṃ patiścaiva niyamendriyavardhanaḥ ॥148॥
slp1: lalAwAkzo viSvadeho hariRo brahmavarcasaH । sTAvarARAM patiScEva niyamendriyavarDanaH ॥148॥

text: siddhārthaḥ sarvabhūtārtho'cintyaḥ satyavrataḥ śuciḥ । vratādhipaḥ paraṃ brahma muktānāṃ paramā gatiḥ ॥149॥
html:
siddhārthaḥ sarvabhūtārtho'cintyaḥ satyavrataḥ śuciḥ ।
vratādhipaḥ paraṃ brahma muktānāṃ paramā gatiḥ ॥149॥
slp1: sidDArTaH sarvaBUtArTo'cintyaH satyavrataH SuciH । vratADipaH paraM brahma muktAnAM paramA gatiH ॥149॥

text: vimukto muktatejāśca śrīmāñśrīvardhano jagat । yathāpradhānaṃ bhagavāniti bhaktyā stuto mayā ॥150॥
html:
vimukto muktatejāśca śrīmāñśrīvardhano jagat ।
yathāpradhānaṃ bhagavāniti bhaktyā stuto mayā ॥150॥
slp1: vimukto muktatejASca SrImAYSrIvarDano jagat । yaTApraDAnaM BagavAniti BaktyA stuto mayA ॥150॥

text: yaṃ na brahmādayo devā viduryaṃ na maharṣayaḥ । taṃ stavyamarcyaṃ vandyaṃ ca kaḥ stoṣyati jagatpatim ॥151॥
html:
yaṃ na brahmādayo devā viduryaṃ na maharṣayaḥ ।
taṃ stavyamarcyaṃ vandyaṃ ca kaḥ stoṣyati jagatpatim ॥151॥
slp1: yaM na brahmAdayo devA viduryaM na maharzayaH । taM stavyamarcyaM vandyaM ca kaH stozyati jagatpatim ॥151॥

text: bhaktimeva puraskṛtya mayā yajñapatirvasuḥ । tato'bhyanujñāṃ prāpyaiva stuto matimatāṃ varaḥ ॥152॥
html:
bhaktimeva puraskṛtya mayā yajñapatirvasuḥ ।
tato'bhyanujñāṃ prāpyaiva stuto matimatāṃ varaḥ ॥152॥
slp1: Baktimeva puraskftya mayA yajYapatirvasuH । tato'ByanujYAM prApyEva stuto matimatAM varaH ॥152॥

text: śivamebhiḥ stuvandevaṃ nāmabhiḥ puṣṭivardhanaiḥ । nityayuktaḥ śucirbhūtvā prāpnotyātmānamātmanā ॥153॥
html:
śivamebhiḥ stuvandevaṃ nāmabhiḥ puṣṭivardhanaiḥ ।
nityayuktaḥ śucirbhūtvā prāpnotyātmānamātmanā ॥153॥
slp1: SivameBiH stuvandevaM nAmaBiH puzwivarDanEH । nityayuktaH SucirBUtvA prApnotyAtmAnamAtmanA ॥153॥

text: etaddhi paramaṃ brahma svayaṃ gītaṃ svayambhuvā । ṛṣayaścaiva devāśca stuvantyetena tatparam ॥154॥
html:
etaddhi paramaṃ brahma svayaṃ gītaṃ svayambhuvā ।
ṛṣayaścaiva devāśca stuvantyetena tatparam ॥154॥
slp1: etadDi paramaM brahma svayaM gItaM svayamBuvA । fzayaScEva devASca stuvantyetena tatparam ॥154॥

text: stūyamāno mahādevaḥ prīyate cātmanāmabhiḥ । bhaktānukampī bhagavānātmasaṃsthānkaroti tān ॥155॥
html:
stūyamāno mahādevaḥ prīyate cātmanāmabhiḥ ।
bhaktānukampī bhagavānātmasaṃsthānkaroti tān ॥155॥
slp1: stUyamAno mahAdevaH prIyate cAtmanAmaBiH । BaktAnukampI BagavAnAtmasaMsTAnkaroti tAn ॥155॥

text: tathaiva ca manuṣyeṣu ye manuṣyāḥ pradhānataḥ । āstikāḥ śraddadhānāśca bahubhirjanmabhiḥ stavaiḥ ॥156॥
html:
tathaiva ca manuṣyeṣu ye manuṣyāḥ pradhānataḥ ।
āstikāḥ śraddadhānāśca bahubhirjanmabhiḥ stavaiḥ ॥156॥
slp1: taTEva ca manuzyezu ye manuzyAH praDAnataH । AstikAH SraddaDAnASca bahuBirjanmaBiH stavEH ॥156॥

text: jāgrataśca svapantaśca vrajantaḥ pathi saṃsthitāḥ । stuvanti stūyamānāśca tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca । janmakoṭisahasreṣu nānāsaṃsārayoniṣu ॥157॥
html:
jāgrataśca svapantaśca vrajantaḥ pathi saṃsthitāḥ ।
stuvanti stūyamānāśca tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca ।
janmakoṭisahasreṣu nānāsaṃsārayoniṣu ॥157॥
slp1: jAgrataSca svapantaSca vrajantaH paTi saMsTitAH । stuvanti stUyamAnASca tuzyanti ca ramanti ca । janmakowisahasrezu nAnAsaMsArayonizu ॥157॥

text: jantorviśuddhapāpasya bhave bhaktiḥ prajāyate । utpannā ca bhave bhaktirananyā sarvabhāvataḥ ॥158॥
html:
jantorviśuddhapāpasya bhave bhaktiḥ prajāyate ।
utpannā ca bhave bhaktirananyā sarvabhāvataḥ ॥158॥
slp1: jantorviSudDapApasya Bave BaktiH prajAyate । utpannA ca Bave BaktirananyA sarvaBAvataH ॥158॥

text: kāraṇaṃ bhāvitaṃ tasya sarvamuktasya sarvataḥ । etaddeveṣu duṣprāpaṃ manuṣyeṣu na labhyate ॥159॥
html:
kāraṇaṃ bhāvitaṃ tasya sarvamuktasya sarvataḥ ।
etaddeveṣu duṣprāpaṃ manuṣyeṣu na labhyate ॥159॥
slp1: kAraRaM BAvitaM tasya sarvamuktasya sarvataH । etaddevezu duzprApaM manuzyezu na laByate ॥159॥

text: nirvighnā niścalā rudre bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī । tasyaiva ca prasādena bhaktirutpadyate nṛṇām । yayā yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ tadbhāvagatacetasaḥ ॥160॥
html:
nirvighnā niścalā rudre bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī ।
tasyaiva ca prasādena bhaktirutpadyate nṛṇām ।
yayā yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ tadbhāvagatacetasaḥ ॥160॥
slp1: nirviGnA niScalA rudre BaktiravyaBicAriRI । tasyEva ca prasAdena Baktirutpadyate nfRAm । yayA yAnti parAM sidDiM tadBAvagatacetasaH ॥160॥

text: ye sarvabhāvopagatāḥ paratvenābhavannarāḥ । prapannavatsalo devaḥ saṃsārāttānsamuddharet ॥161॥
html:
ye sarvabhāvopagatāḥ paratvenābhavannarāḥ ।
prapannavatsalo devaḥ saṃsārāttānsamuddharet ॥161॥
slp1: ye sarvaBAvopagatAH paratvenABavannarAH । prapannavatsalo devaH saMsArAttAnsamudDaret ॥161॥

text: evamanye na kurvanti devāḥ saṃsāramocanam । manuṣyāṇāṃ mahādevādanyatrāpi tapobalāt ॥162॥
html:
evamanye na kurvanti devāḥ saṃsāramocanam ।
manuṣyāṇāṃ mahādevādanyatrāpi tapobalāt ॥162॥
slp1: evamanye na kurvanti devAH saMsAramocanam । manuzyARAM mahAdevAdanyatrApi tapobalAt ॥162॥

text: iti tenendrakalpena bhagavānsadasatpatiḥ । kṛttivāsāḥ stutaḥ kṛṣṇa taṇḍinā śuddhabuddhinā ॥163॥
html:
iti tenendrakalpena bhagavānsadasatpatiḥ ।
kṛttivāsāḥ stutaḥ kṛṣṇa taṇḍinā śuddhabuddhinā ॥163॥
slp1: iti tenendrakalpena BagavAnsadasatpatiH । kfttivAsAH stutaH kfzRa taRqinA SudDabudDinA ॥163॥

text: stavametaṃ bhagavato brahmā svayamadhārayat । brahmā provāca śakrāya śakraḥ provāca mṛtyave ॥164॥
html:
stavametaṃ bhagavato brahmā svayamadhārayat ।
brahmā provāca śakrāya śakraḥ provāca mṛtyave ॥164॥
slp1: stavametaM Bagavato brahmA svayamaDArayat । brahmA provAca SakrAya SakraH provAca mftyave ॥164॥

text: mṛtyuḥ provāca rudrāṇāṃ rudrebhyastaṇḍimāgamat । mahatā tapasā prāptastaṇḍinā brahmasadmani ॥165॥
html:
mṛtyuḥ provāca rudrāṇāṃ rudrebhyastaṇḍimāgamat ।
mahatā tapasā prāptastaṇḍinā brahmasadmani ॥165॥
slp1: mftyuH provAca rudrARAM rudreByastaRqimAgamat । mahatA tapasA prAptastaRqinA brahmasadmani ॥165॥

text: taṇḍiḥ provāca śukrāya gautamāyāha bhārgavaḥ । vaivasvatāya manave gautamaḥ prāha mādhava ॥166॥
html:
taṇḍiḥ provāca śukrāya gautamāyāha bhārgavaḥ ।
vaivasvatāya manave gautamaḥ prāha mādhava ॥166॥
slp1: taRqiH provAca SukrAya gOtamAyAha BArgavaH । vEvasvatAya manave gOtamaH prAha mADava ॥166॥

text: nārāyaṇāya sādhyāya manuriṣṭāya dhīmate । yamāya prāha bhagavānsādhyo nārāyaṇo'cyutaḥ ॥167॥
html:
nārāyaṇāya sādhyāya manuriṣṭāya dhīmate ।
yamāya prāha bhagavānsādhyo nārāyaṇo'cyutaḥ ॥167॥
slp1: nArAyaRAya sADyAya manurizwAya DImate । yamAya prAha BagavAnsADyo nArAyaRo'cyutaH ॥167॥

text: nāciketāya bhagavānāha vaivasvato yamaḥ । mārkaṇḍeyāya vārṣṇeya nāciketo'bhyabhāṣata ॥168॥
html:
nāciketāya bhagavānāha vaivasvato yamaḥ ।
mārkaṇḍeyāya vārṣṇeya nāciketo'bhyabhāṣata ॥168॥
slp1: nAciketAya BagavAnAha vEvasvato yamaH । mArkaRqeyAya vArzReya nAciketo'ByaBAzata ॥168॥

text: mārkaṇḍeyānmayā prāptaṃ niyamena janārdana । tavāpyahamamitraghna stavaṃ dadmyadya viśrutam । svargyamārogyamāyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ balyaṃ tathaiva ca ॥169॥
html:
mārkaṇḍeyānmayā prāptaṃ niyamena janārdana ।
tavāpyahamamitraghna stavaṃ dadmyadya viśrutam ।
svargyamārogyamāyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ balyaṃ tathaiva ca ॥169॥
slp1: mArkaRqeyAnmayA prAptaM niyamena janArdana । tavApyahamamitraGna stavaM dadmyadya viSrutam । svargyamArogyamAyuzyaM DanyaM balyaM taTEva ca ॥169॥

text: na tasya vighnaṃ kurvanti dānavā yakṣarākṣasāḥ । piśācā yātudhānāśca guhyakā bhujagā api ॥170॥
html:
na tasya vighnaṃ kurvanti dānavā yakṣarākṣasāḥ ।
piśācā yātudhānāśca guhyakā bhujagā api ॥170॥
slp1: na tasya viGnaM kurvanti dAnavA yakzarAkzasAH । piSAcA yAtuDAnASca guhyakA BujagA api ॥170॥

text: yaḥ paṭheta śucirbhūtvā brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ । abhagnayogo varṣaṃ tu so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet] ॥171॥
html:
yaḥ paṭheta śucirbhūtvā brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ ।
abhagnayogo varṣaṃ tu so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet] ॥171॥
slp1: yaH paWeta SucirBUtvA brahmacArI jitendriyaH । aBagnayogo varzaM tu so'SvameDaPalaM laBet] ॥171॥

text: mahāyogī tataḥ prāha kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ । paṭhasva putra bhadraṃ te prīyatāṃ te maheśvaraḥ ॥1॥
html:
mahāyogī tataḥ prāha kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ ।
paṭhasva putra bhadraṃ te prīyatāṃ te maheśvaraḥ ॥1॥
slp1: mahAyogI tataH prAha kfzRadvEpAyano muniH । paWasva putra BadraM te prIyatAM te maheSvaraH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: purā putra mayā merau tapyatā paramaṃ tapaḥ । putrahetormahārāja stava eṣo'nukīrtitaḥ ॥2॥
html:
purā putra mayā merau tapyatā paramaṃ tapaḥ ।
putrahetormahārāja stava eṣo'nukīrtitaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: purA putra mayA merO tapyatA paramaM tapaH । putrahetormahArAja stava ezo'nukIrtitaH ॥2॥

text: labdhavānasmi tānkāmānahaṃ vai pāṇḍunandana । tathā tvamapi śarvāddhi sarvānkāmānavāpsyasi ॥3॥
html:
labdhavānasmi tānkāmānahaṃ vai pāṇḍunandana ।
tathā tvamapi śarvāddhi sarvānkāmānavāpsyasi ॥3॥
slp1: labDavAnasmi tAnkAmAnahaM vE pARqunandana । taTA tvamapi SarvAdDi sarvAnkAmAnavApsyasi ॥3॥

text: catuḥśīrṣastataḥ prāha śakrasya dayitaḥ sakhā । ālambāyana ityeva viśrutaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ ॥4॥
html:
catuḥśīrṣastataḥ prāha śakrasya dayitaḥ sakhā ।
ālambāyana ityeva viśrutaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: catuHSIrzastataH prAha Sakrasya dayitaH saKA । AlambAyana ityeva viSrutaH karuRAtmakaH ॥4॥

text: mayā gokarṇamāsādya tapastaptvā śataṃ samāḥ । ayonijānāṃ dāntānāṃ dharmajñānāṃ suvarcasām ॥5॥
html:
mayā gokarṇamāsādya tapastaptvā śataṃ samāḥ ।
ayonijānāṃ dāntānāṃ dharmajñānāṃ suvarcasām ॥5॥
slp1: mayA gokarRamAsAdya tapastaptvA SataM samAH । ayonijAnAM dAntAnAM DarmajYAnAM suvarcasAm ॥5॥

text: ajarāṇāmaduḥkhānāṃ śatavarṣasahasriṇām । labdhaṃ putraśataṃ śarvātpurā pāṇḍunṛpātmaja ॥6॥
html:
ajarāṇāmaduḥkhānāṃ śatavarṣasahasriṇām ।
labdhaṃ putraśataṃ śarvātpurā pāṇḍunṛpātmaja ॥6॥
slp1: ajarARAmaduHKAnAM SatavarzasahasriRAm । labDaM putraSataM SarvAtpurA pARqunfpAtmaja ॥6॥

text: vālmīkiścāpi bhagavānyudhiṣṭhiramabhāṣata । vivāde sāmni munibhirbrahmaghno vai bhavāniti । uktaḥ kṣaṇena cāviṣṭastenādharmeṇa bhārata ॥7॥
html:
vālmīkiścāpi bhagavānyudhiṣṭhiramabhāṣata ।
vivāde sāmni munibhirbrahmaghno vai bhavāniti ।
uktaḥ kṣaṇena cāviṣṭastenādharmeṇa bhārata ॥7॥
slp1: vAlmIkiScApi BagavAnyuDizWiramaBAzata । vivAde sAmni muniBirbrahmaGno vE BavAniti । uktaH kzaRena cAvizwastenADarmeRa BArata ॥7॥

text: so'hamīśānamanaghamastauṣaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ । muktaścāsmyavaśaḥ pāpāttato duḥkhavināśanaḥ । āha māṃ tripuraghno vai yaśaste'gryaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥8॥
html:
so'hamīśānamanaghamastauṣaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।
muktaścāsmyavaśaḥ pāpāttato duḥkhavināśanaḥ ।
āha māṃ tripuraghno vai yaśaste'gryaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥8॥
slp1: so'hamISAnamanaGamastOzaM SaraRaM gataH । muktaScAsmyavaSaH pApAttato duHKavinASanaH । Aha mAM tripuraGno vE yaSaste'gryaM Bavizyati ॥8॥

text: jāmadagnyaśca kaunteyamāha dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ । ṛṣimadhye sthitastāta tapanniva vibhāvasuḥ ॥9॥
html:
jāmadagnyaśca kaunteyamāha dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ।
ṛṣimadhye sthitastāta tapanniva vibhāvasuḥ ॥9॥
slp1: jAmadagnyaSca kOnteyamAha DarmaBftAM varaH । fzimaDye sTitastAta tapanniva viBAvasuH ॥9॥

text: pitṛvipravadhenāhamārto vai pāṇḍavāgraja । śucirbhūtvā mahādevaṃ gatavāñśaraṇaṃ nṛpa ॥10॥
html:
pitṛvipravadhenāhamārto vai pāṇḍavāgraja ।
śucirbhūtvā mahādevaṃ gatavāñśaraṇaṃ nṛpa ॥10॥
slp1: pitfvipravaDenAhamArto vE pARqavAgraja । SucirBUtvA mahAdevaM gatavAYSaraRaM nfpa ॥10॥

text: nāmabhiścāstuvaṃ devaṃ tatastuṣṭo'bhavadbhavaḥ । paraśuṃ ca dadau devo divyānyastrāṇi caiva me ॥11॥
html:
nāmabhiścāstuvaṃ devaṃ tatastuṣṭo'bhavadbhavaḥ ।
paraśuṃ ca dadau devo divyānyastrāṇi caiva me ॥11॥
slp1: nAmaBiScAstuvaM devaM tatastuzwo'BavadBavaH । paraSuM ca dadO devo divyAnyastrARi cEva me ॥11॥

text: pāpaṃ na bhavitā te'dya ajeyaśca bhaviṣyasi । na te prabhavitā mṛtyuryaśasvī ca bhaviṣyasi ॥12॥
html:
pāpaṃ na bhavitā te'dya ajeyaśca bhaviṣyasi ।
na te prabhavitā mṛtyuryaśasvī ca bhaviṣyasi ॥12॥
slp1: pApaM na BavitA te'dya ajeyaSca Bavizyasi । na te praBavitA mftyuryaSasvI ca Bavizyasi ॥12॥

text: āha māṃ bhagavānevaṃ śikhaṇḍī śivavigrahaḥ । yadavāptaṃ ca me sarvaṃ prasādāttasya dhīmataḥ ॥13॥
html:
āha māṃ bhagavānevaṃ śikhaṇḍī śivavigrahaḥ ।
yadavāptaṃ ca me sarvaṃ prasādāttasya dhīmataḥ ॥13॥
slp1: Aha mAM BagavAnevaM SiKaRqI SivavigrahaH । yadavAptaM ca me sarvaM prasAdAttasya DImataH ॥13॥

text: asito devalaścaiva prāha pāṇḍusutaṃ nṛpam । śāpācchakrasya kaunteya cito dharmo'naśanmama । tanme dharmaṃ yaśaścāgryamāyuścaivādadadbhavaḥ ॥14॥
html:
asito devalaścaiva prāha pāṇḍusutaṃ nṛpam ।
śāpācchakrasya kaunteya cito dharmo'naśanmama ।
tanme dharmaṃ yaśaścāgryamāyuścaivādadadbhavaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: asito devalaScEva prAha pARqusutaM nfpam । SApAcCakrasya kOnteya cito Darmo'naSanmama । tanme DarmaM yaSaScAgryamAyuScEvAdadadBavaH ॥14॥

text: ṛṣirgṛtsamado nāma śakrasya dayitaḥ sakhā । prāhājamīḍhaṃ bhagavānbṛhaspatisamadyutiḥ ॥15॥
html:
ṛṣirgṛtsamado nāma śakrasya dayitaḥ sakhā ।
prāhājamīḍhaṃ bhagavānbṛhaspatisamadyutiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: fzirgftsamado nAma Sakrasya dayitaH saKA । prAhAjamIQaM BagavAnbfhaspatisamadyutiH ॥15॥

text: vasiṣṭho nāma bhagavāṃścākṣuṣasya manoḥ sutaḥ । śatakratoracintyasya satre varṣasahasrike । vartamāne'bravīdvākyaṃ sāmni hyuccārite mayā ॥16॥
html:
vasiṣṭho nāma bhagavāṃścākṣuṣasya manoḥ sutaḥ ।
śatakratoracintyasya satre varṣasahasrike ।
vartamāne'bravīdvākyaṃ sāmni hyuccārite mayā ॥16॥
slp1: vasizWo nAma BagavAMScAkzuzasya manoH sutaH । Satakratoracintyasya satre varzasahasrike । vartamAne'bravIdvAkyaM sAmni hyuccArite mayA ॥16॥

text: rathantaraṃ dvijaśreṣṭha na samyagiti vartate । samīkṣasva punarbuddhyā harṣaṃ tyaktvā dvijottama । ayajñavāhinaṃ pāpamakārṣīstvaṃ sudurmate ॥17॥
html:
rathantaraṃ dvijaśreṣṭha na samyagiti vartate ।
samīkṣasva punarbuddhyā harṣaṃ tyaktvā dvijottama ।
ayajñavāhinaṃ pāpamakārṣīstvaṃ sudurmate ॥17॥
slp1: raTantaraM dvijaSrezWa na samyagiti vartate । samIkzasva punarbudDyA harzaM tyaktvA dvijottama । ayajYavAhinaM pApamakArzIstvaM sudurmate ॥17॥

text: evamuktvā mahākrodhātprāha ruṣṭaḥ punarvacaḥ । prajñayā rahito duḥkhī nityaṃ bhīto vanecaraḥ । daśa varṣasahasrāṇi daśāṣṭau ca śatāni ca ॥18॥
html:
evamuktvā mahākrodhātprāha ruṣṭaḥ punarvacaḥ ।
prajñayā rahito duḥkhī nityaṃ bhīto vanecaraḥ ।
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi daśāṣṭau ca śatāni ca ॥18॥
slp1: evamuktvA mahAkroDAtprAha ruzwaH punarvacaH । prajYayA rahito duHKI nityaM BIto vanecaraH । daSa varzasahasrARi daSAzwO ca SatAni ca ॥18॥

text: naṣṭapānīyayavase mṛgairanyaiśca varjite । ayajñīyadrume deśe rurusiṃhaniṣevite । bhavitā tvaṃ mṛgaḥ krūro mahāduḥkhasamanvitaḥ ॥19॥
html:
naṣṭapānīyayavase mṛgairanyaiśca varjite ।
ayajñīyadrume deśe rurusiṃhaniṣevite ।
bhavitā tvaṃ mṛgaḥ krūro mahāduḥkhasamanvitaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: nazwapAnIyayavase mfgEranyESca varjite । ayajYIyadrume deSe rurusiMhanizevite । BavitA tvaM mfgaH krUro mahAduHKasamanvitaH ॥19॥

text: tasya vākyasya nidhane pārtha jāto hyahaṃ mṛgaḥ । tato māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ prāha yogī maheśvaraḥ ॥20॥
html:
tasya vākyasya nidhane pārtha jāto hyahaṃ mṛgaḥ ।
tato māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ prāha yogī maheśvaraḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tasya vAkyasya niDane pArTa jAto hyahaM mfgaH । tato mAM SaraRaM prAptaM prAha yogI maheSvaraH ॥20॥

text: ajaraścāmaraścaiva bhavitā duḥkhavarjitaḥ । sāmyaṃ samastu te saukhyaṃ yuvayorvardhatāṃ kratuḥ ॥21॥
html:
ajaraścāmaraścaiva bhavitā duḥkhavarjitaḥ ।
sāmyaṃ samastu te saukhyaṃ yuvayorvardhatāṃ kratuḥ ॥21॥
slp1: ajaraScAmaraScEva BavitA duHKavarjitaH । sAmyaM samastu te sOKyaM yuvayorvarDatAM kratuH ॥21॥

text: anugrahānevameṣa karoti bhagavānvibhuḥ । paraṃ dhātā vidhātā ca sukhaduḥkhe ca sarvadā ॥22॥
html:
anugrahānevameṣa karoti bhagavānvibhuḥ ।
paraṃ dhātā vidhātā ca sukhaduḥkhe ca sarvadā ॥22॥
slp1: anugrahAnevameza karoti BagavAnviBuH । paraM DAtA viDAtA ca suKaduHKe ca sarvadA ॥22॥

text: acintya eṣa bhagavānkarmaṇā manasā girā । na me tāta yudhiśreṣṭha vidyayā paṇḍitaḥ samaḥ ॥23॥
html:
acintya eṣa bhagavānkarmaṇā manasā girā ।
na me tāta yudhiśreṣṭha vidyayā paṇḍitaḥ samaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: acintya eza BagavAnkarmaRA manasA girA । na me tAta yuDiSrezWa vidyayA paRqitaH samaH ॥23॥

text: mamāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ dattaṃ bhagavatā purā । yatnenālpena balinā vārāṇasyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥24॥
html:
mamāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ dattaṃ bhagavatā purā ।
yatnenālpena balinā vārāṇasyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥24॥
slp1: mamAzwaguRamESvaryaM dattaM BagavatA purA । yatnenAlpena balinA vArARasyAM yuDizWira ॥24॥
author: jaigīṣavya uvāca ।

text: catuḥṣaṣṭyaṅgamadadātkālajñānaṃ mamādbhutam । sarasvatyāstaṭe tuṣṭo manoyajñena pāṇḍava ॥25॥
html:
catuḥṣaṣṭyaṅgamadadātkālajñānaṃ mamādbhutam ।
sarasvatyāstaṭe tuṣṭo manoyajñena pāṇḍava ॥25॥
slp1: catuHzazwyaNgamadadAtkAlajYAnaM mamAdButam । sarasvatyAstawe tuzwo manoyajYena pARqava ॥25॥
author: gārgya uvāca ।

text: tulyaṃ mama sahasraṃ tu sutānāṃ brahmavādinām । āyuścaiva saputrasya saṃvatsaraśatāyutam ॥26॥
html:
tulyaṃ mama sahasraṃ tu sutānāṃ brahmavādinām ।
āyuścaiva saputrasya saṃvatsaraśatāyutam ॥26॥
slp1: tulyaM mama sahasraM tu sutAnAM brahmavAdinAm । AyuScEva saputrasya saMvatsaraSatAyutam ॥26॥

text: prasādyāhaṃ purā śarvaṃ manasācintayaṃ nṛpa । mahātapā mahātejā mahāyogī mahāyaśāḥ । vedavyāsaḥ śriyāvāso brahmaṇyaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ ॥27॥
html:
prasādyāhaṃ purā śarvaṃ manasācintayaṃ nṛpa ।
mahātapā mahātejā mahāyogī mahāyaśāḥ ।
vedavyāsaḥ śriyāvāso brahmaṇyaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: prasAdyAhaM purA SarvaM manasAcintayaM nfpa । mahAtapA mahAtejA mahAyogI mahAyaSAH । vedavyAsaH SriyAvAso brahmaRyaH karuRAtmakaH ॥27॥
author: parāśara uvāca ।

text: api nāmepsitaḥ putro mama syādvai maheśvarāt । iti matvā hṛdi mataṃ prāha māṃ surasattamaḥ ॥28॥
html:
api nāmepsitaḥ putro mama syādvai maheśvarāt ।
iti matvā hṛdi mataṃ prāha māṃ surasattamaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: api nAmepsitaH putro mama syAdvE maheSvarAt । iti matvA hfdi mataM prAha mAM surasattamaH ॥28॥

text: mayi sambhavatastasya phalātkṛṣṇo bhaviṣyati । sāvarṇasya manoḥ sarge saptarṣiśca bhaviṣyati ॥29॥
html:
mayi sambhavatastasya phalātkṛṣṇo bhaviṣyati ।
sāvarṇasya manoḥ sarge saptarṣiśca bhaviṣyati ॥29॥
slp1: mayi samBavatastasya PalAtkfzRo Bavizyati । sAvarRasya manoH sarge saptarziSca Bavizyati ॥29॥

text: vedānāṃ ca sa vai vyastā kuruvaṃśakarastathā । itihāsasya kartā ca putraste jagato hitaḥ ॥30॥
html:
vedānāṃ ca sa vai vyastā kuruvaṃśakarastathā ।
itihāsasya kartā ca putraste jagato hitaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: vedAnAM ca sa vE vyastA kuruvaMSakarastaTA । itihAsasya kartA ca putraste jagato hitaH ॥30॥

text: bhaviṣyati mahendrasya dayitaḥ sa mahāmuniḥ । ajaraścāmaraścaiva parāśara sutastava ॥31॥
html:
bhaviṣyati mahendrasya dayitaḥ sa mahāmuniḥ ।
ajaraścāmaraścaiva parāśara sutastava ॥31॥
slp1: Bavizyati mahendrasya dayitaH sa mahAmuniH । ajaraScAmaraScEva parASara sutastava ॥31॥

text: evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata । yudhiṣṭhira mahāyogī vīryavānakṣayo'vyayaḥ ॥32॥
html:
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata ।
yudhiṣṭhira mahāyogī vīryavānakṣayo'vyayaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: evamuktvA sa BagavAMstatrEvAntaraDIyata । yuDizWira mahAyogI vIryavAnakzayo'vyayaH ॥32॥

text: acauraścauraśaṅkāyāṃ śūle bhinno hyahaṃ yadā । tatrasthena stuto devaḥ prāha māṃ vai maheśvaraḥ ॥33॥
html:
acauraścauraśaṅkāyāṃ śūle bhinno hyahaṃ yadā ।
tatrasthena stuto devaḥ prāha māṃ vai maheśvaraḥ ॥33॥
slp1: acOraScOraSaNkAyAM SUle Binno hyahaM yadA । tatrasTena stuto devaH prAha mAM vE maheSvaraH ॥33॥
author: māṇḍavya uvāca ।

text: mokṣaṃ prāpsyasi śūlācca jīviṣyasi samārbudam । rujā śūlakṛtā caiva na te vipra bhaviṣyati । ādhibhirvyādhibhiścaiva varjitastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ॥34॥
html:
mokṣaṃ prāpsyasi śūlācca jīviṣyasi samārbudam ।
rujā śūlakṛtā caiva na te vipra bhaviṣyati ।
ādhibhirvyādhibhiścaiva varjitastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ॥34॥
slp1: mokzaM prApsyasi SUlAcca jIvizyasi samArbudam । rujA SUlakftA cEva na te vipra Bavizyati । ADiBirvyADiBiScEva varjitastvaM Bavizyasi ॥34॥

text: pādāccaturthātsambhūta ātmā yasmānmune tava । tvaṃ bhaviṣyasyanupamo janma vai saphalaṃ kuru ॥35॥
html:
pādāccaturthātsambhūta ātmā yasmānmune tava ।
tvaṃ bhaviṣyasyanupamo janma vai saphalaṃ kuru ॥35॥
slp1: pAdAccaturTAtsamBUta AtmA yasmAnmune tava । tvaM Bavizyasyanupamo janma vE saPalaM kuru ॥35॥

text: tīrthābhiṣekaṃ saphalaṃ tvamavighnena cāpsyasi । svargaṃ caivākṣayaṃ vipra vidadhāmi tavorjitam ॥36॥
html:
tīrthābhiṣekaṃ saphalaṃ tvamavighnena cāpsyasi ।
svargaṃ caivākṣayaṃ vipra vidadhāmi tavorjitam ॥36॥
slp1: tIrTABizekaM saPalaM tvamaviGnena cApsyasi । svargaM cEvAkzayaM vipra vidaDAmi tavorjitam ॥36॥

text: evamuktvā tu bhagavānvareṇyo vṛṣavāhanaḥ । maheśvaro mahārāja kṛttivāsā mahādyutiḥ । sagaṇo daivataśreṣṭhastatraivāntaradhīyata ॥37॥
html:
evamuktvā tu bhagavānvareṇyo vṛṣavāhanaḥ ।
maheśvaro mahārāja kṛttivāsā mahādyutiḥ ।
sagaṇo daivataśreṣṭhastatraivāntaradhīyata ॥37॥
slp1: evamuktvA tu BagavAnvareRyo vfzavAhanaH । maheSvaro mahArAja kfttivAsA mahAdyutiH । sagaRo dEvataSrezWastatrEvAntaraDIyata ॥37॥

text: viśvāmitrābhyanujñāto hyahaṃ pitaramāgataḥ । abravīnmāṃ tato mātā duḥkhitā rudatī bhṛśam ॥38॥
html:
viśvāmitrābhyanujñāto hyahaṃ pitaramāgataḥ ।
abravīnmāṃ tato mātā duḥkhitā rudatī bhṛśam ॥38॥
slp1: viSvAmitrAByanujYAto hyahaM pitaramAgataH । abravInmAM tato mAtA duHKitA rudatI BfSam ॥38॥
author: gālava uvāca ।

text: kauśikenābhyanujñātaṃ putraṃ vedavibhūṣitam । na tāta taruṇaṃ dāntaṃ pitā tvāṃ paśyate'nagha ॥39॥
html:
kauśikenābhyanujñātaṃ putraṃ vedavibhūṣitam ।
na tāta taruṇaṃ dāntaṃ pitā tvāṃ paśyate'nagha ॥39॥
slp1: kOSikenAByanujYAtaM putraM vedaviBUzitam । na tAta taruRaM dAntaM pitA tvAM paSyate'naGa ॥39॥

text: śrutvā jananyā vacanaṃ nirāśo gurudarśane । niyatātmā mahādevamapaśyaṃ so'bravīcca mām ॥40॥
html:
śrutvā jananyā vacanaṃ nirāśo gurudarśane ।
niyatātmā mahādevamapaśyaṃ so'bravīcca mām ॥40॥
slp1: SrutvA jananyA vacanaM nirASo gurudarSane । niyatAtmA mahAdevamapaSyaM so'bravIcca mAm ॥40॥

text: pitā mātā ca te tvaṃ ca putra mṛtyuvivarjitāḥ । bhaviṣyatha viśa kṣipraṃ draṣṭāsi pitaraṃ kṣaye ॥41॥
html:
pitā mātā ca te tvaṃ ca putra mṛtyuvivarjitāḥ ।
bhaviṣyatha viśa kṣipraṃ draṣṭāsi pitaraṃ kṣaye ॥41॥
slp1: pitA mAtA ca te tvaM ca putra mftyuvivarjitAH । BavizyaTa viSa kzipraM drazwAsi pitaraM kzaye ॥41॥

text: anujñāto bhagavatā gṛhaṃ gatvā yudhiṣṭhira । apaśyaṃ pitaraṃ tāta iṣṭiṃ kṛtvā viniḥsṛtam ॥42॥
html:
anujñāto bhagavatā gṛhaṃ gatvā yudhiṣṭhira ।
apaśyaṃ pitaraṃ tāta iṣṭiṃ kṛtvā viniḥsṛtam ॥42॥
slp1: anujYAto BagavatA gfhaM gatvA yuDizWira । apaSyaM pitaraM tAta izwiM kftvA viniHsftam ॥42॥

text: upaspṛśya gṛhītvedhmaṃ kuśāṃśca śaraṇādgurūn । tānvisṛjya ca māṃ prāha pitā sāsrāvilekṣaṇaḥ ॥43॥
html:
upaspṛśya gṛhītvedhmaṃ kuśāṃśca śaraṇādgurūn ।
tānvisṛjya ca māṃ prāha pitā sāsrāvilekṣaṇaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: upaspfSya gfhItveDmaM kuSAMSca SaraRAdgurUn । tAnvisfjya ca mAM prAha pitA sAsrAvilekzaRaH ॥43॥

text: praṇamantaṃ pariṣvajya mūrdhni cāghrāya pāṇḍava । diṣṭyā dṛṣṭo'si me putra kṛtavidya ihāgataḥ ॥44॥
html:
praṇamantaṃ pariṣvajya mūrdhni cāghrāya pāṇḍava ।
diṣṭyā dṛṣṭo'si me putra kṛtavidya ihāgataḥ ॥44॥
slp1: praRamantaM parizvajya mUrDni cAGrAya pARqava । dizwyA dfzwo'si me putra kftavidya ihAgataH ॥44॥

text: etānyatyadbhutānyeva karmāṇyatha mahātmanaḥ । proktāni munibhiḥ śrutvā vismayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ ॥45॥
html:
etānyatyadbhutānyeva karmāṇyatha mahātmanaḥ ।
proktāni munibhiḥ śrutvā vismayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: etAnyatyadButAnyeva karmARyaTa mahAtmanaH । proktAni muniBiH SrutvA vismayAmAsa pARqavaH ॥45॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tataḥ kṛṣṇo'bravīdvākyaṃ punarmatimatāṃ varaḥ । yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmanityaṃ puruhūtamiveśvaraḥ ॥46॥
html:
tataḥ kṛṣṇo'bravīdvākyaṃ punarmatimatāṃ varaḥ ।
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmanityaṃ puruhūtamiveśvaraḥ ॥46॥
slp1: tataH kfzRo'bravIdvAkyaM punarmatimatAM varaH । yuDizWiraM DarmanityaM puruhUtamiveSvaraH ॥46॥

text: ādityacandrāvanilānalau ca dyaurbhūmirāpo vasavo'tha viśve । dhātāryamā śukrabṛhaspatī ca rudrāḥ sasādhyā varuṇo vittagopaḥ ॥47॥
html:
ādityacandrāvanilānalau ca dyaurbhūmirāpo vasavo'tha viśve ।
dhātāryamā śukrabṛhaspatī ca rudrāḥ sasādhyā varuṇo vittagopaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: AdityacandrAvanilAnalO ca dyOrBUmirApo vasavo'Ta viSve । DAtAryamA SukrabfhaspatI ca rudrAH sasADyA varuRo vittagopaH ॥47॥

text: brahmā śakro māruto brahma satyaṃ vedā yajñā dakṣiṇā vedavāhāḥ । somo yaṣṭā yacca havyaṃ haviśca rakṣā dīkṣā niyamā ye ca kecit ॥48॥
html:
brahmā śakro māruto brahma satyaṃ vedā yajñā dakṣiṇā vedavāhāḥ ।
somo yaṣṭā yacca havyaṃ haviśca rakṣā dīkṣā niyamā ye ca kecit ॥48॥
slp1: brahmA Sakro mAruto brahma satyaM vedA yajYA dakziRA vedavAhAH । somo yazwA yacca havyaM haviSca rakzA dIkzA niyamA ye ca kecit ॥48॥

text: svāhā vaṣaḍbrāhmaṇāḥ saurabheyā dharmaṃ cakraṃ kālacakraṃ caraṃ ca । yaśo damo buddhimatī sthitiśca śubhāśubhaṃ munayaścaiva sapta ॥49॥
html:
svāhā vaṣaḍbrāhmaṇāḥ saurabheyā dharmaṃ cakraṃ kālacakraṃ caraṃ ca ।
yaśo damo buddhimatī sthitiśca śubhāśubhaṃ munayaścaiva sapta ॥49॥
slp1: svAhA vazaqbrAhmaRAH sOraBeyA DarmaM cakraM kAlacakraM caraM ca । yaSo damo budDimatI sTitiSca SuBASuBaM munayaScEva sapta ॥49॥

text: agryā buddhirmanasā darśane ca sparśe siddhiḥ karmaṇāṃ yā ca siddhiḥ । gaṇā devānāmūṣmapāḥ somapāśca lekhāḥ suyāmāstuṣitā brahmakāyāḥ ॥50॥
html:
agryā buddhirmanasā darśane ca sparśe siddhiḥ karmaṇāṃ yā ca siddhiḥ ।
gaṇā devānāmūṣmapāḥ somapāśca lekhāḥ suyāmāstuṣitā brahmakāyāḥ ॥50॥
slp1: agryA budDirmanasA darSane ca sparSe sidDiH karmaRAM yA ca sidDiH । gaRA devAnAmUzmapAH somapASca leKAH suyAmAstuzitA brahmakAyAH ॥50॥

text: ābhāsvarā gandhapā dṛṣṭipāśca vācā viruddhāśca manoviruddhāḥ । śuddhāśca nirvāṇaratāśca devāḥ sparśāśanā darśapā ājyapāśca ॥51॥
html:
ābhāsvarā gandhapā dṛṣṭipāśca vācā viruddhāśca manoviruddhāḥ ।
śuddhāśca nirvāṇaratāśca devāḥ sparśāśanā darśapā ājyapāśca ॥51॥
slp1: ABAsvarA ganDapA dfzwipASca vAcA virudDASca manovirudDAH । SudDASca nirvARaratASca devAH sparSASanA darSapA AjyapASca ॥51॥

text: cintāgatā ye ca deveṣu mukhyā ye cāpyanye devatāścājamīḍha । suparṇagandharvapiśācadānavā yakṣāstathā pannagāścāraṇāśca ॥52॥
html:
cintāgatā ye ca deveṣu mukhyā ye cāpyanye devatāścājamīḍha ।
suparṇagandharvapiśācadānavā yakṣāstathā pannagāścāraṇāśca ॥52॥
slp1: cintAgatA ye ca devezu muKyA ye cApyanye devatAScAjamIQa । suparRaganDarvapiSAcadAnavA yakzAstaTA pannagAScAraRASca ॥52॥

text: sūkṣmaṃ sthūlaṃ mṛdu yaccāpyasūkṣmaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaduḥkhāntaraṃ ca । sāṅkhyaṃ yogaṃ yatparāṇāṃ paraṃ ca śarvājjātaṃ viddhi yatkīrtitaṃ me ॥53॥
html:
sūkṣmaṃ sthūlaṃ mṛdu yaccāpyasūkṣmaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhaduḥkhāntaraṃ ca ।
sāṅkhyaṃ yogaṃ yatparāṇāṃ paraṃ ca śarvājjātaṃ viddhi yatkīrtitaṃ me ॥53॥
slp1: sUkzmaM sTUlaM mfdu yaccApyasUkzmaM suKaM duHKaM suKaduHKAntaraM ca । sANKyaM yogaM yatparARAM paraM ca SarvAjjAtaM vidDi yatkIrtitaM me ॥53॥

text: tatsambhūtā bhūtakṛto vareṇyāḥ sarve devā bhuvanasyāsya gopāḥ । āviśyemāṃ dharaṇīṃ ye'bhyarakṣanpurātanīṃ tasya devasya sṛṣṭim ॥54॥
html:
tatsambhūtā bhūtakṛto vareṇyāḥ sarve devā bhuvanasyāsya gopāḥ ।
āviśyemāṃ dharaṇīṃ ye'bhyarakṣanpurātanīṃ tasya devasya sṛṣṭim ॥54॥
slp1: tatsamBUtA BUtakfto vareRyAH sarve devA BuvanasyAsya gopAH । AviSyemAM DaraRIM ye'ByarakzanpurAtanIM tasya devasya sfzwim ॥54॥

text: vicinvantaṃ manasā toṣṭuvīmi kiñcittattvaṃ prāṇahetornato'smi । dadātu devaḥ sa varāniheṣṭānabhiṣṭuto naḥ prabhuravyayaḥ sadā ॥55॥
html:
vicinvantaṃ manasā toṣṭuvīmi kiñcittattvaṃ prāṇahetornato'smi ।
dadātu devaḥ sa varāniheṣṭānabhiṣṭuto naḥ prabhuravyayaḥ sadā ॥55॥
slp1: vicinvantaM manasA tozwuvImi kiYcittattvaM prARahetornato'smi । dadAtu devaH sa varAnihezwAnaBizwuto naH praBuravyayaH sadA ॥55॥

text: imaṃ stavaṃ sanniyamyendriyāṇi śucirbhūtvā yaḥ puruṣaḥ paṭheta । abhagnayogo niyato'bdamekaṃ sa prāpnuyādaśvamedhe phalaṃ yat ॥56॥
html:
imaṃ stavaṃ sanniyamyendriyāṇi śucirbhūtvā yaḥ puruṣaḥ paṭheta ।
abhagnayogo niyato'bdamekaṃ sa prāpnuyādaśvamedhe phalaṃ yat ॥56॥
slp1: imaM stavaM sanniyamyendriyARi SucirBUtvA yaH puruzaH paWeta । aBagnayogo niyato'bdamekaM sa prApnuyAdaSvameDe PalaM yat ॥56॥

text: vedānkṛtsnānbrāhmaṇaḥ prāpnuyācca jayedrājā pṛthivīṃ cāpi kṛtsnām । vaiśyo lābhaṃ prāpnuyānnaipuṇaṃ ca śūdro gatiṃ pretya tathā sukhaṃ ca ॥57॥
html:
vedānkṛtsnānbrāhmaṇaḥ prāpnuyācca jayedrājā pṛthivīṃ cāpi kṛtsnām ।
vaiśyo lābhaṃ prāpnuyānnaipuṇaṃ ca śūdro gatiṃ pretya tathā sukhaṃ ca ॥57॥
slp1: vedAnkftsnAnbrAhmaRaH prApnuyAcca jayedrAjA pfTivIM cApi kftsnAm । vESyo lABaM prApnuyAnnEpuRaM ca SUdro gatiM pretya taTA suKaM ca ॥57॥

text: stavarājamimaṃ kṛtvā rudrāya dadhire manaḥ । sarvadoṣāpahaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca yaśasvinam ॥58॥
html:
stavarājamimaṃ kṛtvā rudrāya dadhire manaḥ ।
sarvadoṣāpahaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca yaśasvinam ॥58॥
slp1: stavarAjamimaM kftvA rudrAya daDire manaH । sarvadozApahaM puRyaM pavitraM ca yaSasvinam ॥58॥

text: yāvantyasya śarīreṣu romakūpāṇi bhārata । tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svarge vasati mānavaḥ] ॥59॥
html:
yāvantyasya śarīreṣu romakūpāṇi bhārata ।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svarge vasati mānavaḥ] ॥59॥
slp1: yAvantyasya SarIrezu romakUpARi BArata । tAvadvarzasahasrARi svarge vasati mAnavaH] ॥59॥

text: yadidaṃ sahadharmeti procyate bharatarṣabha । pāṇigrahaṇakāle tu strīṇāmetatkathaṃ smṛtam ॥1॥
html:
yadidaṃ sahadharmeti procyate bharatarṣabha ।
pāṇigrahaṇakāle tu strīṇāmetatkathaṃ smṛtam ॥1॥
slp1: yadidaM sahaDarmeti procyate BaratarzaBa । pARigrahaRakAle tu strIRAmetatkaTaM smftam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ārṣa eṣa bhaveddharmaḥ prājāpatyo'tha vāsuraḥ । yadetatsahadharmeti pūrvamuktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ ॥2॥
html:
ārṣa eṣa bhaveddharmaḥ prājāpatyo'tha vāsuraḥ ।
yadetatsahadharmeti pūrvamuktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: Arza eza BavedDarmaH prAjApatyo'Ta vAsuraH । yadetatsahaDarmeti pUrvamuktaM maharziBiH ॥2॥

text: sandehaḥ sumahāneṣa viruddha iti me matiḥ । iha yaḥ sahadharmo vai pretyāyaṃ vihitaḥ kva nu ॥3॥
html:
sandehaḥ sumahāneṣa viruddha iti me matiḥ ।
iha yaḥ sahadharmo vai pretyāyaṃ vihitaḥ kva nu ॥3॥
slp1: sandehaH sumahAneza virudDa iti me matiH । iha yaH sahaDarmo vE pretyAyaM vihitaH kva nu ॥3॥

text: svarge mṛtānāṃ bhavati sahadharmaḥ pitāmaha । pūrvamekastu mriyate kva caikastiṣṭhate vada ॥4॥
html:
svarge mṛtānāṃ bhavati sahadharmaḥ pitāmaha ।
pūrvamekastu mriyate kva caikastiṣṭhate vada ॥4॥
slp1: svarge mftAnAM Bavati sahaDarmaH pitAmaha । pUrvamekastu mriyate kva cEkastizWate vada ॥4॥

text: nānākarmaphalopetā nānākarmanivāsinaḥ । nānānirayaniṣṭhāntā mānuṣā bahavo yadā ॥5॥
html:
nānākarmaphalopetā nānākarmanivāsinaḥ ।
nānānirayaniṣṭhāntā mānuṣā bahavo yadā ॥5॥
slp1: nAnAkarmaPalopetA nAnAkarmanivAsinaH । nAnAnirayanizWAntA mAnuzA bahavo yadA ॥5॥

text: anṛtāḥ striya ityevaṃ sūtrakāro vyavasyati । yadānṛtāḥ striyastāta sahadharmaḥ kutaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥6॥
html:
anṛtāḥ striya ityevaṃ sūtrakāro vyavasyati ।
yadānṛtāḥ striyastāta sahadharmaḥ kutaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: anftAH striya ityevaM sUtrakAro vyavasyati । yadAnftAH striyastAta sahaDarmaH kutaH smftaH ॥6॥

text: anṛtāḥ striya ityevaṃ vedeṣvapi hi paṭhyate । dharmo'yaṃ paurvikī sañjñā upacāraḥ kriyāvidhiḥ ॥7॥
html:
anṛtāḥ striya ityevaṃ vedeṣvapi hi paṭhyate ।
dharmo'yaṃ paurvikī sañjñā upacāraḥ kriyāvidhiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: anftAH striya ityevaM vedezvapi hi paWyate । Darmo'yaM pOrvikI saYjYA upacAraH kriyAviDiH ॥7॥

text: gahvaraṃ pratibhātyetanmama cintayato'niśam । niḥsandehamidaṃ sarvaṃ pitāmaha yathā śrutiḥ ॥8॥
html:
gahvaraṃ pratibhātyetanmama cintayato'niśam ।
niḥsandehamidaṃ sarvaṃ pitāmaha yathā śrutiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: gahvaraM pratiBAtyetanmama cintayato'niSam । niHsandehamidaM sarvaM pitAmaha yaTA SrutiH ॥8॥

text: yadetadyādṛśaṃ caitadyathā caitatpravartitam । nikhilena mahāprājña bhavānetadbravītu me ॥9॥
html:
yadetadyādṛśaṃ caitadyathā caitatpravartitam ।
nikhilena mahāprājña bhavānetadbravītu me ॥9॥
slp1: yadetadyAdfSaM cEtadyaTA cEtatpravartitam । niKilena mahAprAjYa BavAnetadbravItu me ॥9॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । aṣṭāvakrasya saṃvādaṃ diśayā saha bhārata ॥10॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
aṣṭāvakrasya saṃvādaṃ diśayā saha bhārata ॥10॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । azwAvakrasya saMvAdaM diSayA saha BArata ॥10॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: niveṣṭukāmastu purā aṣṭāvakro mahātapāḥ । ṛṣeratha vadānyasya kanyāṃ vavre mahātmanaḥ ॥11॥
html:
niveṣṭukāmastu purā aṣṭāvakro mahātapāḥ ।
ṛṣeratha vadānyasya kanyāṃ vavre mahātmanaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: nivezwukAmastu purA azwAvakro mahAtapAH । fzeraTa vadAnyasya kanyAM vavre mahAtmanaH ॥11॥

text: suprabhāṃ nāma vai nāmnā rūpeṇāpratimāṃ bhuvi । guṇaprabarhāṃ śīlena sādhvīṃ cāritraśobhanām ॥12॥
html:
suprabhāṃ nāma vai nāmnā rūpeṇāpratimāṃ bhuvi ।
guṇaprabarhāṃ śīlena sādhvīṃ cāritraśobhanām ॥12॥
slp1: supraBAM nAma vE nAmnA rUpeRApratimAM Buvi । guRaprabarhAM SIlena sADvIM cAritraSoBanAm ॥12॥

text: sā tasya dṛṣṭvaiva mano jahāra śubhalocanā । vanarājī yathā citrā vasante kusumācitā ॥13॥
html:
sā tasya dṛṣṭvaiva mano jahāra śubhalocanā ।
vanarājī yathā citrā vasante kusumācitā ॥13॥
slp1: sA tasya dfzwvEva mano jahAra SuBalocanA । vanarAjI yaTA citrA vasante kusumAcitA ॥13॥

text: ṛṣistamāha deyā me sutā tubhyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me । gaccha tāvaddiśaṃ puṇyāmuttarāṃ drakṣyase tataḥ ॥14॥
html:
ṛṣistamāha deyā me sutā tubhyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me ।
gaccha tāvaddiśaṃ puṇyāmuttarāṃ drakṣyase tataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: fzistamAha deyA me sutA tuByaM SfRuzva me । gacCa tAvaddiSaM puRyAmuttarAM drakzyase tataH ॥14॥

text: kiṃ draṣṭavyaṃ mayā tatra vaktumarhati me bhavān । tathedānīṃ mayā kāryaṃ yathā vakṣyati māṃ bhavān ॥15॥
html:
kiṃ draṣṭavyaṃ mayā tatra vaktumarhati me bhavān ।
tathedānīṃ mayā kāryaṃ yathā vakṣyati māṃ bhavān ॥15॥
slp1: kiM drazwavyaM mayA tatra vaktumarhati me BavAn । taTedAnIM mayA kAryaM yaTA vakzyati mAM BavAn ॥15॥
author: aṣṭāvakra uvāca ।

text: dhanadaṃ samatikramya himavantaṃ tathaiva ca । rudrasyāyatanaṃ dṛṣṭvā siddhacāraṇasevitam ॥16॥
html:
dhanadaṃ samatikramya himavantaṃ tathaiva ca ।
rudrasyāyatanaṃ dṛṣṭvā siddhacāraṇasevitam ॥16॥
slp1: DanadaM samatikramya himavantaM taTEva ca । rudrasyAyatanaM dfzwvA sidDacAraRasevitam ॥16॥
author: vadānya uvāca ।

text: prahṛṣṭaiḥ pārṣadairjuṣṭaṃ nṛtyadbhirvividhānanaiḥ । divyāṅgarāgaiḥ paiśācairvanyairnānāvidhaistathā ॥17॥
html:
prahṛṣṭaiḥ pārṣadairjuṣṭaṃ nṛtyadbhirvividhānanaiḥ ।
divyāṅgarāgaiḥ paiśācairvanyairnānāvidhaistathā ॥17॥
slp1: prahfzwEH pArzadErjuzwaM nftyadBirviviDAnanEH । divyANgarAgEH pESAcErvanyErnAnAviDEstaTA ॥17॥

text: pāṇitālasatālaiśca śamyātālaiḥ samaistathā । samprahṛṣṭaiḥ pranṛtyadbhiḥ śarvastatra niṣevyate ॥18॥
html:
pāṇitālasatālaiśca śamyātālaiḥ samaistathā ।
samprahṛṣṭaiḥ pranṛtyadbhiḥ śarvastatra niṣevyate ॥18॥
slp1: pARitAlasatAlESca SamyAtAlEH samEstaTA । samprahfzwEH pranftyadBiH Sarvastatra nizevyate ॥18॥

text: iṣṭaṃ kila girau sthānaṃ taddivyamanuśuśruma । nityaṃ sannihito devastathā pāriṣadāḥ śubhāḥ ॥19॥
html:
iṣṭaṃ kila girau sthānaṃ taddivyamanuśuśruma ।
nityaṃ sannihito devastathā pāriṣadāḥ śubhāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: izwaM kila girO sTAnaM taddivyamanuSuSruma । nityaM sannihito devastaTA pArizadAH SuBAH ॥19॥

text: tatra devyā tapastaptaṃ śaṅkarārthaṃ suduścaram । atastadiṣṭaṃ devasya tathomāyā iti śrutiḥ ॥20॥
html:
tatra devyā tapastaptaṃ śaṅkarārthaṃ suduścaram ।
atastadiṣṭaṃ devasya tathomāyā iti śrutiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tatra devyA tapastaptaM SaNkarArTaM suduScaram । atastadizwaM devasya taTomAyA iti SrutiH ॥20॥

text: tatra kūpo mahānpārśve devasyottaratastathā । ṛtavaḥ kālarātriśca ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ॥21॥
html:
tatra kūpo mahānpārśve devasyottaratastathā ।
ṛtavaḥ kālarātriśca ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tatra kUpo mahAnpArSve devasyottaratastaTA । ftavaH kAlarAtriSca ye divyA ye ca mAnuzAH ॥21॥

text: sarve devamupāsante rūpiṇaḥ kila tatra ha । tadatikramya bhavanaṃ tvayā yātavyameva hi ॥22॥
html:
sarve devamupāsante rūpiṇaḥ kila tatra ha ।
tadatikramya bhavanaṃ tvayā yātavyameva hi ॥22॥
slp1: sarve devamupAsante rUpiRaH kila tatra ha । tadatikramya BavanaM tvayA yAtavyameva hi ॥22॥

text: tato nīlaṃ vanoddeśaṃ drakṣyase meghasannibham । ramaṇīyaṃ manogrāhi tatra drakṣyasi vai striyam ॥23॥
html:
tato nīlaṃ vanoddeśaṃ drakṣyase meghasannibham ।
ramaṇīyaṃ manogrāhi tatra drakṣyasi vai striyam ॥23॥
slp1: tato nIlaM vanoddeSaM drakzyase meGasanniBam । ramaRIyaM manogrAhi tatra drakzyasi vE striyam ॥23॥

text: tapasvinīṃ mahābhāgāṃ vṛddhāṃ dīkṣāmanuṣṭhitām । draṣṭavyā sā tvayā tatra sampūjyā caiva yatnataḥ ॥24॥
html:
tapasvinīṃ mahābhāgāṃ vṛddhāṃ dīkṣāmanuṣṭhitām ।
draṣṭavyā sā tvayā tatra sampūjyā caiva yatnataḥ ॥24॥
slp1: tapasvinIM mahABAgAM vfdDAM dIkzAmanuzWitAm । drazwavyA sA tvayA tatra sampUjyA cEva yatnataH ॥24॥

text: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vinivṛttastvaṃ tataḥ pāṇiṃ grahīṣyasi । yadyeṣa samayaḥ satyaḥ sādhyatāṃ tatra gamyatām] ॥25॥
html:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vinivṛttastvaṃ tataḥ pāṇiṃ grahīṣyasi ।
yadyeṣa samayaḥ satyaḥ sādhyatāṃ tatra gamyatām] ॥25॥
slp1: tAM dfzwvA vinivfttastvaM tataH pARiM grahIzyasi । yadyeza samayaH satyaH sADyatAM tatra gamyatAm] ॥25॥

text: tathāstu sādhayiṣyāmi tatra yāsyāmyasaṃśayam । yatra tvaṃ vadase sādho bhavānbhavatu satyavāk ॥1॥
html:
tathāstu sādhayiṣyāmi tatra yāsyāmyasaṃśayam ।
yatra tvaṃ vadase sādho bhavānbhavatu satyavāk ॥1॥
slp1: taTAstu sADayizyAmi tatra yAsyAmyasaMSayam । yatra tvaM vadase sADo BavAnBavatu satyavAk ॥1॥
author: aṣṭāvakra uvāca ।

text: tato'gacchatsa bhagavānuttarāmuttamāṃ diśam । himavantaṃ giriśreṣṭhaṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam ॥2॥
html:
tato'gacchatsa bhagavānuttarāmuttamāṃ diśam ।
himavantaṃ giriśreṣṭhaṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam ॥2॥
slp1: tato'gacCatsa BagavAnuttarAmuttamAM diSam । himavantaM giriSrezWaM sidDacAraRasevitam ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa gatvā dvijaśārdūlo himavantaṃ mahāgirim । abhyagacchannadīṃ puṇyāṃ bāhudāṃ dharmadāyinīm ॥3॥
html:
sa gatvā dvijaśārdūlo himavantaṃ mahāgirim ।
abhyagacchannadīṃ puṇyāṃ bāhudāṃ dharmadāyinīm ॥3॥
slp1: sa gatvA dvijaSArdUlo himavantaM mahAgirim । aByagacCannadIM puRyAM bAhudAM DarmadAyinIm ॥3॥

text: aśoke vimale tīrthe snātvā tarpya ca devatāḥ । tatra vāsāya śayane kauśye sukhamuvāsa ha ॥4॥
html:
aśoke vimale tīrthe snātvā tarpya ca devatāḥ ।
tatra vāsāya śayane kauśye sukhamuvāsa ha ॥4॥
slp1: aSoke vimale tIrTe snAtvA tarpya ca devatAH । tatra vAsAya Sayane kOSye suKamuvAsa ha ॥4॥

text: tato rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ prātarutthāya sa dvijaḥ । snātvā prāduścakārāgniṃ hutvā caiva vidhānataḥ ॥5॥
html:
tato rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ prātarutthāya sa dvijaḥ ।
snātvā prāduścakārāgniṃ hutvā caiva vidhānataḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tato rAtryAM vyatItAyAM prAtarutTAya sa dvijaH । snAtvA prAduScakArAgniM hutvA cEva viDAnataH ॥5॥

text: rudrāṇīkūpamāsādya hrade tatra samāśvasat । viśrāntaśca samutthāya kailāsamabhito yayau ॥6॥
html:
rudrāṇīkūpamāsādya hrade tatra samāśvasat ।
viśrāntaśca samutthāya kailāsamabhito yayau ॥6॥
slp1: rudrARIkUpamAsAdya hrade tatra samASvasat । viSrAntaSca samutTAya kElAsamaBito yayO ॥6॥

text: so'paśyatkāñcanadvāraṃ dīpyamānamiva śriyā । mandākinīṃ ca nalinīṃ dhanadasya mahātmanaḥ ॥7॥
html:
so'paśyatkāñcanadvāraṃ dīpyamānamiva śriyā ।
mandākinīṃ ca nalinīṃ dhanadasya mahātmanaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: so'paSyatkAYcanadvAraM dIpyamAnamiva SriyA । mandAkinIM ca nalinIM Danadasya mahAtmanaH ॥7॥

text: atha te rākṣasāḥ sarve ye'bhirakṣanti padminīm । pratyutthitā bhagavantaṃ maṇibhadrapurogamāḥ ॥8॥
html:
atha te rākṣasāḥ sarve ye'bhirakṣanti padminīm ।
pratyutthitā bhagavantaṃ maṇibhadrapurogamāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: aTa te rAkzasAH sarve ye'Birakzanti padminIm । pratyutTitA BagavantaM maRiBadrapurogamAH ॥8॥

text: sa tānpratyarcayāmāsa rākṣasānbhīmavikramān । nivedayata māṃ kṣipraṃ dhanadāyeti cābravīt ॥9॥
html:
sa tānpratyarcayāmāsa rākṣasānbhīmavikramān ।
nivedayata māṃ kṣipraṃ dhanadāyeti cābravīt ॥9॥
slp1: sa tAnpratyarcayAmAsa rAkzasAnBImavikramAn । nivedayata mAM kzipraM DanadAyeti cAbravIt ॥9॥

text: te rākṣasāstadā rājanbhagavantamathābruvan । asau vaiśravaṇo rājā svayamāyāti te'ntikam ॥10॥
html:
te rākṣasāstadā rājanbhagavantamathābruvan ।
asau vaiśravaṇo rājā svayamāyāti te'ntikam ॥10॥
slp1: te rAkzasAstadA rAjanBagavantamaTAbruvan । asO vESravaRo rAjA svayamAyAti te'ntikam ॥10॥

text: vidito bhagavānasya kāryamāgamane ca yat । paśyainaṃ tvaṃ mahābhāgaṃ jvalantamiva tejasā ॥11॥
html:
vidito bhagavānasya kāryamāgamane ca yat ।
paśyainaṃ tvaṃ mahābhāgaṃ jvalantamiva tejasā ॥11॥
slp1: vidito BagavAnasya kAryamAgamane ca yat । paSyEnaM tvaM mahABAgaM jvalantamiva tejasA ॥11॥

text: tato vaiśravaṇo'bhyetya aṣṭāvakramaninditam । vidhivatkuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā tato brahmarṣimabravīt ॥12॥
html:
tato vaiśravaṇo'bhyetya aṣṭāvakramaninditam ।
vidhivatkuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā tato brahmarṣimabravīt ॥12॥
slp1: tato vESravaRo'Byetya azwAvakramaninditam । viDivatkuSalaM pfzwvA tato brahmarzimabravIt ॥12॥

text: sukhaṃ prāpto bhavānkaccitkiṃ vā mattaścikīrṣasi । brūhi sarvaṃ kariṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ vakṣyasi dvija ॥13॥
html:
sukhaṃ prāpto bhavānkaccitkiṃ vā mattaścikīrṣasi ।
brūhi sarvaṃ kariṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ vakṣyasi dvija ॥13॥
slp1: suKaM prApto BavAnkaccitkiM vA mattaScikIrzasi । brUhi sarvaM karizyAmi yanmAM tvaM vakzyasi dvija ॥13॥

text: bhavanaṃ praviśa tvaṃ me yathākāmaṃ dvijottama । satkṛtaḥ kṛtakāryaśca bhavānyāsyatyavighnataḥ ॥14॥
html:
bhavanaṃ praviśa tvaṃ me yathākāmaṃ dvijottama ।
satkṛtaḥ kṛtakāryaśca bhavānyāsyatyavighnataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: BavanaM praviSa tvaM me yaTAkAmaM dvijottama । satkftaH kftakAryaSca BavAnyAsyatyaviGnataH ॥14॥

text: prāviśadbhavanaṃ svaṃ vai gṛhītvā taṃ dvijottamam । āsanaṃ svaṃ dadau caiva pādyamarghyaṃ tathaiva ca ॥15॥
html:
prāviśadbhavanaṃ svaṃ vai gṛhītvā taṃ dvijottamam ।
āsanaṃ svaṃ dadau caiva pādyamarghyaṃ tathaiva ca ॥15॥
slp1: prAviSadBavanaM svaM vE gfhItvA taM dvijottamam । AsanaM svaM dadO cEva pAdyamarGyaM taTEva ca ॥15॥

text: athopaviṣṭayostatra maṇibhadrapurogamāḥ । niṣedustatra kauberā yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ ॥16॥
html:
athopaviṣṭayostatra maṇibhadrapurogamāḥ ।
niṣedustatra kauberā yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: aTopavizwayostatra maRiBadrapurogamAH । nizedustatra kOberA yakzaganDarvarAkzasAH ॥16॥

text: tatasteṣāṃ niṣaṇṇānāṃ dhanado vākyamabravīt । bhavacchandaṃ samājñāya nṛtyerannapsarogaṇāḥ ॥17॥
html:
tatasteṣāṃ niṣaṇṇānāṃ dhanado vākyamabravīt ।
bhavacchandaṃ samājñāya nṛtyerannapsarogaṇāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tatastezAM nizaRRAnAM Danado vAkyamabravIt । BavacCandaM samAjYAya nftyerannapsarogaRAH ॥17॥

text: ātithyaṃ paramaṃ kāryaṃ śuśrūṣā bhavatastathā । saṃvartatāmityuvāca munirmadhurayā girā ॥18॥
html:
ātithyaṃ paramaṃ kāryaṃ śuśrūṣā bhavatastathā ।
saṃvartatāmityuvāca munirmadhurayā girā ॥18॥
slp1: AtiTyaM paramaM kAryaM SuSrUzA BavatastaTA । saMvartatAmityuvAca munirmaDurayA girA ॥18॥

text: athorvarā miśrakeśī rambhā caivorvaśī tathā । alambusā ghṛtācī ca citrā citrāṅgadā ruciḥ ॥19॥
html:
athorvarā miśrakeśī rambhā caivorvaśī tathā ।
alambusā ghṛtācī ca citrā citrāṅgadā ruciḥ ॥19॥
slp1: aTorvarA miSrakeSI ramBA cEvorvaSI taTA । alambusA GftAcI ca citrA citrANgadA ruciH ॥19॥

text: manoharā sukeśī ca sumukhī hāsinī prabhā । vidyutā praśamā dāntā vidyotā ratireva ca ॥20॥
html:
manoharā sukeśī ca sumukhī hāsinī prabhā ।
vidyutā praśamā dāntā vidyotā ratireva ca ॥20॥
slp1: manoharA sukeSI ca sumuKI hAsinI praBA । vidyutA praSamA dAntA vidyotA ratireva ca ॥20॥

text: etāścānyāśca vai bahvyaḥ pranṛttāpsarasaḥ śubhāḥ । avādayaṃśca gandharvā vādyāni vividhāni ca ॥21॥
html:
etāścānyāśca vai bahvyaḥ pranṛttāpsarasaḥ śubhāḥ ।
avādayaṃśca gandharvā vādyāni vividhāni ca ॥21॥
slp1: etAScAnyASca vE bahvyaH pranfttApsarasaH SuBAH । avAdayaMSca ganDarvA vAdyAni viviDAni ca ॥21॥

text: atha pravṛtte gāndharve divye ṛṣirupāvasat । divyaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tatra ramanvai sumahātapāḥ ॥22॥
html:
atha pravṛtte gāndharve divye ṛṣirupāvasat ।
divyaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tatra ramanvai sumahātapāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: aTa pravftte gAnDarve divye fzirupAvasat । divyaM saMvatsaraM tatra ramanvE sumahAtapAH ॥22॥

text: tato vaiśravaṇo rājā bhagavantamuvāca ha । sāgraḥ saṃvatsaro yātastava vipreha paśyataḥ ॥23॥
html:
tato vaiśravaṇo rājā bhagavantamuvāca ha ।
sāgraḥ saṃvatsaro yātastava vipreha paśyataḥ ॥23॥
slp1: tato vESravaRo rAjA BagavantamuvAca ha । sAgraH saMvatsaro yAtastava vipreha paSyataH ॥23॥

text: hāryo'yaṃ viṣayo brahmangāndharvo nāma nāmataḥ । chandato vartatāṃ vipra yathā vadati vā bhavān ॥24॥
html:
hāryo'yaṃ viṣayo brahmangāndharvo nāma nāmataḥ ।
chandato vartatāṃ vipra yathā vadati vā bhavān ॥24॥
slp1: hAryo'yaM vizayo brahmangAnDarvo nAma nAmataH । Candato vartatAM vipra yaTA vadati vA BavAn ॥24॥

text: atithiḥ pūjanīyastvamidaṃ ca bhavato gṛham । sarvamājñāpyatāmāśu paravanto vayaṃ tvayi ॥25॥
html:
atithiḥ pūjanīyastvamidaṃ ca bhavato gṛham ।
sarvamājñāpyatāmāśu paravanto vayaṃ tvayi ॥25॥
slp1: atiTiH pUjanIyastvamidaM ca Bavato gfham । sarvamAjYApyatAmASu paravanto vayaM tvayi ॥25॥

text: atha vaiśravaṇaṃ prīto bhagavānpratyabhāṣata । arcito'smi yathānyāyaṃ gamiṣyāmi dhaneśvara ॥26॥
html:
atha vaiśravaṇaṃ prīto bhagavānpratyabhāṣata ।
arcito'smi yathānyāyaṃ gamiṣyāmi dhaneśvara ॥26॥
slp1: aTa vESravaRaM prIto BagavAnpratyaBAzata । arcito'smi yaTAnyAyaM gamizyAmi DaneSvara ॥26॥

text: prīto'smi sadṛśaṃ caiva tava sarvaṃ dhanādhipa । tava prasādādbhagavanmaharṣeśca mahātmanaḥ । niyogādadya yāsyāmi vṛddhimānṛddhimānbhava ॥27॥
html:
prīto'smi sadṛśaṃ caiva tava sarvaṃ dhanādhipa ।
tava prasādādbhagavanmaharṣeśca mahātmanaḥ ।
niyogādadya yāsyāmi vṛddhimānṛddhimānbhava ॥27॥
slp1: prIto'smi sadfSaM cEva tava sarvaM DanADipa । tava prasAdAdBagavanmaharzeSca mahAtmanaH । niyogAdadya yAsyAmi vfdDimAnfdDimAnBava ॥27॥

text: atha niṣkramya bhagavānprayayāvuttarāmukhaḥ । kailāsaṃ mandaraṃ haimaṃ sarvānanucacāra ha ॥28॥
html:
atha niṣkramya bhagavānprayayāvuttarāmukhaḥ ।
kailāsaṃ mandaraṃ haimaṃ sarvānanucacāra ha ॥28॥
slp1: aTa nizkramya BagavAnprayayAvuttarAmuKaH । kElAsaM mandaraM hEmaM sarvAnanucacAra ha ॥28॥

text: tānatītya mahāśailānkairātaṃ sthānamuttamam । pradakṣiṇaṃ tataścakre prayataḥ śirasā naman । dharaṇīmavatīryātha pūtātmāsau tadābhavat ॥29॥
html:
tānatītya mahāśailānkairātaṃ sthānamuttamam ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataścakre prayataḥ śirasā naman ।
dharaṇīmavatīryātha pūtātmāsau tadābhavat ॥29॥
slp1: tAnatItya mahASElAnkErAtaM sTAnamuttamam । pradakziRaM tataScakre prayataH SirasA naman । DaraRImavatIryATa pUtAtmAsO tadABavat ॥29॥

text: sa taṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā triḥ śailaṃ cottarāmukhaḥ । samena bhūmibhāgena yayau prītipuraskṛtaḥ ॥30॥
html:
sa taṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā triḥ śailaṃ cottarāmukhaḥ ।
samena bhūmibhāgena yayau prītipuraskṛtaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: sa taM pradakziRaM kftvA triH SElaM cottarAmuKaH । samena BUmiBAgena yayO prItipuraskftaH ॥30॥

text: tato'paraṃ vanoddeśaṃ ramaṇīyamapaśyata । sarvartubhirmūlaphalaiḥ pakṣibhiśca samanvitam । ramaṇīyairvanoddeśaistatra tatra vibhūṣitam ॥31॥
html:
tato'paraṃ vanoddeśaṃ ramaṇīyamapaśyata ।
sarvartubhirmūlaphalaiḥ pakṣibhiśca samanvitam ।
ramaṇīyairvanoddeśaistatra tatra vibhūṣitam ॥31॥
slp1: tato'paraM vanoddeSaM ramaRIyamapaSyata । sarvartuBirmUlaPalEH pakziBiSca samanvitam । ramaRIyErvanoddeSEstatra tatra viBUzitam ॥31॥

text: tatrāśramapadaṃ divyaṃ dadarśa bhagavānatha । śailāṃśca vividhākārānkāñcanānratnabhūṣitān । maṇibhūmau niviṣṭāśca puṣkariṇyastathaiva ca ॥32॥
html:
tatrāśramapadaṃ divyaṃ dadarśa bhagavānatha ।
śailāṃśca vividhākārānkāñcanānratnabhūṣitān ।
maṇibhūmau niviṣṭāśca puṣkariṇyastathaiva ca ॥32॥
slp1: tatrASramapadaM divyaM dadarSa BagavAnaTa । SElAMSca viviDAkArAnkAYcanAnratnaBUzitAn । maRiBUmO nivizwASca puzkariRyastaTEva ca ॥32॥

text: anyānyapi suramyāṇi dadarśa subahūnyatha । bhṛśaṃ tasya mano reme maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ ॥33॥
html:
anyānyapi suramyāṇi dadarśa subahūnyatha ।
bhṛśaṃ tasya mano reme maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: anyAnyapi suramyARi dadarSa subahUnyaTa । BfSaM tasya mano reme maharzerBAvitAtmanaH ॥33॥

text: sa tatra kāñcanaṃ divyaṃ sarvaratnamayaṃ gṛham । dadarśādbhutasaṅkāśaṃ dhanadasya gṛhādvaram ॥34॥
html:
sa tatra kāñcanaṃ divyaṃ sarvaratnamayaṃ gṛham ।
dadarśādbhutasaṅkāśaṃ dhanadasya gṛhādvaram ॥34॥
slp1: sa tatra kAYcanaM divyaM sarvaratnamayaM gfham । dadarSAdButasaNkASaM Danadasya gfhAdvaram ॥34॥

text: mahānto yatra vividhāḥ prāsādāḥ parvatopamāḥ । vimānāni ca ramyāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥35॥
html:
mahānto yatra vividhāḥ prāsādāḥ parvatopamāḥ ।
vimānāni ca ramyāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥35॥
slp1: mahAnto yatra viviDAH prAsAdAH parvatopamAH । vimAnAni ca ramyARi ratnAni viviDAni ca ॥35॥

text: mandārapuṣpaiḥ saṅkīrṇā tathā mandākinī nadī । svayamprabhāśca maṇayo vajrairbhūmiśca bhūṣitā ॥36॥
html:
mandārapuṣpaiḥ saṅkīrṇā tathā mandākinī nadī ।
svayamprabhāśca maṇayo vajrairbhūmiśca bhūṣitā ॥36॥
slp1: mandArapuzpEH saNkIrRA taTA mandAkinI nadI । svayampraBASca maRayo vajrErBUmiSca BUzitA ॥36॥

text: nānāvidhaiśca bhavanairvicitramaṇitoraṇaiḥ । muktājālaparikṣiptairmaṇiratnavibhūṣitaiḥ । manodṛṣṭiharai ramyaiḥ sarvataḥ saṃvṛtaṃ śubhaiḥ ॥37॥
html:
nānāvidhaiśca bhavanairvicitramaṇitoraṇaiḥ ।
muktājālaparikṣiptairmaṇiratnavibhūṣitaiḥ ।
manodṛṣṭiharai ramyaiḥ sarvataḥ saṃvṛtaṃ śubhaiḥ ॥37॥
slp1: nAnAviDESca BavanErvicitramaRitoraREH । muktAjAlaparikziptErmaRiratnaviBUzitEH । manodfzwiharE ramyEH sarvataH saMvftaM SuBEH ॥37॥

text: ṛṣiḥ samantato'paśyattatra tatra manoramam । tato'bhavattasya cintā kva me vāso bhavediti ॥38॥
html:
ṛṣiḥ samantato'paśyattatra tatra manoramam ।
tato'bhavattasya cintā kva me vāso bhavediti ॥38॥
slp1: fziH samantato'paSyattatra tatra manoramam । tato'Bavattasya cintA kva me vAso Bavediti ॥38॥

text: atha dvāraṃ samabhito gatvā sthitvā tato'bravīt । atithiṃ māmanuprāptamanujānantu ye'tra vai ॥39॥
html:
atha dvāraṃ samabhito gatvā sthitvā tato'bravīt ।
atithiṃ māmanuprāptamanujānantu ye'tra vai ॥39॥
slp1: aTa dvAraM samaBito gatvA sTitvA tato'bravIt । atiTiM mAmanuprAptamanujAnantu ye'tra vE ॥39॥

text: atha kanyāparivṛtā gṛhāttasmādviniḥsṛtāḥ । nānārūpāḥ sapta vibho kanyāḥ sarvā manoharāḥ ॥40॥
html:
atha kanyāparivṛtā gṛhāttasmādviniḥsṛtāḥ ।
nānārūpāḥ sapta vibho kanyāḥ sarvā manoharāḥ ॥40॥
slp1: aTa kanyAparivftA gfhAttasmAdviniHsftAH । nAnArUpAH sapta viBo kanyAH sarvA manoharAH ॥40॥

text: yāṃ yāmapaśyatkanyāṃ sa sā sā tasya mano'harat । nāśaknuvaddhārayituṃ mano'thāsyāvasīdati ॥41॥
html:
yāṃ yāmapaśyatkanyāṃ sa sā sā tasya mano'harat ।
nāśaknuvaddhārayituṃ mano'thāsyāvasīdati ॥41॥
slp1: yAM yAmapaSyatkanyAM sa sA sA tasya mano'harat । nASaknuvadDArayituM mano'TAsyAvasIdati ॥41॥

text: tato dhṛtiḥ samutpannā tasya viprasya dhīmataḥ । atha taṃ pramadāḥ prāhurbhagavānpraviśatviti ॥42॥
html:
tato dhṛtiḥ samutpannā tasya viprasya dhīmataḥ ।
atha taṃ pramadāḥ prāhurbhagavānpraviśatviti ॥42॥
slp1: tato DftiH samutpannA tasya viprasya DImataH । aTa taM pramadAH prAhurBagavAnpraviSatviti ॥42॥

text: sa ca tāsāṃ surūpāṇāṃ tasyaiva bhavanasya ca । kautūhalasamāviṣṭaḥ praviveśa gṛhaṃ dvijaḥ ॥43॥
html:
sa ca tāsāṃ surūpāṇāṃ tasyaiva bhavanasya ca ।
kautūhalasamāviṣṭaḥ praviveśa gṛhaṃ dvijaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: sa ca tAsAM surUpARAM tasyEva Bavanasya ca । kOtUhalasamAvizwaH praviveSa gfhaM dvijaH ॥43॥

text: tatrāpaśyajjarāyuktāmarajombaradhāriṇīm । vṛddhāṃ paryaṅkamāsīnāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ॥44॥
html:
tatrāpaśyajjarāyuktāmarajombaradhāriṇīm ।
vṛddhāṃ paryaṅkamāsīnāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ॥44॥
slp1: tatrApaSyajjarAyuktAmarajombaraDAriRIm । vfdDAM paryaNkamAsInAM sarvABaraRaBUzitAm ॥44॥

text: svastīti cātha tenoktā sā strī pratyavadattadā । pratyutthāya ca taṃ vipramāsyatāmityuvāca ha ॥45॥
html:
svastīti cātha tenoktā sā strī pratyavadattadā ।
pratyutthāya ca taṃ vipramāsyatāmityuvāca ha ॥45॥
slp1: svastIti cATa tenoktA sA strI pratyavadattadA । pratyutTAya ca taM vipramAsyatAmityuvAca ha ॥45॥

text: sarvāḥ svānālayānyāntu ekā māmupatiṣṭhatu । suprajñātā supraśāntā śeṣā gacchantu cchandataḥ ॥46॥
html:
sarvāḥ svānālayānyāntu ekā māmupatiṣṭhatu ।
suprajñātā supraśāntā śeṣā gacchantu cchandataḥ ॥46॥
slp1: sarvAH svAnAlayAnyAntu ekA mAmupatizWatu । suprajYAtA supraSAntA SezA gacCantu cCandataH ॥46॥
author: aṣṭāvakra uvāca ।

text: tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya kanyāstāstamṛṣiṃ tadā । nirākrāmangṛhāttasmātsā vṛddhātha vyatiṣṭhata ॥47॥
html:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya kanyāstāstamṛṣiṃ tadā ।
nirākrāmangṛhāttasmātsā vṛddhātha vyatiṣṭhata ॥47॥
slp1: tataH pradakziRIkftya kanyAstAstamfziM tadA । nirAkrAmangfhAttasmAtsA vfdDATa vyatizWata ॥47॥

text: atha tāṃ saṃviśanprāha śayane bhāsvare tadā । tvayāpi supyatāṃ bhadre rajanī hyativartate ॥48॥
html:
atha tāṃ saṃviśanprāha śayane bhāsvare tadā ।
tvayāpi supyatāṃ bhadre rajanī hyativartate ॥48॥
slp1: aTa tAM saMviSanprAha Sayane BAsvare tadA । tvayApi supyatAM Badre rajanI hyativartate ॥48॥

text: saṃlāpāttena vipreṇa tathā sā tatra bhāṣitā । dvitīye śayane divye saṃviveśa mahāprabhe ॥49॥
html:
saṃlāpāttena vipreṇa tathā sā tatra bhāṣitā ।
dvitīye śayane divye saṃviveśa mahāprabhe ॥49॥
slp1: saMlApAttena vipreRa taTA sA tatra BAzitA । dvitIye Sayane divye saMviveSa mahApraBe ॥49॥

text: atha sā vepamānāṅgī nimittaṃ śītajaṃ tadā । vyapadiśya maharṣervai śayanaṃ cādhyarohata ॥50॥
html:
atha sā vepamānāṅgī nimittaṃ śītajaṃ tadā ।
vyapadiśya maharṣervai śayanaṃ cādhyarohata ॥50॥
slp1: aTa sA vepamAnANgI nimittaM SItajaM tadA । vyapadiSya maharzervE SayanaM cADyarohata ॥50॥

text: svāgataṃ svāgatenāstu bhagavāṃstāmabhāṣata । sopāgūhadbhujābhyāṃ tu ṛṣiṃ prītyā nararṣabha ॥51॥
html:
svāgataṃ svāgatenāstu bhagavāṃstāmabhāṣata ।
sopāgūhadbhujābhyāṃ tu ṛṣiṃ prītyā nararṣabha ॥51॥
slp1: svAgataM svAgatenAstu BagavAMstAmaBAzata । sopAgUhadBujAByAM tu fziM prItyA nararzaBa ॥51॥

text: nirvikāramṛṣiṃ cāpi kāṣṭhakuḍyopamaṃ tadā । duḥkhitā prekṣya sañjalpamakārṣīdṛṣiṇā saha ॥52॥
html:
nirvikāramṛṣiṃ cāpi kāṣṭhakuḍyopamaṃ tadā ।
duḥkhitā prekṣya sañjalpamakārṣīdṛṣiṇā saha ॥52॥
slp1: nirvikAramfziM cApi kAzWakuqyopamaM tadA । duHKitA prekzya saYjalpamakArzIdfziRA saha ॥52॥

text: brahmanna kāmakāro'sti strīṇāṃ puruṣato dhṛtiḥ । kāmena mohitā cāhaṃ tvāṃ bhajantīṃ bhajasva mām ॥53॥
html:
brahmanna kāmakāro'sti strīṇāṃ puruṣato dhṛtiḥ ।
kāmena mohitā cāhaṃ tvāṃ bhajantīṃ bhajasva mām ॥53॥
slp1: brahmanna kAmakAro'sti strIRAM puruzato DftiH । kAmena mohitA cAhaM tvAM BajantIM Bajasva mAm ॥53॥

text: prahṛṣṭo bhava viprarṣe samāgaccha mayā saha । upagūha ca māṃ vipra kāmārtāhaṃ bhṛśaṃ tvayi ॥54॥
html:
prahṛṣṭo bhava viprarṣe samāgaccha mayā saha ।
upagūha ca māṃ vipra kāmārtāhaṃ bhṛśaṃ tvayi ॥54॥
slp1: prahfzwo Bava viprarze samAgacCa mayA saha । upagUha ca mAM vipra kAmArtAhaM BfSaM tvayi ॥54॥

text: etaddhi tava dharmātmaṃstapasaḥ pūjyate phalam । prārthitaṃ darśanādeva bhajamānāṃ bhajasva mām ॥55॥
html:
etaddhi tava dharmātmaṃstapasaḥ pūjyate phalam ।
prārthitaṃ darśanādeva bhajamānāṃ bhajasva mām ॥55॥
slp1: etadDi tava DarmAtmaMstapasaH pUjyate Palam । prArTitaM darSanAdeva BajamAnAM Bajasva mAm ॥55॥

text: sadma cedaṃ vanaṃ cedaṃ yaccānyadapi paśyasi । prabhutvaṃ tava sarvatra mayi caiva na saṃśayaḥ ॥56॥
html:
sadma cedaṃ vanaṃ cedaṃ yaccānyadapi paśyasi ।
prabhutvaṃ tava sarvatra mayi caiva na saṃśayaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: sadma cedaM vanaM cedaM yaccAnyadapi paSyasi । praButvaM tava sarvatra mayi cEva na saMSayaH ॥56॥

text: sarvānkāmānvidhāsyāmi ramasva sahito mayā । ramaṇīye vane vipra sarvakāmaphalaprade ॥57॥
html:
sarvānkāmānvidhāsyāmi ramasva sahito mayā ।
ramaṇīye vane vipra sarvakāmaphalaprade ॥57॥
slp1: sarvAnkAmAnviDAsyAmi ramasva sahito mayA । ramaRIye vane vipra sarvakAmaPalaprade ॥57॥

text: tvadvaśāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi raṃsyase ca mayā saha । sarvānkāmānupāśnāno ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ॥58॥
html:
tvadvaśāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi raṃsyase ca mayā saha ।
sarvānkāmānupāśnāno ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ॥58॥
slp1: tvadvaSAhaM BavizyAmi raMsyase ca mayA saha । sarvAnkAmAnupASnAno ye divyA ye ca mAnuzAH ॥58॥

text: nātaḥ paraṃ hi nārīṇāṃ kāryaṃ kiñcana vidyate । yathā puruṣasaṃsargaḥ parametaddhi naḥ phalam ॥59॥
html:
nātaḥ paraṃ hi nārīṇāṃ kāryaṃ kiñcana vidyate ।
yathā puruṣasaṃsargaḥ parametaddhi naḥ phalam ॥59॥
slp1: nAtaH paraM hi nArIRAM kAryaM kiYcana vidyate । yaTA puruzasaMsargaH parametadDi naH Palam ॥59॥

text: ātmacchandena vartante nāryo manmathacoditāḥ । na ca dahyanti gacchantyaḥ sutaptairapi pāṃsubhiḥ ॥60॥
html:
ātmacchandena vartante nāryo manmathacoditāḥ ।
na ca dahyanti gacchantyaḥ sutaptairapi pāṃsubhiḥ ॥60॥
slp1: AtmacCandena vartante nAryo manmaTacoditAH । na ca dahyanti gacCantyaH sutaptErapi pAMsuBiH ॥60॥

text: paradārānahaṃ bhadre na gaccheyaṃ kathañcana । dūṣitaṃ dharmaśāstreṣu paradārābhimarśanam ॥61॥
html:
paradārānahaṃ bhadre na gaccheyaṃ kathañcana ।
dūṣitaṃ dharmaśāstreṣu paradārābhimarśanam ॥61॥
slp1: paradArAnahaM Badre na gacCeyaM kaTaYcana । dUzitaM DarmaSAstrezu paradArABimarSanam ॥61॥
author: aṣṭāvakra uvāca ।

text: bhadre niveṣṭukāmaṃ māṃ viddhi satyena vai śape । viṣayeṣvanabhijño'haṃ dharmārthaṃ kila santatiḥ ॥62॥
html:
bhadre niveṣṭukāmaṃ māṃ viddhi satyena vai śape ।
viṣayeṣvanabhijño'haṃ dharmārthaṃ kila santatiḥ ॥62॥
slp1: Badre nivezwukAmaM mAM vidDi satyena vE Sape । vizayezvanaBijYo'haM DarmArTaM kila santatiH ॥62॥

text: evaṃ lokāngamiṣyāmi putrairiti na saṃśayaḥ । bhadre dharmaṃ vijānīṣva jñātvā coparamasva ha ॥63॥
html:
evaṃ lokāngamiṣyāmi putrairiti na saṃśayaḥ ।
bhadre dharmaṃ vijānīṣva jñātvā coparamasva ha ॥63॥
slp1: evaM lokAngamizyAmi putrEriti na saMSayaH । Badre DarmaM vijAnIzva jYAtvA coparamasva ha ॥63॥

text: nānilo'gnirna varuṇo na cānye tridaśā dvija । priyāḥ strīṇāṃ yathā kāmo ratiśīlā hi yoṣitaḥ ॥64॥
html:
nānilo'gnirna varuṇo na cānye tridaśā dvija ।
priyāḥ strīṇāṃ yathā kāmo ratiśīlā hi yoṣitaḥ ॥64॥
slp1: nAnilo'gnirna varuRo na cAnye tridaSA dvija । priyAH strIRAM yaTA kAmo ratiSIlA hi yozitaH ॥64॥
author: stryuvāca ।

text: sahasraikā yatā nārī prāpnotīha kadācana । tathā śatasahasreṣu yadi kācitpativratā ॥65॥
html:
sahasraikā yatā nārī prāpnotīha kadācana ।
tathā śatasahasreṣu yadi kācitpativratā ॥65॥
slp1: sahasrEkA yatA nArI prApnotIha kadAcana । taTA Satasahasrezu yadi kAcitpativratA ॥65॥

text: naitā jānanti pitaraṃ na kulaṃ na ca mātaram । na bhrātṝnna ca bhartāraṃ na putrānna ca devarān ॥66॥
html:
naitā jānanti pitaraṃ na kulaṃ na ca mātaram ।
na bhrātṝnna ca bhartāraṃ na putrānna ca devarān ॥66॥
slp1: nEtA jAnanti pitaraM na kulaM na ca mAtaram । na BrAtFnna ca BartAraM na putrAnna ca devarAn ॥66॥

text: līlāyantyaḥ kulaṃ ghnanti kūlānīva saridvarāḥ । doṣāṃśca mandānmandāsu prajāpatirabhāṣata ॥67॥
html:
līlāyantyaḥ kulaṃ ghnanti kūlānīva saridvarāḥ ।
doṣāṃśca mandānmandāsu prajāpatirabhāṣata ॥67॥
slp1: lIlAyantyaH kulaM Gnanti kUlAnIva saridvarAH । dozAMSca mandAnmandAsu prajApatiraBAzata ॥67॥

text: tataḥ sa ṛṣirekāgrastāṃ striyaṃ pratyabhāṣata । āsyatāṃ ruciraṃ chandaḥ kiṃ vā kāryaṃ bravīhi me ॥68॥
html:
tataḥ sa ṛṣirekāgrastāṃ striyaṃ pratyabhāṣata ।
āsyatāṃ ruciraṃ chandaḥ kiṃ vā kāryaṃ bravīhi me ॥68॥
slp1: tataH sa fzirekAgrastAM striyaM pratyaBAzata । AsyatAM ruciraM CandaH kiM vA kAryaM bravIhi me ॥68॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sā strī provāca bhagavandrakṣyase deśakālataḥ । vasa tāvanmahāprājña kṛtakṛtyo gamiṣyasi ॥69॥
html:
sā strī provāca bhagavandrakṣyase deśakālataḥ ।
vasa tāvanmahāprājña kṛtakṛtyo gamiṣyasi ॥69॥
slp1: sA strI provAca Bagavandrakzyase deSakAlataH । vasa tAvanmahAprAjYa kftakftyo gamizyasi ॥69॥

text: brahmarṣistāmathovāca sa tatheti yudhiṣṭhira । vatsye'haṃ yāvadutsāho bhavatyā nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥70॥
html:
brahmarṣistāmathovāca sa tatheti yudhiṣṭhira ।
vatsye'haṃ yāvadutsāho bhavatyā nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥70॥
slp1: brahmarzistAmaTovAca sa taTeti yuDizWira । vatsye'haM yAvadutsAho BavatyA nAtra saMSayaH ॥70॥

text: atharṣirabhisamprekṣya striyaṃ tāṃ jarayānvitām । cintāṃ paramikāṃ bheje santapta iva cābhavat ॥71॥
html:
atharṣirabhisamprekṣya striyaṃ tāṃ jarayānvitām ।
cintāṃ paramikāṃ bheje santapta iva cābhavat ॥71॥
slp1: aTarziraBisamprekzya striyaM tAM jarayAnvitAm । cintAM paramikAM Beje santapta iva cABavat ॥71॥

text: yadyadaṅgaṃ hi so'paśyattasyā viprarṣabhastadā । nāramattatra tatrāsya dṛṣṭī rūpaparājitā ॥72॥
html:
yadyadaṅgaṃ hi so'paśyattasyā viprarṣabhastadā ।
nāramattatra tatrāsya dṛṣṭī rūpaparājitā ॥72॥
slp1: yadyadaNgaM hi so'paSyattasyA viprarzaBastadA । nAramattatra tatrAsya dfzwI rUpaparAjitA ॥72॥

text: devateyaṃ gṛhasyāsya śāpānnūnaṃ virūpitā । asyāśca kāraṇaṃ vettuṃ na yuktaṃ sahasā mayā ॥73॥
html:
devateyaṃ gṛhasyāsya śāpānnūnaṃ virūpitā ।
asyāśca kāraṇaṃ vettuṃ na yuktaṃ sahasā mayā ॥73॥
slp1: devateyaM gfhasyAsya SApAnnUnaM virUpitA । asyASca kAraRaM vettuM na yuktaM sahasA mayA ॥73॥

text: iti cintāviṣaktasya tamarthaṃ jñātumicchataḥ । vyagamattadahaḥśeṣaṃ manasā vyākulena tu ॥74॥
html:
iti cintāviṣaktasya tamarthaṃ jñātumicchataḥ ।
vyagamattadahaḥśeṣaṃ manasā vyākulena tu ॥74॥
slp1: iti cintAvizaktasya tamarTaM jYAtumicCataH । vyagamattadahaHSezaM manasA vyAkulena tu ॥74॥

text: atha sā strī tadovāca bhagavanpaśya vai raveḥ । rūpaṃ sandhyābhrasaṃyuktaṃ kimupasthāpyatāṃ tava ॥75॥
html:
atha sā strī tadovāca bhagavanpaśya vai raveḥ ।
rūpaṃ sandhyābhrasaṃyuktaṃ kimupasthāpyatāṃ tava ॥75॥
slp1: aTa sA strI tadovAca BagavanpaSya vE raveH । rUpaM sanDyABrasaMyuktaM kimupasTApyatAM tava ॥75॥

text: sa uvāca tadā tāṃ strīṃ snānodakamihānaya । upāsiṣye tataḥ sandhyāṃ vāgyato niyatendriyaḥ] ॥76॥
html:
sa uvāca tadā tāṃ strīṃ snānodakamihānaya ।
upāsiṣye tataḥ sandhyāṃ vāgyato niyatendriyaḥ] ॥76॥
slp1: sa uvAca tadA tAM strIM snAnodakamihAnaya । upAsizye tataH sanDyAM vAgyato niyatendriyaH] ॥76॥

text: atha sā strī tamuktvā tu vipramevaṃ bhavatviti । tailaṃ divyamupādāya snānaśāṭīmupānayat ॥1॥
html:
atha sā strī tamuktvā tu vipramevaṃ bhavatviti ।
tailaṃ divyamupādāya snānaśāṭīmupānayat ॥1॥
slp1: aTa sA strI tamuktvA tu vipramevaM Bavatviti । tElaM divyamupAdAya snAnaSAwImupAnayat ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।
