text: anujñātā ca muninā sā strī tena mahātmanā । athāsya tailenāṅgāni sarvāṇyevābhyamṛkṣayat ॥2॥
html:
anujñātā ca muninā sā strī tena mahātmanā ।
athāsya tailenāṅgāni sarvāṇyevābhyamṛkṣayat ॥2॥
slp1: anujYAtA ca muninA sA strI tena mahAtmanA । aTAsya tElenANgAni sarvARyevAByamfkzayat ॥2॥

text: śanaiścotsāditastatra snānaśālāmupāgamat । bhadrāsanaṃ tataścitraṃ ṛṣiranvāviśannavam ॥3॥
html:
śanaiścotsāditastatra snānaśālāmupāgamat ।
bhadrāsanaṃ tataścitraṃ ṛṣiranvāviśannavam ॥3॥
slp1: SanEScotsAditastatra snAnaSAlAmupAgamat । BadrAsanaM tataScitraM fziranvAviSannavam ॥3॥

text: athopaviṣṭaśca yadā tasminbhadrāsane tadā । snāpayāmāsa śanakaistamṛṣiṃ sukhahastavat । divyaṃ ca vidhivaccakre sopacāraṃ munestadā ॥4॥
html:
athopaviṣṭaśca yadā tasminbhadrāsane tadā ।
snāpayāmāsa śanakaistamṛṣiṃ sukhahastavat ।
divyaṃ ca vidhivaccakre sopacāraṃ munestadā ॥4॥
slp1: aTopavizwaSca yadA tasminBadrAsane tadA । snApayAmAsa SanakEstamfziM suKahastavat । divyaM ca viDivaccakre sopacAraM munestadA ॥4॥

text: sa tena susukhoṣṇena tasyā hastasukhena ca । vyatītāṃ rajanīṃ kṛtsnāṃ nājānātsa mahāvrataḥ ॥5॥
html:
sa tena susukhoṣṇena tasyā hastasukhena ca ।
vyatītāṃ rajanīṃ kṛtsnāṃ nājānātsa mahāvrataḥ ॥5॥
slp1: sa tena susuKozRena tasyA hastasuKena ca । vyatItAM rajanIM kftsnAM nAjAnAtsa mahAvrataH ॥5॥

text: tata utthāya sa munistadā paramavismitaḥ । pūrvasyāṃ diśi sūryaṃ ca so'paśyaduditaṃ divi ॥6॥
html:
tata utthāya sa munistadā paramavismitaḥ ।
pūrvasyāṃ diśi sūryaṃ ca so'paśyaduditaṃ divi ॥6॥
slp1: tata utTAya sa munistadA paramavismitaH । pUrvasyAM diSi sUryaM ca so'paSyaduditaM divi ॥6॥

text: tasya buddhiriyaṃ kiṃ nu mohastattvamidaṃ bhavet । athopāsya sahasrāṃśuṃ kiṃ karomītyuvāca tām ॥7॥
html:
tasya buddhiriyaṃ kiṃ nu mohastattvamidaṃ bhavet ।
athopāsya sahasrāṃśuṃ kiṃ karomītyuvāca tām ॥7॥
slp1: tasya budDiriyaM kiM nu mohastattvamidaM Bavet । aTopAsya sahasrAMSuM kiM karomItyuvAca tAm ॥7॥

text: sā cāmṛtarasaprakhyamṛṣerannamupāharat । tasya svādutayānnasya na prabhūtaṃ cakāra saḥ । vyagamaccāpyahaḥśeṣaṃ tataḥ sandhyāgamatpunaḥ ॥8॥
html:
sā cāmṛtarasaprakhyamṛṣerannamupāharat ।
tasya svādutayānnasya na prabhūtaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
vyagamaccāpyahaḥśeṣaṃ tataḥ sandhyāgamatpunaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: sA cAmftarasapraKyamfzerannamupAharat । tasya svAdutayAnnasya na praBUtaM cakAra saH । vyagamaccApyahaHSezaM tataH sanDyAgamatpunaH ॥8॥

text: atha strī bhagavantaṃ sā supyatāmityacodayat । tatra vai śayane divye tasya tasyāśca kalpite ॥9॥
html:
atha strī bhagavantaṃ sā supyatāmityacodayat ।
tatra vai śayane divye tasya tasyāśca kalpite ॥9॥
slp1: aTa strI BagavantaM sA supyatAmityacodayat । tatra vE Sayane divye tasya tasyASca kalpite ॥9॥

text: na bhadre paradāreṣu mano me samprasajjati । uttiṣṭha bhadre bhadraṃ te svapa vai viramasva ca ॥10॥
html:
na bhadre paradāreṣu mano me samprasajjati ।
uttiṣṭha bhadre bhadraṃ te svapa vai viramasva ca ॥10॥
slp1: na Badre paradArezu mano me samprasajjati । uttizWa Badre BadraM te svapa vE viramasva ca ॥10॥
author: aṣṭāvakra uvāca ।

text: sā tadā tena vipreṇa tathā dhṛtyā nivartitā । svatantrāsmītyuvācainaṃ na dharmacchalamasti te ॥11॥
html:
sā tadā tena vipreṇa tathā dhṛtyā nivartitā ।
svatantrāsmītyuvācainaṃ na dharmacchalamasti te ॥11॥
slp1: sA tadA tena vipreRa taTA DftyA nivartitA । svatantrAsmItyuvAcEnaM na DarmacCalamasti te ॥11॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: nāsti svatantratā strīṇāmasvatantrā hi yoṣitaḥ । prajāpatimataṃ hyetanna strī svātantryamarhati ॥12॥
html:
nāsti svatantratā strīṇāmasvatantrā hi yoṣitaḥ ।
prajāpatimataṃ hyetanna strī svātantryamarhati ॥12॥
slp1: nAsti svatantratA strIRAmasvatantrA hi yozitaH । prajApatimataM hyetanna strI svAtantryamarhati ॥12॥
author: aṣṭāvakra uvāca ।

text: bādhate maithunaṃ vipra mama bhaktiṃ ca paśya vai । adharmaṃ prāpsyase vipra yanmāṃ tvaṃ nābhinandasi ॥13॥
html:
bādhate maithunaṃ vipra mama bhaktiṃ ca paśya vai ।
adharmaṃ prāpsyase vipra yanmāṃ tvaṃ nābhinandasi ॥13॥
slp1: bADate mETunaM vipra mama BaktiM ca paSya vE । aDarmaM prApsyase vipra yanmAM tvaM nABinandasi ॥13॥
author: stryuvāca ।

text: haranti doṣajātāni naraṃ jātaṃ yathecchakam । prabhavāmi sadā dhṛtyā bhadre svaṃ śayanaṃ vraja ॥14॥
html:
haranti doṣajātāni naraṃ jātaṃ yathecchakam ।
prabhavāmi sadā dhṛtyā bhadre svaṃ śayanaṃ vraja ॥14॥
slp1: haranti dozajAtAni naraM jAtaM yaTecCakam । praBavAmi sadA DftyA Badre svaM SayanaM vraja ॥14॥
author: aṣṭāvakra uvāca ।

text: śirasā praṇame vipra prasādaṃ kartumarhasi । bhūmau nipatamānāyāḥ śaraṇaṃ bhava me'nagha ॥15॥
html:
śirasā praṇame vipra prasādaṃ kartumarhasi ।
bhūmau nipatamānāyāḥ śaraṇaṃ bhava me'nagha ॥15॥
slp1: SirasA praRame vipra prasAdaM kartumarhasi । BUmO nipatamAnAyAH SaraRaM Bava me'naGa ॥15॥
author: stryuvāca ।

text: yadi vā doṣajātaṃ tvaṃ paradāreṣu paśyasi । ātmānaṃ sparśayāmyadya pāṇiṃ gṛhṇīṣva me dvija ॥16॥
html:
yadi vā doṣajātaṃ tvaṃ paradāreṣu paśyasi ।
ātmānaṃ sparśayāmyadya pāṇiṃ gṛhṇīṣva me dvija ॥16॥
slp1: yadi vA dozajAtaM tvaM paradArezu paSyasi । AtmAnaM sparSayAmyadya pARiM gfhRIzva me dvija ॥16॥

text: na doṣo bhavitā caiva satyenaitadbravīmyaham । svatantrāṃ māṃ vijānīhi yo'dharmaḥ so'stu vai mayi ॥17॥
html:
na doṣo bhavitā caiva satyenaitadbravīmyaham ।
svatantrāṃ māṃ vijānīhi yo'dharmaḥ so'stu vai mayi ॥17॥
slp1: na dozo BavitA cEva satyenEtadbravImyaham । svatantrAM mAM vijAnIhi yo'DarmaH so'stu vE mayi ॥17॥

text: svatantrā tvaṃ kathaṃ bhadre brūhi kāraṇamatra vai । nāsti loke hi kācitstrī yā vai svātantryamarhati ॥18॥
html:
svatantrā tvaṃ kathaṃ bhadre brūhi kāraṇamatra vai ।
nāsti loke hi kācitstrī yā vai svātantryamarhati ॥18॥
slp1: svatantrA tvaM kaTaM Badre brUhi kAraRamatra vE । nAsti loke hi kAcitstrI yA vE svAtantryamarhati ॥18॥
author: aṣṭāvakra uvāca ।

text: pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane । putrāśca sthavirībhāve na strī svātantryamarhati ॥19॥
html:
pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane ।
putrāśca sthavirībhāve na strī svātantryamarhati ॥19॥
slp1: pitA rakzati kOmAre BartA rakzati yOvane । putrASca sTavirIBAve na strI svAtantryamarhati ॥19॥

text: kaumāraṃ brahmacaryaṃ me kanyaivāsmi na saṃśayaḥ । kuru mā vimatiṃ vipra śraddhāṃ vijahi mā mama ॥20॥
html:
kaumāraṃ brahmacaryaṃ me kanyaivāsmi na saṃśayaḥ ।
kuru mā vimatiṃ vipra śraddhāṃ vijahi mā mama ॥20॥
slp1: kOmAraM brahmacaryaM me kanyEvAsmi na saMSayaH । kuru mA vimatiM vipra SradDAM vijahi mA mama ॥20॥
author: stryuvāca ।

text: yathā mama tathā tubhyaṃ yathā tava tathā mama । jijñāseyamṛṣestasya vighnaḥ satyaṃ nu kiṃ bhavet ॥21॥
html:
yathā mama tathā tubhyaṃ yathā tava tathā mama ।
jijñāseyamṛṣestasya vighnaḥ satyaṃ nu kiṃ bhavet ॥21॥
slp1: yaTA mama taTA tuByaM yaTA tava taTA mama । jijYAseyamfzestasya viGnaH satyaM nu kiM Bavet ॥21॥
author: aṣṭāvakra uvāca ।

text: āścaryaṃ paramaṃ hīdaṃ kiṃ nu śreyo hi me bhavet । divyābharaṇavastrā hi kanyeyaṃ māmupasthitā ॥22॥
html:
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ hīdaṃ kiṃ nu śreyo hi me bhavet ।
divyābharaṇavastrā hi kanyeyaṃ māmupasthitā ॥22॥
slp1: AScaryaM paramaM hIdaM kiM nu Sreyo hi me Bavet । divyABaraRavastrA hi kanyeyaM mAmupasTitA ॥22॥

text: kiṃ tvasyāḥ paramaṃ rūpaṃ jīrṇamāsītkathaṃ punaḥ । kanyārūpamihādyaiva kimihātrottaraṃ bhavet ॥23॥
html:
kiṃ tvasyāḥ paramaṃ rūpaṃ jīrṇamāsītkathaṃ punaḥ ।
kanyārūpamihādyaiva kimihātrottaraṃ bhavet ॥23॥
slp1: kiM tvasyAH paramaM rUpaM jIrRamAsItkaTaM punaH । kanyArUpamihAdyEva kimihAtrottaraM Bavet ॥23॥

text: yathā paraṃ śaktidhṛterna vyutthāsye kathañcana । na rocaye hi vyutthānaṃ dhṛtyaivaṃ sādhayāmyaham] ॥24॥
html:
yathā paraṃ śaktidhṛterna vyutthāsye kathañcana ।
na rocaye hi vyutthānaṃ dhṛtyaivaṃ sādhayāmyaham] ॥24॥
slp1: yaTA paraM SaktiDfterna vyutTAsye kaTaYcana । na rocaye hi vyutTAnaM DftyEvaM sADayAmyaham] ॥24॥

text: na bibheti kathaṃ sā strī śāpasya paramadyuteḥ । kathaṃ nivṛtto bhagavāṃstadbhavānprabravītu me ॥1॥
html:
na bibheti kathaṃ sā strī śāpasya paramadyuteḥ ।
kathaṃ nivṛtto bhagavāṃstadbhavānprabravītu me ॥1॥
slp1: na biBeti kaTaM sA strI SApasya paramadyuteH । kaTaM nivftto BagavAMstadBavAnprabravItu me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: aṣṭāvakro'nvapṛcchattāṃ rūpaṃ vikuruṣe katham । na cānṛtaṃ te vaktavyaṃ brūhi brāhmaṇakāmyayā ॥2॥
html:
aṣṭāvakro'nvapṛcchattāṃ rūpaṃ vikuruṣe katham ।
na cānṛtaṃ te vaktavyaṃ brūhi brāhmaṇakāmyayā ॥2॥
slp1: azwAvakro'nvapfcCattAM rUpaM vikuruze kaTam । na cAnftaM te vaktavyaM brUhi brAhmaRakAmyayA ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dyāvāpṛthivīmātraiṣā kāmyā brāhmaṇasattama । śṛṇuṣvāvahitaḥ sarvaṃ yadidaṃ satyavikrama ॥3॥
html:
dyāvāpṛthivīmātraiṣā kāmyā brāhmaṇasattama ।
śṛṇuṣvāvahitaḥ sarvaṃ yadidaṃ satyavikrama ॥3॥
slp1: dyAvApfTivImAtrEzA kAmyA brAhmaRasattama । SfRuzvAvahitaH sarvaM yadidaM satyavikrama ॥3॥
author: stryuvāca ।

text: uttarāṃ māṃ diśaṃ viddhi dṛṣṭaṃ strīcāpalaṃ ca te । avyutthānena te lokā jitāḥ satyaparākrama ॥4॥
html:
uttarāṃ māṃ diśaṃ viddhi dṛṣṭaṃ strīcāpalaṃ ca te ।
avyutthānena te lokā jitāḥ satyaparākrama ॥4॥
slp1: uttarAM mAM diSaM vidDi dfzwaM strIcApalaM ca te । avyutTAnena te lokA jitAH satyaparAkrama ॥4॥

text: jijñāseyaṃ prayuktā me sthirīkartuṃ tavānagha । sthavirāṇāmapi strīṇāṃ bādhate maithunajvaraḥ ॥5॥
html:
jijñāseyaṃ prayuktā me sthirīkartuṃ tavānagha ।
sthavirāṇāmapi strīṇāṃ bādhate maithunajvaraḥ ॥5॥
slp1: jijYAseyaM prayuktA me sTirIkartuM tavAnaGa । sTavirARAmapi strIRAM bADate mETunajvaraH ॥5॥

text: tuṣṭaḥ pitāmahaste'dya tathā devāḥ savāsavāḥ । sa tvaṃ yena ca kāryeṇa samprāpto bhagavāniha ॥6॥
html:
tuṣṭaḥ pitāmahaste'dya tathā devāḥ savāsavāḥ ।
sa tvaṃ yena ca kāryeṇa samprāpto bhagavāniha ॥6॥
slp1: tuzwaH pitAmahaste'dya taTA devAH savAsavAH । sa tvaM yena ca kAryeRa samprApto BagavAniha ॥6॥

text: preṣitastena vipreṇa kanyāpitrā dvijarṣabha । tavopadeśaṃ kartuṃ vai tacca sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ॥7॥
html:
preṣitastena vipreṇa kanyāpitrā dvijarṣabha ।
tavopadeśaṃ kartuṃ vai tacca sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ॥7॥
slp1: prezitastena vipreRa kanyApitrA dvijarzaBa । tavopadeSaM kartuM vE tacca sarvaM kftaM mayA ॥7॥

text: kṣemī gamiṣyasi gṛhāñśramaśca na bhaviṣyati । kanyāṃ prāpsyasi tāṃ vipra putriṇī ca bhaviṣyati ॥8॥
html:
kṣemī gamiṣyasi gṛhāñśramaśca na bhaviṣyati ।
kanyāṃ prāpsyasi tāṃ vipra putriṇī ca bhaviṣyati ॥8॥
slp1: kzemI gamizyasi gfhAYSramaSca na Bavizyati । kanyAM prApsyasi tAM vipra putriRI ca Bavizyati ॥8॥

text: kāmyayā pṛṣṭavāṃstvaṃ māṃ tato vyāhṛtamuttaram । anatikramaṇīyaiṣā kṛtsnairlokaistribhiḥ sadā ॥9॥
html:
kāmyayā pṛṣṭavāṃstvaṃ māṃ tato vyāhṛtamuttaram ।
anatikramaṇīyaiṣā kṛtsnairlokaistribhiḥ sadā ॥9॥
slp1: kAmyayA pfzwavAMstvaM mAM tato vyAhftamuttaram । anatikramaRIyEzA kftsnErlokEstriBiH sadA ॥9॥

text: gacchasva sukṛtaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ vānyacchrotumicchasi । yāvadbravīmi viprarṣe aṣṭāvakra yathātatham ॥10॥
html:
gacchasva sukṛtaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ vānyacchrotumicchasi ।
yāvadbravīmi viprarṣe aṣṭāvakra yathātatham ॥10॥
slp1: gacCasva sukftaM kftvA kiM vAnyacCrotumicCasi । yAvadbravImi viprarze azwAvakra yaTAtaTam ॥10॥

text: ṛṣiṇā prasāditā cāsmi tava hetordvijarṣabha । tasya sammānanārthaṃ me tvayi vākyaṃ prabhāṣitam ॥11॥
html:
ṛṣiṇā prasāditā cāsmi tava hetordvijarṣabha ।
tasya sammānanārthaṃ me tvayi vākyaṃ prabhāṣitam ॥11॥
slp1: fziRA prasAditA cAsmi tava hetordvijarzaBa । tasya sammAnanArTaM me tvayi vAkyaM praBAzitam ॥11॥

text: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasyāḥ sa vipraḥ prāñjaliḥ sthitaḥ । anujñātastayā cāpi svagṛhaṃ punarāvrajat ॥12॥
html:
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasyāḥ sa vipraḥ prāñjaliḥ sthitaḥ ।
anujñātastayā cāpi svagṛhaṃ punarāvrajat ॥12॥
slp1: SrutvA tu vacanaM tasyAH sa vipraH prAYjaliH sTitaH । anujYAtastayA cApi svagfhaM punarAvrajat ॥12॥

text: gṛhamāgamya viśrāntaḥ svajanaṃ pratipūjya ca । abhyagacchata taṃ vipraṃ nyāyataḥ kurunandana ॥13॥
html:
gṛhamāgamya viśrāntaḥ svajanaṃ pratipūjya ca ।
abhyagacchata taṃ vipraṃ nyāyataḥ kurunandana ॥13॥
slp1: gfhamAgamya viSrAntaH svajanaM pratipUjya ca । aByagacCata taM vipraM nyAyataH kurunandana ॥13॥

text: pṛṣṭaśca tena vipreṇa dṛṣṭaṃ tvetannidarśanam । prāha vipraṃ tadā vipraḥ suprītenāntarātmanā ॥14॥
html:
pṛṣṭaśca tena vipreṇa dṛṣṭaṃ tvetannidarśanam ।
prāha vipraṃ tadā vipraḥ suprītenāntarātmanā ॥14॥
slp1: pfzwaSca tena vipreRa dfzwaM tvetannidarSanam । prAha vipraM tadA vipraH suprItenAntarAtmanA ॥14॥

text: bhavatāhamanujñātaḥ prasthito gandhamādanam । tasya cottarato deśe dṛṣṭaṃ taddaivataṃ mahat ॥15॥
html:
bhavatāhamanujñātaḥ prasthito gandhamādanam ।
tasya cottarato deśe dṛṣṭaṃ taddaivataṃ mahat ॥15॥
slp1: BavatAhamanujYAtaH prasTito ganDamAdanam । tasya cottarato deSe dfzwaM taddEvataM mahat ॥15॥

text: tayā cāhamanujñāto bhavāṃścāpi prakīrtitaḥ । śrāvitaścāpi tadvākyaṃ gṛhamabhyāgataḥ prabho ॥16॥
html:
tayā cāhamanujñāto bhavāṃścāpi prakīrtitaḥ ।
śrāvitaścāpi tadvākyaṃ gṛhamabhyāgataḥ prabho ॥16॥
slp1: tayA cAhamanujYAto BavAMScApi prakIrtitaH । SrAvitaScApi tadvAkyaM gfhamaByAgataH praBo ॥16॥

text: tamuvāca tato vipraḥ pratigṛhṇīṣva me sutām । nakṣatratithisaṃyoge pātraṃ hi paramaṃ bhavān ॥17॥
html:
tamuvāca tato vipraḥ pratigṛhṇīṣva me sutām ।
nakṣatratithisaṃyoge pātraṃ hi paramaṃ bhavān ॥17॥
slp1: tamuvAca tato vipraH pratigfhRIzva me sutAm । nakzatratiTisaMyoge pAtraM hi paramaM BavAn ॥17॥

text: aṣṭāvakrastathetyuktvā pratigṛhya ca tāṃ prabho । kanyāṃ paramadharmātmā prītimāṃścābhavattadā ॥18॥
html:
aṣṭāvakrastathetyuktvā pratigṛhya ca tāṃ prabho ।
kanyāṃ paramadharmātmā prītimāṃścābhavattadā ॥18॥
slp1: azwAvakrastaTetyuktvA pratigfhya ca tAM praBo । kanyAM paramaDarmAtmA prItimAMScABavattadA ॥18॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kanyāṃ tāṃ pratigṛhyaiva bhāryāṃ paramaśobhanām । uvāsa muditastatra āśrame sve gatajvaraḥ] ॥19॥
html:
kanyāṃ tāṃ pratigṛhyaiva bhāryāṃ paramaśobhanām ।
uvāsa muditastatra āśrame sve gatajvaraḥ] ॥19॥
slp1: kanyAM tAM pratigfhyEva BAryAM paramaSoBanAm । uvAsa muditastatra ASrame sve gatajvaraH] ॥19॥

text: kimāhurbharataśreṣṭha pātraṃ viprāḥ sanātanam । brāhmaṇaṃ liṅginaṃ caiva brāhmaṇaṃ vāpyaliṅginam ॥1॥
html:
kimāhurbharataśreṣṭha pātraṃ viprāḥ sanātanam ।
brāhmaṇaṃ liṅginaṃ caiva brāhmaṇaṃ vāpyaliṅginam ॥1॥
slp1: kimAhurBarataSrezWa pAtraM viprAH sanAtanam । brAhmaRaM liNginaM cEva brAhmaRaM vApyaliNginam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: svavṛttimabhipannāya liṅgine vetarāya vā । deyamāhurmahārāja ubhāvetau tapasvinau ॥2॥
html:
svavṛttimabhipannāya liṅgine vetarāya vā ।
deyamāhurmahārāja ubhāvetau tapasvinau ॥2॥
slp1: svavfttimaBipannAya liNgine vetarAya vA । deyamAhurmahArAja uBAvetO tapasvinO ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śraddhayā parayā pūto yaḥ prayaccheddvijātaye । havyaṃ kavyaṃ tathā dānaṃ ko doṣaḥ syātpitāmaha ॥3॥
html:
śraddhayā parayā pūto yaḥ prayaccheddvijātaye ।
havyaṃ kavyaṃ tathā dānaṃ ko doṣaḥ syātpitāmaha ॥3॥
slp1: SradDayA parayA pUto yaH prayacCeddvijAtaye । havyaM kavyaM taTA dAnaM ko dozaH syAtpitAmaha ॥3॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śraddhāpūto narastāta durdānto'pi na saṃśayaḥ । pūto bhavati sarvatra kiṃ punastvaṃ mahīpate ॥4॥
html:
śraddhāpūto narastāta durdānto'pi na saṃśayaḥ ।
pūto bhavati sarvatra kiṃ punastvaṃ mahīpate ॥4॥
slp1: SradDApUto narastAta durdAnto'pi na saMSayaH । pUto Bavati sarvatra kiM punastvaM mahIpate ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: na brāhmaṇaṃ parīkṣeta daiveṣu satataṃ naraḥ । kavyapradāne tu budhāḥ parīkṣyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥5॥
html:
na brāhmaṇaṃ parīkṣeta daiveṣu satataṃ naraḥ ।
kavyapradāne tu budhāḥ parīkṣyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ ॥5॥
slp1: na brAhmaRaM parIkzeta dEvezu satataM naraH । kavyapradAne tu buDAH parIkzyaM brAhmaRaM viduH ॥5॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: na brāhmaṇaḥ sādhayate havyaṃ daivātprasidhyati । devaprasādādijyante yajamānā na saṃśayaḥ ॥6॥
html:
na brāhmaṇaḥ sādhayate havyaṃ daivātprasidhyati ।
devaprasādādijyante yajamānā na saṃśayaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: na brAhmaRaH sADayate havyaM dEvAtprasiDyati । devaprasAdAdijyante yajamAnA na saMSayaH ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇā bharataśreṣṭha satataṃ brahmavādinaḥ । mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purā prāha iha lokeṣu buddhimān ॥7॥
html:
brāhmaṇā bharataśreṣṭha satataṃ brahmavādinaḥ ।
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purā prāha iha lokeṣu buddhimān ॥7॥
slp1: brAhmaRA BarataSrezWa satataM brahmavAdinaH । mArkaRqeyaH purA prAha iha lokezu budDimAn ॥7॥

text: apūrvo'pyatha vā vidvānsambandhī vātha yo bhavet । tapasvī yajñaśīlo vā kathaṃ pātraṃ bhavettu saḥ ॥8॥
html:
apūrvo'pyatha vā vidvānsambandhī vātha yo bhavet ।
tapasvī yajñaśīlo vā kathaṃ pātraṃ bhavettu saḥ ॥8॥
slp1: apUrvo'pyaTa vA vidvAnsambanDI vATa yo Bavet । tapasvI yajYaSIlo vA kaTaM pAtraM Bavettu saH ॥8॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kulīnaḥ karmakṛdvaidyastathā cāpyānṛśaṃsyavān । hrīmānṛjuḥ satyavādī pātraṃ pūrve ca te trayaḥ ॥9॥
html:
kulīnaḥ karmakṛdvaidyastathā cāpyānṛśaṃsyavān ।
hrīmānṛjuḥ satyavādī pātraṃ pūrve ca te trayaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: kulInaH karmakfdvEdyastaTA cApyAnfSaMsyavAn । hrImAnfjuH satyavAdI pAtraM pUrve ca te trayaH ॥9॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tatredaṃ śṛṇu me pārtha caturṇāṃ tejasāṃ matam । pṛthivyāḥ kāśyapasyāgnermārkaṇḍeyasya caiva hi ॥10॥
html:
tatredaṃ śṛṇu me pārtha caturṇāṃ tejasāṃ matam ।
pṛthivyāḥ kāśyapasyāgnermārkaṇḍeyasya caiva hi ॥10॥
slp1: tatredaM SfRu me pArTa caturRAM tejasAM matam । pfTivyAH kASyapasyAgnermArkaRqeyasya cEva hi ॥10॥

text: yathā mahārṇave kṣiptaḥ kṣipraṃ loṣṭo vinaśyati । tathā duścaritaṃ sarvaṃ trayyāvṛttyā vinaśyati ॥11॥
html:
yathā mahārṇave kṣiptaḥ kṣipraṃ loṣṭo vinaśyati ।
tathā duścaritaṃ sarvaṃ trayyāvṛttyā vinaśyati ॥11॥
slp1: yaTA mahArRave kziptaH kzipraM lozwo vinaSyati । taTA duScaritaM sarvaM trayyAvfttyA vinaSyati ॥11॥
author: pṛthivyuvāca ।

text: sarve ca vedāḥ saha ṣaḍbhiraṅgaiḥ sāṅkhyaṃ purāṇaṃ ca kule ca janma । naitāni sarvāṇi gatirbhavanti śīlavyapetasya narasya rājan ॥12॥
html:
sarve ca vedāḥ saha ṣaḍbhiraṅgaiḥ sāṅkhyaṃ purāṇaṃ ca kule ca janma ।
naitāni sarvāṇi gatirbhavanti śīlavyapetasya narasya rājan ॥12॥
slp1: sarve ca vedAH saha zaqBiraNgEH sANKyaM purARaM ca kule ca janma । nEtAni sarvARi gatirBavanti SIlavyapetasya narasya rAjan ॥12॥
author: kāśyapa uvāca ।

text: adhīyānaḥ paṇḍitaṃ manyamāno yo vidyayā hanti yaśaḥ pareṣām । brahmansa tenācarate brahmahatyāṃ lokāstasya hyantavanto bhavanti ॥13॥
html:
adhīyānaḥ paṇḍitaṃ manyamāno yo vidyayā hanti yaśaḥ pareṣām ।
brahmansa tenācarate brahmahatyāṃ lokāstasya hyantavanto bhavanti ॥13॥
slp1: aDIyAnaH paRqitaM manyamAno yo vidyayA hanti yaSaH parezAm । brahmansa tenAcarate brahmahatyAM lokAstasya hyantavanto Bavanti ॥13॥
author: agniruvāca ।

text: aśvamedhasahasraṃ ca satyaṃ ca tulayā dhṛtam । nābhijānāmi yadyasya satyasyārdhamavāpnuyāt ॥14॥
html:
aśvamedhasahasraṃ ca satyaṃ ca tulayā dhṛtam ।
nābhijānāmi yadyasya satyasyārdhamavāpnuyāt ॥14॥
slp1: aSvameDasahasraM ca satyaM ca tulayA Dftam । nABijAnAmi yadyasya satyasyArDamavApnuyAt ॥14॥
author: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ।

text: ityuktvā te jagmurāśu catvāro'mitatejasaḥ । pṛthivī kāśyapo'gniśca prakṛṣṭāyuśca bhārgavaḥ ॥15॥
html:
ityuktvā te jagmurāśu catvāro'mitatejasaḥ ।
pṛthivī kāśyapo'gniśca prakṛṣṭāyuśca bhārgavaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: ityuktvA te jagmurASu catvAro'mitatejasaH । pfTivI kASyapo'gniSca prakfzwAyuSca BArgavaH ॥15॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yadidaṃ brāhmaṇā loke vratino bhuñjate haviḥ । bhuktaṃ brāhmaṇakāmāya kathaṃ tatsukṛtaṃ bhavet ॥16॥
html:
yadidaṃ brāhmaṇā loke vratino bhuñjate haviḥ ।
bhuktaṃ brāhmaṇakāmāya kathaṃ tatsukṛtaṃ bhavet ॥16॥
slp1: yadidaM brAhmaRA loke vratino BuYjate haviH । BuktaM brAhmaRakAmAya kaTaM tatsukftaM Bavet ॥16॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ādiṣṭino ye rājendra brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ । bhuñjate brahmakāmāya vrataluptā bhavanti te ॥17॥
html:
ādiṣṭino ye rājendra brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ।
bhuñjate brahmakāmāya vrataluptā bhavanti te ॥17॥
slp1: Adizwino ye rAjendra brAhmaRA vedapAragAH । BuYjate brahmakAmAya vrataluptA Bavanti te ॥17॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: anekāntaṃ bahudvāraṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । kiṃ niścitaṃ bhavettatra tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥18॥
html:
anekāntaṃ bahudvāraṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।
kiṃ niścitaṃ bhavettatra tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥18॥
slp1: anekAntaM bahudvAraM DarmamAhurmanIziRaH । kiM niScitaM Bavettatra tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥18॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ahiṃsā satyamakrodha ānṛśaṃsyaṃ damastathā । ārjavaṃ caiva rājendra niścitaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam ॥19॥
html:
ahiṃsā satyamakrodha ānṛśaṃsyaṃ damastathā ।
ārjavaṃ caiva rājendra niścitaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam ॥19॥
slp1: ahiMsA satyamakroDa AnfSaMsyaM damastaTA । ArjavaM cEva rAjendra niScitaM DarmalakzaRam ॥19॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ye tu dharmaṃ praśaṃsantaścaranti pṛthivīmimām । anācarantastaddharmaṃ saṅkare niratāḥ prabho ॥20॥
html:
ye tu dharmaṃ praśaṃsantaścaranti pṛthivīmimām ।
anācarantastaddharmaṃ saṅkare niratāḥ prabho ॥20॥
slp1: ye tu DarmaM praSaMsantaScaranti pfTivImimAm । anAcarantastadDarmaM saNkare niratAH praBo ॥20॥

text: tebhyo ratnaṃ hiraṇyaṃ vā gāmaśvānvā dadāti yaḥ । daśa varṣāṇi viṣṭhāṃ sa bhuṅkte nirayamāśritaḥ ॥21॥
html:
tebhyo ratnaṃ hiraṇyaṃ vā gāmaśvānvā dadāti yaḥ ।
daśa varṣāṇi viṣṭhāṃ sa bhuṅkte nirayamāśritaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: teByo ratnaM hiraRyaM vA gAmaSvAnvA dadAti yaH । daSa varzARi vizWAM sa BuNkte nirayamASritaH ॥21॥

text: medānāṃ pulkasānāṃ ca tathaivāntāvasāyinām । kṛtaṃ karmākṛtaṃ cāpi rāgamohena jalpatām ॥22॥
html:
medānāṃ pulkasānāṃ ca tathaivāntāvasāyinām ।
kṛtaṃ karmākṛtaṃ cāpi rāgamohena jalpatām ॥22॥
slp1: medAnAM pulkasAnAM ca taTEvAntAvasAyinAm । kftaM karmAkftaM cApi rAgamohena jalpatAm ॥22॥

text: vaiśvadevaṃ ca ye mūḍhā viprāya brahmacāriṇe । dadatīha na rājendra te lokānbhuñjate'śubhān ॥23॥
html:
vaiśvadevaṃ ca ye mūḍhā viprāya brahmacāriṇe ।
dadatīha na rājendra te lokānbhuñjate'śubhān ॥23॥
slp1: vESvadevaM ca ye mUQA viprAya brahmacAriRe । dadatIha na rAjendra te lokAnBuYjate'SuBAn ॥23॥

text: kiṃ paraṃ brahmacaryasya kiṃ paraṃ dharmalakṣaṇam । kiṃ ca śreṣṭhatamaṃ śaucaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥24॥
html:
kiṃ paraṃ brahmacaryasya kiṃ paraṃ dharmalakṣaṇam ।
kiṃ ca śreṣṭhatamaṃ śaucaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥24॥
slp1: kiM paraM brahmacaryasya kiM paraM DarmalakzaRam । kiM ca SrezWatamaM SOcaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥24॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ tāta madhumāṃsasya varjanam । maryādāyāṃ sthito dharmaḥ śamaḥ śaucasya lakṣaṇam ॥25॥
html:
brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ tāta madhumāṃsasya varjanam ।
maryādāyāṃ sthito dharmaḥ śamaḥ śaucasya lakṣaṇam ॥25॥
slp1: brahmacaryaM paraM tAta maDumAMsasya varjanam । maryAdAyAM sTito DarmaH SamaH SOcasya lakzaRam ॥25॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kasminkāle careddharmaṃ kasminkāle'rthamācaret । kasminkāle sukhī ca syāttanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥26॥
html:
kasminkāle careddharmaṃ kasminkāle'rthamācaret ।
kasminkāle sukhī ca syāttanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥26॥
slp1: kasminkAle caredDarmaM kasminkAle'rTamAcaret । kasminkAle suKI ca syAttanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥26॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kālyamarthaṃ niṣeveta tato dharmamanantaram । paścātkāmaṃ niṣeveta na ca gacchetprasaṅgitām ॥27॥
html:
kālyamarthaṃ niṣeveta tato dharmamanantaram ।
paścātkāmaṃ niṣeveta na ca gacchetprasaṅgitām ॥27॥
slp1: kAlyamarTaM nizeveta tato Darmamanantaram । paScAtkAmaM nizeveta na ca gacCetprasaNgitAm ॥27॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇāṃścābhimanyeta gurūṃścāpyabhipūjayet । sarvabhūtānulomaśca mṛduśīlaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ ॥28॥
html:
brāhmaṇāṃścābhimanyeta gurūṃścāpyabhipūjayet ।
sarvabhūtānulomaśca mṛduśīlaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: brAhmaRAMScABimanyeta gurUMScApyaBipUjayet । sarvaBUtAnulomaSca mfduSIlaH priyaMvadaH ॥28॥

text: adhikāre yadanṛtaṃ rājagāmi ca paiśunam । guroścālīkakaraṇaṃ samaṃ tadbrahmahatyayā ॥29॥
html:
adhikāre yadanṛtaṃ rājagāmi ca paiśunam ।
guroścālīkakaraṇaṃ samaṃ tadbrahmahatyayā ॥29॥
slp1: aDikAre yadanftaM rAjagAmi ca pESunam । guroScAlIkakaraRaM samaM tadbrahmahatyayA ॥29॥

text: praharenna narendreṣu na gāṃ hanyāttathaiva ca । bhrūṇahatyāsamaṃ caitadubhayaṃ yo niṣevate ॥30॥
html:
praharenna narendreṣu na gāṃ hanyāttathaiva ca ।
bhrūṇahatyāsamaṃ caitadubhayaṃ yo niṣevate ॥30॥
slp1: praharenna narendrezu na gAM hanyAttaTEva ca । BrURahatyAsamaM cEtaduBayaM yo nizevate ॥30॥

text: nāgniṃ parityajejjātu na ca vedānparityajet । na ca brāhmaṇamākrośetsamaṃ tadbrahmahatyayā ॥31॥
html:
nāgniṃ parityajejjātu na ca vedānparityajet ।
na ca brāhmaṇamākrośetsamaṃ tadbrahmahatyayā ॥31॥
slp1: nAgniM parityajejjAtu na ca vedAnparityajet । na ca brAhmaRamAkroSetsamaM tadbrahmahatyayA ॥31॥

text: kīdṛśāḥ sādhavo viprāḥ kebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam । kīdṛśānāṃ ca bhoktavyaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥32॥
html:
kīdṛśāḥ sādhavo viprāḥ kebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ।
kīdṛśānāṃ ca bhoktavyaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥32॥
slp1: kIdfSAH sADavo viprAH keByo dattaM mahAPalam । kIdfSAnAM ca BoktavyaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥32॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: akrodhanā dharmaparāḥ satyanityā dame ratāḥ । tādṛśāḥ sādhavo viprāstebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥33॥
html:
akrodhanā dharmaparāḥ satyanityā dame ratāḥ ।
tādṛśāḥ sādhavo viprāstebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥33॥
slp1: akroDanA DarmaparAH satyanityA dame ratAH । tAdfSAH sADavo viprAsteByo dattaM mahAPalam ॥33॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: amāninaḥ sarvasahā dṛṣṭārthā vijitendriyāḥ । sarvabhūtahitā maitrāstebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥34॥
html:
amāninaḥ sarvasahā dṛṣṭārthā vijitendriyāḥ ।
sarvabhūtahitā maitrāstebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥34॥
slp1: amAninaH sarvasahA dfzwArTA vijitendriyAH । sarvaBUtahitA mEtrAsteByo dattaM mahAPalam ॥34॥

text: alubdhāḥ śucayo vaidyā hrīmantaḥ satyavādinaḥ । svakarmaniratā ye ca tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥35॥
html:
alubdhāḥ śucayo vaidyā hrīmantaḥ satyavādinaḥ ।
svakarmaniratā ye ca tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥35॥
slp1: alubDAH Sucayo vEdyA hrImantaH satyavAdinaH । svakarmaniratA ye ca teByo dattaM mahAPalam ॥35॥

text: sāṅgāṃśca caturo vedānyo'dhīyīta dvijarṣabhaḥ । ṣaḍbhyo nivṛttaḥ karmabhyastaṃ pātramṛṣayo viduḥ ॥36॥
html:
sāṅgāṃśca caturo vedānyo'dhīyīta dvijarṣabhaḥ ।
ṣaḍbhyo nivṛttaḥ karmabhyastaṃ pātramṛṣayo viduḥ ॥36॥
slp1: sANgAMSca caturo vedAnyo'DIyIta dvijarzaBaH । zaqByo nivfttaH karmaByastaM pAtramfzayo viduH ॥36॥

text: ye tvevaṅguṇajātīyāstebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam । sahasraguṇamāpnoti guṇārhāya pradāyakaḥ ॥37॥
html:
ye tvevaṅguṇajātīyāstebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ।
sahasraguṇamāpnoti guṇārhāya pradāyakaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: ye tvevaNguRajAtIyAsteByo dattaM mahAPalam । sahasraguRamApnoti guRArhAya pradAyakaH ॥37॥

text: prajñāśrutābhyāṃ vṛttena śīlena ca samanvitaḥ । tārayeta kulaṃ kṛtsnameko'pīha dvijarṣabhaḥ ॥38॥
html:
prajñāśrutābhyāṃ vṛttena śīlena ca samanvitaḥ ।
tārayeta kulaṃ kṛtsnameko'pīha dvijarṣabhaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: prajYASrutAByAM vfttena SIlena ca samanvitaH । tArayeta kulaM kftsnameko'pIha dvijarzaBaH ॥38॥

text: gāmaśvaṃ vittamannaṃ vā tadvidhe pratipādayet । dravyāṇi cānyāni tathā pretyabhāve na śocati ॥39॥
html:
gāmaśvaṃ vittamannaṃ vā tadvidhe pratipādayet ।
dravyāṇi cānyāni tathā pretyabhāve na śocati ॥39॥
slp1: gAmaSvaM vittamannaM vA tadviDe pratipAdayet । dravyARi cAnyAni taTA pretyaBAve na Socati ॥39॥

text: tārayeta kulaṃ kṛtsnameko'pīha dvijottamaḥ । kimaṅga punarekaṃ vai tasmātpātraṃ samācaret ॥40॥
html:
tārayeta kulaṃ kṛtsnameko'pīha dvijottamaḥ ।
kimaṅga punarekaṃ vai tasmātpātraṃ samācaret ॥40॥
slp1: tArayeta kulaM kftsnameko'pIha dvijottamaH । kimaNga punarekaM vE tasmAtpAtraM samAcaret ॥40॥

text: niśamya ca guṇopetaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sādhusammatam । dūrādānāyayetkṛtye sarvataścābhipūjayet] ॥41॥
html:
niśamya ca guṇopetaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sādhusammatam ।
dūrādānāyayetkṛtye sarvataścābhipūjayet] ॥41॥
slp1: niSamya ca guRopetaM brAhmaRaM sADusammatam । dUrAdAnAyayetkftye sarvataScABipUjayet] ॥41॥

text: śrāddhakāle ca daive ca dharme cāpi pitāmaha । icchāmīha tvayākhyātaṃ vihitaṃ yatsurarṣibhiḥ ॥1॥
html:
śrāddhakāle ca daive ca dharme cāpi pitāmaha ।
icchāmīha tvayākhyātaṃ vihitaṃ yatsurarṣibhiḥ ॥1॥
slp1: SrAdDakAle ca dEve ca Darme cApi pitAmaha । icCAmIha tvayAKyAtaM vihitaM yatsurarziBiH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: daivaṃ pūrvāhṇike kuryādaparāhṇe tu paitṛkam । maṅgalācārasampannaḥ kṛtaśaucaḥ prayatnavān ॥2॥
html:
daivaṃ pūrvāhṇike kuryādaparāhṇe tu paitṛkam ।
maṅgalācārasampannaḥ kṛtaśaucaḥ prayatnavān ॥2॥
slp1: dEvaM pUrvAhRike kuryAdaparAhRe tu pEtfkam । maNgalAcArasampannaH kftaSOcaH prayatnavAn ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: manuṣyāṇāṃ tu madhyāhne pradadyādupapattitaḥ । kālahīnaṃ tu yaddānaṃ taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥3॥
html:
manuṣyāṇāṃ tu madhyāhne pradadyādupapattitaḥ ।
kālahīnaṃ tu yaddānaṃ taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥3॥
slp1: manuzyARAM tu maDyAhne pradadyAdupapattitaH । kAlahInaM tu yaddAnaM taM BAgaM rakzasAM viduH ॥3॥

text: laṅghitaṃ cāvalīḍhaṃ ca kalipūrvaṃ ca yatkṛtam । rajasvalābhirdṛṣṭaṃ ca taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥4॥
html:
laṅghitaṃ cāvalīḍhaṃ ca kalipūrvaṃ ca yatkṛtam ।
rajasvalābhirdṛṣṭaṃ ca taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥4॥
slp1: laNGitaM cAvalIQaM ca kalipUrvaM ca yatkftam । rajasvalABirdfzwaM ca taM BAgaM rakzasAM viduH ॥4॥

text: avaghuṣṭaṃ ca yadbhuktamavratena ca bhārata । parāmṛṣṭaṃ śunā caiva taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥5॥
html:
avaghuṣṭaṃ ca yadbhuktamavratena ca bhārata ।
parāmṛṣṭaṃ śunā caiva taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥5॥
slp1: avaGuzwaM ca yadBuktamavratena ca BArata । parAmfzwaM SunA cEva taM BAgaM rakzasAM viduH ॥5॥

text: keśakīṭāvapatitaṃ kṣutaṃ śvabhiravekṣitam । ruditaṃ cāvadhūtaṃ ca taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥6॥
html:
keśakīṭāvapatitaṃ kṣutaṃ śvabhiravekṣitam ।
ruditaṃ cāvadhūtaṃ ca taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥6॥
slp1: keSakIwAvapatitaM kzutaM SvaBiravekzitam । ruditaM cAvaDUtaM ca taM BAgaM rakzasAM viduH ॥6॥

text: niroṅkāreṇa yadbhuktaṃ saśastreṇa ca bhārata । durātmanā ca yadbhuktaṃ taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥7॥
html:
niroṅkāreṇa yadbhuktaṃ saśastreṇa ca bhārata ।
durātmanā ca yadbhuktaṃ taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥7॥
slp1: niroNkAreRa yadBuktaM saSastreRa ca BArata । durAtmanA ca yadBuktaM taM BAgaM rakzasAM viduH ॥7॥

text: parocchiṣṭaṃ ca yadbhuktaṃ paribhuktaṃ ca yadbhavet । daive pitrye ca satataṃ taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥8॥
html:
parocchiṣṭaṃ ca yadbhuktaṃ paribhuktaṃ ca yadbhavet ।
daive pitrye ca satataṃ taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥8॥
slp1: parocCizwaM ca yadBuktaM pariBuktaM ca yadBavet । dEve pitrye ca satataM taM BAgaM rakzasAM viduH ॥8॥

text: garhitaṃ ninditaṃ caiva pariviṣṭaṃ samanyunā । daivaṃ vāpyatha vā paitryaṃ taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥9॥
html:
garhitaṃ ninditaṃ caiva pariviṣṭaṃ samanyunā ।
daivaṃ vāpyatha vā paitryaṃ taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥9॥
slp1: garhitaM ninditaM cEva parivizwaM samanyunA । dEvaM vApyaTa vA pEtryaM taM BAgaM rakzasAM viduH ॥9॥

text: mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ yacchrāddhaṃ pariviṣyate । tribhirvarṇairnaraśreṣṭha taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥10॥
html:
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ yacchrāddhaṃ pariviṣyate ।
tribhirvarṇairnaraśreṣṭha taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥10॥
slp1: mantrahInaM kriyAhInaM yacCrAdDaM parivizyate । triBirvarRErnaraSrezWa taM BAgaM rakzasAM viduH ॥10॥

text: ājyāhutiṃ vinā caiva yatkiñcitpariviṣyate । durācāraiśca yadbhuktaṃ taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥11॥
html:
ājyāhutiṃ vinā caiva yatkiñcitpariviṣyate ।
durācāraiśca yadbhuktaṃ taṃ bhāgaṃ rakṣasāṃ viduḥ ॥11॥
slp1: AjyAhutiM vinA cEva yatkiYcitparivizyate । durAcArESca yadBuktaM taM BAgaM rakzasAM viduH ॥11॥

text: ye bhāgā rakṣasāṃ proktāsta uktā bharatarṣabha । ata ūrdhvaṃ visargasya parīkṣāṃ brāhmaṇe śṛṇu ॥12॥
html:
ye bhāgā rakṣasāṃ proktāsta uktā bharatarṣabha ।
ata ūrdhvaṃ visargasya parīkṣāṃ brāhmaṇe śṛṇu ॥12॥
slp1: ye BAgA rakzasAM proktAsta uktA BaratarzaBa । ata UrDvaM visargasya parIkzAM brAhmaRe SfRu ॥12॥

text: yāvantaḥ patitā viprā jaḍonmattāstathaiva ca । daive vāpyatha vā pitrye rājannārhanti ketanam ॥13॥
html:
yāvantaḥ patitā viprā jaḍonmattāstathaiva ca ।
daive vāpyatha vā pitrye rājannārhanti ketanam ॥13॥
slp1: yAvantaH patitA viprA jaqonmattAstaTEva ca । dEve vApyaTa vA pitrye rAjannArhanti ketanam ॥13॥

text: śvitrī kuṣṭhī ca klībaśca tathā yakṣmahataśca yaḥ । apasmārī ca yaścāndho rājannārhanti satkṛtim ॥14॥
html:
śvitrī kuṣṭhī ca klībaśca tathā yakṣmahataśca yaḥ ।
apasmārī ca yaścāndho rājannārhanti satkṛtim ॥14॥
slp1: SvitrI kuzWI ca klIbaSca taTA yakzmahataSca yaH । apasmArI ca yaScAnDo rAjannArhanti satkftim ॥14॥

text: cikitsakā devalakā vṛthāniyamadhāriṇaḥ । somavikrayiṇaścaiva śrāddhe nārhanti ketanam ॥15॥
html:
cikitsakā devalakā vṛthāniyamadhāriṇaḥ ।
somavikrayiṇaścaiva śrāddhe nārhanti ketanam ॥15॥
slp1: cikitsakA devalakA vfTAniyamaDAriRaH । somavikrayiRaScEva SrAdDe nArhanti ketanam ॥15॥

text: gāyanā nartakāścaiva plavakā vādakāstathā । kathakā yodhakāścaiva rājannārhanti ketanam ॥16॥
html:
gāyanā nartakāścaiva plavakā vādakāstathā ।
kathakā yodhakāścaiva rājannārhanti ketanam ॥16॥
slp1: gAyanA nartakAScEva plavakA vAdakAstaTA । kaTakA yoDakAScEva rAjannArhanti ketanam ॥16॥

text: hotāro vṛṣalānāṃ ca vṛṣalādhyāpakāstathā । tathā vṛṣalaśiṣyāśca rājannārhanti ketanam ॥17॥
html:
hotāro vṛṣalānāṃ ca vṛṣalādhyāpakāstathā ।
tathā vṛṣalaśiṣyāśca rājannārhanti ketanam ॥17॥
slp1: hotAro vfzalAnAM ca vfzalADyApakAstaTA । taTA vfzalaSizyASca rAjannArhanti ketanam ॥17॥

text: anuyoktā ca yo vipro anuyuktaśca bhārata । nārhatastāvapi śrāddhaṃ brahmavikrayiṇau hi tau ॥18॥
html:
anuyoktā ca yo vipro anuyuktaśca bhārata ।
nārhatastāvapi śrāddhaṃ brahmavikrayiṇau hi tau ॥18॥
slp1: anuyoktA ca yo vipro anuyuktaSca BArata । nArhatastAvapi SrAdDaM brahmavikrayiRO hi tO ॥18॥

text: agraṇīryaḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ varṇāvaraparigrahaḥ । brāhmaṇaḥ sarvavidyo'pi rājannārhati ketanam ॥19॥
html:
agraṇīryaḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ varṇāvaraparigrahaḥ ।
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvavidyo'pi rājannārhati ketanam ॥19॥
slp1: agraRIryaH kftaH pUrvaM varRAvaraparigrahaH । brAhmaRaH sarvavidyo'pi rAjannArhati ketanam ॥19॥

text: anagnayaśca ye viprā mṛtaniryātakāśca ye । stenāśca patitāścaiva rājannārhanti ketanam ॥20॥
html:
anagnayaśca ye viprā mṛtaniryātakāśca ye ।
stenāśca patitāścaiva rājannārhanti ketanam ॥20॥
slp1: anagnayaSca ye viprA mftaniryAtakASca ye । stenASca patitAScEva rAjannArhanti ketanam ॥20॥

text: aparijñātapūrvāśca gaṇapūrvāśca bhārata । putrikāpūrvaputrāśca śrāddhe nārhanti ketanam ॥21॥
html:
aparijñātapūrvāśca gaṇapūrvāśca bhārata ।
putrikāpūrvaputrāśca śrāddhe nārhanti ketanam ॥21॥
slp1: aparijYAtapUrvASca gaRapUrvASca BArata । putrikApUrvaputrASca SrAdDe nArhanti ketanam ॥21॥

text: ṛṇakartā ca yo rājanyaśca vārdhuṣiko dvijaḥ । prāṇivikrayavṛttiśca rājannārhanti ketanam ॥22॥
html:
ṛṇakartā ca yo rājanyaśca vārdhuṣiko dvijaḥ ।
prāṇivikrayavṛttiśca rājannārhanti ketanam ॥22॥
slp1: fRakartA ca yo rAjanyaSca vArDuziko dvijaH । prARivikrayavfttiSca rAjannArhanti ketanam ॥22॥

text: strīpūrvāḥ kāṇḍapṛṣṭhāśca yāvanto bharatarṣabha । ajapā brāhmaṇāścaiva śrāddhe nārhanti ketanam ॥23॥
html:
strīpūrvāḥ kāṇḍapṛṣṭhāśca yāvanto bharatarṣabha ।
ajapā brāhmaṇāścaiva śrāddhe nārhanti ketanam ॥23॥
slp1: strIpUrvAH kARqapfzWASca yAvanto BaratarzaBa । ajapA brAhmaRAScEva SrAdDe nArhanti ketanam ॥23॥

text: śrāddhe daive ca nirdiṣṭā brāhmaṇā bharatarṣabha । dātuḥ pratigrahītuśca śṛṇuṣvānugrahaṃ punaḥ ॥24॥
html:
śrāddhe daive ca nirdiṣṭā brāhmaṇā bharatarṣabha ।
dātuḥ pratigrahītuśca śṛṇuṣvānugrahaṃ punaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: SrAdDe dEve ca nirdizwA brAhmaRA BaratarzaBa । dAtuH pratigrahItuSca SfRuzvAnugrahaM punaH ॥24॥

text: cīrṇavratā guṇairyuktā bhaveyurye'pi karṣakāḥ । sāvitrījñāḥ kriyāvantaste rājanketanakṣamāḥ ॥25॥
html:
cīrṇavratā guṇairyuktā bhaveyurye'pi karṣakāḥ ।
sāvitrījñāḥ kriyāvantaste rājanketanakṣamāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: cIrRavratA guREryuktA Baveyurye'pi karzakAH । sAvitrIjYAH kriyAvantaste rAjanketanakzamAH ॥25॥

text: kṣātradharmiṇamapyājau ketayetkulajaṃ dvijam । na tveva vaṇijaṃ tāta śrāddheṣu parikalpayet ॥26॥
html:
kṣātradharmiṇamapyājau ketayetkulajaṃ dvijam ।
na tveva vaṇijaṃ tāta śrāddheṣu parikalpayet ॥26॥
slp1: kzAtraDarmiRamapyAjO ketayetkulajaM dvijam । na tveva vaRijaM tAta SrAdDezu parikalpayet ॥26॥

text: agnihotrī ca yo vipro grāmavāsī ca yo bhavet । astenaścātithijñaśca sa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥27॥
html:
agnihotrī ca yo vipro grāmavāsī ca yo bhavet ।
astenaścātithijñaśca sa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: agnihotrI ca yo vipro grAmavAsI ca yo Bavet । astenaScAtiTijYaSca sa rAjanketanakzamaH ॥27॥

text: sāvitrīṃ japate yastu trikālaṃ bharatarṣabha । bhikṣāvṛttiḥ kriyāvāṃśca sa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥28॥
html:
sāvitrīṃ japate yastu trikālaṃ bharatarṣabha ।
bhikṣāvṛttiḥ kriyāvāṃśca sa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: sAvitrIM japate yastu trikAlaM BaratarzaBa । BikzAvfttiH kriyAvAMSca sa rAjanketanakzamaH ॥28॥

text: uditāstamito yaśca tathaivāstamitoditaḥ । ahiṃsraścālpadoṣaśca sa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥29॥
html:
uditāstamito yaśca tathaivāstamitoditaḥ ।
ahiṃsraścālpadoṣaśca sa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: uditAstamito yaSca taTEvAstamitoditaH । ahiMsraScAlpadozaSca sa rAjanketanakzamaH ॥29॥

text: akalkako hyatarkaśca brāhmaṇo bharatarṣabha । sasañjño bhaikṣyavṛttiśca sa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥30॥
html:
akalkako hyatarkaśca brāhmaṇo bharatarṣabha ।
sasañjño bhaikṣyavṛttiśca sa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: akalkako hyatarkaSca brAhmaRo BaratarzaBa । sasaYjYo BEkzyavfttiSca sa rAjanketanakzamaH ॥30॥

text: avratī kitavaḥ stenaḥ prāṇivikrayyatho vaṇik । paścācca pītavānsomaṃ sa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥31॥
html:
avratī kitavaḥ stenaḥ prāṇivikrayyatho vaṇik ।
paścācca pītavānsomaṃ sa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: avratI kitavaH stenaH prARivikrayyaTo vaRik । paScAcca pItavAnsomaM sa rAjanketanakzamaH ॥31॥

text: arjayitvā dhanaṃ pūrvaṃ dāruṇaiḥ kṛṣikarmabhiḥ । bhavetsarvātithiḥ paścātsa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥32॥
html:
arjayitvā dhanaṃ pūrvaṃ dāruṇaiḥ kṛṣikarmabhiḥ ।
bhavetsarvātithiḥ paścātsa rājanketanakṣamaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: arjayitvA DanaM pUrvaM dAruREH kfzikarmaBiH । BavetsarvAtiTiH paScAtsa rAjanketanakzamaH ॥32॥

text: brahmavikrayanirdiṣṭaṃ striyā yaccārjitaṃ dhanam । adeyaṃ pitṛdevebhyo yacca klaibyādupārjitam ॥33॥
html:
brahmavikrayanirdiṣṭaṃ striyā yaccārjitaṃ dhanam ।
adeyaṃ pitṛdevebhyo yacca klaibyādupārjitam ॥33॥
slp1: brahmavikrayanirdizwaM striyA yaccArjitaM Danam । adeyaM pitfdeveByo yacca klEbyAdupArjitam ॥33॥

text: kriyamāṇe'pavarge tu yo dvijo bharatarṣabha । na vyāharati yadyuktaṃ tasyādharmo gavānṛtam ॥34॥
html:
kriyamāṇe'pavarge tu yo dvijo bharatarṣabha ।
na vyāharati yadyuktaṃ tasyādharmo gavānṛtam ॥34॥
slp1: kriyamARe'pavarge tu yo dvijo BaratarzaBa । na vyAharati yadyuktaM tasyADarmo gavAnftam ॥34॥

text: śrāddhasya brāhmaṇaḥ kālaḥ prāptaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā । somakṣayaśca māṃsaṃ ca yadāraṇyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥35॥
html:
śrāddhasya brāhmaṇaḥ kālaḥ prāptaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā ।
somakṣayaśca māṃsaṃ ca yadāraṇyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥35॥
slp1: SrAdDasya brAhmaRaH kAlaH prAptaM daDi GftaM taTA । somakzayaSca mAMsaM ca yadAraRyaM yuDizWira ॥35॥

text: śrāddhāpavarge viprasya svadhā vai svaditā bhavet । kṣatriyasyāpyatho brūyātprīyantāṃ pitarastviti ॥36॥
html:
śrāddhāpavarge viprasya svadhā vai svaditā bhavet ।
kṣatriyasyāpyatho brūyātprīyantāṃ pitarastviti ॥36॥
slp1: SrAdDApavarge viprasya svaDA vE svaditA Bavet । kzatriyasyApyaTo brUyAtprIyantAM pitarastviti ॥36॥

text: apavarge tu vaiśyasya śrāddhakarmaṇi bhārata । akṣayyamabhidhātavyaṃ svasti śūdrasya bhārata ॥37॥
html:
apavarge tu vaiśyasya śrāddhakarmaṇi bhārata ।
akṣayyamabhidhātavyaṃ svasti śūdrasya bhārata ॥37॥
slp1: apavarge tu vESyasya SrAdDakarmaRi BArata । akzayyamaBiDAtavyaM svasti SUdrasya BArata ॥37॥

text: puṇyāhavācanaṃ daive brāhmaṇasya vidhīyate । etadeva niroṅkāraṃ kṣatriyasya vidhīyate । vaiśyasya caiva vaktavyaṃ prīyantāṃ devatā iti ॥38॥
html:
puṇyāhavācanaṃ daive brāhmaṇasya vidhīyate ।
etadeva niroṅkāraṃ kṣatriyasya vidhīyate ।
vaiśyasya caiva vaktavyaṃ prīyantāṃ devatā iti ॥38॥
slp1: puRyAhavAcanaM dEve brAhmaRasya viDIyate । etadeva niroNkAraM kzatriyasya viDIyate । vESyasya cEva vaktavyaM prIyantAM devatA iti ॥38॥

text: karmaṇāmānupūrvīṃ ca vidhipūrvakṛtaṃ śṛṇu । jātakarmādikānsarvāṃstriṣu varṇeṣu bhārata । brahmakṣatre hi mantroktā vaiśyasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥39॥
html:
karmaṇāmānupūrvīṃ ca vidhipūrvakṛtaṃ śṛṇu ।
jātakarmādikānsarvāṃstriṣu varṇeṣu bhārata ।
brahmakṣatre hi mantroktā vaiśyasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥39॥
slp1: karmaRAmAnupUrvIM ca viDipUrvakftaM SfRu । jAtakarmAdikAnsarvAMstrizu varRezu BArata । brahmakzatre hi mantroktA vESyasya ca yuDizWira ॥39॥

text: viprasya raśanā mauñjī maurvī rājanyagāminī । bālvajītyeva vaiśyasya dharma eṣa yudhiṣṭhira ॥40॥
html:
viprasya raśanā mauñjī maurvī rājanyagāminī ।
bālvajītyeva vaiśyasya dharma eṣa yudhiṣṭhira ॥40॥
slp1: viprasya raSanA mOYjI mOrvI rAjanyagAminI । bAlvajItyeva vESyasya Darma eza yuDizWira ॥40॥

text: dātuḥ pratigrahītuśca dharmādharmāvimau śṛṇu । brāhmaṇasyānṛte'dharmaḥ proktaḥ pātakasañjñitaḥ । caturguṇaḥ kṣatriyasya vaiśyasyāṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥41॥
html:
dātuḥ pratigrahītuśca dharmādharmāvimau śṛṇu ।
brāhmaṇasyānṛte'dharmaḥ proktaḥ pātakasañjñitaḥ ।
caturguṇaḥ kṣatriyasya vaiśyasyāṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: dAtuH pratigrahItuSca DarmADarmAvimO SfRu । brAhmaRasyAnfte'DarmaH proktaH pAtakasaYjYitaH । caturguRaH kzatriyasya vESyasyAzwaguRaH smftaH ॥41॥

text: nānyatra brāhmaṇo'śnīyātpūrvaṃ vipreṇa ketitaḥ । yavīyānpaśuhiṃsāyāṃ tulyadharmo bhavetsa hi ॥42॥
html:
nānyatra brāhmaṇo'śnīyātpūrvaṃ vipreṇa ketitaḥ ।
yavīyānpaśuhiṃsāyāṃ tulyadharmo bhavetsa hi ॥42॥
slp1: nAnyatra brAhmaRo'SnIyAtpUrvaM vipreRa ketitaH । yavIyAnpaSuhiMsAyAM tulyaDarmo Bavetsa hi ॥42॥

text: atha rājanyavaiśyābhyāṃ yadyaśnīyāttu ketitaḥ । yavīyānpaśuhiṃsāyāṃ bhāgārdhaṃ samavāpnuyāt ॥43॥
html:
atha rājanyavaiśyābhyāṃ yadyaśnīyāttu ketitaḥ ।
yavīyānpaśuhiṃsāyāṃ bhāgārdhaṃ samavāpnuyāt ॥43॥
slp1: aTa rAjanyavESyAByAM yadyaSnIyAttu ketitaH । yavIyAnpaSuhiMsAyAM BAgArDaM samavApnuyAt ॥43॥

text: daivaṃ vāpyatha vā pitryaṃ yo'śnīyādbrāhmaṇādiṣu । asnāto brāhmaṇo rājaṃstasyādharmo gavānṛtam ॥44॥
html:
daivaṃ vāpyatha vā pitryaṃ yo'śnīyādbrāhmaṇādiṣu ।
asnāto brāhmaṇo rājaṃstasyādharmo gavānṛtam ॥44॥
slp1: dEvaM vApyaTa vA pitryaM yo'SnIyAdbrAhmaRAdizu । asnAto brAhmaRo rAjaMstasyADarmo gavAnftam ॥44॥

text: āśauco brāhmaṇo rājanyo'śnīyādbrāhmaṇādiṣu । jñānapūrvamatho lobhāttasyādharmo gavānṛtam ॥45॥
html:
āśauco brāhmaṇo rājanyo'śnīyādbrāhmaṇādiṣu ।
jñānapūrvamatho lobhāttasyādharmo gavānṛtam ॥45॥
slp1: ASOco brAhmaRo rAjanyo'SnIyAdbrAhmaRAdizu । jYAnapUrvamaTo loBAttasyADarmo gavAnftam ॥45॥

text: annenānnaṃ ca yo lipsetkarmārthaṃ caiva bhārata । āmantrayati rājendra tasyādharmo'nṛtaṃ smṛtam ॥46॥
html:
annenānnaṃ ca yo lipsetkarmārthaṃ caiva bhārata ।
āmantrayati rājendra tasyādharmo'nṛtaṃ smṛtam ॥46॥
slp1: annenAnnaM ca yo lipsetkarmArTaM cEva BArata । Amantrayati rAjendra tasyADarmo'nftaM smftam ॥46॥

text: avedavratacāritrāstribhirvarṇairyudhiṣṭhira । mantravatpariviṣyante teṣvadharmo gavānṛtam ॥47॥
html:
avedavratacāritrāstribhirvarṇairyudhiṣṭhira ।
mantravatpariviṣyante teṣvadharmo gavānṛtam ॥47॥
slp1: avedavratacAritrAstriBirvarREryuDizWira । mantravatparivizyante tezvaDarmo gavAnftam ॥47॥

text: pitryaṃ vāpyatha vā daivaṃ dīyate yatpitāmaha । etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ dattaṃ yeṣu mahāphalam ॥48॥
html:
pitryaṃ vāpyatha vā daivaṃ dīyate yatpitāmaha ।
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ dattaṃ yeṣu mahāphalam ॥48॥
slp1: pitryaM vApyaTa vA dEvaM dIyate yatpitAmaha । etadicCAmyahaM SrotuM dattaM yezu mahAPalam ॥48॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yeṣāṃ dārāḥ pratīkṣante suvṛṣṭimiva karṣakāḥ । uccheṣapariśeṣaṃ hi tānbhojaya yudhiṣṭhira ॥49॥
html:
yeṣāṃ dārāḥ pratīkṣante suvṛṣṭimiva karṣakāḥ ।
uccheṣapariśeṣaṃ hi tānbhojaya yudhiṣṭhira ॥49॥
slp1: yezAM dArAH pratIkzante suvfzwimiva karzakAH । ucCezapariSezaM hi tAnBojaya yuDizWira ॥49॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: cāritraniyatā rājanye kṛśāḥ kṛśavṛttayaḥ । arthinaścopagacchanti teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥50॥
html:
cāritraniyatā rājanye kṛśāḥ kṛśavṛttayaḥ ।
arthinaścopagacchanti teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥50॥
slp1: cAritraniyatA rAjanye kfSAH kfSavfttayaH । arTinaScopagacCanti tezu dattaM mahAPalam ॥50॥

text: tadbhaktāstadgṛhā rājaṃstaddhanāstadapāśrayāḥ । arthinaśca bhavantyarthe teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥51॥
html:
tadbhaktāstadgṛhā rājaṃstaddhanāstadapāśrayāḥ ।
arthinaśca bhavantyarthe teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥51॥
slp1: tadBaktAstadgfhA rAjaMstadDanAstadapASrayAH । arTinaSca BavantyarTe tezu dattaM mahAPalam ॥51॥

text: taskarebhyaḥ parebhyo vā ye bhayārtā yudhiṣṭhira । arthino bhoktumicchanti teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥52॥
html:
taskarebhyaḥ parebhyo vā ye bhayārtā yudhiṣṭhira ।
arthino bhoktumicchanti teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥52॥
slp1: taskareByaH pareByo vA ye BayArtA yuDizWira । arTino BoktumicCanti tezu dattaM mahAPalam ॥52॥

text: akalkakasya viprasya bhaikṣotkarakṛtātmanaḥ । baṭavo yasya bhikṣanti tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥53॥
html:
akalkakasya viprasya bhaikṣotkarakṛtātmanaḥ ।
baṭavo yasya bhikṣanti tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥53॥
slp1: akalkakasya viprasya BEkzotkarakftAtmanaH । bawavo yasya Bikzanti teByo dattaM mahAPalam ॥53॥

text: hṛtasvā hṛtadārāśca ye viprā deśasamplave । arthārthamabhigacchanti tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥54॥
html:
hṛtasvā hṛtadārāśca ye viprā deśasamplave ।
arthārthamabhigacchanti tebhyo dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥54॥
slp1: hftasvA hftadArASca ye viprA deSasamplave । arTArTamaBigacCanti teByo dattaM mahAPalam ॥54॥

text: vratino niyamasthāśca ye viprāḥ śrutasammatāḥ । tatsamāptyarthamicchanti teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥55॥
html:
vratino niyamasthāśca ye viprāḥ śrutasammatāḥ ।
tatsamāptyarthamicchanti teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥55॥
slp1: vratino niyamasTASca ye viprAH SrutasammatAH । tatsamAptyarTamicCanti tezu dattaM mahAPalam ॥55॥

text: avyutkrāntāśca dharmeṣu pāṣaṇḍasamayeṣu ca । kṛśaprāṇāḥ kṛśadhanāsteṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥56॥
html:
avyutkrāntāśca dharmeṣu pāṣaṇḍasamayeṣu ca ।
kṛśaprāṇāḥ kṛśadhanāsteṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥56॥
slp1: avyutkrAntASca Darmezu pAzaRqasamayezu ca । kfSaprARAH kfSaDanAstezu dattaM mahAPalam ॥56॥

text: kṛtasarvasvaharaṇā nirdoṣāḥ prabhaviṣṇubhiḥ । spṛhayanti ca bhuktānnaṃ teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥57॥
html:
kṛtasarvasvaharaṇā nirdoṣāḥ prabhaviṣṇubhiḥ ।
spṛhayanti ca bhuktānnaṃ teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥57॥
slp1: kftasarvasvaharaRA nirdozAH praBavizRuBiH । spfhayanti ca BuktAnnaM tezu dattaM mahAPalam ॥57॥

text: tapasvinastaponiṣṭhāsteṣāṃ bhaikṣacarāśca ye । arthinaḥ kiñcidicchanti teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥58॥
html:
tapasvinastaponiṣṭhāsteṣāṃ bhaikṣacarāśca ye ।
arthinaḥ kiñcidicchanti teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam ॥58॥
slp1: tapasvinastaponizWAstezAM BEkzacarASca ye । arTinaH kiYcidicCanti tezu dattaM mahAPalam ॥58॥

text: mahāphalavidhirdāne śrutaste bharatarṣabha । nirayaṃ yena gacchanti svargaṃ caiva hi tacchṛṇu ॥59॥
html:
mahāphalavidhirdāne śrutaste bharatarṣabha ।
nirayaṃ yena gacchanti svargaṃ caiva hi tacchṛṇu ॥59॥
slp1: mahAPalaviDirdAne Srutaste BaratarzaBa । nirayaM yena gacCanti svargaM cEva hi tacCfRu ॥59॥

text: gurvarthaṃ vābhayārthaṃ vā varjayitvā yudhiṣṭhira । ye'nṛtaṃ kathayanti sma te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥60॥
html:
gurvarthaṃ vābhayārthaṃ vā varjayitvā yudhiṣṭhira ।
ye'nṛtaṃ kathayanti sma te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥60॥
slp1: gurvarTaM vABayArTaM vA varjayitvA yuDizWira । ye'nftaM kaTayanti sma te vE nirayagAminaH ॥60॥

text: paradārābhihartāraḥ paradārābhimarśinaḥ । paradāraprayoktāraste vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥61॥
html:
paradārābhihartāraḥ paradārābhimarśinaḥ ।
paradāraprayoktāraste vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥61॥
slp1: paradArABihartAraH paradArABimarSinaH । paradAraprayoktAraste vE nirayagAminaH ॥61॥

text: ye parasvāpahartāraḥ parasvānāṃ ca nāśakāḥ । sūcakāśca pareṣāṃ ye te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥62॥
html:
ye parasvāpahartāraḥ parasvānāṃ ca nāśakāḥ ।
sūcakāśca pareṣāṃ ye te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥62॥
slp1: ye parasvApahartAraH parasvAnAM ca nASakAH । sUcakASca parezAM ye te vE nirayagAminaH ॥62॥

text: prapāṇāṃ ca sabhānāṃ ca saṅkramāṇāṃ ca bhārata । agārāṇāṃ ca bhettāro narā nirayagāminaḥ ॥63॥
html:
prapāṇāṃ ca sabhānāṃ ca saṅkramāṇāṃ ca bhārata ।
agārāṇāṃ ca bhettāro narā nirayagāminaḥ ॥63॥
slp1: prapARAM ca saBAnAM ca saNkramARAM ca BArata । agArARAM ca BettAro narA nirayagAminaH ॥63॥

text: anāthāṃ pramadāṃ bālāṃ vṛddhāṃ bhītāṃ tapasvinīm । vañcayanti narā ye ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥64॥
html:
anāthāṃ pramadāṃ bālāṃ vṛddhāṃ bhītāṃ tapasvinīm ।
vañcayanti narā ye ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥64॥
slp1: anATAM pramadAM bAlAM vfdDAM BItAM tapasvinIm । vaYcayanti narA ye ca te vE nirayagAminaH ॥64॥

text: vṛtticchedaṃ gṛhacchedaṃ dāracchedaṃ ca bhārata । mitracchedaṃ tathāśāyāste vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥65॥
html:
vṛtticchedaṃ gṛhacchedaṃ dāracchedaṃ ca bhārata ।
mitracchedaṃ tathāśāyāste vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥65॥
slp1: vftticCedaM gfhacCedaM dAracCedaM ca BArata । mitracCedaM taTASAyAste vE nirayagAminaH ॥65॥

text: sūcakāḥ sandhibhettāraḥ paravṛttyupajīvakāḥ । akṛtajñāśca mitrāṇāṃ te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥66॥
html:
sūcakāḥ sandhibhettāraḥ paravṛttyupajīvakāḥ ।
akṛtajñāśca mitrāṇāṃ te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥66॥
slp1: sUcakAH sanDiBettAraH paravfttyupajIvakAH । akftajYASca mitrARAM te vE nirayagAminaH ॥66॥

text: pāṣaṇḍā dūṣakāścaiva samayānāṃ ca dūṣakāḥ । ye pratyavasitāścaiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥67॥
html:
pāṣaṇḍā dūṣakāścaiva samayānāṃ ca dūṣakāḥ ।
ye pratyavasitāścaiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥67॥
slp1: pAzaRqA dUzakAScEva samayAnAM ca dUzakAH । ye pratyavasitAScEva te vE nirayagAminaH ॥67॥

text: kṛtāśaṃ kṛtanirveśaṃ kṛtabhaktaṃ kṛtaśramam । bhedairye vyapakarṣanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥68॥
html:
kṛtāśaṃ kṛtanirveśaṃ kṛtabhaktaṃ kṛtaśramam ।
bhedairye vyapakarṣanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥68॥
slp1: kftASaM kftanirveSaM kftaBaktaM kftaSramam । BedErye vyapakarzanti te vE nirayagAminaH ॥68॥

text: paryaśnanti ca ye dārānagnibhṛtyātithīṃstathā । utsannapitṛdevejyāste vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥69॥
html:
paryaśnanti ca ye dārānagnibhṛtyātithīṃstathā ।
utsannapitṛdevejyāste vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥69॥
slp1: paryaSnanti ca ye dArAnagniBftyAtiTIMstaTA । utsannapitfdevejyAste vE nirayagAminaH ॥69॥

text: vedavikrayiṇaścaiva vedānāṃ caiva dūṣakāḥ । vedānāṃ lekhakāścaiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥70॥
html:
vedavikrayiṇaścaiva vedānāṃ caiva dūṣakāḥ ।
vedānāṃ lekhakāścaiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥70॥
slp1: vedavikrayiRaScEva vedAnAM cEva dUzakAH । vedAnAM leKakAScEva te vE nirayagAminaH ॥70॥

text: cāturāśramyabāhyāśca śrutibāhyāśca ye narāḥ । vikarmabhiśca jīvanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥71॥
html:
cāturāśramyabāhyāśca śrutibāhyāśca ye narāḥ ।
vikarmabhiśca jīvanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥71॥
slp1: cAturASramyabAhyASca SrutibAhyASca ye narAH । vikarmaBiSca jIvanti te vE nirayagAminaH ॥71॥

text: keśavikrayikā rājanviṣavikrayikāśca ye । kṣīravikrayikāścaiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥72॥
html:
keśavikrayikā rājanviṣavikrayikāśca ye ।
kṣīravikrayikāścaiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥72॥
slp1: keSavikrayikA rAjanvizavikrayikASca ye । kzIravikrayikAScEva te vE nirayagAminaH ॥72॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ caiva kanyānāṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira । ye'ntaraṃ yānti kāryeṣu te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥73॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ caiva kanyānāṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira ।
ye'ntaraṃ yānti kāryeṣu te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥73॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM gavAM cEva kanyAnAM ca yuDizWira । ye'ntaraM yAnti kAryezu te vE nirayagAminaH ॥73॥

text: śastravikrayakāścaiva kartāraśca yudhiṣṭhira । śalyānāṃ dhanuṣāṃ caiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥74॥
html:
śastravikrayakāścaiva kartāraśca yudhiṣṭhira ।
śalyānāṃ dhanuṣāṃ caiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥74॥
slp1: SastravikrayakAScEva kartAraSca yuDizWira । SalyAnAM DanuzAM cEva te vE nirayagAminaH ॥74॥

text: śalyairvā śaṅkubhirvāpi śvabhrairvā bharatarṣabha । ye mārgamanurundhanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥75॥
html:
śalyairvā śaṅkubhirvāpi śvabhrairvā bharatarṣabha ।
ye mārgamanurundhanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥75॥
slp1: SalyErvA SaNkuBirvApi SvaBrErvA BaratarzaBa । ye mArgamanurunDanti te vE nirayagAminaH ॥75॥

text: upādhyāyāṃśca bhṛtyāṃśca bhaktāṃśca bharatarṣabha । ye tyajantyasamarthāṃstāṃste vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥76॥
html:
upādhyāyāṃśca bhṛtyāṃśca bhaktāṃśca bharatarṣabha ।
ye tyajantyasamarthāṃstāṃste vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥76॥
slp1: upADyAyAMSca BftyAMSca BaktAMSca BaratarzaBa । ye tyajantyasamarTAMstAMste vE nirayagAminaH ॥76॥

text: aprāptadamakāścaiva nāsānāṃ vedhakāstathā । bandhakāśca paśūnāṃ ye te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥77॥
html:
aprāptadamakāścaiva nāsānāṃ vedhakāstathā ।
bandhakāśca paśūnāṃ ye te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥77॥
slp1: aprAptadamakAScEva nAsAnAM veDakAstaTA । banDakASca paSUnAM ye te vE nirayagAminaH ॥77॥

text: agoptāraśchaladravyā baliṣaḍbhāgatatparāḥ । samarthāścāpyadātāraste vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥78॥
html:
agoptāraśchaladravyā baliṣaḍbhāgatatparāḥ ।
samarthāścāpyadātāraste vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥78॥
slp1: agoptAraSCaladravyA balizaqBAgatatparAH । samarTAScApyadAtAraste vE nirayagAminaH ॥78॥

text: kṣāntāndāntāṃstathā prājñāndīrghakālaṃ sahoṣitān । tyajanti kṛtakṛtyā ye te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥79॥
html:
kṣāntāndāntāṃstathā prājñāndīrghakālaṃ sahoṣitān ।
tyajanti kṛtakṛtyā ye te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥79॥
slp1: kzAntAndAntAMstaTA prAjYAndIrGakAlaM sahozitAn । tyajanti kftakftyA ye te vE nirayagAminaH ॥79॥

text: bālānāmatha vṛddhānāṃ dāsānāṃ caiva ye narāḥ । adattvā bhakṣayantyagre te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥80॥
html:
bālānāmatha vṛddhānāṃ dāsānāṃ caiva ye narāḥ ।
adattvā bhakṣayantyagre te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥80॥
slp1: bAlAnAmaTa vfdDAnAM dAsAnAM cEva ye narAH । adattvA Bakzayantyagre te vE nirayagAminaH ॥80॥

text: ete pūrvarṣibhirdṛṣṭāḥ proktā nirayagāminaḥ । bhāginaḥ svargalokasya vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha ॥81॥
html:
ete pūrvarṣibhirdṛṣṭāḥ proktā nirayagāminaḥ ।
bhāginaḥ svargalokasya vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha ॥81॥
slp1: ete pUrvarziBirdfzwAH proktA nirayagAminaH । BAginaH svargalokasya vakzyAmi BaratarzaBa ॥81॥

text: sarveṣveva tu kāryeṣu daivapūrveṣu bhārata । hanti putrānpaśūnkṛtsnānbrāhmaṇātikramaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥82॥
html:
sarveṣveva tu kāryeṣu daivapūrveṣu bhārata ।
hanti putrānpaśūnkṛtsnānbrāhmaṇātikramaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥82॥
slp1: sarvezveva tu kAryezu dEvapUrvezu BArata । hanti putrAnpaSUnkftsnAnbrAhmaRAtikramaH kftaH ॥82॥

text: dānena tapasā caiva satyena ca yudhiṣṭhira । ye dharmamanuvartante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥83॥
html:
dānena tapasā caiva satyena ca yudhiṣṭhira ।
ye dharmamanuvartante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥83॥
slp1: dAnena tapasA cEva satyena ca yuDizWira । ye Darmamanuvartante te narAH svargagAminaH ॥83॥

text: śuśrūṣābhistapobhiśca śrutamādāya bhārata । ye pratigrahaniḥsnehāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥84॥
html:
śuśrūṣābhistapobhiśca śrutamādāya bhārata ।
ye pratigrahaniḥsnehāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥84॥
slp1: SuSrUzABistapoBiSca SrutamAdAya BArata । ye pratigrahaniHsnehAste narAH svargagAminaH ॥84॥

text: bhayātpāpāttathābādhāddāridryādvyādhidharṣaṇāt । yatkṛte pratimucyante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥85॥
html:
bhayātpāpāttathābādhāddāridryādvyādhidharṣaṇāt ।
yatkṛte pratimucyante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥85॥
slp1: BayAtpApAttaTAbADAddAridryAdvyADiDarzaRAt । yatkfte pratimucyante te narAH svargagAminaH ॥85॥

text: kṣamāvantaśca dhīrāśca dharmakāryeṣu cotthitāḥ । maṅgalācārayuktāśca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥86॥
html:
kṣamāvantaśca dhīrāśca dharmakāryeṣu cotthitāḥ ।
maṅgalācārayuktāśca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥86॥
slp1: kzamAvantaSca DIrASca DarmakAryezu cotTitAH । maNgalAcArayuktASca te narAH svargagAminaH ॥86॥

text: nivṛttā madhumāṃsebhyaḥ paradārebhya eva ca । nivṛttāścaiva madyebhyaste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥87॥
html:
nivṛttā madhumāṃsebhyaḥ paradārebhya eva ca ।
nivṛttāścaiva madyebhyaste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥87॥
slp1: nivfttA maDumAMseByaH paradAreBya eva ca । nivfttAScEva madyeByaste narAH svargagAminaH ॥87॥

text: āśramāṇāṃ ca kartāraḥ kulānāṃ caiva bhārata । deśānāṃ nagarāṇāṃ ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥88॥
html:
āśramāṇāṃ ca kartāraḥ kulānāṃ caiva bhārata ।
deśānāṃ nagarāṇāṃ ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥88॥
slp1: ASramARAM ca kartAraH kulAnAM cEva BArata । deSAnAM nagarARAM ca te narAH svargagAminaH ॥88॥

text: vastrābharaṇadātāro bhakṣapānānnadāstathā । kuṭumbānāṃ ca dātāraste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥89॥
html:
vastrābharaṇadātāro bhakṣapānānnadāstathā ।
kuṭumbānāṃ ca dātāraste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥89॥
slp1: vastrABaraRadAtAro BakzapAnAnnadAstaTA । kuwumbAnAM ca dAtAraste narAH svargagAminaH ॥89॥

text: sarvahiṃsānivṛttāśca narāḥ sarvasahāśca ye । sarvasyāśrayabhūtāśca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥90॥
html:
sarvahiṃsānivṛttāśca narāḥ sarvasahāśca ye ।
sarvasyāśrayabhūtāśca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥90॥
slp1: sarvahiMsAnivfttASca narAH sarvasahASca ye । sarvasyASrayaBUtASca te narAH svargagAminaH ॥90॥

text: mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva śuśrūṣanti jitendriyāḥ । bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva sasnehāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥91॥
html:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva śuśrūṣanti jitendriyāḥ ।
bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva sasnehāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥91॥
slp1: mAtaraM pitaraM cEva SuSrUzanti jitendriyAH । BrAtFRAM cEva sasnehAste narAH svargagAminaH ॥91॥

text: āḍhyāśca balavantaśca yauvanasthāśca bhārata । ye vai jitendriyā dhīrāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥92॥
html:
āḍhyāśca balavantaśca yauvanasthāśca bhārata ।
ye vai jitendriyā dhīrāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥92॥
slp1: AQyASca balavantaSca yOvanasTASca BArata । ye vE jitendriyA DIrAste narAH svargagAminaH ॥92॥

text: aparāddheṣu sasnehā mṛdavo mitravatsalāḥ । ārādhanasukhāścāpi te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥93॥
html:
aparāddheṣu sasnehā mṛdavo mitravatsalāḥ ।
ārādhanasukhāścāpi te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥93॥
slp1: aparAdDezu sasnehA mfdavo mitravatsalAH । ArADanasuKAScApi te narAH svargagAminaH ॥93॥

text: sahasrapariveṣṭārastathaiva ca sahasradāḥ । trātāraśca sahasrāṇāṃ puruṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥94॥
html:
sahasrapariveṣṭārastathaiva ca sahasradāḥ ।
trātāraśca sahasrāṇāṃ puruṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥94॥
slp1: sahasraparivezwArastaTEva ca sahasradAH । trAtAraSca sahasrARAM puruzAH svargagAminaH ॥94॥

text: suvarṇasya ca dātāro gavāṃ ca bharatarṣabha । yānānāṃ vāhanānāṃ ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥95॥
html:
suvarṇasya ca dātāro gavāṃ ca bharatarṣabha ।
yānānāṃ vāhanānāṃ ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥95॥
slp1: suvarRasya ca dAtAro gavAM ca BaratarzaBa । yAnAnAM vAhanAnAM ca te narAH svargagAminaH ॥95॥

text: vaivāhikānāṃ kanyānāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira । dātāro vāsasāṃ caiva te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥96॥
html:
vaivāhikānāṃ kanyānāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira ।
dātāro vāsasāṃ caiva te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥96॥
slp1: vEvAhikAnAM kanyAnAM prezyARAM ca yuDizWira । dAtAro vAsasAM cEva te narAH svargagAminaH ॥96॥

text: vihārāvasathodyānakūpārāmasabhāpradāḥ । vaprāṇāṃ caiva kartāraste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥97॥
html:
vihārāvasathodyānakūpārāmasabhāpradāḥ ।
vaprāṇāṃ caiva kartāraste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥97॥
slp1: vihArAvasaTodyAnakUpArAmasaBApradAH । vaprARAM cEva kartAraste narAH svargagAminaH ॥97॥

text: niveśanānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ vasatīnāṃ ca bhārata । dātāraḥ prārthitānāṃ ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥98॥
html:
niveśanānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ vasatīnāṃ ca bhārata ।
dātāraḥ prārthitānāṃ ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥98॥
slp1: niveSanAnAM kzetrARAM vasatInAM ca BArata । dAtAraH prArTitAnAM ca te narAH svargagAminaH ॥98॥

text: rasānāmatha bījānāṃ dhānyānāṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira । svayamutpādya dātāraḥ puruṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥99॥
html:
rasānāmatha bījānāṃ dhānyānāṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira ।
svayamutpādya dātāraḥ puruṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥99॥
slp1: rasAnAmaTa bIjAnAM DAnyAnAM ca yuDizWira । svayamutpAdya dAtAraH puruzAH svargagAminaH ॥99॥

text: yasminkasminkule jātā bahuputrāḥ śatāyuṣaḥ । sānukrośā jitakrodhāḥ puruṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥100॥
html:
yasminkasminkule jātā bahuputrāḥ śatāyuṣaḥ ।
sānukrośā jitakrodhāḥ puruṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥100॥
slp1: yasminkasminkule jAtA bahuputrAH SatAyuzaH । sAnukroSA jitakroDAH puruzAH svargagAminaH ॥100॥

text: etaduktamamutrārthaṃ daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca bhārata । dharmādharmau ca dānasya yathā pūrvarṣibhiḥ kṛtau] ॥101॥
html:
etaduktamamutrārthaṃ daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca bhārata ।
dharmādharmau ca dānasya yathā pūrvarṣibhiḥ kṛtau] ॥101॥
slp1: etaduktamamutrArTaM dEvaM pitryaM ca BArata । DarmADarmO ca dAnasya yaTA pUrvarziBiH kftO] ॥101॥

text: idaṃ me tattvato rājanvaktumarhasi bhārata । ahiṃsayitvā keneha brahmahatyā vidhīyate ॥1॥
html:
idaṃ me tattvato rājanvaktumarhasi bhārata ।
ahiṃsayitvā keneha brahmahatyā vidhīyate ॥1॥
slp1: idaM me tattvato rAjanvaktumarhasi BArata । ahiMsayitvA keneha brahmahatyA viDIyate ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: vyāsamāmantrya rājendra purā yatpṛṣṭavānaham । tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥2॥
html:
vyāsamāmantrya rājendra purā yatpṛṣṭavānaham ।
tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ॥2॥
slp1: vyAsamAmantrya rAjendra purA yatpfzwavAnaham । tatte'haM sampravakzyAmi tadihEkamanAH SfRu ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: caturthastvaṃ vasiṣṭhasya tattvamākhyāhi me mune । ahiṃsayitvā keneha brahmahatyā vidhīyate ॥3॥
html:
caturthastvaṃ vasiṣṭhasya tattvamākhyāhi me mune ।
ahiṃsayitvā keneha brahmahatyā vidhīyate ॥3॥
slp1: caturTastvaM vasizWasya tattvamAKyAhi me mune । ahiMsayitvA keneha brahmahatyA viDIyate ॥3॥

text: iti pṛṣṭo mahārāja parāśaraśarīrajaḥ । abravīnnipuṇo dharme niḥsaṃśayamanuttamam ॥4॥
html:
iti pṛṣṭo mahārāja parāśaraśarīrajaḥ ।
abravīnnipuṇo dharme niḥsaṃśayamanuttamam ॥4॥
slp1: iti pfzwo mahArAja parASaraSarIrajaH । abravInnipuRo Darme niHsaMSayamanuttamam ॥4॥

text: brāhmaṇaṃ svayamāhūya bhikṣārthe kṛśavṛttinam । brūyānnāstīti yaḥ paścāttaṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥5॥
html:
brāhmaṇaṃ svayamāhūya bhikṣārthe kṛśavṛttinam ।
brūyānnāstīti yaḥ paścāttaṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥5॥
slp1: brAhmaRaM svayamAhUya BikzArTe kfSavfttinam । brUyAnnAstIti yaH paScAttaM vidyAdbrahmaGAtinam ॥5॥

text: madhyasthasyeha viprasya yo'nūcānasya bhārata । vṛttiṃ harati durbuddhistaṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥6॥
html:
madhyasthasyeha viprasya yo'nūcānasya bhārata ।
vṛttiṃ harati durbuddhistaṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥6॥
slp1: maDyasTasyeha viprasya yo'nUcAnasya BArata । vfttiM harati durbudDistaM vidyAdbrahmaGAtinam ॥6॥

text: gokulasya tṛṣārtasya jalārthe vasudhādhipa । utpādayati yo vighnaṃ taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥7॥
html:
gokulasya tṛṣārtasya jalārthe vasudhādhipa ।
utpādayati yo vighnaṃ taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥7॥
slp1: gokulasya tfzArtasya jalArTe vasuDADipa । utpAdayati yo viGnaM taM vidyAdbrahmaGAtinam ॥7॥

text: yaḥ pravṛttāṃ śrutiṃ samyakśāstraṃ vā munibhiḥ kṛtam । dūṣayatyanabhijñāya taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥8॥
html:
yaḥ pravṛttāṃ śrutiṃ samyakśāstraṃ vā munibhiḥ kṛtam ।
dūṣayatyanabhijñāya taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥8॥
slp1: yaH pravfttAM SrutiM samyakSAstraM vA muniBiH kftam । dUzayatyanaBijYAya taM vidyAdbrahmaGAtinam ॥8॥

text: ātmajāṃ rūpasampannāṃ mahatīṃ sadṛśe vare । na prayacchati yaḥ kanyāṃ taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥9॥
html:
ātmajāṃ rūpasampannāṃ mahatīṃ sadṛśe vare ।
na prayacchati yaḥ kanyāṃ taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥9॥
slp1: AtmajAM rUpasampannAM mahatIM sadfSe vare । na prayacCati yaH kanyAM taM vidyAdbrahmaGAtinam ॥9॥

text: adharmanirato mūḍho mithyā yo vai dvijātiṣu । dadyānmarmātigaṃ śokaṃ taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥10॥
html:
adharmanirato mūḍho mithyā yo vai dvijātiṣu ।
dadyānmarmātigaṃ śokaṃ taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥10॥
slp1: aDarmanirato mUQo miTyA yo vE dvijAtizu । dadyAnmarmAtigaM SokaM taM vidyAdbrahmaGAtinam ॥10॥

text: cakṣuṣā viprahīnasya paṅgulasya jaḍasya vā । hareta yo vai sarvasvaṃ taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥11॥
html:
cakṣuṣā viprahīnasya paṅgulasya jaḍasya vā ।
hareta yo vai sarvasvaṃ taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam ॥11॥
slp1: cakzuzA viprahInasya paNgulasya jaqasya vA । hareta yo vE sarvasvaM taM vidyAdbrahmaGAtinam ॥11॥

text: āśrame vā vane vā yo grāme vā yadi vā pure । agniṃ samutsṛjenmohāttaṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam] ॥12॥
html:
āśrame vā vane vā yo grāme vā yadi vā pure ।
agniṃ samutsṛjenmohāttaṃ vidyādbrahmaghātinam] ॥12॥
slp1: ASrame vA vane vA yo grAme vA yadi vA pure । agniM samutsfjenmohAttaM vidyAdbrahmaGAtinam] ॥12॥

text: tīrthānāṃ darśanaṃ śreyaḥ snānaṃ ca bharatarṣabha । śravaṇaṃ ca mahāprājña śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ॥1॥
html:
tīrthānāṃ darśanaṃ śreyaḥ snānaṃ ca bharatarṣabha ।
śravaṇaṃ ca mahāprājña śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: tIrTAnAM darSanaM SreyaH snAnaM ca BaratarzaBa । SravaRaM ca mahAprAjYa SrotumicCAmi tattvataH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyāni bharatarṣabha । vaktumarhasi me tāni śrotāsmi niyataḥ prabho ॥2॥
html:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyāni bharatarṣabha ।
vaktumarhasi me tāni śrotāsmi niyataḥ prabho ॥2॥
slp1: pfTivyAM yAni tIrTAni puRyAni BaratarzaBa । vaktumarhasi me tAni SrotAsmi niyataH praBo ॥2॥

text: imamaṅgirasā proktaṃ tīrthavaṃśaṃ mahādyute । śrotumarhasi bhadraṃ te prāpsyase dharmamuttamam ॥3॥
html:
imamaṅgirasā proktaṃ tīrthavaṃśaṃ mahādyute ।
śrotumarhasi bhadraṃ te prāpsyase dharmamuttamam ॥3॥
slp1: imamaNgirasA proktaM tIrTavaMSaM mahAdyute । Srotumarhasi BadraM te prApsyase Darmamuttamam ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tapovanagataṃ vipramabhigamya mahāmunim । papracchāṅgirasaṃ vīra gautamaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ॥4॥
html:
tapovanagataṃ vipramabhigamya mahāmunim ।
papracchāṅgirasaṃ vīra gautamaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tapovanagataM vipramaBigamya mahAmunim । papracCANgirasaM vIra gOtamaH saMSitavrataH ॥4॥

text: asti me bhagavankaścittīrthebhyo dharmasaṃśayaḥ । tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tanme śaṃsa mahāmune ॥5॥
html:
asti me bhagavankaścittīrthebhyo dharmasaṃśayaḥ ।
tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tanme śaṃsa mahāmune ॥5॥
slp1: asti me BagavankaScittIrTeByo DarmasaMSayaH । tatsarvaM SrotumicCAmi tanme SaMsa mahAmune ॥5॥

text: upaspṛśya phalaṃ kiṃ syātteṣu tīrtheṣu vai mune । pretyabhāve mahāprājña tadyathāsti tathā vada ॥6॥
html:
upaspṛśya phalaṃ kiṃ syātteṣu tīrtheṣu vai mune ।
pretyabhāve mahāprājña tadyathāsti tathā vada ॥6॥
slp1: upaspfSya PalaM kiM syAttezu tIrTezu vE mune । pretyaBAve mahAprAjYa tadyaTAsti taTA vada ॥6॥

text: saptāhaṃ candrabhāgāṃ vai vitastāmūrmimālinīm । vigāhya vai nirāhāro nirmamo munivadbhavet ॥7॥
html:
saptāhaṃ candrabhāgāṃ vai vitastāmūrmimālinīm ।
vigāhya vai nirāhāro nirmamo munivadbhavet ॥7॥
slp1: saptAhaM candraBAgAM vE vitastAmUrmimAlinIm । vigAhya vE nirAhAro nirmamo munivadBavet ॥7॥
author: aṅgirā uvāca ।

text: kāśmīramaṇḍale nadyo yāḥ patanti mahānadam । tā nadīḥ sindhumāsādya śīlavānsvargamāpnuyāt ॥8॥
html:
kāśmīramaṇḍale nadyo yāḥ patanti mahānadam ।
tā nadīḥ sindhumāsādya śīlavānsvargamāpnuyāt ॥8॥
slp1: kASmIramaRqale nadyo yAH patanti mahAnadam । tA nadIH sinDumAsAdya SIlavAnsvargamApnuyAt ॥8॥

text: puṣkaraṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ sāgarodakam । devikāmindramārgaṃ ca svarṇabinduṃ vigāhya ca । vibodhyate vimānasthaḥ so'psarobhirabhiṣṭutaḥ ॥9॥
html:
puṣkaraṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ sāgarodakam ।
devikāmindramārgaṃ ca svarṇabinduṃ vigāhya ca ।
vibodhyate vimānasthaḥ so'psarobhirabhiṣṭutaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: puzkaraM ca praBAsaM ca nEmizaM sAgarodakam । devikAmindramArgaM ca svarRabinduM vigAhya ca । viboDyate vimAnasTaH so'psaroBiraBizwutaH ॥9॥

text: hiraṇyabinduṃ vikṣobhya prayataścābhivādya tam । kuśeśayaṃ ca devatvaṃ pūyate tasya kilbiṣam ॥10॥
html:
hiraṇyabinduṃ vikṣobhya prayataścābhivādya tam ।
kuśeśayaṃ ca devatvaṃ pūyate tasya kilbiṣam ॥10॥
slp1: hiraRyabinduM vikzoBya prayataScABivAdya tam । kuSeSayaM ca devatvaM pUyate tasya kilbizam ॥10॥

text: indratoyāṃ samāsādya gandhamādanasannidhau । karatoyāṃ kuraṅgeṣu trirātropoṣito naraḥ । aśvamedhamavāpnoti vigāhya niyataḥ śuciḥ ॥11॥
html:
indratoyāṃ samāsādya gandhamādanasannidhau ।
karatoyāṃ kuraṅgeṣu trirātropoṣito naraḥ ।
aśvamedhamavāpnoti vigāhya niyataḥ śuciḥ ॥11॥
slp1: indratoyAM samAsAdya ganDamAdanasanniDO । karatoyAM kuraNgezu trirAtropozito naraH । aSvameDamavApnoti vigAhya niyataH SuciH ॥11॥

text: gaṅgādvāre kuśāvarte bilvake nemiparvate । tathā kanakhale snātvā dhūtapāpmā divaṃ vrajet ॥12॥
html:
gaṅgādvāre kuśāvarte bilvake nemiparvate ।
tathā kanakhale snātvā dhūtapāpmā divaṃ vrajet ॥12॥
slp1: gaNgAdvAre kuSAvarte bilvake nemiparvate । taTA kanaKale snAtvA DUtapApmA divaM vrajet ॥12॥

text: apāṃ hrada upaspṛśya vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet । brahmacārī jitakrodhaḥ satyasandhastvahiṃsakaḥ ॥13॥
html:
apāṃ hrada upaspṛśya vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet ।
brahmacārī jitakrodhaḥ satyasandhastvahiṃsakaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: apAM hrada upaspfSya vAjapeyaPalaM laBet । brahmacArI jitakroDaH satyasanDastvahiMsakaH ॥13॥

text: yatra bhāgīrathī gaṅgā bhajate diśamuttarām । maheśvarasya niṣṭhāne yo narastvabhiṣicyate । ekamāsaṃ nirāhāraḥ svayaṃ paśyati devatāḥ ॥14॥
html:
yatra bhāgīrathī gaṅgā bhajate diśamuttarām ।
maheśvarasya niṣṭhāne yo narastvabhiṣicyate ।
ekamāsaṃ nirāhāraḥ svayaṃ paśyati devatāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yatra BAgIraTI gaNgA Bajate diSamuttarAm । maheSvarasya nizWAne yo narastvaBizicyate । ekamAsaM nirAhAraH svayaM paSyati devatAH ॥14॥

text: saptagaṅge trigaṅge ca indramārge ca tarpayan । sudhāṃ vai labhate bhoktuṃ yo naro jāyate punaḥ ॥15॥
html:
saptagaṅge trigaṅge ca indramārge ca tarpayan ।
sudhāṃ vai labhate bhoktuṃ yo naro jāyate punaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: saptagaNge trigaNge ca indramArge ca tarpayan । suDAM vE laBate BoktuM yo naro jAyate punaH ॥15॥

text: mahāśrama upaspṛśya yo'gnihotraparaḥ śuciḥ । ekamāsaṃ nirāhāraḥ siddhiṃ māsena sa vrajet ॥16॥
html:
mahāśrama upaspṛśya yo'gnihotraparaḥ śuciḥ ।
ekamāsaṃ nirāhāraḥ siddhiṃ māsena sa vrajet ॥16॥
slp1: mahASrama upaspfSya yo'gnihotraparaH SuciH । ekamAsaM nirAhAraH sidDiM mAsena sa vrajet ॥16॥

text: mahāhrada upaspṛśya bhṛgutuṅge tvalolupaḥ । trirātropoṣito bhūtvā mucyate brahmahatyayā ॥17॥
html:
mahāhrada upaspṛśya bhṛgutuṅge tvalolupaḥ ।
trirātropoṣito bhūtvā mucyate brahmahatyayā ॥17॥
slp1: mahAhrada upaspfSya BfgutuNge tvalolupaH । trirAtropozito BUtvA mucyate brahmahatyayA ॥17॥

text: kanyākūpa upaspṛśya balākāyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ । deveṣu kīrtiṃ labhate yaśasā ca virājate ॥18॥
html:
kanyākūpa upaspṛśya balākāyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ ।
deveṣu kīrtiṃ labhate yaśasā ca virājate ॥18॥
slp1: kanyAkUpa upaspfSya balAkAyAM kftodakaH । devezu kIrtiM laBate yaSasA ca virAjate ॥18॥

text: deśakāla upaspṛśya tathā sundarikāhrade । aśvibhyāṃ rūpavarcasyaṃ pretya vai labhate naraḥ ॥19॥
html:
deśakāla upaspṛśya tathā sundarikāhrade ।
aśvibhyāṃ rūpavarcasyaṃ pretya vai labhate naraḥ ॥19॥
slp1: deSakAla upaspfSya taTA sundarikAhrade । aSviByAM rUpavarcasyaM pretya vE laBate naraH ॥19॥

text: mahāgaṅgāmupaspṛśya kṛttikāṅgārake tathā । pakṣamekaṃ nirāhāraḥ svargamāpnoti nirmalaḥ ॥20॥
html:
mahāgaṅgāmupaspṛśya kṛttikāṅgārake tathā ।
pakṣamekaṃ nirāhāraḥ svargamāpnoti nirmalaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: mahAgaNgAmupaspfSya kfttikANgArake taTA । pakzamekaM nirAhAraH svargamApnoti nirmalaH ॥20॥

text: vaimānika upaspṛśya kiṅkiṇīkāśrame tathā । nivāse'psarasāṃ divye kāmacārī mahīyate ॥21॥
html:
vaimānika upaspṛśya kiṅkiṇīkāśrame tathā ।
nivāse'psarasāṃ divye kāmacārī mahīyate ॥21॥
slp1: vEmAnika upaspfSya kiNkiRIkASrame taTA । nivAse'psarasAM divye kAmacArI mahIyate ॥21॥

text: kālikāśramamāsādya vipāśāyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ । brahmacārī jitakrodhastrirātrānmucyate bhavāt ॥22॥
html:
kālikāśramamāsādya vipāśāyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ ।
brahmacārī jitakrodhastrirātrānmucyate bhavāt ॥22॥
slp1: kAlikASramamAsAdya vipASAyAM kftodakaH । brahmacArI jitakroDastrirAtrAnmucyate BavAt ॥22॥

text: āśrame kṛttikānāṃ tu snātvā yastarpayetpitṝn । toṣayitvā mahādevaṃ nirmalaḥ svargamāpnuyāt ॥23॥
html:
āśrame kṛttikānāṃ tu snātvā yastarpayetpitṝn ।
toṣayitvā mahādevaṃ nirmalaḥ svargamāpnuyāt ॥23॥
slp1: ASrame kfttikAnAM tu snAtvA yastarpayetpitFn । tozayitvA mahAdevaM nirmalaH svargamApnuyAt ॥23॥

text: mahāpura upaspṛśya trirātropoṣito naraḥ । trasānāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca dvipadānāṃ bhayaṃ tyajet ॥24॥
html:
mahāpura upaspṛśya trirātropoṣito naraḥ ।
trasānāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca dvipadānāṃ bhayaṃ tyajet ॥24॥
slp1: mahApura upaspfSya trirAtropozito naraH । trasAnAM sTAvarARAM ca dvipadAnAM BayaM tyajet ॥24॥

text: devadāruvane snātvā dhūtapāpmā kṛtodakaḥ । devalokamavāpnoti saptarātroṣitaḥ śuciḥ ॥25॥
html:
devadāruvane snātvā dhūtapāpmā kṛtodakaḥ ।
devalokamavāpnoti saptarātroṣitaḥ śuciḥ ॥25॥
slp1: devadAruvane snAtvA DUtapApmA kftodakaH । devalokamavApnoti saptarAtrozitaH SuciH ॥25॥

text: kauśante ca kuśastambe droṇaśarmapade tathā । āpaḥprapatane snātaḥ sevyate so'psarogaṇaiḥ ॥26॥
html:
kauśante ca kuśastambe droṇaśarmapade tathā ।
āpaḥprapatane snātaḥ sevyate so'psarogaṇaiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: kOSante ca kuSastambe droRaSarmapade taTA । ApaHprapatane snAtaH sevyate so'psarogaREH ॥26॥

text: citrakūṭe janasthāne tathā mandākinījale । vigāhya vai nirāhāro rājalakṣmīṃ nigacchati ॥27॥
html:
citrakūṭe janasthāne tathā mandākinījale ।
vigāhya vai nirāhāro rājalakṣmīṃ nigacchati ॥27॥
slp1: citrakUwe janasTAne taTA mandAkinIjale । vigAhya vE nirAhAro rAjalakzmIM nigacCati ॥27॥

text: śyāmāyāstvāśramaṃ gatvā uṣya caivābhiṣicya ca । trīṃstrirātrānsa sandhāya gandharvanagare vaset ॥28॥
html:
śyāmāyāstvāśramaṃ gatvā uṣya caivābhiṣicya ca ।
trīṃstrirātrānsa sandhāya gandharvanagare vaset ॥28॥
slp1: SyAmAyAstvASramaM gatvA uzya cEvABizicya ca । trIMstrirAtrAnsa sanDAya ganDarvanagare vaset ॥28॥

text: ramaṇyāṃ ca upaspṛśya tathā vai gandhatārike । ekamāsaṃ nirāhārastvantardhānaphalaṃ labhet ॥29॥
html:
ramaṇyāṃ ca upaspṛśya tathā vai gandhatārike ।
ekamāsaṃ nirāhārastvantardhānaphalaṃ labhet ॥29॥
slp1: ramaRyAM ca upaspfSya taTA vE ganDatArike । ekamAsaM nirAhArastvantarDAnaPalaM laBet ॥29॥

text: kauśikīdvāramāsādya vāyubhakṣastvalolupaḥ । ekaviṃśatirātreṇa svargamārohate naraḥ ॥30॥
html:
kauśikīdvāramāsādya vāyubhakṣastvalolupaḥ ।
ekaviṃśatirātreṇa svargamārohate naraḥ ॥30॥
slp1: kOSikIdvAramAsAdya vAyuBakzastvalolupaH । ekaviMSatirAtreRa svargamArohate naraH ॥30॥

text: mataṅgavāpyāṃ yaḥ snāyādekarātreṇa sidhyati । vigāhati hyanālambamandhakaṃ vai sanātanam ॥31॥
html:
mataṅgavāpyāṃ yaḥ snāyādekarātreṇa sidhyati ।
vigāhati hyanālambamandhakaṃ vai sanātanam ॥31॥
slp1: mataNgavApyAM yaH snAyAdekarAtreRa siDyati । vigAhati hyanAlambamanDakaM vE sanAtanam ॥31॥

text: naimiṣe svargatīrthe ca upaspṛśya jitendriyaḥ । phalaṃ puruṣamedhasya labhenmāsaṃ kṛtodakaḥ ॥32॥
html:
naimiṣe svargatīrthe ca upaspṛśya jitendriyaḥ ।
phalaṃ puruṣamedhasya labhenmāsaṃ kṛtodakaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: nEmize svargatIrTe ca upaspfSya jitendriyaH । PalaM puruzameDasya laBenmAsaM kftodakaH ॥32॥

text: gaṅgāhrada upaspṛśya tathā caivotpalāvane । aśvamedhamavāpnoti tatra māsaṃ kṛtodakaḥ ॥33॥
html:
gaṅgāhrada upaspṛśya tathā caivotpalāvane ।
aśvamedhamavāpnoti tatra māsaṃ kṛtodakaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: gaNgAhrada upaspfSya taTA cEvotpalAvane । aSvameDamavApnoti tatra mAsaM kftodakaH ॥33॥

text: gaṅgāyamunayostīrthe tathā kālañjare girau । ṣaṣṭihrada upaspṛśya dānaṃ nānyadviśiṣyate ॥34॥
html:
gaṅgāyamunayostīrthe tathā kālañjare girau ।
ṣaṣṭihrada upaspṛśya dānaṃ nānyadviśiṣyate ॥34॥
slp1: gaNgAyamunayostIrTe taTA kAlaYjare girO । zazwihrada upaspfSya dAnaM nAnyadviSizyate ॥34॥

text: daśa tīrthasahasrāṇi tisraḥ koṭyastathāparāḥ । samāgacchanti māghyāṃ tu prayāge bharatarṣabha ॥35॥
html:
daśa tīrthasahasrāṇi tisraḥ koṭyastathāparāḥ ।
samāgacchanti māghyāṃ tu prayāge bharatarṣabha ॥35॥
slp1: daSa tIrTasahasrARi tisraH kowyastaTAparAH । samAgacCanti mAGyAM tu prayAge BaratarzaBa ॥35॥

text: māghamāsaṃ prayāge tu niyataḥ saṃśitavrataḥ । snātvā tu bharataśreṣṭha nirmalaḥ svargamāpnuyāt ॥36॥
html:
māghamāsaṃ prayāge tu niyataḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ।
snātvā tu bharataśreṣṭha nirmalaḥ svargamāpnuyāt ॥36॥
slp1: mAGamAsaM prayAge tu niyataH saMSitavrataH । snAtvA tu BarataSrezWa nirmalaH svargamApnuyAt ॥36॥

text: marudgaṇa upaspṛśya pitṝṇāmāśrame śuciḥ । vaivasvatasya tīrthe ca tīrthabhūto bhavennaraḥ ॥37॥
html:
marudgaṇa upaspṛśya pitṝṇāmāśrame śuciḥ ।
vaivasvatasya tīrthe ca tīrthabhūto bhavennaraḥ ॥37॥
slp1: marudgaRa upaspfSya pitFRAmASrame SuciH । vEvasvatasya tIrTe ca tIrTaBUto BavennaraH ॥37॥

text: tathā brahmaśiro gatvā bhāgīrathyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ । ekamāsaṃ nirāhāraḥ somalokamavāpnuyāt ॥38॥
html:
tathā brahmaśiro gatvā bhāgīrathyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ ।
ekamāsaṃ nirāhāraḥ somalokamavāpnuyāt ॥38॥
slp1: taTA brahmaSiro gatvA BAgIraTyAM kftodakaH । ekamAsaM nirAhAraH somalokamavApnuyAt ॥38॥

text: kapotake naraḥ snātvā aṣṭāvakre kṛtodakaḥ । dvādaśāhaṃ nirāhāro naramedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥39॥
html:
kapotake naraḥ snātvā aṣṭāvakre kṛtodakaḥ ।
dvādaśāhaṃ nirāhāro naramedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥39॥
slp1: kapotake naraH snAtvA azwAvakre kftodakaH । dvAdaSAhaM nirAhAro narameDaPalaM laBet ॥39॥

text: muñjapṛṣṭhaṃ gayāṃ caiva nirṛtiṃ devaparvatam । tṛtīyāṃ krauñcapādīṃ ca brahmahatyā viśudhyati ॥40॥
html:
muñjapṛṣṭhaṃ gayāṃ caiva nirṛtiṃ devaparvatam ।
tṛtīyāṃ krauñcapādīṃ ca brahmahatyā viśudhyati ॥40॥
slp1: muYjapfzWaM gayAM cEva nirftiM devaparvatam । tftIyAM krOYcapAdIM ca brahmahatyA viSuDyati ॥40॥

text: kalaśyāṃ vāpyupaspṛśya vedyāṃ ca bahuśojalām । agneḥ pure naraḥ snātvā viśālāyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ । devahrada upaspṛśya brahmabhūto virājate ॥41॥
html:
kalaśyāṃ vāpyupaspṛśya vedyāṃ ca bahuśojalām ।
agneḥ pure naraḥ snātvā viśālāyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ ।
devahrada upaspṛśya brahmabhūto virājate ॥41॥
slp1: kalaSyAM vApyupaspfSya vedyAM ca bahuSojalAm । agneH pure naraH snAtvA viSAlAyAM kftodakaH । devahrada upaspfSya brahmaBUto virAjate ॥41॥

text: purāpavartanaṃ nandāṃ mahānandāṃ ca sevya vai । nandane sevyate dāntastvapsarobhirahiṃsakaḥ ॥42॥
html:
purāpavartanaṃ nandāṃ mahānandāṃ ca sevya vai ।
nandane sevyate dāntastvapsarobhirahiṃsakaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: purApavartanaM nandAM mahAnandAM ca sevya vE । nandane sevyate dAntastvapsaroBirahiMsakaH ॥42॥

text: urvaśīkṛttikāyoge gatvā yaḥ susamāhitaḥ । lauhitye vidhivatsnātvā puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet ॥43॥
html:
urvaśīkṛttikāyoge gatvā yaḥ susamāhitaḥ ।
lauhitye vidhivatsnātvā puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet ॥43॥
slp1: urvaSIkfttikAyoge gatvA yaH susamAhitaH । lOhitye viDivatsnAtvA puRqarIkaPalaM laBet ॥43॥

text: rāmahrada upaspṛśya viśālāyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ । dvādaśāhaṃ nirāhāraḥ kalmaṣādvipramucyate ॥44॥
html:
rāmahrada upaspṛśya viśālāyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ ।
dvādaśāhaṃ nirāhāraḥ kalmaṣādvipramucyate ॥44॥
slp1: rAmahrada upaspfSya viSAlAyAM kftodakaH । dvAdaSAhaM nirAhAraH kalmazAdvipramucyate ॥44॥

text: mahāhrada upaspṛśya śuddhena manasā naraḥ । ekamāsaṃ nirāhāro jamadagnigatiṃ labhet ॥45॥
html:
mahāhrada upaspṛśya śuddhena manasā naraḥ ।
ekamāsaṃ nirāhāro jamadagnigatiṃ labhet ॥45॥
slp1: mahAhrada upaspfSya SudDena manasA naraH । ekamAsaM nirAhAro jamadagnigatiM laBet ॥45॥

text: vindhye santāpya cātmānaṃ satyasandhastvahiṃsakaḥ । ṣaṇmāsaṃ padamāsthāya māsenaikena śudhyati ॥46॥
html:
vindhye santāpya cātmānaṃ satyasandhastvahiṃsakaḥ ।
ṣaṇmāsaṃ padamāsthāya māsenaikena śudhyati ॥46॥
slp1: vinDye santApya cAtmAnaM satyasanDastvahiMsakaH । zaRmAsaM padamAsTAya mAsenEkena SuDyati ॥46॥

text: narmadāyāmupaspṛśya tathā sūrpārakodake । ekapakṣaṃ nirāhāro rājaputro vidhīyate ॥47॥
html:
narmadāyāmupaspṛśya tathā sūrpārakodake ।
ekapakṣaṃ nirāhāro rājaputro vidhīyate ॥47॥
slp1: narmadAyAmupaspfSya taTA sUrpArakodake । ekapakzaM nirAhAro rAjaputro viDIyate ॥47॥

text: jambūmārge tribhirmāsaiḥ saṃyataḥ susamāhitaḥ । ahorātreṇa caikena siddhiṃ samadhigacchati ॥48॥
html:
jambūmārge tribhirmāsaiḥ saṃyataḥ susamāhitaḥ ।
ahorātreṇa caikena siddhiṃ samadhigacchati ॥48॥
slp1: jambUmArge triBirmAsEH saMyataH susamAhitaH । ahorAtreRa cEkena sidDiM samaDigacCati ॥48॥

text: kokāmukhe vigāhyāpo gatvā caṇḍālikāśramam । śākabhakṣaścīravāsāḥ kumārīrvindate daśa ॥49॥
html:
kokāmukhe vigāhyāpo gatvā caṇḍālikāśramam ।
śākabhakṣaścīravāsāḥ kumārīrvindate daśa ॥49॥
slp1: kokAmuKe vigAhyApo gatvA caRqAlikASramam । SAkaBakzaScIravAsAH kumArIrvindate daSa ॥49॥

text: vaivasvatasya sadanaṃ na sa gacchetkadācana । yasya kanyāhrade vāso devalokaṃ sa gacchati ॥50॥
html:
vaivasvatasya sadanaṃ na sa gacchetkadācana ।
yasya kanyāhrade vāso devalokaṃ sa gacchati ॥50॥
slp1: vEvasvatasya sadanaM na sa gacCetkadAcana । yasya kanyAhrade vAso devalokaM sa gacCati ॥50॥

text: prabhāse tvekarātreṇa amāvāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ । sidhyate'tra mahābāho yo naro jāyate punaḥ ॥51॥
html:
prabhāse tvekarātreṇa amāvāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ ।
sidhyate'tra mahābāho yo naro jāyate punaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: praBAse tvekarAtreRa amAvAsyAM samAhitaH । siDyate'tra mahAbAho yo naro jAyate punaH ॥51॥

text: ujjānaka upaspṛśya ārṣṭiṣeṇasya cāśrame । piṅgāyāścāśrame snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥52॥
html:
ujjānaka upaspṛśya ārṣṭiṣeṇasya cāśrame ।
piṅgāyāścāśrame snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥52॥
slp1: ujjAnaka upaspfSya ArzwizeRasya cASrame । piNgAyAScASrame snAtvA sarvapApEH pramucyate ॥52॥

text: kulyāyāṃ samupaspṛśya japtvā caivāghamarṣaṇam । aśvamedhamavāpnoti trirātropoṣitaḥ śuciḥ ॥53॥
html:
kulyāyāṃ samupaspṛśya japtvā caivāghamarṣaṇam ।
aśvamedhamavāpnoti trirātropoṣitaḥ śuciḥ ॥53॥
slp1: kulyAyAM samupaspfSya japtvA cEvAGamarzaRam । aSvameDamavApnoti trirAtropozitaH SuciH ॥53॥

text: piṇḍāraka upaspṛśya ekarātroṣito naraḥ । agniṣṭomamavāpnoti prabhātāṃ śarvarīṃ śuciḥ ॥54॥
html:
piṇḍāraka upaspṛśya ekarātroṣito naraḥ ।
agniṣṭomamavāpnoti prabhātāṃ śarvarīṃ śuciḥ ॥54॥
slp1: piRqAraka upaspfSya ekarAtrozito naraH । agnizwomamavApnoti praBAtAM SarvarIM SuciH ॥54॥

text: tathā brahmasaro gatvā dharmāraṇyopaśobhitam । puṇḍarīkamavāpnoti prabhātāṃ śarvarīṃ śuciḥ ॥55॥
html:
tathā brahmasaro gatvā dharmāraṇyopaśobhitam ।
puṇḍarīkamavāpnoti prabhātāṃ śarvarīṃ śuciḥ ॥55॥
slp1: taTA brahmasaro gatvA DarmAraRyopaSoBitam । puRqarIkamavApnoti praBAtAM SarvarIM SuciH ॥55॥

text: maināke parvate snātvā tathā sandhyāmupāsya ca । kāmaṃ jitvā ca vai māsaṃ sarvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥56॥
html:
maināke parvate snātvā tathā sandhyāmupāsya ca ।
kāmaṃ jitvā ca vai māsaṃ sarvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥56॥
slp1: mEnAke parvate snAtvA taTA sanDyAmupAsya ca । kAmaM jitvA ca vE mAsaM sarvameDaPalaM laBet ॥56॥

text: vikhyāto himavānpuṇyaḥ śaṅkaraśvaśuro giriḥ । ākaraḥ sarvaratnānāṃ siddhacāraṇasevitaḥ ॥57॥
html:
vikhyāto himavānpuṇyaḥ śaṅkaraśvaśuro giriḥ ।
ākaraḥ sarvaratnānāṃ siddhacāraṇasevitaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: viKyAto himavAnpuRyaH SaNkaraSvaSuro giriH । AkaraH sarvaratnAnAM sidDacAraRasevitaH ॥57॥
