text: śarīramutsṛjettatra vidhipūrvamanāśake । adhruvaṃ jīvitaṃ jñātvā yo vai vedāntago dvijaḥ ॥58॥
html:
śarīramutsṛjettatra vidhipūrvamanāśake ।
adhruvaṃ jīvitaṃ jñātvā yo vai vedāntago dvijaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: SarIramutsfjettatra viDipUrvamanASake । aDruvaM jIvitaM jYAtvA yo vE vedAntago dvijaH ॥58॥

text: abhyarcya devatāstatra namaskṛtya munīṃstathā । tataḥ siddho divaṃ gacchedbrahmalokaṃ sanātanam ॥59॥
html:
abhyarcya devatāstatra namaskṛtya munīṃstathā ।
tataḥ siddho divaṃ gacchedbrahmalokaṃ sanātanam ॥59॥
slp1: aByarcya devatAstatra namaskftya munIMstaTA । tataH sidDo divaM gacCedbrahmalokaM sanAtanam ॥59॥

text: kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca yo jitvā tīrthamāvaset । na tena kiñcinna prāptaṃ tīrthābhigamanādbhavet ॥60॥
html:
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca yo jitvā tīrthamāvaset ।
na tena kiñcinna prāptaṃ tīrthābhigamanādbhavet ॥60॥
slp1: kAmaM kroDaM ca loBaM ca yo jitvA tIrTamAvaset । na tena kiYcinna prAptaM tIrTABigamanAdBavet ॥60॥

text: yānyagamyāni tīrthāni durgāṇi viṣamāṇi ca । manasā tāni gamyāni sarvatīrthasamāsataḥ ॥61॥
html:
yānyagamyāni tīrthāni durgāṇi viṣamāṇi ca ।
manasā tāni gamyāni sarvatīrthasamāsataḥ ॥61॥
slp1: yAnyagamyAni tIrTAni durgARi vizamARi ca । manasA tAni gamyAni sarvatIrTasamAsataH ॥61॥

text: idaṃ medhyamidaṃ dhanyamidaṃ svargyamidaṃ sukham । idaṃ rahasyaṃ devānāmāplāvyānāṃ ca pāvanam ॥62॥
html:
idaṃ medhyamidaṃ dhanyamidaṃ svargyamidaṃ sukham ।
idaṃ rahasyaṃ devānāmāplāvyānāṃ ca pāvanam ॥62॥
slp1: idaM meDyamidaM DanyamidaM svargyamidaM suKam । idaM rahasyaM devAnAmAplAvyAnAM ca pAvanam ॥62॥

text: idaṃ dadyāddvijātīnāṃ sādhūnāmātmajasya vā । suhṛdāṃ ca japetkarṇe śiṣyasyānugatasya vā ॥63॥
html:
idaṃ dadyāddvijātīnāṃ sādhūnāmātmajasya vā ।
suhṛdāṃ ca japetkarṇe śiṣyasyānugatasya vā ॥63॥
slp1: idaM dadyAddvijAtInAM sADUnAmAtmajasya vA । suhfdAM ca japetkarRe SizyasyAnugatasya vA ॥63॥

text: dattavāngautamasyedamaṅgirā vai mahātapāḥ । gurubhiḥ samanujñātaḥ kāśyapena ca dhīmatā ॥64॥
html:
dattavāngautamasyedamaṅgirā vai mahātapāḥ ।

slp1: dattavAngOtamasyedamaNgirA vE mahAtapAH । guruBiH samanujYAtaH kASyapena ca DImatA ॥64॥

text: maharṣīṇāmidaṃ japyaṃ pāvanānāṃ tathottamam । japaṃścābhyutthitaḥ śaśvannirmalaḥ svargamāpnuyāt ॥65॥
html:
maharṣīṇāmidaṃ japyaṃ pāvanānāṃ tathottamam ।
japaṃścābhyutthitaḥ śaśvannirmalaḥ svargamāpnuyāt ॥65॥
slp1: maharzIRAmidaM japyaM pAvanAnAM taTottamam । japaMScAByutTitaH SaSvannirmalaH svargamApnuyAt ॥65॥

text: idaṃ yaścāpi śṛṇuyādrahasyaṃ tvaṅgiromatam । uttame ca kule janma labhejjātiṃ ca saṃsmaret] ॥66॥
html:

uttame ca kule janma labhejjātiṃ ca saṃsmaret] ॥66॥
slp1: idaM yaScApi SfRuyAdrahasyaM tvaNgiromatam । uttame ca kule janma laBejjAtiM ca saMsmaret] ॥66॥

text: bṛhaspatisamaṃ buddhyā kṣamayā brahmaṇaḥ samam । parākrame śakrasamamādityasamatejasam ॥1॥
html:
bṛhaspatisamaṃ buddhyā kṣamayā brahmaṇaḥ samam ।

slp1: bfhaspatisamaM budDyA kzamayA brahmaRaH samam । parAkrame SakrasamamAdityasamatejasam ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: gāṅgeyamarjunenājau nihataṃ bhūrivarcasam । bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito'nyaiśca paryupāste yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥2॥
html:
gāṅgeyamarjunenājau nihataṃ bhūrivarcasam ।
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito'nyaiśca paryupāste yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥2॥
slp1: gANgeyamarjunenAjO nihataM BUrivarcasam । BrAtfBiH sahito'nyESca paryupAste yuDizWiraH ॥2॥

text: śayānaṃ vīraśayane kālākāṅkṣiṇamacyutam । ājagmurbharataśreṣṭhaṃ draṣṭukāmā maharṣayaḥ ॥3॥
html:
śayānaṃ vīraśayane kālākāṅkṣiṇamacyutam ।
ājagmurbharataśreṣṭhaṃ draṣṭukāmā maharṣayaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: SayAnaM vIraSayane kAlAkANkziRamacyutam । AjagmurBarataSrezWaM drazwukAmA maharzayaH ॥3॥

text: atrirvasiṣṭho'tha bhṛguḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ । aṅgirā gautamo'gastyaḥ sumatiḥ svāyurātmavān ॥4॥
html:

aṅgirā gautamo'gastyaḥ sumatiḥ svāyurātmavān ॥4॥
slp1: atrirvasizWo'Ta BfguH pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH । aNgirA gOtamo'gastyaH sumatiH svAyurAtmavAn ॥4॥

text: viśvāmitraḥ sthūlaśirāḥ saṃvartaḥ pramatirdamaḥ । uśanā bṛhaspatirvyāsaścyavanaḥ kāśyapo dhruvaḥ ॥5॥
html:
viśvāmitraḥ sthūlaśirāḥ saṃvartaḥ pramatirdamaḥ ।
uśanā bṛhaspatirvyāsaścyavanaḥ kāśyapo dhruvaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: viSvAmitraH sTUlaSirAH saMvartaH pramatirdamaH । uSanA bfhaspatirvyAsaScyavanaH kASyapo DruvaH ॥5॥

text: durvāsā jamadagniśca mārkaṇḍeyo'tha gālavaḥ । bharadvājaśca raibhyaśca yavakrītastritastathā ॥6॥
html:
durvāsā jamadagniśca mārkaṇḍeyo'tha gālavaḥ ।
bharadvājaśca raibhyaśca yavakrītastritastathā ॥6॥
slp1: durvAsA jamadagniSca mArkaRqeyo'Ta gAlavaH । BaradvAjaSca rEByaSca yavakrItastritastaTA ॥6॥

text: sthūlākṣaḥ śakalākṣaśca kaṇvo medhātithiḥ kṛśaḥ । nāradaḥ parvataścaiva sudhanvāthaikato dvitaḥ ॥7॥
html:
sthūlākṣaḥ śakalākṣaśca kaṇvo medhātithiḥ kṛśaḥ ।
nāradaḥ parvataścaiva sudhanvāthaikato dvitaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: sTUlAkzaH SakalAkzaSca kaRvo meDAtiTiH kfSaH । nAradaH parvataScEva suDanvATEkato dvitaH ॥7॥

text: nitambhūrbhuvano dhaumyaḥ śatānando'kṛtavraṇaḥ । jāmadagnyastathā rāmaḥ kāmyaścetyevamādayaḥ । samāgatā mahātmāno bhīṣmaṃ draṣṭuṃ maharṣayaḥ ॥8॥
html:
nitambhūrbhuvano dhaumyaḥ śatānando'kṛtavraṇaḥ ।
jāmadagnyastathā rāmaḥ kāmyaścetyevamādayaḥ ।
samāgatā mahātmāno bhīṣmaṃ draṣṭuṃ maharṣayaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: nitamBUrBuvano DOmyaH SatAnando'kftavraRaH । jAmadagnyastaTA rAmaH kAmyaScetyevamAdayaH । samAgatA mahAtmAno BIzmaM drazwuM maharzayaH ॥8॥

text: teṣāṃ mahātmanāṃ pūjāmāgatānāṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaścakre yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ॥9॥
html:
teṣāṃ mahātmanāṃ pūjāmāgatānāṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaścakre yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tezAM mahAtmanAM pUjAmAgatAnAM yuDizWiraH । BrAtfBiH sahitaScakre yaTAvadanupUrvaSaH ॥9॥

text: te pūjitāḥ sukhāsīnāḥ kathāścakrurmaharṣayaḥ । bhīṣmāśritāḥ sumadhurāḥ sarvendriyamanoharāḥ ॥10॥
html:
te pūjitāḥ sukhāsīnāḥ kathāścakrurmaharṣayaḥ ।
bhīṣmāśritāḥ sumadhurāḥ sarvendriyamanoharāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: te pUjitAH suKAsInAH kaTAScakrurmaharzayaH । BIzmASritAH sumaDurAH sarvendriyamanoharAH ॥10॥

text: bhīṣmasteṣāṃ kathāḥ śrutvā ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām । mene divisthamātmānaṃ tuṣṭyā paramayā yutaḥ ॥11॥
html:
bhīṣmasteṣāṃ kathāḥ śrutvā ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām ।
mene divisthamātmānaṃ tuṣṭyā paramayā yutaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: BIzmastezAM kaTAH SrutvA fzIRAM BAvitAtmanAm । mene divisTamAtmAnaM tuzwyA paramayA yutaH ॥11॥

text: tataste bhīṣmamāmantrya pāṇḍavāṃśca maharṣayaḥ । antardhānaṃ gatāḥ sarve sarveṣāmeva paśyatām ॥12॥
html:
tataste bhīṣmamāmantrya pāṇḍavāṃśca maharṣayaḥ ।
antardhānaṃ gatāḥ sarve sarveṣāmeva paśyatām ॥12॥
slp1: tataste BIzmamAmantrya pARqavAMSca maharzayaH । antarDAnaM gatAH sarve sarvezAmeva paSyatAm ॥12॥

text: tānṛṣīnsumahābhāgānantardhānagatānapi । pāṇḍavāstuṣṭuvuḥ sarve praṇemuśca muhurmuhuḥ ॥13॥
html:
tānṛṣīnsumahābhāgānantardhānagatānapi ।
pāṇḍavāstuṣṭuvuḥ sarve praṇemuśca muhurmuhuḥ ॥13॥
slp1: tAnfzInsumahABAgAnantarDAnagatAnapi । pARqavAstuzwuvuH sarve praRemuSca muhurmuhuH ॥13॥

html:
prasannamanasaḥ sarve gāṅgeyaṃ kurusattamāḥ ।
upatasthuryathodyantamādityaṃ mantrakovidāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: prasannamanasaH sarve gANgeyaM kurusattamAH । upatasTuryaTodyantamAdityaM mantrakovidAH ॥14॥

text: prabhāvāttapasasteṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ vīkṣya pāṇḍavāḥ । prakāśanto diśaḥ sarvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ ॥15॥
html:
prabhāvāttapasasteṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ vīkṣya pāṇḍavāḥ ।
prakāśanto diśaḥ sarvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ ॥15॥
slp1: praBAvAttapasastezAmfzIRAM vIkzya pARqavAH । prakASanto diSaH sarvA vismayaM paramaM yayuH ॥15॥

text: mahābhāgyaṃ paraṃ teṣāmṛṣīṇāmanucintya te । pāṇḍavāḥ saha bhīṣmeṇa kathāścakrustadāśrayāḥ ॥16॥
html:
mahābhāgyaṃ paraṃ teṣāmṛṣīṇāmanucintya te ।
pāṇḍavāḥ saha bhīṣmeṇa kathāścakrustadāśrayāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: mahABAgyaM paraM tezAmfzIRAmanucintya te । pARqavAH saha BIzmeRa kaTAScakrustadASrayAH ॥16॥

text: kathānte śirasā pādau spṛṣṭvā bhīṣmasya pāṇḍavaḥ । dharmyaṃ dharmasutaḥ praśnaṃ paryapṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥17॥
html:
kathānte śirasā pādau spṛṣṭvā bhīṣmasya pāṇḍavaḥ ।
dharmyaṃ dharmasutaḥ praśnaṃ paryapṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥17॥
slp1: kaTAnte SirasA pAdO spfzwvA BIzmasya pARqavaH । DarmyaM DarmasutaH praSnaM paryapfcCadyuDizWiraH ॥17॥

text: ke deśāḥ ke janapadā āśramāḥ ke ca parvatāḥ । prakṛṣṭāḥ puṇyataḥ kāśca jñeyā nadyaḥ pitāmaha ॥18॥
html:
ke deśāḥ ke janapadā āśramāḥ ke ca parvatāḥ ।
prakṛṣṭāḥ puṇyataḥ kāśca jñeyā nadyaḥ pitāmaha ॥18॥
slp1: ke deSAH ke janapadA ASramAH ke ca parvatAH । prakfzwAH puRyataH kASca jYeyA nadyaH pitAmaha ॥18॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । śiloñchavṛtteḥ saṃvādaṃ siddhasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥19॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
śiloñchavṛtteḥ saṃvādaṃ siddhasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥19॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । SiloYCavftteH saMvAdaM sidDasya ca yuDizWira ॥19॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: imāṃ kaścitparikramya pṛthivīṃ śailabhūṣitām । asakṛddvipadāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhasya gṛhamedhinaḥ ॥20॥
html:

slp1: imAM kaScitparikramya pfTivIM SElaBUzitAm । asakfddvipadAM SrezWaH SrezWasya gfhameDinaH ॥20॥

text: śilavṛttergṛhaṃ prāptaḥ sa tena vidhinārcitaḥ । kṛtakṛtya upātiṣṭhatsiddhaṃ tamatithiṃ tadā ॥21॥
html:

slp1: SilavfttergfhaM prAptaH sa tena viDinArcitaH । kftakftya upAtizWatsidDaM tamatiTiM tadA ॥21॥

text: tau sametya mahātmānau sukhāsīnau kathāḥ śubhāḥ । cakraturvedasambaddhāstaccheṣakṛtalakṣaṇāḥ ॥22॥
html:

html:

slp1: SilavfttiH kaTAnte tu sidDamAmantrya yatnataH । praSnaM papracCa meDAvI yanmAM tvaM paripfcCasi ॥23॥

text: ke deśāḥ ke janapadāḥ ke''śramāḥ ke ca parvatāḥ । prakṛṣṭāḥ puṇyataḥ kāśca jñeyā nadyastaducyatām ॥24॥
html:
ke deśāḥ ke janapadāḥ ke''śramāḥ ke ca parvatāḥ ।
prakṛṣṭāḥ puṇyataḥ kāśca jñeyā nadyastaducyatām ॥24॥
slp1: ke deSAH ke janapadAH ke''SramAH ke ca parvatAH । prakfzwAH puRyataH kASca jYeyA nadyastaducyatAm ॥24॥

text: te deśāste janapadāste''śramāste ca parvatāḥ । yeṣāṃ bhāgīrathī gaṅgā madhyenaiti saridvarā ॥25॥

te deśāste janapadāste''śramāste ca parvatāḥ ।
yeṣāṃ bhāgīrathī gaṅgā madhyenaiti saridvarā ॥25॥
slp1: te deSAste janapadAste''SramAste ca parvatAH । yezAM BAgIraTI gaNgA maDyenEti saridvarA ॥25॥
author: siddha uvāca ।

text: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajñaistyāgena vā punaḥ । gatiṃ tāṃ na labhejjanturgaṅgāṃ saṃsevya yāṃ labhet ॥26॥
html:
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajñaistyāgena vā punaḥ ।
gatiṃ tāṃ na labhejjanturgaṅgāṃ saṃsevya yāṃ labhet ॥26॥
slp1: tapasA brahmacaryeRa yajYEstyAgena vA punaH । gatiM tAM na laBejjanturgaNgAM saMsevya yAM laBet ॥26॥

text: spṛṣṭāni yeṣāṃ gāṅgeyaistoyairgātrāṇi dehinām । nyastāni na punasteṣāṃ tyāgaḥ svargādvidhīyate ॥27॥
html:
spṛṣṭāni yeṣāṃ gāṅgeyaistoyairgātrāṇi dehinām ।
nyastāni na punasteṣāṃ tyāgaḥ svargādvidhīyate ॥27॥
slp1: spfzwAni yezAM gANgeyEstoyErgAtrARi dehinAm । nyastAni na punastezAM tyAgaH svargAdviDIyate ॥27॥

html:

slp1: sarvARi yezAM gANgeyEstoyEH kftyAni dehinAm । gAM tyaktvA mAnavA vipra divi tizWanti te'calAH ॥28॥

text: pūrve vayasi karmāṇi kṛtvā pāpāni ye narāḥ । paścādgaṅgāṃ niṣevante te'pi yāntyuttamāṃ gatim ॥29॥
html:
pūrve vayasi karmāṇi kṛtvā pāpāni ye narāḥ ।
paścādgaṅgāṃ niṣevante te'pi yāntyuttamāṃ gatim ॥29॥
slp1: pUrve vayasi karmARi kftvA pApAni ye narAH । paScAdgaNgAM nizevante te'pi yAntyuttamAM gatim ॥29॥

text: snātānāṃ śucibhistoyairgāṅgeyaiḥ prayatātmanām । vyuṣṭirbhavati yā puṃsāṃ na sā kratuśatairapi ॥30॥
html:

text: yāvadasthi manuṣyasya gaṅgātoyeṣu tiṣṭhati । tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaṃ prāpya mahīyate ॥31॥
html:
yāvadasthi manuṣyasya gaṅgātoyeṣu tiṣṭhati ।

text: apahatya tamastīvraṃ yathā bhātyudaye raviḥ । tathāpahatya pāpmānaṃ bhāti gaṅgājalokṣitaḥ ॥32॥

html:

kṣatriyo yadi vā vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā rājasattama ।
brāhmaṇyaṃ prāpnuyātkena tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥2॥
slp1: kzatriyo yadi vA vESyaH SUdro vA rAjasattama । brAhmaRyaM prApnuyAtkena tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥2॥

text: tapasā vā sumahatā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā । brāhmaṇyamatha cedicchettanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥3॥
html:
tapasā vā sumahatā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā ।
brāhmaṇyamatha cedicchettanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥3॥
slp1: tapasA vA sumahatA karmaRA vA Srutena vA । brAhmaRyamaTa cedicCettanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥3॥

text: brāhmaṇyaṃ tāta duṣprāpaṃ varṇaiḥ kṣatrādibhistribhiḥ । paraṃ hi sarvabhūtānāṃ sthānametadyudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
html:
brāhmaṇyaṃ tāta duṣprāpaṃ varṇaiḥ kṣatrādibhistribhiḥ ।
paraṃ hi sarvabhūtānāṃ sthānametadyudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
slp1: brAhmaRyaM tAta duzprApaM varREH kzatrAdiBistriBiH । paraM hi sarvaBUtAnAM sTAnametadyuDizWira ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bahvīstu saṃsaranyonīrjāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ । paryāye tāta kasmiṃścidbrāhmaṇo nāma jāyate ॥5॥
html:
bahvīstu saṃsaranyonīrjāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
paryāye tāta kasmiṃścidbrāhmaṇo nāma jāyate ॥5॥
slp1: bahvIstu saMsaranyonIrjAyamAnaH punaH punaH । paryAye tAta kasmiMScidbrAhmaRo nAma jAyate ॥5॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । mataṅgasya ca saṃvādaṃ gardabhyāśca yudhiṣṭhira ॥6॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
mataṅgasya ca saṃvādaṃ gardabhyāśca yudhiṣṭhira ॥6॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । mataNgasya ca saMvAdaM gardaByASca yuDizWira ॥6॥

text: dvijāteḥ kasyacittāta tulyavarṇaḥ sutaḥ prabhuḥ । mataṅgo nāma nāmnābhūtsarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ ॥7॥
html:
dvijāteḥ kasyacittāta tulyavarṇaḥ sutaḥ prabhuḥ ।
mataṅgo nāma nāmnābhūtsarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: dvijAteH kasyacittAta tulyavarRaH sutaH praBuH । mataNgo nAma nAmnABUtsarvEH samudito guREH ॥7॥

text: sa yajñakāraḥ kaunteya pitrā sṛṣṭaḥ parantapa । prāyādgardabhayuktena rathenehāśugāminā ॥8॥
html:
sa yajñakāraḥ kaunteya pitrā sṛṣṭaḥ parantapa ।
prāyādgardabhayuktena rathenehāśugāminā ॥8॥
slp1: sa yajYakAraH kOnteya pitrA sfzwaH parantapa । prAyAdgardaBayuktena raTenehASugAminA ॥8॥

text: sa bālaṃ gardabhaṃ rājanvahantaṃ māturantike । niravidhyatpratodena nāsikāyāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ॥9॥
html:
sa bālaṃ gardabhaṃ rājanvahantaṃ māturantike ।
niravidhyatpratodena nāsikāyāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sa bAlaM gardaBaM rAjanvahantaM mAturantike । niraviDyatpratodena nAsikAyAM punaH punaH ॥9॥

text: taṃ tu tīvravraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā gardabhī putragṛddhinī । uvāca mā śucaḥ putra caṇḍālastvādhitiṣṭhati ॥10॥
html:
taṃ tu tīvravraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā gardabhī putragṛddhinī ।
uvāca mā śucaḥ putra caṇḍālastvādhitiṣṭhati ॥10॥
slp1: taM tu tIvravraRaM dfzwvA gardaBI putragfdDinI । uvAca mA SucaH putra caRqAlastvADitizWati ॥10॥

text: brāhmaṇe dāruṇaṃ nāsti maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate । ācāryaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ śāstā kiṃ prahariṣyati ॥11॥
html:
brāhmaṇe dāruṇaṃ nāsti maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate ।
ācāryaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ śāstā kiṃ prahariṣyati ॥11॥
slp1: brAhmaRe dAruRaM nAsti mEtro brAhmaRa ucyate । AcAryaH sarvaBUtAnAM SAstA kiM praharizyati ॥11॥

text: ayaṃ tu pāpaprakṛtirbāle na kurute dayām । svayoniṃ mānayatyeṣa bhāvo bhāvaṃ nigacchati ॥12॥
html:
ayaṃ tu pāpaprakṛtirbāle na kurute dayām ।
svayoniṃ mānayatyeṣa bhāvo bhāvaṃ nigacchati ॥12॥
slp1: ayaM tu pApaprakftirbAle na kurute dayAm । svayoniM mAnayatyeza BAvo BAvaM nigacCati ॥12॥

text: etacchrutvā mataṅgastu dāruṇaṃ rāsabhīvacaḥ । avatīrya rathāttūrṇaṃ rāsabhīṃ pratyabhāṣata ॥13॥
html:
etacchrutvā mataṅgastu dāruṇaṃ rāsabhīvacaḥ ।
avatīrya rathāttūrṇaṃ rāsabhīṃ pratyabhāṣata ॥13॥
slp1: etacCrutvA mataNgastu dAruRaM rAsaBIvacaH । avatIrya raTAttUrRaM rAsaBIM pratyaBAzata ॥13॥

text: brūhi rāsabhi kalyāṇi mātā me yena dūṣitā । kathaṃ māṃ vetsi caṇḍālaṃ kṣipraṃ rāsabhi śaṃsa me ॥14॥
html:
brūhi rāsabhi kalyāṇi mātā me yena dūṣitā ।
kathaṃ māṃ vetsi caṇḍālaṃ kṣipraṃ rāsabhi śaṃsa me ॥14॥
slp1: brUhi rAsaBi kalyARi mAtA me yena dUzitA । kaTaM mAM vetsi caRqAlaM kzipraM rAsaBi SaMsa me ॥14॥

text: kena jāto'smi caṇḍālo brāhmaṇyaṃ yena me'naśat । tattvenaitanmahāprājñe brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ ॥15॥
html:
kena jāto'smi caṇḍālo brāhmaṇyaṃ yena me'naśat ।
tattvenaitanmahāprājñe brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ ॥15॥
slp1: kena jAto'smi caRqAlo brAhmaRyaM yena me'naSat । tattvenEtanmahAprAjYe brUhi sarvamaSezataH ॥15॥

text: brāhmaṇyāṃ vṛṣalena tvaṃ mattāyāṃ nāpitena ha । jātastvamasi caṇḍālo brāhmaṇyaṃ tena te'naśat ॥16॥
html:
brāhmaṇyāṃ vṛṣalena tvaṃ mattāyāṃ nāpitena ha ।
jātastvamasi caṇḍālo brāhmaṇyaṃ tena te'naśat ॥16॥
slp1: brAhmaRyAM vfzalena tvaM mattAyAM nApitena ha । jAtastvamasi caRqAlo brAhmaRyaM tena te'naSat ॥16॥
author: gardabhyuvāca ।

text: evamukto mataṅgastu pratyupāyādgṛhaṃ prati । tamāgatamabhiprekṣya pitā vākyamathābravīt ॥17॥
html:
evamukto mataṅgastu pratyupāyādgṛhaṃ prati ।
tamāgatamabhiprekṣya pitā vākyamathābravīt ॥17॥
slp1: evamukto mataNgastu pratyupAyAdgfhaM prati । tamAgatamaBiprekzya pitA vAkyamaTAbravIt ॥17॥

text: mayā tvaṃ yajñasaṃsiddhau niyukto gurukarmaṇi । kasmātpratinivṛtto'si kaccinna kuśalaṃ tava ॥18॥
html:
mayā tvaṃ yajñasaṃsiddhau niyukto gurukarmaṇi ।
kasmātpratinivṛtto'si kaccinna kuśalaṃ tava ॥18॥
slp1: mayA tvaM yajYasaMsidDO niyukto gurukarmaRi । kasmAtpratinivftto'si kaccinna kuSalaM tava ॥18॥

text: ayoniragryayonirvā yaḥ syātsa kuśalī bhavet । kuśalaṃ tu kutastasya yasyeyaṃ jananī pitaḥ ॥19॥
html:
ayoniragryayonirvā yaḥ syātsa kuśalī bhavet ।
kuśalaṃ tu kutastasya yasyeyaṃ jananī pitaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: ayoniragryayonirvA yaH syAtsa kuSalI Bavet । kuSalaM tu kutastasya yasyeyaM jananI pitaH ॥19॥
author: mataṅga uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇyāṃ vṛṣalājjātaṃ pitarvedayatīha mām । amānuṣī gardabhīyaṃ tasmāttapsye tapo mahat ॥20॥
html:
brāhmaṇyāṃ vṛṣalājjātaṃ pitarvedayatīha mām ।
amānuṣī gardabhīyaṃ tasmāttapsye tapo mahat ॥20॥
slp1: brAhmaRyAM vfzalAjjAtaM pitarvedayatIha mAm । amAnuzI gardaBIyaM tasmAttapsye tapo mahat ॥20॥

text: evamuktvā sa pitaraṃ pratasthe kṛtaniścayaḥ । tato gatvā mahāraṇyamatapyata mahattapaḥ ॥21॥
html:
evamuktvā sa pitaraṃ pratasthe kṛtaniścayaḥ ।
tato gatvā mahāraṇyamatapyata mahattapaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: evamuktvA sa pitaraM pratasTe kftaniScayaH । tato gatvA mahAraRyamatapyata mahattapaH ॥21॥

text: tataḥ santāpayāmāsa vibudhāṃstapasānvitaḥ । mataṅgaḥ susukhaṃ prepsuḥ sthānaṃ sucaritādapi ॥22॥
html:
tataḥ santāpayāmāsa vibudhāṃstapasānvitaḥ ।
mataṅgaḥ susukhaṃ prepsuḥ sthānaṃ sucaritādapi ॥22॥
slp1: tataH santApayAmAsa vibuDAMstapasAnvitaH । mataNgaH susuKaM prepsuH sTAnaM sucaritAdapi ॥22॥

text: taṃ tathā tapasā yuktamuvāca harivāhanaḥ । mataṅga tapyase kiṃ tvaṃ bhogānutsṛjya mānuṣān ॥23॥
html:
taṃ tathā tapasā yuktamuvāca harivāhanaḥ ।
mataṅga tapyase kiṃ tvaṃ bhogānutsṛjya mānuṣān ॥23॥
slp1: taM taTA tapasA yuktamuvAca harivAhanaH । mataNga tapyase kiM tvaM BogAnutsfjya mAnuzAn ॥23॥

text: varaṃ dadāni te hanta vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ yadicchasi । yaccāpyavāpyamanyatte sarvaṃ prabrūhi māciram ॥24॥
html:
varaṃ dadāni te hanta vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ yadicchasi ।
yaccāpyavāpyamanyatte sarvaṃ prabrūhi māciram ॥24॥
slp1: varaM dadAni te hanta vfRIzva tvaM yadicCasi । yaccApyavApyamanyatte sarvaM prabrUhi mAciram ॥24॥

text: brāhmaṇyaṃ kāmayāno'hamidamārabdhavāṃstapaḥ । gaccheyaṃ tadavāpyeha vara eṣa vṛto mayā ॥25॥
html:
brāhmaṇyaṃ kāmayāno'hamidamārabdhavāṃstapaḥ ।
gaccheyaṃ tadavāpyeha vara eṣa vṛto mayā ॥25॥
slp1: brAhmaRyaM kAmayAno'hamidamArabDavAMstapaH । gacCeyaM tadavApyeha vara eza vfto mayA ॥25॥
author: mataṅga uvāca ।

text: etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ tamuvāca purandaraḥ । brāhmaṇyaṃ prārthayānastvamaprāpyamakṛtātmabhiḥ ॥26॥
html:
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ tamuvāca purandaraḥ ।
brāhmaṇyaṃ prārthayānastvamaprāpyamakṛtātmabhiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: etacCrutvA tu vacanaM tamuvAca purandaraH । brAhmaRyaM prArTayAnastvamaprApyamakftAtmaBiH ॥26॥

text: śreṣṭhaṃ yatsarvabhūteṣu tapo yannātivartate । tadagryaṃ prārthayānastvamacirādvinaśiṣyasi ॥27॥
html:
śreṣṭhaṃ yatsarvabhūteṣu tapo yannātivartate ।
tadagryaṃ prārthayānastvamacirādvinaśiṣyasi ॥27॥
slp1: SrezWaM yatsarvaBUtezu tapo yannAtivartate । tadagryaM prArTayAnastvamacirAdvinaSizyasi ॥27॥

text: devatāsuramartyeṣu yatpavitraṃ paraṃ smṛtam । caṇḍālayonau jātena na tatprāpyaṃ kathañcana] ॥28॥
html:
devatāsuramartyeṣu yatpavitraṃ paraṃ smṛtam ।
caṇḍālayonau jātena na tatprāpyaṃ kathañcana] ॥28॥
slp1: devatAsuramartyezu yatpavitraM paraM smftam । caRqAlayonO jAtena na tatprApyaM kaTaYcana] ॥28॥

text: evamukto mataṅgastu saṃśitātmā yatavrataḥ । atiṣṭhadekapādena varṣāṇāṃ śatamacyuta ॥1॥
html:
evamukto mataṅgastu saṃśitātmā yatavrataḥ ।
atiṣṭhadekapādena varṣāṇāṃ śatamacyuta ॥1॥
slp1: evamukto mataNgastu saMSitAtmA yatavrataH । atizWadekapAdena varzARAM Satamacyuta ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tamuvāca tataḥ śakraḥ punareva mahāyaśāḥ । mataṅga paramaṃ sthānaṃ prārthayannatidurlabham ॥2॥
html:
tamuvāca tataḥ śakraḥ punareva mahāyaśāḥ ।
mataṅga paramaṃ sthānaṃ prārthayannatidurlabham ॥2॥
slp1: tamuvAca tataH SakraH punareva mahAyaSAH । mataNga paramaM sTAnaM prArTayannatidurlaBam ॥2॥

text: mā kṛthāḥ sāhasaṃ putra naiṣa dharmapathastava । aprāpyaṃ prārthayāno hi nacirādvinaśiṣyasi ॥3॥
html:
mā kṛthāḥ sāhasaṃ putra naiṣa dharmapathastava ।
aprāpyaṃ prārthayāno hi nacirādvinaśiṣyasi ॥3॥
slp1: mA kfTAH sAhasaM putra nEza DarmapaTastava । aprApyaM prArTayAno hi nacirAdvinaSizyasi ॥3॥

text: mataṅga paramaṃ sthānaṃ vāryamāṇo mayā sakṛt । cikīrṣasyeva tapasā sarvathā na bhaviṣyasi ॥4॥
html:
mataṅga paramaṃ sthānaṃ vāryamāṇo mayā sakṛt ।
cikīrṣasyeva tapasā sarvathā na bhaviṣyasi ॥4॥
slp1: mataNga paramaM sTAnaM vAryamARo mayA sakft । cikIrzasyeva tapasA sarvaTA na Bavizyasi ॥4॥

text: tiryagyonigataḥ sarvo mānuṣyaṃ yadi gacchati । sa jāyate pulkaso vā caṇḍālo vā kadācana ॥5॥
html:
tiryagyonigataḥ sarvo mānuṣyaṃ yadi gacchati ।
sa jāyate pulkaso vā caṇḍālo vā kadācana ॥5॥
slp1: tiryagyonigataH sarvo mAnuzyaM yadi gacCati । sa jAyate pulkaso vA caRqAlo vA kadAcana ॥5॥

text: puṃścalaḥ pāpayonirvā yaḥ kaścidiha lakṣyate । sa tasyāmeva suciraṃ mataṅga parivartate ॥6॥
html:
puṃścalaḥ pāpayonirvā yaḥ kaścidiha lakṣyate ।
sa tasyāmeva suciraṃ mataṅga parivartate ॥6॥
slp1: puMScalaH pApayonirvA yaH kaScidiha lakzyate । sa tasyAmeva suciraM mataNga parivartate ॥6॥

text: tato daśaguṇe kāle labhate śūdratāmapi । śūdrayonāvapi tato bahuśaḥ parivartate ॥7॥
html:
tato daśaguṇe kāle labhate śūdratāmapi ।
śūdrayonāvapi tato bahuśaḥ parivartate ॥7॥
slp1: tato daSaguRe kAle laBate SUdratAmapi । SUdrayonAvapi tato bahuSaH parivartate ॥7॥

text: tatastriṃśadguṇe kāle labhate vaiśyatāmapi । vaiśyatāyāṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥8॥
html:
tatastriṃśadguṇe kāle labhate vaiśyatāmapi ।
vaiśyatāyāṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥8॥
slp1: tatastriMSadguRe kAle laBate vESyatAmapi । vESyatAyAM ciraM kAlaM tatrEva parivartate ॥8॥

text: tataḥ ṣaṣṭiguṇe kāle rājanyo nāma jāyate । rājanyatve ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥9॥
html:
tataḥ ṣaṣṭiguṇe kāle rājanyo nāma jāyate ।
rājanyatve ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥9॥
slp1: tataH zazwiguRe kAle rAjanyo nAma jAyate । rAjanyatve ciraM kAlaM tatrEva parivartate ॥9॥

text: tataḥ ṣaṣṭiguṇe kāle labhate brahmabandhutām । brahmabandhuściraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥10॥
html:
tataḥ ṣaṣṭiguṇe kāle labhate brahmabandhutām ।
brahmabandhuściraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥10॥
slp1: tataH zazwiguRe kAle laBate brahmabanDutAm । brahmabanDuSciraM kAlaM tatrEva parivartate ॥10॥

text: tatastu dviśate kāle labhate kāṇḍapṛṣṭhatām । kāṇḍapṛṣṭhaściraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥11॥
html:
tatastu dviśate kāle labhate kāṇḍapṛṣṭhatām ।
kāṇḍapṛṣṭhaściraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥11॥
slp1: tatastu dviSate kAle laBate kARqapfzWatAm । kARqapfzWaSciraM kAlaM tatrEva parivartate ॥11॥

text: tatastu triśate kāle labhate dvijatāmapi । tāṃ ca prāpya ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥12॥
html:
tatastu triśate kāle labhate dvijatāmapi ।
tāṃ ca prāpya ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥12॥
slp1: tatastu triSate kAle laBate dvijatAmapi । tAM ca prApya ciraM kAlaM tatrEva parivartate ॥12॥

text: tataścatuḥśate kāle śrotriyo nāma jāyate । śrotriyatve ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥13॥
html:
tataścatuḥśate kāle śrotriyo nāma jāyate ।
śrotriyatve ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate ॥13॥
slp1: tataScatuHSate kAle Srotriyo nAma jAyate । Srotriyatve ciraM kAlaM tatrEva parivartate ॥13॥

text: tadaiva krodhaharṣau ca kāmadveṣau ca putraka । atimānātivādau tamāviśanti dvijādhamam ॥14॥
html:
tadaiva krodhaharṣau ca kāmadveṣau ca putraka ।
atimānātivādau tamāviśanti dvijādhamam ॥14॥
slp1: tadEva kroDaharzO ca kAmadvezO ca putraka । atimAnAtivAdO tamAviSanti dvijADamam ॥14॥

text: tāṃścejjayati śatrūnsa tadā prāpnoti sadgatim । atha te vai jayantyenaṃ tālāgrādiva pātyate ॥15॥
html:
tāṃścejjayati śatrūnsa tadā prāpnoti sadgatim ।
atha te vai jayantyenaṃ tālāgrādiva pātyate ॥15॥
slp1: tAMScejjayati SatrUnsa tadA prApnoti sadgatim । aTa te vE jayantyenaM tAlAgrAdiva pAtyate ॥15॥

text: mataṅga sampradhāryaitadyadahaṃ tvāmacūcudam । vṛṇīṣva kāmamanyaṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ hi sudurlabham] ॥16॥
html:
mataṅga sampradhāryaitadyadahaṃ tvāmacūcudam ।
vṛṇīṣva kāmamanyaṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ hi sudurlabham] ॥16॥
slp1: mataNga sampraDAryEtadyadahaM tvAmacUcudam । vfRIzva kAmamanyaM tvaM brAhmaRyaM hi sudurlaBam] ॥16॥

text: evamukto mataṅgastu bhṛśaṃ śokaparāyaṇaḥ । atiṣṭhata gayāṃ gatvā so'ṅguṣṭhena śataṃ samāḥ ॥1॥
html:
evamukto mataṅgastu bhṛśaṃ śokaparāyaṇaḥ ।
atiṣṭhata gayāṃ gatvā so'ṅguṣṭhena śataṃ samāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: evamukto mataNgastu BfSaM SokaparAyaRaH । atizWata gayAM gatvA so'NguzWena SataM samAH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: suduṣkaraṃ vahanyogaṃ kṛśo dhamanisantataḥ । tvagasthibhūto dharmātmā sa papāteti naḥ śrutam ॥2॥
html:
suduṣkaraṃ vahanyogaṃ kṛśo dhamanisantataḥ ।
tvagasthibhūto dharmātmā sa papāteti naḥ śrutam ॥2॥
slp1: suduzkaraM vahanyogaM kfSo DamanisantataH । tvagasTiBUto DarmAtmA sa papAteti naH Srutam ॥2॥

text: taṃ patantamabhidrutya parijagrāha vāsavaḥ । varāṇāmīśvaro dātā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ॥3॥
html:
taṃ patantamabhidrutya parijagrāha vāsavaḥ ।
varāṇāmīśvaro dātā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: taM patantamaBidrutya parijagrAha vAsavaH । varARAmISvaro dAtA sarvaBUtahite rataH ॥3॥

text: mataṅga brāhmaṇatvaṃ te saṃvṛtaṃ paripanthibhiḥ । pūjayansukhamāpnoti duḥkhamāpnotyapūjayan ॥4॥
html:
mataṅga brāhmaṇatvaṃ te saṃvṛtaṃ paripanthibhiḥ ।
pūjayansukhamāpnoti duḥkhamāpnotyapūjayan ॥4॥
slp1: mataNga brAhmaRatvaM te saMvftaM paripanTiBiH । pUjayansuKamApnoti duHKamApnotyapUjayan ॥4॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇe sarvabhūtānāṃ yogakṣemaḥ samāhitaḥ । brāhmaṇebhyo'nutṛpyanti pitaro devatāstathā ॥5॥
html:
brāhmaṇe sarvabhūtānāṃ yogakṣemaḥ samāhitaḥ ।
brāhmaṇebhyo'nutṛpyanti pitaro devatāstathā ॥5॥
slp1: brAhmaRe sarvaBUtAnAM yogakzemaH samAhitaH । brAhmaReByo'nutfpyanti pitaro devatAstaTA ॥5॥

text: brāhmaṇaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ mataṅga para ucyate । brāhmaṇaḥ kurute taddhi yathā yadyacca vāñchati ॥6॥
html:
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ mataṅga para ucyate ।
brāhmaṇaḥ kurute taddhi yathā yadyacca vāñchati ॥6॥
slp1: brAhmaRaH sarvaBUtAnAM mataNga para ucyate । brAhmaRaH kurute tadDi yaTA yadyacca vAYCati ॥6॥

text: bahvīstu saṃsaranyonīrjāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ । paryāye tāta kasmiṃścidbrāhmaṇyamiha vindati ॥7॥
html:
bahvīstu saṃsaranyonīrjāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
paryāye tāta kasmiṃścidbrāhmaṇyamiha vindati ॥7॥
slp1: bahvIstu saMsaranyonIrjAyamAnaH punaH punaH । paryAye tAta kasmiMScidbrAhmaRyamiha vindati ॥7॥

text: kiṃ māṃ tudasi duḥkhārtaṃ mṛtaṃ mārayase ca mām । taṃ tu śocāmi yo labdhvā brāhmaṇyaṃ na bubhūṣate ॥8॥
html:
kiṃ māṃ tudasi duḥkhārtaṃ mṛtaṃ mārayase ca mām ।
taṃ tu śocāmi yo labdhvā brāhmaṇyaṃ na bubhūṣate ॥8॥
slp1: kiM mAM tudasi duHKArtaM mftaM mArayase ca mAm । taM tu SocAmi yo labDvA brAhmaRyaM na buBUzate ॥8॥
author: mataṅga uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇyaṃ yadi duṣprāpaṃ tribhirvarṇaiḥ śatakrato । sudurlabhaṃ tadāvāpya nānutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ ॥9॥
html:
brāhmaṇyaṃ yadi duṣprāpaṃ tribhirvarṇaiḥ śatakrato ।
sudurlabhaṃ tadāvāpya nānutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: brAhmaRyaM yadi duzprApaM triBirvarREH Satakrato । sudurlaBaM tadAvApya nAnutizWanti mAnavAH ॥9॥

text: yaḥ pāpebhyaḥ pāpatamasteṣāmadhama eva saḥ । brāhmaṇyaṃ yo'vajānīte dhanaṃ labdhveva durlabham ॥10॥
html:
yaḥ pāpebhyaḥ pāpatamasteṣāmadhama eva saḥ ।
brāhmaṇyaṃ yo'vajānīte dhanaṃ labdhveva durlabham ॥10॥
slp1: yaH pApeByaH pApatamastezAmaDama eva saH । brAhmaRyaM yo'vajAnIte DanaM labDveva durlaBam ॥10॥

text: duṣprāpaṃ khalu vipratvaṃ prāptaṃ duranupālanam । duravāpamavāpyaitannānutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ ॥11॥
html:
duṣprāpaṃ khalu vipratvaṃ prāptaṃ duranupālanam ।
duravāpamavāpyaitannānutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: duzprApaM Kalu vipratvaM prAptaM duranupAlanam । duravApamavApyEtannAnutizWanti mAnavAH ॥11॥

text: ekārāmo hyahaṃ śakra nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ । ahiṃsādamadānasthaḥ kathaṃ nārhāmi vipratām ॥12॥
html:
ekārāmo hyahaṃ śakra nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ ।
ahiṃsādamadānasthaḥ kathaṃ nārhāmi vipratām ॥12॥
slp1: ekArAmo hyahaM Sakra nirdvandvo nizparigrahaH । ahiMsAdamadAnasTaH kaTaM nArhAmi vipratAm ॥12॥

text: yathākāmavihārī syāṃ kāmarūpī vihaṅgamaḥ । brahmakṣatrāvirodhena pūjāṃ ca prāpnuyāmaham । yathā mamākṣayā kīrtirbhaveccāpi purandara ॥13॥
html:
yathākāmavihārī syāṃ kāmarūpī vihaṅgamaḥ ।
brahmakṣatrāvirodhena pūjāṃ ca prāpnuyāmaham ।
yathā mamākṣayā kīrtirbhaveccāpi purandara ॥13॥
slp1: yaTAkAmavihArI syAM kAmarUpI vihaNgamaH । brahmakzatrAviroDena pUjAM ca prApnuyAmaham । yaTA mamAkzayA kIrtirBaveccApi purandara ॥13॥

text: chandodeva iti khyātaḥ strīṇāṃ pūjyo bhaviṣyasi ॥14॥
html: chandodeva iti khyātaḥ strīṇāṃ pūjyo bhaviṣyasi ॥14॥
slp1: Candodeva iti KyAtaH strIRAM pUjyo Bavizyasi ॥14॥
author: indra uvāca ।

text: evaṃ tasmai varaṃ dattvā vāsavo'ntaradhīyata । prāṇāṃstyaktvā mataṅgo'pi prāpa tatsthānamuttamam ॥15॥
html:
evaṃ tasmai varaṃ dattvā vāsavo'ntaradhīyata ।
prāṇāṃstyaktvā mataṅgo'pi prāpa tatsthānamuttamam ॥15॥
slp1: evaM tasmE varaM dattvA vAsavo'ntaraDIyata । prARAMstyaktvA mataNgo'pi prApa tatsTAnamuttamam ॥15॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: evametatparaṃ sthānaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ nāma bhārata । tacca duṣprāpamiha vai mahendravacanaṃ yathā] ॥16॥
html:
evametatparaṃ sthānaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ nāma bhārata ।
tacca duṣprāpamiha vai mahendravacanaṃ yathā] ॥16॥
slp1: evametatparaM sTAnaM brAhmaRyaM nAma BArata । tacca duzprApamiha vE mahendravacanaM yaTA] ॥16॥

text: śrutaṃ me mahadākhyānametatkurukulodvaha । suduṣprāpaṃ bravīṣi tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ vadatāṃ vara ॥1॥
html:
śrutaṃ me mahadākhyānametatkurukulodvaha ।
suduṣprāpaṃ bravīṣi tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ vadatāṃ vara ॥1॥
slp1: SrutaM me mahadAKyAnametatkurukulodvaha । suduzprApaM bravIzi tvaM brAhmaRyaM vadatAM vara ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: viśvāmitreṇa ca purā brāhmaṇyaṃ prāptamityuta । śrūyate vadase tacca duṣprāpamiti sattama ॥2॥
html:
viśvāmitreṇa ca purā brāhmaṇyaṃ prāptamityuta ।
śrūyate vadase tacca duṣprāpamiti sattama ॥2॥
slp1: viSvAmitreRa ca purA brAhmaRyaM prAptamityuta । SrUyate vadase tacca duzprApamiti sattama ॥2॥

text: vītahavyaśca rājarṣiḥ śruto me vipratāṃ gataḥ । tadeva tāvadgāṅgeya śrotumicchāmyahaṃ vibho ॥3॥
html:
vītahavyaśca rājarṣiḥ śruto me vipratāṃ gataḥ ।
tadeva tāvadgāṅgeya śrotumicchāmyahaṃ vibho ॥3॥
slp1: vItahavyaSca rAjarziH Sruto me vipratAM gataH । tadeva tAvadgANgeya SrotumicCAmyahaM viBo ॥3॥

text: sa kena karmaṇā prāpto brāhmaṇyaṃ rājasattama । vareṇa tapasā vāpi tanme vyākhyātumarhati ॥4॥
html:
sa kena karmaṇā prāpto brāhmaṇyaṃ rājasattama ।
vareṇa tapasā vāpi tanme vyākhyātumarhati ॥4॥
slp1: sa kena karmaRA prApto brAhmaRyaM rAjasattama । vareRa tapasA vApi tanme vyAKyAtumarhati ॥4॥

text: śṛṇu rājanyathā rājā vītahavyo mahāyaśāḥ । kṣatriyaḥ sanpunaḥ prāpto brāhmaṇyaṃ lokasatkṛtam ॥5॥
html:
śṛṇu rājanyathā rājā vītahavyo mahāyaśāḥ ।
kṣatriyaḥ sanpunaḥ prāpto brāhmaṇyaṃ lokasatkṛtam ॥5॥
slp1: SfRu rAjanyaTA rAjA vItahavyo mahAyaSAH । kzatriyaH sanpunaH prApto brAhmaRyaM lokasatkftam ॥5॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: manormahātmanastāta prajādharmeṇa śāsataḥ । babhūva putro dharmātmā śaryātiriti viśrutaḥ ॥6॥
html:
manormahātmanastāta prajādharmeṇa śāsataḥ ।
babhūva putro dharmātmā śaryātiriti viśrutaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: manormahAtmanastAta prajADarmeRa SAsataH । baBUva putro DarmAtmA SaryAtiriti viSrutaH ॥6॥

text: tasyānvavāye dvau rājanrājānau sambabhūvatuḥ । hehayastālajaṅghaśca vatseṣu jayatāṃ vara ॥7॥
html:
tasyānvavāye dvau rājanrājānau sambabhūvatuḥ ।
hehayastālajaṅghaśca vatseṣu jayatāṃ vara ॥7॥
slp1: tasyAnvavAye dvO rAjanrAjAnO sambaBUvatuH । hehayastAlajaNGaSca vatsezu jayatAM vara ॥7॥

text: hehayasya tu putrāṇāṃ daśasu strīṣu bhārata । śataṃ babhūva prakhyātaṃ śūrāṇāmanivartinām ॥8॥
html:
hehayasya tu putrāṇāṃ daśasu strīṣu bhārata ।
śataṃ babhūva prakhyātaṃ śūrāṇāmanivartinām ॥8॥
slp1: hehayasya tu putrARAM daSasu strIzu BArata । SataM baBUva praKyAtaM SUrARAmanivartinAm ॥8॥

text: tulyarūpaprabhāvāṇāṃ viduṣāṃ yuddhaśālinām । dhanurvede ca vede ca sarvatraiva kṛtaśramāḥ ॥9॥
html:
tulyarūpaprabhāvāṇāṃ viduṣāṃ yuddhaśālinām ।
dhanurvede ca vede ca sarvatraiva kṛtaśramāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tulyarUpapraBAvARAM viduzAM yudDaSAlinAm । Danurvede ca vede ca sarvatrEva kftaSramAH ॥9॥

text: kāśiṣvapi nṛpo rājandivodāsapitāmahaḥ । haryaśva iti vikhyāto babhūva jayatāṃ varaḥ ॥10॥
html:
kāśiṣvapi nṛpo rājandivodāsapitāmahaḥ ।
haryaśva iti vikhyāto babhūva jayatāṃ varaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kASizvapi nfpo rAjandivodAsapitAmahaH । haryaSva iti viKyAto baBUva jayatAM varaH ॥10॥

text: sa vītahavyadāyādairāgatya puruṣarṣabha । gaṅgāyamunayormadhye saṅgrāme vinipātitaḥ ॥11॥
html:
sa vītahavyadāyādairāgatya puruṣarṣabha ।
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye saṅgrāme vinipātitaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: sa vItahavyadAyAdErAgatya puruzarzaBa । gaNgAyamunayormaDye saNgrAme vinipAtitaH ॥11॥

text: taṃ tu hatvā naravaraṃ hehayāste mahārathāḥ । pratijagmuḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ vatsānāmakutobhayāḥ ॥12॥
html:
taṃ tu hatvā naravaraṃ hehayāste mahārathāḥ ।
pratijagmuḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ vatsānāmakutobhayāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: taM tu hatvA naravaraM hehayAste mahAraTAH । pratijagmuH purIM ramyAM vatsAnAmakutoBayAH ॥12॥

text: haryaśvasya tu dāyādaḥ kāśirājo'bhyaṣicyata । sudevo devasaṅkāśaḥ sākṣāddharma ivāparaḥ ॥13॥
html:
haryaśvasya tu dāyādaḥ kāśirājo'bhyaṣicyata ।
sudevo devasaṅkāśaḥ sākṣāddharma ivāparaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: haryaSvasya tu dAyAdaH kASirAjo'Byazicyata । sudevo devasaNkASaH sAkzAdDarma ivAparaH ॥13॥

text: sa pālayanneva mahīṃ dharmātmā kāśinandanaḥ । tairvītahavyairāgatya yudhi sarvairvinirjitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
sa pālayanneva mahīṃ dharmātmā kāśinandanaḥ ।
tairvītahavyairāgatya yudhi sarvairvinirjitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sa pAlayanneva mahIM DarmAtmA kASinandanaH । tErvItahavyErAgatya yuDi sarvErvinirjitaH ॥14॥

text: tamapyājau vinirjitya pratijagmuryathāgatam । saudevistvatha kāśīśo divodāso'bhyaṣicyata ॥15॥
html:
tamapyājau vinirjitya pratijagmuryathāgatam ।
saudevistvatha kāśīśo divodāso'bhyaṣicyata ॥15॥
slp1: tamapyAjO vinirjitya pratijagmuryaTAgatam । sOdevistvaTa kASISo divodAso'Byazicyata ॥15॥

text: divodāsastu vijñāya vīryaṃ teṣāṃ mahātmanām । vārāṇasīṃ mahātejā nirmame śakraśāsanāt ॥16॥
html:
divodāsastu vijñāya vīryaṃ teṣāṃ mahātmanām ।
vārāṇasīṃ mahātejā nirmame śakraśāsanāt ॥16॥
slp1: divodAsastu vijYAya vIryaM tezAM mahAtmanAm । vArARasIM mahAtejA nirmame SakraSAsanAt ॥16॥

text: viprakṣatriyasambādhāṃ vaiśyaśūdrasamākulām । naikadravyoccayavatīṃ samṛddhavipaṇāpaṇām ॥17॥
html:
viprakṣatriyasambādhāṃ vaiśyaśūdrasamākulām ।
naikadravyoccayavatīṃ samṛddhavipaṇāpaṇām ॥17॥
slp1: viprakzatriyasambADAM vESyaSUdrasamAkulAm । nEkadravyoccayavatIM samfdDavipaRApaRAm ॥17॥

text: gaṅgāyā uttare kūle vaprānte rājasattama । gomatyā dakṣiṇe caiva śakrasyevāmarāvatīm ॥18॥
html:
gaṅgāyā uttare kūle vaprānte rājasattama ।
gomatyā dakṣiṇe caiva śakrasyevāmarāvatīm ॥18॥
slp1: gaNgAyA uttare kUle vaprAnte rAjasattama । gomatyA dakziRe cEva SakrasyevAmarAvatIm ॥18॥

text: tatra taṃ rājaśārdūlaṃ nivasantaṃ mahīpatim । āgatya hehayā bhūyaḥ paryadhāvanta bhārata ॥19॥
html:
tatra taṃ rājaśārdūlaṃ nivasantaṃ mahīpatim ।
āgatya hehayā bhūyaḥ paryadhāvanta bhārata ॥19॥
slp1: tatra taM rAjaSArdUlaM nivasantaM mahIpatim । Agatya hehayA BUyaH paryaDAvanta BArata ॥19॥

text: sa niṣpatya dadau yuddhaṃ tebhyo rājā mahābalaḥ । devāsurasamaṃ ghoraṃ divodāso mahādyutiḥ ॥20॥
html:
sa niṣpatya dadau yuddhaṃ tebhyo rājā mahābalaḥ ।
devāsurasamaṃ ghoraṃ divodāso mahādyutiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: sa nizpatya dadO yudDaM teByo rAjA mahAbalaH । devAsurasamaM GoraM divodAso mahAdyutiH ॥20॥

text: sa tu yuddhe mahārāja dinānāṃ daśatīrdaśa । hatavāhanabhūyiṣṭhastato dainyamupāgamat ॥21॥
html:
sa tu yuddhe mahārāja dinānāṃ daśatīrdaśa ।
hatavāhanabhūyiṣṭhastato dainyamupāgamat ॥21॥
slp1: sa tu yudDe mahArAja dinAnAM daSatIrdaSa । hatavAhanaBUyizWastato dEnyamupAgamat ॥21॥

text: hatayodhastato rājankṣīṇakośaśca bhūmipaḥ । divodāsaḥ purīṃ hitvā palāyanaparo'bhavat ॥22॥
html:
hatayodhastato rājankṣīṇakośaśca bhūmipaḥ ।
divodāsaḥ purīṃ hitvā palāyanaparo'bhavat ॥22॥
slp1: hatayoDastato rAjankzIRakoSaSca BUmipaH । divodAsaH purIM hitvA palAyanaparo'Bavat ॥22॥

text: sa tvāśramamupāgamya bharadvājasya dhīmataḥ । jagāma śaraṇaṃ rājā kṛtāñjalirarindama ॥23॥
html:
sa tvāśramamupāgamya bharadvājasya dhīmataḥ ।
jagāma śaraṇaṃ rājā kṛtāñjalirarindama ॥23॥
slp1: sa tvASramamupAgamya BaradvAjasya DImataH । jagAma SaraRaM rAjA kftAYjalirarindama ॥23॥

text: bhagavanvaitahavyairme yuddhe vaṃśaḥ praṇāśitaḥ । ahamekaḥ paridyūno bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ॥24॥
html:
bhagavanvaitahavyairme yuddhe vaṃśaḥ praṇāśitaḥ ।
ahamekaḥ paridyūno bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ॥24॥
slp1: BagavanvEtahavyErme yudDe vaMSaH praRASitaH । ahamekaH paridyUno BavantaM SaraRaM gataH ॥24॥
author: rājovāca ।

text: śiṣyasnehena bhagavansa māṃ rakṣitumarhasi । niḥśeṣo hi kṛto vaṃśo mama taiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ ॥25॥
html:
śiṣyasnehena bhagavansa māṃ rakṣitumarhasi ।
niḥśeṣo hi kṛto vaṃśo mama taiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ ॥25॥
slp1: Sizyasnehena Bagavansa mAM rakzitumarhasi । niHSezo hi kfto vaMSo mama tEH pApakarmaBiH ॥25॥

text: tamuvāca mahābhāgo bharadvājaḥ pratāpavān । na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyaṃ saudeva vyetu te bhayam ॥26॥
html:
tamuvāca mahābhāgo bharadvājaḥ pratāpavān ।
na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyaṃ saudeva vyetu te bhayam ॥26॥
slp1: tamuvAca mahABAgo BaradvAjaH pratApavAn । na BetavyaM na BetavyaM sOdeva vyetu te Bayam ॥26॥

slp1: ahamizwiM karomyadya putrArTaM te viSAM pate । vEtahavyasahasrARi yaTA tvaM prasahizyasi ॥27॥

text: tata iṣṭiṃ cakārarṣistasya vai putrakāmikīm । athāsya tanayo jajñe pratardana iti śrutaḥ ॥28॥

text: sa jātamātro vavṛdhe samāḥ sadyastrayodaśa । vedaṃ cādhijage kṛtsnaṃ dhanurvedaṃ ca bhārata ॥29॥

text: tataḥ sa kavacī dhanvī bāṇī dīpta ivānalaḥ । prayayau sa dhanurdhunvanvivarṣuriva toyadaḥ ॥31॥

slp1: tataH sa kavacI DanvI bARI dIpta ivAnalaH । prayayO sa DanurDunvanvivarzuriva toyadaH ॥31॥

html:

slp1: vEtahavyAstu saMSrutya raTaGozaM samudDatam । niryayurnagarAkArE raTEH pararaTArujEH ॥36॥

text: niṣkramya te naravyāghrā daṃśitāścitrayodhinaḥ । pratardanaṃ samājaghnuḥ śaravarṣairudāyudhāḥ ॥37॥

text: astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya teṣāṃ rājā pratardanaḥ । jaghāna tānmahātejā vajrānalasamaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥39॥
html:

slp1: astrErastrARi saMvArya tezAM rAjA pratardanaH । jaGAna tAnmahAtejA vajrAnalasamEH SarEH ॥39॥

text: kṛttottamāṅgāste rājanbhallaiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ । apatanrudhirārdrāṅgā nikṛttā iva kiṃśukāḥ ॥40॥
html:

apatanrudhirārdrāṅgā nikṛttā iva kiṃśukāḥ ॥40॥
slp1: kfttottamANgAste rAjanBallEH SatasahasraSaH । apatanruDirArdrANgA nikfttA iva kiMSukAH ॥40॥

text: yayau bhṛguṃ ca śaraṇaṃ vītahavyo narādhipaḥ । abhayaṃ ca dadau tasmai rājñe rājanbhṛgustathā । tato dadāvāsanaṃ ca tasmai śiṣyo bhṛgostadā ॥42॥
html:

text: bho bhoḥ ke'trāśrame santi bhṛgoḥ śiṣyā mahātmanaḥ । draṣṭumicche munimahaṃ tasyācakṣata māmiti ॥44॥

text: ayaṃ brahmannito rājā vītahavyo visarjyatām । asya putrairhi me brahmankṛtsno vaṃśaḥ praṇāśitaḥ । utsāditaśca viṣayaḥ kāśīnāṃ ratnasañcayaḥ ॥47॥

html:
śṛṇu govinda yānetānpūjayāmyarimardana ।
tvatto'nyaḥ kaḥ pumāṁlloke śrotumetadihārhati ॥5॥
slp1: SfRu govinda yAnetAnpUjayAmyarimardana । tvatto'nyaH kaH pumAṁlloke SrotumetadihArhati ॥5॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: varuṇaṃ vāyumādityaṃ parjanyaṃ jātavedasam । sthāṇuṃ skandaṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇameva ca ॥6॥
html:
varuṇaṃ vāyumādityaṃ parjanyaṃ jātavedasam ।
sthāṇuṃ skandaṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇameva ca ॥6॥
slp1: varuRaM vAyumAdityaM parjanyaM jAtavedasam । sTARuM skandaM taTA lakzmIM vizRuM brahmARameva ca ॥6॥

text: vācaspatiṃ candramasamapaḥ pṛthvīṃ sarasvatīm । satataṃ ye namasyanti tānnamasyāmyahaṃ vibho ॥7॥
html:
vācaspatiṃ candramasamapaḥ pṛthvīṃ sarasvatīm ।
satataṃ ye namasyanti tānnamasyāmyahaṃ vibho ॥7॥
slp1: vAcaspatiM candramasamapaH pfTvIM sarasvatIm । satataM ye namasyanti tAnnamasyAmyahaM viBo ॥7॥

text: tapodhanānvedavido nityaṃ vedaparāyaṇān । mahārhānvṛṣṇiśārdūla sadā sampūjayāmyaham ॥8॥
html:
tapodhanānvedavido nityaṃ vedaparāyaṇān ।
mahārhānvṛṣṇiśārdūla sadā sampūjayāmyaham ॥8॥
slp1: tapoDanAnvedavido nityaM vedaparAyaRAn । mahArhAnvfzRiSArdUla sadA sampUjayAmyaham ॥8॥

text: abhuktvā devakāryāṇi kurvate ye'vikatthanāḥ । santuṣṭāśca kṣamāyuktāstānnamasyāmyahaṃ vibho ॥9॥
html:
abhuktvā devakāryāṇi kurvate ye'vikatthanāḥ ।
santuṣṭāśca kṣamāyuktāstānnamasyāmyahaṃ vibho ॥9॥
slp1: aBuktvA devakAryARi kurvate ye'vikatTanAH । santuzwASca kzamAyuktAstAnnamasyAmyahaM viBo ॥9॥

text: samyagdadati ye ceṣṭānkṣāntā dāntā jitendriyāḥ । sasyaṃ dhanaṃ kṣitiṃ gāśca tānnamasyāmi yādava ॥10॥
html:
samyagdadati ye ceṣṭānkṣāntā dāntā jitendriyāḥ ।
sasyaṃ dhanaṃ kṣitiṃ gāśca tānnamasyāmi yādava ॥10॥
slp1: samyagdadati ye cezwAnkzAntA dAntA jitendriyAH । sasyaM DanaM kzitiM gASca tAnnamasyAmi yAdava ॥10॥

text: ye te tapasi vartante vane mūlaphalāśanāḥ । asañcayāḥ kriyāvantastānnamasyāmi yādava ॥11॥
html:
ye te tapasi vartante vane mūlaphalāśanāḥ ।
asañcayāḥ kriyāvantastānnamasyāmi yādava ॥11॥
slp1: ye te tapasi vartante vane mUlaPalASanAH । asaYcayAH kriyAvantastAnnamasyAmi yAdava ॥11॥

text: ye bhṛtyabharaṇe saktāḥ satataṃ cātithipriyāḥ । bhuñjante devaśeṣāṇi tānnamasyāmi yādava ॥12॥
html:
ye bhṛtyabharaṇe saktāḥ satataṃ cātithipriyāḥ ।
bhuñjante devaśeṣāṇi tānnamasyāmi yādava ॥12॥
slp1: ye BftyaBaraRe saktAH satataM cAtiTipriyAH । BuYjante devaSezARi tAnnamasyAmi yAdava ॥12॥

text: ye vedaṃ prāpya durdharṣā vāgmino brahmavādinaḥ । yājanādhyāpane yuktā nityaṃ tānpūjayāmyaham ॥13॥
html:
ye vedaṃ prāpya durdharṣā vāgmino brahmavādinaḥ ।
yājanādhyāpane yuktā nityaṃ tānpūjayāmyaham ॥13॥
slp1: ye vedaM prApya durDarzA vAgmino brahmavAdinaH । yAjanADyApane yuktA nityaM tAnpUjayAmyaham ॥13॥

text: prasannahṛdayāścaiva sarvasattveṣu nityaśaḥ । ā pṛṣṭhatāpātsvādhyāye yuktāstānpūjayāmyaham ॥14॥
html:
prasannahṛdayāścaiva sarvasattveṣu nityaśaḥ ।
ā pṛṣṭhatāpātsvādhyāye yuktāstānpūjayāmyaham ॥14॥
slp1: prasannahfdayAScEva sarvasattvezu nityaSaH । A pfzWatApAtsvADyAye yuktAstAnpUjayAmyaham ॥14॥

text: guruprasāde svādhyāye yatante ye sthiravratāḥ । śuśrūṣavo'nasūyantastānnamasyāmi yādava ॥15॥
html:
guruprasāde svādhyāye yatante ye sthiravratāḥ ।
śuśrūṣavo'nasūyantastānnamasyāmi yādava ॥15॥
slp1: guruprasAde svADyAye yatante ye sTiravratAH । SuSrUzavo'nasUyantastAnnamasyAmi yAdava ॥15॥

text: suvratā munayo ye ca brahmaṇyāḥ satyasaṅgarāḥ । voḍhāro havyakavyānāṃ tānnamasyāmi yādava ॥16॥
html:
suvratā munayo ye ca brahmaṇyāḥ satyasaṅgarāḥ ।
voḍhāro havyakavyānāṃ tānnamasyāmi yādava ॥16॥
slp1: suvratA munayo ye ca brahmaRyAH satyasaNgarAH । voQAro havyakavyAnAM tAnnamasyAmi yAdava ॥16॥

text: bhaikṣyacaryāsu niratāḥ kṛśā gurukulāśrayāḥ । niḥsukhā nirdhanā ye ca tānnamasyāmi yādava ॥17॥
html:
bhaikṣyacaryāsu niratāḥ kṛśā gurukulāśrayāḥ ।
niḥsukhā nirdhanā ye ca tānnamasyāmi yādava ॥17॥
slp1: BEkzyacaryAsu niratAH kfSA gurukulASrayAH । niHsuKA nirDanA ye ca tAnnamasyAmi yAdava ॥17॥

text: nirmamā niṣpratidvandvā nirhrīkā niṣprayojanāḥ । ahiṃsāniratā ye ca ye ca satyavratā narāḥ । dāntāḥ śamaparāścaiva tānnamasyāmi keśava ॥18॥
html:
nirmamā niṣpratidvandvā nirhrīkā niṣprayojanāḥ ।
ahiṃsāniratā ye ca ye ca satyavratā narāḥ ।
dāntāḥ śamaparāścaiva tānnamasyāmi keśava ॥18॥
slp1: nirmamA nizpratidvandvA nirhrIkA nizprayojanAH । ahiMsAniratA ye ca ye ca satyavratA narAH । dAntAH SamaparAScEva tAnnamasyAmi keSava ॥18॥

text: devatātithipūjāyāṃ prasaktā gṛhamedhinaḥ । kapotavṛttayo nityaṃ tānnamasyāmi yādava ॥19॥
html:
devatātithipūjāyāṃ prasaktā gṛhamedhinaḥ ।
kapotavṛttayo nityaṃ tānnamasyāmi yādava ॥19॥
slp1: devatAtiTipUjAyAM prasaktA gfhameDinaH । kapotavfttayo nityaM tAnnamasyAmi yAdava ॥19॥

text: yeṣāṃ trivargaḥ kṛtyeṣu vartate nopahīyate । śiṣṭācārapravṛttāśca tānnamasyāmyahaṃ sadā ॥20॥
html:
yeṣāṃ trivargaḥ kṛtyeṣu vartate nopahīyate ।
śiṣṭācārapravṛttāśca tānnamasyāmyahaṃ sadā ॥20॥
slp1: yezAM trivargaH kftyezu vartate nopahIyate । SizwAcArapravfttASca tAnnamasyAmyahaM sadA ॥20॥

text: brāhmaṇāstriṣu lokeṣu ye trivargamanuṣṭhitāḥ । alolupāḥ puṇyaśīlāstānnamasyāmi keśava ॥21॥
html:
brāhmaṇāstriṣu lokeṣu ye trivargamanuṣṭhitāḥ ।
alolupāḥ puṇyaśīlāstānnamasyāmi keśava ॥21॥
slp1: brAhmaRAstrizu lokezu ye trivargamanuzWitAH । alolupAH puRyaSIlAstAnnamasyAmi keSava ॥21॥

text: abbhakṣā vāyubhakṣāśca sudhābhakṣāśca ye sadā । vrataiśca vividhairyuktāstānnamasyāmi mādhava ॥22॥
html:
abbhakṣā vāyubhakṣāśca sudhābhakṣāśca ye sadā ।
vrataiśca vividhairyuktāstānnamasyāmi mādhava ॥22॥
slp1: abBakzA vAyuBakzASca suDABakzASca ye sadA । vratESca viviDEryuktAstAnnamasyAmi mADava ॥22॥

text: ayonīnagniyonīṃśca brahmayonīṃstathaiva ca । sarvabhūtātmayonīṃśca tānnamasyāmyahaṃ dvijān ॥23॥
html:
ayonīnagniyonīṃśca brahmayonīṃstathaiva ca ।
sarvabhūtātmayonīṃśca tānnamasyāmyahaṃ dvijān ॥23॥
slp1: ayonInagniyonIMSca brahmayonIMstaTEva ca । sarvaBUtAtmayonIMSca tAnnamasyAmyahaM dvijAn ॥23॥

text: nityametānnamasyāmi kṛṣṇa lokakarānṛṣīn । lokajyeṣṭhāñjñānaniṣṭhāṃstamoghnāṁllokabhāskarān ॥24॥
html:
nityametānnamasyāmi kṛṣṇa lokakarānṛṣīn ।
lokajyeṣṭhāñjñānaniṣṭhāṃstamoghnāṁllokabhāskarān ॥24॥
slp1: nityametAnnamasyAmi kfzRa lokakarAnfzIn । lokajyezWAYjYAnanizWAMstamoGnAṁllokaBAskarAn ॥24॥

text: tasmāttvamapi vārṣṇeya dvijānpūjaya nityadā । pūjitāḥ pūjanārhā hi sukhaṃ dāsyanti te'nagha ॥25॥
html:
tasmāttvamapi vārṣṇeya dvijānpūjaya nityadā ।
pūjitāḥ pūjanārhā hi sukhaṃ dāsyanti te'nagha ॥25॥
slp1: tasmAttvamapi vArzReya dvijAnpUjaya nityadA । pUjitAH pUjanArhA hi suKaM dAsyanti te'naGa ॥25॥

text: asmiṁlloke sadā hyete paratra ca sukhapradāḥ । ta ete mānyamānā vai pradāsyanti sukhaṃ tava ॥26॥
html:
asmiṁlloke sadā hyete paratra ca sukhapradāḥ ।
ta ete mānyamānā vai pradāsyanti sukhaṃ tava ॥26॥
slp1: asmiṁlloke sadA hyete paratra ca suKapradAH । ta ete mAnyamAnA vE pradAsyanti suKaM tava ॥26॥

text: ye sarvātithayo nityaṃ goṣu ca brāhmaṇeṣu ca । nityaṃ satye ca niratā durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥27॥
html:
ye sarvātithayo nityaṃ goṣu ca brāhmaṇeṣu ca ।
nityaṃ satye ca niratā durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥27॥
slp1: ye sarvAtiTayo nityaM gozu ca brAhmaRezu ca । nityaM satye ca niratA durgARyatitaranti te ॥27॥

text: nityaṃ śamaparā ye ca tathā ye cānasūyakāḥ । nityaṃ svādhyāyino ye ca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥28॥
html:
nityaṃ śamaparā ye ca tathā ye cānasūyakāḥ ।
nityaṃ svādhyāyino ye ca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥28॥
slp1: nityaM SamaparA ye ca taTA ye cAnasUyakAH । nityaM svADyAyino ye ca durgARyatitaranti te ॥28॥

text: sarvāndevānnamasyanti ye caikaṃ devamāśritāḥ । śraddadhānāśca dāntāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥29॥
html:
sarvāndevānnamasyanti ye caikaṃ devamāśritāḥ ।
śraddadhānāśca dāntāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥29॥
slp1: sarvAndevAnnamasyanti ye cEkaM devamASritAH । SraddaDAnASca dAntASca durgARyatitaranti te ॥29॥

text: tathaiva viprapravarānnamaskṛtya yatavratān । bhavanti ye dānaratā durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥30॥
html:
tathaiva viprapravarānnamaskṛtya yatavratān ।
bhavanti ye dānaratā durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥30॥
slp1: taTEva viprapravarAnnamaskftya yatavratAn । Bavanti ye dAnaratA durgARyatitaranti te ॥30॥

text: agnīnādhāya vidhivatprayatā dhārayanti ye । prāptāḥ somāhutiṃ caiva durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥31॥
html:
agnīnādhāya vidhivatprayatā dhārayanti ye ।
prāptāḥ somāhutiṃ caiva durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥31॥
slp1: agnInADAya viDivatprayatA DArayanti ye । prAptAH somAhutiM cEva durgARyatitaranti te ॥31॥

text: mātāpitrorguruṣu ca samyagvartanti ye sadā । yathā tvaṃ vṛṣṇiśārdūletyuktvaivaṃ virarāma saḥ ॥32॥
html:
mātāpitrorguruṣu ca samyagvartanti ye sadā ।
yathā tvaṃ vṛṣṇiśārdūletyuktvaivaṃ virarāma saḥ ॥32॥
slp1: mAtApitrorguruzu ca samyagvartanti ye sadA । yaTA tvaM vfzRiSArdUletyuktvEvaM virarAma saH ॥32॥

text: tasmāttvamapi kaunteya pitṛdevadvijātithīn । samyakpūjaya yena tvaṃ gatimiṣṭāmavāpsyasi] ॥33॥
html:
tasmāttvamapi kaunteya pitṛdevadvijātithīn ।
samyakpūjaya yena tvaṃ gatimiṣṭāmavāpsyasi] ॥33॥
slp1: tasmAttvamapi kOnteya pitfdevadvijAtiTIn । samyakpUjaya yena tvaM gatimizwAmavApsyasi] ॥33॥

text: kiṃ rājñaḥ sarvakṛtyānāṃ garīyaḥ syātpitāmaha । kiṃ kurvankarma nṛpatirubhau lokau samaśnute ॥1॥
html:
kiṃ rājñaḥ sarvakṛtyānāṃ garīyaḥ syātpitāmaha ।
kiṃ kurvankarma nṛpatirubhau lokau samaśnute ॥1॥
slp1: kiM rAjYaH sarvakftyAnAM garIyaH syAtpitAmaha । kiM kurvankarma nfpatiruBO lokO samaSnute ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: etadrājñaḥ kṛtyatamamabhiṣiktasya bhārata । brāhmaṇānāmanuṣṭhānamatyantaṃ sukhamicchatā । śrotriyānbrāhmaṇānvṛddhānnityamevābhipūjayet ॥2॥
html:
etadrājñaḥ kṛtyatamamabhiṣiktasya bhārata ।
brāhmaṇānāmanuṣṭhānamatyantaṃ sukhamicchatā ।
śrotriyānbrāhmaṇānvṛddhānnityamevābhipūjayet ॥2॥
slp1: etadrAjYaH kftyatamamaBiziktasya BArata । brAhmaRAnAmanuzWAnamatyantaM suKamicCatA । SrotriyAnbrAhmaRAnvfdDAnnityamevABipUjayet ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: paurajānapadāṃścāpi brāhmaṇāṃśca bahuśrutān । sāntvena bhogadānena namaskāraistathārcayet ॥3॥
html:
paurajānapadāṃścāpi brāhmaṇāṃśca bahuśrutān ।
sāntvena bhogadānena namaskāraistathārcayet ॥3॥
slp1: pOrajAnapadAMScApi brAhmaRAMSca bahuSrutAn । sAntvena BogadAnena namaskArEstaTArcayet ॥3॥

text: etatkṛtyatamaṃ rājño nityameveti lakṣayet । yathātmānaṃ yathā putrāṃstathaitānparipālayet ॥4॥
html:
etatkṛtyatamaṃ rājño nityameveti lakṣayet ।
yathātmānaṃ yathā putrāṃstathaitānparipālayet ॥4॥
slp1: etatkftyatamaM rAjYo nityameveti lakzayet । yaTAtmAnaM yaTA putrAMstaTEtAnparipAlayet ॥4॥

text: ye cāpyeṣāṃ pūjyatamāstāndṛḍhaṃ pratipūjayet । teṣu śānteṣu tadrāṣṭraṃ sarvameva virājate ॥5॥
html:
ye cāpyeṣāṃ pūjyatamāstāndṛḍhaṃ pratipūjayet ।
teṣu śānteṣu tadrāṣṭraṃ sarvameva virājate ॥5॥
slp1: ye cApyezAM pUjyatamAstAndfQaM pratipUjayet । tezu SAntezu tadrAzwraM sarvameva virAjate ॥5॥

text: te pūjyāste namaskāryāste rakṣyāḥ pitaro yathā । teṣveva yātrā lokasya bhūtānāmiva vāsave ॥6॥
html:
te pūjyāste namaskāryāste rakṣyāḥ pitaro yathā ।
teṣveva yātrā lokasya bhūtānāmiva vāsave ॥6॥
slp1: te pUjyAste namaskAryAste rakzyAH pitaro yaTA । tezveva yAtrA lokasya BUtAnAmiva vAsave ॥6॥

text: abhicārairupāyaiśca daheyurapi tejasā । niḥśeṣaṃ kupitāḥ kuryurugrāḥ satyaparākramāḥ ॥7॥
html:
abhicārairupāyaiśca daheyurapi tejasā ।
niḥśeṣaṃ kupitāḥ kuryurugrāḥ satyaparākramāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: aBicArErupAyESca daheyurapi tejasA । niHSezaM kupitAH kuryurugrAH satyaparAkramAH ॥7॥

text: nāntameṣāṃ prapaśyāmi na diśaścāpyapāvṛtāḥ । kupitāḥ samudīkṣante dāveṣvagniśikhā iva ॥8॥
html:
nāntameṣāṃ prapaśyāmi na diśaścāpyapāvṛtāḥ ।
kupitāḥ samudīkṣante dāveṣvagniśikhā iva ॥8॥
slp1: nAntamezAM prapaSyAmi na diSaScApyapAvftAH । kupitAH samudIkzante dAvezvagniSiKA iva ॥8॥

text: vidyanteṣāṃ sāhasikā guṇāsteṣāmatīva hi । kūpā iva tṛṇacchannā viśuddhā dyaurivāpare ॥9॥
html:
vidyanteṣāṃ sāhasikā guṇāsteṣāmatīva hi ।
kūpā iva tṛṇacchannā viśuddhā dyaurivāpare ॥9॥
slp1: vidyantezAM sAhasikA guRAstezAmatIva hi । kUpA iva tfRacCannA viSudDA dyOrivApare ॥9॥

text: prasahyakāriṇaḥ kecitkārpāsamṛdavo'pare । santi caiṣāmatiśaṭhāstathānye'titapasvinaḥ ॥10॥
html:
prasahyakāriṇaḥ kecitkārpāsamṛdavo'pare ।
santi caiṣāmatiśaṭhāstathānye'titapasvinaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: prasahyakAriRaH kecitkArpAsamfdavo'pare । santi cEzAmatiSaWAstaTAnye'titapasvinaH ॥10॥

text: kṛṣigorakṣyamapyanye bhaikṣamanye'pyanuṣṭhitāḥ । corāścānye'nṛtāścānye tathānye naṭanartakāḥ ॥11॥
html:
kṛṣigorakṣyamapyanye bhaikṣamanye'pyanuṣṭhitāḥ ।
corāścānye'nṛtāścānye tathānye naṭanartakāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: kfzigorakzyamapyanye BEkzamanye'pyanuzWitAH । corAScAnye'nftAScAnye taTAnye nawanartakAH ॥11॥

text: sarvakarmasu dṛśyante praśānteṣvitareṣu ca । vividhācārayuktāśca brāhmaṇā bharatarṣabha ॥12॥
html:
sarvakarmasu dṛśyante praśānteṣvitareṣu ca ।
vividhācārayuktāśca brāhmaṇā bharatarṣabha ॥12॥
slp1: sarvakarmasu dfSyante praSAntezvitarezu ca । viviDAcArayuktASca brAhmaRA BaratarzaBa ॥12॥

text: nānākarmasu yuktānāṃ bahukarmopajīvinām । dharmajñānāṃ satāṃ teṣāṃ nityamevānukīrtayet ॥13॥
html:
nānākarmasu yuktānāṃ bahukarmopajīvinām ।
dharmajñānāṃ satāṃ teṣāṃ nityamevānukīrtayet ॥13॥
slp1: nAnAkarmasu yuktAnAM bahukarmopajIvinAm । DarmajYAnAM satAM tezAM nityamevAnukIrtayet ॥13॥

text: pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca manuṣyoragarakṣasām । purohitā mahābhāgā brāhmaṇā vai narādhipa ॥14॥
html:
pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca manuṣyoragarakṣasām ।
purohitā mahābhāgā brāhmaṇā vai narādhipa ॥14॥
slp1: pitFRAM devatAnAM ca manuzyoragarakzasAm । purohitA mahABAgA brAhmaRA vE narADipa ॥14॥

text: naite devairna pitṛbhirna gandharvairna rākṣasaiḥ । nāsurairna piśācaiśca śakyā jetuṃ dvijātayaḥ ॥15॥
html:
naite devairna pitṛbhirna gandharvairna rākṣasaiḥ ।
nāsurairna piśācaiśca śakyā jetuṃ dvijātayaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: nEte devErna pitfBirna ganDarvErna rAkzasEH । nAsurErna piSAcESca SakyA jetuM dvijAtayaH ॥15॥

text: adaivaṃ daivataṃ kuryurdaivataṃ cāpyadaivatam । yamiccheyuḥ sa rājā syādyaṃ dviṣyuḥ sa parābhavet ॥16॥
html:
adaivaṃ daivataṃ kuryurdaivataṃ cāpyadaivatam ।
yamiccheyuḥ sa rājā syādyaṃ dviṣyuḥ sa parābhavet ॥16॥
slp1: adEvaM dEvataM kuryurdEvataM cApyadEvatam । yamicCeyuH sa rAjA syAdyaM dvizyuH sa parABavet ॥16॥

text: parivādaṃ ca ye kuryurbrāhmaṇānāmacetasaḥ । nindāpraśaṃsākuśalāḥ kīrtyakīrtiparāvarāḥ । parikupyanti te rājansatataṃ dviṣatāṃ dvijāḥ ॥17॥
html:
parivādaṃ ca ye kuryurbrāhmaṇānāmacetasaḥ ।
nindāpraśaṃsākuśalāḥ kīrtyakīrtiparāvarāḥ ।
parikupyanti te rājansatataṃ dviṣatāṃ dvijāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: parivAdaM ca ye kuryurbrAhmaRAnAmacetasaH । nindApraSaMsAkuSalAH kIrtyakIrtiparAvarAH । parikupyanti te rAjansatataM dvizatAM dvijAH ॥17॥

text: brāhmaṇā yaṃ praśaṃsanti puruṣaḥ sa pravardhate । brāhmaṇairyaḥ parākruṣṭaḥ parābhūyātkṣaṇāddhi saḥ ॥18॥
html:
brāhmaṇā yaṃ praśaṃsanti puruṣaḥ sa pravardhate ।
brāhmaṇairyaḥ parākruṣṭaḥ parābhūyātkṣaṇāddhi saḥ ॥18॥
slp1: brAhmaRA yaM praSaMsanti puruzaH sa pravarDate । brAhmaREryaH parAkruzwaH parABUyAtkzaRAdDi saH ॥18॥

text: śakā yavanakāmbojāstāstāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ । vṛṣalatvaṃ parigatā brāhmaṇānāmadarśanāt ॥19॥
html:
śakā yavanakāmbojāstāstāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ ।
vṛṣalatvaṃ parigatā brāhmaṇānāmadarśanāt ॥19॥
slp1: SakA yavanakAmbojAstAstAH kzatriyajAtayaH । vfzalatvaM parigatA brAhmaRAnAmadarSanAt ॥19॥

text: dramiळाśca kaliṅgāśca pulindāścāpyuśīnarāḥ । kaulāḥ sarpā māhiṣakāstāstāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ ॥20॥
html:
dramiळाśca kaliṅgāśca pulindāścāpyuśīnarāḥ ।
kaulāḥ sarpā māhiṣakāstāstāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: dramiळाSca kaliNgASca pulindAScApyuSInarAH । kOlAH sarpA mAhizakAstAstAH kzatriyajAtayaH ॥20॥

text: vṛṣalatvaṃ parigatā brāhmaṇānāmadarśanāt । śreyānparājayastebhyo na jayo jayatāṃ vara ॥21॥
html:
vṛṣalatvaṃ parigatā brāhmaṇānāmadarśanāt ।
śreyānparājayastebhyo na jayo jayatāṃ vara ॥21॥
slp1: vfzalatvaM parigatA brAhmaRAnAmadarSanAt । SreyAnparAjayasteByo na jayo jayatAM vara ॥21॥

text: yastu sarvamidaṃ hanyādbrāhmaṇaṃ ca na tatsamam । brahmavadhyā mahāndoṣa ityāhuḥ paramarṣayaḥ ॥22॥
html:
yastu sarvamidaṃ hanyādbrāhmaṇaṃ ca na tatsamam ।
brahmavadhyā mahāndoṣa ityāhuḥ paramarṣayaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: yastu sarvamidaM hanyAdbrAhmaRaM ca na tatsamam । brahmavaDyA mahAndoza ityAhuH paramarzayaH ॥22॥

text: parivādo dvijātīnāṃ na śrotavyaḥ kathañcana । āsītādhomukhastūṣṇīṃ samutthāya vrajeta vā ॥23॥
html:
parivādo dvijātīnāṃ na śrotavyaḥ kathañcana ।
āsītādhomukhastūṣṇīṃ samutthāya vrajeta vā ॥23॥
slp1: parivAdo dvijAtInAM na SrotavyaH kaTaYcana । AsItADomuKastUzRIM samutTAya vrajeta vA ॥23॥

text: na sa jāto janiṣyo vā pṛthivyāmiha kaścana । yo brāhmaṇavirodhena sukhaṃ jīvitumutsahet ॥24॥
html:
na sa jāto janiṣyo vā pṛthivyāmiha kaścana ।
yo brāhmaṇavirodhena sukhaṃ jīvitumutsahet ॥24॥
slp1: na sa jAto janizyo vA pfTivyAmiha kaScana । yo brAhmaRaviroDena suKaM jIvitumutsahet ॥24॥

text: durgraho muṣṭinā vāyurduḥsparśaḥ pāṇinā śaśī । durdharā pṛthivī mūrdhnā durjayā brāhmaṇā bhuvi] ॥25॥
html:
durgraho muṣṭinā vāyurduḥsparśaḥ pāṇinā śaśī ।
durdharā pṛthivī mūrdhnā durjayā brāhmaṇā bhuvi] ॥25॥
slp1: durgraho muzwinA vAyurduHsparSaH pARinA SaSI । durDarA pfTivI mUrDnA durjayA brAhmaRA Buvi] ॥25॥

text: brāhmaṇāneva satataṃ bhṛśaṃ sampratipūjayet । ete hi somarājāna īśvarāḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ॥1॥
html:
brāhmaṇāneva satataṃ bhṛśaṃ sampratipūjayet ।
ete hi somarājāna īśvarāḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ॥1॥
slp1: brAhmaRAneva satataM BfSaM sampratipUjayet । ete hi somarAjAna ISvarAH suKaduHKayoH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ete bhogairalaṅkārairanyaiścaiva kimicchakaiḥ । sadā pūjyā namaskāryā rakṣyāśca pitṛvannṛpaiḥ । ato rāṣṭrasya śāntirhi bhūtānāmiva vāsavāt ॥2॥
html:
ete bhogairalaṅkārairanyaiścaiva kimicchakaiḥ ।
sadā pūjyā namaskāryā rakṣyāśca pitṛvannṛpaiḥ ।
ato rāṣṭrasya śāntirhi bhūtānāmiva vāsavāt ॥2॥
slp1: ete BogEralaNkArEranyEScEva kimicCakEH । sadA pUjyA namaskAryA rakzyASca pitfvannfpEH । ato rAzwrasya SAntirhi BUtAnAmiva vAsavAt ॥2॥

text: jāyatāṃ brahmavarcasvī rāṣṭre vai brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ । mahārathaśca rājanya eṣṭavyaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ ॥3॥
html:
jāyatāṃ brahmavarcasvī rāṣṭre vai brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ ।
mahārathaśca rājanya eṣṭavyaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: jAyatAM brahmavarcasvI rAzwre vE brAhmaRaH SuciH । mahAraTaSca rAjanya ezwavyaH SatrutApanaH ॥3॥

text: brāhmaṇaṃ jātisampannaṃ dharmajñaṃ saṃśitavratam । vāsayeta gṛhe rājanna tasmātparamasti vai ॥4॥
html:
brāhmaṇaṃ jātisampannaṃ dharmajñaṃ saṃśitavratam ।
vāsayeta gṛhe rājanna tasmātparamasti vai ॥4॥
slp1: brAhmaRaM jAtisampannaM DarmajYaM saMSitavratam । vAsayeta gfhe rAjanna tasmAtparamasti vE ॥4॥

text: brāhmaṇebhyo havirdattaṃ pratigṛhṇanti devatāḥ । pitaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ naitebhyo vidyate param ॥5॥
html:
brāhmaṇebhyo havirdattaṃ pratigṛhṇanti devatāḥ ।
pitaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ naitebhyo vidyate param ॥5॥
slp1: brAhmaReByo havirdattaM pratigfhRanti devatAH । pitaraH sarvaBUtAnAM nEteByo vidyate param ॥5॥

text: ādityaścandramā vāyurbhūmirāpo'mbaraṃ diśaḥ । sarve brāhmaṇamāviśya sadānnamupabhuñjate ॥6॥
html:
ādityaścandramā vāyurbhūmirāpo'mbaraṃ diśaḥ ।
sarve brāhmaṇamāviśya sadānnamupabhuñjate ॥6॥
slp1: AdityaScandramA vAyurBUmirApo'mbaraM diSaH । sarve brAhmaRamAviSya sadAnnamupaBuYjate ॥6॥

text: na tasyāśnanti pitaro yasya viprā na bhuñjate । devāścāpyasya nāśnanti pāpasya brāhmaṇadviṣaḥ ॥7॥
html:
na tasyāśnanti pitaro yasya viprā na bhuñjate ।
devāścāpyasya nāśnanti pāpasya brāhmaṇadviṣaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: na tasyASnanti pitaro yasya viprA na BuYjate । devAScApyasya nASnanti pApasya brAhmaRadvizaH ॥7॥

text: brāhmaṇeṣu tu tuṣṭeṣu prīyante pitaraḥ sadā । tathaiva devatā rājannātra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥8॥
html:
brāhmaṇeṣu tu tuṣṭeṣu prīyante pitaraḥ sadā ।
tathaiva devatā rājannātra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥8॥
slp1: brAhmaRezu tu tuzwezu prIyante pitaraH sadA । taTEva devatA rAjannAtra kAryA vicAraRA ॥8॥

text: tathaiva te'pi prīyante yeṣāṃ bhavati taddhaviḥ । na ca pretya vinaśyanti gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ॥9॥
html:
tathaiva te'pi prīyante yeṣāṃ bhavati taddhaviḥ ।
na ca pretya vinaśyanti gacchanti paramāṃ gatim ॥9॥
slp1: taTEva te'pi prIyante yezAM Bavati tadDaviH । na ca pretya vinaSyanti gacCanti paramAM gatim ॥9॥

text: yena yenaiva haviṣā brāhmaṇāṃstarpayennaraḥ । tena tenaiva prīyante pitaro devatāstathā ॥10॥
html:
yena yenaiva haviṣā brāhmaṇāṃstarpayennaraḥ ।
tena tenaiva prīyante pitaro devatāstathā ॥10॥
slp1: yena yenEva havizA brAhmaRAMstarpayennaraH । tena tenEva prIyante pitaro devatAstaTA ॥10॥

text: brāhmaṇādeva tadbhūtaṃ prabhavanti yataḥ prajāḥ । yataścāyaṃ prabhavati pretya yatra ca gacchati ॥11॥
html:
brāhmaṇādeva tadbhūtaṃ prabhavanti yataḥ prajāḥ ।
yataścāyaṃ prabhavati pretya yatra ca gacchati ॥11॥
slp1: brAhmaRAdeva tadBUtaM praBavanti yataH prajAH । yataScAyaM praBavati pretya yatra ca gacCati ॥11॥

text: vedaiṣa mārgaṃ svargasya tathaiva narakasya ca । āgatānāgate cobhe brāhmaṇo dvipadāṃ varaḥ । brāhmaṇo bharataśreṣṭha svadharmaṃ veda medhayā ॥12॥
html:
vedaiṣa mārgaṃ svargasya tathaiva narakasya ca ।
āgatānāgate cobhe brāhmaṇo dvipadāṃ varaḥ ।
brāhmaṇo bharataśreṣṭha svadharmaṃ veda medhayā ॥12॥
slp1: vedEza mArgaM svargasya taTEva narakasya ca । AgatAnAgate coBe brAhmaRo dvipadAM varaH । brAhmaRo BarataSrezWa svaDarmaM veda meDayA ॥12॥

text: ye cainamanuvartante te na yānti parābhavam । na te pretya vinaśyanti gacchanti na parābhavam ॥13॥
html:
ye cainamanuvartante te na yānti parābhavam ।
na te pretya vinaśyanti gacchanti na parābhavam ॥13॥
slp1: ye cEnamanuvartante te na yAnti parABavam । na te pretya vinaSyanti gacCanti na parABavam ॥13॥

text: ye brāhmaṇamukhātprāptaṃ pratigṛhṇanti vai vacaḥ । kṛtātmāno mahātmānaste na yānti parābhavam ॥14॥
html:
ye brāhmaṇamukhātprāptaṃ pratigṛhṇanti vai vacaḥ ।
kṛtātmāno mahātmānaste na yānti parābhavam ॥14॥
slp1: ye brAhmaRamuKAtprAptaM pratigfhRanti vE vacaH । kftAtmAno mahAtmAnaste na yAnti parABavam ॥14॥

text: kṣatriyāṇāṃ pratapatāṃ tejasā ca balena ca । brāhmaṇeṣveva śāmyanti tejāṃsi ca balāni ca ॥15॥
html:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ pratapatāṃ tejasā ca balena ca ।
brāhmaṇeṣveva śāmyanti tejāṃsi ca balāni ca ॥15॥
slp1: kzatriyARAM pratapatAM tejasA ca balena ca । brAhmaRezveva SAmyanti tejAMsi ca balAni ca ॥15॥

text: bhṛgavo'jayaṃstālajaṅghānnīpānaṅgiraso'jayan । bharadvājo vaitahavyānailāṃśca bharatarṣabha ॥16॥
html:
bhṛgavo'jayaṃstālajaṅghānnīpānaṅgiraso'jayan ।
bharadvājo vaitahavyānailāṃśca bharatarṣabha ॥16॥
slp1: Bfgavo'jayaMstAlajaNGAnnIpAnaNgiraso'jayan । BaradvAjo vEtahavyAnElAMSca BaratarzaBa ॥16॥

text: citrāyudhāṃścāpyajayannete kṛṣṇājinadhvajāḥ । prakṣipyātha ca kumbhānvai pāragāminamārabhet ॥17॥
html:
citrāyudhāṃścāpyajayannete kṛṣṇājinadhvajāḥ ।
prakṣipyātha ca kumbhānvai pāragāminamārabhet ॥17॥
slp1: citrAyuDAMScApyajayannete kfzRAjinaDvajAH । prakzipyATa ca kumBAnvE pAragAminamAraBet ॥17॥

text: yatkiñcitkathyate loke śrūyate paśyate'pi vā । sarvaṃ tadbrāhmaṇeṣveva gūḍho'gniriva dāruṣu ॥18॥
html:
yatkiñcitkathyate loke śrūyate paśyate'pi vā ।
sarvaṃ tadbrāhmaṇeṣveva gūḍho'gniriva dāruṣu ॥18॥
slp1: yatkiYcitkaTyate loke SrUyate paSyate'pi vA । sarvaM tadbrAhmaRezveva gUQo'gniriva dAruzu ॥18॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । saṃvādaṃ vāsudevasya pṛthvyāśca bharatarṣabha ॥19॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
saṃvādaṃ vāsudevasya pṛthvyāśca bharatarṣabha ॥19॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । saMvAdaM vAsudevasya pfTvyASca BaratarzaBa ॥19॥

text: mātaraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pṛcche tvā saṃśayaṃ śubhe । kena svitkarmaṇā pāpaṃ vyapohati naro gṛhī ॥20॥
html:
mātaraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pṛcche tvā saṃśayaṃ śubhe ।
kena svitkarmaṇā pāpaṃ vyapohati naro gṛhī ॥20॥
slp1: mAtaraM sarvaBUtAnAM pfcCe tvA saMSayaM SuBe । kena svitkarmaRA pApaM vyapohati naro gfhI ॥20॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇāneva seveta pavitraṃ hyetaduttamam । brāhmaṇānsevamānasya rajaḥ sarvaṃ praṇaśyati ॥21॥
html:
brāhmaṇāneva seveta pavitraṃ hyetaduttamam ।
brāhmaṇānsevamānasya rajaḥ sarvaṃ praṇaśyati ॥21॥
slp1: brAhmaRAneva seveta pavitraM hyetaduttamam । brAhmaRAnsevamAnasya rajaH sarvaM praRaSyati ॥21॥
author: pṛthivyuvāca ।

text: ato bhūtirataḥ kīrtirato buddhiḥ prajāyate । apareṣāṃ pareṣāṃ ca parebhyaścaiva ye pare ॥22॥
html:
ato bhūtirataḥ kīrtirato buddhiḥ prajāyate ।
apareṣāṃ pareṣāṃ ca parebhyaścaiva ye pare ॥22॥
slp1: ato BUtirataH kIrtirato budDiH prajAyate । aparezAM parezAM ca pareByaScEva ye pare ॥22॥

text: brāhmaṇā yaṃ praśaṃsanti puruṣaḥ sa pravardhate । atha yo brāhmaṇākruṣṭaḥ parābhavati so'cirāt ॥23॥
html:
brāhmaṇā yaṃ praśaṃsanti puruṣaḥ sa pravardhate ।
atha yo brāhmaṇākruṣṭaḥ parābhavati so'cirāt ॥23॥
slp1: brAhmaRA yaM praSaMsanti puruzaH sa pravarDate । aTa yo brAhmaRAkruzwaH parABavati so'cirAt ॥23॥

text: yathā mahārṇave kṣipta āmaloṣṭo vinaśyati । tathā duścaritaṃ karma parābhāvāya kalpate ॥24॥
html:
yathā mahārṇave kṣipta āmaloṣṭo vinaśyati ।
tathā duścaritaṃ karma parābhāvāya kalpate ॥24॥
slp1: yaTA mahArRave kzipta Amalozwo vinaSyati । taTA duScaritaM karma parABAvAya kalpate ॥24॥

text: paśya candre kṛtaṃ lakṣma samudre lavaṇodakam । tathā bhagasahasreṇa mahendraṃ paricihnitam ॥25॥
html:
paśya candre kṛtaṃ lakṣma samudre lavaṇodakam ।
tathā bhagasahasreṇa mahendraṃ paricihnitam ॥25॥
slp1: paSya candre kftaM lakzma samudre lavaRodakam । taTA BagasahasreRa mahendraM paricihnitam ॥25॥

text: teṣāmeva prabhāvena sahasranayano hyasau । śatakratuḥ samabhavatpaśya mādhava yādṛśam ॥26॥
html:
teṣāmeva prabhāvena sahasranayano hyasau ।
śatakratuḥ samabhavatpaśya mādhava yādṛśam ॥26॥
slp1: tezAmeva praBAvena sahasranayano hyasO । SatakratuH samaBavatpaSya mADava yAdfSam ॥26॥

text: icchanbhūtiṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca lokāṃśca madhusūdana । brāhmaṇānumate tiṣṭhetpuruṣaḥ śucirātmavān ॥27॥
html:
icchanbhūtiṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca lokāṃśca madhusūdana ।
brāhmaṇānumate tiṣṭhetpuruṣaḥ śucirātmavān ॥27॥
slp1: icCanBUtiM ca kIrtiM ca lokAMSca maDusUdana । brAhmaRAnumate tizWetpuruzaH SucirAtmavAn ॥27॥

text: ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā medinyā madhusūdanaḥ । sādhu sādhvityathetyuktvā medinīṃ pratyapūjayat ॥28॥
html:
ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā medinyā madhusūdanaḥ ।
sādhu sādhvityathetyuktvā medinīṃ pratyapūjayat ॥28॥
slp1: ityetadvacanaM SrutvA medinyA maDusUdanaH । sADu sADvityaTetyuktvA medinIM pratyapUjayat ॥28॥

text: etāṃ śrutvopamāṃ pārtha prayato brāhmaṇarṣabhān । satataṃ pūjayethāstvaṃ tataḥ śreyo'bhipatsyase] ॥29॥
html:
etāṃ śrutvopamāṃ pārtha prayato brāhmaṇarṣabhān ।
satataṃ pūjayethāstvaṃ tataḥ śreyo'bhipatsyase] ॥29॥
slp1: etAM SrutvopamAM pArTa prayato brAhmaRarzaBAn । satataM pUjayeTAstvaM tataH Sreyo'Bipatsyase] ॥29॥

text: janmanaiva mahābhāgo brāhmaṇo nāma jāyate । namasyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmatithiḥ prasṛtāgrabhuk ॥1॥
html:
janmanaiva mahābhāgo brāhmaṇo nāma jāyate ।
namasyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmatithiḥ prasṛtāgrabhuk ॥1॥
slp1: janmanEva mahABAgo brAhmaRo nAma jAyate । namasyaH sarvaBUtAnAmatiTiH prasftAgraBuk ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sarvānnaḥ suhṛdastāta brāhmaṇāḥ sumanomukhāḥ । gīrbhirmaṅgalayuktābhiranudhyāyanti pūjitāḥ ॥2॥
html:
sarvānnaḥ suhṛdastāta brāhmaṇāḥ sumanomukhāḥ ।
gīrbhirmaṅgalayuktābhiranudhyāyanti pūjitāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: sarvAnnaH suhfdastAta brAhmaRAH sumanomuKAH । gIrBirmaNgalayuktABiranuDyAyanti pUjitAH ॥2॥

text: sarvānno dviṣatastāta brāhmaṇā jātamanyavaḥ । gīrbhirdāruṇayuktābhirabhihanyurapūjitāḥ ॥3॥
html:
sarvānno dviṣatastāta brāhmaṇā jātamanyavaḥ ।
gīrbhirdāruṇayuktābhirabhihanyurapūjitāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: sarvAnno dvizatastAta brAhmaRA jAtamanyavaH । gIrBirdAruRayuktABiraBihanyurapUjitAH ॥3॥

text: atra gāthā brahmagītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ । sṛṣṭvā dvijātīndhātā hi yathāpūrvaṃ samādadhat ॥4॥
html:
atra gāthā brahmagītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ।
sṛṣṭvā dvijātīndhātā hi yathāpūrvaṃ samādadhat ॥4॥
slp1: atra gATA brahmagItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH । sfzwvA dvijAtInDAtA hi yaTApUrvaM samAdaDat ॥4॥

text: na vo'nyadiha kartavyaṃ kiñcidūrdhvaṃ yathāvidhi । guptā gopāyata brahma śreyo vastena śobhanam ॥5॥
html:
na vo'nyadiha kartavyaṃ kiñcidūrdhvaṃ yathāvidhi ।
guptā gopāyata brahma śreyo vastena śobhanam ॥5॥
slp1: na vo'nyadiha kartavyaM kiYcidUrDvaM yaTAviDi । guptA gopAyata brahma Sreyo vastena SoBanam ॥5॥

text: svameva kurvatāṃ karma śrīrvo brāhmī bhaviṣyati । pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pragrahaṃ ca gamiṣyatha ॥6॥
html:
svameva kurvatāṃ karma śrīrvo brāhmī bhaviṣyati ।
pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pragrahaṃ ca gamiṣyatha ॥6॥
slp1: svameva kurvatAM karma SrIrvo brAhmI Bavizyati । pramARaM sarvaBUtAnAM pragrahaM ca gamizyaTa ॥6॥

text: na śaudraṃ karma kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇena vipaścitā । śaudraṃ hi kurvataḥ karma dharmaḥ samuparudhyate ॥7॥
html:
na śaudraṃ karma kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇena vipaścitā ।
śaudraṃ hi kurvataḥ karma dharmaḥ samuparudhyate ॥7॥
slp1: na SOdraM karma kartavyaM brAhmaRena vipaScitA । SOdraM hi kurvataH karma DarmaH samuparuDyate ॥7॥

text: śrīśca buddhiśca tejaśca vibhūtiśca pratāpinī । svādhyāyenaiva māhātmyaṃ vimalaṃ pratipatsyatha ॥8॥
html:
śrīśca buddhiśca tejaśca vibhūtiśca pratāpinī ।
svādhyāyenaiva māhātmyaṃ vimalaṃ pratipatsyatha ॥8॥
slp1: SrISca budDiSca tejaSca viBUtiSca pratApinI । svADyAyenEva mAhAtmyaM vimalaM pratipatsyaTa ॥8॥

text: hutvā cāhavanīyasthaṃ mahābhāgye pratiṣṭhitāḥ । agrabhojyāḥ prasūtīnāṃ śriyā brāhmyānukalpitāḥ ॥9॥
html:
hutvā cāhavanīyasthaṃ mahābhāgye pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।
agrabhojyāḥ prasūtīnāṃ śriyā brāhmyānukalpitāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: hutvA cAhavanIyasTaM mahABAgye pratizWitAH । agraBojyAH prasUtInAM SriyA brAhmyAnukalpitAH ॥9॥

text: śraddhayā parayā yuktā hyanabhidrohalabdhayā । damasvādhyāyaniratāḥ sarvānkāmānavāpsyatha ॥10॥
html:
śraddhayā parayā yuktā hyanabhidrohalabdhayā ।
damasvādhyāyaniratāḥ sarvānkāmānavāpsyatha ॥10॥
slp1: SradDayA parayA yuktA hyanaBidrohalabDayA । damasvADyAyaniratAH sarvAnkAmAnavApsyaTa ॥10॥

text: yaccaiva mānuṣe loke yacca deveṣu kiñcana । sarvaṃ tattapasā sādhyaṃ jñānena vinayena ca ॥11॥
html:
yaccaiva mānuṣe loke yacca deveṣu kiñcana ।
sarvaṃ tattapasā sādhyaṃ jñānena vinayena ca ॥11॥
slp1: yaccEva mAnuze loke yacca devezu kiYcana । sarvaM tattapasA sADyaM jYAnena vinayena ca ॥11॥

text: ityetā brahmagītāste samākhyātā mayānagha । viprānukampārthamidaṃ tena proktaṃ hi dhīmatā ॥12॥
html:
ityetā brahmagītāste samākhyātā mayānagha ।
viprānukampārthamidaṃ tena proktaṃ hi dhīmatā ॥12॥
slp1: ityetA brahmagItAste samAKyAtA mayAnaGa । viprAnukampArTamidaM tena proktaM hi DImatA ॥12॥

text: bhūyasteṣāṃ balaṃ manye yathā rājñastapasvinaḥ । durāsadāśca caṇḍāśca rabhasāḥ kṣiprakāriṇaḥ ॥13॥
html:
bhūyasteṣāṃ balaṃ manye yathā rājñastapasvinaḥ ।
durāsadāśca caṇḍāśca rabhasāḥ kṣiprakāriṇaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: BUyastezAM balaM manye yaTA rAjYastapasvinaH । durAsadASca caRqASca raBasAH kziprakAriRaH ॥13॥

text: santyeṣāṃ siṃhasattvāśca vyāghrasattvāstathāpare । varāhamṛgasattvāśca gajasattvāstathāpare ॥14॥
html:
santyeṣāṃ siṃhasattvāśca vyāghrasattvāstathāpare ।
varāhamṛgasattvāśca gajasattvāstathāpare ॥14॥
slp1: santyezAM siMhasattvASca vyAGrasattvAstaTApare । varAhamfgasattvASca gajasattvAstaTApare ॥14॥

text: karpāsamṛdavaḥ kecittathānye makaraspṛśaḥ । vibhāṣyaghātinaḥ kecittathā cakṣurhaṇo'pare ॥15॥
html:
karpāsamṛdavaḥ kecittathānye makaraspṛśaḥ ।
vibhāṣyaghātinaḥ kecittathā cakṣurhaṇo'pare ॥15॥
slp1: karpAsamfdavaH kecittaTAnye makaraspfSaH । viBAzyaGAtinaH kecittaTA cakzurhaRo'pare ॥15॥

text: santi cāśīviṣanibhāḥ santi mandāstathāpare । vividhānīha vṛttāni brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥16॥
html:
santi cāśīviṣanibhāḥ santi mandāstathāpare ।
vividhānīha vṛttāni brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥16॥
slp1: santi cASIvizaniBAH santi mandAstaTApare । viviDAnIha vfttAni brAhmaRAnAM yuDizWira ॥16॥

text: mekalā dramiḍāḥ kāśāḥ pauṇḍrāḥ kollagirāstathā । śauṇḍikā daradā darvāścaurāḥ śabarabarbarāḥ ॥17॥
html:
mekalā dramiḍāḥ kāśāḥ pauṇḍrāḥ kollagirāstathā ।
śauṇḍikā daradā darvāścaurāḥ śabarabarbarāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: mekalA dramiqAH kASAH pORqrAH kollagirAstaTA । SORqikA daradA darvAScOrAH SabarabarbarAH ॥17॥

text: kirātā yavanāścaiva tāstāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ । vṛṣalatvamanuprāptā brāhmaṇānāmadarśanāt ॥18॥
html:
kirātā yavanāścaiva tāstāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ ।
vṛṣalatvamanuprāptā brāhmaṇānāmadarśanāt ॥18॥
slp1: kirAtA yavanAScEva tAstAH kzatriyajAtayaH । vfzalatvamanuprAptA brAhmaRAnAmadarSanAt ॥18॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ paribhavādasurāḥ salileśayāḥ । brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādācca devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ ॥19॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ paribhavādasurāḥ salileśayāḥ ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādācca devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM pariBavAdasurAH salileSayAH । brAhmaRAnAM prasAdAcca devAH svarganivAsinaH ॥19॥

text: aśakyaṃ spraṣṭumākāśamacālyo himavāngiriḥ । avāryā setunā gaṅgā durjayā brāhmaṇā bhuvi ॥20॥
html:
aśakyaṃ spraṣṭumākāśamacālyo himavāngiriḥ ।
avāryā setunā gaṅgā durjayā brāhmaṇā bhuvi ॥20॥
slp1: aSakyaM sprazwumAkASamacAlyo himavAngiriH । avAryA setunA gaNgA durjayA brAhmaRA Buvi ॥20॥

text: na brāhmaṇavirodhena śakyā śāstuṃ vasundharā । brāhmaṇā hi mahātmāno devānāmapi devatāḥ ॥21॥
html:
na brāhmaṇavirodhena śakyā śāstuṃ vasundharā ।
brāhmaṇā hi mahātmāno devānāmapi devatāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: na brAhmaRaviroDena SakyA SAstuM vasunDarA । brAhmaRA hi mahAtmAno devAnAmapi devatAH ॥21॥

text: tānpūjayasva satataṃ dānena paricaryayā । yadīcchasi mahīṃ bhoktumimāṃ sāgaramekhalām ॥22॥
html:
tānpūjayasva satataṃ dānena paricaryayā ।
yadīcchasi mahīṃ bhoktumimāṃ sāgaramekhalām ॥22॥
slp1: tAnpUjayasva satataM dAnena paricaryayA । yadIcCasi mahIM BoktumimAM sAgarameKalAm ॥22॥

text: pratigraheṇa tejo hi viprāṇāṃ śāmyate'nagha । pratigrahaṃ ye neccheyuste'pi rakṣyāstvayānagha] ॥23॥
html:
pratigraheṇa tejo hi viprāṇāṃ śāmyate'nagha ।
pratigrahaṃ ye neccheyuste'pi rakṣyāstvayānagha] ॥23॥
slp1: pratigraheRa tejo hi viprARAM SAmyate'naGa । pratigrahaM ye necCeyuste'pi rakzyAstvayAnaGa] ॥23॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । śakraśambarasaṃvādaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
śakraśambarasaṃvādaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । SakraSambarasaMvAdaM tanniboDa yuDizWira ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śakro hyajñātarūpeṇa jaṭī bhūtvā rajoruṇaḥ । virūpaṃ rūpamāsthāya praśnaṃ papraccha śambaram ॥2॥
html:
śakro hyajñātarūpeṇa jaṭī bhūtvā rajoruṇaḥ ।
virūpaṃ rūpamāsthāya praśnaṃ papraccha śambaram ॥2॥
slp1: Sakro hyajYAtarUpeRa jawI BUtvA rajoruRaH । virUpaM rUpamAsTAya praSnaM papracCa Sambaram ॥2॥

text: kena śambara vṛttena svajātyānadhitiṣṭhasi । śreṣṭhaṃ tvāṃ kena manyante tanme prabrūhi pṛcchataḥ ॥3॥
html:
kena śambara vṛttena svajātyānadhitiṣṭhasi ।
śreṣṭhaṃ tvāṃ kena manyante tanme prabrūhi pṛcchataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: kena Sambara vfttena svajAtyAnaDitizWasi । SrezWaM tvAM kena manyante tanme prabrUhi pfcCataH ॥3॥

text: nāsūyāmi sadā viprānbrahmāṇaṃ ca pitāmaham । śāstrāṇi vadato viprānsammanyāmi yathāsukham ॥4॥
html:
nāsūyāmi sadā viprānbrahmāṇaṃ ca pitāmaham ।
śāstrāṇi vadato viprānsammanyāmi yathāsukham ॥4॥
slp1: nAsUyAmi sadA viprAnbrahmARaM ca pitAmaham । SAstrARi vadato viprAnsammanyAmi yaTAsuKam ॥4॥
author: śambara uvāca ।

text: śrutvā ca nāvajānāmi nāparādhyāmi karhicit । abhyarcyānanupṛcchāmi pādau gṛhṇāmi dhīmatām ॥5॥
html:
śrutvā ca nāvajānāmi nāparādhyāmi karhicit ।
abhyarcyānanupṛcchāmi pādau gṛhṇāmi dhīmatām ॥5॥
slp1: SrutvA ca nAvajAnAmi nAparADyAmi karhicit । aByarcyAnanupfcCAmi pAdO gfhRAmi DImatAm ॥5॥

text: te viśrabdhāḥ prabhāṣante saṃyacchanti ca māṃ sadā । pramatteṣvapramatto'smi sadā supteṣu jāgṛmi ॥6॥
html:
te viśrabdhāḥ prabhāṣante saṃyacchanti ca māṃ sadā ।
pramatteṣvapramatto'smi sadā supteṣu jāgṛmi ॥6॥
slp1: te viSrabDAH praBAzante saMyacCanti ca mAM sadA । pramattezvapramatto'smi sadA suptezu jAgfmi ॥6॥

text: te mā śāstrapathe yuktaṃ brahmaṇyamanasūyakam । samāsiñcanti śāstāraḥ kṣaudraṃ madhviva makṣikāḥ ॥7॥
html:
te mā śāstrapathe yuktaṃ brahmaṇyamanasūyakam ।
samāsiñcanti śāstāraḥ kṣaudraṃ madhviva makṣikāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: te mA SAstrapaTe yuktaM brahmaRyamanasUyakam । samAsiYcanti SAstAraH kzOdraM maDviva makzikAH ॥7॥

text: yacca bhāṣanti te tuṣṭāstattadgṛhṇāmi medhayā । samādhimātmano nityamanulomamacintayan ॥8॥
html:
yacca bhāṣanti te tuṣṭāstattadgṛhṇāmi medhayā ।
samādhimātmano nityamanulomamacintayan ॥8॥
slp1: yacca BAzanti te tuzwAstattadgfhRAmi meDayA । samADimAtmano nityamanulomamacintayan ॥8॥

text: so'haṃ vāgagrasṛṣṭānāṃ rasānāmavalehakaḥ । svajātyānadhitiṣṭhāmi nakṣatrāṇīva candramāḥ ॥9॥
html:
so'haṃ vāgagrasṛṣṭānāṃ rasānāmavalehakaḥ ।
svajātyānadhitiṣṭhāmi nakṣatrāṇīva candramāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: so'haM vAgagrasfzwAnAM rasAnAmavalehakaH । svajAtyAnaDitizWAmi nakzatrARIva candramAH ॥9॥

text: etatpṛthivyāmamṛtametaccakṣuranuttamam । yadbrāhmaṇamukhācchāstramiha śrutvā pravartate ॥10॥
html:
etatpṛthivyāmamṛtametaccakṣuranuttamam ।
yadbrāhmaṇamukhācchāstramiha śrutvā pravartate ॥10॥
slp1: etatpfTivyAmamftametaccakzuranuttamam । yadbrAhmaRamuKAcCAstramiha SrutvA pravartate ॥10॥

text: etatkāraṇamājñāya dṛṣṭvā devāsuraṃ purā । yuddhaṃ pitā me hṛṣṭātmā vismitaḥ pratyapadyata ॥11॥
html:
etatkāraṇamājñāya dṛṣṭvā devāsuraṃ purā ।
yuddhaṃ pitā me hṛṣṭātmā vismitaḥ pratyapadyata ॥11॥
slp1: etatkAraRamAjYAya dfzwvA devAsuraM purA । yudDaM pitA me hfzwAtmA vismitaH pratyapadyata ॥11॥

text: dṛṣṭvā ca brāhmaṇānāṃ tu mahimānaṃ mahātmanām । paryapṛcchatkathamime siddhā iti niśākaram ॥12॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā ca brāhmaṇānāṃ tu mahimānaṃ mahātmanām ।
paryapṛcchatkathamime siddhā iti niśākaram ॥12॥
slp1: dfzwvA ca brAhmaRAnAM tu mahimAnaM mahAtmanAm । paryapfcCatkaTamime sidDA iti niSAkaram ॥12॥

text: brāhmaṇāstapasā sarve sidhyante vāgbalāḥ sadā । bhujavīryā hi rājāno vāgastrāśca dvijātayaḥ ॥13॥
html:
brāhmaṇāstapasā sarve sidhyante vāgbalāḥ sadā ।
bhujavīryā hi rājāno vāgastrāśca dvijātayaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: brAhmaRAstapasA sarve siDyante vAgbalAH sadA । BujavIryA hi rAjAno vAgastrASca dvijAtayaH ॥13॥
author: soma uvāca ।

text: pravasanvāpyadhīyīta bahvīrdurvasatīrvasan । nirmanyurapi nirmāno yatiḥ syātsamadarśanaḥ ॥14॥
html:
pravasanvāpyadhīyīta bahvīrdurvasatīrvasan ।
nirmanyurapi nirmāno yatiḥ syātsamadarśanaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: pravasanvApyaDIyIta bahvIrdurvasatIrvasan । nirmanyurapi nirmAno yatiH syAtsamadarSanaH ॥14॥

text: api cejjātisampannaḥ sarvānvedānpiturgṛhe । ślāghamāna ivādhīyedgrāmya ityeva taṃ viduḥ ॥15॥
html:
api cejjātisampannaḥ sarvānvedānpiturgṛhe ।
ślāghamāna ivādhīyedgrāmya ityeva taṃ viduḥ ॥15॥
slp1: api cejjAtisampannaH sarvAnvedAnpiturgfhe । SlAGamAna ivADIyedgrAmya ityeva taM viduH ॥15॥

text: bhūmiretau nigirati sarpo bilaśayāniva । rājānaṃ cāpyayoddhāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāpravāsinam ॥16॥
html:
bhūmiretau nigirati sarpo bilaśayāniva ।
rājānaṃ cāpyayoddhāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāpravāsinam ॥16॥
slp1: BUmiretO nigirati sarpo bilaSayAniva । rAjAnaM cApyayodDAraM brAhmaRaM cApravAsinam ॥16॥

text: atimānaḥ śriyaṃ hanti puruṣasyālpamedhasaḥ । garbheṇa duṣyate kanyā gṛhavāsena ca dvijaḥ ॥17॥
html:
atimānaḥ śriyaṃ hanti puruṣasyālpamedhasaḥ ।
garbheṇa duṣyate kanyā gṛhavāsena ca dvijaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: atimAnaH SriyaM hanti puruzasyAlpameDasaH । garBeRa duzyate kanyA gfhavAsena ca dvijaH ॥17॥

text: ityetanme pitā śrutvā somādadbhutadarśanāt । brāhmaṇānpūjayāmāsa tathaivāhaṃ mahāvratān ॥18॥
html:
ityetanme pitā śrutvā somādadbhutadarśanāt ।
brāhmaṇānpūjayāmāsa tathaivāhaṃ mahāvratān ॥18॥
slp1: ityetanme pitA SrutvA somAdadButadarSanAt । brAhmaRAnpUjayAmAsa taTEvAhaM mahAvratAn ॥18॥

text: śrutvaitadvacanaṃ śakro dānavendramukhāccyutam । dvijānsampūjayāmāsa mahendratvamavāpa ca] ॥19॥
html:
śrutvaitadvacanaṃ śakro dānavendramukhāccyutam ।
dvijānsampūjayāmāsa mahendratvamavāpa ca] ॥19॥
slp1: SrutvEtadvacanaM Sakro dAnavendramuKAccyutam । dvijAnsampUjayAmAsa mahendratvamavApa ca] ॥19॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: apūrvaṃ vā bhavetpātramatha vāpi ciroṣitam । dūrādabhyāgataṃ vāpi kiṃ pātraṃ syātpitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
apūrvaṃ vā bhavetpātramatha vāpi ciroṣitam ।
dūrādabhyāgataṃ vāpi kiṃ pātraṃ syātpitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: apUrvaM vA BavetpAtramaTa vApi cirozitam । dUrAdaByAgataM vApi kiM pAtraM syAtpitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kriyā bhavati keṣāñcidupāṃśuvratamuttamam । yo yo yāceta yatkiñcitsarvaṃ dadyāma ityuta ॥2॥
html:
kriyā bhavati keṣāñcidupāṃśuvratamuttamam ।
yo yo yāceta yatkiñcitsarvaṃ dadyāma ityuta ॥2॥
slp1: kriyA Bavati kezAYcidupAMSuvratamuttamam । yo yo yAceta yatkiYcitsarvaM dadyAma ityuta ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: apīḍayanbhṛtyavargamityevamanuśuśruma । pīḍayanbhṛtyavargaṃ hi ātmānamapakarṣati ॥3॥
html:
apīḍayanbhṛtyavargamityevamanuśuśruma ।
pīḍayanbhṛtyavargaṃ hi ātmānamapakarṣati ॥3॥
slp1: apIqayanBftyavargamityevamanuSuSruma । pIqayanBftyavargaM hi AtmAnamapakarzati ॥3॥

text: apūrvaṃ vāpi yatpātraṃ yaccāpi syācciroṣitam । dūrādabhyāgataṃ cāpi tatpātraṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ ॥4॥
html:
apūrvaṃ vāpi yatpātraṃ yaccāpi syācciroṣitam ।
dūrādabhyāgataṃ cāpi tatpātraṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: apUrvaM vApi yatpAtraM yaccApi syAccirozitam । dUrAdaByAgataM cApi tatpAtraM ca vidurbuDAH ॥4॥

text: apīḍayā ca bhṛtyānāṃ dharmasyāhiṃsayā tathā । pātraṃ vidyāma tattvena yasmai dattaṃ na santapet ॥5॥
html:
apīḍayā ca bhṛtyānāṃ dharmasyāhiṃsayā tathā ।
pātraṃ vidyāma tattvena yasmai dattaṃ na santapet ॥5॥
slp1: apIqayA ca BftyAnAM DarmasyAhiMsayA taTA । pAtraM vidyAma tattvena yasmE dattaM na santapet ॥5॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ṛtvikpurohitācāryāḥ śiṣyāḥ sambandhibāndhavāḥ । sarve pūjyāśca mānyāśca śrutavṛttopasaṃhitāḥ ॥6॥
html:
ṛtvikpurohitācāryāḥ śiṣyāḥ sambandhibāndhavāḥ ।
sarve pūjyāśca mānyāśca śrutavṛttopasaṃhitāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: ftvikpurohitAcAryAH SizyAH sambanDibAnDavAH । sarve pUjyASca mAnyASca SrutavfttopasaMhitAH ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ato'nyathā vartamānāḥ sarve nārhanti satkriyām । tasmānnityaṃ parīkṣeta puruṣānpraṇidhāya vai ॥7॥
html:
ato'nyathā vartamānāḥ sarve nārhanti satkriyām ।
tasmānnityaṃ parīkṣeta puruṣānpraṇidhāya vai ॥7॥
slp1: ato'nyaTA vartamAnAH sarve nArhanti satkriyAm । tasmAnnityaM parIkzeta puruzAnpraRiDAya vE ॥7॥

text: akrodhaḥ satyavacanamahiṃsā dama ārjavam । adroho nātimānaśca hrīstitikṣā tapaḥ śamaḥ ॥8॥
html:
akrodhaḥ satyavacanamahiṃsā dama ārjavam ।
adroho nātimānaśca hrīstitikṣā tapaḥ śamaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: akroDaH satyavacanamahiMsA dama Arjavam । adroho nAtimAnaSca hrIstitikzA tapaH SamaH ॥8॥

text: yasminnetāni dṛśyante na cākāryāṇi bhārata । bhāvato viniviṣṭāni tatpātraṃ mānamarhati ॥9॥
html:
yasminnetāni dṛśyante na cākāryāṇi bhārata ।
bhāvato viniviṣṭāni tatpātraṃ mānamarhati ॥9॥
