slp1: yasminnetAni dfSyante na cAkAryARi BArata । BAvato vinivizwAni tatpAtraM mAnamarhati ॥9॥

text: tathā ciroṣitaṃ cāpi sampratyāgatameva ca । apūrvaṃ caiva pūrvaṃ ca tatpātraṃ mānamarhati ॥10॥
html:
tathā ciroṣitaṃ cāpi sampratyāgatameva ca ।
apūrvaṃ caiva pūrvaṃ ca tatpātraṃ mānamarhati ॥10॥
slp1: taTA cirozitaM cApi sampratyAgatameva ca । apUrvaM cEva pUrvaM ca tatpAtraM mAnamarhati ॥10॥

text: aprāmāṇyaṃ ca vedānāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ cātilaṅghanam । sarvatra cānavasthānametannāśanamātmanaḥ ॥11॥
html:
aprāmāṇyaṃ ca vedānāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ cātilaṅghanam ।
sarvatra cānavasthānametannāśanamātmanaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: aprAmARyaM ca vedAnAM SAstrARAM cAtilaNGanam । sarvatra cAnavasTAnametannASanamAtmanaH ॥11॥

text: bhavetpaṇḍitamānī yo brāhmaṇo vedanindakaḥ । ānvīkṣikīṃ tarkavidyāmanurakto nirarthikām ॥12॥
html:
bhavetpaṇḍitamānī yo brāhmaṇo vedanindakaḥ ।
ānvīkṣikīṃ tarkavidyāmanurakto nirarthikām ॥12॥
slp1: BavetpaRqitamAnI yo brAhmaRo vedanindakaH । AnvIkzikIM tarkavidyAmanurakto nirarTikAm ॥12॥

text: hetuvādānbruvansatsu vijetāhetuvādikaḥ । ākroṣṭā cātivaktā ca brāhmaṇānāṃ sadaiva hi ॥13॥
html:
hetuvādānbruvansatsu vijetāhetuvādikaḥ ।
ākroṣṭā cātivaktā ca brāhmaṇānāṃ sadaiva hi ॥13॥
slp1: hetuvAdAnbruvansatsu vijetAhetuvAdikaH । AkrozwA cAtivaktA ca brAhmaRAnAM sadEva hi ॥13॥

text: sarvābhiśaṅkī mūḍhaśca bālaḥ kaṭukavāgapi । boddhavyastādṛśastāta naraśvānaṃ hi taṃ viduḥ ॥14॥
html:
sarvābhiśaṅkī mūḍhaśca bālaḥ kaṭukavāgapi ।
boddhavyastādṛśastāta naraśvānaṃ hi taṃ viduḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sarvABiSaNkI mUQaSca bAlaH kawukavAgapi । bodDavyastAdfSastAta naraSvAnaM hi taM viduH ॥14॥

text: yathā śvā bhaṣituṃ caiva hantuṃ caivāvasṛjyate । evaṃ sambhāṣaṇārthāya sarvaśāstravadhāya ca । alpaśrutāḥ kutarkāśca dṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭāḥ kupaṇḍitāḥ ॥15॥
html:
yathā śvā bhaṣituṃ caiva hantuṃ caivāvasṛjyate ।
evaṃ sambhāṣaṇārthāya sarvaśāstravadhāya ca ।
alpaśrutāḥ kutarkāśca dṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭāḥ kupaṇḍitāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yaTA SvA BazituM cEva hantuM cEvAvasfjyate । evaM samBAzaRArTAya sarvaSAstravaDAya ca । alpaSrutAH kutarkASca dfzwAH spfzwAH kupaRqitAH ॥15॥

text: śrutismṛtītihāsādipurāṇāraṇyavedinaḥ । anurundhyādbahujñāṃśca sārajñāṃścaiva paṇḍitān ॥16॥
html:
śrutismṛtītihāsādipurāṇāraṇyavedinaḥ ।
anurundhyādbahujñāṃśca sārajñāṃścaiva paṇḍitān ॥16॥
slp1: SrutismftItihAsAdipurARAraRyavedinaH । anurunDyAdbahujYAMSca sArajYAMScEva paRqitAn ॥16॥

text: lokayātrā ca draṣṭavyā dharmaścātmahitāni ca । evaṃ naro vartamānaḥ śāśvatīredhate samāḥ ॥17॥
html:
lokayātrā ca draṣṭavyā dharmaścātmahitāni ca ।
evaṃ naro vartamānaḥ śāśvatīredhate samāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: lokayAtrA ca drazwavyA DarmaScAtmahitAni ca । evaM naro vartamAnaH SASvatIreDate samAH ॥17॥

text: ṛṇamunmucya devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca । pitṝṇāmatha viprāṇāmatithīnāṃ ca pañcamam ॥18॥
html:
ṛṇamunmucya devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca ।
pitṝṇāmatha viprāṇāmatithīnāṃ ca pañcamam ॥18॥
slp1: fRamunmucya devAnAmfzIRAM ca taTEva ca । pitFRAmaTa viprARAmatiTInAM ca paYcamam ॥18॥

text: paryāyeṇa viśuddhena sunirṇiktena karmaṇā । evaṃ gṛhasthaḥ karmāṇi kurvandharmānna hīyate] ॥19॥
html:
paryāyeṇa viśuddhena sunirṇiktena karmaṇā ।
evaṃ gṛhasthaḥ karmāṇi kurvandharmānna hīyate] ॥19॥
slp1: paryAyeRa viSudDena sunirRiktena karmaRA । evaM gfhasTaH karmARi kurvanDarmAnna hIyate] ॥19॥

text: strīṇāṃ svabhāvamicchāmi śrotuṃ bharatasattama । striyo hi mūlaṃ doṣāṇāṃ laghucittāḥ pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
strīṇāṃ svabhāvamicchāmi śrotuṃ bharatasattama ।
striyo hi mūlaṃ doṣāṇāṃ laghucittāḥ pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: strIRAM svaBAvamicCAmi SrotuM Baratasattama । striyo hi mUlaM dozARAM laGucittAH pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । nāradasya ca saṃvādaṃ puṃścalyā pañcacūḍayā ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
nāradasya ca saṃvādaṃ puṃścalyā pañcacūḍayā ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । nAradasya ca saMvAdaM puMScalyA paYcacUqayA ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: lokānanucarandhīmāndevarṣirnāradaḥ purā । dadarśāpsarasaṃ brāhmīṃ pañcacūḍāmaninditām ॥3॥
html:
lokānanucarandhīmāndevarṣirnāradaḥ purā ।
dadarśāpsarasaṃ brāhmīṃ pañcacūḍāmaninditām ॥3॥
slp1: lokAnanucaranDImAndevarzirnAradaH purA । dadarSApsarasaM brAhmIM paYcacUqAmaninditAm ॥3॥

text: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīṃ papracchāpsarasaṃ muniḥ । saṃśayo hṛdi me kaścittanme brūhi sumadhyame ॥4॥
html:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīṃ papracchāpsarasaṃ muniḥ ।
saṃśayo hṛdi me kaścittanme brūhi sumadhyame ॥4॥
slp1: tAM dfzwvA cArusarvANgIM papracCApsarasaM muniH । saMSayo hfdi me kaScittanme brUhi sumaDyame ॥4॥

text: evamuktā tu sā vipraṃ pratyuvācātha nāradam । viṣaye sati vakṣyāmi samarthāṃ manyase ca mām ॥5॥
html:
evamuktā tu sā vipraṃ pratyuvācātha nāradam ।
viṣaye sati vakṣyāmi samarthāṃ manyase ca mām ॥5॥
slp1: evamuktA tu sA vipraM pratyuvAcATa nAradam । vizaye sati vakzyAmi samarTAM manyase ca mAm ॥5॥

text: na tvāmaviṣaye bhadre niyokṣyāmi kathañcana । strīṇāṃ svabhāvamicchāmi tvattaḥ śrotuṃ varānane ॥6॥
html:
na tvāmaviṣaye bhadre niyokṣyāmi kathañcana ।
strīṇāṃ svabhāvamicchāmi tvattaḥ śrotuṃ varānane ॥6॥
slp1: na tvAmavizaye Badre niyokzyAmi kaTaYcana । strIRAM svaBAvamicCAmi tvattaH SrotuM varAnane ॥6॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: etacchrutvā vacastasya devarṣerapsarottamā । pratyuvāca na śakṣyāmi strī satī nindituṃ striyaḥ ॥7॥
html:
etacchrutvā vacastasya devarṣerapsarottamā ।
pratyuvāca na śakṣyāmi strī satī nindituṃ striyaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: etacCrutvA vacastasya devarzerapsarottamA । pratyuvAca na SakzyAmi strI satI nindituM striyaH ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: viditāste striyo yāśca yādṛśāśca svabhāvataḥ । na māmarhasi devarṣe niyoktuṃ praśna īdṛśe ॥8॥
html:
viditāste striyo yāśca yādṛśāśca svabhāvataḥ ।
na māmarhasi devarṣe niyoktuṃ praśna īdṛśe ॥8॥
slp1: viditAste striyo yASca yAdfSASca svaBAvataH । na mAmarhasi devarze niyoktuM praSna IdfSe ॥8॥

text: tāmuvāca sa devarṣiḥ satyaṃ vada sumadhyame । mṛṣāvāde bhaveddoṣaḥ satye doṣo na vidyate ॥9॥
html:
tāmuvāca sa devarṣiḥ satyaṃ vada sumadhyame ।
mṛṣāvāde bhaveddoṣaḥ satye doṣo na vidyate ॥9॥
slp1: tAmuvAca sa devarziH satyaM vada sumaDyame । mfzAvAde BaveddozaH satye dozo na vidyate ॥9॥

text: ityuktā sā kṛtamatirabhavaccāruhāsinī । strīdoṣāñśāśvatānsatyānbhāṣituṃ sampracakrame ॥10॥
html:
ityuktā sā kṛtamatirabhavaccāruhāsinī ।
strīdoṣāñśāśvatānsatyānbhāṣituṃ sampracakrame ॥10॥
slp1: ityuktA sA kftamatiraBavaccAruhAsinI । strIdozAYSASvatAnsatyAnBAzituM sampracakrame ॥10॥

text: kulīnā rūpavatyaśca nāthavatyaśca yoṣitaḥ । maryādāsu na tiṣṭhanti sa doṣaḥ strīṣu nārada ॥11॥
html:
kulīnā rūpavatyaśca nāthavatyaśca yoṣitaḥ ।
maryādāsu na tiṣṭhanti sa doṣaḥ strīṣu nārada ॥11॥
slp1: kulInA rUpavatyaSca nATavatyaSca yozitaH । maryAdAsu na tizWanti sa dozaH strIzu nArada ॥11॥
author: pañcacūḍovāca ।

text: na strībhyaḥ kiñcidanyadvai pāpīyastaramasti vai । striyo hi mūlaṃ doṣāṇāṃ tathā tvamapi vettha ha ॥12॥
html:
na strībhyaḥ kiñcidanyadvai pāpīyastaramasti vai ।
striyo hi mūlaṃ doṣāṇāṃ tathā tvamapi vettha ha ॥12॥
slp1: na strIByaH kiYcidanyadvE pApIyastaramasti vE । striyo hi mUlaM dozARAM taTA tvamapi vetTa ha ॥12॥

text: samājñātānṛddhimataḥ pratirūpānvaśe sthitān । patīnantaramāsādya nālaṃ nāryaḥ pratīkṣitum ॥13॥
html:
samājñātānṛddhimataḥ pratirūpānvaśe sthitān ।
patīnantaramāsādya nālaṃ nāryaḥ pratīkṣitum ॥13॥
slp1: samAjYAtAnfdDimataH pratirUpAnvaSe sTitAn । patInantaramAsAdya nAlaM nAryaH pratIkzitum ॥13॥

text: asaddharmastvayaṃ strīṇāmasmākaṃ bhavati prabho । pāpīyaso narānyadvai lajjāṃ tyaktvā bhajāmahe ॥14॥
html:
asaddharmastvayaṃ strīṇāmasmākaṃ bhavati prabho ।
pāpīyaso narānyadvai lajjāṃ tyaktvā bhajāmahe ॥14॥
slp1: asadDarmastvayaM strIRAmasmAkaM Bavati praBo । pApIyaso narAnyadvE lajjAM tyaktvA BajAmahe ॥14॥

text: striyaṃ hi yaḥ prārthayate sannikarṣaṃ ca gacchati । īṣacca kurute sevāṃ tamevecchanti yoṣitaḥ ॥15॥
html:
striyaṃ hi yaḥ prārthayate sannikarṣaṃ ca gacchati ।
īṣacca kurute sevāṃ tamevecchanti yoṣitaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: striyaM hi yaH prArTayate sannikarzaM ca gacCati । Izacca kurute sevAM tamevecCanti yozitaH ॥15॥

text: anarthitvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhayātparijanasya ca । maryādāyāmamaryādāḥ striyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu ॥16॥
html:
anarthitvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhayātparijanasya ca ।
maryādāyāmamaryādāḥ striyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu ॥16॥
slp1: anarTitvAnmanuzyARAM BayAtparijanasya ca । maryAdAyAmamaryAdAH striyastizWanti Bartfzu ॥16॥

text: nāsāṃ kaścidagamyo'sti nāsāṃ vayasi saṃsthitiḥ । virūpaṃ rūpavantaṃ vā pumānityeva bhuñjate ॥17॥
html:
nāsāṃ kaścidagamyo'sti nāsāṃ vayasi saṃsthitiḥ ।
virūpaṃ rūpavantaṃ vā pumānityeva bhuñjate ॥17॥
slp1: nAsAM kaScidagamyo'sti nAsAM vayasi saMsTitiH । virUpaM rUpavantaM vA pumAnityeva BuYjate ॥17॥

text: na bhayānnāpyanukrośānnārthahetoḥ kathañcana । na jñātikulasaṃbandhātstriyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu ॥18॥
html:
na bhayānnāpyanukrośānnārthahetoḥ kathañcana ।
na jñātikulasaṃbandhātstriyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu ॥18॥
slp1: na BayAnnApyanukroSAnnArTahetoH kaTaYcana । na jYAtikulasaMbanDAtstriyastizWanti Bartfzu ॥18॥

text: yauvane vartamānānāṃ mṛṣṭābharaṇavāsasām । nārīṇāṃ svairavṛttānāṃ spṛhayanti kulastriyaḥ ॥19॥
html:
yauvane vartamānānāṃ mṛṣṭābharaṇavāsasām ।
nārīṇāṃ svairavṛttānāṃ spṛhayanti kulastriyaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: yOvane vartamAnAnAM mfzwABaraRavAsasAm । nArIRAM svEravfttAnAM spfhayanti kulastriyaH ॥19॥

text: yāśca śaśvadbahumatā rakṣyante dayitāḥ striyaḥ । api tāḥ samprasajjante kubjāndhajaḍavāmanaiḥ ॥20॥
html:
yāśca śaśvadbahumatā rakṣyante dayitāḥ striyaḥ ।
api tāḥ samprasajjante kubjāndhajaḍavāmanaiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: yASca SaSvadbahumatA rakzyante dayitAH striyaH । api tAH samprasajjante kubjAnDajaqavAmanEH ॥20॥

text: paṅguṣvapi ca devarṣe ye cānye kutsitā narāḥ । strīṇāmagamyo loke'sminnāsti kaścinmahāmune ॥21॥
html:
paṅguṣvapi ca devarṣe ye cānye kutsitā narāḥ ।
strīṇāmagamyo loke'sminnāsti kaścinmahāmune ॥21॥
slp1: paNguzvapi ca devarze ye cAnye kutsitA narAH । strIRAmagamyo loke'sminnAsti kaScinmahAmune ॥21॥

text: yadi puṃsāṃ gatirbrahma kathañcinnopapadyate । apyanyonyaṃ pravartante na hi tiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu ॥22॥
html:
yadi puṃsāṃ gatirbrahma kathañcinnopapadyate ।
apyanyonyaṃ pravartante na hi tiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu ॥22॥
slp1: yadi puMsAM gatirbrahma kaTaYcinnopapadyate । apyanyonyaM pravartante na hi tizWanti Bartfzu ॥22॥

text: alābhātpuruṣāṇāṃ hi bhayātparijanasya ca । vadhabandhabhayāccāpi svayaṃ guptā bhavanti tāḥ ॥23॥
html:
alābhātpuruṣāṇāṃ hi bhayātparijanasya ca ।
vadhabandhabhayāccāpi svayaṃ guptā bhavanti tāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: alABAtpuruzARAM hi BayAtparijanasya ca । vaDabanDaBayAccApi svayaM guptA Bavanti tAH ॥23॥

text: calasvabhāvā duḥsevyā durgrāhyā bhāvatastathā । prājñasya puruṣasyeha yathā vācastathā striyaḥ ॥24॥
html:
calasvabhāvā duḥsevyā durgrāhyā bhāvatastathā ।
prājñasya puruṣasyeha yathā vācastathā striyaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: calasvaBAvA duHsevyA durgrAhyA BAvatastaTA । prAjYasya puruzasyeha yaTA vAcastaTA striyaH ॥24॥

text: nāgnistṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ mahodadhiḥ । nāntakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ na puṃsāṃ vāmalocanāḥ ॥25॥
html:
nāgnistṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ mahodadhiḥ ।
nāntakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ na puṃsāṃ vāmalocanāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: nAgnistfpyati kAzWAnAM nApagAnAM mahodaDiH । nAntakaH sarvaBUtAnAM na puMsAM vAmalocanAH ॥25॥

text: idamanyacca devarṣe rahasyaṃ sarvayoṣitām । dṛṣṭvaiva puruṣaṃ hṛdyaṃ yoniḥ praklidyate striyaḥ ॥26॥
html:
idamanyacca devarṣe rahasyaṃ sarvayoṣitām ।
dṛṣṭvaiva puruṣaṃ hṛdyaṃ yoniḥ praklidyate striyaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: idamanyacca devarze rahasyaM sarvayozitAm । dfzwvEva puruzaM hfdyaM yoniH praklidyate striyaH ॥26॥

text: kāmānāmapi dātāraṃ kartāraṃ mānasāntvayoḥ । rakṣitāraṃ na mṛṣyanti bhartāraṃ paramaṃ striyaḥ ॥27॥
html:
kāmānāmapi dātāraṃ kartāraṃ mānasāntvayoḥ ।
rakṣitāraṃ na mṛṣyanti bhartāraṃ paramaṃ striyaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: kAmAnAmapi dAtAraM kartAraM mAnasAntvayoH । rakzitAraM na mfzyanti BartAraM paramaM striyaH ॥27॥

text: na kāmabhogānbahulānnālaṅkārārthasañcayān । tathaiva bahu manyante yathā ratyāmanugraham ॥28॥
html:
na kāmabhogānbahulānnālaṅkārārthasañcayān ।
tathaiva bahu manyante yathā ratyāmanugraham ॥28॥
slp1: na kAmaBogAnbahulAnnAlaNkArArTasaYcayAn । taTEva bahu manyante yaTA ratyAmanugraham ॥28॥

text: antakaḥ śamano mṛtyuḥ pātālaṃ vaḍavāmukham । kṣuradhārā viṣaṃ sarpo vahnirityekataḥ striyaḥ ॥29॥
html:
antakaḥ śamano mṛtyuḥ pātālaṃ vaḍavāmukham ।
kṣuradhārā viṣaṃ sarpo vahnirityekataḥ striyaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: antakaH Samano mftyuH pAtAlaM vaqavAmuKam । kzuraDArA vizaM sarpo vahnirityekataH striyaH ॥29॥

text: yataśca bhūtāni mahānti pañca yataśca lokā vihitā vidhātrā । yataḥ pumāṃsaḥ pramadāśca nirmitāstadaiva doṣāḥ pramadāsu nārada] ॥30॥
html:
yataśca bhūtāni mahānti pañca yataśca lokā vihitā vidhātrā ।
yataḥ pumāṃsaḥ pramadāśca nirmitāstadaiva doṣāḥ pramadāsu nārada] ॥30॥
slp1: yataSca BUtAni mahAnti paYca yataSca lokA vihitA viDAtrA । yataH pumAMsaH pramadASca nirmitAstadEva dozAH pramadAsu nArada] ॥30॥

text: ime vai mānavā loke strīṣu sajjantyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ । mohena paramāviṣṭā daivādiṣṭena pārthiva । striyaśca puruṣeṣveva pratyakṣaṃ lokasākṣikam ॥1॥
html:
ime vai mānavā loke strīṣu sajjantyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ।
mohena paramāviṣṭā daivādiṣṭena pārthiva ।
striyaśca puruṣeṣveva pratyakṣaṃ lokasākṣikam ॥1॥
slp1: ime vE mAnavA loke strIzu sajjantyaBIkzRaSaH । mohena paramAvizwA dEvAdizwena pArTiva । striyaSca puruzezveva pratyakzaM lokasAkzikam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atra me saṃśayastīvro hṛdi samparivartate । kathamāsāṃ narāḥ saṅgaṃ kurvate kurunandana । striyo vā teṣu rajyante virajyante'tha vā punaḥ ॥2॥
html:
atra me saṃśayastīvro hṛdi samparivartate ।
kathamāsāṃ narāḥ saṅgaṃ kurvate kurunandana ।
striyo vā teṣu rajyante virajyante'tha vā punaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: atra me saMSayastIvro hfdi samparivartate । kaTamAsAM narAH saNgaM kurvate kurunandana । striyo vA tezu rajyante virajyante'Ta vA punaH ॥2॥

text: iti tāḥ puruṣavyāghra kathaṃ śakyāḥ sma rakṣitum । pramadāḥ puruṣeṇeha tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥3॥
html:
iti tāḥ puruṣavyāghra kathaṃ śakyāḥ sma rakṣitum ।
pramadāḥ puruṣeṇeha tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥3॥
slp1: iti tAH puruzavyAGra kaTaM SakyAH sma rakzitum । pramadAH puruzeReha tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥3॥

text: etā hi mayamāyābhirvañcayantīha mānavān । na cāsāṃ mucyate kaścitpuruṣo hastamāgataḥ । gāvo navatṛṇānīva gṛhṇantyeva navānnavān ॥4॥
html:
etā hi mayamāyābhirvañcayantīha mānavān ।
na cāsāṃ mucyate kaścitpuruṣo hastamāgataḥ ।
gāvo navatṛṇānīva gṛhṇantyeva navānnavān ॥4॥
slp1: etA hi mayamAyABirvaYcayantIha mAnavAn । na cAsAM mucyate kaScitpuruzo hastamAgataH । gAvo navatfRAnIva gfhRantyeva navAnnavAn ॥4॥

text: śambarasya ca yā māyā yā māyā namucerapi । baleḥ kumbhīnaseścaiva sarvāstā yoṣito viduḥ ॥5॥
html:
śambarasya ca yā māyā yā māyā namucerapi ।
baleḥ kumbhīnaseścaiva sarvāstā yoṣito viduḥ ॥5॥
slp1: Sambarasya ca yA mAyA yA mAyA namucerapi । baleH kumBInaseScEva sarvAstA yozito viduH ॥5॥

text: hasantaṃ prahasantyetā rudantaṃ prarudanti ca । apriyaṃ priyavākyaiśca gṛhṇate kālayogataḥ ॥6॥
html:
hasantaṃ prahasantyetā rudantaṃ prarudanti ca ।
apriyaṃ priyavākyaiśca gṛhṇate kālayogataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: hasantaM prahasantyetA rudantaM prarudanti ca । apriyaM priyavAkyESca gfhRate kAlayogataH ॥6॥

text: uśanā veda yacchāstraṃ yacca veda bṛhaspatiḥ । strībuddhyā na viśiṣyete tāḥ sma rakṣyāḥ kathaṃ naraiḥ ॥7॥
html:
uśanā veda yacchāstraṃ yacca veda bṛhaspatiḥ ।
strībuddhyā na viśiṣyete tāḥ sma rakṣyāḥ kathaṃ naraiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: uSanA veda yacCAstraM yacca veda bfhaspatiH । strIbudDyA na viSizyete tAH sma rakzyAH kaTaM narEH ॥7॥

text: anṛtaṃ satyamityāhuḥ satyaṃ cāpi tathānṛtam । iti yāstāḥ kathaṃ vīra saṃrakṣyāḥ puruṣairiha ॥8॥
html:
anṛtaṃ satyamityāhuḥ satyaṃ cāpi tathānṛtam ।
iti yāstāḥ kathaṃ vīra saṃrakṣyāḥ puruṣairiha ॥8॥
slp1: anftaM satyamityAhuH satyaM cApi taTAnftam । iti yAstAH kaTaM vIra saMrakzyAH puruzEriha ॥8॥

text: strīṇāṃ buddhyupaniṣkarṣādarthaśāstrāṇi śatruhan । bṛhaspatiprabhṛtibhirmanye sadbhiḥ kṛtāni vai ॥9॥
html:
strīṇāṃ buddhyupaniṣkarṣādarthaśāstrāṇi śatruhan ।
bṛhaspatiprabhṛtibhirmanye sadbhiḥ kṛtāni vai ॥9॥
slp1: strIRAM budDyupanizkarzAdarTaSAstrARi Satruhan । bfhaspatipraBftiBirmanye sadBiH kftAni vE ॥9॥

text: sampūjyamānāḥ puruṣairvikurvanti mano nṛṣu । apāstāśca tathā rājanvikurvanti manaḥ striyaḥ ॥10॥
html:
sampūjyamānāḥ puruṣairvikurvanti mano nṛṣu ।
apāstāśca tathā rājanvikurvanti manaḥ striyaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: sampUjyamAnAH puruzErvikurvanti mano nfzu । apAstASca taTA rAjanvikurvanti manaH striyaH ॥10॥

text: kastāḥ śakto rakṣituṃ syāditi me saṃśayo mahān । tanme brūhi mahābāho kurūṇāṃ vaṃśavardhana ॥11॥
html:
kastāḥ śakto rakṣituṃ syāditi me saṃśayo mahān ।
tanme brūhi mahābāho kurūṇāṃ vaṃśavardhana ॥11॥
slp1: kastAH Sakto rakzituM syAditi me saMSayo mahAn । tanme brUhi mahAbAho kurURAM vaMSavarDana ॥11॥

text: yadi śakyā kuruśreṣṭha rakṣā tāsāṃ kathañcana । kartuṃ vā kṛtapūrvā vā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi] ॥12॥
html:
yadi śakyā kuruśreṣṭha rakṣā tāsāṃ kathañcana ।
kartuṃ vā kṛtapūrvā vā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi] ॥12॥
slp1: yadi SakyA kuruSrezWa rakzA tAsAM kaTaYcana । kartuM vA kftapUrvA vA tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi] ॥12॥

text: evametanmahābāho nātra mithyāsti kiñcana । yathā bravīṣi kauravya nārīṃ prati janādhipa ॥1॥
html:
evametanmahābāho nātra mithyāsti kiñcana ।
yathā bravīṣi kauravya nārīṃ prati janādhipa ॥1॥
slp1: evametanmahAbAho nAtra miTyAsti kiYcana । yaTA bravIzi kOravya nArIM prati janADipa ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam । yathā rakṣā kṛtā pūrvaṃ vipulena mahātmanā ॥2॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam ।
yathā rakṣā kṛtā pūrvaṃ vipulena mahātmanā ॥2॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi itihAsaM purAtanam । yaTA rakzA kftA pUrvaM vipulena mahAtmanA ॥2॥

text: pramadāśca yathā sṛṣṭā brahmaṇā bharatarṣabha । yadarthaṃ tacca te tāta pravakṣye vasudhādhipa ॥3॥
html:
pramadāśca yathā sṛṣṭā brahmaṇā bharatarṣabha ।
yadarthaṃ tacca te tāta pravakṣye vasudhādhipa ॥3॥
slp1: pramadASca yaTA sfzwA brahmaRA BaratarzaBa । yadarTaM tacca te tAta pravakzye vasuDADipa ॥3॥

text: na hi strībhya paraṃ putra pāpīyaḥ kiñcidasti vai । agnirhi pramadā dīpto māyāśca mayajā vibho । kṣuradhārā viṣaṃ sarpo mṛtyurityekataḥ striyaḥ ॥4॥
html:
na hi strībhya paraṃ putra pāpīyaḥ kiñcidasti vai ।
agnirhi pramadā dīpto māyāśca mayajā vibho ।
kṣuradhārā viṣaṃ sarpo mṛtyurityekataḥ striyaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: na hi strIBya paraM putra pApIyaH kiYcidasti vE । agnirhi pramadA dIpto mAyASca mayajA viBo । kzuraDArA vizaM sarpo mftyurityekataH striyaH ॥4॥

text: imāḥ prajā mahābāho dhārmikā iti naḥ śrutam । svayaṃ gacchanti devatvaṃ tato devāniyādbhayam ॥5॥
html:
imāḥ prajā mahābāho dhārmikā iti naḥ śrutam ।
svayaṃ gacchanti devatvaṃ tato devāniyādbhayam ॥5॥
slp1: imAH prajA mahAbAho DArmikA iti naH Srutam । svayaM gacCanti devatvaM tato devAniyAdBayam ॥5॥

text: athābhyagacchandevāste pitāmahamarindama । nivedya mānasaṃ cāpi tūṣṇīmāsannavāṅmukhāḥ ॥6॥
html:
athābhyagacchandevāste pitāmahamarindama ।
nivedya mānasaṃ cāpi tūṣṇīmāsannavāṅmukhāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: aTAByagacCandevAste pitAmahamarindama । nivedya mAnasaM cApi tUzRImAsannavANmuKAH ॥6॥

text: teṣāmantargataṃ jñātvā devānāṃ sa pitāmahaḥ । mānavānāṃ pramohārthaṃ kṛtyā nāryo'sṛjatprabhuḥ ॥7॥
html:
teṣāmantargataṃ jñātvā devānāṃ sa pitāmahaḥ ।
mānavānāṃ pramohārthaṃ kṛtyā nāryo'sṛjatprabhuḥ ॥7॥
slp1: tezAmantargataM jYAtvA devAnAM sa pitAmahaH । mAnavAnAM pramohArTaM kftyA nAryo'sfjatpraBuH ॥7॥

text: pūrvasarge tu kaunteya sādhvyo nārya ihābhavan । asādhvyastu samutpannā kṛtyā sargātprajāpateḥ ॥8॥
html:
pūrvasarge tu kaunteya sādhvyo nārya ihābhavan ।
asādhvyastu samutpannā kṛtyā sargātprajāpateḥ ॥8॥
slp1: pUrvasarge tu kOnteya sADvyo nArya ihABavan । asADvyastu samutpannA kftyA sargAtprajApateH ॥8॥

text: tābhyaḥ kāmānyathākāmaṃ prādāddhi sa pitāmahaḥ । tāḥ kāmalubdhāḥ pramadāḥ prāmathnanta narāṃstadā ॥9॥
html:
tābhyaḥ kāmānyathākāmaṃ prādāddhi sa pitāmahaḥ ।
tāḥ kāmalubdhāḥ pramadāḥ prāmathnanta narāṃstadā ॥9॥
slp1: tAByaH kAmAnyaTAkAmaM prAdAdDi sa pitAmahaH । tAH kAmalubDAH pramadAH prAmaTnanta narAMstadA ॥9॥

text: krodhaṃ kāmasya deveśaḥ sahāyaṃ cāsṛjatprabhuḥ । asajjanta prajāḥ sarvāḥ kāmakrodhavaśaṃ gatāḥ ॥10॥
html:
krodhaṃ kāmasya deveśaḥ sahāyaṃ cāsṛjatprabhuḥ ।
asajjanta prajāḥ sarvāḥ kāmakrodhavaśaṃ gatāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: kroDaM kAmasya deveSaH sahAyaM cAsfjatpraBuH । asajjanta prajAH sarvAH kAmakroDavaSaM gatAH ॥10॥

text: na ca strīṇāṃ kriyā kāciditi dharmo vyavasthitaḥ । nirindriyā amantrāśca striyo'nṛtamiti śrutiḥ ॥11॥
html:
na ca strīṇāṃ kriyā kāciditi dharmo vyavasthitaḥ ।
nirindriyā amantrāśca striyo'nṛtamiti śrutiḥ ॥11॥
slp1: na ca strIRAM kriyA kAciditi Darmo vyavasTitaH । nirindriyA amantrASca striyo'nftamiti SrutiH ॥11॥

text: śayyāsanamalaṅkāramannapānamanāryatām । durvāgbhāvaṃ ratiṃ caiva dadau strībhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥12॥
html:
śayyāsanamalaṅkāramannapānamanāryatām ।
durvāgbhāvaṃ ratiṃ caiva dadau strībhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥12॥
slp1: SayyAsanamalaNkAramannapAnamanAryatAm । durvAgBAvaM ratiM cEva dadO strIByaH prajApatiH ॥12॥

text: na tāsāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ puṃsā kathañcana । api viśvakṛtā tāta kutastu puruṣairiha ॥13॥
html:
na tāsāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ puṃsā kathañcana ।
api viśvakṛtā tāta kutastu puruṣairiha ॥13॥
slp1: na tAsAM rakzaRaM kartuM SakyaM puMsA kaTaYcana । api viSvakftA tAta kutastu puruzEriha ॥13॥

text: vācā vā vadhabandhairvā kleśairvā vividhaistathā । na śakyā rakṣituṃ nāryastā hi nityamasaṃyatāḥ ॥14॥
html:
vācā vā vadhabandhairvā kleśairvā vividhaistathā ।
na śakyā rakṣituṃ nāryastā hi nityamasaṃyatāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: vAcA vA vaDabanDErvA kleSErvA viviDEstaTA । na SakyA rakzituM nAryastA hi nityamasaMyatAH ॥14॥

text: idaṃ tu puruṣavyāghra purastācchrutavānaham । yathā rakṣā kṛtā pūrvaṃ vipulena gurustriyaḥ ॥15॥
html:
idaṃ tu puruṣavyāghra purastācchrutavānaham ।
yathā rakṣā kṛtā pūrvaṃ vipulena gurustriyaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: idaM tu puruzavyAGra purastAcCrutavAnaham । yaTA rakzA kftA pUrvaM vipulena gurustriyaH ॥15॥

text: ṛṣirāsīnmahābhāgo devaśarmeti viśrutaḥ । tasya bhāryā rucirnāma rūpeṇāsadṛśī bhuvi ॥16॥
html:
ṛṣirāsīnmahābhāgo devaśarmeti viśrutaḥ ।
tasya bhāryā rucirnāma rūpeṇāsadṛśī bhuvi ॥16॥
slp1: fzirAsInmahABAgo devaSarmeti viSrutaH । tasya BAryA rucirnAma rUpeRAsadfSI Buvi ॥16॥

text: tasya rūpeṇa sammattā devagandharvadānavāḥ । viśeṣatastu rājendra vṛtrahā pākaśāsanaḥ ॥17॥
html:
tasya rūpeṇa sammattā devagandharvadānavāḥ ।
viśeṣatastu rājendra vṛtrahā pākaśāsanaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tasya rUpeRa sammattA devaganDarvadAnavAH । viSezatastu rAjendra vftrahA pAkaSAsanaH ॥17॥

text: nārīṇāṃ caritajñaśca devaśarmā mahāmuniḥ । yathāśakti yathotsāhaṃ bhāryāṃ tāmabhyarakṣata ॥18॥
html:
nārīṇāṃ caritajñaśca devaśarmā mahāmuniḥ ।
yathāśakti yathotsāhaṃ bhāryāṃ tāmabhyarakṣata ॥18॥
slp1: nArIRAM caritajYaSca devaSarmA mahAmuniH । yaTASakti yaTotsAhaM BAryAM tAmaByarakzata ॥18॥

text: purandaraṃ ca jānīte parastrīkāmacāriṇam । tasmādyatnena bhāryāyā rakṣaṇaṃ sa cakāra ha ॥19॥
html:
purandaraṃ ca jānīte parastrīkāmacāriṇam ।
tasmādyatnena bhāryāyā rakṣaṇaṃ sa cakāra ha ॥19॥
slp1: purandaraM ca jAnIte parastrIkAmacAriRam । tasmAdyatnena BAryAyA rakzaRaM sa cakAra ha ॥19॥

text: sa kadācidṛṣistāta yajñaṃ kartumanāstadā । bhāryāsaṃrakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ kathaṃ syādityacintayat ॥20॥
html:
sa kadācidṛṣistāta yajñaṃ kartumanāstadā ।
bhāryāsaṃrakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ kathaṃ syādityacintayat ॥20॥
slp1: sa kadAcidfzistAta yajYaM kartumanAstadA । BAryAsaMrakzaRaM kAryaM kaTaM syAdityacintayat ॥20॥

text: rakṣāvidhānaṃ manasā sa vicintya mahātapāḥ । āhūya dayitaṃ śiṣyaṃ vipulaṃ prāha bhārgavam ॥21॥
html:
rakṣāvidhānaṃ manasā sa vicintya mahātapāḥ ।
āhūya dayitaṃ śiṣyaṃ vipulaṃ prāha bhārgavam ॥21॥
slp1: rakzAviDAnaM manasA sa vicintya mahAtapAH । AhUya dayitaM SizyaM vipulaM prAha BArgavam ॥21॥

text: yajñakāro gamiṣyāmi ruciṃ cemāṃ sureśvaraḥ । putra prārthayate nityaṃ tāṃ rakṣasva yathābalam ॥22॥
html:
yajñakāro gamiṣyāmi ruciṃ cemāṃ sureśvaraḥ ।
putra prārthayate nityaṃ tāṃ rakṣasva yathābalam ॥22॥
slp1: yajYakAro gamizyAmi ruciM cemAM sureSvaraH । putra prArTayate nityaM tAM rakzasva yaTAbalam ॥22॥

text: apramattena te bhāvyaṃ sadā prati purandaram । sa hi rūpāṇi kurute vividhāni bhṛgūdvaha ॥23॥
html:
apramattena te bhāvyaṃ sadā prati purandaram ।
sa hi rūpāṇi kurute vividhāni bhṛgūdvaha ॥23॥
slp1: apramattena te BAvyaM sadA prati purandaram । sa hi rUpARi kurute viviDAni BfgUdvaha ॥23॥

text: ityukto vipulastena tapasvī niyatendriyaḥ । sadaivogratapā rājannagnyarkasadṛśadyutiḥ ॥24॥
html:
ityukto vipulastena tapasvī niyatendriyaḥ ।
sadaivogratapā rājannagnyarkasadṛśadyutiḥ ॥24॥
slp1: ityukto vipulastena tapasvI niyatendriyaH । sadEvogratapA rAjannagnyarkasadfSadyutiH ॥24॥

text: dharmajñaḥ satyavādī ca tatheti pratyabhāṣata । punaścedaṃ mahārāja papraccha prasthitaṃ gurum ॥25॥
html:
dharmajñaḥ satyavādī ca tatheti pratyabhāṣata ।
punaścedaṃ mahārāja papraccha prasthitaṃ gurum ॥25॥
slp1: DarmajYaH satyavAdI ca taTeti pratyaBAzata । punaScedaM mahArAja papracCa prasTitaM gurum ॥25॥

text: kāni rūpāṇi śakrasya bhavantyāgacchato mune । vapustejaśca kīdṛgvai tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥26॥
html:
kāni rūpāṇi śakrasya bhavantyāgacchato mune ।
vapustejaśca kīdṛgvai tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥26॥
slp1: kAni rUpARi Sakrasya BavantyAgacCato mune । vapustejaSca kIdfgvE tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥26॥

text: tataḥ sa bhagavāṃstasmai vipulāya mahātmane । ācacakṣe yathātattvaṃ māyāṃ śakrasya bhārata ॥27॥
html:
tataḥ sa bhagavāṃstasmai vipulāya mahātmane ।
ācacakṣe yathātattvaṃ māyāṃ śakrasya bhārata ॥27॥
slp1: tataH sa BagavAMstasmE vipulAya mahAtmane । Acacakze yaTAtattvaM mAyAM Sakrasya BArata ॥27॥

text: bahumāyaḥ sa viprarṣe balahā pākaśāsanaḥ । tāṃstānvikurute bhāvānbahūnatha muhurmuhuḥ ॥28॥
html:
bahumāyaḥ sa viprarṣe balahā pākaśāsanaḥ ।
tāṃstānvikurute bhāvānbahūnatha muhurmuhuḥ ॥28॥
slp1: bahumAyaH sa viprarze balahA pAkaSAsanaH । tAMstAnvikurute BAvAnbahUnaTa muhurmuhuH ॥28॥

text: kirīṭī vajrabhṛddhanvī mukuṭī baddhakuṇḍalaḥ । bhavatyatha muhūrtena caṇḍālasamadarśanaḥ ॥29॥
html:
kirīṭī vajrabhṛddhanvī mukuṭī baddhakuṇḍalaḥ ।
bhavatyatha muhūrtena caṇḍālasamadarśanaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: kirIwI vajraBfdDanvI mukuwI badDakuRqalaH । BavatyaTa muhUrtena caRqAlasamadarSanaH ॥29॥

text: śikhī jaṭī cīravāsāḥ punarbhavati putraka । bṛhaccharīraśca punaḥ pīvaro'tha punaḥ kṛśaḥ ॥30॥
html:
śikhī jaṭī cīravāsāḥ punarbhavati putraka ।
bṛhaccharīraśca punaḥ pīvaro'tha punaḥ kṛśaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: SiKI jawI cIravAsAH punarBavati putraka । bfhacCarIraSca punaH pIvaro'Ta punaH kfSaH ॥30॥

text: gauraṃ śyāmaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇaṃ vikurute punaḥ । virūpo rūpavāṃścaiva yuvā vṛddhastathaiva ca ॥31॥
html:
gauraṃ śyāmaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇaṃ vikurute punaḥ ।
virūpo rūpavāṃścaiva yuvā vṛddhastathaiva ca ॥31॥
slp1: gOraM SyAmaM ca kfzRaM ca varRaM vikurute punaH । virUpo rUpavAMScEva yuvA vfdDastaTEva ca ॥31॥

text: prājño jaḍaśca mūkaśca hrasvo dīrghastathaiva ca । brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyaścaiva vaiśyaḥ śūdrastathaiva ca । pratilomānulomaśca bhavatyatha śatakratuḥ ॥32॥
html:
prājño jaḍaśca mūkaśca hrasvo dīrghastathaiva ca ।
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyaścaiva vaiśyaḥ śūdrastathaiva ca ।
pratilomānulomaśca bhavatyatha śatakratuḥ ॥32॥
slp1: prAjYo jaqaSca mUkaSca hrasvo dIrGastaTEva ca । brAhmaRaH kzatriyaScEva vESyaH SUdrastaTEva ca । pratilomAnulomaSca BavatyaTa SatakratuH ॥32॥

text: śukavāyasarūpī ca haṃsakokilarūpavān । siṃhavyāghragajānāṃ ca rūpaṃ dhārayate punaḥ ॥33॥
html:
śukavāyasarūpī ca haṃsakokilarūpavān ।
siṃhavyāghragajānāṃ ca rūpaṃ dhārayate punaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: SukavAyasarUpI ca haMsakokilarUpavAn । siMhavyAGragajAnAM ca rUpaM DArayate punaH ॥33॥

text: daivaṃ daityamatho rājñāṃ vapurdhārayate'pi ca । sukṛśo vāyubhagnāṅgaḥ śakunirvikṛtastathā ॥34॥
html:
daivaṃ daityamatho rājñāṃ vapurdhārayate'pi ca ।
sukṛśo vāyubhagnāṅgaḥ śakunirvikṛtastathā ॥34॥
slp1: dEvaM dEtyamaTo rAjYAM vapurDArayate'pi ca । sukfSo vAyuBagnANgaH SakunirvikftastaTA ॥34॥

text: catuṣpādbahurūpaśca punarbhavati bāliśaḥ । makṣikāmaśakādīnāṃ vapurdhārayate'pi ca ॥35॥
html:
catuṣpādbahurūpaśca punarbhavati bāliśaḥ ।
makṣikāmaśakādīnāṃ vapurdhārayate'pi ca ॥35॥
slp1: catuzpAdbahurUpaSca punarBavati bAliSaH । makzikAmaSakAdInAM vapurDArayate'pi ca ॥35॥

text: na śakyamasya grahaṇaṃ kartuṃ vipula kenacit । api viśvakṛtā tāta yena sṛṣṭamidaṃ jagat ॥36॥
html:
na śakyamasya grahaṇaṃ kartuṃ vipula kenacit ।
api viśvakṛtā tāta yena sṛṣṭamidaṃ jagat ॥36॥
slp1: na Sakyamasya grahaRaM kartuM vipula kenacit । api viSvakftA tAta yena sfzwamidaM jagat ॥36॥

text: punarantarhitaḥ śakro dṛśyate jñānacakṣuṣā । vāyubhūtaśca sa punardevarājo bhavatyuta ॥37॥
html:
punarantarhitaḥ śakro dṛśyate jñānacakṣuṣā ।
vāyubhūtaśca sa punardevarājo bhavatyuta ॥37॥
slp1: punarantarhitaH Sakro dfSyate jYAnacakzuzA । vAyuBUtaSca sa punardevarAjo Bavatyuta ॥37॥

text: evaṃ rūpāṇi satataṃ kurute pākaśāsanaḥ । tasmādvipula yatnena rakṣemāṃ tanumadhyamām ॥38॥
html:
evaṃ rūpāṇi satataṃ kurute pākaśāsanaḥ ।
tasmādvipula yatnena rakṣemāṃ tanumadhyamām ॥38॥
slp1: evaM rUpARi satataM kurute pAkaSAsanaH । tasmAdvipula yatnena rakzemAM tanumaDyamAm ॥38॥

text: yathā ruciṃ nāvaliheddevendro bhṛgusattama । kratāvupahitaṃ nyastaṃ haviḥ śveva durātmavān ॥39॥
html:
yathā ruciṃ nāvaliheddevendro bhṛgusattama ।
kratāvupahitaṃ nyastaṃ haviḥ śveva durātmavān ॥39॥
slp1: yaTA ruciM nAvaliheddevendro Bfgusattama । kratAvupahitaM nyastaM haviH Sveva durAtmavAn ॥39॥

text: evamākhyāya sa muniryajñakāro'gamattadā । devaśarmā mahābhāgastato bharatasattama ॥40॥
html:
evamākhyāya sa muniryajñakāro'gamattadā ।
devaśarmā mahābhāgastato bharatasattama ॥40॥
slp1: evamAKyAya sa muniryajYakAro'gamattadA । devaSarmA mahABAgastato Baratasattama ॥40॥

text: vipulastu vacaḥ śrutvā gurościntāparo'bhavat । rakṣāṃ ca paramāṃ cakre devarājānmahābalāt ॥41॥
html:
vipulastu vacaḥ śrutvā gurościntāparo'bhavat ।
rakṣāṃ ca paramāṃ cakre devarājānmahābalāt ॥41॥
slp1: vipulastu vacaH SrutvA guroScintAparo'Bavat । rakzAM ca paramAM cakre devarAjAnmahAbalAt ॥41॥

text: kiṃ nu śakyaṃ mayā kartuṃ gurudārābhirakṣaṇe । māyāvī hi surendro'sau durdharṣaścāpi vīryavān ॥42॥
html:
kiṃ nu śakyaṃ mayā kartuṃ gurudārābhirakṣaṇe ।
māyāvī hi surendro'sau durdharṣaścāpi vīryavān ॥42॥
slp1: kiM nu SakyaM mayA kartuM gurudArABirakzaRe । mAyAvI hi surendro'sO durDarzaScApi vIryavAn ॥42॥

text: nāpidhāyāśramaṃ śakyo rakṣituṃ pākaśāsanaḥ । uṭajaṃ vā tathā hyasya nānāvidhasarūpatā ॥43॥
html:
nāpidhāyāśramaṃ śakyo rakṣituṃ pākaśāsanaḥ ।
uṭajaṃ vā tathā hyasya nānāvidhasarūpatā ॥43॥
slp1: nApiDAyASramaM Sakyo rakzituM pAkaSAsanaH । uwajaM vA taTA hyasya nAnAviDasarUpatA ॥43॥

text: vāyurūpeṇa vā śakro gurupatnīṃ pradharṣayet । tasmādimāṃ sampraviśya ruciṃ sthāsye'hamadya vai ॥44॥
html:
vāyurūpeṇa vā śakro gurupatnīṃ pradharṣayet ।
tasmādimāṃ sampraviśya ruciṃ sthāsye'hamadya vai ॥44॥
slp1: vAyurUpeRa vA Sakro gurupatnIM praDarzayet । tasmAdimAM sampraviSya ruciM sTAsye'hamadya vE ॥44॥

text: atha vā pauruṣeṇeyamaśakyā rakṣituṃ mayā । bahurūpo hi bhagavāñchrūyate harivāhanaḥ ॥45॥
html:
atha vā pauruṣeṇeyamaśakyā rakṣituṃ mayā ।
bahurūpo hi bhagavāñchrūyate harivāhanaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: aTa vA pOruzeReyamaSakyA rakzituM mayA । bahurUpo hi BagavAYCrUyate harivAhanaH ॥45॥

text: so'haṃ yogabalādenāṃ rakṣiṣye pākaśāsanāt । gātrāṇi gātrairasyāhaṃ sampravekṣye'bhirakṣitum ॥46॥
html:
so'haṃ yogabalādenāṃ rakṣiṣye pākaśāsanāt ।
gātrāṇi gātrairasyāhaṃ sampravekṣye'bhirakṣitum ॥46॥
slp1: so'haM yogabalAdenAM rakzizye pAkaSAsanAt । gAtrARi gAtrErasyAhaM sampravekzye'Birakzitum ॥46॥

text: yadyucchiṣṭāmimāṃ patnīṃ ruciṃ paśyeta me guruḥ । śapsyatyasaṃśayaṃ kopāddivyajñāno mahātapāḥ ॥47॥
html:
yadyucchiṣṭāmimāṃ patnīṃ ruciṃ paśyeta me guruḥ ।
śapsyatyasaṃśayaṃ kopāddivyajñāno mahātapāḥ ॥47॥
slp1: yadyucCizwAmimAM patnIM ruciM paSyeta me guruH । SapsyatyasaMSayaM kopAddivyajYAno mahAtapAH ॥47॥

text: na ceyaṃ rakṣituṃ śakyā yathānyā pramadā nṛbhiḥ । māyāvī hi surendro'sāvaho prāpto'smi saṃśayam ॥48॥
html:
na ceyaṃ rakṣituṃ śakyā yathānyā pramadā nṛbhiḥ ।
māyāvī hi surendro'sāvaho prāpto'smi saṃśayam ॥48॥
slp1: na ceyaM rakzituM SakyA yaTAnyA pramadA nfBiH । mAyAvI hi surendro'sAvaho prApto'smi saMSayam ॥48॥

text: avaśyakaraṇīyaṃ hi guroriha hi śāsanam । yadi tvetadahaṃ kuryāmāścaryaṃ syātkṛtaṃ mayā ॥49॥
html:
avaśyakaraṇīyaṃ hi guroriha hi śāsanam ।
yadi tvetadahaṃ kuryāmāścaryaṃ syātkṛtaṃ mayā ॥49॥
slp1: avaSyakaraRIyaM hi guroriha hi SAsanam । yadi tvetadahaM kuryAmAScaryaM syAtkftaM mayA ॥49॥

text: yogenānupraviśyeha gurupatnyāḥ kalevaram । nirmuktasya rajorūpānnāparādho bhavenmama ॥50॥
html:
yogenānupraviśyeha gurupatnyāḥ kalevaram ।
nirmuktasya rajorūpānnāparādho bhavenmama ॥50॥
slp1: yogenAnupraviSyeha gurupatnyAH kalevaram । nirmuktasya rajorUpAnnAparADo Bavenmama ॥50॥

text: yathā hi śūnyāṃ pathikaḥ sabhāmadhyāvasetpathi । tathādyāvāsayiṣyāmi gurupatnyāḥ kalevaram ॥51॥
html:
yathā hi śūnyāṃ pathikaḥ sabhāmadhyāvasetpathi ।
tathādyāvāsayiṣyāmi gurupatnyāḥ kalevaram ॥51॥
slp1: yaTA hi SUnyAM paTikaH saBAmaDyAvasetpaTi । taTAdyAvAsayizyAmi gurupatnyAH kalevaram ॥51॥

text: asaktaḥ padmapatrastho jalabinduryathā calaḥ । evameva śarīre'syā nivatsyāmi samāhitaḥ ॥52॥
html:
asaktaḥ padmapatrastho jalabinduryathā calaḥ ।
evameva śarīre'syā nivatsyāmi samāhitaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: asaktaH padmapatrasTo jalabinduryaTA calaH । evameva SarIre'syA nivatsyAmi samAhitaH ॥52॥

text: ityevaṃ dharmamālokya vedavedāṃśca sarvaśaḥ । tapaśca vipulaṃ dṛṣṭvā gurorātmana eva ca ॥53॥
html:
ityevaṃ dharmamālokya vedavedāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ।
tapaśca vipulaṃ dṛṣṭvā gurorātmana eva ca ॥53॥
slp1: ityevaM DarmamAlokya vedavedAMSca sarvaSaH । tapaSca vipulaM dfzwvA gurorAtmana eva ca ॥53॥

text: iti niścitya manasā rakṣāṃ prati sa bhārgavaḥ । ātiṣṭhatparamaṃ yatnaṃ yathā tacchṛṇu pārthiva ॥54॥
html:
iti niścitya manasā rakṣāṃ prati sa bhārgavaḥ ।
ātiṣṭhatparamaṃ yatnaṃ yathā tacchṛṇu pārthiva ॥54॥
slp1: iti niScitya manasA rakzAM prati sa BArgavaH । AtizWatparamaM yatnaM yaTA tacCfRu pArTiva ॥54॥

text: gurupatnīmupāsīno vipulaḥ sa mahātapāḥ । upāsīnāmanindyāṅgīṃ kathābhiḥ samalobhayat ॥55॥
html:
gurupatnīmupāsīno vipulaḥ sa mahātapāḥ ।
upāsīnāmanindyāṅgīṃ kathābhiḥ samalobhayat ॥55॥
slp1: gurupatnImupAsIno vipulaH sa mahAtapAH । upAsInAmanindyANgIM kaTABiH samaloBayat ॥55॥

text: netrābhyāṃ netrayorasyā raśmīnsaṃyojya raśmibhiḥ । viveśa vipulaḥ kāyamākāśaṃ pavano yathā ॥56॥
html:
netrābhyāṃ netrayorasyā raśmīnsaṃyojya raśmibhiḥ ।
viveśa vipulaḥ kāyamākāśaṃ pavano yathā ॥56॥
slp1: netrAByAM netrayorasyA raSmInsaMyojya raSmiBiH । viveSa vipulaH kAyamAkASaM pavano yaTA ॥56॥

text: lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣaṇenaiva vadanaṃ vadanena ca । aviceṣṭannatiṣṭhadvai chāyevāntargato muniḥ ॥57॥
html:
lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣaṇenaiva vadanaṃ vadanena ca ।
aviceṣṭannatiṣṭhadvai chāyevāntargato muniḥ ॥57॥
slp1: lakzaRaM lakzaRenEva vadanaM vadanena ca । avicezwannatizWadvE CAyevAntargato muniH ॥57॥

text: tato viṣṭabhya vipulo gurupatnyāḥ kalevaram । uvāsa rakṣaṇe yukto na ca sā tamabudhyata ॥58॥
html:
tato viṣṭabhya vipulo gurupatnyāḥ kalevaram ।
uvāsa rakṣaṇe yukto na ca sā tamabudhyata ॥58॥
slp1: tato vizwaBya vipulo gurupatnyAH kalevaram । uvAsa rakzaRe yukto na ca sA tamabuDyata ॥58॥

text: yaṃ kālaṃ nāgato rājangurustasya mahātmanaḥ । kratuṃ samāpya svagṛhaṃ taṃ kālaṃ so'bhyarakṣata] ॥59॥
html:
yaṃ kālaṃ nāgato rājangurustasya mahātmanaḥ ।
kratuṃ samāpya svagṛhaṃ taṃ kālaṃ so'bhyarakṣata] ॥59॥
slp1: yaM kAlaM nAgato rAjangurustasya mahAtmanaH । kratuM samApya svagfhaM taM kAlaM so'Byarakzata] ॥59॥

text: tataḥ kadāciddevendro divyarūpavapurdharaḥ । idamantaramityevaṃ tato'bhyāgādathāśramam ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ kadāciddevendro divyarūpavapurdharaḥ ।
idamantaramityevaṃ tato'bhyāgādathāśramam ॥1॥
slp1: tataH kadAciddevendro divyarUpavapurDaraH । idamantaramityevaM tato'ByAgAdaTASramam ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: rūpamapratimaṃ kṛtvā lobhanīyaṃ janādhipa । darśanīyatamo bhūtvā praviveśa tamāśramam ॥2॥
html:
rūpamapratimaṃ kṛtvā lobhanīyaṃ janādhipa ।
darśanīyatamo bhūtvā praviveśa tamāśramam ॥2॥
slp1: rUpamapratimaM kftvA loBanIyaM janADipa । darSanIyatamo BUtvA praviveSa tamASramam ॥2॥

text: sa dadarśa tamāsīnaṃ vipulasya kalevaram । niśceṣṭaṃ stabdhanayanaṃ yathālekhyagataṃ tathā ॥3॥
html:
sa dadarśa tamāsīnaṃ vipulasya kalevaram ।
niśceṣṭaṃ stabdhanayanaṃ yathālekhyagataṃ tathā ॥3॥
slp1: sa dadarSa tamAsInaM vipulasya kalevaram । niScezwaM stabDanayanaM yaTAleKyagataM taTA ॥3॥

text: ruciṃ ca rucirāpāṅgīṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām । padmapatraviśālākṣīṃ sampūrṇendunibhānanām ॥4॥
html:
ruciṃ ca rucirāpāṅgīṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām ।
padmapatraviśālākṣīṃ sampūrṇendunibhānanām ॥4॥
slp1: ruciM ca rucirApANgIM pInaSroRipayoDarAm । padmapatraviSAlAkzIM sampUrRenduniBAnanAm ॥4॥

text: sā tamālokya sahasā pratyutthātumiyeṣa ha । rūpeṇa vismitā ko'sītyatha vaktumihecchatī ॥5॥
html:
sā tamālokya sahasā pratyutthātumiyeṣa ha ।
rūpeṇa vismitā ko'sītyatha vaktumihecchatī ॥5॥
slp1: sA tamAlokya sahasA pratyutTAtumiyeza ha । rUpeRa vismitA ko'sItyaTa vaktumihecCatI ॥5॥

text: utthātukāmāpi satī vyatiṣṭhadvipulena sā । nigṛhītā manuṣyendra na śaśāka viceṣṭitum ॥6॥
html:
utthātukāmāpi satī vyatiṣṭhadvipulena sā ।
nigṛhītā manuṣyendra na śaśāka viceṣṭitum ॥6॥
slp1: utTAtukAmApi satI vyatizWadvipulena sA । nigfhItA manuzyendra na SaSAka vicezwitum ॥6॥

text: tāmābabhāṣe devendraḥ sāmnā paramavalgunā । tvadarthamāgataṃ viddhi devendraṃ māṃ śucismite ॥7॥
html:
tāmābabhāṣe devendraḥ sāmnā paramavalgunā ।
tvadarthamāgataṃ viddhi devendraṃ māṃ śucismite ॥7॥
slp1: tAmAbaBAze devendraH sAmnA paramavalgunA । tvadarTamAgataM vidDi devendraM mAM Sucismite ॥7॥

text: kliśyamānamanaṅgena tvatsamkalpodbhavena vai । tatparyāpnuhi māṃ subhru purā kālo'tivartate ॥8॥
html:
kliśyamānamanaṅgena tvatsamkalpodbhavena vai ।
tatparyāpnuhi māṃ subhru purā kālo'tivartate ॥8॥
slp1: kliSyamAnamanaNgena tvatsamkalpodBavena vE । tatparyApnuhi mAM suBru purA kAlo'tivartate ॥8॥

text: tamevaṃvādinaṃ śakraṃ śuśrāva vipulo muniḥ । gurupatnyāḥ śarīrastho dadarśa ca surādhipam ॥9॥
html:
tamevaṃvādinaṃ śakraṃ śuśrāva vipulo muniḥ ।
gurupatnyāḥ śarīrastho dadarśa ca surādhipam ॥9॥
slp1: tamevaMvAdinaM SakraM SuSrAva vipulo muniH । gurupatnyAH SarIrasTo dadarSa ca surADipam ॥9॥

text: na śaśāka ca sā rājanpratyutthātumaninditā । vaktuṃ ca nāśakadrājanviṣṭabdhā vipulena sā ॥10॥
html:
na śaśāka ca sā rājanpratyutthātumaninditā ।
vaktuṃ ca nāśakadrājanviṣṭabdhā vipulena sā ॥10॥
slp1: na SaSAka ca sA rAjanpratyutTAtumaninditA । vaktuM ca nASakadrAjanvizwabDA vipulena sA ॥10॥

text: ākāraṃ gurupatnyāstu vijñāya sa bhṛgūdvahaḥ । nijagrāha mahātejā yogena balavatprabho । babandha yogabandhaiśca tasyāḥ sarvendriyāṇi saḥ ॥11॥
html:
ākāraṃ gurupatnyāstu vijñāya sa bhṛgūdvahaḥ ।
nijagrāha mahātejā yogena balavatprabho ।
babandha yogabandhaiśca tasyāḥ sarvendriyāṇi saḥ ॥11॥
slp1: AkAraM gurupatnyAstu vijYAya sa BfgUdvahaH । nijagrAha mahAtejA yogena balavatpraBo । babanDa yogabanDESca tasyAH sarvendriyARi saH ॥11॥

text: tāṃ nirvikārāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu punareva śacīpatiḥ । uvāca vrīḍito rājaṃstāṃ yogabalamohitām ॥12॥
html:
tāṃ nirvikārāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu punareva śacīpatiḥ ।
uvāca vrīḍito rājaṃstāṃ yogabalamohitām ॥12॥
slp1: tAM nirvikArAM dfzwvA tu punareva SacIpatiH । uvAca vrIqito rAjaMstAM yogabalamohitAm ॥12॥

text: ehyehīti tataḥ sā taṃ prativaktumiyeṣa ca । sa tāṃ vācaṃ guroḥ patnyā vipulaḥ paryavartayat ॥13॥
html:
ehyehīti tataḥ sā taṃ prativaktumiyeṣa ca ।
sa tāṃ vācaṃ guroḥ patnyā vipulaḥ paryavartayat ॥13॥
slp1: ehyehIti tataH sA taM prativaktumiyeza ca । sa tAM vAcaM guroH patnyA vipulaH paryavartayat ॥13॥

text: bhoḥ kimāgamane kṛtyamiti tasyāśca niḥsṛtā । vaktrācchaśāṅkapratimādvāṇī saṃskārabhūṣitā ॥14॥
html:
bhoḥ kimāgamane kṛtyamiti tasyāśca niḥsṛtā ।
vaktrācchaśāṅkapratimādvāṇī saṃskārabhūṣitā ॥14॥
slp1: BoH kimAgamane kftyamiti tasyASca niHsftA । vaktrAcCaSANkapratimAdvARI saMskAraBUzitA ॥14॥

text: vrīḍitā sā tu tadvākyamuktvā paravaśā tadā । purandaraśca santrasto babhūva vimanāstadā ॥15॥
html:
vrīḍitā sā tu tadvākyamuktvā paravaśā tadā ।
purandaraśca santrasto babhūva vimanāstadā ॥15॥
slp1: vrIqitA sA tu tadvAkyamuktvA paravaSA tadA । purandaraSca santrasto baBUva vimanAstadA ॥15॥

text: sa tadvaikṛtamālakṣya devarājo viśāṃ pate । avaikṣata sahasrākṣastadā divyena cakṣuṣā ॥16॥
html:
sa tadvaikṛtamālakṣya devarājo viśāṃ pate ।
avaikṣata sahasrākṣastadā divyena cakṣuṣā ॥16॥
slp1: sa tadvEkftamAlakzya devarAjo viSAM pate । avEkzata sahasrAkzastadA divyena cakzuzA ॥16॥

text: dadarśa ca muniṃ tasyāḥ śarīrāntaragocaram । pratibimbamivādarśe gurupatnyāḥ śarīragam ॥17॥
html:
dadarśa ca muniṃ tasyāḥ śarīrāntaragocaram ।
pratibimbamivādarśe gurupatnyāḥ śarīragam ॥17॥
slp1: dadarSa ca muniM tasyAH SarIrAntaragocaram । pratibimbamivAdarSe gurupatnyAH SarIragam ॥17॥

text: sa taṃ ghoreṇa tapasā yuktaṃ dṛṣṭvā purandaraḥ । prāvepata susantrastaḥ śāpabhītastadā vibho ॥18॥
html:
sa taṃ ghoreṇa tapasā yuktaṃ dṛṣṭvā purandaraḥ ।
prāvepata susantrastaḥ śāpabhītastadā vibho ॥18॥
slp1: sa taM GoreRa tapasA yuktaM dfzwvA purandaraH । prAvepata susantrastaH SApaBItastadA viBo ॥18॥

text: vimucya gurupatnīṃ tu vipulaḥ sumahātapāḥ । svaṃ kalevaramāviśya śakraṃ bhītamathābravīt ॥19॥
html:
vimucya gurupatnīṃ tu vipulaḥ sumahātapāḥ ।
svaṃ kalevaramāviśya śakraṃ bhītamathābravīt ॥19॥
slp1: vimucya gurupatnIM tu vipulaH sumahAtapAH । svaM kalevaramAviSya SakraM BItamaTAbravIt ॥19॥

text: ajitendriya pāpātmankāmātmaka purandara । na ciraṃ pūjayiṣyanti devāstvāṃ mānuṣāstathā ॥20॥
html:
ajitendriya pāpātmankāmātmaka purandara ।
na ciraṃ pūjayiṣyanti devāstvāṃ mānuṣāstathā ॥20॥
slp1: ajitendriya pApAtmankAmAtmaka purandara । na ciraM pUjayizyanti devAstvAM mAnuzAstaTA ॥20॥

text: kiṃ nu tadvismṛtaṃ śakra na tanmanasi te sthitam । gautamenāsi yanmukto bhagāṅkaparicihnitaḥ ॥21॥
html:
kiṃ nu tadvismṛtaṃ śakra na tanmanasi te sthitam ।
gautamenāsi yanmukto bhagāṅkaparicihnitaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: kiM nu tadvismftaM Sakra na tanmanasi te sTitam । gOtamenAsi yanmukto BagANkaparicihnitaH ॥21॥

text: jāne tvāṃ bāliśamatimakṛtātmānamasthiram । mayeyaṃ rakṣyate mūḍha gaccha pāpa yathāgatam ॥22॥
html:
jāne tvāṃ bāliśamatimakṛtātmānamasthiram ।
mayeyaṃ rakṣyate mūḍha gaccha pāpa yathāgatam ॥22॥
slp1: jAne tvAM bAliSamatimakftAtmAnamasTiram । mayeyaM rakzyate mUQa gacCa pApa yaTAgatam ॥22॥

text: nāhaṃ tvāmadya mūḍhātmandaheyaṃ hi svatejasā । kṛpāyamāṇastu na te dagdhumicchāmi vāsava ॥23॥
html:
nāhaṃ tvāmadya mūḍhātmandaheyaṃ hi svatejasā ।
kṛpāyamāṇastu na te dagdhumicchāmi vāsava ॥23॥
slp1: nAhaM tvAmadya mUQAtmandaheyaM hi svatejasA । kfpAyamARastu na te dagDumicCAmi vAsava ॥23॥

text: sa ca ghoratapā dhīmāngururme pāpacetasam । dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ nirdahedadya krodhadīptena cakṣuṣā ॥24॥
html:
sa ca ghoratapā dhīmāngururme pāpacetasam ।
dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ nirdahedadya krodhadīptena cakṣuṣā ॥24॥
slp1: sa ca GoratapA DImAngururme pApacetasam । dfzwvA tvAM nirdahedadya kroDadIptena cakzuzA ॥24॥

text: naivaṃ tu śakra kartavyaṃ punarmānyāśca te dvijāḥ । mā gamaḥ sasutāmātyo'tyayaṃ brahmabalārditaḥ ॥25॥
html:
naivaṃ tu śakra kartavyaṃ punarmānyāśca te dvijāḥ ।
mā gamaḥ sasutāmātyo'tyayaṃ brahmabalārditaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: nEvaM tu Sakra kartavyaM punarmAnyASca te dvijAH । mA gamaH sasutAmAtyo'tyayaM brahmabalArditaH ॥25॥

text: amaro'smīti yadbuddhimetāmāsthāya vartase । māvamaṃsthā na tapasāmasādhyaṃ nāma kiñcana ॥26॥
html:
amaro'smīti yadbuddhimetāmāsthāya vartase ।
māvamaṃsthā na tapasāmasādhyaṃ nāma kiñcana ॥26॥
slp1: amaro'smIti yadbudDimetAmAsTAya vartase । mAvamaMsTA na tapasAmasADyaM nAma kiYcana ॥26॥

text: tacchrutvā vacanaṃ śakro vipulasya mahātmanaḥ । akiñciduktvā vrīḍitastatraivāntaradhīyata ॥27॥
html:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ śakro vipulasya mahātmanaḥ ।
akiñciduktvā vrīḍitastatraivāntaradhīyata ॥27॥
slp1: tacCrutvA vacanaM Sakro vipulasya mahAtmanaH । akiYciduktvA vrIqitastatrEvAntaraDIyata ॥27॥

text: muhūrtayāte śakre tu devaśarmā mahātapāḥ । kṛtvā yajñaṃ yathākāmamājagāma svamāśramam ॥28॥
html:
muhūrtayāte śakre tu devaśarmā mahātapāḥ ।
kṛtvā yajñaṃ yathākāmamājagāma svamāśramam ॥28॥
slp1: muhUrtayAte Sakre tu devaSarmA mahAtapAH । kftvA yajYaM yaTAkAmamAjagAma svamASramam ॥28॥

text: āgate'tha gurau rājanvipulaḥ priyakarmakṛt । rakṣitāṃ gurave bhāryāṃ nyavedayadaninditām ॥29॥
html:
āgate'tha gurau rājanvipulaḥ priyakarmakṛt ।
rakṣitāṃ gurave bhāryāṃ nyavedayadaninditām ॥29॥
slp1: Agate'Ta gurO rAjanvipulaH priyakarmakft । rakzitAM gurave BAryAM nyavedayadaninditAm ॥29॥

text: abhivādya ca śāntātmā sa guruṃ guruvatsalaḥ । vipulaḥ paryupātiṣṭhadyathāpūrvamaśaṅkitaḥ ॥30॥
html:
abhivādya ca śāntātmā sa guruṃ guruvatsalaḥ ।
vipulaḥ paryupātiṣṭhadyathāpūrvamaśaṅkitaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: aBivAdya ca SAntAtmA sa guruM guruvatsalaH । vipulaH paryupAtizWadyaTApUrvamaSaNkitaH ॥30॥

text: viśrāntāya tatastasmai sahāsīnāya bhāryayā । nivedayāmāsa tadā vipulaḥ śakrakarma tat ॥31॥
html:
viśrāntāya tatastasmai sahāsīnāya bhāryayā ।
nivedayāmāsa tadā vipulaḥ śakrakarma tat ॥31॥
slp1: viSrAntAya tatastasmE sahAsInAya BAryayA । nivedayAmAsa tadA vipulaH Sakrakarma tat ॥31॥

text: tacchrutvā sa munistuṣṭo vipulasya pratāpavān । babhūva śīlavṛttābhyāṃ tapasā niyamena ca ॥32॥
html:
tacchrutvā sa munistuṣṭo vipulasya pratāpavān ।
babhūva śīlavṛttābhyāṃ tapasā niyamena ca ॥32॥
slp1: tacCrutvA sa munistuzwo vipulasya pratApavAn । baBUva SIlavfttAByAM tapasA niyamena ca ॥32॥

text: vipulasya gurau vṛttiṃ bhaktimātmani ca prabhuḥ । dharme ca sthiratāṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhu sādhvityuvāca ha ॥33॥
html:
vipulasya gurau vṛttiṃ bhaktimātmani ca prabhuḥ ।
dharme ca sthiratāṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhu sādhvityuvāca ha ॥33॥
slp1: vipulasya gurO vfttiM BaktimAtmani ca praBuH । Darme ca sTiratAM dfzwvA sADu sADvityuvAca ha ॥33॥

text: pratinandya ca dharmātmā śiṣyaṃ dharmaparāyaṇam । vareṇa cchandayāmāsa sa tasmādguruvatsalaḥ । anujñātaśca guruṇā cacārānuttamaṃ tapaḥ ॥34॥
html:
pratinandya ca dharmātmā śiṣyaṃ dharmaparāyaṇam ।
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa sa tasmādguruvatsalaḥ ।
anujñātaśca guruṇā cacārānuttamaṃ tapaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: pratinandya ca DarmAtmA SizyaM DarmaparAyaRam । vareRa cCandayAmAsa sa tasmAdguruvatsalaH । anujYAtaSca guruRA cacArAnuttamaM tapaH ॥34॥

text: tathaiva devaśarmāpi sabhāryaḥ sa mahātapāḥ । nirbhayo balavṛtraghnāccacāra vijane vane] ॥35॥
html:
tathaiva devaśarmāpi sabhāryaḥ sa mahātapāḥ ।
nirbhayo balavṛtraghnāccacāra vijane vane] ॥35॥
slp1: taTEva devaSarmApi saBAryaH sa mahAtapAH । nirBayo balavftraGnAccacAra vijane vane] ॥35॥

text: vipulastvakarottīvraṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā gurorvacaḥ । tapoyuktamathātmānamamanyata ca vīryavān ॥1॥
html:
vipulastvakarottīvraṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā gurorvacaḥ ।
tapoyuktamathātmānamamanyata ca vīryavān ॥1॥
slp1: vipulastvakarottIvraM tapaH kftvA gurorvacaH । tapoyuktamaTAtmAnamamanyata ca vIryavAn ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa tena karmaṇā spardhanpṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpate । cacāra gatabhīḥ prīto labdhakīrtirvaro nṛṣu ॥2॥
html:
sa tena karmaṇā spardhanpṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpate ।
cacāra gatabhīḥ prīto labdhakīrtirvaro nṛṣu ॥2॥
slp1: sa tena karmaRA sparDanpfTivIM pfTivIpate । cacAra gataBIH prIto labDakIrtirvaro nfzu ॥2॥

text: ubhau lokau jitau cāpi tathaivāmanyata prabhuḥ । karmaṇā tena kauravya tapasā vipulena ca ॥3॥
html:
ubhau lokau jitau cāpi tathaivāmanyata prabhuḥ ।
karmaṇā tena kauravya tapasā vipulena ca ॥3॥
slp1: uBO lokO jitO cApi taTEvAmanyata praBuH । karmaRA tena kOravya tapasA vipulena ca ॥3॥

text: atha kāle vyatikrānte kasmiṃścitkurunandana । rucyā bhaginyā dānaṃ vai babhūva dhanadhānyavat ॥4॥
html:
atha kāle vyatikrānte kasmiṃścitkurunandana ।
rucyā bhaginyā dānaṃ vai babhūva dhanadhānyavat ॥4॥
slp1: aTa kAle vyatikrAnte kasmiMScitkurunandana । rucyA BaginyA dAnaM vE baBUva DanaDAnyavat ॥4॥

text: etasminneva kāle tu divyā kācidvarāṅganā । bibhratī paramaṃ rūpaṃ jagāmātha vihāyasā ॥5॥
html:
etasminneva kāle tu divyā kācidvarāṅganā ।
bibhratī paramaṃ rūpaṃ jagāmātha vihāyasā ॥5॥
slp1: etasminneva kAle tu divyA kAcidvarANganA । biBratI paramaM rUpaM jagAmATa vihAyasA ॥5॥

text: tasyāḥ śarīrātpuṣpāṇi patitāni mahītale । tasyāśramasyāvidūre divyagandhāni bhārata ॥6॥
html:
tasyāḥ śarīrātpuṣpāṇi patitāni mahītale ।
tasyāśramasyāvidūre divyagandhāni bhārata ॥6॥
slp1: tasyAH SarIrAtpuzpARi patitAni mahItale । tasyASramasyAvidUre divyaganDAni BArata ॥6॥

text: tānyagṛhṇāttato rājanrucirnalinalocanā । tadā nimantrakastasyā aṅgebhyaḥ kṣipramāgamat ॥7॥
html:
tānyagṛhṇāttato rājanrucirnalinalocanā ।
tadā nimantrakastasyā aṅgebhyaḥ kṣipramāgamat ॥7॥
slp1: tAnyagfhRAttato rAjanrucirnalinalocanA । tadA nimantrakastasyA aNgeByaH kzipramAgamat ॥7॥

text: tasyā hi bhaginī tāta jyeṣṭhā nāmnā prabhāvatī । bhāryā citrarathasyātha babhūvāṅgeśvarasya vai ॥8॥
html:
tasyā hi bhaginī tāta jyeṣṭhā nāmnā prabhāvatī ।
bhāryā citrarathasyātha babhūvāṅgeśvarasya vai ॥8॥
slp1: tasyA hi BaginI tAta jyezWA nAmnA praBAvatI । BAryA citraraTasyATa baBUvANgeSvarasya vE ॥8॥

text: pinahya tāni puṣpāṇi keśeṣu varavarṇinī । āmantritā tato'gacchadruciraṅgapatergṛhān ॥9॥
html:
pinahya tāni puṣpāṇi keśeṣu varavarṇinī ।
āmantritā tato'gacchadruciraṅgapatergṛhān ॥9॥
slp1: pinahya tAni puzpARi keSezu varavarRinI । AmantritA tato'gacCadruciraNgapatergfhAn ॥9॥

text: puṣpāṇi tāni dṛṣṭvātha tadāṅgendravarāṅganā । bhaginīṃ codayāmāsa puṣpārthe cārulocanā ॥10॥
html:
puṣpāṇi tāni dṛṣṭvātha tadāṅgendravarāṅganā ।
bhaginīṃ codayāmāsa puṣpārthe cārulocanā ॥10॥
slp1: puzpARi tAni dfzwvATa tadANgendravarANganA । BaginIM codayAmAsa puzpArTe cArulocanA ॥10॥

text: sā bhartre sarvamācaṣṭa ruciḥ surucirānanā । bhaginyā bhāṣitaṃ sarvamṛṣistaccābhyanandata ॥11॥
html:
sā bhartre sarvamācaṣṭa ruciḥ surucirānanā ।
bhaginyā bhāṣitaṃ sarvamṛṣistaccābhyanandata ॥11॥
slp1: sA Bartre sarvamAcazwa ruciH surucirAnanA । BaginyA BAzitaM sarvamfzistaccAByanandata ॥11॥

text: tato vipulamānāyya devaśarmā mahātapāḥ । puṣpārthe codayāmāsa gaccha gaccheti bhārata ॥12॥
html:
tato vipulamānāyya devaśarmā mahātapāḥ ।
puṣpārthe codayāmāsa gaccha gaccheti bhārata ॥12॥
slp1: tato vipulamAnAyya devaSarmA mahAtapAH । puzpArTe codayAmAsa gacCa gacCeti BArata ॥12॥

text: vipulastu gurorvākyamavicārya mahātapāḥ । sa tathetyabravīdrājaṃstaṃ ca deśaṃ jagāma ha ॥13॥
html:
vipulastu gurorvākyamavicārya mahātapāḥ ।
sa tathetyabravīdrājaṃstaṃ ca deśaṃ jagāma ha ॥13॥
slp1: vipulastu gurorvAkyamavicArya mahAtapAH । sa taTetyabravIdrAjaMstaM ca deSaM jagAma ha ॥13॥

text: yasmindeśe tu tānyāsanpatitāni nabhastalāt । amlānānyapi tatrāsankusumānyaparāṇyapi ॥14॥
html:
yasmindeśe tu tānyāsanpatitāni nabhastalāt ।
amlānānyapi tatrāsankusumānyaparāṇyapi ॥14॥
slp1: yasmindeSe tu tAnyAsanpatitAni naBastalAt । amlAnAnyapi tatrAsankusumAnyaparARyapi ॥14॥

text: tataḥ sa tāni jagrāha divyāni rucirāṇi ca । prāptāni svena tapasā divyagandhāni bhārata ॥15॥
html:
tataḥ sa tāni jagrāha divyāni rucirāṇi ca ।
prāptāni svena tapasā divyagandhāni bhārata ॥15॥
slp1: tataH sa tAni jagrAha divyAni rucirARi ca । prAptAni svena tapasA divyaganDAni BArata ॥15॥

text: samprāpya tāni prītātmā gurorvacanakārakaḥ । tato jagāma tūrṇaṃ ca campāṃ campakamālinīm ॥16॥
html:
samprāpya tāni prītātmā gurorvacanakārakaḥ ।
tato jagāma tūrṇaṃ ca campāṃ campakamālinīm ॥16॥
slp1: samprApya tAni prItAtmA gurorvacanakArakaH । tato jagAma tUrRaM ca campAM campakamAlinIm ॥16॥

text: sa vane vijane tāta dadarśa mithunaṃ nṛṇām । cakravatparivartantaṃ gṛhītvā pāṇinā karam ॥17॥
html:
sa vane vijane tāta dadarśa mithunaṃ nṛṇām ।
cakravatparivartantaṃ gṛhītvā pāṇinā karam ॥17॥
slp1: sa vane vijane tAta dadarSa miTunaM nfRAm । cakravatparivartantaM gfhItvA pARinA karam ॥17॥

text: tatraikastūrṇamagamattatpade parivartayan । ekastu na tathā rājaṃścakratuḥ kalahaṃ tataḥ ॥18॥
html:
tatraikastūrṇamagamattatpade parivartayan ।
ekastu na tathā rājaṃścakratuḥ kalahaṃ tataḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tatrEkastUrRamagamattatpade parivartayan । ekastu na taTA rAjaMScakratuH kalahaM tataH ॥18॥

text: tvaṃ śīghraṃ gacchasītyeko'bravīnneti tathāparaḥ । neti neti ca tau tāta parasparamathocatuḥ ॥19॥
html:
tvaṃ śīghraṃ gacchasītyeko'bravīnneti tathāparaḥ ।
neti neti ca tau tāta parasparamathocatuḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tvaM SIGraM gacCasItyeko'bravInneti taTAparaH । neti neti ca tO tAta parasparamaTocatuH ॥19॥

text: tayorvispardhatorevaṃ śapatho'yamabhūttadā । manasoddiśya vipulaṃ tato vākyamathocatuḥ ॥20॥
html:
tayorvispardhatorevaṃ śapatho'yamabhūttadā ।
manasoddiśya vipulaṃ tato vākyamathocatuḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tayorvisparDatorevaM SapaTo'yamaBUttadA । manasoddiSya vipulaM tato vAkyamaTocatuH ॥20॥

text: āvayoranṛtaṃ prāha yastasyātha dvijasya vai । vipulasya pare loke yā gatiḥ sā bhavediti ॥21॥
html:
āvayoranṛtaṃ prāha yastasyātha dvijasya vai ।
vipulasya pare loke yā gatiḥ sā bhavediti ॥21॥
slp1: AvayoranftaM prAha yastasyATa dvijasya vE । vipulasya pare loke yA gatiH sA Bavediti ॥21॥

text: etacchrutvā tu vipulo viṣaṇṇavadano'bhavat । evaṃ tīvratapāścāhaṃ kaṣṭaścāyaṃ parigrahaḥ ॥22॥
html:
etacchrutvā tu vipulo viṣaṇṇavadano'bhavat ।
evaṃ tīvratapāścāhaṃ kaṣṭaścāyaṃ parigrahaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: etacCrutvA tu vipulo vizaRRavadano'Bavat । evaM tIvratapAScAhaM kazwaScAyaM parigrahaH ॥22॥

text: mithunasyāsya kiṃ me syātkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yato gatiḥ । aniṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ kīrtitānena me'dya vai ॥23॥
html:
mithunasyāsya kiṃ me syātkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yato gatiḥ ।
aniṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ kīrtitānena me'dya vai ॥23॥
slp1: miTunasyAsya kiM me syAtkftaM pApaM yato gatiH । anizwA sarvaBUtAnAM kIrtitAnena me'dya vE ॥23॥

text: evaṃ sañcintayanneva vipulo rājasattama । avāṅmukho nyastaśirā dadhyau duṣkṛtamātmanaḥ ॥24॥
html:
evaṃ sañcintayanneva vipulo rājasattama ।
avāṅmukho nyastaśirā dadhyau duṣkṛtamātmanaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: evaM saYcintayanneva vipulo rAjasattama । avANmuKo nyastaSirA daDyO duzkftamAtmanaH ॥24॥

text: tataḥ ṣaḍanyānpuruṣānakṣaiḥ kāñcanarājataiḥ । apaśyaddīvyamānānvai lobhaharṣānvitāṃstathā ॥25॥
html:
tataḥ ṣaḍanyānpuruṣānakṣaiḥ kāñcanarājataiḥ ।
apaśyaddīvyamānānvai lobhaharṣānvitāṃstathā ॥25॥
slp1: tataH zaqanyAnpuruzAnakzEH kAYcanarAjatEH । apaSyaddIvyamAnAnvE loBaharzAnvitAMstaTA ॥25॥

text: kurvataḥ śapathaṃ taṃ vai yaḥ kṛto mithunena vai । vipulaṃ vai samuddiśya te'pi vākyamathābruvan ॥26॥
html:
kurvataḥ śapathaṃ taṃ vai yaḥ kṛto mithunena vai ।
vipulaṃ vai samuddiśya te'pi vākyamathābruvan ॥26॥
slp1: kurvataH SapaTaM taM vE yaH kfto miTunena vE । vipulaM vE samuddiSya te'pi vAkyamaTAbruvan ॥26॥

text: yo lobhamāsthāyāsmākaṃ viṣamaṃ kartumutsahet । vipulasya pare loke yā gatistāmavāpnuyāt ॥27॥
html:
yo lobhamāsthāyāsmākaṃ viṣamaṃ kartumutsahet ।
vipulasya pare loke yā gatistāmavāpnuyāt ॥27॥
slp1: yo loBamAsTAyAsmAkaM vizamaM kartumutsahet । vipulasya pare loke yA gatistAmavApnuyAt ॥27॥

text: etacchrutvā tu vipulo nāpaśyaddharmasaṅkaram । janmaprabhṛti kauravya kṛtapūrvamathātmanaḥ ॥28॥
html:
etacchrutvā tu vipulo nāpaśyaddharmasaṅkaram ।
janmaprabhṛti kauravya kṛtapūrvamathātmanaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: etacCrutvA tu vipulo nApaSyadDarmasaNkaram । janmapraBfti kOravya kftapUrvamaTAtmanaH ॥28॥

text: sa pradadhyau tadā rājannagnāvagnirivāhitaḥ । dahyamānena manasā śāpaṃ śrutvā tathāvidham ॥29॥
html:
sa pradadhyau tadā rājannagnāvagnirivāhitaḥ ।
dahyamānena manasā śāpaṃ śrutvā tathāvidham ॥29॥
slp1: sa pradaDyO tadA rAjannagnAvagnirivAhitaH । dahyamAnena manasA SApaM SrutvA taTAviDam ॥29॥

text: tasya cintayatastāta bahvyo dinaniśā yayuḥ । idamāsīnmanasi ca rucyā rakṣaṇakāritam ॥30॥
html:
tasya cintayatastāta bahvyo dinaniśā yayuḥ ।
idamāsīnmanasi ca rucyā rakṣaṇakāritam ॥30॥
slp1: tasya cintayatastAta bahvyo dinaniSA yayuH । idamAsInmanasi ca rucyA rakzaRakAritam ॥30॥

text: lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣaṇenaiva vadanaṃ vadanena ca । vidhāya na mayā coktaṃ satyametadgurostadā ॥31॥
html:
lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣaṇenaiva vadanaṃ vadanena ca ।
vidhāya na mayā coktaṃ satyametadgurostadā ॥31॥
slp1: lakzaRaM lakzaRenEva vadanaM vadanena ca । viDAya na mayA coktaM satyametadgurostadA ॥31॥

text: etadātmani kauravya duṣkṛtaṃ vipulastadā । amanyata mahābhāga tathā tacca na saṃśayaḥ ॥32॥
html:
etadātmani kauravya duṣkṛtaṃ vipulastadā ।
amanyata mahābhāga tathā tacca na saṃśayaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: etadAtmani kOravya duzkftaM vipulastadA । amanyata mahABAga taTA tacca na saMSayaH ॥32॥

text: sa campāṃ nagarīmetya puṣpāṇi gurave dadau । pūjayāmāsa ca guruṃ vidhivatsa gurupriyaḥ] ॥33॥
html:
sa campāṃ nagarīmetya puṣpāṇi gurave dadau ।
pūjayāmāsa ca guruṃ vidhivatsa gurupriyaḥ] ॥33॥
slp1: sa campAM nagarImetya puzpARi gurave dadO । pUjayAmAsa ca guruM viDivatsa gurupriyaH] ॥33॥

text: tamāgatamabhiprekṣya śiṣyaṃ vākyamathābravīt । devaśarmā mahātejā yattacchṛṇu narādhipa ॥1॥
html:
tamāgatamabhiprekṣya śiṣyaṃ vākyamathābravīt ।
devaśarmā mahātejā yattacchṛṇu narādhipa ॥1॥
slp1: tamAgatamaBiprekzya SizyaM vAkyamaTAbravIt । devaSarmA mahAtejA yattacCfRu narADipa ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kiṃ te vipula dṛṣṭaṃ vai tasminnadya mahāvane । te tvā jānanti nipuṇa ātmā ca rucireva ca ॥2॥
html:
kiṃ te vipula dṛṣṭaṃ vai tasminnadya mahāvane ।
te tvā jānanti nipuṇa ātmā ca rucireva ca ॥2॥
slp1: kiM te vipula dfzwaM vE tasminnadya mahAvane । te tvA jAnanti nipuRa AtmA ca rucireva ca ॥2॥
author: devaśarmovāca ।

text: brahmarṣe mithunaṃ kiṃ tatke ca te puruṣā vibho । ye māṃ jānanti tattvena tāṃśca me vaktumarhasi ॥3॥
html:
brahmarṣe mithunaṃ kiṃ tatke ca te puruṣā vibho ।
ye māṃ jānanti tattvena tāṃśca me vaktumarhasi ॥3॥
slp1: brahmarze miTunaM kiM tatke ca te puruzA viBo । ye mAM jAnanti tattvena tAMSca me vaktumarhasi ॥3॥
author: vipula uvāca ।

text: yadvai tanmithunaṃ brahmannahorātraṃ hi viddhi tat । cakravatparivarteta tatte jānāti duṣkṛtam ॥4॥
html:
yadvai tanmithunaṃ brahmannahorātraṃ hi viddhi tat ।
cakravatparivarteta tatte jānāti duṣkṛtam ॥4॥
slp1: yadvE tanmiTunaM brahmannahorAtraM hi vidDi tat । cakravatparivarteta tatte jAnAti duzkftam ॥4॥
author: devaśarmovāca ।

text: ye ca te puruṣā vipra akṣairdīvyanti hṛṣṭavat । ṛtūṃstānabhijānīhi te te jānanti duṣkṛtam ॥5॥
html:
ye ca te puruṣā vipra akṣairdīvyanti hṛṣṭavat ।
ṛtūṃstānabhijānīhi te te jānanti duṣkṛtam ॥5॥
slp1: ye ca te puruzA vipra akzErdIvyanti hfzwavat । ftUMstAnaBijAnIhi te te jAnanti duzkftam ॥5॥

text: na māṃ kaścidvijānīta iti kṛtvā na viśvaset । naro rahasi pāpātmā pāpakaṃ karma vai dvija ॥6॥
html:
na māṃ kaścidvijānīta iti kṛtvā na viśvaset ।
naro rahasi pāpātmā pāpakaṃ karma vai dvija ॥6॥
slp1: na mAM kaScidvijAnIta iti kftvA na viSvaset । naro rahasi pApAtmA pApakaM karma vE dvija ॥6॥

text: kurvāṇaṃ hi naraṃ karma pāpaṃ rahasi sarvadā । paśyanti ṛtavaścāpi tathā dinaniśe'pyuta ॥7॥
html:
kurvāṇaṃ hi naraṃ karma pāpaṃ rahasi sarvadā ।
paśyanti ṛtavaścāpi tathā dinaniśe'pyuta ॥7॥
slp1: kurvARaM hi naraM karma pApaM rahasi sarvadA । paSyanti ftavaScApi taTA dinaniSe'pyuta ॥7॥

text: te tvāṃ harṣasmitaṃ dṛṣṭvā guroḥ karmānivedakam । smārayantastathā prāhuste yathā śrutavānbhavān ॥8॥
html:
te tvāṃ harṣasmitaṃ dṛṣṭvā guroḥ karmānivedakam ।
smārayantastathā prāhuste yathā śrutavānbhavān ॥8॥
slp1: te tvAM harzasmitaM dfzwvA guroH karmAnivedakam । smArayantastaTA prAhuste yaTA SrutavAnBavAn ॥8॥

text: ahorātraṃ vijānāti ṛtavaścāpi nityaśaḥ । puruṣe pāpakaṃ karma śubhaṃ vā śubhakarmaṇaḥ ॥9॥
html:
ahorātraṃ vijānāti ṛtavaścāpi nityaśaḥ ।
puruṣe pāpakaṃ karma śubhaṃ vā śubhakarmaṇaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: ahorAtraM vijAnAti ftavaScApi nityaSaH । puruze pApakaM karma SuBaM vA SuBakarmaRaH ॥9॥

text: tattvayā mama yatkarma vyabhicārādbhayātmakam । nākhyātamiti jānantaste tvāmāhustathā dvija ॥10॥
html:
tattvayā mama yatkarma vyabhicārādbhayātmakam ।
nākhyātamiti jānantaste tvāmāhustathā dvija ॥10॥
slp1: tattvayA mama yatkarma vyaBicArAdBayAtmakam । nAKyAtamiti jAnantaste tvAmAhustaTA dvija ॥10॥

text: te caiva hi bhaveyuste lokāḥ pāpakṛto yathā । kṛtvā nācakṣataḥ karma mama yacca tvayā kṛtam ॥11॥
html:
te caiva hi bhaveyuste lokāḥ pāpakṛto yathā ।
kṛtvā nācakṣataḥ karma mama yacca tvayā kṛtam ॥11॥
slp1: te cEva hi Baveyuste lokAH pApakfto yaTA । kftvA nAcakzataH karma mama yacca tvayA kftam ॥11॥

text: tathā śakyā ca durvṛttā rakṣituṃ pramadā dvija । na ca tvaṃ kṛtavānkiñcidāgaḥ prīto'smi tena te ॥12॥
html:
tathā śakyā ca durvṛttā rakṣituṃ pramadā dvija ।
na ca tvaṃ kṛtavānkiñcidāgaḥ prīto'smi tena te ॥12॥
slp1: taTA SakyA ca durvfttA rakzituM pramadA dvija । na ca tvaM kftavAnkiYcidAgaH prIto'smi tena te ॥12॥

text: yadi tvahaṃ tvā durvṛttamadrākṣaṃ dvijasattama । śapeyaṃ tvāmahaṃ krodhānna me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥13॥
html:
yadi tvahaṃ tvā durvṛttamadrākṣaṃ dvijasattama ।
śapeyaṃ tvāmahaṃ krodhānna me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥13॥
slp1: yadi tvahaM tvA durvfttamadrAkzaM dvijasattama । SapeyaM tvAmahaM kroDAnna me'trAsti vicAraRA ॥13॥

text: sajjanti puruṣe nāryaḥ puṃsāṃ so'rthaśca puṣkalaḥ । anyathā rakṣataḥ śāpo'bhaviṣyatte gatiśca sā ॥14॥
html:
sajjanti puruṣe nāryaḥ puṃsāṃ so'rthaśca puṣkalaḥ ।
anyathā rakṣataḥ śāpo'bhaviṣyatte gatiśca sā ॥14॥
slp1: sajjanti puruze nAryaH puMsAM so'rTaSca puzkalaH । anyaTA rakzataH SApo'Bavizyatte gatiSca sA ॥14॥

text: rakṣitā sā tvayā putra mama cāpi niveditā । ahaṃ te prītimāṃstāta svasti svargaṃ gamiṣyasi ॥15॥
html:
rakṣitā sā tvayā putra mama cāpi niveditā ।
ahaṃ te prītimāṃstāta svasti svargaṃ gamiṣyasi ॥15॥
slp1: rakzitA sA tvayA putra mama cApi niveditA । ahaM te prItimAMstAta svasti svargaM gamizyasi ॥15॥

text: ityuktvā vipulaṃ prīto devaśarmā mahānṛṣiḥ । mumoda svargamāsthāya sahabhāryaḥ saśiṣyakaḥ ॥16॥
html:
ityuktvā vipulaṃ prīto devaśarmā mahānṛṣiḥ ।
mumoda svargamāsthāya sahabhāryaḥ saśiṣyakaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: ityuktvA vipulaM prIto devaSarmA mahAnfziH । mumoda svargamAsTAya sahaBAryaH saSizyakaH ॥16॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: idamākhyātavāṃścāpi mamākhyānaṃ mahāmuniḥ । mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purā rājangaṅgākūle kathāntare ॥17॥
html:
idamākhyātavāṃścāpi mamākhyānaṃ mahāmuniḥ ।
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purā rājangaṅgākūle kathāntare ॥17॥
slp1: idamAKyAtavAMScApi mamAKyAnaM mahAmuniH । mArkaRqeyaH purA rAjangaNgAkUle kaTAntare ॥17॥

text: tasmādbravīmi pārtha tvā striyaḥ sarvāḥ sadaiva ca । ubhayaṃ dṛśyate tāsu satataṃ sādhvasādhu ca ॥18॥
html:
tasmādbravīmi pārtha tvā striyaḥ sarvāḥ sadaiva ca ।
ubhayaṃ dṛśyate tāsu satataṃ sādhvasādhu ca ॥18॥
slp1: tasmAdbravImi pArTa tvA striyaH sarvAH sadEva ca । uBayaM dfSyate tAsu satataM sADvasADu ca ॥18॥

text: striyaḥ sādhvyo mahābhāgāḥ sammatā lokamātaraḥ । dhārayanti mahīṃ rājannimāṃ savanakānanām ॥19॥
html:
striyaḥ sādhvyo mahābhāgāḥ sammatā lokamātaraḥ ।
dhārayanti mahīṃ rājannimāṃ savanakānanām ॥19॥
slp1: striyaH sADvyo mahABAgAH sammatA lokamAtaraH । DArayanti mahIM rAjannimAM savanakAnanAm ॥19॥

text: asādhvyaścāpi durvṛttāḥ kulaghnyaḥ pāpaniścayāḥ । vijñeyā lakṣaṇairduṣṭaiḥ svagātrasahajairnṛpa ॥20॥
html:
asādhvyaścāpi durvṛttāḥ kulaghnyaḥ pāpaniścayāḥ ।
vijñeyā lakṣaṇairduṣṭaiḥ svagātrasahajairnṛpa ॥20॥
slp1: asADvyaScApi durvfttAH kulaGnyaH pApaniScayAH । vijYeyA lakzaRErduzwEH svagAtrasahajErnfpa ॥20॥

text: evametāsu rakṣā vai śakyā kartuṃ mahātmabhiḥ । anyathā rājaśārdūla na śakyā rakṣituṃ striyaḥ ॥21॥
html:
evametāsu rakṣā vai śakyā kartuṃ mahātmabhiḥ ।
anyathā rājaśārdūla na śakyā rakṣituṃ striyaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: evametAsu rakzA vE SakyA kartuM mahAtmaBiH । anyaTA rAjaSArdUla na SakyA rakzituM striyaH ॥21॥

text: etā hi manujavyāghra tīkṣṇāstīkṣṇaparākramāḥ । nāsāmasti priyo nāma maithune saṅgame nṛbhiḥ ॥22॥
html:
etā hi manujavyāghra tīkṣṇāstīkṣṇaparākramāḥ ।
nāsāmasti priyo nāma maithune saṅgame nṛbhiḥ ॥22॥
slp1: etA hi manujavyAGra tIkzRAstIkzRaparAkramAH । nAsAmasti priyo nAma mETune saNgame nfBiH ॥22॥

text: etāḥ kṛtyāśca kāryāśca kṛtāśca bharatarṣabha । na caikasminramantyetāḥ puruṣe pāṇḍunandana ॥23॥
html:
etāḥ kṛtyāśca kāryāśca kṛtāśca bharatarṣabha ।
na caikasminramantyetāḥ puruṣe pāṇḍunandana ॥23॥
slp1: etAH kftyASca kAryASca kftASca BaratarzaBa । na cEkasminramantyetAH puruze pARqunandana ॥23॥

text: nāsu sneho nṛbhiḥ kāryastathaiverṣyā janeśvara । khedamāsthāya bhuñjīta dharmamāsthāya caiva hi ॥24॥
html:
nāsu sneho nṛbhiḥ kāryastathaiverṣyā janeśvara ।
khedamāsthāya bhuñjīta dharmamāsthāya caiva hi ॥24॥
slp1: nAsu sneho nfBiH kAryastaTEverzyA janeSvara । KedamAsTAya BuYjIta DarmamAsTAya cEva hi ॥24॥

text: vihanyetānyathā kurvannaraḥ kauravanandana । sarvathā rājaśārdūla yuktiḥ sarvatra pūjyate ॥25॥
html:
vihanyetānyathā kurvannaraḥ kauravanandana ।
sarvathā rājaśārdūla yuktiḥ sarvatra pūjyate ॥25॥
slp1: vihanyetAnyaTA kurvannaraH kOravanandana । sarvaTA rAjaSArdUla yuktiH sarvatra pUjyate ॥25॥

text: tenaikena tu rakṣā vai vipulena kṛtā striyāḥ । nānyaḥ śakto nṛloke'sminrakṣituṃ nṛpa yoṣitaḥ] ॥26॥
html:
tenaikena tu rakṣā vai vipulena kṛtā striyāḥ ।
nānyaḥ śakto nṛloke'sminrakṣituṃ nṛpa yoṣitaḥ] ॥26॥
slp1: tenEkena tu rakzA vE vipulena kftA striyAH । nAnyaH Sakto nfloke'sminrakzituM nfpa yozitaH] ॥26॥

text: yanmūlaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ prajanasya gṛhasya ca । pitṛdevātithīnāṃ ca tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
yanmūlaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ prajanasya gṛhasya ca ।
pitṛdevātithīnāṃ ca tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: yanmUlaM sarvaDarmARAM prajanasya gfhasya ca । pitfdevAtiTInAM ca tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ayaṃ hi sarvadharmāṇāṃ dharmaścintyatamo mataḥ । kīdṛśāya pradeyā syātkanyeti vasudhādhipa ॥2॥
html:
ayaṃ hi sarvadharmāṇāṃ dharmaścintyatamo mataḥ ।
kīdṛśāya pradeyā syātkanyeti vasudhādhipa ॥2॥
slp1: ayaM hi sarvaDarmARAM DarmaScintyatamo mataH । kIdfSAya pradeyA syAtkanyeti vasuDADipa ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śīlavṛtte samājñāya vidyāṃ yoniṃ ca karma ca । adbhireva pradātavyā kanyā guṇavate vare । brāhmaṇānāṃ satāmeṣa dharmo nityaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
html:
śīlavṛtte samājñāya vidyāṃ yoniṃ ca karma ca ।
adbhireva pradātavyā kanyā guṇavate vare ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ satāmeṣa dharmo nityaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
slp1: SIlavftte samAjYAya vidyAM yoniM ca karma ca । adBireva pradAtavyA kanyA guRavate vare । brAhmaRAnAM satAmeza Darmo nityaM yuDizWira ॥3॥

text: āvāhyamāvahedevaṃ yo dadyādanukūlataḥ । śiṣṭānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ॥4॥
html:
āvāhyamāvahedevaṃ yo dadyādanukūlataḥ ।
śiṣṭānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: AvAhyamAvahedevaM yo dadyAdanukUlataH । SizwAnAM kzatriyARAM ca Darma eza sanAtanaH ॥4॥

text: ātmābhipretamutsṛjya kanyābhipreta eva yaḥ । abhipretā ca yā yasya tasmai deyā yudhiṣṭhira । gāndharvamiti taṃ dharmaṃ prāhurdharmavido janāḥ ॥5॥
html:
ātmābhipretamutsṛjya kanyābhipreta eva yaḥ ।
abhipretā ca yā yasya tasmai deyā yudhiṣṭhira ।
gāndharvamiti taṃ dharmaṃ prāhurdharmavido janāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: AtmABipretamutsfjya kanyABipreta eva yaH । aBipretA ca yA yasya tasmE deyA yuDizWira । gAnDarvamiti taM DarmaM prAhurDarmavido janAH ॥5॥

text: dhanena bahunā krītvā sampralobhya ca bāndhavān । asurāṇāṃ nṛpaitaṃ vai dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥6॥
html:
dhanena bahunā krītvā sampralobhya ca bāndhavān ।
asurāṇāṃ nṛpaitaṃ vai dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: Danena bahunA krItvA sampraloBya ca bAnDavAn । asurARAM nfpEtaM vE DarmamAhurmanIziRaH ॥6॥

text: hatvā chittvā ca śīrṣāṇi rudatāṃ rudatīṃ gṛhāt । prasahya haraṇaṃ tāta rākṣasaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam ॥7॥
html:
hatvā chittvā ca śīrṣāṇi rudatāṃ rudatīṃ gṛhāt ।
prasahya haraṇaṃ tāta rākṣasaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam ॥7॥
slp1: hatvA CittvA ca SIrzARi rudatAM rudatIM gfhAt । prasahya haraRaM tAta rAkzasaM DarmalakzaRam ॥7॥

text: pañcānāṃ tu trayo dharmyā dvāvadharmyau yudhiṣṭhira । paiśāca āsuraścaiva na kartavyau kathañcana ॥8॥
html:
pañcānāṃ tu trayo dharmyā dvāvadharmyau yudhiṣṭhira ।
paiśāca āsuraścaiva na kartavyau kathañcana ॥8॥
slp1: paYcAnAM tu trayo DarmyA dvAvaDarmyO yuDizWira । pESAca AsuraScEva na kartavyO kaTaYcana ॥8॥

text: brāhmaḥ kṣātro'tha gāndharva ete dharmyā nararṣabha । pṛthagvā yadi vā miśrāḥ kartavyā nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥9॥
html:
brāhmaḥ kṣātro'tha gāndharva ete dharmyā nararṣabha ।
pṛthagvā yadi vā miśrāḥ kartavyā nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: brAhmaH kzAtro'Ta gAnDarva ete DarmyA nararzaBa । pfTagvA yadi vA miSrAH kartavyA nAtra saMSayaH ॥9॥

text: tisro bhāryā brāhmaṇasya dve bhārye kṣatriyasya tu । vaiśyaḥ svajātiṃ vindeta tāsvapatyaṃ samaṃ bhavet ॥10॥
html:
tisro bhāryā brāhmaṇasya dve bhārye kṣatriyasya tu ।
vaiśyaḥ svajātiṃ vindeta tāsvapatyaṃ samaṃ bhavet ॥10॥
slp1: tisro BAryA brAhmaRasya dve BArye kzatriyasya tu । vESyaH svajAtiM vindeta tAsvapatyaM samaM Bavet ॥10॥

text: brāhmaṇī tu bhavejjyeṣṭhā kṣatriyā kṣatriyasya tu । ratyarthamapi śūdrā syānnetyāhurapare janāḥ ॥11॥
html:
brāhmaṇī tu bhavejjyeṣṭhā kṣatriyā kṣatriyasya tu ।
ratyarthamapi śūdrā syānnetyāhurapare janāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: brAhmaRI tu BavejjyezWA kzatriyA kzatriyasya tu । ratyarTamapi SUdrA syAnnetyAhurapare janAH ॥11॥

text: apatyajanma śūdrāyāṃ na praśaṃsanti sādhavaḥ । śūdrāyāṃ janayanvipraḥ prāyaścittī vidhīyate ॥12॥
html:
apatyajanma śūdrāyāṃ na praśaṃsanti sādhavaḥ ।
śūdrāyāṃ janayanvipraḥ prāyaścittī vidhīyate ॥12॥
slp1: apatyajanma SUdrAyAM na praSaMsanti sADavaH । SUdrAyAM janayanvipraH prAyaScittI viDIyate ॥12॥

text: triṃśadvarṣo daśavarṣāṃ bhāryāṃ vindeta nagnikām । ekaviṃśativarṣo vā saptavarṣāmavāpnuyāt ॥13॥
html:
triṃśadvarṣo daśavarṣāṃ bhāryāṃ vindeta nagnikām ।
ekaviṃśativarṣo vā saptavarṣāmavāpnuyāt ॥13॥
slp1: triMSadvarzo daSavarzAM BAryAM vindeta nagnikAm । ekaviMSativarzo vA saptavarzAmavApnuyAt ॥13॥

text: yasyāstu na bhavedbhrātā pitā vā bharatarṣabha । nopayaccheta tāṃ jātu putrikādharmiṇī hi sā ॥14॥
html:
yasyāstu na bhavedbhrātā pitā vā bharatarṣabha ।
nopayaccheta tāṃ jātu putrikādharmiṇī hi sā ॥14॥
slp1: yasyAstu na BavedBrAtA pitA vA BaratarzaBa । nopayacCeta tAM jAtu putrikADarmiRI hi sA ॥14॥

text: trīṇi varṣāṇyudīkṣeta kanyā ṛtumatī satī । caturthe tvatha samprāpte svayaṃ bhartāramarjayet ॥15॥
html:
trīṇi varṣāṇyudīkṣeta kanyā ṛtumatī satī ।
caturthe tvatha samprāpte svayaṃ bhartāramarjayet ॥15॥
slp1: trIRi varzARyudIkzeta kanyA ftumatI satI । caturTe tvaTa samprApte svayaM BartAramarjayet ॥15॥

text: prajano hīyate tasyā ratiśca bharatarṣabha । ato'nyathā vartamānā bhavedvācyā prajāpateḥ ॥16॥
html:
prajano hīyate tasyā ratiśca bharatarṣabha ।
ato'nyathā vartamānā bhavedvācyā prajāpateḥ ॥16॥
slp1: prajano hIyate tasyA ratiSca BaratarzaBa । ato'nyaTA vartamAnA BavedvAcyA prajApateH ॥16॥

text: asapiṇḍā ca yā māturasagotrā ca yā pituḥ । ityetāmanugaccheta taṃ dharmaṃ manurabravīt ॥17॥
html:
asapiṇḍā ca yā māturasagotrā ca yā pituḥ ।
ityetāmanugaccheta taṃ dharmaṃ manurabravīt ॥17॥
slp1: asapiRqA ca yA mAturasagotrA ca yA pituH । ityetAmanugacCeta taM DarmaM manurabravIt ॥17॥

text: śulkamanyena dattaṃ syāddadānītyāha cāparaḥ । balādanyaḥ prabhāṣeta dhanamanyaḥ pradarśayet ॥18॥
html:
śulkamanyena dattaṃ syāddadānītyāha cāparaḥ ।
balādanyaḥ prabhāṣeta dhanamanyaḥ pradarśayet ॥18॥
slp1: Sulkamanyena dattaM syAddadAnItyAha cAparaH । balAdanyaH praBAzeta DanamanyaH pradarSayet ॥18॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: pāṇigrahītā tvanyaḥ syātkasya kanyā pitāmaha । tattvaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ cakṣurbhavatu no bhavān ॥19॥
html:
pāṇigrahītā tvanyaḥ syātkasya kanyā pitāmaha ।
tattvaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ cakṣurbhavatu no bhavān ॥19॥
slp1: pARigrahItA tvanyaH syAtkasya kanyA pitAmaha । tattvaM jijYAsamAnAnAM cakzurBavatu no BavAn ॥19॥

text: yatkiñcitkarma mānuṣyaṃ saṃsthānāya prakṛṣyate । mantravanmantritaṃ tasya mṛṣāvādastu pātakaḥ ॥20॥
html:
yatkiñcitkarma mānuṣyaṃ saṃsthānāya prakṛṣyate ।
mantravanmantritaṃ tasya mṛṣāvādastu pātakaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: yatkiYcitkarma mAnuzyaM saMsTAnAya prakfzyate । mantravanmantritaM tasya mfzAvAdastu pAtakaH ॥20॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhāryāpatyṛtvigācāryāḥ śiṣyopādhyāya eva ca । mṛṣokte daṇḍamarhanti netyāhurapare janāḥ ॥21॥
html:
bhāryāpatyṛtvigācāryāḥ śiṣyopādhyāya eva ca ।
mṛṣokte daṇḍamarhanti netyāhurapare janāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: BAryApatyftvigAcAryAH SizyopADyAya eva ca । mfzokte daRqamarhanti netyAhurapare janAH ॥21॥

text: na hyakāmena saṃvādaṃ manurevaṃ praśaṃsati । ayaśasyamadharmyaṃ ca yanmṛṣā dharmakopanam ॥22॥
html:
na hyakāmena saṃvādaṃ manurevaṃ praśaṃsati ।
ayaśasyamadharmyaṃ ca yanmṛṣā dharmakopanam ॥22॥
slp1: na hyakAmena saMvAdaM manurevaM praSaMsati । ayaSasyamaDarmyaM ca yanmfzA Darmakopanam ॥22॥

text: naikāntadoṣa ekasmiṃstaddānaṃ nopalabhyate । dharmato yāṃ prayacchanti yāṃ ca krīṇanti bhārata ॥23॥
html:
naikāntadoṣa ekasmiṃstaddānaṃ nopalabhyate ।
dharmato yāṃ prayacchanti yāṃ ca krīṇanti bhārata ॥23॥
slp1: nEkAntadoza ekasmiMstaddAnaM nopalaByate । Darmato yAM prayacCanti yAM ca krIRanti BArata ॥23॥

text: bandhubhiḥ samanujñāto mantrahomau prayojayet । tathā sidhyanti te mantrā nādattāyāḥ kathañcana ॥24॥
html:
bandhubhiḥ samanujñāto mantrahomau prayojayet ।
tathā sidhyanti te mantrā nādattāyāḥ kathañcana ॥24॥
slp1: banDuBiH samanujYAto mantrahomO prayojayet । taTA siDyanti te mantrA nAdattAyAH kaTaYcana ॥24॥

text: yastvatra mantrasamayo bhāryāpatyormithaḥ kṛtaḥ । tamevāhurgarīyāṃsaṃ yaścāsau jñātibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ॥25॥
html:
yastvatra mantrasamayo bhāryāpatyormithaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
tamevāhurgarīyāṃsaṃ yaścāsau jñātibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: yastvatra mantrasamayo BAryApatyormiTaH kftaH । tamevAhurgarIyAMsaM yaScAsO jYAtiBiH kftaH ॥25॥

text: devadattāṃ patirbhāryāṃ vetti dharmasya śāsanāt । sā daivīṃ mānuṣīṃ vācamanṛtāṃ paryudasyati ॥26॥
html:
devadattāṃ patirbhāryāṃ vetti dharmasya śāsanāt ।
sā daivīṃ mānuṣīṃ vācamanṛtāṃ paryudasyati ॥26॥
slp1: devadattAM patirBAryAM vetti Darmasya SAsanAt । sA dEvIM mAnuzIM vAcamanftAM paryudasyati ॥26॥

text: kanyāyāṃ prāptaśulkāyāṃ jyāyāṃścedāvrajedvaraḥ । dharmakāmārthasampanno vācyamatrānṛtaṃ na vā ॥27॥
html:
kanyāyāṃ prāptaśulkāyāṃ jyāyāṃścedāvrajedvaraḥ ।
dharmakāmārthasampanno vācyamatrānṛtaṃ na vā ॥27॥
slp1: kanyAyAM prAptaSulkAyAM jyAyAMScedAvrajedvaraH । DarmakAmArTasampanno vAcyamatrAnftaM na vA ॥27॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: tasminnubhayato doṣe kurvañchreyaḥ samācaret । ayaṃ naḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ dharmaścintyatamo mataḥ ॥28॥
html:
tasminnubhayato doṣe kurvañchreyaḥ samācaret ।
ayaṃ naḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ dharmaścintyatamo mataḥ ॥28॥
slp1: tasminnuBayato doze kurvaYCreyaH samAcaret । ayaM naH sarvaDarmARAM DarmaScintyatamo mataH ॥28॥

text: tattvaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ cakṣurbhavatu no bhavān । tadetatsarvamācakṣva na hi tṛpyāmi kathyatām ॥29॥
html:
tattvaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ cakṣurbhavatu no bhavān ।
tadetatsarvamācakṣva na hi tṛpyāmi kathyatām ॥29॥
slp1: tattvaM jijYAsamAnAnAM cakzurBavatu no BavAn । tadetatsarvamAcakzva na hi tfpyAmi kaTyatAm ॥29॥

text: na vai niṣṭhākaraṃ śulkaṃ jñātvāsīttena nāhṛtam । na hi śulkaparāḥ santaḥ kanyāṃ dadati karhicit ॥30॥
html:
na vai niṣṭhākaraṃ śulkaṃ jñātvāsīttena nāhṛtam ।
na hi śulkaparāḥ santaḥ kanyāṃ dadati karhicit ॥30॥
slp1: na vE nizWAkaraM SulkaM jYAtvAsIttena nAhftam । na hi SulkaparAH santaH kanyAM dadati karhicit ॥30॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: anyairguṇairupetaṃ tu śulkaṃ yācanti bāndhavāḥ । alaṅkṛtvā vahasveti yo dadyādanukūlataḥ ॥31॥
html:
anyairguṇairupetaṃ tu śulkaṃ yācanti bāndhavāḥ ।
alaṅkṛtvā vahasveti yo dadyādanukūlataḥ ॥31॥
slp1: anyErguRErupetaM tu SulkaM yAcanti bAnDavAH । alaNkftvA vahasveti yo dadyAdanukUlataH ॥31॥

text: tacca tāṃ ca dadātyeva na śulkaṃ vikrayo na saḥ । pratigṛhya bhaveddeyameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥32॥
html:
tacca tāṃ ca dadātyeva na śulkaṃ vikrayo na saḥ ।
pratigṛhya bhaveddeyameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: tacca tAM ca dadAtyeva na SulkaM vikrayo na saH । pratigfhya Baveddeyameza DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥32॥

text: dāsyāmi bhavate kanyāmiti pūrvaṃ nabhāṣitam । ye caivāhurye ca nāhurye cāvaśyaṃ vadantyuta ॥33॥
html:
dāsyāmi bhavate kanyāmiti pūrvaṃ nabhāṣitam ।
ye caivāhurye ca nāhurye cāvaśyaṃ vadantyuta ॥33॥
slp1: dAsyAmi Bavate kanyAmiti pUrvaM naBAzitam । ye cEvAhurye ca nAhurye cAvaSyaM vadantyuta ॥33॥

text: tasmādā grahaṇātpāṇeryācayanti parasparam । kanyāvaraḥ purā datto marudbhiriti naḥ śrutam ॥34॥
html:
tasmādā grahaṇātpāṇeryācayanti parasparam ।
kanyāvaraḥ purā datto marudbhiriti naḥ śrutam ॥34॥
slp1: tasmAdA grahaRAtpAReryAcayanti parasparam । kanyAvaraH purA datto marudBiriti naH Srutam ॥34॥

text: nāniṣṭāya pradātavyā kanyā ityṛṣicoditam । tanmūlaṃ kāmamūlasya prajanasyeti me matiḥ ॥35॥
html:
nāniṣṭāya pradātavyā kanyā ityṛṣicoditam ।
tanmūlaṃ kāmamūlasya prajanasyeti me matiḥ ॥35॥
slp1: nAnizwAya pradAtavyA kanyA ityfzicoditam । tanmUlaM kAmamUlasya prajanasyeti me matiH ॥35॥

text: samīkṣya ca bahūndoṣānsaṃvāsādvidviṣāṇayoḥ । yathā niṣṭhākaraṃ śulkaṃ na jātvāsīttathā śṛṇu ॥36॥
html:
samīkṣya ca bahūndoṣānsaṃvāsādvidviṣāṇayoḥ ।
yathā niṣṭhākaraṃ śulkaṃ na jātvāsīttathā śṛṇu ॥36॥
slp1: samIkzya ca bahUndozAnsaMvAsAdvidvizARayoH । yaTA nizWAkaraM SulkaM na jAtvAsIttaTA SfRu ॥36॥

text: ahaṃ vicitravīryāya dve kanye samudāvaham । jitvā ca māgadhānsarvānkāśīnatha ca kosalān । gṛhītapāṇirekāsītprāptaśulkāparābhavat ॥37॥
html:
ahaṃ vicitravīryāya dve kanye samudāvaham ।
jitvā ca māgadhānsarvānkāśīnatha ca kosalān ।
gṛhītapāṇirekāsītprāptaśulkāparābhavat ॥37॥
slp1: ahaM vicitravIryAya dve kanye samudAvaham । jitvA ca mAgaDAnsarvAnkASInaTa ca kosalAn । gfhItapARirekAsItprAptaSulkAparABavat ॥37॥

text: pāṇau gṛhītā tatraiva visṛjyā iti me pitā । abravīditarāṃ kanyāmāvahatsa tu kauravaḥ ॥38॥
html:
pāṇau gṛhītā tatraiva visṛjyā iti me pitā ।
abravīditarāṃ kanyāmāvahatsa tu kauravaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: pARO gfhItA tatrEva visfjyA iti me pitA । abravIditarAM kanyAmAvahatsa tu kOravaH ॥38॥

text: apyanyāmanupapraccha śaṅkamānaḥ piturvacaḥ । atīva hyasya dharmepsā piturme'bhyadhikābhavat ॥39॥
html:
apyanyāmanupapraccha śaṅkamānaḥ piturvacaḥ ।
atīva hyasya dharmepsā piturme'bhyadhikābhavat ॥39॥
slp1: apyanyAmanupapracCa SaNkamAnaH piturvacaH । atIva hyasya DarmepsA piturme'ByaDikABavat ॥39॥

text: tato'hamabruvaṃ rājannācārepsuridaṃ vacaḥ । ācāraṃ tattvato vettumicchāmīti punaḥ punaḥ ॥40॥
html:
tato'hamabruvaṃ rājannācārepsuridaṃ vacaḥ ।
ācāraṃ tattvato vettumicchāmīti punaḥ punaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: tato'hamabruvaM rAjannAcArepsuridaM vacaH । AcAraM tattvato vettumicCAmIti punaH punaH ॥40॥

text: tato mayaivamukte tu vākye dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ । pitā mama mahārāja bāhlīko vākyamabravīt ॥41॥
html:
tato mayaivamukte tu vākye dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ।
pitā mama mahārāja bāhlīko vākyamabravīt ॥41॥
slp1: tato mayEvamukte tu vAkye DarmaBftAM varaH । pitA mama mahArAja bAhlIko vAkyamabravIt ॥41॥

text: yadi vaḥ śulkato niṣṭhā na pāṇigrahaṇaṃ tathā । lājāntaramupāsīta prāptaśulkā patiṃ vṛtam ॥42॥
html:
yadi vaḥ śulkato niṣṭhā na pāṇigrahaṇaṃ tathā ।
lājāntaramupāsīta prāptaśulkā patiṃ vṛtam ॥42॥
slp1: yadi vaH Sulkato nizWA na pARigrahaRaM taTA । lAjAntaramupAsIta prAptaSulkA patiM vftam ॥42॥

text: na hi dharmavidaḥ prāhuḥ pramāṇaṃ vākyataḥ smṛtam । yeṣāṃ vai śulkato niṣṭhā na pāṇigrahaṇāttathā ॥43॥
html:
na hi dharmavidaḥ prāhuḥ pramāṇaṃ vākyataḥ smṛtam ।
yeṣāṃ vai śulkato niṣṭhā na pāṇigrahaṇāttathā ॥43॥
slp1: na hi DarmavidaH prAhuH pramARaM vAkyataH smftam । yezAM vE Sulkato nizWA na pARigrahaRAttaTA ॥43॥

text: prasiddhaṃ bhāṣitaṃ dāne teṣāṃ pratyasanaṃ punaḥ । ye manyante krayaṃ śulkaṃ na te dharmavido janāḥ ॥44॥
html:
prasiddhaṃ bhāṣitaṃ dāne teṣāṃ pratyasanaṃ punaḥ ।
ye manyante krayaṃ śulkaṃ na te dharmavido janāḥ ॥44॥
slp1: prasidDaM BAzitaM dAne tezAM pratyasanaM punaH । ye manyante krayaM SulkaM na te Darmavido janAH ॥44॥

text: na caitebhyaḥ pradātavyā na voḍhavyā tathāvidhā । na hyeva bhāryā kretavyā na vikreyā kathañcana ॥45॥
html:
na caitebhyaḥ pradātavyā na voḍhavyā tathāvidhā ।
na hyeva bhāryā kretavyā na vikreyā kathañcana ॥45॥
slp1: na cEteByaH pradAtavyA na voQavyA taTAviDA । na hyeva BAryA kretavyA na vikreyA kaTaYcana ॥45॥

text: ye ca krīṇanti dāsīvadye ca vikrīṇate janāḥ । bhavetteṣāṃ tathā niṣṭhā lubdhānāṃ pāpacetasām ॥46॥
html:
ye ca krīṇanti dāsīvadye ca vikrīṇate janāḥ ।
bhavetteṣāṃ tathā niṣṭhā lubdhānāṃ pāpacetasām ॥46॥
slp1: ye ca krIRanti dAsIvadye ca vikrIRate janAH । BavettezAM taTA nizWA lubDAnAM pApacetasAm ॥46॥

text: asmindharme satyavantaṃ paryapṛcchanta vai janāḥ । kanyāyāḥ prāptaśulkāyāḥ śulkadaḥ praśamaṃ gataḥ ॥47॥
html:
asmindharme satyavantaṃ paryapṛcchanta vai janāḥ ।
kanyāyāḥ prāptaśulkāyāḥ śulkadaḥ praśamaṃ gataḥ ॥47॥
slp1: asminDarme satyavantaM paryapfcCanta vE janAH । kanyAyAH prAptaSulkAyAH SulkadaH praSamaM gataH ॥47॥

text: pāṇigrahītā cānyaḥ syādatra no dharmasaṃśayaḥ । tannaśchindhi mahāprājña tvaṃ hi vai prājñasammataḥ । tattvaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ cakṣurbhavatu no bhavān ॥48॥
html:
pāṇigrahītā cānyaḥ syādatra no dharmasaṃśayaḥ ।
tannaśchindhi mahāprājña tvaṃ hi vai prājñasammataḥ ।
tattvaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ cakṣurbhavatu no bhavān ॥48॥
slp1: pARigrahItA cAnyaH syAdatra no DarmasaMSayaH । tannaSCinDi mahAprAjYa tvaM hi vE prAjYasammataH । tattvaM jijYAsamAnAnAM cakzurBavatu no BavAn ॥48॥

text: tānevaṃ bruvataḥ sarvānsatyavānvākyamabravīt । yatreṣṭaṃ tatra deyā syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā । kurvate jīvato'pyevaṃ mṛte naivāsti saṃśayaḥ ॥49॥
html:
tānevaṃ bruvataḥ sarvānsatyavānvākyamabravīt ।
yatreṣṭaṃ tatra deyā syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।
kurvate jīvato'pyevaṃ mṛte naivāsti saṃśayaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: tAnevaM bruvataH sarvAnsatyavAnvAkyamabravIt । yatrezwaM tatra deyA syAnnAtra kAryA vicAraRA । kurvate jIvato'pyevaM mfte nEvAsti saMSayaH ॥49॥

text: devaraṃ praviśetkanyā tapyedvāpi mahattapaḥ । tamevānuvratā bhūtvā pāṇigrāhasya nāma sā ॥50॥
html:
devaraṃ praviśetkanyā tapyedvāpi mahattapaḥ ।
tamevānuvratā bhūtvā pāṇigrāhasya nāma sā ॥50॥
slp1: devaraM praviSetkanyA tapyedvApi mahattapaH । tamevAnuvratA BUtvA pARigrAhasya nAma sA ॥50॥

text: likhantyeva tu keṣāñcidapareṣāṃ śanairapi । iti ye saṃvadantyatra ta etaṃ niścayaṃ viduḥ ॥51॥
html:
likhantyeva tu keṣāñcidapareṣāṃ śanairapi ।
iti ye saṃvadantyatra ta etaṃ niścayaṃ viduḥ ॥51॥
