slp1: liKantyeva tu kezAYcidaparezAM SanErapi । iti ye saMvadantyatra ta etaM niScayaM viduH ॥51॥

text: tatpāṇigrahaṇātpūrvamuttaraṃ yatra vartate । sarvamaṅgalamantraṃ vai mṛṣāvādastu pātakaḥ ॥52॥
html:
tatpāṇigrahaṇātpūrvamuttaraṃ yatra vartate ।
sarvamaṅgalamantraṃ vai mṛṣāvādastu pātakaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: tatpARigrahaRAtpUrvamuttaraM yatra vartate । sarvamaNgalamantraM vE mfzAvAdastu pAtakaH ॥52॥

text: pāṇigrahaṇamantrāṇāṃ niṣṭhā syātsaptame pade । pāṇigrāhasya bhāryā syādyasya cādbhiḥ pradīyate ॥53॥
html:
pāṇigrahaṇamantrāṇāṃ niṣṭhā syātsaptame pade ।
pāṇigrāhasya bhāryā syādyasya cādbhiḥ pradīyate ॥53॥
slp1: pARigrahaRamantrARAM nizWA syAtsaptame pade । pARigrAhasya BAryA syAdyasya cAdBiH pradIyate ॥53॥

text: anukūlāmanuvaṃśāṃ bhrātrā dattāmupāgnikām । parikramya yathānyāyaṃ bhāryāṃ vindeddvijottamaḥ] ॥54॥
html:
anukūlāmanuvaṃśāṃ bhrātrā dattāmupāgnikām ।
parikramya yathānyāyaṃ bhāryāṃ vindeddvijottamaḥ] ॥54॥
slp1: anukUlAmanuvaMSAM BrAtrA dattAmupAgnikAm । parikramya yaTAnyAyaM BAryAM vindeddvijottamaH] ॥54॥

text: kanyāyāḥ prāptaśulkāyāḥ patiścennāsti kaścana । tatra kā pratipattiḥ syāttanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
kanyāyāḥ prāptaśulkāyāḥ patiścennāsti kaścana ।
tatra kā pratipattiḥ syāttanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: kanyAyAH prAptaSulkAyAH patiScennAsti kaScana । tatra kA pratipattiH syAttanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yāputrakasyāpyarikthasya pratipatsā tadā bhavet ॥2॥
html: yāputrakasyāpyarikthasya pratipatsā tadā bhavet ॥2॥
slp1: yAputrakasyApyarikTasya pratipatsA tadA Bavet ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atha cetsāharecchulkaṃ krītā śulkapradasya sā । tasyārthe'patyamīheta yena nyāyena śaknuyāt ॥3॥
html:
atha cetsāharecchulkaṃ krītā śulkapradasya sā ।
tasyārthe'patyamīheta yena nyāyena śaknuyāt ॥3॥
slp1: aTa cetsAharecCulkaM krItA Sulkapradasya sA । tasyArTe'patyamIheta yena nyAyena SaknuyAt ॥3॥

text: na tasyā mantravatkāryaṃ kaścitkurvīta kiñcana ॥4॥
html: na tasyā mantravatkāryaṃ kaścitkurvīta kiñcana ॥4॥
slp1: na tasyA mantravatkAryaM kaScitkurvIta kiYcana ॥4॥

text: svayaṃ vṛteti sāvitrī pitrā vai pratyapadyata । tattasyānye praśaṃsanti dharmajñā netare janāḥ ॥5॥
html:
svayaṃ vṛteti sāvitrī pitrā vai pratyapadyata ।
tattasyānye praśaṃsanti dharmajñā netare janāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: svayaM vfteti sAvitrI pitrA vE pratyapadyata । tattasyAnye praSaMsanti DarmajYA netare janAH ॥5॥

text: etattu nāpare cakrurna pare jātu sādhavaḥ । sādhūnāṃ punarācāro garīyo dharmalakṣaṇam ॥6॥
html:
etattu nāpare cakrurna pare jātu sādhavaḥ ।
sādhūnāṃ punarācāro garīyo dharmalakṣaṇam ॥6॥
slp1: etattu nApare cakrurna pare jAtu sADavaH । sADUnAM punarAcAro garIyo DarmalakzaRam ॥6॥

text: asminneva prakaraṇe sukraturvākyamabravīt । naptā videharājasya janakasya mahātmanaḥ ॥7॥
html:
asminneva prakaraṇe sukraturvākyamabravīt ।
naptā videharājasya janakasya mahātmanaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: asminneva prakaraRe sukraturvAkyamabravIt । naptA videharAjasya janakasya mahAtmanaH ॥7॥

text: asadācarite mārge kathaṃ syādanukīrtanam । anupraśnaḥ saṃśayo vā satāmetadupālabhet ॥8॥
html:
asadācarite mārge kathaṃ syādanukīrtanam ।
anupraśnaḥ saṃśayo vā satāmetadupālabhet ॥8॥
slp1: asadAcarite mArge kaTaM syAdanukIrtanam । anupraSnaH saMSayo vA satAmetadupAlaBet ॥8॥

text: asadeva hi dharmasya pramādo dharma āsuraḥ । nānuśuśruma jātvetāmimāṃ pūrveṣu janmasu ॥9॥
html:
asadeva hi dharmasya pramādo dharma āsuraḥ ।
nānuśuśruma jātvetāmimāṃ pūrveṣu janmasu ॥9॥
slp1: asadeva hi Darmasya pramAdo Darma AsuraH । nAnuSuSruma jAtvetAmimAM pUrvezu janmasu ॥9॥

text: bhāryāpatyorhi sambandhaḥ strīpuṃsostulya eva saḥ । ratiḥ sādhāraṇo dharma iti cāha sa pārthivaḥ ॥10॥
html:
bhāryāpatyorhi sambandhaḥ strīpuṃsostulya eva saḥ ।
ratiḥ sādhāraṇo dharma iti cāha sa pārthivaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: BAryApatyorhi sambanDaH strIpuMsostulya eva saH । ratiH sADAraRo Darma iti cAha sa pArTivaH ॥10॥

text: atha kena pramāṇena puṃsāmādīyate dhanam । putravaddhi pitustasya kanyā bhavitumarhati ॥11॥
html:
atha kena pramāṇena puṃsāmādīyate dhanam ।
putravaddhi pitustasya kanyā bhavitumarhati ॥11॥
slp1: aTa kena pramARena puMsAmAdIyate Danam । putravadDi pitustasya kanyA Bavitumarhati ॥11॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yathaivātmā tathā putraḥ putreṇa duhitā samā । tasyāmātmani tiṣṭhantyāṃ kathamanyo dhanaṃ haret ॥12॥
html:
yathaivātmā tathā putraḥ putreṇa duhitā samā ।
tasyāmātmani tiṣṭhantyāṃ kathamanyo dhanaṃ haret ॥12॥
slp1: yaTEvAtmA taTA putraH putreRa duhitA samA । tasyAmAtmani tizWantyAM kaTamanyo DanaM haret ॥12॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: mātuśca yautakaṃ yatsyātkumārībhāga eva saḥ । dauhitra eva vā rikthamaputrasya piturharet ॥13॥
html:
mātuśca yautakaṃ yatsyātkumārībhāga eva saḥ ।
dauhitra eva vā rikthamaputrasya piturharet ॥13॥
slp1: mAtuSca yOtakaM yatsyAtkumArIBAga eva saH । dOhitra eva vA rikTamaputrasya piturharet ॥13॥

text: dadāti hi sa piṇḍaṃ vai piturmātāmahasya ca । putradauhitrayorneha viśeṣo dharmataḥ smṛtaḥ ॥14॥
html:
dadāti hi sa piṇḍaṃ vai piturmātāmahasya ca ।
putradauhitrayorneha viśeṣo dharmataḥ smṛtaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: dadAti hi sa piRqaM vE piturmAtAmahasya ca । putradOhitrayorneha viSezo DarmataH smftaH ॥14॥

text: anyatra jātayā sā hi prajayā putra īhate । duhitānyatra jātena putreṇāpi viśiṣyate ॥15॥
html:
anyatra jātayā sā hi prajayā putra īhate ।
duhitānyatra jātena putreṇāpi viśiṣyate ॥15॥
slp1: anyatra jAtayA sA hi prajayA putra Ihate । duhitAnyatra jAtena putreRApi viSizyate ॥15॥

text: dauhitrakeṇa dharmeṇa nātra paśyāmi kāraṇam । vikrītāsu ca ye putrā bhavanti pitureva te ॥16॥
html:
dauhitrakeṇa dharmeṇa nātra paśyāmi kāraṇam ।
vikrītāsu ca ye putrā bhavanti pitureva te ॥16॥
slp1: dOhitrakeRa DarmeRa nAtra paSyAmi kAraRam । vikrItAsu ca ye putrA Bavanti pitureva te ॥16॥

text: asūyavastvadharmiṣṭhāḥ parasvādāyinaḥ śaṭhāḥ । āsurādadhisambhūtā dharmādviṣamavṛttayaḥ ॥17॥
html:
asūyavastvadharmiṣṭhāḥ parasvādāyinaḥ śaṭhāḥ ।
āsurādadhisambhūtā dharmādviṣamavṛttayaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: asUyavastvaDarmizWAH parasvAdAyinaH SaWAH । AsurAdaDisamBUtA DarmAdvizamavfttayaH ॥17॥

text: atra gāthā yamodgītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ । dharmajñā dharmaśāstreṣu nibaddhā dharmasetuṣu ॥18॥
html:
atra gāthā yamodgītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ।
dharmajñā dharmaśāstreṣu nibaddhā dharmasetuṣu ॥18॥
slp1: atra gATA yamodgItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH । DarmajYA DarmaSAstrezu nibadDA Darmasetuzu ॥18॥

text: yo manuṣyaḥ svakaṃ putraṃ vikrīya dhanamicchati । kanyāṃ vā jīvitārthāya yaḥ śulkena prayacchati ॥19॥
html:
yo manuṣyaḥ svakaṃ putraṃ vikrīya dhanamicchati ।
kanyāṃ vā jīvitārthāya yaḥ śulkena prayacchati ॥19॥
slp1: yo manuzyaH svakaM putraM vikrIya DanamicCati । kanyAM vA jIvitArTAya yaH Sulkena prayacCati ॥19॥

text: saptāvare mahāghore niraye kālasāhvaye । svedaṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca tasminpreta upāśnute ॥20॥
html:
saptāvare mahāghore niraye kālasāhvaye ।
svedaṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca tasminpreta upāśnute ॥20॥
slp1: saptAvare mahAGore niraye kAlasAhvaye । svedaM mUtraM purIzaM ca tasminpreta upASnute ॥20॥

text: ārṣe gomithunaṃ śulkaṃ kecidāhurmṛṣaiva tat । alpaṃ vā bahu vā rājanvikrayastāvadeva saḥ ॥21॥
html:
ārṣe gomithunaṃ śulkaṃ kecidāhurmṛṣaiva tat ।
alpaṃ vā bahu vā rājanvikrayastāvadeva saḥ ॥21॥
slp1: Arze gomiTunaM SulkaM kecidAhurmfzEva tat । alpaM vA bahu vA rAjanvikrayastAvadeva saH ॥21॥

text: yadyapyācaritaḥ kaiścinnaiṣa dharmaḥ kathañcana । anyeṣāmapi dṛśyante lobhataḥ sampravṛttayaḥ ॥22॥
html:
yadyapyācaritaḥ kaiścinnaiṣa dharmaḥ kathañcana ।
anyeṣāmapi dṛśyante lobhataḥ sampravṛttayaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: yadyapyAcaritaH kEScinnEza DarmaH kaTaYcana । anyezAmapi dfSyante loBataH sampravfttayaH ॥22॥

text: vaśyāṃ kumārīṃ vihitāṃ ye ca tāmupabhuñjate । ete pāpasya kartārastamasyandhe'tha śerate ॥23॥
html:
vaśyāṃ kumārīṃ vihitāṃ ye ca tāmupabhuñjate ।
ete pāpasya kartārastamasyandhe'tha śerate ॥23॥
slp1: vaSyAM kumArIM vihitAM ye ca tAmupaBuYjate । ete pApasya kartArastamasyanDe'Ta Serate ॥23॥

text: anyo'pyatha na vikreyo manuṣyaḥ kiṃ punaḥ prajāḥ । adharmamūlairhi dhanairna tairartho'sti kaścana] ॥24॥
html:
anyo'pyatha na vikreyo manuṣyaḥ kiṃ punaḥ prajāḥ ।
adharmamūlairhi dhanairna tairartho'sti kaścana] ॥24॥
slp1: anyo'pyaTa na vikreyo manuzyaH kiM punaH prajAH । aDarmamUlErhi DanErna tErarTo'sti kaScana] ॥24॥

text: prācetasasya vacanaṃ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ । yasyāḥ kiñcinnādadate jñātayo na sa vikrayaḥ ॥1॥
html:
prācetasasya vacanaṃ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ।
yasyāḥ kiñcinnādadate jñātayo na sa vikrayaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: prAcetasasya vacanaM kIrtayanti purAvidaH । yasyAH kiYcinnAdadate jYAtayo na sa vikrayaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: arhaṇaṃ tatkumārīṇāmānṛśaṃsyatamaṃ ca tat । sarvaṃ ca pratideyaṃ syātkanyāyai tadaśeṣataḥ ॥2॥
html:
arhaṇaṃ tatkumārīṇāmānṛśaṃsyatamaṃ ca tat ।
sarvaṃ ca pratideyaṃ syātkanyāyai tadaśeṣataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: arhaRaM tatkumArIRAmAnfSaMsyatamaM ca tat । sarvaM ca pratideyaM syAtkanyAyE tadaSezataH ॥2॥

text: pitṛbhirbhrātṛbhiścaiva śvaśurairatha devaraiḥ । pūjyā lālayitavyāśca bahukalyāṇamīpsubhiḥ ॥3॥
html:
pitṛbhirbhrātṛbhiścaiva śvaśurairatha devaraiḥ ।
pūjyā lālayitavyāśca bahukalyāṇamīpsubhiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: pitfBirBrAtfBiScEva SvaSurEraTa devarEH । pUjyA lAlayitavyASca bahukalyARamIpsuBiH ॥3॥

text: yadi vai strī na roceta pumāṃsaṃ na pramodayet । amodanātpunaḥ puṃsaḥ prajanaṃ na pravardhate ॥4॥
html:
yadi vai strī na roceta pumāṃsaṃ na pramodayet ।
amodanātpunaḥ puṃsaḥ prajanaṃ na pravardhate ॥4॥
slp1: yadi vE strI na roceta pumAMsaM na pramodayet । amodanAtpunaH puMsaH prajanaM na pravarDate ॥4॥

text: pūjyā lālayitavyāśca striyo nityaṃ janādhipa । apūjitāśca yatraitāḥ sarvāstatrāphalāḥ kriyāḥ । tadaiva tatkulaṃ nāsti yadā śocanti jāmayaḥ ॥5॥
html:
pūjyā lālayitavyāśca striyo nityaṃ janādhipa ।
apūjitāśca yatraitāḥ sarvāstatrāphalāḥ kriyāḥ ।
tadaiva tatkulaṃ nāsti yadā śocanti jāmayaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: pUjyA lAlayitavyASca striyo nityaM janADipa । apUjitASca yatrEtAH sarvAstatrAPalAH kriyAH । tadEva tatkulaM nAsti yadA Socanti jAmayaH ॥5॥

text: jāmīśaptāni gehāni nikṛttānīva kṛtyayā । naiva bhānti na vardhante śriyā hīnāni pārthiva ॥6॥
html:
jāmīśaptāni gehāni nikṛttānīva kṛtyayā ।
naiva bhānti na vardhante śriyā hīnāni pārthiva ॥6॥
slp1: jAmISaptAni gehAni nikfttAnIva kftyayA । nEva BAnti na varDante SriyA hInAni pArTiva ॥6॥

text: striyaḥ puṃsāṃ paridade manurjigamiṣurdivam । abalāḥ svalpakaupīnāḥ suhṛdaḥ satyajiṣṇavaḥ ॥7॥
html:
striyaḥ puṃsāṃ paridade manurjigamiṣurdivam ।
abalāḥ svalpakaupīnāḥ suhṛdaḥ satyajiṣṇavaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: striyaH puMsAM paridade manurjigamizurdivam । abalAH svalpakOpInAH suhfdaH satyajizRavaH ॥7॥

text: īrṣyavo mānakāmāśca caṇḍā asuhṛdo'budhāḥ । striyo mānanamarhanti tā mānayata mānavāḥ ॥8॥
html:
īrṣyavo mānakāmāśca caṇḍā asuhṛdo'budhāḥ ।
striyo mānanamarhanti tā mānayata mānavāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: Irzyavo mAnakAmASca caRqA asuhfdo'buDAH । striyo mAnanamarhanti tA mAnayata mAnavAH ॥8॥

text: strīpratyayo hi vo dharmo ratibhogāśca kevalāḥ । paricaryānnasaṃskārāstadāyattā bhavantu vaḥ ॥9॥
html:
strīpratyayo hi vo dharmo ratibhogāśca kevalāḥ ।
paricaryānnasaṃskārāstadāyattā bhavantu vaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: strIpratyayo hi vo Darmo ratiBogASca kevalAH । paricaryAnnasaMskArAstadAyattA Bavantu vaH ॥9॥

text: utpādanamapatyasya jātasya paripālanam । prītyarthaṃ lokayātrā ca paśyata strīnibandhanam ॥10॥
html:
utpādanamapatyasya jātasya paripālanam ।
prītyarthaṃ lokayātrā ca paśyata strīnibandhanam ॥10॥
slp1: utpAdanamapatyasya jAtasya paripAlanam । prItyarTaM lokayAtrA ca paSyata strInibanDanam ॥10॥

text: sammānyamānāścaitābhiḥ sarvakāryāṇyavāpsyatha । videharājaduhitā cātra ślokamagāyata ॥11॥
html:
sammānyamānāścaitābhiḥ sarvakāryāṇyavāpsyatha ।
videharājaduhitā cātra ślokamagāyata ॥11॥
slp1: sammAnyamAnAScEtABiH sarvakAryARyavApsyaTa । videharAjaduhitA cAtra SlokamagAyata ॥11॥

text: nāsti yajñaḥ striyaḥ kaścinna śrāddhaṃ nopavāsakam । dharmastu bhartṛśuśrūṣā tayā svargaṃ jayatyuta ॥12॥
html:
nāsti yajñaḥ striyaḥ kaścinna śrāddhaṃ nopavāsakam ।
dharmastu bhartṛśuśrūṣā tayā svargaṃ jayatyuta ॥12॥
slp1: nAsti yajYaH striyaH kaScinna SrAdDaM nopavAsakam । Darmastu BartfSuSrUzA tayA svargaM jayatyuta ॥12॥

text: pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane । putrāstu sthavirībhāve na strī svātantryamarhati ॥13॥
html:
pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane ।
putrāstu sthavirībhāve na strī svātantryamarhati ॥13॥
slp1: pitA rakzati kOmAre BartA rakzati yOvane । putrAstu sTavirIBAve na strI svAtantryamarhati ॥13॥

text: śriya etāḥ striyo nāma satkāryā bhūtimicchatā । lālitā nigṛhītā ca strī śrīrbhavati bhārata] ॥14॥
html:
śriya etāḥ striyo nāma satkāryā bhūtimicchatā ।
lālitā nigṛhītā ca strī śrīrbhavati bhārata] ॥14॥
slp1: Sriya etAH striyo nAma satkAryA BUtimicCatA । lAlitA nigfhItA ca strI SrIrBavati BArata] ॥14॥

text: sarvaśāstravidhānajña rājadharmārthavittama । atīva saṃśayacchettā bhavānvai prathitaḥ kṣitau ॥1॥
html:
sarvaśāstravidhānajña rājadharmārthavittama ।
atīva saṃśayacchettā bhavānvai prathitaḥ kṣitau ॥1॥
slp1: sarvaSAstraviDAnajYa rAjaDarmArTavittama । atIva saMSayacCettA BavAnvE praTitaH kzitO ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kaścittu saṃśayo me'sti tanme brūhi pitāmaha । asyāmāpadi kaṣṭāyāmanyaṃ pṛcchāma kaṃ vayam ॥2॥
html:
kaścittu saṃśayo me'sti tanme brūhi pitāmaha ।
asyāmāpadi kaṣṭāyāmanyaṃ pṛcchāma kaṃ vayam ॥2॥
slp1: kaScittu saMSayo me'sti tanme brUhi pitAmaha । asyAmApadi kazwAyAmanyaM pfcCAma kaM vayam ॥2॥

text: yathā nareṇa kartavyaṃ yaśca dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । etatsarvaṃ mahābāho bhavānvyākhyātumarhati ॥3॥
html:
yathā nareṇa kartavyaṃ yaśca dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
etatsarvaṃ mahābāho bhavānvyākhyātumarhati ॥3॥
slp1: yaTA nareRa kartavyaM yaSca DarmaH sanAtanaH । etatsarvaM mahAbAho BavAnvyAKyAtumarhati ॥3॥

text: catasro vihitā bhāryā brāhmaṇasya pitāmaha । brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca ratimicchataḥ ॥4॥
html:
catasro vihitā bhāryā brāhmaṇasya pitāmaha ।
brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca ratimicchataḥ ॥4॥
slp1: catasro vihitA BAryA brAhmaRasya pitAmaha । brAhmaRI kzatriyA vESyA SUdrA ca ratimicCataH ॥4॥

text: tatra jāteṣu putreṣu sarvāsāṃ kurusattama । ānupūrvyeṇa kasteṣāṃ pitryaṃ dāyādyamarhati ॥5॥
html:
tatra jāteṣu putreṣu sarvāsāṃ kurusattama ।
ānupūrvyeṇa kasteṣāṃ pitryaṃ dāyādyamarhati ॥5॥
slp1: tatra jAtezu putrezu sarvAsAM kurusattama । AnupUrvyeRa kastezAM pitryaM dAyAdyamarhati ॥5॥

text: kena vā kiṃ tato hāryaṃ pitṛvittātpitāmaha । etadicchāmi kathitaṃ vibhāgasteṣu yaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥6॥
html:
kena vā kiṃ tato hāryaṃ pitṛvittātpitāmaha ।
etadicchāmi kathitaṃ vibhāgasteṣu yaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: kena vA kiM tato hAryaM pitfvittAtpitAmaha । etadicCAmi kaTitaM viBAgastezu yaH smftaH ॥6॥

text: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyastrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ । eteṣu vihito dharmo brāhmaṇasya yudhiṣṭhira ॥7॥
html:
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyastrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ ।
eteṣu vihito dharmo brāhmaṇasya yudhiṣṭhira ॥7॥
slp1: brAhmaRaH kzatriyo vESyastrayo varRA dvijAtayaH । etezu vihito Darmo brAhmaRasya yuDizWira ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: vaiṣamyādatha vā lobhātkāmādvāpi parantapa । brāhmaṇasya bhavecchūdrā na tu dṛṣṭāntataḥ smṛtā ॥8॥
html:
vaiṣamyādatha vā lobhātkāmādvāpi parantapa ।
brāhmaṇasya bhavecchūdrā na tu dṛṣṭāntataḥ smṛtā ॥8॥
slp1: vEzamyAdaTa vA loBAtkAmAdvApi parantapa । brAhmaRasya BavecCUdrA na tu dfzwAntataH smftA ॥8॥

text: śūdrāṃ śayanamāropya brāhmaṇaḥ pīḍito bhavet । prāyaścittīyate cāpi vidhidṛṣṭena hetunā ॥9॥
html:
śūdrāṃ śayanamāropya brāhmaṇaḥ pīḍito bhavet ।
prāyaścittīyate cāpi vidhidṛṣṭena hetunā ॥9॥
slp1: SUdrAM SayanamAropya brAhmaRaH pIqito Bavet । prAyaScittIyate cApi viDidfzwena hetunA ॥9॥

text: tatra jāteṣvapatyeṣu dviguṇaṃ syādyudhiṣṭhira । ataste niyamaṃ vitte sampravakṣyāmi bhārata ॥10॥
html:
tatra jāteṣvapatyeṣu dviguṇaṃ syādyudhiṣṭhira ।
ataste niyamaṃ vitte sampravakṣyāmi bhārata ॥10॥
slp1: tatra jAtezvapatyezu dviguRaM syAdyuDizWira । ataste niyamaM vitte sampravakzyAmi BArata ॥10॥

text: lakṣaṇyo govṛṣo yānaṃ yatpradhānatamaṃ bhavet । brāhmaṇyāstaddharetputra ekāṃśaṃ vai piturdhanāt ॥11॥
html:
lakṣaṇyo govṛṣo yānaṃ yatpradhānatamaṃ bhavet ।
brāhmaṇyāstaddharetputra ekāṃśaṃ vai piturdhanāt ॥11॥
slp1: lakzaRyo govfzo yAnaM yatpraDAnatamaM Bavet । brAhmaRyAstadDaretputra ekAMSaM vE piturDanAt ॥11॥

text: śeṣaṃ tu daśadhā kāryaṃ brāhmaṇasvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । tatra tenaiva hartavyāścatvāroṃ'śāḥ piturdhanāt ॥12॥
html:
śeṣaṃ tu daśadhā kāryaṃ brāhmaṇasvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
tatra tenaiva hartavyāścatvāroṃ'śāḥ piturdhanāt ॥12॥
slp1: SezaM tu daSaDA kAryaM brAhmaRasvaM yuDizWira । tatra tenEva hartavyAScatvAroM'SAH piturDanAt ॥12॥

text: kṣatriyāyāstu yaḥ putro brāhmaṇaḥ so'pyasaṃśayaḥ । sa tu mātṛviśeṣeṇa trīnaṃśānhartumarhati ॥13॥
html:
kṣatriyāyāstu yaḥ putro brāhmaṇaḥ so'pyasaṃśayaḥ ।
sa tu mātṛviśeṣeṇa trīnaṃśānhartumarhati ॥13॥
slp1: kzatriyAyAstu yaH putro brAhmaRaH so'pyasaMSayaH । sa tu mAtfviSezeRa trInaMSAnhartumarhati ॥13॥

text: varṇe tṛtīye jātastu vaiśyāyāṃ brāhmaṇādapi । dviraṃśastena hartavyo brāhmaṇasvādyudhiṣṭhira ॥14॥
html:
varṇe tṛtīye jātastu vaiśyāyāṃ brāhmaṇādapi ।
dviraṃśastena hartavyo brāhmaṇasvādyudhiṣṭhira ॥14॥
slp1: varRe tftIye jAtastu vESyAyAM brAhmaRAdapi । dviraMSastena hartavyo brAhmaRasvAdyuDizWira ॥14॥

text: śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇājjāto nityādeyadhanaḥ smṛtaḥ । alpaṃ vāpi pradātavyaṃ śūdrāputrāya bhārata ॥15॥
html:
śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇājjāto nityādeyadhanaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
alpaṃ vāpi pradātavyaṃ śūdrāputrāya bhārata ॥15॥
slp1: SUdrAyAM brAhmaRAjjAto nityAdeyaDanaH smftaH । alpaM vApi pradAtavyaM SUdrAputrAya BArata ॥15॥

text: daśadhā pravibhaktasya dhanasyaiṣa bhavetkramaḥ । savarṇāsu tu jātānāṃ samānbhāgānprakalpayet ॥16॥
html:
daśadhā pravibhaktasya dhanasyaiṣa bhavetkramaḥ ।
savarṇāsu tu jātānāṃ samānbhāgānprakalpayet ॥16॥
slp1: daSaDA praviBaktasya DanasyEza BavetkramaH । savarRAsu tu jAtAnAM samAnBAgAnprakalpayet ॥16॥

text: abrāhmaṇaṃ tu manyante śūdrāputramanaipuṇāt । triṣu varṇeṣu jāto hi brāhmaṇādbrāhmaṇo bhavet ॥17॥
html:
abrāhmaṇaṃ tu manyante śūdrāputramanaipuṇāt ।
triṣu varṇeṣu jāto hi brāhmaṇādbrāhmaṇo bhavet ॥17॥
slp1: abrAhmaRaM tu manyante SUdrAputramanEpuRAt । trizu varRezu jAto hi brAhmaRAdbrAhmaRo Bavet ॥17॥

text: smṛtā varṇāśca catvāraḥ pañcamo nādhigamyate । harettu daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ śūdrāputraḥ piturdhanāt ॥18॥
html:
smṛtā varṇāśca catvāraḥ pañcamo nādhigamyate ।
harettu daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ śūdrāputraḥ piturdhanāt ॥18॥
slp1: smftA varRASca catvAraH paYcamo nADigamyate । harettu daSamaM BAgaM SUdrAputraH piturDanAt ॥18॥

text: tattu dattaṃ haretpitrā nādattaṃ hartumarhati । avaśyaṃ hi dhanaṃ deyaṃ śūdrāputrāya bhārata ॥19॥
html:
tattu dattaṃ haretpitrā nādattaṃ hartumarhati ।
avaśyaṃ hi dhanaṃ deyaṃ śūdrāputrāya bhārata ॥19॥
slp1: tattu dattaM haretpitrA nAdattaM hartumarhati । avaSyaM hi DanaM deyaM SUdrAputrAya BArata ॥19॥

text: ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharma iti tasmai pradīyate । yatra tatra samutpanno guṇāyaivopakalpate ॥20॥
html:
ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharma iti tasmai pradīyate ।
yatra tatra samutpanno guṇāyaivopakalpate ॥20॥
slp1: AnfSaMsyaM paro Darma iti tasmE pradIyate । yatra tatra samutpanno guRAyEvopakalpate ॥20॥

text: yadi vāpyekaputraḥ syādaputro yadi vā bhavet । nādhikaṃ daśamāddadyācchūdrāputrāya bhārata ॥21॥
html:
yadi vāpyekaputraḥ syādaputro yadi vā bhavet ।
nādhikaṃ daśamāddadyācchūdrāputrāya bhārata ॥21॥
slp1: yadi vApyekaputraH syAdaputro yadi vA Bavet । nADikaM daSamAddadyAcCUdrAputrAya BArata ॥21॥

text: traivārṣikādyadā bhaktādadhikaṃ syāddvijasya tu । yajeta tena dravyeṇa na vṛthā sādhayeddhanam ॥22॥
html:
traivārṣikādyadā bhaktādadhikaṃ syāddvijasya tu ।
yajeta tena dravyeṇa na vṛthā sādhayeddhanam ॥22॥
slp1: trEvArzikAdyadA BaktAdaDikaM syAddvijasya tu । yajeta tena dravyeRa na vfTA sADayedDanam ॥22॥

text: trisāhasraparo dāyaḥ striyo deyo dhanasya vai । tacca bhartrā dhanaṃ dattaṃ nādattaṃ bhoktumarhati ॥23॥
html:
trisāhasraparo dāyaḥ striyo deyo dhanasya vai ।
tacca bhartrā dhanaṃ dattaṃ nādattaṃ bhoktumarhati ॥23॥
slp1: trisAhasraparo dAyaH striyo deyo Danasya vE । tacca BartrA DanaM dattaM nAdattaM Boktumarhati ॥23॥

text: strīṇāṃ tu patidāyādyamupabhogaphalaṃ smṛtam । nāpahāraṃ striyaḥ kuryuḥ pativittātkathañcana ॥24॥
html:
strīṇāṃ tu patidāyādyamupabhogaphalaṃ smṛtam ।
nāpahāraṃ striyaḥ kuryuḥ pativittātkathañcana ॥24॥
slp1: strIRAM tu patidAyAdyamupaBogaPalaM smftam । nApahAraM striyaH kuryuH pativittAtkaTaYcana ॥24॥

text: striyāstu yadbhavedvittaṃ pitrā dattaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । brāhmaṇyāstaddharetkanyā yathā putrastathā hi sā । sā hi putrasamā rājanvihitā kurunandana ॥25॥
html:
striyāstu yadbhavedvittaṃ pitrā dattaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
brāhmaṇyāstaddharetkanyā yathā putrastathā hi sā ।
sā hi putrasamā rājanvihitā kurunandana ॥25॥
slp1: striyAstu yadBavedvittaM pitrA dattaM yuDizWira । brAhmaRyAstadDaretkanyA yaTA putrastaTA hi sA । sA hi putrasamA rAjanvihitA kurunandana ॥25॥

text: evametatsamuddiṣṭaṃ dharmeṣu bharatarṣabha । etaddharmamanusmṛtya na vṛthā sādhayeddhanam ॥26॥
html:
evametatsamuddiṣṭaṃ dharmeṣu bharatarṣabha ।
etaddharmamanusmṛtya na vṛthā sādhayeddhanam ॥26॥
slp1: evametatsamuddizwaM Darmezu BaratarzaBa । etadDarmamanusmftya na vfTA sADayedDanam ॥26॥

text: śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇājjāto yadyadeyadhanaḥ smṛtaḥ । kena prativiśeṣeṇa daśamo'pyasya dīyate ॥27॥
html:
śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇājjāto yadyadeyadhanaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
kena prativiśeṣeṇa daśamo'pyasya dīyate ॥27॥
slp1: SUdrAyAM brAhmaRAjjAto yadyadeyaDanaH smftaH । kena prativiSezeRa daSamo'pyasya dIyate ॥27॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇājjāto brāhmaṇaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ । kṣatriyāyāṃ tathaiva syādvaiśyāyāmapi caiva hi ॥28॥
html:
brāhmaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇājjāto brāhmaṇaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ ।
kṣatriyāyāṃ tathaiva syādvaiśyāyāmapi caiva hi ॥28॥
slp1: brAhmaRyAM brAhmaRAjjAto brAhmaRaH syAnna saMSayaH । kzatriyAyAM taTEva syAdvESyAyAmapi cEva hi ॥28॥

text: kasmātte viṣamaṃ bhāgaṃ bhajerannṛpasattama । yadā sarve trayo varṇāstvayoktā brāhmaṇā iti ॥29॥
html:
kasmātte viṣamaṃ bhāgaṃ bhajerannṛpasattama ।
yadā sarve trayo varṇāstvayoktā brāhmaṇā iti ॥29॥
slp1: kasmAtte vizamaM BAgaM Bajerannfpasattama । yadA sarve trayo varRAstvayoktA brAhmaRA iti ॥29॥

text: dārā ityucyate loke nāmnaikena parantapa । proktena caikanāmnāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ sumahānbhavet ॥30॥
html:
dārā ityucyate loke nāmnaikena parantapa ।
proktena caikanāmnāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ sumahānbhavet ॥30॥
slp1: dArA ityucyate loke nAmnEkena parantapa । proktena cEkanAmnAyaM viSezaH sumahAnBavet ॥30॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tisraḥ kṛtvā puro bhāryāḥ paścādvindeta brāhmaṇīm । sā jyeṣṭhā sā ca pūjyā syātsā ca tābhyo garīyasī ॥31॥
html:
tisraḥ kṛtvā puro bhāryāḥ paścādvindeta brāhmaṇīm ।
sā jyeṣṭhā sā ca pūjyā syātsā ca tābhyo garīyasī ॥31॥
slp1: tisraH kftvA puro BAryAH paScAdvindeta brAhmaRIm । sA jyezWA sA ca pUjyA syAtsA ca tAByo garIyasI ॥31॥

text: snānaṃ prasādhanaṃ bharturdantadhāvanamañjanam । havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca yaccānyaddharmayuktaṃ bhavedgṛhe ॥32॥
html:
snānaṃ prasādhanaṃ bharturdantadhāvanamañjanam ।
havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca yaccānyaddharmayuktaṃ bhavedgṛhe ॥32॥
slp1: snAnaM prasADanaM BarturdantaDAvanamaYjanam । havyaM kavyaM ca yaccAnyadDarmayuktaM Bavedgfhe ॥32॥

text: na tasyāṃ jātu tiṣṭhantyāmanyā tatkartumarhati । brāhmaṇī tveva tatkuryādbrāhmaṇasya yudhiṣṭhira ॥33॥
html:
na tasyāṃ jātu tiṣṭhantyāmanyā tatkartumarhati ।
brāhmaṇī tveva tatkuryādbrāhmaṇasya yudhiṣṭhira ॥33॥
slp1: na tasyAM jAtu tizWantyAmanyA tatkartumarhati । brAhmaRI tveva tatkuryAdbrAhmaRasya yuDizWira ॥33॥

text: annaṃ pānaṃ ca mālyaṃ ca vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca । brāhmaṇyai tāni deyāni bhartuḥ sā hi garīyasī ॥34॥
html:
annaṃ pānaṃ ca mālyaṃ ca vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ।
brāhmaṇyai tāni deyāni bhartuḥ sā hi garīyasī ॥34॥
slp1: annaM pAnaM ca mAlyaM ca vAsAMsyABaraRAni ca । brAhmaRyE tAni deyAni BartuH sA hi garIyasI ॥34॥

text: manunābhihitaṃ śāstraṃ yaccāpi kurunandana । tatrāpyeṣa mahārāja dṛṣṭo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥35॥
html:
manunābhihitaṃ śāstraṃ yaccāpi kurunandana ।
tatrāpyeṣa mahārāja dṛṣṭo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: manunABihitaM SAstraM yaccApi kurunandana । tatrApyeza mahArAja dfzwo DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥35॥

text: atha cedanyathā kuryādyadi kāmādyudhiṣṭhira । yathā brāhmaṇacaṇḍālaḥ pūrvadṛṣṭastathaiva saḥ ॥36॥
html:
atha cedanyathā kuryādyadi kāmādyudhiṣṭhira ।
yathā brāhmaṇacaṇḍālaḥ pūrvadṛṣṭastathaiva saḥ ॥36॥
slp1: aTa cedanyaTA kuryAdyadi kAmAdyuDizWira । yaTA brAhmaRacaRqAlaH pUrvadfzwastaTEva saH ॥36॥

text: brāhmaṇyāḥ sadṛśaḥ putraḥ kṣatriyāyāśca yo bhavet । rājanviśeṣo nāstyatra varṇayorubhayorapi ॥37॥
html:
brāhmaṇyāḥ sadṛśaḥ putraḥ kṣatriyāyāśca yo bhavet ।
rājanviśeṣo nāstyatra varṇayorubhayorapi ॥37॥
slp1: brAhmaRyAH sadfSaH putraH kzatriyAyASca yo Bavet । rAjanviSezo nAstyatra varRayoruBayorapi ॥37॥

text: na tu jātyā samā loke brāhmaṇyāḥ kṣatriyā bhavet । brāhmaṇyāḥ prathamaḥ putro bhūyānsyādrājasattama । bhūyo'pi bhūyasā hāryaṃ pitṛvittādyudhiṣṭhira ॥38॥
html:
na tu jātyā samā loke brāhmaṇyāḥ kṣatriyā bhavet ।
brāhmaṇyāḥ prathamaḥ putro bhūyānsyādrājasattama ।
bhūyo'pi bhūyasā hāryaṃ pitṛvittādyudhiṣṭhira ॥38॥
slp1: na tu jAtyA samA loke brAhmaRyAH kzatriyA Bavet । brAhmaRyAH praTamaH putro BUyAnsyAdrAjasattama । BUyo'pi BUyasA hAryaM pitfvittAdyuDizWira ॥38॥

text: yathā na sadṛśī jātu brāhmaṇyāḥ kṣatriyā bhavet । kṣatriyāyāstathā vaiśyā na jātu sadṛśī bhavet ॥39॥
html:
yathā na sadṛśī jātu brāhmaṇyāḥ kṣatriyā bhavet ।
kṣatriyāyāstathā vaiśyā na jātu sadṛśī bhavet ॥39॥
slp1: yaTA na sadfSI jAtu brAhmaRyAH kzatriyA Bavet । kzatriyAyAstaTA vESyA na jAtu sadfSI Bavet ॥39॥

text: śrīśca rājyaṃ ca kośaśca kṣatriyāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । vihitaṃ dṛśyate rājansāgarāntā ca medinī ॥40॥
html:
śrīśca rājyaṃ ca kośaśca kṣatriyāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
vihitaṃ dṛśyate rājansāgarāntā ca medinī ॥40॥
slp1: SrISca rAjyaM ca koSaSca kzatriyARAM yuDizWira । vihitaM dfSyate rAjansAgarAntA ca medinI ॥40॥

text: kṣatriyo hi svadharmeṇa śriyaṃ prāpnoti bhūyasīm । rājā daṇḍadharo rājanrakṣā nānyatra kṣatriyāt ॥41॥
html:
kṣatriyo hi svadharmeṇa śriyaṃ prāpnoti bhūyasīm ।
rājā daṇḍadharo rājanrakṣā nānyatra kṣatriyāt ॥41॥
slp1: kzatriyo hi svaDarmeRa SriyaM prApnoti BUyasIm । rAjA daRqaDaro rAjanrakzA nAnyatra kzatriyAt ॥41॥

text: brāhmaṇā hi mahābhāgā devānāmapi devatāḥ । teṣu rājā pravarteta pūjayā vidhipūrvakam ॥42॥
html:
brāhmaṇā hi mahābhāgā devānāmapi devatāḥ ।
teṣu rājā pravarteta pūjayā vidhipūrvakam ॥42॥
slp1: brAhmaRA hi mahABAgA devAnAmapi devatAH । tezu rAjA pravarteta pUjayA viDipUrvakam ॥42॥

text: praṇītamṛṣibhirjñātvā dharmaṃ śāśvatamavyayam । lupyamānāḥ svadharmeṇa kṣatriyo rakṣati prajāḥ ॥43॥
html:
praṇītamṛṣibhirjñātvā dharmaṃ śāśvatamavyayam ।
lupyamānāḥ svadharmeṇa kṣatriyo rakṣati prajāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: praRItamfziBirjYAtvA DarmaM SASvatamavyayam । lupyamAnAH svaDarmeRa kzatriyo rakzati prajAH ॥43॥

text: dasyubhirhriyamāṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ dārāśca sarvaśaḥ । sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ trātā bhavati pārthivaḥ ॥44॥
html:
dasyubhirhriyamāṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ dārāśca sarvaśaḥ ।
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ trātā bhavati pārthivaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: dasyuBirhriyamARaM ca DanaM dArASca sarvaSaH । sarvezAmeva varRAnAM trAtA Bavati pArTivaH ॥44॥

text: bhūyānsyātkṣatriyāputro vaiśyāputrānna saṃśayaḥ । bhūyastenāpi hartavyaṃ pitṛvittādyudhiṣṭhira ॥45॥
html:
bhūyānsyātkṣatriyāputro vaiśyāputrānna saṃśayaḥ ।
bhūyastenāpi hartavyaṃ pitṛvittādyudhiṣṭhira ॥45॥
slp1: BUyAnsyAtkzatriyAputro vESyAputrAnna saMSayaH । BUyastenApi hartavyaM pitfvittAdyuDizWira ॥45॥

text: uktaṃ te vidhivadrājanbrāhmaṇasve pitāmaha । itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ kathaṃ viniyamo bhavet ॥46॥
html:
uktaṃ te vidhivadrājanbrāhmaṇasve pitāmaha ।
itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ kathaṃ viniyamo bhavet ॥46॥
slp1: uktaM te viDivadrAjanbrAhmaRasve pitAmaha । itarezAM tu varRAnAM kaTaM viniyamo Bavet ॥46॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kṣatriyasyāpi bhārye dve vihite kurunandana । tṛtīyā ca bhavecchūdrā na tu dṛṣṭāntataḥ smṛtā ॥47॥
html:
kṣatriyasyāpi bhārye dve vihite kurunandana ।
tṛtīyā ca bhavecchūdrā na tu dṛṣṭāntataḥ smṛtā ॥47॥
slp1: kzatriyasyApi BArye dve vihite kurunandana । tftIyA ca BavecCUdrA na tu dfzwAntataH smftA ॥47॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: eṣa eva kramo hi syātkṣatriyāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira । aṣṭadhā tu bhavetkāryaṃ kṣatriyasvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥48॥
html:
eṣa eva kramo hi syātkṣatriyāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
aṣṭadhā tu bhavetkāryaṃ kṣatriyasvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥48॥
slp1: eza eva kramo hi syAtkzatriyARAM yuDizWira । azwaDA tu BavetkAryaM kzatriyasvaM yuDizWira ॥48॥

text: kṣatriyāyā haretputraścaturoṃ'śānpiturdhanāt । yuddhāvahārikaṃ yacca pituḥ syātsa harecca tat ॥49॥
html:
kṣatriyāyā haretputraścaturoṃ'śānpiturdhanāt ।
yuddhāvahārikaṃ yacca pituḥ syātsa harecca tat ॥49॥
slp1: kzatriyAyA haretputraScaturoM'SAnpiturDanAt । yudDAvahArikaM yacca pituH syAtsa harecca tat ॥49॥

text: vaiśyāputrastu bhāgāṃstrīnśūdrāputrastathāṣṭamam । so'pi dattaṃ haretpitrā nādattaṃ hartumarhati ॥50॥
html:
vaiśyāputrastu bhāgāṃstrīnśūdrāputrastathāṣṭamam ।
so'pi dattaṃ haretpitrā nādattaṃ hartumarhati ॥50॥
slp1: vESyAputrastu BAgAMstrInSUdrAputrastaTAzwamam । so'pi dattaM haretpitrA nAdattaM hartumarhati ॥50॥

text: ekaiva hi bhavedbhāryā vaiśyasya kurunandana । dvitīyā vā bhavecchūdrā na tu dṛṣṭāntataḥ smṛtā ॥51॥
html:
ekaiva hi bhavedbhāryā vaiśyasya kurunandana ।
dvitīyā vā bhavecchūdrā na tu dṛṣṭāntataḥ smṛtā ॥51॥
slp1: ekEva hi BavedBAryA vESyasya kurunandana । dvitIyA vA BavecCUdrA na tu dfzwAntataH smftA ॥51॥

text: vaiśyasya vartamānasya vaiśyāyāṃ bharatarṣabha । śūdrāyāṃ caiva kaunteya tayorviniyamaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥52॥
html:
vaiśyasya vartamānasya vaiśyāyāṃ bharatarṣabha ।
śūdrāyāṃ caiva kaunteya tayorviniyamaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: vESyasya vartamAnasya vESyAyAM BaratarzaBa । SUdrAyAM cEva kOnteya tayorviniyamaH smftaH ॥52॥

text: pañcadhā tu bhavetkāryaṃ vaiśyasvaṃ bharatarṣabha । tayorapatye vakṣyāmi vibhāgaṃ ca janādhipa ॥53॥
html:
pañcadhā tu bhavetkāryaṃ vaiśyasvaṃ bharatarṣabha ।
tayorapatye vakṣyāmi vibhāgaṃ ca janādhipa ॥53॥
slp1: paYcaDA tu BavetkAryaM vESyasvaM BaratarzaBa । tayorapatye vakzyAmi viBAgaM ca janADipa ॥53॥

text: vaiśyāputreṇa hartavyāścatvāroṃ'śāḥ piturdhanāt । pañcamastu bhavedbhāgaḥ śūdrāputrāya bhārata ॥54॥
html:
vaiśyāputreṇa hartavyāścatvāroṃ'śāḥ piturdhanāt ।
pañcamastu bhavedbhāgaḥ śūdrāputrāya bhārata ॥54॥
slp1: vESyAputreRa hartavyAScatvAroM'SAH piturDanAt । paYcamastu BavedBAgaH SUdrAputrAya BArata ॥54॥

text: so'pi dattaṃ haretpitrā nādattaṃ hartumarhati । tribhirvarṇaistathā jātaḥ śūdro deyadhano bhavet ॥55॥
html:
so'pi dattaṃ haretpitrā nādattaṃ hartumarhati ।
tribhirvarṇaistathā jātaḥ śūdro deyadhano bhavet ॥55॥
slp1: so'pi dattaM haretpitrA nAdattaM hartumarhati । triBirvarREstaTA jAtaH SUdro deyaDano Bavet ॥55॥

text: śūdrasya syātsavarṇaiva bhāryā nānyā kathañcana । śūdrasya samabhāgaḥ syādyadi putraśataṃ bhavet ॥56॥
html:
śūdrasya syātsavarṇaiva bhāryā nānyā kathañcana ।
śūdrasya samabhāgaḥ syādyadi putraśataṃ bhavet ॥56॥
slp1: SUdrasya syAtsavarREva BAryA nAnyA kaTaYcana । SUdrasya samaBAgaH syAdyadi putraSataM Bavet ॥56॥

text: jātānāṃ samavarṇāsu putrāṇāmaviśeṣataḥ । sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ samabhāgo dhane smṛtaḥ ॥57॥
html:
jātānāṃ samavarṇāsu putrāṇāmaviśeṣataḥ ।
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ samabhāgo dhane smṛtaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: jAtAnAM samavarRAsu putrARAmaviSezataH । sarvezAmeva varRAnAM samaBAgo Dane smftaH ॥57॥

text: jyeṣṭhasya bhāgo jyeṣṭhaḥ syādekāṃśo yaḥ pradhānataḥ । eṣa dāyavidhiḥ pārtha pūrvamuktaḥ svayambhuvā ॥58॥
html:
jyeṣṭhasya bhāgo jyeṣṭhaḥ syādekāṃśo yaḥ pradhānataḥ ।
eṣa dāyavidhiḥ pārtha pūrvamuktaḥ svayambhuvā ॥58॥
slp1: jyezWasya BAgo jyezWaH syAdekAMSo yaH praDAnataH । eza dAyaviDiH pArTa pUrvamuktaH svayamBuvA ॥58॥

text: samavarṇāsu jātānāṃ viśeṣo'styaparo nṛpa । vivāhavaiśeṣyakṛtaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvo viśiṣyate ॥59॥
html:
samavarṇāsu jātānāṃ viśeṣo'styaparo nṛpa ।
vivāhavaiśeṣyakṛtaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvo viśiṣyate ॥59॥
slp1: samavarRAsu jAtAnAM viSezo'styaparo nfpa । vivAhavESezyakftaH pUrvaH pUrvo viSizyate ॥59॥

text: harejjyeṣṭhaḥ pradhānāṃśamekaṃ tulyāsuteṣvapi । madhyamo madhyamaṃ caiva kanīyāṃstu kanīyasam ॥60॥
html:
harejjyeṣṭhaḥ pradhānāṃśamekaṃ tulyāsuteṣvapi ।
madhyamo madhyamaṃ caiva kanīyāṃstu kanīyasam ॥60॥
slp1: harejjyezWaH praDAnAMSamekaM tulyAsutezvapi । maDyamo maDyamaM cEva kanIyAMstu kanIyasam ॥60॥

text: evaṃ jātiṣu sarvāsu savarṇāḥ śreṣṭhatāṃ gatāḥ । maharṣirapi caitadvai mārīcaḥ kāśyapo'bravīt] ॥61॥
html:
evaṃ jātiṣu sarvāsu savarṇāḥ śreṣṭhatāṃ gatāḥ ।
maharṣirapi caitadvai mārīcaḥ kāśyapo'bravīt] ॥61॥
slp1: evaM jAtizu sarvAsu savarRAH SrezWatAM gatAH । maharzirapi cEtadvE mArIcaH kASyapo'bravIt] ॥61॥

text: arthāśrayādvā kāmādvā varṇānāṃ vāpyaniścayāt । ajñānādvāpi varṇānāṃ jāyate varṇasaṅkaraḥ ॥1॥
html:
arthāśrayādvā kāmādvā varṇānāṃ vāpyaniścayāt ।
ajñānādvāpi varṇānāṃ jāyate varṇasaṅkaraḥ ॥1॥
slp1: arTASrayAdvA kAmAdvA varRAnAM vApyaniScayAt । ajYAnAdvApi varRAnAM jAyate varRasaNkaraH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: teṣāmetena vidhinā jātānāṃ varṇasaṅkare । ko dharmaḥ kāni karmāṇi tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
teṣāmetena vidhinā jātānāṃ varṇasaṅkare ।
ko dharmaḥ kāni karmāṇi tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: tezAmetena viDinA jAtAnAM varRasaNkare । ko DarmaH kAni karmARi tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: cāturvarṇyasya karmāṇi cāturvarṇyaṃ ca kevalam । asṛjatsa ha yajñārthe pūrvameva prajāpatiḥ ॥3॥
html:
cāturvarṇyasya karmāṇi cāturvarṇyaṃ ca kevalam ।
asṛjatsa ha yajñārthe pūrvameva prajāpatiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: cAturvarRyasya karmARi cAturvarRyaM ca kevalam । asfjatsa ha yajYArTe pUrvameva prajApatiH ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhāryāścatasro viprasya dvayorātmāsya jāyate । ānupūrvyāddvayorhīnau mātṛjātyau prasūyataḥ ॥4॥
html:
bhāryāścatasro viprasya dvayorātmāsya jāyate ।
ānupūrvyāddvayorhīnau mātṛjātyau prasūyataḥ ॥4॥
slp1: BAryAScatasro viprasya dvayorAtmAsya jAyate । AnupUrvyAddvayorhInO mAtfjAtyO prasUyataH ॥4॥

text: paraṃ śavādbrāhmaṇasyaiṣa putraḥ śūdrāputraṃ pāraśavaṃ tamāhuḥ । śuśrūṣakaḥ svasya kulasya sa syātsvaṃ cāritraṃ nityamatho na jahyāt ॥5॥
html:
paraṃ śavādbrāhmaṇasyaiṣa putraḥ śūdrāputraṃ pāraśavaṃ tamāhuḥ ।
śuśrūṣakaḥ svasya kulasya sa syātsvaṃ cāritraṃ nityamatho na jahyāt ॥5॥
slp1: paraM SavAdbrAhmaRasyEza putraH SUdrAputraM pAraSavaM tamAhuH । SuSrUzakaH svasya kulasya sa syAtsvaM cAritraM nityamaTo na jahyAt ॥5॥

text: sarvānupāyānapi sampradhārya samuddharetsvasya kulasya tantum । jyeṣṭho yavīyānapi yo dvijasya śuśrūṣavāndānaparāyaṇaḥ syāt ॥6॥
html:
sarvānupāyānapi sampradhārya samuddharetsvasya kulasya tantum ।
jyeṣṭho yavīyānapi yo dvijasya śuśrūṣavāndānaparāyaṇaḥ syāt ॥6॥
slp1: sarvAnupAyAnapi sampraDArya samudDaretsvasya kulasya tantum । jyezWo yavIyAnapi yo dvijasya SuSrUzavAndAnaparAyaRaH syAt ॥6॥

text: tisraḥ kṣatriyasambandhāddvayorātmāsya jāyate । hīnavarṇastṛtīyāyāṃ śūdra ugra iti smṛtaḥ ॥7॥
html:
tisraḥ kṣatriyasambandhāddvayorātmāsya jāyate ।
hīnavarṇastṛtīyāyāṃ śūdra ugra iti smṛtaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: tisraH kzatriyasambanDAddvayorAtmAsya jAyate । hInavarRastftIyAyAM SUdra ugra iti smftaH ॥7॥

text: dve cāpi bhārye vaiśyasya dvayorātmāsya jāyate । śūdrā śūdrasya cāpyekā śūdrameva prajāyate ॥8॥
html:
dve cāpi bhārye vaiśyasya dvayorātmāsya jāyate ।
śūdrā śūdrasya cāpyekā śūdrameva prajāyate ॥8॥
slp1: dve cApi BArye vESyasya dvayorAtmAsya jAyate । SUdrA SUdrasya cApyekA SUdrameva prajAyate ॥8॥

text: ato viśiṣṭastvadhamo gurudārapradharṣakaḥ । bāhyaṃ varṇaṃ janayati cāturvarṇyavigarhitam ॥9॥
html:
ato viśiṣṭastvadhamo gurudārapradharṣakaḥ ।
bāhyaṃ varṇaṃ janayati cāturvarṇyavigarhitam ॥9॥
slp1: ato viSizwastvaDamo gurudArapraDarzakaH । bAhyaM varRaM janayati cAturvarRyavigarhitam ॥9॥

text: ayājyaṃ kṣatriyo vrātyaṃ sūtaṃ stomakriyāparam । vaiśyo vaidehakaṃ cāpi maudgalyamapavarjitam ॥10॥
html:
ayājyaṃ kṣatriyo vrātyaṃ sūtaṃ stomakriyāparam ।
vaiśyo vaidehakaṃ cāpi maudgalyamapavarjitam ॥10॥
slp1: ayAjyaM kzatriyo vrAtyaM sUtaM stomakriyAparam । vESyo vEdehakaM cApi mOdgalyamapavarjitam ॥10॥

text: śūdraścaṇḍālamatyugraṃ vadhyaghnaṃ bāhyavāsinam । brāhmaṇyāṃ samprajāyanta ityete kulapāṃsanāḥ । ete matimatāṃ śreṣṭha varṇasaṅkarajāḥ prabho ॥11॥
html:
śūdraścaṇḍālamatyugraṃ vadhyaghnaṃ bāhyavāsinam ।
brāhmaṇyāṃ samprajāyanta ityete kulapāṃsanāḥ ।
ete matimatāṃ śreṣṭha varṇasaṅkarajāḥ prabho ॥11॥
slp1: SUdraScaRqAlamatyugraM vaDyaGnaM bAhyavAsinam । brAhmaRyAM samprajAyanta ityete kulapAMsanAH । ete matimatAM SrezWa varRasaNkarajAH praBo ॥11॥

text: bandī tu jāyate vaiśyānmāgadho vākyajīvanaḥ । śūdrānniṣādo matsyaghnaḥ kṣatriyāyāṃ vyatikramāt ॥12॥
html:
bandī tu jāyate vaiśyānmāgadho vākyajīvanaḥ ।
śūdrānniṣādo matsyaghnaḥ kṣatriyāyāṃ vyatikramāt ॥12॥
slp1: bandI tu jAyate vESyAnmAgaDo vAkyajIvanaH । SUdrAnnizAdo matsyaGnaH kzatriyAyAM vyatikramAt ॥12॥

text: śūdrādāyogavaścāpi vaiśyāyāṃ grāmadharmiṇaḥ । brāhmaṇairapratigrāhyastakṣā sa vanajīvanaḥ ॥13॥
html:
śūdrādāyogavaścāpi vaiśyāyāṃ grāmadharmiṇaḥ ।
brāhmaṇairapratigrāhyastakṣā sa vanajīvanaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: SUdrAdAyogavaScApi vESyAyAM grAmaDarmiRaH । brAhmaRErapratigrAhyastakzA sa vanajIvanaH ॥13॥

text: ete'pi sadṛśaṃ varṇaṃ janayanti svayoniṣu । mātṛjātyāṃ prasūyante pravarā hīnayoniṣu ॥14॥
html:
ete'pi sadṛśaṃ varṇaṃ janayanti svayoniṣu ।
mātṛjātyāṃ prasūyante pravarā hīnayoniṣu ॥14॥
slp1: ete'pi sadfSaM varRaM janayanti svayonizu । mAtfjAtyAM prasUyante pravarA hInayonizu ॥14॥

text: yathā caturṣu varṇeṣu dvayorātmāsya jāyate । ānantaryāttu jāyante tathā bāhyāḥ pradhānataḥ ॥15॥
html:
yathā caturṣu varṇeṣu dvayorātmāsya jāyate ।
ānantaryāttu jāyante tathā bāhyāḥ pradhānataḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yaTA caturzu varRezu dvayorAtmAsya jAyate । AnantaryAttu jAyante taTA bAhyAH praDAnataH ॥15॥

text: te cāpi sadṛśaṃ varṇaṃ janayanti svayoniṣu । parasparasya vartanto janayanti vigarhitān ॥16॥
html:
te cāpi sadṛśaṃ varṇaṃ janayanti svayoniṣu ।
parasparasya vartanto janayanti vigarhitān ॥16॥
slp1: te cApi sadfSaM varRaM janayanti svayonizu । parasparasya vartanto janayanti vigarhitAn ॥16॥

text: yathā ca śūdro brāhmaṇyāṃ jantuṃ bāhyaṃ prasūyate । evaṃ bāhyatarādbāhyaścāturvarṇyātprasūyate ॥17॥
html:
yathā ca śūdro brāhmaṇyāṃ jantuṃ bāhyaṃ prasūyate ।
evaṃ bāhyatarādbāhyaścāturvarṇyātprasūyate ॥17॥
slp1: yaTA ca SUdro brAhmaRyAM jantuM bAhyaM prasUyate । evaM bAhyatarAdbAhyaScAturvarRyAtprasUyate ॥17॥

text: pratilomaṃ tu vartanto bāhyādbāhyataraṃ punaḥ । hīnā hīnātprasūyante varṇāḥ pañcadaśaiva te ॥18॥
html:
pratilomaṃ tu vartanto bāhyādbāhyataraṃ punaḥ ।
hīnā hīnātprasūyante varṇāḥ pañcadaśaiva te ॥18॥
slp1: pratilomaM tu vartanto bAhyAdbAhyataraM punaH । hInA hInAtprasUyante varRAH paYcadaSEva te ॥18॥

text: agamyāgamanāccaiva vartate varṇasaṅkaraḥ । vrātyānāmatra jāyante sairandhrā māgadheṣu ca । prasādhanopacārajñamadāsaṃ dāsajīvanam ॥19॥
html:
agamyāgamanāccaiva vartate varṇasaṅkaraḥ ।
vrātyānāmatra jāyante sairandhrā māgadheṣu ca ।
prasādhanopacārajñamadāsaṃ dāsajīvanam ॥19॥
slp1: agamyAgamanAccEva vartate varRasaNkaraH । vrAtyAnAmatra jAyante sEranDrA mAgaDezu ca । prasADanopacArajYamadAsaM dAsajIvanam ॥19॥

text: ataścāyogavaṃ sūte vāgurāvanajīvanam । maireyakaṃ ca vaidehaḥ samprasūte'tha mādhukam ॥20॥
html:
ataścāyogavaṃ sūte vāgurāvanajīvanam ।
maireyakaṃ ca vaidehaḥ samprasūte'tha mādhukam ॥20॥
slp1: ataScAyogavaM sUte vAgurAvanajIvanam । mEreyakaM ca vEdehaH samprasUte'Ta mADukam ॥20॥

text: niṣādo mudgaraṃ sūte dāśaṃ nāvopajīvinam । mṛtapaṃ cāpi caṇḍālaḥ śvapākamatikutsitam ॥21॥
html:
niṣādo mudgaraṃ sūte dāśaṃ nāvopajīvinam ।
mṛtapaṃ cāpi caṇḍālaḥ śvapākamatikutsitam ॥21॥
slp1: nizAdo mudgaraM sUte dASaM nAvopajIvinam । mftapaM cApi caRqAlaH SvapAkamatikutsitam ॥21॥

text: caturo māgadhī sūte krūrānmāyopajīvinaḥ । māṃsasvādukaraṃ sūdaṃ saugandhamiti sañjñitam ॥22॥
html:
caturo māgadhī sūte krūrānmāyopajīvinaḥ ।
māṃsasvādukaraṃ sūdaṃ saugandhamiti sañjñitam ॥22॥
slp1: caturo mAgaDI sUte krUrAnmAyopajIvinaH । mAMsasvAdukaraM sUdaM sOganDamiti saYjYitam ॥22॥

text: vaidehakācca pāpiṣṭhaṃ krūraṃ bhāryopajīvinam । niṣādānmadranābhaṃ ca kharayānaprayāyinam ॥23॥
html:
vaidehakācca pāpiṣṭhaṃ krūraṃ bhāryopajīvinam ।
niṣādānmadranābhaṃ ca kharayānaprayāyinam ॥23॥
slp1: vEdehakAcca pApizWaM krUraM BAryopajIvinam । nizAdAnmadranABaM ca KarayAnaprayAyinam ॥23॥

text: caṇḍālātpulkasaṃ cāpi kharāśvagajabhojinam । mṛtacelapraticchannaṃ bhinnabhājanabhojinam ॥24॥
html:
caṇḍālātpulkasaṃ cāpi kharāśvagajabhojinam ।
mṛtacelapraticchannaṃ bhinnabhājanabhojinam ॥24॥
slp1: caRqAlAtpulkasaM cApi KarASvagajaBojinam । mftacelapraticCannaM BinnaBAjanaBojinam ॥24॥

text: āyogavīṣu jāyante hīnavarṇāsu te trayaḥ । kṣudro vaidehakādandhro bahirgrāmapratiśrayaḥ ॥25॥
html:
āyogavīṣu jāyante hīnavarṇāsu te trayaḥ ।
kṣudro vaidehakādandhro bahirgrāmapratiśrayaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: AyogavIzu jAyante hInavarRAsu te trayaH । kzudro vEdehakAdanDro bahirgrAmapratiSrayaH ॥25॥

text: kārāvaro niṣādyāṃ tu carmakārātprajāyate । caṇḍālātpāṇḍusaupākastvaksāravyavahāravān ॥26॥
html:
kārāvaro niṣādyāṃ tu carmakārātprajāyate ।
caṇḍālātpāṇḍusaupākastvaksāravyavahāravān ॥26॥
slp1: kArAvaro nizAdyAM tu carmakArAtprajAyate । caRqAlAtpARqusOpAkastvaksAravyavahAravAn ॥26॥

text: āhiṇḍiko niṣādena vaidehyāṃ samprajāyate । caṇḍālena tu saupāko maudgalyasamavṛttimān ॥27॥
html:
āhiṇḍiko niṣādena vaidehyāṃ samprajāyate ।
caṇḍālena tu saupāko maudgalyasamavṛttimān ॥27॥
slp1: AhiRqiko nizAdena vEdehyAM samprajAyate । caRqAlena tu sOpAko mOdgalyasamavfttimAn ॥27॥

text: niṣādī cāpi caṇḍālātputramantāvasāyinam । śmaśānagocaraṃ sūte bāhyairapi bahiṣkṛtam ॥28॥
html:
niṣādī cāpi caṇḍālātputramantāvasāyinam ।
śmaśānagocaraṃ sūte bāhyairapi bahiṣkṛtam ॥28॥
slp1: nizAdI cApi caRqAlAtputramantAvasAyinam । SmaSAnagocaraM sUte bAhyErapi bahizkftam ॥28॥

text: ityetāḥ saṅkare jātyaḥ pitṛmātṛvyatikramāt । pracchannā vā prakāśā vā veditavyāḥ svakarmabhiḥ ॥29॥
html:
ityetāḥ saṅkare jātyaḥ pitṛmātṛvyatikramāt ।
pracchannā vā prakāśā vā veditavyāḥ svakarmabhiḥ ॥29॥
slp1: ityetAH saNkare jAtyaH pitfmAtfvyatikramAt । pracCannA vA prakASA vA veditavyAH svakarmaBiH ॥29॥

text: caturṇāmeva varṇānāṃ dharmo nānyasya vidyate । varṇānāṃ dharmahīneṣu sañjñā nāstīha kasyacit ॥30॥
html:
caturṇāmeva varṇānāṃ dharmo nānyasya vidyate ।
varṇānāṃ dharmahīneṣu sañjñā nāstīha kasyacit ॥30॥
slp1: caturRAmeva varRAnAM Darmo nAnyasya vidyate । varRAnAM DarmahInezu saYjYA nAstIha kasyacit ॥30॥

text: yadṛcchayopasampannairyajñasādhubahiṣkṛtaiḥ । bāhyā bāhyaistu jāyante yathāvṛtti yathāśrayam ॥31॥
html:
yadṛcchayopasampannairyajñasādhubahiṣkṛtaiḥ ।
bāhyā bāhyaistu jāyante yathāvṛtti yathāśrayam ॥31॥
slp1: yadfcCayopasampannEryajYasADubahizkftEH । bAhyA bAhyEstu jAyante yaTAvftti yaTASrayam ॥31॥

text: catuṣpathaśmaśānāni śailāṃścānyānvanaspatīn । yuñjante cāpyalaṅkārāṃstathopakaraṇāni ca ॥32॥
html:
catuṣpathaśmaśānāni śailāṃścānyānvanaspatīn ।
yuñjante cāpyalaṅkārāṃstathopakaraṇāni ca ॥32॥
slp1: catuzpaTaSmaSAnAni SElAMScAnyAnvanaspatIn । yuYjante cApyalaNkArAMstaTopakaraRAni ca ॥32॥

text: gobrāhmaṇārthe sāhāyyaṃ kurvāṇā vai na saṃśayaḥ । ānṛśaṃsyamanukrośaḥ satyavākyamatha kṣamā ॥33॥
html:
gobrāhmaṇārthe sāhāyyaṃ kurvāṇā vai na saṃśayaḥ ।
ānṛśaṃsyamanukrośaḥ satyavākyamatha kṣamā ॥33॥
slp1: gobrAhmaRArTe sAhAyyaM kurvARA vE na saMSayaH । AnfSaMsyamanukroSaH satyavAkyamaTa kzamA ॥33॥

text: svaśarīraiḥ paritrāṇaṃ bāhyānāṃ siddhikārakam । manujavyāghra bhavati tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ॥34॥
html:
svaśarīraiḥ paritrāṇaṃ bāhyānāṃ siddhikārakam ।
manujavyāghra bhavati tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: svaSarIrEH paritrARaM bAhyAnAM sidDikArakam । manujavyAGra Bavati tatra me nAsti saMSayaH ॥34॥

text: yathopadeśaṃ parikīrtitāsu naraḥ prajāyeta vicārya buddhimān । vihīnayonirhi suto'vasādayettitīrṣamāṇaṃ salile yathopalam ॥35॥
html:
yathopadeśaṃ parikīrtitāsu naraḥ prajāyeta vicārya buddhimān ।
vihīnayonirhi suto'vasādayettitīrṣamāṇaṃ salile yathopalam ॥35॥
slp1: yaTopadeSaM parikIrtitAsu naraH prajAyeta vicArya budDimAn । vihInayonirhi suto'vasAdayettitIrzamARaM salile yaTopalam ॥35॥

text: avidvāṃsamalaṃ loke vidvāṃsamapi vā punaḥ । nayante hyutpathaṃ nāryaḥ kāmakrodhavaśānugam ॥36॥
html:
avidvāṃsamalaṃ loke vidvāṃsamapi vā punaḥ ।
nayante hyutpathaṃ nāryaḥ kāmakrodhavaśānugam ॥36॥
slp1: avidvAMsamalaM loke vidvAMsamapi vA punaH । nayante hyutpaTaM nAryaH kAmakroDavaSAnugam ॥36॥

text: svabhāvaścaiva nārīṇāṃ narāṇāmiha dūṣaṇam । ityarthaṃ na prasajjante pramadāsu vipaścitaḥ ॥37॥
html:
svabhāvaścaiva nārīṇāṃ narāṇāmiha dūṣaṇam ।
ityarthaṃ na prasajjante pramadāsu vipaścitaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: svaBAvaScEva nArIRAM narARAmiha dUzaRam । ityarTaM na prasajjante pramadAsu vipaScitaH ॥37॥

text: varṇāpetamavijñātaṃ naraṃ kaluṣayonijam । āryarūpamivānāryaṃ kathaṃ vidyāmahe nṛpa ॥38॥
html:
varṇāpetamavijñātaṃ naraṃ kaluṣayonijam ।
āryarūpamivānāryaṃ kathaṃ vidyāmahe nṛpa ॥38॥
slp1: varRApetamavijYAtaM naraM kaluzayonijam । AryarUpamivAnAryaM kaTaM vidyAmahe nfpa ॥38॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yonisaṅkaluṣe jātaṃ nānācārasamāhitam । karmabhiḥ sajjanācīrṇairvijñeyā yoniśuddhatā ॥39॥
html:
yonisaṅkaluṣe jātaṃ nānācārasamāhitam ।
karmabhiḥ sajjanācīrṇairvijñeyā yoniśuddhatā ॥39॥
slp1: yonisaNkaluze jAtaM nAnAcArasamAhitam । karmaBiH sajjanAcIrRErvijYeyA yoniSudDatA ॥39॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: anāryatvamanācāraḥ krūratvaṃ niṣkriyātmatā । puruṣaṃ vyañjayantīha loke kaluṣayonijam ॥40॥
html:
anāryatvamanācāraḥ krūratvaṃ niṣkriyātmatā ।
puruṣaṃ vyañjayantīha loke kaluṣayonijam ॥40॥
slp1: anAryatvamanAcAraH krUratvaM nizkriyAtmatA । puruzaM vyaYjayantIha loke kaluzayonijam ॥40॥

text: pitryaṃ vā bhajate śīlaṃ mātṛjaṃ vā tathobhayam । na kathañcana saṅkīrṇaḥ prakṛtiṃ svāṃ niyacchati ॥41॥
html:
pitryaṃ vā bhajate śīlaṃ mātṛjaṃ vā tathobhayam ।
na kathañcana saṅkīrṇaḥ prakṛtiṃ svāṃ niyacchati ॥41॥
slp1: pitryaM vA Bajate SIlaM mAtfjaM vA taToBayam । na kaTaYcana saNkIrRaH prakftiM svAM niyacCati ॥41॥

text: yathaiva sadṛśo rūpe mātāpitrorhi jāyate । vyāghraścitraistathā yoniṃ puruṣaḥ svāṃ niyacchati ॥42॥
html:
yathaiva sadṛśo rūpe mātāpitrorhi jāyate ।
vyāghraścitraistathā yoniṃ puruṣaḥ svāṃ niyacchati ॥42॥
slp1: yaTEva sadfSo rUpe mAtApitrorhi jAyate । vyAGraScitrEstaTA yoniM puruzaH svAM niyacCati ॥42॥

text: kulasrotasi sañchanne yasya syādyonisaṅkaraḥ । saṃśrayatyeva tacchīlaṃ naro'lpamapi vā bahu ॥43॥
html:
kulasrotasi sañchanne yasya syādyonisaṅkaraḥ ।
saṃśrayatyeva tacchīlaṃ naro'lpamapi vā bahu ॥43॥
slp1: kulasrotasi saYCanne yasya syAdyonisaNkaraH । saMSrayatyeva tacCIlaM naro'lpamapi vA bahu ॥43॥

text: āryarūpasamācāraṃ carantaṃ kṛtake pathi । svavarṇamanyavarṇaṃ vā svaśīlaṃ śāsti niścaye ॥44॥
html:
āryarūpasamācāraṃ carantaṃ kṛtake pathi ।
svavarṇamanyavarṇaṃ vā svaśīlaṃ śāsti niścaye ॥44॥
slp1: AryarUpasamAcAraM carantaM kftake paTi । svavarRamanyavarRaM vA svaSIlaM SAsti niScaye ॥44॥

text: nānāvṛtteṣu bhūteṣu nānākarmarateṣu ca । janmavṛttasamaṃ loke suśliṣṭaṃ na virajyate ॥45॥
html:
nānāvṛtteṣu bhūteṣu nānākarmarateṣu ca ।
janmavṛttasamaṃ loke suśliṣṭaṃ na virajyate ॥45॥
slp1: nAnAvfttezu BUtezu nAnAkarmaratezu ca । janmavfttasamaM loke suSlizwaM na virajyate ॥45॥

text: śarīramiha sattvena narasya parikṛṣyate । jyeṣṭhamadhyāvaraṃ sattvaṃ tulyasattvaṃ pramodate ॥46॥
html:
śarīramiha sattvena narasya parikṛṣyate ।
jyeṣṭhamadhyāvaraṃ sattvaṃ tulyasattvaṃ pramodate ॥46॥
slp1: SarIramiha sattvena narasya parikfzyate । jyezWamaDyAvaraM sattvaM tulyasattvaM pramodate ॥46॥

text: jyāyāṃsamapi śīlena vihīnaṃ naiva pūjayet । api śūdraṃ tu sadvṛttaṃ dharmajñamabhipūjayet ॥47॥
html:
jyāyāṃsamapi śīlena vihīnaṃ naiva pūjayet ।
api śūdraṃ tu sadvṛttaṃ dharmajñamabhipūjayet ॥47॥
slp1: jyAyAMsamapi SIlena vihInaM nEva pUjayet । api SUdraM tu sadvfttaM DarmajYamaBipUjayet ॥47॥

text: ātmānamākhyāti hi karmabhirnaraḥ svaśīlacāritrakṛtaiḥ śubhāśubhaiḥ । pranaṣṭamapyātmakulaṃ tathā naraḥ punaḥ prakāśaṃ kurute svakarmabhiḥ ॥48॥
html:
ātmānamākhyāti hi karmabhirnaraḥ svaśīlacāritrakṛtaiḥ śubhāśubhaiḥ ।
pranaṣṭamapyātmakulaṃ tathā naraḥ punaḥ prakāśaṃ kurute svakarmabhiḥ ॥48॥
slp1: AtmAnamAKyAti hi karmaBirnaraH svaSIlacAritrakftEH SuBASuBEH । pranazwamapyAtmakulaM taTA naraH punaH prakASaM kurute svakarmaBiH ॥48॥

text: yoniṣvetāsu sarvāsu saṅkīrṇāsvitarāsu ca । yatrātmānaṃ na janayedbudhastāḥ parivarjayet] ॥49॥
html:
yoniṣvetāsu sarvāsu saṅkīrṇāsvitarāsu ca ।
yatrātmānaṃ na janayedbudhastāḥ parivarjayet] ॥49॥
slp1: yonizvetAsu sarvAsu saNkIrRAsvitarAsu ca । yatrAtmAnaM na janayedbuDastAH parivarjayet] ॥49॥

text: brūhi putrānkuruśreṣṭha varṇānāṃ tvaṃ pṛthakpṛthak । kīdṛśyāṃ kīdṛśāścāpi putrāḥ kasya ca ke ca te ॥1॥
html:
brūhi putrānkuruśreṣṭha varṇānāṃ tvaṃ pṛthakpṛthak ।
kīdṛśyāṃ kīdṛśāścāpi putrāḥ kasya ca ke ca te ॥1॥
slp1: brUhi putrAnkuruSrezWa varRAnAM tvaM pfTakpfTak । kIdfSyAM kIdfSAScApi putrAH kasya ca ke ca te ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: vipravādāḥ subahuśaḥ śrūyante putrakāritāḥ । atra no muhyatāṃ rājansaṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi ॥2॥
html:
vipravādāḥ subahuśaḥ śrūyante putrakāritāḥ ।
atra no muhyatāṃ rājansaṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi ॥2॥
slp1: vipravAdAH subahuSaH SrUyante putrakAritAH । atra no muhyatAM rAjansaMSayaM Cettumarhasi ॥2॥

text: ātmā putrastu vijñeyastasyānantarajaśca yaḥ । niyuktajaśca vijñeyaḥ sutaḥ prasṛtajastathā ॥3॥
html:
ātmā putrastu vijñeyastasyānantarajaśca yaḥ ।
niyuktajaśca vijñeyaḥ sutaḥ prasṛtajastathā ॥3॥
slp1: AtmA putrastu vijYeyastasyAnantarajaSca yaH । niyuktajaSca vijYeyaH sutaH prasftajastaTA ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: patitasya ca bhāryāyāṃ bhartrā susamavetayā । tathā dattakṛtau putrāvadhyūḍhaśca tathāparaḥ ॥4॥
html:
patitasya ca bhāryāyāṃ bhartrā susamavetayā ।
tathā dattakṛtau putrāvadhyūḍhaśca tathāparaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: patitasya ca BAryAyAM BartrA susamavetayA । taTA dattakftO putrAvaDyUQaSca taTAparaH ॥4॥

text: ṣaḍapadhvaṃsajāścāpi kānīnāpasadāstathā । ityete te samākhyātāstānvijānīhi bhārata ॥5॥
html:
ṣaḍapadhvaṃsajāścāpi kānīnāpasadāstathā ।
ityete te samākhyātāstānvijānīhi bhārata ॥5॥
slp1: zaqapaDvaMsajAScApi kAnInApasadAstaTA । ityete te samAKyAtAstAnvijAnIhi BArata ॥5॥

text: ṣaḍapadhvaṃsajāḥ ke syuḥ ke vāpyapasadāstathā । etatsarvaṃ yathātattvaṃ vyākhyātuṃ me tvamarhasi ॥6॥
html:
ṣaḍapadhvaṃsajāḥ ke syuḥ ke vāpyapasadāstathā ।
etatsarvaṃ yathātattvaṃ vyākhyātuṃ me tvamarhasi ॥6॥
slp1: zaqapaDvaMsajAH ke syuH ke vApyapasadAstaTA । etatsarvaM yaTAtattvaM vyAKyAtuM me tvamarhasi ॥6॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: triṣu varṇeṣu ye putrā brāhmaṇasya yudhiṣṭhira । varṇayośca dvayoḥ syātāṃ yau rājanyasya bhārata ॥7॥
html:
triṣu varṇeṣu ye putrā brāhmaṇasya yudhiṣṭhira ।
varṇayośca dvayoḥ syātāṃ yau rājanyasya bhārata ॥7॥
slp1: trizu varRezu ye putrA brAhmaRasya yuDizWira । varRayoSca dvayoH syAtAM yO rAjanyasya BArata ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: eko dvivarṇa evātha tathātraivopalakṣitaḥ । ṣaḍapadhvaṃsajāste hi tathaivāpasadāñśṛṇu ॥8॥
html:
eko dvivarṇa evātha tathātraivopalakṣitaḥ ।
ṣaḍapadhvaṃsajāste hi tathaivāpasadāñśṛṇu ॥8॥
slp1: eko dvivarRa evATa taTAtrEvopalakzitaH । zaqapaDvaMsajAste hi taTEvApasadAYSfRu ॥8॥

text: caṇḍālo vrātyavenau ca brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyāsu ca । vaiśyāyāṃ caiva śūdrasya lakṣyante'pasadāstrayaḥ ॥9॥
html:
caṇḍālo vrātyavenau ca brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyāsu ca ।
vaiśyāyāṃ caiva śūdrasya lakṣyante'pasadāstrayaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: caRqAlo vrAtyavenO ca brAhmaRyAM kzatriyAsu ca । vESyAyAM cEva SUdrasya lakzyante'pasadAstrayaH ॥9॥

text: māgadho vāmakaścaiva dvau vaiśyasyopalakṣitau । brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyāyāṃ ca kṣatriyasyaika eva tu ॥10॥
html:
māgadho vāmakaścaiva dvau vaiśyasyopalakṣitau ।
brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyāyāṃ ca kṣatriyasyaika eva tu ॥10॥
slp1: mAgaDo vAmakaScEva dvO vESyasyopalakzitO । brAhmaRyAM kzatriyAyAM ca kzatriyasyEka eva tu ॥10॥

text: brāhmaṇyāṃ lakṣyate sūta ityete'pasadāḥ smṛtāḥ । putrareto na śakyaṃ hi mithyā kartuṃ narādhipa ॥11॥
html:
brāhmaṇyāṃ lakṣyate sūta ityete'pasadāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
putrareto na śakyaṃ hi mithyā kartuṃ narādhipa ॥11॥
slp1: brAhmaRyAM lakzyate sUta ityete'pasadAH smftAH । putrareto na SakyaM hi miTyA kartuM narADipa ॥11॥

text: kṣetrajaṃ kecidevāhuḥ sutaṃ kecittu śukrajam । tulyāvetau sutau kasya tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥12॥
html:
kṣetrajaṃ kecidevāhuḥ sutaṃ kecittu śukrajam ।
tulyāvetau sutau kasya tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥12॥
slp1: kzetrajaM kecidevAhuH sutaM kecittu Sukrajam । tulyAvetO sutO kasya tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥12॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: retajo vā bhavetputrastyakto vā kṣetrajo bhavet । adhyūḍhaḥ samayaṃ bhittvetyetadeva nibodha me ॥13॥
html:
retajo vā bhavetputrastyakto vā kṣetrajo bhavet ।
adhyūḍhaḥ samayaṃ bhittvetyetadeva nibodha me ॥13॥
slp1: retajo vA Bavetputrastyakto vA kzetrajo Bavet । aDyUQaH samayaM Bittvetyetadeva niboDa me ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: retojaṃ vidma vai putraṃ kṣetrajasyāgamaḥ katham । adhyūḍhaṃ vidma vai putraṃ hitvā ca samayaṃ katham ॥14॥
html:
retojaṃ vidma vai putraṃ kṣetrajasyāgamaḥ katham ।
adhyūḍhaṃ vidma vai putraṃ hitvā ca samayaṃ katham ॥14॥
slp1: retojaM vidma vE putraM kzetrajasyAgamaH kaTam । aDyUQaM vidma vE putraM hitvA ca samayaM kaTam ॥14॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ātmajaṃ putramutpādya yastyajetkāraṇāntare । na tatra kāraṇaṃ retaḥ sa kṣetrasvāmino bhavet ॥15॥
html:
ātmajaṃ putramutpādya yastyajetkāraṇāntare ।
na tatra kāraṇaṃ retaḥ sa kṣetrasvāmino bhavet ॥15॥
slp1: AtmajaM putramutpAdya yastyajetkAraRAntare । na tatra kAraRaM retaH sa kzetrasvAmino Bavet ॥15॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: putrakāmo hi putrārthe yāṃ vṛṇīte viśāṃ pate । tatra kṣetraṃ pramāṇaṃ syānna vai tatrātmajaḥ sutaḥ ॥16॥
html:
putrakāmo hi putrārthe yāṃ vṛṇīte viśāṃ pate ।
tatra kṣetraṃ pramāṇaṃ syānna vai tatrātmajaḥ sutaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: putrakAmo hi putrArTe yAM vfRIte viSAM pate । tatra kzetraM pramARaM syAnna vE tatrAtmajaH sutaH ॥16॥

text: anyatra kṣetrajaḥ putro lakṣyate bharatarṣabha । na hyātmā śakyate hantuṃ dṛṣṭāntopagato hyasau ॥17॥
html:
anyatra kṣetrajaḥ putro lakṣyate bharatarṣabha ।
na hyātmā śakyate hantuṃ dṛṣṭāntopagato hyasau ॥17॥
slp1: anyatra kzetrajaH putro lakzyate BaratarzaBa । na hyAtmA Sakyate hantuM dfzwAntopagato hyasO ॥17॥

text: kaścicca kṛtakaḥ putraḥ saṅgrahādeva lakṣyate । na tatra retaḥ kṣetraṃ vā pramāṇaṃ syādyudhiṣṭhira ॥18॥
html:
kaścicca kṛtakaḥ putraḥ saṅgrahādeva lakṣyate ।
na tatra retaḥ kṣetraṃ vā pramāṇaṃ syādyudhiṣṭhira ॥18॥
slp1: kaScicca kftakaH putraH saNgrahAdeva lakzyate । na tatra retaH kzetraM vA pramARaM syAdyuDizWira ॥18॥

text: kīdṛśaḥ kṛtakaḥ putraḥ saṅgrahādeva lakṣyate । śukraṃ kṣetraṃ pramāṇaṃ vā yatra lakṣyeta bhārata ॥19॥
html:
kīdṛśaḥ kṛtakaḥ putraḥ saṅgrahādeva lakṣyate ।
śukraṃ kṣetraṃ pramāṇaṃ vā yatra lakṣyeta bhārata ॥19॥
slp1: kIdfSaH kftakaH putraH saNgrahAdeva lakzyate । SukraM kzetraM pramARaM vA yatra lakzyeta BArata ॥19॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mātāpitṛbhyāṃ santyaktaṃ pathi yaṃ tu pralakṣayet । na cāsya mātāpitarau jñāyete sa hi kṛtrimaḥ ॥20॥
html:
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ santyaktaṃ pathi yaṃ tu pralakṣayet ।
na cāsya mātāpitarau jñāyete sa hi kṛtrimaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: mAtApitfByAM santyaktaM paTi yaM tu pralakzayet । na cAsya mAtApitarO jYAyete sa hi kftrimaH ॥20॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: asvāmikasya svāmitvaṃ yasminsampratilakṣayet । savarṇastaṃ ca poṣeta savarṇastasya jāyate ॥21॥
html:
asvāmikasya svāmitvaṃ yasminsampratilakṣayet ।
savarṇastaṃ ca poṣeta savarṇastasya jāyate ॥21॥
slp1: asvAmikasya svAmitvaM yasminsampratilakzayet । savarRastaM ca pozeta savarRastasya jAyate ॥21॥

text: kathamasya prayoktavyaḥ saṃskāraḥ kasya vā katham । deyā kanyā kathaṃ ceti tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥22॥
html:
kathamasya prayoktavyaḥ saṃskāraḥ kasya vā katham ।
deyā kanyā kathaṃ ceti tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥22॥
slp1: kaTamasya prayoktavyaH saMskAraH kasya vA kaTam । deyA kanyA kaTaM ceti tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥22॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ātmavattasya kurvīta saṃskāraṃ svāmivattathā ॥23॥
html: ātmavattasya kurvīta saṃskāraṃ svāmivattathā ॥23॥
slp1: Atmavattasya kurvIta saMskAraM svAmivattaTA ॥23॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tyakto mātāpitṛbhyāṃ yaḥ savarṇaṃ pratipadyate । tadgotravarṇatastasya kuryātsaṃskāramacyuta ॥24॥
html:
tyakto mātāpitṛbhyāṃ yaḥ savarṇaṃ pratipadyate ।
tadgotravarṇatastasya kuryātsaṃskāramacyuta ॥24॥
slp1: tyakto mAtApitfByAM yaH savarRaM pratipadyate । tadgotravarRatastasya kuryAtsaMskAramacyuta ॥24॥

text: atha deyā tu kanyā syāttadvarṇena yudhiṣṭhira । saṃskartuṃ mātṛgotraṃ ca mātṛvarṇaviniścaye ॥25॥
html:
atha deyā tu kanyā syāttadvarṇena yudhiṣṭhira ।
saṃskartuṃ mātṛgotraṃ ca mātṛvarṇaviniścaye ॥25॥
slp1: aTa deyA tu kanyA syAttadvarRena yuDizWira । saMskartuM mAtfgotraM ca mAtfvarRaviniScaye ॥25॥

text: kānīnādhyūḍhajau cāpi vijñeyau putrakilbiṣau । tāvapi svāviva sutau saṃskāryāviti niścayaḥ ॥26॥
html:
kānīnādhyūḍhajau cāpi vijñeyau putrakilbiṣau ।
tāvapi svāviva sutau saṃskāryāviti niścayaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: kAnInADyUQajO cApi vijYeyO putrakilbizO । tAvapi svAviva sutO saMskAryAviti niScayaH ॥26॥

text: kṣetrajo vāpyapasado ye'dhyūḍhāsteṣu cāpyatha । ātmavadvai prayuñjīransaṃskāraṃ brāhmaṇādayaḥ ॥27॥
html:
kṣetrajo vāpyapasado ye'dhyūḍhāsteṣu cāpyatha ।
ātmavadvai prayuñjīransaṃskāraṃ brāhmaṇādayaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: kzetrajo vApyapasado ye'DyUQAstezu cApyaTa । AtmavadvE prayuYjIransaMskAraM brAhmaRAdayaH ॥27॥

text: dharmaśāstreṣu varṇānāṃ niścayo'yaṃ pradṛśyate । etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥28॥
html:
dharmaśāstreṣu varṇānāṃ niścayo'yaṃ pradṛśyate ।
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥28॥
slp1: DarmaSAstrezu varRAnAM niScayo'yaM pradfSyate । etatte sarvamAKyAtaM kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi] ॥28॥

text: darśane kīdṛśaḥ snehaḥ saṃvāse ca pitāmaha । mahābhāgyaṃ gavāṃ caiva tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
darśane kīdṛśaḥ snehaḥ saṃvāse ca pitāmaha ।
mahābhāgyaṃ gavāṃ caiva tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: darSane kIdfSaH snehaH saMvAse ca pitAmaha । mahABAgyaM gavAM cEva tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ mahādyute । nahuṣasya ca saṃvādaṃ maharṣeścyavanasya ca ॥2॥
html:
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ mahādyute ।
nahuṣasya ca saṃvādaṃ maharṣeścyavanasya ca ॥2॥
slp1: hanta te kaTayizyAmi purAvfttaM mahAdyute । nahuzasya ca saMvAdaM maharzeScyavanasya ca ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: purā maharṣiścyavano bhārgavo bharatarṣabha । udavāsakṛtārambho babhūva sumahāvrataḥ ॥3॥
html:
purā maharṣiścyavano bhārgavo bharatarṣabha ।
udavāsakṛtārambho babhūva sumahāvrataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: purA maharziScyavano BArgavo BaratarzaBa । udavAsakftAramBo baBUva sumahAvrataH ॥3॥

text: nihatya mānaṃ krodhaṃ ca praharṣaṃ śokameva ca । varṣāṇi dvādaśa munirjalavāse dhṛtavrataḥ ॥4॥
html:
nihatya mānaṃ krodhaṃ ca praharṣaṃ śokameva ca ।
varṣāṇi dvādaśa munirjalavāse dhṛtavrataḥ ॥4॥
slp1: nihatya mAnaM kroDaM ca praharzaM Sokameva ca । varzARi dvAdaSa munirjalavAse DftavrataH ॥4॥

text: ādadhatsarvabhūteṣu visrambhaṃ paramaṃ śubham । jalecareṣu sattveṣu śītaraśmiriva prabhuḥ ॥5॥
html:
ādadhatsarvabhūteṣu visrambhaṃ paramaṃ śubham ।
jalecareṣu sattveṣu śītaraśmiriva prabhuḥ ॥5॥
slp1: AdaDatsarvaBUtezu visramBaM paramaM SuBam । jalecarezu sattvezu SItaraSmiriva praBuH ॥5॥

text: sthāṇubhūtaḥ śucirbhūtvā daivatebhyaḥ praṇamya ca । gaṅgāyamunayormadhye jalaṃ sampraviveśa ha ॥6॥
html:
sthāṇubhūtaḥ śucirbhūtvā daivatebhyaḥ praṇamya ca ।
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye jalaṃ sampraviveśa ha ॥6॥
slp1: sTARuBUtaH SucirBUtvA dEvateByaH praRamya ca । gaNgAyamunayormaDye jalaM sampraviveSa ha ॥6॥

text: gaṅgāyamunayorvegaṃ subhīmaṃ bhīmaniḥsvanam । pratijagrāha śirasā vātavegasamaṃ jave ॥7॥
html:
gaṅgāyamunayorvegaṃ subhīmaṃ bhīmaniḥsvanam ।
pratijagrāha śirasā vātavegasamaṃ jave ॥7॥
slp1: gaNgAyamunayorvegaM suBImaM BImaniHsvanam । pratijagrAha SirasA vAtavegasamaM jave ॥7॥

text: gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva saritaścānugāstayoḥ । pradakṣiṇamṛṣiṃ cakrurna cainaṃ paryapīḍayan ॥8॥
html:
gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva saritaścānugāstayoḥ ।
pradakṣiṇamṛṣiṃ cakrurna cainaṃ paryapīḍayan ॥8॥
slp1: gaNgA ca yamunA cEva saritaScAnugAstayoH । pradakziRamfziM cakrurna cEnaM paryapIqayan ॥8॥

text: antarjale sa suṣvāpa kāṣṭhabhūto mahāmuniḥ । tataścordhvasthito dhīmānabhavadbharatarṣabha ॥9॥
html:
antarjale sa suṣvāpa kāṣṭhabhūto mahāmuniḥ ।
tataścordhvasthito dhīmānabhavadbharatarṣabha ॥9॥
slp1: antarjale sa suzvApa kAzWaBUto mahAmuniH । tataScorDvasTito DImAnaBavadBaratarzaBa ॥9॥

text: jalaukasāṃ sa sattvānāṃ babhūva priyadarśanaḥ । upājighranta ca tadā matsyāstaṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ । tatra tasyāsataḥ kālaḥ samatīto'bhavanmahān ॥10॥
html:
jalaukasāṃ sa sattvānāṃ babhūva priyadarśanaḥ ।
upājighranta ca tadā matsyāstaṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।
tatra tasyāsataḥ kālaḥ samatīto'bhavanmahān ॥10॥
slp1: jalOkasAM sa sattvAnAM baBUva priyadarSanaH । upAjiGranta ca tadA matsyAstaM hfzwamAnasAH । tatra tasyAsataH kAlaH samatIto'BavanmahAn ॥10॥

text: tataḥ kadācitsamaye kasmiṃścinmatsyajīvinaḥ । taṃ deśaṃ samupājagmurjālahastā mahādyute ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ kadācitsamaye kasmiṃścinmatsyajīvinaḥ ।
taṃ deśaṃ samupājagmurjālahastā mahādyute ॥11॥
slp1: tataH kadAcitsamaye kasmiMScinmatsyajIvinaH । taM deSaM samupAjagmurjAlahastA mahAdyute ॥11॥

text: niṣādā bahavastatra matsyoddharaṇaniścitāḥ । vyāyatā balinaḥ śūrāḥ salileṣvanivartinaḥ । abhyāyayuśca taṃ deśaṃ niścitā jālakarmaṇi ॥12॥
html:
niṣādā bahavastatra matsyoddharaṇaniścitāḥ ।
vyāyatā balinaḥ śūrāḥ salileṣvanivartinaḥ ।
abhyāyayuśca taṃ deśaṃ niścitā jālakarmaṇi ॥12॥
slp1: nizAdA bahavastatra matsyodDaraRaniScitAH । vyAyatA balinaH SUrAH salilezvanivartinaH । aByAyayuSca taM deSaM niScitA jAlakarmaRi ॥12॥

text: jālaṃ ca yojayāmāsurviśeṣeṇa janādhipa । matsyodakaṃ samāsādya tadā bharatasattama ॥13॥
html:
jālaṃ ca yojayāmāsurviśeṣeṇa janādhipa ।
matsyodakaṃ samāsādya tadā bharatasattama ॥13॥
slp1: jAlaM ca yojayAmAsurviSezeRa janADipa । matsyodakaM samAsAdya tadA Baratasattama ॥13॥

text: tataste bahubhiryogaiḥ kaivartā matsyakāṅkṣiṇaḥ । gaṅgāyamunayorvāri jālairabhyakiraṃstataḥ ॥14॥
html:
tataste bahubhiryogaiḥ kaivartā matsyakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।
gaṅgāyamunayorvāri jālairabhyakiraṃstataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tataste bahuBiryogEH kEvartA matsyakANkziRaH । gaNgAyamunayorvAri jAlEraByakiraMstataH ॥14॥

text: jālaṃ suvitataṃ teṣāṃ navasūtrakṛtaṃ tathā । vistārāyāmasampannaṃ yattatra salile kṣamam ॥15॥
html:
jālaṃ suvitataṃ teṣāṃ navasūtrakṛtaṃ tathā ।
vistārāyāmasampannaṃ yattatra salile kṣamam ॥15॥
slp1: jAlaM suvitataM tezAM navasUtrakftaM taTA । vistArAyAmasampannaM yattatra salile kzamam ॥15॥

text: tataste sumahaccaiva balavacca suvartitam । prakīrya sarvataḥ sarve jālaṃ cakṛṣire tadā ॥16॥
html:
tataste sumahaccaiva balavacca suvartitam ।
prakīrya sarvataḥ sarve jālaṃ cakṛṣire tadā ॥16॥
slp1: tataste sumahaccEva balavacca suvartitam । prakIrya sarvataH sarve jAlaM cakfzire tadA ॥16॥

text: abhītarūpāḥ saṃhṛṣṭāste'nyonyavaśavartinaḥ । babandhustatra matsyāṃśca tathānyāñjalacāriṇaḥ ॥17॥
html:
abhītarūpāḥ saṃhṛṣṭāste'nyonyavaśavartinaḥ ।
babandhustatra matsyāṃśca tathānyāñjalacāriṇaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: aBItarUpAH saMhfzwAste'nyonyavaSavartinaH । babanDustatra matsyAMSca taTAnyAYjalacAriRaH ॥17॥

text: tathā matsyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ cyavanaṃ bhṛgunandanam । ākarṣanta mahārāja jālenātha yadṛcchayā ॥18॥
html:
tathā matsyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ cyavanaṃ bhṛgunandanam ।
ākarṣanta mahārāja jālenātha yadṛcchayā ॥18॥
slp1: taTA matsyEH parivftaM cyavanaM Bfgunandanam । Akarzanta mahArAja jAlenATa yadfcCayA ॥18॥

text: nadīśaivaladigdhāṅgaṃ hariśmaśrujaṭādharam । lagnaiḥ śaṅkhagaṇairgātraiḥ koṣṭhaiścitrairivāvṛtam ॥19॥
html:
nadīśaivaladigdhāṅgaṃ hariśmaśrujaṭādharam ।
lagnaiḥ śaṅkhagaṇairgātraiḥ koṣṭhaiścitrairivāvṛtam ॥19॥
slp1: nadISEvaladigDANgaM hariSmaSrujawADaram । lagnEH SaNKagaRErgAtrEH kozWEScitrErivAvftam ॥19॥

text: taṃ jālenoddhṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā te tadā vedapāragam । sarve prāñjalayo dāśāḥ śirobhiḥ prāpatanbhuvi ॥20॥
html:
taṃ jālenoddhṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā te tadā vedapāragam ।
sarve prāñjalayo dāśāḥ śirobhiḥ prāpatanbhuvi ॥20॥
slp1: taM jAlenodDftaM dfzwvA te tadA vedapAragam । sarve prAYjalayo dASAH SiroBiH prApatanBuvi ॥20॥

text: parikhedaparitrāsājjālasyākarṣaṇena ca । matsyā babhūvurvyāpannāḥ sthalasaṅkarṣaṇena ca ॥21॥
html:
parikhedaparitrāsājjālasyākarṣaṇena ca ।
matsyā babhūvurvyāpannāḥ sthalasaṅkarṣaṇena ca ॥21॥
slp1: pariKedaparitrAsAjjAlasyAkarzaRena ca । matsyA baBUvurvyApannAH sTalasaNkarzaRena ca ॥21॥

text: sa munistattadā dṛṣṭvā matsyānāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtam । babhūva kṛpayāviṣṭo niḥśvasaṃśca punaḥ punaḥ ॥22॥
html:
sa munistattadā dṛṣṭvā matsyānāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtam ।
babhūva kṛpayāviṣṭo niḥśvasaṃśca punaḥ punaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: sa munistattadA dfzwvA matsyAnAM kadanaM kftam । baBUva kfpayAvizwo niHSvasaMSca punaH punaH ॥22॥

text: ajñānādyatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prasādaṃ tatra naḥ kuru । karavāma priyaṃ kiṃ te tanno brūhi mahāmune ॥23॥
html:
ajñānādyatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prasādaṃ tatra naḥ kuru ।
karavāma priyaṃ kiṃ te tanno brūhi mahāmune ॥23॥
slp1: ajYAnAdyatkftaM pApaM prasAdaM tatra naH kuru । karavAma priyaM kiM te tanno brUhi mahAmune ॥23॥
author: niṣādā ūcuḥ ।

text: ityukto matsyamadhyasthaścyavano vākyamabravīt । yo me'dya paramaḥ kāmastaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ ॥24॥
html:
ityukto matsyamadhyasthaścyavano vākyamabravīt ।
yo me'dya paramaḥ kāmastaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: ityukto matsyamaDyasTaScyavano vAkyamabravIt । yo me'dya paramaH kAmastaM SfRuDvaM samAhitAH ॥24॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prāṇotsargaṃ vikrayaṃ vā matsyairyāsyāmyahaṃ saha । saṃvāsānnotsahe tyaktuṃ salilādhyuṣitānimān ॥25॥
html:
prāṇotsargaṃ vikrayaṃ vā matsyairyāsyāmyahaṃ saha ।
saṃvāsānnotsahe tyaktuṃ salilādhyuṣitānimān ॥25॥
slp1: prARotsargaM vikrayaM vA matsyEryAsyAmyahaM saha । saMvAsAnnotsahe tyaktuM salilADyuzitAnimAn ॥25॥

text: ityuktāste niṣādāstu subhṛśaṃ bhayakampitāḥ । sarve viṣaṇṇavadanā nahuṣāya nyavedayan] ॥26॥
html:
ityuktāste niṣādāstu subhṛśaṃ bhayakampitāḥ ।
sarve viṣaṇṇavadanā nahuṣāya nyavedayan] ॥26॥
slp1: ityuktAste nizAdAstu suBfSaM BayakampitAH । sarve vizaRRavadanA nahuzAya nyavedayan] ॥26॥

text: nahuṣastu tataḥ śrutvā cyavanaṃ taṃ tathāgatam । tvaritaḥ prayayau tatra sahāmātyapurohitaḥ ॥1॥
html:
nahuṣastu tataḥ śrutvā cyavanaṃ taṃ tathāgatam ।
tvaritaḥ prayayau tatra sahāmātyapurohitaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: nahuzastu tataH SrutvA cyavanaM taM taTAgatam । tvaritaH prayayO tatra sahAmAtyapurohitaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ prāñjaliḥ prayato nṛpaḥ । ātmānamācacakṣe ca cyavanāya mahātmane ॥2॥
html:
śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ prāñjaliḥ prayato nṛpaḥ ।
ātmānamācacakṣe ca cyavanāya mahātmane ॥2॥
slp1: SOcaM kftvA yaTAnyAyaM prAYjaliH prayato nfpaH । AtmAnamAcacakze ca cyavanAya mahAtmane ॥2॥

text: arcayāmāsa taṃ cāpi tasya rājñaḥ purohitaḥ । satyavrataṃ mahābhāgaṃ devakalpaṃ viśāṃ pate ॥3॥
html:
arcayāmāsa taṃ cāpi tasya rājñaḥ purohitaḥ ।
satyavrataṃ mahābhāgaṃ devakalpaṃ viśāṃ pate ॥3॥
slp1: arcayAmAsa taM cApi tasya rAjYaH purohitaH । satyavrataM mahABAgaM devakalpaM viSAM pate ॥3॥

text: karavāṇi priyaṃ kiṃ te tanme vyākhyātumarhasi । sarvaṃ kartāsmi bhagavanyadyapi syātsuduṣkaram ॥4॥
html:
karavāṇi priyaṃ kiṃ te tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।
sarvaṃ kartāsmi bhagavanyadyapi syātsuduṣkaram ॥4॥
slp1: karavARi priyaM kiM te tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi । sarvaM kartAsmi Bagavanyadyapi syAtsuduzkaram ॥4॥
author: nahuṣa uvāca ।

text: śrameṇa mahatā yuktāḥ kaivartā matsyajīvinaḥ । mama mūlyaṃ prayacchaibhyo matsyānāṃ vikrayaiḥ saha ॥5॥
html:
śrameṇa mahatā yuktāḥ kaivartā matsyajīvinaḥ ।
mama mūlyaṃ prayacchaibhyo matsyānāṃ vikrayaiḥ saha ॥5॥
slp1: SrameRa mahatA yuktAH kEvartA matsyajIvinaH । mama mUlyaM prayacCEByo matsyAnAM vikrayEH saha ॥5॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: sahasraṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ niṣādebhyaḥ purohita । niṣkrayārthaṃ bhagavato yathāha bhṛgunandanaḥ ॥6॥
html:
sahasraṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ niṣādebhyaḥ purohita ।
niṣkrayārthaṃ bhagavato yathāha bhṛgunandanaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: sahasraM dIyatAM mUlyaM nizAdeByaH purohita । nizkrayArTaM Bagavato yaTAha BfgunandanaH ॥6॥
author: nahuṣa uvāca ।

text: sahasraṃ nāhamarhāmi kiṃ vā tvaṃ manyase nṛpa । sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ svabuddhyā niścayaṃ kuru ॥7॥
html:
sahasraṃ nāhamarhāmi kiṃ vā tvaṃ manyase nṛpa ।
sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ svabuddhyā niścayaṃ kuru ॥7॥
slp1: sahasraM nAhamarhAmi kiM vA tvaM manyase nfpa । sadfSaM dIyatAM mUlyaM svabudDyA niScayaM kuru ॥7॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ kṣipraṃ niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām । syādetattu bhavenmūlyaṃ kiṃ vānyanmanyate bhavān ॥8॥
html:
sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ kṣipraṃ niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām ।
syādetattu bhavenmūlyaṃ kiṃ vānyanmanyate bhavān ॥8॥
slp1: sahasrARAM SataM kzipraM nizAdeByaH pradIyatAm । syAdetattu BavenmUlyaM kiM vAnyanmanyate BavAn ॥8॥
author: nahuṣa uvāca ।

text: nāhaṃ śatasahasreṇa nimeyaḥ pārthivarṣabha । dīyatāṃ sadṛśaṃ mūlyamamātyaiḥ saha cintaya ॥9॥
html:
nāhaṃ śatasahasreṇa nimeyaḥ pārthivarṣabha ।
dīyatāṃ sadṛśaṃ mūlyamamātyaiḥ saha cintaya ॥9॥
slp1: nAhaM SatasahasreRa nimeyaH pArTivarzaBa । dIyatAM sadfSaM mUlyamamAtyEH saha cintaya ॥9॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: koṭiḥ pradīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ niṣādebhyaḥ purohita । yadetadapi naupamyamato bhūyaḥ pradīyatām ॥10॥
html:
koṭiḥ pradīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ niṣādebhyaḥ purohita ।
yadetadapi naupamyamato bhūyaḥ pradīyatām ॥10॥
slp1: kowiH pradIyatAM mUlyaM nizAdeByaH purohita । yadetadapi nOpamyamato BUyaH pradIyatAm ॥10॥
author: nahuṣa uvāca ।

text: rājannārhāmyahaṃ koṭiṃ bhūyo vāpi mahādyute । sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha cintaya ॥11॥
html:
rājannārhāmyahaṃ koṭiṃ bhūyo vāpi mahādyute ।
sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha cintaya ॥11॥
slp1: rAjannArhAmyahaM kowiM BUyo vApi mahAdyute । sadfSaM dIyatAM mUlyaM brAhmaREH saha cintaya ॥11॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: ardharājyaṃ samagraṃ vā niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām । etanmūlyamahaṃ manye kiṃ vānyanmanyase dvija ॥12॥
html:
ardharājyaṃ samagraṃ vā niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām ।
etanmūlyamahaṃ manye kiṃ vānyanmanyase dvija ॥12॥
slp1: arDarAjyaM samagraM vA nizAdeByaH pradIyatAm । etanmUlyamahaM manye kiM vAnyanmanyase dvija ॥12॥
author: nahuṣa uvāca ।

text: ardharājyaṃ samagraṃ vā nāhamarhāmi pārthiva । sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyamṛṣibhiḥ saha cintyatām ॥13॥
html:
ardharājyaṃ samagraṃ vā nāhamarhāmi pārthiva ।
sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyamṛṣibhiḥ saha cintyatām ॥13॥
slp1: arDarAjyaM samagraM vA nAhamarhAmi pArTiva । sadfSaM dIyatAM mUlyamfziBiH saha cintyatAm ॥13॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: maharṣervacanaṃ śrutvā nahuṣo duḥkhakarśitaḥ । sa cintayāmāsa tadā sahāmātyapurohitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
maharṣervacanaṃ śrutvā nahuṣo duḥkhakarśitaḥ ।
sa cintayāmāsa tadā sahāmātyapurohitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: maharzervacanaM SrutvA nahuzo duHKakarSitaH । sa cintayAmAsa tadA sahAmAtyapurohitaH ॥14॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tatra tvanyo vanacaraḥ kaścinmūlaphalāśanaḥ । nahuṣasya samīpastho gavijāto'bhavanmuniḥ ॥15॥
html:
tatra tvanyo vanacaraḥ kaścinmūlaphalāśanaḥ ।
nahuṣasya samīpastho gavijāto'bhavanmuniḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tatra tvanyo vanacaraH kaScinmUlaPalASanaH । nahuzasya samIpasTo gavijAto'BavanmuniH ॥15॥

text: sa samābhāṣya rājānamabravīddvijasattamaḥ । toṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ vipraṃ yathā tuṣṭo bhaviṣyati ॥16॥
html:
sa samābhāṣya rājānamabravīddvijasattamaḥ ।
toṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ vipraṃ yathā tuṣṭo bhaviṣyati ॥16॥
slp1: sa samABAzya rAjAnamabravIddvijasattamaH । tozayizyAmyahaM vipraM yaTA tuzwo Bavizyati ॥16॥

text: nāhaṃ mithyāvaco brūyāṃ svaireṣvapi kuto'nyathā । bhavato yadahaṃ brūyāṃ tatkāryamaviśaṅkayā ॥17॥
html:
nāhaṃ mithyāvaco brūyāṃ svaireṣvapi kuto'nyathā ।
bhavato yadahaṃ brūyāṃ tatkāryamaviśaṅkayā ॥17॥
slp1: nAhaM miTyAvaco brUyAM svErezvapi kuto'nyaTA । Bavato yadahaM brUyAM tatkAryamaviSaNkayA ॥17॥

text: bravītu bhagavānmūlyaṃ maharṣeḥ sadṛśaṃ bhṛgoḥ । paritrāyasva māmasmādviṣayaṃ ca kulaṃ ca me ॥18॥
html:
bravītu bhagavānmūlyaṃ maharṣeḥ sadṛśaṃ bhṛgoḥ ।
paritrāyasva māmasmādviṣayaṃ ca kulaṃ ca me ॥18॥
slp1: bravItu BagavAnmUlyaM maharzeH sadfSaM BfgoH । paritrAyasva mAmasmAdvizayaM ca kulaM ca me ॥18॥
author: nahuṣa uvāca ।

text: hanyāddhi bhagavānkruddhastrailokyamapi kevalam । kiṃ punarmāṃ tapohīnaṃ bāhuvīryaparāyaṇam ॥19॥
html:
hanyāddhi bhagavānkruddhastrailokyamapi kevalam ।
kiṃ punarmāṃ tapohīnaṃ bāhuvīryaparāyaṇam ॥19॥
slp1: hanyAdDi BagavAnkrudDastrElokyamapi kevalam । kiM punarmAM tapohInaM bAhuvIryaparAyaRam ॥19॥

text: agādhe'mbhasi magnasya sāmātyasya sahartvijaḥ । plavo bhava maharṣe tvaṃ kuru mūlyaviniścayam ॥20॥
html:
agādhe'mbhasi magnasya sāmātyasya sahartvijaḥ ।
plavo bhava maharṣe tvaṃ kuru mūlyaviniścayam ॥20॥
slp1: agADe'mBasi magnasya sAmAtyasya sahartvijaH । plavo Bava maharze tvaM kuru mUlyaviniScayam ॥20॥

text: nahuṣasya vacaḥ śrutvā gavijātaḥ pratāpavān । uvāca harṣayansarvānamātyānpārthivaṃ ca tam ॥21॥
html:
nahuṣasya vacaḥ śrutvā gavijātaḥ pratāpavān ।
uvāca harṣayansarvānamātyānpārthivaṃ ca tam ॥21॥
slp1: nahuzasya vacaH SrutvA gavijAtaH pratApavAn । uvAca harzayansarvAnamAtyAnpArTivaM ca tam ॥21॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: anargheyā mahārāja dvijā varṇamahattamāḥ । gāvaśca pṛthivīpāla gaurmūlyaṃ parikalpyatām ॥22॥
html:
anargheyā mahārāja dvijā varṇamahattamāḥ ।
gāvaśca pṛthivīpāla gaurmūlyaṃ parikalpyatām ॥22॥
slp1: anarGeyA mahArAja dvijA varRamahattamAH । gAvaSca pfTivIpAla gOrmUlyaM parikalpyatAm ॥22॥

text: nahuṣastu tataḥ śrutvā maharṣervacanaṃ nṛpa । harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ sahāmātyapurohitaḥ ॥23॥
html:
nahuṣastu tataḥ śrutvā maharṣervacanaṃ nṛpa ।
harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ sahāmātyapurohitaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: nahuzastu tataH SrutvA maharzervacanaM nfpa । harzeRa mahatA yuktaH sahAmAtyapurohitaH ॥23॥

text: abhigamya bhṛgoḥ putraṃ cyavanaṃ saṃśitavratam । idaṃ provāca nṛpate vācā santarpayanniva ॥24॥
html:
abhigamya bhṛgoḥ putraṃ cyavanaṃ saṃśitavratam ।
idaṃ provāca nṛpate vācā santarpayanniva ॥24॥
slp1: aBigamya BfgoH putraM cyavanaM saMSitavratam । idaM provAca nfpate vAcA santarpayanniva ॥24॥

text: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha viprarṣe gavā krīto'si bhārgava । etanmūlyamahaṃ manye tava dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥25॥
html:
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha viprarṣe gavā krīto'si bhārgava ।
etanmūlyamahaṃ manye tava dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ॥25॥
slp1: uttizWottizWa viprarze gavA krIto'si BArgava । etanmUlyamahaM manye tava DarmaBftAM vara ॥25॥

text: uttiṣṭhāmyeṣa rājendra samyakkrīto'smi te'nagha । gobhistulyaṃ na paśyāmi dhanaṃ kiñcidihācyuta ॥26॥
html:
uttiṣṭhāmyeṣa rājendra samyakkrīto'smi te'nagha ।
gobhistulyaṃ na paśyāmi dhanaṃ kiñcidihācyuta ॥26॥
slp1: uttizWAmyeza rAjendra samyakkrIto'smi te'naGa । goBistulyaM na paSyAmi DanaM kiYcidihAcyuta ॥26॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ dānaṃ darśanaṃ cāpi pārthiva । gavāṃ praśasyate vīra sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam ॥27॥
html:
kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ dānaṃ darśanaṃ cāpi pārthiva ।
gavāṃ praśasyate vīra sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam ॥27॥
slp1: kIrtanaM SravaRaM dAnaM darSanaM cApi pArTiva । gavAM praSasyate vIra sarvapApaharaM Sivam ॥27॥

text: gāvo lakṣmyāḥ sadā mūlaṃ goṣu pāpmā na vidyate । annameva sadā gāvo devānāṃ paramaṃ haviḥ ॥28॥
html:
gāvo lakṣmyāḥ sadā mūlaṃ goṣu pāpmā na vidyate ।
annameva sadā gāvo devānāṃ paramaṃ haviḥ ॥28॥
slp1: gAvo lakzmyAH sadA mUlaM gozu pApmA na vidyate । annameva sadA gAvo devAnAM paramaM haviH ॥28॥

text: svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau goṣu nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitau । gāvo yajñapraṇetryo vai tathā yajñasya tā mukham ॥29॥
html:
svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau goṣu nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitau ।
gāvo yajñapraṇetryo vai tathā yajñasya tā mukham ॥29॥
slp1: svAhAkAravazawkArO gozu nityaM pratizWitO । gAvo yajYapraRetryo vE taTA yajYasya tA muKam ॥29॥

text: amṛtaṃ hyakṣayaṃ divyaṃ kṣaranti ca vahanti ca । amṛtāyatanaṃ caitāḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ ॥30॥
html:
amṛtaṃ hyakṣayaṃ divyaṃ kṣaranti ca vahanti ca ।
amṛtāyatanaṃ caitāḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: amftaM hyakzayaM divyaM kzaranti ca vahanti ca । amftAyatanaM cEtAH sarvalokanamaskftAH ॥30॥

text: tejasā vapuṣā caiva gāvo vahnisamā bhuvi । gāvo hi sumahattejaḥ prāṇināṃ ca sukhapradāḥ ॥31॥
html:
tejasā vapuṣā caiva gāvo vahnisamā bhuvi ।
gāvo hi sumahattejaḥ prāṇināṃ ca sukhapradāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tejasA vapuzA cEva gAvo vahnisamA Buvi । gAvo hi sumahattejaH prARinAM ca suKapradAH ॥31॥

text: niviṣṭaṃ gokulaṃ yatra śvāsaṃ muñcati nirbhayam । virājayati taṃ deśaṃ pāpmānaṃ cāpakarṣati ॥32॥
html:
niviṣṭaṃ gokulaṃ yatra śvāsaṃ muñcati nirbhayam ।
virājayati taṃ deśaṃ pāpmānaṃ cāpakarṣati ॥32॥
slp1: nivizwaM gokulaM yatra SvAsaM muYcati nirBayam । virAjayati taM deSaM pApmAnaM cApakarzati ॥32॥

text: gāvaḥ svargasya sopānaṃ gāvaḥ svarge'pi pūjitāḥ । gāvaḥ kāmadughā devyo nānyatkiñcitparaṃ smṛtam ॥33॥
html:
gāvaḥ svargasya sopānaṃ gāvaḥ svarge'pi pūjitāḥ ।
gāvaḥ kāmadughā devyo nānyatkiñcitparaṃ smṛtam ॥33॥
slp1: gAvaH svargasya sopAnaM gAvaH svarge'pi pUjitAH । gAvaH kAmaduGA devyo nAnyatkiYcitparaM smftam ॥33॥

text: ityetadgoṣu me proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ pārthivarṣabha । guṇaikadeśavacanaṃ śakyaṃ pārāyaṇaṃ na tu ॥34॥
html:
ityetadgoṣu me proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ pārthivarṣabha ।
guṇaikadeśavacanaṃ śakyaṃ pārāyaṇaṃ na tu ॥34॥
slp1: ityetadgozu me proktaM mAhAtmyaM pArTivarzaBa । guREkadeSavacanaM SakyaM pArAyaRaM na tu ॥34॥

text: darśanaṃ kathanaṃ caiva sahāsmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ mune । satāṃ saptapadaṃ mitraṃ prasādaṃ naḥ kuru prabho ॥35॥
html:
darśanaṃ kathanaṃ caiva sahāsmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ mune ।
satāṃ saptapadaṃ mitraṃ prasādaṃ naḥ kuru prabho ॥35॥
slp1: darSanaM kaTanaM cEva sahAsmABiH kftaM mune । satAM saptapadaM mitraM prasAdaM naH kuru praBo ॥35॥
author: niṣādā ūcuḥ ।

text: havīṃṣi sarvāṇi yathā hyupabhuṅkte hutāśanaḥ । evaṃ tvamapi dharmātmanpuruṣāgniḥ pratāpavān ॥36॥
html:
havīṃṣi sarvāṇi yathā hyupabhuṅkte hutāśanaḥ ।
evaṃ tvamapi dharmātmanpuruṣāgniḥ pratāpavān ॥36॥
slp1: havIMzi sarvARi yaTA hyupaBuNkte hutASanaH । evaM tvamapi DarmAtmanpuruzAgniH pratApavAn ॥36॥

text: prasādayāmahe vidvanbhavantaṃ praṇatā vayam । anugrahārthamasmākamiyaṃ gauḥ pratigṛhyatām ॥37॥
html:
prasādayāmahe vidvanbhavantaṃ praṇatā vayam ।
anugrahārthamasmākamiyaṃ gauḥ pratigṛhyatām ॥37॥
slp1: prasAdayAmahe vidvanBavantaM praRatA vayam । anugrahArTamasmAkamiyaM gOH pratigfhyatAm ॥37॥

text: kṛpaṇasya ca yaccakṣurmunerāśīviṣasya ca । naraṃ samūlaṃ dahati kakṣamagniriva jvalan ॥38॥
html:
kṛpaṇasya ca yaccakṣurmunerāśīviṣasya ca ।
naraṃ samūlaṃ dahati kakṣamagniriva jvalan ॥38॥
slp1: kfpaRasya ca yaccakzurmunerASIvizasya ca । naraM samUlaM dahati kakzamagniriva jvalan ॥38॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: pratigṛhṇāmi vo dhenuṃ kaivartā muktakilbiṣāḥ । divaṃ gacchata vai kṣipraṃ matsyairjāloddhṛtaiḥ saha ॥39॥
html:
pratigṛhṇāmi vo dhenuṃ kaivartā muktakilbiṣāḥ ।
divaṃ gacchata vai kṣipraṃ matsyairjāloddhṛtaiḥ saha ॥39॥
slp1: pratigfhRAmi vo DenuM kEvartA muktakilbizAH । divaM gacCata vE kzipraM matsyErjAlodDftEH saha ॥39॥

text: tatastasya prasādātte maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ । niṣādāstena vākyena saha matsyairdivaṃ yayuḥ ॥40॥
html:
tatastasya prasādātte maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ ।
niṣādāstena vākyena saha matsyairdivaṃ yayuḥ ॥40॥
slp1: tatastasya prasAdAtte maharzerBAvitAtmanaH । nizAdAstena vAkyena saha matsyErdivaM yayuH ॥40॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tataḥ sa rājā nahuṣo vismitaḥ prekṣya dhīvarān । ārohamāṇāṃstridivaṃ matsyāṃśca bharatarṣabha ॥41॥
html:
tataḥ sa rājā nahuṣo vismitaḥ prekṣya dhīvarān ।
ārohamāṇāṃstridivaṃ matsyāṃśca bharatarṣabha ॥41॥
slp1: tataH sa rAjA nahuzo vismitaH prekzya DIvarAn । ArohamARAMstridivaM matsyAMSca BaratarzaBa ॥41॥

text: tatastau gavijaścaiva cyavanaśca bhṛgūdvahaḥ । varābhyāmanurūpābhyāṃ chandayāmāsaturnṛpam ॥42॥
html:
tatastau gavijaścaiva cyavanaśca bhṛgūdvahaḥ ।
varābhyāmanurūpābhyāṃ chandayāmāsaturnṛpam ॥42॥
slp1: tatastO gavijaScEva cyavanaSca BfgUdvahaH । varAByAmanurUpAByAM CandayAmAsaturnfpam ॥42॥

text: tato rājā mahāvīryo nahuṣaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ । paramityabravītprītastadā bharatasattama ॥43॥
html:
tato rājā mahāvīryo nahuṣaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ।
paramityabravītprītastadā bharatasattama ॥43॥
slp1: tato rAjA mahAvIryo nahuzaH pfTivIpatiH । paramityabravItprItastadA Baratasattama ॥43॥

text: tato jagrāha dharme sa sthitimindranibho nṛpaḥ । tatheti coditaḥ prītastāvṛṣī pratyapūjayat ॥44॥
html:
tato jagrāha dharme sa sthitimindranibho nṛpaḥ ।
tatheti coditaḥ prītastāvṛṣī pratyapūjayat ॥44॥
slp1: tato jagrAha Darme sa sTitimindraniBo nfpaH । taTeti coditaH prItastAvfzI pratyapUjayat ॥44॥

text: samāptadīkṣaścyavanastato'gacchatsvamāśramam । gavijaśca mahātejāḥ svamāśramapadaṃ yayau ॥45॥
html:
samāptadīkṣaścyavanastato'gacchatsvamāśramam ।
gavijaśca mahātejāḥ svamāśramapadaṃ yayau ॥45॥
slp1: samAptadIkzaScyavanastato'gacCatsvamASramam । gavijaSca mahAtejAH svamASramapadaM yayO ॥45॥

text: niṣādāśca divaṃ jagmuste ca matsyā janādhipa । nahuṣo'pi varaṃ labdhvā praviveśa puraṃ svakam ॥46॥
html:
niṣādāśca divaṃ jagmuste ca matsyā janādhipa ।
nahuṣo'pi varaṃ labdhvā praviveśa puraṃ svakam ॥46॥
slp1: nizAdASca divaM jagmuste ca matsyA janADipa । nahuzo'pi varaM labDvA praviveSa puraM svakam ॥46॥

text: etatte kathitaṃ tāta yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi । darśane yādṛśaḥ snehaḥ saṃvāse ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥47॥
html:
etatte kathitaṃ tāta yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ।
darśane yādṛśaḥ snehaḥ saṃvāse ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥47॥
slp1: etatte kaTitaM tAta yanmAM tvaM paripfcCasi । darSane yAdfSaH snehaH saMvAse ca yuDizWira ॥47॥

text: mahābhāgyaṃ gavāṃ caiva tathā dharmaviniścayam । kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathyatāṃ vīra kiṃ te hṛdi vivakṣitam] ॥48॥
html:
mahābhāgyaṃ gavāṃ caiva tathā dharmaviniścayam ।
kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathyatāṃ vīra kiṃ te hṛdi vivakṣitam] ॥48॥
slp1: mahABAgyaM gavAM cEva taTA DarmaviniScayam । kiM BUyaH kaTyatAM vIra kiM te hfdi vivakzitam] ॥48॥

text: saṃśayo me mahāprājña sumahānsāgaropamaḥ । tanme śṛṇu mahābāho śrutvā cākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
html:
saṃśayo me mahāprājña sumahānsāgaropamaḥ ।
tanme śṛṇu mahābāho śrutvā cākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
slp1: saMSayo me mahAprAjYa sumahAnsAgaropamaH । tanme SfRu mahAbAho SrutvA cAKyAtumarhasi ॥1॥
