author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kautūhalaṃ me sumahajjāmadagnyaṃ prati prabho । rāmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥2॥
html:
kautūhalaṃ me sumahajjāmadagnyaṃ prati prabho ।
rāmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥2॥
slp1: kOtUhalaM me sumahajjAmadagnyaM prati praBo । rAmaM DarmaBftAM SrezWaM tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥2॥

text: kathameṣa samutpanno rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ । kathaṃ brahmarṣivaṃśe ca kṣatradharmā vyajāyata ॥3॥
html:
kathameṣa samutpanno rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ ।
kathaṃ brahmarṣivaṃśe ca kṣatradharmā vyajāyata ॥3॥
slp1: kaTameza samutpanno rAmaH satyaparAkramaH । kaTaM brahmarzivaMSe ca kzatraDarmA vyajAyata ॥3॥

text: tadasya sambhavaṃ rājannikhilenānukīrtaya । kauśikācca kathaṃ vaṃśātkṣatrādvai brāhmaṇo'bhavat ॥4॥
html:
tadasya sambhavaṃ rājannikhilenānukīrtaya ।
kauśikācca kathaṃ vaṃśātkṣatrādvai brāhmaṇo'bhavat ॥4॥
slp1: tadasya samBavaM rAjanniKilenAnukIrtaya । kOSikAcca kaTaM vaMSAtkzatrAdvE brAhmaRo'Bavat ॥4॥

text: aho prabhāvaḥ sumahānāsīdvai sumahātmanoḥ । rāmasya ca naravyāghra viśvāmitrasya caiva ha ॥5॥
html:
aho prabhāvaḥ sumahānāsīdvai sumahātmanoḥ ।
rāmasya ca naravyāghra viśvāmitrasya caiva ha ॥5॥
slp1: aho praBAvaH sumahAnAsIdvE sumahAtmanoH । rAmasya ca naravyAGra viSvAmitrasya cEva ha ॥5॥

text: kathaṃ putrānatikramya teṣāṃ naptṛṣvathābhavat । eṣa doṣaḥ sutānhitvā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥6॥
html:
kathaṃ putrānatikramya teṣāṃ naptṛṣvathābhavat ।
eṣa doṣaḥ sutānhitvā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥6॥
slp1: kaTaM putrAnatikramya tezAM naptfzvaTABavat । eza dozaH sutAnhitvA tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥6॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । cyavanasya ca saṃvādaṃ kuśikasya ca bhārata ॥7॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
cyavanasya ca saṃvādaṃ kuśikasya ca bhārata ॥7॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । cyavanasya ca saMvAdaM kuSikasya ca BArata ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: etaṃ doṣaṃ purā dṛṣṭvā bhārgavaścyavanastadā । āgāminaṃ mahābuddhiḥ svavaṃśe munipuṅgavaḥ ॥8॥
html:
etaṃ doṣaṃ purā dṛṣṭvā bhārgavaścyavanastadā ।
āgāminaṃ mahābuddhiḥ svavaṃśe munipuṅgavaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: etaM dozaM purA dfzwvA BArgavaScyavanastadA । AgAminaM mahAbudDiH svavaMSe munipuNgavaH ॥8॥

text: sañcintya manasā sarvaṃ guṇadoṣabalābalam । dagdhukāmaḥ kulaṃ sarvaṃ kuśikānāṃ tapodhanaḥ ॥9॥
html:
sañcintya manasā sarvaṃ guṇadoṣabalābalam ।
dagdhukāmaḥ kulaṃ sarvaṃ kuśikānāṃ tapodhanaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: saYcintya manasA sarvaM guRadozabalAbalam । dagDukAmaH kulaM sarvaM kuSikAnAM tapoDanaH ॥9॥

text: cyavanastamanuprāpya kuśikaṃ vākyamabravīt । vastumicchā samutpannā tvayā saha mamānagha ॥10॥
html:
cyavanastamanuprāpya kuśikaṃ vākyamabravīt ।
vastumicchā samutpannā tvayā saha mamānagha ॥10॥
slp1: cyavanastamanuprApya kuSikaM vAkyamabravIt । vastumicCA samutpannA tvayA saha mamAnaGa ॥10॥

text: bhagavansahadharmo'yaṃ paṇḍitairiha dhāryate । pradānakāle kanyānāmucyate ca sadā budhaiḥ ॥11॥
html:
bhagavansahadharmo'yaṃ paṇḍitairiha dhāryate ।
pradānakāle kanyānāmucyate ca sadā budhaiḥ ॥11॥
slp1: BagavansahaDarmo'yaM paRqitEriha DAryate । pradAnakAle kanyAnAmucyate ca sadA buDEH ॥11॥
author: kuśika uvāca ।

text: yattu tāvadatikrāntaṃ dharmadvāraṃ tapodhana । tatkāryaṃ prakariṣyāmi tadanujñātumarhasi ॥12॥
html:
yattu tāvadatikrāntaṃ dharmadvāraṃ tapodhana ।
tatkāryaṃ prakariṣyāmi tadanujñātumarhasi ॥12॥
slp1: yattu tAvadatikrAntaM DarmadvAraM tapoDana । tatkAryaM prakarizyAmi tadanujYAtumarhasi ॥12॥

text: athāsanamupādāya cyavanasya mahāmuneḥ । kuśiko bhāryayā sārdhamājagāma yato muniḥ ॥13॥
html:
athāsanamupādāya cyavanasya mahāmuneḥ ।
kuśiko bhāryayā sārdhamājagāma yato muniḥ ॥13॥
slp1: aTAsanamupAdAya cyavanasya mahAmuneH । kuSiko BAryayA sArDamAjagAma yato muniH ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: pragṛhya rājā bhṛṅgāraṃ pādyamasmai nyavedayat । kārayāmāsa sarvāśca kriyāstasya mahātmanaḥ ॥14॥
html:
pragṛhya rājā bhṛṅgāraṃ pādyamasmai nyavedayat ।
kārayāmāsa sarvāśca kriyāstasya mahātmanaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: pragfhya rAjA BfNgAraM pAdyamasmE nyavedayat । kArayAmAsa sarvASca kriyAstasya mahAtmanaH ॥14॥

text: tataḥ sa rājā cyavanaṃ madhuparkaṃ yathāvidhi । pratyagrāhayadavyagro mahātmā niyatavrataḥ ॥15॥
html:
tataḥ sa rājā cyavanaṃ madhuparkaṃ yathāvidhi ।
pratyagrāhayadavyagro mahātmā niyatavrataḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tataH sa rAjA cyavanaM maDuparkaM yaTAviDi । pratyagrAhayadavyagro mahAtmA niyatavrataH ॥15॥

text: satkṛtya sa tathā vipramidaṃ vacanamabravīt । bhagavanparavantau svo brūhi kiṃ karavāvahe ॥16॥
html:
satkṛtya sa tathā vipramidaṃ vacanamabravīt ।
bhagavanparavantau svo brūhi kiṃ karavāvahe ॥16॥
slp1: satkftya sa taTA vipramidaM vacanamabravIt । BagavanparavantO svo brUhi kiM karavAvahe ॥16॥

text: yadi rājyaṃ yadi dhanaṃ yadi gāḥ saṃśitavrata । yajñadānāni ca tathā brūhi sarvaṃ dadāmi te ॥17॥
html:
yadi rājyaṃ yadi dhanaṃ yadi gāḥ saṃśitavrata ।
yajñadānāni ca tathā brūhi sarvaṃ dadāmi te ॥17॥
slp1: yadi rAjyaM yadi DanaM yadi gAH saMSitavrata । yajYadAnAni ca taTA brUhi sarvaM dadAmi te ॥17॥

text: idaṃ gṛhamidaṃ rājyamidaṃ dharmāsanaṃ ca te । rājā tvamasi śādhyurvīṃ bhṛtyo'haṃ paravāṃstvayi ॥18॥
html:
idaṃ gṛhamidaṃ rājyamidaṃ dharmāsanaṃ ca te ।
rājā tvamasi śādhyurvīṃ bhṛtyo'haṃ paravāṃstvayi ॥18॥
slp1: idaM gfhamidaM rAjyamidaM DarmAsanaM ca te । rAjA tvamasi SADyurvIM Bftyo'haM paravAMstvayi ॥18॥

text: evamukte tato vākye cyavano bhārgavastadā । kuśikaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ mudā paramayā yutaḥ ॥19॥
html:
evamukte tato vākye cyavano bhārgavastadā ।
kuśikaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ mudā paramayā yutaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: evamukte tato vAkye cyavano BArgavastadA । kuSikaM pratyuvAcedaM mudA paramayA yutaH ॥19॥

text: na rājyaṃ kāmaye rājanna dhanaṃ na ca yoṣitaḥ । na ca gā na ca te deśānna yajñāñśrūyatāmidam ॥20॥
html:
na rājyaṃ kāmaye rājanna dhanaṃ na ca yoṣitaḥ ।
na ca gā na ca te deśānna yajñāñśrūyatāmidam ॥20॥
slp1: na rAjyaM kAmaye rAjanna DanaM na ca yozitaH । na ca gA na ca te deSAnna yajYAYSrUyatAmidam ॥20॥

text: niyamaṃ kañcidārapsye yuvayoryadi rocate । paricaryo'smi yattābhyāṃ yuvābhyāmaviśaṅkayā ॥21॥
html:
niyamaṃ kañcidārapsye yuvayoryadi rocate ।
paricaryo'smi yattābhyāṃ yuvābhyāmaviśaṅkayā ॥21॥
slp1: niyamaM kaYcidArapsye yuvayoryadi rocate । paricaryo'smi yattAByAM yuvAByAmaviSaNkayA ॥21॥

text: evamukte tadā tena dampatī tau jaharṣatuḥ । pratyabrūtāṃ ca tamṛṣimevamastviti bhārata ॥22॥
html:
evamukte tadā tena dampatī tau jaharṣatuḥ ।
pratyabrūtāṃ ca tamṛṣimevamastviti bhārata ॥22॥
slp1: evamukte tadA tena dampatI tO jaharzatuH । pratyabrUtAM ca tamfzimevamastviti BArata ॥22॥

text: atha taṃ kuśiko hṛṣṭaḥ prāveśayadanuttamam । gṛhoddeśaṃ tatastatra darśanīyamadarśayat ॥23॥
html:
atha taṃ kuśiko hṛṣṭaḥ prāveśayadanuttamam ।
gṛhoddeśaṃ tatastatra darśanīyamadarśayat ॥23॥
slp1: aTa taM kuSiko hfzwaH prAveSayadanuttamam । gfhoddeSaM tatastatra darSanIyamadarSayat ॥23॥

text: iyaṃ śayyā bhagavato yathākāmamihoṣyatām । prayatiṣyāvahe prītimāhartuṃ te tapodhana ॥24॥
html:
iyaṃ śayyā bhagavato yathākāmamihoṣyatām ।
prayatiṣyāvahe prītimāhartuṃ te tapodhana ॥24॥
slp1: iyaM SayyA Bagavato yaTAkAmamihozyatAm । prayatizyAvahe prItimAhartuM te tapoDana ॥24॥

text: atha sūryo'ticakrāma teṣāṃ saṃvadatāṃ tathā । atharṣiścodayāmāsa pānamannaṃ tathaiva ca ॥25॥
html:
atha sūryo'ticakrāma teṣāṃ saṃvadatāṃ tathā ।
atharṣiścodayāmāsa pānamannaṃ tathaiva ca ॥25॥
slp1: aTa sUryo'ticakrAma tezAM saMvadatAM taTA । aTarziScodayAmAsa pAnamannaM taTEva ca ॥25॥

text: tamapṛcchattato rājā kuśikaḥ praṇatastadā । kimannajātamiṣṭaṃ te kimupasthāpayāmyaham ॥26॥
html:
tamapṛcchattato rājā kuśikaḥ praṇatastadā ।
kimannajātamiṣṭaṃ te kimupasthāpayāmyaham ॥26॥
slp1: tamapfcCattato rAjA kuSikaH praRatastadA । kimannajAtamizwaM te kimupasTApayAmyaham ॥26॥

text: tataḥ sa parayā prītyā pratyuvāca janādhipam । aupapattikamāhāraṃ prayacchasveti bhārata ॥27॥
html:
tataḥ sa parayā prītyā pratyuvāca janādhipam ।
aupapattikamāhāraṃ prayacchasveti bhārata ॥27॥
slp1: tataH sa parayA prItyA pratyuvAca janADipam । OpapattikamAhAraM prayacCasveti BArata ॥27॥

text: tadvacaḥ pūjayitvā tu tathetyāha sa pārthivaḥ । yathopapannaṃ cāhāraṃ tasmai prādājjanādhipaḥ ॥28॥
html:
tadvacaḥ pūjayitvā tu tathetyāha sa pārthivaḥ ।
yathopapannaṃ cāhāraṃ tasmai prādājjanādhipaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: tadvacaH pUjayitvA tu taTetyAha sa pArTivaH । yaTopapannaM cAhAraM tasmE prAdAjjanADipaH ॥28॥

text: tataḥ sa bhagavānbhuktvā dampatī prāha dharmavit । svaptumicchāmyahaṃ nidrā bādhate māmiti prabho ॥29॥
html:
tataḥ sa bhagavānbhuktvā dampatī prāha dharmavit ।
svaptumicchāmyahaṃ nidrā bādhate māmiti prabho ॥29॥
slp1: tataH sa BagavAnBuktvA dampatI prAha Darmavit । svaptumicCAmyahaM nidrA bADate mAmiti praBo ॥29॥

text: tataḥ śayyāgṛhaṃ prāpya bhagavānṛṣisattamaḥ । saṃviveśa narendrastu sapatnīkaḥ sthito'bhavat ॥30॥
html:
tataḥ śayyāgṛhaṃ prāpya bhagavānṛṣisattamaḥ ।
saṃviveśa narendrastu sapatnīkaḥ sthito'bhavat ॥30॥
slp1: tataH SayyAgfhaM prApya BagavAnfzisattamaH । saMviveSa narendrastu sapatnIkaH sTito'Bavat ॥30॥

text: na prabodhyo'smi saṃsupta ityuvācātha bhārgavaḥ । saṃvāhitavyau pādau me jāgartavyaṃ ca vāṃ niśi ॥31॥
html:
na prabodhyo'smi saṃsupta ityuvācātha bhārgavaḥ ।
saṃvāhitavyau pādau me jāgartavyaṃ ca vāṃ niśi ॥31॥
slp1: na praboDyo'smi saMsupta ityuvAcATa BArgavaH । saMvAhitavyO pAdO me jAgartavyaM ca vAM niSi ॥31॥

text: aviśaṅkaśca kuśikastathetyāha sa dharmavit । na prabodhayatāṃ taṃ ca tau tadā rajanīkṣaye ॥32॥
html:
aviśaṅkaśca kuśikastathetyāha sa dharmavit ।
na prabodhayatāṃ taṃ ca tau tadā rajanīkṣaye ॥32॥
slp1: aviSaNkaSca kuSikastaTetyAha sa Darmavit । na praboDayatAM taM ca tO tadA rajanIkzaye ॥32॥

text: yathādeśaṃ maharṣestu śuśrūṣāparamau tadā । babhūvaturmahārāja prayatāvatha dampatī ॥33॥
html:
yathādeśaṃ maharṣestu śuśrūṣāparamau tadā ।
babhūvaturmahārāja prayatāvatha dampatī ॥33॥
slp1: yaTAdeSaM maharzestu SuSrUzAparamO tadA । baBUvaturmahArAja prayatAvaTa dampatI ॥33॥

text: tataḥ sa bhagavānvipraḥ samādiśya narādhipam । suṣvāpaikena pārśvena divasānekaviṃśatim ॥34॥
html:
tataḥ sa bhagavānvipraḥ samādiśya narādhipam ।
suṣvāpaikena pārśvena divasānekaviṃśatim ॥34॥
slp1: tataH sa BagavAnvipraH samAdiSya narADipam । suzvApEkena pArSvena divasAnekaviMSatim ॥34॥

text: sa tu rājā nirāhāraḥ sabhāryaḥ kurunandana । paryupāsata taṃ hṛṣṭaścyavanārādhane rataḥ ॥35॥
html:
sa tu rājā nirāhāraḥ sabhāryaḥ kurunandana ।
paryupāsata taṃ hṛṣṭaścyavanārādhane rataḥ ॥35॥
slp1: sa tu rAjA nirAhAraH saBAryaH kurunandana । paryupAsata taM hfzwaScyavanArADane rataH ॥35॥

text: bhārgavastu samuttasthau svayameva tapodhanaḥ । akiñciduktvā tu gṛhānniścakrāma mahātapāḥ ॥36॥
html:
bhārgavastu samuttasthau svayameva tapodhanaḥ ।
akiñciduktvā tu gṛhānniścakrāma mahātapāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: BArgavastu samuttasTO svayameva tapoDanaH । akiYciduktvA tu gfhAnniScakrAma mahAtapAH ॥36॥

text: tamanvagacchatāṃ tau tu kṣudhitau śramakarśitau । bhāryāpatī muniśreṣṭho na ca tāvavalokayat ॥37॥
html:
tamanvagacchatāṃ tau tu kṣudhitau śramakarśitau ।
bhāryāpatī muniśreṣṭho na ca tāvavalokayat ॥37॥
slp1: tamanvagacCatAM tO tu kzuDitO SramakarSitO । BAryApatI muniSrezWo na ca tAvavalokayat ॥37॥

text: tayostu prekṣatoreva bhārgavāṇāṃ kulodvahaḥ । antarhito'bhūdrājendra tato rājāpatatkṣitau ॥38॥
html:
tayostu prekṣatoreva bhārgavāṇāṃ kulodvahaḥ ।
antarhito'bhūdrājendra tato rājāpatatkṣitau ॥38॥
slp1: tayostu prekzatoreva BArgavARAM kulodvahaH । antarhito'BUdrAjendra tato rAjApatatkzitO ॥38॥

text: sa muhūrtaṃ samāśvasya saha devyā mahādyutiḥ । punaranveṣaṇe yatnamakarotparamaṃ tadā] ॥39॥
html:
sa muhūrtaṃ samāśvasya saha devyā mahādyutiḥ ।
punaranveṣaṇe yatnamakarotparamaṃ tadā] ॥39॥
slp1: sa muhUrtaM samASvasya saha devyA mahAdyutiH । punaranvezaRe yatnamakarotparamaM tadA] ॥39॥

text: tasminnantarhite vipre rājā kimakarottadā । bhāryā cāsya mahābhāgā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
tasminnantarhite vipre rājā kimakarottadā ।
bhāryā cāsya mahābhāgā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: tasminnantarhite vipre rAjA kimakarottadA । BAryA cAsya mahABAgA tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: adṛṣṭvā sa mahīpālastamṛṣiṃ saha bhāryayā । pariśrānto nivavṛte vrīḍito naṣṭacetanaḥ ॥2॥
html:
adṛṣṭvā sa mahīpālastamṛṣiṃ saha bhāryayā ।
pariśrānto nivavṛte vrīḍito naṣṭacetanaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: adfzwvA sa mahIpAlastamfziM saha BAryayA । pariSrAnto nivavfte vrIqito nazwacetanaH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sa praviśya purīṃ dīno nābhyabhāṣata kiñcana । tadeva cintayāmāsa cyavanasya viceṣṭitam ॥3॥
html:
sa praviśya purīṃ dīno nābhyabhāṣata kiñcana ।
tadeva cintayāmāsa cyavanasya viceṣṭitam ॥3॥
slp1: sa praviSya purIM dIno nAByaBAzata kiYcana । tadeva cintayAmAsa cyavanasya vicezwitam ॥3॥

text: atha śūnyena manasā praviveśa gṛhaṃ nṛpaḥ । dadarśa śayane tasmiñśayānaṃ bhṛgunandanam ॥4॥
html:
atha śūnyena manasā praviveśa gṛhaṃ nṛpaḥ ।
dadarśa śayane tasmiñśayānaṃ bhṛgunandanam ॥4॥
slp1: aTa SUnyena manasA praviveSa gfhaM nfpaH । dadarSa Sayane tasmiYSayAnaM Bfgunandanam ॥4॥

text: vismitau tau tu dṛṣṭvā taṃ tadāścaryaṃ vicintya ca । darśanāttasya ca munerviśrāntau sambabhūvatuḥ ॥5॥
html:
vismitau tau tu dṛṣṭvā taṃ tadāścaryaṃ vicintya ca ।
darśanāttasya ca munerviśrāntau sambabhūvatuḥ ॥5॥
slp1: vismitO tO tu dfzwvA taM tadAScaryaM vicintya ca । darSanAttasya ca munerviSrAntO sambaBUvatuH ॥5॥

text: yathāsthānaṃ tu tau sthitvā bhūyastaṃ saṃvavāhatuḥ । athāpareṇa pārśvena suṣvāpa sa mahāmuniḥ ॥6॥
html:
yathāsthānaṃ tu tau sthitvā bhūyastaṃ saṃvavāhatuḥ ।
athāpareṇa pārśvena suṣvāpa sa mahāmuniḥ ॥6॥
slp1: yaTAsTAnaM tu tO sTitvA BUyastaM saMvavAhatuH । aTApareRa pArSvena suzvApa sa mahAmuniH ॥6॥

text: tenaiva ca sa kālena pratyabudhyata vīryavān । na ca tau cakratuḥ kiñcidvikāraṃ bhayaśaṅkitau ॥7॥
html:
tenaiva ca sa kālena pratyabudhyata vīryavān ।
na ca tau cakratuḥ kiñcidvikāraṃ bhayaśaṅkitau ॥7॥
slp1: tenEva ca sa kAlena pratyabuDyata vIryavAn । na ca tO cakratuH kiYcidvikAraM BayaSaNkitO ॥7॥

text: pratibuddhastu sa munistau provāca viśāṃ pate । tailābhyaṅgo dīyatāṃ me snāsye'hamiti bhārata ॥8॥
html:
pratibuddhastu sa munistau provāca viśāṃ pate ।
tailābhyaṅgo dīyatāṃ me snāsye'hamiti bhārata ॥8॥
slp1: pratibudDastu sa munistO provAca viSAM pate । tElAByaNgo dIyatAM me snAsye'hamiti BArata ॥8॥

text: tatheti tau pratiśrutya kṣudhitau śramakarśitau । śatapākena tailena mahārheṇopatasthatuḥ ॥9॥
html:
tatheti tau pratiśrutya kṣudhitau śramakarśitau ।
śatapākena tailena mahārheṇopatasthatuḥ ॥9॥
slp1: taTeti tO pratiSrutya kzuDitO SramakarSitO । SatapAkena tElena mahArheRopatasTatuH ॥9॥

text: tataḥ sukhāsīnamṛṣiṃ vāgyatau saṃvavāhatuḥ । na ca paryāptamityāha bhārgavaḥ sumahātapāḥ ॥10॥
html:
tataḥ sukhāsīnamṛṣiṃ vāgyatau saṃvavāhatuḥ ।
na ca paryāptamityāha bhārgavaḥ sumahātapāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: tataH suKAsInamfziM vAgyatO saMvavAhatuH । na ca paryAptamityAha BArgavaH sumahAtapAH ॥10॥

text: yadā tau nirvikārau tu lakṣayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ । tata utthāya sahasā snānaśālāṃ viveśa ha । kḷptameva tu tatrāsītsnānīyaṃ pārthivocitam ॥11॥
html:
yadā tau nirvikārau tu lakṣayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ ।
tata utthāya sahasā snānaśālāṃ viveśa ha ।
kḷptameva tu tatrāsītsnānīyaṃ pārthivocitam ॥11॥
slp1: yadA tO nirvikArO tu lakzayAmAsa BArgavaH । tata utTAya sahasA snAnaSAlAM viveSa ha । kxptameva tu tatrAsItsnAnIyaM pArTivocitam ॥11॥

text: asatkṛtya tu tatsarvaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata । sa muniḥ punarevātha nṛpateḥ paśyatastadā । nāsūyāṃ cakratustau ca dampatī bharatarṣabha ॥12॥
html:
asatkṛtya tu tatsarvaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ।
sa muniḥ punarevātha nṛpateḥ paśyatastadā ।
nāsūyāṃ cakratustau ca dampatī bharatarṣabha ॥12॥
slp1: asatkftya tu tatsarvaM tatrEvAntaraDIyata । sa muniH punarevATa nfpateH paSyatastadA । nAsUyAM cakratustO ca dampatI BaratarzaBa ॥12॥

text: atha snātaḥ sa bhagavānsiṃhāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ । darśayāmāsa kuśikaṃ sabhāryaṃ bhṛgunandanaḥ ॥13॥
html:
atha snātaḥ sa bhagavānsiṃhāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ ।
darśayāmāsa kuśikaṃ sabhāryaṃ bhṛgunandanaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: aTa snAtaH sa BagavAnsiMhAsanagataH praBuH । darSayAmAsa kuSikaM saBAryaM BfgunandanaH ॥13॥

text: saṃhṛṣṭavadano rājā sabhāryaḥ kuśiko munim । siddhamannamiti prahvo nirvikāro nyavedayat ॥14॥
html:
saṃhṛṣṭavadano rājā sabhāryaḥ kuśiko munim ।
siddhamannamiti prahvo nirvikāro nyavedayat ॥14॥
slp1: saMhfzwavadano rAjA saBAryaH kuSiko munim । sidDamannamiti prahvo nirvikAro nyavedayat ॥14॥

text: ānīyatāmiti munistaṃ covāca narādhipam । rājā ca samupājahre tadannaṃ saha bhāryayā ॥15॥
html:
ānīyatāmiti munistaṃ covāca narādhipam ।
rājā ca samupājahre tadannaṃ saha bhāryayā ॥15॥
slp1: AnIyatAmiti munistaM covAca narADipam । rAjA ca samupAjahre tadannaM saha BAryayA ॥15॥

text: māṃsaprakārānvividhāñśākāni vividhāni ca । vesavāravikārāṃśca pānakāni laghūni ca ॥16॥
html:
māṃsaprakārānvividhāñśākāni vividhāni ca ।
vesavāravikārāṃśca pānakāni laghūni ca ॥16॥
slp1: mAMsaprakArAnviviDAYSAkAni viviDAni ca । vesavAravikArAMSca pAnakAni laGUni ca ॥16॥

text: rasālāpūpakāṃścitrānmodakānatha ṣāḍavān । rasānnānāprakārāṃśca vanyaṃ ca munibhojanam ॥17॥
html:
rasālāpūpakāṃścitrānmodakānatha ṣāḍavān ।
rasānnānāprakārāṃśca vanyaṃ ca munibhojanam ॥17॥
slp1: rasAlApUpakAMScitrAnmodakAnaTa zAqavAn । rasAnnAnAprakArAMSca vanyaM ca muniBojanam ॥17॥

text: phalāni ca vicitrāṇi tathā bhojyāni bhūriśaḥ । badareṅgudakāśmaryabhallātakavaṭāni ca ॥18॥
html:
phalāni ca vicitrāṇi tathā bhojyāni bhūriśaḥ ।
badareṅgudakāśmaryabhallātakavaṭāni ca ॥18॥
slp1: PalAni ca vicitrARi taTA BojyAni BUriSaH । badareNgudakASmaryaBallAtakavawAni ca ॥18॥

text: gṛhasthānāṃ ca yadbhojyaṃ yaccāpi vanavāsinām । sarvamāhārayāmāsa rājā śāpabhayānmuneḥ ॥19॥
html:
gṛhasthānāṃ ca yadbhojyaṃ yaccāpi vanavāsinām ।
sarvamāhārayāmāsa rājā śāpabhayānmuneḥ ॥19॥
slp1: gfhasTAnAM ca yadBojyaM yaccApi vanavAsinAm । sarvamAhArayAmAsa rAjA SApaBayAnmuneH ॥19॥

text: atha sarvamupanyastamagrataścyavanasya tat । tataḥ sarvaṃ samānīya tacca śayyāsanaṃ muniḥ ॥20॥
html:
atha sarvamupanyastamagrataścyavanasya tat ।
tataḥ sarvaṃ samānīya tacca śayyāsanaṃ muniḥ ॥20॥
slp1: aTa sarvamupanyastamagrataScyavanasya tat । tataH sarvaM samAnIya tacca SayyAsanaM muniH ॥20॥

text: vastraiḥ śubhairavacchādya bhojanopaskaraiḥ saha । sarvamādīpayāmāsa cyavano bhṛgunandanaḥ ॥21॥
html:
vastraiḥ śubhairavacchādya bhojanopaskaraiḥ saha ।
sarvamādīpayāmāsa cyavano bhṛgunandanaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: vastrEH SuBEravacCAdya BojanopaskarEH saha । sarvamAdIpayAmAsa cyavano BfgunandanaH ॥21॥

text: na ca tau cakratuḥ kopaṃ dampatī sumahāvratau । tayoḥ samprekṣatoreva punarantarhito'bhavat ॥22॥
html:
na ca tau cakratuḥ kopaṃ dampatī sumahāvratau ।
tayoḥ samprekṣatoreva punarantarhito'bhavat ॥22॥
slp1: na ca tO cakratuH kopaM dampatI sumahAvratO । tayoH samprekzatoreva punarantarhito'Bavat ॥22॥

text: tatraiva ca sa rājarṣistasthau tāṃ rajanīṃ tadā । sabhāryo vāgyataḥ śrīmānna ca taṃ kopa āviśat ॥23॥
html:
tatraiva ca sa rājarṣistasthau tāṃ rajanīṃ tadā ।
sabhāryo vāgyataḥ śrīmānna ca taṃ kopa āviśat ॥23॥
slp1: tatrEva ca sa rAjarzistasTO tAM rajanIM tadA । saBAryo vAgyataH SrImAnna ca taM kopa AviSat ॥23॥

text: nityaṃ saṃskṛtamannaṃ tu vividhaṃ rājaveśmani । śayanāni ca mukhyāni pariṣekāśca puṣkalāḥ ॥24॥
html:
nityaṃ saṃskṛtamannaṃ tu vividhaṃ rājaveśmani ।
śayanāni ca mukhyāni pariṣekāśca puṣkalāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: nityaM saMskftamannaM tu viviDaM rAjaveSmani । SayanAni ca muKyAni parizekASca puzkalAH ॥24॥

text: vastraṃ ca vividhākāramabhavatsamupārjitam । na śaśāka tato draṣṭumantaraṃ cyavanastadā ॥25॥
html:
vastraṃ ca vividhākāramabhavatsamupārjitam ।
na śaśāka tato draṣṭumantaraṃ cyavanastadā ॥25॥
slp1: vastraM ca viviDAkAramaBavatsamupArjitam । na SaSAka tato drazwumantaraM cyavanastadA ॥25॥

text: punareva ca viprarṣiḥ provāca kuśikaṃ nṛpam । sabhāryo māṃ rathenāśu vaha yatra bravīmyaham ॥26॥
html:
punareva ca viprarṣiḥ provāca kuśikaṃ nṛpam ।
sabhāryo māṃ rathenāśu vaha yatra bravīmyaham ॥26॥
slp1: punareva ca viprarziH provAca kuSikaM nfpam । saBAryo mAM raTenASu vaha yatra bravImyaham ॥26॥

text: tatheti ca prāha nṛpo nirviśaṅkastapodhanam । krīḍāratho'stu bhagavannuta sāṅgrāmiko rathaḥ ॥27॥
html:
tatheti ca prāha nṛpo nirviśaṅkastapodhanam ।
krīḍāratho'stu bhagavannuta sāṅgrāmiko rathaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: taTeti ca prAha nfpo nirviSaNkastapoDanam । krIqAraTo'stu Bagavannuta sANgrAmiko raTaH ॥27॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa munistena rājñā hṛṣṭena tadvacaḥ । cyavanaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ parapurañjayam ॥28॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa munistena rājñā hṛṣṭena tadvacaḥ ।
cyavanaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ parapurañjayam ॥28॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa munistena rAjYA hfzwena tadvacaH । cyavanaH pratyuvAcedaM hfzwaH parapuraYjayam ॥28॥

text: sajjīkuru rathaṃ kṣipraṃ yaste sāṅgrāmiko mataḥ । sāyudhaḥ sapatākaśca saśaktiḥ kaṇayaṣṭimān ॥29॥
html:
sajjīkuru rathaṃ kṣipraṃ yaste sāṅgrāmiko mataḥ ।
sāyudhaḥ sapatākaśca saśaktiḥ kaṇayaṣṭimān ॥29॥
slp1: sajjIkuru raTaM kzipraM yaste sANgrAmiko mataH । sAyuDaH sapatAkaSca saSaktiH kaRayazwimAn ॥29॥

text: kiṅkiṇīśatanirghoṣo yuktastomarakalpanaiḥ । gadākhaḍganibaddhaśca parameṣuśatānvitaḥ ॥30॥
html:
kiṅkiṇīśatanirghoṣo yuktastomarakalpanaiḥ ।
gadākhaḍganibaddhaśca parameṣuśatānvitaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: kiNkiRISatanirGozo yuktastomarakalpanEH । gadAKaqganibadDaSca paramezuSatAnvitaH ॥30॥

text: tataḥ sa taṃ tathetyuktvā kalpayitvā mahāratham । bhāryāṃ vāme dhuri tadā cātmānaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā ॥31॥
html:
tataḥ sa taṃ tathetyuktvā kalpayitvā mahāratham ।
bhāryāṃ vāme dhuri tadā cātmānaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā ॥31॥
slp1: tataH sa taM taTetyuktvA kalpayitvA mahAraTam । BAryAM vAme Duri tadA cAtmAnaM dakziRe taTA ॥31॥

text: tridaṃṣṭraṃ vajrasūcyagraṃ pratodaṃ tatra cādadhat । sarvametattato dattvā nṛpo vākyamathābravīt ॥32॥
html:
tridaṃṣṭraṃ vajrasūcyagraṃ pratodaṃ tatra cādadhat ।
sarvametattato dattvā nṛpo vākyamathābravīt ॥32॥
slp1: tridaMzwraM vajrasUcyagraM pratodaM tatra cAdaDat । sarvametattato dattvA nfpo vAkyamaTAbravIt ॥32॥

text: bhagavankva ratho yātu bravītu bhṛgunandanaḥ । yatra vakṣyasi viprarṣe tatra yāsyati te rathaḥ ॥33॥
html:
bhagavankva ratho yātu bravītu bhṛgunandanaḥ ।
yatra vakṣyasi viprarṣe tatra yāsyati te rathaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: Bagavankva raTo yAtu bravItu BfgunandanaH । yatra vakzyasi viprarze tatra yAsyati te raTaH ॥33॥

text: evamuktastu bhagavānpratyuvācātha taṃ nṛpam । itaḥprabhṛti yātavyaṃ padakaṃ padakaṃ śanaiḥ ॥34॥
html:
evamuktastu bhagavānpratyuvācātha taṃ nṛpam ।
itaḥprabhṛti yātavyaṃ padakaṃ padakaṃ śanaiḥ ॥34॥
slp1: evamuktastu BagavAnpratyuvAcATa taM nfpam । itaHpraBfti yAtavyaM padakaM padakaM SanEH ॥34॥

text: śramo mama yathā na syāttathā me chandacāriṇau । sukhaṃ caivāsmi voḍhavyo janaḥ sarvaśca paśyatu ॥35॥
html:
śramo mama yathā na syāttathā me chandacāriṇau ।
sukhaṃ caivāsmi voḍhavyo janaḥ sarvaśca paśyatu ॥35॥
slp1: Sramo mama yaTA na syAttaTA me CandacAriRO । suKaM cEvAsmi voQavyo janaH sarvaSca paSyatu ॥35॥

text: notsāryaḥ pathikaḥ kaścittebhyo dāsyāmyahaṃ vasu । brāhmaṇebhyaśca ye kāmānarthayiṣyanti māṃ pathi ॥36॥
html:
notsāryaḥ pathikaḥ kaścittebhyo dāsyāmyahaṃ vasu ।
brāhmaṇebhyaśca ye kāmānarthayiṣyanti māṃ pathi ॥36॥
slp1: notsAryaH paTikaH kaScitteByo dAsyAmyahaM vasu । brAhmaReByaSca ye kAmAnarTayizyanti mAM paTi ॥36॥

text: sarvaṃ dāsyāmyaśeṣeṇa dhanaṃ ratnāni caiva hi । kriyatāṃ nikhilenaitanmā vicāraya pārthiva ॥37॥
html:
sarvaṃ dāsyāmyaśeṣeṇa dhanaṃ ratnāni caiva hi ।
kriyatāṃ nikhilenaitanmā vicāraya pārthiva ॥37॥
slp1: sarvaM dAsyAmyaSezeRa DanaM ratnAni cEva hi । kriyatAM niKilenEtanmA vicAraya pArTiva ॥37॥

text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā bhṛtyānathābravīt । yadyadbrūyānmunistattatsarvaṃ deyamaśaṅkitaiḥ ॥38॥
html:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā bhṛtyānathābravīt ।
yadyadbrūyānmunistattatsarvaṃ deyamaśaṅkitaiḥ ॥38॥
slp1: tasya tadvacanaM SrutvA rAjA BftyAnaTAbravIt । yadyadbrUyAnmunistattatsarvaM deyamaSaNkitEH ॥38॥

text: tato ratnānyanekāni striyo yugyamajāvikam । kṛtākṛtaṃ ca kanakaṃ gajendrāścācalopamāḥ ॥39॥
html:
tato ratnānyanekāni striyo yugyamajāvikam ।
kṛtākṛtaṃ ca kanakaṃ gajendrāścācalopamāḥ ॥39॥
slp1: tato ratnAnyanekAni striyo yugyamajAvikam । kftAkftaM ca kanakaM gajendrAScAcalopamAH ॥39॥

text: anvagacchanta tamṛṣiṃ rājāmātyāśca sarvaśaḥ । hāhābhūtaṃ ca tatsarvamāsīnnagaramārtimat ॥40॥
html:
anvagacchanta tamṛṣiṃ rājāmātyāśca sarvaśaḥ ।
hāhābhūtaṃ ca tatsarvamāsīnnagaramārtimat ॥40॥
slp1: anvagacCanta tamfziM rAjAmAtyASca sarvaSaH । hAhABUtaM ca tatsarvamAsInnagaramArtimat ॥40॥

text: tau tīkṣṇāgreṇa sahasā pratodena pracoditau । pṛṣṭhe viddhau kaṭe caiva nirvikārau tamūhatuḥ ॥41॥
html:
tau tīkṣṇāgreṇa sahasā pratodena pracoditau ।
pṛṣṭhe viddhau kaṭe caiva nirvikārau tamūhatuḥ ॥41॥
slp1: tO tIkzRAgreRa sahasA pratodena pracoditO । pfzWe vidDO kawe cEva nirvikArO tamUhatuH ॥41॥

text: vepamānau virāhārau pañcāśadrātrakarśitau । kathañcidūhaturvīrau dampatī taṃ rathottamam ॥42॥
html:
vepamānau virāhārau pañcāśadrātrakarśitau ।
kathañcidūhaturvīrau dampatī taṃ rathottamam ॥42॥
slp1: vepamAnO virAhArO paYcASadrAtrakarSitO । kaTaYcidUhaturvIrO dampatI taM raTottamam ॥42॥

text: bahuśo bhṛśaviddhau tau kṣaramāṇau kṣatodbhavam । dadṛśāte mahārāja puṣpitāviva kiṃśukau ॥43॥
html:
bahuśo bhṛśaviddhau tau kṣaramāṇau kṣatodbhavam ।
dadṛśāte mahārāja puṣpitāviva kiṃśukau ॥43॥
slp1: bahuSo BfSavidDO tO kzaramARO kzatodBavam । dadfSAte mahArAja puzpitAviva kiMSukO ॥43॥

text: tau dṛṣṭvā pauravargastu bhṛśaṃ śokaparāyaṇaḥ । abhiśāpabhayāttrasto na ca kiñciduvāca ha ॥44॥
html:
tau dṛṣṭvā pauravargastu bhṛśaṃ śokaparāyaṇaḥ ।
abhiśāpabhayāttrasto na ca kiñciduvāca ha ॥44॥
slp1: tO dfzwvA pOravargastu BfSaM SokaparAyaRaH । aBiSApaBayAttrasto na ca kiYciduvAca ha ॥44॥

text: dvandvaśaścābruvansarve paśyadhvaṃ tapaso balam । kruddhā api muniśreṣṭhaṃ vīkṣituṃ naiva śaknumaḥ ॥45॥
html:
dvandvaśaścābruvansarve paśyadhvaṃ tapaso balam ।
kruddhā api muniśreṣṭhaṃ vīkṣituṃ naiva śaknumaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: dvandvaSaScAbruvansarve paSyaDvaM tapaso balam । krudDA api muniSrezWaM vIkzituM nEva SaknumaH ॥45॥

text: aho bhagavato vīryaṃ maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ । rājñaścāpi sabhāryasya dhairyaṃ paśyata yādṛśam ॥46॥
html:
aho bhagavato vīryaṃ maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ ।
rājñaścāpi sabhāryasya dhairyaṃ paśyata yādṛśam ॥46॥
slp1: aho Bagavato vIryaM maharzerBAvitAtmanaH । rAjYaScApi saBAryasya DEryaM paSyata yAdfSam ॥46॥

text: śrāntāvapi hi kṛcchreṇa rathametaṃ samūhatuḥ । na caitayorvikāraṃ vai dadarśa bhṛgunandanaḥ ॥47॥
html:
śrāntāvapi hi kṛcchreṇa rathametaṃ samūhatuḥ ।
na caitayorvikāraṃ vai dadarśa bhṛgunandanaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: SrAntAvapi hi kfcCreRa raTametaM samUhatuH । na cEtayorvikAraM vE dadarSa BfgunandanaH ॥47॥

text: tataḥ sa nirvikārau tau dṛṣṭvā bhṛgukulodvahaḥ । vasu viśrāṇayāmāsa yathā vaiśravaṇastathā ॥48॥
html:
tataḥ sa nirvikārau tau dṛṣṭvā bhṛgukulodvahaḥ ।
vasu viśrāṇayāmāsa yathā vaiśravaṇastathā ॥48॥
slp1: tataH sa nirvikArO tO dfzwvA BfgukulodvahaH । vasu viSrARayAmAsa yaTA vESravaRastaTA ॥48॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tatrāpi rājā prītātmā yathājñaptamathākarot । tato'sya bhagavānprīto babhūva munisattamaḥ ॥49॥
html:
tatrāpi rājā prītātmā yathājñaptamathākarot ।
tato'sya bhagavānprīto babhūva munisattamaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: tatrApi rAjA prItAtmA yaTAjYaptamaTAkarot । tato'sya BagavAnprIto baBUva munisattamaH ॥49॥

text: avatīrya rathaśreṣṭhāddampatī tau mumoca ha । vimocya caitau vidhivattato vākyamuvāca ha ॥50॥
html:
avatīrya rathaśreṣṭhāddampatī tau mumoca ha ।
vimocya caitau vidhivattato vākyamuvāca ha ॥50॥
slp1: avatIrya raTaSrezWAddampatI tO mumoca ha । vimocya cEtO viDivattato vAkyamuvAca ha ॥50॥

text: snigdhagambhīrayā vācā bhārgavaḥ suprasannayā । dadāni vāṃ varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadbrūtāmiti bhārata ॥51॥
html:
snigdhagambhīrayā vācā bhārgavaḥ suprasannayā ।
dadāni vāṃ varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tadbrūtāmiti bhārata ॥51॥
slp1: snigDagamBIrayA vAcA BArgavaH suprasannayA । dadAni vAM varaM SrezWaM tadbrUtAmiti BArata ॥51॥

text: sukumārau ca tau vidvānkarābhyāṃ munisattamaḥ । pasparśāmṛtakalpābhyāṃ snehādbharatasattama ॥52॥
html:
sukumārau ca tau vidvānkarābhyāṃ munisattamaḥ ।
pasparśāmṛtakalpābhyāṃ snehādbharatasattama ॥52॥
slp1: sukumArO ca tO vidvAnkarAByAM munisattamaH । pasparSAmftakalpAByAM snehAdBaratasattama ॥52॥

text: athābravīnnṛpo vākyaṃ śramo nāstyāvayoriha । viśrāntau svaḥ prabhāvātte dhyānenaiveti bhārgava ॥53॥
html:
athābravīnnṛpo vākyaṃ śramo nāstyāvayoriha ।
viśrāntau svaḥ prabhāvātte dhyānenaiveti bhārgava ॥53॥
slp1: aTAbravInnfpo vAkyaM Sramo nAstyAvayoriha । viSrAntO svaH praBAvAtte DyAnenEveti BArgava ॥53॥

text: atha tau bhagavānprāha prahṛṣṭaścyavanastadā । na vṛthā vyāhṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ yanmayā tadbhaviṣyati ॥54॥
html:
atha tau bhagavānprāha prahṛṣṭaścyavanastadā ।
na vṛthā vyāhṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ yanmayā tadbhaviṣyati ॥54॥
slp1: aTa tO BagavAnprAha prahfzwaScyavanastadA । na vfTA vyAhftaM pUrvaM yanmayA tadBavizyati ॥54॥

text: ramaṇīyaḥ samuddeśo gaṅgātīramidaṃ śubham । kañcitkālaṃ vrataparo nivatsyāmīha pārthiva ॥55॥
html:
ramaṇīyaḥ samuddeśo gaṅgātīramidaṃ śubham ।
kañcitkālaṃ vrataparo nivatsyāmīha pārthiva ॥55॥
slp1: ramaRIyaH samuddeSo gaNgAtIramidaM SuBam । kaYcitkAlaM vrataparo nivatsyAmIha pArTiva ॥55॥

text: gamyatāṃ svapuraṃ putra viśrāntaḥ punareṣyasi । ihasthaṃ māṃ sabhāryastvaṃ draṣṭāsi śvo narādhipa ॥56॥
html:
gamyatāṃ svapuraṃ putra viśrāntaḥ punareṣyasi ।
ihasthaṃ māṃ sabhāryastvaṃ draṣṭāsi śvo narādhipa ॥56॥
slp1: gamyatAM svapuraM putra viSrAntaH punarezyasi । ihasTaM mAM saBAryastvaM drazwAsi Svo narADipa ॥56॥

text: na ca manyustvayā kāryaḥ śreyaste samupasthitam । yatkāṅkṣitaṃ hṛdisthaṃ te tatsarvaṃ sambhaviṣyati ॥57॥
html:
na ca manyustvayā kāryaḥ śreyaste samupasthitam ।
yatkāṅkṣitaṃ hṛdisthaṃ te tatsarvaṃ sambhaviṣyati ॥57॥
slp1: na ca manyustvayA kAryaH Sreyaste samupasTitam । yatkANkzitaM hfdisTaM te tatsarvaM samBavizyati ॥57॥

text: ityevamuktaḥ kuśikaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā । provāca muniśārdūlamidaṃ vacanamarthavat ॥58॥
html:
ityevamuktaḥ kuśikaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā ।
provāca muniśārdūlamidaṃ vacanamarthavat ॥58॥
slp1: ityevamuktaH kuSikaH prahfzwenAntarAtmanA । provAca muniSArdUlamidaM vacanamarTavat ॥58॥

text: na me manyurmahābhāga pūto'smi bhagavaṃstvayā । saṃvṛttau yauvanasthau svo vapuṣmantau balānvitau ॥59॥
html:
na me manyurmahābhāga pūto'smi bhagavaṃstvayā ।
saṃvṛttau yauvanasthau svo vapuṣmantau balānvitau ॥59॥
slp1: na me manyurmahABAga pUto'smi BagavaMstvayA । saMvfttO yOvanasTO svo vapuzmantO balAnvitO ॥59॥

text: pratodena vraṇā ye me sabhāryasya kṛtāstvayā । tānna paśyāmi gātreṣu svastho'smi saha bhāryayā ॥60॥
html:
pratodena vraṇā ye me sabhāryasya kṛtāstvayā ।
tānna paśyāmi gātreṣu svastho'smi saha bhāryayā ॥60॥
slp1: pratodena vraRA ye me saBAryasya kftAstvayA । tAnna paSyAmi gAtrezu svasTo'smi saha BAryayA ॥60॥

text: imāṃ ca devīṃ paśyāmi mune divyāpsaropamām । śriyā paramayā yuktāṃ yathādṛṣṭāṃ mayā purā ॥61॥
html:
imāṃ ca devīṃ paśyāmi mune divyāpsaropamām ।
śriyā paramayā yuktāṃ yathādṛṣṭāṃ mayā purā ॥61॥
slp1: imAM ca devIM paSyAmi mune divyApsaropamAm । SriyA paramayA yuktAM yaTAdfzwAM mayA purA ॥61॥

text: tava prasādātsaṃvṛttamidaṃ sarvaṃ mahāmune । naitaccitraṃ tu bhagavaṃstvayi satyaparākrama ॥62॥
html:
tava prasādātsaṃvṛttamidaṃ sarvaṃ mahāmune ।
naitaccitraṃ tu bhagavaṃstvayi satyaparākrama ॥62॥
slp1: tava prasAdAtsaMvfttamidaM sarvaM mahAmune । nEtaccitraM tu BagavaMstvayi satyaparAkrama ॥62॥

text: ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ cyavanaḥ kuśikaṃ tadā । āgacchethāḥ sabhāryaśca tvamiheti narādhipa ॥63॥
html:
ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ cyavanaḥ kuśikaṃ tadā ।
āgacchethāḥ sabhāryaśca tvamiheti narādhipa ॥63॥
slp1: ityuktaH pratyuvAcedaM cyavanaH kuSikaM tadA । AgacCeTAH saBAryaSca tvamiheti narADipa ॥63॥

text: ityuktaḥ samanujñāto rājarṣirabhivādya tam । prayayau vapuṣā yukto nagaraṃ devarājavat ॥64॥
html:
ityuktaḥ samanujñāto rājarṣirabhivādya tam ।
prayayau vapuṣā yukto nagaraṃ devarājavat ॥64॥
slp1: ityuktaH samanujYAto rAjarziraBivAdya tam । prayayO vapuzA yukto nagaraM devarAjavat ॥64॥

text: tata enamupājagmuramātyāḥ sapurohitāḥ । balasthā gaṇikāyuktāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayastathā ॥65॥
html:
tata enamupājagmuramātyāḥ sapurohitāḥ ।
balasthā gaṇikāyuktāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayastathā ॥65॥
slp1: tata enamupAjagmuramAtyAH sapurohitAH । balasTA gaRikAyuktAH sarvAH prakftayastaTA ॥65॥

text: tairvṛtaḥ kuśiko rājā śriyā paramayā jvalan । praviveśa puraṃ hṛṣṭaḥ pūjyamāno'tha bandibhiḥ ॥66॥
html:
tairvṛtaḥ kuśiko rājā śriyā paramayā jvalan ।
praviveśa puraṃ hṛṣṭaḥ pūjyamāno'tha bandibhiḥ ॥66॥
slp1: tErvftaH kuSiko rAjA SriyA paramayA jvalan । praviveSa puraM hfzwaH pUjyamAno'Ta bandiBiH ॥66॥

text: tataḥ praviśya nagaraṃ kṛtvā sarvāhṇikakriyāḥ । bhuktvā sabhāryo rajanīmuvāsa sa mahīpatiḥ ॥67॥
html:
tataḥ praviśya nagaraṃ kṛtvā sarvāhṇikakriyāḥ ।
bhuktvā sabhāryo rajanīmuvāsa sa mahīpatiḥ ॥67॥
slp1: tataH praviSya nagaraM kftvA sarvAhRikakriyAH । BuktvA saBAryo rajanImuvAsa sa mahIpatiH ॥67॥

text: tatastu tau navamabhivīkṣya yauvanaṃ parasparaṃ vigatajarāvivāmarau । nanandatuḥ śayanagatau vapurdharau śriyā yutau dvijavaradattayā tayā ॥68॥
html:
tatastu tau navamabhivīkṣya yauvanaṃ parasparaṃ vigatajarāvivāmarau ।
nanandatuḥ śayanagatau vapurdharau śriyā yutau dvijavaradattayā tayā ॥68॥
slp1: tatastu tO navamaBivIkzya yOvanaM parasparaM vigatajarAvivAmarO । nanandatuH SayanagatO vapurDarO SriyA yutO dvijavaradattayA tayA ॥68॥

varaśca gṛhyatāṃ matto yaśca te saṃśayo hṛdi ।
taṃ ca brūhi naraśreṣṭha sarvaṃ sampādayāmi te ॥1॥
slp1: varaSca gfhyatAM matto yaSca te saMSayo hfdi । taM ca brUhi naraSrezWa sarvaM sampAdayAmi te ॥1॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: yadi prīto'si bhagavaṃstato me vada bhārgava । kāraṇaṃ śrotumicchāmi madgṛhe vāsakāritam ॥2॥
html:
yadi prīto'si bhagavaṃstato me vada bhārgava ।
kāraṇaṃ śrotumicchāmi madgṛhe vāsakāritam ॥2॥
slp1: yadi prIto'si BagavaMstato me vada BArgava । kAraRaM SrotumicCAmi madgfhe vAsakAritam ॥2॥
author: kuśika uvāca ।

text: śayanaṃ caikapārśvena divasānekaviṃśatim । akiñciduktvā gamanaṃ bahiśca munipuṅgava ॥3॥
html:
śayanaṃ caikapārśvena divasānekaviṃśatim ।
akiñciduktvā gamanaṃ bahiśca munipuṅgava ॥3॥
slp1: SayanaM cEkapArSvena divasAnekaviMSatim । akiYciduktvA gamanaM bahiSca munipuNgava ॥3॥

text: antardhānamakasmācca punareva ca darśanam । punaśca śayanaṃ vipra divasānekaviṃśatim ॥4॥
html:
antardhānamakasmācca punareva ca darśanam ।
punaśca śayanaṃ vipra divasānekaviṃśatim ॥4॥
slp1: antarDAnamakasmAcca punareva ca darSanam । punaSca SayanaM vipra divasAnekaviMSatim ॥4॥

text: tailābhyaktasya gamanaṃ bhojanaṃ ca gṛhe mama । samupānīya vividhaṃ yaddagdhaṃ jātavedasā । niryāṇaṃ ca rathenāśu sahasā yatkṛtaṃ tvayā ॥5॥
html:
tailābhyaktasya gamanaṃ bhojanaṃ ca gṛhe mama ।
samupānīya vividhaṃ yaddagdhaṃ jātavedasā ।
niryāṇaṃ ca rathenāśu sahasā yatkṛtaṃ tvayā ॥5॥
slp1: tElAByaktasya gamanaM BojanaM ca gfhe mama । samupAnIya viviDaM yaddagDaM jAtavedasA । niryARaM ca raTenASu sahasA yatkftaM tvayA ॥5॥

text: dhanānāṃ ca visargasya vanasyāpi ca darśanam । prāsādānāṃ bahūnāṃ ca kāñcanānāṃ mahāmune ॥6॥
html:
dhanānāṃ ca visargasya vanasyāpi ca darśanam ।
prāsādānāṃ bahūnāṃ ca kāñcanānāṃ mahāmune ॥6॥
slp1: DanAnAM ca visargasya vanasyApi ca darSanam । prAsAdAnAM bahUnAM ca kAYcanAnAM mahAmune ॥6॥

text: maṇividrumapādānāṃ paryaṅkānāṃ ca darśanam । punaścādarśanaṃ tasya śrotumicchāmi kāraṇam ॥7॥
html:
maṇividrumapādānāṃ paryaṅkānāṃ ca darśanam ।
punaścādarśanaṃ tasya śrotumicchāmi kāraṇam ॥7॥
slp1: maRividrumapAdAnAM paryaNkAnAM ca darSanam । punaScAdarSanaM tasya SrotumicCAmi kAraRam ॥7॥

text: atīva hyatra muhyāmi cintayāno divāniśam । na caivātrādhigacchāmi sarvasyāsya viniścayam । etadicchāmi kārtsnyena satyaṃ śrotuṃ tapodhana ॥8॥
html:
atīva hyatra muhyāmi cintayāno divāniśam ।
na caivātrādhigacchāmi sarvasyāsya viniścayam ।
etadicchāmi kārtsnyena satyaṃ śrotuṃ tapodhana ॥8॥
slp1: atIva hyatra muhyAmi cintayAno divAniSam । na cEvAtrADigacCAmi sarvasyAsya viniScayam । etadicCAmi kArtsnyena satyaM SrotuM tapoDana ॥8॥

text: śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣeṇa yadidaṃ yena hetunā । na hi śakyamanākhyātumevaṃ pṛṣṭena pārthiva ॥9॥
html:
śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣeṇa yadidaṃ yena hetunā ।
na hi śakyamanākhyātumevaṃ pṛṣṭena pārthiva ॥9॥
slp1: SfRu sarvamaSezeRa yadidaM yena hetunA । na hi SakyamanAKyAtumevaM pfzwena pArTiva ॥9॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: pitāmahasya vadataḥ purā devasamāgame । śrutavānasmi yadrājaṃstanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥10॥
html:
pitāmahasya vadataḥ purā devasamāgame ।
śrutavānasmi yadrājaṃstanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥10॥
slp1: pitAmahasya vadataH purA devasamAgame । SrutavAnasmi yadrAjaMstanme nigadataH SfRu ॥10॥

text: brahmakṣatravirodhena bhavitā kulasaṅkaraḥ । pautraste bhavitā rājaṃstejovīryasamanvitaḥ ॥11॥
html:
brahmakṣatravirodhena bhavitā kulasaṅkaraḥ ।
pautraste bhavitā rājaṃstejovīryasamanvitaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: brahmakzatraviroDena BavitA kulasaNkaraH । pOtraste BavitA rAjaMstejovIryasamanvitaH ॥11॥

text: tataḥ svakularakṣārthamahaṃ tvā samupāgamam । cikīrṣankuśikocchedaṃ sandidhakṣuḥ kulaṃ tava ॥12॥
html:
tataḥ svakularakṣārthamahaṃ tvā samupāgamam ।
cikīrṣankuśikocchedaṃ sandidhakṣuḥ kulaṃ tava ॥12॥
slp1: tataH svakularakzArTamahaM tvA samupAgamam । cikIrzankuSikocCedaM sandiDakzuH kulaM tava ॥12॥

text: tato'hamāgamya purā tvāmavocaṃ mahīpate । niyamaṃ kañcidārapsye śuśrūṣā kriyatāmiti ॥13॥
html:
tato'hamāgamya purā tvāmavocaṃ mahīpate ।
niyamaṃ kañcidārapsye śuśrūṣā kriyatāmiti ॥13॥
slp1: tato'hamAgamya purA tvAmavocaM mahIpate । niyamaM kaYcidArapsye SuSrUzA kriyatAmiti ॥13॥

text: na ca te duṣkṛtaṃ kiñcidahamāsādayaṃ gṛhe । tena jīvasi rājarṣe na bhavethāstato'nyathā ॥14॥
html:
na ca te duṣkṛtaṃ kiñcidahamāsādayaṃ gṛhe ।
tena jīvasi rājarṣe na bhavethāstato'nyathā ॥14॥
slp1: na ca te duzkftaM kiYcidahamAsAdayaM gfhe । tena jIvasi rAjarze na BaveTAstato'nyaTA ॥14॥

text: etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya divasānekaviṃśatim । supto'smi yadi māṃ kaścidbodhayediti pārthiva ॥15॥
html:
etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya divasānekaviṃśatim ।
supto'smi yadi māṃ kaścidbodhayediti pārthiva ॥15॥
slp1: etAM budDiM samAsTAya divasAnekaviMSatim । supto'smi yadi mAM kaScidboDayediti pArTiva ॥15॥

text: yadā tvayā sabhāryeṇa saṃsupto na prabodhitaḥ । ahaṃ tadaiva te prīto manasā rājasattama ॥16॥
html:
yadā tvayā sabhāryeṇa saṃsupto na prabodhitaḥ ।
ahaṃ tadaiva te prīto manasā rājasattama ॥16॥
slp1: yadA tvayA saBAryeRa saMsupto na praboDitaH । ahaM tadEva te prIto manasA rAjasattama ॥16॥

text: utthāya cāsmi niṣkrānto yadi māṃ tvaṃ mahīpate । pṛccheḥ kva yāsyasītyevaṃ śapeyaṃ tvāmiti prabho ॥17॥
html:
utthāya cāsmi niṣkrānto yadi māṃ tvaṃ mahīpate ।
pṛccheḥ kva yāsyasītyevaṃ śapeyaṃ tvāmiti prabho ॥17॥
slp1: utTAya cAsmi nizkrAnto yadi mAM tvaM mahIpate । pfcCeH kva yAsyasItyevaM SapeyaM tvAmiti praBo ॥17॥

text: antarhitaścāsmi punaḥ punareva ca te gṛhe । yogamāsthāya saṃviṣṭo divasānekaviṃśatim ॥18॥
html:
antarhitaścāsmi punaḥ punareva ca te gṛhe ।
yogamāsthāya saṃviṣṭo divasānekaviṃśatim ॥18॥
slp1: antarhitaScAsmi punaH punareva ca te gfhe । yogamAsTAya saMvizwo divasAnekaviMSatim ॥18॥

text: kṣudhito māmasūyethāḥ śramādveti narādhipa । etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya karśitau vāṃ mayā kṣudhā ॥19॥
html:
kṣudhito māmasūyethāḥ śramādveti narādhipa ।
etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya karśitau vāṃ mayā kṣudhā ॥19॥
slp1: kzuDito mAmasUyeTAH SramAdveti narADipa । etAM budDiM samAsTAya karSitO vAM mayA kzuDA ॥19॥

text: na ca te'bhūtsusūkṣmo'pi manyurmanasi pārthiva । sabhāryasya naraśreṣṭha tena te prītimānaham ॥20॥
html:
na ca te'bhūtsusūkṣmo'pi manyurmanasi pārthiva ।
sabhāryasya naraśreṣṭha tena te prītimānaham ॥20॥
slp1: na ca te'BUtsusUkzmo'pi manyurmanasi pArTiva । saBAryasya naraSrezWa tena te prItimAnaham ॥20॥

text: bhojanaṃ ca samānāyya yattadādīpitaṃ mayā । krudhyethā yadi mātsaryāditi tanmarṣitaṃ ca te ॥21॥
html:
bhojanaṃ ca samānāyya yattadādīpitaṃ mayā ।
krudhyethā yadi mātsaryāditi tanmarṣitaṃ ca te ॥21॥
slp1: BojanaM ca samAnAyya yattadAdIpitaM mayA । kruDyeTA yadi mAtsaryAditi tanmarzitaM ca te ॥21॥

text: tato'haṃ rathamāruhya tvāmavocaṃ narādhipa । sabhāryo māṃ vahasveti tacca tvaṃ kṛtavāṃstathā ॥22॥
html:
tato'haṃ rathamāruhya tvāmavocaṃ narādhipa ।
sabhāryo māṃ vahasveti tacca tvaṃ kṛtavāṃstathā ॥22॥
slp1: tato'haM raTamAruhya tvAmavocaM narADipa । saBAryo mAM vahasveti tacca tvaM kftavAMstaTA ॥22॥

text: aviśaṅko narapate prīto'haṃ cāpi tena te । dhanotsarge'pi ca kṛte na tvāṃ krodhaḥ pradharṣayat ॥23॥
html:
aviśaṅko narapate prīto'haṃ cāpi tena te ।
dhanotsarge'pi ca kṛte na tvāṃ krodhaḥ pradharṣayat ॥23॥
slp1: aviSaNko narapate prIto'haM cApi tena te । Danotsarge'pi ca kfte na tvAM kroDaH praDarzayat ॥23॥

text: tataḥ prītena te rājanpunaretatkṛtaṃ tava । sabhāryasya vanaṃ bhūyastadviddhi manujādhipa ॥24॥
html:
tataḥ prītena te rājanpunaretatkṛtaṃ tava ।
sabhāryasya vanaṃ bhūyastadviddhi manujādhipa ॥24॥
slp1: tataH prItena te rAjanpunaretatkftaM tava । saBAryasya vanaM BUyastadvidDi manujADipa ॥24॥

text: prītyarthaṃ tava caitanme svargasandarśanaṃ kṛtam । yatte vane'sminnṛpate dṛṣṭaṃ divyaṃ nidarśanam ॥25॥
html:
prītyarthaṃ tava caitanme svargasandarśanaṃ kṛtam ।
yatte vane'sminnṛpate dṛṣṭaṃ divyaṃ nidarśanam ॥25॥
slp1: prItyarTaM tava cEtanme svargasandarSanaM kftam । yatte vane'sminnfpate dfzwaM divyaM nidarSanam ॥25॥

text: svargoddeśastvayā rājansaśarīreṇa pārthiva । muhūrtamanubhūto'sau sabhāryeṇa nṛpottama ॥26॥
html:
svargoddeśastvayā rājansaśarīreṇa pārthiva ।
muhūrtamanubhūto'sau sabhāryeṇa nṛpottama ॥26॥
slp1: svargoddeSastvayA rAjansaSarIreRa pArTiva । muhUrtamanuBUto'sO saBAryeRa nfpottama ॥26॥

text: nidarśanārthaṃ tapaso dharmasya ca narādhipa । tatra yāsītspṛhā rājaṃstaccāpi viditaṃ mama ॥27॥
html:
nidarśanārthaṃ tapaso dharmasya ca narādhipa ।
tatra yāsītspṛhā rājaṃstaccāpi viditaṃ mama ॥27॥
slp1: nidarSanArTaM tapaso Darmasya ca narADipa । tatra yAsItspfhA rAjaMstaccApi viditaM mama ॥27॥

text: brāhmaṇyaṃ kāṅkṣase hi tvaṃ tapaśca pṛthivīpate । avamanya narendratvaṃ devendratvaṃ ca pārthiva ॥28॥
html:
brāhmaṇyaṃ kāṅkṣase hi tvaṃ tapaśca pṛthivīpate ।
avamanya narendratvaṃ devendratvaṃ ca pārthiva ॥28॥
slp1: brAhmaRyaM kANkzase hi tvaM tapaSca pfTivIpate । avamanya narendratvaM devendratvaM ca pArTiva ॥28॥

text: evametadyathāttha tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ tāta durlabham । brāhmaṇye sati carṣitvamṛṣitve ca tapasvitā ॥29॥
html:
evametadyathāttha tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ tāta durlabham ।
brāhmaṇye sati carṣitvamṛṣitve ca tapasvitā ॥29॥
slp1: evametadyaTAtTa tvaM brAhmaRyaM tAta durlaBam । brAhmaRye sati carzitvamfzitve ca tapasvitA ॥29॥

text: bhaviṣyatyeṣa te kāmaḥ kuśikātkauśiko dvijaḥ । tṛtīyaṃ puruṣaṃ prāpya brāhmaṇatvaṃ gamiṣyati ॥30॥
html:
bhaviṣyatyeṣa te kāmaḥ kuśikātkauśiko dvijaḥ ।
tṛtīyaṃ puruṣaṃ prāpya brāhmaṇatvaṃ gamiṣyati ॥30॥
slp1: Bavizyatyeza te kAmaH kuSikAtkOSiko dvijaH । tftIyaM puruzaM prApya brAhmaRatvaM gamizyati ॥30॥

text: vaṃśaste pārthivaśreṣṭha bhṛgūṇāmeva tejasā । pautraste bhavitā vipra tapasvī pāvakadyutiḥ ॥31॥
html:
vaṃśaste pārthivaśreṣṭha bhṛgūṇāmeva tejasā ।
pautraste bhavitā vipra tapasvī pāvakadyutiḥ ॥31॥
slp1: vaMSaste pArTivaSrezWa BfgURAmeva tejasA । pOtraste BavitA vipra tapasvI pAvakadyutiH ॥31॥

text: yaḥ sa devamanuṣyāṇāṃ bhayamutpādayiṣyati । trayāṇāṃ caiva lokānāṃ satyametadbravīmi te ॥32॥
html:
yaḥ sa devamanuṣyāṇāṃ bhayamutpādayiṣyati ।
trayāṇāṃ caiva lokānāṃ satyametadbravīmi te ॥32॥
slp1: yaH sa devamanuzyARAM BayamutpAdayizyati । trayARAM cEva lokAnAM satyametadbravImi te ॥32॥

text: varaṃ gṛhāṇa rājarṣe yaste manasi vartate । tīrthayātrāṃ gamiṣyāmi purā kālo'tivartate ॥33॥
html:
varaṃ gṛhāṇa rājarṣe yaste manasi vartate ।
tīrthayātrāṃ gamiṣyāmi purā kālo'tivartate ॥33॥
slp1: varaM gfhARa rAjarze yaste manasi vartate । tIrTayAtrAM gamizyAmi purA kAlo'tivartate ॥33॥

text: eṣa eva varo me'dya yattvaṃ prīto mahāmune । bhavatvetadyathāttha tvaṃ tapaḥ pautre mamānagha । brāhmaṇyaṃ me kulasyāstu bhagavanneṣa me varaḥ ॥34॥
html:
eṣa eva varo me'dya yattvaṃ prīto mahāmune ।
bhavatvetadyathāttha tvaṃ tapaḥ pautre mamānagha ।
brāhmaṇyaṃ me kulasyāstu bhagavanneṣa me varaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: eza eva varo me'dya yattvaM prIto mahAmune । BavatvetadyaTAtTa tvaM tapaH pOtre mamAnaGa । brAhmaRyaM me kulasyAstu Bagavanneza me varaH ॥34॥
author: kuśika uvāca ।

text: punaścākhyātumicchāmi bhagavanvistareṇa vai । kathameṣyati vipratvaṃ kulaṃ me bhṛgunandana । kaścāsau bhavitā bandhurmama kaścāpi sammataḥ] ॥35॥
html:
punaścākhyātumicchāmi bhagavanvistareṇa vai ।
kathameṣyati vipratvaṃ kulaṃ me bhṛgunandana ।
kaścāsau bhavitā bandhurmama kaścāpi sammataḥ] ॥35॥
slp1: punaScAKyAtumicCAmi BagavanvistareRa vE । kaTamezyati vipratvaM kulaM me Bfgunandana । kaScAsO BavitA banDurmama kaScApi sammataH] ॥35॥

text: avaśyaṃ kathanīyaṃ me tavaitannarapuṅgava । yadarthaṃ tvāhamucchettuṃ samprāpto manujādhipa ॥1॥
html:
avaśyaṃ kathanīyaṃ me tavaitannarapuṅgava ।
yadarthaṃ tvāhamucchettuṃ samprāpto manujādhipa ॥1॥
slp1: avaSyaM kaTanIyaM me tavEtannarapuNgava । yadarTaM tvAhamucCettuM samprApto manujADipa ॥1॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: bhṛgūṇāṃ kṣatriyā yājyā nityameva janādhipa । te ca bhedaṃ gamiṣyanti daivayuktena hetunā ॥2॥
html:
bhṛgūṇāṃ kṣatriyā yājyā nityameva janādhipa ।
te ca bhedaṃ gamiṣyanti daivayuktena hetunā ॥2॥
slp1: BfgURAM kzatriyA yAjyA nityameva janADipa । te ca BedaM gamizyanti dEvayuktena hetunA ॥2॥

text: kṣatriyāśca bhṛgūnsarvānvadhiṣyanti narādhipa । ā garbhādanukṛntanto daivadaṇḍanipīḍitāḥ ॥3॥
html:
kṣatriyāśca bhṛgūnsarvānvadhiṣyanti narādhipa ।
ā garbhādanukṛntanto daivadaṇḍanipīḍitāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: kzatriyASca BfgUnsarvAnvaDizyanti narADipa । A garBAdanukfntanto dEvadaRqanipIqitAH ॥3॥

text: tata utpatsyate'smākaṃ kule gotravivardhanaḥ । aurvo nāma mahātejā jvalanārkasamadyutiḥ ॥4॥
html:
tata utpatsyate'smākaṃ kule gotravivardhanaḥ ।
aurvo nāma mahātejā jvalanārkasamadyutiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tata utpatsyate'smAkaM kule gotravivarDanaH । Orvo nAma mahAtejA jvalanArkasamadyutiH ॥4॥

text: sa trailokyavināśāya kopāgniṃ janayiṣyati । mahīṃ saparvatavanāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati bhasmasāt ॥5॥
html:
sa trailokyavināśāya kopāgniṃ janayiṣyati ।
mahīṃ saparvatavanāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati bhasmasāt ॥5॥
slp1: sa trElokyavinASAya kopAgniM janayizyati । mahIM saparvatavanAM yaH karizyati BasmasAt ॥5॥

text: kañcitkālaṃ tu taṃ vahniṃ sa eva śamayiṣyati । samudre vaḍavāvaktre prakṣipya munisattamaḥ ॥6॥
html:
kañcitkālaṃ tu taṃ vahniṃ sa eva śamayiṣyati ।
samudre vaḍavāvaktre prakṣipya munisattamaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: kaYcitkAlaM tu taM vahniM sa eva Samayizyati । samudre vaqavAvaktre prakzipya munisattamaH ॥6॥

text: putraṃ tasya mahābhāgamṛcīkaṃ bhṛgunandanam । sākṣātkṛtsno dhanurvedaḥ samupasthāsyate'nagha ॥7॥
html:
putraṃ tasya mahābhāgamṛcīkaṃ bhṛgunandanam ।
sākṣātkṛtsno dhanurvedaḥ samupasthāsyate'nagha ॥7॥
slp1: putraM tasya mahABAgamfcIkaM Bfgunandanam । sAkzAtkftsno DanurvedaH samupasTAsyate'naGa ॥7॥

text: kṣatriyāṇāmabhāvāya daivayuktena hetunā । sa tu taṃ pratigṛhyaiva putre saṅkrāmayiṣyati ॥8॥
html:
kṣatriyāṇāmabhāvāya daivayuktena hetunā ।
sa tu taṃ pratigṛhyaiva putre saṅkrāmayiṣyati ॥8॥
slp1: kzatriyARAmaBAvAya dEvayuktena hetunA । sa tu taM pratigfhyEva putre saNkrAmayizyati ॥8॥

text: jamadagnau mahābhāge tapasā bhāvitātmani । sa cāpi bhṛguśārdūlastaṃ vedaṃ dhārayiṣyati ॥9॥
html:
jamadagnau mahābhāge tapasā bhāvitātmani ।
sa cāpi bhṛguśārdūlastaṃ vedaṃ dhārayiṣyati ॥9॥
slp1: jamadagnO mahABAge tapasA BAvitAtmani । sa cApi BfguSArdUlastaM vedaM DArayizyati ॥9॥

text: kulāttu tava dharmātmankanyāṃ so'dhigamiṣyati । udbhāvanārthaṃ bhavato vaṃśasya nṛpasattama ॥10॥
html:
kulāttu tava dharmātmankanyāṃ so'dhigamiṣyati ।
udbhāvanārthaṃ bhavato vaṃśasya nṛpasattama ॥10॥
slp1: kulAttu tava DarmAtmankanyAM so'Digamizyati । udBAvanArTaM Bavato vaMSasya nfpasattama ॥10॥

text: gādherduhitaraṃ prāpya pautrīṃ tava mahātapāḥ । brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatradharmāṇaṃ rāmamutpādayiṣyati ॥11॥
html:
gādherduhitaraṃ prāpya pautrīṃ tava mahātapāḥ ।
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatradharmāṇaṃ rāmamutpādayiṣyati ॥11॥
slp1: gADerduhitaraM prApya pOtrIM tava mahAtapAH । brAhmaRaM kzatraDarmARaM rAmamutpAdayizyati ॥11॥

text: kṣatriyaṃ viprakarmāṇaṃ bṛhaspatimivaujasā । viśvāmitraṃ tava kule gādheḥ putraṃ sudhārmikam । tapasā mahatā yuktaṃ pradāsyati mahādyute ॥12॥
html:
kṣatriyaṃ viprakarmāṇaṃ bṛhaspatimivaujasā ।
viśvāmitraṃ tava kule gādheḥ putraṃ sudhārmikam ।
tapasā mahatā yuktaṃ pradāsyati mahādyute ॥12॥
slp1: kzatriyaM viprakarmARaM bfhaspatimivOjasA । viSvAmitraM tava kule gADeH putraM suDArmikam । tapasA mahatA yuktaM pradAsyati mahAdyute ॥12॥

text: striyau tu kāraṇaṃ tatra parivarte bhaviṣyataḥ । pitāmahaniyogādvai nānyathaitadbhaviṣyati ॥13॥
html:
striyau tu kāraṇaṃ tatra parivarte bhaviṣyataḥ ।
pitāmahaniyogādvai nānyathaitadbhaviṣyati ॥13॥
slp1: striyO tu kAraRaM tatra parivarte BavizyataH । pitAmahaniyogAdvE nAnyaTEtadBavizyati ॥13॥

text: tṛtīye puruṣe tubhyaṃ brāhmaṇatvamupaiṣyati । bhavitā tvaṃ ca sambandhī bhṛgūṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām ॥14॥
html:
tṛtīye puruṣe tubhyaṃ brāhmaṇatvamupaiṣyati ।
bhavitā tvaṃ ca sambandhī bhṛgūṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām ॥14॥
slp1: tftIye puruze tuByaM brAhmaRatvamupEzyati । BavitA tvaM ca sambanDI BfgURAM BAvitAtmanAm ॥14॥

text: kuśikastu munervākyaṃ cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ । śrutvā hṛṣṭo'bhavadrājā vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha । evamastviti dharmātmā tadā bharatasattama ॥15॥
html:
kuśikastu munervākyaṃ cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ ।
śrutvā hṛṣṭo'bhavadrājā vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha ।
evamastviti dharmātmā tadā bharatasattama ॥15॥
slp1: kuSikastu munervAkyaM cyavanasya mahAtmanaH । SrutvA hfzwo'BavadrAjA vAkyaM cedamuvAca ha । evamastviti DarmAtmA tadA Baratasattama ॥15॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: cyavanastu mahātejāḥ punareva narādhipam । varārthaṃ codayāmāsa tamuvāca sa pārthivaḥ ॥16॥
html:
cyavanastu mahātejāḥ punareva narādhipam ।
varārthaṃ codayāmāsa tamuvāca sa pārthivaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: cyavanastu mahAtejAH punareva narADipam । varArTaM codayAmAsa tamuvAca sa pArTivaH ॥16॥

text: bāḍhamevaṃ grahīṣyāmi kāmaṃ tvatto mahāmune । brahmabhūtaṃ kulaṃ me'stu dharme cāsya mano bhavet ॥17॥
html:
bāḍhamevaṃ grahīṣyāmi kāmaṃ tvatto mahāmune ।
brahmabhūtaṃ kulaṃ me'stu dharme cāsya mano bhavet ॥17॥
slp1: bAQamevaM grahIzyAmi kAmaM tvatto mahAmune । brahmaBUtaM kulaM me'stu Darme cAsya mano Bavet ॥17॥

text: evamuktastathetyevaṃ pratyuktvā cyavano muniḥ । abhyanujñāya nṛpatiṃ tīrthayātrāṃ yayau tadā ॥18॥
html:
evamuktastathetyevaṃ pratyuktvā cyavano muniḥ ।
abhyanujñāya nṛpatiṃ tīrthayātrāṃ yayau tadā ॥18॥
slp1: evamuktastaTetyevaM pratyuktvA cyavano muniH । aByanujYAya nfpatiM tIrTayAtrAM yayO tadA ॥18॥

text: etatte kathitaṃ sarvamaśeṣeṇa mayā nṛpa । bhṛgūṇāṃ kuśikānāṃ ca prati sambandhakāraṇam ॥19॥
html:
etatte kathitaṃ sarvamaśeṣeṇa mayā nṛpa ।
bhṛgūṇāṃ kuśikānāṃ ca prati sambandhakāraṇam ॥19॥
slp1: etatte kaTitaM sarvamaSezeRa mayA nfpa । BfgURAM kuSikAnAM ca prati sambanDakAraRam ॥19॥

text: yathoktaṃ muninā cāpi tathā tadabhavannṛpa । janma rāmasya ca munerviśvāmitrasya caiva ha] ॥20॥
html:
yathoktaṃ muninā cāpi tathā tadabhavannṛpa ।
janma rāmasya ca munerviśvāmitrasya caiva ha] ॥20॥
slp1: yaToktaM muninA cApi taTA tadaBavannfpa । janma rAmasya ca munerviSvAmitrasya cEva ha] ॥20॥

text: muhyāmīva niśamyādya cintayānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ । hīnāṃ pārthivasaṅghātaiḥ śrīmadbhiḥ pṛthivīmimām ॥1॥
html:
muhyāmīva niśamyādya cintayānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
hīnāṃ pārthivasaṅghātaiḥ śrīmadbhiḥ pṛthivīmimām ॥1॥
slp1: muhyAmIva niSamyAdya cintayAnaH punaH punaH । hInAM pArTivasaNGAtEH SrImadBiH pfTivImimAm ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: prāpya rājyāni śataśo mahīṃ jitvāpi bhārata । koṭiśaḥ puruṣānhatvā paritapye pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
prāpya rājyāni śataśo mahīṃ jitvāpi bhārata ।
koṭiśaḥ puruṣānhatvā paritapye pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: prApya rAjyAni SataSo mahIM jitvApi BArata । kowiSaH puruzAnhatvA paritapye pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: kā nu tāsāṃ varastrīṇāmavasthādya bhaviṣyati । yā hīnāḥ patibhiḥ putrairmātulairbhrātṛbhistathā ॥3॥
html:
kā nu tāsāṃ varastrīṇāmavasthādya bhaviṣyati ।
yā hīnāḥ patibhiḥ putrairmātulairbhrātṛbhistathā ॥3॥
slp1: kA nu tAsAM varastrIRAmavasTAdya Bavizyati । yA hInAH patiBiH putrErmAtulErBrAtfBistaTA ॥3॥

text: vayaṃ hi tāngurūnhatvā jñātīṃśca suhṛdo'pi ca । avākśīrṣāḥ patiṣyāmo narake nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥4॥
html:
vayaṃ hi tāngurūnhatvā jñātīṃśca suhṛdo'pi ca ।
avākśīrṣāḥ patiṣyāmo narake nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: vayaM hi tAngurUnhatvA jYAtIMSca suhfdo'pi ca । avAkSIrzAH patizyAmo narake nAtra saMSayaH ॥4॥

text: śarīraṃ yoktumicchāmi tapasogreṇa bhārata । upadiṣṭamihecchāmi tattvato'haṃ viśāṃ pate ॥5॥
html:
śarīraṃ yoktumicchāmi tapasogreṇa bhārata ।
upadiṣṭamihecchāmi tattvato'haṃ viśāṃ pate ॥5॥
slp1: SarIraM yoktumicCAmi tapasogreRa BArata । upadizwamihecCAmi tattvato'haM viSAM pate ॥5॥

text: yudhiṣṭhirasya tadvākyaṃ śrutvā bhīṣmo mahāmanāḥ । parīkṣya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā yudhiṣṭhiramabhāṣata ॥6॥
html:
yudhiṣṭhirasya tadvākyaṃ śrutvā bhīṣmo mahāmanāḥ ।
parīkṣya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā yudhiṣṭhiramabhāṣata ॥6॥
slp1: yuDizWirasya tadvAkyaM SrutvA BIzmo mahAmanAH । parIkzya nipuRaM budDyA yuDizWiramaBAzata ॥6॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: rahasyamadbhutaṃ caiva śṛṇu vakṣyāmi yattvayi । yā gatiḥ prāpyate yena pretyabhāveṣu bhārata ॥7॥
html:
rahasyamadbhutaṃ caiva śṛṇu vakṣyāmi yattvayi ।
yā gatiḥ prāpyate yena pretyabhāveṣu bhārata ॥7॥
slp1: rahasyamadButaM cEva SfRu vakzyAmi yattvayi । yA gatiH prApyate yena pretyaBAvezu BArata ॥7॥

text: tapasā prāpyate svargastapasā prāpyate yaśaḥ । āyuḥprakarṣo bhogāśca labhyante tapasā vibho ॥8॥
html:
tapasā prāpyate svargastapasā prāpyate yaśaḥ ।
āyuḥprakarṣo bhogāśca labhyante tapasā vibho ॥8॥
slp1: tapasA prApyate svargastapasA prApyate yaSaH । AyuHprakarzo BogASca laByante tapasA viBo ॥8॥

text: jñānaṃ vijñānamārogyaṃ rūpaṃ sampattathaiva ca । saubhāgyaṃ caiva tapasā prāpyate bharatarṣabha ॥9॥
html:
jñānaṃ vijñānamārogyaṃ rūpaṃ sampattathaiva ca ।
saubhāgyaṃ caiva tapasā prāpyate bharatarṣabha ॥9॥
slp1: jYAnaM vijYAnamArogyaM rUpaM sampattaTEva ca । sOBAgyaM cEva tapasA prApyate BaratarzaBa ॥9॥

text: dhanaṃ prāpnoti tapasā maunaṃ jñānaṃ prayacchati । upabhogāṃstu dānena brahmacaryeṇa jīvitam ॥10॥
html:
dhanaṃ prāpnoti tapasā maunaṃ jñānaṃ prayacchati ।
upabhogāṃstu dānena brahmacaryeṇa jīvitam ॥10॥
slp1: DanaM prApnoti tapasA mOnaM jYAnaM prayacCati । upaBogAMstu dAnena brahmacaryeRa jIvitam ॥10॥

text: ahiṃsāyāḥ phalaṃ rūpaṃ dīkṣāyā janma vai kule । phalamūlāśināṃ rājyaṃ svargaḥ parṇāśināṃ bhavet ॥11॥
html:
ahiṃsāyāḥ phalaṃ rūpaṃ dīkṣāyā janma vai kule ।
phalamūlāśināṃ rājyaṃ svargaḥ parṇāśināṃ bhavet ॥11॥
slp1: ahiMsAyAH PalaM rUpaM dIkzAyA janma vE kule । PalamUlASinAM rAjyaM svargaH parRASinAM Bavet ॥11॥

text: payobhakṣo divaṃ yāti snānena draviṇādhikaḥ । guruśuśrūṣayā vidyā nityaśrāddhena santatiḥ ॥12॥
html:
payobhakṣo divaṃ yāti snānena draviṇādhikaḥ ।
guruśuśrūṣayā vidyā nityaśrāddhena santatiḥ ॥12॥
slp1: payoBakzo divaM yAti snAnena draviRADikaH । guruSuSrUzayA vidyA nityaSrAdDena santatiH ॥12॥

text: gavāḍhyaḥ śākadīkṣābhiḥ svargamāhustṛṇāśanāt । striyastriṣavaṇasnānādvāyuṃ pītvā kratuṃ labhet ॥13॥
html:
gavāḍhyaḥ śākadīkṣābhiḥ svargamāhustṛṇāśanāt ।
striyastriṣavaṇasnānādvāyuṃ pītvā kratuṃ labhet ॥13॥
slp1: gavAQyaH SAkadIkzABiH svargamAhustfRASanAt । striyastrizavaRasnAnAdvAyuM pItvA kratuM laBet ॥13॥

text: nityasnāyī bhaveddakṣaḥ sandhye tu dve japandvijaḥ । maruṃ sādhayato rājyaṃ nākapṛṣṭhamanāśake ॥14॥
html:
nityasnāyī bhaveddakṣaḥ sandhye tu dve japandvijaḥ ।
maruṃ sādhayato rājyaṃ nākapṛṣṭhamanāśake ॥14॥
slp1: nityasnAyI BaveddakzaH sanDye tu dve japandvijaH । maruM sADayato rAjyaM nAkapfzWamanASake ॥14॥

text: sthaṇḍile śayamānānāṃ gṛhāṇi śayanāni ca । cīravalkalavāsobhirvāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ॥15॥
html:
sthaṇḍile śayamānānāṃ gṛhāṇi śayanāni ca ।
cīravalkalavāsobhirvāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ॥15॥
slp1: sTaRqile SayamAnAnAM gfhARi SayanAni ca । cIravalkalavAsoBirvAsAMsyABaraRAni ca ॥15॥

text: śayyāsanāni yānāni yogayukte tapodhane । agnipraveśe niyataṃ brahmaloko vidhīyate ॥16॥
html:
śayyāsanāni yānāni yogayukte tapodhane ।
agnipraveśe niyataṃ brahmaloko vidhīyate ॥16॥
slp1: SayyAsanAni yAnAni yogayukte tapoDane । agnipraveSe niyataM brahmaloko viDIyate ॥16॥

text: rasānāṃ pratisaṃhārātsaubhāgyamiha vindati । āmiṣapratisaṃhārātprajāsyāyuṣmatī bhavet ॥17॥
html:
rasānāṃ pratisaṃhārātsaubhāgyamiha vindati ।
āmiṣapratisaṃhārātprajāsyāyuṣmatī bhavet ॥17॥
slp1: rasAnAM pratisaMhArAtsOBAgyamiha vindati । AmizapratisaMhArAtprajAsyAyuzmatI Bavet ॥17॥

text: udavāsaṃ vasedyastu sa narādhipatirbhavet । satyavādī naraśreṣṭha daivataiḥ saha modate ॥18॥
html:
udavāsaṃ vasedyastu sa narādhipatirbhavet ।
satyavādī naraśreṣṭha daivataiḥ saha modate ॥18॥
slp1: udavAsaM vasedyastu sa narADipatirBavet । satyavAdI naraSrezWa dEvatEH saha modate ॥18॥

text: kīrtirbhavati dānena tathārogyamahiṃsayā । dvijaśuśrūṣayā rājyaṃ dvijatvaṃ vāpi puṣkalam ॥19॥
html:
kīrtirbhavati dānena tathārogyamahiṃsayā ।
dvijaśuśrūṣayā rājyaṃ dvijatvaṃ vāpi puṣkalam ॥19॥
slp1: kIrtirBavati dAnena taTArogyamahiMsayA । dvijaSuSrUzayA rAjyaM dvijatvaM vApi puzkalam ॥19॥

text: pānīyasya pradānena kīrtirbhavati śāśvatī । annapānapradānena tṛpyate kāmabhogataḥ ॥20॥
html:
pānīyasya pradānena kīrtirbhavati śāśvatī ।
annapānapradānena tṛpyate kāmabhogataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: pAnIyasya pradAnena kIrtirBavati SASvatI । annapAnapradAnena tfpyate kAmaBogataH ॥20॥

text: sāntvadaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvaśokairvimucyate । devaśuśrūṣayā rājyaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ niyacchati ॥21॥
html:
sāntvadaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvaśokairvimucyate ।
devaśuśrūṣayā rājyaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ niyacchati ॥21॥
slp1: sAntvadaH sarvaBUtAnAM sarvaSokErvimucyate । devaSuSrUzayA rAjyaM divyaM rUpaM niyacCati ॥21॥

text: dīpālokapradānena cakṣuṣmānbhavate naraḥ । prekṣaṇīyapradānena smṛtiṃ medhāṃ ca vindati ॥22॥
html:
dīpālokapradānena cakṣuṣmānbhavate naraḥ ।
prekṣaṇīyapradānena smṛtiṃ medhāṃ ca vindati ॥22॥
slp1: dIpAlokapradAnena cakzuzmAnBavate naraH । prekzaRIyapradAnena smftiM meDAM ca vindati ॥22॥

text: gandhamālyanivṛttyā tu kīrtirbhavati puṣkalā । keśaśmaśrūndhārayatāmagryā bhavati santatiḥ ॥23॥
html:
gandhamālyanivṛttyā tu kīrtirbhavati puṣkalā ।
keśaśmaśrūndhārayatāmagryā bhavati santatiḥ ॥23॥
slp1: ganDamAlyanivfttyA tu kIrtirBavati puzkalA । keSaSmaSrUnDArayatAmagryA Bavati santatiH ॥23॥

text: upavāsaṃ ca dīkṣāṃ ca abhiṣekaṃ ca pārthiva । kṛtvā dvādaśa varṣāṇi vīrasthānādviśiṣyate ॥24॥
html:
upavāsaṃ ca dīkṣāṃ ca abhiṣekaṃ ca pārthiva ।
kṛtvā dvādaśa varṣāṇi vīrasthānādviśiṣyate ॥24॥
slp1: upavAsaM ca dIkzAM ca aBizekaM ca pArTiva । kftvA dvAdaSa varzARi vIrasTAnAdviSizyate ॥24॥

text: dāsīdāsamalaṅkārānkṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca । brahmadeyāṃ sutāṃ dattvā prāpnoti manujarṣabha ॥25॥
html:
dāsīdāsamalaṅkārānkṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca ।
brahmadeyāṃ sutāṃ dattvā prāpnoti manujarṣabha ॥25॥
slp1: dAsIdAsamalaNkArAnkzetrARi ca gfhARi ca । brahmadeyAM sutAM dattvA prApnoti manujarzaBa ॥25॥

text: kratubhiścopavāsaiśca tridivaṃ yāti bhārata । labhate ca ciraṃ sthānaṃ balipuṣpaprado naraḥ ॥26॥
html:
kratubhiścopavāsaiśca tridivaṃ yāti bhārata ।
labhate ca ciraṃ sthānaṃ balipuṣpaprado naraḥ ॥26॥
slp1: kratuBiScopavAsESca tridivaM yAti BArata । laBate ca ciraM sTAnaM balipuzpaprado naraH ॥26॥

text: suvarṇaśṛṅgaistu vibhūṣitānāṃ gavāṃ sahasrasya naraḥ pradātā । prāpnoti puṇyaṃ divi devalokamityevamāhurmunidevasaṅghāḥ ॥27॥
html:
suvarṇaśṛṅgaistu vibhūṣitānāṃ gavāṃ sahasrasya naraḥ pradātā ।
prāpnoti puṇyaṃ divi devalokamityevamāhurmunidevasaṅghāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: suvarRaSfNgEstu viBUzitAnAM gavAM sahasrasya naraH pradAtA । prApnoti puRyaM divi devalokamityevamAhurmunidevasaNGAH ॥27॥

text: prayacchate yaḥ kapilāṃ sacailāṃ kāṃsyopadohāṃ kanakāgraśṛṅgīm । taistairguṇaiḥ kāmadughāsya bhūtvā naraṃ pradātāramupaiti sā gauḥ ॥28॥
html:
prayacchate yaḥ kapilāṃ sacailāṃ kāṃsyopadohāṃ kanakāgraśṛṅgīm ।
taistairguṇaiḥ kāmadughāsya bhūtvā naraṃ pradātāramupaiti sā gauḥ ॥28॥
slp1: prayacCate yaH kapilAM sacElAM kAMsyopadohAM kanakAgraSfNgIm । tEstErguREH kAmaduGAsya BUtvA naraM pradAtAramupEti sA gOH ॥28॥

text: yāvanti lomāni bhavanti dhenvāstāvatphalaṃ prāpnute gopradātā । putrāṃśca pautrāṃśca kulaṃ ca sarvamāsaptamaṃ tārayate paratra ॥29॥
html:
yāvanti lomāni bhavanti dhenvāstāvatphalaṃ prāpnute gopradātā ।
putrāṃśca pautrāṃśca kulaṃ ca sarvamāsaptamaṃ tārayate paratra ॥29॥
slp1: yAvanti lomAni Bavanti DenvAstAvatPalaM prApnute gopradAtA । putrAMSca pOtrAMSca kulaM ca sarvamAsaptamaM tArayate paratra ॥29॥

text: sadakṣiṇāṃ kāñcanacāruśṛṅgīṃ kāṃsyopadohāṃ draviṇottarīyām । dhenuṃ tilānāṃ dadato dvijāya lokā vasūnāṃ sulabhā bhavanti ॥30॥
html:
sadakṣiṇāṃ kāñcanacāruśṛṅgīṃ kāṃsyopadohāṃ draviṇottarīyām ।
dhenuṃ tilānāṃ dadato dvijāya lokā vasūnāṃ sulabhā bhavanti ॥30॥
slp1: sadakziRAM kAYcanacAruSfNgIM kAMsyopadohAM draviRottarIyAm । DenuM tilAnAM dadato dvijAya lokA vasUnAM sulaBA Bavanti ॥30॥

text: svakarmabhirmānavaṃ saṃnibaddhaṃ tīvrāndhakāre narake patantam । mahārṇave nauriva vāyuyuktā dānaṃ gavāṃ tārayate paratra ॥31॥
html:
svakarmabhirmānavaṃ saṃnibaddhaṃ tīvrāndhakāre narake patantam ।
mahārṇave nauriva vāyuyuktā dānaṃ gavāṃ tārayate paratra ॥31॥
slp1: svakarmaBirmAnavaM saMnibadDaM tIvrAnDakAre narake patantam । mahArRave nOriva vAyuyuktA dAnaM gavAM tArayate paratra ॥31॥

text: yo brahmadeyāṃ tu dadāti kanyāṃ bhūmipradānaṃ ca karoti vipre । dadāti cānnaṃ vidhivacca yaśca sa lokamāpnoti purandarasya ॥32॥
html:
yo brahmadeyāṃ tu dadāti kanyāṃ bhūmipradānaṃ ca karoti vipre ।
dadāti cānnaṃ vidhivacca yaśca sa lokamāpnoti purandarasya ॥32॥
slp1: yo brahmadeyAM tu dadAti kanyAM BUmipradAnaM ca karoti vipre । dadAti cAnnaM viDivacca yaSca sa lokamApnoti purandarasya ॥32॥

text: naiveśikaṃ sarvaguṇopapannaṃ dadāti vai yastu naro dvijāya । svādhyāyacāritraguṇānvitāya tasyāpi lokāḥ kuruṣūttareṣu ॥33॥
html:
naiveśikaṃ sarvaguṇopapannaṃ dadāti vai yastu naro dvijāya ।
svādhyāyacāritraguṇānvitāya tasyāpi lokāḥ kuruṣūttareṣu ॥33॥
slp1: nEveSikaM sarvaguRopapannaM dadAti vE yastu naro dvijAya । svADyAyacAritraguRAnvitAya tasyApi lokAH kuruzUttarezu ॥33॥

text: dhuryapradānena gavāṃ tathāśvairlokānavāpnoti naro vasūnām । svargāya cāhurhi hiraṇyadānaṃ tato viśiṣṭaṃ kanakapradānam ॥34॥
html:
dhuryapradānena gavāṃ tathāśvairlokānavāpnoti naro vasūnām ।
svargāya cāhurhi hiraṇyadānaṃ tato viśiṣṭaṃ kanakapradānam ॥34॥
slp1: DuryapradAnena gavAM taTASvErlokAnavApnoti naro vasUnAm । svargAya cAhurhi hiraRyadAnaM tato viSizwaM kanakapradAnam ॥34॥

text: chatrapradānena gṛhaṃ variṣṭhaṃ yānaṃ tathopānahasampradāne । vastrapradānena phalaṃ surūpaṃ gandhapradāne surabhirnaraḥ syāt ॥35॥
html:
chatrapradānena gṛhaṃ variṣṭhaṃ yānaṃ tathopānahasampradāne ।
vastrapradānena phalaṃ surūpaṃ gandhapradāne surabhirnaraḥ syāt ॥35॥
slp1: CatrapradAnena gfhaM varizWaM yAnaM taTopAnahasampradAne । vastrapradAnena PalaM surUpaM ganDapradAne suraBirnaraH syAt ॥35॥

text: puṣpopagaṃ vātha phalopagaṃ vā yaḥ pādapaṃ sparśayate dvijāya । sa strīsamṛddhaṃ bahuratnapūrṇaṃ labhatyayatnopagataṃ gṛhaṃ vai ॥36॥
html:
puṣpopagaṃ vātha phalopagaṃ vā yaḥ pādapaṃ sparśayate dvijāya ।
sa strīsamṛddhaṃ bahuratnapūrṇaṃ labhatyayatnopagataṃ gṛhaṃ vai ॥36॥
slp1: puzpopagaM vATa PalopagaM vA yaH pAdapaM sparSayate dvijAya । sa strIsamfdDaM bahuratnapUrRaM laBatyayatnopagataM gfhaM vE ॥36॥

text: bhakṣānnapānīyarasapradātā sarvānavāpnoti rasānprakāmam । pratiśrayācchādanasampradātā prāpnoti tāneva na saṃśayo'tra ॥37॥
html:
bhakṣānnapānīyarasapradātā sarvānavāpnoti rasānprakāmam ।
pratiśrayācchādanasampradātā prāpnoti tāneva na saṃśayo'tra ॥37॥
slp1: BakzAnnapAnIyarasapradAtA sarvAnavApnoti rasAnprakAmam । pratiSrayAcCAdanasampradAtA prApnoti tAneva na saMSayo'tra ॥37॥

text: sragdhūpagandhānyanulepanāni snānāni mālyāni ca mānavo yaḥ । dadyāddvijebhyaḥ sa bhavedarogastathābhirūpaśca narendraloke ॥38॥
html:
sragdhūpagandhānyanulepanāni snānāni mālyāni ca mānavo yaḥ ।
dadyāddvijebhyaḥ sa bhavedarogastathābhirūpaśca narendraloke ॥38॥
slp1: sragDUpaganDAnyanulepanAni snAnAni mAlyAni ca mAnavo yaH । dadyAddvijeByaH sa BavedarogastaTABirUpaSca narendraloke ॥38॥

text: bījairaśūnyaṃ śayanairupetaṃ dadyādgṛhaṃ yaḥ puruṣo dvijāya । puṇyābhirāmaṃ bahuratnapūrṇaṃ labhatyadhiṣṭhānavaraṃ sa rājan ॥39॥
html:
bījairaśūnyaṃ śayanairupetaṃ dadyādgṛhaṃ yaḥ puruṣo dvijāya ।
puṇyābhirāmaṃ bahuratnapūrṇaṃ labhatyadhiṣṭhānavaraṃ sa rājan ॥39॥
slp1: bIjEraSUnyaM SayanErupetaM dadyAdgfhaM yaH puruzo dvijAya । puRyABirAmaM bahuratnapUrRaM laBatyaDizWAnavaraM sa rAjan ॥39॥

text: sugandhacitrāstaraṇopapannaṃ dadyānnaro yaḥ śayanaṃ dvijāya । rūpānvitāṃ pakṣavatīṃ manojñāṃ bhāryāmayatnopagatāṃ labhetsaḥ ॥40॥
html:
sugandhacitrāstaraṇopapannaṃ dadyānnaro yaḥ śayanaṃ dvijāya ।
rūpānvitāṃ pakṣavatīṃ manojñāṃ bhāryāmayatnopagatāṃ labhetsaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: suganDacitrAstaraRopapannaM dadyAnnaro yaH SayanaM dvijAya । rUpAnvitAM pakzavatIM manojYAM BAryAmayatnopagatAM laBetsaH ॥40॥

text: pitāmahasyānucaro vīraśāyī bhavennaraḥ । nādhikaṃ vidyate tasmādityāhuḥ paramarṣayaḥ ॥41॥
html:
pitāmahasyānucaro vīraśāyī bhavennaraḥ ।
nādhikaṃ vidyate tasmādityāhuḥ paramarṣayaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: pitAmahasyAnucaro vIraSAyI BavennaraH । nADikaM vidyate tasmAdityAhuH paramarzayaH ॥41॥

text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prītātmā kurunandanaḥ । nāśrame'rocayadvāsaṃ vīramārgābhikāṅkṣayā ॥42॥
html:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prītātmā kurunandanaḥ ।
nāśrame'rocayadvāsaṃ vīramārgābhikāṅkṣayā ॥42॥
slp1: tasya tadvacanaM SrutvA prItAtmA kurunandanaH । nASrame'rocayadvAsaM vIramArgABikANkzayA ॥42॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāha pāṇḍavānbharatarṣabha । pitāmahasya yadvākyaṃ tadvo rocatviti prabhuḥ ॥43॥
html:
tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāha pāṇḍavānbharatarṣabha ।
pitāmahasya yadvākyaṃ tadvo rocatviti prabhuḥ ॥43॥
slp1: tato yuDizWiraH prAha pARqavAnBaratarzaBa । pitAmahasya yadvAkyaM tadvo rocatviti praBuH ॥43॥

text: tatastu pāṇḍavāḥ sarve draupadī ca yaśasvinī । yudhiṣṭhirasya tadvākyaṃ bāḍhamityabhyapūjayan] ॥44॥
html:
tatastu pāṇḍavāḥ sarve draupadī ca yaśasvinī ।
yudhiṣṭhirasya tadvākyaṃ bāḍhamityabhyapūjayan] ॥44॥
slp1: tatastu pARqavAH sarve drOpadI ca yaSasvinI । yuDizWirasya tadvAkyaM bAQamityaByapUjayan] ॥44॥

text: yānīmāni bahirvedyāṃ dānāni paricakṣate । tebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ kiṃ dānaṃ mataṃ te kurupuṅgava ॥1॥
html:
yānīmāni bahirvedyāṃ dānāni paricakṣate ।
tebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ kiṃ dānaṃ mataṃ te kurupuṅgava ॥1॥
slp1: yAnImAni bahirvedyAM dAnAni paricakzate । teByo viSizwaM kiM dAnaM mataM te kurupuNgava ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kautūhalaṃ hi paramaṃ tatra me vartate prabho । dātāraṃ dattamanveti yaddānaṃ tatpracakṣva me ॥2॥
html:
kautūhalaṃ hi paramaṃ tatra me vartate prabho ।
dātāraṃ dattamanveti yaddānaṃ tatpracakṣva me ॥2॥
slp1: kOtUhalaM hi paramaM tatra me vartate praBo । dAtAraM dattamanveti yaddAnaM tatpracakzva me ॥2॥

text: abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo vyasane cāpyanugraham । yaccābhilaṣitaṃ dadyāttṛṣitāyābhiyācate ॥3॥
html:
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo vyasane cāpyanugraham ।
yaccābhilaṣitaṃ dadyāttṛṣitāyābhiyācate ॥3॥
slp1: aBayaM sarvaBUteByo vyasane cApyanugraham । yaccABilazitaM dadyAttfzitAyABiyAcate ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dattaṃ manyeta yaddattvā taddānaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate । dattaṃ dātāramanveti yaddānaṃ bharatarṣabha ॥4॥
html:
dattaṃ manyeta yaddattvā taddānaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate ।
dattaṃ dātāramanveti yaddānaṃ bharatarṣabha ॥4॥
slp1: dattaM manyeta yaddattvA taddAnaM SrezWamucyate । dattaM dAtAramanveti yaddAnaM BaratarzaBa ॥4॥

text: hiraṇyadānaṃ godānaṃ pṛthivīdānameva ca । etāni vai pavitrāṇi tārayantyapi duṣkṛtam ॥5॥
html:
hiraṇyadānaṃ godānaṃ pṛthivīdānameva ca ।
etāni vai pavitrāṇi tārayantyapi duṣkṛtam ॥5॥
slp1: hiraRyadAnaM godAnaM pfTivIdAnameva ca । etAni vE pavitrARi tArayantyapi duzkftam ॥5॥

text: etāni puruṣavyāghra sādhubhyo dehi nityadā । dānāni hi naraṃ pāpānmokṣayanti na saṃśayaḥ ॥6॥
html:
etāni puruṣavyāghra sādhubhyo dehi nityadā ।
dānāni hi naraṃ pāpānmokṣayanti na saṃśayaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: etAni puruzavyAGra sADuByo dehi nityadA । dAnAni hi naraM pApAnmokzayanti na saMSayaH ॥6॥

text: yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccāsya dayitaṃ gṛhe । tattadguṇavate deyaṃ tadevākṣayamicchatā ॥7॥
html:
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccāsya dayitaṃ gṛhe ।
tattadguṇavate deyaṃ tadevākṣayamicchatā ॥7॥
slp1: yadyadizwatamaM loke yaccAsya dayitaM gfhe । tattadguRavate deyaM tadevAkzayamicCatA ॥7॥

text: priyāṇi labhate loke priyadaḥ priyakṛttathā । priyo bhavati bhūtānāmiha caiva paratra ca ॥8॥
html:
priyāṇi labhate loke priyadaḥ priyakṛttathā ।
priyo bhavati bhūtānāmiha caiva paratra ca ॥8॥
slp1: priyARi laBate loke priyadaH priyakfttaTA । priyo Bavati BUtAnAmiha cEva paratra ca ॥8॥

text: yācamānamabhīmānādāśāvantamakiñcanam । yo nārcati yathāśakti sa nṛśaṃso yudhiṣṭhira ॥9॥
html:
yācamānamabhīmānādāśāvantamakiñcanam ।
yo nārcati yathāśakti sa nṛśaṃso yudhiṣṭhira ॥9॥
slp1: yAcamAnamaBImAnAdASAvantamakiYcanam । yo nArcati yaTASakti sa nfSaMso yuDizWira ॥9॥

text: amitramapi ceddīnaṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇamāgatam । vyasane yo'nugṛhṇāti sa vai puruṣasattamaḥ ॥10॥
html:
amitramapi ceddīnaṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇamāgatam ।
vyasane yo'nugṛhṇāti sa vai puruṣasattamaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: amitramapi ceddInaM SaraREziRamAgatam । vyasane yo'nugfhRAti sa vE puruzasattamaH ॥10॥

text: kṛśāya hrīmate tāta vṛttikṣīṇāya sīdate । apahanyātkṣudhaṃ yastu na tena puruṣaḥ samaḥ ॥11॥
html:
kṛśāya hrīmate tāta vṛttikṣīṇāya sīdate ।
apahanyātkṣudhaṃ yastu na tena puruṣaḥ samaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: kfSAya hrImate tAta vfttikzIRAya sIdate । apahanyAtkzuDaM yastu na tena puruzaH samaH ॥11॥

text: hriyā tu niyatānsādhūnputradāraiśca karśitān । ayācamānānkaunteya sarvopāyairnimantraya ॥12॥
html:
hriyā tu niyatānsādhūnputradāraiśca karśitān ।
ayācamānānkaunteya sarvopāyairnimantraya ॥12॥
slp1: hriyA tu niyatAnsADUnputradArESca karSitAn । ayAcamAnAnkOnteya sarvopAyErnimantraya ॥12॥

text: āśiṣaṃ ye na deveṣu na martyeṣu ca kurvate । arhanto nityasattvasthā yathālabdhopajīvinaḥ ॥13॥
html:
āśiṣaṃ ye na deveṣu na martyeṣu ca kurvate ।
arhanto nityasattvasthā yathālabdhopajīvinaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: ASizaM ye na devezu na martyezu ca kurvate । arhanto nityasattvasTA yaTAlabDopajIvinaH ॥13॥

text: āśīviṣasamebhyaśca tebhyo rakṣasva bhārata । tānyuktairupajijñāsya tathā dvijavarottamān ॥14॥
html:
āśīviṣasamebhyaśca tebhyo rakṣasva bhārata ।
tānyuktairupajijñāsya tathā dvijavarottamān ॥14॥
slp1: ASIvizasameByaSca teByo rakzasva BArata । tAnyuktErupajijYAsya taTA dvijavarottamAn ॥14॥

text: kṛtairāvasathairnityaṃ sapreṣyaiḥ saparicchadaiḥ । nimantrayethāḥ kauravya sarvakāmasukhāvahaiḥ ॥15॥
html:
kṛtairāvasathairnityaṃ sapreṣyaiḥ saparicchadaiḥ ।
nimantrayethāḥ kauravya sarvakāmasukhāvahaiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: kftErAvasaTErnityaM saprezyEH saparicCadEH । nimantrayeTAH kOravya sarvakAmasuKAvahEH ॥15॥

text: yadi te pratigṛhṇīyuḥ śraddhāpūtaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । kāryamityeva manvānā dhārmikāḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ ॥16॥
html:
yadi te pratigṛhṇīyuḥ śraddhāpūtaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
kāryamityeva manvānā dhārmikāḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: yadi te pratigfhRIyuH SradDApUtaM yuDizWira । kAryamityeva manvAnA DArmikAH puRyakarmiRaH ॥16॥

text: vidyāsnātā vratasnātā ye vyapāśrityajīvinaḥ । gūḍhasvādhyāyatapaso brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ॥17॥
html:
vidyāsnātā vratasnātā ye vyapāśrityajīvinaḥ ।
gūḍhasvādhyāyatapaso brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: vidyAsnAtA vratasnAtA ye vyapASrityajIvinaH । gUQasvADyAyatapaso brAhmaRAH saMSitavratAH ॥17॥

text: teṣu śuddheṣu dānteṣu svadāranirateṣu ca । yatkariṣyasi kalyāṇaṃ tattvā lokeṣu dhāsyati ॥18॥
html:
teṣu śuddheṣu dānteṣu svadāranirateṣu ca ।
yatkariṣyasi kalyāṇaṃ tattvā lokeṣu dhāsyati ॥18॥
slp1: tezu SudDezu dAntezu svadAraniratezu ca । yatkarizyasi kalyARaM tattvA lokezu DAsyati ॥18॥

text: yathāgnihotraṃ suhutaṃ sāyaṃ prātardvijātinā । tathā bhavati dattaṃ vai dvijebhyo'tha kṛtātmanā ॥19॥
html:
yathāgnihotraṃ suhutaṃ sāyaṃ prātardvijātinā ।
tathā bhavati dattaṃ vai dvijebhyo'tha kṛtātmanā ॥19॥
slp1: yaTAgnihotraM suhutaM sAyaM prAtardvijAtinA । taTA Bavati dattaM vE dvijeByo'Ta kftAtmanA ॥19॥

text: eṣa te vitato yajñaḥ śraddhāpūtaḥ sadakṣiṇaḥ । viśiṣṭaḥ sarvayajñebhyo dadatastāta vartatām ॥20॥
html:
eṣa te vitato yajñaḥ śraddhāpūtaḥ sadakṣiṇaḥ ।
viśiṣṭaḥ sarvayajñebhyo dadatastāta vartatām ॥20॥
slp1: eza te vitato yajYaH SradDApUtaH sadakziRaH । viSizwaH sarvayajYeByo dadatastAta vartatAm ॥20॥

text: nivāpo dānasadṛśastādṛśeṣu yudhiṣṭhira । nivapanpūjayaṃścaiva teṣvānṛṇyaṃ nigacchati ॥21॥
html:
nivāpo dānasadṛśastādṛśeṣu yudhiṣṭhira ।
nivapanpūjayaṃścaiva teṣvānṛṇyaṃ nigacchati ॥21॥
slp1: nivApo dAnasadfSastAdfSezu yuDizWira । nivapanpUjayaMScEva tezvAnfRyaM nigacCati ॥21॥

text: ya eva no na kupyanti na lubhyanti tṛṇeṣvapi । ta eva naḥ pūjyatamā ye cānye priyavādinaḥ ॥22॥
html:
ya eva no na kupyanti na lubhyanti tṛṇeṣvapi ।
ta eva naḥ pūjyatamā ye cānye priyavādinaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: ya eva no na kupyanti na luByanti tfRezvapi । ta eva naH pUjyatamA ye cAnye priyavAdinaH ॥22॥

text: ye no na bahu manyante na pravartanti cāpare । putravatparipālyāste namastebhyastathābhayam ॥23॥
html:
ye no na bahu manyante na pravartanti cāpare ।
putravatparipālyāste namastebhyastathābhayam ॥23॥
slp1: ye no na bahu manyante na pravartanti cApare । putravatparipAlyAste namasteByastaTABayam ॥23॥

text: ṛtvikpurohitācāryā mṛdubrahmadharā hi te । kṣatreṇāpi hi saṃsṛṣṭaṃ tejaḥ śāmyati vai dvije ॥24॥
html:
ṛtvikpurohitācāryā mṛdubrahmadharā hi te ।
kṣatreṇāpi hi saṃsṛṣṭaṃ tejaḥ śāmyati vai dvije ॥24॥
slp1: ftvikpurohitAcAryA mfdubrahmaDarA hi te । kzatreRApi hi saMsfzwaM tejaH SAmyati vE dvije ॥24॥

text: asti me balavānasmi rājāsmīti yudhiṣṭhira । brāhmaṇānmā sma paryaśnīrvāsobhiraśanena ca ॥25॥
html:
asti me balavānasmi rājāsmīti yudhiṣṭhira ।
brāhmaṇānmā sma paryaśnīrvāsobhiraśanena ca ॥25॥
slp1: asti me balavAnasmi rAjAsmIti yuDizWira । brAhmaRAnmA sma paryaSnIrvAsoBiraSanena ca ॥25॥

text: yacchobhārthaṃ balārthaṃ vā vittamasti tavānagha । tena te brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ svadharmamanutiṣṭhatā ॥26॥
html:
yacchobhārthaṃ balārthaṃ vā vittamasti tavānagha ।
tena te brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ svadharmamanutiṣṭhatā ॥26॥
slp1: yacCoBArTaM balArTaM vA vittamasti tavAnaGa । tena te brAhmaRAH pUjyAH svaDarmamanutizWatA ॥26॥

text: namaskāryāstvayā viprā vartamānā yathātatham । yathāsukhaṃ yathotsāhaṃ lalantu tvayi putravat ॥27॥
html:
namaskāryāstvayā viprā vartamānā yathātatham ।
yathāsukhaṃ yathotsāhaṃ lalantu tvayi putravat ॥27॥
slp1: namaskAryAstvayA viprA vartamAnA yaTAtaTam । yaTAsuKaM yaTotsAhaM lalantu tvayi putravat ॥27॥

text: ko hyanyaḥ suprasādānāṃ suhṛdāmalpatoṣiṇām । vṛttimarhatyupakṣeptuṃ tvadanyaḥ kurusattama ॥28॥
html:
ko hyanyaḥ suprasādānāṃ suhṛdāmalpatoṣiṇām ।
vṛttimarhatyupakṣeptuṃ tvadanyaḥ kurusattama ॥28॥
slp1: ko hyanyaH suprasAdAnAM suhfdAmalpatoziRAm । vfttimarhatyupakzeptuM tvadanyaH kurusattama ॥28॥

text: yathā patyāśrayo dharmaḥ strīṇāṃ loke sanātanaḥ । sa devaḥ sā gatirnānyā tathāsmākaṃ dvijātayaḥ ॥29॥
html:
yathā patyāśrayo dharmaḥ strīṇāṃ loke sanātanaḥ ।
sa devaḥ sā gatirnānyā tathāsmākaṃ dvijātayaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: yaTA patyASrayo DarmaH strIRAM loke sanAtanaH । sa devaH sA gatirnAnyA taTAsmAkaM dvijAtayaH ॥29॥

text: yadi no brāhmaṇāstāta santyajeyurapūjitāḥ । paśyanto dāruṇaṃ karma satataṃ kṣatriye sthitam ॥30॥
html:
yadi no brāhmaṇāstāta santyajeyurapūjitāḥ ।
paśyanto dāruṇaṃ karma satataṃ kṣatriye sthitam ॥30॥
slp1: yadi no brAhmaRAstAta santyajeyurapUjitAH । paSyanto dAruRaM karma satataM kzatriye sTitam ॥30॥

text: avedānāmakīrtīnāmalokānāmayajvanām । ko'smākaṃ jīvitenārthastaddhi no brāhmaṇāśrayam ॥31॥
html:
avedānāmakīrtīnāmalokānāmayajvanām ।
ko'smākaṃ jīvitenārthastaddhi no brāhmaṇāśrayam ॥31॥
slp1: avedAnAmakIrtInAmalokAnAmayajvanAm । ko'smAkaM jIvitenArTastadDi no brAhmaRASrayam ॥31॥

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । rājanyo brāhmaṇaṃ rājanpurā paricacāra ha । vaiśyo rājanyamityeva śūdro vaiśyamiti śrutiḥ ॥32॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
rājanyo brāhmaṇaṃ rājanpurā paricacāra ha ।
vaiśyo rājanyamityeva śūdro vaiśyamiti śrutiḥ ॥32॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi yaTA DarmaH sanAtanaH । rAjanyo brAhmaRaM rAjanpurA paricacAra ha । vESyo rAjanyamityeva SUdro vESyamiti SrutiH ॥32॥

text: dūrācchūdreṇopacaryo brāhmaṇo'gniriva jvalan । saṃsparśaparicaryastu vaiśyena kṣatriyeṇa ca ॥33॥
html:
dūrācchūdreṇopacaryo brāhmaṇo'gniriva jvalan ।
saṃsparśaparicaryastu vaiśyena kṣatriyeṇa ca ॥33॥
slp1: dUrAcCUdreRopacaryo brAhmaRo'gniriva jvalan । saMsparSaparicaryastu vESyena kzatriyeRa ca ॥33॥

text: mṛdubhāvānsatyaśīlānsatyadharmānupālakān । āśīviṣāniva kruddhāṃstānupācarata dvijān ॥34॥
html:
mṛdubhāvānsatyaśīlānsatyadharmānupālakān ।
āśīviṣāniva kruddhāṃstānupācarata dvijān ॥34॥
slp1: mfduBAvAnsatyaSIlAnsatyaDarmAnupAlakAn । ASIvizAniva krudDAMstAnupAcarata dvijAn ॥34॥

text: apareṣāṃ pareṣāṃ ca parebhyaścaiva ye pare । kṣatriyāṇāṃ pratapatāṃ tejasā ca balena ca । brāhmaṇeṣveva śāmyanti tejāṃsi ca tapāṃsi ca ॥35॥
html:
apareṣāṃ pareṣāṃ ca parebhyaścaiva ye pare ।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ pratapatāṃ tejasā ca balena ca ।
brāhmaṇeṣveva śāmyanti tejāṃsi ca tapāṃsi ca ॥35॥
slp1: aparezAM parezAM ca pareByaScEva ye pare । kzatriyARAM pratapatAM tejasA ca balena ca । brAhmaRezveva SAmyanti tejAMsi ca tapAMsi ca ॥35॥

text: na me pitā priyataro na tvaṃ tāta tathā priyaḥ । na me pituḥ pitā rājanna cātmā na ca jīvitam ॥36॥
html:
na me pitā priyataro na tvaṃ tāta tathā priyaḥ ।
na me pituḥ pitā rājanna cātmā na ca jīvitam ॥36॥
slp1: na me pitA priyataro na tvaM tAta taTA priyaH । na me pituH pitA rAjanna cAtmA na ca jIvitam ॥36॥

text: tvattaśca me priyataraḥ pṛthivyāṃ nāsti kaścana । tvatto'pi me priyatarā brāhmaṇā bharatarṣabha ॥37॥
html:
tvattaśca me priyataraḥ pṛthivyāṃ nāsti kaścana ।
tvatto'pi me priyatarā brāhmaṇā bharatarṣabha ॥37॥
slp1: tvattaSca me priyataraH pfTivyAM nAsti kaScana । tvatto'pi me priyatarA brAhmaRA BaratarzaBa ॥37॥

text: bravīmi satyametacca yathāhaṃ pāṇḍunandana । tena satyena gaccheyaṃ lokānyatra sa śantanuḥ ॥38॥
html:
bravīmi satyametacca yathāhaṃ pāṇḍunandana ।
tena satyena gaccheyaṃ lokānyatra sa śantanuḥ ॥38॥
slp1: bravImi satyametacca yaTAhaM pARqunandana । tena satyena gacCeyaM lokAnyatra sa SantanuH ॥38॥

text: paśyeyaṃ ca satāṃ lokāñchucīnbrahmapuraskṛtān । tatra me tāta gantavyamahnāya ca cirāya ca ॥39॥
html:
paśyeyaṃ ca satāṃ lokāñchucīnbrahmapuraskṛtān ।
tatra me tāta gantavyamahnāya ca cirāya ca ॥39॥
slp1: paSyeyaM ca satAM lokAYCucInbrahmapuraskftAn । tatra me tAta gantavyamahnAya ca cirAya ca ॥39॥

text: so'hametādṛśāṁllokāndṛṣṭvā bharatasattama । yanme kṛtaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu na tapye tena pārthiva] ॥40॥
html:
so'hametādṛśāṁllokāndṛṣṭvā bharatasattama ।
yanme kṛtaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu na tapye tena pārthiva] ॥40॥
slp1: so'hametAdfSAṁllokAndfzwvA Baratasattama । yanme kftaM brAhmaRezu na tapye tena pArTiva] ॥40॥

text: yau tu syātāṃ caraṇenopapannau yau vidyayā sadṛśau janmanā ca । tābhyāṃ dānaṃ katarasmai viśiṣṭamayācamānāya ca yācate ca ॥1॥
html:
yau tu syātāṃ caraṇenopapannau yau vidyayā sadṛśau janmanā ca ।
tābhyāṃ dānaṃ katarasmai viśiṣṭamayācamānāya ca yācate ca ॥1॥
slp1: yO tu syAtAM caraRenopapannO yO vidyayA sadfSO janmanA ca । tAByAM dAnaM katarasmE viSizwamayAcamAnAya ca yAcate ca ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śreyo vai yācataḥ pārtha dattamāhurayācate । arhattamo vai dhṛtimānkṛpaṇādadhṛtātmanaḥ ॥2॥
html:
śreyo vai yācataḥ pārtha dattamāhurayācate ।
arhattamo vai dhṛtimānkṛpaṇādadhṛtātmanaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: Sreyo vE yAcataH pArTa dattamAhurayAcate । arhattamo vE DftimAnkfpaRAdaDftAtmanaH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kṣatriyo rakṣaṇadhṛtirbrāhmaṇo'narthanādhṛtiḥ । brāhmaṇo dhṛtimānvidvāndevānprīṇāti tuṣṭimān ॥3॥
html:
kṣatriyo rakṣaṇadhṛtirbrāhmaṇo'narthanādhṛtiḥ ।
brāhmaṇo dhṛtimānvidvāndevānprīṇāti tuṣṭimān ॥3॥
slp1: kzatriyo rakzaRaDftirbrAhmaRo'narTanADftiH । brAhmaRo DftimAnvidvAndevAnprIRAti tuzwimAn ॥3॥

text: yācñāmāhuranīśasya abhihāraṃ ca bhārata । udvejayati yācanhi sadā bhūtāni dasyuvat ॥4॥
html:
yācñāmāhuranīśasya abhihāraṃ ca bhārata ।
udvejayati yācanhi sadā bhūtāni dasyuvat ॥4॥
slp1: yAcYAmAhuranISasya aBihAraM ca BArata । udvejayati yAcanhi sadA BUtAni dasyuvat ॥4॥

text: mriyate yācamāno vai tamanu mriyate dadat । dadatsañjīvayatyenamātmānaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
html:
mriyate yācamāno vai tamanu mriyate dadat ।
dadatsañjīvayatyenamātmānaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
slp1: mriyate yAcamAno vE tamanu mriyate dadat । dadatsaYjIvayatyenamAtmAnaM ca yuDizWira ॥5॥

text: ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmo yācate yatpradīyate । ayācataḥ sīdamānānsarvopāyairnimantraya ॥6॥
html:
ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmo yācate yatpradīyate ।
ayācataḥ sīdamānānsarvopāyairnimantraya ॥6॥
slp1: AnfSaMsyaM paro Darmo yAcate yatpradIyate । ayAcataH sIdamAnAnsarvopAyErnimantraya ॥6॥

text: yadi vai tādṛśā rāṣṭre vaseyuste dvijottamāḥ । bhasmacchannānivāgnīṃstānbudhyethāstvaṃ prayatnataḥ ॥7॥
html:
yadi vai tādṛśā rāṣṭre vaseyuste dvijottamāḥ ।
bhasmacchannānivāgnīṃstānbudhyethāstvaṃ prayatnataḥ ॥7॥
slp1: yadi vE tAdfSA rAzwre vaseyuste dvijottamAH । BasmacCannAnivAgnIMstAnbuDyeTAstvaM prayatnataH ॥7॥

text: tapasā dīpyamānāste daheyuḥ pṛthivīmapi । pūjyā hi jñānavijñānatapoyogasamanvitāḥ ॥8॥
html:
tapasā dīpyamānāste daheyuḥ pṛthivīmapi ।
pūjyā hi jñānavijñānatapoyogasamanvitāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tapasA dIpyamAnAste daheyuH pfTivImapi । pUjyA hi jYAnavijYAnatapoyogasamanvitAH ॥8॥

text: tebhyaḥ pūjāṃ prayuñjīthā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ parantapa । dadadbahuvidhāndāyānupacchandānayācatām ॥9॥
html:
tebhyaḥ pūjāṃ prayuñjīthā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ parantapa ।
dadadbahuvidhāndāyānupacchandānayācatām ॥9॥
slp1: teByaH pUjAM prayuYjITA brAhmaReByaH parantapa । dadadbahuviDAndAyAnupacCandAnayAcatAm ॥9॥
