text: yadagnihotre suhute sāyamprātarbhavetphalam । vidyāvedavratavati taddānaphalamucyate ॥10॥
html:
yadagnihotre suhute sāyamprātarbhavetphalam ।
vidyāvedavratavati taddānaphalamucyate ॥10॥
slp1: yadagnihotre suhute sAyamprAtarBavetPalam । vidyAvedavratavati taddAnaPalamucyate ॥10॥

text: vidyāvedavratasnātānavyapāśrayajīvinaḥ । gūḍhasvādhyāyatapaso brāhmaṇānsaṃśitavratān ॥11॥
html:
vidyāvedavratasnātānavyapāśrayajīvinaḥ ।
gūḍhasvādhyāyatapaso brāhmaṇānsaṃśitavratān ॥11॥
slp1: vidyAvedavratasnAtAnavyapASrayajIvinaH । gUQasvADyAyatapaso brAhmaRAnsaMSitavratAn ॥11॥

text: kṛtairāvasathairhṛdyaiḥ sapreṣyaiḥ saparicchadaiḥ । nimantrayethāḥ kaunteya kāmaiścānyairdvijottamān ॥12॥
html:
kṛtairāvasathairhṛdyaiḥ sapreṣyaiḥ saparicchadaiḥ ।
nimantrayethāḥ kaunteya kāmaiścānyairdvijottamān ॥12॥
slp1: kftErAvasaTErhfdyEH saprezyEH saparicCadEH । nimantrayeTAH kOnteya kAmEScAnyErdvijottamAn ॥12॥

text: api te pratigṛhṇīyuḥ śraddhāpūtaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । kāryamityeva manvānā dharmajñāḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ ॥13॥
html:
api te pratigṛhṇīyuḥ śraddhāpūtaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
kāryamityeva manvānā dharmajñāḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: api te pratigfhRIyuH SradDApUtaM yuDizWira । kAryamityeva manvAnA DarmajYAH sUkzmadarSinaH ॥13॥

text: api te brāhmaṇā bhuktvā gatāḥ soddharaṇāngṛhān । yeṣāṃ dārāḥ pratīkṣante parjanyamiva karṣakāḥ ॥14॥
html:
api te brāhmaṇā bhuktvā gatāḥ soddharaṇāngṛhān ।
yeṣāṃ dārāḥ pratīkṣante parjanyamiva karṣakāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: api te brAhmaRA BuktvA gatAH sodDaraRAngfhAn । yezAM dArAH pratIkzante parjanyamiva karzakAH ॥14॥

text: annāni prātaḥsavane niyatā brahmacāriṇaḥ । brāhmaṇāstāta bhuñjānāstretāgnīnprīṇayantu te ॥15॥
html:
annāni prātaḥsavane niyatā brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
brāhmaṇāstāta bhuñjānāstretāgnīnprīṇayantu te ॥15॥
slp1: annAni prAtaHsavane niyatA brahmacAriRaH । brAhmaRAstAta BuYjAnAstretAgnInprIRayantu te ॥15॥

text: mādhyandinaṃ te savanaṃ dadatastāta vartatām । gā hiraṇyāni vāsāṃsi tenendraḥ prīyatāṃ tava ॥16॥
html:
mādhyandinaṃ te savanaṃ dadatastāta vartatām ।
gā hiraṇyāni vāsāṃsi tenendraḥ prīyatāṃ tava ॥16॥
slp1: mADyandinaM te savanaM dadatastAta vartatAm । gA hiraRyAni vAsAMsi tenendraH prIyatAM tava ॥16॥

text: tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ tatte vaiśvadevaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । yaddevebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca viprebhyaśca prayacchasi ॥17॥
html:
tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ tatte vaiśvadevaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
yaddevebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca viprebhyaśca prayacchasi ॥17॥
slp1: tftIyaM savanaM tatte vESvadevaM yuDizWira । yaddeveByaH pitfByaSca vipreByaSca prayacCasi ॥17॥

text: ahiṃsā sarvabhūtebhyaḥ saṃvibhāgaśca sarvaśaḥ । damastyāgo dhṛtiḥ satyaṃ bhavatvavabhṛthāya te ॥18॥
html:
ahiṃsā sarvabhūtebhyaḥ saṃvibhāgaśca sarvaśaḥ ।
damastyāgo dhṛtiḥ satyaṃ bhavatvavabhṛthāya te ॥18॥
slp1: ahiMsA sarvaBUteByaH saMviBAgaSca sarvaSaH । damastyAgo DftiH satyaM BavatvavaBfTAya te ॥18॥

text: eṣa te vitato yajñaḥ śraddhāpūtaḥ sadakṣiṇaḥ । viśiṣṭaḥ sarvayajñebhyo nityaṃ tāta pravartatām] ॥19॥
html:
eṣa te vitato yajñaḥ śraddhāpūtaḥ sadakṣiṇaḥ ।
viśiṣṭaḥ sarvayajñebhyo nityaṃ tāta pravartatām] ॥19॥
slp1: eza te vitato yajYaH SradDApUtaH sadakziRaH । viSizwaH sarvayajYeByo nityaM tAta pravartatAm] ॥19॥

text: dānaṃ yajñakriyā ceha kiṃ svitpretya mahāphalam । kasya jyāyaḥ phalaṃ proktaṃ kīdṛśebhyaḥ kathaṃ kadā ॥1॥
html:
dānaṃ yajñakriyā ceha kiṃ svitpretya mahāphalam ।
kasya jyāyaḥ phalaṃ proktaṃ kīdṛśebhyaḥ kathaṃ kadā ॥1॥
slp1: dAnaM yajYakriyA ceha kiM svitpretya mahAPalam । kasya jyAyaH PalaM proktaM kIdfSeByaH kaTaM kadA ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ yāthātathyena bhārata । vidvañjijñāsamānāya dānadharmānpracakṣva me ॥2॥
html:
etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ yāthātathyena bhārata ।
vidvañjijñāsamānāya dānadharmānpracakṣva me ॥2॥
slp1: etadicCAmi vijYAtuM yATAtaTyena BArata । vidvaYjijYAsamAnAya dAnaDarmAnpracakzva me ॥2॥

text: antarvedyāṃ ca yaddattaṃ śraddhayā cānṛśaṃsyataḥ । kiṃ svinniḥśreyasaṃ tāta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥3॥
html:
antarvedyāṃ ca yaddattaṃ śraddhayā cānṛśaṃsyataḥ ।
kiṃ svinniḥśreyasaṃ tāta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥3॥
slp1: antarvedyAM ca yaddattaM SradDayA cAnfSaMsyataH । kiM svinniHSreyasaM tAta tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥3॥

text: raudraṃ karma kṣatriyasya satataṃ tāta vartate । tasya vaitānikaṃ karma dānaṃ caiveha pāvanam ॥4॥
html:
raudraṃ karma kṣatriyasya satataṃ tāta vartate ।
tasya vaitānikaṃ karma dānaṃ caiveha pāvanam ॥4॥
slp1: rOdraM karma kzatriyasya satataM tAta vartate । tasya vEtAnikaM karma dAnaM cEveha pAvanam ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: na tu pāpakṛtāṃ rājñāṃ pratigṛhṇanti sādhavaḥ । etasmātkāraṇādyajñairyajedrājāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ॥5॥
html:
na tu pāpakṛtāṃ rājñāṃ pratigṛhṇanti sādhavaḥ ।
etasmātkāraṇādyajñairyajedrājāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: na tu pApakftAM rAjYAM pratigfhRanti sADavaH । etasmAtkAraRAdyajYEryajedrAjAptadakziREH ॥5॥

text: atha cetpratigṛhṇīyurdadyādaharaharnṛpaḥ । śraddhāmāsthāya paramāṃ pāvanaṃ hyetaduttamam ॥6॥
html:
atha cetpratigṛhṇīyurdadyādaharaharnṛpaḥ ।
śraddhāmāsthāya paramāṃ pāvanaṃ hyetaduttamam ॥6॥
slp1: aTa cetpratigfhRIyurdadyAdaharaharnfpaH । SradDAmAsTAya paramAM pAvanaM hyetaduttamam ॥6॥

text: brāhmaṇāṃstarpayeddravyaistato yajñe yatavrataḥ । maitrānsādhūnvedavidaḥ śīlavṛttataponvitān ॥7॥
html:
brāhmaṇāṃstarpayeddravyaistato yajñe yatavrataḥ ।
maitrānsādhūnvedavidaḥ śīlavṛttataponvitān ॥7॥
slp1: brAhmaRAMstarpayeddravyEstato yajYe yatavrataH । mEtrAnsADUnvedavidaH SIlavfttataponvitAn ॥7॥

text: yatte tena kariṣyanti kṛtaṃ tena bhaviṣyati । yajñānsādhaya sādhubhyaḥ svādvannāndakṣiṇāvataḥ ॥8॥
html:
yatte tena kariṣyanti kṛtaṃ tena bhaviṣyati ।
yajñānsādhaya sādhubhyaḥ svādvannāndakṣiṇāvataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yatte tena karizyanti kftaM tena Bavizyati । yajYAnsADaya sADuByaH svAdvannAndakziRAvataH ॥8॥

text: iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ ca manyethā ātmānaṃ dānakarmaṇā । pūjayethā yāyajūkāṃstavāpyaṃśo bhavedyathā ॥9॥
html:
iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ ca manyethā ātmānaṃ dānakarmaṇā ।
pūjayethā yāyajūkāṃstavāpyaṃśo bhavedyathā ॥9॥
slp1: izwaM dattaM ca manyeTA AtmAnaM dAnakarmaRA । pUjayeTA yAyajUkAMstavApyaMSo BavedyaTA ॥9॥

text: prajāvato bharethāśca brāhmaṇānbahubhāriṇaḥ । prajāvāṃstena bhavati yathā janayitā tathā ॥10॥
html:
prajāvato bharethāśca brāhmaṇānbahubhāriṇaḥ ।
prajāvāṃstena bhavati yathā janayitā tathā ॥10॥
slp1: prajAvato BareTASca brAhmaRAnbahuBAriRaH । prajAvAMstena Bavati yaTA janayitA taTA ॥10॥

text: yāvato vai sādhudharmānsantaḥ saṃvartayantyuta । sarve te cāpi bhartavyā narā ye bahubhāriṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
yāvato vai sādhudharmānsantaḥ saṃvartayantyuta ।
sarve te cāpi bhartavyā narā ye bahubhāriṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: yAvato vE sADuDarmAnsantaH saMvartayantyuta । sarve te cApi BartavyA narA ye bahuBAriRaH ॥11॥

text: samṛddhaḥ samprayacchasva brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira । dhenūranaḍuho'nnāni cchatraṃ vāsāṃsyupānahau ॥12॥
html:
samṛddhaḥ samprayacchasva brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira ।
dhenūranaḍuho'nnāni cchatraṃ vāsāṃsyupānahau ॥12॥
slp1: samfdDaH samprayacCasva brAhmaReByo yuDizWira । DenUranaquho'nnAni cCatraM vAsAMsyupAnahO ॥12॥

text: ājyāni yajamānebhyastathānnādyāni bhārata । aśvavanti ca yānāni veśmāni śayanāni ca ॥13॥
html:
ājyāni yajamānebhyastathānnādyāni bhārata ।
aśvavanti ca yānāni veśmāni śayanāni ca ॥13॥
slp1: AjyAni yajamAneByastaTAnnAdyAni BArata । aSvavanti ca yAnAni veSmAni SayanAni ca ॥13॥

text: ete deyā vyuṣṭimanto laghūpāyāśca bhārata । ajugupsāṃśca vijñāya brāhmaṇānvṛttikarśitān ॥14॥
html:
ete deyā vyuṣṭimanto laghūpāyāśca bhārata ।
ajugupsāṃśca vijñāya brāhmaṇānvṛttikarśitān ॥14॥
slp1: ete deyA vyuzwimanto laGUpAyASca BArata । ajugupsAMSca vijYAya brAhmaRAnvfttikarSitAn ॥14॥

text: upacchannaṃ prakāśaṃ vā vṛttyā tānpratipādaya । rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ śreyastatkṣatriyānprati ॥15॥
html:
upacchannaṃ prakāśaṃ vā vṛttyā tānpratipādaya ।
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ śreyastatkṣatriyānprati ॥15॥
slp1: upacCannaM prakASaM vA vfttyA tAnpratipAdaya । rAjasUyASvameDAByAM SreyastatkzatriyAnprati ॥15॥

text: evaṃ pāpairvimuktastvaṃ pūtaḥ svargamavāpsyasi । sraṃsayitvā punaḥ kośaṃ yadrāṣṭraṃ pālayiṣyasi ॥16॥
html:
evaṃ pāpairvimuktastvaṃ pūtaḥ svargamavāpsyasi ।
sraṃsayitvā punaḥ kośaṃ yadrāṣṭraṃ pālayiṣyasi ॥16॥
slp1: evaM pApErvimuktastvaM pUtaH svargamavApsyasi । sraMsayitvA punaH koSaM yadrAzwraM pAlayizyasi ॥16॥

text: tataśca brahmabhūyastvamavāpsyasi dhanāni ca । ātmanaśca pareṣāṃ ca vṛttiṃ saṃrakṣa bhārata ॥17॥
html:
tataśca brahmabhūyastvamavāpsyasi dhanāni ca ।
ātmanaśca pareṣāṃ ca vṛttiṃ saṃrakṣa bhārata ॥17॥
slp1: tataSca brahmaBUyastvamavApsyasi DanAni ca । AtmanaSca parezAM ca vfttiM saMrakza BArata ॥17॥

text: putravaccāpi bhṛtyānsvānprajāśca paripālaya । yogakṣemaśca te nityaṃ brāhmaṇeṣvastu bhārata ॥18॥
html:
putravaccāpi bhṛtyānsvānprajāśca paripālaya ।
yogakṣemaśca te nityaṃ brāhmaṇeṣvastu bhārata ॥18॥
slp1: putravaccApi BftyAnsvAnprajASca paripAlaya । yogakzemaSca te nityaM brAhmaRezvastu BArata ॥18॥

text: arakṣitāraṃ hartāraṃ viloptāramadāyakam । taṃ sma rājakaliṃ hanyuḥ prajāḥ sambhūya nirghṛṇam ॥19॥
html:
arakṣitāraṃ hartāraṃ viloptāramadāyakam ।
taṃ sma rājakaliṃ hanyuḥ prajāḥ sambhūya nirghṛṇam ॥19॥
slp1: arakzitAraM hartAraM viloptAramadAyakam । taM sma rAjakaliM hanyuH prajAH samBUya nirGfRam ॥19॥

text: ahaṃ vo rakṣitetyuktvā yo na rakṣati bhūmipaḥ । sa saṃhatya nihantavyaḥ śveva sonmāda āturaḥ ॥20॥
html:
ahaṃ vo rakṣitetyuktvā yo na rakṣati bhūmipaḥ ।
sa saṃhatya nihantavyaḥ śveva sonmāda āturaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: ahaM vo rakzitetyuktvA yo na rakzati BUmipaH । sa saMhatya nihantavyaH Sveva sonmAda AturaH ॥20॥

text: pāpaṃ kurvanti yatkiñcitprajā rājñā hyarakṣitāḥ । caturthaṃ tasya pāpasya rājā bhārata vindati ॥21॥
html:
pāpaṃ kurvanti yatkiñcitprajā rājñā hyarakṣitāḥ ।
caturthaṃ tasya pāpasya rājā bhārata vindati ॥21॥
slp1: pApaM kurvanti yatkiYcitprajA rAjYA hyarakzitAH । caturTaM tasya pApasya rAjA BArata vindati ॥21॥

text: apyāhuḥ sarvameveti bhūyo'rdhamiti niścayaḥ । caturthaṃ matamasmākaṃ manoḥ śrutvānuśāsanam ॥22॥
html:
apyāhuḥ sarvameveti bhūyo'rdhamiti niścayaḥ ।
caturthaṃ matamasmākaṃ manoḥ śrutvānuśāsanam ॥22॥
slp1: apyAhuH sarvameveti BUyo'rDamiti niScayaH । caturTaM matamasmAkaM manoH SrutvAnuSAsanam ॥22॥

text: śubhaṃ vā yatprakurvanti prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ । caturthaṃ tasya puṇyasya rājā cāpnoti bhārata ॥23॥
html:
śubhaṃ vā yatprakurvanti prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ ।
caturthaṃ tasya puṇyasya rājā cāpnoti bhārata ॥23॥
slp1: SuBaM vA yatprakurvanti prajA rAjYA surakzitAH । caturTaM tasya puRyasya rAjA cApnoti BArata ॥23॥

text: jīvantaṃ tvānujīvantu prajāḥ sarvā yudhiṣṭhira । parjanyamiva bhūtāni mahādrumamiva dvijāḥ ॥24॥
html:
jīvantaṃ tvānujīvantu prajāḥ sarvā yudhiṣṭhira ।
parjanyamiva bhūtāni mahādrumamiva dvijāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: jIvantaM tvAnujIvantu prajAH sarvA yuDizWira । parjanyamiva BUtAni mahAdrumamiva dvijAH ॥24॥

text: kuberamiva rakṣāṃsi śatakratumivāmarāḥ । jñātayastvānujīvantu suhṛdaśca parantapa] ॥25॥
html:
kuberamiva rakṣāṃsi śatakratumivāmarāḥ ।
jñātayastvānujīvantu suhṛdaśca parantapa] ॥25॥
slp1: kuberamiva rakzAMsi SatakratumivAmarAH । jYAtayastvAnujIvantu suhfdaSca parantapa] ॥25॥

text: idaṃ deyamidaṃ deyamitīyaṃ śruticodanā । bahudeyāśca rājānaḥ kiṃ sviddeyamanuttamam ॥1॥
html:
idaṃ deyamidaṃ deyamitīyaṃ śruticodanā ।
bahudeyāśca rājānaḥ kiṃ sviddeyamanuttamam ॥1॥
slp1: idaM deyamidaM deyamitIyaM SruticodanA । bahudeyASca rAjAnaH kiM sviddeyamanuttamam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ati dānāni sarvāṇi pṛthivīdānamucyate । acalā hyakṣayā bhūmirdogdhrī kāmānanuttamān ॥2॥
html:
ati dānāni sarvāṇi pṛthivīdānamucyate ।
acalā hyakṣayā bhūmirdogdhrī kāmānanuttamān ॥2॥
slp1: ati dAnAni sarvARi pfTivIdAnamucyate । acalA hyakzayA BUmirdogDrI kAmAnanuttamAn ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dogdhrī vāsāṃsi ratnāni paśūnvrīhiyavāṃstathā । bhūmidaḥ sarvabhūteṣu śāśvatīredhate samāḥ ॥3॥
html:
dogdhrī vāsāṃsi ratnāni paśūnvrīhiyavāṃstathā ।
bhūmidaḥ sarvabhūteṣu śāśvatīredhate samāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: dogDrI vAsAMsi ratnAni paSUnvrIhiyavAMstaTA । BUmidaH sarvaBUtezu SASvatIreDate samAH ॥3॥

text: yāvadbhūmerāyuriha tāvadbhūmida edhate । na bhūmidānādastīha paraṃ kiñcidyudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
html:
yāvadbhūmerāyuriha tāvadbhūmida edhate ।
na bhūmidānādastīha paraṃ kiñcidyudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
slp1: yAvadBUmerAyuriha tAvadBUmida eDate । na BUmidAnAdastIha paraM kiYcidyuDizWira ॥4॥

text: apyalpaṃ pradaduḥ pūrve pṛthivyā iti naḥ śrutam । bhūmimete daduḥ sarve ye bhūmiṃ bhuñjate janāḥ ॥5॥
html:
apyalpaṃ pradaduḥ pūrve pṛthivyā iti naḥ śrutam ।
bhūmimete daduḥ sarve ye bhūmiṃ bhuñjate janāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: apyalpaM pradaduH pUrve pfTivyA iti naH Srutam । BUmimete daduH sarve ye BUmiM BuYjate janAH ॥5॥

text: svakarmaivopajīvanti narā iha paratra ca । bhūmirbhūtirmahādevī dātāraṃ kurute priyam ॥6॥
html:
svakarmaivopajīvanti narā iha paratra ca ।
bhūmirbhūtirmahādevī dātāraṃ kurute priyam ॥6॥
slp1: svakarmEvopajIvanti narA iha paratra ca । BUmirBUtirmahAdevI dAtAraM kurute priyam ॥6॥

text: ya etāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādakṣayāṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ । punarnaratvaṃ samprāpya bhavetsa pṛthivīpatiḥ ॥7॥
html:
ya etāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādakṣayāṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ ।
punarnaratvaṃ samprāpya bhavetsa pṛthivīpatiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: ya etAM dakziRAM dadyAdakzayAM pfTivIpatiH । punarnaratvaM samprApya Bavetsa pfTivIpatiH ॥7॥

text: yathā dānaṃ tathā bhoga iti dharmeṣu niścayaḥ । saṅgrāme vā tanuṃ jahyāddadyādvā pṛthivīmimām ॥8॥
html:
yathā dānaṃ tathā bhoga iti dharmeṣu niścayaḥ ।
saṅgrāme vā tanuṃ jahyāddadyādvā pṛthivīmimām ॥8॥
slp1: yaTA dAnaM taTA Boga iti Darmezu niScayaH । saNgrAme vA tanuM jahyAddadyAdvA pfTivImimAm ॥8॥

text: ityetāṃ kṣatrabandhūnāṃ vadanti paramāśiṣam । punāti dattā pṛthivī dātāramiti śuśruma ॥9॥
html:
ityetāṃ kṣatrabandhūnāṃ vadanti paramāśiṣam ।
punāti dattā pṛthivī dātāramiti śuśruma ॥9॥
slp1: ityetAM kzatrabanDUnAM vadanti paramASizam । punAti dattA pfTivI dAtAramiti SuSruma ॥9॥

text: api pāpasamācāraṃ brahmaghnamapi vānṛtam । saiva pāpaṃ pāvayati saiva pāpātpramocayet ॥10॥
html:
api pāpasamācāraṃ brahmaghnamapi vānṛtam ।
saiva pāpaṃ pāvayati saiva pāpātpramocayet ॥10॥
slp1: api pApasamAcAraM brahmaGnamapi vAnftam । sEva pApaM pAvayati sEva pApAtpramocayet ॥10॥

text: api pāpakṛtāṃ rājñāṃ pratigṛhṇanti sādhavaḥ । pṛthivīṃ nānyadicchanti pāvanaṃ jananī yathā ॥11॥
html:
api pāpakṛtāṃ rājñāṃ pratigṛhṇanti sādhavaḥ ।
pṛthivīṃ nānyadicchanti pāvanaṃ jananī yathā ॥11॥
slp1: api pApakftAM rAjYAM pratigfhRanti sADavaH । pfTivIM nAnyadicCanti pAvanaM jananI yaTA ॥11॥

text: nāmāsyāḥ priyadatteti guhyaṃ devyāḥ sanātanam । dānaṃ vāpyatha vā jñānaṃ nāmno'syāḥ paramaṃ priyam । tasmātprāpyaiva pṛthivīṃ dadyādviprāya pārthivaḥ ॥12॥
html:
nāmāsyāḥ priyadatteti guhyaṃ devyāḥ sanātanam ।
dānaṃ vāpyatha vā jñānaṃ nāmno'syāḥ paramaṃ priyam ।
tasmātprāpyaiva pṛthivīṃ dadyādviprāya pārthivaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: nAmAsyAH priyadatteti guhyaM devyAH sanAtanam । dAnaM vApyaTa vA jYAnaM nAmno'syAH paramaM priyam । tasmAtprApyEva pfTivIM dadyAdviprAya pArTivaH ॥12॥

text: nābhūmipatinā bhūmiradhiṣṭheyā kathañcana । na vā pātreṇa vā gūhedantardhānena vā caret । ye cānye bhūmimiccheyuḥ kuryurevamasaṃśayam ॥13॥
html:
nābhūmipatinā bhūmiradhiṣṭheyā kathañcana ।
na vā pātreṇa vā gūhedantardhānena vā caret ।
ye cānye bhūmimiccheyuḥ kuryurevamasaṃśayam ॥13॥
slp1: nABUmipatinA BUmiraDizWeyA kaTaYcana । na vA pAtreRa vA gUhedantarDAnena vA caret । ye cAnye BUmimicCeyuH kuryurevamasaMSayam ॥13॥

text: yaḥ sādhorbhūmimādatte na bhūmiṃ vindate tu saḥ । bhūmiṃ tu dattvā sādhubhyo vindate bhūmimeva hi । pretyeha ca sa dharmātmā samprāpnoti mahadyaśaḥ ॥14॥
html:
yaḥ sādhorbhūmimādatte na bhūmiṃ vindate tu saḥ ।
bhūmiṃ tu dattvā sādhubhyo vindate bhūmimeva hi ।
pretyeha ca sa dharmātmā samprāpnoti mahadyaśaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yaH sADorBUmimAdatte na BUmiM vindate tu saH । BUmiM tu dattvA sADuByo vindate BUmimeva hi । pretyeha ca sa DarmAtmA samprApnoti mahadyaSaH ॥14॥

text: yasya viprānuśāsanti sādhorbhūmiṃ sadaiva hi । na tasya śatravo rājanpraśāsanti vasundharām ॥15॥
html:
yasya viprānuśāsanti sādhorbhūmiṃ sadaiva hi ।
na tasya śatravo rājanpraśāsanti vasundharām ॥15॥
slp1: yasya viprAnuSAsanti sADorBUmiM sadEva hi । na tasya Satravo rAjanpraSAsanti vasunDarAm ॥15॥

text: yatkiñcitpuruṣaḥ pāpaṃ kurute vṛttikarśitaḥ । api gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena pūyate ॥16॥
html:
yatkiñcitpuruṣaḥ pāpaṃ kurute vṛttikarśitaḥ ।
api gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena pūyate ॥16॥
slp1: yatkiYcitpuruzaH pApaM kurute vfttikarSitaH । api gocarmamAtreRa BUmidAnena pUyate ॥16॥

text: ye'pi saṅkīrṇakarmāṇo rājāno raudrakarmiṇaḥ । tebhyaḥ pavitramākhyeyaṃ bhūmidānamanuttamam ॥17॥
html:
ye'pi saṅkīrṇakarmāṇo rājāno raudrakarmiṇaḥ ।
tebhyaḥ pavitramākhyeyaṃ bhūmidānamanuttamam ॥17॥
slp1: ye'pi saNkIrRakarmARo rAjAno rOdrakarmiRaH । teByaH pavitramAKyeyaM BUmidAnamanuttamam ॥17॥

text: alpāntaramidaṃ śaśvatpurāṇā menire janāḥ । yo yajedaśvamedhena dadyādvā sādhave mahīm ॥18॥
html:
alpāntaramidaṃ śaśvatpurāṇā menire janāḥ ।
yo yajedaśvamedhena dadyādvā sādhave mahīm ॥18॥
slp1: alpAntaramidaM SaSvatpurARA menire janAH । yo yajedaSvameDena dadyAdvA sADave mahIm ॥18॥

text: api cetsukṛtaṃ kṛtvā śaṅkerannapi paṇḍitāḥ । aśakyamekamevaitadbhūmidānamanuttamam ॥19॥
html:
api cetsukṛtaṃ kṛtvā śaṅkerannapi paṇḍitāḥ ।
aśakyamekamevaitadbhūmidānamanuttamam ॥19॥
slp1: api cetsukftaM kftvA SaNkerannapi paRqitAH । aSakyamekamevEtadBUmidAnamanuttamam ॥19॥

text: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ maṇimuktāvasūni ca । sarvametanmahāprājña dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat ॥20॥
html:
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ maṇimuktāvasūni ca ।
sarvametanmahāprājña dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat ॥20॥
slp1: suvarRaM rajataM vastraM maRimuktAvasUni ca । sarvametanmahAprAjYa dadAti vasuDAM dadat ॥20॥

text: tapo yajñaḥ śrutaṃ śīlamalobhaḥ satyasandhatā । gurudaivatapūjā ca nātivartanti bhūmidam ॥21॥
html:
tapo yajñaḥ śrutaṃ śīlamalobhaḥ satyasandhatā ।
gurudaivatapūjā ca nātivartanti bhūmidam ॥21॥
slp1: tapo yajYaH SrutaM SIlamaloBaH satyasanDatA । gurudEvatapUjA ca nAtivartanti BUmidam ॥21॥

text: bharturniḥśreyase yuktāstyaktātmāno raṇe hatāḥ । brahmalokagatāḥ siddhā nātikrāmanti bhūmidam ॥22॥
html:
bharturniḥśreyase yuktāstyaktātmāno raṇe hatāḥ ।
brahmalokagatāḥ siddhā nātikrāmanti bhūmidam ॥22॥
slp1: BarturniHSreyase yuktAstyaktAtmAno raRe hatAH । brahmalokagatAH sidDA nAtikrAmanti BUmidam ॥22॥

text: yathā janitrī kṣīreṇa svaputraṃ bharate sadā । anugṛhṇāti dātāraṃ tathā sarvarasairmahī ॥23॥
html:
yathā janitrī kṣīreṇa svaputraṃ bharate sadā ।
anugṛhṇāti dātāraṃ tathā sarvarasairmahī ॥23॥
slp1: yaTA janitrI kzIreRa svaputraM Barate sadA । anugfhRAti dAtAraM taTA sarvarasErmahI ॥23॥

text: mṛtyorvai kiṅkaro daṇḍastāpo vahneḥ sudāruṇaḥ । ghorāśca vāruṇāḥ pāśā nopasarpanti bhūmidam ॥24॥
html:
mṛtyorvai kiṅkaro daṇḍastāpo vahneḥ sudāruṇaḥ ।
ghorāśca vāruṇāḥ pāśā nopasarpanti bhūmidam ॥24॥
slp1: mftyorvE kiNkaro daRqastApo vahneH sudAruRaH । GorASca vAruRAH pASA nopasarpanti BUmidam ॥24॥

text: pitṝṃśca pitṛlokasthāndevaloke ca devatāḥ । santarpayati śāntātmā yo dadāti vasundharām ॥25॥
html:
pitṝṃśca pitṛlokasthāndevaloke ca devatāḥ ।
santarpayati śāntātmā yo dadāti vasundharām ॥25॥
slp1: pitFMSca pitflokasTAndevaloke ca devatAH । santarpayati SAntAtmA yo dadAti vasunDarAm ॥25॥

text: kṛśāya mriyamāṇāya vṛttimlānāya sīdate । bhūmiṃ vṛttikarīṃ dattvā satrī bhavati mānavaḥ ॥26॥
html:
kṛśāya mriyamāṇāya vṛttimlānāya sīdate ।
bhūmiṃ vṛttikarīṃ dattvā satrī bhavati mānavaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: kfSAya mriyamARAya vfttimlAnAya sIdate । BUmiM vfttikarIM dattvA satrI Bavati mAnavaH ॥26॥

text: yathā dhāvati gaurvatsaṃ kṣīramabhyutsṛjantyuta । evameva mahābhāga bhūmirbhavati bhūmidam ॥27॥
html:
yathā dhāvati gaurvatsaṃ kṣīramabhyutsṛjantyuta ।
evameva mahābhāga bhūmirbhavati bhūmidam ॥27॥
slp1: yaTA DAvati gOrvatsaM kzIramaByutsfjantyuta । evameva mahABAga BUmirBavati BUmidam ॥27॥

text: halakṛṣṭāṃ mahīṃ dattvā sabījāṃ saphalāmapi । udīrṇaṃ vāpi śaraṇaṃ tathā bhavati kāmadaḥ ॥28॥
html:
halakṛṣṭāṃ mahīṃ dattvā sabījāṃ saphalāmapi ।
udīrṇaṃ vāpi śaraṇaṃ tathā bhavati kāmadaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: halakfzwAM mahIM dattvA sabIjAM saPalAmapi । udIrRaM vApi SaraRaM taTA Bavati kAmadaH ॥28॥

text: brāhmaṇaṃ vṛttasampannamāhitāgniṃ śucivratam । naraḥ pratigrāhya mahīṃ na yāti yamasādanam ॥29॥
html:
brāhmaṇaṃ vṛttasampannamāhitāgniṃ śucivratam ।
naraḥ pratigrāhya mahīṃ na yāti yamasādanam ॥29॥
slp1: brAhmaRaM vfttasampannamAhitAgniM Sucivratam । naraH pratigrAhya mahIM na yAti yamasAdanam ॥29॥

text: yathā candramaso vṛddhirahanyahani jāyate । tathā bhūmikṛtaṃ dānaṃ sasye sasye vivardhate ॥30॥
html:
yathā candramaso vṛddhirahanyahani jāyate ।
tathā bhūmikṛtaṃ dānaṃ sasye sasye vivardhate ॥30॥
slp1: yaTA candramaso vfdDirahanyahani jAyate । taTA BUmikftaM dAnaM sasye sasye vivarDate ॥30॥

text: atra gāthā bhūmigītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ । yāḥ śrutvā jāmadagnyena dattā bhūḥ kāśyapāya vai ॥31॥
html:
atra gāthā bhūmigītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ।
yāḥ śrutvā jāmadagnyena dattā bhūḥ kāśyapāya vai ॥31॥
slp1: atra gATA BUmigItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH । yAH SrutvA jAmadagnyena dattA BUH kASyapAya vE ॥31॥

text: māmevādatta māṃ datta māṃ dattvā māmavāpsyatha । asmiṁlloke pare caiva tataścājanane punaḥ ॥32॥
html:
māmevādatta māṃ datta māṃ dattvā māmavāpsyatha ।
asmiṁlloke pare caiva tataścājanane punaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: mAmevAdatta mAM datta mAM dattvA mAmavApsyaTa । asmiṁlloke pare cEva tataScAjanane punaH ॥32॥

text: ya imāṃ vyāhṛtiṃ veda brāhmaṇo brahmasaṃśritaḥ । śrāddhasya hūyamānasya brahmabhūyaṃ sa gacchati ॥33॥
html:
ya imāṃ vyāhṛtiṃ veda brāhmaṇo brahmasaṃśritaḥ ।
śrāddhasya hūyamānasya brahmabhūyaṃ sa gacchati ॥33॥
slp1: ya imAM vyAhftiM veda brAhmaRo brahmasaMSritaH । SrAdDasya hUyamAnasya brahmaBUyaM sa gacCati ॥33॥

text: kṛtyānāmabhiśastānāṃ duriṣṭaśamanaṃ mahat । prāyaścittamahaṃ kṛtvā punātyubhayato daśa ॥34॥
html:
kṛtyānāmabhiśastānāṃ duriṣṭaśamanaṃ mahat ।
prāyaścittamahaṃ kṛtvā punātyubhayato daśa ॥34॥
slp1: kftyAnAmaBiSastAnAM durizwaSamanaM mahat । prAyaScittamahaM kftvA punAtyuBayato daSa ॥34॥

text: punāti ya idaṃ veda veda cāhaṃ tathaiva ca । prakṛtiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhūmirvai śāśvatī matā ॥35॥
html:
punāti ya idaṃ veda veda cāhaṃ tathaiva ca ।
prakṛtiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhūmirvai śāśvatī matā ॥35॥
slp1: punAti ya idaM veda veda cAhaM taTEva ca । prakftiH sarvaBUtAnAM BUmirvE SASvatI matA ॥35॥

text: abhiṣicyaiva nṛpatiṃ śrāvayedimamāgamam । yathā śrutvā mahīṃ dadyānnādadyātsādhutaśca tām ॥36॥
html:
abhiṣicyaiva nṛpatiṃ śrāvayedimamāgamam ।
yathā śrutvā mahīṃ dadyānnādadyātsādhutaśca tām ॥36॥
slp1: aBizicyEva nfpatiM SrAvayedimamAgamam । yaTA SrutvA mahIM dadyAnnAdadyAtsADutaSca tAm ॥36॥

text: so'yaṃ kṛtsno brāhmaṇārtho rājārthaścāpyasaṃśayam । rājā hi dharmakuśalaḥ prathamaṃ bhūtilakṣaṇam ॥37॥
html:
so'yaṃ kṛtsno brāhmaṇārtho rājārthaścāpyasaṃśayam ।
rājā hi dharmakuśalaḥ prathamaṃ bhūtilakṣaṇam ॥37॥
slp1: so'yaM kftsno brAhmaRArTo rAjArTaScApyasaMSayam । rAjA hi DarmakuSalaH praTamaM BUtilakzaRam ॥37॥

text: atha yeṣāmadharmajño rājā bhavati nāstikaḥ । na te sukhaṃ prabudhyante na sukhaṃ prasvapanti ca ॥38॥
html:
atha yeṣāmadharmajño rājā bhavati nāstikaḥ ।
na te sukhaṃ prabudhyante na sukhaṃ prasvapanti ca ॥38॥
slp1: aTa yezAmaDarmajYo rAjA Bavati nAstikaH । na te suKaM prabuDyante na suKaM prasvapanti ca ॥38॥

text: sadā bhavanti codvignāstasya duścaritairnarāḥ । yogakṣemā hi bahavo rāṣṭraṃ nāsyāviśanti tat ॥39॥
html:
sadā bhavanti codvignāstasya duścaritairnarāḥ ।
yogakṣemā hi bahavo rāṣṭraṃ nāsyāviśanti tat ॥39॥
slp1: sadA Bavanti codvignAstasya duScaritErnarAH । yogakzemA hi bahavo rAzwraM nAsyAviSanti tat ॥39॥

text: atha yeṣāṃ punaḥ prājño rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ । sukhaṃ te pratibudhyante susukhaṃ prasvapanti ca ॥40॥
html:
atha yeṣāṃ punaḥ prājño rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ।
sukhaṃ te pratibudhyante susukhaṃ prasvapanti ca ॥40॥
slp1: aTa yezAM punaH prAjYo rAjA Bavati DArmikaH । suKaM te pratibuDyante susuKaM prasvapanti ca ॥40॥

text: tasya rājñaḥ śubhairāryaiḥ karmabhirnirvṛtāḥ prajāḥ । yogakṣemeṇa vṛṣṭyā ca vivardhante svakarmabhiḥ ॥41॥
html:
tasya rājñaḥ śubhairāryaiḥ karmabhirnirvṛtāḥ prajāḥ ।
yogakṣemeṇa vṛṣṭyā ca vivardhante svakarmabhiḥ ॥41॥
slp1: tasya rAjYaH SuBErAryEH karmaBirnirvftAH prajAH । yogakzemeRa vfzwyA ca vivarDante svakarmaBiH ॥41॥

text: sa kulīnaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sa bandhuḥ sa ca puṇyakṛt । sa dātā sa ca vikrānto yo dadāti vasundharām ॥42॥
html:
sa kulīnaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sa bandhuḥ sa ca puṇyakṛt ।
sa dātā sa ca vikrānto yo dadāti vasundharām ॥42॥
slp1: sa kulInaH sa puruzaH sa banDuH sa ca puRyakft । sa dAtA sa ca vikrAnto yo dadAti vasunDarAm ॥42॥

text: ādityā iva dīpyante tejasā bhuvi mānavāḥ । dadanti vasudhāṃ sphītāṃ ye vedaviduṣi dvije ॥43॥
html:
ādityā iva dīpyante tejasā bhuvi mānavāḥ ।
dadanti vasudhāṃ sphītāṃ ye vedaviduṣi dvije ॥43॥
slp1: AdityA iva dIpyante tejasA Buvi mAnavAH । dadanti vasuDAM sPItAM ye vedaviduzi dvije ॥43॥

text: yathā bījāni rohanti prakīrṇāni mahītale । tathā kāmāḥ prarohanti bhūmidānasamārjitāḥ ॥44॥
html:
yathā bījāni rohanti prakīrṇāni mahītale ।
tathā kāmāḥ prarohanti bhūmidānasamārjitāḥ ॥44॥
slp1: yaTA bIjAni rohanti prakIrRAni mahItale । taTA kAmAH prarohanti BUmidAnasamArjitAH ॥44॥

text: ādityo varuṇo viṣṇurbrahmā somo hutāśanaḥ । śūlapāṇiśca bhagavānpratinandanti bhūmidam ॥45॥
html:
ādityo varuṇo viṣṇurbrahmā somo hutāśanaḥ ।
śūlapāṇiśca bhagavānpratinandanti bhūmidam ॥45॥
slp1: Adityo varuRo vizRurbrahmA somo hutASanaH । SUlapARiSca BagavAnpratinandanti BUmidam ॥45॥

text: bhūmau jāyanti puruṣā bhūmau niṣṭhāṃ vrajanti ca । caturvidho hi loko'yaṃ yo'yaṃ bhūmiguṇātmakaḥ ॥46॥
html:
bhūmau jāyanti puruṣā bhūmau niṣṭhāṃ vrajanti ca ।
caturvidho hi loko'yaṃ yo'yaṃ bhūmiguṇātmakaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: BUmO jAyanti puruzA BUmO nizWAM vrajanti ca । caturviDo hi loko'yaM yo'yaM BUmiguRAtmakaH ॥46॥

text: eṣā mātā pitā caiva jagataḥ pṛthivīpate । nānayā sadṛśaṃ bhūtaṃ kiñcidasti janādhipa ॥47॥
html:
eṣā mātā pitā caiva jagataḥ pṛthivīpate ।
nānayā sadṛśaṃ bhūtaṃ kiñcidasti janādhipa ॥47॥
slp1: ezA mAtA pitA cEva jagataH pfTivIpate । nAnayA sadfSaM BUtaM kiYcidasti janADipa ॥47॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । bṛhaspateśca saṃvādamindrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥48॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
bṛhaspateśca saṃvādamindrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥48॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । bfhaspateSca saMvAdamindrasya ca yuDizWira ॥48॥

text: iṣṭvā kratuśatenātha mahatā dakṣiṇāvatā । maghavā vāgvidāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ papracchedaṃ bṛhaspatim ॥49॥
html:
iṣṭvā kratuśatenātha mahatā dakṣiṇāvatā ।
maghavā vāgvidāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ papracchedaṃ bṛhaspatim ॥49॥
slp1: izwvA kratuSatenATa mahatA dakziRAvatA । maGavA vAgvidAM SrezWaM papracCedaM bfhaspatim ॥49॥

text: bhagavankena dānena svargataḥ sukhamedhate । yadakṣayaṃ mahārghaṃ ca tadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥50॥
html:
bhagavankena dānena svargataḥ sukhamedhate ।
yadakṣayaṃ mahārghaṃ ca tadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ॥50॥
slp1: Bagavankena dAnena svargataH suKameDate । yadakzayaM mahArGaM ca tadbrUhi vadatAM vara ॥50॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa surendreṇa tato devapurohitaḥ । bṛhaspatirmahātejāḥ pratyuvāca śatakratum ॥51॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa surendreṇa tato devapurohitaḥ ।
bṛhaspatirmahātejāḥ pratyuvāca śatakratum ॥51॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa surendreRa tato devapurohitaH । bfhaspatirmahAtejAH pratyuvAca Satakratum ॥51॥

text: suvarṇadānaṃ godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca vṛtrahan । dadadetānmahāprājñaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥52॥
html:
suvarṇadānaṃ godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ ca vṛtrahan ।
dadadetānmahāprājñaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥52॥
slp1: suvarRadAnaM godAnaM BUmidAnaM ca vftrahan । dadadetAnmahAprAjYaH sarvapApEH pramucyate ॥52॥

text: na bhūmidānāddevendra paraṃ kiñciditi prabho । viśiṣṭamiti manyāmi yathā prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥53॥
html:
na bhūmidānāddevendra paraṃ kiñciditi prabho ।
viśiṣṭamiti manyāmi yathā prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: na BUmidAnAddevendra paraM kiYciditi praBo । viSizwamiti manyAmi yaTA prAhurmanIziRaH ॥53॥

text: ye śūrā nihatā yuddhe svaryātā dānagṛddhinaḥ । sarve te vibudhaśreṣṭha nātikrāmanti bhūmidam ॥54॥
html:
ye śūrā nihatā yuddhe svaryātā dānagṛddhinaḥ ।
sarve te vibudhaśreṣṭha nātikrāmanti bhūmidam ॥54॥
slp1: ye SUrA nihatA yudDe svaryAtA dAnagfdDinaH । sarve te vibuDaSrezWa nAtikrAmanti BUmidam ॥54॥

text: bharturniḥśreyase yuktāstyaktātmāno raṇe hatāḥ । brahmalokagatāḥ śūrā nātikrāmanti bhūmidam ॥55॥
html:
bharturniḥśreyase yuktāstyaktātmāno raṇe hatāḥ ।
brahmalokagatāḥ śūrā nātikrāmanti bhūmidam ॥55॥
slp1: BarturniHSreyase yuktAstyaktAtmAno raRe hatAH । brahmalokagatAH SUrA nAtikrAmanti BUmidam ॥55॥

text: pañca pūrvādipuruṣāḥ ṣaṭca ye vasudhāṃ gatāḥ । ekādaśa dadadbhūmiṃ paritrātīha mānavaḥ ॥56॥
html:
pañca pūrvādipuruṣāḥ ṣaṭca ye vasudhāṃ gatāḥ ।
ekādaśa dadadbhūmiṃ paritrātīha mānavaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: paYca pUrvAdipuruzAH zawca ye vasuDAM gatAH । ekAdaSa dadadBUmiM paritrAtIha mAnavaH ॥56॥

text: ratnopakīrṇāṃ vasudhāṃ yo dadāti purandara । sa muktaḥ sarvakaluṣaiḥ svargaloke mahīyate ॥57॥
html:
ratnopakīrṇāṃ vasudhāṃ yo dadāti purandara ।
sa muktaḥ sarvakaluṣaiḥ svargaloke mahīyate ॥57॥
slp1: ratnopakIrRAM vasuDAM yo dadAti purandara । sa muktaH sarvakaluzEH svargaloke mahIyate ॥57॥

text: mahīṃ sphītāṃ dadadrājā sarvakāmaguṇānvitām । rājādhirājo bhavati taddhi dānamanuttamam ॥58॥
html:
mahīṃ sphītāṃ dadadrājā sarvakāmaguṇānvitām ।
rājādhirājo bhavati taddhi dānamanuttamam ॥58॥
slp1: mahIM sPItAM dadadrAjA sarvakAmaguRAnvitAm । rAjADirAjo Bavati tadDi dAnamanuttamam ॥58॥

text: sarvakāmasamāyuktāṃ kāśyapīṃ yaḥ prayacchati । sarvabhūtāni manyante māṃ dadātīti vāsava ॥59॥
html:
sarvakāmasamāyuktāṃ kāśyapīṃ yaḥ prayacchati ।
sarvabhūtāni manyante māṃ dadātīti vāsava ॥59॥
slp1: sarvakAmasamAyuktAM kASyapIM yaH prayacCati । sarvaBUtAni manyante mAM dadAtIti vAsava ॥59॥

text: sarvakāmadughāṃ dhenuṃ sarvakāmapurogamām । dadāti yaḥ sahasrākṣa sa svargaṃ yāti mānavaḥ ॥60॥
html:
sarvakāmadughāṃ dhenuṃ sarvakāmapurogamām ।
dadāti yaḥ sahasrākṣa sa svargaṃ yāti mānavaḥ ॥60॥
slp1: sarvakAmaduGAM DenuM sarvakAmapurogamAm । dadAti yaH sahasrAkza sa svargaM yAti mAnavaH ॥60॥

text: madhusarpiḥpravāhinyaḥ payodadhivahāstathā । saritastarpayantīha surendra vasudhāpradam ॥61॥
html:
madhusarpiḥpravāhinyaḥ payodadhivahāstathā ।
saritastarpayantīha surendra vasudhāpradam ॥61॥
slp1: maDusarpiHpravAhinyaH payodaDivahAstaTA । saritastarpayantIha surendra vasuDApradam ॥61॥

text: bhūmipradānānnṛpatirmucyate rājakilbiṣāt । na hi bhūmipradānena dānamanyadviśiṣyate ॥62॥
html:
bhūmipradānānnṛpatirmucyate rājakilbiṣāt ।
na hi bhūmipradānena dānamanyadviśiṣyate ॥62॥
slp1: BUmipradAnAnnfpatirmucyate rAjakilbizAt । na hi BUmipradAnena dAnamanyadviSizyate ॥62॥

text: dadāti yaḥ samudrāntāṃ pṛthivīṃ śastranirjitām । taṃ janāḥ kathayantīha yāvaddharati gauriyam ॥63॥
html:
dadāti yaḥ samudrāntāṃ pṛthivīṃ śastranirjitām ।
taṃ janāḥ kathayantīha yāvaddharati gauriyam ॥63॥
slp1: dadAti yaH samudrAntAM pfTivIM SastranirjitAm । taM janAH kaTayantIha yAvadDarati gOriyam ॥63॥

text: puṇyāmṛddharasāṃ bhūmiṃ yo dadāti purandara । na tasya lokāḥ kṣīyante bhūmidānaguṇārjitāḥ ॥64॥
html:
puṇyāmṛddharasāṃ bhūmiṃ yo dadāti purandara ।
na tasya lokāḥ kṣīyante bhūmidānaguṇārjitāḥ ॥64॥
slp1: puRyAmfdDarasAM BUmiM yo dadAti purandara । na tasya lokAH kzIyante BUmidAnaguRArjitAH ॥64॥

text: sarvathā pārthiveneha satataṃ bhūtimicchatā । bhūrdeyā vidhivacchakra pātre sukhamabhīpsatā ॥65॥
html:
sarvathā pārthiveneha satataṃ bhūtimicchatā ।
bhūrdeyā vidhivacchakra pātre sukhamabhīpsatā ॥65॥
slp1: sarvaTA pArTiveneha satataM BUtimicCatA । BUrdeyA viDivacCakra pAtre suKamaBIpsatA ॥65॥

text: api kṛtvā naraḥ pāpaṃ bhūmiṃ dattvā dvijātaye । samutsṛjati tatpāpaṃ jīrṇāṃ tvacamivoragaḥ ॥66॥
html:
api kṛtvā naraḥ pāpaṃ bhūmiṃ dattvā dvijātaye ।
samutsṛjati tatpāpaṃ jīrṇāṃ tvacamivoragaḥ ॥66॥
slp1: api kftvA naraH pApaM BUmiM dattvA dvijAtaye । samutsfjati tatpApaM jIrRAM tvacamivoragaH ॥66॥

text: sāgarānsaritaḥ śailānkānanāni ca sarvaśaḥ । sarvametannaraḥ śakra dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat ॥67॥
html:
sāgarānsaritaḥ śailānkānanāni ca sarvaśaḥ ।
sarvametannaraḥ śakra dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat ॥67॥
slp1: sAgarAnsaritaH SElAnkAnanAni ca sarvaSaH । sarvametannaraH Sakra dadAti vasuDAM dadat ॥67॥

text: taḍāgānyudapānāni srotāṃsi ca sarāṃsi ca । snehānsarvarasāṃścaiva dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat ॥68॥
html:
taḍāgānyudapānāni srotāṃsi ca sarāṃsi ca ।
snehānsarvarasāṃścaiva dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat ॥68॥
slp1: taqAgAnyudapAnAni srotAMsi ca sarAMsi ca । snehAnsarvarasAMScEva dadAti vasuDAM dadat ॥68॥

text: oṣadhīḥ kṣīrasampannā nagānpuṣpaphalānvitān । kānanopalaśailāṃśca dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat ॥69॥
html:
oṣadhīḥ kṣīrasampannā nagānpuṣpaphalānvitān ।
kānanopalaśailāṃśca dadāti vasudhāṃ dadat ॥69॥
slp1: ozaDIH kzIrasampannA nagAnpuzpaPalAnvitAn । kAnanopalaSElAMSca dadAti vasuDAM dadat ॥69॥

text: agniṣṭomaprabhṛtibhiriṣṭvā ca svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ । na tatphalamavāpnoti bhūmidānādyadaśnute ॥70॥
html:
agniṣṭomaprabhṛtibhiriṣṭvā ca svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ।
na tatphalamavāpnoti bhūmidānādyadaśnute ॥70॥
slp1: agnizwomapraBftiBirizwvA ca svAptadakziREH । na tatPalamavApnoti BUmidAnAdyadaSnute ॥70॥

text: dātā daśānugṛhṇāti daśa hanti tathā kṣipan । pūrvadattāṃ haranbhūmiṃ narakāyopagacchati ॥71॥
html:
dātā daśānugṛhṇāti daśa hanti tathā kṣipan ।
pūrvadattāṃ haranbhūmiṃ narakāyopagacchati ॥71॥
slp1: dAtA daSAnugfhRAti daSa hanti taTA kzipan । pUrvadattAM haranBUmiM narakAyopagacCati ॥71॥

text: na dadāti pratiśrutya dattvā vā harate tu yaḥ । sa baddho vāruṇaiḥ pāśaistapyate mṛtyuśāsanāt ॥72॥
html:
na dadāti pratiśrutya dattvā vā harate tu yaḥ ।
sa baddho vāruṇaiḥ pāśaistapyate mṛtyuśāsanāt ॥72॥
slp1: na dadAti pratiSrutya dattvA vA harate tu yaH । sa badDo vAruREH pASEstapyate mftyuSAsanAt ॥72॥

text: āhitāgniṃ sadāyajñaṃ kṛśabhṛtyaṃ priyātithim । ye bharanti dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ nopasarpanti te yamam ॥73॥
html:
āhitāgniṃ sadāyajñaṃ kṛśabhṛtyaṃ priyātithim ।
ye bharanti dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ nopasarpanti te yamam ॥73॥
slp1: AhitAgniM sadAyajYaM kfSaBftyaM priyAtiTim । ye Baranti dvijaSrezWaM nopasarpanti te yamam ॥73॥

text: brāhmaṇeṣvṛṇabhūtaṃ syātpārthivasya purandara । itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ tārayetkṛśadurbalān ॥74॥
html:
brāhmaṇeṣvṛṇabhūtaṃ syātpārthivasya purandara ।
itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ tārayetkṛśadurbalān ॥74॥
slp1: brAhmaRezvfRaBUtaM syAtpArTivasya purandara । itarezAM tu varRAnAM tArayetkfSadurbalAn ॥74॥

text: nācchindyātsparśitāṃ bhūmiṃ pareṇa tridaśādhipa । brāhmaṇāya suraśreṣṭha kṛśabhṛtyāya kaścana ॥75॥
html:
nācchindyātsparśitāṃ bhūmiṃ pareṇa tridaśādhipa ।
brāhmaṇāya suraśreṣṭha kṛśabhṛtyāya kaścana ॥75॥
slp1: nAcCindyAtsparSitAM BUmiM pareRa tridaSADipa । brAhmaRAya suraSrezWa kfSaBftyAya kaScana ॥75॥

text: athāśru patitaṃ teṣāṃ dīnānāmavasīdatām । brāhmaṇānāṃ hṛte kṣetre hanyāttripuruṣaṃ kulam ॥76॥
html:
athāśru patitaṃ teṣāṃ dīnānāmavasīdatām ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ hṛte kṣetre hanyāttripuruṣaṃ kulam ॥76॥
slp1: aTASru patitaM tezAM dInAnAmavasIdatAm । brAhmaRAnAM hfte kzetre hanyAttripuruzaM kulam ॥76॥

text: bhūmipālaṃ cyutaṃ rāṣṭrādyastu saṃsthāpayetpunaḥ । tasya vāsaḥ sahasrākṣa nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate ॥77॥
html:
bhūmipālaṃ cyutaṃ rāṣṭrādyastu saṃsthāpayetpunaḥ ।
tasya vāsaḥ sahasrākṣa nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate ॥77॥
slp1: BUmipAlaM cyutaM rAzwrAdyastu saMsTApayetpunaH । tasya vAsaH sahasrAkza nAkapfzWe mahIyate ॥77॥

text: ikṣubhiḥ santatāṃ bhūmiṃ yavagodhūmasaṅkulām । gośvavāhanasampūrṇāṃ bāhuvīryasamārjitām ॥78॥
html:
ikṣubhiḥ santatāṃ bhūmiṃ yavagodhūmasaṅkulām ।
gośvavāhanasampūrṇāṃ bāhuvīryasamārjitām ॥78॥
slp1: ikzuBiH santatAM BUmiM yavagoDUmasaNkulAm । goSvavAhanasampUrRAM bAhuvIryasamArjitAm ॥78॥

text: nidhigarbhāṃ dadadbhūmiṃ sarvaratnaparicchadām । akṣayāṁllabhate lokānbhūmisatraṃ hi tasya tat ॥79॥
html:
nidhigarbhāṃ dadadbhūmiṃ sarvaratnaparicchadām ।
akṣayāṁllabhate lokānbhūmisatraṃ hi tasya tat ॥79॥
slp1: niDigarBAM dadadBUmiM sarvaratnaparicCadAm । akzayAṁllaBate lokAnBUmisatraM hi tasya tat ॥79॥

text: vidhūya kaluṣaṃ sarvaṃ virajāḥ sammataḥ satām । loke mahīyate sadbhiryo dadāti vasundharām ॥80॥
html:
vidhūya kaluṣaṃ sarvaṃ virajāḥ sammataḥ satām ।
loke mahīyate sadbhiryo dadāti vasundharām ॥80॥
slp1: viDUya kaluzaM sarvaM virajAH sammataH satAm । loke mahIyate sadBiryo dadAti vasunDarAm ॥80॥

text: yathāpsu patitaḥ śakra tailabindurvisarpati । tathā bhūmikṛtaṃ dānaṃ sasye sasye visarpati ॥81॥
html:
yathāpsu patitaḥ śakra tailabindurvisarpati ।
tathā bhūmikṛtaṃ dānaṃ sasye sasye visarpati ॥81॥
slp1: yaTApsu patitaH Sakra tElabindurvisarpati । taTA BUmikftaM dAnaM sasye sasye visarpati ॥81॥

text: ye raṇāgre mahīpālāḥ śūrāḥ samitiśobhanāḥ । vadhyante'bhimukhāḥ śakra brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te ॥82॥
html:
ye raṇāgre mahīpālāḥ śūrāḥ samitiśobhanāḥ ।
vadhyante'bhimukhāḥ śakra brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te ॥82॥
slp1: ye raRAgre mahIpAlAH SUrAH samitiSoBanAH । vaDyante'BimuKAH Sakra brahmalokaM vrajanti te ॥82॥

text: nṛtyagītaparā nāryo divyamālyavibhūṣitāḥ । upatiṣṭhanti devendra sadā bhūmipradaṃ divi ॥83॥
html:
nṛtyagītaparā nāryo divyamālyavibhūṣitāḥ ।
upatiṣṭhanti devendra sadā bhūmipradaṃ divi ॥83॥
slp1: nftyagItaparA nAryo divyamAlyaviBUzitAH । upatizWanti devendra sadA BUmipradaM divi ॥83॥

text: modate ca sukhaṃ svarge devagandharvapūjitaḥ । yo dadāti mahīṃ samyagvidhineha dvijātaye ॥84॥
html:
modate ca sukhaṃ svarge devagandharvapūjitaḥ ।
yo dadāti mahīṃ samyagvidhineha dvijātaye ॥84॥
slp1: modate ca suKaM svarge devaganDarvapUjitaH । yo dadAti mahIM samyagviDineha dvijAtaye ॥84॥

text: śatamapsarasaścaiva divyamālyavibhūṣitāḥ । upatiṣṭhanti devendra sadā bhūmipradaṃ naram ॥85॥
html:
śatamapsarasaścaiva divyamālyavibhūṣitāḥ ।
upatiṣṭhanti devendra sadā bhūmipradaṃ naram ॥85॥
slp1: SatamapsarasaScEva divyamAlyaviBUzitAH । upatizWanti devendra sadA BUmipradaM naram ॥85॥

text: śaṅkhaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ chatraṃ varāśvā varavāraṇāḥ । bhūmipradānātpuṣpāṇi hiraṇyanicayāstathā ॥86॥
html:
śaṅkhaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ chatraṃ varāśvā varavāraṇāḥ ।
bhūmipradānātpuṣpāṇi hiraṇyanicayāstathā ॥86॥
slp1: SaNKaM BadrAsanaM CatraM varASvA varavAraRAH । BUmipradAnAtpuzpARi hiraRyanicayAstaTA ॥86॥

text: ājñā sadāpratihatā jayaśabdo bhavatyatha । bhūmidānasya puṣpāṇi phalaṃ svargaḥ purandara ॥87॥
html:
ājñā sadāpratihatā jayaśabdo bhavatyatha ।
bhūmidānasya puṣpāṇi phalaṃ svargaḥ purandara ॥87॥
slp1: AjYA sadApratihatA jayaSabdo BavatyaTa । BUmidAnasya puzpARi PalaM svargaH purandara ॥87॥

text: hiraṇyapuṣpāścauṣadhyaḥ kuśakāñcanaśāḍvalāḥ । amṛtaprasavāṃ bhūmiṃ prāpnoti puruṣo dadat ॥88॥
html:
hiraṇyapuṣpāścauṣadhyaḥ kuśakāñcanaśāḍvalāḥ ।
amṛtaprasavāṃ bhūmiṃ prāpnoti puruṣo dadat ॥88॥
slp1: hiraRyapuzpAScOzaDyaH kuSakAYcanaSAqvalAH । amftaprasavAM BUmiM prApnoti puruzo dadat ॥88॥

text: nāsti bhūmisamaṃ dānaṃ nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ । nāsti satyasamo dharmo nāsti dānasamo nidhiḥ ॥89॥
html:
nāsti bhūmisamaṃ dānaṃ nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ ।
nāsti satyasamo dharmo nāsti dānasamo nidhiḥ ॥89॥
slp1: nAsti BUmisamaM dAnaM nAsti mAtfsamo guruH । nAsti satyasamo Darmo nAsti dAnasamo niDiH ॥89॥

text: etadāṅgirasācchrutvā vāsavo vasudhāmimām । vasuratnasamākīrṇāṃ dadāvāṅgirase tadā ॥90॥
html:
etadāṅgirasācchrutvā vāsavo vasudhāmimām ।
vasuratnasamākīrṇāṃ dadāvāṅgirase tadā ॥90॥
slp1: etadANgirasAcCrutvA vAsavo vasuDAmimAm । vasuratnasamAkIrRAM dadAvANgirase tadA ॥90॥

text: ya imaṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe bhūmidānasya saṃstavam । na tasya rakṣasāṃ bhāgo nāsurāṇāṃ bhavatyuta ॥91॥
html:
ya imaṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe bhūmidānasya saṃstavam ।
na tasya rakṣasāṃ bhāgo nāsurāṇāṃ bhavatyuta ॥91॥
slp1: ya imaM SrAvayecCrAdDe BUmidAnasya saMstavam । na tasya rakzasAM BAgo nAsurARAM Bavatyuta ॥91॥

text: akṣayaṃ ca bhaveddattaṃ pitṛbhyastanna saṃśayaḥ । tasmācchrāddheṣvidaṃ vipro bhuñjataḥ śrāvayeddvijān ॥92॥
html:
akṣayaṃ ca bhaveddattaṃ pitṛbhyastanna saṃśayaḥ ।
tasmācchrāddheṣvidaṃ vipro bhuñjataḥ śrāvayeddvijān ॥92॥
slp1: akzayaM ca BaveddattaM pitfByastanna saMSayaH । tasmAcCrAdDezvidaM vipro BuYjataH SrAvayeddvijAn ॥92॥

text: ityetatsarvadānānāṃ śreṣṭhamuktaṃ tavānagha । mayā bharataśārdūla kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥93॥
html:
ityetatsarvadānānāṃ śreṣṭhamuktaṃ tavānagha ।
mayā bharataśārdūla kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi] ॥93॥
slp1: ityetatsarvadAnAnAM SrezWamuktaM tavAnaGa । mayA BarataSArdUla kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi] ॥93॥

text: kāni dānāni loke'smindātukāmo mahīpatiḥ । guṇādhikebhyo viprebhyo dadyādbharatasattama ॥1॥
html:
kāni dānāni loke'smindātukāmo mahīpatiḥ ।
guṇādhikebhyo viprebhyo dadyādbharatasattama ॥1॥
slp1: kAni dAnAni loke'smindAtukAmo mahIpatiH । guRADikeByo vipreByo dadyAdBaratasattama ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kena tuṣyanti te sadyastuṣṭāḥ kiṃ pradiśantyuta । śaṃsa me tanmahābāho phalaṃ puṇyakṛtaṃ mahat ॥2॥
html:
kena tuṣyanti te sadyastuṣṭāḥ kiṃ pradiśantyuta ।
śaṃsa me tanmahābāho phalaṃ puṇyakṛtaṃ mahat ॥2॥
slp1: kena tuzyanti te sadyastuzwAH kiM pradiSantyuta । SaMsa me tanmahAbAho PalaM puRyakftaM mahat ॥2॥

text: dattaṃ kiṃ phalavadrājanniha loke paratra ca । bhavataḥ śrotumicchāmi tanme vistarato vada ॥3॥
html:
dattaṃ kiṃ phalavadrājanniha loke paratra ca ।
bhavataḥ śrotumicchāmi tanme vistarato vada ॥3॥
slp1: dattaM kiM PalavadrAjanniha loke paratra ca । BavataH SrotumicCAmi tanme vistarato vada ॥3॥

text: imamarthaṃ purā pṛṣṭo nārado devadarśanaḥ । yaduktavānasau tanme gadataḥ śṛṇu bhārata ॥4॥
html:
imamarthaṃ purā pṛṣṭo nārado devadarśanaḥ ।
yaduktavānasau tanme gadataḥ śṛṇu bhārata ॥4॥
slp1: imamarTaM purA pfzwo nArado devadarSanaH । yaduktavAnasO tanme gadataH SfRu BArata ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: annameva praśaṃsanti devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ purā । lokatantraṃ hi yajñāśca sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam ॥5॥
html:
annameva praśaṃsanti devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ purā ।
lokatantraṃ hi yajñāśca sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam ॥5॥
slp1: annameva praSaMsanti devAH sarzigaRAH purA । lokatantraM hi yajYASca sarvamanne pratizWitam ॥5॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: annena sadṛśaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati । tasmādannaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātumicchanti mānavāḥ ॥6॥
html:
annena sadṛśaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।
tasmādannaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātumicchanti mānavāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: annena sadfSaM dAnaM na BUtaM na Bavizyati । tasmAdannaM viSezeRa dAtumicCanti mAnavAH ॥6॥

text: annamūrjaskaraṃ loke prāṇāścānne pratiṣṭhitāḥ । annena dhāryate sarvaṃ viśvaṃ jagadidaṃ prabho ॥7॥
html:
annamūrjaskaraṃ loke prāṇāścānne pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।
annena dhāryate sarvaṃ viśvaṃ jagadidaṃ prabho ॥7॥
slp1: annamUrjaskaraM loke prARAScAnne pratizWitAH । annena DAryate sarvaM viSvaM jagadidaM praBo ॥7॥

text: annādgṛhasthā loke'sminbhikṣavastata eva ca । annātprabhavati prāṇaḥ pratyakṣaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥8॥
html:
annādgṛhasthā loke'sminbhikṣavastata eva ca ।
annātprabhavati prāṇaḥ pratyakṣaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: annAdgfhasTA loke'sminBikzavastata eva ca । annAtpraBavati prARaH pratyakzaM nAtra saMSayaH ॥8॥

text: kuṭumbaṃ pīḍayitvāpi brāhmaṇāya mahātmane । dātavyaṃ bhikṣave cānnamātmano bhūtimicchatā ॥9॥
html:
kuṭumbaṃ pīḍayitvāpi brāhmaṇāya mahātmane ।
dātavyaṃ bhikṣave cānnamātmano bhūtimicchatā ॥9॥
slp1: kuwumbaM pIqayitvApi brAhmaRAya mahAtmane । dAtavyaM Bikzave cAnnamAtmano BUtimicCatA ॥9॥

text: brāhmaṇāyābhirūpāya yo dadyādannamarthine । nidadhāti nidhiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pāralaukikamātmanaḥ ॥10॥
html:
brāhmaṇāyābhirūpāya yo dadyādannamarthine ।
nidadhāti nidhiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pāralaukikamātmanaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: brAhmaRAyABirUpAya yo dadyAdannamarTine । nidaDAti niDiM SrezWaM pAralOkikamAtmanaH ॥10॥

text: śrāntamadhvani vartantaṃ vṛddhamarhamupasthitam । arcayedbhūtimanvicchangṛhastho gṛhamāgatam ॥11॥
html:
śrāntamadhvani vartantaṃ vṛddhamarhamupasthitam ।
arcayedbhūtimanvicchangṛhastho gṛhamāgatam ॥11॥
slp1: SrAntamaDvani vartantaM vfdDamarhamupasTitam । arcayedBUtimanvicCangfhasTo gfhamAgatam ॥11॥

text: krodhamutpatitaṃ hitvā suśīlo vītamatsaraḥ । annadaḥ prāpnute rājandivi ceha ca yatsukham ॥12॥
html:
krodhamutpatitaṃ hitvā suśīlo vītamatsaraḥ ।
annadaḥ prāpnute rājandivi ceha ca yatsukham ॥12॥
slp1: kroDamutpatitaM hitvA suSIlo vItamatsaraH । annadaH prApnute rAjandivi ceha ca yatsuKam ॥12॥

text: nāvamanyedabhigataṃ na praṇudyātkathañcana । api śvapāke śuni vā na dānaṃ vipraṇaśyati ॥13॥
html:
nāvamanyedabhigataṃ na praṇudyātkathañcana ।
api śvapāke śuni vā na dānaṃ vipraṇaśyati ॥13॥
slp1: nAvamanyedaBigataM na praRudyAtkaTaYcana । api SvapAke Suni vA na dAnaM vipraRaSyati ॥13॥

text: yo dadyādaparikliṣṭamannamadhvani vartate । śrāntāyādṛṣṭapūrvāya sa mahaddharmamāpnuyāt ॥14॥
html:
yo dadyādaparikliṣṭamannamadhvani vartate ।
śrāntāyādṛṣṭapūrvāya sa mahaddharmamāpnuyāt ॥14॥
slp1: yo dadyAdapariklizwamannamaDvani vartate । SrAntAyAdfzwapUrvAya sa mahadDarmamApnuyAt ॥14॥

text: pitṝndevānṛṣīnviprānatithīṃśca janādhipa । yo naraḥ prīṇayatyannaistasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ॥15॥
html:
pitṝndevānṛṣīnviprānatithīṃśca janādhipa ।
yo naraḥ prīṇayatyannaistasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ॥15॥
slp1: pitFndevAnfzInviprAnatiTIMSca janADipa । yo naraH prIRayatyannEstasya puRyaPalaM mahat ॥15॥

text: kṛtvāpi pāpakaṃ karma yo dadyādannamarthine । brāhmaṇāya viśeṣeṇa na sa pāpena yujyate ॥16॥
html:
kṛtvāpi pāpakaṃ karma yo dadyādannamarthine ।
brāhmaṇāya viśeṣeṇa na sa pāpena yujyate ॥16॥
slp1: kftvApi pApakaM karma yo dadyAdannamarTine । brAhmaRAya viSezeRa na sa pApena yujyate ॥16॥

text: brāhmaṇeṣvakṣayaṃ dānamannaṃ śūdre mahāphalam । annadānaṃ ca śūdre ca brāhmaṇe ca viśiṣyate ॥17॥
html:
brāhmaṇeṣvakṣayaṃ dānamannaṃ śūdre mahāphalam ।
annadānaṃ ca śūdre ca brāhmaṇe ca viśiṣyate ॥17॥
slp1: brAhmaRezvakzayaM dAnamannaM SUdre mahAPalam । annadAnaM ca SUdre ca brAhmaRe ca viSizyate ॥17॥

text: na pṛcchedgotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ deśameva vā । bhikṣito brāhmaṇeneha janma vānnaṃ prayācitaḥ ॥18॥
html:
na pṛcchedgotracaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ deśameva vā ।
bhikṣito brāhmaṇeneha janma vānnaṃ prayācitaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: na pfcCedgotracaraRaM svADyAyaM deSameva vA । Bikzito brAhmaReneha janma vAnnaM prayAcitaH ॥18॥

text: annadasyānnavṛkṣāśca sarvakāmaphalānvitāḥ । bhavantīhātha vāmutra nṛpate nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥19॥
html:
annadasyānnavṛkṣāśca sarvakāmaphalānvitāḥ ।
bhavantīhātha vāmutra nṛpate nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: annadasyAnnavfkzASca sarvakAmaPalAnvitAH । BavantIhATa vAmutra nfpate nAtra saMSayaH ॥19॥

text: āśaṃsante hi pitaraḥ suvṛṣṭimiva karṣakāḥ । asmākamapi putro vā pautro vānnaṃ pradāsyati ॥20॥
html:
āśaṃsante hi pitaraḥ suvṛṣṭimiva karṣakāḥ ।
asmākamapi putro vā pautro vānnaṃ pradāsyati ॥20॥
slp1: ASaMsante hi pitaraH suvfzwimiva karzakAH । asmAkamapi putro vA pOtro vAnnaM pradAsyati ॥20॥

text: brāhmaṇo hi mahadbhūtaṃ svayaṃ dehīti yācate । akāmo vā sakāmo vā dattvā puṇyamavāpnuyāt ॥21॥
html:
brāhmaṇo hi mahadbhūtaṃ svayaṃ dehīti yācate ।
akāmo vā sakāmo vā dattvā puṇyamavāpnuyāt ॥21॥
slp1: brAhmaRo hi mahadBUtaM svayaM dehIti yAcate । akAmo vA sakAmo vA dattvA puRyamavApnuyAt ॥21॥

text: brāhmaṇaḥ sarvabhūtānāmatithiḥ prasṛtāgrabhuk । viprā yamabhigacchanti bhikṣamāṇā gṛhaṃ sadā ॥22॥
html:
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvabhūtānāmatithiḥ prasṛtāgrabhuk ।
viprā yamabhigacchanti bhikṣamāṇā gṛhaṃ sadā ॥22॥
slp1: brAhmaRaH sarvaBUtAnAmatiTiH prasftAgraBuk । viprA yamaBigacCanti BikzamARA gfhaM sadA ॥22॥

text: satkṛtāśca nivartante tadatīva pravardhate । mahābhoge kule janma pretya prāpnoti bhārata ॥23॥
html:
satkṛtāśca nivartante tadatīva pravardhate ।
mahābhoge kule janma pretya prāpnoti bhārata ॥23॥
slp1: satkftASca nivartante tadatIva pravarDate । mahABoge kule janma pretya prApnoti BArata ॥23॥

text: dattvā tvannaṃ naro loke tathā sthānamanuttamam । mṛṣṭamṛṣṭānnadāyī tu svarge vasati satkṛtaḥ ॥24॥
html:
dattvā tvannaṃ naro loke tathā sthānamanuttamam ।
mṛṣṭamṛṣṭānnadāyī tu svarge vasati satkṛtaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: dattvA tvannaM naro loke taTA sTAnamanuttamam । mfzwamfzwAnnadAyI tu svarge vasati satkftaH ॥24॥

text: annaṃ prāṇā narāṇāṃ hi sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam । annadaḥ paśumānputrī dhanavānbhogavānapi ॥25॥
html:
annaṃ prāṇā narāṇāṃ hi sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam ।
annadaḥ paśumānputrī dhanavānbhogavānapi ॥25॥
slp1: annaM prARA narARAM hi sarvamanne pratizWitam । annadaH paSumAnputrI DanavAnBogavAnapi ॥25॥

text: prāṇavāṃścāpi bhavati rūpavāṃśca tathā nṛpa । annadaḥ prāṇado loke sarvadaḥ procyate tu saḥ ॥26॥
html:
prāṇavāṃścāpi bhavati rūpavāṃśca tathā nṛpa ।
annadaḥ prāṇado loke sarvadaḥ procyate tu saḥ ॥26॥
slp1: prARavAMScApi Bavati rUpavAMSca taTA nfpa । annadaH prARado loke sarvadaH procyate tu saH ॥26॥

text: annaṃ hi dattvātithaye brāhmaṇāya yathāvidhi । pradātā sukhamāpnoti devaiścāpyabhipūjyate ॥27॥
html:
annaṃ hi dattvātithaye brāhmaṇāya yathāvidhi ।
pradātā sukhamāpnoti devaiścāpyabhipūjyate ॥27॥
slp1: annaM hi dattvAtiTaye brAhmaRAya yaTAviDi । pradAtA suKamApnoti devEScApyaBipUjyate ॥27॥

text: brāhmaṇo hi mahadbhūtaṃ kṣetraṃ carati pādavat । upyate tatra yadbījaṃ taddhi puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ॥28॥
html:
brāhmaṇo hi mahadbhūtaṃ kṣetraṃ carati pādavat ।
upyate tatra yadbījaṃ taddhi puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ॥28॥
slp1: brAhmaRo hi mahadBUtaM kzetraM carati pAdavat । upyate tatra yadbIjaM tadDi puRyaPalaM mahat ॥28॥

text: pratyakṣaṃ prītijananaṃ bhoktṛdātrorbhavatyuta । sarvāṇyanyāni dānāni parokṣaphalavantyuta ॥29॥
html:
pratyakṣaṃ prītijananaṃ bhoktṛdātrorbhavatyuta ।
sarvāṇyanyāni dānāni parokṣaphalavantyuta ॥29॥
slp1: pratyakzaM prItijananaM BoktfdAtrorBavatyuta । sarvARyanyAni dAnAni parokzaPalavantyuta ॥29॥

text: annāddhi prasavaṃ viddhi ratimannāddhi bhārata । dharmārthāvannato viddhi roganāśaṃ tathānnataḥ ॥30॥
html:
annāddhi prasavaṃ viddhi ratimannāddhi bhārata ।
dharmārthāvannato viddhi roganāśaṃ tathānnataḥ ॥30॥
slp1: annAdDi prasavaM vidDi ratimannAdDi BArata । DarmArTAvannato vidDi roganASaM taTAnnataH ॥30॥

text: annaṃ hyamṛtamityāha purākalpe prajāpatiḥ । annaṃ bhuvaṃ divaṃ khaṃ ca sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam ॥31॥
html:
annaṃ hyamṛtamityāha purākalpe prajāpatiḥ ।
annaṃ bhuvaṃ divaṃ khaṃ ca sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam ॥31॥
slp1: annaM hyamftamityAha purAkalpe prajApatiH । annaM BuvaM divaM KaM ca sarvamanne pratizWitam ॥31॥

text: annapraṇāśe bhidyante śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ । balaṃ balavato'pīha praṇaśyatyannahānitaḥ ॥32॥
html:
annapraṇāśe bhidyante śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ ।
balaṃ balavato'pīha praṇaśyatyannahānitaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: annapraRASe Bidyante SarIre paYca DAtavaH । balaM balavato'pIha praRaSyatyannahAnitaH ॥32॥

text: āvāhāśca vivāhāśca yajñāścānnamṛte tathā । na vartante naraśreṣṭha brahma cātra pralīyate ॥33॥
html:
āvāhāśca vivāhāśca yajñāścānnamṛte tathā ।
na vartante naraśreṣṭha brahma cātra pralīyate ॥33॥
slp1: AvAhASca vivAhASca yajYAScAnnamfte taTA । na vartante naraSrezWa brahma cAtra pralIyate ॥33॥

text: annataḥ sarvametaddhi yatkiñcitsthāṇu jaṅgamam । triṣu lokeṣu dharmārthamannaṃ deyamato budhaiḥ ॥34॥
html:
annataḥ sarvametaddhi yatkiñcitsthāṇu jaṅgamam ।
triṣu lokeṣu dharmārthamannaṃ deyamato budhaiḥ ॥34॥
slp1: annataH sarvametadDi yatkiYcitsTARu jaNgamam । trizu lokezu DarmArTamannaM deyamato buDEH ॥34॥

text: annadasya manuṣyasya balamojo yaśaḥ sukham । kīrtiśca vardhate śaśvattriṣu lokeṣu pārthiva ॥35॥
html:
annadasya manuṣyasya balamojo yaśaḥ sukham ।
kīrtiśca vardhate śaśvattriṣu lokeṣu pārthiva ॥35॥
slp1: annadasya manuzyasya balamojo yaSaH suKam । kIrtiSca varDate SaSvattrizu lokezu pArTiva ॥35॥

text: megheṣvambhaḥ sannidhatte prāṇānāṃ pavanaḥ śivaḥ । tacca meghagataṃ vāri śakro varṣati bhārata ॥36॥
html:
megheṣvambhaḥ sannidhatte prāṇānāṃ pavanaḥ śivaḥ ।
tacca meghagataṃ vāri śakro varṣati bhārata ॥36॥
slp1: meGezvamBaH sanniDatte prARAnAM pavanaH SivaH । tacca meGagataM vAri Sakro varzati BArata ॥36॥

text: ādatte ca rasaṃ bhaumamādityaḥ svagabhastibhiḥ । vāyurādityatastāṃśca rasāndevaḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥37॥
html:
ādatte ca rasaṃ bhaumamādityaḥ svagabhastibhiḥ ।
vāyurādityatastāṃśca rasāndevaḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥37॥
slp1: Adatte ca rasaM BOmamAdityaH svagaBastiBiH । vAyurAdityatastAMSca rasAndevaH prajApatiH ॥37॥

text: tadyadā meghato vāri patitaṃ bhavati kṣitau । tadā vasumatī devī snigdhā bhavati bhārata ॥38॥
html:
tadyadā meghato vāri patitaṃ bhavati kṣitau ।
tadā vasumatī devī snigdhā bhavati bhārata ॥38॥
slp1: tadyadA meGato vAri patitaM Bavati kzitO । tadA vasumatI devI snigDA Bavati BArata ॥38॥

text: tataḥ sasyāni rohanti yena vartayate jagat । māṃsamedosthiśukrāṇāṃ prādurbhāvastataḥ punaḥ ॥39॥
html:
tataḥ sasyāni rohanti yena vartayate jagat ।
māṃsamedosthiśukrāṇāṃ prādurbhāvastataḥ punaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: tataH sasyAni rohanti yena vartayate jagat । mAMsamedosTiSukrARAM prAdurBAvastataH punaH ॥39॥

text: sambhavanti tataḥ śukrātprāṇinaḥ pṛthivīpate । agnīṣomau hi tacchukraṃ prajanaḥ puṣyataśca ha ॥40॥
html:
sambhavanti tataḥ śukrātprāṇinaḥ pṛthivīpate ।
agnīṣomau hi tacchukraṃ prajanaḥ puṣyataśca ha ॥40॥
slp1: samBavanti tataH SukrAtprARinaH pfTivIpate । agnIzomO hi tacCukraM prajanaH puzyataSca ha ॥40॥

text: evamannaṃ ca sūryaśca pavanaḥ śukrameva ca । eka eva smṛto rāśiryato bhūtāni jajñire ॥41॥
html:
evamannaṃ ca sūryaśca pavanaḥ śukrameva ca ।
eka eva smṛto rāśiryato bhūtāni jajñire ॥41॥
slp1: evamannaM ca sUryaSca pavanaH Sukrameva ca । eka eva smfto rASiryato BUtAni jajYire ॥41॥

text: prāṇāndadāti bhūtānāṃ tejaśca bharatarṣabha । gṛhamabhyāgatāyāśu yo dadyādannamarthine ॥42॥
html:
prāṇāndadāti bhūtānāṃ tejaśca bharatarṣabha ।
gṛhamabhyāgatāyāśu yo dadyādannamarthine ॥42॥
slp1: prARAndadAti BUtAnAM tejaSca BaratarzaBa । gfhamaByAgatAyASu yo dadyAdannamarTine ॥42॥

text: nāradenaivamukto'hamadāmannaṃ sadā nṛpa । anasūyustvamapyannaṃ tasmāddehi gatajvaraḥ ॥43॥
html:
nāradenaivamukto'hamadāmannaṃ sadā nṛpa ।
anasūyustvamapyannaṃ tasmāddehi gatajvaraḥ ॥43॥
slp1: nAradenEvamukto'hamadAmannaM sadA nfpa । anasUyustvamapyannaM tasmAddehi gatajvaraH ॥43॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dattvānnaṃ vidhivadrājanviprebhyastvamapi prabho । yathāvadanurūpebhyastataḥ svargamavāpsyasi ॥44॥
html:
dattvānnaṃ vidhivadrājanviprebhyastvamapi prabho ।
yathāvadanurūpebhyastataḥ svargamavāpsyasi ॥44॥
slp1: dattvAnnaM viDivadrAjanvipreByastvamapi praBo । yaTAvadanurUpeByastataH svargamavApsyasi ॥44॥

text: annadānāṃ hi ye lokāstāṃstvaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa । bhavanāni prakāśante divi teṣāṃ mahātmanām । nānāsaṃsthānarūpāṇi nānāstambhānvitāni ca ॥45॥
html:
annadānāṃ hi ye lokāstāṃstvaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa ।
bhavanāni prakāśante divi teṣāṃ mahātmanām ।
nānāsaṃsthānarūpāṇi nānāstambhānvitāni ca ॥45॥
slp1: annadAnAM hi ye lokAstAMstvaM SfRu narADipa । BavanAni prakASante divi tezAM mahAtmanAm । nAnAsaMsTAnarUpARi nAnAstamBAnvitAni ca ॥45॥

text: candramaṇḍalaśubhrāṇi kiṅkiṇījālavanti ca । taruṇādityavarṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥46॥
html:
candramaṇḍalaśubhrāṇi kiṅkiṇījālavanti ca ।
taruṇādityavarṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥46॥
slp1: candramaRqalaSuBrARi kiNkiRIjAlavanti ca । taruRAdityavarRAni sTAvarARi carARi ca ॥46॥

text: anekaśatabhaumāni sāntarjalavanāni ca । vaiḍūryārkaprakāśāni raupyarukmamayāni ca ॥47॥
html:
anekaśatabhaumāni sāntarjalavanāni ca ।
vaiḍūryārkaprakāśāni raupyarukmamayāni ca ॥47॥
slp1: anekaSataBOmAni sAntarjalavanAni ca । vEqUryArkaprakASAni rOpyarukmamayAni ca ॥47॥

text: sarvakāmaphalāścāpi vṛkṣā bhavanasaṃsthitāḥ । vāpyo vīthyaḥ sabhāḥ kūpā dīrghikāścaiva sarvaśaḥ ॥48॥
html:
sarvakāmaphalāścāpi vṛkṣā bhavanasaṃsthitāḥ ।
vāpyo vīthyaḥ sabhāḥ kūpā dīrghikāścaiva sarvaśaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: sarvakAmaPalAScApi vfkzA BavanasaMsTitAH । vApyo vITyaH saBAH kUpA dIrGikAScEva sarvaSaH ॥48॥

text: ghoṣavanti ca yānāni yuktānyatha sahasraśaḥ । bhakṣyabhojyamayāḥ śailā vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ॥49॥
html:
ghoṣavanti ca yānāni yuktānyatha sahasraśaḥ ।
bhakṣyabhojyamayāḥ śailā vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ॥49॥
slp1: Gozavanti ca yAnAni yuktAnyaTa sahasraSaH । BakzyaBojyamayAH SElA vAsAMsyABaraRAni ca ॥49॥

text: kṣīraṃ sravantyaḥ saritastathā caivānnaparvatāḥ । prāsādāḥ pāṇḍurābhrābhāḥ śayyāśca kanakojjvalāḥ । tānannadāḥ prapadyante tasmādannaprado bhava ॥50॥
html:
kṣīraṃ sravantyaḥ saritastathā caivānnaparvatāḥ ।
prāsādāḥ pāṇḍurābhrābhāḥ śayyāśca kanakojjvalāḥ ।
tānannadāḥ prapadyante tasmādannaprado bhava ॥50॥
slp1: kzIraM sravantyaH saritastaTA cEvAnnaparvatAH । prAsAdAH pARqurABrABAH SayyASca kanakojjvalAH । tAnannadAH prapadyante tasmAdannaprado Bava ॥50॥

text: ete lokāḥ puṇyakṛtāmannadānāṃ mahātmanām । tasmādannaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātavyaṃ mānavairbhuvi] ॥51॥
html:
ete lokāḥ puṇyakṛtāmannadānāṃ mahātmanām ।
tasmādannaṃ viśeṣeṇa dātavyaṃ mānavairbhuvi] ॥51॥
slp1: ete lokAH puRyakftAmannadAnAM mahAtmanAm । tasmAdannaM viSezeRa dAtavyaM mAnavErBuvi] ॥51॥

text: śrutaṃ me bhavato vākyamannadānasya yo vidhiḥ । nakṣatrayogasyedānīṃ dānakalpaṃ bravīhi me ॥1॥
html:
śrutaṃ me bhavato vākyamannadānasya yo vidhiḥ ।
nakṣatrayogasyedānīṃ dānakalpaṃ bravīhi me ॥1॥
slp1: SrutaM me Bavato vAkyamannadAnasya yo viDiH । nakzatrayogasyedAnIM dAnakalpaM bravIhi me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । devakyāścaiva saṃvādaṃ devarṣernāradasya ca ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
devakyāścaiva saṃvādaṃ devarṣernāradasya ca ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । devakyAScEva saMvAdaM devarzernAradasya ca ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dvārakāmanusamprāptaṃ nāradaṃ devadarśanam । papracchainaṃ tataḥ praśnaṃ devakī dharmadarśinī ॥3॥
html:
dvārakāmanusamprāptaṃ nāradaṃ devadarśanam ।
papracchainaṃ tataḥ praśnaṃ devakī dharmadarśinī ॥3॥
slp1: dvArakAmanusamprAptaM nAradaM devadarSanam । papracCEnaM tataH praSnaM devakI DarmadarSinI ॥3॥

text: tasyāḥ sampṛcchamānāyā devarṣirnāradastadā । ācaṣṭa vidhivatsarvaṃ yattacchṛṇu viśāṃ pate ॥4॥
html:
tasyāḥ sampṛcchamānāyā devarṣirnāradastadā ।
ācaṣṭa vidhivatsarvaṃ yattacchṛṇu viśāṃ pate ॥4॥
slp1: tasyAH sampfcCamAnAyA devarzirnAradastadA । Acazwa viDivatsarvaM yattacCfRu viSAM pate ॥4॥

text: kṛttikāsu mahābhāge pāyasena sasarpiṣā । santarpya brāhmaṇānsādhūṁllokānāpnotyanuttamān ॥5॥
html:
kṛttikāsu mahābhāge pāyasena sasarpiṣā ।
santarpya brāhmaṇānsādhūṁllokānāpnotyanuttamān ॥5॥
slp1: kfttikAsu mahABAge pAyasena sasarpizA । santarpya brAhmaRAnsADUṁllokAnApnotyanuttamAn ॥5॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: rohiṇyāṃ prathitairmāṃsairmāṣairannena sarpiṣā । payo'nupānaṃ dātavyamānṛṇyārthaṃ dvijātaye ॥6॥
html:
rohiṇyāṃ prathitairmāṃsairmāṣairannena sarpiṣā ।
payo'nupānaṃ dātavyamānṛṇyārthaṃ dvijātaye ॥6॥
slp1: rohiRyAM praTitErmAMsErmAzErannena sarpizA । payo'nupAnaM dAtavyamAnfRyArTaM dvijAtaye ॥6॥

text: dogdhrīṃ dattvā savatsāṃ tu nakṣatre somadaivate । gacchanti mānuṣāllokātsvargalokamanuttamam ॥7॥
html:
dogdhrīṃ dattvā savatsāṃ tu nakṣatre somadaivate ।
gacchanti mānuṣāllokātsvargalokamanuttamam ॥7॥
slp1: dogDrIM dattvA savatsAM tu nakzatre somadEvate । gacCanti mAnuzAllokAtsvargalokamanuttamam ॥7॥

text: ārdrāyāṃ kṛsaraṃ dattvā tailamiśramupoṣitaḥ । narastarati durgāṇi kṣuradhārāṃśca parvatān ॥8॥
html:
ārdrāyāṃ kṛsaraṃ dattvā tailamiśramupoṣitaḥ ।
narastarati durgāṇi kṣuradhārāṃśca parvatān ॥8॥
slp1: ArdrAyAM kfsaraM dattvA tElamiSramupozitaH । narastarati durgARi kzuraDArAMSca parvatAn ॥8॥

text: apūpānpunarvasau dattvā tathaivānnāni śobhane । yaśasvī rūpasampanno bahvanne jāyate kule ॥9॥
html:
apūpānpunarvasau dattvā tathaivānnāni śobhane ।
yaśasvī rūpasampanno bahvanne jāyate kule ॥9॥
slp1: apUpAnpunarvasO dattvA taTEvAnnAni SoBane । yaSasvI rUpasampanno bahvanne jAyate kule ॥9॥

text: puṣye tu kanakaṃ dattvā kṛtaṃ cākṛtameva ca । anālokeṣu lokeṣu somavatsa virājate ॥10॥
html:
puṣye tu kanakaṃ dattvā kṛtaṃ cākṛtameva ca ।
anālokeṣu lokeṣu somavatsa virājate ॥10॥
slp1: puzye tu kanakaM dattvA kftaM cAkftameva ca । anAlokezu lokezu somavatsa virAjate ॥10॥

text: āśleṣāyāṃ tu yo rūpyamṛṣabhaṃ vā prayacchati । sa sarvabhayanirmuktaḥ śātravānadhitiṣṭhati ॥11॥
html:
āśleṣāyāṃ tu yo rūpyamṛṣabhaṃ vā prayacchati ।
sa sarvabhayanirmuktaḥ śātravānadhitiṣṭhati ॥11॥
slp1: ASlezAyAM tu yo rUpyamfzaBaM vA prayacCati । sa sarvaBayanirmuktaH SAtravAnaDitizWati ॥11॥

text: maghāsu tilapūrṇāni vardhamānāni mānavaḥ । pradāya putrapaśumāniha pretya ca modate ॥12॥
html:
maghāsu tilapūrṇāni vardhamānāni mānavaḥ ।
pradāya putrapaśumāniha pretya ca modate ॥12॥
slp1: maGAsu tilapUrRAni varDamAnAni mAnavaH । pradAya putrapaSumAniha pretya ca modate ॥12॥

text: phalgunīpūrvasamaye brāhmaṇānāmupoṣitaḥ । bhakṣānphāṇitasaṃyuktāndattvā saubhāgyamṛcchati ॥13॥
html:
phalgunīpūrvasamaye brāhmaṇānāmupoṣitaḥ ।
bhakṣānphāṇitasaṃyuktāndattvā saubhāgyamṛcchati ॥13॥
slp1: PalgunIpUrvasamaye brAhmaRAnAmupozitaH । BakzAnPARitasaMyuktAndattvA sOBAgyamfcCati ॥13॥

text: ghṛtakṣīrasamāyuktaṃ vidhivatṣaṣṭikaudanam । uttarāviṣaye dattvā svargaloke mahīyate ॥14॥
html:
ghṛtakṣīrasamāyuktaṃ vidhivatṣaṣṭikaudanam ।
uttarāviṣaye dattvā svargaloke mahīyate ॥14॥
slp1: GftakzIrasamAyuktaM viDivatzazwikOdanam । uttarAvizaye dattvA svargaloke mahIyate ॥14॥

text: yadyatpradīyate dānamuttarāviṣaye naraiḥ । mahāphalamanantaṃ ca bhavatīti viniścayaḥ ॥15॥
html:
yadyatpradīyate dānamuttarāviṣaye naraiḥ ।
mahāphalamanantaṃ ca bhavatīti viniścayaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yadyatpradIyate dAnamuttarAvizaye narEH । mahAPalamanantaM ca BavatIti viniScayaH ॥15॥

text: haste hastirathaṃ dattvā caturyuktamupoṣitaḥ । prāpnoti paramāṁllokānpuṇyakāmasamanvitān ॥16॥
html:
haste hastirathaṃ dattvā caturyuktamupoṣitaḥ ।
prāpnoti paramāṁllokānpuṇyakāmasamanvitān ॥16॥
slp1: haste hastiraTaM dattvA caturyuktamupozitaH । prApnoti paramAṁllokAnpuRyakAmasamanvitAn ॥16॥

text: citrāyāmṛṣabhaṃ dattvā puṇyāngandhāṃśca bhārata । caratyapsarasāṃ loke ramate nandane tathā ॥17॥
html:
citrāyāmṛṣabhaṃ dattvā puṇyāngandhāṃśca bhārata ।
caratyapsarasāṃ loke ramate nandane tathā ॥17॥
slp1: citrAyAmfzaBaM dattvA puRyAnganDAMSca BArata । caratyapsarasAM loke ramate nandane taTA ॥17॥

text: svātāvatha dhanaṃ dattvā yadiṣṭatamamātmanaḥ । prāpnoti lokānsa śubhāniha caiva mahadyaśaḥ ॥18॥
html:
svātāvatha dhanaṃ dattvā yadiṣṭatamamātmanaḥ ।
prāpnoti lokānsa śubhāniha caiva mahadyaśaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: svAtAvaTa DanaM dattvA yadizwatamamAtmanaH । prApnoti lokAnsa SuBAniha cEva mahadyaSaH ॥18॥

text: viśākhāyāmanaḍvāhaṃ dhenuṃ dattvā ca dugdhadām । saprāsaṅgaṃ ca śakaṭaṃ sadhānyaṃ vastrasaṃyutam ॥19॥
html:
viśākhāyāmanaḍvāhaṃ dhenuṃ dattvā ca dugdhadām ।
saprāsaṅgaṃ ca śakaṭaṃ sadhānyaṃ vastrasaṃyutam ॥19॥
slp1: viSAKAyAmanaqvAhaM DenuM dattvA ca dugDadAm । saprAsaNgaM ca SakawaM saDAnyaM vastrasaMyutam ॥19॥

text: pitṝndevāṃśca prīṇāti pretya cānantyamaśnute । na ca durgāṇyavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ॥20॥
html:
pitṝndevāṃśca prīṇāti pretya cānantyamaśnute ।
na ca durgāṇyavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ॥20॥
slp1: pitFndevAMSca prIRAti pretya cAnantyamaSnute । na ca durgARyavApnoti svargalokaM ca gacCati ॥20॥

text: dattvā yathoktaṃ viprebhyo vṛttimiṣṭāṃ sa vindati । narakādīṃśca saṅkleśānnāpnotīti viniścayaḥ ॥21॥
html:
dattvā yathoktaṃ viprebhyo vṛttimiṣṭāṃ sa vindati ।
narakādīṃśca saṅkleśānnāpnotīti viniścayaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: dattvA yaToktaM vipreByo vfttimizwAM sa vindati । narakAdIMSca saNkleSAnnApnotIti viniScayaH ॥21॥

text: anurādhāsu prāvāraṃ vastrāntaramupoṣitaḥ । dattvā yugaśataṃ cāpi naraḥ svarge mahīyate ॥22॥
html:
anurādhāsu prāvāraṃ vastrāntaramupoṣitaḥ ।
dattvā yugaśataṃ cāpi naraḥ svarge mahīyate ॥22॥
slp1: anurADAsu prAvAraM vastrAntaramupozitaH । dattvA yugaSataM cApi naraH svarge mahIyate ॥22॥

text: kālaśākaṃ tu viprebhyo dattvā martyaḥ samūlakam । jyeṣṭhāyāmṛddhimiṣṭāṃ vai gatimiṣṭāṃ ca vindati ॥23॥
html:
kālaśākaṃ tu viprebhyo dattvā martyaḥ samūlakam ।
jyeṣṭhāyāmṛddhimiṣṭāṃ vai gatimiṣṭāṃ ca vindati ॥23॥
slp1: kAlaSAkaM tu vipreByo dattvA martyaH samUlakam । jyezWAyAmfdDimizwAM vE gatimizwAM ca vindati ॥23॥

text: mūle mūlaphalaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ । pitṝnprīṇayate cāpi gatimiṣṭāṃ ca gacchati ॥24॥
html:
mūle mūlaphalaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ ।
pitṝnprīṇayate cāpi gatimiṣṭāṃ ca gacchati ॥24॥
slp1: mUle mUlaPalaM dattvA brAhmaReByaH samAhitaH । pitFnprIRayate cApi gatimizwAM ca gacCati ॥24॥

text: atha pūrvāsvaṣāḍhāsu dadhipātrāṇyupoṣitaḥ । kulavṛttopasampanne brāhmaṇe vedapārage । pradāya jāyate pretya kule subahugokule ॥25॥
html:
atha pūrvāsvaṣāḍhāsu dadhipātrāṇyupoṣitaḥ ।
kulavṛttopasampanne brāhmaṇe vedapārage ।
pradāya jāyate pretya kule subahugokule ॥25॥
slp1: aTa pUrvAsvazAQAsu daDipAtrARyupozitaH । kulavfttopasampanne brAhmaRe vedapArage । pradAya jAyate pretya kule subahugokule ॥25॥

text: udamanthaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ prabhūtamadhuphāṇitam । dattvottarāsvaṣāḍhāsu sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt ॥26॥
html:
udamanthaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ prabhūtamadhuphāṇitam ।
dattvottarāsvaṣāḍhāsu sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt ॥26॥
slp1: udamanTaM sasarpizkaM praBUtamaDuPARitam । dattvottarAsvazAQAsu sarvakAmAnavApnuyAt ॥26॥

text: dugdhaṃ tvabhijite yoge dattvā madhughṛtāplutam । dharmanityo manīṣibhyaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ॥27॥
html:
dugdhaṃ tvabhijite yoge dattvā madhughṛtāplutam ।
dharmanityo manīṣibhyaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ॥27॥
slp1: dugDaM tvaBijite yoge dattvA maDuGftAplutam । Darmanityo manIziByaH svargaloke mahIyate ॥27॥

text: śravaṇe kambalaṃ dattvā vastrāntaritameva ca । śvetena yāti yānena sarvalokānasaṃvṛtān ॥28॥
html:
śravaṇe kambalaṃ dattvā vastrāntaritameva ca ।
śvetena yāti yānena sarvalokānasaṃvṛtān ॥28॥
slp1: SravaRe kambalaM dattvA vastrAntaritameva ca । Svetena yAti yAnena sarvalokAnasaMvftAn ॥28॥

text: goprayuktaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsu yānaṃ dattvā samāhitaḥ । vastraraśmidharaṃ sadyaḥ pretya rājyaṃ prapadyate ॥29॥
html:
goprayuktaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsu yānaṃ dattvā samāhitaḥ ।
vastraraśmidharaṃ sadyaḥ pretya rājyaṃ prapadyate ॥29॥
slp1: goprayuktaM DanizWAsu yAnaM dattvA samAhitaH । vastraraSmiDaraM sadyaH pretya rAjyaM prapadyate ॥29॥

text: gandhāñśatabhiṣagyoge dattvā sāgurucandanān । prāpnotyapsarasāṃ lokānpretya gandhāṃśca śāśvatān ॥30॥
html:
gandhāñśatabhiṣagyoge dattvā sāgurucandanān ।
prāpnotyapsarasāṃ lokānpretya gandhāṃśca śāśvatān ॥30॥
slp1: ganDAYSataBizagyoge dattvA sAgurucandanAn । prApnotyapsarasAM lokAnpretya ganDAMSca SASvatAn ॥30॥

text: pūrvabhādrapadāyoge rājamāṣānpradāya tu । sarvabhakṣaphalopetaḥ sa vai pretya sukhī bhavet ॥31॥
html:
pūrvabhādrapadāyoge rājamāṣānpradāya tu ।
sarvabhakṣaphalopetaḥ sa vai pretya sukhī bhavet ॥31॥
slp1: pUrvaBAdrapadAyoge rAjamAzAnpradAya tu । sarvaBakzaPalopetaH sa vE pretya suKI Bavet ॥31॥

text: aurabhramuttarāyoge yastu māṃsaṃ prayacchati । sa pitṝnprīṇayati vai pretya cānantyamaśnute ॥32॥
html:
aurabhramuttarāyoge yastu māṃsaṃ prayacchati ।
sa pitṝnprīṇayati vai pretya cānantyamaśnute ॥32॥
slp1: OraBramuttarAyoge yastu mAMsaM prayacCati । sa pitFnprIRayati vE pretya cAnantyamaSnute ॥32॥

text: kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dhenuṃ revatyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati । sā pretya kāmānādāya dātāramupatiṣṭhati ॥33॥
html:
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dhenuṃ revatyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati ।
sā pretya kāmānādāya dātāramupatiṣṭhati ॥33॥
slp1: kAMsyopadohanAM DenuM revatyAM yaH prayacCati । sA pretya kAmAnAdAya dAtAramupatizWati ॥33॥

text: rathamaśvasamāyuktaṃ dattvāśvinyāṃ narottamaḥ । hastyaśvarathasampanne varcasvī jāyate kule ॥34॥
html:
rathamaśvasamāyuktaṃ dattvāśvinyāṃ narottamaḥ ।
hastyaśvarathasampanne varcasvī jāyate kule ॥34॥
slp1: raTamaSvasamAyuktaM dattvASvinyAM narottamaH । hastyaSvaraTasampanne varcasvI jAyate kule ॥34॥

text: bharaṇīṣu dvijātibhyastiladhenuṃ pradāya vai । gāḥ suprabhūtāḥ prāpnoti naraḥ pretya yaśastathā ॥35॥
html:
bharaṇīṣu dvijātibhyastiladhenuṃ pradāya vai ।
gāḥ suprabhūtāḥ prāpnoti naraḥ pretya yaśastathā ॥35॥
slp1: BaraRIzu dvijAtiByastilaDenuM pradAya vE । gAH supraBUtAH prApnoti naraH pretya yaSastaTA ॥35॥

text: ityeṣa lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ prokto nakṣatrayogataḥ । devakyā nāradeneha sā snuṣābhyo'bravīdidam] ॥36॥
html:
ityeṣa lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ prokto nakṣatrayogataḥ ।
devakyā nāradeneha sā snuṣābhyo'bravīdidam] ॥36॥
slp1: ityeza lakzaRoddeSaH prokto nakzatrayogataH । devakyA nAradeneha sA snuzAByo'bravIdidam] ॥36॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sarvānkāmānprayacchanti ye prayacchanti kāñcanam । ityevaṃ bhagavānatriḥ pitāmahasuto'bravīt ॥1॥
html:
sarvānkāmānprayacchanti ye prayacchanti kāñcanam ।
ityevaṃ bhagavānatriḥ pitāmahasuto'bravīt ॥1॥
slp1: sarvAnkAmAnprayacCanti ye prayacCanti kAYcanam । ityevaM BagavAnatriH pitAmahasuto'bravIt ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: pavitraṃ śucyathāyuṣyaṃ pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ ca tat । suvarṇaṃ manujendreṇa hariścandreṇa kīrtitam ॥2॥
html:
pavitraṃ śucyathāyuṣyaṃ pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ ca tat ।
suvarṇaṃ manujendreṇa hariścandreṇa kīrtitam ॥2॥
slp1: pavitraM SucyaTAyuzyaM pitFRAmakzayaM ca tat । suvarRaM manujendreRa hariScandreRa kIrtitam ॥2॥

text: pānīyadānaṃ paramaṃ dānānāṃ manurabravīt । tasmādvāpīśca kūpāṃśca taḍāgāni ca khānayet ॥3॥
html:
pānīyadānaṃ paramaṃ dānānāṃ manurabravīt ।
tasmādvāpīśca kūpāṃśca taḍāgāni ca khānayet ॥3॥
slp1: pAnIyadAnaM paramaM dAnAnAM manurabravIt । tasmAdvApISca kUpAMSca taqAgAni ca KAnayet ॥3॥

text: ardhaṃ pāpasya harati puruṣasyeha karmaṇaḥ । kūpaḥ pravṛttapānīyaḥ supravṛttaśca nityaśaḥ ॥4॥
html:
ardhaṃ pāpasya harati puruṣasyeha karmaṇaḥ ।
kūpaḥ pravṛttapānīyaḥ supravṛttaśca nityaśaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: arDaM pApasya harati puruzasyeha karmaRaH । kUpaH pravfttapAnIyaH supravfttaSca nityaSaH ॥4॥

text: sarvaṃ tārayate vaṃśaṃ yasya khāte jalāśaye । gāvaḥ pibanti viprāśca sādhavaśca narāḥ sadā ॥5॥
html:
sarvaṃ tārayate vaṃśaṃ yasya khāte jalāśaye ।
gāvaḥ pibanti viprāśca sādhavaśca narāḥ sadā ॥5॥
slp1: sarvaM tArayate vaMSaM yasya KAte jalASaye । gAvaH pibanti viprASca sADavaSca narAH sadA ॥5॥

text: nidāghakāle pānīyaṃ yasya tiṣṭhatyavāritam । sa durgaṃ viṣamaṃ kṛcchraṃ na kadācidavāpnute ॥6॥
html:
nidāghakāle pānīyaṃ yasya tiṣṭhatyavāritam ।
sa durgaṃ viṣamaṃ kṛcchraṃ na kadācidavāpnute ॥6॥
slp1: nidAGakAle pAnIyaM yasya tizWatyavAritam । sa durgaM vizamaM kfcCraM na kadAcidavApnute ॥6॥

text: bṛhaspaterbhagavataḥ pūṣṇaścaiva bhagasya ca । aśvinoścaiva vahneśca prītirbhavati sarpiṣā ॥7॥
html:
bṛhaspaterbhagavataḥ pūṣṇaścaiva bhagasya ca ।
aśvinoścaiva vahneśca prītirbhavati sarpiṣā ॥7॥
slp1: bfhaspaterBagavataH pUzRaScEva Bagasya ca । aSvinoScEva vahneSca prItirBavati sarpizA ॥7॥

text: paramaṃ bheṣajaṃ hyetadyajñānāmetaduttamam । rasānāmuttamaṃ caitatphalānāṃ caitaduttamam ॥8॥
html:
paramaṃ bheṣajaṃ hyetadyajñānāmetaduttamam ।
rasānāmuttamaṃ caitatphalānāṃ caitaduttamam ॥8॥
slp1: paramaM BezajaM hyetadyajYAnAmetaduttamam । rasAnAmuttamaM cEtatPalAnAM cEtaduttamam ॥8॥

text: phalakāmo yaśaskāmaḥ puṣṭikāmaśca nityadā । ghṛtaṃ dadyāddvijātibhyaḥ puruṣaḥ śucirātmavān ॥9॥
html:
phalakāmo yaśaskāmaḥ puṣṭikāmaśca nityadā ।
ghṛtaṃ dadyāddvijātibhyaḥ puruṣaḥ śucirātmavān ॥9॥
slp1: PalakAmo yaSaskAmaH puzwikAmaSca nityadA । GftaM dadyAddvijAtiByaH puruzaH SucirAtmavAn ॥9॥

text: ghṛtaṃ māse āśvayuji viprebhyo yaḥ prayacchati । tasmai prayacchato rūpaṃ prītau devāvihāśvinau ॥10॥
html:
ghṛtaṃ māse āśvayuji viprebhyo yaḥ prayacchati ।
tasmai prayacchato rūpaṃ prītau devāvihāśvinau ॥10॥
slp1: GftaM mAse ASvayuji vipreByo yaH prayacCati । tasmE prayacCato rUpaM prItO devAvihASvinO ॥10॥

text: pāyasaṃ sarpiṣā miśraṃ dvijebhyo yaḥ prayacchati । gṛhaṃ tasya na rakṣāṃsi dharṣayanti kadācana ॥11॥
html:
pāyasaṃ sarpiṣā miśraṃ dvijebhyo yaḥ prayacchati ।
gṛhaṃ tasya na rakṣāṃsi dharṣayanti kadācana ॥11॥
slp1: pAyasaM sarpizA miSraM dvijeByo yaH prayacCati । gfhaM tasya na rakzAMsi Darzayanti kadAcana ॥11॥

text: pipāsayā na mriyate sopacchandaśca dṛśyate । na prāpnuyācca vyasanaṃ karakānyaḥ prayacchati ॥12॥
html:
pipāsayā na mriyate sopacchandaśca dṛśyate ।
na prāpnuyācca vyasanaṃ karakānyaḥ prayacchati ॥12॥
slp1: pipAsayA na mriyate sopacCandaSca dfSyate । na prApnuyAcca vyasanaM karakAnyaH prayacCati ॥12॥

text: prayato brāhmaṇāgrebhyaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ । upasparśanaṣaḍbhāgaṃ labhate puruṣaḥ sadā ॥13॥
html:
prayato brāhmaṇāgrebhyaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ।
upasparśanaṣaḍbhāgaṃ labhate puruṣaḥ sadā ॥13॥
slp1: prayato brAhmaRAgreByaH SradDayA parayA yutaH । upasparSanazaqBAgaM laBate puruzaH sadA ॥13॥

text: yaḥ sādhanārthaṃ kāṣṭhāni brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati । pratāpārthaṃ ca rājendra vṛttavadbhyaḥ sadā naraḥ ॥14॥
html:
yaḥ sādhanārthaṃ kāṣṭhāni brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati ।
pratāpārthaṃ ca rājendra vṛttavadbhyaḥ sadā naraḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yaH sADanArTaM kAzWAni brAhmaReByaH prayacCati । pratApArTaM ca rAjendra vfttavadByaH sadA naraH ॥14॥

text: sidhyantyarthāḥ sadā tasya kāryāṇi vividhāni ca । uparyupari śatrūṇāṃ vapuṣā dīpyate ca saḥ ॥15॥
html:
sidhyantyarthāḥ sadā tasya kāryāṇi vividhāni ca ।
uparyupari śatrūṇāṃ vapuṣā dīpyate ca saḥ ॥15॥
slp1: siDyantyarTAH sadA tasya kAryARi viviDAni ca । uparyupari SatrURAM vapuzA dIpyate ca saH ॥15॥

text: bhagavāṃścāsya suprīto vahnirbhavati nityaśaḥ । na taṃ tyajante paśavaḥ saṅgrāme ca jayatyapi ॥16॥
html:
bhagavāṃścāsya suprīto vahnirbhavati nityaśaḥ ।
na taṃ tyajante paśavaḥ saṅgrāme ca jayatyapi ॥16॥
slp1: BagavAMScAsya suprIto vahnirBavati nityaSaH । na taM tyajante paSavaH saNgrAme ca jayatyapi ॥16॥

text: putrāñchriyaṃ ca labhate yaśchatraṃ samprayacchati । cakṣurvyādhiṃ na labhate yajñabhāgamathāśnute ॥17॥
html:
putrāñchriyaṃ ca labhate yaśchatraṃ samprayacchati ।
cakṣurvyādhiṃ na labhate yajñabhāgamathāśnute ॥17॥
slp1: putrAYCriyaM ca laBate yaSCatraM samprayacCati । cakzurvyADiM na laBate yajYaBAgamaTASnute ॥17॥

text: nidāghakāle varṣe vā yaśchatraṃ samprayacchati । nāsya kaścinmanodāhaḥ kadācidapi jāyate । kṛcchrātsa viṣamāccaiva vipra mokṣamavāpnute ॥18॥
html:
nidāghakāle varṣe vā yaśchatraṃ samprayacchati ।
nāsya kaścinmanodāhaḥ kadācidapi jāyate ।
kṛcchrātsa viṣamāccaiva vipra mokṣamavāpnute ॥18॥
slp1: nidAGakAle varze vA yaSCatraM samprayacCati । nAsya kaScinmanodAhaH kadAcidapi jAyate । kfcCrAtsa vizamAccEva vipra mokzamavApnute ॥18॥

text: pradānaṃ sarvadānānāṃ śakaṭasya viśiṣyate । evamāha mahābhāgaḥ śāṇḍilyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ] ॥19॥
html:
pradānaṃ sarvadānānāṃ śakaṭasya viśiṣyate ।
evamāha mahābhāgaḥ śāṇḍilyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ] ॥19॥
slp1: pradAnaM sarvadAnAnAM Sakawasya viSizyate । evamAha mahABAgaH SARqilyo BagavAnfziH] ॥19॥

text: dahyamānāya viprāya yaḥ prayacchatyupānahau । yatphalaṃ tasya bhavati tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
dahyamānāya viprāya yaḥ prayacchatyupānahau ।
yatphalaṃ tasya bhavati tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: dahyamAnAya viprAya yaH prayacCatyupAnahO । yatPalaM tasya Bavati tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: upānahau prayacchedyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ । mardate kaṇṭakānsarvānviṣamānnistaratyapi । sa śatrūṇāmupari ca santiṣṭhati yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
upānahau prayacchedyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ ।
mardate kaṇṭakānsarvānviṣamānnistaratyapi ।
sa śatrūṇāmupari ca santiṣṭhati yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: upAnahO prayacCedyo brAhmaReByaH samAhitaH । mardate kaRwakAnsarvAnvizamAnnistaratyapi । sa SatrURAmupari ca santizWati yuDizWira ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yānaṃ cāśvatarīyuktaṃ tasya śubhraṃ viśāṃ pate । upatiṣṭhati kaunteya rūpyakāñcanabhūṣaṇam । śakaṭaṃ damyasaṃyuktaṃ dattaṃ bhavati caiva hi ॥3॥
html:
yānaṃ cāśvatarīyuktaṃ tasya śubhraṃ viśāṃ pate ।
upatiṣṭhati kaunteya rūpyakāñcanabhūṣaṇam ।
śakaṭaṃ damyasaṃyuktaṃ dattaṃ bhavati caiva hi ॥3॥
slp1: yAnaM cASvatarIyuktaM tasya SuBraM viSAM pate । upatizWati kOnteya rUpyakAYcanaBUzaRam । SakawaM damyasaMyuktaM dattaM Bavati cEva hi ॥3॥

text: yatphalaṃ tiladāne ca bhūmidāne ca kīrtitam । gopradāne'nnadāne ca bhūyastadbrūhi kaurava ॥4॥
html:
yatphalaṃ tiladāne ca bhūmidāne ca kīrtitam ।
gopradāne'nnadāne ca bhūyastadbrūhi kaurava ॥4॥
slp1: yatPalaM tiladAne ca BUmidAne ca kIrtitam । gopradAne'nnadAne ca BUyastadbrUhi kOrava ॥4॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śṛṇuṣva mama kaunteya tiladānasya yatphalam । niśamya ca yathānyāyaṃ prayaccha kurusattama ॥5॥
html:
śṛṇuṣva mama kaunteya tiladānasya yatphalam ।
niśamya ca yathānyāyaṃ prayaccha kurusattama ॥5॥
slp1: SfRuzva mama kOnteya tiladAnasya yatPalam । niSamya ca yaTAnyAyaM prayacCa kurusattama ॥5॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: pitṝṇāṃ prathamaṃ bhojyaṃ tilāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā । tiladānena vai tasmātpitṛpakṣaḥ pramodate ॥6॥
html:
pitṝṇāṃ prathamaṃ bhojyaṃ tilāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā ।
tiladānena vai tasmātpitṛpakṣaḥ pramodate ॥6॥
slp1: pitFRAM praTamaM BojyaM tilAH sfzwAH svayamBuvA । tiladAnena vE tasmAtpitfpakzaH pramodate ॥6॥

text: māghamāse tilānyastu brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati । sarvasattvasamākīrṇaṃ narakaṃ sa na paśyati ॥7॥
html:
māghamāse tilānyastu brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati ।
sarvasattvasamākīrṇaṃ narakaṃ sa na paśyati ॥7॥
slp1: mAGamAse tilAnyastu brAhmaReByaH prayacCati । sarvasattvasamAkIrRaM narakaM sa na paSyati ॥7॥

text: sarvakāmaiḥ sa yajate yastilairyajate pitṝn । na cākāmena dātavyaṃ tilaśrāddhaṃ kathañcana ॥8॥
html:
sarvakāmaiḥ sa yajate yastilairyajate pitṝn ।
na cākāmena dātavyaṃ tilaśrāddhaṃ kathañcana ॥8॥
slp1: sarvakAmEH sa yajate yastilEryajate pitFn । na cAkAmena dAtavyaM tilaSrAdDaM kaTaYcana ॥8॥

text: maharṣeḥ kaśyapasyaite gātrebhyaḥ prasṛtāstilāḥ । tato divyaṃ gatā bhāvaṃ pradāneṣu tilāḥ prabho ॥9॥
html:
maharṣeḥ kaśyapasyaite gātrebhyaḥ prasṛtāstilāḥ ।
tato divyaṃ gatā bhāvaṃ pradāneṣu tilāḥ prabho ॥9॥
slp1: maharzeH kaSyapasyEte gAtreByaH prasftAstilAH । tato divyaM gatA BAvaM pradAnezu tilAH praBo ॥9॥

text: pauṣṭikā rūpadāścaiva tathā pāpavināśanāḥ । tasmātsarvapradānebhyastiladānaṃ viśiṣyate ॥10॥
html:
pauṣṭikā rūpadāścaiva tathā pāpavināśanāḥ ।
tasmātsarvapradānebhyastiladānaṃ viśiṣyate ॥10॥
slp1: pOzwikA rUpadAScEva taTA pApavinASanAH । tasmAtsarvapradAneByastiladAnaM viSizyate ॥10॥

text: āpastambaśca medhāvī śaṅkhaśca likhitastathā । maharṣirgautamaścāpi tiladānairdivaṃ gatāḥ ॥11॥
html:
āpastambaśca medhāvī śaṅkhaśca likhitastathā ।
maharṣirgautamaścāpi tiladānairdivaṃ gatāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: ApastambaSca meDAvI SaNKaSca liKitastaTA । maharzirgOtamaScApi tiladAnErdivaM gatAH ॥11॥

text: tilahomaparā viprāḥ sarve saṃyatamaithunāḥ । samā gavyena haviṣā pravṛttiṣu ca saṃsthitāḥ ॥12॥
html:
tilahomaparā viprāḥ sarve saṃyatamaithunāḥ ।
samā gavyena haviṣā pravṛttiṣu ca saṃsthitāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tilahomaparA viprAH sarve saMyatamETunAH । samA gavyena havizA pravfttizu ca saMsTitAH ॥12॥

text: sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ tiladānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam । akṣayaṃ sarvadānānāṃ tiladānamihocyate ॥13॥
html:
sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ tiladānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam ।
akṣayaṃ sarvadānānāṃ tiladānamihocyate ॥13॥
slp1: sarvezAmeva dAnAnAM tiladAnaM paraM smftam । akzayaM sarvadAnAnAM tiladAnamihocyate ॥13॥

text: utpanne ca purā havye kuśikarṣiḥ parantapa । tilairagnitrayaṃ hutvā prāptavāngatimuttamām ॥14॥
html:
utpanne ca purā havye kuśikarṣiḥ parantapa ।
tilairagnitrayaṃ hutvā prāptavāngatimuttamām ॥14॥
slp1: utpanne ca purA havye kuSikarziH parantapa । tilEragnitrayaM hutvA prAptavAngatimuttamAm ॥14॥

text: iti proktaṃ kuruśreṣṭha tiladānamanuttamam । vidhānaṃ yena vidhinā tilānāmiha śasyate ॥15॥
html:
iti proktaṃ kuruśreṣṭha tiladānamanuttamam ।
vidhānaṃ yena vidhinā tilānāmiha śasyate ॥15॥
slp1: iti proktaM kuruSrezWa tiladAnamanuttamam । viDAnaM yena viDinA tilAnAmiha Sasyate ॥15॥

text: ata ūrdhvaṃ nibodhedaṃ devānāṃ yaṣṭumicchatām । samāgamaṃ mahārāja brahmaṇā vai svayambhuvā ॥16॥
html:
ata ūrdhvaṃ nibodhedaṃ devānāṃ yaṣṭumicchatām ।
samāgamaṃ mahārāja brahmaṇā vai svayambhuvā ॥16॥
slp1: ata UrDvaM niboDedaM devAnAM yazwumicCatAm । samAgamaM mahArAja brahmaRA vE svayamBuvA ॥16॥

text: devāḥ sametya brahmāṇaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ yiyakṣavaḥ । śubhaṃ deśamayācanta yajema iti pārthiva ॥17॥
html:
devāḥ sametya brahmāṇaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ yiyakṣavaḥ ।
śubhaṃ deśamayācanta yajema iti pārthiva ॥17॥
slp1: devAH sametya brahmARaM BUmiBAgaM yiyakzavaH । SuBaM deSamayAcanta yajema iti pArTiva ॥17॥

text: bhagavaṃstvaṃ prabhurbhūmeḥ sarvasya tridivasya ca । yajemahi mahābhāga yajñaṃ bhavadanujñayā । nānanujñātabhūmirhi yajñasya phalamaśnute ॥18॥
html:
bhagavaṃstvaṃ prabhurbhūmeḥ sarvasya tridivasya ca ।
yajemahi mahābhāga yajñaṃ bhavadanujñayā ।
nānanujñātabhūmirhi yajñasya phalamaśnute ॥18॥
slp1: BagavaMstvaM praBurBUmeH sarvasya tridivasya ca । yajemahi mahABAga yajYaM BavadanujYayA । nAnanujYAtaBUmirhi yajYasya PalamaSnute ॥18॥
author: devā ūcuḥ ।

text: tvaṃ hi sarvasya jagataḥ sthāvarasya carasya ca । prabhurbhavasi tasmāttvaṃ samanujñātumarhasi ॥19॥
html:
tvaṃ hi sarvasya jagataḥ sthāvarasya carasya ca ।
prabhurbhavasi tasmāttvaṃ samanujñātumarhasi ॥19॥
slp1: tvaM hi sarvasya jagataH sTAvarasya carasya ca । praBurBavasi tasmAttvaM samanujYAtumarhasi ॥19॥

text: dadāmi medinībhāgaṃ bhavadbhyo'haṃ surarṣabhāḥ । yasmindeśe kariṣyadhvaṃ yajñaṃ kāśyapanandanāḥ ॥20॥
html:
dadāmi medinībhāgaṃ bhavadbhyo'haṃ surarṣabhāḥ ।
yasmindeśe kariṣyadhvaṃ yajñaṃ kāśyapanandanāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: dadAmi medinIBAgaM BavadByo'haM surarzaBAH । yasmindeSe karizyaDvaM yajYaM kASyapanandanAH ॥20॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: bhagavankṛtakāmāḥ smo yakṣyāmastvāptadakṣiṇaiḥ । imaṃ tu deśaṃ munayaḥ paryupāsanta nityadā ॥21॥
html:
bhagavankṛtakāmāḥ smo yakṣyāmastvāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ।
imaṃ tu deśaṃ munayaḥ paryupāsanta nityadā ॥21॥
slp1: BagavankftakAmAH smo yakzyAmastvAptadakziREH । imaM tu deSaM munayaH paryupAsanta nityadA ॥21॥
author: devā ūcuḥ ।

text: tato'gastyaśca kaṇvaśca bhṛguratrirvṛṣākapiḥ । asito devalaścaiva devayajñamupāgaman ॥22॥
html:
tato'gastyaśca kaṇvaśca bhṛguratrirvṛṣākapiḥ ।
asito devalaścaiva devayajñamupāgaman ॥22॥
slp1: tato'gastyaSca kaRvaSca BfguratrirvfzAkapiH । asito devalaScEva devayajYamupAgaman ॥22॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato devā mahātmāna ījire yajñamacyuta । tathā samāpayāmāsuryathākālaṃ surarṣabhāḥ ॥23॥
html:
tato devā mahātmāna ījire yajñamacyuta ।
tathā samāpayāmāsuryathākālaṃ surarṣabhāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: tato devA mahAtmAna Ijire yajYamacyuta । taTA samApayAmAsuryaTAkAlaM surarzaBAH ॥23॥

text: ta iṣṭayajñāstridaśā himavatyacalottame । ṣaṣṭhamaṃśaṃ kratostasya bhūmidānaṃ pracakrire ॥24॥
html:
ta iṣṭayajñāstridaśā himavatyacalottame ।
ṣaṣṭhamaṃśaṃ kratostasya bhūmidānaṃ pracakrire ॥24॥
