slp1: ta izwayajYAstridaSA himavatyacalottame । zazWamaMSaM kratostasya BUmidAnaM pracakrire ॥24॥

text: prādeśamātraṃ bhūmestu yo dadyādanupaskṛtam । na sīdati sa kṛcchreṣu na ca durgāṇyavāpnute ॥25॥
html:
prādeśamātraṃ bhūmestu yo dadyādanupaskṛtam ।
na sīdati sa kṛcchreṣu na ca durgāṇyavāpnute ॥25॥
slp1: prAdeSamAtraM BUmestu yo dadyAdanupaskftam । na sIdati sa kfcCrezu na ca durgARyavApnute ॥25॥

text: śītavātātapasahāṃ gṛhabhūmiṃ susaṃskṛtām । pradāya suralokasthaḥ puṇyānte'pi na cālyate ॥26॥
html:
śītavātātapasahāṃ gṛhabhūmiṃ susaṃskṛtām ।
pradāya suralokasthaḥ puṇyānte'pi na cālyate ॥26॥
slp1: SItavAtAtapasahAM gfhaBUmiM susaMskftAm । pradAya suralokasTaH puRyAnte'pi na cAlyate ॥26॥

text: mudito vasate prājñaḥ śakreṇa saha pārthiva । pratiśrayapradātā ca so'pi svarge mahīyate ॥27॥
html:
mudito vasate prājñaḥ śakreṇa saha pārthiva ।
pratiśrayapradātā ca so'pi svarge mahīyate ॥27॥
slp1: mudito vasate prAjYaH SakreRa saha pArTiva । pratiSrayapradAtA ca so'pi svarge mahIyate ॥27॥

text: adhyāpakakule jātaḥ śrotriyo niyatendriyaḥ । gṛhe yasya vasettuṣṭaḥ pradhānaṃ lokamaśnute ॥28॥
html:
adhyāpakakule jātaḥ śrotriyo niyatendriyaḥ ।
gṛhe yasya vasettuṣṭaḥ pradhānaṃ lokamaśnute ॥28॥
slp1: aDyApakakule jAtaH Srotriyo niyatendriyaH । gfhe yasya vasettuzwaH praDAnaM lokamaSnute ॥28॥

text: tathā gavārthe śaraṇaṃ śītavarṣasahaṃ mahat । āsaptamaṃ tārayati kulaṃ bharatasattama ॥29॥
html:
tathā gavārthe śaraṇaṃ śītavarṣasahaṃ mahat ।
āsaptamaṃ tārayati kulaṃ bharatasattama ॥29॥
slp1: taTA gavArTe SaraRaM SItavarzasahaM mahat । AsaptamaM tArayati kulaM Baratasattama ॥29॥

text: kṣetrabhūmiṃ dadalloke putra śriyamavāpnuyāt । ratnabhūmiṃ pradattvā tu kulavaṃśaṃ vivardhayet ॥30॥
html:
kṣetrabhūmiṃ dadalloke putra śriyamavāpnuyāt ।
ratnabhūmiṃ pradattvā tu kulavaṃśaṃ vivardhayet ॥30॥
slp1: kzetraBUmiM dadalloke putra SriyamavApnuyAt । ratnaBUmiM pradattvA tu kulavaMSaM vivarDayet ॥30॥

text: na coṣarāṃ na nirdagdhāṃ mahīṃ dadyātkathañcana । na śmaśānaparītāṃ ca na ca pāpaniṣevitām ॥31॥
html:
na coṣarāṃ na nirdagdhāṃ mahīṃ dadyātkathañcana ।
na śmaśānaparītāṃ ca na ca pāpaniṣevitām ॥31॥
slp1: na cozarAM na nirdagDAM mahIM dadyAtkaTaYcana । na SmaSAnaparItAM ca na ca pApanizevitAm ॥31॥

text: pārakye bhūmideśe tu pitṝṇāṃ nirvapettu yaḥ । tadbhūmisvāmipitṛbhiḥ śrāddhakarma vihanyate ॥32॥
html:
pārakye bhūmideśe tu pitṝṇāṃ nirvapettu yaḥ ।
tadbhūmisvāmipitṛbhiḥ śrāddhakarma vihanyate ॥32॥
slp1: pArakye BUmideSe tu pitFRAM nirvapettu yaH । tadBUmisvAmipitfBiH SrAdDakarma vihanyate ॥32॥

text: tasmātkrītvā mahīṃ dadyātsvalpāmapi vicakṣaṇaḥ । piṇḍaḥ pitṛbhyo datto vai tasyāṃ bhavati śāśvataḥ ॥33॥
html:
tasmātkrītvā mahīṃ dadyātsvalpāmapi vicakṣaṇaḥ ।
piṇḍaḥ pitṛbhyo datto vai tasyāṃ bhavati śāśvataḥ ॥33॥
slp1: tasmAtkrItvA mahIM dadyAtsvalpAmapi vicakzaRaH । piRqaH pitfByo datto vE tasyAM Bavati SASvataH ॥33॥

text: aṭavīparvatāścaiva nadītīrthāni yāni ca । sarvāṇyasvāmikānyāhurna hi tatra parigrahaḥ ॥34॥
html:
aṭavīparvatāścaiva nadītīrthāni yāni ca ।
sarvāṇyasvāmikānyāhurna hi tatra parigrahaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: awavIparvatAScEva nadItIrTAni yAni ca । sarvARyasvAmikAnyAhurna hi tatra parigrahaH ॥34॥

text: ityetadbhūmidānasya phalamuktaṃ viśāṃ pate । ataḥ paraṃ tu godānaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi te'nagha ॥35॥
html:
ityetadbhūmidānasya phalamuktaṃ viśāṃ pate ।
ataḥ paraṃ tu godānaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi te'nagha ॥35॥
slp1: ityetadBUmidAnasya PalamuktaM viSAM pate । ataH paraM tu godAnaM kIrtayizyAmi te'naGa ॥35॥

text: gāvo'dhikāstapasvibhyo yasmātsarvebhya eva ca । tasmānmaheśvaro devastapastābhiḥ samāsthitaḥ ॥36॥
html:
gāvo'dhikāstapasvibhyo yasmātsarvebhya eva ca ।
tasmānmaheśvaro devastapastābhiḥ samāsthitaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: gAvo'DikAstapasviByo yasmAtsarveBya eva ca । tasmAnmaheSvaro devastapastABiH samAsTitaH ॥36॥

text: brahmaloke vasantyetāḥ somena saha bhārata । āsāṃ brahmarṣayaḥ siddhāḥ prārthayanti parāṃ gatim ॥37॥
html:
brahmaloke vasantyetāḥ somena saha bhārata ।
āsāṃ brahmarṣayaḥ siddhāḥ prārthayanti parāṃ gatim ॥37॥
slp1: brahmaloke vasantyetAH somena saha BArata । AsAM brahmarzayaH sidDAH prArTayanti parAM gatim ॥37॥

text: payasā haviṣā dadhnā śakṛtāpyatha carmaṇā । asthibhiścopakurvanti śṛṅgairvālaiśca bhārata ॥38॥
html:
payasā haviṣā dadhnā śakṛtāpyatha carmaṇā ।
asthibhiścopakurvanti śṛṅgairvālaiśca bhārata ॥38॥
slp1: payasA havizA daDnA SakftApyaTa carmaRA । asTiBiScopakurvanti SfNgErvAlESca BArata ॥38॥

text: nāsāṃ śītātapau syātāṃ sadaitāḥ karma kurvate । na varṣaṃ viṣamaṃ vāpi duḥkhamāsāṃ bhavatyuta ॥39॥
html:
nāsāṃ śītātapau syātāṃ sadaitāḥ karma kurvate ।
na varṣaṃ viṣamaṃ vāpi duḥkhamāsāṃ bhavatyuta ॥39॥
slp1: nAsAM SItAtapO syAtAM sadEtAH karma kurvate । na varzaM vizamaM vApi duHKamAsAM Bavatyuta ॥39॥

text: brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitā yānti tasmātparataraṃ padam । ekaṃ gobrāhmaṇaṃ tasmātpravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥40॥
html:
brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitā yānti tasmātparataraṃ padam ।
ekaṃ gobrāhmaṇaṃ tasmātpravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: brAhmaREH sahitA yAnti tasmAtparataraM padam । ekaM gobrAhmaRaM tasmAtpravadanti manIziRaH ॥40॥

text: rantidevasya yajñe tāḥ paśutvenopakalpitāḥ । tataścarmaṇvatī rājangocarmabhyaḥ pravartitā ॥41॥
html:
rantidevasya yajñe tāḥ paśutvenopakalpitāḥ ।
tataścarmaṇvatī rājangocarmabhyaḥ pravartitā ॥41॥
slp1: rantidevasya yajYe tAH paSutvenopakalpitAH । tataScarmaRvatI rAjangocarmaByaH pravartitA ॥41॥

text: paśutvācca vinirmuktāḥ pradānāyopakalpitāḥ । tā imā vipramukhyebhyo yo dadāti mahīpate । nistaredāpadaṃ kṛcchrāṃ viṣamastho'pi pārthiva ॥42॥
html:
paśutvācca vinirmuktāḥ pradānāyopakalpitāḥ ।
tā imā vipramukhyebhyo yo dadāti mahīpate ।
nistaredāpadaṃ kṛcchrāṃ viṣamastho'pi pārthiva ॥42॥
slp1: paSutvAcca vinirmuktAH pradAnAyopakalpitAH । tA imA vipramuKyeByo yo dadAti mahIpate । nistaredApadaM kfcCrAM vizamasTo'pi pArTiva ॥42॥

text: gavāṃ sahasradaḥ pretya narakaṃ na prapaśyati । sarvatra vijayaṃ cāpi labhate manujādhipa ॥43॥
html:
gavāṃ sahasradaḥ pretya narakaṃ na prapaśyati ।
sarvatra vijayaṃ cāpi labhate manujādhipa ॥43॥
slp1: gavAM sahasradaH pretya narakaM na prapaSyati । sarvatra vijayaM cApi laBate manujADipa ॥43॥

text: amṛtaṃ vai gavāṃ kṣīramityāha tridaśādhipaḥ । tasmāddadāti yo dhenumamṛtaṃ sa prayacchati ॥44॥
html:
amṛtaṃ vai gavāṃ kṣīramityāha tridaśādhipaḥ ।
tasmāddadāti yo dhenumamṛtaṃ sa prayacchati ॥44॥
slp1: amftaM vE gavAM kzIramityAha tridaSADipaH । tasmAddadAti yo DenumamftaM sa prayacCati ॥44॥

text: agnīnāmavyayaṃ hyetaddhaumyaṃ vedavido viduḥ । tasmāddadāti yo dhenuṃ sa haumyaṃ samprayacchati ॥45॥
html:
agnīnāmavyayaṃ hyetaddhaumyaṃ vedavido viduḥ ।
tasmāddadāti yo dhenuṃ sa haumyaṃ samprayacchati ॥45॥
slp1: agnInAmavyayaM hyetadDOmyaM vedavido viduH । tasmAddadAti yo DenuM sa hOmyaM samprayacCati ॥45॥

text: svargo vai mūrtimāneṣa vṛṣabhaṃ yo gavāṃ patim । vipre guṇayute dadyātsa vai svarge mahīyate ॥46॥
html:
svargo vai mūrtimāneṣa vṛṣabhaṃ yo gavāṃ patim ।
vipre guṇayute dadyātsa vai svarge mahīyate ॥46॥
slp1: svargo vE mUrtimAneza vfzaBaM yo gavAM patim । vipre guRayute dadyAtsa vE svarge mahIyate ॥46॥

text: prāṇā vai prāṇināmete procyante bharatarṣabha । tasmāddadāti yo dhenuṃ prāṇānvai sa prayacchati ॥47॥
html:
prāṇā vai prāṇināmete procyante bharatarṣabha ।
tasmāddadāti yo dhenuṃ prāṇānvai sa prayacchati ॥47॥
slp1: prARA vE prARinAmete procyante BaratarzaBa । tasmAddadAti yo DenuM prARAnvE sa prayacCati ॥47॥

text: gāvaḥ śaraṇyā bhūtānāmiti vedavido viduḥ । tasmāddadāti yo dhenuṃ śaraṇaṃ samprayacchati ॥48॥
html:
gāvaḥ śaraṇyā bhūtānāmiti vedavido viduḥ ।
tasmāddadāti yo dhenuṃ śaraṇaṃ samprayacchati ॥48॥
slp1: gAvaH SaraRyA BUtAnAmiti vedavido viduH । tasmAddadAti yo DenuM SaraRaM samprayacCati ॥48॥

text: na vadhārthaṃ pradātavyā na kīnāśe na nāstike । gojīvine na dātavyā tathā gauḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥49॥
html:
na vadhārthaṃ pradātavyā na kīnāśe na nāstike ।
gojīvine na dātavyā tathā gauḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥49॥
slp1: na vaDArTaM pradAtavyA na kInASe na nAstike । gojIvine na dAtavyA taTA gOH puruzarzaBa ॥49॥

text: dadāti tādṛśānāṃ vai naro gāḥ pāpakarmaṇām । akṣayaṃ narakaṃ yātītyevamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥50॥
html:
dadāti tādṛśānāṃ vai naro gāḥ pāpakarmaṇām ।
akṣayaṃ narakaṃ yātītyevamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: dadAti tAdfSAnAM vE naro gAH pApakarmaRAm । akzayaM narakaM yAtItyevamAhurmanIziRaH ॥50॥

text: na kṛśāṃ pāpavatsāṃ vā vandhyāṃ rogānvitāṃ tathā । na vyaṅgāṃ na pariśrāntāṃ dadyādgāṃ brāhmaṇāya vai ॥51॥
html:
na kṛśāṃ pāpavatsāṃ vā vandhyāṃ rogānvitāṃ tathā ।
na vyaṅgāṃ na pariśrāntāṃ dadyādgāṃ brāhmaṇāya vai ॥51॥
slp1: na kfSAM pApavatsAM vA vanDyAM rogAnvitAM taTA । na vyaNgAM na pariSrAntAM dadyAdgAM brAhmaRAya vE ॥51॥

text: daśagosahasradaḥ samyakśakreṇa saha modate । akṣayāṁllabhate lokānnaraḥ śatasahasradaḥ ॥52॥
html:
daśagosahasradaḥ samyakśakreṇa saha modate ।
akṣayāṁllabhate lokānnaraḥ śatasahasradaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: daSagosahasradaH samyakSakreRa saha modate । akzayAṁllaBate lokAnnaraH SatasahasradaH ॥52॥

text: ityetadgopradānaṃ ca tiladānaṃ ca kīrtitam । tathā bhūmipradānaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvānne ca bhārata ॥53॥
html:
ityetadgopradānaṃ ca tiladānaṃ ca kīrtitam ।
tathā bhūmipradānaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvānne ca bhārata ॥53॥
slp1: ityetadgopradAnaM ca tiladAnaM ca kIrtitam । taTA BUmipradAnaM ca SfRuzvAnne ca BArata ॥53॥

text: annadānaṃ pradhānaṃ hi kaunteya paricakṣate । annasya hi pradānena rantidevo divaṃ gataḥ ॥54॥
html:
annadānaṃ pradhānaṃ hi kaunteya paricakṣate ।
annasya hi pradānena rantidevo divaṃ gataḥ ॥54॥
slp1: annadAnaM praDAnaM hi kOnteya paricakzate । annasya hi pradAnena rantidevo divaM gataH ॥54॥

text: śrāntāya kṣudhitāyānnaṃ yaḥ prayacchati bhūmipa । svāyambhuvaṃ mahābhāgaṃ sa paśyati narādhipa ॥55॥
html:
śrāntāya kṣudhitāyānnaṃ yaḥ prayacchati bhūmipa ।
svāyambhuvaṃ mahābhāgaṃ sa paśyati narādhipa ॥55॥
slp1: SrAntAya kzuDitAyAnnaM yaH prayacCati BUmipa । svAyamBuvaM mahABAgaM sa paSyati narADipa ॥55॥

text: na hiraṇyairna vāsobhirnāśvadānena bhārata । prāpnuvanti narāḥ śreyo yathehānnapradāḥ prabho ॥56॥
html:
na hiraṇyairna vāsobhirnāśvadānena bhārata ।
prāpnuvanti narāḥ śreyo yathehānnapradāḥ prabho ॥56॥
slp1: na hiraRyErna vAsoBirnASvadAnena BArata । prApnuvanti narAH Sreyo yaTehAnnapradAH praBo ॥56॥

text: annaṃ vai paramaṃ dravyamannaṃ śrīśca parā matā । annātprāṇaḥ prabhavati tejo vīryaṃ balaṃ tathā ॥57॥
html:
annaṃ vai paramaṃ dravyamannaṃ śrīśca parā matā ।
annātprāṇaḥ prabhavati tejo vīryaṃ balaṃ tathā ॥57॥
slp1: annaM vE paramaM dravyamannaM SrISca parA matA । annAtprARaH praBavati tejo vIryaM balaM taTA ॥57॥

text: sadbhyo dadāti yaścānnaṃ sadaikāgramanā naraḥ । na sa durgāṇyavāpnotītyevamāha parāśaraḥ ॥58॥
html:
sadbhyo dadāti yaścānnaṃ sadaikāgramanā naraḥ ।
na sa durgāṇyavāpnotītyevamāha parāśaraḥ ॥58॥
slp1: sadByo dadAti yaScAnnaM sadEkAgramanA naraH । na sa durgARyavApnotItyevamAha parASaraH ॥58॥

text: arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ devebhyo'nnaṃ nivedayet । yadanno hi naro rājaṃstadannāstasya devatāḥ ॥59॥
html:
arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ devebhyo'nnaṃ nivedayet ।
yadanno hi naro rājaṃstadannāstasya devatāḥ ॥59॥
slp1: arcayitvA yaTAnyAyaM deveByo'nnaM nivedayet । yadanno hi naro rAjaMstadannAstasya devatAH ॥59॥

text: kaumudyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu yo'nnadānaṃ karotyuta । sa santarati durgāṇi pretya cānantyamaśnute ॥60॥
html:
kaumudyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu yo'nnadānaṃ karotyuta ।
sa santarati durgāṇi pretya cānantyamaśnute ॥60॥
slp1: kOmudyAM Suklapakze tu yo'nnadAnaM karotyuta । sa santarati durgARi pretya cAnantyamaSnute ॥60॥

text: abhuktvātithaye cānnaṃ prayacchedyaḥ samāhitaḥ । sa vai brahmavidāṃ lokānprāpnuyādbharatarṣabha ॥61॥
html:
abhuktvātithaye cānnaṃ prayacchedyaḥ samāhitaḥ ।
sa vai brahmavidāṃ lokānprāpnuyādbharatarṣabha ॥61॥
slp1: aBuktvAtiTaye cAnnaM prayacCedyaH samAhitaH । sa vE brahmavidAM lokAnprApnuyAdBaratarzaBa ॥61॥

text: sukṛcchrāmāpadaṃ prāptaścānnadaḥ puruṣastaret । pāpaṃ tarati caiveha duṣkṛtaṃ cāpakarṣati ॥62॥
html:
sukṛcchrāmāpadaṃ prāptaścānnadaḥ puruṣastaret ।
pāpaṃ tarati caiveha duṣkṛtaṃ cāpakarṣati ॥62॥
slp1: sukfcCrAmApadaM prAptaScAnnadaH puruzastaret । pApaM tarati cEveha duzkftaM cApakarzati ॥62॥

text: ityetadannadānasya tiladānasya caiva ha । bhūmidānasya ca phalaṃ godānasya ca kīrtitam] ॥63॥
html:
ityetadannadānasya tiladānasya caiva ha ।
bhūmidānasya ca phalaṃ godānasya ca kīrtitam] ॥63॥
slp1: ityetadannadAnasya tiladAnasya cEva ha । BUmidAnasya ca PalaM godAnasya ca kIrtitam] ॥63॥

text: śrutaṃ dānaphalaṃ tāta yattvayā parikīrtitam । annaṃ tu te viśeṣeṇa praśastamiha bhārata ॥1॥
html:
śrutaṃ dānaphalaṃ tāta yattvayā parikīrtitam ।
annaṃ tu te viśeṣeṇa praśastamiha bhārata ॥1॥
slp1: SrutaM dAnaPalaM tAta yattvayA parikIrtitam । annaM tu te viSezeRa praSastamiha BArata ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: pānīyadānaṃ paramaṃ kathaṃ ceha mahāphalam । ityetacchrotumicchāmi vistareṇa pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
pānīyadānaṃ paramaṃ kathaṃ ceha mahāphalam ।
ityetacchrotumicchāmi vistareṇa pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: pAnIyadAnaM paramaM kaTaM ceha mahAPalam । ityetacCrotumicCAmi vistareRa pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: hanta te vartayiṣyāmi yathāvadbharatarṣabha । gadatastanmamādyeha śṛṇu satyaparākrama । pānīyadānātprabhṛti sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi te'nagha ॥3॥
html:
hanta te vartayiṣyāmi yathāvadbharatarṣabha ।
gadatastanmamādyeha śṛṇu satyaparākrama ।
pānīyadānātprabhṛti sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi te'nagha ॥3॥
slp1: hanta te vartayizyAmi yaTAvadBaratarzaBa । gadatastanmamAdyeha SfRu satyaparAkrama । pAnIyadAnAtpraBfti sarvaM vakzyAmi te'naGa ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yadannaṃ yacca pānīyaṃ sampradāyāśnute naraḥ । na tasmātparamaṃ dānaṃ kiñcidastīti me matiḥ ॥4॥
html:
yadannaṃ yacca pānīyaṃ sampradāyāśnute naraḥ ।
na tasmātparamaṃ dānaṃ kiñcidastīti me matiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: yadannaM yacca pAnIyaM sampradAyASnute naraH । na tasmAtparamaM dAnaM kiYcidastIti me matiH ॥4॥

text: annātprāṇabhṛtastāta pravartante hi sarvaśaḥ । tasmādannaṃ paraṃ loke sarvadāneṣu kathyate ॥5॥
html:
annātprāṇabhṛtastāta pravartante hi sarvaśaḥ ।
tasmādannaṃ paraṃ loke sarvadāneṣu kathyate ॥5॥
slp1: annAtprARaBftastAta pravartante hi sarvaSaH । tasmAdannaM paraM loke sarvadAnezu kaTyate ॥5॥

text: annādbalaṃ ca tejaśca prāṇināṃ vardhate sadā । annadānamatastasmācchreṣṭhamāha prajāpatiḥ ॥6॥
html:
annādbalaṃ ca tejaśca prāṇināṃ vardhate sadā ।
annadānamatastasmācchreṣṭhamāha prajāpatiḥ ॥6॥
slp1: annAdbalaM ca tejaSca prARinAM varDate sadA । annadAnamatastasmAcCrezWamAha prajApatiH ॥6॥

text: sāvitryā hyapi kaunteya śrutaṃ te vacanaṃ śubham । yataścaitadyathā caitaddevasatre mahāmate ॥7॥
html:
sāvitryā hyapi kaunteya śrutaṃ te vacanaṃ śubham ।
yataścaitadyathā caitaddevasatre mahāmate ॥7॥
slp1: sAvitryA hyapi kOnteya SrutaM te vacanaM SuBam । yataScEtadyaTA cEtaddevasatre mahAmate ॥7॥

text: anne datte nareṇeha prāṇā dattā bhavantyuta । prāṇadānāddhi paramaṃ na dānamiha vidyate ॥8॥
html:
anne datte nareṇeha prāṇā dattā bhavantyuta ।
prāṇadānāddhi paramaṃ na dānamiha vidyate ॥8॥
slp1: anne datte nareReha prARA dattA Bavantyuta । prARadAnAdDi paramaM na dAnamiha vidyate ॥8॥

text: śrutaṃ hi te mahābāho lomaśasyāpi tadvacaḥ । prāṇāndattvā kapotāya yatprāptaṃ śibinā purā ॥9॥
html:
śrutaṃ hi te mahābāho lomaśasyāpi tadvacaḥ ।
prāṇāndattvā kapotāya yatprāptaṃ śibinā purā ॥9॥
slp1: SrutaM hi te mahAbAho lomaSasyApi tadvacaH । prARAndattvA kapotAya yatprAptaM SibinA purA ॥9॥

text: tāṃ gatiṃ labhate dattvā dvijasyānnaṃ viśāṃ pate । gatiṃ viśiṣṭāṃ gacchanti prāṇadā iti naḥ śrutam ॥10॥
html:
tāṃ gatiṃ labhate dattvā dvijasyānnaṃ viśāṃ pate ।
gatiṃ viśiṣṭāṃ gacchanti prāṇadā iti naḥ śrutam ॥10॥
slp1: tAM gatiM laBate dattvA dvijasyAnnaM viSAM pate । gatiM viSizwAM gacCanti prARadA iti naH Srutam ॥10॥

text: annaṃ cāpi prabhavati pānīyātkurusattama । nīrajātena hi vinā na kiñcitsampravartate ॥11॥
html:
annaṃ cāpi prabhavati pānīyātkurusattama ।
nīrajātena hi vinā na kiñcitsampravartate ॥11॥
slp1: annaM cApi praBavati pAnIyAtkurusattama । nIrajAtena hi vinA na kiYcitsampravartate ॥11॥

text: nīrajātaśca bhagavānsomo grahagaṇeśvaraḥ । amṛtaṃ ca sudhā caiva svāhā caiva vaṣaṭtathā ॥12॥
html:
nīrajātaśca bhagavānsomo grahagaṇeśvaraḥ ।
amṛtaṃ ca sudhā caiva svāhā caiva vaṣaṭtathā ॥12॥
slp1: nIrajAtaSca BagavAnsomo grahagaReSvaraH । amftaM ca suDA cEva svAhA cEva vazawtaTA ॥12॥

text: annauṣadhyo mahārāja vīrudhaśca jalodbhavāḥ । yataḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ prāṇāḥ sambhavanti viśāṃ pate ॥13॥
html:
annauṣadhyo mahārāja vīrudhaśca jalodbhavāḥ ।
yataḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ prāṇāḥ sambhavanti viśāṃ pate ॥13॥
slp1: annOzaDyo mahArAja vIruDaSca jalodBavAH । yataH prARaBftAM prARAH samBavanti viSAM pate ॥13॥

text: devānāmamṛtaṃ cānnaṃ nāgānāṃ ca sudhā tathā । pitṝṇāṃ ca svadhā proktā paśūnāṃ cāpi vīrudhaḥ ॥14॥
html:
devānāmamṛtaṃ cānnaṃ nāgānāṃ ca sudhā tathā ।
pitṝṇāṃ ca svadhā proktā paśūnāṃ cāpi vīrudhaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: devAnAmamftaM cAnnaM nAgAnAM ca suDA taTA । pitFRAM ca svaDA proktA paSUnAM cApi vIruDaH ॥14॥

text: annameva manuṣyāṇāṃ prāṇānāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । tacca sarvaṃ naravyāghra pānīyātsampravartate ॥15॥
html:
annameva manuṣyāṇāṃ prāṇānāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।
tacca sarvaṃ naravyāghra pānīyātsampravartate ॥15॥
slp1: annameva manuzyARAM prARAnAhurmanIziRaH । tacca sarvaM naravyAGra pAnIyAtsampravartate ॥15॥

text: tasmātpānīyadānādvai na paraṃ vidyate kvacit । tacca dadyānnaro nityaṃ ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ॥16॥
html:
tasmātpānīyadānādvai na paraṃ vidyate kvacit ।
tacca dadyānnaro nityaṃ ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: tasmAtpAnIyadAnAdvE na paraM vidyate kvacit । tacca dadyAnnaro nityaM ya icCedBUtimAtmanaH ॥16॥

text: dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ jaladānaṃ viśāṃ pate । śatrūṃścāpyadhi kaunteya sadā tiṣṭhati toyadaḥ ॥17॥
html:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ jaladānaṃ viśāṃ pate ।
śatrūṃścāpyadhi kaunteya sadā tiṣṭhati toyadaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: DanyaM yaSasyamAyuzyaM jaladAnaM viSAM pate । SatrUMScApyaDi kOnteya sadA tizWati toyadaH ॥17॥

text: sarvakāmānavāpnoti kīrtiṃ caiveha śāśvatīm । pretya cānantyamāpnoti pāpebhyaśca pramucyate ॥18॥
html:
sarvakāmānavāpnoti kīrtiṃ caiveha śāśvatīm ।
pretya cānantyamāpnoti pāpebhyaśca pramucyate ॥18॥
slp1: sarvakAmAnavApnoti kIrtiM cEveha SASvatIm । pretya cAnantyamApnoti pApeByaSca pramucyate ॥18॥

text: toyado manujavyāghra svargaṃ gatvā mahādyute । akṣayānsamavāpnoti lokānityabravīnmanuḥ] ॥19॥
html:
toyado manujavyāghra svargaṃ gatvā mahādyute ।
akṣayānsamavāpnoti lokānityabravīnmanuḥ] ॥19॥
slp1: toyado manujavyAGra svargaM gatvA mahAdyute । akzayAnsamavApnoti lokAnityabravInmanuH] ॥19॥

text: tilānāṃ kīdṛśaṃ dānamatha dīpasya caiva ha । annānāṃ vāsasāṃ caiva bhūya eva bravīhi me ॥1॥
html:
tilānāṃ kīdṛśaṃ dānamatha dīpasya caiva ha ।
annānāṃ vāsasāṃ caiva bhūya eva bravīhi me ॥1॥
slp1: tilAnAM kIdfSaM dAnamaTa dIpasya cEva ha । annAnAM vAsasAM cEva BUya eva bravIhi me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । brāhmaṇasya ca saṃvādaṃ yamasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
brāhmaṇasya ca saṃvādaṃ yamasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । brAhmaRasya ca saMvAdaM yamasya ca yuDizWira ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: madhyadeśe mahāngrāmo brāhmaṇānāṃ babhūva ha । gaṅgāyamunayormadhye yāmunasya gireradhaḥ ॥3॥
html:
madhyadeśe mahāngrāmo brāhmaṇānāṃ babhūva ha ।
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye yāmunasya gireradhaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: maDyadeSe mahAngrAmo brAhmaRAnAM baBUva ha । gaNgAyamunayormaDye yAmunasya gireraDaH ॥3॥

text: parṇaśāleti vikhyāto ramaṇīyo narādhipa । vidvāṃsastatra bhūyiṣṭhā brāhmaṇāścāvasaṃstadā ॥4॥
html:
parṇaśāleti vikhyāto ramaṇīyo narādhipa ।
vidvāṃsastatra bhūyiṣṭhā brāhmaṇāścāvasaṃstadā ॥4॥
slp1: parRaSAleti viKyAto ramaRIyo narADipa । vidvAMsastatra BUyizWA brAhmaRAScAvasaMstadA ॥4॥

text: atha prāha yamaḥ kañcitpuruṣaṃ kṛṣṇavāsasam । raktākṣamūrdhvaromāṇaṃ kākajaṅghākṣināsikam ॥5॥
html:
atha prāha yamaḥ kañcitpuruṣaṃ kṛṣṇavāsasam ।
raktākṣamūrdhvaromāṇaṃ kākajaṅghākṣināsikam ॥5॥
slp1: aTa prAha yamaH kaYcitpuruzaM kfzRavAsasam । raktAkzamUrDvaromARaM kAkajaNGAkzinAsikam ॥5॥

text: gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇagrāmaṃ tato gatvā tamānaya । agastyaṃ gotrataścāpi nāmataścāpi śarmiṇam ॥6॥
html:
gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇagrāmaṃ tato gatvā tamānaya ।
agastyaṃ gotrataścāpi nāmataścāpi śarmiṇam ॥6॥
slp1: gacCa tvaM brAhmaRagrAmaM tato gatvA tamAnaya । agastyaM gotrataScApi nAmataScApi SarmiRam ॥6॥

text: śame niviṣṭaṃ vidvāṃsamadhyāpakamanādṛtam । mā cānyamānayethāstvaṃ sagotraṃ tasya pārśvataḥ ॥7॥
html:
śame niviṣṭaṃ vidvāṃsamadhyāpakamanādṛtam ।
mā cānyamānayethāstvaṃ sagotraṃ tasya pārśvataḥ ॥7॥
slp1: Same nivizwaM vidvAMsamaDyApakamanAdftam । mA cAnyamAnayeTAstvaM sagotraM tasya pArSvataH ॥7॥

text: sa hi tādṛgguṇastena tulyo'dhyayanajanmanā । apatyeṣu tathā vṛtte samastenaiva dhīmatā । tamānaya yathoddiṣṭaṃ pūjā kāryā hi tasya me ॥8॥
html:
sa hi tādṛgguṇastena tulyo'dhyayanajanmanā ।
apatyeṣu tathā vṛtte samastenaiva dhīmatā ।
tamānaya yathoddiṣṭaṃ pūjā kāryā hi tasya me ॥8॥
slp1: sa hi tAdfgguRastena tulyo'DyayanajanmanA । apatyezu taTA vftte samastenEva DImatA । tamAnaya yaToddizwaM pUjA kAryA hi tasya me ॥8॥

text: sa gatvā pratikūlaṃ taccakāra yamaśāsanam । tamākramyānayāmāsa pratiṣiddho yamena yaḥ ॥9॥
html:
sa gatvā pratikūlaṃ taccakāra yamaśāsanam ।
tamākramyānayāmāsa pratiṣiddho yamena yaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sa gatvA pratikUlaM taccakAra yamaSAsanam । tamAkramyAnayAmAsa pratizidDo yamena yaH ॥9॥

text: tasmai yamaḥ samutthāya pūjāṃ kṛtvā ca vīryavān । provāca nīyatāmeṣa so'nya ānīyatāmiti ॥10॥
html:
tasmai yamaḥ samutthāya pūjāṃ kṛtvā ca vīryavān ।
provāca nīyatāmeṣa so'nya ānīyatāmiti ॥10॥
slp1: tasmE yamaH samutTAya pUjAM kftvA ca vIryavAn । provAca nIyatAmeza so'nya AnIyatAmiti ॥10॥

text: evamukte tu vacane dharmarājena sa dvijaḥ । uvāca dharmarājānaṃ nirviṇṇo'dhyayanena vai । yo me kālo bhaveccheṣastaṃ vaseyamihācyuta ॥11॥
html:
evamukte tu vacane dharmarājena sa dvijaḥ ।
uvāca dharmarājānaṃ nirviṇṇo'dhyayanena vai ।
yo me kālo bhaveccheṣastaṃ vaseyamihācyuta ॥11॥
slp1: evamukte tu vacane DarmarAjena sa dvijaH । uvAca DarmarAjAnaM nirviRRo'Dyayanena vE । yo me kAlo BavecCezastaM vaseyamihAcyuta ॥11॥

text: nāhaṃ kālasya vihitaṃ prāpnomīha kathañcana । yo hi dharmaṃ carati vai taṃ tu jānāmi kevalam ॥12॥
html:
nāhaṃ kālasya vihitaṃ prāpnomīha kathañcana ।
yo hi dharmaṃ carati vai taṃ tu jānāmi kevalam ॥12॥
slp1: nAhaM kAlasya vihitaM prApnomIha kaTaYcana । yo hi DarmaM carati vE taM tu jAnAmi kevalam ॥12॥
author: yama uvāca ।

text: gaccha vipra tvamadyaiva ālayaṃ svaṃ mahādyute । brūhi vā tvaṃ yathā svairaṃ karavāṇi kimityuta ॥13॥
html:
gaccha vipra tvamadyaiva ālayaṃ svaṃ mahādyute ।
brūhi vā tvaṃ yathā svairaṃ karavāṇi kimityuta ॥13॥
slp1: gacCa vipra tvamadyEva AlayaM svaM mahAdyute । brUhi vA tvaM yaTA svEraM karavARi kimityuta ॥13॥

text: yattatra kṛtvā sumahatpuṇyaṃ syāttadbravīhi me । sarvasya hi pramāṇaṃ tvaṃ trailokyasyāpi sattama ॥14॥
html:
yattatra kṛtvā sumahatpuṇyaṃ syāttadbravīhi me ।
sarvasya hi pramāṇaṃ tvaṃ trailokyasyāpi sattama ॥14॥
slp1: yattatra kftvA sumahatpuRyaM syAttadbravIhi me । sarvasya hi pramARaM tvaM trElokyasyApi sattama ॥14॥
author: brāhmaṇa uvāca ।

text: śṛṇu tattvena viprarṣe pradānavidhimuttamam । tilāḥ paramakaṃ dānaṃ puṇyaṃ caiveha śāśvatam ॥15॥
html:
śṛṇu tattvena viprarṣe pradānavidhimuttamam ।
tilāḥ paramakaṃ dānaṃ puṇyaṃ caiveha śāśvatam ॥15॥
slp1: SfRu tattvena viprarze pradAnaviDimuttamam । tilAH paramakaM dAnaM puRyaM cEveha SASvatam ॥15॥
author: yama uvāca ।

text: tilāśca sampradātavyā yathāśakti dvijarṣabha । nityadānātsarvakāmāṃstilā nirvartayantyuta ॥16॥
html:
tilāśca sampradātavyā yathāśakti dvijarṣabha ।
nityadānātsarvakāmāṃstilā nirvartayantyuta ॥16॥
slp1: tilASca sampradAtavyA yaTASakti dvijarzaBa । nityadAnAtsarvakAmAMstilA nirvartayantyuta ॥16॥

text: tilāñśrāddhe praśaṃsanti dānametaddhyanuttamam । tānprayacchasva viprebhyo vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥17॥
html:
tilāñśrāddhe praśaṃsanti dānametaddhyanuttamam ।
tānprayacchasva viprebhyo vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥17॥
slp1: tilAYSrAdDe praSaMsanti dAnametadDyanuttamam । tAnprayacCasva vipreByo viDidfzwena karmaRA ॥17॥

text: tilā bhakṣayitavyāśca sadā tvālabhanaṃ ca taiḥ । kāryaṃ satatamicchadbhiḥ śreyaḥ sarvātmanā gṛhe ॥18॥
html:
tilā bhakṣayitavyāśca sadā tvālabhanaṃ ca taiḥ ।
kāryaṃ satatamicchadbhiḥ śreyaḥ sarvātmanā gṛhe ॥18॥
slp1: tilA BakzayitavyASca sadA tvAlaBanaM ca tEH । kAryaM satatamicCadBiH SreyaH sarvAtmanA gfhe ॥18॥

text: tathāpaḥ sarvadā deyāḥ peyāścaiva na saṃśayaḥ । puṣkariṇyastaḍāgāni kūpāṃścaivātra khānayet ॥19॥
html:
tathāpaḥ sarvadā deyāḥ peyāścaiva na saṃśayaḥ ।
puṣkariṇyastaḍāgāni kūpāṃścaivātra khānayet ॥19॥
slp1: taTApaH sarvadA deyAH peyAScEva na saMSayaH । puzkariRyastaqAgAni kUpAMScEvAtra KAnayet ॥19॥

text: etatsudurlabhataramiha loke dvijottama । āpo nityaṃ pradeyāste puṇyaṃ hyetadanuttamam ॥20॥
html:
etatsudurlabhataramiha loke dvijottama ।
āpo nityaṃ pradeyāste puṇyaṃ hyetadanuttamam ॥20॥
slp1: etatsudurlaBataramiha loke dvijottama । Apo nityaM pradeyAste puRyaM hyetadanuttamam ॥20॥

text: prapāśca kāryāḥ pānārthaṃ nityaṃ te dvijasattama । bhukte'pyatha pradeyaṃ te pānīyaṃ vai viśeṣataḥ ॥21॥
html:
prapāśca kāryāḥ pānārthaṃ nityaṃ te dvijasattama ।
bhukte'pyatha pradeyaṃ te pānīyaṃ vai viśeṣataḥ ॥21॥
slp1: prapASca kAryAH pAnArTaM nityaM te dvijasattama । Bukte'pyaTa pradeyaM te pAnIyaM vE viSezataH ॥21॥

text: ityukte sa tadā tena yamadūtena vai gṛhān । nītaścakāra ca tathā sarvaṃ tadyamaśāsanam ॥22॥
html:
ityukte sa tadā tena yamadūtena vai gṛhān ।
nītaścakāra ca tathā sarvaṃ tadyamaśāsanam ॥22॥
slp1: ityukte sa tadA tena yamadUtena vE gfhAn । nItaScakAra ca taTA sarvaM tadyamaSAsanam ॥22॥

text: nītvā taṃ yamadūto'pi gṛhītvā śarmiṇaṃ tadā । yayau sa dharmarājāya nyavedayata cāpi tam ॥23॥
html:
nītvā taṃ yamadūto'pi gṛhītvā śarmiṇaṃ tadā ।
yayau sa dharmarājāya nyavedayata cāpi tam ॥23॥
slp1: nItvA taM yamadUto'pi gfhItvA SarmiRaM tadA । yayO sa DarmarAjAya nyavedayata cApi tam ॥23॥

text: taṃ dharmarājo dharmajñaṃ pūjayitvā pratāpavān । kṛtvā ca saṃvidaṃ tena visasarja yathāgatam ॥24॥
html:
taṃ dharmarājo dharmajñaṃ pūjayitvā pratāpavān ।
kṛtvā ca saṃvidaṃ tena visasarja yathāgatam ॥24॥
slp1: taM DarmarAjo DarmajYaM pUjayitvA pratApavAn । kftvA ca saMvidaM tena visasarja yaTAgatam ॥24॥

text: tasyāpi ca yamaḥ sarvamupadeśaṃ cakāra ha । pratyetya ca sa tatsarvaṃ cakāroktaṃ yamena tat ॥25॥
html:
tasyāpi ca yamaḥ sarvamupadeśaṃ cakāra ha ।
pratyetya ca sa tatsarvaṃ cakāroktaṃ yamena tat ॥25॥
slp1: tasyApi ca yamaH sarvamupadeSaM cakAra ha । pratyetya ca sa tatsarvaM cakAroktaM yamena tat ॥25॥

text: tathā praśaṃsate dīpānyamaḥ pitṛhitepsayā । tasmāddīpaprado nityaṃ santārayati vai pitṝn ॥26॥
html:
tathā praśaṃsate dīpānyamaḥ pitṛhitepsayā ।
tasmāddīpaprado nityaṃ santārayati vai pitṝn ॥26॥
slp1: taTA praSaMsate dIpAnyamaH pitfhitepsayA । tasmAddIpaprado nityaM santArayati vE pitFn ॥26॥

text: dātavyāḥ satataṃ dīpāstasmādbharatasattama । devānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca cakṣuṣyāste matāḥ prabho ॥27॥
html:
dātavyāḥ satataṃ dīpāstasmādbharatasattama ।
devānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca cakṣuṣyāste matāḥ prabho ॥27॥
slp1: dAtavyAH satataM dIpAstasmAdBaratasattama । devAnAM ca pitFRAM ca cakzuzyAste matAH praBo ॥27॥

text: ratnadānaṃ ca sumahatpuṇyamuktaṃ janādhipa । tāni vikrīya yajate brāhmaṇo hyabhayaṅkaraḥ ॥28॥
html:
ratnadānaṃ ca sumahatpuṇyamuktaṃ janādhipa ।
tāni vikrīya yajate brāhmaṇo hyabhayaṅkaraḥ ॥28॥
slp1: ratnadAnaM ca sumahatpuRyamuktaM janADipa । tAni vikrIya yajate brAhmaRo hyaBayaNkaraH ॥28॥

text: yadvai dadāti viprebhyo brāhmaṇaḥ pratigṛhya vai । ubhayoḥ syāttadakṣayyaṃ dāturādātureva ca ॥29॥
html:
yadvai dadāti viprebhyo brāhmaṇaḥ pratigṛhya vai ।
ubhayoḥ syāttadakṣayyaṃ dāturādātureva ca ॥29॥
slp1: yadvE dadAti vipreByo brAhmaRaH pratigfhya vE । uBayoH syAttadakzayyaM dAturAdAtureva ca ॥29॥

text: yo dadāti sthitaḥ sthityāṃ tādṛśāya pratigraham । ubhayorakṣayaṃ dharmaṃ taṃ manuḥ prāha dharmavit ॥30॥
html:
yo dadāti sthitaḥ sthityāṃ tādṛśāya pratigraham ।
ubhayorakṣayaṃ dharmaṃ taṃ manuḥ prāha dharmavit ॥30॥
slp1: yo dadAti sTitaH sTityAM tAdfSAya pratigraham । uBayorakzayaM DarmaM taM manuH prAha Darmavit ॥30॥

text: vāsasāṃ tu pradānena svadāranirato naraḥ । suvastraśca suveṣaśca bhavatītyanuśuśruma ॥31॥
html:
vāsasāṃ tu pradānena svadāranirato naraḥ ।
suvastraśca suveṣaśca bhavatītyanuśuśruma ॥31॥
slp1: vAsasAM tu pradAnena svadAranirato naraH । suvastraSca suvezaSca BavatItyanuSuSruma ॥31॥

text: gāvaḥ suvarṇaṃ ca tathā tilāścaivānuvarṇitāḥ । bahuśaḥ puruṣavyāghra vedaprāmāṇyadarśanāt ॥32॥
html:
gāvaḥ suvarṇaṃ ca tathā tilāścaivānuvarṇitāḥ ।
bahuśaḥ puruṣavyāghra vedaprāmāṇyadarśanāt ॥32॥
slp1: gAvaH suvarRaM ca taTA tilAScEvAnuvarRitAH । bahuSaH puruzavyAGra vedaprAmARyadarSanAt ॥32॥

text: vivāhāṃścaiva kurvīta putrānutpādayeta ca । putralābho hi kauravya sarvalābhādviśiṣyate] ॥33॥
html:
vivāhāṃścaiva kurvīta putrānutpādayeta ca ।
putralābho hi kauravya sarvalābhādviśiṣyate] ॥33॥
slp1: vivAhAMScEva kurvIta putrAnutpAdayeta ca । putralABo hi kOravya sarvalABAdviSizyate] ॥33॥

text: bhūya eva kuruśreṣṭha dānānāṃ vidhimuttamam । kathayasva mahāprājña bhūmidānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ॥1॥
html:
bhūya eva kuruśreṣṭha dānānāṃ vidhimuttamam ।
kathayasva mahāprājña bhūmidānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ॥1॥
slp1: BUya eva kuruSrezWa dAnAnAM viDimuttamam । kaTayasva mahAprAjYa BUmidAnaM viSezataH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: pṛthivīṃ kṣatriyo dadyādbrāhmaṇastāṃ svakarmaṇā । vidhivatpratigṛhṇīyānna tvanyo dātumarhati ॥2॥
html:
pṛthivīṃ kṣatriyo dadyādbrāhmaṇastāṃ svakarmaṇā ।
vidhivatpratigṛhṇīyānna tvanyo dātumarhati ॥2॥
slp1: pfTivIM kzatriyo dadyAdbrAhmaRastAM svakarmaRA । viDivatpratigfhRIyAnna tvanyo dAtumarhati ॥2॥

text: sarvavarṇaistu yacchakyaṃ pradātuṃ phalakāṅkṣibhiḥ । vede vā yatsamāmnātaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥3॥
html:
sarvavarṇaistu yacchakyaṃ pradātuṃ phalakāṅkṣibhiḥ ।
vede vā yatsamāmnātaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥3॥
slp1: sarvavarREstu yacCakyaM pradAtuM PalakANkziBiH । vede vA yatsamAmnAtaM tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥3॥

text: tulyanāmāni deyāni trīṇi tulyaphalāni ca । sarvakāmaphalānīha gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī ॥4॥
html:
tulyanāmāni deyāni trīṇi tulyaphalāni ca ।
sarvakāmaphalānīha gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī ॥4॥
slp1: tulyanAmAni deyAni trIRi tulyaPalAni ca । sarvakAmaPalAnIha gAvaH pfTvI sarasvatI ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yo brūyāccāpi śiṣyāya dharmyāṃ brāhmīṃ sarasvatīm । pṛthivīgopradānābhyāṃ sa tulyaṃ phalamaśnute ॥5॥

text: tathaiva gāḥ praśaṃsanti na ca deyaṃ tataḥ param । sannikṛṣṭaphalāstā hi laghvarthāśca yudhiṣṭhira । mātaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ sarvasukhapradāḥ ॥6॥

text: vṛddhimākāṅkṣatā nityaṃ gāvaḥ kāryāḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ । maṅgalāyatanaṃ devyastasmātpūjyāḥ sadaiva hi ॥7॥

text: pracodanaṃ devakṛtaṃ gavāṃ karmasu vartatām । pūrvamevākṣaraṃ nānyadabhidheyaṃ kathañcana ॥8॥
html:

text: pracāre vā nipāne vā budho nodvejayeta gāḥ । tṛṣitā hyabhivīkṣantyo naraṃ hanyuḥ sabāndhavam ॥9॥

text: pitṛsadmāni satataṃ devatāyatanāni ca । pūyante śakṛtā yāsāṃ pūtaṃ kimadhikaṃ tataḥ ॥10॥

text: grāsamuṣṭiṃ paragave dadyātsaṃvatsaraṃ tu yaḥ । akṛtvā svayamāhāraṃ vrataṃ tatsārvakāmikam ॥11॥

text: deyāḥ kiṃlakṣaṇā gāvaḥ kāścāpi parivarjayet । kīdṛśāya pradātavyā na deyāḥ kīdṛśāya ca ॥13॥
html:

text: yaṃ caiva dharmaṃ kurute tasya puṇyaphalaṃ ca yat । sarvasyaivāṃśabhāgdātā tannimittaṃ pravṛttayaḥ ॥16॥

text: kalmaṣaṃ guruśuśrūṣā hanti māno mahadyaśaḥ । aputratāṃ trayaḥ putrā avṛttiṃ daśa dhenavaḥ ॥18॥

text: na tvevāsāṃ dānamātraṃ praśastaṃ pātraṃ kālo goviśeṣo vidhiśca । jñātvā deyā vipra gavāntaraṃ hi duḥkhaṃ jñātuṃ pāvakādityabhūtam ॥29॥
html:
na tvevāsāṃ dānamātraṃ praśastaṃ pātraṃ kālo goviśeṣo vidhiśca ।
jñātvā deyā vipra gavāntaraṃ hi duḥkhaṃ jñātuṃ pāvakādityabhūtam ॥29॥
slp1: na tvevAsAM dAnamAtraM praSastaM pAtraM kAlo goviSezo viDiSca । jYAtvA deyA vipra gavAntaraM hi duHKaM jYAtuM pAvakAdityaBUtam ॥29॥

text: svādhyāyāḍhyo yo'timātraṃ tapasvī vaitānastho brāhmaṇaḥ pātramāsām । kṛcchrotsṛṣṭāḥ poṣaṇābhyāgatāśca dvārairetairgoviśeṣāḥ praśastāḥ ॥30॥
html:
svādhyāyāḍhyo yo'timātraṃ tapasvī vaitānastho brāhmaṇaḥ pātramāsām ।
kṛcchrotsṛṣṭāḥ poṣaṇābhyāgatāśca dvārairetairgoviśeṣāḥ praśastāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: svADyAyAQyo yo'timAtraM tapasvI vEtAnasTo brAhmaRaH pAtramAsAm । kfcCrotsfzwAH pozaRAByAgatASca dvArEretErgoviSezAH praSastAH ॥30॥

text: tisro rātrīradbhirupoṣya bhūmau tṛptā gāvastarpitebhyaḥ pradeyāḥ । vatsaiḥ prītāḥ suprajāḥ sopacārāstryahaṃ dattvā gorasairvartitavyam ॥31॥
html:
tisro rātrīradbhirupoṣya bhūmau tṛptā gāvastarpitebhyaḥ pradeyāḥ ।
vatsaiḥ prītāḥ suprajāḥ sopacārāstryahaṃ dattvā gorasairvartitavyam ॥31॥
slp1: tisro rAtrIradBirupozya BUmO tfptA gAvastarpiteByaH pradeyAH । vatsEH prItAH suprajAH sopacArAstryahaM dattvA gorasErvartitavyam ॥31॥

text: dattvā dhenuṃ suvratāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ kalyāṇavatsāmapalāyinīṃ ca । yāvanti lomāni bhavanti tasyāstāvadvarṣāṇyaśnute svargalokam ॥32॥
html:
dattvā dhenuṃ suvratāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ kalyāṇavatsāmapalāyinīṃ ca ।
yāvanti lomāni bhavanti tasyāstāvadvarṣāṇyaśnute svargalokam ॥32॥
slp1: dattvA DenuM suvratAM kAMsyadohAM kalyARavatsAmapalAyinIM ca । yAvanti lomAni Bavanti tasyAstAvadvarzARyaSnute svargalokam ॥32॥

text: tathānaḍvāhaṃ brāhmaṇāya pradāya dāntaṃ dhuryaṃ balavantaṃ yuvānam । kulānujīvaṃ vīryavantaṃ bṛhantaṃ bhuṅkte lokānsammitāndhenudasya ॥33॥
html:
tathānaḍvāhaṃ brāhmaṇāya pradāya dāntaṃ dhuryaṃ balavantaṃ yuvānam ।
kulānujīvaṃ vīryavantaṃ bṛhantaṃ bhuṅkte lokānsammitāndhenudasya ॥33॥
slp1: taTAnaqvAhaM brAhmaRAya pradAya dAntaM DuryaM balavantaM yuvAnam । kulAnujIvaM vIryavantaM bfhantaM BuNkte lokAnsammitAnDenudasya ॥33॥

text: goṣu kṣāntaṃ gośaraṇyaṃ kṛtajñaṃ vṛttiglānaṃ tādṛśaṃ pātramāhuḥ । vṛttiglāne sambhrame vā mahārthe kṛṣyarthe vā homahetoḥ prasūtyām ॥34॥
html:
goṣu kṣāntaṃ gośaraṇyaṃ kṛtajñaṃ vṛttiglānaṃ tādṛśaṃ pātramāhuḥ ।
vṛttiglāne sambhrame vā mahārthe kṛṣyarthe vā homahetoḥ prasūtyām ॥34॥
slp1: gozu kzAntaM goSaraRyaM kftajYaM vfttiglAnaM tAdfSaM pAtramAhuH । vfttiglAne samBrame vA mahArTe kfzyarTe vA homahetoH prasUtyAm ॥34॥

text: gurvarthe vā bālapuṣṭyābhiṣaṅgādgāvo dātuṃ deśakālo'viśiṣṭaḥ । antarjātāḥ sukrayajñānalabdhāḥ prāṇakrītā nirjitāścaudakāśca ॥35॥
html:
gurvarthe vā bālapuṣṭyābhiṣaṅgādgāvo dātuṃ deśakālo'viśiṣṭaḥ ।
antarjātāḥ sukrayajñānalabdhāḥ prāṇakrītā nirjitāścaudakāśca ॥35॥
slp1: gurvarTe vA bAlapuzwyABizaNgAdgAvo dAtuM deSakAlo'viSizwaH । antarjAtAH sukrayajYAnalabDAH prARakrItA nirjitAScOdakASca ॥35॥

text: śrutvā vaivasvatavacastamahaṃ punarabruvam । agomī gopradātṝṇāṃ kathaṃ lokānnigacchati ॥36॥
html:
śrutvā vaivasvatavacastamahaṃ punarabruvam ।
agomī gopradātṝṇāṃ kathaṃ lokānnigacchati ॥36॥
slp1: SrutvA vEvasvatavacastamahaM punarabruvam । agomI gopradAtFRAM kaTaM lokAnnigacCati ॥36॥
author: nāciketa uvāca ।

text: tato yamo'bravīddhīmāngopradāne parāṃ gatim । gopradānānukalpaṃ tu gāmṛte santi gopradāḥ ॥37॥
html:
tato yamo'bravīddhīmāngopradāne parāṃ gatim ।
gopradānānukalpaṃ tu gāmṛte santi gopradāḥ ॥37॥
slp1: tato yamo'bravIdDImAngopradAne parAM gatim । gopradAnAnukalpaM tu gAmfte santi gopradAH ॥37॥

text: alābhe yo gavāṃ dadyādghṛtadhenuṃ yatavrataḥ । tasyaitā ghṛtavāhinyaḥ kṣarante vatsalā iva ॥38॥
html:
alābhe yo gavāṃ dadyādghṛtadhenuṃ yatavrataḥ ।
tasyaitā ghṛtavāhinyaḥ kṣarante vatsalā iva ॥38॥
slp1: alABe yo gavAM dadyAdGftaDenuM yatavrataH । tasyEtA GftavAhinyaH kzarante vatsalA iva ॥38॥

text: ghṛtālābhe ca yo dadyāttiladhenuṃ yatavrataḥ । sa durgāttārito dhenvā kṣīranadyāṃ pramodate ॥39॥
html:
ghṛtālābhe ca yo dadyāttiladhenuṃ yatavrataḥ ।
sa durgāttārito dhenvā kṣīranadyāṃ pramodate ॥39॥
slp1: GftAlABe ca yo dadyAttilaDenuM yatavrataH । sa durgAttArito DenvA kzIranadyAM pramodate ॥39॥

text: tilālābhe ca yo dadyājjaladhenuṃ yatavrataḥ । sa kāmapravahāṃ śītāṃ nadīmetāmupāśnute ॥40॥
html:
tilālābhe ca yo dadyājjaladhenuṃ yatavrataḥ ।
sa kāmapravahāṃ śītāṃ nadīmetāmupāśnute ॥40॥
slp1: tilAlABe ca yo dadyAjjalaDenuM yatavrataH । sa kAmapravahAM SItAM nadImetAmupASnute ॥40॥

text: evamādīni me tatra dharmarājo nyadarśayat । dṛṣṭvā ca paramaṃ harṣamavāpamahamacyuta ॥41॥
html:
evamādīni me tatra dharmarājo nyadarśayat ।
dṛṣṭvā ca paramaṃ harṣamavāpamahamacyuta ॥41॥
slp1: evamAdIni me tatra DarmarAjo nyadarSayat । dfzwvA ca paramaM harzamavApamahamacyuta ॥41॥

text: nivedaye cāpi priyaṃ bhavatsu kraturmahānalpadhanapracāraḥ । prāpto mayā tāta sa matprasūtaḥ prapatsyate vedavidhipravṛttaḥ ॥42॥
html:
nivedaye cāpi priyaṃ bhavatsu kraturmahānalpadhanapracāraḥ ।
prāpto mayā tāta sa matprasūtaḥ prapatsyate vedavidhipravṛttaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: nivedaye cApi priyaM Bavatsu kraturmahAnalpaDanapracAraH । prApto mayA tAta sa matprasUtaH prapatsyate vedaviDipravfttaH ॥42॥

text: śāpo hyayaṃ bhavato'nugrahāya prāpto mayā yatra dṛṣṭo yamo me । dānavyuṣṭiṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā mahārthāṃ niḥsandigdhaṃ dānadharmāṃścariṣye ॥43॥
html:
śāpo hyayaṃ bhavato'nugrahāya prāpto mayā yatra dṛṣṭo yamo me ।
dānavyuṣṭiṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā mahārthāṃ niḥsandigdhaṃ dānadharmāṃścariṣye ॥43॥
slp1: SApo hyayaM Bavato'nugrahAya prApto mayA yatra dfzwo yamo me । dAnavyuzwiM tatra dfzwvA mahArTAM niHsandigDaM dAnaDarmAMScarizye ॥43॥

text: idaṃ ca māmabravīddharmarājaḥ punaḥ punaḥ samprahṛṣṭo dvijarṣe । dānena tāta prayato'bhūḥ sadaiva viśeṣato gopradānaṃ ca kuryāḥ ॥44॥
html:
idaṃ ca māmabravīddharmarājaḥ punaḥ punaḥ samprahṛṣṭo dvijarṣe ।
dānena tāta prayato'bhūḥ sadaiva viśeṣato gopradānaṃ ca kuryāḥ ॥44॥
slp1: idaM ca mAmabravIdDarmarAjaH punaH punaH samprahfzwo dvijarze । dAnena tAta prayato'BUH sadEva viSezato gopradAnaM ca kuryAH ॥44॥

text: śuddho hyartho nāvamanyaḥ svadharmātpātre deyaṃ deśakālopapanne । tasmādgāvaste nityameva pradeyā mā bhūcca te saṃśayaḥ kaścidatra ॥45॥
html:
śuddho hyartho nāvamanyaḥ svadharmātpātre deyaṃ deśakālopapanne ।
tasmādgāvaste nityameva pradeyā mā bhūcca te saṃśayaḥ kaścidatra ॥45॥
slp1: SudDo hyarTo nAvamanyaH svaDarmAtpAtre deyaM deSakAlopapanne । tasmAdgAvaste nityameva pradeyA mA BUcca te saMSayaH kaScidatra ॥45॥

text: etāḥ purā adadannityameva śāntātmāno dānapathe niviṣṭāḥ । tapāṃsyugrāṇyapratiśaṅkamānāste vai dānaṃ pradaduścāpi śaktyā ॥46॥
html:
etāḥ purā adadannityameva śāntātmāno dānapathe niviṣṭāḥ ।
tapāṃsyugrāṇyapratiśaṅkamānāste vai dānaṃ pradaduścāpi śaktyā ॥46॥
slp1: etAH purA adadannityameva SAntAtmAno dAnapaTe nivizwAH । tapAMsyugrARyapratiSaNkamAnAste vE dAnaM pradaduScApi SaktyA ॥46॥

text: kāle śaktyā matsaraṃ varjayitvā śuddhātmānaḥ śraddhinaḥ puṇyaśīlāḥ । dattvā taptvā lokamamuṃ prapannā dedīpyante puṇyaśīlāśca nāke ॥47॥
html:
kāle śaktyā matsaraṃ varjayitvā śuddhātmānaḥ śraddhinaḥ puṇyaśīlāḥ ।
dattvā taptvā lokamamuṃ prapannā dedīpyante puṇyaśīlāśca nāke ॥47॥
slp1: kAle SaktyA matsaraM varjayitvA SudDAtmAnaH SradDinaH puRyaSIlAH । dattvA taptvA lokamamuM prapannA dedIpyante puRyaSIlASca nAke ॥47॥

text: etaddānaṃ nyāyalabdhaṃ dvijebhyaḥ pātre dattaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ parīkṣya । kāmyāṣṭamyāṃ vartitavyaṃ daśāhaṃ rasairgavāṃ śakṛtā prasnavairvā ॥48॥
html:
etaddānaṃ nyāyalabdhaṃ dvijebhyaḥ pātre dattaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ parīkṣya ।
kāmyāṣṭamyāṃ vartitavyaṃ daśāhaṃ rasairgavāṃ śakṛtā prasnavairvā ॥48॥
slp1: etaddAnaM nyAyalabDaM dvijeByaH pAtre dattaM prApaRIyaM parIkzya । kAmyAzwamyAM vartitavyaM daSAhaM rasErgavAM SakftA prasnavErvA ॥48॥

text: vedavratī syādvṛṣabhapradātā vedāvāptirgoyugasya pradāne । tīrthāvāptirgoprayuktapradāne pāpotsargaḥ kapilāyāḥ pradāne ॥49॥
html:
vedavratī syādvṛṣabhapradātā vedāvāptirgoyugasya pradāne ।
tīrthāvāptirgoprayuktapradāne pāpotsargaḥ kapilāyāḥ pradāne ॥49॥
slp1: vedavratI syAdvfzaBapradAtA vedAvAptirgoyugasya pradAne । tIrTAvAptirgoprayuktapradAne pApotsargaH kapilAyAH pradAne ॥49॥

text: gāmapyekāṃ kapilāṃ sampradāya nyāyopetāṃ kalmaṣādvipramucyet । gavāṃ rasātparamaṃ nāsti kiñcidgavāṃ dānaṃ sumahattadvadanti ॥50॥
html:
gāmapyekāṃ kapilāṃ sampradāya nyāyopetāṃ kalmaṣādvipramucyet ।
gavāṃ rasātparamaṃ nāsti kiñcidgavāṃ dānaṃ sumahattadvadanti ॥50॥
slp1: gAmapyekAM kapilAM sampradAya nyAyopetAM kalmazAdvipramucyet । gavAM rasAtparamaM nAsti kiYcidgavAM dAnaM sumahattadvadanti ॥50॥

text: gāvo lokāndhārayanti kṣarantyo gāvaścānnaṃ sañjanayanti loke । yastajjānanna gavāṃ hārdameti sa vai gantā nirayaṃ pāpacetāḥ ॥51॥
html:
gāvo lokāndhārayanti kṣarantyo gāvaścānnaṃ sañjanayanti loke ।
yastajjānanna gavāṃ hārdameti sa vai gantā nirayaṃ pāpacetāḥ ॥51॥
slp1: gAvo lokAnDArayanti kzarantyo gAvaScAnnaM saYjanayanti loke । yastajjAnanna gavAM hArdameti sa vE gantA nirayaM pApacetAH ॥51॥

text: yatte dātuṃ gosahasraṃ śataṃ vā śatārdhaṃ vā daśa vā sādhuvatsāḥ । apyekāṃ vā sādhave brāhmaṇāya sāsyāmuṣminpuṇyatīrthā nadī vai ॥52॥
html:
yatte dātuṃ gosahasraṃ śataṃ vā śatārdhaṃ vā daśa vā sādhuvatsāḥ ।
apyekāṃ vā sādhave brāhmaṇāya sāsyāmuṣminpuṇyatīrthā nadī vai ॥52॥
slp1: yatte dAtuM gosahasraM SataM vA SatArDaM vA daSa vA sADuvatsAH । apyekAM vA sADave brAhmaRAya sAsyAmuzminpuRyatIrTA nadI vE ॥52॥

text: prāptyā puṣṭyā lokasaṃrakṣaṇena gāvastulyāḥ sūryapādaiḥ pṛthivyām । śabdaścaikaḥ santatiścopabhogastasmādgodaḥ sūrya ivābhibhāti ॥53॥
html:
prāptyā puṣṭyā lokasaṃrakṣaṇena gāvastulyāḥ sūryapādaiḥ pṛthivyām ।
śabdaścaikaḥ santatiścopabhogastasmādgodaḥ sūrya ivābhibhāti ॥53॥
slp1: prAptyA puzwyA lokasaMrakzaRena gAvastulyAH sUryapAdEH pfTivyAm । SabdaScEkaH santatiScopaBogastasmAdgodaH sUrya ivABiBAti ॥53॥

text: guruṃ śiṣyo varayedgopradāne sa vai vaktā niyataṃ svargadātā । vidhijñānāṃ sumahāneṣa dharmo vidhiṃ hyādyaṃ vidhayaḥ saṃśrayanti ॥54॥
html:
guruṃ śiṣyo varayedgopradāne sa vai vaktā niyataṃ svargadātā ।
vidhijñānāṃ sumahāneṣa dharmo vidhiṃ hyādyaṃ vidhayaḥ saṃśrayanti ॥54॥
slp1: guruM Sizyo varayedgopradAne sa vE vaktA niyataM svargadAtA । viDijYAnAM sumahAneza Darmo viDiM hyAdyaM viDayaH saMSrayanti ॥54॥

text: etaddānaṃ nyāyalabdhaṃ dvijebhyaḥ pātre dattvā prāpayethāḥ parīkṣya । tvayyāśaṃsantyamarā mānavāśca vayaṃ cāpi prasṛte puṇyaśīlāḥ ॥55॥
html:
etaddānaṃ nyāyalabdhaṃ dvijebhyaḥ pātre dattvā prāpayethāḥ parīkṣya ।
tvayyāśaṃsantyamarā mānavāśca vayaṃ cāpi prasṛte puṇyaśīlāḥ ॥55॥
slp1: etaddAnaM nyAyalabDaM dvijeByaH pAtre dattvA prApayeTAH parIkzya । tvayyASaMsantyamarA mAnavASca vayaM cApi prasfte puRyaSIlAH ॥55॥

text: ityukto'haṃ dharmarājñā maharṣe dharmātmānaṃ śirasābhipraṇamya । anujñātastena vaivasvatena pratyāgamaṃ bhagavatpādamūlam] ॥56॥
html:
ityukto'haṃ dharmarājñā maharṣe dharmātmānaṃ śirasābhipraṇamya ।
anujñātastena vaivasvatena pratyāgamaṃ bhagavatpādamūlam] ॥56॥

text: uktaṃ vai gopradānaṃ te nāciketamṛṣiṃ prati । māhātmyamapi caivoktamuddeśena gavāṃ prabho ॥1॥

text: nṛgeṇa ca yathā duḥkhamanubhūtaṃ mahātmanā । ekāparādhādajñānātpitāmaha mahāmate ॥2॥

nṛgeṇa ca yathā duḥkhamanubhūtaṃ mahātmanā ।

html:

text: svarlokavāsināṃ lakṣmīmabhibhūya svayā tviṣā । golokavāsinaḥ paśye vrajataḥ saṃśayo'tra me ॥6॥
html:
svarlokavāsināṃ lakṣmīmabhibhūya svayā tviṣā ।
golokavāsinaḥ paśye vrajataḥ saṃśayo'tra me ॥6॥

text: kīdṛśā bhagavaṁllokā gavāṃ tadbrūhi me'nagha । yānāvasanti dātāra etadicchāmi veditum ॥7॥
html:
kīdṛśā bhagavaṁllokā gavāṃ tadbrūhi me'nagha ।
yānāvasanti dātāra etadicchāmi veditum ॥7॥
slp1: kIdfSA BagavaṁllokA gavAM tadbrUhi me'naGa । yAnAvasanti dAtAra etadicCAmi veditum ॥7॥

text: kīdṛśāḥ kimphalāḥ kaḥ svitparamastatra vai guṇaḥ । kathaṃ ca puruṣāstatra gacchanti vigatajvarāḥ ॥8॥
html:
kīdṛśāḥ kimphalāḥ kaḥ svitparamastatra vai guṇaḥ ।
kathaṃ ca puruṣāstatra gacchanti vigatajvarāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: kIdfSAH kimPalAH kaH svitparamastatra vE guRaH । kaTaM ca puruzAstatra gacCanti vigatajvarAH ॥8॥

text: kiyatkālaṃ pradānasya dātā ca phalamaśnute । kathaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dānaṃ syādalpamapi vā katham ॥9॥
html:
kiyatkālaṃ pradānasya dātā ca phalamaśnute ।
kathaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dānaṃ syādalpamapi vā katham ॥9॥
slp1: kiyatkAlaM pradAnasya dAtA ca PalamaSnute । kaTaM bahuviDaM dAnaM syAdalpamapi vA kaTam ॥9॥

text: bahvīnāṃ kīdṛśaṃ dānamalpānāṃ vāpi kīdṛśam । adattvā gopradāḥ santi kena vā tacca śaṃsa me ॥10॥
html:
bahvīnāṃ kīdṛśaṃ dānamalpānāṃ vāpi kīdṛśam ।
adattvā gopradāḥ santi kena vā tacca śaṃsa me ॥10॥
slp1: bahvInAM kIdfSaM dAnamalpAnAM vApi kIdfSam । adattvA gopradAH santi kena vA tacca SaMsa me ॥10॥

text: kathaṃ ca bahudātā syādalpadātrā samaḥ prabho । alpapradātā bahudaḥ kathaṃ ca syādiheśvara ॥11॥
html:
kathaṃ ca bahudātā syādalpadātrā samaḥ prabho ।
alpapradātā bahudaḥ kathaṃ ca syādiheśvara ॥11॥
slp1: kaTaM ca bahudAtA syAdalpadAtrA samaH praBo । alpapradAtA bahudaH kaTaM ca syAdiheSvara ॥11॥

text: kīdṛśī dakṣiṇā caiva gopradāne viśiṣyate । etattathyena bhagavanmama śaṃsitumarhasi] ॥12॥
html:
kīdṛśī dakṣiṇā caiva gopradāne viśiṣyate ।
etattathyena bhagavanmama śaṃsitumarhasi] ॥12॥
slp1: kIdfSI dakziRA cEva gopradAne viSizyate । etattaTyena Bagavanmama SaMsitumarhasi] ॥12॥

text: yo'yaṃ praśnastvayā pṛṣṭo gopradānādhikāravān । nāsya praṣṭāsti loke'smiṃstvatto'nyo hi śatakrato ॥1॥
html:
yo'yaṃ praśnastvayā pṛṣṭo gopradānādhikāravān ।
nāsya praṣṭāsti loke'smiṃstvatto'nyo hi śatakrato ॥1॥
slp1: yo'yaM praSnastvayA pfzwo gopradAnADikAravAn । nAsya prazwAsti loke'smiMstvatto'nyo hi Satakrato ॥1॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: santi nānāvidhā lokā yāṃstvaṃ śakra na paśyasi । paśyāmi yānahaṃ lokānekapatnyaśca yāḥ striyaḥ ॥2॥
html:
santi nānāvidhā lokā yāṃstvaṃ śakra na paśyasi ।
paśyāmi yānahaṃ lokānekapatnyaśca yāḥ striyaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: santi nAnAviDA lokA yAMstvaM Sakra na paSyasi । paSyAmi yAnahaM lokAnekapatnyaSca yAH striyaH ॥2॥

text: karmabhiścāpi suśubhaiḥ suvratā ṛṣayastathā । saśarīrā hi tānyānti brāhmaṇāḥ śubhavṛttayaḥ ॥3॥
html:
karmabhiścāpi suśubhaiḥ suvratā ṛṣayastathā ।
saśarīrā hi tānyānti brāhmaṇāḥ śubhavṛttayaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: karmaBiScApi suSuBEH suvratA fzayastaTA । saSarIrA hi tAnyAnti brAhmaRAH SuBavfttayaH ॥3॥

text: śarīranyāsamokṣeṇa manasā nirmalena ca । svapnabhūtāṃśca tāṁllokānpaśyantīhāpi suvratāḥ ॥4॥
html:
śarīranyāsamokṣeṇa manasā nirmalena ca ।
svapnabhūtāṃśca tāṁllokānpaśyantīhāpi suvratāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: SarIranyAsamokzeRa manasA nirmalena ca । svapnaBUtAMSca tAṁllokAnpaSyantIhApi suvratAH ॥4॥

text: te tu lokāḥ sahasrākṣa śṛṇu yādṛgguṇānvitāḥ । na tatra kramate kālo na jarā na ca pāpakam । tathānyannāśubhaṃ kiñcinna vyādhistatra na klamaḥ ॥5॥
html:
te tu lokāḥ sahasrākṣa śṛṇu yādṛgguṇānvitāḥ ।
na tatra kramate kālo na jarā na ca pāpakam ।
tathānyannāśubhaṃ kiñcinna vyādhistatra na klamaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: te tu lokAH sahasrAkza SfRu yAdfgguRAnvitAH । na tatra kramate kAlo na jarA na ca pApakam । taTAnyannASuBaM kiYcinna vyADistatra na klamaH ॥5॥

text: yadyacca gāvo manasā tasminvāñchanti vāsava । tatsarvaṃ prāpayanti sma mama pratyakṣadarśanāt । kāmagāḥ kāmacāriṇyaḥ kāmātkāmāṃśca bhuñjate ॥6॥
html:
yadyacca gāvo manasā tasminvāñchanti vāsava ।
tatsarvaṃ prāpayanti sma mama pratyakṣadarśanāt ।
kāmagāḥ kāmacāriṇyaḥ kāmātkāmāṃśca bhuñjate ॥6॥
slp1: yadyacca gAvo manasA tasminvAYCanti vAsava । tatsarvaM prApayanti sma mama pratyakzadarSanAt । kAmagAH kAmacAriRyaH kAmAtkAmAMSca BuYjate ॥6॥

text: vāpyaḥ sarāṃsi sarito vividhāni vanāni ca । gṛhāṇi parvatāścaiva yāvaddravyaṃ ca kiñcana ॥7॥
html:
vāpyaḥ sarāṃsi sarito vividhāni vanāni ca ।
gṛhāṇi parvatāścaiva yāvaddravyaṃ ca kiñcana ॥7॥
slp1: vApyaH sarAMsi sarito viviDAni vanAni ca । gfhARi parvatAScEva yAvaddravyaM ca kiYcana ॥7॥

text: manojñaṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sarvaṃ tatra pradṛśyate । īdṛśānviddhi tāṁllokānnāsti lokastato'dhikaḥ ॥8॥
html:
manojñaṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sarvaṃ tatra pradṛśyate ।
īdṛśānviddhi tāṁllokānnāsti lokastato'dhikaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: manojYaM sarvaBUteByaH sarvaM tatra pradfSyate । IdfSAnvidDi tAṁllokAnnAsti lokastato'DikaH ॥8॥

text: tatra sarvasahāḥ kṣāntā vatsalā guruvartinaḥ । ahaṅkārairvirahitā yānti śakra narottamāḥ ॥9॥
html:
tatra sarvasahāḥ kṣāntā vatsalā guruvartinaḥ ।
ahaṅkārairvirahitā yānti śakra narottamāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tatra sarvasahAH kzAntA vatsalA guruvartinaH । ahaNkArErvirahitA yAnti Sakra narottamAH ॥9॥

text: yaḥ sarvamāṃsāni na bhakṣayīta pumānsadā yāvadantāya yuktaḥ । mātāpitrorarcitā satyayuktaḥ śuśrūṣitā brāhmaṇānāmanindyaḥ ॥10॥
html:
yaḥ sarvamāṃsāni na bhakṣayīta pumānsadā yāvadantāya yuktaḥ ।
mātāpitrorarcitā satyayuktaḥ śuśrūṣitā brāhmaṇānāmanindyaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yaH sarvamAMsAni na BakzayIta pumAnsadA yAvadantAya yuktaH । mAtApitrorarcitA satyayuktaH SuSrUzitA brAhmaRAnAmanindyaH ॥10॥

text: akrodhano goṣu tathā dvijeṣu dharme rato guruśuśrūṣakaśca । yāvajjīvaṃ satyavṛtte rataśca dāne rato yaḥ kṣamī cāparādhe ॥11॥
html:
akrodhano goṣu tathā dvijeṣu dharme rato guruśuśrūṣakaśca ।
yāvajjīvaṃ satyavṛtte rataśca dāne rato yaḥ kṣamī cāparādhe ॥11॥
slp1: akroDano gozu taTA dvijezu Darme rato guruSuSrUzakaSca । yAvajjIvaM satyavftte rataSca dAne rato yaH kzamI cAparADe ॥11॥

text: mṛdurdānto devaparāyaṇaśca sarvātithiścāpi tathā dayāvān । īdṛgguṇo mānavaḥ samprayāti lokaṃ gavāṃ śāśvataṃ cāvyayaṃ ca ॥12॥
html:
mṛdurdānto devaparāyaṇaśca sarvātithiścāpi tathā dayāvān ।
īdṛgguṇo mānavaḥ samprayāti lokaṃ gavāṃ śāśvataṃ cāvyayaṃ ca ॥12॥
slp1: mfdurdAnto devaparAyaRaSca sarvAtiTiScApi taTA dayAvAn । IdfgguRo mAnavaH samprayAti lokaM gavAM SASvataM cAvyayaM ca ॥12॥

text: na pāradārī paśyati lokamenaṃ na vai gurughno na mṛṣāpralāpī । sadāpavādī brāhmaṇaḥ śāntavedo doṣairanyairyaśca yukto durātmā ॥13॥
html:
na pāradārī paśyati lokamenaṃ na vai gurughno na mṛṣāpralāpī ।
sadāpavādī brāhmaṇaḥ śāntavedo doṣairanyairyaśca yukto durātmā ॥13॥
slp1: na pAradArI paSyati lokamenaM na vE guruGno na mfzApralApI । sadApavAdI brAhmaRaH SAntavedo dozEranyEryaSca yukto durAtmA ॥13॥

text: na mitradhruṅnaikṛtikaḥ kṛtaghnaḥ śaṭho'nṛjurdharmavidveṣakaśca । na brahmahā manasāpi prapaśyedgavāṃ lokaṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ nivāsam ॥14॥
html:
na mitradhruṅnaikṛtikaḥ kṛtaghnaḥ śaṭho'nṛjurdharmavidveṣakaśca ।
na brahmahā manasāpi prapaśyedgavāṃ lokaṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ nivāsam ॥14॥
slp1: na mitraDruNnEkftikaH kftaGnaH SaWo'nfjurDarmavidvezakaSca । na brahmahA manasApi prapaSyedgavAM lokaM puRyakftAM nivAsam ॥14॥

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ naipuṇena sureśvara । gopradānaratānāṃ tu phalaṃ śṛṇu śatakrato ॥15॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ naipuṇena sureśvara ।
gopradānaratānāṃ tu phalaṃ śṛṇu śatakrato ॥15॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM nEpuRena sureSvara । gopradAnaratAnAM tu PalaM SfRu Satakrato ॥15॥

text: dāyādyalabdhairarthairyo gāḥ krītvā samprayacchati । dharmārjitadhanakrītānsa lokānaśnute'kṣayān ॥16॥
html:
dāyādyalabdhairarthairyo gāḥ krītvā samprayacchati ।
dharmārjitadhanakrītānsa lokānaśnute'kṣayān ॥16॥
slp1: dAyAdyalabDErarTEryo gAH krItvA samprayacCati । DarmArjitaDanakrItAnsa lokAnaSnute'kzayAn ॥16॥

text: yo vai dyūte dhanaṃ jitvā gāḥ krītvā samprayacchati । sa divyamayutaṃ śakra varṣāṇāṃ phalamaśnute ॥17॥
html:
yo vai dyūte dhanaṃ jitvā gāḥ krītvā samprayacchati ।
sa divyamayutaṃ śakra varṣāṇāṃ phalamaśnute ॥17॥
slp1: yo vE dyUte DanaM jitvA gAH krItvA samprayacCati । sa divyamayutaM Sakra varzARAM PalamaSnute ॥17॥

text: dāyādyā yasya vai gāvo nyāyapūrvairupārjitāḥ । pradattāstāḥ pradātṝṇāṃ sambhavantyakṣayā dhruvāḥ ॥18॥
html:
dāyādyā yasya vai gāvo nyāyapūrvairupārjitāḥ ।
pradattāstāḥ pradātṝṇāṃ sambhavantyakṣayā dhruvāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: dAyAdyA yasya vE gAvo nyAyapUrvErupArjitAH । pradattAstAH pradAtFRAM samBavantyakzayA DruvAH ॥18॥

text: pratigṛhya ca yo dadyādgāḥ suśuddhena cetasā । tasyāpīhākṣayāṁllokāndhruvānviddhi śacīpate ॥19॥
html:
pratigṛhya ca yo dadyādgāḥ suśuddhena cetasā ।
tasyāpīhākṣayāṁllokāndhruvānviddhi śacīpate ॥19॥
slp1: pratigfhya ca yo dadyAdgAH suSudDena cetasA । tasyApIhAkzayAṁllokAnDruvAnvidDi SacIpate ॥19॥

text: janmaprabhṛti satyaṃ ca yo brūyānniyatendriyaḥ । gurudvijasahaḥ kṣāntastasya gobhiḥ samā gatiḥ ॥20॥
html:
janmaprabhṛti satyaṃ ca yo brūyānniyatendriyaḥ ।
gurudvijasahaḥ kṣāntastasya gobhiḥ samā gatiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: janmapraBfti satyaM ca yo brUyAnniyatendriyaH । gurudvijasahaH kzAntastasya goBiH samA gatiH ॥20॥

text: na jātu brāhmaṇo vācyo yadavācyaṃ śacīpate । manasā goṣu na druhyedgovṛttirgonukampakaḥ ॥21॥
html:
na jātu brāhmaṇo vācyo yadavācyaṃ śacīpate ।
manasā goṣu na druhyedgovṛttirgonukampakaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: na jAtu brAhmaRo vAcyo yadavAcyaM SacIpate । manasA gozu na druhyedgovfttirgonukampakaH ॥21॥

text: satye dharme ca niratastasya śakra phalaṃ śṛṇu । gosahasreṇa samitā tasya dhenurbhavatyuta ॥22॥
html:
satye dharme ca niratastasya śakra phalaṃ śṛṇu ।
gosahasreṇa samitā tasya dhenurbhavatyuta ॥22॥
slp1: satye Darme ca niratastasya Sakra PalaM SfRu । gosahasreRa samitA tasya DenurBavatyuta ॥22॥

text: kṣatriyasya guṇairebhiranvitasya phalaṃ śṛṇu । tasyāpi śatatulyā gaurbhavatīti viniścayaḥ ॥23॥
html:
kṣatriyasya guṇairebhiranvitasya phalaṃ śṛṇu ।
tasyāpi śatatulyā gaurbhavatīti viniścayaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: kzatriyasya guREreBiranvitasya PalaM SfRu । tasyApi SatatulyA gOrBavatIti viniScayaH ॥23॥

text: vaiśyasyaite yadi guṇāstasya pañcāśataṃ bhavet । śūdrasyāpi vinītasya caturbhāgaphalaṃ smṛtam ॥24॥
html:
vaiśyasyaite yadi guṇāstasya pañcāśataṃ bhavet ।
śūdrasyāpi vinītasya caturbhāgaphalaṃ smṛtam ॥24॥
slp1: vESyasyEte yadi guRAstasya paYcASataM Bavet । SUdrasyApi vinItasya caturBAgaPalaM smftam ॥24॥

text: etaccaivaṃ yo'nutiṣṭheta yuktaḥ satyena yukto guruśuśrūṣayā ca । dāntaḥ kṣānto devatārcī praśāntaḥ śucirbuddho dharmaśīlo'nahaṃvāk ॥25॥
html:
etaccaivaṃ yo'nutiṣṭheta yuktaḥ satyena yukto guruśuśrūṣayā ca ।
dāntaḥ kṣānto devatārcī praśāntaḥ śucirbuddho dharmaśīlo'nahaṃvāk ॥25॥
slp1: etaccEvaM yo'nutizWeta yuktaH satyena yukto guruSuSrUzayA ca । dAntaH kzAnto devatArcI praSAntaH SucirbudDo DarmaSIlo'nahaMvAk ॥25॥

text: mahatphalaṃ prāpnute sa dvijāya dattvā dogdhrīṃ vidhinānena dhenum । nityaṃ dadyādekabhaktaḥ sadā ca satye sthito guruśuśrūṣitā ca ॥26॥
html:
mahatphalaṃ prāpnute sa dvijāya dattvā dogdhrīṃ vidhinānena dhenum ।
nityaṃ dadyādekabhaktaḥ sadā ca satye sthito guruśuśrūṣitā ca ॥26॥
slp1: mahatPalaM prApnute sa dvijAya dattvA dogDrIM viDinAnena Denum । nityaM dadyAdekaBaktaH sadA ca satye sTito guruSuSrUzitA ca ॥26॥

text: vedādhyāyī goṣu yo bhaktimāṃśca nityaṃ dṛṣṭvā yo'bhinandeta gāśca । ā jātito yaśca gavāṃ nameta idaṃ phalaṃ śakra nibodha tasya ॥27॥
html:
vedādhyāyī goṣu yo bhaktimāṃśca nityaṃ dṛṣṭvā yo'bhinandeta gāśca ।
ā jātito yaśca gavāṃ nameta idaṃ phalaṃ śakra nibodha tasya ॥27॥
slp1: vedADyAyI gozu yo BaktimAMSca nityaM dfzwvA yo'Binandeta gASca । A jAtito yaSca gavAM nameta idaM PalaM Sakra niboDa tasya ॥27॥

text: yatsyādiṣṭvā rājasūye phalaṃ tu yatsyādiṣṭvā bahunā kāñcanena । etattulyaṃ phalamasyāhuragryaṃ sarve santastvṛṣayo ye ca siddhāḥ ॥28॥
html:
yatsyādiṣṭvā rājasūye phalaṃ tu yatsyādiṣṭvā bahunā kāñcanena ।
etattulyaṃ phalamasyāhuragryaṃ sarve santastvṛṣayo ye ca siddhāḥ ॥28॥
slp1: yatsyAdizwvA rAjasUye PalaM tu yatsyAdizwvA bahunA kAYcanena । etattulyaM PalamasyAhuragryaM sarve santastvfzayo ye ca sidDAH ॥28॥

text: yo'graṃ bhaktānkiñcidaprāśya dadyādgobhyo nityaṃ govratī satyavādī । śānto buddho gosahasrasya puṇyaṃ saṃvatsareṇāpnuyātpuṇyaśīlaḥ ॥29॥
html:
yo'graṃ bhaktānkiñcidaprāśya dadyādgobhyo nityaṃ govratī satyavādī ।
śānto buddho gosahasrasya puṇyaṃ saṃvatsareṇāpnuyātpuṇyaśīlaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: yo'graM BaktAnkiYcidaprASya dadyAdgoByo nityaM govratI satyavAdI । SAnto budDo gosahasrasya puRyaM saMvatsareRApnuyAtpuRyaSIlaH ॥29॥

text: ya ekaṃ bhaktamaśnīyāddadyādekaṃ gavāṃ ca yat । daśa varṣāṇyanantāni govratī gonukampakaḥ ॥30॥
html:
ya ekaṃ bhaktamaśnīyāddadyādekaṃ gavāṃ ca yat ।
daśa varṣāṇyanantāni govratī gonukampakaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: ya ekaM BaktamaSnIyAddadyAdekaM gavAM ca yat । daSa varzARyanantAni govratI gonukampakaH ॥30॥

text: ekenaiva ca bhaktena yaḥ krītvā gāṃ prayacchati । yāvanti tasya proktāni divasāni śatakrato । tāvacchatānāṃ sa gavāṃ phalamāpnoti śāśvatam ॥31॥
html:
ekenaiva ca bhaktena yaḥ krītvā gāṃ prayacchati ।
yāvanti tasya proktāni divasāni śatakrato ।
tāvacchatānāṃ sa gavāṃ phalamāpnoti śāśvatam ॥31॥
slp1: ekenEva ca Baktena yaH krItvA gAM prayacCati । yAvanti tasya proktAni divasAni Satakrato । tAvacCatAnAM sa gavAM PalamApnoti SASvatam ॥31॥

text: brāhmaṇasya phalaṃ hīdaṃ kṣatriye'bhihitaṃ śṛṇu । pañcavārṣikametattu kṣatriyasya phalaṃ smṛtam । tato'rdhena tu vaiśyasya śūdro vaiśyārdhataḥ smṛtaḥ ॥32॥
html:
brāhmaṇasya phalaṃ hīdaṃ kṣatriye'bhihitaṃ śṛṇu ।
pañcavārṣikametattu kṣatriyasya phalaṃ smṛtam ।
tato'rdhena tu vaiśyasya śūdro vaiśyārdhataḥ smṛtaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: brAhmaRasya PalaM hIdaM kzatriye'BihitaM SfRu । paYcavArzikametattu kzatriyasya PalaM smftam । tato'rDena tu vESyasya SUdro vESyArDataH smftaH ॥32॥

text: yaścātmavikrayaṃ kṛtvā gāḥ krītvā samprayacchati । yāvatīḥ sparśayedgā vai tāvattu phalamaśnute । lomni lomni mahābhāga lokāścāsyākṣayāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥33॥
html:
yaścātmavikrayaṃ kṛtvā gāḥ krītvā samprayacchati ।
yāvatīḥ sparśayedgā vai tāvattu phalamaśnute ।
lomni lomni mahābhāga lokāścāsyākṣayāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥33॥
slp1: yaScAtmavikrayaM kftvA gAH krItvA samprayacCati । yAvatIH sparSayedgA vE tAvattu PalamaSnute । lomni lomni mahABAga lokAScAsyAkzayAH smftAH ॥33॥

text: saṅgrāmeṣvarjayitvā tu yo vai gāḥ samprayacchati । ātmavikrayatulyāstāḥ śāśvatā viddhi kauśika ॥34॥
html:
saṅgrāmeṣvarjayitvā tu yo vai gāḥ samprayacchati ।
ātmavikrayatulyāstāḥ śāśvatā viddhi kauśika ॥34॥
slp1: saNgrAmezvarjayitvA tu yo vE gAH samprayacCati । AtmavikrayatulyAstAH SASvatA vidDi kOSika ॥34॥

text: alābhe yo gavāṃ dadyāttiladhenuṃ yatavrataḥ । durgātsa tārito dhenvā kṣīranadyāṃ pramodate ॥35॥
html:
alābhe yo gavāṃ dadyāttiladhenuṃ yatavrataḥ ।
durgātsa tārito dhenvā kṣīranadyāṃ pramodate ॥35॥
slp1: alABe yo gavAM dadyAttilaDenuM yatavrataH । durgAtsa tArito DenvA kzIranadyAM pramodate ॥35॥

text: na tvevāsāṃ dānamātraṃ praśastaṃ pātraṃ kālo goviśeṣo vidhiśca । kālajñānaṃ vipra gavāntaraṃ hi duḥkhaṃ jñātuṃ pāvakādityabhūtam ॥36॥
html:
na tvevāsāṃ dānamātraṃ praśastaṃ pātraṃ kālo goviśeṣo vidhiśca ।
kālajñānaṃ vipra gavāntaraṃ hi duḥkhaṃ jñātuṃ pāvakādityabhūtam ॥36॥
slp1: na tvevAsAM dAnamAtraM praSastaM pAtraM kAlo goviSezo viDiSca । kAlajYAnaM vipra gavAntaraM hi duHKaM jYAtuM pAvakAdityaBUtam ॥36॥

text: svādhyāyāḍhyaṃ śuddhayoniṃ praśāntaṃ vaitānasthaṃ pāpabhīruṃ kṛtajñam । goṣu kṣāntaṃ nātitīkṣṇaṃ śaraṇyaṃ vṛttiglānaṃ tādṛśaṃ pātramāhuḥ ॥37॥
html:
svādhyāyāḍhyaṃ śuddhayoniṃ praśāntaṃ vaitānasthaṃ pāpabhīruṃ kṛtajñam ।
goṣu kṣāntaṃ nātitīkṣṇaṃ śaraṇyaṃ vṛttiglānaṃ tādṛśaṃ pātramāhuḥ ॥37॥
slp1: svADyAyAQyaM SudDayoniM praSAntaM vEtAnasTaM pApaBIruM kftajYam । gozu kzAntaM nAtitIkzRaM SaraRyaM vfttiglAnaM tAdfSaM pAtramAhuH ॥37॥

text: vṛttiglāne sīdati cātimātraṃ kṛṣyarthaṃ vā homahetoḥ prasūtyām । gurvarthaṃ vā bālasaṃvṛddhaye vā dhenuṃ dadyāddeśakāle viśiṣṭe ॥38॥
html:
vṛttiglāne sīdati cātimātraṃ kṛṣyarthaṃ vā homahetoḥ prasūtyām ।
gurvarthaṃ vā bālasaṃvṛddhaye vā dhenuṃ dadyāddeśakāle viśiṣṭe ॥38॥
slp1: vfttiglAne sIdati cAtimAtraM kfzyarTaM vA homahetoH prasUtyAm । gurvarTaM vA bAlasaMvfdDaye vA DenuM dadyAddeSakAle viSizwe ॥38॥

text: antarjātāḥ sukrayajñānalabdhāḥ prāṇakrītā nirjitāścaukajāśca । kṛcchrotsṛṣṭāḥ poṣaṇābhyāgatāśca dvārairetairgoviśeṣāḥ praśastāḥ ॥39॥
html:
antarjātāḥ sukrayajñānalabdhāḥ prāṇakrītā nirjitāścaukajāśca ।
kṛcchrotsṛṣṭāḥ poṣaṇābhyāgatāśca dvārairetairgoviśeṣāḥ praśastāḥ ॥39॥
slp1: antarjAtAH sukrayajYAnalabDAH prARakrItA nirjitAScOkajASca । kfcCrotsfzwAH pozaRAByAgatASca dvArEretErgoviSezAH praSastAH ॥39॥

text: balānvitāḥ śīlavayopapannāḥ sarvāḥ praśaṃsanti sugandhavatyaḥ । yathā hi gaṅgā saritāṃ variṣṭhā tathārjunīnāṃ kapilā variṣṭhā ॥40॥
html:
balānvitāḥ śīlavayopapannāḥ sarvāḥ praśaṃsanti sugandhavatyaḥ ।
yathā hi gaṅgā saritāṃ variṣṭhā tathārjunīnāṃ kapilā variṣṭhā ॥40॥
slp1: balAnvitAH SIlavayopapannAH sarvAH praSaMsanti suganDavatyaH । yaTA hi gaNgA saritAM varizWA taTArjunInAM kapilA varizWA ॥40॥

text: tisro rātrīstvadbhirupoṣya bhūmau tṛptā gāvastarpitebhyaḥ pradeyāḥ । vatsaiḥ puṣṭaiḥ kṣīrapaiḥ supracārāstryahaṃ dattvā gorasairvartitavyam ॥41॥
html:
tisro rātrīstvadbhirupoṣya bhūmau tṛptā gāvastarpitebhyaḥ pradeyāḥ ।
vatsaiḥ puṣṭaiḥ kṣīrapaiḥ supracārāstryahaṃ dattvā gorasairvartitavyam ॥41॥
slp1: tisro rAtrIstvadBirupozya BUmO tfptA gAvastarpiteByaH pradeyAH । vatsEH puzwEH kzIrapEH supracArAstryahaM dattvA gorasErvartitavyam ॥41॥

text: dattvā dhenuṃ suvratāṃ sādhuvatsāṃ kalyāṇavṛttāmapalāyinīṃ ca । yāvanti lomāni bhavanti tasyāstāvanti varṣāṇi vasatyamutra ॥42॥
html:
dattvā dhenuṃ suvratāṃ sādhuvatsāṃ kalyāṇavṛttāmapalāyinīṃ ca ।
yāvanti lomāni bhavanti tasyāstāvanti varṣāṇi vasatyamutra ॥42॥
slp1: dattvA DenuM suvratAM sADuvatsAM kalyARavfttAmapalAyinIM ca । yAvanti lomAni Bavanti tasyAstAvanti varzARi vasatyamutra ॥42॥

text: tathānaḍvāhaṃ brāhmaṇāyātha dhuryaṃ dattvā yuvānaṃ balinaṃ vinītam । halasya voḍhāramanantavīryaṃ prāpnoti lokāndaśadhenudasya ॥43॥
html:
tathānaḍvāhaṃ brāhmaṇāyātha dhuryaṃ dattvā yuvānaṃ balinaṃ vinītam ।
halasya voḍhāramanantavīryaṃ prāpnoti lokāndaśadhenudasya ॥43॥
slp1: taTAnaqvAhaM brAhmaRAyATa DuryaM dattvA yuvAnaM balinaM vinItam । halasya voQAramanantavIryaM prApnoti lokAndaSaDenudasya ॥43॥

text: kāntāre brāhmaṇāngāśca yaḥ paritrāti kauśika । kṣemeṇa ca vimucyeta tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu । aśvamedhakratostulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavati śāśvatam ॥44॥
html:
kāntāre brāhmaṇāngāśca yaḥ paritrāti kauśika ।
kṣemeṇa ca vimucyeta tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ।
aśvamedhakratostulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavati śāśvatam ॥44॥
slp1: kAntAre brAhmaRAngASca yaH paritrAti kOSika । kzemeRa ca vimucyeta tasya puRyaPalaM SfRu । aSvameDakratostulyaM PalaM Bavati SASvatam ॥44॥

text: mṛtyukāle sahasrākṣa yāṃ vṛttimanukāṅkṣate । lokānbahuvidhāndivyānyadvāsya hṛdi vartate ॥45॥
html:
mṛtyukāle sahasrākṣa yāṃ vṛttimanukāṅkṣate ।
lokānbahuvidhāndivyānyadvāsya hṛdi vartate ॥45॥
slp1: mftyukAle sahasrAkza yAM vfttimanukANkzate । lokAnbahuviDAndivyAnyadvAsya hfdi vartate ॥45॥

text: tatsarvaṃ samavāpnoti karmaṇā tena mānavaḥ । gobhiśca samanujñātaḥ sarvatra sa mahīyate ॥46॥
html:
tatsarvaṃ samavāpnoti karmaṇā tena mānavaḥ ।
gobhiśca samanujñātaḥ sarvatra sa mahīyate ॥46॥
slp1: tatsarvaM samavApnoti karmaRA tena mAnavaH । goBiSca samanujYAtaH sarvatra sa mahIyate ॥46॥

text: yastvetenaiva vidhinā gāṃ vaneṣvanugacchati । tṛṇagomayaparṇāśī niḥspṛho niyataḥ śuciḥ ॥47॥
html:
yastvetenaiva vidhinā gāṃ vaneṣvanugacchati ।
tṛṇagomayaparṇāśī niḥspṛho niyataḥ śuciḥ ॥47॥
slp1: yastvetenEva viDinA gAM vanezvanugacCati । tfRagomayaparRASI niHspfho niyataH SuciH ॥47॥

text: akāmaṃ tena vastavyaṃ muditena śatakrato । mama loke suraiḥ sārdhaṃ loke yatrāpi cecchati] ॥48॥
html:
akāmaṃ tena vastavyaṃ muditena śatakrato ।
mama loke suraiḥ sārdhaṃ loke yatrāpi cecchati] ॥48॥
slp1: akAmaM tena vastavyaM muditena Satakrato । mama loke surEH sArDaM loke yatrApi cecCati] ॥48॥

text: jānanyo gāmapaharedvikrīyādvārthakāraṇāt । etadvijñātumicchāmi kā nu tasya gatirbhavet ॥1॥
html:
jānanyo gāmapaharedvikrīyādvārthakāraṇāt ।
etadvijñātumicchāmi kā nu tasya gatirbhavet ॥1॥
slp1: jAnanyo gAmapaharedvikrIyAdvArTakAraRAt । etadvijYAtumicCAmi kA nu tasya gatirBavet ॥1॥
author: indra uvāca ।

text: bhakṣārthaṃ vikrayārthaṃ vā ye'pahāraṃ hi kurvate । dānārthaṃ vā brāhmaṇāya tatredaṃ śrūyatāṃ phalam ॥2॥
html:
bhakṣārthaṃ vikrayārthaṃ vā ye'pahāraṃ hi kurvate ।
dānārthaṃ vā brāhmaṇāya tatredaṃ śrūyatāṃ phalam ॥2॥
slp1: BakzArTaM vikrayArTaM vA ye'pahAraM hi kurvate । dAnArTaM vA brAhmaRAya tatredaM SrUyatAM Palam ॥2॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: vikrayārthaṃ hi yo hiṃsyādbhakṣayedvā niraṅkuśaḥ । ghātayānaṃ hi puruṣaṃ ye'numanyeyurarthinaḥ ॥3॥
html:
vikrayārthaṃ hi yo hiṃsyādbhakṣayedvā niraṅkuśaḥ ।
ghātayānaṃ hi puruṣaṃ ye'numanyeyurarthinaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: vikrayArTaM hi yo hiMsyAdBakzayedvA niraNkuSaH । GAtayAnaM hi puruzaM ye'numanyeyurarTinaH ॥3॥

text: ghātakaḥ khādako vāpi tathā yaścānumanyate । yāvanti tasyā lomāni tāvadvarṣāṇi majjati ॥4॥
html:
ghātakaḥ khādako vāpi tathā yaścānumanyate ।
yāvanti tasyā lomāni tāvadvarṣāṇi majjati ॥4॥
slp1: GAtakaH KAdako vApi taTA yaScAnumanyate । yAvanti tasyA lomAni tAvadvarzARi majjati ॥4॥

text: ye doṣā yādṛśāścaiva dvijayajñopaghātake । vikraye cāpahāre ca te doṣā vai smṛtāḥ prabho ॥5॥
html:
ye doṣā yādṛśāścaiva dvijayajñopaghātake ।
vikraye cāpahāre ca te doṣā vai smṛtāḥ prabho ॥5॥
slp1: ye dozA yAdfSAScEva dvijayajYopaGAtake । vikraye cApahAre ca te dozA vE smftAH praBo ॥5॥

text: apahṛtya tu yo gāṃ vai brāhmaṇāya prayacchati । yāvaddāne phalaṃ tasyāstāvannirayamṛcchati ॥6॥
html:
apahṛtya tu yo gāṃ vai brāhmaṇāya prayacchati ।
yāvaddāne phalaṃ tasyāstāvannirayamṛcchati ॥6॥
slp1: apahftya tu yo gAM vE brAhmaRAya prayacCati । yAvaddAne PalaM tasyAstAvannirayamfcCati ॥6॥

text: suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāmāhurgopradāne mahādyute । suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ hyuktaṃ dakṣiṇārthamasaṃśayam ॥7॥
html:
suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāmāhurgopradāne mahādyute ।
suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ hyuktaṃ dakṣiṇārthamasaṃśayam ॥7॥
slp1: suvarRaM dakziRAmAhurgopradAne mahAdyute । suvarRaM paramaM hyuktaM dakziRArTamasaMSayam ॥7॥

text: gopradānaṃ tārayate sapta pūrvāṃstathā parān । suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā tāvaddviguṇamucyate ॥8॥
html:
gopradānaṃ tārayate sapta pūrvāṃstathā parān ।
suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā tāvaddviguṇamucyate ॥8॥
slp1: gopradAnaM tArayate sapta pUrvAMstaTA parAn । suvarRaM dakziRAM dattvA tAvaddviguRamucyate ॥8॥

text: suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā parā । suvarṇaṃ pāvanaṃ śakra pāvanānāṃ paraṃ smṛtam ॥9॥
html:
suvarṇaṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇā parā ।
suvarṇaṃ pāvanaṃ śakra pāvanānāṃ paraṃ smṛtam ॥9॥
slp1: suvarRaM paramaM dAnaM suvarRaM dakziRA parA । suvarRaM pAvanaM Sakra pAvanAnAM paraM smftam ॥9॥

text: kulānāṃ pāvanaṃ prāhurjātarūpaṃ śatakrato । eṣā me dakṣiṇā proktā samāsena mahādyute ॥10॥
html:
kulānāṃ pāvanaṃ prāhurjātarūpaṃ śatakrato ।
eṣā me dakṣiṇā proktā samāsena mahādyute ॥10॥
slp1: kulAnAM pAvanaM prAhurjAtarUpaM Satakrato । ezA me dakziRA proktA samAsena mahAdyute ॥10॥

text: etatpitāmahenoktamindrāya bharatarṣabha । indro daśarathāyāha rāmāyāha pitā tathā ॥11॥
html:
etatpitāmahenoktamindrāya bharatarṣabha ।
indro daśarathāyāha rāmāyāha pitā tathā ॥11॥
slp1: etatpitAmahenoktamindrAya BaratarzaBa । indro daSaraTAyAha rAmAyAha pitA taTA ॥11॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: rāghavo'pi priyabhrātre lakṣmaṇāya yaśasvine । ṛṣibhyo lakṣmaṇenoktamaraṇye vasatā vibho ॥12॥
html:
rāghavo'pi priyabhrātre lakṣmaṇāya yaśasvine ।
ṛṣibhyo lakṣmaṇenoktamaraṇye vasatā vibho ॥12॥
slp1: rAGavo'pi priyaBrAtre lakzmaRAya yaSasvine । fziByo lakzmaRenoktamaraRye vasatA viBo ॥12॥

text: pāramparyāgataṃ cedamṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ । durdharaṃ dhārayāmāsū rājānaścaiva dhārmikāḥ । upādhyāyena gaditaṃ mama cedaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
html:
pāramparyāgataṃ cedamṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ।
durdharaṃ dhārayāmāsū rājānaścaiva dhārmikāḥ ।
upādhyāyena gaditaṃ mama cedaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
slp1: pAramparyAgataM cedamfzayaH saMSitavratAH । durDaraM DArayAmAsU rAjAnaScEva DArmikAH । upADyAyena gaditaM mama cedaM yuDizWira ॥13॥

text: ya idaṃ brāhmaṇo nityaṃ vadedbrāhmaṇasaṃsadi । yajñeṣu gopradāneṣu dvayorapi samāgame ॥14॥
html:
ya idaṃ brāhmaṇo nityaṃ vadedbrāhmaṇasaṃsadi ।
yajñeṣu gopradāneṣu dvayorapi samāgame ॥14॥
slp1: ya idaM brAhmaRo nityaM vadedbrAhmaRasaMsadi । yajYezu gopradAnezu dvayorapi samAgame ॥14॥

text: tasya lokāḥ kilākṣayyā daivataiḥ saha nityadā । iti brahmā sa bhagavānuvāca parameśvaraḥ] ॥15॥
html:
tasya lokāḥ kilākṣayyā daivataiḥ saha nityadā ।
iti brahmā sa bhagavānuvāca parameśvaraḥ] ॥15॥
slp1: tasya lokAH kilAkzayyA dEvatEH saha nityadA । iti brahmA sa BagavAnuvAca parameSvaraH] ॥15॥

text: visrambhito'haṃ bhavatā dharmānpravadatā vibho । pravakṣyāmi tu sandehaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
visrambhito'haṃ bhavatā dharmānpravadatā vibho ।
pravakṣyāmi tu sandehaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: visramBito'haM BavatA DarmAnpravadatA viBo । pravakzyAmi tu sandehaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: vratānāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ proktaṃ kīdṛśaṃ vā mahādyute । niyamānāṃ phalaṃ kiṃ ca svadhītasya ca kiṃ phalam ॥2॥
html:
vratānāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ proktaṃ kīdṛśaṃ vā mahādyute ।
niyamānāṃ phalaṃ kiṃ ca svadhītasya ca kiṃ phalam ॥2॥
slp1: vratAnAM kiM PalaM proktaM kIdfSaM vA mahAdyute । niyamAnAM PalaM kiM ca svaDItasya ca kiM Palam ॥2॥

text: damasyeha phalaṃ kiṃ ca vedānāṃ dhāraṇe ca kim । adhyāpane phalaṃ kiṃ ca sarvamicchāmi veditum ॥3॥
html:
damasyeha phalaṃ kiṃ ca vedānāṃ dhāraṇe ca kim ।
adhyāpane phalaṃ kiṃ ca sarvamicchāmi veditum ॥3॥
slp1: damasyeha PalaM kiM ca vedAnAM DAraRe ca kim । aDyApane PalaM kiM ca sarvamicCAmi veditum ॥3॥

text: apratigrāhake kiṃ ca phalaṃ loke pitāmaha । tasya kiṃ ca phalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ yaḥ samprayacchati ॥4॥
html:
apratigrāhake kiṃ ca phalaṃ loke pitāmaha ।
tasya kiṃ ca phalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ yaḥ samprayacchati ॥4॥
slp1: apratigrAhake kiM ca PalaM loke pitAmaha । tasya kiM ca PalaM dfzwaM SrutaM yaH samprayacCati ॥4॥

text: svakarmaniratānāṃ ca śūrāṇāṃ cāpi kiṃ phalam । satye ca kiṃ phalaṃ proktaṃ brahmacarye ca kiṃ phalam ॥5॥
html:
svakarmaniratānāṃ ca śūrāṇāṃ cāpi kiṃ phalam ।
satye ca kiṃ phalaṃ proktaṃ brahmacarye ca kiṃ phalam ॥5॥
slp1: svakarmaniratAnAM ca SUrARAM cApi kiM Palam । satye ca kiM PalaM proktaM brahmacarye ca kiM Palam ॥5॥

text: pitṛśuśrūṣaṇe kiṃ ca mātṛśuśrūṣaṇe tathā । ācāryaguruśuśrūṣāsvanukrośānukampane ॥6॥
html:
pitṛśuśrūṣaṇe kiṃ ca mātṛśuśrūṣaṇe tathā ।
ācāryaguruśuśrūṣāsvanukrośānukampane ॥6॥
slp1: pitfSuSrUzaRe kiM ca mAtfSuSrUzaRe taTA । AcAryaguruSuSrUzAsvanukroSAnukampane ॥6॥

text: etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa pitāmaha yathātatham । vettumicchāmi dharmajña paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥7॥
html:
etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa pitāmaha yathātatham ।
vettumicchāmi dharmajña paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥7॥
slp1: etatsarvamaSezeRa pitAmaha yaTAtaTam । vettumicCAmi DarmajYa paraM kOtUhalaM hi me ॥7॥

text: yo vrataṃ vai yathoddiṣṭaṃ tathā sampratipadyate । akhaṇḍaṃ samyagārabdhaṃ tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥8॥
html:
yo vrataṃ vai yathoddiṣṭaṃ tathā sampratipadyate ।
akhaṇḍaṃ samyagārabdhaṃ tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yo vrataM vE yaToddizwaM taTA sampratipadyate । aKaRqaM samyagArabDaM tasya lokAH sanAtanAH ॥8॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: niyamānāṃ phalaṃ rājanpratyakṣamiha dṛśyate । niyamānāṃ kratūnāṃ ca tvayāvāptamidaṃ phalam ॥9॥
html:
niyamānāṃ phalaṃ rājanpratyakṣamiha dṛśyate ।
niyamānāṃ kratūnāṃ ca tvayāvāptamidaṃ phalam ॥9॥
slp1: niyamAnAM PalaM rAjanpratyakzamiha dfSyate । niyamAnAM kratUnAM ca tvayAvAptamidaM Palam ॥9॥

text: svadhītasyāpi ca phalaṃ dṛśyate'mutra ceha ca । ihaloke'rthavānnityaṃ brahmaloke ca modate ॥10॥
html:
svadhītasyāpi ca phalaṃ dṛśyate'mutra ceha ca ।
ihaloke'rthavānnityaṃ brahmaloke ca modate ॥10॥
slp1: svaDItasyApi ca PalaM dfSyate'mutra ceha ca । ihaloke'rTavAnnityaM brahmaloke ca modate ॥10॥

text: damasya tu phalaṃ rājañśṛṇu tvaṃ vistareṇa me । dāntāḥ sarvatra sukhino dāntāḥ sarvatra nirvṛtāḥ ॥11॥
html:
damasya tu phalaṃ rājañśṛṇu tvaṃ vistareṇa me ।
dāntāḥ sarvatra sukhino dāntāḥ sarvatra nirvṛtāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: damasya tu PalaM rAjaYSfRu tvaM vistareRa me । dAntAH sarvatra suKino dAntAH sarvatra nirvftAH ॥11॥

text: yatrecchāgāmino dāntāḥ sarvaśatruniṣūdanāḥ । prārthayanti ca yaddāntā labhante tanna saṃśayaḥ ॥12॥
html:
yatrecchāgāmino dāntāḥ sarvaśatruniṣūdanāḥ ।
prārthayanti ca yaddāntā labhante tanna saṃśayaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: yatrecCAgAmino dAntAH sarvaSatrunizUdanAH । prArTayanti ca yaddAntA laBante tanna saMSayaH ॥12॥

text: yujyante sarvakāmairhi dāntāḥ sarvatra pāṇḍava । svarge tathā pramodante tapasā vikrameṇa ca ॥13॥
html:
yujyante sarvakāmairhi dāntāḥ sarvatra pāṇḍava ।
svarge tathā pramodante tapasā vikrameṇa ca ॥13॥
slp1: yujyante sarvakAmErhi dAntAH sarvatra pARqava । svarge taTA pramodante tapasA vikrameRa ca ॥13॥

text: dānairyajñaiśca vividhairyathā dāntāḥ kṣamānvitāḥ । dātā kupyati no dāntastasmāddānātparo damaḥ ॥14॥
html:
dānairyajñaiśca vividhairyathā dāntāḥ kṣamānvitāḥ ।
dātā kupyati no dāntastasmāddānātparo damaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: dAnEryajYESca viviDEryaTA dAntAH kzamAnvitAH । dAtA kupyati no dAntastasmAddAnAtparo damaH ॥14॥

text: yastu dadyādakupyanhi tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ । krodho hanti hi yaddānaṃ tasmāddānātparo damaḥ ॥15॥
html:
yastu dadyādakupyanhi tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ।
krodho hanti hi yaddānaṃ tasmāddānātparo damaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yastu dadyAdakupyanhi tasya lokAH sanAtanAH । kroDo hanti hi yaddAnaM tasmAddAnAtparo damaH ॥15॥

text: adṛśyāni mahārāja sthānānyayutaśo divi । ṛṣīṇāṃ sarvalokeṣu yānīto yānti devatāḥ ॥16॥
html:
adṛśyāni mahārāja sthānānyayutaśo divi ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ sarvalokeṣu yānīto yānti devatāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: adfSyAni mahArAja sTAnAnyayutaSo divi । fzIRAM sarvalokezu yAnIto yAnti devatAH ॥16॥

text: damena yāni nṛpate gacchanti paramarṣayaḥ । kāmayānā mahatsthānaṃ tasmāddānātparo damaḥ ॥17॥
html:
damena yāni nṛpate gacchanti paramarṣayaḥ ।
kāmayānā mahatsthānaṃ tasmāddānātparo damaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: damena yAni nfpate gacCanti paramarzayaH । kAmayAnA mahatsTAnaM tasmAddAnAtparo damaH ॥17॥

text: adhyāpakaḥ parikleśādakṣayaṃ phalamaśnute । vidhivatpāvakaṃ hutvā brahmaloke narādhipa ॥18॥
html:
adhyāpakaḥ parikleśādakṣayaṃ phalamaśnute ।
vidhivatpāvakaṃ hutvā brahmaloke narādhipa ॥18॥
slp1: aDyApakaH parikleSAdakzayaM PalamaSnute । viDivatpAvakaM hutvA brahmaloke narADipa ॥18॥

text: adhītyāpi hi yo vedānnyāyavidbhyaḥ prayacchati । gurukarmapraśaṃsī ca so'pi svarge mahīyate ॥19॥
html:
adhītyāpi hi yo vedānnyāyavidbhyaḥ prayacchati ।
gurukarmapraśaṃsī ca so'pi svarge mahīyate ॥19॥
slp1: aDItyApi hi yo vedAnnyAyavidByaH prayacCati । gurukarmapraSaMsI ca so'pi svarge mahIyate ॥19॥

text: kṣatriyo'dhyayane yukto yajane dānakarmaṇi । yuddhe yaśca paritrātā so'pi svarge mahīyate ॥20॥
html:
kṣatriyo'dhyayane yukto yajane dānakarmaṇi ।
yuddhe yaśca paritrātā so'pi svarge mahīyate ॥20॥
slp1: kzatriyo'Dyayane yukto yajane dAnakarmaRi । yudDe yaSca paritrAtA so'pi svarge mahIyate ॥20॥

text: vaiśyaḥ svakarmanirataḥ pradānāllabhate mahat । śūdraḥ svakarmanirataḥ svargaṃ śuśrūṣayārcchati ॥21॥
html:
vaiśyaḥ svakarmanirataḥ pradānāllabhate mahat ।
śūdraḥ svakarmanirataḥ svargaṃ śuśrūṣayārcchati ॥21॥
slp1: vESyaH svakarmanirataH pradAnAllaBate mahat । SUdraH svakarmanirataH svargaM SuSrUzayArcCati ॥21॥

text: śūrā bahuvidhāḥ proktāsteṣāmarthāṃśca me śṛṇu । śūrānvayānāṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ phalaṃ śūrasya caiva ha ॥22॥
html:
śūrā bahuvidhāḥ proktāsteṣāmarthāṃśca me śṛṇu ।
śūrānvayānāṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ phalaṃ śūrasya caiva ha ॥22॥
slp1: SUrA bahuviDAH proktAstezAmarTAMSca me SfRu । SUrAnvayAnAM nirdizwaM PalaM SUrasya cEva ha ॥22॥

text: yajñaśūrā dame śūrāḥ satyaśūrāstathāpare । yuddhaśūrāstathaivoktā dānaśūrāśca mānavāḥ ॥23॥
html:
yajñaśūrā dame śūrāḥ satyaśūrāstathāpare ।
yuddhaśūrāstathaivoktā dānaśūrāśca mānavāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: yajYaSUrA dame SUrAH satyaSUrAstaTApare । yudDaSUrAstaTEvoktA dAnaSUrASca mAnavAH ॥23॥

text: buddhiśūrāstathaivānye kṣamāśūrāstathāpare । ārjave ca tathā śūrāḥ śame vartanti mānavāḥ ॥24॥
html:
buddhiśūrāstathaivānye kṣamāśūrāstathāpare ।
ārjave ca tathā śūrāḥ śame vartanti mānavāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: budDiSUrAstaTEvAnye kzamASUrAstaTApare । Arjave ca taTA SUrAH Same vartanti mAnavAH ॥24॥

text: taistaistu niyamaiḥ śūrā bahavaḥ santi cāpare । vedādhyayanaśūrāśca śūrāścādhyāpane ratāḥ ॥25॥
html:
taistaistu niyamaiḥ śūrā bahavaḥ santi cāpare ।
vedādhyayanaśūrāśca śūrāścādhyāpane ratāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: tEstEstu niyamEH SUrA bahavaH santi cApare । vedADyayanaSUrASca SUrAScADyApane ratAH ॥25॥

text: guruśuśrūṣayā śūrāḥ pitṛśuśrūṣayāpare । mātṛśuśrūṣayā śūrā bhaikṣyaśūrāstathāpare ॥26॥
html:
guruśuśrūṣayā śūrāḥ pitṛśuśrūṣayāpare ।
mātṛśuśrūṣayā śūrā bhaikṣyaśūrāstathāpare ॥26॥
slp1: guruSuSrUzayA SUrAH pitfSuSrUzayApare । mAtfSuSrUzayA SUrA BEkzyaSUrAstaTApare ॥26॥

text: sāṅkhyaśūrāśca bahavo yogaśūrāstathāpare । araṇye gṛhavāse ca śūrāścātithipūjane । sarve yānti parāṁllokānsvakarmaphalanirjitān ॥27॥
html:
sāṅkhyaśūrāśca bahavo yogaśūrāstathāpare ।
araṇye gṛhavāse ca śūrāścātithipūjane ।
sarve yānti parāṁllokānsvakarmaphalanirjitān ॥27॥
slp1: sANKyaSUrASca bahavo yogaSUrAstaTApare । araRye gfhavAse ca SUrAScAtiTipUjane । sarve yAnti parAṁllokAnsvakarmaPalanirjitAn ॥27॥

text: dhāraṇaṃ sarvavedānāṃ sarvatīrthāvagāhanam । satyaṃ ca bruvato nityaṃ samaṃ vā syānna vā samam ॥28॥
html:
dhāraṇaṃ sarvavedānāṃ sarvatīrthāvagāhanam ।
satyaṃ ca bruvato nityaṃ samaṃ vā syānna vā samam ॥28॥
slp1: DAraRaM sarvavedAnAM sarvatIrTAvagAhanam । satyaM ca bruvato nityaM samaM vA syAnna vA samam ॥28॥

text: aśvamedhasahasraṃ ca satyaṃ ca tulayā dhṛtam । aśvamedhasahasrāddhi satyameva viśiṣyate ॥29॥
html:
aśvamedhasahasraṃ ca satyaṃ ca tulayā dhṛtam ।
aśvamedhasahasrāddhi satyameva viśiṣyate ॥29॥
slp1: aSvameDasahasraM ca satyaM ca tulayA Dftam । aSvameDasahasrAdDi satyameva viSizyate ॥29॥

text: satyena sūryastapati satyenāgniḥ pradīpyate । satyena māruto vāti sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam ॥30॥
html:
satyena sūryastapati satyenāgniḥ pradīpyate ।
satyena māruto vāti sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam ॥30॥
slp1: satyena sUryastapati satyenAgniH pradIpyate । satyena mAruto vAti sarvaM satye pratizWitam ॥30॥

text: satyena devānprīṇāti pitṝnvai brāhmaṇāṃstathā । satyamāhuḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ tasmātsatyaṃ na laṅghayet ॥31॥
html:
satyena devānprīṇāti pitṝnvai brāhmaṇāṃstathā ।
satyamāhuḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ tasmātsatyaṃ na laṅghayet ॥31॥
slp1: satyena devAnprIRAti pitFnvE brAhmaRAMstaTA । satyamAhuH paraM DarmaM tasmAtsatyaM na laNGayet ॥31॥

text: munayaḥ satyaniratā munayaḥ satyavikramāḥ । munayaḥ satyaśapathāstasmātsatyaṃ viśiṣyate । satyavantaḥ svargaloke modante bharatarṣabha ॥32॥
html:
munayaḥ satyaniratā munayaḥ satyavikramāḥ ।
munayaḥ satyaśapathāstasmātsatyaṃ viśiṣyate ।
satyavantaḥ svargaloke modante bharatarṣabha ॥32॥
slp1: munayaH satyaniratA munayaH satyavikramAH । munayaH satyaSapaTAstasmAtsatyaM viSizyate । satyavantaH svargaloke modante BaratarzaBa ॥32॥

text: damaḥ satyaphalāvāptiruktā sarvātmanā mayā । asaṃśayaṃ vinītātmā sarvaḥ svarge mahīyate ॥33॥
html:
damaḥ satyaphalāvāptiruktā sarvātmanā mayā ।
asaṃśayaṃ vinītātmā sarvaḥ svarge mahīyate ॥33॥
slp1: damaH satyaPalAvAptiruktA sarvAtmanA mayA । asaMSayaM vinItAtmA sarvaH svarge mahIyate ॥33॥

text: brahmacaryasya tu guṇāñśṛṇu me vasudhādhipa । ā janmamaraṇādyastu brahmacārī bhavediha । na tasya kiñcidaprāpyamiti viddhi janādhipa ॥34॥
html:
brahmacaryasya tu guṇāñśṛṇu me vasudhādhipa ।
ā janmamaraṇādyastu brahmacārī bhavediha ।
na tasya kiñcidaprāpyamiti viddhi janādhipa ॥34॥
slp1: brahmacaryasya tu guRAYSfRu me vasuDADipa । A janmamaraRAdyastu brahmacArI Bavediha । na tasya kiYcidaprApyamiti vidDi janADipa ॥34॥

text: bahvyaḥ koṭyastvṛṣīṇāṃ tu brahmaloke vasantyuta । satye ratānāṃ satataṃ dāntānāmūrdhvaretasām ॥35॥
html:
bahvyaḥ koṭyastvṛṣīṇāṃ tu brahmaloke vasantyuta ।
satye ratānāṃ satataṃ dāntānāmūrdhvaretasām ॥35॥
slp1: bahvyaH kowyastvfzIRAM tu brahmaloke vasantyuta । satye ratAnAM satataM dAntAnAmUrDvaretasAm ॥35॥

text: brahmacaryaṃ dahedrājansarvapāpānyupāsitam । brāhmaṇena viśeṣeṇa brāhmaṇo hyagnirucyate ॥36॥
html:
brahmacaryaṃ dahedrājansarvapāpānyupāsitam ।
brāhmaṇena viśeṣeṇa brāhmaṇo hyagnirucyate ॥36॥
slp1: brahmacaryaM dahedrAjansarvapApAnyupAsitam । brAhmaRena viSezeRa brAhmaRo hyagnirucyate ॥36॥

text: pratyakṣaṃ ca tavāpyetadbrāhmaṇeṣu tapasviṣu । bibheti hi yathā śakro brahmacāripradharṣitaḥ । tadbrahmacaryasya phalamṛṣīṇāmiha dṛśyate ॥37॥
html:
pratyakṣaṃ ca tavāpyetadbrāhmaṇeṣu tapasviṣu ।
bibheti hi yathā śakro brahmacāripradharṣitaḥ ।
tadbrahmacaryasya phalamṛṣīṇāmiha dṛśyate ॥37॥
slp1: pratyakzaM ca tavApyetadbrAhmaRezu tapasvizu । biBeti hi yaTA Sakro brahmacAripraDarzitaH । tadbrahmacaryasya PalamfzIRAmiha dfSyate ॥37॥

text: mātāpitroḥ pūjane yo dharmastamapi me śṛṇu । śuśrūṣate yaḥ pitaraṃ na cāsūyetkathañcana । mātaraṃ vānahaṃvādī gurumācāryameva ca ॥38॥
html:
mātāpitroḥ pūjane yo dharmastamapi me śṛṇu ।
śuśrūṣate yaḥ pitaraṃ na cāsūyetkathañcana ।
mātaraṃ vānahaṃvādī gurumācāryameva ca ॥38॥
slp1: mAtApitroH pUjane yo Darmastamapi me SfRu । SuSrUzate yaH pitaraM na cAsUyetkaTaYcana । mAtaraM vAnahaMvAdI gurumAcAryameva ca ॥38॥

text: tasya rājanphalaṃ viddhi svarloke sthānamuttamam । na ca paśyeta narakaṃ guruśuśrūṣurātmavān] ॥39॥
html:
tasya rājanphalaṃ viddhi svarloke sthānamuttamam ।
na ca paśyeta narakaṃ guruśuśrūṣurātmavān] ॥39॥
slp1: tasya rAjanPalaM vidDi svarloke sTAnamuttamam । na ca paSyeta narakaM guruSuSrUzurAtmavAn] ॥39॥

text: vidhiṃ gavāṃ paramahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ । yena tāñśāśvatāṁllokānakhilānaśnuvīmahi ॥1॥
html:
vidhiṃ gavāṃ paramahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ।
yena tāñśāśvatāṁllokānakhilānaśnuvīmahi ॥1॥
slp1: viDiM gavAM paramahaM SrotumicCAmi tattvataH । yena tAYSASvatAṁllokAnaKilAnaSnuvImahi ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: na godānātparaṃ kiñcidvidyate vasudhādhipa । gaurhi nyāyāgatā dattā sadyastārayate kulam ॥2॥
html:
na godānātparaṃ kiñcidvidyate vasudhādhipa ।
gaurhi nyāyāgatā dattā sadyastārayate kulam ॥2॥
slp1: na godAnAtparaM kiYcidvidyate vasuDADipa । gOrhi nyAyAgatA dattA sadyastArayate kulam ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: satāmarthe samyagutpādito yaḥ sa vai kḷptaḥ samyagiṣṭaḥ prajābhyaḥ । tasmātpūrvaṃ hyādikāle pravṛttaṃ gavāṃ dāne śṛṇu rājanvidhiṃ me ॥3॥
html:
satāmarthe samyagutpādito yaḥ sa vai kḷptaḥ samyagiṣṭaḥ prajābhyaḥ ।
tasmātpūrvaṃ hyādikāle pravṛttaṃ gavāṃ dāne śṛṇu rājanvidhiṃ me ॥3॥
slp1: satAmarTe samyagutpAdito yaH sa vE kxptaH samyagizwaH prajAByaH । tasmAtpUrvaM hyAdikAle pravfttaM gavAM dAne SfRu rAjanviDiM me ॥3॥

text: purā goṣūpanītāsu goṣu sandigdhadarśinā । māndhātrā prakṛtaṃ praśnaṃ bṛhaspatirabhāṣata ॥4॥
html:
purā goṣūpanītāsu goṣu sandigdhadarśinā ।
māndhātrā prakṛtaṃ praśnaṃ bṛhaspatirabhāṣata ॥4॥
