slp1: purA gozUpanItAsu gozu sandigDadarSinA । mAnDAtrA prakftaM praSnaM bfhaspatiraBAzata ॥4॥

text: dvijātimabhisatkṛtya śvaḥ kālamabhivedya ca । pradānārthe niyuñjīta rohiṇīṃ niyatavrataḥ ॥5॥
html:
dvijātimabhisatkṛtya śvaḥ kālamabhivedya ca ।
pradānārthe niyuñjīta rohiṇīṃ niyatavrataḥ ॥5॥
slp1: dvijAtimaBisatkftya SvaH kAlamaBivedya ca । pradAnArTe niyuYjIta rohiRIM niyatavrataH ॥5॥

text: āhvānaṃ ca prayuñjīta samaṅge bahuleti ca । praviśya ca gavāṃ madhyamimāṃ śrutimudāharet ॥6॥
html:
āhvānaṃ ca prayuñjīta samaṅge bahuleti ca ।
praviśya ca gavāṃ madhyamimāṃ śrutimudāharet ॥6॥
slp1: AhvAnaM ca prayuYjIta samaNge bahuleti ca । praviSya ca gavAM maDyamimAM SrutimudAharet ॥6॥

text: gaurme mātā govṛṣabhaḥ pitā me divaṃ śarma jagatī me pratiṣṭhā । prapadyaivaṃ śarvarīmuṣya goṣu munirvāṇīmutsṛjedgopradāne ॥7॥
html:
gaurme mātā govṛṣabhaḥ pitā me divaṃ śarma jagatī me pratiṣṭhā ।
prapadyaivaṃ śarvarīmuṣya goṣu munirvāṇīmutsṛjedgopradāne ॥7॥
slp1: gOrme mAtA govfzaBaH pitA me divaM Sarma jagatI me pratizWA । prapadyEvaM SarvarImuzya gozu munirvARImutsfjedgopradAne ॥7॥

text: sa tāmekāṃ niśāṃ gobhiḥ samasakhyaḥ samavrataḥ । aikātmyagamanātsadyaḥ kalmaṣādvipramucyate ॥8॥
html:
sa tāmekāṃ niśāṃ gobhiḥ samasakhyaḥ samavrataḥ ।
aikātmyagamanātsadyaḥ kalmaṣādvipramucyate ॥8॥
slp1: sa tAmekAM niSAM goBiH samasaKyaH samavrataH । EkAtmyagamanAtsadyaH kalmazAdvipramucyate ॥8॥

text: utsṛṣṭavṛṣavatsā hi pradeyā sūryadarśane । trividhaṃ pratipattavyamarthavādāśiṣaḥ stavāḥ ॥9॥
html:
utsṛṣṭavṛṣavatsā hi pradeyā sūryadarśane ।
trividhaṃ pratipattavyamarthavādāśiṣaḥ stavāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: utsfzwavfzavatsA hi pradeyA sUryadarSane । triviDaM pratipattavyamarTavAdASizaH stavAH ॥9॥

text: ūrjasvinya ūrjamedhāśca yajño garbho'mṛtasya jagataśca pratiṣṭhā । kṣitau rādhaḥprabhavaḥ śaśvadeva prājāpatyāḥ sarvamityarthavādaḥ ॥10॥
html:
ūrjasvinya ūrjamedhāśca yajño garbho'mṛtasya jagataśca pratiṣṭhā ।
kṣitau rādhaḥprabhavaḥ śaśvadeva prājāpatyāḥ sarvamityarthavādaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: Urjasvinya UrjameDASca yajYo garBo'mftasya jagataSca pratizWA । kzitO rADaHpraBavaH SaSvadeva prAjApatyAH sarvamityarTavAdaH ॥10॥

text: gāvo mamainaḥ praṇudantu sauryāstathā saumyāḥ svargayānāya santu । āmnātā me dadatīrāśrayaṃ tu tathānuktāḥ santu sarvāśiṣo me ॥11॥
html:
gāvo mamainaḥ praṇudantu sauryāstathā saumyāḥ svargayānāya santu ।
āmnātā me dadatīrāśrayaṃ tu tathānuktāḥ santu sarvāśiṣo me ॥11॥
slp1: gAvo mamEnaH praRudantu sOryAstaTA sOmyAH svargayAnAya santu । AmnAtA me dadatIrASrayaM tu taTAnuktAH santu sarvASizo me ॥11॥

text: śeṣotsarge karmabhirdehamokṣe sarasvatyaḥ śreyasi sampravṛttāḥ । yūyaṃ nityaṃ puṇyakarmopavāhyā diśadhvaṃ me gatimiṣṭāṃ prapannāḥ ॥12॥
html:
śeṣotsarge karmabhirdehamokṣe sarasvatyaḥ śreyasi sampravṛttāḥ ।
yūyaṃ nityaṃ puṇyakarmopavāhyā diśadhvaṃ me gatimiṣṭāṃ prapannāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: Sezotsarge karmaBirdehamokze sarasvatyaH Sreyasi sampravfttAH । yUyaM nityaM puRyakarmopavAhyA diSaDvaM me gatimizwAM prapannAH ॥12॥

text: yā vai yūyaṃ so'hamadyaikabhāvo yuṣmāndattvā cāhamātmapradātā । manaścyutā manaevopapannāḥ sandhukṣadhvaṃ saumyarūpograrūpāḥ ॥13॥
html:
yā vai yūyaṃ so'hamadyaikabhāvo yuṣmāndattvā cāhamātmapradātā ।
manaścyutā manaevopapannāḥ sandhukṣadhvaṃ saumyarūpograrūpāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: yA vE yUyaM so'hamadyEkaBAvo yuzmAndattvA cAhamAtmapradAtA । manaScyutA manaevopapannAH sanDukzaDvaM sOmyarUpograrUpAH ॥13॥

text: evaṃ tasyāgre pūrvamardhaṃ vadeta gavāṃ dātā vidhivatpūrvadṛṣṭam । pratibrūyāccheṣamardhaṃ dvijātiḥ pratigṛhṇanvai gopradāne vidhijñaḥ ॥14॥
html:
evaṃ tasyāgre pūrvamardhaṃ vadeta gavāṃ dātā vidhivatpūrvadṛṣṭam ।
pratibrūyāccheṣamardhaṃ dvijātiḥ pratigṛhṇanvai gopradāne vidhijñaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: evaM tasyAgre pUrvamarDaM vadeta gavAM dAtA viDivatpUrvadfzwam । pratibrUyAcCezamarDaM dvijAtiH pratigfhRanvE gopradAne viDijYaH ॥14॥

text: gāṃ dadānīti vaktavyamarghyavastravasupradaḥ । ūdhasyā bharitavyā ca vaiṣṇavīti ca codayet ॥15॥
html:
gāṃ dadānīti vaktavyamarghyavastravasupradaḥ ।
ūdhasyā bharitavyā ca vaiṣṇavīti ca codayet ॥15॥
slp1: gAM dadAnIti vaktavyamarGyavastravasupradaH । UDasyA BaritavyA ca vEzRavIti ca codayet ॥15॥

text: nāma saṅkīrtayettasyā yathāsaṅkhyottaraṃ sa vai । phalaṃ ṣaḍviṃśadaṣṭau ca sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ ॥16॥
html:
nāma saṅkīrtayettasyā yathāsaṅkhyottaraṃ sa vai ।
phalaṃ ṣaḍviṃśadaṣṭau ca sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ ॥16॥
slp1: nAma saNkIrtayettasyA yaTAsaNKyottaraM sa vE । PalaM zaqviMSadazwO ca sahasrARi ca viMSatiH ॥16॥

text: evametānguṇānvṛddhāngavādīnāṃ yathākramam । gopradātā samāpnoti samastānaṣṭame krame ॥17॥
html:
evametānguṇānvṛddhāngavādīnāṃ yathākramam ।
gopradātā samāpnoti samastānaṣṭame krame ॥17॥
slp1: evametAnguRAnvfdDAngavAdInAM yaTAkramam । gopradAtA samApnoti samastAnazwame krame ॥17॥

text: godaḥ śīlī nirbhayaścārghadātā na syādduḥkhī vasudātā ca kāmī । ūdhasyoḍhā bhārata yaśca vidvānvyākhyātāste vaiṣṇavāścandralokāḥ ॥18॥
html:
godaḥ śīlī nirbhayaścārghadātā na syādduḥkhī vasudātā ca kāmī ।
ūdhasyoḍhā bhārata yaśca vidvānvyākhyātāste vaiṣṇavāścandralokāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: godaH SIlI nirBayaScArGadAtA na syAdduHKI vasudAtA ca kAmI । UDasyoQA BArata yaSca vidvAnvyAKyAtAste vEzRavAScandralokAH ॥18॥

text: gā vai dattvā govratī syāttrirātraṃ niśāṃ caikāṃ saṃvaseteha tābhiḥ । kāmyāṣṭamyāṃ vartitavyaṃ trirātraṃ rasairvā goḥ śakṛtā prasnavairvā ॥19॥
html:
gā vai dattvā govratī syāttrirātraṃ niśāṃ caikāṃ saṃvaseteha tābhiḥ ।
kāmyāṣṭamyāṃ vartitavyaṃ trirātraṃ rasairvā goḥ śakṛtā prasnavairvā ॥19॥
slp1: gA vE dattvA govratI syAttrirAtraM niSAM cEkAM saMvaseteha tABiH । kAmyAzwamyAM vartitavyaM trirAtraM rasErvA goH SakftA prasnavErvA ॥19॥

text: vedavratī syādvṛṣabhapradātā vedāvāptirgoyugasya pradāne । tathā gavāṃ vidhimāsādya yajvā lokānagryānvindate nāvidhijñaḥ ॥20॥
html:
vedavratī syādvṛṣabhapradātā vedāvāptirgoyugasya pradāne ।
tathā gavāṃ vidhimāsādya yajvā lokānagryānvindate nāvidhijñaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: vedavratI syAdvfzaBapradAtA vedAvAptirgoyugasya pradAne । taTA gavAM viDimAsAdya yajvA lokAnagryAnvindate nAviDijYaH ॥20॥

text: kāmānsarvānpārthivānekasaṃsthānyo vai dadyātkāmadughāṃ ca dhenum । samyaktāḥ syurhavyakavyaughavatyastāsāmukṣṇāṃ jyāyasāṃ sampradānam ॥21॥
html:
kāmānsarvānpārthivānekasaṃsthānyo vai dadyātkāmadughāṃ ca dhenum ।
samyaktāḥ syurhavyakavyaughavatyastāsāmukṣṇāṃ jyāyasāṃ sampradānam ॥21॥
slp1: kAmAnsarvAnpArTivAnekasaMsTAnyo vE dadyAtkAmaduGAM ca Denum । samyaktAH syurhavyakavyOGavatyastAsAmukzRAM jyAyasAM sampradAnam ॥21॥

text: na cāśiṣyāyāvratāyopakuryānnāśraddadhānāya na vakrabuddhaye । guhyo hyayaṃ sarvalokasya dharmo nemaṃ dharmaṃ yatra tatra prajalpet ॥22॥
html:
na cāśiṣyāyāvratāyopakuryānnāśraddadhānāya na vakrabuddhaye ।
guhyo hyayaṃ sarvalokasya dharmo nemaṃ dharmaṃ yatra tatra prajalpet ॥22॥
slp1: na cASizyAyAvratAyopakuryAnnASraddaDAnAya na vakrabudDaye । guhyo hyayaM sarvalokasya Darmo nemaM DarmaM yatra tatra prajalpet ॥22॥

text: santi loke śraddadhānā manuṣyāḥ santi kṣudrā rākṣasā mānuṣeṣu । yeṣāṃ dānaṃ dīyamānaṃ hyaniṣṭaṃ nāstikyaṃ cāpyāśrayante hyapuṇyāḥ ॥23॥
html:
santi loke śraddadhānā manuṣyāḥ santi kṣudrā rākṣasā mānuṣeṣu ।
yeṣāṃ dānaṃ dīyamānaṃ hyaniṣṭaṃ nāstikyaṃ cāpyāśrayante hyapuṇyāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: santi loke SraddaDAnA manuzyAH santi kzudrA rAkzasA mAnuzezu । yezAM dAnaM dIyamAnaM hyanizwaM nAstikyaM cApyASrayante hyapuRyAH ॥23॥

text: bārhaspatyaṃ vākyametanniśamya ye rājāno gopradānāni kṛtvā । lokānprāptāḥ puṇyaśīlāḥ suvṛttāstānme rājankīrtyamānānnibodha ॥24॥
html:
bārhaspatyaṃ vākyametanniśamya ye rājāno gopradānāni kṛtvā ।
lokānprāptāḥ puṇyaśīlāḥ suvṛttāstānme rājankīrtyamānānnibodha ॥24॥
slp1: bArhaspatyaM vAkyametanniSamya ye rAjAno gopradAnAni kftvA । lokAnprAptAH puRyaSIlAH suvfttAstAnme rAjankIrtyamAnAnniboDa ॥24॥

text: uśīnaro viṣvagaśvo nṛgaśca bhagīratho viśruto yauvanāśvaḥ । māndhātā vai mucukundaśca rājā bhūridyumno naiṣadhaḥ somakaśca ॥25॥
html:
uśīnaro viṣvagaśvo nṛgaśca bhagīratho viśruto yauvanāśvaḥ ।
māndhātā vai mucukundaśca rājā bhūridyumno naiṣadhaḥ somakaśca ॥25॥
slp1: uSInaro vizvagaSvo nfgaSca BagIraTo viSruto yOvanASvaH । mAnDAtA vE mucukundaSca rAjA BUridyumno nEzaDaH somakaSca ॥25॥

text: purūravā bharataścakravartī yasyānvaye bhāratāḥ sarva eva । tathā vīro dāśarathiśca rāmo ye cāpyanye viśrutāḥ kīrtimantaḥ ॥26॥
html:
purūravā bharataścakravartī yasyānvaye bhāratāḥ sarva eva ।
tathā vīro dāśarathiśca rāmo ye cāpyanye viśrutāḥ kīrtimantaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: purUravA BarataScakravartI yasyAnvaye BAratAH sarva eva । taTA vIro dASaraTiSca rAmo ye cApyanye viSrutAH kIrtimantaH ॥26॥

text: tathā rājā pṛthukarmā dilīpo divaṃ prāpto gopradāne vidhijñaḥ । yajñairdānaistapasā rājadharmairmāndhātābhūdgopradānaiśca yuktaḥ ॥27॥
html:
tathā rājā pṛthukarmā dilīpo divaṃ prāpto gopradāne vidhijñaḥ ।
yajñairdānaistapasā rājadharmairmāndhātābhūdgopradānaiśca yuktaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: taTA rAjA pfTukarmA dilIpo divaM prApto gopradAne viDijYaH । yajYErdAnEstapasA rAjaDarmErmAnDAtABUdgopradAnESca yuktaH ॥27॥

text: tasmātpārtha tvamapīmāṃ mayoktāṃ bārhaspatīṃ bhāratīṃ dhārayasva । dvijāgryebhyaḥ samprayaccha pratīto gāḥ puṇyā vai prāpya rājyaṃ kurūṇām ॥28॥
html:
tasmātpārtha tvamapīmāṃ mayoktāṃ bārhaspatīṃ bhāratīṃ dhārayasva ।
dvijāgryebhyaḥ samprayaccha pratīto gāḥ puṇyā vai prāpya rājyaṃ kurūṇām ॥28॥
slp1: tasmAtpArTa tvamapImAM mayoktAM bArhaspatIM BAratIM DArayasva । dvijAgryeByaH samprayacCa pratIto gAH puRyA vE prApya rAjyaM kurURAm ॥28॥

text: tathā sarvaṃ kṛtavāndharmarājo bhīṣmeṇokto vidhivadgopradāne । sa māndhāturdevadevopadiṣṭaṃ samyagdharmaṃ dhārayāmāsa rājā ॥29॥
html:
tathā sarvaṃ kṛtavāndharmarājo bhīṣmeṇokto vidhivadgopradāne ।
sa māndhāturdevadevopadiṣṭaṃ samyagdharmaṃ dhārayāmāsa rājā ॥29॥
slp1: taTA sarvaM kftavAnDarmarAjo BIzmeRokto viDivadgopradAne । sa mAnDAturdevadevopadizwaM samyagDarmaM DArayAmAsa rAjA ॥29॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: iti nṛpa satataṃ gavāṃ pradāne yavaśakalānsaha gomayaiḥ pibānaḥ । kṣititalaśayanaḥ śikhī yatātmā vṛṣa iva rājavṛṣastadā babhūva ॥30॥
html:
iti nṛpa satataṃ gavāṃ pradāne yavaśakalānsaha gomayaiḥ pibānaḥ ।
kṣititalaśayanaḥ śikhī yatātmā vṛṣa iva rājavṛṣastadā babhūva ॥30॥
slp1: iti nfpa satataM gavAM pradAne yavaSakalAnsaha gomayEH pibAnaH । kzititalaSayanaH SiKI yatAtmA vfza iva rAjavfzastadA baBUva ॥30॥

text: sa nṛpatirabhavatsadaiva tābhyaḥ prayatamanā hyabhisaṃstuvaṃśca gā vai । nṛpadhuri ca na gāmayuṅkta bhūyasturagavarairagamacca yatra tatra] ॥31॥
html:
sa nṛpatirabhavatsadaiva tābhyaḥ prayatamanā hyabhisaṃstuvaṃśca gā vai ।
nṛpadhuri ca na gāmayuṅkta bhūyasturagavarairagamacca yatra tatra] ॥31॥
slp1: sa nfpatiraBavatsadEva tAByaH prayatamanA hyaBisaMstuvaMSca gA vE । nfpaDuri ca na gAmayuNkta BUyasturagavarEragamacca yatra tatra] ॥31॥

text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā bhūyaḥ śāntanavaṃ nṛpa । godāne vistaraṃ dhīmānpapraccha vinayānvitaḥ ॥1॥
html:
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā bhūyaḥ śāntanavaṃ nṛpa ।
godāne vistaraṃ dhīmānpapraccha vinayānvitaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: tato yuDizWiro rAjA BUyaH SAntanavaM nfpa । godAne vistaraM DImAnpapracCa vinayAnvitaH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: gopradāne guṇānsamyakpunaḥ prabrūhi bhārata । na hi tṛpyāmyahaṃ vīra śṛṇvāno'mṛtamīdṛśam ॥2॥
html:
gopradāne guṇānsamyakpunaḥ prabrūhi bhārata ।
na hi tṛpyāmyahaṃ vīra śṛṇvāno'mṛtamīdṛśam ॥2॥
slp1: gopradAne guRAnsamyakpunaH prabrUhi BArata । na hi tfpyAmyahaM vIra SfRvAno'mftamIdfSam ॥2॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ityukto dharmarājena tadā śāntanavo nṛpa । samyagāha guṇāṃstasmai gopradānasya kevalān ॥3॥
html:
ityukto dharmarājena tadā śāntanavo nṛpa ।
samyagāha guṇāṃstasmai gopradānasya kevalān ॥3॥
slp1: ityukto DarmarAjena tadA SAntanavo nfpa । samyagAha guRAMstasmE gopradAnasya kevalAn ॥3॥

text: vatsalāṃ guṇasampannāṃ taruṇīṃ vastrasaṃvṛtām । dattvedṛśīṃ gāṃ viprāya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥4॥
html:
vatsalāṃ guṇasampannāṃ taruṇīṃ vastrasaṃvṛtām ।
dattvedṛśīṃ gāṃ viprāya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ॥4॥
slp1: vatsalAM guRasampannAM taruRIM vastrasaMvftAm । dattvedfSIM gAM viprAya sarvapApEH pramucyate ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: asuryā nāma te lokā gāṃ dattvā tatra gacchati । pītodakāṃ jagdhatṛṇāṃ naṣṭadugdhāṃ nirindriyām ॥5॥
html:
asuryā nāma te lokā gāṃ dattvā tatra gacchati ।
pītodakāṃ jagdhatṛṇāṃ naṣṭadugdhāṃ nirindriyām ॥5॥
slp1: asuryA nAma te lokA gAM dattvA tatra gacCati । pItodakAM jagDatfRAM nazwadugDAM nirindriyAm ॥5॥

text: jarogrāmupayuktārthāṃ jīrṇāṃ kūpamivājalam । dattvā tamaḥ praviśati dvijaṃ kleśena yojayet ॥6॥
html:
jarogrāmupayuktārthāṃ jīrṇāṃ kūpamivājalam ।
dattvā tamaḥ praviśati dvijaṃ kleśena yojayet ॥6॥
slp1: jarogrAmupayuktArTAM jIrRAM kUpamivAjalam । dattvA tamaH praviSati dvijaM kleSena yojayet ॥6॥

text: duṣṭā ruṣṭā vyādhitā durbalā vā na dātavyā yāśca mūlyairadattaiḥ । kleśairvipraṃ yo'phalaiḥ saṃyunakti tasyāvīryāścāphalāścaiva lokāḥ ॥7॥
html:
duṣṭā ruṣṭā vyādhitā durbalā vā na dātavyā yāśca mūlyairadattaiḥ ।
kleśairvipraṃ yo'phalaiḥ saṃyunakti tasyāvīryāścāphalāścaiva lokāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: duzwA ruzwA vyADitA durbalA vA na dAtavyA yASca mUlyEradattEH । kleSErvipraM yo'PalEH saMyunakti tasyAvIryAScAPalAScEva lokAH ॥7॥

text: balānvitāḥ śīlavayopapannāḥ sarvāḥ praśaṃsanti sugandhavatyaḥ । yathā hi gaṅgā saritāṃ variṣṭhā tathārjunīnāṃ kapilā variṣṭhā ॥8॥
html:
balānvitāḥ śīlavayopapannāḥ sarvāḥ praśaṃsanti sugandhavatyaḥ ।
yathā hi gaṅgā saritāṃ variṣṭhā tathārjunīnāṃ kapilā variṣṭhā ॥8॥
slp1: balAnvitAH SIlavayopapannAH sarvAH praSaMsanti suganDavatyaH । yaTA hi gaNgA saritAM varizWA taTArjunInAM kapilA varizWA ॥8॥

text: kasmātsamāne bahulāpradāne sadbhiḥ praśastaṃ kapilāpradānam । viśeṣamicchāmi mahānubhāva śrotuṃ samartho hi bhavānpravaktum ॥9॥
html:
kasmātsamāne bahulāpradāne sadbhiḥ praśastaṃ kapilāpradānam ।
viśeṣamicchāmi mahānubhāva śrotuṃ samartho hi bhavānpravaktum ॥9॥
slp1: kasmAtsamAne bahulApradAne sadBiH praSastaM kapilApradAnam । viSezamicCAmi mahAnuBAva SrotuM samarTo hi BavAnpravaktum ॥9॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: vṛddhānāṃ bruvatāṃ tāta śrutaṃ me yatprabhāṣase । vakṣyāmi tadaśeṣeṇa rohiṇyo nirmitā yathā ॥10॥
html:
vṛddhānāṃ bruvatāṃ tāta śrutaṃ me yatprabhāṣase ।
vakṣyāmi tadaśeṣeṇa rohiṇyo nirmitā yathā ॥10॥
slp1: vfdDAnAM bruvatAM tAta SrutaM me yatpraBAzase । vakzyAmi tadaSezeRa rohiRyo nirmitA yaTA ॥10॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: prajāḥ sṛjeti vyādiṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ svayambhuvā । asṛjadvṛttimevāgre prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥11॥
html:
prajāḥ sṛjeti vyādiṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ svayambhuvā ।
asṛjadvṛttimevāgre prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā ॥11॥
slp1: prajAH sfjeti vyAdizwaH pUrvaM dakzaH svayamBuvA । asfjadvfttimevAgre prajAnAM hitakAmyayA ॥11॥

text: yathā hyamṛtamāśritya vartayanti divaukasaḥ । tathā vṛttiṃ samāśritya vartayanti prajā vibho ॥12॥
html:
yathā hyamṛtamāśritya vartayanti divaukasaḥ ।
tathā vṛttiṃ samāśritya vartayanti prajā vibho ॥12॥
slp1: yaTA hyamftamASritya vartayanti divOkasaH । taTA vfttiM samASritya vartayanti prajA viBo ॥12॥

text: acarebhyaśca bhūtebhyaścarāḥ śreṣṭhāstato narāḥ । brāhmaṇāśca tataḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥13॥
html:
acarebhyaśca bhūtebhyaścarāḥ śreṣṭhāstato narāḥ ।
brāhmaṇāśca tataḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: acareByaSca BUteByaScarAH SrezWAstato narAH । brAhmaRASca tataH SrezWAstezu yajYAH pratizWitAH ॥13॥

text: yajñairāpyāyate somaḥ sa ca goṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ । sarve devāḥ pramodante pūrvavṛttāstataḥ prajāḥ ॥14॥
html:
yajñairāpyāyate somaḥ sa ca goṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
sarve devāḥ pramodante pūrvavṛttāstataḥ prajāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yajYErApyAyate somaH sa ca gozu pratizWitaH । sarve devAH pramodante pUrvavfttAstataH prajAH ॥14॥

text: etānyeva tu bhūtāni prākrośanvṛttikāṅkṣayā । vṛttidaṃ cānvapadyanta tṛṣitāḥ pitṛmātṛvat ॥15॥
html:
etānyeva tu bhūtāni prākrośanvṛttikāṅkṣayā ।
vṛttidaṃ cānvapadyanta tṛṣitāḥ pitṛmātṛvat ॥15॥
slp1: etAnyeva tu BUtAni prAkroSanvfttikANkzayA । vfttidaM cAnvapadyanta tfzitAH pitfmAtfvat ॥15॥

text: itīdaṃ manasā gatvā prajāsargārthamātmanaḥ । prajāpatirbalādhānamamṛtaṃ prāpibattadā ॥16॥
html:
itīdaṃ manasā gatvā prajāsargārthamātmanaḥ ।
prajāpatirbalādhānamamṛtaṃ prāpibattadā ॥16॥
slp1: itIdaM manasA gatvA prajAsargArTamAtmanaH । prajApatirbalADAnamamftaM prApibattadA ॥16॥

text: sa gatastasya tṛptiṃ tu gandhaṃ surabhimudgiran । dadarśodgārasaṃvṛttāṃ surabhiṃ mukhajāṃ sutām ॥17॥
html:
sa gatastasya tṛptiṃ tu gandhaṃ surabhimudgiran ।
dadarśodgārasaṃvṛttāṃ surabhiṃ mukhajāṃ sutām ॥17॥
slp1: sa gatastasya tfptiM tu ganDaM suraBimudgiran । dadarSodgArasaMvfttAM suraBiM muKajAM sutAm ॥17॥

text: sāsṛjatsaurabheyīstu surabhirlokamātaraḥ । suvarṇavarṇāḥ kapilāḥ prajānāṃ vṛttidhenavaḥ ॥18॥
html:
sāsṛjatsaurabheyīstu surabhirlokamātaraḥ ।
suvarṇavarṇāḥ kapilāḥ prajānāṃ vṛttidhenavaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: sAsfjatsOraBeyIstu suraBirlokamAtaraH । suvarRavarRAH kapilAH prajAnAM vfttiDenavaH ॥18॥

text: tāsāmamṛtavarṇānāṃ kṣarantīnāṃ samantataḥ । babhūvāmṛtajaḥ phenaḥ sravantīnāmivormijaḥ ॥19॥
html:
tāsāmamṛtavarṇānāṃ kṣarantīnāṃ samantataḥ ।
babhūvāmṛtajaḥ phenaḥ sravantīnāmivormijaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tAsAmamftavarRAnAM kzarantInAM samantataH । baBUvAmftajaH PenaH sravantInAmivormijaH ॥19॥

text: sa vatsamukhavibhraṣṭo bhavasya bhuvi tiṣṭhataḥ । śirasyavāpa tatkruddhaḥ sa tadodaikṣata prabhuḥ । lalāṭaprabhavenākṣṇā rohiṇīḥ pradahanniva ॥20॥
html:
sa vatsamukhavibhraṣṭo bhavasya bhuvi tiṣṭhataḥ ।
śirasyavāpa tatkruddhaḥ sa tadodaikṣata prabhuḥ ।
lalāṭaprabhavenākṣṇā rohiṇīḥ pradahanniva ॥20॥
slp1: sa vatsamuKaviBrazwo Bavasya Buvi tizWataH । SirasyavApa tatkrudDaH sa tadodEkzata praBuH । lalAwapraBavenAkzRA rohiRIH pradahanniva ॥20॥

text: tattejastu tato raudraṃ kapilā gā viśāṃ pate । nānāvarṇatvamanayanmeghāniva divākaraḥ ॥21॥
html:
tattejastu tato raudraṃ kapilā gā viśāṃ pate ।
nānāvarṇatvamanayanmeghāniva divākaraḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tattejastu tato rOdraM kapilA gA viSAM pate । nAnAvarRatvamanayanmeGAniva divAkaraH ॥21॥

text: yāstu tasmādapakramya somamevābhisaṃśritāḥ । yathotpannāḥ svavarṇasthāstā nītā nānyavarṇatām ॥22॥
html:
yāstu tasmādapakramya somamevābhisaṃśritāḥ ।
yathotpannāḥ svavarṇasthāstā nītā nānyavarṇatām ॥22॥
slp1: yAstu tasmAdapakramya somamevABisaMSritAH । yaTotpannAH svavarRasTAstA nItA nAnyavarRatAm ॥22॥

text: atha kruddhaṃ mahādevaṃ prajāpatirabhāṣata । amṛtenāvasiktastvaṃ nocchiṣṭaṃ vidyate gavām ॥23॥
html:
atha kruddhaṃ mahādevaṃ prajāpatirabhāṣata ।
amṛtenāvasiktastvaṃ nocchiṣṭaṃ vidyate gavām ॥23॥
slp1: aTa krudDaM mahAdevaM prajApatiraBAzata । amftenAvasiktastvaM nocCizwaM vidyate gavAm ॥23॥

text: yathā hyamṛtamādāya somo viṣyandate punaḥ । tathā kṣīraṃ kṣarantyetā rohiṇyo'mṛtasambhavāḥ ॥24॥
html:
yathā hyamṛtamādāya somo viṣyandate punaḥ ।
tathā kṣīraṃ kṣarantyetā rohiṇyo'mṛtasambhavāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: yaTA hyamftamAdAya somo vizyandate punaH । taTA kzIraM kzarantyetA rohiRyo'mftasamBavAH ॥24॥

text: na duṣyatyanilo nāgnirna suvarṇaṃ na codadhiḥ । nāmṛtenāmṛtaṃ pītaṃ vatsapītā na vatsalā ॥25॥
html:
na duṣyatyanilo nāgnirna suvarṇaṃ na codadhiḥ ।
nāmṛtenāmṛtaṃ pītaṃ vatsapītā na vatsalā ॥25॥
slp1: na duzyatyanilo nAgnirna suvarRaM na codaDiH । nAmftenAmftaM pItaM vatsapItA na vatsalA ॥25॥

text: imāṁllokānbhariṣyanti haviṣā prasnavena ca । āsāmaiśvaryamaśnīhi sarvāmṛtamayaṃ śubham ॥26॥
html:
imāṁllokānbhariṣyanti haviṣā prasnavena ca ।
āsāmaiśvaryamaśnīhi sarvāmṛtamayaṃ śubham ॥26॥
slp1: imAṁllokAnBarizyanti havizA prasnavena ca । AsAmESvaryamaSnIhi sarvAmftamayaM SuBam ॥26॥

text: vṛṣabhaṃ ca dadau tasmai saha tābhiḥ prajāpatiḥ । prasādayāmāsa manastena rudrasya bhārata ॥27॥
html:
vṛṣabhaṃ ca dadau tasmai saha tābhiḥ prajāpatiḥ ।
prasādayāmāsa manastena rudrasya bhārata ॥27॥
slp1: vfzaBaM ca dadO tasmE saha tABiH prajApatiH । prasAdayAmAsa manastena rudrasya BArata ॥27॥

text: prītaścāpi mahādevaścakāra vṛṣabhaṃ tadā । dhvajaṃ ca vāhanaṃ caiva tasmātsa vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ॥28॥
html:
prītaścāpi mahādevaścakāra vṛṣabhaṃ tadā ।
dhvajaṃ ca vāhanaṃ caiva tasmātsa vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: prItaScApi mahAdevaScakAra vfzaBaM tadA । DvajaM ca vAhanaM cEva tasmAtsa vfzaBaDvajaH ॥28॥

text: tato devairmahādevastadā paśupatiḥ kṛtaḥ । īśvaraḥ sa gavāṃ madhye vṛṣāṅka iti cocyate ॥29॥
html:
tato devairmahādevastadā paśupatiḥ kṛtaḥ ।
īśvaraḥ sa gavāṃ madhye vṛṣāṅka iti cocyate ॥29॥
slp1: tato devErmahAdevastadA paSupatiH kftaH । ISvaraH sa gavAM maDye vfzANka iti cocyate ॥29॥

text: evamavyagravarṇānāṃ kapilānāṃ mahaujasām । pradāne prathamaḥ kalpaḥ sarvāsāmeva kīrtitaḥ ॥30॥
html:
evamavyagravarṇānāṃ kapilānāṃ mahaujasām ।
pradāne prathamaḥ kalpaḥ sarvāsāmeva kīrtitaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: evamavyagravarRAnAM kapilAnAM mahOjasAm । pradAne praTamaH kalpaH sarvAsAmeva kIrtitaH ॥30॥

text: lokajyeṣṭhā lokavṛttipravṛttā rudropetāḥ somaviṣyandabhūtāḥ । saumyāḥ puṇyāḥ kāmadāḥ prāṇadāśca gā vai dattvā sarvakāmapradaḥ syāt ॥31॥
html:
lokajyeṣṭhā lokavṛttipravṛttā rudropetāḥ somaviṣyandabhūtāḥ ।
saumyāḥ puṇyāḥ kāmadāḥ prāṇadāśca gā vai dattvā sarvakāmapradaḥ syāt ॥31॥
slp1: lokajyezWA lokavfttipravfttA rudropetAH somavizyandaBUtAH । sOmyAH puRyAH kAmadAH prARadASca gA vE dattvA sarvakAmapradaH syAt ॥31॥

text: imaṃ gavāṃ prabhavavidhānamuttamaṃ paṭhansadā śuciratimaṅgalapriyaḥ । vimucyate kalikaluṣeṇa mānavaḥ priyaṃ sutānpaśudhanamāpnuyāttathā ॥32॥
html:
imaṃ gavāṃ prabhavavidhānamuttamaṃ paṭhansadā śuciratimaṅgalapriyaḥ ।
vimucyate kalikaluṣeṇa mānavaḥ priyaṃ sutānpaśudhanamāpnuyāttathā ॥32॥
slp1: imaM gavAM praBavaviDAnamuttamaM paWansadA SuciratimaNgalapriyaH । vimucyate kalikaluzeRa mAnavaH priyaM sutAnpaSuDanamApnuyAttaTA ॥32॥

text: havyaṃ kavyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ śāntikarma yānaṃ vāso vṛddhabālasya puṣṭim । etānsarvāngopradāne guṇānvai dātā rājannāpnuyādvai sadaiva ॥33॥
html:
havyaṃ kavyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ śāntikarma yānaṃ vāso vṛddhabālasya puṣṭim ।
etānsarvāngopradāne guṇānvai dātā rājannāpnuyādvai sadaiva ॥33॥
slp1: havyaM kavyaM tarpaRaM SAntikarma yAnaM vAso vfdDabAlasya puzwim । etAnsarvAngopradAne guRAnvE dAtA rAjannApnuyAdvE sadEva ॥33॥

text: pitāmahasyātha niśamya vākyaṃ rājā saha bhrātṛbhirājamīḍhaḥ । sauvarṇakāṃsyopaduhāstato gāḥ pārtho dadau brāhmaṇasattamebhyaḥ ॥34॥
html:
pitāmahasyātha niśamya vākyaṃ rājā saha bhrātṛbhirājamīḍhaḥ ।
sauvarṇakāṃsyopaduhāstato gāḥ pārtho dadau brāhmaṇasattamebhyaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: pitAmahasyATa niSamya vAkyaM rAjA saha BrAtfBirAjamIQaH । sOvarRakAMsyopaduhAstato gAH pArTo dadO brAhmaRasattameByaH ॥34॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tathaiva tebhyo'bhidadau dvijebhyo gavāṃ sahasrāṇi śatāni caiva । yajñānsamuddiśya ca dakṣiṇārthe lokānvijetuṃ paramāṃ ca kīrtim] ॥35॥
html:
tathaiva tebhyo'bhidadau dvijebhyo gavāṃ sahasrāṇi śatāni caiva ।
yajñānsamuddiśya ca dakṣiṇārthe lokānvijetuṃ paramāṃ ca kīrtim] ॥35॥
slp1: taTEva teByo'BidadO dvijeByo gavAM sahasrARi SatAni cEva । yajYAnsamuddiSya ca dakziRArTe lokAnvijetuM paramAM ca kIrtim] ॥35॥

text: etasminneva kāle tu vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam । ikṣvākuvaṃśajo rājā saudāso dadatāṃ varaḥ ॥1॥
html:
etasminneva kāle tu vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam ।
ikṣvākuvaṃśajo rājā saudāso dadatāṃ varaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: etasminneva kAle tu vasizWamfzisattamam । ikzvAkuvaMSajo rAjA sOdAso dadatAM varaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sarvalokacaraṃ siddhaṃ brahmakośaṃ sanātanam । purohitamidaṃ praṣṭumabhivādyopacakrame ॥2॥
html:
sarvalokacaraṃ siddhaṃ brahmakośaṃ sanātanam ।
purohitamidaṃ praṣṭumabhivādyopacakrame ॥2॥
slp1: sarvalokacaraM sidDaM brahmakoSaM sanAtanam । purohitamidaM prazwumaBivAdyopacakrame ॥2॥

text: trailokye bhagavankiṃsvitpavitraṃ kathyate'nagha । yatkīrtayansadā martyaḥ prāpnuyātpuṇyamuttamam ॥3॥
html:
trailokye bhagavankiṃsvitpavitraṃ kathyate'nagha ।
yatkīrtayansadā martyaḥ prāpnuyātpuṇyamuttamam ॥3॥
slp1: trElokye BagavankiMsvitpavitraM kaTyate'naGa । yatkIrtayansadA martyaH prApnuyAtpuRyamuttamam ॥3॥
author: saudāsa uvāca ।

text: tasmai provāca vacanaṃ praṇatāya hitaṃ tadā । gavāmupaniṣadvidvānnamaskṛtya gavāṃ śuciḥ ॥4॥
html:
tasmai provāca vacanaṃ praṇatāya hitaṃ tadā ।
gavāmupaniṣadvidvānnamaskṛtya gavāṃ śuciḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tasmE provAca vacanaM praRatAya hitaM tadA । gavAmupanizadvidvAnnamaskftya gavAM SuciH ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: gāvaḥ surabhigandhinyastathā guggulugandhikāḥ । gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ svastyayanaṃ mahat ॥5॥
html:
gāvaḥ surabhigandhinyastathā guggulugandhikāḥ ।
gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ svastyayanaṃ mahat ॥5॥
slp1: gAvaH suraBiganDinyastaTA gugguluganDikAH । gAvaH pratizWA BUtAnAM gAvaH svastyayanaM mahat ॥5॥

text: gāvo bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacca gāvaḥ puṣṭiḥ sanātanī । gāvo lakṣmyāstathā mūlaṃ goṣu dattaṃ na naśyati । annaṃ hi satataṃ gāvo devānāṃ paramaṃ haviḥ ॥6॥
html:
gāvo bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacca gāvaḥ puṣṭiḥ sanātanī ।
gāvo lakṣmyāstathā mūlaṃ goṣu dattaṃ na naśyati ।
annaṃ hi satataṃ gāvo devānāṃ paramaṃ haviḥ ॥6॥
slp1: gAvo BUtaM Bavizyacca gAvaH puzwiH sanAtanI । gAvo lakzmyAstaTA mUlaM gozu dattaM na naSyati । annaM hi satataM gAvo devAnAM paramaM haviH ॥6॥

text: svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau goṣu nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitau । gāvo yajñasya hi phalaṃ goṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥7॥
html:
svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau goṣu nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitau ।
gāvo yajñasya hi phalaṃ goṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: svAhAkAravazawkArO gozu nityaM pratizWitO । gAvo yajYasya hi PalaM gozu yajYAH pratizWitAH ॥7॥

text: sāyaṃ prātaśca satataṃ homakāle mahāmate । gāvo dadati vai homyamṛṣibhyaḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥8॥
html:
sāyaṃ prātaśca satataṃ homakāle mahāmate ।
gāvo dadati vai homyamṛṣibhyaḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥8॥
slp1: sAyaM prAtaSca satataM homakAle mahAmate । gAvo dadati vE homyamfziByaH puruzarzaBa ॥8॥

text: kānicidyāni durgāṇi duṣkṛtāni kṛtāni ca । taranti caiva pāpmānaṃ dhenuṃ ye dadati prabho ॥9॥
html:
kānicidyāni durgāṇi duṣkṛtāni kṛtāni ca ।
taranti caiva pāpmānaṃ dhenuṃ ye dadati prabho ॥9॥
slp1: kAnicidyAni durgARi duzkftAni kftAni ca । taranti cEva pApmAnaM DenuM ye dadati praBo ॥9॥

text: ekāṃ ca daśagurdadyāddaśa dadyācca gośatī । śataṃ sahasragurdadyātsarve tulyaphalā hi te ॥10॥
html:
ekāṃ ca daśagurdadyāddaśa dadyācca gośatī ।
śataṃ sahasragurdadyātsarve tulyaphalā hi te ॥10॥
slp1: ekAM ca daSagurdadyAddaSa dadyAcca goSatI । SataM sahasragurdadyAtsarve tulyaPalA hi te ॥10॥

text: anāhitāgniḥ śatagurayajvā ca sahasraguḥ । samṛddho yaśca kīnāśo nārghyamarhanti te trayaḥ ॥11॥
html:
anāhitāgniḥ śatagurayajvā ca sahasraguḥ ।
samṛddho yaśca kīnāśo nārghyamarhanti te trayaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: anAhitAgniH SatagurayajvA ca sahasraguH । samfdDo yaSca kInASo nArGyamarhanti te trayaH ॥11॥

text: kapilāṃ ye prayacchanti savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām । suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāmubhau lokau jayanti te ॥12॥
html:
kapilāṃ ye prayacchanti savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām ।
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāmubhau lokau jayanti te ॥12॥
slp1: kapilAM ye prayacCanti savatsAM kAMsyadohanAm । suvratAM vastrasaMvItAmuBO lokO jayanti te ॥12॥

text: yuvānamindriyopetaṃ śatena saha yūthapam । gavendraṃ brāhmaṇendrāya bhūriśṛṅgamalaṅkṛtam ॥13॥
html:
yuvānamindriyopetaṃ śatena saha yūthapam ।
gavendraṃ brāhmaṇendrāya bhūriśṛṅgamalaṅkṛtam ॥13॥
slp1: yuvAnamindriyopetaM Satena saha yUTapam । gavendraM brAhmaRendrAya BUriSfNgamalaNkftam ॥13॥

text: vṛṣabhaṃ ye prayacchanti śrotriyāya parantapa । aiśvaryaṃ te'bhijāyante jāyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥14॥
html:
vṛṣabhaṃ ye prayacchanti śrotriyāya parantapa ।
aiśvaryaṃ te'bhijāyante jāyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: vfzaBaM ye prayacCanti SrotriyAya parantapa । ESvaryaM te'BijAyante jAyamAnAH punaH punaH ॥14॥

text: nākīrtayitvā gāḥ supyānnāsmṛtya punarutpatet । sāyaṃ prātarnamasyecca gāstataḥ puṣṭimāpnuyāt ॥15॥
html:
nākīrtayitvā gāḥ supyānnāsmṛtya punarutpatet ।
sāyaṃ prātarnamasyecca gāstataḥ puṣṭimāpnuyāt ॥15॥
slp1: nAkIrtayitvA gAH supyAnnAsmftya punarutpatet । sAyaM prAtarnamasyecca gAstataH puzwimApnuyAt ॥15॥

text: gavāṃ mūtrapurīṣasya nodvijeta kadācana । na cāsāṃ māṃsamaśnīyādgavāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tathāśnute ॥16॥
html:
gavāṃ mūtrapurīṣasya nodvijeta kadācana ।
na cāsāṃ māṃsamaśnīyādgavāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tathāśnute ॥16॥
slp1: gavAM mUtrapurIzasya nodvijeta kadAcana । na cAsAM mAMsamaSnIyAdgavAM vyuzwiM taTASnute ॥16॥

text: gāśca saṅkīrtayennityaṃ nāvamanyeta gāstathā । aniṣṭaṃ svapnamālakṣya gāṃ naraḥ samprakīrtayet ॥17॥
html:
gāśca saṅkīrtayennityaṃ nāvamanyeta gāstathā ।
aniṣṭaṃ svapnamālakṣya gāṃ naraḥ samprakīrtayet ॥17॥
slp1: gASca saNkIrtayennityaM nAvamanyeta gAstaTA । anizwaM svapnamAlakzya gAM naraH samprakIrtayet ॥17॥

text: gomayena sadā snāyādgokarīṣe ca saṃviśet । śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇi pratighātaṃ ca varjayet ॥18॥
html:
gomayena sadā snāyādgokarīṣe ca saṃviśet ।
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇi pratighātaṃ ca varjayet ॥18॥
slp1: gomayena sadA snAyAdgokarIze ca saMviSet । SlezmamUtrapurIzARi pratiGAtaM ca varjayet ॥18॥

text: sārdracarmaṇi bhuñjīta nirīkṣanvāruṇīṃ diśam । vāgyataḥ sarpiṣā bhūmau gavāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tathāśnute ॥19॥
html:
sārdracarmaṇi bhuñjīta nirīkṣanvāruṇīṃ diśam ।
vāgyataḥ sarpiṣā bhūmau gavāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tathāśnute ॥19॥
slp1: sArdracarmaRi BuYjIta nirIkzanvAruRIM diSam । vAgyataH sarpizA BUmO gavAM vyuzwiM taTASnute ॥19॥

text: ghṛtena juhuyādagniṃ ghṛtena svasti vācayet । ghṛtaṃ dadyādghṛtaṃ prāśedgavāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tathāśnute ॥20॥
html:
ghṛtena juhuyādagniṃ ghṛtena svasti vācayet ।
ghṛtaṃ dadyādghṛtaṃ prāśedgavāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tathāśnute ॥20॥
slp1: Gftena juhuyAdagniM Gftena svasti vAcayet । GftaM dadyAdGftaM prASedgavAM vyuzwiM taTASnute ॥20॥

text: gomatyā vidyayā dhenuṃ tilānāmabhimantrya yaḥ । rasaratnamayīṃ dadyānna sa śocetkṛtākṛte ॥21॥
html:
gomatyā vidyayā dhenuṃ tilānāmabhimantrya yaḥ ।
rasaratnamayīṃ dadyānna sa śocetkṛtākṛte ॥21॥
slp1: gomatyA vidyayA DenuM tilAnAmaBimantrya yaH । rasaratnamayIM dadyAnna sa SocetkftAkfte ॥21॥

text: gāvo māmupatiṣṭhantu hemaśṛṅgāḥ payomucaḥ । surabhyaḥ saurabheyāśca saritaḥ sāgaraṃ yathā ॥22॥
html:
gāvo māmupatiṣṭhantu hemaśṛṅgāḥ payomucaḥ ।
surabhyaḥ saurabheyāśca saritaḥ sāgaraṃ yathā ॥22॥
slp1: gAvo mAmupatizWantu hemaSfNgAH payomucaH । suraByaH sOraBeyASca saritaH sAgaraM yaTA ॥22॥

text: gāvaḥ paśyantu māṃ nityaṃ gāvaḥ paśyāmyahaṃ tadā । gāvo'smākaṃ vayaṃ tāsāṃ yato gāvastato vayam ॥23॥
html:
gāvaḥ paśyantu māṃ nityaṃ gāvaḥ paśyāmyahaṃ tadā ।
gāvo'smākaṃ vayaṃ tāsāṃ yato gāvastato vayam ॥23॥
slp1: gAvaH paSyantu mAM nityaM gAvaH paSyAmyahaM tadA । gAvo'smAkaM vayaM tAsAM yato gAvastato vayam ॥23॥

text: evaṃ rātrau divā caiva sameṣu viṣameṣu ca । mahābhayeṣu ca naraḥ kīrtayanmucyate bhayāt] ॥24॥
html:
evaṃ rātrau divā caiva sameṣu viṣameṣu ca ।
mahābhayeṣu ca naraḥ kīrtayanmucyate bhayāt] ॥24॥
slp1: evaM rAtrO divA cEva samezu vizamezu ca । mahABayezu ca naraH kIrtayanmucyate BayAt] ॥24॥

text: śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ tapastaptaṃ suduścaram । gobhiḥ pūrvavisṛṣṭābhirgacchema śreṣṭhatāmiti ॥1॥
html:
śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ tapastaptaṃ suduścaram ।
gobhiḥ pūrvavisṛṣṭābhirgacchema śreṣṭhatāmiti ॥1॥
slp1: SataM varzasahasrARAM tapastaptaM suduScaram । goBiH pUrvavisfzwABirgacCema SrezWatAmiti ॥1॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: loke'smindakṣiṇānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ vayamuttamāḥ । bhavema na ca lipyema doṣeṇeti parantapa ॥2॥
html:
loke'smindakṣiṇānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ vayamuttamāḥ ।
bhavema na ca lipyema doṣeṇeti parantapa ॥2॥
slp1: loke'smindakziRAnAM ca sarvAsAM vayamuttamAH । Bavema na ca lipyema dozeReti parantapa ॥2॥

text: sa eva cetasā tena hato lipyeta sarvadā । śakṛtā ca pavitrārthaṃ kurvīrandevamānuṣāḥ ॥3॥
html:
sa eva cetasā tena hato lipyeta sarvadā ।
śakṛtā ca pavitrārthaṃ kurvīrandevamānuṣāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: sa eva cetasA tena hato lipyeta sarvadA । SakftA ca pavitrArTaM kurvIrandevamAnuzAH ॥3॥

text: tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca । pradātāraśca golokāngaccheyuriti mānada ॥4॥
html:
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ।
pradātāraśca golokāngaccheyuriti mānada ॥4॥
slp1: taTA sarvARi BUtAni sTAvarARi carARi ca । pradAtAraSca golokAngacCeyuriti mAnada ॥4॥

text: tābhyo varaṃ dadau brahmā tapaso'nte svayaṃ prabhuḥ । evaṃ bhavatviti vibhurlokāṃstārayateti ca ॥5॥
html:
tābhyo varaṃ dadau brahmā tapaso'nte svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
evaṃ bhavatviti vibhurlokāṃstārayateti ca ॥5॥
slp1: tAByo varaM dadO brahmA tapaso'nte svayaM praBuH । evaM Bavatviti viBurlokAMstArayateti ca ॥5॥

text: uttasthuḥ siddhikāmāstā bhūtabhavyasya mātaraḥ । tapaso'nte mahārāja gāvo lokaparāyaṇāḥ ॥6॥
html:
uttasthuḥ siddhikāmāstā bhūtabhavyasya mātaraḥ ।
tapaso'nte mahārāja gāvo lokaparāyaṇāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: uttasTuH sidDikAmAstA BUtaBavyasya mAtaraH । tapaso'nte mahArAja gAvo lokaparAyaRAH ॥6॥

text: tasmādgāvo mahābhāgāḥ pavitraṃ paramucyate । tathaiva sarvabhūtānāṃ gāvastiṣṭhanti mūrdhani ॥7॥
html:
tasmādgāvo mahābhāgāḥ pavitraṃ paramucyate ।
tathaiva sarvabhūtānāṃ gāvastiṣṭhanti mūrdhani ॥7॥
slp1: tasmAdgAvo mahABAgAH pavitraM paramucyate । taTEva sarvaBUtAnAM gAvastizWanti mUrDani ॥7॥

text: samānavatsāṃ kapilāṃ dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm । suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ॥8॥
html:
samānavatsāṃ kapilāṃ dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm ।
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ॥8॥
slp1: samAnavatsAM kapilAM DenuM dattvA payasvinIm । suvratAM vastrasaMvItAM brahmaloke mahIyate ॥8॥

text: rohiṇīṃ tulyavatsāṃ tu dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm । suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ॥9॥
html:
rohiṇīṃ tulyavatsāṃ tu dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm ।
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ॥9॥
slp1: rohiRIM tulyavatsAM tu DenuM dattvA payasvinIm । suvratAM vastrasaMvItAM sUryaloke mahIyate ॥9॥

text: samānavatsāṃ śabalāṃ dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm । suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ somaloke mahīyate ॥10॥
html:
samānavatsāṃ śabalāṃ dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm ।
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ somaloke mahīyate ॥10॥
slp1: samAnavatsAM SabalAM DenuM dattvA payasvinIm । suvratAM vastrasaMvItAM somaloke mahIyate ॥10॥

text: samānavatsāṃ śvetāṃ tu dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm । suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāmindraloke mahīyate ॥11॥
html:
samānavatsāṃ śvetāṃ tu dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm ।
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāmindraloke mahīyate ॥11॥
slp1: samAnavatsAM SvetAM tu DenuM dattvA payasvinIm । suvratAM vastrasaMvItAmindraloke mahIyate ॥11॥

text: samānavatsāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ tu dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm । suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāmagniloke mahīyate ॥12॥
html:
samānavatsāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ tu dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm ।
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāmagniloke mahīyate ॥12॥
slp1: samAnavatsAM kfzRAM tu DenuM dattvA payasvinIm । suvratAM vastrasaMvItAmagniloke mahIyate ॥12॥

text: samānavatsāṃ dhūmrāṃ tu dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm । suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ yāmyaloke mahīyate ॥13॥
html:
samānavatsāṃ dhūmrāṃ tu dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm ।
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ yāmyaloke mahīyate ॥13॥
slp1: samAnavatsAM DUmrAM tu DenuM dattvA payasvinIm । suvratAM vastrasaMvItAM yAmyaloke mahIyate ॥13॥

text: apāṃ phenasavarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām । pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamaśnute ॥14॥
html:
apāṃ phenasavarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām ।
pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamaśnute ॥14॥
slp1: apAM PenasavarRAM tu savatsAM kAMsyadohanAm । pradAya vastrasaMvItAM vAruRaM lokamaSnute ॥14॥

text: vātareṇusavarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām । pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ vāyuloke mahīyate ॥15॥
html:
vātareṇusavarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām ।
pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ vāyuloke mahīyate ॥15॥
slp1: vAtareRusavarRAM tu savatsAM kAMsyadohanAm । pradAya vastrasaMvItAM vAyuloke mahIyate ॥15॥

text: hiraṇyavarṇāṃ piṅgākṣīṃ savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām । pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ kauberaṃ lokamaśnute ॥16॥
html:
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ piṅgākṣīṃ savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām ।
pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ kauberaṃ lokamaśnute ॥16॥
slp1: hiraRyavarRAM piNgAkzIM savatsAM kAMsyadohanAm । pradAya vastrasaMvItAM kOberaM lokamaSnute ॥16॥

text: palāladhūmravarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām । pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ pitṛloke mahīyate ॥17॥
html:
palāladhūmravarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām ।
pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ pitṛloke mahīyate ॥17॥
slp1: palAlaDUmravarRAM tu savatsAM kAMsyadohanAm । pradAya vastrasaMvItAM pitfloke mahIyate ॥17॥

text: savatsāṃ pīvarīṃ dattvā śitikaṇṭhāmalaṅkṛtām । vaiśvadevamasambādhaṃ sthānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prapadyate ॥18॥
html:
savatsāṃ pīvarīṃ dattvā śitikaṇṭhāmalaṅkṛtām ।
vaiśvadevamasambādhaṃ sthānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prapadyate ॥18॥
slp1: savatsAM pIvarIM dattvA SitikaRWAmalaNkftAm । vESvadevamasambADaM sTAnaM SrezWaM prapadyate ॥18॥

text: samānavatsāṃ gaurīṃ tu dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm । suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ vasūnāṃ lokamaśnute ॥19॥
html:
samānavatsāṃ gaurīṃ tu dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm ।
suvratāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ vasūnāṃ lokamaśnute ॥19॥
slp1: samAnavatsAM gOrIM tu DenuM dattvA payasvinIm । suvratAM vastrasaMvItAM vasUnAM lokamaSnute ॥19॥

text: pāṇḍukambalavarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām । pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ sādhyānāṃ lokamaśnute ॥20॥
html:
pāṇḍukambalavarṇāṃ tu savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām ।
pradāya vastrasaṃvītāṃ sādhyānāṃ lokamaśnute ॥20॥
slp1: pARqukambalavarRAM tu savatsAM kAMsyadohanAm । pradAya vastrasaMvItAM sADyAnAM lokamaSnute ॥20॥

text: vairāṭapṛṣṭhamukṣāṇaṃ sarvaratnairalaṅkṛtam । pradāya marutāṃ lokānajarānpratipadyate ॥21॥
html:
vairāṭapṛṣṭhamukṣāṇaṃ sarvaratnairalaṅkṛtam ।
pradāya marutāṃ lokānajarānpratipadyate ॥21॥
slp1: vErAwapfzWamukzARaM sarvaratnEralaNkftam । pradAya marutAM lokAnajarAnpratipadyate ॥21॥

text: vatsopapannāṃ nīlāṅgāṃ sarvaratnasamanvitām । gandharvāpsarasāṃ lokāndattvā prāpnoti mānavaḥ ॥22॥
html:
vatsopapannāṃ nīlāṅgāṃ sarvaratnasamanvitām ।
gandharvāpsarasāṃ lokāndattvā prāpnoti mānavaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: vatsopapannAM nIlANgAM sarvaratnasamanvitAm । ganDarvApsarasAM lokAndattvA prApnoti mAnavaH ॥22॥

text: śitikaṇṭhamanaḍvāhaṃ sarvaratnairalaṅkṛtam । dattvā prajāpaterlokānviśokaḥ pratipadyate ॥23॥
html:
śitikaṇṭhamanaḍvāhaṃ sarvaratnairalaṅkṛtam ।
dattvā prajāpaterlokānviśokaḥ pratipadyate ॥23॥
slp1: SitikaRWamanaqvAhaM sarvaratnEralaNkftam । dattvA prajApaterlokAnviSokaH pratipadyate ॥23॥

text: gopradānarato yāti bhittvā jaladasañcayān । vimānenārkavarṇena divi rājanvirājatā ॥24॥
html:
gopradānarato yāti bhittvā jaladasañcayān ।
vimānenārkavarṇena divi rājanvirājatā ॥24॥
slp1: gopradAnarato yAti BittvA jaladasaYcayAn । vimAnenArkavarRena divi rAjanvirAjatA ॥24॥

text: taṃ cāruveṣāḥ suśroṇyaḥ sahasraṃ varayoṣitaḥ । ramayanti naraśreṣṭha gopradānarataṃ naram ॥25॥
html:
taṃ cāruveṣāḥ suśroṇyaḥ sahasraṃ varayoṣitaḥ ।
ramayanti naraśreṣṭha gopradānarataṃ naram ॥25॥
slp1: taM cAruvezAH suSroRyaH sahasraM varayozitaH । ramayanti naraSrezWa gopradAnarataM naram ॥25॥

text: vīṇānāṃ vallakīnāṃ ca nūpurāṇāṃ ca śiñjitaiḥ । hāsaiśca hariṇākṣīṇāṃ prasuptaḥ pratibodhyate ॥26॥
html:
vīṇānāṃ vallakīnāṃ ca nūpurāṇāṃ ca śiñjitaiḥ ।
hāsaiśca hariṇākṣīṇāṃ prasuptaḥ pratibodhyate ॥26॥
slp1: vIRAnAM vallakInAM ca nUpurARAM ca SiYjitEH । hAsESca hariRAkzIRAM prasuptaH pratiboDyate ॥26॥

text: yāvanti lomāni bhavanti dhenvāstāvanti varṣāṇi mahīyate saḥ । svargāccyutaścāpi tato nṛloke kule samutpatsyati gomināṃ saḥ] ॥27॥
html:
yāvanti lomāni bhavanti dhenvāstāvanti varṣāṇi mahīyate saḥ ।
svargāccyutaścāpi tato nṛloke kule samutpatsyati gomināṃ saḥ] ॥27॥
slp1: yAvanti lomAni Bavanti DenvAstAvanti varzARi mahIyate saH । svargAccyutaScApi tato nfloke kule samutpatsyati gominAM saH] ॥27॥

text: ghṛtakṣīrapradā gāvo ghṛtayonyo ghṛtodbhavāḥ । ghṛtanadyo ghṛtāvartāstā me santu sadā gṛhe ॥1॥
html:
ghṛtakṣīrapradā gāvo ghṛtayonyo ghṛtodbhavāḥ ।
ghṛtanadyo ghṛtāvartāstā me santu sadā gṛhe ॥1॥
slp1: GftakzIrapradA gAvo Gftayonyo GftodBavAH । Gftanadyo GftAvartAstA me santu sadA gfhe ॥1॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: ghṛtaṃ me hṛdaye nityaṃ ghṛtaṃ nābhyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam । ghṛtaṃ sarveṣu gātreṣu ghṛtaṃ me manasi sthitam ॥2॥
html:
ghṛtaṃ me hṛdaye nityaṃ ghṛtaṃ nābhyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।
ghṛtaṃ sarveṣu gātreṣu ghṛtaṃ me manasi sthitam ॥2॥
slp1: GftaM me hfdaye nityaM GftaM nAByAM pratizWitam । GftaM sarvezu gAtrezu GftaM me manasi sTitam ॥2॥

text: gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca । gāvo me sarvataścaiva gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham ॥3॥
html:
gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca ।
gāvo me sarvataścaiva gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham ॥3॥
slp1: gAvo mamAgrato nityaM gAvaH pfzWata eva ca । gAvo me sarvataScEva gavAM maDye vasAmyaham ॥3॥

text: ityācamya japetsāyaṃ prātaśca puruṣaḥ sadā । yadahnā kurute pāpaṃ tasmātsa parimucyate ॥4॥
html:
ityācamya japetsāyaṃ prātaśca puruṣaḥ sadā ।
yadahnā kurute pāpaṃ tasmātsa parimucyate ॥4॥
slp1: ityAcamya japetsAyaM prAtaSca puruzaH sadA । yadahnA kurute pApaM tasmAtsa parimucyate ॥4॥

text: prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā vasordhārā ca yatra sā । gandharvāpsaraso yatra tatra yānti sahasradāḥ ॥5॥
html:
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā vasordhārā ca yatra sā ।
gandharvāpsaraso yatra tatra yānti sahasradāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: prAsAdA yatra sOvarRA vasorDArA ca yatra sA । ganDarvApsaraso yatra tatra yAnti sahasradAH ॥5॥

text: navanītapaṅkāḥ kṣīrodā dadhiśaivalasaṅkulāḥ । vahanti yatra nadyo vai tatra yānti sahasradāḥ ॥6॥
html:
navanītapaṅkāḥ kṣīrodā dadhiśaivalasaṅkulāḥ ।
vahanti yatra nadyo vai tatra yānti sahasradāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: navanItapaNkAH kzIrodA daDiSEvalasaNkulAH । vahanti yatra nadyo vE tatra yAnti sahasradAH ॥6॥

text: gavāṃ śatasahasraṃ tu yaḥ prayacchedyathāvidhi । parāmṛddhimavāpyātha sa goloke mahīyate ॥7॥
html:
gavāṃ śatasahasraṃ tu yaḥ prayacchedyathāvidhi ।
parāmṛddhimavāpyātha sa goloke mahīyate ॥7॥
slp1: gavAM SatasahasraM tu yaH prayacCedyaTAviDi । parAmfdDimavApyATa sa goloke mahIyate ॥7॥

text: daśa cobhayataḥ pretya mātāpitroḥ pitāmahān । dadhāti sukṛtāṁllokānpunāti ca kulaṃ naraḥ ॥8॥
html:
daśa cobhayataḥ pretya mātāpitroḥ pitāmahān ।
dadhāti sukṛtāṁllokānpunāti ca kulaṃ naraḥ ॥8॥
slp1: daSa coBayataH pretya mAtApitroH pitAmahAn । daDAti sukftAṁllokAnpunAti ca kulaM naraH ॥8॥

text: dhenvāḥ pramāṇena samapramāṇāṃ dhenuṃ tilānāmapi ca pradāya । pānīyadātā ca yamasya loke na yātanāṃ kāñcidupaiti tatra ॥9॥
html:
dhenvāḥ pramāṇena samapramāṇāṃ dhenuṃ tilānāmapi ca pradāya ।
pānīyadātā ca yamasya loke na yātanāṃ kāñcidupaiti tatra ॥9॥
slp1: DenvAH pramARena samapramARAM DenuM tilAnAmapi ca pradAya । pAnIyadAtA ca yamasya loke na yAtanAM kAYcidupEti tatra ॥9॥

text: pavitramagryaṃ jagataḥ pratiṣṭhā divaukasāṃ mātaro'thāprameyāḥ । anvālabheddakṣiṇato vrajecca dadyācca pātre prasamīkṣya kālam ॥10॥
html:
pavitramagryaṃ jagataḥ pratiṣṭhā divaukasāṃ mātaro'thāprameyāḥ ।
anvālabheddakṣiṇato vrajecca dadyācca pātre prasamīkṣya kālam ॥10॥
slp1: pavitramagryaM jagataH pratizWA divOkasAM mAtaro'TAprameyAH । anvAlaBeddakziRato vrajecca dadyAcca pAtre prasamIkzya kAlam ॥10॥

text: dhenuṃ savatsāṃ kapilāṃ bhūriśṛṅgāṃ kāṃsyopadohāṃ vasanottarīyām । pradāya tāṃ gāhati durvigāhyāṃ yāmyāṃ sabhāṃ vītabhayo manuṣyaḥ ॥11॥
html:
dhenuṃ savatsāṃ kapilāṃ bhūriśṛṅgāṃ kāṃsyopadohāṃ vasanottarīyām ।
pradāya tāṃ gāhati durvigāhyāṃ yāmyāṃ sabhāṃ vītabhayo manuṣyaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: DenuM savatsAM kapilAM BUriSfNgAM kAMsyopadohAM vasanottarIyAm । pradAya tAM gAhati durvigAhyAM yAmyAM saBAM vItaBayo manuzyaH ॥11॥

text: surūpā bahurūpāśca viśvarūpāśca mātaraḥ । gāvo māmupatiṣṭhantāmiti nityaṃ prakīrtayet ॥12॥
html:
surūpā bahurūpāśca viśvarūpāśca mātaraḥ ।
gāvo māmupatiṣṭhantāmiti nityaṃ prakīrtayet ॥12॥
slp1: surUpA bahurUpASca viSvarUpASca mAtaraH । gAvo mAmupatizWantAmiti nityaM prakIrtayet ॥12॥

text: nātaḥ puṇyataraṃ dānaṃ nātaḥ puṇyataraṃ phalam । nāto viśiṣṭaṃ lokeṣu bhūtaṃ bhavitumarhati ॥13॥
html:
nātaḥ puṇyataraṃ dānaṃ nātaḥ puṇyataraṃ phalam ।
nāto viśiṣṭaṃ lokeṣu bhūtaṃ bhavitumarhati ॥13॥
slp1: nAtaH puRyataraM dAnaM nAtaH puRyataraM Palam । nAto viSizwaM lokezu BUtaM Bavitumarhati ॥13॥

text: tvacā lomnātha śṛṅgaiśca vālaiḥ kṣīreṇa medasā । yajñaṃ vahanti sambhūya kimastyabhyadhikaṃ tataḥ ॥14॥
html:
tvacā lomnātha śṛṅgaiśca vālaiḥ kṣīreṇa medasā ।
yajñaṃ vahanti sambhūya kimastyabhyadhikaṃ tataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tvacA lomnATa SfNgESca vAlEH kzIreRa medasA । yajYaM vahanti samBUya kimastyaByaDikaM tataH ॥14॥

text: yayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam । tāṃ dhenuṃ śirasā vande bhūtabhavyasya mātaram ॥15॥
html:
yayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam ।
tāṃ dhenuṃ śirasā vande bhūtabhavyasya mātaram ॥15॥
slp1: yayA sarvamidaM vyAptaM jagatsTAvarajaNgamam । tAM DenuM SirasA vande BUtaBavyasya mAtaram ॥15॥

text: guṇavacanasamuccayaikadeśo nṛvara mayaiṣa gavāṃ prakīrtitaste । na hi paramiha dānamasti gobhyo bhavanti na cāpi parāyaṇaṃ tathānyat ॥16॥
html:
guṇavacanasamuccayaikadeśo nṛvara mayaiṣa gavāṃ prakīrtitaste ।
na hi paramiha dānamasti gobhyo bhavanti na cāpi parāyaṇaṃ tathānyat ॥16॥
slp1: guRavacanasamuccayEkadeSo nfvara mayEza gavAM prakIrtitaste । na hi paramiha dAnamasti goByo Bavanti na cApi parAyaRaM taTAnyat ॥16॥

text: paramidamiti bhūmipo vicintya pravaramṛṣervacanaṃ tato mahātmā । vyasṛjata niyatātmavāndvijebhyaḥ subahu ca godhanamāptavāṃśca lokān] ॥17॥
html:
paramidamiti bhūmipo vicintya pravaramṛṣervacanaṃ tato mahātmā ।
vyasṛjata niyatātmavāndvijebhyaḥ subahu ca godhanamāptavāṃśca lokān] ॥17॥
slp1: paramidamiti BUmipo vicintya pravaramfzervacanaM tato mahAtmA । vyasfjata niyatAtmavAndvijeByaH subahu ca goDanamAptavAMSca lokAn] ॥17॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yacchreṣṭhaṃ loke ca yadbhavet । pāvanaṃ paramaṃ caiva tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yacchreṣṭhaṃ loke ca yadbhavet ।
pāvanaṃ paramaṃ caiva tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: pavitrARAM pavitraM yacCrezWaM loke ca yadBavet । pAvanaM paramaM cEva tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: gāvo mahārthāḥ puṇyāśca tārayanti ca mānavān । dhārayanti prajāścemāḥ payasā haviṣā tathā ॥2॥
html:
gāvo mahārthāḥ puṇyāśca tārayanti ca mānavān ।
dhārayanti prajāścemāḥ payasā haviṣā tathā ॥2॥
slp1: gAvo mahArTAH puRyASca tArayanti ca mAnavAn । DArayanti prajAScemAH payasA havizA taTA ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: na hi puṇyatamaṃ kiñcidgobhyo bharatasattama । etāḥ pavitrāḥ puṇyāśca triṣu lokeṣvanuttamāḥ ॥3॥
html:
na hi puṇyatamaṃ kiñcidgobhyo bharatasattama ।
etāḥ pavitrāḥ puṇyāśca triṣu lokeṣvanuttamāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: na hi puRyatamaM kiYcidgoByo Baratasattama । etAH pavitrAH puRyASca trizu lokezvanuttamAH ॥3॥

text: devānāmupariṣṭācca gāvaḥ prativasanti vai । dattvā caitā narapate yānti svargaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ ॥4॥
html:
devānāmupariṣṭācca gāvaḥ prativasanti vai ।
dattvā caitā narapate yānti svargaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: devAnAmuparizwAcca gAvaH prativasanti vE । dattvA cEtA narapate yAnti svargaM manIziRaH ॥4॥

text: māndhātā yauvanāśvaśca yayātirnahuṣastathā । gāvo dadantaḥ satataṃ sahasraśatasammitāḥ । gatāḥ paramakaṃ sthānaṃ devairapi sudurlabham ॥5॥
html:
māndhātā yauvanāśvaśca yayātirnahuṣastathā ।
gāvo dadantaḥ satataṃ sahasraśatasammitāḥ ।
gatāḥ paramakaṃ sthānaṃ devairapi sudurlabham ॥5॥
slp1: mAnDAtA yOvanASvaSca yayAtirnahuzastaTA । gAvo dadantaH satataM sahasraSatasammitAH । gatAH paramakaM sTAnaM devErapi sudurlaBam ॥5॥

text: api cātra purāvṛttaṃ kathayiṣyāmi te'nagha ॥6॥
html: api cātra purāvṛttaṃ kathayiṣyāmi te'nagha ॥6॥
slp1: api cAtra purAvfttaM kaTayizyAmi te'naGa ॥6॥

text: ṛṣīṇāmuttamaṃ dhīmānkṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ śukaḥ । abhivādyāhnikaṃ kṛtvā śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ । pitaraṃ paripapraccha dṛṣṭalokaparāvaram ॥7॥
html:
ṛṣīṇāmuttamaṃ dhīmānkṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ śukaḥ ।
abhivādyāhnikaṃ kṛtvā śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ ।
pitaraṃ paripapraccha dṛṣṭalokaparāvaram ॥7॥
slp1: fzIRAmuttamaM DImAnkfzRadvEpAyanaM SukaH । aBivAdyAhnikaM kftvA SuciH prayatamAnasaH । pitaraM paripapracCa dfzwalokaparAvaram ॥7॥

text: ko yajñaḥ sarvayajñānāṃ variṣṭha upalakṣyate । kiṃ ca kṛtvā paraṃ svargaṃ prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥8॥
html:
ko yajñaḥ sarvayajñānāṃ variṣṭha upalakṣyate ।
kiṃ ca kṛtvā paraṃ svargaṃ prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: ko yajYaH sarvayajYAnAM varizWa upalakzyate । kiM ca kftvA paraM svargaM prApnuvanti manIziRaH ॥8॥

text: kena devāḥ pavitreṇa svargamaśnanti vā vibho । kiṃ ca yajñasya yajñatvaṃ kva ca yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥9॥
html:
kena devāḥ pavitreṇa svargamaśnanti vā vibho ।
kiṃ ca yajñasya yajñatvaṃ kva ca yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: kena devAH pavitreRa svargamaSnanti vA viBo । kiM ca yajYasya yajYatvaM kva ca yajYaH pratizWitaH ॥9॥

text: dānānāmuttamaṃ kiṃ ca kiṃ ca satramataḥ param । pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca yattadbrūhi mamānagha ॥10॥
html:
dānānāmuttamaṃ kiṃ ca kiṃ ca satramataḥ param ।
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca yattadbrūhi mamānagha ॥10॥
slp1: dAnAnAmuttamaM kiM ca kiM ca satramataH param । pavitrARAM pavitraM ca yattadbrUhi mamAnaGa ॥10॥

text: etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ vyāsaḥ paramadharmavit । putrāyākathayatsarvaṃ tattvena bharatarṣabha ॥11॥
html:
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ vyāsaḥ paramadharmavit ।
putrāyākathayatsarvaṃ tattvena bharatarṣabha ॥11॥
slp1: etacCrutvA tu vacanaM vyAsaH paramaDarmavit । putrAyAkaTayatsarvaM tattvena BaratarzaBa ॥11॥

text: gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ tathā gāvaḥ parāyaṇam । gāvaḥ puṇyāḥ pavitrāśca pāvanaṃ dharma eva ca ॥12॥
html:
gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ tathā gāvaḥ parāyaṇam ।
gāvaḥ puṇyāḥ pavitrāśca pāvanaṃ dharma eva ca ॥12॥
slp1: gAvaH pratizWA BUtAnAM taTA gAvaH parAyaRam । gAvaH puRyAH pavitrASca pAvanaM Darma eva ca ॥12॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: pūrvamāsannaśṛṅgā vai gāva ityanuśuśrumaḥ । śṛṅgārthe samupāsanta tāḥ kila prabhumavyayam ॥13॥
html:
pūrvamāsannaśṛṅgā vai gāva ityanuśuśrumaḥ ।
śṛṅgārthe samupāsanta tāḥ kila prabhumavyayam ॥13॥
slp1: pUrvamAsannaSfNgA vE gAva ityanuSuSrumaH । SfNgArTe samupAsanta tAH kila praBumavyayam ॥13॥

text: tato brahmā tu gāḥ prāyamupaviṣṭāḥ samīkṣya ha । īpsitaṃ pradadau tābhyo gobhyaḥ pratyekaśaḥ prabhuḥ ॥14॥
html:
tato brahmā tu gāḥ prāyamupaviṣṭāḥ samīkṣya ha ।
īpsitaṃ pradadau tābhyo gobhyaḥ pratyekaśaḥ prabhuḥ ॥14॥
slp1: tato brahmA tu gAH prAyamupavizwAH samIkzya ha । IpsitaM pradadO tAByo goByaH pratyekaSaH praBuH ॥14॥

text: tāsāṃ śṛṅgāṇyajāyanta yasyā yādṛṅmanogatam । nānāvarṇāḥ śṛṅgavantyastā vyarocanta putraka ॥15॥
html:
tāsāṃ śṛṅgāṇyajāyanta yasyā yādṛṅmanogatam ।
nānāvarṇāḥ śṛṅgavantyastā vyarocanta putraka ॥15॥
slp1: tAsAM SfNgARyajAyanta yasyA yAdfNmanogatam । nAnAvarRAH SfNgavantyastA vyarocanta putraka ॥15॥

text: brahmaṇā varadattāstā havyakavyapradāḥ śubhāḥ । puṇyāḥ pavitrāḥ subhagā divyasaṃsthānalakṣaṇāḥ । gāvastejo mahaddivyaṃ gavāṃ dānaṃ praśasyate ॥16॥
html:
brahmaṇā varadattāstā havyakavyapradāḥ śubhāḥ ।
puṇyāḥ pavitrāḥ subhagā divyasaṃsthānalakṣaṇāḥ ।
gāvastejo mahaddivyaṃ gavāṃ dānaṃ praśasyate ॥16॥
slp1: brahmaRA varadattAstA havyakavyapradAH SuBAH । puRyAH pavitrAH suBagA divyasaMsTAnalakzaRAH । gAvastejo mahaddivyaM gavAM dAnaM praSasyate ॥16॥

text: ye caitāḥ samprayacchanti sādhavo vītamatsarāḥ । te vai sukṛtinaḥ proktāḥ sarvadānapradāśca te । gavāṃ lokaṃ tathā puṇyamāpnuvanti ca te'nagha ॥17॥
html:
ye caitāḥ samprayacchanti sādhavo vītamatsarāḥ ।
te vai sukṛtinaḥ proktāḥ sarvadānapradāśca te ।
gavāṃ lokaṃ tathā puṇyamāpnuvanti ca te'nagha ॥17॥
slp1: ye cEtAH samprayacCanti sADavo vItamatsarAH । te vE sukftinaH proktAH sarvadAnapradASca te । gavAM lokaM taTA puRyamApnuvanti ca te'naGa ॥17॥

text: yatra vṛkṣā madhuphalā divyapuṣpaphalopagāḥ । puṣpāṇi ca sugandhīni divyāni dvijasattama ॥18॥
html:
yatra vṛkṣā madhuphalā divyapuṣpaphalopagāḥ ।
puṣpāṇi ca sugandhīni divyāni dvijasattama ॥18॥
slp1: yatra vfkzA maDuPalA divyapuzpaPalopagAH । puzpARi ca suganDIni divyAni dvijasattama ॥18॥

text: sarvā maṇimayī bhūmiḥ sūkṣmakāñcanavālukā । sarvatra sukhasaṃsparśā niṣpaṅkā nīrajā śubhā ॥19॥
html:
sarvā maṇimayī bhūmiḥ sūkṣmakāñcanavālukā ।
sarvatra sukhasaṃsparśā niṣpaṅkā nīrajā śubhā ॥19॥
slp1: sarvA maRimayI BUmiH sUkzmakAYcanavAlukA । sarvatra suKasaMsparSA nizpaNkA nIrajA SuBA ॥19॥

text: raktotpalavanaiścaiva maṇidaṇḍairhiraṇmayaiḥ । taruṇādityasaṅkāśairbhānti tatra jalāśayāḥ ॥20॥
html:
raktotpalavanaiścaiva maṇidaṇḍairhiraṇmayaiḥ ।
taruṇādityasaṅkāśairbhānti tatra jalāśayāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: raktotpalavanEScEva maRidaRqErhiraRmayEH । taruRAdityasaNkASErBAnti tatra jalASayAH ॥20॥

text: mahārhamaṇipatraiśca kāñcanaprabhakesaraiḥ । nīlotpalavimiśraiśca sarobhirbahupaṅkajaiḥ ॥21॥
html:
mahārhamaṇipatraiśca kāñcanaprabhakesaraiḥ ।
nīlotpalavimiśraiśca sarobhirbahupaṅkajaiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: mahArhamaRipatrESca kAYcanapraBakesarEH । nIlotpalavimiSrESca saroBirbahupaNkajEH ॥21॥

text: karavīravanaiḥ phullaiḥ sahasrāvartasaṃvṛtaiḥ । santānakavanaiḥ phullairvṛkṣaiśca samalaṅkṛtāḥ ॥22॥
html:
karavīravanaiḥ phullaiḥ sahasrāvartasaṃvṛtaiḥ ।
santānakavanaiḥ phullairvṛkṣaiśca samalaṅkṛtāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: karavIravanEH PullEH sahasrAvartasaMvftEH । santAnakavanEH PullErvfkzESca samalaNkftAH ॥22॥

text: nirmalābhiśca muktābhirmaṇibhiśca mahādhanaiḥ । uddhūtapulināstatra jātarūpaiśca nimnagāḥ ॥23॥
html:
nirmalābhiśca muktābhirmaṇibhiśca mahādhanaiḥ ।
uddhūtapulināstatra jātarūpaiśca nimnagāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: nirmalABiSca muktABirmaRiBiSca mahADanEH । udDUtapulinAstatra jAtarUpESca nimnagAH ॥23॥

text: sarvaratnamayaiścitrairavagāḍhā nagottamaiḥ । jātarūpamayaiścānyairhutāśanasamaprabhaiḥ ॥24॥
html:
sarvaratnamayaiścitrairavagāḍhā nagottamaiḥ ।
jātarūpamayaiścānyairhutāśanasamaprabhaiḥ ॥24॥
slp1: sarvaratnamayEScitrEravagAQA nagottamEH । jAtarUpamayEScAnyErhutASanasamapraBEH ॥24॥

text: sauvarṇagirayastatra maṇiratnaśiloccayāḥ । sarvaratnamayairbhānti śṛṅgaiścārubhirucchritaiḥ ॥25॥
html:
sauvarṇagirayastatra maṇiratnaśiloccayāḥ ।
sarvaratnamayairbhānti śṛṅgaiścārubhirucchritaiḥ ॥25॥
slp1: sOvarRagirayastatra maRiratnaSiloccayAH । sarvaratnamayErBAnti SfNgEScAruBirucCritEH ॥25॥

text: nityapuṣpaphalāstatra nagāḥ patrarathākulāḥ । divyagandharasaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiśca bharatarṣabha ॥26॥
html:
nityapuṣpaphalāstatra nagāḥ patrarathākulāḥ ।
divyagandharasaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiśca bharatarṣabha ॥26॥
slp1: nityapuzpaPalAstatra nagAH patraraTAkulAH । divyaganDarasEH puzpEH PalESca BaratarzaBa ॥26॥

text: ramante puṇyakarmāṇastatra nityaṃ yudhiṣṭhira । sarvakāmasamṛddhārthā niḥśokā gatamanyavaḥ ॥27॥
html:
ramante puṇyakarmāṇastatra nityaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ।
sarvakāmasamṛddhārthā niḥśokā gatamanyavaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: ramante puRyakarmARastatra nityaM yuDizWira । sarvakAmasamfdDArTA niHSokA gatamanyavaH ॥27॥

text: vimāneṣu vicitreṣu ramaṇīyeṣu bhārata । modante puṇyakarmāṇo viharanto yaśasvinaḥ ॥28॥
html:
vimāneṣu vicitreṣu ramaṇīyeṣu bhārata ।
modante puṇyakarmāṇo viharanto yaśasvinaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: vimAnezu vicitrezu ramaRIyezu BArata । modante puRyakarmARo viharanto yaSasvinaH ॥28॥

text: upakrīḍanti tānrājañśubhāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ । etāṁllokānavāpnoti gāṃ dattvā vai yudhiṣṭhira ॥29॥
html:
upakrīḍanti tānrājañśubhāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ।
etāṁllokānavāpnoti gāṃ dattvā vai yudhiṣṭhira ॥29॥
slp1: upakrIqanti tAnrAjaYSuBAScApsarasAM gaRAH । etAṁllokAnavApnoti gAM dattvA vE yuDizWira ॥29॥

text: yāsāmadhipatiḥ pūṣā māruto balavānbalī । aiśvarye varuṇo rājā tā māṃ pāntu yugandharāḥ ॥30॥
html:
yāsāmadhipatiḥ pūṣā māruto balavānbalī ।
aiśvarye varuṇo rājā tā māṃ pāntu yugandharāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: yAsAmaDipatiH pUzA mAruto balavAnbalI । ESvarye varuRo rAjA tA mAM pAntu yuganDarAH ॥30॥

text: surūpā bahurūpāśca viśvarūpāśca mātaraḥ । prājāpatyā iti brahmañjapennityaṃ yatavrataḥ ॥31॥
html:
surūpā bahurūpāśca viśvarūpāśca mātaraḥ ।
prājāpatyā iti brahmañjapennityaṃ yatavrataḥ ॥31॥
slp1: surUpA bahurUpASca viSvarUpASca mAtaraH । prAjApatyA iti brahmaYjapennityaM yatavrataH ॥31॥

text: gāstu śuśrūṣate yaśca samanveti ca sarvaśaḥ । tasmai tuṣṭāḥ prayacchanti varānapi sudurlabhān ॥32॥
html:
gāstu śuśrūṣate yaśca samanveti ca sarvaśaḥ ।
tasmai tuṣṭāḥ prayacchanti varānapi sudurlabhān ॥32॥
slp1: gAstu SuSrUzate yaSca samanveti ca sarvaSaH । tasmE tuzwAH prayacCanti varAnapi sudurlaBAn ॥32॥

text: na druhyenmanasā cāpi goṣu tā hi sukhapradāḥ । arcayeta sadā caiva namaskāraiśca pūjayet । dāntaḥ prītamanā nityaṃ gavāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tathāśnute ॥33॥
html:
na druhyenmanasā cāpi goṣu tā hi sukhapradāḥ ।
arcayeta sadā caiva namaskāraiśca pūjayet ।
dāntaḥ prītamanā nityaṃ gavāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tathāśnute ॥33॥
slp1: na druhyenmanasA cApi gozu tA hi suKapradAH । arcayeta sadA cEva namaskArESca pUjayet । dAntaH prItamanA nityaM gavAM vyuzwiM taTASnute ॥33॥

text: yena devāḥ pavitreṇa bhuñjate lokamuttamam । yatpavitraṃ pavitrāṇāṃ tadghṛtaṃ śirasā vahet ॥34॥
html:
yena devāḥ pavitreṇa bhuñjate lokamuttamam ।
yatpavitraṃ pavitrāṇāṃ tadghṛtaṃ śirasā vahet ॥34॥
slp1: yena devAH pavitreRa BuYjate lokamuttamam । yatpavitraM pavitrARAM tadGftaM SirasA vahet ॥34॥

text: ghṛtena juhuyādagniṃ ghṛtena svasti vācayet । ghṛtaṃ prāśedghṛtaṃ dadyādgavāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tathāśnute ॥35॥
html:
ghṛtena juhuyādagniṃ ghṛtena svasti vācayet ।
ghṛtaṃ prāśedghṛtaṃ dadyādgavāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tathāśnute ॥35॥
slp1: Gftena juhuyAdagniM Gftena svasti vAcayet । GftaM prASedGftaM dadyAdgavAM vyuzwiM taTASnute ॥35॥

text: tryahamuṣṇaṃ pibenmūtraṃ tryahamuṣṇaṃ pibetpayaḥ । gavāmuṣṇaṃ payaḥ pītvā tryahamuṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet । tryahamuṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā vāyubhakṣo bhavettryaham ॥36॥
html:
tryahamuṣṇaṃ pibenmūtraṃ tryahamuṣṇaṃ pibetpayaḥ ।
gavāmuṣṇaṃ payaḥ pītvā tryahamuṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet ।
tryahamuṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā vāyubhakṣo bhavettryaham ॥36॥
slp1: tryahamuzRaM pibenmUtraM tryahamuzRaM pibetpayaH । gavAmuzRaM payaH pItvA tryahamuzRaM GftaM pibet । tryahamuzRaM GftaM pItvA vAyuBakzo Bavettryaham ॥36॥

text: nirhṛtaiśca yavairgobhirmāsaṃ prasṛtayāvakaḥ । brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ sarvametena śudhyati ॥37॥
html:
nirhṛtaiśca yavairgobhirmāsaṃ prasṛtayāvakaḥ ।
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ sarvametena śudhyati ॥37॥
slp1: nirhftESca yavErgoBirmAsaM prasftayAvakaH । brahmahatyAsamaM pApaM sarvametena SuDyati ॥37॥

text: parābhavārthaṃ daityānāṃ devaiḥ śaucamidaṃ kṛtam । devatvamapi ca prāptāḥ saṃsiddhāśca mahābalāḥ ॥38॥
html:
parābhavārthaṃ daityānāṃ devaiḥ śaucamidaṃ kṛtam ।
devatvamapi ca prāptāḥ saṃsiddhāśca mahābalāḥ ॥38॥
slp1: parABavArTaM dEtyAnAM devEH SOcamidaM kftam । devatvamapi ca prAptAH saMsidDASca mahAbalAH ॥38॥

text: gāvaḥ pavitrāḥ puṇyāśca pāvanaṃ paramaṃ mahat । tāśca dattvā dvijātibhyo naraḥ svargamupāśnute ॥39॥
html:
gāvaḥ pavitrāḥ puṇyāśca pāvanaṃ paramaṃ mahat ।
tāśca dattvā dvijātibhyo naraḥ svargamupāśnute ॥39॥
slp1: gAvaH pavitrAH puRyASca pAvanaM paramaM mahat । tASca dattvA dvijAtiByo naraH svargamupASnute ॥39॥

text: gavāṃ madhye śucirbhūtvā gomatīṃ manasā japet । pūtābhiradbhirācamya śucirbhavati nirmalaḥ ॥40॥
html:
gavāṃ madhye śucirbhūtvā gomatīṃ manasā japet ।
pūtābhiradbhirācamya śucirbhavati nirmalaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: gavAM maDye SucirBUtvA gomatIM manasA japet । pUtABiradBirAcamya SucirBavati nirmalaH ॥40॥

text: agnimadhye gavāṃ madhye brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃsadi । vidyāvedavratasnātā brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ ॥41॥
html:
agnimadhye gavāṃ madhye brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃsadi ।
vidyāvedavratasnātā brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: agnimaDye gavAM maDye brAhmaRAnAM ca saMsadi । vidyAvedavratasnAtA brAhmaRAH puRyakarmiRaH ॥41॥

text: adhyāpayerañśiṣyānvai gomatīṃ yajñasammitām । trirātropoṣitaḥ śrutvā gomatīṃ labhate varam ॥42॥
html:
adhyāpayerañśiṣyānvai gomatīṃ yajñasammitām ।
trirātropoṣitaḥ śrutvā gomatīṃ labhate varam ॥42॥
slp1: aDyApayeraYSizyAnvE gomatIM yajYasammitAm । trirAtropozitaH SrutvA gomatIM laBate varam ॥42॥

text: putrakāmaśca labhate putraṃ dhanamathāpi ca । patikāmā ca bhartāraṃ sarvakāmāṃśca mānavaḥ । gāvastuṣṭāḥ prayacchanti sevitā vai na saṃśayaḥ ॥43॥
html:
putrakāmaśca labhate putraṃ dhanamathāpi ca ।
patikāmā ca bhartāraṃ sarvakāmāṃśca mānavaḥ ।
gāvastuṣṭāḥ prayacchanti sevitā vai na saṃśayaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: putrakAmaSca laBate putraM DanamaTApi ca । patikAmA ca BartAraM sarvakAmAMSca mAnavaH । gAvastuzwAH prayacCanti sevitA vE na saMSayaH ॥43॥

text: evametā mahābhāgā yajñiyāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ । rohiṇya iti jānīhi naitābhyo vidyate param ॥44॥
html:
evametā mahābhāgā yajñiyāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ ।
rohiṇya iti jānīhi naitābhyo vidyate param ॥44॥
slp1: evametA mahABAgA yajYiyAH sarvakAmadAH । rohiRya iti jAnIhi nEtAByo vidyate param ॥44॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa mahātejāḥ śukaḥ pitrā mahātmanā । pūjayāmāsa gā nityaṃ tasmāttvamapi pūjaya] ॥45॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa mahātejāḥ śukaḥ pitrā mahātmanā ।
pūjayāmāsa gā nityaṃ tasmāttvamapi pūjaya] ॥45॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa mahAtejAH SukaH pitrA mahAtmanA । pUjayAmAsa gA nityaM tasmAttvamapi pUjaya] ॥45॥

text: mayā gavāṃ purīṣaṃ vai śriyā juṣṭamiti śrutam । etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ saṃśayo'tra hi me mahān ॥1॥
html:
mayā gavāṃ purīṣaṃ vai śriyā juṣṭamiti śrutam ।
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ saṃśayo'tra hi me mahān ॥1॥
slp1: mayA gavAM purIzaM vE SriyA juzwamiti Srutam । etadicCAmyahaM SrotuM saMSayo'tra hi me mahAn ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gobhirnṛpeha saṃvādaṃ śriyā bharatasattama ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
gobhirnṛpeha saṃvādaṃ śriyā bharatasattama ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । goBirnfpeha saMvAdaM SriyA Baratasattama ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śrīḥ kṛtveha vapuḥ kāntaṃ gomadhyaṃ praviveśa ha । gāvo'tha vismitāstasyā dṛṣṭvā rūpasya sampadam ॥3॥
html:
śrīḥ kṛtveha vapuḥ kāntaṃ gomadhyaṃ praviveśa ha ।
gāvo'tha vismitāstasyā dṛṣṭvā rūpasya sampadam ॥3॥
slp1: SrIH kftveha vapuH kAntaM gomaDyaM praviveSa ha । gAvo'Ta vismitAstasyA dfzwvA rUpasya sampadam ॥3॥

text: kāsi devi kuto vā tvaṃ rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi । vismitāḥ sma mahābhāge tava rūpasya sampadā ॥4॥
html:
kāsi devi kuto vā tvaṃ rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi ।
vismitāḥ sma mahābhāge tava rūpasya sampadā ॥4॥
slp1: kAsi devi kuto vA tvaM rUpeRApratimA Buvi । vismitAH sma mahABAge tava rUpasya sampadA ॥4॥
author: gāva ūcuḥ ।

text: icchāmastvāṃ vayaṃ jñātuṃ kā tvaṃ kva ca gamiṣyasi । tattvena ca suvarṇābhe sarvametadbravīhi naḥ ॥5॥
html:
icchāmastvāṃ vayaṃ jñātuṃ kā tvaṃ kva ca gamiṣyasi ।
tattvena ca suvarṇābhe sarvametadbravīhi naḥ ॥5॥
slp1: icCAmastvAM vayaM jYAtuM kA tvaM kva ca gamizyasi । tattvena ca suvarRABe sarvametadbravIhi naH ॥5॥

text: lokakāntāsmi bhadraṃ vaḥ śrīrnāmneha pariśrutā । mayā daityāḥ parityaktā vinaṣṭāḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ॥6॥
html:
lokakāntāsmi bhadraṃ vaḥ śrīrnāmneha pariśrutā ।
mayā daityāḥ parityaktā vinaṣṭāḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: lokakAntAsmi BadraM vaH SrIrnAmneha pariSrutA । mayA dEtyAH parityaktA vinazwAH SASvatIH samAH ॥6॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: indro vivasvānsomaśca viṣṇurāpo'gnireva ca । mayābhipannā ṛdhyante ṛṣayo devatāstathā ॥7॥
html:
indro vivasvānsomaśca viṣṇurāpo'gnireva ca ।
mayābhipannā ṛdhyante ṛṣayo devatāstathā ॥7॥
slp1: indro vivasvAnsomaSca vizRurApo'gnireva ca । mayABipannA fDyante fzayo devatAstaTA ॥7॥

text: yāṃśca dviṣāmyahaṃ gāvaste vinaśyanti sarvaśaḥ । dharmārthakāmahīnāśca te bhavantyasukhānvitāḥ ॥8॥
html:
yāṃśca dviṣāmyahaṃ gāvaste vinaśyanti sarvaśaḥ ।
dharmārthakāmahīnāśca te bhavantyasukhānvitāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yAMSca dvizAmyahaM gAvaste vinaSyanti sarvaSaH । DarmArTakAmahInASca te BavantyasuKAnvitAH ॥8॥

text: evamprabhāvāṃ māṃ gāvo vijānīta sukhapradām । icchāmi cāpi yuṣmāsu vastuṃ sarvāsu nityadā । āgatā prārthayānāhaṃ śrījuṣṭā bhavatānaghāḥ ॥9॥
html:
evamprabhāvāṃ māṃ gāvo vijānīta sukhapradām ।
icchāmi cāpi yuṣmāsu vastuṃ sarvāsu nityadā ।
āgatā prārthayānāhaṃ śrījuṣṭā bhavatānaghāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: evampraBAvAM mAM gAvo vijAnIta suKapradAm । icCAmi cApi yuzmAsu vastuM sarvAsu nityadA । AgatA prArTayAnAhaM SrIjuzwA BavatAnaGAH ॥9॥

text: adhruvāṃ cañcalāṃ ca tvāṃ sāmānyāṃ bahubhiḥ saha । na tvāmicchāmi bhadraṃ te gamyatāṃ yatra rocate ॥10॥
html:
adhruvāṃ cañcalāṃ ca tvāṃ sāmānyāṃ bahubhiḥ saha ।
na tvāmicchāmi bhadraṃ te gamyatāṃ yatra rocate ॥10॥
slp1: aDruvAM caYcalAM ca tvAM sAmAnyAM bahuBiH saha । na tvAmicCAmi BadraM te gamyatAM yatra rocate ॥10॥
author: gāva ūcuḥ ।

text: vapuṣmantyo vayaṃ sarvāḥ kimasmākaṃ tvayādya vai । yatreṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ tatra kṛtakāryā vayaṃ tvayā ॥11॥
html:
vapuṣmantyo vayaṃ sarvāḥ kimasmākaṃ tvayādya vai ।
yatreṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ tatra kṛtakāryā vayaṃ tvayā ॥11॥
slp1: vapuzmantyo vayaM sarvAH kimasmAkaM tvayAdya vE । yatrezwaM gamyatAM tatra kftakAryA vayaM tvayA ॥11॥

text: kimetadvaḥ kṣamaṃ gāvo yanmāṃ nehābhyanandatha । na māṃ samprati gṛhṇītha kasmādvai durlabhāṃ satīm ॥12॥
html:
kimetadvaḥ kṣamaṃ gāvo yanmāṃ nehābhyanandatha ।
na māṃ samprati gṛhṇītha kasmādvai durlabhāṃ satīm ॥12॥
slp1: kimetadvaH kzamaM gAvo yanmAM nehAByanandaTa । na mAM samprati gfhRITa kasmAdvE durlaBAM satIm ॥12॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: satyaśca lokavādo'yaṃ loke carati suvratāḥ । svayaṃ prāpte paribhavo bhavatīti viniścayaḥ ॥13॥
html:
satyaśca lokavādo'yaṃ loke carati suvratāḥ ।
svayaṃ prāpte paribhavo bhavatīti viniścayaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: satyaSca lokavAdo'yaM loke carati suvratAH । svayaM prApte pariBavo BavatIti viniScayaH ॥13॥

text: mahadugraṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā māṃ niṣevanti mānavāḥ । devadānavagandharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ ॥14॥
html:
mahadugraṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā māṃ niṣevanti mānavāḥ ।
devadānavagandharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: mahadugraM tapaH kftvA mAM nizevanti mAnavAH । devadAnavaganDarvAH piSAcoragarAkzasAH ॥14॥

text: kṣamametaddhi vo gāvaḥ pratigṛhṇīta māmiha । nāvamanyā hyahaṃ saumyāstrailokye sacarācare ॥15॥
html:
kṣamametaddhi vo gāvaḥ pratigṛhṇīta māmiha ।
nāvamanyā hyahaṃ saumyāstrailokye sacarācare ॥15॥
slp1: kzamametadDi vo gAvaH pratigfhRIta mAmiha । nAvamanyA hyahaM sOmyAstrElokye sacarAcare ॥15॥

text: nāvamanyāmahe devi na tvāṃ paribhavāmahe । adhruvā calacittāsi tatastvāṃ varjayāmahe ॥16॥
html:
nāvamanyāmahe devi na tvāṃ paribhavāmahe ।
adhruvā calacittāsi tatastvāṃ varjayāmahe ॥16॥
slp1: nAvamanyAmahe devi na tvAM pariBavAmahe । aDruvA calacittAsi tatastvAM varjayAmahe ॥16॥
author: gāva ūcuḥ ।

text: bahunātra kimuktena gamyatāṃ yatra vāñchasi । vapuṣmatyo vayaṃ sarvāḥ kimasmākaṃ tvayānaghe ॥17॥
html:
bahunātra kimuktena gamyatāṃ yatra vāñchasi ।
vapuṣmatyo vayaṃ sarvāḥ kimasmākaṃ tvayānaghe ॥17॥
slp1: bahunAtra kimuktena gamyatAM yatra vAYCasi । vapuzmatyo vayaM sarvAH kimasmAkaM tvayAnaGe ॥17॥

text: avajñātā bhaviṣyāmi sarvalokeṣu mānadāḥ । pratyākhyānena yuṣmābhiḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti ॥18॥
html:
avajñātā bhaviṣyāmi sarvalokeṣu mānadāḥ ।
pratyākhyānena yuṣmābhiḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti ॥18॥
slp1: avajYAtA BavizyAmi sarvalokezu mAnadAH । pratyAKyAnena yuzmABiH prasAdaH kriyatAmiti ॥18॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: mahābhāgā bhavatyo vai śaraṇyāḥ śaraṇāgatām । paritrāyantu māṃ nityaṃ bhajamānāmaninditām । mānanāṃ tvahamicchāmi bhavatyaḥ satataṃ śubhāḥ ॥19॥
html:
mahābhāgā bhavatyo vai śaraṇyāḥ śaraṇāgatām ।
paritrāyantu māṃ nityaṃ bhajamānāmaninditām ।
mānanāṃ tvahamicchāmi bhavatyaḥ satataṃ śubhāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: mahABAgA Bavatyo vE SaraRyAH SaraRAgatAm । paritrAyantu mAM nityaM BajamAnAmaninditAm । mAnanAM tvahamicCAmi BavatyaH satataM SuBAH ॥19॥

text: apyekāṅge tu vo vastumicchāmi ca sukutsite । na vo'sti kutsitaṃ kiñcidaṅgeṣvālakṣyate'naghāḥ ॥20॥
html:
apyekāṅge tu vo vastumicchāmi ca sukutsite ।
na vo'sti kutsitaṃ kiñcidaṅgeṣvālakṣyate'naghāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: apyekANge tu vo vastumicCAmi ca sukutsite । na vo'sti kutsitaM kiYcidaNgezvAlakzyate'naGAH ॥20॥

text: puṇyāḥ pavitrāḥ subhagā mamādeśaṃ prayacchata । vaseyaṃ yatra cāṅge'haṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhatha ॥21॥
html:
puṇyāḥ pavitrāḥ subhagā mamādeśaṃ prayacchata ।
vaseyaṃ yatra cāṅge'haṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhatha ॥21॥
slp1: puRyAH pavitrAH suBagA mamAdeSaM prayacCata । vaseyaM yatra cANge'haM tanme vyAKyAtumarhaTa ॥21॥

text: evamuktāstu tā gāvaḥ śubhāḥ karuṇavatsalāḥ । sammantrya sahitāḥ sarvāḥ śriyamūcurnarādhipa ॥22॥
html:
evamuktāstu tā gāvaḥ śubhāḥ karuṇavatsalāḥ ।
sammantrya sahitāḥ sarvāḥ śriyamūcurnarādhipa ॥22॥
slp1: evamuktAstu tA gAvaH SuBAH karuRavatsalAH । sammantrya sahitAH sarvAH SriyamUcurnarADipa ॥22॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: avaśyaṃ mānanā kāryā tavāsmābhiryaśasvini । śakṛnmūtre nivasa naḥ puṇyametaddhi naḥ śubhe ॥23॥
html:
avaśyaṃ mānanā kāryā tavāsmābhiryaśasvini ।
śakṛnmūtre nivasa naḥ puṇyametaddhi naḥ śubhe ॥23॥
slp1: avaSyaM mAnanA kAryA tavAsmABiryaSasvini । SakfnmUtre nivasa naH puRyametadDi naH SuBe ॥23॥

text: diṣṭyā prasādo yuṣmābhiḥ kṛto me'nugrahātmakaḥ । evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ vaḥ pūjitāsmi sukhapradāḥ ॥24॥
html:
diṣṭyā prasādo yuṣmābhiḥ kṛto me'nugrahātmakaḥ ।
evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ vaḥ pūjitāsmi sukhapradāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: dizwyA prasAdo yuzmABiH kfto me'nugrahAtmakaH । evaM Bavatu BadraM vaH pUjitAsmi suKapradAH ॥24॥
author: śrīruvāca ।

text: evaṃ kṛtvā tu samayaṃ śrīrgobhiḥ saha bhārata । paśyantīnāṃ tatastāsāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥25॥
html:
evaṃ kṛtvā tu samayaṃ śrīrgobhiḥ saha bhārata ।
paśyantīnāṃ tatastāsāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥25॥
slp1: evaM kftvA tu samayaM SrIrgoBiH saha BArata । paSyantInAM tatastAsAM tatrEvAntaraDIyata ॥25॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: etadgośakṛtaḥ putra māhātmyaṃ te'nuvarṇitam । māhātmyaṃ ca gavāṃ bhūyaḥ śrūyatāṃ gadato mama] ॥26॥
html:
etadgośakṛtaḥ putra māhātmyaṃ te'nuvarṇitam ।
māhātmyaṃ ca gavāṃ bhūyaḥ śrūyatāṃ gadato mama] ॥26॥
slp1: etadgoSakftaH putra mAhAtmyaM te'nuvarRitam । mAhAtmyaM ca gavAM BUyaH SrUyatAM gadato mama] ॥26॥

text: ye ca gāḥ samprayacchanti hutaśiṣṭāśinaśca ye । teṣāṃ satrāṇi yajñāśca nityameva yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
html:
ye ca gāḥ samprayacchanti hutaśiṣṭāśinaśca ye ।
teṣāṃ satrāṇi yajñāśca nityameva yudhiṣṭhira ॥1॥
slp1: ye ca gAH samprayacCanti hutaSizwASinaSca ye । tezAM satrARi yajYASca nityameva yuDizWira ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ṛte dadhighṛteneha na yajñaḥ sampravartate । tena yajñasya yajñatvamatomūlaṃ ca lakṣyate ॥2॥
html:
ṛte dadhighṛteneha na yajñaḥ sampravartate ।
tena yajñasya yajñatvamatomūlaṃ ca lakṣyate ॥2॥
slp1: fte daDiGfteneha na yajYaH sampravartate । tena yajYasya yajYatvamatomUlaM ca lakzyate ॥2॥

text: dānānāmapi sarveṣāṃ gavāṃ dānaṃ praśasyate । gāvaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pavitrāśca pāvanaṃ hyetaduttamam ॥3॥
html:
dānānāmapi sarveṣāṃ gavāṃ dānaṃ praśasyate ।
gāvaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pavitrāśca pāvanaṃ hyetaduttamam ॥3॥
slp1: dAnAnAmapi sarvezAM gavAM dAnaM praSasyate । gAvaH SrezWAH pavitrASca pAvanaM hyetaduttamam ॥3॥

text: puṣṭyarthametāḥ seveta śāntyarthamapi caiva ha । payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ yāsāṃ sarvapāpapramocanam ॥4॥
html:
puṣṭyarthametāḥ seveta śāntyarthamapi caiva ha ।
payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ yāsāṃ sarvapāpapramocanam ॥4॥
slp1: puzwyarTametAH seveta SAntyarTamapi cEva ha । payo daDi GftaM yAsAM sarvapApapramocanam ॥4॥

text: gāvastejaḥ paraṃ proktamiha loke paratra ca । na gobhyaḥ paramaṃ kiñcitpavitraṃ puruṣarṣabha ॥5॥
html:
gāvastejaḥ paraṃ proktamiha loke paratra ca ।
na gobhyaḥ paramaṃ kiñcitpavitraṃ puruṣarṣabha ॥5॥
slp1: gAvastejaH paraM proktamiha loke paratra ca । na goByaH paramaM kiYcitpavitraM puruzarzaBa ॥5॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । pitāmahasya saṃvādamindrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥6॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
pitāmahasya saṃvādamindrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥6॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । pitAmahasya saMvAdamindrasya ca yuDizWira ॥6॥

text: parābhūteṣu daityeṣu śakre tribhuvaneśvare । prajāḥ samuditāḥ sarvāḥ satyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ ॥7॥
html:
parābhūteṣu daityeṣu śakre tribhuvaneśvare ।
prajāḥ samuditāḥ sarvāḥ satyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: parABUtezu dEtyezu Sakre triBuvaneSvare । prajAH samuditAH sarvAH satyaDarmaparAyaRAH ॥7॥

text: atharṣayaḥ sagandharvāḥ kinnaroragarākṣasāḥ । devāsurasuparṇāśca prajānāṃ patayastathā । paryupāsanta kauravya kadācidvai pitāmaham ॥8॥
html:
atharṣayaḥ sagandharvāḥ kinnaroragarākṣasāḥ ।
devāsurasuparṇāśca prajānāṃ patayastathā ।
paryupāsanta kauravya kadācidvai pitāmaham ॥8॥
slp1: aTarzayaH saganDarvAH kinnaroragarAkzasAH । devAsurasuparRASca prajAnAM patayastaTA । paryupAsanta kOravya kadAcidvE pitAmaham ॥8॥

text: nāradaḥ parvataścaiva viśvāvasuhahāhuhū । divyatāneṣu gāyantaḥ paryupāsanta taṃ prabhum ॥9॥
html:
nāradaḥ parvataścaiva viśvāvasuhahāhuhū ।
divyatāneṣu gāyantaḥ paryupāsanta taṃ prabhum ॥9॥
slp1: nAradaH parvataScEva viSvAvasuhahAhuhU । divyatAnezu gAyantaH paryupAsanta taM praBum ॥9॥

text: tatra divyāni puṣpāṇi prāvahatpavanastathā । ājahrurṛtavaścāpi sugandhīni pṛthakpṛthak ॥10॥
html:
tatra divyāni puṣpāṇi prāvahatpavanastathā ।
ājahrurṛtavaścāpi sugandhīni pṛthakpṛthak ॥10॥
slp1: tatra divyAni puzpARi prAvahatpavanastaTA । AjahrurftavaScApi suganDIni pfTakpfTak ॥10॥

text: tasmindevasamāvāye sarvabhūtasamāgame । divyavāditrasaṅghuṣṭe divyastrīcāraṇāvṛte । indraḥ papraccha deveśamabhivādya praṇamya ca ॥11॥
html:
tasmindevasamāvāye sarvabhūtasamāgame ।
divyavāditrasaṅghuṣṭe divyastrīcāraṇāvṛte ।
indraḥ papraccha deveśamabhivādya praṇamya ca ॥11॥
slp1: tasmindevasamAvAye sarvaBUtasamAgame । divyavAditrasaNGuzwe divyastrIcAraRAvfte । indraH papracCa deveSamaBivAdya praRamya ca ॥11॥

text: devānāṃ bhagavankasmāllokeśānāṃ pitāmaha । upariṣṭādgavāṃ loka etadicchāmi veditum ॥12॥
html:
devānāṃ bhagavankasmāllokeśānāṃ pitāmaha ।
upariṣṭādgavāṃ loka etadicchāmi veditum ॥12॥
slp1: devAnAM BagavankasmAllokeSAnAM pitAmaha । uparizwAdgavAM loka etadicCAmi veditum ॥12॥

text: kiṃ tapo brahmacaryaṃ vā gobhiḥ kṛtamiheśvara । devānāmupariṣṭādyadvasantyarajasaḥ sukham ॥13॥
html:
kiṃ tapo brahmacaryaṃ vā gobhiḥ kṛtamiheśvara ।
devānāmupariṣṭādyadvasantyarajasaḥ sukham ॥13॥
slp1: kiM tapo brahmacaryaM vA goBiH kftamiheSvara । devAnAmuparizwAdyadvasantyarajasaH suKam ॥13॥

text: tataḥ provāca taṃ brahmā śakraṃ balanisūdanam । avajñātāstvayā nityaṃ gāvo balanisūdana ॥14॥
html:
tataḥ provāca taṃ brahmā śakraṃ balanisūdanam ।
avajñātāstvayā nityaṃ gāvo balanisūdana ॥14॥
slp1: tataH provAca taM brahmA SakraM balanisUdanam । avajYAtAstvayA nityaM gAvo balanisUdana ॥14॥

text: tena tvamāsāṃ māhātmyaṃ na vettha śṛṇu tatprabho । gavāṃ prabhāvaṃ paramaṃ māhātmyaṃ ca surarṣabha ॥15॥
html:
tena tvamāsāṃ māhātmyaṃ na vettha śṛṇu tatprabho ।
gavāṃ prabhāvaṃ paramaṃ māhātmyaṃ ca surarṣabha ॥15॥
slp1: tena tvamAsAM mAhAtmyaM na vetTa SfRu tatpraBo । gavAM praBAvaM paramaM mAhAtmyaM ca surarzaBa ॥15॥

text: yajñāṅgaṃ kathitā gāvo yajña eva ca vāsava । etābhiścāpyṛte yajño na pravartetkathañcana ॥16॥
html:
yajñāṅgaṃ kathitā gāvo yajña eva ca vāsava ।
etābhiścāpyṛte yajño na pravartetkathañcana ॥16॥
slp1: yajYANgaM kaTitA gAvo yajYa eva ca vAsava । etABiScApyfte yajYo na pravartetkaTaYcana ॥16॥

text: dhārayanti prajāścaiva payasā haviṣā tathā । etāsāṃ tanayāścāpi kṛṣiyogamupāsate ॥17॥
html:
dhārayanti prajāścaiva payasā haviṣā tathā ।
etāsāṃ tanayāścāpi kṛṣiyogamupāsate ॥17॥
slp1: DArayanti prajAScEva payasA havizA taTA । etAsAM tanayAScApi kfziyogamupAsate ॥17॥

text: janayanti ca dhānyāni bījāni vividhāni ca । tato yajñāḥ pravartante havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥18॥
html:
janayanti ca dhānyāni bījāni vividhāni ca ।
tato yajñāḥ pravartante havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: janayanti ca DAnyAni bIjAni viviDAni ca । tato yajYAH pravartante havyaM kavyaM ca sarvaSaH ॥18॥

text: payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ caiva puṇyāścaitāḥ surādhipa । vahanti vividhānbhārānkṣuttṛṣṇāparipīḍitāḥ ॥19॥
html:
payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ caiva puṇyāścaitāḥ surādhipa ।
vahanti vividhānbhārānkṣuttṛṣṇāparipīḍitāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: payo daDi GftaM cEva puRyAScEtAH surADipa । vahanti viviDAnBArAnkzuttfzRAparipIqitAH ॥19॥

text: munīṃśca dhārayantīha prajāścaivāpi karmaṇā । vāsavākūṭavāhinyaḥ karmaṇā sukṛtena ca । upariṣṭāttato'smākaṃ vasantyetāḥ sadaiva hi ॥20॥
html:
munīṃśca dhārayantīha prajāścaivāpi karmaṇā ।
vāsavākūṭavāhinyaḥ karmaṇā sukṛtena ca ।
upariṣṭāttato'smākaṃ vasantyetāḥ sadaiva hi ॥20॥
slp1: munIMSca DArayantIha prajAScEvApi karmaRA । vAsavAkUwavAhinyaH karmaRA sukftena ca । uparizwAttato'smAkaM vasantyetAH sadEva hi ॥20॥

text: etatte kāraṇaṃ śakra nivāsakṛtamadya vai । gavāṃ devopariṣṭāddhi samākhyātaṃ śatakrato ॥21॥
html:
etatte kāraṇaṃ śakra nivāsakṛtamadya vai ।
gavāṃ devopariṣṭāddhi samākhyātaṃ śatakrato ॥21॥
slp1: etatte kAraRaM Sakra nivAsakftamadya vE । gavAM devoparizwAdDi samAKyAtaM Satakrato ॥21॥

text: etā hi varadattāśca varadāścaiva vāsava । saurabhyaḥ puṇyakarmiṇyaḥ pāvanāḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥ ॥22॥
html:
etā hi varadattāśca varadāścaiva vāsava ।
saurabhyaḥ puṇyakarmiṇyaḥ pāvanāḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: etA hi varadattASca varadAScEva vAsava । sOraByaH puRyakarmiRyaH pAvanAH SuBalakzaRAH ॥22॥

text: yadarthaṃ gā gatāścaiva saurabhyaḥ surasattama । tacca me śṛṇu kārtsnyena vadato balasūdana ॥23॥
html:
yadarthaṃ gā gatāścaiva saurabhyaḥ surasattama ।
tacca me śṛṇu kārtsnyena vadato balasūdana ॥23॥
slp1: yadarTaM gA gatAScEva sOraByaH surasattama । tacca me SfRu kArtsnyena vadato balasUdana ॥23॥

text: purā devayuge tāta daityendreṣu mahātmasu । trīṁllokānanuśāsatsu viṣṇau garbhatvamāgate ॥24॥
html:
purā devayuge tāta daityendreṣu mahātmasu ।
trīṁllokānanuśāsatsu viṣṇau garbhatvamāgate ॥24॥
slp1: purA devayuge tAta dEtyendrezu mahAtmasu । trIṁllokAnanuSAsatsu vizRO garBatvamAgate ॥24॥

text: adityāstapyamānāyāstapo ghoraṃ suduścaram । putrārthamamaraśreṣṭha pādenaikena nityadā ॥25॥
html:
adityāstapyamānāyāstapo ghoraṃ suduścaram ।
putrārthamamaraśreṣṭha pādenaikena nityadā ॥25॥
slp1: adityAstapyamAnAyAstapo GoraM suduScaram । putrArTamamaraSrezWa pAdenEkena nityadA ॥25॥

text: tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mahādevīṃ tapyamānāṃ mahattapaḥ । dakṣasya duhitā devī surabhirnāma nāmataḥ ॥26॥
html:
tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mahādevīṃ tapyamānāṃ mahattapaḥ ।
dakṣasya duhitā devī surabhirnāma nāmataḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tAM tu dfzwvA mahAdevIM tapyamAnAM mahattapaH । dakzasya duhitA devI suraBirnAma nAmataH ॥26॥

text: atapyata tapo ghoraṃ hṛṣṭā dharmaparāyaṇā । kailāsaśikhare ramye devagandharvasevite ॥27॥
html:
atapyata tapo ghoraṃ hṛṣṭā dharmaparāyaṇā ।
kailāsaśikhare ramye devagandharvasevite ॥27॥
slp1: atapyata tapo GoraM hfzwA DarmaparAyaRA । kElAsaSiKare ramye devaganDarvasevite ॥27॥

text: vyatiṣṭhadekapādena paramaṃ yogamāsthitā । daśa varṣasahasrāṇi daśa varṣaśatāni ca ॥28॥
html:
vyatiṣṭhadekapādena paramaṃ yogamāsthitā ।
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi daśa varṣaśatāni ca ॥28॥
slp1: vyatizWadekapAdena paramaM yogamAsTitA । daSa varzasahasrARi daSa varzaSatAni ca ॥28॥

text: santaptāstapasā tasyā devāḥ sarṣimahoragāḥ । tatra gatvā mayā sārdhaṃ paryupāsanta tāṃ śubhām ॥29॥
html:
santaptāstapasā tasyā devāḥ sarṣimahoragāḥ ।
tatra gatvā mayā sārdhaṃ paryupāsanta tāṃ śubhām ॥29॥
slp1: santaptAstapasA tasyA devAH sarzimahoragAH । tatra gatvA mayA sArDaM paryupAsanta tAM SuBAm ॥29॥

text: athāhamabruvaṃ tatra devīṃ tāṃ tapasānvitām । kimarthaṃ tapyate devi tapo ghoramanindite ॥30॥
html:
athāhamabruvaṃ tatra devīṃ tāṃ tapasānvitām ।
kimarthaṃ tapyate devi tapo ghoramanindite ॥30॥
slp1: aTAhamabruvaM tatra devIM tAM tapasAnvitAm । kimarTaM tapyate devi tapo Goramanindite ॥30॥

text: prītaste'haṃ mahābhāge tapasānena śobhane । varayasva varaṃ devi dātāsmīti purandara ॥31॥
html:
prītaste'haṃ mahābhāge tapasānena śobhane ।
varayasva varaṃ devi dātāsmīti purandara ॥31॥
slp1: prItaste'haM mahABAge tapasAnena SoBane । varayasva varaM devi dAtAsmIti purandara ॥31॥

text: vareṇa bhagavanmahyaṃ kṛtaṃ lokapitāmaha । eṣa eva varo me'dya yatprīto'si mamānagha ॥32॥
html:
vareṇa bhagavanmahyaṃ kṛtaṃ lokapitāmaha ।
eṣa eva varo me'dya yatprīto'si mamānagha ॥32॥
slp1: vareRa BagavanmahyaM kftaM lokapitAmaha । eza eva varo me'dya yatprIto'si mamAnaGa ॥32॥
author: surabhyuvāca ।

text: tāmevaṃ bruvatīṃ devīṃ surabhīṃ tridaśeśvara । pratyabruvaṃ yaddevendra tannibodha śacīpate ॥33॥
html:
tāmevaṃ bruvatīṃ devīṃ surabhīṃ tridaśeśvara ।
pratyabruvaṃ yaddevendra tannibodha śacīpate ॥33॥
slp1: tAmevaM bruvatIM devIM suraBIM tridaSeSvara । pratyabruvaM yaddevendra tanniboDa SacIpate ॥33॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: alobhakāmyayā devi tapasā ca śubhena te । prasanno'haṃ varaṃ tasmādamaratvaṃ dadāni te ॥34॥
html:
alobhakāmyayā devi tapasā ca śubhena te ।
prasanno'haṃ varaṃ tasmādamaratvaṃ dadāni te ॥34॥
slp1: aloBakAmyayA devi tapasA ca SuBena te । prasanno'haM varaM tasmAdamaratvaM dadAni te ॥34॥

text: trayāṇāmapi lokānāmupariṣṭānnivatsyasi । matprasādācca vikhyāto golokaḥ sa bhaviṣyati ॥35॥
html:
trayāṇāmapi lokānāmupariṣṭānnivatsyasi ।
matprasādācca vikhyāto golokaḥ sa bhaviṣyati ॥35॥
slp1: trayARAmapi lokAnAmuparizwAnnivatsyasi । matprasAdAcca viKyAto golokaH sa Bavizyati ॥35॥

text: mānuṣeṣu ca kurvāṇāḥ prajāḥ karma sutāstava । nivatsyanti mahābhāge sarvā duhitaraśca te ॥36॥
html:
mānuṣeṣu ca kurvāṇāḥ prajāḥ karma sutāstava ।
nivatsyanti mahābhāge sarvā duhitaraśca te ॥36॥
slp1: mAnuzezu ca kurvARAH prajAH karma sutAstava । nivatsyanti mahABAge sarvA duhitaraSca te ॥36॥

text: manasā cintitā bhogāstvayā vai divyamānuṣāḥ । yacca svargasukhaṃ devi tatte sampatsyate śubhe ॥37॥
html:
manasā cintitā bhogāstvayā vai divyamānuṣāḥ ।
yacca svargasukhaṃ devi tatte sampatsyate śubhe ॥37॥
slp1: manasA cintitA BogAstvayA vE divyamAnuzAH । yacca svargasuKaM devi tatte sampatsyate SuBe ॥37॥

text: tasyā lokāḥ sahasrākṣa sarvakāmasamanvitāḥ । na tatra kramate mṛtyurna jarā na ca pāvakaḥ । na dainyaṃ nāśubhaṃ kiñcidvidyate tatra vāsava ॥38॥
html:
tasyā lokāḥ sahasrākṣa sarvakāmasamanvitāḥ ।
na tatra kramate mṛtyurna jarā na ca pāvakaḥ ।
na dainyaṃ nāśubhaṃ kiñcidvidyate tatra vāsava ॥38॥
slp1: tasyA lokAH sahasrAkza sarvakAmasamanvitAH । na tatra kramate mftyurna jarA na ca pAvakaH । na dEnyaM nASuBaM kiYcidvidyate tatra vAsava ॥38॥

text: tatra divyānyaraṇyāni divyāni bhavanāni ca । vimānāni ca yuktāni kāmagāni ca vāsava ॥39॥
html:
tatra divyānyaraṇyāni divyāni bhavanāni ca ।
vimānāni ca yuktāni kāmagāni ca vāsava ॥39॥
slp1: tatra divyAnyaraRyAni divyAni BavanAni ca । vimAnAni ca yuktAni kAmagAni ca vAsava ॥39॥

text: vrataiśca vividhaiḥ puṇyaistathā tīrthānusevanāt । tapasā mahatā caiva sukṛtena ca karmaṇā । śakyaḥ samāsādayituṃ golokaḥ puṣkarekṣaṇa ॥40॥
html:
vrataiśca vividhaiḥ puṇyaistathā tīrthānusevanāt ।
tapasā mahatā caiva sukṛtena ca karmaṇā ।
śakyaḥ samāsādayituṃ golokaḥ puṣkarekṣaṇa ॥40॥
slp1: vratESca viviDEH puRyEstaTA tIrTAnusevanAt । tapasA mahatA cEva sukftena ca karmaRA । SakyaH samAsAdayituM golokaH puzkarekzaRa ॥40॥

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā śakrānupṛcchate । na te paribhavaḥ kāryo gavāmarinisūdana ॥41॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā śakrānupṛcchate ।
na te paribhavaḥ kāryo gavāmarinisūdana ॥41॥
