slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM mayA SakrAnupfcCate । na te pariBavaH kAryo gavAmarinisUdana ॥41॥

text: etacchrutvā sahasrākṣaḥ pūjayāmāsa nityadā । gāścakre bahumānaṃ ca tāsu nityaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥42॥
html:
etacchrutvā sahasrākṣaḥ pūjayāmāsa nityadā ।
gāścakre bahumānaṃ ca tāsu nityaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ॥42॥
slp1: etacCrutvA sahasrAkzaH pUjayAmAsa nityadA । gAScakre bahumAnaM ca tAsu nityaM yuDizWira ॥42॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ pāvanaṃ ca mahādyute । pavitraṃ paramaṃ cāpi gavāṃ māhātmyamuttamam । kīrtitaṃ puruṣavyāghra sarvapāpavināśanam ॥43॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ pāvanaṃ ca mahādyute ।
pavitraṃ paramaṃ cāpi gavāṃ māhātmyamuttamam ।
kīrtitaṃ puruṣavyāghra sarvapāpavināśanam ॥43॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM pAvanaM ca mahAdyute । pavitraM paramaM cApi gavAM mAhAtmyamuttamam । kIrtitaM puruzavyAGra sarvapApavinASanam ॥43॥

text: ya idaṃ kathayennityaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ । havyakavyeṣu yajñeṣu pitṛkāryeṣu caiva ha । sārvakāmikamakṣayyaṃ pitṝṃstasyopatiṣṭhati ॥44॥
html:
ya idaṃ kathayennityaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ ।
havyakavyeṣu yajñeṣu pitṛkāryeṣu caiva ha ।
sārvakāmikamakṣayyaṃ pitṝṃstasyopatiṣṭhati ॥44॥
slp1: ya idaM kaTayennityaM brAhmaReByaH samAhitaH । havyakavyezu yajYezu pitfkAryezu cEva ha । sArvakAmikamakzayyaM pitFMstasyopatizWati ॥44॥

text: goṣu bhaktaśca labhate yadyadicchati mānavaḥ । striyo'pi bhaktā yā goṣu tāśca kāmānavāpnuyuḥ ॥45॥
html:
goṣu bhaktaśca labhate yadyadicchati mānavaḥ ।
striyo'pi bhaktā yā goṣu tāśca kāmānavāpnuyuḥ ॥45॥
slp1: gozu BaktaSca laBate yadyadicCati mAnavaH । striyo'pi BaktA yA gozu tASca kAmAnavApnuyuH ॥45॥

text: putrārthī labhate putraṃ kanyā patimavāpnuyāt । dhanārthī labhate vittaṃ dharmārthī dharmamāpnuyāt ॥46॥
html:
putrārthī labhate putraṃ kanyā patimavāpnuyāt ।
dhanārthī labhate vittaṃ dharmārthī dharmamāpnuyāt ॥46॥
slp1: putrArTI laBate putraM kanyA patimavApnuyAt । DanArTI laBate vittaM DarmArTI DarmamApnuyAt ॥46॥

text: vidyārthī prāpnuyādvidyāṃ sukhārthī prāpnuyātsukham । na kiñciddurlabhaṃ caiva gavāṃ bhaktasya bhārata] ॥47॥
html:
vidyārthī prāpnuyādvidyāṃ sukhārthī prāpnuyātsukham ।
na kiñciddurlabhaṃ caiva gavāṃ bhaktasya bhārata] ॥47॥
slp1: vidyArTI prApnuyAdvidyAM suKArTI prApnuyAtsuKam । na kiYciddurlaBaM cEva gavAM Baktasya BArata] ॥47॥

text: uktaṃ pitāmahenedaṃ gavāṃ dānamanuttamam । viśeṣeṇa narendrāṇāmiti dharmamavekṣatām ॥1॥
html:
uktaṃ pitāmahenedaṃ gavāṃ dānamanuttamam ।
viśeṣeṇa narendrāṇāmiti dharmamavekṣatām ॥1॥
slp1: uktaM pitAmahenedaM gavAM dAnamanuttamam । viSezeRa narendrARAmiti DarmamavekzatAm ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: rājyaṃ hi satataṃ duḥkhamāśramāśca sudurvidāḥ । parivāreṇa vai duḥkhaṃ durdharaṃ cākṛtātmabhiḥ । bhūyiṣṭhaṃ ca narendrāṇāṃ vidyate na śubhā gatiḥ ॥2॥
html:
rājyaṃ hi satataṃ duḥkhamāśramāśca sudurvidāḥ ।
parivāreṇa vai duḥkhaṃ durdharaṃ cākṛtātmabhiḥ ।
bhūyiṣṭhaṃ ca narendrāṇāṃ vidyate na śubhā gatiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: rAjyaM hi satataM duHKamASramASca sudurvidAH । parivAreRa vE duHKaM durDaraM cAkftAtmaBiH । BUyizWaM ca narendrARAM vidyate na SuBA gatiH ॥2॥

text: pūyante te'tra niyataṃ prayacchanto vasundharām । pūrvaṃ ca kathitā dharmāstvayā me kurunandana ॥3॥
html:
pūyante te'tra niyataṃ prayacchanto vasundharām ।
pūrvaṃ ca kathitā dharmāstvayā me kurunandana ॥3॥
slp1: pUyante te'tra niyataM prayacCanto vasunDarAm । pUrvaM ca kaTitA DarmAstvayA me kurunandana ॥3॥

text: evameva gavāmuktaṃ pradānaṃ te nṛgeṇa ha । ṛṣiṇā nāciketena pūrvameva nidarśitam ॥4॥
html:
evameva gavāmuktaṃ pradānaṃ te nṛgeṇa ha ।
ṛṣiṇā nāciketena pūrvameva nidarśitam ॥4॥
slp1: evameva gavAmuktaM pradAnaM te nfgeRa ha । fziRA nAciketena pUrvameva nidarSitam ॥4॥

text: vedopaniṣade caiva sarvakarmasu dakṣiṇā । sarvakratuṣu coddiṣṭaṃ bhūmirgāvo'tha kāñcanam ॥5॥
html:
vedopaniṣade caiva sarvakarmasu dakṣiṇā ।
sarvakratuṣu coddiṣṭaṃ bhūmirgāvo'tha kāñcanam ॥5॥
slp1: vedopanizade cEva sarvakarmasu dakziRA । sarvakratuzu coddizwaM BUmirgAvo'Ta kAYcanam ॥5॥

text: tatra śrutistu paramā suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇeti vai । etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ pitāmaha yathātatham ॥6॥
html:
tatra śrutistu paramā suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇeti vai ।
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ pitāmaha yathātatham ॥6॥
slp1: tatra Srutistu paramA suvarRaM dakziReti vE । etadicCAmyahaM SrotuM pitAmaha yaTAtaTam ॥6॥

text: kiṃ suvarṇaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ kasminkāle kimātmakam । kiṃ dānaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ caiva kasmācca paramucyate ॥7॥
html:
kiṃ suvarṇaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ kasminkāle kimātmakam ।
kiṃ dānaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ caiva kasmācca paramucyate ॥7॥
slp1: kiM suvarRaM kaTaM jAtaM kasminkAle kimAtmakam । kiM dAnaM kiM PalaM cEva kasmAcca paramucyate ॥7॥

text: kasmāddānaṃ suvarṇasya pūjayanti manīṣiṇaḥ । kasmācca dakṣiṇārthaṃ tadyajñakarmasu śasyate ॥8॥
html:
kasmāddānaṃ suvarṇasya pūjayanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।
kasmācca dakṣiṇārthaṃ tadyajñakarmasu śasyate ॥8॥
slp1: kasmAddAnaM suvarRasya pUjayanti manIziRaH । kasmAcca dakziRArTaM tadyajYakarmasu Sasyate ॥8॥

text: kasmācca pāvanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhūmergobhyaśca kāñcanam । paramaṃ dakṣiṇārthe ca tadbravīhi pitāmaha ॥9॥
html:
kasmācca pāvanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhūmergobhyaśca kāñcanam ।
paramaṃ dakṣiṇārthe ca tadbravīhi pitāmaha ॥9॥
slp1: kasmAcca pAvanaM SrezWaM BUmergoByaSca kAYcanam । paramaM dakziRArTe ca tadbravIhi pitAmaha ॥9॥

text: śṛṇu rājannavahito bahukāraṇavistaram । jātarūpasamutpattimanubhūtaṃ ca yanmayā ॥10॥
html:
śṛṇu rājannavahito bahukāraṇavistaram ।
jātarūpasamutpattimanubhūtaṃ ca yanmayā ॥10॥
slp1: SfRu rAjannavahito bahukAraRavistaram । jAtarUpasamutpattimanuBUtaM ca yanmayA ॥10॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: pitā mama mahātejāḥ śantanurnidhanaṃ gataḥ । tasya ditsurahaṃ śrāddhaṃ gaṅgādvāramupāgamam ॥11॥
html:
pitā mama mahātejāḥ śantanurnidhanaṃ gataḥ ।
tasya ditsurahaṃ śrāddhaṃ gaṅgādvāramupāgamam ॥11॥
slp1: pitA mama mahAtejAH SantanurniDanaM gataH । tasya ditsurahaM SrAdDaM gaNgAdvAramupAgamam ॥11॥

text: tatrāgamya pituḥ putra śrāddhakarma samārabham । mātā me jāhnavī caiva sāhāyyamakarottadā ॥12॥
html:
tatrāgamya pituḥ putra śrāddhakarma samārabham ।
mātā me jāhnavī caiva sāhāyyamakarottadā ॥12॥
slp1: tatrAgamya pituH putra SrAdDakarma samAraBam । mAtA me jAhnavI cEva sAhAyyamakarottadA ॥12॥

text: tato'gratastapaḥsiddhānupaveśya bahūnṛṣīn । toyapradānātprabhṛti kāryāṇyahamathārabham ॥13॥
html:
tato'gratastapaḥsiddhānupaveśya bahūnṛṣīn ।
toyapradānātprabhṛti kāryāṇyahamathārabham ॥13॥
slp1: tato'gratastapaHsidDAnupaveSya bahUnfzIn । toyapradAnAtpraBfti kAryARyahamaTAraBam ॥13॥

text: tatsamāpya yathoddiṣṭaṃ pūrvakarma samāhitaḥ । dātuṃ nirvapaṇaṃ samyagyathāvadahamārabham ॥14॥
html:
tatsamāpya yathoddiṣṭaṃ pūrvakarma samāhitaḥ ।
dātuṃ nirvapaṇaṃ samyagyathāvadahamārabham ॥14॥
slp1: tatsamApya yaToddizwaM pUrvakarma samAhitaH । dAtuM nirvapaRaM samyagyaTAvadahamAraBam ॥14॥

text: tatastaṃ darbhavinyāsaṃ bhittvā surucirāṅgadaḥ । pralambābharaṇo bāhurudatiṣṭhadviśāṃ pate ॥15॥
html:
tatastaṃ darbhavinyāsaṃ bhittvā surucirāṅgadaḥ ।
pralambābharaṇo bāhurudatiṣṭhadviśāṃ pate ॥15॥
slp1: tatastaM darBavinyAsaM BittvA surucirANgadaH । pralambABaraRo bAhurudatizWadviSAM pate ॥15॥

text: tamutthitamahaṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayamāgamam । pratigrahītā sākṣānme piteti bharatarṣabha ॥16॥
html:
tamutthitamahaṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayamāgamam ।
pratigrahītā sākṣānme piteti bharatarṣabha ॥16॥
slp1: tamutTitamahaM dfzwvA paraM vismayamAgamam । pratigrahItA sAkzAnme piteti BaratarzaBa ॥16॥

text: tato me punarevāsītsañjñā sañcintya śāstrataḥ । nāyaṃ vedeṣu vihito vidhirhasta iti prabho । piṇḍo deyo nareṇeha tato matirabhūnmama ॥17॥
html:
tato me punarevāsītsañjñā sañcintya śāstrataḥ ।
nāyaṃ vedeṣu vihito vidhirhasta iti prabho ।
piṇḍo deyo nareṇeha tato matirabhūnmama ॥17॥
slp1: tato me punarevAsItsaYjYA saYcintya SAstrataH । nAyaM vedezu vihito viDirhasta iti praBo । piRqo deyo nareReha tato matiraBUnmama ॥17॥

text: sākṣānneha manuṣyasya pitaro'ntarhitāḥ kvacit । gṛhṇanti vihitaṃ tvevaṃ piṇḍo deyaḥ kuśeṣviti ॥18॥
html:
sākṣānneha manuṣyasya pitaro'ntarhitāḥ kvacit ।
gṛhṇanti vihitaṃ tvevaṃ piṇḍo deyaḥ kuśeṣviti ॥18॥
slp1: sAkzAnneha manuzyasya pitaro'ntarhitAH kvacit । gfhRanti vihitaM tvevaM piRqo deyaH kuSezviti ॥18॥

text: tato'haṃ tadanādṛtya piturhastanidarśanam । śāstrapramāṇātsūkṣmaṃ tu vidhiṃ pārthiva saṃsmaran ॥19॥
html:
tato'haṃ tadanādṛtya piturhastanidarśanam ।
śāstrapramāṇātsūkṣmaṃ tu vidhiṃ pārthiva saṃsmaran ॥19॥
slp1: tato'haM tadanAdftya piturhastanidarSanam । SAstrapramARAtsUkzmaM tu viDiM pArTiva saMsmaran ॥19॥

text: tato darbheṣu tatsarvamadadaṃ bharatarṣabha । śāstramārgānusāreṇa tadviddhi manujarṣabha ॥20॥
html:
tato darbheṣu tatsarvamadadaṃ bharatarṣabha ।
śāstramārgānusāreṇa tadviddhi manujarṣabha ॥20॥
slp1: tato darBezu tatsarvamadadaM BaratarzaBa । SAstramArgAnusAreRa tadvidDi manujarzaBa ॥20॥

text: tataḥ so'ntarhito bāhuḥ piturmama narādhipa । tato māṃ darśayāmāsuḥ svapnānte pitarastadā ॥21॥
html:
tataḥ so'ntarhito bāhuḥ piturmama narādhipa ।
tato māṃ darśayāmāsuḥ svapnānte pitarastadā ॥21॥
slp1: tataH so'ntarhito bAhuH piturmama narADipa । tato mAM darSayAmAsuH svapnAnte pitarastadA ॥21॥

text: prīyamāṇāstu māmūcuḥ prītāḥ sma bharatarṣabha । vijñānena tavānena yanna muhyasi dharmataḥ ॥22॥
html:
prīyamāṇāstu māmūcuḥ prītāḥ sma bharatarṣabha ।
vijñānena tavānena yanna muhyasi dharmataḥ ॥22॥
slp1: prIyamARAstu mAmUcuH prItAH sma BaratarzaBa । vijYAnena tavAnena yanna muhyasi DarmataH ॥22॥

text: tvayā hi kurvatā śāstraṃ pramāṇamiha pārthiva । ātmā dharmaḥ śrutaṃ vedāḥ pitaraśca maharṣibhiḥ ॥23॥
html:
tvayā hi kurvatā śāstraṃ pramāṇamiha pārthiva ।
ātmā dharmaḥ śrutaṃ vedāḥ pitaraśca maharṣibhiḥ ॥23॥
slp1: tvayA hi kurvatA SAstraM pramARamiha pArTiva । AtmA DarmaH SrutaM vedAH pitaraSca maharziBiH ॥23॥

text: sākṣātpitāmaho brahmā guravo'tha prajāpatiḥ । pramāṇamupanītā vai sthitiśca na vicālitā ॥24॥
html:
sākṣātpitāmaho brahmā guravo'tha prajāpatiḥ ।
pramāṇamupanītā vai sthitiśca na vicālitā ॥24॥
slp1: sAkzAtpitAmaho brahmA guravo'Ta prajApatiH । pramARamupanItA vE sTitiSca na vicAlitA ॥24॥

text: tadidaṃ samyagārabdhaṃ tvayādya bharatarṣabha । kiṃ tu bhūmergavāṃ cārthe suvarṇaṃ dīyatāmiti ॥25॥
html:
tadidaṃ samyagārabdhaṃ tvayādya bharatarṣabha ।
kiṃ tu bhūmergavāṃ cārthe suvarṇaṃ dīyatāmiti ॥25॥
slp1: tadidaM samyagArabDaM tvayAdya BaratarzaBa । kiM tu BUmergavAM cArTe suvarRaM dIyatAmiti ॥25॥

text: evaṃ vayaṃ ca dharmaśca sarve cāsmatpitāmahāḥ । pāvitā vai bhaviṣyanti pāvanaṃ paramaṃ hi tat ॥26॥
html:
evaṃ vayaṃ ca dharmaśca sarve cāsmatpitāmahāḥ ।
pāvitā vai bhaviṣyanti pāvanaṃ paramaṃ hi tat ॥26॥
slp1: evaM vayaM ca DarmaSca sarve cAsmatpitAmahAH । pAvitA vE Bavizyanti pAvanaM paramaM hi tat ॥26॥

text: daśa pūrvāndaśa parāṃstathā santārayanti te । suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti evaṃ me pitaro'bruvan ॥27॥
html:
daśa pūrvāndaśa parāṃstathā santārayanti te ।
suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti evaṃ me pitaro'bruvan ॥27॥
slp1: daSa pUrvAndaSa parAMstaTA santArayanti te । suvarRaM ye prayacCanti evaM me pitaro'bruvan ॥27॥

text: tato'haṃ vismito rājanpratibuddho viśāṃ pate । suvarṇadāne'karavaṃ matiṃ bharatasattama ॥28॥
html:
tato'haṃ vismito rājanpratibuddho viśāṃ pate ।
suvarṇadāne'karavaṃ matiṃ bharatasattama ॥28॥
slp1: tato'haM vismito rAjanpratibudDo viSAM pate । suvarRadAne'karavaM matiM Baratasattama ॥28॥

text: itihāsamimaṃ cāpi śṛṇu rājanpurātanam । jāmadagnyaṃ prati vibho dhanyamāyuṣyameva ca ॥29॥
html:
itihāsamimaṃ cāpi śṛṇu rājanpurātanam ।
jāmadagnyaṃ prati vibho dhanyamāyuṣyameva ca ॥29॥
slp1: itihAsamimaM cApi SfRu rAjanpurAtanam । jAmadagnyaM prati viBo DanyamAyuzyameva ca ॥29॥

text: jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa tīvraroṣānvitena vai । triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī kṛtā niḥkṣatriyā purā ॥30॥
html:
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa tīvraroṣānvitena vai ।
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī kṛtā niḥkṣatriyā purā ॥30॥
slp1: jAmadagnyena rAmeRa tIvrarozAnvitena vE । triHsaptakftvaH pfTivI kftA niHkzatriyA purA ॥30॥

text: tato jitvā mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ । ājahāra kratuṃ vīro brahmakṣatreṇa pūjitam ॥31॥
html:
tato jitvā mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ ।
ājahāra kratuṃ vīro brahmakṣatreṇa pūjitam ॥31॥
slp1: tato jitvA mahIM kftsnAM rAmo rAjIvalocanaH । AjahAra kratuM vIro brahmakzatreRa pUjitam ॥31॥

text: vājimedhaṃ mahārāja sarvakāmasamanvitam । pāvanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tejodyutivivardhanam ॥32॥
html:
vājimedhaṃ mahārāja sarvakāmasamanvitam ।
pāvanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tejodyutivivardhanam ॥32॥
slp1: vAjimeDaM mahArAja sarvakAmasamanvitam । pAvanaM sarvaBUtAnAM tejodyutivivarDanam ॥32॥

text: vipāpmāpi sa tejasvī tena kratuphalena vai । naivātmano'tha laghutāṃ jāmadagnyo'bhyagacchata ॥33॥
html:
vipāpmāpi sa tejasvī tena kratuphalena vai ।
naivātmano'tha laghutāṃ jāmadagnyo'bhyagacchata ॥33॥
slp1: vipApmApi sa tejasvI tena kratuPalena vE । nEvAtmano'Ta laGutAM jAmadagnyo'ByagacCata ॥33॥

text: sa tu kratuvareṇeṣṭvā mahātmā dakṣiṇāvatā । papracchāgamasampannānṛṣīndevāṃśca bhārgavaḥ ॥34॥
html:
sa tu kratuvareṇeṣṭvā mahātmā dakṣiṇāvatā ।
papracchāgamasampannānṛṣīndevāṃśca bhārgavaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: sa tu kratuvareRezwvA mahAtmA dakziRAvatA । papracCAgamasampannAnfzIndevAMSca BArgavaH ॥34॥

text: pāvanaṃ yatparaṃ nṝṇāmugre karmaṇi vartatām । taducyatāṃ mahābhāgā iti jātaghṛṇo'bravīt ॥35॥
html:
pāvanaṃ yatparaṃ nṝṇāmugre karmaṇi vartatām ।
taducyatāṃ mahābhāgā iti jātaghṛṇo'bravīt ॥35॥
slp1: pAvanaM yatparaM nFRAmugre karmaRi vartatAm । taducyatAM mahABAgA iti jAtaGfRo'bravIt ॥35॥

text: devatāste prayacchanti suvarṇaṃ ye dadatyuta । agnirhi devatāḥ sarvāḥ suvarṇaṃ ca tadātmakam ॥36॥
html:
devatāste prayacchanti suvarṇaṃ ye dadatyuta ।
agnirhi devatāḥ sarvāḥ suvarṇaṃ ca tadātmakam ॥36॥
slp1: devatAste prayacCanti suvarRaM ye dadatyuta । agnirhi devatAH sarvAH suvarRaM ca tadAtmakam ॥36॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: tasmātsuvarṇaṃ dadatā dattāḥ sarvāśca devatāḥ । bhavanti puruṣavyāghra na hyataḥ paramaṃ viduḥ ॥37॥
html:
tasmātsuvarṇaṃ dadatā dattāḥ sarvāśca devatāḥ ।
bhavanti puruṣavyāghra na hyataḥ paramaṃ viduḥ ॥37॥
slp1: tasmAtsuvarRaM dadatA dattAH sarvASca devatAH । Bavanti puruzavyAGra na hyataH paramaM viduH ॥37॥

text: bhūya eva ca māhātmyaṃ suvarṇasya nibodha me । gadato mama viprarṣe sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ vara ॥38॥
html:
bhūya eva ca māhātmyaṃ suvarṇasya nibodha me ।
gadato mama viprarṣe sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ vara ॥38॥
slp1: BUya eva ca mAhAtmyaM suvarRasya niboDa me । gadato mama viprarze sarvaSastraBftAM vara ॥38॥

text: mayā śrutamidaṃ pūrvaṃ purāṇe bhṛgunandana । prajāpateḥ kathayato manoḥ svāyambhuvasya vai ॥39॥
html:
mayā śrutamidaṃ pūrvaṃ purāṇe bhṛgunandana ।
prajāpateḥ kathayato manoḥ svāyambhuvasya vai ॥39॥
slp1: mayA SrutamidaM pUrvaM purARe Bfgunandana । prajApateH kaTayato manoH svAyamBuvasya vE ॥39॥

text: śūlapāṇerbhagavato rudrasya ca mahātmanaḥ । girau himavati śreṣṭhe tadā bhṛgukulodvaha ॥40॥
html:
śūlapāṇerbhagavato rudrasya ca mahātmanaḥ ।
girau himavati śreṣṭhe tadā bhṛgukulodvaha ॥40॥
slp1: SUlapARerBagavato rudrasya ca mahAtmanaH । girO himavati SrezWe tadA Bfgukulodvaha ॥40॥

text: devyā vivāhe nirvṛtte rudrāṇyā bhṛgunandana । samāgame bhagavato devyā saha mahātmanaḥ । tataḥ sarve samudvignā bhagavantamupāgaman ॥41॥
html:
devyā vivāhe nirvṛtte rudrāṇyā bhṛgunandana ।
samāgame bhagavato devyā saha mahātmanaḥ ।
tataḥ sarve samudvignā bhagavantamupāgaman ॥41॥
slp1: devyA vivAhe nirvftte rudrARyA Bfgunandana । samAgame Bagavato devyA saha mahAtmanaH । tataH sarve samudvignA BagavantamupAgaman ॥41॥

text: te mahādevamāsīnaṃ devīṃ ca varadāmumām । prasādya śirasā sarve rudramūcurbhṛgūdvaha ॥42॥
html:
te mahādevamāsīnaṃ devīṃ ca varadāmumām ।
prasādya śirasā sarve rudramūcurbhṛgūdvaha ॥42॥
slp1: te mahAdevamAsInaM devIM ca varadAmumAm । prasAdya SirasA sarve rudramUcurBfgUdvaha ॥42॥

text: ayaṃ samāgamo deva devyā saha tavānagha । tapasvinastapasvinyā tejasvinyātitejasaḥ । amoghatejāstvaṃ deva devī ceyamumā tathā ॥43॥
html:
ayaṃ samāgamo deva devyā saha tavānagha ।
tapasvinastapasvinyā tejasvinyātitejasaḥ ।
amoghatejāstvaṃ deva devī ceyamumā tathā ॥43॥
slp1: ayaM samAgamo deva devyA saha tavAnaGa । tapasvinastapasvinyA tejasvinyAtitejasaH । amoGatejAstvaM deva devI ceyamumA taTA ॥43॥

text: apatyaṃ yuvayordeva balavadbhavitā prabho । tannūnaṃ triṣu lokeṣu na kiñciccheṣayiṣyati ॥44॥
html:
apatyaṃ yuvayordeva balavadbhavitā prabho ।
tannūnaṃ triṣu lokeṣu na kiñciccheṣayiṣyati ॥44॥
slp1: apatyaM yuvayordeva balavadBavitA praBo । tannUnaM trizu lokezu na kiYcicCezayizyati ॥44॥

text: tadebhyaḥ praṇatebhyastvaṃ devebhyaḥ pṛthulocana । varaṃ prayaccha lokeśa trailokyahitakāmyayā । apatyārthaṃ nigṛhṇīṣva tejo jvalitamuttamam ॥45॥
html:
tadebhyaḥ praṇatebhyastvaṃ devebhyaḥ pṛthulocana ।
varaṃ prayaccha lokeśa trailokyahitakāmyayā ।
apatyārthaṃ nigṛhṇīṣva tejo jvalitamuttamam ॥45॥
slp1: tadeByaH praRateByastvaM deveByaH pfTulocana । varaM prayacCa lokeSa trElokyahitakAmyayA । apatyArTaM nigfhRIzva tejo jvalitamuttamam ॥45॥

text: iti teṣāṃ kathayatāṃ bhagavāngovṛṣadhvajaḥ । evamastviti devāṃstānviprarṣe pratyabhāṣata ॥46॥
html:
iti teṣāṃ kathayatāṃ bhagavāngovṛṣadhvajaḥ ।
evamastviti devāṃstānviprarṣe pratyabhāṣata ॥46॥
slp1: iti tezAM kaTayatAM BagavAngovfzaDvajaH । evamastviti devAMstAnviprarze pratyaBAzata ॥46॥

text: ityuktvā cordhvamanayattadreto vṛṣavāhanaḥ । ūrdhvaretāḥ samabhavattataḥprabhṛti cāpi saḥ ॥47॥
html:
ityuktvā cordhvamanayattadreto vṛṣavāhanaḥ ।
ūrdhvaretāḥ samabhavattataḥprabhṛti cāpi saḥ ॥47॥
slp1: ityuktvA corDvamanayattadreto vfzavAhanaH । UrDvaretAH samaBavattataHpraBfti cApi saH ॥47॥

text: rudrāṇī tu tataḥ kruddhā prajocchede tathā kṛte । devānathābravīttatra strībhāvātparuṣaṃ vacaḥ ॥48॥
html:
rudrāṇī tu tataḥ kruddhā prajocchede tathā kṛte ।
devānathābravīttatra strībhāvātparuṣaṃ vacaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: rudrARI tu tataH krudDA prajocCede taTA kfte । devAnaTAbravIttatra strIBAvAtparuzaM vacaH ॥48॥

text: yasmādapatyakāmo vai bhartā me vinivartitaḥ । tasmātsarve surā yūyamanapatyā bhaviṣyatha ॥49॥
html:
yasmādapatyakāmo vai bhartā me vinivartitaḥ ।
tasmātsarve surā yūyamanapatyā bhaviṣyatha ॥49॥
slp1: yasmAdapatyakAmo vE BartA me vinivartitaH । tasmAtsarve surA yUyamanapatyA BavizyaTa ॥49॥

text: prajocchedo mama kṛto yasmādyuṣmābhiradya vai । tasmātprajā vaḥ khagamāḥ sarveṣāṃ na bhaviṣyati ॥50॥
html:
prajocchedo mama kṛto yasmādyuṣmābhiradya vai ।
tasmātprajā vaḥ khagamāḥ sarveṣāṃ na bhaviṣyati ॥50॥
slp1: prajocCedo mama kfto yasmAdyuzmABiradya vE । tasmAtprajA vaH KagamAH sarvezAM na Bavizyati ॥50॥

text: pāvakastu na tatrāsīcchāpakāle bhṛgūdvaha । devā devyāstathā śāpādanapatyāstadābhavan ॥51॥
html:
pāvakastu na tatrāsīcchāpakāle bhṛgūdvaha ।
devā devyāstathā śāpādanapatyāstadābhavan ॥51॥
slp1: pAvakastu na tatrAsIcCApakAle BfgUdvaha । devA devyAstaTA SApAdanapatyAstadABavan ॥51॥

text: rudrastu tejo'pratimaṃ dhārayāmāsa tattadā । praskannaṃ tu tatastasmātkiñcittatrāpatadbhuvi ॥52॥
html:
rudrastu tejo'pratimaṃ dhārayāmāsa tattadā ।
praskannaṃ tu tatastasmātkiñcittatrāpatadbhuvi ॥52॥
slp1: rudrastu tejo'pratimaM DArayAmAsa tattadA । praskannaM tu tatastasmAtkiYcittatrApatadBuvi ॥52॥

text: tatpapāta tadā cāgnau vavṛdhe cādbhutopamam । tejastejasi sampṛktamekayonitvamāgatam ॥53॥
html:
tatpapāta tadā cāgnau vavṛdhe cādbhutopamam ।
tejastejasi sampṛktamekayonitvamāgatam ॥53॥
slp1: tatpapAta tadA cAgnO vavfDe cAdButopamam । tejastejasi sampfktamekayonitvamAgatam ॥53॥

text: etasminneva kāle tu devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ । asurastārako nāma tena santāpitā bhṛśam ॥54॥
html:
etasminneva kāle tu devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ।
asurastārako nāma tena santāpitā bhṛśam ॥54॥
slp1: etasminneva kAle tu devAH SakrapurogamAH । asurastArako nAma tena santApitA BfSam ॥54॥

text: ādityā vasavo rudrā maruto'thāśvināvapi । sādhyāśca sarve santrastā daiteyasya parākramāt ॥55॥
html:
ādityā vasavo rudrā maruto'thāśvināvapi ।
sādhyāśca sarve santrastā daiteyasya parākramāt ॥55॥
slp1: AdityA vasavo rudrA maruto'TASvinAvapi । sADyASca sarve santrastA dEteyasya parAkramAt ॥55॥

text: sthānāni devatānāṃ hi vimānāni purāṇi ca । ṛṣīṇāmāśramāścaiva babhūvurasurairhṛtāḥ ॥56॥
html:
sthānāni devatānāṃ hi vimānāni purāṇi ca ।
ṛṣīṇāmāśramāścaiva babhūvurasurairhṛtāḥ ॥56॥
slp1: sTAnAni devatAnAM hi vimAnAni purARi ca । fzIRAmASramAScEva baBUvurasurErhftAH ॥56॥

text: te dīnamanasaḥ sarve devāśca ṛṣayaśca ha । prajagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇamajaraṃ prabhum] ॥57॥
html:
te dīnamanasaḥ sarve devāśca ṛṣayaśca ha ।
prajagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇamajaraṃ prabhum] ॥57॥
slp1: te dInamanasaH sarve devASca fzayaSca ha । prajagmuH SaraRaM devaM brahmARamajaraM praBum] ॥57॥

text: asurastārako nāma tvayā dattavaraḥ prabho । surānṛṣīṃśca kliśnāti vadhastasya vidhīyatām ॥1॥
html:
asurastārako nāma tvayā dattavaraḥ prabho ।
surānṛṣīṃśca kliśnāti vadhastasya vidhīyatām ॥1॥
slp1: asurastArako nAma tvayA dattavaraH praBo । surAnfzIMSca kliSnAti vaDastasya viDIyatAm ॥1॥
author: devā ūcuḥ ।

text: tasmādbhayaṃ samutpannamasmākaṃ vai pitāmaha । paritrāyasva no deva na hyanyā gatirasti naḥ ॥2॥
html:
tasmādbhayaṃ samutpannamasmākaṃ vai pitāmaha ।
paritrāyasva no deva na hyanyā gatirasti naḥ ॥2॥
slp1: tasmAdBayaM samutpannamasmAkaM vE pitAmaha । paritrAyasva no deva na hyanyA gatirasti naH ॥2॥

text: samo'haṃ sarvabhūtānāmadharmaṃ neha rocaye । hanyatāṃ tārakaḥ kṣipraṃ surarṣigaṇabādhakaḥ ॥3॥
html:
samo'haṃ sarvabhūtānāmadharmaṃ neha rocaye ।
hanyatāṃ tārakaḥ kṣipraṃ surarṣigaṇabādhakaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: samo'haM sarvaBUtAnAmaDarmaM neha rocaye । hanyatAM tArakaH kzipraM surarzigaRabADakaH ॥3॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: vedā dharmāśca notsādaṃ gaccheyuḥ surasattamāḥ । vihitaṃ pūrvamevātra mayā vai vyetu vo jvaraḥ ॥4॥
html:
vedā dharmāśca notsādaṃ gaccheyuḥ surasattamāḥ ।
vihitaṃ pūrvamevātra mayā vai vyetu vo jvaraḥ ॥4॥
slp1: vedA DarmASca notsAdaM gacCeyuH surasattamAH । vihitaM pUrvamevAtra mayA vE vyetu vo jvaraH ॥4॥

text: varadānādbhagavato daiteyo balagarvitaḥ । devairna śakyate hantuṃ sa kathaṃ praśamaṃ vrajet ॥5॥
html:
varadānādbhagavato daiteyo balagarvitaḥ ।
devairna śakyate hantuṃ sa kathaṃ praśamaṃ vrajet ॥5॥
slp1: varadAnAdBagavato dEteyo balagarvitaH । devErna Sakyate hantuM sa kaTaM praSamaM vrajet ॥5॥
author: devā ūcuḥ ।

text: sa hi naiva sma devānāṃ nāsurāṇāṃ na rakṣasām । vadhyaḥ syāmiti jagrāha varaṃ tvattaḥ pitāmaha ॥6॥
html:
sa hi naiva sma devānāṃ nāsurāṇāṃ na rakṣasām ।
vadhyaḥ syāmiti jagrāha varaṃ tvattaḥ pitāmaha ॥6॥
slp1: sa hi nEva sma devAnAM nAsurARAM na rakzasAm । vaDyaH syAmiti jagrAha varaM tvattaH pitAmaha ॥6॥

text: devāśca śaptā rudrāṇyā prajocchede purā kṛte । na bhaviṣyati vo'patyamiti sarvajagatpate ॥7॥
html:
devāśca śaptā rudrāṇyā prajocchede purā kṛte ।
na bhaviṣyati vo'patyamiti sarvajagatpate ॥7॥
slp1: devASca SaptA rudrARyA prajocCede purA kfte । na Bavizyati vo'patyamiti sarvajagatpate ॥7॥

text: hutāśano na tatrāsīcchāpakāle surottamāḥ । sa utpādayitāpatyaṃ vadhārthaṃ tridaśadviṣām ॥8॥
html:
hutāśano na tatrāsīcchāpakāle surottamāḥ ।
sa utpādayitāpatyaṃ vadhārthaṃ tridaśadviṣām ॥8॥
slp1: hutASano na tatrAsIcCApakAle surottamAH । sa utpAdayitApatyaM vaDArTaM tridaSadvizAm ॥8॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: tadvai sarvānatikramya devadānavarākṣasān । mānuṣānatha gandharvānnāgānatha ca pakṣiṇaḥ ॥9॥
html:
tadvai sarvānatikramya devadānavarākṣasān ।
mānuṣānatha gandharvānnāgānatha ca pakṣiṇaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tadvE sarvAnatikramya devadAnavarAkzasAn । mAnuzAnaTa ganDarvAnnAgAnaTa ca pakziRaH ॥9॥

text: astreṇāmoghapātena śaktyā taṃ ghātayiṣyati । yato vo bhayamutpannaṃ ye cānye suraśatravaḥ ॥10॥
html:
astreṇāmoghapātena śaktyā taṃ ghātayiṣyati ।
yato vo bhayamutpannaṃ ye cānye suraśatravaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: astreRAmoGapAtena SaktyA taM GAtayizyati । yato vo BayamutpannaM ye cAnye suraSatravaH ॥10॥

text: sanātano hi saṅkalpaḥ kāma ityabhidhīyate । rudrasya tejaḥ praskannamagnau nipatitaṃ ca tat ॥11॥
html:
sanātano hi saṅkalpaḥ kāma ityabhidhīyate ।
rudrasya tejaḥ praskannamagnau nipatitaṃ ca tat ॥11॥
slp1: sanAtano hi saNkalpaH kAma ityaBiDIyate । rudrasya tejaH praskannamagnO nipatitaM ca tat ॥11॥

text: tattejo'gnirmahadbhūtaṃ dvitīyamiva pāvakam । vadhārthaṃ devaśatrūṇāṃ gaṅgāyāṃ janayiṣyati ॥12॥
html:
tattejo'gnirmahadbhūtaṃ dvitīyamiva pāvakam ।
vadhārthaṃ devaśatrūṇāṃ gaṅgāyāṃ janayiṣyati ॥12॥
slp1: tattejo'gnirmahadBUtaM dvitIyamiva pAvakam । vaDArTaM devaSatrURAM gaNgAyAM janayizyati ॥12॥

text: sa tu nāvāpa taṃ śāpaṃ naṣṭaḥ sa hutabhuktadā । tasmādvo bhayahṛddevāḥ samutpatsyati pāvakiḥ ॥13॥
html:
sa tu nāvāpa taṃ śāpaṃ naṣṭaḥ sa hutabhuktadā ।
tasmādvo bhayahṛddevāḥ samutpatsyati pāvakiḥ ॥13॥
slp1: sa tu nAvApa taM SApaM nazwaH sa hutaBuktadA । tasmAdvo BayahfddevAH samutpatsyati pAvakiH ॥13॥

text: anviṣyatāṃ vai jvalanastathā cādya niyujyatām । tārakasya vadhopāyaḥ kathito vai mayānaghāḥ ॥14॥
html:
anviṣyatāṃ vai jvalanastathā cādya niyujyatām ।
tārakasya vadhopāyaḥ kathito vai mayānaghāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: anvizyatAM vE jvalanastaTA cAdya niyujyatAm । tArakasya vaDopAyaH kaTito vE mayAnaGAH ॥14॥

text: na hi tejasvināṃ śāpāstejaḥsu prabhavanti vai । balānyatibalaṃ prāpya nabalāni bhavanti vai ॥15॥
html:
na hi tejasvināṃ śāpāstejaḥsu prabhavanti vai ।
balānyatibalaṃ prāpya nabalāni bhavanti vai ॥15॥
slp1: na hi tejasvinAM SApAstejaHsu praBavanti vE । balAnyatibalaM prApya nabalAni Bavanti vE ॥15॥

text: hanyādavadhyānvaradānapi caiva tapasvinaḥ । saṅkalpābhiruciḥ kāmaḥ sanātanatamo'nalaḥ ॥16॥
html:
hanyādavadhyānvaradānapi caiva tapasvinaḥ ।
saṅkalpābhiruciḥ kāmaḥ sanātanatamo'nalaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: hanyAdavaDyAnvaradAnapi cEva tapasvinaH । saNkalpABiruciH kAmaH sanAtanatamo'nalaH ॥16॥

text: jagatpatiranirdeśyaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ । hṛcchayaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jyeṣṭho rudrādapi prabhuḥ ॥17॥
html:
jagatpatiranirdeśyaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ ।
hṛcchayaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jyeṣṭho rudrādapi prabhuḥ ॥17॥
slp1: jagatpatiranirdeSyaH sarvagaH sarvaBAvanaH । hfcCayaH sarvaBUtAnAM jyezWo rudrAdapi praBuH ॥17॥

text: anviṣyatāṃ sa tu kṣipraṃ tejorāśirhutāśanaḥ । sa vo manogataṃ kāmaṃ devaḥ sampādayiṣyati ॥18॥
html:
anviṣyatāṃ sa tu kṣipraṃ tejorāśirhutāśanaḥ ।
sa vo manogataṃ kāmaṃ devaḥ sampādayiṣyati ॥18॥
slp1: anvizyatAM sa tu kzipraM tejorASirhutASanaH । sa vo manogataM kAmaM devaH sampAdayizyati ॥18॥

text: etadvākyamupaśrutya tato devā mahātmanaḥ । jagmuḥ saṃsiddhasaṅkalpāḥ paryeṣanto vibhāvasum ॥19॥
html:
etadvākyamupaśrutya tato devā mahātmanaḥ ।
jagmuḥ saṃsiddhasaṅkalpāḥ paryeṣanto vibhāvasum ॥19॥
slp1: etadvAkyamupaSrutya tato devA mahAtmanaH । jagmuH saMsidDasaNkalpAH paryezanto viBAvasum ॥19॥

text: tatastrailokyamṛṣayo vyacinvanta suraiḥ saha । kāṅkṣanto darśanaṃ vahneḥ sarve tadgatamānasāḥ ॥20॥
html:
tatastrailokyamṛṣayo vyacinvanta suraiḥ saha ।
kāṅkṣanto darśanaṃ vahneḥ sarve tadgatamānasāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: tatastrElokyamfzayo vyacinvanta surEH saha । kANkzanto darSanaM vahneH sarve tadgatamAnasAH ॥20॥

text: pareṇa tapasā yuktāḥ śrīmanto lokaviśrutāḥ । lokānanvacaransiddhāḥ sarva eva bhṛgūdvaha । naṣṭamātmani saṃlīnaṃ nādhijagmurhutāśanam ॥21॥
html:
pareṇa tapasā yuktāḥ śrīmanto lokaviśrutāḥ ।
lokānanvacaransiddhāḥ sarva eva bhṛgūdvaha ।
naṣṭamātmani saṃlīnaṃ nādhijagmurhutāśanam ॥21॥
slp1: pareRa tapasA yuktAH SrImanto lokaviSrutAH । lokAnanvacaransidDAH sarva eva BfgUdvaha । nazwamAtmani saMlInaM nADijagmurhutASanam ॥21॥

text: tataḥ sañjātasantrāsānagnerdarśanalālasān । jalecaraḥ klāntamanāstejasāgneḥ pradīpitaḥ । uvāca devānmaṇḍūko rasātalatalotthitaḥ ॥22॥

jalecaraḥ klāntamanāstejasāgneḥ pradīpitaḥ ।

slp1: tataH saYjAtasantrAsAnagnerdarSanalAlasAn । jalecaraH klAntamanAstejasAgneH pradIpitaH । uvAca devAnmaRqUko rasAtalatalotTitaH ॥22॥

text: rasātalatale devā vasatyagniriti prabho । santāpādiha samprāptaḥ pāvakaprabhavādaham ॥23॥
html:

santāpādiha samprāptaḥ pāvakaprabhavādaham ॥23॥
slp1: rasAtalatale devA vasatyagniriti praBo । santApAdiha samprAptaH pAvakapraBavAdaham ॥23॥

text: sa saṃsupto jale devā bhagavānhavyavāhanaḥ । apaḥ saṃsṛjya tejobhistena santāpitā vayam ॥24॥
html:
sa saṃsupto jale devā bhagavānhavyavāhanaḥ ।
apaḥ saṃsṛjya tejobhistena santāpitā vayam ॥24॥
slp1: sa saMsupto jale devA BagavAnhavyavAhanaH । apaH saMsfjya tejoBistena santApitA vayam ॥24॥

text: tasya darśanamiṣṭaṃ vo yadi devā vibhāvasoḥ । tatrainamabhigacchadhvaṃ kāryaṃ vo yadi vahninā ॥25॥
html:
tasya darśanamiṣṭaṃ vo yadi devā vibhāvasoḥ ।
tatrainamabhigacchadhvaṃ kāryaṃ vo yadi vahninā ॥25॥
slp1: tasya darSanamizwaM vo yadi devA viBAvasoH । tatrEnamaBigacCaDvaM kAryaM vo yadi vahninA ॥25॥

text: gamyatāṃ sādhayiṣyāmo vayaṃ hyagnibhayātsurāḥ । etāvaduktvā maṇḍūkastvarito jalamāviśat ॥26॥
html:
gamyatāṃ sādhayiṣyāmo vayaṃ hyagnibhayātsurāḥ ।

slp1: gamyatAM sADayizyAmo vayaM hyagniBayAtsurAH । etAvaduktvA maRqUkastvarito jalamAviSat ॥26॥

text: hutāśanastu bubudhe maṇḍūkasyātha paiśunam । śaśāpa sa tamāsādya na rasānvetsyasīti vai ॥27॥
html:
hutāśanastu bubudhe maṇḍūkasyātha paiśunam ।

slp1: hutASanastu bubuDe maRqUkasyATa pESunam । SaSApa sa tamAsAdya na rasAnvetsyasIti vE ॥27॥

text: taṃ sa saṃyujya śāpena maṇḍūkaṃ pāvako yayau । anyatra vāsāya vibhurna ca devānadarśayat ॥28॥
html:
taṃ sa saṃyujya śāpena maṇḍūkaṃ pāvako yayau ।
anyatra vāsāya vibhurna ca devānadarśayat ॥28॥
slp1: taM sa saMyujya SApena maRqUkaM pAvako yayO । anyatra vAsAya viBurna ca devAnadarSayat ॥28॥

text: devāstvanugrahaṃ cakrurmaṇḍūkānāṃ bhṛgūdvaha । yattacchṛṇu mahābāho gadato mama sarvaśaḥ ॥29॥
html:
devāstvanugrahaṃ cakrurmaṇḍūkānāṃ bhṛgūdvaha ।
yattacchṛṇu mahābāho gadato mama sarvaśaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: devAstvanugrahaM cakrurmaRqUkAnAM BfgUdvaha । yattacCfRu mahAbAho gadato mama sarvaSaH ॥29॥

text: agniśāpādajihvāpi rasajñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ । sarasvatīṃ bahuvidhāṃ yūyamuccārayiṣyatha ॥30॥
html:
agniśāpādajihvāpi rasajñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ ।
sarasvatīṃ bahuvidhāṃ yūyamuccārayiṣyatha ॥30॥
slp1: agniSApAdajihvApi rasajYAnabahizkftAH । sarasvatIM bahuviDAM yUyamuccArayizyaTa ॥30॥

text: bilavāsagatāṃścaiva nirādānānacetasaḥ । gatāsūnapi vaḥ śuṣkānbhūmiḥ sandhārayiṣyati । tamogatāyāmapi ca niśāyāṃ vicariṣyatha ॥31॥
html:
bilavāsagatāṃścaiva nirādānānacetasaḥ ।
gatāsūnapi vaḥ śuṣkānbhūmiḥ sandhārayiṣyati ।
tamogatāyāmapi ca niśāyāṃ vicariṣyatha ॥31॥
slp1: bilavAsagatAMScEva nirAdAnAnacetasaH । gatAsUnapi vaH SuzkAnBUmiH sanDArayizyati । tamogatAyAmapi ca niSAyAM vicarizyaTa ॥31॥

text: ityuktvā tāṃstato devāḥ punareva mahīmimām । parīyurjvalanasyārthe na cāvindanhutāśanam ॥32॥
html:
ityuktvā tāṃstato devāḥ punareva mahīmimām ।
parīyurjvalanasyārthe na cāvindanhutāśanam ॥32॥
slp1: ityuktvA tAMstato devAH punareva mahImimAm । parIyurjvalanasyArTe na cAvindanhutASanam ॥32॥

text: atha tāndviradaḥ kaścitsurendradviradopamaḥ । aśvatthastho'gnirityevaṃ prāha devānbhṛgūdvaha ॥33॥
html:
atha tāndviradaḥ kaścitsurendradviradopamaḥ ।
aśvatthastho'gnirityevaṃ prāha devānbhṛgūdvaha ॥33॥
slp1: aTa tAndviradaH kaScitsurendradviradopamaH । aSvatTasTo'gnirityevaM prAha devAnBfgUdvaha ॥33॥

text: śaśāpa jvalanaḥ sarvāndviradānkrodhamūrchitaḥ । pratīpā bhavatāṃ jihvā bhavitrīti bhṛgūdvaha ॥34॥
html:
śaśāpa jvalanaḥ sarvāndviradānkrodhamūrchitaḥ ।
pratīpā bhavatāṃ jihvā bhavitrīti bhṛgūdvaha ॥34॥
slp1: SaSApa jvalanaH sarvAndviradAnkroDamUrCitaH । pratIpA BavatAM jihvA BavitrIti BfgUdvaha ॥34॥

text: ityuktvā niḥsṛto'śvatthādagnirvāraṇasūcitaḥ । praviveśa śamīgarbhamatha vahniḥ suṣupsayā ॥35॥
html:
ityuktvā niḥsṛto'śvatthādagnirvāraṇasūcitaḥ ।
praviveśa śamīgarbhamatha vahniḥ suṣupsayā ॥35॥
slp1: ityuktvA niHsfto'SvatTAdagnirvAraRasUcitaH । praviveSa SamIgarBamaTa vahniH suzupsayA ॥35॥

text: anugrahaṃ tu nāgānāṃ yaṃ cakruḥ śṛṇu taṃ prabho । devā bhṛgukulaśreṣṭha prītāḥ satyaparākramāḥ ॥36॥
html:
anugrahaṃ tu nāgānāṃ yaṃ cakruḥ śṛṇu taṃ prabho ।
devā bhṛgukulaśreṣṭha prītāḥ satyaparākramāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: anugrahaM tu nAgAnAM yaM cakruH SfRu taM praBo । devA BfgukulaSrezWa prItAH satyaparAkramAH ॥36॥

text: pratīpayā jihvayāpi sarvāhārānkariṣyatha । vācaṃ coccārayiṣyadhvamuccairavyañjitākṣaram । ityuktvā punarevāgnimanusasrurdivaukasaḥ ॥37॥
html:
pratīpayā jihvayāpi sarvāhārānkariṣyatha ।
vācaṃ coccārayiṣyadhvamuccairavyañjitākṣaram ।
ityuktvā punarevāgnimanusasrurdivaukasaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: pratIpayA jihvayApi sarvAhArAnkarizyaTa । vAcaM coccArayizyaDvamuccEravyaYjitAkzaram । ityuktvA punarevAgnimanusasrurdivOkasaH ॥37॥
author: devā ūcuḥ ।

text: aśvatthānniḥsṛtaścāgniḥ śamīgarbhagatastadā । śukena khyāpito vipra taṃ devāḥ samupādravan ॥38॥
html:
aśvatthānniḥsṛtaścāgniḥ śamīgarbhagatastadā ।
śukena khyāpito vipra taṃ devāḥ samupādravan ॥38॥
slp1: aSvatTAnniHsftaScAgniH SamIgarBagatastadA । Sukena KyApito vipra taM devAH samupAdravan ॥38॥

html:
śaśāpa śukamagnistu vāgvihīno bhaviṣyasi ।

slp1: SaSApa Sukamagnistu vAgvihIno Bavizyasi । jihvAM cAvartayAmAsa tasyApi hutaBuktadA ॥39॥

text: dṛṣṭvā tu jvalanaṃ devāḥ śukamūcurdayānvitāḥ । bhavitā na tvamatyantaṃ śakune naṣṭavāgiti ॥40॥
html:

slp1: dfzwvA tu jvalanaM devAH SukamUcurdayAnvitAH । BavitA na tvamatyantaM Sakune nazwavAgiti ॥40॥

html:
āvṛttajihvasya sato vākyaṃ kāntaṃ bhaviṣyati ।

slp1: Avfttajihvasya sato vAkyaM kAntaM Bavizyati । bAlasyeva pravfdDasya kalamavyaktamadButam ॥41॥

text: ityuktvā taṃ śamīgarbhe vahnimālakṣya devatāḥ । tadevāyatanaṃ cakruḥ puṇyaṃ sarvakriyāsvapi ॥42॥
html:
ityuktvā taṃ śamīgarbhe vahnimālakṣya devatāḥ ।
tadevāyatanaṃ cakruḥ puṇyaṃ sarvakriyāsvapi ॥42॥
slp1: ityuktvA taM SamIgarBe vahnimAlakzya devatAH । tadevAyatanaM cakruH puRyaM sarvakriyAsvapi ॥42॥

html:
tataḥprabhṛti cāpyagniḥ śamīgarbheṣu dṛśyate ।
utpādane tathopāyamanujagmuśca mānavāḥ ॥43॥

text: āpo rasātale yāstu saṃsṛṣṭāścitrabhānunā । tāḥ parvataprasravaṇairūṣmāṃ muñcanti bhārgava । pāvakenādhiśayatā santaptāstasya tejasā ॥44॥
html:
āpo rasātale yāstu saṃsṛṣṭāścitrabhānunā ।
tāḥ parvataprasravaṇairūṣmāṃ muñcanti bhārgava ।
pāvakenādhiśayatā santaptāstasya tejasā ॥44॥
slp1: Apo rasAtale yAstu saMsfzwAScitraBAnunA । tAH parvataprasravaRErUzmAM muYcanti BArgava । pAvakenADiSayatA santaptAstasya tejasA ॥44॥

text: tato'gnirdevatā dṛṣṭvā babhūva vyathitastadā । kimāgamanamityevaṃ tānapṛcchata pāvakaḥ ॥45॥
html:
tato'gnirdevatā dṛṣṭvā babhūva vyathitastadā ।

text: tamūcurvibudhāḥ sarve te caiva paramarṣayaḥ । tvāṃ niyokṣyāmahe kārye tadbhavānkartumarhati । kṛte ca tasminbhavitā tavāpi sumahānguṇaḥ ॥46॥
html:

tvāṃ niyokṣyāmahe kārye tadbhavānkartumarhati ।
kṛte ca tasminbhavitā tavāpi sumahānguṇaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: tamUcurvibuDAH sarve te cEva paramarzayaH । tvAM niyokzyAmahe kArye tadBavAnkartumarhati । kfte ca tasminBavitA tavApi sumahAnguRaH ॥46॥

text: brūta yadbhavatāṃ kāryaṃ sarvaṃ kartāsmi tatsurāḥ । bhavatāṃ hi niyojyo'haṃ mā vo'trāstu vicāraṇā ॥47॥
html:
brūta yadbhavatāṃ kāryaṃ sarvaṃ kartāsmi tatsurāḥ ।
bhavatāṃ hi niyojyo'haṃ mā vo'trāstu vicāraṇā ॥47॥
slp1: brUta yadBavatAM kAryaM sarvaM kartAsmi tatsurAH । BavatAM hi niyojyo'haM mA vo'trAstu vicAraRA ॥47॥

text: asurastārako nāma brahmaṇo varadarpitaḥ । asmānprabādhate vīryādvadhastasya vidhīyatām ॥48॥

asurastārako nāma brahmaṇo varadarpitaḥ ।
asmānprabādhate vīryādvadhastasya vidhīyatām ॥48॥

html:

apatyaṃ tejasā yuktaṃ pravīraṃ janaya prabho ।

slp1: SaptAnAM no mahAdevyA nAnyadasti parAyaRam । anyatra Bavato vIryaM tasmAttrAyasva nastataH ॥51॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa tathetyuktvā bhagavānhavyakavyabhuk । jagāmātha durādharṣo gaṅgāṃ bhāgīrathīṃ prati ॥52॥
html:

slp1: ityuktaH sa taTetyuktvA BagavAnhavyakavyaBuk । jagAmATa durADarzo gaNgAM BAgIraTIM prati ॥52॥

html:
tayā cāpyabhavanmiśro garbhaścāsyābhavattadā ।

text: āhite jvalanenātha garbhe tejaḥsamanvite । gaṅgāyāmasuraḥ kaścidbhairavaṃ nādamutsṛjat ॥55॥
html:

text: abuddhāpatitenātha nādena vipulena sā । vitrastodbhrāntanayanā gaṅgā viplutalocanā । visañjñā nāśakadgarbhaṃ sandhārayitumātmanā ॥56॥

vitrastodbhrāntanayanā gaṅgā viplutalocanā ।
visañjñā nāśakadgarbhaṃ sandhārayitumātmanā ॥56॥
slp1: abudDApatitenATa nAdena vipulena sA । vitrastodBrAntanayanA gaNgA viplutalocanA । visaYjYA nASakadgarBaM sanDArayitumAtmanA ॥56॥

text: sā tu tejaḥparītāṅgī kampamānā ca jāhnavī । uvāca vacanaṃ vipra tadā garbhabaloddhatā । na te śaktāsmi bhagavaṃstejaso'sya vidhāraṇe ॥57॥
html:
sā tu tejaḥparītāṅgī kampamānā ca jāhnavī ।
uvāca vacanaṃ vipra tadā garbhabaloddhatā ।
na te śaktāsmi bhagavaṃstejaso'sya vidhāraṇe ॥57॥
slp1: sA tu tejaHparItANgI kampamAnA ca jAhnavI । uvAca vacanaM vipra tadA garBabalodDatA । na te SaktAsmi BagavaMstejaso'sya viDAraRe ॥57॥

text: vimūḍhāsmi kṛtānena tathāsvāsthyaṃ kṛtaṃ param । vihvalā cāsmi bhagavaṃstejo naṣṭaṃ ca me'nagha ॥58॥
html:
vimūḍhāsmi kṛtānena tathāsvāsthyaṃ kṛtaṃ param ।
vihvalā cāsmi bhagavaṃstejo naṣṭaṃ ca me'nagha ॥58॥
slp1: vimUQAsmi kftAnena taTAsvAsTyaM kftaM param । vihvalA cAsmi BagavaMstejo nazwaM ca me'naGa ॥58॥

text: dhāraṇe nāsya śaktāhaṃ garbhasya tapatāṃ vara । utsrakṣye'hamimaṃ duḥkhānna tu kāmātkathañcana ॥59॥
html:
dhāraṇe nāsya śaktāhaṃ garbhasya tapatāṃ vara ।
utsrakṣye'hamimaṃ duḥkhānna tu kāmātkathañcana ॥59॥
slp1: DAraRe nAsya SaktAhaM garBasya tapatAM vara । utsrakzye'hamimaM duHKAnna tu kAmAtkaTaYcana ॥59॥

text: na cetaso'sti saṃsparśo mama deva vibhāvaso । āpadarthe hi sambandhaḥ susūkṣmo'pi mahādyute ॥60॥
html:
na cetaso'sti saṃsparśo mama deva vibhāvaso ।
āpadarthe hi sambandhaḥ susūkṣmo'pi mahādyute ॥60॥
slp1: na cetaso'sti saMsparSo mama deva viBAvaso । ApadarTe hi sambanDaH susUkzmo'pi mahAdyute ॥60॥

text: yadatra guṇasampannamitaraṃ vā hutāśana । tvayyeva tadahaṃ manye dharmādharmau ca kevalau ॥61॥
html:
yadatra guṇasampannamitaraṃ vā hutāśana ।
tvayyeva tadahaṃ manye dharmādharmau ca kevalau ॥61॥
slp1: yadatra guRasampannamitaraM vA hutASana । tvayyeva tadahaM manye DarmADarmO ca kevalO ॥61॥

text: tāmuvāca tato vahnirdhāryatāṃ dhāryatāmayam । garbho mattejasā yukto mahāguṇaphalodayaḥ ॥62॥
html:
tāmuvāca tato vahnirdhāryatāṃ dhāryatāmayam ।
garbho mattejasā yukto mahāguṇaphalodayaḥ ॥62॥
slp1: tAmuvAca tato vahnirDAryatAM DAryatAmayam । garBo mattejasA yukto mahAguRaPalodayaH ॥62॥

text: śaktā hyasi mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ voḍhuṃ dhārayituṃ tathā । na hi te kiñcidaprāpyaṃ madretodhāraṇādṛte ॥63॥
html:
śaktā hyasi mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ voḍhuṃ dhārayituṃ tathā ।
na hi te kiñcidaprāpyaṃ madretodhāraṇādṛte ॥63॥
slp1: SaktA hyasi mahIM kftsnAM voQuM DArayituM taTA । na hi te kiYcidaprApyaM madretoDAraRAdfte ॥63॥

text: sā vahninā vāryamāṇā devaiścāpi saridvarā । samutsasarja taṃ garbhaṃ merau girivare tadā ॥64॥
html:
sā vahninā vāryamāṇā devaiścāpi saridvarā ।
samutsasarja taṃ garbhaṃ merau girivare tadā ॥64॥
slp1: sA vahninA vAryamARA devEScApi saridvarA । samutsasarja taM garBaM merO girivare tadA ॥64॥

text: samarthā dhāraṇe cāpi rudratejaḥpradharṣitā । nāśakattaṃ tadā garbhaṃ sandhārayitumojasā ॥65॥
html:
samarthā dhāraṇe cāpi rudratejaḥpradharṣitā ।
nāśakattaṃ tadā garbhaṃ sandhārayitumojasā ॥65॥
slp1: samarTA DAraRe cApi rudratejaHpraDarzitA । nASakattaM tadA garBaM sanDArayitumojasA ॥65॥

text: sā samutsṛjya taṃ duḥkhāddīptavaiśvānaraprabham । darśayāmāsa cāgnistāṃ tadā gaṅgāṃ bhṛgūdvaha । papraccha saritāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ kaccidgarbhaḥ sukhodayaḥ ॥66॥
html:
sā samutsṛjya taṃ duḥkhāddīptavaiśvānaraprabham ।
darśayāmāsa cāgnistāṃ tadā gaṅgāṃ bhṛgūdvaha ।
papraccha saritāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ kaccidgarbhaḥ sukhodayaḥ ॥66॥
slp1: sA samutsfjya taM duHKAddIptavESvAnarapraBam । darSayAmAsa cAgnistAM tadA gaNgAM BfgUdvaha । papracCa saritAM SrezWAM kaccidgarBaH suKodayaH ॥66॥

text: kīdṛgvarṇo'pi vā devi kīdṛgrūpaśca dṛśyate । tejasā kena vā yuktaḥ sarvametadbravīhi me ॥67॥
html:
kīdṛgvarṇo'pi vā devi kīdṛgrūpaśca dṛśyate ।
tejasā kena vā yuktaḥ sarvametadbravīhi me ॥67॥
slp1: kIdfgvarRo'pi vA devi kIdfgrUpaSca dfSyate । tejasA kena vA yuktaH sarvametadbravIhi me ॥67॥

text: jātarūpaḥ sa garbho vai tejasā tvamivānala । suvarṇo vimalo dīptaḥ parvataṃ cāvabhāsayat ॥68॥
html:
jātarūpaḥ sa garbho vai tejasā tvamivānala ।
suvarṇo vimalo dīptaḥ parvataṃ cāvabhāsayat ॥68॥
slp1: jAtarUpaH sa garBo vE tejasA tvamivAnala । suvarRo vimalo dIptaH parvataM cAvaBAsayat ॥68॥
author: gaṅgovāca ।

text: padmotpalavimiśrāṇāṃ hradānāmiva śītalaḥ । gandho'sya sa kadambānāṃ tulyo vai tapatāṃ vara ॥69॥
html:
padmotpalavimiśrāṇāṃ hradānāmiva śītalaḥ ।
gandho'sya sa kadambānāṃ tulyo vai tapatāṃ vara ॥69॥
slp1: padmotpalavimiSrARAM hradAnAmiva SItalaH । ganDo'sya sa kadambAnAM tulyo vE tapatAM vara ॥69॥

text: tejasā tasya garbhasya bhāskarasyeva raśmibhiḥ । yaddravyaṃ parisaṃsṛṣṭaṃ pṛthivyāṃ parvateṣu vā । tatsarvaṃ kāñcanībhūtaṃ samantātpratyadṛśyata ॥70॥
html:
tejasā tasya garbhasya bhāskarasyeva raśmibhiḥ ।
yaddravyaṃ parisaṃsṛṣṭaṃ pṛthivyāṃ parvateṣu vā ।
tatsarvaṃ kāñcanībhūtaṃ samantātpratyadṛśyata ॥70॥
slp1: tejasA tasya garBasya BAskarasyeva raSmiBiH । yaddravyaM parisaMsfzwaM pfTivyAM parvatezu vA । tatsarvaM kAYcanIBUtaM samantAtpratyadfSyata ॥70॥

text: paryadhāvata śailāṃśca nadīḥ prasravaṇāni ca । vyadīpayattejasā ca trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ॥71॥
html:
paryadhāvata śailāṃśca nadīḥ prasravaṇāni ca ।
vyadīpayattejasā ca trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ॥71॥
slp1: paryaDAvata SElAMSca nadIH prasravaRAni ca । vyadIpayattejasA ca trElokyaM sacarAcaram ॥71॥

text: evaṃrūpaḥ sa bhagavānputraste havyavāhana । sūryavaiśvānarasamaḥ kāntyā soma ivāparaḥ । evamuktvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥72॥
html:
evaṃrūpaḥ sa bhagavānputraste havyavāhana ।
sūryavaiśvānarasamaḥ kāntyā soma ivāparaḥ ।
evamuktvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥72॥
slp1: evaMrUpaH sa BagavAnputraste havyavAhana । sUryavESvAnarasamaH kAntyA soma ivAparaH । evamuktvA tu sA devI tatrEvAntaraDIyata ॥72॥

text: pāvakaścāpi tejasvī kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaukasām । jagāmeṣṭaṃ tato deśaṃ tadā bhārgavanandana ॥73॥
html:
pāvakaścāpi tejasvī kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaukasām ।
jagāmeṣṭaṃ tato deśaṃ tadā bhārgavanandana ॥73॥
slp1: pAvakaScApi tejasvI kftvA kAryaM divOkasAm । jagAmezwaM tato deSaM tadA BArgavanandana ॥73॥

text: etaiḥ karmaguṇairloke nāmāgneḥ parigīyate । hiraṇyaretā iti vai ṛṣibhirvibudhaistathā । pṛthivī ca tadā devī khyātā vasumatīti vai ॥74॥
html:
etaiḥ karmaguṇairloke nāmāgneḥ parigīyate ।
hiraṇyaretā iti vai ṛṣibhirvibudhaistathā ।
pṛthivī ca tadā devī khyātā vasumatīti vai ॥74॥
slp1: etEH karmaguRErloke nAmAgneH parigIyate । hiraRyaretA iti vE fziBirvibuDEstaTA । pfTivI ca tadA devI KyAtA vasumatIti vE ॥74॥

text: sa tu garbho mahātejā gāṅgeyaḥ pāvakodbhavaḥ । divyaṃ śaravaṇaṃ prāpya vavṛdhe'dbhutadarśanaḥ ॥75॥
html:
sa tu garbho mahātejā gāṅgeyaḥ pāvakodbhavaḥ ।
divyaṃ śaravaṇaṃ prāpya vavṛdhe'dbhutadarśanaḥ ॥75॥
slp1: sa tu garBo mahAtejA gANgeyaH pAvakodBavaH । divyaM SaravaRaM prApya vavfDe'dButadarSanaH ॥75॥

text: dadṛśuḥ kṛttikāstaṃ tu bālārkasadṛśadyutim । jātasnehāśca taṃ bālaṃ pupuṣuḥ stanyavisravaiḥ ॥76॥
html:
dadṛśuḥ kṛttikāstaṃ tu bālārkasadṛśadyutim ।
jātasnehāśca taṃ bālaṃ pupuṣuḥ stanyavisravaiḥ ॥76॥
slp1: dadfSuH kfttikAstaM tu bAlArkasadfSadyutim । jAtasnehASca taM bAlaM pupuzuH stanyavisravEH ॥76॥

text: tataḥ sa kārttikeyatvamavāpa paramadyutiḥ । skannatvātskandatāṃ cāpi guhāvāsādguho'bhavat ॥77॥
html:
tataḥ sa kārttikeyatvamavāpa paramadyutiḥ ।
skannatvātskandatāṃ cāpi guhāvāsādguho'bhavat ॥77॥
slp1: tataH sa kArttikeyatvamavApa paramadyutiH । skannatvAtskandatAM cApi guhAvAsAdguho'Bavat ॥77॥

text: evaṃ suvarṇamutpannamapatyaṃ jātavedasaḥ । tatra jāmbūnadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ devānāmapi bhūṣaṇam ॥78॥
html:
evaṃ suvarṇamutpannamapatyaṃ jātavedasaḥ ।
tatra jāmbūnadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ devānāmapi bhūṣaṇam ॥78॥
slp1: evaM suvarRamutpannamapatyaM jAtavedasaH । tatra jAmbUnadaM SrezWaM devAnAmapi BUzaRam ॥78॥

text: tataḥprabhṛti cāpyetajjātarūpamudāhṛtam । yatsuvarṇaṃ sa bhagavānagnirīśaḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥79॥
html:
tataḥprabhṛti cāpyetajjātarūpamudāhṛtam ।
yatsuvarṇaṃ sa bhagavānagnirīśaḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥79॥
slp1: tataHpraBfti cApyetajjAtarUpamudAhftam । yatsuvarRaM sa BagavAnagnirISaH prajApatiH ॥79॥

text: pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ hi kanakaṃ dvijasattama । agnīṣomātmakaṃ caiva jātarūpamudāhṛtam ॥80॥
html:
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ hi kanakaṃ dvijasattama ।
agnīṣomātmakaṃ caiva jātarūpamudāhṛtam ॥80॥
slp1: pavitrARAM pavitraM hi kanakaM dvijasattama । agnIzomAtmakaM cEva jAtarUpamudAhftam ॥80॥

text: ratnānāmuttamaṃ ratnaṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ tathottamam । pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam] ॥81॥
html:
ratnānāmuttamaṃ ratnaṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ tathottamam ।
pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam] ॥81॥
slp1: ratnAnAmuttamaM ratnaM BUzaRAnAM taTottamam । pavitraM ca pavitrARAM maNgalAnAM ca maNgalam] ॥81॥

text: api cedaṃ purā rāma śrutaṃ me brahmadarśanam । pitāmahasya yadvṛttaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ ॥1॥
html:
api cedaṃ purā rāma śrutaṃ me brahmadarśanam ।
pitāmahasya yadvṛttaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: api cedaM purA rAma SrutaM me brahmadarSanam । pitAmahasya yadvfttaM brahmaRaH paramAtmanaH ॥1॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: devasya mahatastāta vāruṇīṃ bibhratastanum । aiśvarye vāruṇe rāma rudrasyeśasya vai prabho ॥2॥
html:
devasya mahatastāta vāruṇīṃ bibhratastanum ।
aiśvarye vāruṇe rāma rudrasyeśasya vai prabho ॥2॥
slp1: devasya mahatastAta vAruRIM biBratastanum । ESvarye vAruRe rAma rudrasyeSasya vE praBo ॥2॥

text: ājagmurmunayaḥ sarve devāścāgnipurogamāḥ । yajñāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi vaṣaṭkāraśca mūrtimān ॥3॥
html:
ājagmurmunayaḥ sarve devāścāgnipurogamāḥ ।
yajñāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi vaṣaṭkāraśca mūrtimān ॥3॥
slp1: AjagmurmunayaH sarve devAScAgnipurogamAH । yajYANgAni ca sarvARi vazawkAraSca mUrtimAn ॥3॥

text: mūrtimanti ca sāmāni yajūṃṣi ca sahasraśaḥ । ṛgvedaścāgamattatra padakramavibhūṣitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
mūrtimanti ca sāmāni yajūṃṣi ca sahasraśaḥ ।
ṛgvedaścāgamattatra padakramavibhūṣitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: mUrtimanti ca sAmAni yajUMzi ca sahasraSaH । fgvedaScAgamattatra padakramaviBUzitaH ॥4॥

text: lakṣaṇāni svarāḥ stobhā niruktaṃ svarabhaktayaḥ । oṅkāraścāvasannetre nigrahapragrahau tathā ॥5॥
html:
lakṣaṇāni svarāḥ stobhā niruktaṃ svarabhaktayaḥ ।
oṅkāraścāvasannetre nigrahapragrahau tathā ॥5॥
slp1: lakzaRAni svarAH stoBA niruktaM svaraBaktayaH । oNkAraScAvasannetre nigrahapragrahO taTA ॥5॥

text: vedāśca sopaniṣado vidyā sāvitryathāpi ca । bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca dadhāra bhagavāñśivaḥ । juhvaccātmanyathātmānaṃ svayameva tadā prabho ॥6॥
html:
vedāśca sopaniṣado vidyā sāvitryathāpi ca ।
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca dadhāra bhagavāñśivaḥ ।
juhvaccātmanyathātmānaṃ svayameva tadā prabho ॥6॥
slp1: vedASca sopanizado vidyA sAvitryaTApi ca । BUtaM BavyaM Bavizyacca daDAra BagavAYSivaH । juhvaccAtmanyaTAtmAnaM svayameva tadA praBo ॥6॥

text: devapatnyaśca kanyāśca devānāṃ caiva mātaraḥ । ājagmuḥ sahitāstatra tadā bhṛgukulodvaha ॥7॥
html:
devapatnyaśca kanyāśca devānāṃ caiva mātaraḥ ।
ājagmuḥ sahitāstatra tadā bhṛgukulodvaha ॥7॥
slp1: devapatnyaSca kanyASca devAnAM cEva mAtaraH । AjagmuH sahitAstatra tadA Bfgukulodvaha ॥7॥

text: yajñaṃ paśupateḥ prītā varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ । svayambhuvastu tā dṛṣṭvā retaḥ samapatadbhuvi ॥8॥
html:
yajñaṃ paśupateḥ prītā varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ ।
svayambhuvastu tā dṛṣṭvā retaḥ samapatadbhuvi ॥8॥
slp1: yajYaM paSupateH prItA varuRasya mahAtmanaH । svayamBuvastu tA dfzwvA retaH samapatadBuvi ॥8॥

text: tasya śukrasya niṣpandātpāṃsūnsaṅgṛhya bhūmitaḥ । prāsyatpūṣā karābhyāṃ vai tasminneva hutāśane ॥9॥
html:
tasya śukrasya niṣpandātpāṃsūnsaṅgṛhya bhūmitaḥ ।
prāsyatpūṣā karābhyāṃ vai tasminneva hutāśane ॥9॥
slp1: tasya Sukrasya nizpandAtpAMsUnsaNgfhya BUmitaH । prAsyatpUzA karAByAM vE tasminneva hutASane ॥9॥

text: tatastasminsampravṛtte satre jvalitapāvake । brahmaṇo juhvatastatra prādurbhāvo babhūva ha ॥10॥
html:
tatastasminsampravṛtte satre jvalitapāvake ।
brahmaṇo juhvatastatra prādurbhāvo babhūva ha ॥10॥
slp1: tatastasminsampravftte satre jvalitapAvake । brahmaRo juhvatastatra prAdurBAvo baBUva ha ॥10॥

text: skannamātraṃ ca tacchukraṃ sruveṇa pratigṛhya saḥ । ājyavanmantravaccāpi so'juhodbhṛgunandana ॥11॥
html:
skannamātraṃ ca tacchukraṃ sruveṇa pratigṛhya saḥ ।
ājyavanmantravaccāpi so'juhodbhṛgunandana ॥11॥
slp1: skannamAtraM ca tacCukraM sruveRa pratigfhya saH । AjyavanmantravaccApi so'juhodBfgunandana ॥11॥

text: tataḥ sañjanayāmāsa bhūtagrāmaṃ sa vīryavān । tatastu tejasastasmājjajñe lokeṣu taijasam ॥12॥
html:
tataḥ sañjanayāmāsa bhūtagrāmaṃ sa vīryavān ।
tatastu tejasastasmājjajñe lokeṣu taijasam ॥12॥
slp1: tataH saYjanayAmAsa BUtagrAmaM sa vIryavAn । tatastu tejasastasmAjjajYe lokezu tEjasam ॥12॥

text: tamasastāmasā bhāvā vyāpi sattvaṃ tathobhayam । saguṇastejaso nityaṃ tamasyākāśameva ca ॥13॥
html:
tamasastāmasā bhāvā vyāpi sattvaṃ tathobhayam ।
saguṇastejaso nityaṃ tamasyākāśameva ca ॥13॥
slp1: tamasastAmasA BAvA vyApi sattvaM taToBayam । saguRastejaso nityaM tamasyAkASameva ca ॥13॥

text: sarvabhūteṣvatha tathā sattvaṃ tejastathā tamaḥ । śukre hute'gnau tasmiṃstu prādurāsaṃstrayaḥ prabho ॥14॥
html:
sarvabhūteṣvatha tathā sattvaṃ tejastathā tamaḥ ।
śukre hute'gnau tasmiṃstu prādurāsaṃstrayaḥ prabho ॥14॥
slp1: sarvaBUtezvaTa taTA sattvaM tejastaTA tamaH । Sukre hute'gnO tasmiMstu prAdurAsaMstrayaH praBo ॥14॥

text: puruṣā vapuṣā yuktā yuktāḥ prasavajairguṇaiḥ । bhṛgityeva bhṛguḥ pūrvamaṅgārebhyo'ṅgirābhavat ॥15॥
html:
puruṣā vapuṣā yuktā yuktāḥ prasavajairguṇaiḥ ।
bhṛgityeva bhṛguḥ pūrvamaṅgārebhyo'ṅgirābhavat ॥15॥
slp1: puruzA vapuzA yuktA yuktAH prasavajErguREH । Bfgityeva BfguH pUrvamaNgAreByo'NgirABavat ॥15॥

text: aṅgārasaṃśrayāccaiva kavirityaparo'bhavat । saha jvālābhirutpanno bhṛgustasmādbhṛguḥ smṛtaḥ ॥16॥
html:
aṅgārasaṃśrayāccaiva kavirityaparo'bhavat ।
saha jvālābhirutpanno bhṛgustasmādbhṛguḥ smṛtaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: aNgArasaMSrayAccEva kavirityaparo'Bavat । saha jvAlABirutpanno BfgustasmAdBfguH smftaH ॥16॥

text: marīcibhyo marīcistu mārīcaḥ kaśyapo hyabhūt । aṅgārebhyo'ṅgirāstāta vālakhilyāḥ śiloccayāt । atraivātreti ca vibho jātamatriṃ vadantyapi ॥17॥
html:
marīcibhyo marīcistu mārīcaḥ kaśyapo hyabhūt ।
aṅgārebhyo'ṅgirāstāta vālakhilyāḥ śiloccayāt ।
atraivātreti ca vibho jātamatriṃ vadantyapi ॥17॥
slp1: marIciByo marIcistu mArIcaH kaSyapo hyaBUt । aNgAreByo'NgirAstAta vAlaKilyAH SiloccayAt । atrEvAtreti ca viBo jAtamatriM vadantyapi ॥17॥

text: tathā bhasmavyapohebhyo brahmarṣigaṇasammitāḥ । vaikhānasāḥ samutpannāstapaḥśrutaguṇepsavaḥ । aśruto'sya samutpannāvaśvinau rūpasammatau ॥18॥
html:
tathā bhasmavyapohebhyo brahmarṣigaṇasammitāḥ ।
vaikhānasāḥ samutpannāstapaḥśrutaguṇepsavaḥ ।
aśruto'sya samutpannāvaśvinau rūpasammatau ॥18॥
slp1: taTA BasmavyapoheByo brahmarzigaRasammitAH । vEKAnasAH samutpannAstapaHSrutaguRepsavaH । aSruto'sya samutpannAvaSvinO rUpasammatO ॥18॥

text: śeṣāḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ srotobhyastasya jajñire । ṛṣayo lomakūpebhyaḥ svedācchando malātmakam ॥19॥
html:
śeṣāḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ srotobhyastasya jajñire ।
ṛṣayo lomakūpebhyaḥ svedācchando malātmakam ॥19॥
slp1: SezAH prajAnAM patayaH srotoByastasya jajYire । fzayo lomakUpeByaH svedAcCando malAtmakam ॥19॥

text: etasmātkāraṇādāhuragniṃ sarvāstu devatāḥ । ṛṣayaḥ śrutasampannā vedaprāmāṇyadarśanāt ॥20॥
html:
etasmātkāraṇādāhuragniṃ sarvāstu devatāḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ śrutasampannā vedaprāmāṇyadarśanāt ॥20॥
slp1: etasmAtkAraRAdAhuragniM sarvAstu devatAH । fzayaH SrutasampannA vedaprAmARyadarSanAt ॥20॥

text: yāni dārūṇi te māsā niryāsāḥ pakṣasañjñitāḥ । ahorātrā muhūrtāstu pittaṃ jyotiśca vāruṇam ॥21॥
html:
yāni dārūṇi te māsā niryāsāḥ pakṣasañjñitāḥ ।
ahorātrā muhūrtāstu pittaṃ jyotiśca vāruṇam ॥21॥
slp1: yAni dArURi te mAsA niryAsAH pakzasaYjYitAH । ahorAtrA muhUrtAstu pittaM jyotiSca vAruRam ॥21॥

text: raudraṃ lohitamityāhurlohitātkanakaṃ smṛtam । tanmaitramiti vijñeyaṃ dhūmācca vasavaḥ smṛtāḥ ॥22॥
html:
raudraṃ lohitamityāhurlohitātkanakaṃ smṛtam ।
tanmaitramiti vijñeyaṃ dhūmācca vasavaḥ smṛtāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: rOdraM lohitamityAhurlohitAtkanakaM smftam । tanmEtramiti vijYeyaM DUmAcca vasavaH smftAH ॥22॥

text: arciṣo yāśca te rudrāstathādityā mahāprabhāḥ । uddiṣṭāste tathāṅgārā ye dhiṣṇyeṣu divi sthitāḥ ॥23॥
html:
arciṣo yāśca te rudrāstathādityā mahāprabhāḥ ।
uddiṣṭāste tathāṅgārā ye dhiṣṇyeṣu divi sthitāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: arcizo yASca te rudrAstaTAdityA mahApraBAH । uddizwAste taTANgArA ye DizRyezu divi sTitAH ॥23॥

text: ādināthaśca lokasya tatparaṃ brahma taddhruvam । sarvakāmadamityāhustatra havyamudāvahat ॥24॥
html:
ādināthaśca lokasya tatparaṃ brahma taddhruvam ।
sarvakāmadamityāhustatra havyamudāvahat ॥24॥
slp1: AdinATaSca lokasya tatparaM brahma tadDruvam । sarvakAmadamityAhustatra havyamudAvahat ॥24॥

text: tato'bravīnmahādevo varuṇaḥ paramātmakaḥ । mama satramidaṃ divyamahaṃ gṛhapatistviha ॥25॥
html:
tato'bravīnmahādevo varuṇaḥ paramātmakaḥ ।
mama satramidaṃ divyamahaṃ gṛhapatistviha ॥25॥
slp1: tato'bravInmahAdevo varuRaH paramAtmakaH । mama satramidaM divyamahaM gfhapatistviha ॥25॥

text: trīṇi pūrvāṇyapatyāni mama tāni na saṃśayaḥ । iti jānīta khagamā mama yajñaphalaṃ hi tat ॥26॥
html:
trīṇi pūrvāṇyapatyāni mama tāni na saṃśayaḥ ।
iti jānīta khagamā mama yajñaphalaṃ hi tat ॥26॥
slp1: trIRi pUrvARyapatyAni mama tAni na saMSayaH । iti jAnIta KagamA mama yajYaPalaM hi tat ॥26॥

text: madaṅgebhyaḥ prasūtāni madāśrayakṛtāni ca । mamaiva tānyapatyāni varuṇo hyavaśātmakaḥ ॥27॥
html:
madaṅgebhyaḥ prasūtāni madāśrayakṛtāni ca ।
mamaiva tānyapatyāni varuṇo hyavaśātmakaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: madaNgeByaH prasUtAni madASrayakftAni ca । mamEva tAnyapatyAni varuRo hyavaSAtmakaH ॥27॥
author: agniruvāca ।

text: athābravīllokagururbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ । mamaiva tānyapatyāni mama śukraṃ hutaṃ hi tat ॥28॥
html:
athābravīllokagururbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।
mamaiva tānyapatyāni mama śukraṃ hutaṃ hi tat ॥28॥
slp1: aTAbravIllokagururbrahmA lokapitAmahaH । mamEva tAnyapatyAni mama SukraM hutaM hi tat ॥28॥

text: ahaṃ vaktā ca mantrasya hotā śukrasya caiva ha । yasya bījaṃ phalaṃ tasya śukraṃ cetkāraṇaṃ matam ॥29॥
html:
ahaṃ vaktā ca mantrasya hotā śukrasya caiva ha ।
yasya bījaṃ phalaṃ tasya śukraṃ cetkāraṇaṃ matam ॥29॥
slp1: ahaM vaktA ca mantrasya hotA Sukrasya cEva ha । yasya bIjaM PalaM tasya SukraM cetkAraRaM matam ॥29॥

text: tato'bruvandevagaṇāḥ pitāmahamupetya vai । kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve śirobhirabhivandya ca ॥30॥
html:
tato'bruvandevagaṇāḥ pitāmahamupetya vai ।
kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve śirobhirabhivandya ca ॥30॥
slp1: tato'bruvandevagaRAH pitAmahamupetya vE । kftAYjalipuwAH sarve SiroBiraBivandya ca ॥30॥

text: vayaṃ ca bhagavansarve jagacca sacarācaram । tavaiva prasavāḥ sarve tasmādagnirvibhāvasuḥ । varuṇaśceśvaro devo labhatāṃ kāmamīpsitam ॥31॥
html:
vayaṃ ca bhagavansarve jagacca sacarācaram ।
tavaiva prasavāḥ sarve tasmādagnirvibhāvasuḥ ।
varuṇaśceśvaro devo labhatāṃ kāmamīpsitam ॥31॥
slp1: vayaM ca Bagavansarve jagacca sacarAcaram । tavEva prasavAH sarve tasmAdagnirviBAvasuH । varuRaSceSvaro devo laBatAM kAmamIpsitam ॥31॥

text: nisargādvaruṇaścāpi brahmaṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ । jagrāha vai bhṛguṃ pūrvamapatyaṃ sūryavarcasam ॥32॥
html:
nisargādvaruṇaścāpi brahmaṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ ।
jagrāha vai bhṛguṃ pūrvamapatyaṃ sūryavarcasam ॥32॥
slp1: nisargAdvaruRaScApi brahmaRo yAdasAM patiH । jagrAha vE BfguM pUrvamapatyaM sUryavarcasam ॥32॥

text: īśvaro'ṅgirasaṃ cāgnerapatyārthe'bhyakalpayat । pitāmahastvapatyaṃ vai kaviṃ jagrāha tattvavit ॥33॥
html:
īśvaro'ṅgirasaṃ cāgnerapatyārthe'bhyakalpayat ।
pitāmahastvapatyaṃ vai kaviṃ jagrāha tattvavit ॥33॥
slp1: ISvaro'NgirasaM cAgnerapatyArTe'Byakalpayat । pitAmahastvapatyaM vE kaviM jagrAha tattvavit ॥33॥

text: tadā sa vāruṇaḥ khyāto bhṛguḥ prasavakarmakṛt । āgneyastvaṅgirāḥ śrīmānkavirbrāhmo mahāyaśāḥ । bhārgavāṅgirasau loke lokasantānalakṣaṇau ॥34॥
html:
tadā sa vāruṇaḥ khyāto bhṛguḥ prasavakarmakṛt ।
āgneyastvaṅgirāḥ śrīmānkavirbrāhmo mahāyaśāḥ ।
bhārgavāṅgirasau loke lokasantānalakṣaṇau ॥34॥
slp1: tadA sa vAruRaH KyAto BfguH prasavakarmakft । AgneyastvaNgirAH SrImAnkavirbrAhmo mahAyaSAH । BArgavANgirasO loke lokasantAnalakzaRO ॥34॥

text: ete vipravarāḥ sarve prajānāṃ patayastrayaḥ । sarvaṃ santānameteṣāmidamityupadhāraya ॥35॥
html:
ete vipravarāḥ sarve prajānāṃ patayastrayaḥ ।
sarvaṃ santānameteṣāmidamityupadhāraya ॥35॥
slp1: ete vipravarAH sarve prajAnAM patayastrayaH । sarvaM santAnametezAmidamityupaDAraya ॥35॥

text: bhṛgostu putrāstatrāsansapta tulyā bhṛgorguṇaiḥ । cyavano vajraśīrṣaśca śuciraurvastathaiva ca ॥36॥
html:
bhṛgostu putrāstatrāsansapta tulyā bhṛgorguṇaiḥ ।
cyavano vajraśīrṣaśca śuciraurvastathaiva ca ॥36॥
slp1: Bfgostu putrAstatrAsansapta tulyA BfgorguREH । cyavano vajraSIrzaSca SucirOrvastaTEva ca ॥36॥

text: śukro vareṇyaśca vibhuḥ savanaśceti sapta te । bhārgavā vāruṇāḥ sarve yeṣāṃ vaṃśe bhavānapi ॥37॥
html:
śukro vareṇyaśca vibhuḥ savanaśceti sapta te ।
bhārgavā vāruṇāḥ sarve yeṣāṃ vaṃśe bhavānapi ॥37॥
slp1: Sukro vareRyaSca viBuH savanaSceti sapta te । BArgavA vAruRAH sarve yezAM vaMSe BavAnapi ॥37॥

text: aṣṭau cāṅgirasaḥ putrā vāruṇāste'pyudāhṛtāḥ । bṛhaspatirutathyaśca vayasyaḥ śāntireva ca ॥38॥
html:
aṣṭau cāṅgirasaḥ putrā vāruṇāste'pyudāhṛtāḥ ।
bṛhaspatirutathyaśca vayasyaḥ śāntireva ca ॥38॥
slp1: azwO cANgirasaH putrA vAruRAste'pyudAhftAH । bfhaspatirutaTyaSca vayasyaH SAntireva ca ॥38॥

text: ghoro virūpaḥ saṃvartaḥ sudhanvā cāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ । ete'ṣṭāvagnijāḥ sarve jñānaniṣṭhā nirāmayāḥ ॥39॥
html:
ghoro virūpaḥ saṃvartaḥ sudhanvā cāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
ete'ṣṭāvagnijāḥ sarve jñānaniṣṭhā nirāmayāḥ ॥39॥
slp1: Goro virUpaH saMvartaH suDanvA cAzwamaH smftaH । ete'zwAvagnijAH sarve jYAnanizWA nirAmayAH ॥39॥

text: brāhmaṇasya kaveḥ putrā vāruṇāste'pyudāhṛtāḥ । aṣṭau prasavajairyuktā guṇairbrahmavidaḥ śubhāḥ ॥40॥
html:
brāhmaṇasya kaveḥ putrā vāruṇāste'pyudāhṛtāḥ ।
aṣṭau prasavajairyuktā guṇairbrahmavidaḥ śubhāḥ ॥40॥
slp1: brAhmaRasya kaveH putrA vAruRAste'pyudAhftAH । azwO prasavajEryuktA guRErbrahmavidaH SuBAH ॥40॥

text: kaviḥ kāvyaśca viṣṇuśca buddhimānuśanāstathā । bhṛguśca virajāścaiva kāśī cograśca dharmavit ॥41॥
html:
kaviḥ kāvyaśca viṣṇuśca buddhimānuśanāstathā ।
bhṛguśca virajāścaiva kāśī cograśca dharmavit ॥41॥
slp1: kaviH kAvyaSca vizRuSca budDimAnuSanAstaTA । BfguSca virajAScEva kASI cograSca Darmavit ॥41॥

text: aṣṭau kavisutā hyete sarvamebhirjagattatam । prajāpataya ete hi prajānāṃ yairimāḥ prajāḥ ॥42॥
html:
aṣṭau kavisutā hyete sarvamebhirjagattatam ।
prajāpataya ete hi prajānāṃ yairimāḥ prajāḥ ॥42॥
slp1: azwO kavisutA hyete sarvameBirjagattatam । prajApataya ete hi prajAnAM yErimAH prajAH ॥42॥

text: evamaṅgirasaścaiva kaveśca prasavānvayaiḥ । bhṛgośca bhṛguśārdūla vaṃśajaiḥ satataṃ jagat ॥43॥
html:
evamaṅgirasaścaiva kaveśca prasavānvayaiḥ ।
bhṛgośca bhṛguśārdūla vaṃśajaiḥ satataṃ jagat ॥43॥
slp1: evamaNgirasaScEva kaveSca prasavAnvayEH । BfgoSca BfguSArdUla vaMSajEH satataM jagat ॥43॥

text: varuṇaścādito vipra jagrāha prabhurīśvaraḥ । kaviṃ tāta bhṛguṃ caiva tasmāttau vāruṇau smṛtau ॥44॥
html:
varuṇaścādito vipra jagrāha prabhurīśvaraḥ ।
kaviṃ tāta bhṛguṃ caiva tasmāttau vāruṇau smṛtau ॥44॥
slp1: varuRaScAdito vipra jagrAha praBurISvaraH । kaviM tAta BfguM cEva tasmAttO vAruRO smftO ॥44॥

text: jagrāhāṅgirasaṃ devaḥ śikhī tasmāddhutāśanaḥ । tasmādaṅgiraso jñeyāḥ sarva eva tadanvayāḥ ॥45॥
html:
jagrāhāṅgirasaṃ devaḥ śikhī tasmāddhutāśanaḥ ।
tasmādaṅgiraso jñeyāḥ sarva eva tadanvayāḥ ॥45॥
slp1: jagrAhANgirasaM devaH SiKI tasmAdDutASanaH । tasmAdaNgiraso jYeyAH sarva eva tadanvayAH ॥45॥

text: brahmā pitāmahaḥ pūrvaṃ devatābhiḥ prasāditaḥ । ime naḥ santariṣyanti prajābhirjagadīśvarāḥ ॥46॥
html:
brahmā pitāmahaḥ pūrvaṃ devatābhiḥ prasāditaḥ ।
ime naḥ santariṣyanti prajābhirjagadīśvarāḥ ॥46॥
slp1: brahmA pitAmahaH pUrvaM devatABiH prasAditaH । ime naH santarizyanti prajABirjagadISvarAH ॥46॥

text: sarve prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve cātitapasvinaḥ । tvatprasādādimaṃ lokaṃ tārayiṣyanti śāśvatam ॥47॥
html:
sarve prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve cātitapasvinaḥ ।
tvatprasādādimaṃ lokaṃ tārayiṣyanti śāśvatam ॥47॥
slp1: sarve prajAnAM patayaH sarve cAtitapasvinaH । tvatprasAdAdimaM lokaM tArayizyanti SASvatam ॥47॥

text: tathaiva vaṃśakartārastava tejovivardhanāḥ । bhaveyurvedaviduṣaḥ sarve vākpatayastathā ॥48॥
html:
tathaiva vaṃśakartārastava tejovivardhanāḥ ।
bhaveyurvedaviduṣaḥ sarve vākpatayastathā ॥48॥
slp1: taTEva vaMSakartArastava tejovivarDanAH । BaveyurvedaviduzaH sarve vAkpatayastaTA ॥48॥

text: devapakṣadharāḥ saumyāḥ prājāpatyā maharṣayaḥ । āpnuvanti tapaścaiva brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ tathā ॥49॥
html:
devapakṣadharāḥ saumyāḥ prājāpatyā maharṣayaḥ ।
āpnuvanti tapaścaiva brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ tathā ॥49॥
slp1: devapakzaDarAH sOmyAH prAjApatyA maharzayaH । Apnuvanti tapaScEva brahmacaryaM paraM taTA ॥49॥

text: sarve hi vayamete ca tavaiva prasavaḥ prabho । devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tvaṃ hi kartā pitāmaha ॥50॥
html:
sarve hi vayamete ca tavaiva prasavaḥ prabho ।
devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tvaṃ hi kartā pitāmaha ॥50॥
slp1: sarve hi vayamete ca tavEva prasavaH praBo । devAnAM brAhmaRAnAM ca tvaM hi kartA pitAmaha ॥50॥

text: marīcimāditaḥ kṛtvā sarve caivātha bhārgavāḥ । apatyānīti samprekṣya kṣamayāma pitāmaha ॥51॥
html:
marīcimāditaḥ kṛtvā sarve caivātha bhārgavāḥ ।
apatyānīti samprekṣya kṣamayāma pitāmaha ॥51॥
slp1: marIcimAditaH kftvA sarve cEvATa BArgavAH । apatyAnIti samprekzya kzamayAma pitAmaha ॥51॥

text: te tvanenaiva rūpeṇa prajaniṣyanti vai prajāḥ । sthāpayiṣyanti cātmānaṃ yugādinidhane tathā ॥52॥
html:
te tvanenaiva rūpeṇa prajaniṣyanti vai prajāḥ ।
sthāpayiṣyanti cātmānaṃ yugādinidhane tathā ॥52॥
slp1: te tvanenEva rUpeRa prajanizyanti vE prajAH । sTApayizyanti cAtmAnaM yugAdiniDane taTA ॥52॥

text: evametatpurā vṛttaṃ tasya yajñe mahātmanaḥ । devaśreṣṭhasya lokādau vāruṇīṃ bibhratastanum ॥53॥
html:
evametatpurā vṛttaṃ tasya yajñe mahātmanaḥ ।
devaśreṣṭhasya lokādau vāruṇīṃ bibhratastanum ॥53॥
slp1: evametatpurA vfttaM tasya yajYe mahAtmanaH । devaSrezWasya lokAdO vAruRIM biBratastanum ॥53॥

text: agnirbrahmā paśupatiḥ śarvo rudraḥ prajāpatiḥ । agnerapatyametadvai suvarṇamiti dhāraṇā ॥54॥
html:
agnirbrahmā paśupatiḥ śarvo rudraḥ prajāpatiḥ ।
agnerapatyametadvai suvarṇamiti dhāraṇā ॥54॥
slp1: agnirbrahmA paSupatiH Sarvo rudraH prajApatiH । agnerapatyametadvE suvarRamiti DAraRA ॥54॥

text: agnyabhāve ca kurvanti vahnisthāneṣu kāñcanam । jāmadagnya pramāṇajñā vedaśrutinidarśanāt ॥55॥
html:
agnyabhāve ca kurvanti vahnisthāneṣu kāñcanam ।
jāmadagnya pramāṇajñā vedaśrutinidarśanāt ॥55॥
slp1: agnyaBAve ca kurvanti vahnisTAnezu kAYcanam । jAmadagnya pramARajYA vedaSrutinidarSanAt ॥55॥

text: kuśastambe juhotyagniṃ suvarṇaṃ tatra saṃsthitam । hute prītikarīmṛddhiṃ bhagavāṃstatra manyate ॥56॥
html:
kuśastambe juhotyagniṃ suvarṇaṃ tatra saṃsthitam ।
hute prītikarīmṛddhiṃ bhagavāṃstatra manyate ॥56॥
slp1: kuSastambe juhotyagniM suvarRaM tatra saMsTitam । hute prItikarImfdDiM BagavAMstatra manyate ॥56॥

text: tasmādagniparāḥ sarvā devatā iti śuśruma । brahmaṇo hi prasūto'gniragnerapi ca kāñcanam ॥57॥
html:
tasmādagniparāḥ sarvā devatā iti śuśruma ।
brahmaṇo hi prasūto'gniragnerapi ca kāñcanam ॥57॥
slp1: tasmAdagniparAH sarvA devatA iti SuSruma । brahmaRo hi prasUto'gniragnerapi ca kAYcanam ॥57॥

text: tasmādye vai prayacchanti suvarṇaṃ dharmadarśinaḥ । devatāste prayacchanti samastā iti naḥ śrutam ॥58॥
html:
tasmādye vai prayacchanti suvarṇaṃ dharmadarśinaḥ ।
devatāste prayacchanti samastā iti naḥ śrutam ॥58॥
slp1: tasmAdye vE prayacCanti suvarRaM DarmadarSinaH । devatAste prayacCanti samastA iti naH Srutam ॥58॥

text: tasya cātamaso lokā gacchataḥ paramāṃ gatim । svarloke rājarājyena so'bhiṣicyeta bhārgava ॥59॥
html:
tasya cātamaso lokā gacchataḥ paramāṃ gatim ।
svarloke rājarājyena so'bhiṣicyeta bhārgava ॥59॥
slp1: tasya cAtamaso lokA gacCataH paramAM gatim । svarloke rAjarAjyena so'Bizicyeta BArgava ॥59॥

text: ādityodayane prāpte vidhimantrapuraskṛtam । dadāti kāñcanaṃ yo vai duḥsvapnaṃ pratihanti saḥ ॥60॥
html:
ādityodayane prāpte vidhimantrapuraskṛtam ।
dadāti kāñcanaṃ yo vai duḥsvapnaṃ pratihanti saḥ ॥60॥
slp1: Adityodayane prApte viDimantrapuraskftam । dadAti kAYcanaM yo vE duHsvapnaM pratihanti saH ॥60॥

text: dadātyuditamātre yastasya pāpmā vidhūyate । madhyāhne dadato rukmaṃ hanti pāpamanāgatam ॥61॥
html:
dadātyuditamātre yastasya pāpmā vidhūyate ।
madhyāhne dadato rukmaṃ hanti pāpamanāgatam ॥61॥
slp1: dadAtyuditamAtre yastasya pApmA viDUyate । maDyAhne dadato rukmaM hanti pApamanAgatam ॥61॥

text: dadāti paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ yaḥ suvarṇaṃ dhṛtavrataḥ । brahmavāyvagnisomānāṃ sālokyamupayāti saḥ ॥62॥
html:
dadāti paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ yaḥ suvarṇaṃ dhṛtavrataḥ ।
brahmavāyvagnisomānāṃ sālokyamupayāti saḥ ॥62॥
slp1: dadAti paScimAM sanDyAM yaH suvarRaM DftavrataH । brahmavAyvagnisomAnAM sAlokyamupayAti saH ॥62॥

text: sendreṣu caiva lokeṣu pratiṣṭhāṃ prāpnute śubhām । iha loke yaśaḥ prāpya śāntapāpmā pramodate ॥63॥
html:
sendreṣu caiva lokeṣu pratiṣṭhāṃ prāpnute śubhām ।
iha loke yaśaḥ prāpya śāntapāpmā pramodate ॥63॥
slp1: sendrezu cEva lokezu pratizWAM prApnute SuBAm । iha loke yaSaH prApya SAntapApmA pramodate ॥63॥

text: tataḥ sampadyate'nyeṣu lokeṣvapratimaḥ sadā । anāvṛtagatiścaiva kāmacārī bhavatyuta ॥64॥
html:
tataḥ sampadyate'nyeṣu lokeṣvapratimaḥ sadā ।
anāvṛtagatiścaiva kāmacārī bhavatyuta ॥64॥
slp1: tataH sampadyate'nyezu lokezvapratimaH sadA । anAvftagatiScEva kAmacArI Bavatyuta ॥64॥

text: na ca kṣarati tebhyaḥ sa śaśvaccaivāpnute mahat । suvarṇamakṣayaṃ dattvā lokānāpnoti puṣkalān ॥65॥
html:
na ca kṣarati tebhyaḥ sa śaśvaccaivāpnute mahat ।
suvarṇamakṣayaṃ dattvā lokānāpnoti puṣkalān ॥65॥
slp1: na ca kzarati teByaH sa SaSvaccEvApnute mahat । suvarRamakzayaM dattvA lokAnApnoti puzkalAn ॥65॥

text: yastu sañjanayitvāgnimādityodayanaṃ prati । dadyādvai vratamuddiśya sarvānkāmānsamaśnute ॥66॥
html:
yastu sañjanayitvāgnimādityodayanaṃ prati ।
dadyādvai vratamuddiśya sarvānkāmānsamaśnute ॥66॥
slp1: yastu saYjanayitvAgnimAdityodayanaM prati । dadyAdvE vratamuddiSya sarvAnkAmAnsamaSnute ॥66॥

text: agnirityeva tatprāhuḥ pradānaṃ vai sukhāvaham । yatheṣṭaguṇasampannaṃ pravartakamiti smṛtam ॥67॥
html:
agnirityeva tatprāhuḥ pradānaṃ vai sukhāvaham ।
yatheṣṭaguṇasampannaṃ pravartakamiti smṛtam ॥67॥
slp1: agnirityeva tatprAhuH pradAnaM vE suKAvaham । yaTezwaguRasampannaM pravartakamiti smftam ॥67॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa vasiṣṭhena jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān । dadau suvarṇaṃ viprebhyo vyamucyata ca kilbiṣāt ॥68॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa vasiṣṭhena jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān ।
dadau suvarṇaṃ viprebhyo vyamucyata ca kilbiṣāt ॥68॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa vasizWena jAmadagnyaH pratApavAn । dadO suvarRaM vipreByo vyamucyata ca kilbizAt ॥68॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ suvarṇasya mahīpate । pradānasya phalaṃ caiva janma cāgnyamanuttamam ॥69॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ suvarṇasya mahīpate ।
pradānasya phalaṃ caiva janma cāgnyamanuttamam ॥69॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM suvarRasya mahIpate । pradAnasya PalaM cEva janma cAgnyamanuttamam ॥69॥

text: tasmāttvamapi viprebhyaḥ prayaccha kanakaṃ bahu । dadatsuvarṇaṃ nṛpate kilbiṣādvipramokṣyasi] ॥70॥
html:
tasmāttvamapi viprebhyaḥ prayaccha kanakaṃ bahu ।
dadatsuvarṇaṃ nṛpate kilbiṣādvipramokṣyasi] ॥70॥
slp1: tasmAttvamapi vipreByaH prayacCa kanakaM bahu । dadatsuvarRaM nfpate kilbizAdvipramokzyasi] ॥70॥

text: uktāḥ pitāmaheneha suvarṇasya vidhānataḥ । vistareṇa pradānasya ye guṇāḥ śrutilakṣaṇāḥ ॥1॥
html:
uktāḥ pitāmaheneha suvarṇasya vidhānataḥ ।
vistareṇa pradānasya ye guṇāḥ śrutilakṣaṇāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: uktAH pitAmaheneha suvarRasya viDAnataH । vistareRa pradAnasya ye guRAH SrutilakzaRAH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: yattu kāraṇamutpatteḥ suvarṇasyeha kīrtitam । sa kathaṃ tārakaḥ prāpto nidhanaṃ tadbravīhi me ॥2॥
html:
yattu kāraṇamutpatteḥ suvarṇasyeha kīrtitam ।
sa kathaṃ tārakaḥ prāpto nidhanaṃ tadbravīhi me ॥2॥
slp1: yattu kAraRamutpatteH suvarRasyeha kIrtitam । sa kaTaM tArakaH prApto niDanaM tadbravIhi me ॥2॥

text: uktaḥ sa devatānāṃ hi avadhya iti pārthiva । na ca tasyeha te mṛtyurvistareṇa prakīrtitaḥ ॥3॥
html:
uktaḥ sa devatānāṃ hi avadhya iti pārthiva ।
na ca tasyeha te mṛtyurvistareṇa prakīrtitaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: uktaH sa devatAnAM hi avaDya iti pArTiva । na ca tasyeha te mftyurvistareRa prakIrtitaH ॥3॥

text: etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tvattaḥ kurukulodvaha । kārtsnyena tārakavadhaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥4॥
html:
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tvattaḥ kurukulodvaha ।
kārtsnyena tārakavadhaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥4॥
slp1: etadicCAmyahaM SrotuM tvattaH kurukulodvaha । kArtsnyena tArakavaDaM paraM kOtUhalaM hi me ॥4॥

text: vipannakṛtyā rājendra devatā ṛṣayastathā । kṛttikāścodayāmāsurapatyabharaṇāya vai ॥5॥
html:
vipannakṛtyā rājendra devatā ṛṣayastathā ।
kṛttikāścodayāmāsurapatyabharaṇāya vai ॥5॥
slp1: vipannakftyA rAjendra devatA fzayastaTA । kfttikAScodayAmAsurapatyaBaraRAya vE ॥5॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: na devatānāṃ kāciddhi samarthā jātavedasaḥ । ekāpi śaktā taṃ garbhaṃ sandhārayitumojasā ॥6॥
html:
na devatānāṃ kāciddhi samarthā jātavedasaḥ ।
ekāpi śaktā taṃ garbhaṃ sandhārayitumojasā ॥6॥
slp1: na devatAnAM kAcidDi samarTA jAtavedasaH । ekApi SaktA taM garBaM sanDArayitumojasA ॥6॥

text: ṣaṇṇāṃ tāsāṃ tataḥ prītaḥ pāvako garbhadhāraṇāt । svena tejovisargeṇa vīryeṇa parameṇa ca ॥7॥
html:
ṣaṇṇāṃ tāsāṃ tataḥ prītaḥ pāvako garbhadhāraṇāt ।
svena tejovisargeṇa vīryeṇa parameṇa ca ॥7॥
slp1: zaRRAM tAsAM tataH prItaH pAvako garBaDAraRAt । svena tejovisargeRa vIryeRa parameRa ca ॥7॥

text: tāstu ṣaṭkṛttikā garbhaṃ pupuṣurjātavedasaḥ । ṣaṭsu vartmasu tejo'gneḥ sakalaṃ nihitaṃ prabho ॥8॥
html:
tāstu ṣaṭkṛttikā garbhaṃ pupuṣurjātavedasaḥ ।
ṣaṭsu vartmasu tejo'gneḥ sakalaṃ nihitaṃ prabho ॥8॥
slp1: tAstu zawkfttikA garBaM pupuzurjAtavedasaH । zawsu vartmasu tejo'gneH sakalaM nihitaM praBo ॥8॥

text: tatastā vardhamānasya kumārasya mahātmanaḥ । tejasābhiparītāṅgyo na kvaciccharma lebhire ॥9॥
html:
tatastā vardhamānasya kumārasya mahātmanaḥ ।
tejasābhiparītāṅgyo na kvaciccharma lebhire ॥9॥
slp1: tatastA varDamAnasya kumArasya mahAtmanaH । tejasABiparItANgyo na kvacicCarma leBire ॥9॥

text: tatastejaḥparītāṅgyaḥ sarvāḥ kāla upasthite । samaṃ garbhaṃ suṣuvire kṛttikāstā nararṣabha ॥10॥
html:
tatastejaḥparītāṅgyaḥ sarvāḥ kāla upasthite ।
samaṃ garbhaṃ suṣuvire kṛttikāstā nararṣabha ॥10॥
slp1: tatastejaHparItANgyaH sarvAH kAla upasTite । samaM garBaM suzuvire kfttikAstA nararzaBa ॥10॥

text: tatastaṃ ṣaḍadhiṣṭhānaṃ garbhamekatvamāgatam । pṛthivī pratijagrāha kāntīpurasamīpataḥ ॥11॥
html:
tatastaṃ ṣaḍadhiṣṭhānaṃ garbhamekatvamāgatam ।
pṛthivī pratijagrāha kāntīpurasamīpataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tatastaM zaqaDizWAnaM garBamekatvamAgatam । pfTivI pratijagrAha kAntIpurasamIpataH ॥11॥

text: sa garbho divyasaṃsthāno dīptimānpāvakaprabhaḥ । divyaṃ śaravaṇaṃ prāpya vavṛdhe priyadarśanaḥ ॥12॥
html:
sa garbho divyasaṃsthāno dīptimānpāvakaprabhaḥ ।
divyaṃ śaravaṇaṃ prāpya vavṛdhe priyadarśanaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: sa garBo divyasaMsTAno dIptimAnpAvakapraBaH । divyaM SaravaRaM prApya vavfDe priyadarSanaH ॥12॥

text: dadṛśuḥ kṛttikāstaṃ tu bālaṃ vahnisamadyutim । jātasnehāśca sauhārdātpupuṣuḥ stanyavisravaiḥ ॥13॥
html:
dadṛśuḥ kṛttikāstaṃ tu bālaṃ vahnisamadyutim ।
jātasnehāśca sauhārdātpupuṣuḥ stanyavisravaiḥ ॥13॥
slp1: dadfSuH kfttikAstaM tu bAlaM vahnisamadyutim । jAtasnehASca sOhArdAtpupuzuH stanyavisravEH ॥13॥

text: abhavatkārttikeyaḥ sa trailokye sacarācare । skannatvātskandatāṃ cāpa guhāvāsādguho'bhavat ॥14॥
html:
abhavatkārttikeyaḥ sa trailokye sacarācare ।
skannatvātskandatāṃ cāpa guhāvāsādguho'bhavat ॥14॥
slp1: aBavatkArttikeyaH sa trElokye sacarAcare । skannatvAtskandatAM cApa guhAvAsAdguho'Bavat ॥14॥

text: tato devāstrayastriṃśaddiśaśca sadigīśvarāḥ । rudro dhātā ca viṣṇuśca yajñaḥ pūṣāryamā bhagaḥ ॥15॥
html:
tato devāstrayastriṃśaddiśaśca sadigīśvarāḥ ।
rudro dhātā ca viṣṇuśca yajñaḥ pūṣāryamā bhagaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tato devAstrayastriMSaddiSaSca sadigISvarAH । rudro DAtA ca vizRuSca yajYaH pUzAryamA BagaH ॥15॥

text: aṃśo mitraśca sādhyāśca vasavo vāsavo'śvinau । āpo vāyurnabhaścandro nakṣatrāṇi grahā raviḥ ॥16॥
html:
aṃśo mitraśca sādhyāśca vasavo vāsavo'śvinau ।
āpo vāyurnabhaścandro nakṣatrāṇi grahā raviḥ ॥16॥
slp1: aMSo mitraSca sADyASca vasavo vAsavo'SvinO । Apo vAyurnaBaScandro nakzatrARi grahA raviH ॥16॥

text: pṛthagbhūtāni cānyāni yāni devārpaṇāni vai । ājagmustatra taṃ draṣṭuṃ kumāraṃ jvalanātmajam । ṛṣayastuṣṭuvuścaiva gandharvāśca jagustathā ॥17॥
html:
pṛthagbhūtāni cānyāni yāni devārpaṇāni vai ।
ājagmustatra taṃ draṣṭuṃ kumāraṃ jvalanātmajam ।
ṛṣayastuṣṭuvuścaiva gandharvāśca jagustathā ॥17॥
slp1: pfTagBUtAni cAnyAni yAni devArpaRAni vE । Ajagmustatra taM drazwuM kumAraM jvalanAtmajam । fzayastuzwuvuScEva ganDarvASca jagustaTA ॥17॥

text: ṣaḍānanaṃ kumāraṃ taṃ dviṣaḍakṣaṃ dvijapriyam । pīnāṃsaṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ pāvakādityavarcasam ॥18॥
html:
ṣaḍānanaṃ kumāraṃ taṃ dviṣaḍakṣaṃ dvijapriyam ।
pīnāṃsaṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ pāvakādityavarcasam ॥18॥
slp1: zaqAnanaM kumAraM taM dvizaqakzaM dvijapriyam । pInAMsaM dvAdaSaBujaM pAvakAdityavarcasam ॥18॥

text: śayānaṃ śaragulmasthaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ । lebhire paramaṃ harṣaṃ menire cāsuraṃ hatam ॥19॥
html:
śayānaṃ śaragulmasthaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ।
lebhire paramaṃ harṣaṃ menire cāsuraṃ hatam ॥19॥
slp1: SayAnaM SaragulmasTaM dfzwvA devAH saharziBiH । leBire paramaM harzaM menire cAsuraM hatam ॥19॥

text: tato devāḥ priyāṇyasya sarva eva samācaran । krīḍataḥ krīḍanīyāni daduḥ pakṣigaṇāṃśca ha ॥20॥
html:
tato devāḥ priyāṇyasya sarva eva samācaran ।
krīḍataḥ krīḍanīyāni daduḥ pakṣigaṇāṃśca ha ॥20॥
slp1: tato devAH priyARyasya sarva eva samAcaran । krIqataH krIqanIyAni daduH pakzigaRAMSca ha ॥20॥

text: suparṇo'sya dadau patraṃ mayūraṃ citrabarhiṇam । rākṣasāśca dadustasmai varāhamahiṣāvubhau ॥21॥
html:
suparṇo'sya dadau patraṃ mayūraṃ citrabarhiṇam ।
rākṣasāśca dadustasmai varāhamahiṣāvubhau ॥21॥
slp1: suparRo'sya dadO patraM mayUraM citrabarhiRam । rAkzasASca dadustasmE varAhamahizAvuBO ॥21॥

text: kukkuṭaṃ cāgnisaṅkāśaṃ pradadau varuṇaḥ svayam । candramāḥ pradadau meṣamādityo rucirāṃ prabhām ॥22॥
html:
kukkuṭaṃ cāgnisaṅkāśaṃ pradadau varuṇaḥ svayam ।
candramāḥ pradadau meṣamādityo rucirāṃ prabhām ॥22॥
slp1: kukkuwaM cAgnisaNkASaM pradadO varuRaH svayam । candramAH pradadO mezamAdityo rucirAM praBAm ॥22॥

text: gavāṃ mātā ca gā devī dadau śatasahasraśaḥ । chāgamagnirguṇopetamilā puṣpaphalaṃ bahu ॥23॥
html:
gavāṃ mātā ca gā devī dadau śatasahasraśaḥ ।
chāgamagnirguṇopetamilā puṣpaphalaṃ bahu ॥23॥
slp1: gavAM mAtA ca gA devI dadO SatasahasraSaH । CAgamagnirguRopetamilA puzpaPalaM bahu ॥23॥

text: sudhanvā śakaṭaṃ caiva rathaṃ cāmitakūbaram । varuṇo vāruṇāndivyānbhujaṅgānpradadau śubhān । siṃhānsurendro vyāghrāṃśca dvīpino'nyāṃśca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ ॥24॥
html:
sudhanvā śakaṭaṃ caiva rathaṃ cāmitakūbaram ।
varuṇo vāruṇāndivyānbhujaṅgānpradadau śubhān ।
siṃhānsurendro vyāghrāṃśca dvīpino'nyāṃśca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: suDanvA SakawaM cEva raTaM cAmitakUbaram । varuRo vAruRAndivyAnBujaNgAnpradadO SuBAn । siMhAnsurendro vyAGrAMSca dvIpino'nyAMSca daMzwriRaH ॥24॥

text: śvāpadāṃśca bahūnghorāṃśchatrāṇi vividhāni ca । rākṣasāsurasaṅghāśca ye'nujagmustamīśvaram ॥25॥
html:
śvāpadāṃśca bahūnghorāṃśchatrāṇi vividhāni ca ।
rākṣasāsurasaṅghāśca ye'nujagmustamīśvaram ॥25॥
slp1: SvApadAMSca bahUnGorAMSCatrARi viviDAni ca । rAkzasAsurasaNGASca ye'nujagmustamISvaram ॥25॥

text: vardhamānaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā prārthayāmāsa tārakaḥ । upāyairbahubhirhantuṃ nāśakaccāpi taṃ vibhum ॥26॥
html:
vardhamānaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā prārthayāmāsa tārakaḥ ।
upāyairbahubhirhantuṃ nāśakaccāpi taṃ vibhum ॥26॥
slp1: varDamAnaM tu taM dfzwvA prArTayAmAsa tArakaH । upAyErbahuBirhantuM nASakaccApi taM viBum ॥26॥

text: senāpatyena taṃ devāḥ pūjayitvā guhālayam । śaśaṃsurviprakāraṃ taṃ tasmai tārakakāritam ॥27॥
html:
senāpatyena taṃ devāḥ pūjayitvā guhālayam ।
śaśaṃsurviprakāraṃ taṃ tasmai tārakakāritam ॥27॥
slp1: senApatyena taM devAH pUjayitvA guhAlayam । SaSaMsurviprakAraM taM tasmE tArakakAritam ॥27॥

text: sa vivṛddho mahāvīryo devasenāpatiḥ prabhuḥ । jaghānāmoghayā śaktyā dānavaṃ tārakaṃ guhaḥ ॥28॥
html:
sa vivṛddho mahāvīryo devasenāpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।

yamastu yāni śrāddhāni provāca śaśabindave ।
tāni me śṛṇu kāmyāni nakṣatreṣu pṛthakpṛthak ॥1॥
slp1: yamastu yAni SrAdDAni provAca SaSabindave । tAni me SfRu kAmyAni nakzatrezu pfTakpfTak ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kṛttikāyoge kurvīta satataṃ naraḥ । agnīnādhāya sāpatyo yajeta vigatajvaraḥ ॥2॥
html:
śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kṛttikāyoge kurvīta satataṃ naraḥ ।
agnīnādhāya sāpatyo yajeta vigatajvaraḥ ॥2॥
slp1: SrAdDaM yaH kfttikAyoge kurvIta satataM naraH । agnInADAya sApatyo yajeta vigatajvaraH ॥2॥

text: apatyakāmo rohiṇyāmojaskāmo mṛgottame । krūrakarmā dadacchrāddhamārdrāyāṃ mānavo bhavet ॥3॥
html:
apatyakāmo rohiṇyāmojaskāmo mṛgottame ।
krūrakarmā dadacchrāddhamārdrāyāṃ mānavo bhavet ॥3॥
slp1: apatyakAmo rohiRyAmojaskAmo mfgottame । krUrakarmA dadacCrAdDamArdrAyAM mAnavo Bavet ॥3॥

text: kṛṣibhāgī bhavenmartyaḥ kurvañśrāddhaṃ punarvasau । puṣṭikāmo'tha puṣyeṇa śrāddhamīheta mānavaḥ ॥4॥
html:
kṛṣibhāgī bhavenmartyaḥ kurvañśrāddhaṃ punarvasau ।
puṣṭikāmo'tha puṣyeṇa śrāddhamīheta mānavaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: kfziBAgI BavenmartyaH kurvaYSrAdDaM punarvasO । puzwikAmo'Ta puzyeRa SrAdDamIheta mAnavaH ॥4॥

text: āśleṣāyāṃ dadacchrāddhaṃ vīrānputrānprajāyate । jñātīnāṃ tu bhavecchreṣṭho maghāsu śrāddhamāvapan ॥5॥
html:
āśleṣāyāṃ dadacchrāddhaṃ vīrānputrānprajāyate ।
jñātīnāṃ tu bhavecchreṣṭho maghāsu śrāddhamāvapan ॥5॥
slp1: ASlezAyAM dadacCrAdDaM vIrAnputrAnprajAyate । jYAtInAM tu BavecCrezWo maGAsu SrAdDamAvapan ॥5॥

text: phalgunīṣu dadacchrāddhaṃ subhagaḥ śrāddhado bhavet । apatyabhāguttarāsu hastena phalabhāgbhavet ॥6॥
html:
phalgunīṣu dadacchrāddhaṃ subhagaḥ śrāddhado bhavet ।
apatyabhāguttarāsu hastena phalabhāgbhavet ॥6॥
slp1: PalgunIzu dadacCrAdDaM suBagaH SrAdDado Bavet । apatyaBAguttarAsu hastena PalaBAgBavet ॥6॥

text: citrāyāṃ tu dadacchrāddhaṃ labhedrūpavataḥ sutān । svātiyoge pitṝnarcya vāṇijyamupajīvati ॥7॥
html:
citrāyāṃ tu dadacchrāddhaṃ labhedrūpavataḥ sutān ।
svātiyoge pitṝnarcya vāṇijyamupajīvati ॥7॥
slp1: citrAyAM tu dadacCrAdDaM laBedrUpavataH sutAn । svAtiyoge pitFnarcya vARijyamupajIvati ॥7॥

text: bahuputro viśākhāsu pitryamīhanbhavennaraḥ । anurādhāsu kurvāṇo rājacakraṃ pravartayet ॥8॥
html:
bahuputro viśākhāsu pitryamīhanbhavennaraḥ ।
anurādhāsu kurvāṇo rājacakraṃ pravartayet ॥8॥
slp1: bahuputro viSAKAsu pitryamIhanBavennaraH । anurADAsu kurvARo rAjacakraM pravartayet ॥8॥

text: ādipatyaṃ vrajenmartyo jyeṣṭhāyāmapavarjayan । naraḥ kurukulaśreṣṭha śraddhādamapuraḥsaraḥ ॥9॥
html:
ādipatyaṃ vrajenmartyo jyeṣṭhāyāmapavarjayan ।
naraḥ kurukulaśreṣṭha śraddhādamapuraḥsaraḥ ॥9॥
slp1: AdipatyaM vrajenmartyo jyezWAyAmapavarjayan । naraH kurukulaSrezWa SradDAdamapuraHsaraH ॥9॥

text: mūle tvārogyamarccheta yaśo'ṣāḍhāsvanuttamam । uttarāsu tvaṣāḍhāsu vītaśokaścarenmahīm ॥10॥
html:
mūle tvārogyamarccheta yaśo'ṣāḍhāsvanuttamam ।
uttarāsu tvaṣāḍhāsu vītaśokaścarenmahīm ॥10॥
slp1: mUle tvArogyamarcCeta yaSo'zAQAsvanuttamam । uttarAsu tvazAQAsu vItaSokaScarenmahIm ॥10॥

text: śrāddhaṃ tvabhijitā kurvanvidyāṃ śreṣṭhāmavāpnuyāt । śravaṇe tu dadacchrāddhaṃ pretya gacchetparāṃ gatim ॥11॥
html:
śrāddhaṃ tvabhijitā kurvanvidyāṃ śreṣṭhāmavāpnuyāt ।
śravaṇe tu dadacchrāddhaṃ pretya gacchetparāṃ gatim ॥11॥
slp1: SrAdDaM tvaBijitA kurvanvidyAM SrezWAmavApnuyAt । SravaRe tu dadacCrAdDaM pretya gacCetparAM gatim ॥11॥

text: rājyabhāgī dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ prāpnuyānnāpadaṃ naraḥ । nakṣatre vāruṇe kurvanbhiṣaksiddhimavāpnuyāt ॥12॥
html:
rājyabhāgī dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ prāpnuyānnāpadaṃ naraḥ ।
nakṣatre vāruṇe kurvanbhiṣaksiddhimavāpnuyāt ॥12॥
slp1: rAjyaBAgI DanizWAyAM prApnuyAnnApadaM naraH । nakzatre vAruRe kurvanBizaksidDimavApnuyAt ॥12॥

text: pūrvaproṣṭhapadāḥ kurvanbahu vindedajāvikam । uttarāsvatha kurvāṇo vindate gāḥ sahasraśaḥ ॥13॥
html:
pūrvaproṣṭhapadāḥ kurvanbahu vindedajāvikam ।
uttarāsvatha kurvāṇo vindate gāḥ sahasraśaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: pUrvaprozWapadAH kurvanbahu vindedajAvikam । uttarAsvaTa kurvARo vindate gAH sahasraSaH ॥13॥

text: bahurūpyakṛtaṃ vittaṃ vindate revatīṃ śritaḥ । aśvāṃścāśvayuje vetti bharaṇīṣvāyuruttamam ॥14॥
html:
bahurūpyakṛtaṃ vittaṃ vindate revatīṃ śritaḥ ।
aśvāṃścāśvayuje vetti bharaṇīṣvāyuruttamam ॥14॥
slp1: bahurUpyakftaM vittaM vindate revatIM SritaH । aSvAMScASvayuje vetti BaraRIzvAyuruttamam ॥14॥

text: imaṃ śrāddhavidhiṃ śrutvā śaśabindustathākarot । akleśenājayaccāpi mahīṃ so'nuśaśāsa ha] ॥15॥
html:
imaṃ śrāddhavidhiṃ śrutvā śaśabindustathākarot ।
akleśenājayaccāpi mahīṃ so'nuśaśāsa ha] ॥15॥
slp1: imaM SrAdDaviDiM SrutvA SaSabindustaTAkarot । akleSenAjayaccApi mahIM so'nuSaSAsa ha] ॥15॥

text: kīdṛśebhyaḥ pradātavyaṃ bhavecchrāddhaṃ pitāmaha । dvijebhyaḥ kuruśārdūla tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
html:
kīdṛśebhyaḥ pradātavyaṃ bhavecchrāddhaṃ pitāmaha ।
dvijebhyaḥ kuruśārdūla tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
slp1: kIdfSeByaH pradAtavyaM BavecCrAdDaM pitAmaha । dvijeByaH kuruSArdUla tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇānna parīkṣeta kṣatriyo dānadharmavit । daive karmaṇi pitrye tu nyāyyamāhuḥ parīkṣaṇam ॥2॥
html:
brāhmaṇānna parīkṣeta kṣatriyo dānadharmavit ।
daive karmaṇi pitrye tu nyāyyamāhuḥ parīkṣaṇam ॥2॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnna parIkzeta kzatriyo dAnaDarmavit । dEve karmaRi pitrye tu nyAyyamAhuH parIkzaRam ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: devatāḥ pūjayantīha daivenaiveha tejasā । upetya tasmāddevebhyaḥ sarvebhyo dāpayennaraḥ ॥3॥
html:
devatāḥ pūjayantīha daivenaiveha tejasā ।
upetya tasmāddevebhyaḥ sarvebhyo dāpayennaraḥ ॥3॥
slp1: devatAH pUjayantIha dEvenEveha tejasA । upetya tasmAddeveByaH sarveByo dApayennaraH ॥3॥

text: śrāddhe tvatha mahārāja parīkṣedbrāhmaṇānbudhaḥ । kulaśīlavayorūpairvidyayābhijanena ca ॥4॥
html:
śrāddhe tvatha mahārāja parīkṣedbrāhmaṇānbudhaḥ ।
kulaśīlavayorūpairvidyayābhijanena ca ॥4॥
