slp1: SrAdDe tvaTa mahArAja parIkzedbrAhmaRAnbuDaH । kulaSIlavayorUpErvidyayABijanena ca ॥4॥

text: eṣāmanye paṅktidūṣāstathānye paṅktipāvanāḥ । apāṅkteyāstu ye rājankīrtayiṣyāmi tāñśṛṇu ॥5॥
html:
eṣāmanye paṅktidūṣāstathānye paṅktipāvanāḥ ।
apāṅkteyāstu ye rājankīrtayiṣyāmi tāñśṛṇu ॥5॥
slp1: ezAmanye paNktidUzAstaTAnye paNktipAvanAH । apANkteyAstu ye rAjankIrtayizyAmi tAYSfRu ॥5॥

text: kitavo bhrūṇahā yakṣmī paśupālo nirākṛtiḥ । grāmapreṣyo vārdhuṣiko gāyanaḥ sarvavikrayī ॥6॥
html:
kitavo bhrūṇahā yakṣmī paśupālo nirākṛtiḥ ।
grāmapreṣyo vārdhuṣiko gāyanaḥ sarvavikrayī ॥6॥
slp1: kitavo BrURahA yakzmI paSupAlo nirAkftiH । grAmaprezyo vArDuziko gAyanaH sarvavikrayI ॥6॥

text: agāradāhī garadaḥ kuṇḍāśī somavikrayī । sāmudriko rājabhṛtyastailikaḥ kūṭakārakaḥ ॥7॥
html:
agāradāhī garadaḥ kuṇḍāśī somavikrayī ।
sāmudriko rājabhṛtyastailikaḥ kūṭakārakaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: agAradAhI garadaH kuRqASI somavikrayI । sAmudriko rAjaBftyastElikaH kUwakArakaH ॥7॥

text: pitrā vivadamānaśca yasya copapatirgṛhe । abhiśastastathā stenaḥ śilpaṃ yaścopajīvati ॥8॥
html:
pitrā vivadamānaśca yasya copapatirgṛhe ।
abhiśastastathā stenaḥ śilpaṃ yaścopajīvati ॥8॥
slp1: pitrA vivadamAnaSca yasya copapatirgfhe । aBiSastastaTA stenaH SilpaM yaScopajIvati ॥8॥

text: parvakāraśca sūcī ca mitradhrukpāradārikaḥ । avratānāmupādhyāyaḥ kāṇḍapṛṣṭhastathaiva ca ॥9॥
html:
parvakāraśca sūcī ca mitradhrukpāradārikaḥ ।
avratānāmupādhyāyaḥ kāṇḍapṛṣṭhastathaiva ca ॥9॥
slp1: parvakAraSca sUcI ca mitraDrukpAradArikaH । avratAnAmupADyAyaH kARqapfzWastaTEva ca ॥9॥

text: śvabhiryaśca parikrāmedyaḥ śunā daṣṭa eva ca । parivittiśca yaśca syādduścarmā gurutalpagaḥ । kuśīlavo devalako nakṣatrairyaśca jīvati ॥10॥
html:
śvabhiryaśca parikrāmedyaḥ śunā daṣṭa eva ca ।
parivittiśca yaśca syādduścarmā gurutalpagaḥ ।
kuśīlavo devalako nakṣatrairyaśca jīvati ॥10॥
slp1: SvaBiryaSca parikrAmedyaH SunA dazwa eva ca । parivittiSca yaSca syAdduScarmA gurutalpagaH । kuSIlavo devalako nakzatrEryaSca jIvati ॥10॥

text: etāniha vijānīyādapāṅkteyāndvijādhamān । śūdrāṇāmupadeśaṃ ca ye kurvantyalpacetasaḥ ॥11॥
html:
etāniha vijānīyādapāṅkteyāndvijādhamān ।
śūdrāṇāmupadeśaṃ ca ye kurvantyalpacetasaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: etAniha vijAnIyAdapANkteyAndvijADamAn । SUdrARAmupadeSaM ca ye kurvantyalpacetasaH ॥11॥

text: ṣaṣṭiṃ kāṇaḥ śataṃ ṣaṇḍhaḥ śvitrī yāvatprapaśyati । paṅktyāṃ samupaviṣṭāyāṃ tāvaddūṣayate nṛpa ॥12॥
html:
ṣaṣṭiṃ kāṇaḥ śataṃ ṣaṇḍhaḥ śvitrī yāvatprapaśyati ।
paṅktyāṃ samupaviṣṭāyāṃ tāvaddūṣayate nṛpa ॥12॥
slp1: zazwiM kARaH SataM zaRQaH SvitrI yAvatprapaSyati । paNktyAM samupavizwAyAM tAvaddUzayate nfpa ॥12॥

text: yadveṣṭitaśirā bhuṅkte yadbhuṅkte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ । sopānatkaśca yadbhuṅkte sarvaṃ vidyāttadāsuram ॥13॥
html:
yadveṣṭitaśirā bhuṅkte yadbhuṅkte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ।
sopānatkaśca yadbhuṅkte sarvaṃ vidyāttadāsuram ॥13॥
slp1: yadvezwitaSirA BuNkte yadBuNkte dakziRAmuKaH । sopAnatkaSca yadBuNkte sarvaM vidyAttadAsuram ॥13॥

text: asūyatā ca yaddattaṃ yacca śraddhāvivarjitam । sarvaṃ tadasurendrāya brahmā bhāgamakalpayat ॥14॥
html:
asūyatā ca yaddattaṃ yacca śraddhāvivarjitam ।
sarvaṃ tadasurendrāya brahmā bhāgamakalpayat ॥14॥
slp1: asUyatA ca yaddattaM yacca SradDAvivarjitam । sarvaM tadasurendrAya brahmA BAgamakalpayat ॥14॥

text: śvānaśca paṅktidūṣāśca nāvekṣerankathañcana । tasmātparivṛte dadyāttilāṃścānvavakīrayet ॥15॥
html:
śvānaśca paṅktidūṣāśca nāvekṣerankathañcana ।
tasmātparivṛte dadyāttilāṃścānvavakīrayet ॥15॥
slp1: SvAnaSca paNktidUzASca nAvekzerankaTaYcana । tasmAtparivfte dadyAttilAMScAnvavakIrayet ॥15॥

text: tilādāne ca kravyādā ye ca krodhavaśā gaṇāḥ । yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca vipralumpanti taddhaviḥ ॥16॥
html:
tilādāne ca kravyādā ye ca krodhavaśā gaṇāḥ ।
yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca vipralumpanti taddhaviḥ ॥16॥
slp1: tilAdAne ca kravyAdA ye ca kroDavaSA gaRAH । yAtuDAnAH piSAcASca vipralumpanti tadDaviH ॥16॥

text: yāvaddhyapaṅktyaḥ paṅktyāṃ vai bhuñjānānanupaśyati । tāvatphalādbhraṃśayati dātāraṃ tasya bāliśam ॥17॥
html:
yāvaddhyapaṅktyaḥ paṅktyāṃ vai bhuñjānānanupaśyati ।
tāvatphalādbhraṃśayati dātāraṃ tasya bāliśam ॥17॥
slp1: yAvadDyapaNktyaH paNktyAM vE BuYjAnAnanupaSyati । tAvatPalAdBraMSayati dAtAraM tasya bAliSam ॥17॥

text: ime tu bharataśreṣṭha vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ । ye tvatastānpravakṣyāmi parīkṣasveha tāndvijān ॥18॥
html:
ime tu bharataśreṣṭha vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ ।
ye tvatastānpravakṣyāmi parīkṣasveha tāndvijān ॥18॥
slp1: ime tu BarataSrezWa vijYeyAH paNktipAvanAH । ye tvatastAnpravakzyAmi parIkzasveha tAndvijAn ॥18॥

text: vedavidyāvratasnātā brāhmaṇāḥ sarva eva hi । pāṅkteyānyāṃstu vakṣyāmi jñeyāste paṅktipāvanāḥ ॥19॥
html:
vedavidyāvratasnātā brāhmaṇāḥ sarva eva hi ।
pāṅkteyānyāṃstu vakṣyāmi jñeyāste paṅktipāvanāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: vedavidyAvratasnAtA brAhmaRAH sarva eva hi । pANkteyAnyAMstu vakzyAmi jYeyAste paNktipAvanAH ॥19॥

text: triṇāciketaḥ pañcāgnistrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit । brahmadeyānusantānaśchandogo jyeṣṭhasāmagaḥ ॥20॥
html:
triṇāciketaḥ pañcāgnistrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit ।
brahmadeyānusantānaśchandogo jyeṣṭhasāmagaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: triRAciketaH paYcAgnistrisuparRaH zaqaNgavit । brahmadeyAnusantAnaSCandogo jyezWasAmagaH ॥20॥

text: mātāpitroryaśca vaśyaḥ śrotriyo daśapūruṣaḥ । ṛtukālābhigāmī ca dharmapatnīṣu yaḥ sadā । vedavidyāvratasnāto vipraḥ paṅktiṃ punātyuta ॥21॥
html:
mātāpitroryaśca vaśyaḥ śrotriyo daśapūruṣaḥ ।
ṛtukālābhigāmī ca dharmapatnīṣu yaḥ sadā ।
vedavidyāvratasnāto vipraḥ paṅktiṃ punātyuta ॥21॥
slp1: mAtApitroryaSca vaSyaH Srotriyo daSapUruzaH । ftukAlABigAmI ca DarmapatnIzu yaH sadA । vedavidyAvratasnAto vipraH paNktiM punAtyuta ॥21॥

text: atharvaśiraso'dhyetā brahmacārī yatavrataḥ । satyavādī dharmaśīlaḥ svakarmanirataśca yaḥ ॥22॥
html:
atharvaśiraso'dhyetā brahmacārī yatavrataḥ ।
satyavādī dharmaśīlaḥ svakarmanirataśca yaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: aTarvaSiraso'DyetA brahmacArI yatavrataH । satyavAdI DarmaSIlaH svakarmanirataSca yaH ॥22॥

text: ye ca puṇyeṣu tīrtheṣu abhiṣekakṛtaśramāḥ । makheṣu ca samantreṣu bhavantyavabhṛthāplutāḥ ॥23॥
html:
ye ca puṇyeṣu tīrtheṣu abhiṣekakṛtaśramāḥ ।
makheṣu ca samantreṣu bhavantyavabhṛthāplutāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: ye ca puRyezu tIrTezu aBizekakftaSramAH । maKezu ca samantrezu BavantyavaBfTAplutAH ॥23॥

text: akrodhanā acapalāḥ kṣāntā dāntā jitendriyāḥ । sarvabhūtahitā ye ca śrāddheṣvetānnimantrayet । eteṣu dattamakṣayyamete vai paṅktipāvanāḥ ॥24॥
html:
akrodhanā acapalāḥ kṣāntā dāntā jitendriyāḥ ।
sarvabhūtahitā ye ca śrāddheṣvetānnimantrayet ।
eteṣu dattamakṣayyamete vai paṅktipāvanāḥ ॥24॥
slp1: akroDanA acapalAH kzAntA dAntA jitendriyAH । sarvaBUtahitA ye ca SrAdDezvetAnnimantrayet । etezu dattamakzayyamete vE paNktipAvanAH ॥24॥

text: ime pare mahārāja vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ । yatayo mokṣadharmajñā yogāḥ sucaritavratāḥ ॥25॥
html:
ime pare mahārāja vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ ।
yatayo mokṣadharmajñā yogāḥ sucaritavratāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: ime pare mahArAja vijYeyAH paNktipAvanAH । yatayo mokzaDarmajYA yogAH sucaritavratAH ॥25॥

text: ye cetihāsaṃ prayatāḥ śrāvayanti dvijottamān । ye ca bhāṣyavidaḥ kecidye ca vyākaraṇe ratāḥ ॥26॥
html:
ye cetihāsaṃ prayatāḥ śrāvayanti dvijottamān ।
ye ca bhāṣyavidaḥ kecidye ca vyākaraṇe ratāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: ye cetihAsaM prayatAH SrAvayanti dvijottamAn । ye ca BAzyavidaH kecidye ca vyAkaraRe ratAH ॥26॥

text: adhīyate purāṇaṃ ye dharmaśāstrāṇyathāpi ca । adhītya ca yathānyāyaṃ vidhivattasya kāriṇaḥ ॥27॥
html:
adhīyate purāṇaṃ ye dharmaśāstrāṇyathāpi ca ।
adhītya ca yathānyāyaṃ vidhivattasya kāriṇaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: aDIyate purARaM ye DarmaSAstrARyaTApi ca । aDItya ca yaTAnyAyaM viDivattasya kAriRaH ॥27॥

text: upapanno gurukule satyavādī sahasradaḥ । agryaḥ sarveṣu vedeṣu sarvapravacaneṣu ca ॥28॥
html:
upapanno gurukule satyavādī sahasradaḥ ।
agryaḥ sarveṣu vedeṣu sarvapravacaneṣu ca ॥28॥
slp1: upapanno gurukule satyavAdI sahasradaH । agryaH sarvezu vedezu sarvapravacanezu ca ॥28॥

text: yāvadete prapaśyanti paṅktyāstāvatpunantyuta । tato hi pāvanātpaṅktyāḥ paṅktipāvana ucyate ॥29॥
html:
yāvadete prapaśyanti paṅktyāstāvatpunantyuta ।
tato hi pāvanātpaṅktyāḥ paṅktipāvana ucyate ॥29॥
slp1: yAvadete prapaSyanti paNktyAstAvatpunantyuta । tato hi pAvanAtpaNktyAH paNktipAvana ucyate ॥29॥

text: krośādardhatṛtīyāttu pāvayedeka eva hi । brahmadeyānusantāna iti brahmavido viduḥ ॥30॥
html:
krośādardhatṛtīyāttu pāvayedeka eva hi ।
brahmadeyānusantāna iti brahmavido viduḥ ॥30॥
slp1: kroSAdarDatftIyAttu pAvayedeka eva hi । brahmadeyAnusantAna iti brahmavido viduH ॥30॥

text: anṛtviganupādhyāyaḥ sa cedagrāsanaṃ vrajet । ṛtvigbhirananujñātaḥ paṅktyā harati duṣkṛtam ॥31॥
html:
anṛtviganupādhyāyaḥ sa cedagrāsanaṃ vrajet ।
ṛtvigbhirananujñātaḥ paṅktyā harati duṣkṛtam ॥31॥
slp1: anftviganupADyAyaH sa cedagrAsanaM vrajet । ftvigBirananujYAtaH paNktyA harati duzkftam ॥31॥

text: atha cedvedavitsarvaiḥ paṅktidoṣairvivarjitaḥ । na ca syātpatito rājanpaṅktipāvana eva saḥ ॥32॥
html:
atha cedvedavitsarvaiḥ paṅktidoṣairvivarjitaḥ ।
na ca syātpatito rājanpaṅktipāvana eva saḥ ॥32॥
slp1: aTa cedvedavitsarvEH paNktidozErvivarjitaH । na ca syAtpatito rAjanpaNktipAvana eva saH ॥32॥

text: tasmātsarvaprayatnena parīkṣyāmantrayeddvijān । svakarmaniratāndāntānkule jātānbahuśrutān ॥33॥
html:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena parīkṣyāmantrayeddvijān ।
svakarmaniratāndāntānkule jātānbahuśrutān ॥33॥
slp1: tasmAtsarvaprayatnena parIkzyAmantrayeddvijAn । svakarmaniratAndAntAnkule jAtAnbahuSrutAn ॥33॥

text: yasya mitrapradhānāni śrāddhāni ca havīṃṣi ca । na prīṇāti pitṝndevānsvargaṃ ca na sa gacchati ॥34॥
html:
yasya mitrapradhānāni śrāddhāni ca havīṃṣi ca ।
na prīṇāti pitṝndevānsvargaṃ ca na sa gacchati ॥34॥
slp1: yasya mitrapraDAnAni SrAdDAni ca havIMzi ca । na prIRAti pitFndevAnsvargaM ca na sa gacCati ॥34॥

text: yaśca śrāddhe kurute saṅgatāni na devayānena pathā sa yāti । sa vai muktaḥ pippalaṃ bandhanādvā svargāllokāccyavate śrāddhamitraḥ ॥35॥
html:
yaśca śrāddhe kurute saṅgatāni na devayānena pathā sa yāti ।
sa vai muktaḥ pippalaṃ bandhanādvā svargāllokāccyavate śrāddhamitraḥ ॥35॥
slp1: yaSca SrAdDe kurute saNgatAni na devayAnena paTA sa yAti । sa vE muktaH pippalaM banDanAdvA svargAllokAccyavate SrAdDamitraH ॥35॥

text: tasmānmitraṃ śrāddhakṛnnādriyeta dadyānmitrebhyaḥ saṅgrahārthaṃ dhanāni । yaṃ manyate naiva śatruṃ na mitraṃ taṃ madhyasthaṃ bhojayeddhavyakavye ॥36॥
html:
tasmānmitraṃ śrāddhakṛnnādriyeta dadyānmitrebhyaḥ saṅgrahārthaṃ dhanāni ।
yaṃ manyate naiva śatruṃ na mitraṃ taṃ madhyasthaṃ bhojayeddhavyakavye ॥36॥
slp1: tasmAnmitraM SrAdDakfnnAdriyeta dadyAnmitreByaH saNgrahArTaM DanAni । yaM manyate nEva SatruM na mitraM taM maDyasTaM BojayedDavyakavye ॥36॥

text: yathoṣare bījamuptaṃ na rohenna cāsyoptā prāpnuyādbījabhāgam । evaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhuktamanarhamāṇairna ceha nāmutra phalaṃ dadāti ॥37॥
html:
yathoṣare bījamuptaṃ na rohenna cāsyoptā prāpnuyādbījabhāgam ।
evaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhuktamanarhamāṇairna ceha nāmutra phalaṃ dadāti ॥37॥
slp1: yaTozare bIjamuptaM na rohenna cAsyoptA prApnuyAdbIjaBAgam । evaM SrAdDaM BuktamanarhamARErna ceha nAmutra PalaM dadAti ॥37॥

text: brāhmaṇo hyanadhīyānastṛṇāgniriva śāmyati । tasmai śrāddhaṃ na dātavyaṃ na hi bhasmani hūyate ॥38॥
html:
brāhmaṇo hyanadhīyānastṛṇāgniriva śāmyati ।
tasmai śrāddhaṃ na dātavyaṃ na hi bhasmani hūyate ॥38॥
slp1: brAhmaRo hyanaDIyAnastfRAgniriva SAmyati । tasmE SrAdDaM na dAtavyaM na hi Basmani hUyate ॥38॥

text: sambhojanī nāma piśācadakṣiṇā sā naiva devānna pitṝnupaiti । ihaiva sā bhrāmyati kṣīṇapuṇyā śālāntare gauriva naṣṭavatsā ॥39॥
html:
sambhojanī nāma piśācadakṣiṇā sā naiva devānna pitṝnupaiti ।
ihaiva sā bhrāmyati kṣīṇapuṇyā śālāntare gauriva naṣṭavatsā ॥39॥
slp1: samBojanI nAma piSAcadakziRA sA nEva devAnna pitFnupEti । ihEva sA BrAmyati kzIRapuRyA SAlAntare gOriva nazwavatsA ॥39॥

text: yathāgnau śānte ghṛtamājuhoti tannaiva devānna pitṝnupaiti । tathā dattaṃ nartane gāyane ca yāṃ cānṛce dakṣiṇāmāvṛṇoti ॥40॥
html:
yathāgnau śānte ghṛtamājuhoti tannaiva devānna pitṝnupaiti ।
tathā dattaṃ nartane gāyane ca yāṃ cānṛce dakṣiṇāmāvṛṇoti ॥40॥
slp1: yaTAgnO SAnte GftamAjuhoti tannEva devAnna pitFnupEti । taTA dattaM nartane gAyane ca yAM cAnfce dakziRAmAvfRoti ॥40॥

text: ubhau hinasti na bhunakti caiṣā yā cānṛce dakṣiṇā dīyate vai । āghātanī garhitaiṣā patantī teṣāṃ pretānpātayeddevayānāt ॥41॥
html:
ubhau hinasti na bhunakti caiṣā yā cānṛce dakṣiṇā dīyate vai ।
āghātanī garhitaiṣā patantī teṣāṃ pretānpātayeddevayānāt ॥41॥
slp1: uBO hinasti na Bunakti cEzA yA cAnfce dakziRA dIyate vE । AGAtanI garhitEzA patantI tezAM pretAnpAtayeddevayAnAt ॥41॥

text: ṛṣīṇāṃ samayaṃ nityaṃ ye caranti yudhiṣṭhira । niścitāḥ sarvadharmajñāstāndevā brāhmaṇānviduḥ ॥42॥
html:
ṛṣīṇāṃ samayaṃ nityaṃ ye caranti yudhiṣṭhira ।
niścitāḥ sarvadharmajñāstāndevā brāhmaṇānviduḥ ॥42॥
slp1: fzIRAM samayaM nityaM ye caranti yuDizWira । niScitAH sarvaDarmajYAstAndevA brAhmaRAnviduH ॥42॥

text: svādhyāyaniṣṭhā ṛṣayo jñānaniṣṭhāstathaiva ca । taponiṣṭhāśca boddhavyāḥ karmaniṣṭhāśca bhārata ॥43॥
html:
svādhyāyaniṣṭhā ṛṣayo jñānaniṣṭhāstathaiva ca ।
taponiṣṭhāśca boddhavyāḥ karmaniṣṭhāśca bhārata ॥43॥
slp1: svADyAyanizWA fzayo jYAnanizWAstaTEva ca । taponizWASca bodDavyAH karmanizWASca BArata ॥43॥

text: kavyāni jñānaniṣṭhebhyaḥ pratiṣṭhāpyāni bhārata । tatra ye brāhmaṇāḥ kecinna nindati hi te varāḥ ॥44॥
html:
kavyāni jñānaniṣṭhebhyaḥ pratiṣṭhāpyāni bhārata ।
tatra ye brāhmaṇāḥ kecinna nindati hi te varāḥ ॥44॥
slp1: kavyAni jYAnanizWeByaH pratizWApyAni BArata । tatra ye brAhmaRAH kecinna nindati hi te varAH ॥44॥

text: ye tu nindanti jalpeṣu na tāñśrāddheṣu bhojayet । brāhmaṇā ninditā rājanhanyustripuruṣaṃ kulam ॥45॥
html:
ye tu nindanti jalpeṣu na tāñśrāddheṣu bhojayet ।
brāhmaṇā ninditā rājanhanyustripuruṣaṃ kulam ॥45॥
slp1: ye tu nindanti jalpezu na tAYSrAdDezu Bojayet । brAhmaRA ninditA rAjanhanyustripuruzaM kulam ॥45॥

text: vaikhānasānāṃ vacanamṛṣīṇāṃ śrūyate nṛpa । dūrādeva parīkṣeta brāhmaṇānvedapāragān । priyānvā yadi vā dveṣyāṃsteṣu tacchrāddhamāvapet ॥46॥
html:
vaikhānasānāṃ vacanamṛṣīṇāṃ śrūyate nṛpa ।
dūrādeva parīkṣeta brāhmaṇānvedapāragān ।
priyānvā yadi vā dveṣyāṃsteṣu tacchrāddhamāvapet ॥46॥
slp1: vEKAnasAnAM vacanamfzIRAM SrUyate nfpa । dUrAdeva parIkzeta brAhmaRAnvedapAragAn । priyAnvA yadi vA dvezyAMstezu tacCrAdDamAvapet ॥46॥

text: yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ bhojayedanṛcāṃ naraḥ । ekastānmantravitprītaḥ sarvānarhati bhārata] ॥47॥
html:
yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇāṃ bhojayedanṛcāṃ naraḥ ।
ekastānmantravitprītaḥ sarvānarhati bhārata] ॥47॥
slp1: yaH sahasraM sahasrARAM BojayedanfcAM naraH । ekastAnmantravitprItaH sarvAnarhati BArata] ॥47॥

text: kena saṅkalpitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kasminkāle kimātmakam । bhṛgvaṅgirasake kāle muninā katareṇa vā ॥1॥
html:
kena saṅkalpitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kasminkāle kimātmakam ।
bhṛgvaṅgirasake kāle muninā katareṇa vā ॥1॥
slp1: kena saNkalpitaM SrAdDaM kasminkAle kimAtmakam । BfgvaNgirasake kAle muninA katareRa vA ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kāni śrāddheṣu varjyāni tathā mūlaphalāni ca । dhānyajātiśca kā varjyā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
kāni śrāddheṣu varjyāni tathā mūlaphalāni ca ।
dhānyajātiśca kā varjyā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: kAni SrAdDezu varjyAni taTA mUlaPalAni ca । DAnyajAtiSca kA varjyA tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: yathā śrāddhaṃ sampravṛttaṃ yasminkāle yadātmakam । yena saṅkalpitaṃ caiva tanme śṛṇu janādhipa ॥3॥
html:
yathā śrāddhaṃ sampravṛttaṃ yasminkāle yadātmakam ।
yena saṅkalpitaṃ caiva tanme śṛṇu janādhipa ॥3॥
slp1: yaTA SrAdDaM sampravfttaM yasminkAle yadAtmakam । yena saNkalpitaM cEva tanme SfRu janADipa ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: svāyambhuvo'triḥ kauravya paramarṣiḥ pratāpavān । tasya vaṃśe mahārāja dattātreya iti smṛtaḥ ॥4॥
html:
svāyambhuvo'triḥ kauravya paramarṣiḥ pratāpavān ।
tasya vaṃśe mahārāja dattātreya iti smṛtaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: svAyamBuvo'triH kOravya paramarziH pratApavAn । tasya vaMSe mahArAja dattAtreya iti smftaH ॥4॥

text: dattātreyasya putro'bhūnnimirnāma tapodhanaḥ । nimeścāpyabhavatputraḥ śrīmānnāma śriyā vṛtaḥ ॥5॥
html:
dattātreyasya putro'bhūnnimirnāma tapodhanaḥ ।
nimeścāpyabhavatputraḥ śrīmānnāma śriyā vṛtaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: dattAtreyasya putro'BUnnimirnAma tapoDanaH । nimeScApyaBavatputraH SrImAnnAma SriyA vftaH ॥5॥

text: pūrṇe varṣasahasrānte sa kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ । kāladharmaparītātmā nidhanaṃ samupāgataḥ ॥6॥
html:
pūrṇe varṣasahasrānte sa kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ।
kāladharmaparītātmā nidhanaṃ samupāgataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: pUrRe varzasahasrAnte sa kftvA duzkaraM tapaH । kAlaDarmaparItAtmA niDanaM samupAgataH ॥6॥

text: nimistu kṛtvā śaucāni vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā । santāpamagamattīvraṃ putraśokaparāyaṇaḥ ॥7॥
html:
nimistu kṛtvā śaucāni vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ।
santāpamagamattīvraṃ putraśokaparāyaṇaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: nimistu kftvA SOcAni viDidfzwena karmaRA । santApamagamattIvraM putraSokaparAyaRaH ॥7॥

text: atha kṛtvopahāryāṇi caturdaśyāṃ mahāmatiḥ । tameva gaṇayañśokaṃ virātre pratyabudhyata ॥8॥
html:
atha kṛtvopahāryāṇi caturdaśyāṃ mahāmatiḥ ।
tameva gaṇayañśokaṃ virātre pratyabudhyata ॥8॥
slp1: aTa kftvopahAryARi caturdaSyAM mahAmatiH । tameva gaRayaYSokaM virAtre pratyabuDyata ॥8॥

text: tasyāsītpratibuddhasya śokena pihitātmanaḥ । manaḥ saṃhṛtya viṣaye buddhirvistaragāminī ॥9॥
html:
tasyāsītpratibuddhasya śokena pihitātmanaḥ ।
manaḥ saṃhṛtya viṣaye buddhirvistaragāminī ॥9॥
slp1: tasyAsItpratibudDasya Sokena pihitAtmanaH । manaH saMhftya vizaye budDirvistaragAminI ॥9॥

text: tataḥ sañcintayāmāsa śrāddhakalpaṃ samāhitaḥ । yāni tasyaiva bhojyāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥10॥
html:
tataḥ sañcintayāmāsa śrāddhakalpaṃ samāhitaḥ ।
yāni tasyaiva bhojyāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥10॥
slp1: tataH saYcintayAmAsa SrAdDakalpaM samAhitaH । yAni tasyEva BojyAni mUlAni ca PalAni ca ॥10॥

text: uktāni yāni cānyāni yāni ceṣṭāni tasya ha । tāni sarvāṇi manasā viniścitya tapodhanaḥ ॥11॥
html:
uktāni yāni cānyāni yāni ceṣṭāni tasya ha ।
tāni sarvāṇi manasā viniścitya tapodhanaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: uktAni yAni cAnyAni yAni cezwAni tasya ha । tAni sarvARi manasA viniScitya tapoDanaH ॥11॥

text: amāvāsyāṃ mahāprājña viprānānāyya pūjitān । dakṣiṇāvartikāḥ sarvā bṛsīḥ svayamathākarot ॥12॥
html:
amāvāsyāṃ mahāprājña viprānānāyya pūjitān ।
dakṣiṇāvartikāḥ sarvā bṛsīḥ svayamathākarot ॥12॥
slp1: amAvAsyAM mahAprAjYa viprAnAnAyya pUjitAn । dakziRAvartikAH sarvA bfsIH svayamaTAkarot ॥12॥

text: sapta viprāṃstato bhojye yugapatsamupānayat । ṛte ca lavaṇaṃ bhojyaṃ śyāmākānnaṃ dadau prabhuḥ ॥13॥
html:
sapta viprāṃstato bhojye yugapatsamupānayat ।
ṛte ca lavaṇaṃ bhojyaṃ śyāmākānnaṃ dadau prabhuḥ ॥13॥
slp1: sapta viprAMstato Bojye yugapatsamupAnayat । fte ca lavaRaM BojyaM SyAmAkAnnaM dadO praBuH ॥13॥

text: dakṣiṇāgrāstato darbhā viṣṭareṣu niveśitāḥ । pādayoścaiva viprāṇāṃ ye tvannamupabhuñjate ॥14॥
html:
dakṣiṇāgrāstato darbhā viṣṭareṣu niveśitāḥ ।
pādayoścaiva viprāṇāṃ ye tvannamupabhuñjate ॥14॥
slp1: dakziRAgrAstato darBA vizwarezu niveSitAH । pAdayoScEva viprARAM ye tvannamupaBuYjate ॥14॥

text: kṛtvā ca dakṣiṇāgrānvai darbhānsuprayataḥ śuciḥ । pradadau śrīmate piṇḍaṃ nāmagotramudāharan ॥15॥
html:
kṛtvā ca dakṣiṇāgrānvai darbhānsuprayataḥ śuciḥ ।
pradadau śrīmate piṇḍaṃ nāmagotramudāharan ॥15॥
slp1: kftvA ca dakziRAgrAnvE darBAnsuprayataH SuciH । pradadO SrImate piRqaM nAmagotramudAharan ॥15॥

text: tatkṛtvā sa muniśreṣṭho dharmasaṅkaramātmanaḥ । paścāttāpena mahatā tapyamāno'bhyacintayat ॥16॥
html:
tatkṛtvā sa muniśreṣṭho dharmasaṅkaramātmanaḥ ।
paścāttāpena mahatā tapyamāno'bhyacintayat ॥16॥
slp1: tatkftvA sa muniSrezWo DarmasaNkaramAtmanaH । paScAttApena mahatA tapyamAno'Byacintayat ॥16॥

text: akṛtaṃ munibhiḥ pūrvaṃ kiṃ mayaitadanuṣṭhitam । kathaṃ nu śāpena na māṃ daheyurbrāhmaṇā iti ॥17॥
html:
akṛtaṃ munibhiḥ pūrvaṃ kiṃ mayaitadanuṣṭhitam ।
kathaṃ nu śāpena na māṃ daheyurbrāhmaṇā iti ॥17॥
slp1: akftaM muniBiH pUrvaM kiM mayEtadanuzWitam । kaTaM nu SApena na mAM daheyurbrAhmaRA iti ॥17॥

text: tataḥ sañcintayāmāsa vaṃśakartāramātmanaḥ । dhyātamātrastathā cātrirājagāma tapodhanaḥ ॥18॥
html:
tataḥ sañcintayāmāsa vaṃśakartāramātmanaḥ ।
dhyātamātrastathā cātrirājagāma tapodhanaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tataH saYcintayAmAsa vaMSakartAramAtmanaH । DyAtamAtrastaTA cAtrirAjagAma tapoDanaH ॥18॥

text: athātristaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā putraśokena karśitam । bhṛśamāśvāsayāmāsa vāgbhiriṣṭābhiravyayaḥ ॥19॥
html:
athātristaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā putraśokena karśitam ।
bhṛśamāśvāsayāmāsa vāgbhiriṣṭābhiravyayaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: aTAtristaM taTA dfzwvA putraSokena karSitam । BfSamASvAsayAmAsa vAgBirizwABiravyayaH ॥19॥

text: nime saṅkalpitaste'yaṃ pitṛyajñastapodhanaḥ । mā te bhūdbhīḥ pūrvadṛṣṭo dharmo'yaṃ brahmaṇā svayam ॥20॥
html:
nime saṅkalpitaste'yaṃ pitṛyajñastapodhanaḥ ।
mā te bhūdbhīḥ pūrvadṛṣṭo dharmo'yaṃ brahmaṇā svayam ॥20॥
slp1: nime saNkalpitaste'yaM pitfyajYastapoDanaH । mA te BUdBIH pUrvadfzwo Darmo'yaM brahmaRA svayam ॥20॥

text: so'yaṃ svayambhuvihito dharmaḥ saṅkalpitastvayā । ṛte svayambhuvaḥ ko'nyaḥ śrāddheyaṃ vidhimāharet ॥21॥
html:
so'yaṃ svayambhuvihito dharmaḥ saṅkalpitastvayā ।
ṛte svayambhuvaḥ ko'nyaḥ śrāddheyaṃ vidhimāharet ॥21॥
slp1: so'yaM svayamBuvihito DarmaH saNkalpitastvayA । fte svayamBuvaH ko'nyaH SrAdDeyaM viDimAharet ॥21॥

text: ākhyāsyāmi ca te bhūyaḥ śrāddheyaṃ vidhimuttamam । svayambhuvihitaṃ putra tatkuruṣva nibodha me ॥22॥
html:
ākhyāsyāmi ca te bhūyaḥ śrāddheyaṃ vidhimuttamam ।
svayambhuvihitaṃ putra tatkuruṣva nibodha me ॥22॥
slp1: AKyAsyAmi ca te BUyaH SrAdDeyaM viDimuttamam । svayamBuvihitaM putra tatkuruzva niboDa me ॥22॥

text: kṛtvāgnikaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ mantrapūrvaṃ tapodhana । tato'ryamṇe ca somāya varuṇāya ca nityaśaḥ ॥23॥
html:
kṛtvāgnikaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ mantrapūrvaṃ tapodhana ।
tato'ryamṇe ca somāya varuṇāya ca nityaśaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: kftvAgnikaraRaM pUrvaM mantrapUrvaM tapoDana । tato'ryamRe ca somAya varuRAya ca nityaSaH ॥23॥

text: viśvedevāśca ye nityaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha gocarāḥ । tebhyaḥ saṅkalpitā bhāgāḥ svayameva svayambhuvā ॥24॥
html:
viśvedevāśca ye nityaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha gocarāḥ ।
tebhyaḥ saṅkalpitā bhāgāḥ svayameva svayambhuvā ॥24॥
slp1: viSvedevASca ye nityaM pitfBiH saha gocarAH । teByaH saNkalpitA BAgAH svayameva svayamBuvA ॥24॥

text: stotavyā ceha pṛthivī nivāpasyeha dhāriṇī । vaiṣṇavī kāśyapī ceti tathaivehākṣayeti ca ॥25॥
html:
stotavyā ceha pṛthivī nivāpasyeha dhāriṇī ।
vaiṣṇavī kāśyapī ceti tathaivehākṣayeti ca ॥25॥
slp1: stotavyA ceha pfTivI nivApasyeha DAriRI । vEzRavI kASyapI ceti taTEvehAkzayeti ca ॥25॥

text: udakānayane caiva stotavyo varuṇo vibhuḥ । tato'gniścaiva somaśca āpyāyyāviha te'nagha ॥26॥
html:
udakānayane caiva stotavyo varuṇo vibhuḥ ।
tato'gniścaiva somaśca āpyāyyāviha te'nagha ॥26॥
slp1: udakAnayane cEva stotavyo varuRo viBuH । tato'gniScEva somaSca ApyAyyAviha te'naGa ॥26॥

text: devāstu pitaro nāma nirmitā vai svayambhuvā । ūṣmapāḥ sumahābhāgāsteṣāṃ bhāgāḥ prakalpitāḥ ॥27॥
html:
devāstu pitaro nāma nirmitā vai svayambhuvā ।
ūṣmapāḥ sumahābhāgāsteṣāṃ bhāgāḥ prakalpitāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: devAstu pitaro nAma nirmitA vE svayamBuvA । UzmapAH sumahABAgAstezAM BAgAH prakalpitAH ॥27॥

text: te śrāddhenārcyamānā vai vimucyante ha kilbiṣāt । saptakaḥ pitṛvaṃśastu pūrvadṛṣṭaḥ svayambhuvā ॥28॥
html:
te śrāddhenārcyamānā vai vimucyante ha kilbiṣāt ।
saptakaḥ pitṛvaṃśastu pūrvadṛṣṭaḥ svayambhuvā ॥28॥
slp1: te SrAdDenArcyamAnA vE vimucyante ha kilbizAt । saptakaH pitfvaMSastu pUrvadfzwaH svayamBuvA ॥28॥

text: viśve cāgnimukhā devāḥ saṅkhyātāḥ pūrvameva te । teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi bhāgārhāṇāṃ mahātmanām ॥29॥
html:
viśve cāgnimukhā devāḥ saṅkhyātāḥ pūrvameva te ।
teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi bhāgārhāṇāṃ mahātmanām ॥29॥
slp1: viSve cAgnimuKA devAH saNKyAtAH pUrvameva te । tezAM nAmAni vakzyAmi BAgArhARAM mahAtmanAm ॥29॥

text: sahaḥ kṛtirvipāpmā ca puṇyakṛtpāvanastathā । grāmniḥ kṣemaḥ samūhaśca divyasānustathaiva ca ॥30॥
html:
sahaḥ kṛtirvipāpmā ca puṇyakṛtpāvanastathā ।
grāmniḥ kṣemaḥ samūhaśca divyasānustathaiva ca ॥30॥
slp1: sahaH kftirvipApmA ca puRyakftpAvanastaTA । grAmniH kzemaH samUhaSca divyasAnustaTEva ca ॥30॥

text: vivasvānvīryavānhrīmānkīrtimānkṛta eva ca । vipūrvaḥ somapūrvaśca sūryaśrīśceti nāmataḥ ॥31॥
html:
vivasvānvīryavānhrīmānkīrtimānkṛta eva ca ।
vipūrvaḥ somapūrvaśca sūryaśrīśceti nāmataḥ ॥31॥
slp1: vivasvAnvIryavAnhrImAnkIrtimAnkfta eva ca । vipUrvaH somapUrvaSca sUryaSrISceti nAmataH ॥31॥

text: somapaḥ sūryasāvitro dattātmā puṣkarīyakaḥ । uṣṇīnābho nabhodaśca viśvāyurdīptireva ca ॥32॥
html:
somapaḥ sūryasāvitro dattātmā puṣkarīyakaḥ ।
uṣṇīnābho nabhodaśca viśvāyurdīptireva ca ॥32॥
slp1: somapaH sUryasAvitro dattAtmA puzkarIyakaH । uzRInABo naBodaSca viSvAyurdIptireva ca ॥32॥

text: camūharaḥ suveṣaśca vyomāriḥ śaṅkaro bhavaḥ । īśaḥ kartā kṛtirdakṣo bhuvano divyakarmakṛt ॥33॥
html:
camūharaḥ suveṣaśca vyomāriḥ śaṅkaro bhavaḥ ।
īśaḥ kartā kṛtirdakṣo bhuvano divyakarmakṛt ॥33॥
slp1: camUharaH suvezaSca vyomAriH SaNkaro BavaH । ISaH kartA kftirdakzo Buvano divyakarmakft ॥33॥

text: gaṇitaḥ pañcavīryaśca ādityo raśmimāṃstathā । saptakṛtsomavarcāśca viśvakṛtkavireva ca ॥34॥
html:
gaṇitaḥ pañcavīryaśca ādityo raśmimāṃstathā ।
saptakṛtsomavarcāśca viśvakṛtkavireva ca ॥34॥
slp1: gaRitaH paYcavIryaSca Adityo raSmimAMstaTA । saptakftsomavarcASca viSvakftkavireva ca ॥34॥

text: anugoptā sugoptā ca naptā ceśvara eva ca । jitātmā munivīryaśca dīptalomā bhayaṅkaraḥ ॥35॥
html:
anugoptā sugoptā ca naptā ceśvara eva ca ।
jitātmā munivīryaśca dīptalomā bhayaṅkaraḥ ॥35॥
slp1: anugoptA sugoptA ca naptA ceSvara eva ca । jitAtmA munivIryaSca dIptalomA BayaNkaraH ॥35॥

text: atikarmā pratītaśca pradātā cāṃśumāṃstathā । śailābhaḥ paramakrodhī dhīroṣṇī bhūpatistathā ॥36॥
html:
atikarmā pratītaśca pradātā cāṃśumāṃstathā ।
śailābhaḥ paramakrodhī dhīroṣṇī bhūpatistathā ॥36॥
slp1: atikarmA pratItaSca pradAtA cAMSumAMstaTA । SElABaH paramakroDI DIrozRI BUpatistaTA ॥36॥

text: srajī vajrī varī caiva viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ । kīrtitāste mahābhāgāḥ kālasya gatigocarāḥ ॥37॥
html:
srajī vajrī varī caiva viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ ।
kīrtitāste mahābhāgāḥ kālasya gatigocarāḥ ॥37॥
slp1: srajI vajrI varI cEva viSvedevAH sanAtanAH । kIrtitAste mahABAgAH kAlasya gatigocarAH ॥37॥

text: aśrāddheyāni dhānyāni kodravāḥ pulakāstathā । hiṅgu dravyeṣu śākeṣu palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ tathā ॥38॥
html:
aśrāddheyāni dhānyāni kodravāḥ pulakāstathā ।
hiṅgu dravyeṣu śākeṣu palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ tathā ॥38॥
slp1: aSrAdDeyAni DAnyAni kodravAH pulakAstaTA । hiNgu dravyezu SAkezu palARquM laSunaM taTA ॥38॥

text: palāṇḍuḥ saubhañjanakastathā gṛñjanakādayaḥ । kūṣmāṇḍajātyalābuṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ lavaṇameva ca ॥39॥
html:
palāṇḍuḥ saubhañjanakastathā gṛñjanakādayaḥ ।
kūṣmāṇḍajātyalābuṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ lavaṇameva ca ॥39॥
slp1: palARquH sOBaYjanakastaTA gfYjanakAdayaH । kUzmARqajAtyalAbuM ca kfzRaM lavaRameva ca ॥39॥

text: grāmyaṃ vārāhamāṃsaṃ ca yaccaivāprokṣitaṃ bhavet । kṛṣṇājājī viḍaścaiva śītapākī tathaiva ca । aṅkurādyāstathā varjyā iha śṛṅgāṭakāni ca ॥40॥
html:
grāmyaṃ vārāhamāṃsaṃ ca yaccaivāprokṣitaṃ bhavet ।
kṛṣṇājājī viḍaścaiva śītapākī tathaiva ca ।
aṅkurādyāstathā varjyā iha śṛṅgāṭakāni ca ॥40॥
slp1: grAmyaM vArAhamAMsaM ca yaccEvAprokzitaM Bavet । kfzRAjAjI viqaScEva SItapAkI taTEva ca । aNkurAdyAstaTA varjyA iha SfNgAwakAni ca ॥40॥

text: varjayellavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ tathā jambūphalāni ca । avakṣutāvaruditaṃ tathā śrāddheṣu varjayet ॥41॥
html:
varjayellavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ tathā jambūphalāni ca ।
avakṣutāvaruditaṃ tathā śrāddheṣu varjayet ॥41॥
slp1: varjayellavaRaM sarvaM taTA jambUPalAni ca । avakzutAvaruditaM taTA SrAdDezu varjayet ॥41॥

text: nivāpe havyakavye vā garhitaṃ ca śvadarśanam । pitaraścaiva devāśca nābhinandanti taddhaviḥ ॥42॥
html:
nivāpe havyakavye vā garhitaṃ ca śvadarśanam ।
pitaraścaiva devāśca nābhinandanti taddhaviḥ ॥42॥
slp1: nivApe havyakavye vA garhitaM ca SvadarSanam । pitaraScEva devASca nABinandanti tadDaviH ॥42॥

text: caṇḍālaśvapacau varjyau nivāpe samupasthite । kāṣāyavāsī kuṣṭhī vā patito brahmahāpi vā ॥43॥
html:
caṇḍālaśvapacau varjyau nivāpe samupasthite ।
kāṣāyavāsī kuṣṭhī vā patito brahmahāpi vā ॥43॥
slp1: caRqAlaSvapacO varjyO nivApe samupasTite । kAzAyavAsI kuzWI vA patito brahmahApi vA ॥43॥

text: saṅkīrṇayonirvipraśca sambandhī patitaśca yaḥ । varjanīyā budhairete nivāpe samupasthite ॥44॥
html:
saṅkīrṇayonirvipraśca sambandhī patitaśca yaḥ ।
varjanīyā budhairete nivāpe samupasthite ॥44॥
slp1: saNkIrRayonirvipraSca sambanDI patitaSca yaH । varjanIyA buDErete nivApe samupasTite ॥44॥

text: ityevamuktvā bhagavānsvavaṃśajamṛṣiṃ purā । pitāmahasabhāṃ divyāṃ jagāmātristapodhanaḥ] ॥45॥
html:
ityevamuktvā bhagavānsvavaṃśajamṛṣiṃ purā ।
pitāmahasabhāṃ divyāṃ jagāmātristapodhanaḥ] ॥45॥
slp1: ityevamuktvA BagavAnsvavaMSajamfziM purA । pitAmahasaBAM divyAM jagAmAtristapoDanaH] ॥45॥

text: tathā vidhau pravṛtte tu sarva eva maharṣayaḥ । pitṛyajñānakurvanta vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥1॥
html:
tathā vidhau pravṛtte tu sarva eva maharṣayaḥ ।
pitṛyajñānakurvanta vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥1॥
slp1: taTA viDO pravftte tu sarva eva maharzayaH । pitfyajYAnakurvanta viDidfzwena karmaRA ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ṛṣayo dharmanityāstu kṛtvā nivapanānyuta । tarpaṇaṃ cāpyakurvanta tīrthāmbhobhiryatavratāḥ ॥2॥
html:
ṛṣayo dharmanityāstu kṛtvā nivapanānyuta ।
tarpaṇaṃ cāpyakurvanta tīrthāmbhobhiryatavratāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: fzayo DarmanityAstu kftvA nivapanAnyuta । tarpaRaM cApyakurvanta tIrTAmBoBiryatavratAH ॥2॥

text: nivāpairdīyamānaiśca cāturvarṇyena bhārata । tarpitāḥ pitaro devāste nānnaṃ jarayanti vai ॥3॥
html:
nivāpairdīyamānaiśca cāturvarṇyena bhārata ।
tarpitāḥ pitaro devāste nānnaṃ jarayanti vai ॥3॥
slp1: nivApErdIyamAnESca cAturvarRyena BArata । tarpitAH pitaro devAste nAnnaM jarayanti vE ॥3॥

text: ajīrṇenābhihanyante te devāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha । somamevābhyapadyanta nivāpānnābhipīḍitāḥ ॥4॥
html:
ajīrṇenābhihanyante te devāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha ।
somamevābhyapadyanta nivāpānnābhipīḍitāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: ajIrRenABihanyante te devAH pitfBiH saha । somamevAByapadyanta nivApAnnABipIqitAH ॥4॥

text: te'bruvansomamāsādya pitaro'jīrṇapīḍitāḥ । nivāpānnena pīḍyāmaḥ śreyo no'tra vidhīyatām ॥5॥
html:
te'bruvansomamāsādya pitaro'jīrṇapīḍitāḥ ।
nivāpānnena pīḍyāmaḥ śreyo no'tra vidhīyatām ॥5॥
slp1: te'bruvansomamAsAdya pitaro'jIrRapIqitAH । nivApAnnena pIqyAmaH Sreyo no'tra viDIyatAm ॥5॥

text: tānsomaḥ pratyuvācātha śreyaścedīpsitaṃ surāḥ । svayambhūsadanaṃ yāta sa vaḥ śreyo vidhāsyati ॥6॥
html:
tānsomaḥ pratyuvācātha śreyaścedīpsitaṃ surāḥ ।
svayambhūsadanaṃ yāta sa vaḥ śreyo vidhāsyati ॥6॥
slp1: tAnsomaH pratyuvAcATa SreyaScedIpsitaM surAH । svayamBUsadanaM yAta sa vaH Sreyo viDAsyati ॥6॥

text: te somavacanāddevāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha bhārata । meruśṛṅge samāsīnaṃ pitāmahamupāgaman ॥7॥
html:
te somavacanāddevāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha bhārata ।
meruśṛṅge samāsīnaṃ pitāmahamupāgaman ॥7॥
slp1: te somavacanAddevAH pitfBiH saha BArata । meruSfNge samAsInaM pitAmahamupAgaman ॥7॥

text: nivāpānnena bhagavanbhṛśaṃ pīḍyāmahe vayam । prasādaṃ kuru no deva śreyo naḥ saṃvidhīyatām ॥8॥
html:
nivāpānnena bhagavanbhṛśaṃ pīḍyāmahe vayam ।
prasādaṃ kuru no deva śreyo naḥ saṃvidhīyatām ॥8॥
slp1: nivApAnnena BagavanBfSaM pIqyAmahe vayam । prasAdaM kuru no deva Sreyo naH saMviDIyatAm ॥8॥
author: pitara ūcuḥ ।

text: iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā svayambhūridamabravīt । eṣa me pārśvato vahniryuṣmacchreyo vidhāsyati ॥9॥
html:
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā svayambhūridamabravīt ।
eṣa me pārśvato vahniryuṣmacchreyo vidhāsyati ॥9॥
slp1: iti tezAM vacaH SrutvA svayamBUridamabravIt । eza me pArSvato vahniryuzmacCreyo viDAsyati ॥9॥

text: sahitāstāta bhokṣyāmo nivāpe samupasthite । jarayiṣyatha cāpyannaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ॥10॥
html:
sahitāstāta bhokṣyāmo nivāpe samupasthite ।
jarayiṣyatha cāpyannaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: sahitAstAta BokzyAmo nivApe samupasTite । jarayizyaTa cApyannaM mayA sArDaM na saMSayaH ॥10॥
author: agniruvāca ।

text: etacchrutvā tu pitarastataste vijvarābhavan । etasmātkāraṇāccāgneḥ prāktanaṃ dīyate nṛpa ॥11॥
html:
etacchrutvā tu pitarastataste vijvarābhavan ।
etasmātkāraṇāccāgneḥ prāktanaṃ dīyate nṛpa ॥11॥
slp1: etacCrutvA tu pitarastataste vijvarABavan । etasmAtkAraRAccAgneH prAktanaM dIyate nfpa ॥11॥

text: nivapte cāgnipūrve vai nivāpe puruṣarṣabha । na brahmarākṣasāstaṃ vai nivāpaṃ dharṣayantyuta । rakṣāṃsi cāpavartante sthite deve vibhāvasau ॥12॥
html:
nivapte cāgnipūrve vai nivāpe puruṣarṣabha ।
na brahmarākṣasāstaṃ vai nivāpaṃ dharṣayantyuta ।
rakṣāṃsi cāpavartante sthite deve vibhāvasau ॥12॥
slp1: nivapte cAgnipUrve vE nivApe puruzarzaBa । na brahmarAkzasAstaM vE nivApaM Darzayantyuta । rakzAMsi cApavartante sTite deve viBAvasO ॥12॥

text: pūrvaṃ piṇḍaṃ piturdadyāttato dadyātpitāmahe । prapitāmahāya ca tata eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ॥13॥
html:
pūrvaṃ piṇḍaṃ piturdadyāttato dadyātpitāmahe ।
prapitāmahāya ca tata eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: pUrvaM piRqaM piturdadyAttato dadyAtpitAmahe । prapitAmahAya ca tata eza SrAdDaviDiH smftaH ॥13॥

text: brūyācchrāddhe ca sāvitrīṃ piṇḍe piṇḍe samāhitaḥ । somāyeti ca vaktavyaṃ tathā pitṛmateti ca ॥14॥
html:
brūyācchrāddhe ca sāvitrīṃ piṇḍe piṇḍe samāhitaḥ ।
somāyeti ca vaktavyaṃ tathā pitṛmateti ca ॥14॥
slp1: brUyAcCrAdDe ca sAvitrIM piRqe piRqe samAhitaH । somAyeti ca vaktavyaM taTA pitfmateti ca ॥14॥

text: rajasvalā ca yā nārī vyaṅgitā karṇayośca yā । nivāpe nopatiṣṭheta saṅgrāhyā nānyavaṃśajāḥ ॥15॥
html:
rajasvalā ca yā nārī vyaṅgitā karṇayośca yā ।
nivāpe nopatiṣṭheta saṅgrāhyā nānyavaṃśajāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: rajasvalA ca yA nArI vyaNgitA karRayoSca yA । nivApe nopatizWeta saNgrAhyA nAnyavaMSajAH ॥15॥

text: jalaṃ prataramāṇaśca kīrtayeta pitāmahān । nadīmāsādya kurvīta pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍatarpaṇam ॥16॥
html:
jalaṃ prataramāṇaśca kīrtayeta pitāmahān ।
nadīmāsādya kurvīta pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍatarpaṇam ॥16॥
slp1: jalaM prataramARaSca kIrtayeta pitAmahAn । nadImAsAdya kurvIta pitFRAM piRqatarpaRam ॥16॥

text: pūrvaṃ svavaṃśajānāṃ tu kṛtvādbhistarpaṇaṃ punaḥ । suhṛtsambandhivargāṇāṃ tato dadyājjalāñjalim ॥17॥
html:
pūrvaṃ svavaṃśajānāṃ tu kṛtvādbhistarpaṇaṃ punaḥ ।
suhṛtsambandhivargāṇāṃ tato dadyājjalāñjalim ॥17॥
slp1: pUrvaM svavaMSajAnAM tu kftvAdBistarpaRaM punaH । suhftsambanDivargARAM tato dadyAjjalAYjalim ॥17॥

text: kalmāṣagoyugenātha yuktena tarato jalam । pitaro'bhilaṣante vai nāvaṃ cāpyadhirohataḥ । sadā nāvi jalaṃ tajjñāḥ prayacchanti samāhitāḥ ॥18॥
html:
kalmāṣagoyugenātha yuktena tarato jalam ।
pitaro'bhilaṣante vai nāvaṃ cāpyadhirohataḥ ।
sadā nāvi jalaṃ tajjñāḥ prayacchanti samāhitāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: kalmAzagoyugenATa yuktena tarato jalam । pitaro'Bilazante vE nAvaM cApyaDirohataH । sadA nAvi jalaM tajjYAH prayacCanti samAhitAH ॥18॥

text: māsārdhe kṛṣṇapakṣasya kuryānnivapanāni vai । puṣṭirāyustathā vīryaṃ śrīścaiva pitṛvartinaḥ ॥19॥
html:
māsārdhe kṛṣṇapakṣasya kuryānnivapanāni vai ।
puṣṭirāyustathā vīryaṃ śrīścaiva pitṛvartinaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: mAsArDe kfzRapakzasya kuryAnnivapanAni vE । puzwirAyustaTA vIryaM SrIScEva pitfvartinaH ॥19॥

text: pitāmahaḥ pulastyaśca vasiṣṭhaḥ pulahastathā । aṅgirāśca kratuścaiva kaśyapaśca mahānṛṣiḥ । ete kurukulaśreṣṭha mahāyogeśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥20॥
html:
pitāmahaḥ pulastyaśca vasiṣṭhaḥ pulahastathā ।
aṅgirāśca kratuścaiva kaśyapaśca mahānṛṣiḥ ।
ete kurukulaśreṣṭha mahāyogeśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: pitAmahaH pulastyaSca vasizWaH pulahastaTA । aNgirASca kratuScEva kaSyapaSca mahAnfziH । ete kurukulaSrezWa mahAyogeSvarAH smftAH ॥20॥

text: ete ca pitaro rājanneṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ paraḥ । pretāstu piṇḍasambandhānmucyante tena karmaṇā ॥21॥
html:
ete ca pitaro rājanneṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ paraḥ ।
pretāstu piṇḍasambandhānmucyante tena karmaṇā ॥21॥
slp1: ete ca pitaro rAjanneza SrAdDaviDiH paraH । pretAstu piRqasambanDAnmucyante tena karmaRA ॥21॥

text: ityeṣā puruṣaśreṣṭha śrāddhotpattiryathāgamam । khyāpitā pūrvanirdiṣṭā dānaṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ param] ॥22॥
html:
ityeṣā puruṣaśreṣṭha śrāddhotpattiryathāgamam ।
khyāpitā pūrvanirdiṣṭā dānaṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ param] ॥22॥
slp1: ityezA puruzaSrezWa SrAdDotpattiryaTAgamam । KyApitA pUrvanirdizwA dAnaM vakzyAmyataH param] ॥22॥

text: dvijātayo vratopetā haviste yadi bhuñjate । annaṃ brāhmaṇakāmāya kathametatpitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
dvijātayo vratopetā haviste yadi bhuñjate ।
annaṃ brāhmaṇakāmāya kathametatpitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: dvijAtayo vratopetA haviste yadi BuYjate । annaM brAhmaRakAmAya kaTametatpitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: avedoktavratāścaiva bhuñjānāḥ kāryakāriṇaḥ । vedokteṣu tu bhuñjānā vrataluptā yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
html:
avedoktavratāścaiva bhuñjānāḥ kāryakāriṇaḥ ।
vedokteṣu tu bhuñjānā vrataluptā yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
slp1: avedoktavratAScEva BuYjAnAH kAryakAriRaH । vedoktezu tu BuYjAnA vrataluptA yuDizWira ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yadidaṃ tapa ityāhurupavāsaṃ pṛthagjanāḥ । tapaḥ syādetadiha vai tapo'nyadvāpi kiṃ bhavet ॥3॥
html:
yadidaṃ tapa ityāhurupavāsaṃ pṛthagjanāḥ ।
tapaḥ syādetadiha vai tapo'nyadvāpi kiṃ bhavet ॥3॥
slp1: yadidaM tapa ityAhurupavAsaM pfTagjanAH । tapaH syAdetadiha vE tapo'nyadvApi kiM Bavet ॥3॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: māsārdhamāsau nopavasedyattapo manyate janaḥ । ātmatantropaghātī yo na tapasvī na dharmavit ॥4॥
html:
māsārdhamāsau nopavasedyattapo manyate janaḥ ।
ātmatantropaghātī yo na tapasvī na dharmavit ॥4॥
slp1: mAsArDamAsO nopavasedyattapo manyate janaH । AtmatantropaGAtI yo na tapasvI na Darmavit ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tyāgasyāpi ca sampattiḥ śiṣyate tapa uttamam । sadopavāsī ca bhavedbrahmacārī tathaiva ca ॥5॥
html:
tyāgasyāpi ca sampattiḥ śiṣyate tapa uttamam ।
sadopavāsī ca bhavedbrahmacārī tathaiva ca ॥5॥
slp1: tyAgasyApi ca sampattiH Sizyate tapa uttamam । sadopavAsI ca BavedbrahmacArI taTEva ca ॥5॥

text: muniśca syātsadā vipro devāṃścaiva sadā yajet । kuṭumbiko dharmakāmaḥ sadāsvapnaśca bhārata ॥6॥
html:
muniśca syātsadā vipro devāṃścaiva sadā yajet ।
kuṭumbiko dharmakāmaḥ sadāsvapnaśca bhārata ॥6॥
slp1: muniSca syAtsadA vipro devAMScEva sadA yajet । kuwumbiko DarmakAmaH sadAsvapnaSca BArata ॥6॥

text: amṛtāśī sadā ca syātpavitrī ca sadā bhavet । ṛtavādī sadā ca syānniyataśca sadā bhavet ॥7॥
html:
amṛtāśī sadā ca syātpavitrī ca sadā bhavet ।
ṛtavādī sadā ca syānniyataśca sadā bhavet ॥7॥
slp1: amftASI sadA ca syAtpavitrI ca sadA Bavet । ftavAdI sadA ca syAnniyataSca sadA Bavet ॥7॥

text: vighasāśī sadā ca syātsadā caivātithipriyaḥ । amāṃsāśī sadā ca syātpavitrī ca sadā bhavet ॥8॥
html:
vighasāśī sadā ca syātsadā caivātithipriyaḥ ।
amāṃsāśī sadā ca syātpavitrī ca sadā bhavet ॥8॥
slp1: viGasASI sadA ca syAtsadA cEvAtiTipriyaH । amAMsASI sadA ca syAtpavitrI ca sadA Bavet ॥8॥

text: kathaṃ sadopavāsī syādbrahmacārī ca pārthiva । vighasāśī kathaṃ ca syātkathaṃ caivātithipriyaḥ ॥9॥
html:
kathaṃ sadopavāsī syādbrahmacārī ca pārthiva ।
vighasāśī kathaṃ ca syātkathaṃ caivātithipriyaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: kaTaM sadopavAsI syAdbrahmacArI ca pArTiva । viGasASI kaTaM ca syAtkaTaM cEvAtiTipriyaH ॥9॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: antarā sāyamāśaṃ ca prātarāśaṃ tathaiva ca । sadopavāsī bhavati yo na bhuṅkte'ntarā punaḥ ॥10॥
html:
antarā sāyamāśaṃ ca prātarāśaṃ tathaiva ca ।
sadopavāsī bhavati yo na bhuṅkte'ntarā punaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: antarA sAyamASaM ca prAtarASaM taTEva ca । sadopavAsI Bavati yo na BuNkte'ntarA punaH ॥10॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: bhāryāṃ gacchanbrahmacārī sadā bhavati caiva ha । ṛtavādī sadā ca syāddānaśīlaśca mānavaḥ ॥11॥
html:
bhāryāṃ gacchanbrahmacārī sadā bhavati caiva ha ।
ṛtavādī sadā ca syāddānaśīlaśca mānavaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: BAryAM gacCanbrahmacArI sadA Bavati cEva ha । ftavAdI sadA ca syAddAnaSIlaSca mAnavaH ॥11॥

text: abhakṣayanvṛthā māṃsamamāṃsāśī bhavatyuta । dānaṃ dadatpavitrī syādasvapnaśca divāsvapan ॥12॥
html:
abhakṣayanvṛthā māṃsamamāṃsāśī bhavatyuta ।
dānaṃ dadatpavitrī syādasvapnaśca divāsvapan ॥12॥
slp1: aBakzayanvfTA mAMsamamAMsASI Bavatyuta । dAnaM dadatpavitrI syAdasvapnaSca divAsvapan ॥12॥

text: bhṛtyātithiṣu yo bhuṅkte bhuktavatsu naraḥ sadā । amṛtaṃ kevalaṃ bhuṅkte iti viddhi yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
html:
bhṛtyātithiṣu yo bhuṅkte bhuktavatsu naraḥ sadā ।
amṛtaṃ kevalaṃ bhuṅkte iti viddhi yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
slp1: BftyAtiTizu yo BuNkte Buktavatsu naraH sadA । amftaM kevalaM BuNkte iti vidDi yuDizWira ॥13॥

text: abhuktavatsu nāśnāti brāhmaṇeṣu tu yo naraḥ । abhojanena tenāsya jitaḥ svargo bhavatyuta ॥14॥
html:
abhuktavatsu nāśnāti brāhmaṇeṣu tu yo naraḥ ।
abhojanena tenāsya jitaḥ svargo bhavatyuta ॥14॥
slp1: aBuktavatsu nASnAti brAhmaRezu tu yo naraH । aBojanena tenAsya jitaH svargo Bavatyuta ॥14॥

text: devebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca bhṛtyebhyo'tithibhiḥ saha । avaśiṣṭāni yo bhuṅkte tamāhurvighasāśinam ॥15॥
html:
devebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca bhṛtyebhyo'tithibhiḥ saha ।
avaśiṣṭāni yo bhuṅkte tamāhurvighasāśinam ॥15॥
slp1: deveByaSca pitfByaSca BftyeByo'tiTiBiH saha । avaSizwAni yo BuNkte tamAhurviGasASinam ॥15॥

text: teṣāṃ lokā hyaparyantāḥ sadane brahmaṇaḥ smṛtāḥ । upasthitā hyapsarobhirgandharvaiśca janādhipa ॥16॥
html:
teṣāṃ lokā hyaparyantāḥ sadane brahmaṇaḥ smṛtāḥ ।
upasthitā hyapsarobhirgandharvaiśca janādhipa ॥16॥
slp1: tezAM lokA hyaparyantAH sadane brahmaRaH smftAH । upasTitA hyapsaroBirganDarvESca janADipa ॥16॥

text: devatātithibhiḥ sārdhaṃ pitṛbhiścopabhuñjate । ramante putrapautraiśca teṣāṃ gatiranuttamā] ॥17॥
html:
devatātithibhiḥ sārdhaṃ pitṛbhiścopabhuñjate ।
ramante putrapautraiśca teṣāṃ gatiranuttamā] ॥17॥
slp1: devatAtiTiBiH sArDaM pitfBiScopaBuYjate । ramante putrapOtrESca tezAM gatiranuttamA] ॥17॥

text: brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchanti dānāni vividhāni ca । dātṛpratigrahītrorvā ko viśeṣaḥ pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchanti dānāni vividhāni ca ।
dātṛpratigrahītrorvā ko viśeṣaḥ pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: brAhmaReByaH prayacCanti dAnAni viviDAni ca । dAtfpratigrahItrorvA ko viSezaH pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sādhoryaḥ pratigṛhṇīyāttathaivāsādhuto dvijaḥ । guṇavatyalpadoṣaḥ syānnirguṇe tu nimajjati ॥2॥
html:
sādhoryaḥ pratigṛhṇīyāttathaivāsādhuto dvijaḥ ।
guṇavatyalpadoṣaḥ syānnirguṇe tu nimajjati ॥2॥
slp1: sADoryaH pratigfhRIyAttaTEvAsADuto dvijaH । guRavatyalpadozaH syAnnirguRe tu nimajjati ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । vṛṣādarbheśca saṃvādaṃ saptarṣīṇāṃ ca bhārata ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
vṛṣādarbheśca saṃvādaṃ saptarṣīṇāṃ ca bhārata ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । vfzAdarBeSca saMvAdaM saptarzIRAM ca BArata ॥3॥

text: kaśyapo'trirvasiṣṭhaśca bharadvājo'tha gautamaḥ । viśvāmitro jamadagniḥ sādhvī caivāpyarundhatī ॥4॥
html:
kaśyapo'trirvasiṣṭhaśca bharadvājo'tha gautamaḥ ।
viśvāmitro jamadagniḥ sādhvī caivāpyarundhatī ॥4॥
slp1: kaSyapo'trirvasizWaSca BaradvAjo'Ta gOtamaH । viSvAmitro jamadagniH sADvI cEvApyarunDatI ॥4॥

text: sarveṣāmatha teṣāṃ tu gaṇḍābhūtkarmakārikā । śūdraḥ paśusakhaścaiva bhartā cāsyā babhūva ha ॥5॥
html:
sarveṣāmatha teṣāṃ tu gaṇḍābhūtkarmakārikā ।
śūdraḥ paśusakhaścaiva bhartā cāsyā babhūva ha ॥5॥
slp1: sarvezAmaTa tezAM tu gaRqABUtkarmakArikA । SUdraH paSusaKaScEva BartA cAsyA baBUva ha ॥5॥

text: te vai sarve tapasyantaḥ purā cerurmahīmimām । samādhinopaśikṣanto brahmalokaṃ sanātanam ॥6॥
html:
te vai sarve tapasyantaḥ purā cerurmahīmimām ।
samādhinopaśikṣanto brahmalokaṃ sanātanam ॥6॥
slp1: te vE sarve tapasyantaH purA cerurmahImimAm । samADinopaSikzanto brahmalokaM sanAtanam ॥6॥

text: athābhavadanāvṛṣṭirmahatī kurunandana । kṛcchraprāṇo'bhavadyatra loko'yaṃ vai kṣudhānvitaḥ ॥7॥
html:
athābhavadanāvṛṣṭirmahatī kurunandana ।
kṛcchraprāṇo'bhavadyatra loko'yaṃ vai kṣudhānvitaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: aTABavadanAvfzwirmahatI kurunandana । kfcCraprARo'Bavadyatra loko'yaM vE kzuDAnvitaH ॥7॥

text: kasmiṃścicca purā yajñe yājyena śibisūnunā । dakṣiṇārthe'tha ṛtvigbhyo dattaḥ putro nijaḥ kila ॥8॥
html:
kasmiṃścicca purā yajñe yājyena śibisūnunā ।
dakṣiṇārthe'tha ṛtvigbhyo dattaḥ putro nijaḥ kila ॥8॥
slp1: kasmiMScicca purA yajYe yAjyena SibisUnunA । dakziRArTe'Ta ftvigByo dattaH putro nijaH kila ॥8॥

text: tasminkāle'tha so'lpāyurdiṣṭāntamagamatprabho । te taṃ kṣudhābhisantaptāḥ parivāryopatasthire ॥9॥
html:
tasminkāle'tha so'lpāyurdiṣṭāntamagamatprabho ।
te taṃ kṣudhābhisantaptāḥ parivāryopatasthire ॥9॥
slp1: tasminkAle'Ta so'lpAyurdizwAntamagamatpraBo । te taM kzuDABisantaptAH parivAryopatasTire ॥9॥

text: yājyātmajamatho dṛṣṭvā gatāsumṛṣisattamāḥ । apacanta tadā sthālyāṃ kṣudhārtāḥ kila bhārata ॥10॥
html:
yājyātmajamatho dṛṣṭvā gatāsumṛṣisattamāḥ ।
apacanta tadā sthālyāṃ kṣudhārtāḥ kila bhārata ॥10॥
slp1: yAjyAtmajamaTo dfzwvA gatAsumfzisattamAH । apacanta tadA sTAlyAM kzuDArtAH kila BArata ॥10॥

text: nirādye martyaloke'sminnātmānaṃ te parīpsavaḥ । kṛcchrāmāpedire vṛttimannahetostapasvinaḥ ॥11॥
html:
nirādye martyaloke'sminnātmānaṃ te parīpsavaḥ ।
kṛcchrāmāpedire vṛttimannahetostapasvinaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: nirAdye martyaloke'sminnAtmAnaM te parIpsavaH । kfcCrAmApedire vfttimannahetostapasvinaH ॥11॥

text: aṭamāno'tha tānmārge pacamānānmahīpatiḥ । rājā śaibyo vṛṣādarbhiḥ kliśyamānāndadarśa ha ॥12॥
html:
aṭamāno'tha tānmārge pacamānānmahīpatiḥ ।
rājā śaibyo vṛṣādarbhiḥ kliśyamānāndadarśa ha ॥12॥
slp1: awamAno'Ta tAnmArge pacamAnAnmahIpatiH । rAjA SEbyo vfzAdarBiH kliSyamAnAndadarSa ha ॥12॥

text: pratigrahastārayati puṣṭirvai pratigṛhṇatām । mayi yadvidyate vittaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ tapodhanāḥ ॥13॥
html:
pratigrahastārayati puṣṭirvai pratigṛhṇatām ।
mayi yadvidyate vittaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ tapodhanāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: pratigrahastArayati puzwirvE pratigfhRatAm । mayi yadvidyate vittaM tacCfRuDvaM tapoDanAH ॥13॥
author: vṛṣādarbhiruvāca ।

text: priyo hi me brāhmaṇo yācamāno dadyāmahaṃ vo'śvatarīsahasram । ekaikaśaḥ savṛṣāḥ samprasūtāḥ sarveṣāṃ vai śīghragāḥ śvetalomāḥ ॥14॥
html:
priyo hi me brāhmaṇo yācamāno dadyāmahaṃ vo'śvatarīsahasram ।
ekaikaśaḥ savṛṣāḥ samprasūtāḥ sarveṣāṃ vai śīghragāḥ śvetalomāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: priyo hi me brAhmaRo yAcamAno dadyAmahaM vo'SvatarIsahasram । ekEkaSaH savfzAH samprasUtAH sarvezAM vE SIGragAH SvetalomAH ॥14॥

text: kulambharānanaḍuhaḥ śataṃśatāndhuryāñśubhānsarvaśo'haṃ dadāni । pṛthvīvāhānpīvarāṃścaiva tāvadagryā gṛṣṭyo dhenavaḥ suvratāśca ॥15॥
html:
kulambharānanaḍuhaḥ śataṃśatāndhuryāñśubhānsarvaśo'haṃ dadāni ।
pṛthvīvāhānpīvarāṃścaiva tāvadagryā gṛṣṭyo dhenavaḥ suvratāśca ॥15॥
slp1: kulamBarAnanaquhaH SataMSatAnDuryAYSuBAnsarvaSo'haM dadAni । pfTvIvAhAnpIvarAMScEva tAvadagryA gfzwyo DenavaH suvratASca ॥15॥

text: varāngrāmānvrīhiyavaṃ rasāṃśca ratnaṃ cānyaddurlabhaṃ kiṃ dadāni । mā smābhakṣye bhāvamevaṃ kurudhvaṃ puṣṭyarthaṃ vai kiṃ prayacchāmyahaṃ vaḥ ॥16॥
html:
varāngrāmānvrīhiyavaṃ rasāṃśca ratnaṃ cānyaddurlabhaṃ kiṃ dadāni ।
mā smābhakṣye bhāvamevaṃ kurudhvaṃ puṣṭyarthaṃ vai kiṃ prayacchāmyahaṃ vaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: varAngrAmAnvrIhiyavaM rasAMSca ratnaM cAnyaddurlaBaM kiM dadAni । mA smABakzye BAvamevaM kuruDvaM puzwyarTaM vE kiM prayacCAmyahaM vaH ॥16॥

text: rājanpratigraho rājño madhvāsvādo viṣopamaḥ । tajjānamānaḥ kasmāttvaṃ kuruṣe naḥ pralobhanam ॥17॥
html:
rājanpratigraho rājño madhvāsvādo viṣopamaḥ ।
tajjānamānaḥ kasmāttvaṃ kuruṣe naḥ pralobhanam ॥17॥
slp1: rAjanpratigraho rAjYo maDvAsvAdo vizopamaH । tajjAnamAnaH kasmAttvaM kuruze naH praloBanam ॥17॥
author: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ।

text: kṣatraṃ hi daivatamiva brāhmaṇaṃ samupāśritam । amalo hyeṣa tapasā prītaḥ prīṇāti devatāḥ ॥18॥
html:
kṣatraṃ hi daivatamiva brāhmaṇaṃ samupāśritam ।
amalo hyeṣa tapasā prītaḥ prīṇāti devatāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: kzatraM hi dEvatamiva brAhmaRaM samupASritam । amalo hyeza tapasA prItaH prIRAti devatAH ॥18॥

text: ahnāpīha tapo jātu brāhmaṇasyopajāyate । taddāva iva nirdahyātprāpto rājapratigrahaḥ ॥19॥
html:
ahnāpīha tapo jātu brāhmaṇasyopajāyate ।
taddāva iva nirdahyātprāpto rājapratigrahaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: ahnApIha tapo jAtu brAhmaRasyopajAyate । taddAva iva nirdahyAtprApto rAjapratigrahaH ॥19॥

text: kuśalaṃ saha dānena rājannastu sadā tava । arthibhyo dīyatāṃ sarvamityuktvā te tato yayuḥ ॥20॥
html:
kuśalaṃ saha dānena rājannastu sadā tava ।
arthibhyo dīyatāṃ sarvamityuktvā te tato yayuḥ ॥20॥
slp1: kuSalaM saha dAnena rAjannastu sadA tava । arTiByo dIyatAM sarvamityuktvA te tato yayuH ॥20॥

text: apakvameva tanmāṃsamabhūtteṣāṃ ca dhīmatām । atha hitvā yayuḥ sarve vanamāhārakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥21॥
html:
apakvameva tanmāṃsamabhūtteṣāṃ ca dhīmatām ।
atha hitvā yayuḥ sarve vanamāhārakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: apakvameva tanmAMsamaBUttezAM ca DImatAm । aTa hitvA yayuH sarve vanamAhArakANkziRaH ॥21॥

text: tataḥ pracoditā rājñā vanaṃ gatvāsya mantriṇaḥ । pracīyodumbarāṇi sma dānaṃ dātuṃ pracakramuḥ ॥22॥
html:
tataḥ pracoditā rājñā vanaṃ gatvāsya mantriṇaḥ ।
pracīyodumbarāṇi sma dānaṃ dātuṃ pracakramuḥ ॥22॥
slp1: tataH pracoditA rAjYA vanaM gatvAsya mantriRaH । pracIyodumbarARi sma dAnaM dAtuM pracakramuH ॥22॥

text: udumbarāṇyathānyāni hemagarbhāṇyupāharan । bhṛtyāsteṣāṃ tatastāni pragrāhitumupādravan ॥23॥
html:
udumbarāṇyathānyāni hemagarbhāṇyupāharan ।
bhṛtyāsteṣāṃ tatastāni pragrāhitumupādravan ॥23॥
slp1: udumbarARyaTAnyAni hemagarBARyupAharan । BftyAstezAM tatastAni pragrAhitumupAdravan ॥23॥

text: gurūṇīti viditvātha na grāhyāṇyatrirabravīt । na sma he mūḍhavijñānā na sma he mandabuddhayaḥ । haimānīmāni jānīmaḥ pratibuddhāḥ sma jāgṛmaḥ ॥24॥
html:
gurūṇīti viditvātha na grāhyāṇyatrirabravīt ।
na sma he mūḍhavijñānā na sma he mandabuddhayaḥ ।
haimānīmāni jānīmaḥ pratibuddhāḥ sma jāgṛmaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: gurURIti viditvATa na grAhyARyatrirabravIt । na sma he mUQavijYAnA na sma he mandabudDayaH । hEmAnImAni jAnImaH pratibudDAH sma jAgfmaH ॥24॥

text: iha hyetadupādattaṃ pretya syātkaṭukodayam । apratigrāhyamevaitatpretya ceha sukhepsunā ॥25॥
html:
iha hyetadupādattaṃ pretya syātkaṭukodayam ।
apratigrāhyamevaitatpretya ceha sukhepsunā ॥25॥
slp1: iha hyetadupAdattaM pretya syAtkawukodayam । apratigrAhyamevEtatpretya ceha suKepsunA ॥25॥

text: śatena niṣkaṃ gaṇitaṃ sahasreṇa ca sammitam । yathā bahu pratīcchanhi pāpiṣṭhāṃ labhate gatim ॥26॥
html:
śatena niṣkaṃ gaṇitaṃ sahasreṇa ca sammitam ।
yathā bahu pratīcchanhi pāpiṣṭhāṃ labhate gatim ॥26॥
slp1: Satena nizkaM gaRitaM sahasreRa ca sammitam । yaTA bahu pratIcCanhi pApizWAM laBate gatim ॥26॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: yatpṛthivyāṃ vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ paśavaḥ striyaḥ । sarvaṃ tannālamekasya tasmādvidvāñśamaṃ vrajet ॥27॥
html:
yatpṛthivyāṃ vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ paśavaḥ striyaḥ ।
sarvaṃ tannālamekasya tasmādvidvāñśamaṃ vrajet ॥27॥
slp1: yatpfTivyAM vrIhiyavaM hiraRyaM paSavaH striyaH । sarvaM tannAlamekasya tasmAdvidvAYSamaM vrajet ॥27॥
author: kaśyapa uvāca ।

text: utpannasya ruroḥ śṛṅgaṃ vardhamānasya vardhate । prārthanā puruṣasyeva tasya mātrā na vidyate ॥28॥
html:
utpannasya ruroḥ śṛṅgaṃ vardhamānasya vardhate ।
prārthanā puruṣasyeva tasya mātrā na vidyate ॥28॥
slp1: utpannasya ruroH SfNgaM varDamAnasya varDate । prArTanA puruzasyeva tasya mAtrA na vidyate ॥28॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: na talloke dravyamasti yallokaṃ pratipūrayet । samudrakalpaḥ puruṣo na kadācana pūryate ॥29॥
html:
na talloke dravyamasti yallokaṃ pratipūrayet ।
samudrakalpaḥ puruṣo na kadācana pūryate ॥29॥
slp1: na talloke dravyamasti yallokaM pratipUrayet । samudrakalpaH puruzo na kadAcana pUryate ॥29॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: kāmaṃ kāmayamānasya yadā kāmaḥ samṛdhyate । athainamaparaḥ kāmastṛṣṇā vidhyati bāṇavat ॥30॥
html:
kāmaṃ kāmayamānasya yadā kāmaḥ samṛdhyate ।
athainamaparaḥ kāmastṛṣṇā vidhyati bāṇavat ॥30॥
slp1: kAmaM kAmayamAnasya yadA kAmaH samfDyate । aTEnamaparaH kAmastfzRA viDyati bARavat ॥30॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: pratigrahe saṃyamo vai tapo dhārayate dhruvam । taddhanaṃ brāhmaṇasyeha lubhyamānasya visravet ॥31॥
html:
pratigrahe saṃyamo vai tapo dhārayate dhruvam ।
taddhanaṃ brāhmaṇasyeha lubhyamānasya visravet ॥31॥
slp1: pratigrahe saMyamo vE tapo DArayate Druvam । tadDanaM brAhmaRasyeha luByamAnasya visravet ॥31॥
author: jamadagniruvāca ।

text: dharmārthaṃ sañcayo yo vai dravyāṇāṃ pakṣasammataḥ । tapaḥsañcaya eveha viśiṣṭo dravyasañcayāt ॥32॥
html:
dharmārthaṃ sañcayo yo vai dravyāṇāṃ pakṣasammataḥ ।
tapaḥsañcaya eveha viśiṣṭo dravyasañcayāt ॥32॥
slp1: DarmArTaM saYcayo yo vE dravyARAM pakzasammataH । tapaHsaYcaya eveha viSizwo dravyasaYcayAt ॥32॥
author: arundhatyuvāca ।

text: ugrādito bhayādyasmādbibhyatīme mameśvarāḥ । balīyāṃso durbalavadbibhemyahamataḥ param ॥33॥
html:
ugrādito bhayādyasmādbibhyatīme mameśvarāḥ ।
balīyāṃso durbalavadbibhemyahamataḥ param ॥33॥
slp1: ugrAdito BayAdyasmAdbiByatIme mameSvarAH । balIyAMso durbalavadbiBemyahamataH param ॥33॥
author: gaṇḍovāca ।

text: yadvai dharme paraṃ nāsti brāhmaṇāstaddhanaṃ viduḥ । vinayārthaṃ suvidvāṃsamupāseyaṃ yathātatham ॥34॥
html:
yadvai dharme paraṃ nāsti brāhmaṇāstaddhanaṃ viduḥ ।
vinayārthaṃ suvidvāṃsamupāseyaṃ yathātatham ॥34॥
slp1: yadvE Darme paraM nAsti brAhmaRAstadDanaM viduH । vinayArTaM suvidvAMsamupAseyaM yaTAtaTam ॥34॥
author: paśusakha uvāca ।

text: kuśalaṃ saha dānāya tasmai yasya prajā imāḥ । phalānyupadhiyuktāni ya evaṃ naḥ prayacchasi ॥35॥
html:
kuśalaṃ saha dānāya tasmai yasya prajā imāḥ ।
phalānyupadhiyuktāni ya evaṃ naḥ prayacchasi ॥35॥
slp1: kuSalaM saha dAnAya tasmE yasya prajA imAH । PalAnyupaDiyuktAni ya evaM naH prayacCasi ॥35॥
author: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ।

text: ityuktvā hemagarbhāṇi hitvā tāni phalāni te । ṛṣayo jagmuranyatra sarva eva dhṛtavratāḥ ॥36॥
html:
ityuktvā hemagarbhāṇi hitvā tāni phalāni te ।
ṛṣayo jagmuranyatra sarva eva dhṛtavratāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: ityuktvA hemagarBARi hitvA tAni PalAni te । fzayo jagmuranyatra sarva eva DftavratAH ॥36॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: upadhiṃ śaṅkamānāste hitvemāni phalāni vai । tato'nyenaiva gacchanti viditaṃ te'stu pārthiva ॥37॥
html:
upadhiṃ śaṅkamānāste hitvemāni phalāni vai ।
tato'nyenaiva gacchanti viditaṃ te'stu pārthiva ॥37॥
slp1: upaDiM SaNkamAnAste hitvemAni PalAni vE । tato'nyenEva gacCanti viditaM te'stu pArTiva ॥37॥
author: mantriṇaḥ ūcuḥ ।

text: ityuktaḥ sa tu bhṛtyaistairvṛṣādarbhiścukopa ha । teṣāṃ sampratikartuṃ ca sarveṣāmagamadgṛham ॥38॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa tu bhṛtyaistairvṛṣādarbhiścukopa ha ।
teṣāṃ sampratikartuṃ ca sarveṣāmagamadgṛham ॥38॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa tu BftyEstErvfzAdarBiScukopa ha । tezAM sampratikartuM ca sarvezAmagamadgfham ॥38॥

text: sa gatvāhavanīye'gnau tīvraṃ niyamamāsthitaḥ । juhāva saṃskṛtāṃ mantrairekaikāmāhutiṃ nṛpaḥ ॥39॥
html:
sa gatvāhavanīye'gnau tīvraṃ niyamamāsthitaḥ ।
juhāva saṃskṛtāṃ mantrairekaikāmāhutiṃ nṛpaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: sa gatvAhavanIye'gnO tIvraM niyamamAsTitaH । juhAva saMskftAM mantrErekEkAmAhutiM nfpaH ॥39॥

text: tasmādagneḥ samuttasthau kṛtyā lokabhayaṅkarī । tasyā nāma vṛṣādarbhiryātudhānītyathākarot ॥40॥
html:
tasmādagneḥ samuttasthau kṛtyā lokabhayaṅkarī ।
tasyā nāma vṛṣādarbhiryātudhānītyathākarot ॥40॥
slp1: tasmAdagneH samuttasTO kftyA lokaBayaNkarI । tasyA nAma vfzAdarBiryAtuDAnItyaTAkarot ॥40॥

text: sā kṛtyā kālarātrīva kṛtāñjalirupasthitā । vṛṣādarbhiṃ narapatiṃ kiṃ karomīti cābravīt ॥41॥
html:
sā kṛtyā kālarātrīva kṛtāñjalirupasthitā ।
vṛṣādarbhiṃ narapatiṃ kiṃ karomīti cābravīt ॥41॥
slp1: sA kftyA kAlarAtrIva kftAYjalirupasTitA । vfzAdarBiM narapatiM kiM karomIti cAbravIt ॥41॥

text: ṛṣīṇāṃ gaccha saptānāmarundhatyāstathaiva ca । dāsībhartuśca dāsyāśca manasā nāma dhāraya ॥42॥
html:
ṛṣīṇāṃ gaccha saptānāmarundhatyāstathaiva ca ।
dāsībhartuśca dāsyāśca manasā nāma dhāraya ॥42॥
slp1: fzIRAM gacCa saptAnAmarunDatyAstaTEva ca । dAsIBartuSca dAsyASca manasA nAma DAraya ॥42॥
author: vṛṣādarbhiruvāca ।

text: jñātvā nāmāni caiteṣāṃ sarvānetānvināśaya । vinaṣṭeṣu yathā svairaṃ gaccha yatrepsitaṃ tava ॥43॥
html:
jñātvā nāmāni caiteṣāṃ sarvānetānvināśaya ।
vinaṣṭeṣu yathā svairaṃ gaccha yatrepsitaṃ tava ॥43॥
slp1: jYAtvA nAmAni cEtezAM sarvAnetAnvinASaya । vinazwezu yaTA svEraM gacCa yatrepsitaM tava ॥43॥

text: sā tatheti pratiśrutya yātudhānī svarūpiṇī । jagāma tadvanaṃ yatra viceruste maharṣayaḥ] ॥44॥
html:
sā tatheti pratiśrutya yātudhānī svarūpiṇī ।
jagāma tadvanaṃ yatra viceruste maharṣayaḥ] ॥44॥
slp1: sA taTeti pratiSrutya yAtuDAnI svarUpiRI । jagAma tadvanaM yatra viceruste maharzayaH] ॥44॥

text: athātripramukhā rājanvane tasminmaharṣayaḥ । vyacaranbhakṣayanto vai mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥1॥
html:
athātripramukhā rājanvane tasminmaharṣayaḥ ।
vyacaranbhakṣayanto vai mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥1॥
slp1: aTAtripramuKA rAjanvane tasminmaharzayaH । vyacaranBakzayanto vE mUlAni ca PalAni ca ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: athāpaśyansupīnāṃsapāṇipādamukhodaram । parivrajantaṃ sthūlāṅgaṃ parivrājaṃ śunaḥsakham ॥2॥
html:
athāpaśyansupīnāṃsapāṇipādamukhodaram ।
parivrajantaṃ sthūlāṅgaṃ parivrājaṃ śunaḥsakham ॥2॥
slp1: aTApaSyansupInAMsapARipAdamuKodaram । parivrajantaM sTUlANgaM parivrAjaM SunaHsaKam ॥2॥

text: arundhatī tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvāṅgopacitaṃ śubhā । bhavitāro bhavanto vai naivamityabravīdṛṣīn ॥3॥
html:
arundhatī tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvāṅgopacitaṃ śubhā ।
bhavitāro bhavanto vai naivamityabravīdṛṣīn ॥3॥
slp1: arunDatI tu taM dfzwvA sarvANgopacitaM SuBA । BavitAro Bavanto vE nEvamityabravIdfzIn ॥3॥

text: naitasyeha yathāsmākamagnihotramanirhutam । sāyaṃ prātaśca hotavyaṃ tena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥4॥
html:
naitasyeha yathāsmākamagnihotramanirhutam ।
sāyaṃ prātaśca hotavyaṃ tena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: nEtasyeha yaTAsmAkamagnihotramanirhutam । sAyaM prAtaSca hotavyaM tena pIvAYSunaHsaKaH ॥4॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ kṣudhā vīryaṃ samāhatam । kṛcchrādhītaṃ pranaṣṭaṃ ca tena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥5॥
html:
naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ kṣudhā vīryaṃ samāhatam ।
kṛcchrādhītaṃ pranaṣṭaṃ ca tena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: nEtasyeha yaTAsmAkaM kzuDA vIryaM samAhatam । kfcCrADItaM pranazwaM ca tena pIvAYSunaHsaKaH ॥5॥
author: atriruvāca ।

text: naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ śaśvacchāstraṃ jaradgavaḥ । alasaḥ kṣutparo mūrkhastena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥6॥
html:
naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ śaśvacchāstraṃ jaradgavaḥ ।
alasaḥ kṣutparo mūrkhastena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: nEtasyeha yaTAsmAkaM SaSvacCAstraM jaradgavaH । alasaH kzutparo mUrKastena pIvAYSunaHsaKaH ॥6॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ bhaktamindhanameva ca । sañcintya vārṣikaṃ kiñcittena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥7॥
html:
naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ bhaktamindhanameva ca ।
sañcintya vārṣikaṃ kiñcittena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: nEtasyeha yaTAsmAkaM BaktaminDanameva ca । saYcintya vArzikaM kiYcittena pIvAYSunaHsaKaH ॥7॥
author: jamadagniruvāca ।

text: naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ catvāraśca sahodarāḥ । dehi dehīti bhikṣanti tena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥8॥
html:
naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ catvāraśca sahodarāḥ ।
dehi dehīti bhikṣanti tena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: nEtasyeha yaTAsmAkaM catvAraSca sahodarAH । dehi dehIti Bikzanti tena pIvAYSunaHsaKaH ॥8॥
author: kaśyapa uvāca ।

text: naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ brahmabandhoracetasaḥ । śoko bhāryāpavādena tena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥9॥
html:
naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ brahmabandhoracetasaḥ ।
śoko bhāryāpavādena tena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: nEtasyeha yaTAsmAkaM brahmabanDoracetasaH । Soko BAryApavAdena tena pIvAYSunaHsaKaH ॥9॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ trikauśeyaṃ hi rāṅkavam । ekaikaṃ vai trivārṣīyaṃ tena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥10॥
html:
naitasyeha yathāsmākaṃ trikauśeyaṃ hi rāṅkavam ।
ekaikaṃ vai trivārṣīyaṃ tena pīvāñśunaḥsakhaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: nEtasyeha yaTAsmAkaM trikOSeyaM hi rANkavam । ekEkaM vE trivArzIyaM tena pIvAYSunaHsaKaH ॥10॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: atha dṛṣṭvā parivrāṭsa tānmaharṣīñśunaḥsakhaḥ । abhigamya yathānyāyaṃ pāṇisparśamathācarat ॥11॥
html:
atha dṛṣṭvā parivrāṭsa tānmaharṣīñśunaḥsakhaḥ ।
abhigamya yathānyāyaṃ pāṇisparśamathācarat ॥11॥
slp1: aTa dfzwvA parivrAwsa tAnmaharzIYSunaHsaKaH । aBigamya yaTAnyAyaM pARisparSamaTAcarat ॥11॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: paricaryāṃ vane tāṃ tu kṣutpratīghātakārikām । anyonyena nivedyātha prātiṣṭhanta sahaiva te ॥12॥
html:
paricaryāṃ vane tāṃ tu kṣutpratīghātakārikām ।
anyonyena nivedyātha prātiṣṭhanta sahaiva te ॥12॥
slp1: paricaryAM vane tAM tu kzutpratIGAtakArikAm । anyonyena nivedyATa prAtizWanta sahEva te ॥12॥

text: ekaniścayakāryāśca vyacaranta vanāni te । ādadānāḥ samuddhṛtya mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥13॥
html:
ekaniścayakāryāśca vyacaranta vanāni te ।
ādadānāḥ samuddhṛtya mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥13॥
slp1: ekaniScayakAryASca vyacaranta vanAni te । AdadAnAH samudDftya mUlAni ca PalAni ca ॥13॥

text: kadācidvicarantaste vṛkṣairaviralairvṛtām । śucivāriprasannodāṃ dadṛśuḥ padminīṃ śubhām ॥14॥
html:
kadācidvicarantaste vṛkṣairaviralairvṛtām ।
śucivāriprasannodāṃ dadṛśuḥ padminīṃ śubhām ॥14॥
slp1: kadAcidvicarantaste vfkzEraviralErvftAm । SucivAriprasannodAM dadfSuH padminIM SuBAm ॥14॥

text: bālādityavapuḥprakhyaiḥ puṣkarairupaśobhitām । vaidūryavarṇasadṛśaiḥ padmapatrairathāvṛtām ॥15॥
html:
bālādityavapuḥprakhyaiḥ puṣkarairupaśobhitām ।
vaidūryavarṇasadṛśaiḥ padmapatrairathāvṛtām ॥15॥
slp1: bAlAdityavapuHpraKyEH puzkarErupaSoBitAm । vEdUryavarRasadfSEH padmapatrEraTAvftAm ॥15॥

text: nānāvidhaiśca vihagairjalaprakarasevibhiḥ । ekadvārāmanādeyāṃ sūpatīrthāmakardamām ॥16॥
html:
nānāvidhaiśca vihagairjalaprakarasevibhiḥ ।
ekadvārāmanādeyāṃ sūpatīrthāmakardamām ॥16॥
slp1: nAnAviDESca vihagErjalaprakaraseviBiH । ekadvArAmanAdeyAM sUpatIrTAmakardamAm ॥16॥

text: vṛṣādarbhiprayuktā tu kṛtyā vikṛtadarśanā । yātudhānīti vikhyātā padminīṃ tāmarakṣata ॥17॥
html:
vṛṣādarbhiprayuktā tu kṛtyā vikṛtadarśanā ।
yātudhānīti vikhyātā padminīṃ tāmarakṣata ॥17॥
slp1: vfzAdarBiprayuktA tu kftyA vikftadarSanA । yAtuDAnIti viKyAtA padminIM tAmarakzata ॥17॥

text: śunaḥsakhasahāyāstu bisārthaṃ te maharṣayaḥ । padminīmabhijagmuste sarve kṛtyābhirakṣitām ॥18॥
html:
śunaḥsakhasahāyāstu bisārthaṃ te maharṣayaḥ ।
padminīmabhijagmuste sarve kṛtyābhirakṣitām ॥18॥
slp1: SunaHsaKasahAyAstu bisArTaM te maharzayaH । padminImaBijagmuste sarve kftyABirakzitAm ॥18॥

text: tataste yātudhānīṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtadarśanām । sthitāṃ kamalinītīre kṛtyāmūcurmaharṣayaḥ ॥19॥
html:
tataste yātudhānīṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtadarśanām ।
sthitāṃ kamalinītīre kṛtyāmūcurmaharṣayaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: tataste yAtuDAnIM tAM dfzwvA vikftadarSanAm । sTitAM kamalinItIre kftyAmUcurmaharzayaH ॥19॥

text: ekā tiṣṭhasi kā nu tvaṃ kasyārthe kiṃ prayojanam । padminītīramāśritya brūhi tvaṃ kiṃ cikīrṣasi ॥20॥
html:
ekā tiṣṭhasi kā nu tvaṃ kasyārthe kiṃ prayojanam ।
padminītīramāśritya brūhi tvaṃ kiṃ cikīrṣasi ॥20॥
slp1: ekA tizWasi kA nu tvaM kasyArTe kiM prayojanam । padminItIramASritya brUhi tvaM kiM cikIrzasi ॥20॥

text: yāsmi sāsmyanuyogo me na kartavyaḥ kathañcana । ārakṣiṇīṃ māṃ padminyā vitta sarve tapodhanāḥ ॥21॥
html:
yāsmi sāsmyanuyogo me na kartavyaḥ kathañcana ।
ārakṣiṇīṃ māṃ padminyā vitta sarve tapodhanāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: yAsmi sAsmyanuyogo me na kartavyaH kaTaYcana । ArakziRIM mAM padminyA vitta sarve tapoDanAH ॥21॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: sarva eva kṣudhārtāḥ sma na cānyatkiñcidasti naḥ । bhavatyāḥ sammate sarve gṛhṇīmahi bisānyuta ॥22॥
html:
sarva eva kṣudhārtāḥ sma na cānyatkiñcidasti naḥ ।
bhavatyāḥ sammate sarve gṛhṇīmahi bisānyuta ॥22॥
slp1: sarva eva kzuDArtAH sma na cAnyatkiYcidasti naH । BavatyAH sammate sarve gfhRImahi bisAnyuta ॥22॥
author: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ।

text: samayena bisānīto gṛhṇīdhvaṃ kāmakārataḥ । ekaiko nāma me proktvā tato gṛhṇīta māciram ॥23॥
html:
samayena bisānīto gṛhṇīdhvaṃ kāmakārataḥ ।
ekaiko nāma me proktvā tato gṛhṇīta māciram ॥23॥
slp1: samayena bisAnIto gfhRIDvaM kAmakArataH । ekEko nAma me proktvA tato gfhRIta mAciram ॥23॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: vijñāya yātudhānīṃ tāṃ kṛtyāmṛṣivadhaiṣiṇīm । atriḥ kṣudhāparītātmā tato vacanamabravīt ॥24॥
html:
vijñāya yātudhānīṃ tāṃ kṛtyāmṛṣivadhaiṣiṇīm ।
atriḥ kṣudhāparītātmā tato vacanamabravīt ॥24॥
slp1: vijYAya yAtuDAnIM tAM kftyAmfzivaDEziRIm । atriH kzuDAparItAtmA tato vacanamabravIt ॥24॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: arātriratreḥ sā rātriryāṃ nādhīte triradya vai । arātriratrirityeva nāma me viddhi śobhane ॥25॥
html:
arātriratreḥ sā rātriryāṃ nādhīte triradya vai ।
arātriratrirityeva nāma me viddhi śobhane ॥25॥
slp1: arAtriratreH sA rAtriryAM nADIte triradya vE । arAtriratrirityeva nAma me vidDi SoBane ॥25॥

text: yathodāhṛtametatte mayi nāma mahāmune । durdhāryametanmanasā gacchāvatara padminīm ॥26॥
html:
yathodāhṛtametatte mayi nāma mahāmune ।
durdhāryametanmanasā gacchāvatara padminīm ॥26॥
slp1: yaTodAhftametatte mayi nAma mahAmune । durDAryametanmanasA gacCAvatara padminIm ॥26॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: vasiṣṭho'smi variṣṭho'smi vase vāsaṃ gṛheṣvapi । variṣṭhatvācca vāsācca vasiṣṭha iti viddhi mām ॥27॥
html:
vasiṣṭho'smi variṣṭho'smi vase vāsaṃ gṛheṣvapi ।
variṣṭhatvācca vāsācca vasiṣṭha iti viddhi mām ॥27॥
slp1: vasizWo'smi varizWo'smi vase vAsaM gfhezvapi । varizWatvAcca vAsAcca vasizWa iti vidDi mAm ॥27॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram । naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥28॥
html:
nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram ।
naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥28॥
slp1: nAmanEruktametatte duHKavyABAzitAkzaram । nEtadDArayituM SakyaM gacCAvatara padminIm ॥28॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: kulaṃ kulaṃ ca kupapaḥ kupayaḥ kaśyapo dvijaḥ । kāśyaḥ kāśanikāśatvādetanme nāma dhāraya ॥29॥
html:
kulaṃ kulaṃ ca kupapaḥ kupayaḥ kaśyapo dvijaḥ ।
kāśyaḥ kāśanikāśatvādetanme nāma dhāraya ॥29॥
slp1: kulaM kulaM ca kupapaH kupayaH kaSyapo dvijaH । kASyaH kASanikASatvAdetanme nAma DAraya ॥29॥
author: kaśyapa uvāca ।

text: yathodāhṛtametatte mayi nāma mahāmune । durdhāryametanmanasā gacchāvatara padminīm ॥30॥
html:
yathodāhṛtametatte mayi nāma mahāmune ।
durdhāryametanmanasā gacchāvatara padminīm ॥30॥
slp1: yaTodAhftametatte mayi nAma mahAmune । durDAryametanmanasA gacCAvatara padminIm ॥30॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: bhare sutānbhare śiṣyānbhare devānbhare dvijān । bhare bhāryāmanavyājo bharadvājo'smi śobhane ॥31॥
html:
bhare sutānbhare śiṣyānbhare devānbhare dvijān ।
bhare bhāryāmanavyājo bharadvājo'smi śobhane ॥31॥
slp1: Bare sutAnBare SizyAnBare devAnBare dvijAn । Bare BAryAmanavyAjo BaradvAjo'smi SoBane ॥31॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram । naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥32॥
html:
nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram ।
naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥32॥
slp1: nAmanEruktametatte duHKavyABAzitAkzaram । nEtadDArayituM SakyaM gacCAvatara padminIm ॥32॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: godamo damago'dhūmo damo durdarśanaśca te । viddhi māṃ gautamaṃ kṛtye yātudhāni nibodha me ॥33॥
html:
godamo damago'dhūmo damo durdarśanaśca te ।
viddhi māṃ gautamaṃ kṛtye yātudhāni nibodha me ॥33॥
slp1: godamo damago'DUmo damo durdarSanaSca te । vidDi mAM gOtamaM kftye yAtuDAni niboDa me ॥33॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: yathodāhṛtametatte mayi nāma mahāmune । naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥34॥
html:
yathodāhṛtametatte mayi nāma mahāmune ।
naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥34॥
slp1: yaTodAhftametatte mayi nAma mahAmune । nEtadDArayituM SakyaM gacCAvatara padminIm ॥34॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: viśvedevāśca me mitraṃ mitramasmi gavāṃ tathā । viśvāmitramiti khyātaṃ yātudhāni nibodha me ॥35॥
html:
viśvedevāśca me mitraṃ mitramasmi gavāṃ tathā ।
viśvāmitramiti khyātaṃ yātudhāni nibodha me ॥35॥
slp1: viSvedevASca me mitraM mitramasmi gavAM taTA । viSvAmitramiti KyAtaM yAtuDAni niboDa me ॥35॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram । naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥36॥
html:
nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram ।
naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥36॥
slp1: nAmanEruktametatte duHKavyABAzitAkzaram । nEtadDArayituM SakyaM gacCAvatara padminIm ॥36॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: jājamadyajajā nāma mṛjā māha jijāyiṣe । jamadagniriti khyātamato māṃ viddhi śobhane ॥37॥
html:
jājamadyajajā nāma mṛjā māha jijāyiṣe ।
jamadagniriti khyātamato māṃ viddhi śobhane ॥37॥
slp1: jAjamadyajajA nAma mfjA mAha jijAyize । jamadagniriti KyAtamato mAM vidDi SoBane ॥37॥
author: jamadagniruvāca ।

text: yathodāhṛtametatte mayi nāma mahāmune । naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥38॥
html:
yathodāhṛtametatte mayi nāma mahāmune ।
naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥38॥
slp1: yaTodAhftametatte mayi nAma mahAmune । nEtadDArayituM SakyaM gacCAvatara padminIm ॥38॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: dharāṃ dharitrīṃ vasudhāṃ bhartustiṣṭhāmyanantaram । mano'nurundhatī bharturiti māṃ viddhyarundhatīm ॥39॥
html:
dharāṃ dharitrīṃ vasudhāṃ bhartustiṣṭhāmyanantaram ।
mano'nurundhatī bharturiti māṃ viddhyarundhatīm ॥39॥
slp1: DarAM DaritrIM vasuDAM BartustizWAmyanantaram । mano'nurunDatI Barturiti mAM vidDyarunDatIm ॥39॥
author: arundhatyuvāca ।

text: nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram । naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥40॥
html:
nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram ।
naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥40॥
slp1: nAmanEruktametatte duHKavyABAzitAkzaram । nEtadDArayituM SakyaM gacCAvatara padminIm ॥40॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: gaṇḍaṃ gaṇḍaṃ gatavatī gaṇḍagaṇḍeti sañjñitā । gaṇḍagaṇḍeva gaṇḍeti viddhi mānalasambhave ॥41॥
html:
gaṇḍaṃ gaṇḍaṃ gatavatī gaṇḍagaṇḍeti sañjñitā ।
gaṇḍagaṇḍeva gaṇḍeti viddhi mānalasambhave ॥41॥
slp1: gaRqaM gaRqaM gatavatI gaRqagaRqeti saYjYitA । gaRqagaRqeva gaRqeti vidDi mAnalasamBave ॥41॥
author: gaṇḍovāca ।

text: nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram । naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥42॥
html:
nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram ।
naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥42॥
slp1: nAmanEruktametatte duHKavyABAzitAkzaram । nEtadDArayituM SakyaM gacCAvatara padminIm ॥42॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: sakhā sakhe yaḥ sakhyeyaḥ paśūnāṃ ca sakhā sadā । gauṇaṃ paśusakhetyevaṃ viddhi māmagnisambhave ॥43॥
html:
sakhā sakhe yaḥ sakhyeyaḥ paśūnāṃ ca sakhā sadā ।
gauṇaṃ paśusakhetyevaṃ viddhi māmagnisambhave ॥43॥
slp1: saKA saKe yaH saKyeyaH paSUnAM ca saKA sadA । gORaM paSusaKetyevaM vidDi mAmagnisamBave ॥43॥
author: paśusakha uvāca ।

text: nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram । naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥44॥
html:
nāmanairuktametatte duḥkhavyābhāṣitākṣaram ।
naitaddhārayituṃ śakyaṃ gacchāvatara padminīm ॥44॥
slp1: nAmanEruktametatte duHKavyABAzitAkzaram । nEtadDArayituM SakyaM gacCAvatara padminIm ॥44॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: ebhiruktaṃ yathā nāma nāhaṃ vaktumihotsahe । śunaḥsakhasakhāyaṃ māṃ yātudhānyupadhāraya ॥45॥
html:
ebhiruktaṃ yathā nāma nāhaṃ vaktumihotsahe ।
śunaḥsakhasakhāyaṃ māṃ yātudhānyupadhāraya ॥45॥
slp1: eBiruktaM yaTA nAma nAhaM vaktumihotsahe । SunaHsaKasaKAyaM mAM yAtuDAnyupaDAraya ॥45॥
author: śunaḥsakha uvāca ।

text: nāma te'vyaktamuktaṃ vai vākyaṃ sandigdhayā girā । tasmātsakṛdidānīṃ tvaṃ brūhi yannāma te dvija ॥46॥
html:
nāma te'vyaktamuktaṃ vai vākyaṃ sandigdhayā girā ।
tasmātsakṛdidānīṃ tvaṃ brūhi yannāma te dvija ॥46॥
slp1: nAma te'vyaktamuktaM vE vAkyaM sandigDayA girA । tasmAtsakfdidAnIM tvaM brUhi yannAma te dvija ॥46॥
author: yātudhānyuvāca ।

text: sakṛduktaṃ mayā nāma na gṛhītaṃ yadā tvayā । tasmāttridaṇḍābhihatā gaccha bhasmeti māciram ॥47॥
html:
sakṛduktaṃ mayā nāma na gṛhītaṃ yadā tvayā ।
tasmāttridaṇḍābhihatā gaccha bhasmeti māciram ॥47॥
slp1: sakfduktaM mayA nAma na gfhItaM yadA tvayA । tasmAttridaRqABihatA gacCa Basmeti mAciram ॥47॥
author: śunaḥsakha uvāca ।

text: sā brahmadaṇḍakalpena tena mūrdhni hatā tadā । kṛtyā papāta medinyāṃ bhasmasācca jagāma ha ॥48॥
html:
sā brahmadaṇḍakalpena tena mūrdhni hatā tadā ।
kṛtyā papāta medinyāṃ bhasmasācca jagāma ha ॥48॥
slp1: sA brahmadaRqakalpena tena mUrDni hatA tadA । kftyA papAta medinyAM BasmasAcca jagAma ha ॥48॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śunaḥsakhaśca hatvā tāṃ yātudhānīṃ mahābalām । bhuvi tridaṇḍaṃ viṣṭabhya śādvale samupāviśat ॥49॥
html:
śunaḥsakhaśca hatvā tāṃ yātudhānīṃ mahābalām ।
bhuvi tridaṇḍaṃ viṣṭabhya śādvale samupāviśat ॥49॥
slp1: SunaHsaKaSca hatvA tAM yAtuDAnIM mahAbalAm । Buvi tridaRqaM vizwaBya SAdvale samupAviSat ॥49॥

text: tataste munayaḥ sarve puṣkarāṇi bisāni ca । yathākāmamupādāya samuttasthurmudānvitāḥ ॥50॥
html:
tataste munayaḥ sarve puṣkarāṇi bisāni ca ।
yathākāmamupādāya samuttasthurmudānvitāḥ ॥50॥
slp1: tataste munayaH sarve puzkarARi bisAni ca । yaTAkAmamupAdAya samuttasTurmudAnvitAH ॥50॥

text: śrameṇa mahatā yuktāste bisāni kalāpaśaḥ । tīre nikṣipya padminyāstarpaṇaṃ cakrurambhasā ॥51॥
html:
śrameṇa mahatā yuktāste bisāni kalāpaśaḥ ।
tīre nikṣipya padminyāstarpaṇaṃ cakrurambhasā ॥51॥
slp1: SrameRa mahatA yuktAste bisAni kalApaSaH । tIre nikzipya padminyAstarpaRaM cakruramBasA ॥51॥

text: athotthāya jalāttasmātsarve te vai samāgaman । nāpaśyaṃścāpi te tāni bisāni puruṣarṣabha ॥52॥
html:
athotthāya jalāttasmātsarve te vai samāgaman ।
nāpaśyaṃścāpi te tāni bisāni puruṣarṣabha ॥52॥
slp1: aTotTAya jalAttasmAtsarve te vE samAgaman । nApaSyaMScApi te tAni bisAni puruzarzaBa ॥52॥

text: kena kṣudhābhibhūtānāmasmākaṃ pāpakarmaṇā । nṛśaṃsenāpanītāni bisānyāhārakāṅkṣiṇām ॥53॥
html:
kena kṣudhābhibhūtānāmasmākaṃ pāpakarmaṇā ।
nṛśaṃsenāpanītāni bisānyāhārakāṅkṣiṇām ॥53॥
slp1: kena kzuDABiBUtAnAmasmAkaM pApakarmaRA । nfSaMsenApanItAni bisAnyAhArakANkziRAm ॥53॥
author: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ।

text: te śaṅkamānāstvanyonyaṃ papracchurdvijasattamāḥ । ta ūcuḥ śapathaṃ sarve kurma ityarikarśana ॥54॥
html:
te śaṅkamānāstvanyonyaṃ papracchurdvijasattamāḥ ।
ta ūcuḥ śapathaṃ sarve kurma ityarikarśana ॥54॥
slp1: te SaNkamAnAstvanyonyaM papracCurdvijasattamAH । ta UcuH SapaTaM sarve kurma ityarikarSana ॥54॥

text: ta uktvā bāḍhamityeva sarva eva śunaḥsakham । kṣudhārtāḥ supariśrāntāḥ śapathāyopacakramuḥ ॥55॥
html:
ta uktvā bāḍhamityeva sarva eva śunaḥsakham ।
kṣudhārtāḥ supariśrāntāḥ śapathāyopacakramuḥ ॥55॥
slp1: ta uktvA bAQamityeva sarva eva SunaHsaKam । kzuDArtAH supariSrAntAH SapaTAyopacakramuH ॥55॥

text: sa gāṃ spṛśatu pādena sūryaṃ ca pratimehatu । anadhyāyeṣvadhīyīta bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥56॥
html:
sa gāṃ spṛśatu pādena sūryaṃ ca pratimehatu ।
anadhyāyeṣvadhīyīta bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: sa gAM spfSatu pAdena sUryaM ca pratimehatu । anaDyAyezvaDIyIta bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥56॥
author: atriruvāca ।

text: anadhyāyaparo loke śunaḥ sa parikarṣatu । parivrāṭkāmavṛtto'stu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥57॥
html:
anadhyāyaparo loke śunaḥ sa parikarṣatu ।
parivrāṭkāmavṛtto'stu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥57॥
slp1: anaDyAyaparo loke SunaH sa parikarzatu । parivrAwkAmavftto'stu bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥57॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: śaraṇāgataṃ hantu mitraṃ svasutāṃ copajīvatu । arthānkāṅkṣatu kīnāśādbisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥58॥
html:
śaraṇāgataṃ hantu mitraṃ svasutāṃ copajīvatu ।
arthānkāṅkṣatu kīnāśādbisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: SaraRAgataM hantu mitraM svasutAM copajIvatu । arTAnkANkzatu kInASAdbisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥58॥

text: sarvatra sarvaṃ paṇatu nyāsalopaṃ karotu ca । kūṭasākṣitvamabhyetu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥59॥
html:
sarvatra sarvaṃ paṇatu nyāsalopaṃ karotu ca ।
kūṭasākṣitvamabhyetu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥59॥
slp1: sarvatra sarvaM paRatu nyAsalopaM karotu ca । kUwasAkzitvamaByetu bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥59॥
author: kaśyapa uvāca ।

text: vṛthāmāṃsaṃ samaśnātu vṛthādānaṃ karotu ca । yātu striyaṃ divā caiva bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥60॥
html:
vṛthāmāṃsaṃ samaśnātu vṛthādānaṃ karotu ca ।
yātu striyaṃ divā caiva bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥60॥
slp1: vfTAmAMsaM samaSnAtu vfTAdAnaM karotu ca । yAtu striyaM divA cEva bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥60॥

text: nṛśaṃsastyaktadharmāstu strīṣu jñātiṣu goṣu ca । brāhmaṇaṃ cāpi jayatāṃ bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥61॥
html:
nṛśaṃsastyaktadharmāstu strīṣu jñātiṣu goṣu ca ।
brāhmaṇaṃ cāpi jayatāṃ bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥61॥
slp1: nfSaMsastyaktaDarmAstu strIzu jYAtizu gozu ca । brAhmaRaM cApi jayatAM bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥61॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: upādhyāyamadhaḥ kṛtvā ṛco'dhyetu yajūṃṣi ca । juhotu ca sa kakṣāgnau bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥62॥
html:
upādhyāyamadhaḥ kṛtvā ṛco'dhyetu yajūṃṣi ca ।
juhotu ca sa kakṣāgnau bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥62॥
slp1: upADyAyamaDaH kftvA fco'Dyetu yajUMzi ca । juhotu ca sa kakzAgnO bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥62॥

text: purīṣamutsṛjatvapsu hantu gāṃ cāpi dohinīm । anṛtau maithunaṃ yātu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥63॥
html:
purīṣamutsṛjatvapsu hantu gāṃ cāpi dohinīm ।
anṛtau maithunaṃ yātu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥63॥
slp1: purIzamutsfjatvapsu hantu gAM cApi dohinIm । anftO mETunaM yAtu bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥63॥
author: jamadagniruvāca ।

text: dveṣyo bhāryopajīvī syāddūrabandhuśca vairavān । anyonyasyātithiścāstu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥64॥
html:
dveṣyo bhāryopajīvī syāddūrabandhuśca vairavān ।
anyonyasyātithiścāstu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥64॥
slp1: dvezyo BAryopajIvI syAddUrabanDuSca vEravAn । anyonyasyAtiTiScAstu bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥64॥

text: adhītya vedāṃstyajatu trīnagnīnapavidhyatu । vikrīṇātu tathā somaṃ bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥65॥
html:
adhītya vedāṃstyajatu trīnagnīnapavidhyatu ।
vikrīṇātu tathā somaṃ bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥65॥
slp1: aDItya vedAMstyajatu trInagnInapaviDyatu । vikrIRAtu taTA somaM bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥65॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: udapānaplave grāme brāhmaṇo vṛṣalīpatiḥ । tasya sālokyatāṃ yātu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥66॥
html:
udapānaplave grāme brāhmaṇo vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।
tasya sālokyatāṃ yātu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥66॥
slp1: udapAnaplave grAme brAhmaRo vfzalIpatiH । tasya sAlokyatAM yAtu bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥66॥

text: jīvato vai gurūnbhṛtyānbharantvasya pare janāḥ । agatirbahuputraḥ syādbisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥67॥
html:
jīvato vai gurūnbhṛtyānbharantvasya pare janāḥ ।
agatirbahuputraḥ syādbisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥67॥
slp1: jIvato vE gurUnBftyAnBarantvasya pare janAH । agatirbahuputraH syAdbisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥67॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: aśucirbrahmakūṭo'stu ṛddhyā caivāpyahaṅkṛtaḥ । karṣako matsarī cāstu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥68॥
html:
aśucirbrahmakūṭo'stu ṛddhyā caivāpyahaṅkṛtaḥ ।
karṣako matsarī cāstu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥68॥
slp1: aSucirbrahmakUwo'stu fdDyA cEvApyahaNkftaH । karzako matsarI cAstu bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥68॥

text: varṣānkarotu bhṛtako rājñaścāstu purohitaḥ । ayājyasya bhavedṛtvigbisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥69॥
html:
varṣānkarotu bhṛtako rājñaścāstu purohitaḥ ।
ayājyasya bhavedṛtvigbisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥69॥
slp1: varzAnkarotu Bftako rAjYaScAstu purohitaH । ayAjyasya BavedftvigbisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥69॥

text: nityaṃ parivadecchvaśrūṃ bharturbhavatu durmanāḥ । ekā svādu samaśnātu bisastainyaṃ karoti yā ॥70॥
html:
nityaṃ parivadecchvaśrūṃ bharturbhavatu durmanāḥ ।
ekā svādu samaśnātu bisastainyaṃ karoti yā ॥70॥
slp1: nityaM parivadecCvaSrUM BarturBavatu durmanAH । ekA svAdu samaSnAtu bisastEnyaM karoti yA ॥70॥
author: arundhatyuvāca ।

text: jñātīnāṃ gṛhamadhyasthā saktūnattu dinakṣaye । abhāgyāvīrasūrastu bisastainyaṃ karoti yā ॥71॥
html:
jñātīnāṃ gṛhamadhyasthā saktūnattu dinakṣaye ।
abhāgyāvīrasūrastu bisastainyaṃ karoti yā ॥71॥
slp1: jYAtInAM gfhamaDyasTA saktUnattu dinakzaye । aBAgyAvIrasUrastu bisastEnyaM karoti yA ॥71॥

text: anṛtaṃ bhāṣatu sadā sādhubhiśca virudhyatu । dadātu kanyāṃ śulkena bisastainyaṃ karoti yā ॥72॥
html:
anṛtaṃ bhāṣatu sadā sādhubhiśca virudhyatu ।
dadātu kanyāṃ śulkena bisastainyaṃ karoti yā ॥72॥
slp1: anftaM BAzatu sadA sADuBiSca viruDyatu । dadAtu kanyAM Sulkena bisastEnyaM karoti yA ॥72॥
author: gaṇḍovāca ।

text: sādhayitvā svayaṃ prāśeddāsye jīvatu caiva ha । vikarmaṇā pramīyeta bisastainyaṃ karoti yā ॥73॥
html:
sādhayitvā svayaṃ prāśeddāsye jīvatu caiva ha ।
vikarmaṇā pramīyeta bisastainyaṃ karoti yā ॥73॥
slp1: sADayitvA svayaM prASeddAsye jIvatu cEva ha । vikarmaRA pramIyeta bisastEnyaM karoti yA ॥73॥

text: dāsya eva prajāyeta so'prasūtirakiñcanaḥ । daivateṣvanamaskāro bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥74॥
html:
dāsya eva prajāyeta so'prasūtirakiñcanaḥ ।
daivateṣvanamaskāro bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ॥74॥
slp1: dAsya eva prajAyeta so'prasUtirakiYcanaH । dEvatezvanamaskAro bisastEnyaM karoti yaH ॥74॥
author: paśusakha uvāca ।

text: adhvaryave duhitaraṃ dadātu cchandoge vā caritabrahmacarye । ātharvaṇaṃ vedamadhītya vipraḥ snāyīta yo vai harate bisāni ॥75॥
html:
adhvaryave duhitaraṃ dadātu cchandoge vā caritabrahmacarye ।
ātharvaṇaṃ vedamadhītya vipraḥ snāyīta yo vai harate bisāni ॥75॥
slp1: aDvaryave duhitaraM dadAtu cCandoge vA caritabrahmacarye । ATarvaRaM vedamaDItya vipraH snAyIta yo vE harate bisAni ॥75॥
author: śunaḥsakha uvāca ।

text: iṣṭametaddvijātīnāṃ yo'yaṃ te śapathaḥ kṛtaḥ । tvayā kṛtaṃ bisastainyaṃ sarveṣāṃ naḥ śunaḥsakha ॥76॥
html:
iṣṭametaddvijātīnāṃ yo'yaṃ te śapathaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
tvayā kṛtaṃ bisastainyaṃ sarveṣāṃ naḥ śunaḥsakha ॥76॥
slp1: izwametaddvijAtInAM yo'yaM te SapaTaH kftaH । tvayA kftaM bisastEnyaM sarvezAM naH SunaHsaKa ॥76॥
author: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ।

text: nyastamādyamapaśyadbhiryaduktaṃ kṛtakarmabhiḥ । satyametanna mithyaitadbisastainyaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ॥77॥
html:
nyastamādyamapaśyadbhiryaduktaṃ kṛtakarmabhiḥ ।
satyametanna mithyaitadbisastainyaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ॥77॥
slp1: nyastamAdyamapaSyadBiryaduktaM kftakarmaBiH । satyametanna miTyEtadbisastEnyaM kftaM mayA ॥77॥
author: śunaḥsakha uvāca ।

text: mayā hyantarhitānīha bisānīmāni paśyata । parīkṣārthaṃ bhagavatāṃ kṛtametanmayānaghāḥ । rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhavatāmahamāgataḥ ॥78॥
html:
mayā hyantarhitānīha bisānīmāni paśyata ।
parīkṣārthaṃ bhagavatāṃ kṛtametanmayānaghāḥ ।
rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhavatāmahamāgataḥ ॥78॥
slp1: mayA hyantarhitAnIha bisAnImAni paSyata । parIkzArTaM BagavatAM kftametanmayAnaGAH । rakzaRArTaM ca sarvezAM BavatAmahamAgataH ॥78॥

text: yātudhānī hyatikruddhā kṛtyaiṣā vo vadhaiṣiṇī । vṛṣādarbhiprayuktaiṣā nihatā me tapodhanāḥ ॥79॥
html:
yātudhānī hyatikruddhā kṛtyaiṣā vo vadhaiṣiṇī ।
vṛṣādarbhiprayuktaiṣā nihatā me tapodhanāḥ ॥79॥
