slp1: yAtuDAnI hyatikrudDA kftyEzA vo vaDEziRI । vfzAdarBiprayuktEzA nihatA me tapoDanAH ॥79॥

text: duṣṭā hiṃsyādiyaṃ pāpā yuṣmānpratyagnisambhavā । tasmādasmyāgato viprā vāsavaṃ māṃ nibodhata ॥80॥
html:
duṣṭā hiṃsyādiyaṃ pāpā yuṣmānpratyagnisambhavā ।
tasmādasmyāgato viprā vāsavaṃ māṃ nibodhata ॥80॥
slp1: duzwA hiMsyAdiyaM pApA yuzmAnpratyagnisamBavA । tasmAdasmyAgato viprA vAsavaM mAM niboData ॥80॥

text: alobhādakṣayā lokāḥ prāptā vaḥ sārvakāmikāḥ । uttiṣṭhadhvamitaḥ kṣipraṃ tānavāpnuta vai dvijāḥ ॥81॥
html:
alobhādakṣayā lokāḥ prāptā vaḥ sārvakāmikāḥ ।
uttiṣṭhadhvamitaḥ kṣipraṃ tānavāpnuta vai dvijāḥ ॥81॥
slp1: aloBAdakzayA lokAH prAptA vaH sArvakAmikAH । uttizWaDvamitaH kzipraM tAnavApnuta vE dvijAH ॥81॥

text: tato maharṣayaḥ prītāstathetyuktvā purandaram । sahaiva tridaśendreṇa sarve jagmustriviṣṭapam ॥82॥
html:
tato maharṣayaḥ prītāstathetyuktvā purandaram ।
sahaiva tridaśendreṇa sarve jagmustriviṣṭapam ॥82॥
slp1: tato maharzayaH prItAstaTetyuktvA purandaram । sahEva tridaSendreRa sarve jagmustrivizwapam ॥82॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: evamete mahātmāno bhogairbahuvidhairapi । kṣudhā paramayā yuktāśchandyamānā mahātmabhiḥ । naiva lobhaṃ tadā cakrustataḥ svargamavāpnuvan ॥83॥
html:
evamete mahātmāno bhogairbahuvidhairapi ।
kṣudhā paramayā yuktāśchandyamānā mahātmabhiḥ ।
naiva lobhaṃ tadā cakrustataḥ svargamavāpnuvan ॥83॥
slp1: evamete mahAtmAno BogErbahuviDErapi । kzuDA paramayA yuktASCandyamAnA mahAtmaBiH । nEva loBaM tadA cakrustataH svargamavApnuvan ॥83॥

text: tasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu naro lobhaṃ vivarjayet । eṣa dharmaḥ paro rājannalobha iti viśrutaḥ ॥84॥
html:
tasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu naro lobhaṃ vivarjayet ।
eṣa dharmaḥ paro rājannalobha iti viśrutaḥ ॥84॥
slp1: tasmAtsarvAsvavasTAsu naro loBaM vivarjayet । eza DarmaH paro rAjannaloBa iti viSrutaH ॥84॥

text: idaṃ naraḥ saccaritaṃ samavāyeṣu kīrtayet । sukhabhāgī ca bhavati na ca durgāṇyavāpnute ॥85॥
html:
idaṃ naraḥ saccaritaṃ samavāyeṣu kīrtayet ।
sukhabhāgī ca bhavati na ca durgāṇyavāpnute ॥85॥
slp1: idaM naraH saccaritaM samavAyezu kIrtayet । suKaBAgI ca Bavati na ca durgARyavApnute ॥85॥

text: prīyante pitaraścāsya ṛṣayo devatāstathā । yaśodharmārthabhāgī ca bhavati pretya mānavaḥ] ॥86॥
html:
prīyante pitaraścāsya ṛṣayo devatāstathā ।
yaśodharmārthabhāgī ca bhavati pretya mānavaḥ] ॥86॥
slp1: prIyante pitaraScAsya fzayo devatAstaTA । yaSoDarmArTaBAgI ca Bavati pretya mAnavaH] ॥86॥

text: atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । yadvṛttaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ śapathaṃ prati tacchṛṇu ॥1॥
html:
atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
yadvṛttaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ śapathaṃ prati tacchṛṇu ॥1॥
slp1: atrEvodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । yadvfttaM tIrTayAtrAyAM SapaTaM prati tacCfRu ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: puṣkarārthaṃ kṛtaṃ stainyaṃ purā bharatasattama । rājarṣibhirmahārāja tathaiva ca dvijarṣibhiḥ ॥2॥
html:
puṣkarārthaṃ kṛtaṃ stainyaṃ purā bharatasattama ।
rājarṣibhirmahārāja tathaiva ca dvijarṣibhiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: puzkarArTaM kftaM stEnyaM purA Baratasattama । rAjarziBirmahArAja taTEva ca dvijarziBiH ॥2॥

text: ṛṣayaḥ sametāḥ paścime vai prabhāse samāgatā mantramamantrayanta । carāma sarve pṛthivīṃ puṇyatīrthāṃ tannaḥ kāryaṃ hanta gacchāma sarve ॥3॥
html:
ṛṣayaḥ sametāḥ paścime vai prabhāse samāgatā mantramamantrayanta ।
carāma sarve pṛthivīṃ puṇyatīrthāṃ tannaḥ kāryaṃ hanta gacchāma sarve ॥3॥
slp1: fzayaH sametAH paScime vE praBAse samAgatA mantramamantrayanta । carAma sarve pfTivIM puRyatIrTAM tannaH kAryaM hanta gacCAma sarve ॥3॥

text: śukro'ṅgirāścaiva kaviśca vidvāṃstathāgastyo nāradaparvatau ca । bhṛgurvasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo gautamaśca viśvāmitro jamadagniśca rājan ॥4॥
html:
śukro'ṅgirāścaiva kaviśca vidvāṃstathāgastyo nāradaparvatau ca ।
bhṛgurvasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo gautamaśca viśvāmitro jamadagniśca rājan ॥4॥
slp1: Sukro'NgirAScEva kaviSca vidvAMstaTAgastyo nAradaparvatO ca । BfgurvasizWaH kaSyapo gOtamaSca viSvAmitro jamadagniSca rAjan ॥4॥

text: ṛṣistathā gālavo'thāṣṭakaśca bharadvājo'rundhatī vālakhilyāḥ । śibirdilīpo nahuṣo'mbarīṣo rājā yayātirdhundhumāro'tha pūruḥ ॥5॥
html:
ṛṣistathā gālavo'thāṣṭakaśca bharadvājo'rundhatī vālakhilyāḥ ।
śibirdilīpo nahuṣo'mbarīṣo rājā yayātirdhundhumāro'tha pūruḥ ॥5॥
slp1: fzistaTA gAlavo'TAzwakaSca BaradvAjo'runDatI vAlaKilyAH । SibirdilIpo nahuzo'mbarIzo rAjA yayAtirDunDumAro'Ta pUruH ॥5॥

text: jagmuḥ puraskṛtya mahānubhāvaṃ śatakratuṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ narendra । tīrthāni sarvāṇi parikramanto māghyāṃ yayuḥ kauśikīṃ puṇyatīrthām ॥6॥
html:
jagmuḥ puraskṛtya mahānubhāvaṃ śatakratuṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ narendra ।
tīrthāni sarvāṇi parikramanto māghyāṃ yayuḥ kauśikīṃ puṇyatīrthām ॥6॥
slp1: jagmuH puraskftya mahAnuBAvaM SatakratuM vftrahaRaM narendra । tIrTAni sarvARi parikramanto mAGyAM yayuH kOSikIM puRyatIrTAm ॥6॥

text: sarveṣu tīrtheṣvatha dhūtapāpā jagmustato brahmasaraḥ supuṇyam । devasya tīrthe jalamagnikalpā vigāhya te bhuktabisaprasūnāḥ ॥7॥
html:
sarveṣu tīrtheṣvatha dhūtapāpā jagmustato brahmasaraḥ supuṇyam ।
devasya tīrthe jalamagnikalpā vigāhya te bhuktabisaprasūnāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: sarvezu tIrTezvaTa DUtapApA jagmustato brahmasaraH supuRyam । devasya tIrTe jalamagnikalpA vigAhya te BuktabisaprasUnAH ॥7॥

text: kecidbisānyakhanaṃstatra rājannanye mṛṇālānyakhanaṃstatra viprāḥ । athāpaśyanpuṣkaraṃ te hriyantaṃ hradādagastyena samuddhṛtaṃ vai ॥8॥
html:
kecidbisānyakhanaṃstatra rājannanye mṛṇālānyakhanaṃstatra viprāḥ ।
athāpaśyanpuṣkaraṃ te hriyantaṃ hradādagastyena samuddhṛtaṃ vai ॥8॥
slp1: kecidbisAnyaKanaMstatra rAjannanye mfRAlAnyaKanaMstatra viprAH । aTApaSyanpuzkaraM te hriyantaM hradAdagastyena samudDftaM vE ॥8॥

text: tānāha sarvānṛṣimukhyānagastyaḥ kenādattaṃ puṣkaraṃ me sujātam । yuṣmāñśaṅke dīyatāṃ puṣkaraṃ me na vai bhavanto hartumarhanti padmam ॥9॥
html:
tānāha sarvānṛṣimukhyānagastyaḥ kenādattaṃ puṣkaraṃ me sujātam ।
yuṣmāñśaṅke dīyatāṃ puṣkaraṃ me na vai bhavanto hartumarhanti padmam ॥9॥
slp1: tAnAha sarvAnfzimuKyAnagastyaH kenAdattaM puzkaraM me sujAtam । yuzmAYSaNke dIyatAM puzkaraM me na vE Bavanto hartumarhanti padmam ॥9॥

text: śṛṇomi kālo hiṃsate dharmavīryaṃ seyaṃ prāptā vardhate dharmapīḍā । purādharmo vardhate neha yāvattāvadgacchāmi paralokaṃ cirāya ॥10॥
html:
śṛṇomi kālo hiṃsate dharmavīryaṃ seyaṃ prāptā vardhate dharmapīḍā ।
purādharmo vardhate neha yāvattāvadgacchāmi paralokaṃ cirāya ॥10॥
slp1: SfRomi kAlo hiMsate DarmavIryaM seyaM prAptA varDate DarmapIqA । purADarmo varDate neha yAvattAvadgacCAmi paralokaM cirAya ॥10॥

text: purā vedānbrāhmaṇā grāmamadhye ghuṣṭasvarā vṛṣalāñśrāvayanti । purā rājā vyavahārānadharmyānpaśyatyahaṃ paralokaṃ vrajāmi ॥11॥
html:
purā vedānbrāhmaṇā grāmamadhye ghuṣṭasvarā vṛṣalāñśrāvayanti ।
purā rājā vyavahārānadharmyānpaśyatyahaṃ paralokaṃ vrajāmi ॥11॥
slp1: purA vedAnbrAhmaRA grAmamaDye GuzwasvarA vfzalAYSrAvayanti । purA rAjA vyavahArAnaDarmyAnpaSyatyahaM paralokaM vrajAmi ॥11॥

text: purāvarānpratyavarāngarīyaso yāvannarā nāvamaṃsyanti sarve । tamottaraṃ yāvadidaṃ na vartate tāvadvrajāmi paralokaṃ cirāya ॥12॥
html:
purāvarānpratyavarāngarīyaso yāvannarā nāvamaṃsyanti sarve ।
tamottaraṃ yāvadidaṃ na vartate tāvadvrajāmi paralokaṃ cirāya ॥12॥
slp1: purAvarAnpratyavarAngarIyaso yAvannarA nAvamaMsyanti sarve । tamottaraM yAvadidaM na vartate tAvadvrajAmi paralokaM cirAya ॥12॥

text: purā prapaśyāmi pareṇa martyānbalīyasā durbalānbhujyamānān । tasmādyāsyāmi paralokaṃ cirāya na hyutsahe draṣṭumīdṛṅnṛloke ॥13॥
html:
purā prapaśyāmi pareṇa martyānbalīyasā durbalānbhujyamānān ।
tasmādyāsyāmi paralokaṃ cirāya na hyutsahe draṣṭumīdṛṅnṛloke ॥13॥
slp1: purA prapaSyAmi pareRa martyAnbalIyasA durbalAnBujyamAnAn । tasmAdyAsyAmi paralokaM cirAya na hyutsahe drazwumIdfNnfloke ॥13॥

text: tamāhurārtā ṛṣayo maharṣiṃ na te vayaṃ puṣkaraṃ corayāmaḥ । mithyābhiṣaṅgo bhavatā na kāryaḥ śapāma tīkṣṇāñśapathānmaharṣe ॥14॥
html:
tamāhurārtā ṛṣayo maharṣiṃ na te vayaṃ puṣkaraṃ corayāmaḥ ।
mithyābhiṣaṅgo bhavatā na kāryaḥ śapāma tīkṣṇāñśapathānmaharṣe ॥14॥
slp1: tamAhurArtA fzayo maharziM na te vayaM puzkaraM corayAmaH । miTyABizaNgo BavatA na kAryaH SapAma tIkzRAYSapaTAnmaharze ॥14॥

text: te niścitāstatra maharṣayastu sammanyanto dharmamevaṃ narendra । tato'śapañśapathānparyayeṇa sahaiva te pārthiva putrapautraiḥ ॥15॥
html:
te niścitāstatra maharṣayastu sammanyanto dharmamevaṃ narendra ।
tato'śapañśapathānparyayeṇa sahaiva te pārthiva putrapautraiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: te niScitAstatra maharzayastu sammanyanto DarmamevaM narendra । tato'SapaYSapaTAnparyayeRa sahEva te pArTiva putrapOtrEH ॥15॥

text: pratyākrośedihākruṣṭastāḍitaḥ pratitāḍayet । khādecca pṛṣṭhamāṃsāni yaste harati puṣkaram ॥16॥
html:
pratyākrośedihākruṣṭastāḍitaḥ pratitāḍayet ।
khādecca pṛṣṭhamāṃsāni yaste harati puṣkaram ॥16॥
slp1: pratyAkroSedihAkruzwastAqitaH pratitAqayet । KAdecca pfzWamAMsAni yaste harati puzkaram ॥16॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: asvādhyāyaparo loke śvānaṃ ca parikarṣatu । pure ca bhikṣurbhavatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥17॥
html:
asvādhyāyaparo loke śvānaṃ ca parikarṣatu ।
pure ca bhikṣurbhavatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥17॥
slp1: asvADyAyaparo loke SvAnaM ca parikarzatu । pure ca BikzurBavatu yaste harati puzkaram ॥17॥
author: vasiṣṭha uvāca ।

text: sarvatra sarvaṃ paṇatu nyāse lobhaṃ karotu ca । kūṭasākṣitvamabhyetu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥18॥
html:
sarvatra sarvaṃ paṇatu nyāse lobhaṃ karotu ca ।
kūṭasākṣitvamabhyetu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥18॥
slp1: sarvatra sarvaM paRatu nyAse loBaM karotu ca । kUwasAkzitvamaByetu yaste harati puzkaram ॥18॥
author: kaśyapa uvāca ।

text: jīvatvahaṅkṛto buddhyā vipaṇatvadhamena saḥ । karṣako matsarī cāstu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥19॥
html:
jīvatvahaṅkṛto buddhyā vipaṇatvadhamena saḥ ।
karṣako matsarī cāstu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥19॥
slp1: jIvatvahaNkfto budDyA vipaRatvaDamena saH । karzako matsarI cAstu yaste harati puzkaram ॥19॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: aśucirbrahmakūṭo'stu śvānaṃ ca parikarṣatu । brahmahānikṛtiścāstu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥20॥
html:
aśucirbrahmakūṭo'stu śvānaṃ ca parikarṣatu ।
brahmahānikṛtiścāstu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥20॥
slp1: aSucirbrahmakUwo'stu SvAnaM ca parikarzatu । brahmahAnikftiScAstu yaste harati puzkaram ॥20॥
author: aṅgirā uvāca ।

text: akṛtajño'stu mitrāṇāṃ śūdrāyāṃ tu prajāyatu । ekaḥ sampannamaśnātu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥21॥
html:
akṛtajño'stu mitrāṇāṃ śūdrāyāṃ tu prajāyatu ।
ekaḥ sampannamaśnātu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥21॥
slp1: akftajYo'stu mitrARAM SUdrAyAM tu prajAyatu । ekaH sampannamaSnAtu yaste harati puzkaram ॥21॥
author: dhundhumāra uvāca ।

text: cikitsāyāṃ pracaratu bhāryayā caiva puṣyatu । śvaśurāttasya vṛttiḥ syādyaste harati puṣkaram ॥22॥
html:
cikitsāyāṃ pracaratu bhāryayā caiva puṣyatu ।
śvaśurāttasya vṛttiḥ syādyaste harati puṣkaram ॥22॥
slp1: cikitsAyAM pracaratu BAryayA cEva puzyatu । SvaSurAttasya vfttiH syAdyaste harati puzkaram ॥22॥
author: pūruruvāca ।

text: udapānaplave grāme brāhmaṇo vṛṣalīpatiḥ । tasya lokānsa vrajatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥23॥
html:
udapānaplave grāme brāhmaṇo vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।
tasya lokānsa vrajatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥23॥
slp1: udapAnaplave grAme brAhmaRo vfzalIpatiH । tasya lokAnsa vrajatu yaste harati puzkaram ॥23॥
author: dilīpa uvāca ।

text: pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ samaśnātu divā gacchatu maithunam । preṣyo bhavatu rājñaśca yaste harati puṣkaram ॥24॥
html:
pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ samaśnātu divā gacchatu maithunam ।
preṣyo bhavatu rājñaśca yaste harati puṣkaram ॥24॥
slp1: pfzWamAMsaM samaSnAtu divA gacCatu mETunam । prezyo Bavatu rAjYaSca yaste harati puzkaram ॥24॥
author: śukra uvāca ।

text: anadhyāyeṣvadhīyīta mitraṃ śrāddhe ca bhojayet । śrāddhe śūdrasya cāśnīyādyaste harati puṣkaram ॥25॥
html:
anadhyāyeṣvadhīyīta mitraṃ śrāddhe ca bhojayet ।
śrāddhe śūdrasya cāśnīyādyaste harati puṣkaram ॥25॥
slp1: anaDyAyezvaDIyIta mitraM SrAdDe ca Bojayet । SrAdDe SUdrasya cASnIyAdyaste harati puzkaram ॥25॥
author: jamadagniruvāca ।

text: anāhitāgnirmriyatāṃ yajñe vighnaṃ karotu ca । tapasvibhirvirudhyeta yaste harati puṣkaram ॥26॥
html:
anāhitāgnirmriyatāṃ yajñe vighnaṃ karotu ca ।
tapasvibhirvirudhyeta yaste harati puṣkaram ॥26॥
slp1: anAhitAgnirmriyatAM yajYe viGnaM karotu ca । tapasviBirviruDyeta yaste harati puzkaram ॥26॥
author: śibiruvāca ।

text: anṛtau jaṭī vratinyāṃ vai bhāryāyāṃ samprajāyatu । nirākarotu vedāṃśca yaste harati puṣkaram ॥27॥
html:
anṛtau jaṭī vratinyāṃ vai bhāryāyāṃ samprajāyatu ।
nirākarotu vedāṃśca yaste harati puṣkaram ॥27॥
slp1: anftO jawI vratinyAM vE BAryAyAM samprajAyatu । nirAkarotu vedAMSca yaste harati puzkaram ॥27॥
author: yayātiruvāca ।

text: atithiṃ gṛhastho nudatu kāmavṛtto'stu dīkṣitaḥ । vidyāṃ prayacchatu bhṛto yaste harati puṣkaram ॥28॥
html:
atithiṃ gṛhastho nudatu kāmavṛtto'stu dīkṣitaḥ ।
vidyāṃ prayacchatu bhṛto yaste harati puṣkaram ॥28॥
slp1: atiTiM gfhasTo nudatu kAmavftto'stu dIkzitaH । vidyAM prayacCatu Bfto yaste harati puzkaram ॥28॥
author: nahuṣa uvāca ।

text: nṛśaṃsastyaktadharmo'stu strīṣu jñātiṣu goṣu ca । brāhmaṇaṃ cāpi jahatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥29॥
html:
nṛśaṃsastyaktadharmo'stu strīṣu jñātiṣu goṣu ca ।
brāhmaṇaṃ cāpi jahatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥29॥
slp1: nfSaMsastyaktaDarmo'stu strIzu jYAtizu gozu ca । brAhmaRaM cApi jahatu yaste harati puzkaram ॥29॥
author: ambarīṣa uvāca ।

text: gūḍho'jñānī bahiḥ śāstraṃ paṭhatāṃ visvaraṃ padam । garīyaso'vajānātu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥30॥
html:
gūḍho'jñānī bahiḥ śāstraṃ paṭhatāṃ visvaraṃ padam ।
garīyaso'vajānātu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥30॥
slp1: gUQo'jYAnI bahiH SAstraM paWatAM visvaraM padam । garIyaso'vajAnAtu yaste harati puzkaram ॥30॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: anṛtaṃ bhāṣatu sadā sadbhiścaiva virudhyatu । śulkena kanyāṃ dadatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥31॥
html:
anṛtaṃ bhāṣatu sadā sadbhiścaiva virudhyatu ।
śulkena kanyāṃ dadatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥31॥
slp1: anftaM BAzatu sadA sadBiScEva viruDyatu । Sulkena kanyAM dadatu yaste harati puzkaram ॥31॥
author: nābhāga uvāca ।

text: padā sa gāṃ tāḍayatu sūryaṃ ca prati mehatu । śaraṇāgataṃ ca tyajatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥32॥
html:
padā sa gāṃ tāḍayatu sūryaṃ ca prati mehatu ।
śaraṇāgataṃ ca tyajatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥32॥
slp1: padA sa gAM tAqayatu sUryaM ca prati mehatu । SaraRAgataM ca tyajatu yaste harati puzkaram ॥32॥
author: kaviruvāca ।

text: karotu bhṛtako'varṣāṃ rājñaścāstu purohitaḥ । ṛtvigastu hyayājyasya yaste harati puṣkaram ॥33॥
html:
karotu bhṛtako'varṣāṃ rājñaścāstu purohitaḥ ।
ṛtvigastu hyayājyasya yaste harati puṣkaram ॥33॥
slp1: karotu Bftako'varzAM rAjYaScAstu purohitaH । ftvigastu hyayAjyasya yaste harati puzkaram ॥33॥
author: viśvāmitra uvāca ।

text: grāme cādhikṛtaḥ so'stu kharayānena gacchatu । śunaḥ karṣatu vṛttyarthe yaste harati puṣkaram ॥34॥
html:
grāme cādhikṛtaḥ so'stu kharayānena gacchatu ।
śunaḥ karṣatu vṛttyarthe yaste harati puṣkaram ॥34॥
slp1: grAme cADikftaH so'stu KarayAnena gacCatu । SunaH karzatu vfttyarTe yaste harati puzkaram ॥34॥
author: parvata uvāca ।

text: sarvapāpasamādānaṃ nṛśaṃse cānṛte ca yat । tattasyāstu sadā pāpaṃ yaste harati puṣkaram ॥35॥
html:
sarvapāpasamādānaṃ nṛśaṃse cānṛte ca yat ।
tattasyāstu sadā pāpaṃ yaste harati puṣkaram ॥35॥
slp1: sarvapApasamAdAnaM nfSaMse cAnfte ca yat । tattasyAstu sadA pApaM yaste harati puzkaram ॥35॥
author: bharadvāja uvāca ।

text: sa rājāstvakṛtaprajñaḥ kāmavṛttiśca pāpakṛt । adharmeṇānuśāstūrvīṃ yaste harati puṣkaram ॥36॥
html:
sa rājāstvakṛtaprajñaḥ kāmavṛttiśca pāpakṛt ।
adharmeṇānuśāstūrvīṃ yaste harati puṣkaram ॥36॥
slp1: sa rAjAstvakftaprajYaH kAmavfttiSca pApakft । aDarmeRAnuSAstUrvIM yaste harati puzkaram ॥36॥
author: aṣṭaka uvāca ।

text: pāpiṣṭhebhyastvanarghārhaḥ sa naro'stu svapāpakṛt । dattvā dānaṃ kīrtayatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥37॥
html:
pāpiṣṭhebhyastvanarghārhaḥ sa naro'stu svapāpakṛt ।
dattvā dānaṃ kīrtayatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥37॥
slp1: pApizWeByastvanarGArhaH sa naro'stu svapApakft । dattvA dAnaM kIrtayatu yaste harati puzkaram ॥37॥
author: gālava uvāca ।

text: śvaśrvāpavādaṃ vadatu bharturbhavatu durmanāḥ । ekā svādu samaśnātu yā te harati puṣkaram ॥38॥
html:
śvaśrvāpavādaṃ vadatu bharturbhavatu durmanāḥ ।
ekā svādu samaśnātu yā te harati puṣkaram ॥38॥
slp1: SvaSrvApavAdaM vadatu BarturBavatu durmanAH । ekA svAdu samaSnAtu yA te harati puzkaram ॥38॥
author: arundhatyuvāca ।

text: ekapādena vṛttyarthaṃ grāmadvāre sa tiṣṭhatu । dharmajñastyaktadharmo'stu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥39॥
html:
ekapādena vṛttyarthaṃ grāmadvāre sa tiṣṭhatu ।
dharmajñastyaktadharmo'stu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥39॥
slp1: ekapAdena vfttyarTaM grAmadvAre sa tizWatu । DarmajYastyaktaDarmo'stu yaste harati puzkaram ॥39॥
author: vālakhilyā ūcuḥ ।

text: agnihotramanādṛtya sukhaṃ svapatu sa dvijaḥ । parivrāṭkāmavṛtto'stu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥40॥
html:
agnihotramanādṛtya sukhaṃ svapatu sa dvijaḥ ।
parivrāṭkāmavṛtto'stu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥40॥
slp1: agnihotramanAdftya suKaM svapatu sa dvijaH । parivrAwkAmavftto'stu yaste harati puzkaram ॥40॥
author: paśusakha uvāca ।

text: bālvajena nidānena kāṃsyaṃ bhavatu dohanam । duhyeta paravatsena yā te harati puṣkaram ॥41॥
html:
bālvajena nidānena kāṃsyaṃ bhavatu dohanam ।
duhyeta paravatsena yā te harati puṣkaram ॥41॥
slp1: bAlvajena nidAnena kAMsyaM Bavatu dohanam । duhyeta paravatsena yA te harati puzkaram ॥41॥
author: surabhyuvāca ।

text: tatastu taiḥ śapathaiḥ śapyamānairnānāvidhairbahubhiḥ kauravendra । sahasrākṣo devarāṭsamprahṛṣṭaḥ samīkṣya taṃ kopanaṃ vipramukhyam ॥42॥
html:
tatastu taiḥ śapathaiḥ śapyamānairnānāvidhairbahubhiḥ kauravendra ।
sahasrākṣo devarāṭsamprahṛṣṭaḥ samīkṣya taṃ kopanaṃ vipramukhyam ॥42॥
slp1: tatastu tEH SapaTEH SapyamAnErnAnAviDErbahuBiH kOravendra । sahasrAkzo devarAwsamprahfzwaH samIkzya taM kopanaM vipramuKyam ॥42॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: athābravīnmaghavā pratyayaṃ svaṃ samābhāṣya tamṛṣiṃ jātaroṣam । brahmarṣidevarṣinṛparṣimadhye yattannibodheha mamādya rājan ॥43॥
html:
athābravīnmaghavā pratyayaṃ svaṃ samābhāṣya tamṛṣiṃ jātaroṣam ।
brahmarṣidevarṣinṛparṣimadhye yattannibodheha mamādya rājan ॥43॥
slp1: aTAbravInmaGavA pratyayaM svaM samABAzya tamfziM jAtarozam । brahmarzidevarzinfparzimaDye yattanniboDeha mamAdya rAjan ॥43॥

text: adhvaryave duhitaraṃ dadātu cchandoge vā caritabrahmacarye । ātharvaṇaṃ vedamadhītya vipraḥ snāyīta yaḥ puṣkaramādadāti ॥44॥
html:
adhvaryave duhitaraṃ dadātu cchandoge vā caritabrahmacarye ।
ātharvaṇaṃ vedamadhītya vipraḥ snāyīta yaḥ puṣkaramādadāti ॥44॥
slp1: aDvaryave duhitaraM dadAtu cCandoge vA caritabrahmacarye । ATarvaRaM vedamaDItya vipraH snAyIta yaH puzkaramAdadAti ॥44॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: sarvānvedānadhīyīta puṇyaśīlo'stu dhārmikaḥ । brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ yātu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥45॥
html:
sarvānvedānadhīyīta puṇyaśīlo'stu dhārmikaḥ ।
brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ yātu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥45॥
slp1: sarvAnvedAnaDIyIta puRyaSIlo'stu DArmikaH । brahmaRaH sadanaM yAtu yaste harati puzkaram ॥45॥

text: āśīrvādastvayā proktaḥ śapatho balasūdana । dīyatāṃ puṣkaraṃ mahyameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥46॥
html:
āśīrvādastvayā proktaḥ śapatho balasūdana ।
dīyatāṃ puṣkaraṃ mahyameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: ASIrvAdastvayA proktaH SapaTo balasUdana । dIyatAM puzkaraM mahyameza DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥46॥
author: agastya uvāca ।

text: na mayā bhagavaṁllobhāddhṛtaṃ puṣkaramadya vai । dharmaṃ tu śrotukāmena hṛtaṃ na kroddhumarhasi ॥47॥
html:
na mayā bhagavaṁllobhāddhṛtaṃ puṣkaramadya vai ।
dharmaṃ tu śrotukāmena hṛtaṃ na kroddhumarhasi ॥47॥
slp1: na mayA BagavaṁlloBAdDftaM puzkaramadya vE । DarmaM tu SrotukAmena hftaM na krodDumarhasi ॥47॥
author: indra uvāca ।

text: dharmaḥ śrutisamutkarṣo dharmaseturanāmayaḥ । ārṣo vai śāśvato nityamavyayo'yaṃ mayā śrutaḥ ॥48॥
html:
dharmaḥ śrutisamutkarṣo dharmaseturanāmayaḥ ।
ārṣo vai śāśvato nityamavyayo'yaṃ mayā śrutaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: DarmaH Srutisamutkarzo DarmaseturanAmayaH । Arzo vE SASvato nityamavyayo'yaM mayA SrutaH ॥48॥

text: tadidaṃ gṛhyatāṃ vidvanpuṣkaraṃ munisattama । atikramaṃ me bhagavankṣantumarhasyanindita ॥49॥
html:
tadidaṃ gṛhyatāṃ vidvanpuṣkaraṃ munisattama ।
atikramaṃ me bhagavankṣantumarhasyanindita ॥49॥
slp1: tadidaM gfhyatAM vidvanpuzkaraM munisattama । atikramaM me Bagavankzantumarhasyanindita ॥49॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa mahendreṇa tapasvī kopano bhṛśam । jagrāha puṣkaraṃ dhīmānprasannaścābhavanmuniḥ ॥50॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa mahendreṇa tapasvī kopano bhṛśam ।
jagrāha puṣkaraṃ dhīmānprasannaścābhavanmuniḥ ॥50॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa mahendreRa tapasvI kopano BfSam । jagrAha puzkaraM DImAnprasannaScABavanmuniH ॥50॥

text: prayayuste tato bhūyastīrthāni vanagocarāḥ । puṇyatīrtheṣu ca tathā gātrāṇyāplāvayanti te ॥51॥
html:
prayayuste tato bhūyastīrthāni vanagocarāḥ ।
puṇyatīrtheṣu ca tathā gātrāṇyāplāvayanti te ॥51॥
slp1: prayayuste tato BUyastIrTAni vanagocarAH । puRyatIrTezu ca taTA gAtrARyAplAvayanti te ॥51॥

text: ākhyānaṃ ya idaṃ yuktaḥ paṭhetparvaṇi parvaṇi । na mūrkhaṃ janayetputraṃ na bhavecca nirākṛtiḥ ॥52॥
html:
ākhyānaṃ ya idaṃ yuktaḥ paṭhetparvaṇi parvaṇi ।
na mūrkhaṃ janayetputraṃ na bhavecca nirākṛtiḥ ॥52॥
slp1: AKyAnaM ya idaM yuktaH paWetparvaRi parvaRi । na mUrKaM janayetputraM na Bavecca nirAkftiH ॥52॥

text: na tamāpatspṛśetkācinna jvaro na rujaśca ha । virajāḥ śreyasā yuktaḥ pretya svargamavāpnuyāt ॥53॥
html:
na tamāpatspṛśetkācinna jvaro na rujaśca ha ।
virajāḥ śreyasā yuktaḥ pretya svargamavāpnuyāt ॥53॥
slp1: na tamApatspfSetkAcinna jvaro na rujaSca ha । virajAH SreyasA yuktaH pretya svargamavApnuyAt ॥53॥

text: yaśca śāstramanudhyāyedṛṣibhiḥ paripālitam । sa gacchedbrahmaṇo lokamavyayaṃ ca narottama] ॥54॥
html:
yaśca śāstramanudhyāyedṛṣibhiḥ paripālitam ।
sa gacchedbrahmaṇo lokamavyayaṃ ca narottama] ॥54॥
slp1: yaSca SAstramanuDyAyedfziBiH paripAlitam । sa gacCedbrahmaRo lokamavyayaM ca narottama] ॥54॥

text: yadidaṃ śrāddhadharmeṣu dīyate bharatarṣabha । chatraṃ copānahau caiva kenaitatsampravartitam । kathaṃ caitatsamutpannaṃ kimarthaṃ ca pradīyate ॥1॥
html:
yadidaṃ śrāddhadharmeṣu dīyate bharatarṣabha ।
chatraṃ copānahau caiva kenaitatsampravartitam ।
kathaṃ caitatsamutpannaṃ kimarthaṃ ca pradīyate ॥1॥
slp1: yadidaM SrAdDaDarmezu dIyate BaratarzaBa । CatraM copAnahO cEva kenEtatsampravartitam । kaTaM cEtatsamutpannaM kimarTaM ca pradIyate ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: na kevalaṃ śrāddhadharme puṇyakeṣvapi dīyate । etadvistarato rājañśrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ॥2॥
html:
na kevalaṃ śrāddhadharme puṇyakeṣvapi dīyate ।
etadvistarato rājañśrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ॥2॥
slp1: na kevalaM SrAdDaDarme puRyakezvapi dIyate । etadvistarato rAjaYSrotumicCAmi tattvataH ॥2॥

text: śṛṇu rājannavahitaśchatropānahavistaram । yathaitatprathitaṃ loke yena caitatpravartitam ॥3॥
html:
śṛṇu rājannavahitaśchatropānahavistaram ।
yathaitatprathitaṃ loke yena caitatpravartitam ॥3॥
slp1: SfRu rAjannavahitaSCatropAnahavistaram । yaTEtatpraTitaM loke yena cEtatpravartitam ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yathā cākṣayyatāṃ prāptaṃ puṇyatāṃ ca yathā gatam । sarvametadaśeṣeṇa pravakṣyāmi janādhipa ॥4॥
html:
yathā cākṣayyatāṃ prāptaṃ puṇyatāṃ ca yathā gatam ।
sarvametadaśeṣeṇa pravakṣyāmi janādhipa ॥4॥
slp1: yaTA cAkzayyatAM prAptaM puRyatAM ca yaTA gatam । sarvametadaSezeRa pravakzyAmi janADipa ॥4॥

text: itihāsaṃ purāvṛttamimaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa । jamadagneśca saṃvādaṃ sūryasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥5॥
html:
itihāsaṃ purāvṛttamimaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa ।
jamadagneśca saṃvādaṃ sūryasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: itihAsaM purAvfttamimaM SfRu narADipa । jamadagneSca saMvAdaM sUryasya ca mahAtmanaH ॥5॥

text: purā sa bhagavānsākṣāddhanuṣākrīḍata prabho । sandhāya sandhāya śarāṃścikṣepa kila bhārgavaḥ ॥6॥
html:
purā sa bhagavānsākṣāddhanuṣākrīḍata prabho ।
sandhāya sandhāya śarāṃścikṣepa kila bhārgavaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: purA sa BagavAnsAkzAdDanuzAkrIqata praBo । sanDAya sanDAya SarAMScikzepa kila BArgavaH ॥6॥

text: tānkṣiptānreṇukā sarvāṃstasyeṣūndīptatejasaḥ । ānāyya sā tadā tasmai prādādasakṛdacyuta ॥7॥
html:
tānkṣiptānreṇukā sarvāṃstasyeṣūndīptatejasaḥ ।
ānāyya sā tadā tasmai prādādasakṛdacyuta ॥7॥
slp1: tAnkziptAnreRukA sarvAMstasyezUndIptatejasaH । AnAyya sA tadA tasmE prAdAdasakfdacyuta ॥7॥

text: atha tena sa śabdena jyātalasya śarasya ca । prahṛṣṭaḥ sampracikṣepa sā ca pratyājahāra tān ॥8॥
html:
atha tena sa śabdena jyātalasya śarasya ca ।
prahṛṣṭaḥ sampracikṣepa sā ca pratyājahāra tān ॥8॥
slp1: aTa tena sa Sabdena jyAtalasya Sarasya ca । prahfzwaH sampracikzepa sA ca pratyAjahAra tAn ॥8॥

text: tato madhyāhnamārūḍhe jyeṣṭhāmūle divākare । sa sāyakāndvijo viddhvā reṇukāmidamabravīt ॥9॥
html:
tato madhyāhnamārūḍhe jyeṣṭhāmūle divākare ।
sa sāyakāndvijo viddhvā reṇukāmidamabravīt ॥9॥
slp1: tato maDyAhnamArUQe jyezWAmUle divAkare । sa sAyakAndvijo vidDvA reRukAmidamabravIt ॥9॥

text: gacchānaya viśālākṣi śarānetāndhanuścyutān । yāvadetānpunaḥ subhru kṣipāmīti janādhipa ॥10॥
html:
gacchānaya viśālākṣi śarānetāndhanuścyutān ।
yāvadetānpunaḥ subhru kṣipāmīti janādhipa ॥10॥
slp1: gacCAnaya viSAlAkzi SarAnetAnDanuScyutAn । yAvadetAnpunaH suBru kzipAmIti janADipa ॥10॥

text: sā gacchatyantarā chāyāṃ vṛkṣamāśritya bhāminī । tasthau tasyā hi santaptaṃ śiraḥ pādau tathaiva ca ॥11॥
html:
sā gacchatyantarā chāyāṃ vṛkṣamāśritya bhāminī ।
tasthau tasyā hi santaptaṃ śiraḥ pādau tathaiva ca ॥11॥
slp1: sA gacCatyantarA CAyAM vfkzamASritya BAminI । tasTO tasyA hi santaptaM SiraH pAdO taTEva ca ॥11॥

text: sthitā sā tu muhūrtaṃ vai bhartuḥ śāpabhayācchubhā । yayāvānayituṃ bhūyaḥ sāyakānasitekṣaṇā । pratyājagāma ca śarāṃstānādāya yaśasvinī ॥12॥
html:
sthitā sā tu muhūrtaṃ vai bhartuḥ śāpabhayācchubhā ।
yayāvānayituṃ bhūyaḥ sāyakānasitekṣaṇā ।
pratyājagāma ca śarāṃstānādāya yaśasvinī ॥12॥
slp1: sTitA sA tu muhUrtaM vE BartuH SApaBayAcCuBA । yayAvAnayituM BUyaH sAyakAnasitekzaRA । pratyAjagAma ca SarAMstAnAdAya yaSasvinI ॥12॥

text: sā prasvinnā sucārvaṅgī padbhyāṃ duḥkhaṃ niyacchatī । upājagāma bhartāraṃ bhayādbhartuḥ pravepatī ॥13॥
html:
sā prasvinnā sucārvaṅgī padbhyāṃ duḥkhaṃ niyacchatī ।
upājagāma bhartāraṃ bhayādbhartuḥ pravepatī ॥13॥
slp1: sA prasvinnA sucArvaNgI padByAM duHKaM niyacCatI । upAjagAma BartAraM BayAdBartuH pravepatI ॥13॥

text: sa tāmṛṣistataḥ kruddho vākyamāha śubhānanām । reṇuke kiṃ cireṇa tvamāgateti punaḥ punaḥ ॥14॥
html:
sa tāmṛṣistataḥ kruddho vākyamāha śubhānanām ।
reṇuke kiṃ cireṇa tvamāgateti punaḥ punaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sa tAmfzistataH krudDo vAkyamAha SuBAnanAm । reRuke kiM cireRa tvamAgateti punaH punaH ॥14॥

text: śirastāvatpradīptaṃ me pādau caiva tapodhana । sūryatejoniruddhāhaṃ vṛkṣacchāyāmupāśritā ॥15॥
html:
śirastāvatpradīptaṃ me pādau caiva tapodhana ।
sūryatejoniruddhāhaṃ vṛkṣacchāyāmupāśritā ॥15॥
slp1: SirastAvatpradIptaM me pAdO cEva tapoDana । sUryatejonirudDAhaM vfkzacCAyAmupASritA ॥15॥
author: reṇukovāca ।

text: etasmātkāraṇādbrahmaṃścirametatkṛtaṃ mayā । etajjñātvā mama vibho mā krudhastvaṃ tapodhana ॥16॥
html:
etasmātkāraṇādbrahmaṃścirametatkṛtaṃ mayā ।
etajjñātvā mama vibho mā krudhastvaṃ tapodhana ॥16॥
slp1: etasmAtkAraRAdbrahmaMScirametatkftaM mayA । etajjYAtvA mama viBo mA kruDastvaM tapoDana ॥16॥

text: adyainaṃ dīptakiraṇaṃ reṇuke tava duḥkhadam । śarairnipātayiṣyāmi sūryamastrāgnitejasā ॥17॥
html:
adyainaṃ dīptakiraṇaṃ reṇuke tava duḥkhadam ।
śarairnipātayiṣyāmi sūryamastrāgnitejasā ॥17॥
slp1: adyEnaM dIptakiraRaM reRuke tava duHKadam । SarErnipAtayizyAmi sUryamastrAgnitejasA ॥17॥
author: jamadagniruvāca ।

text: sa visphārya dhanurdivyaṃ gṛhītvā ca bahūñśarān । atiṣṭhatsūryamabhito yato yāti tatomukhaḥ ॥18॥
html:
sa visphārya dhanurdivyaṃ gṛhītvā ca bahūñśarān ।
atiṣṭhatsūryamabhito yato yāti tatomukhaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: sa visPArya DanurdivyaM gfhItvA ca bahUYSarAn । atizWatsUryamaBito yato yAti tatomuKaH ॥18॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atha taṃ prahariṣyantaṃ sūryo'bhyetya vaco'bravīt । dvijarūpeṇa kaunteya kiṃ te sūryo'parādhyate ॥19॥
html:
atha taṃ prahariṣyantaṃ sūryo'bhyetya vaco'bravīt ।
dvijarūpeṇa kaunteya kiṃ te sūryo'parādhyate ॥19॥
slp1: aTa taM praharizyantaM sUryo'Byetya vaco'bravIt । dvijarUpeRa kOnteya kiM te sUryo'parADyate ॥19॥

text: ādatte raśmibhiḥ sūryo divi vidvaṃstatastataḥ । rasaṃ sa taṃ vai varṣāsu pravarṣati divākaraḥ ॥20॥
html:
ādatte raśmibhiḥ sūryo divi vidvaṃstatastataḥ ।
rasaṃ sa taṃ vai varṣāsu pravarṣati divākaraḥ ॥20॥
slp1: Adatte raSmiBiH sUryo divi vidvaMstatastataH । rasaM sa taM vE varzAsu pravarzati divAkaraH ॥20॥

text: tato'nnaṃ jāyate vipra manuṣyāṇāṃ sukhāvaham । annaṃ prāṇā iti yathā vedeṣu paripaṭhyate ॥21॥
html:
tato'nnaṃ jāyate vipra manuṣyāṇāṃ sukhāvaham ।
annaṃ prāṇā iti yathā vedeṣu paripaṭhyate ॥21॥
slp1: tato'nnaM jAyate vipra manuzyARAM suKAvaham । annaM prARA iti yaTA vedezu paripaWyate ॥21॥

text: athābhreṣu nigūḍhaśca raśmibhiḥ parivāritaḥ । sapta dvīpānimānbrahmanvarṣeṇābhipravarṣati ॥22॥
html:
athābhreṣu nigūḍhaśca raśmibhiḥ parivāritaḥ ।
sapta dvīpānimānbrahmanvarṣeṇābhipravarṣati ॥22॥
slp1: aTABrezu nigUQaSca raSmiBiH parivAritaH । sapta dvIpAnimAnbrahmanvarzeRABipravarzati ॥22॥

text: tatastadauṣadhīnāṃ ca vīrudhāṃ patrapuṣpajam । sarvaṃ varṣābhinirvṛttamannaṃ sambhavati prabho ॥23॥
html:
tatastadauṣadhīnāṃ ca vīrudhāṃ patrapuṣpajam ।
sarvaṃ varṣābhinirvṛttamannaṃ sambhavati prabho ॥23॥
slp1: tatastadOzaDInAM ca vIruDAM patrapuzpajam । sarvaM varzABinirvfttamannaM samBavati praBo ॥23॥

text: jātakarmāṇi sarvāṇi vratopanayanāni ca । godānāni vivāhāśca tathā yajñasamṛddhayaḥ ॥24॥
html:
jātakarmāṇi sarvāṇi vratopanayanāni ca ।
godānāni vivāhāśca tathā yajñasamṛddhayaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: jAtakarmARi sarvARi vratopanayanAni ca । godAnAni vivAhASca taTA yajYasamfdDayaH ॥24॥

text: satrāṇi dānāni tathā saṃyogā vittasañcayāḥ । annataḥ sampravartante yathā tvaṃ vettha bhārgava ॥25॥
html:
satrāṇi dānāni tathā saṃyogā vittasañcayāḥ ।
annataḥ sampravartante yathā tvaṃ vettha bhārgava ॥25॥
slp1: satrARi dAnAni taTA saMyogA vittasaYcayAH । annataH sampravartante yaTA tvaM vetTa BArgava ॥25॥

text: ramaṇīyāni yāvanti yāvadārambhakāṇi ca । sarvamannātprabhavati viditaṃ kīrtayāmi te ॥26॥
html:
ramaṇīyāni yāvanti yāvadārambhakāṇi ca ।
sarvamannātprabhavati viditaṃ kīrtayāmi te ॥26॥
slp1: ramaRIyAni yAvanti yAvadAramBakARi ca । sarvamannAtpraBavati viditaM kIrtayAmi te ॥26॥

text: sarvaṃ hi vettha vipra tvaṃ yadetatkīrtitaṃ mayā । prasādaye tvā viprarṣe kiṃ te sūryo nipātyate] ॥27॥
html:
sarvaṃ hi vettha vipra tvaṃ yadetatkīrtitaṃ mayā ।
prasādaye tvā viprarṣe kiṃ te sūryo nipātyate] ॥27॥
slp1: sarvaM hi vetTa vipra tvaM yadetatkIrtitaM mayA । prasAdaye tvA viprarze kiM te sUryo nipAtyate] ॥27॥

text: evaṃ tadā prayācantaṃ bhāskaraṃ munisattamaḥ । jamadagnirmahātejāḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ pratyapadyata ॥1॥
html:
evaṃ tadā prayācantaṃ bhāskaraṃ munisattamaḥ ।
jamadagnirmahātejāḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ pratyapadyata ॥1॥
slp1: evaM tadA prayAcantaM BAskaraM munisattamaH । jamadagnirmahAtejAH kiM kAryaM pratyapadyata ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: tathā prayācamānasya muniragnisamaprabhaḥ । jamadagniḥ śamaṃ naiva jagāma kurunandana ॥2॥
html:
tathā prayācamānasya muniragnisamaprabhaḥ ।
jamadagniḥ śamaṃ naiva jagāma kurunandana ॥2॥
slp1: taTA prayAcamAnasya muniragnisamapraBaH । jamadagniH SamaM nEva jagAma kurunandana ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tataḥ sūryo madhurayā vācā tamidamabravīt । kṛtāñjalirviprarūpī praṇamyedaṃ viśāṃ pate ॥3॥
html:
tataḥ sūryo madhurayā vācā tamidamabravīt ।
kṛtāñjalirviprarūpī praṇamyedaṃ viśāṃ pate ॥3॥
slp1: tataH sUryo maDurayA vAcA tamidamabravIt । kftAYjalirviprarUpI praRamyedaM viSAM pate ॥3॥

text: calaṃ nimittaṃ viprarṣe sadā sūryasya gacchataḥ । kathaṃ calaṃ vetsyasi tvaṃ sadā yāntaṃ divākaram ॥4॥
html:
calaṃ nimittaṃ viprarṣe sadā sūryasya gacchataḥ ।
kathaṃ calaṃ vetsyasi tvaṃ sadā yāntaṃ divākaram ॥4॥
slp1: calaM nimittaM viprarze sadA sUryasya gacCataH । kaTaM calaM vetsyasi tvaM sadA yAntaM divAkaram ॥4॥

text: sthiraṃ vāpi calaṃ vāpi jāne tvāṃ jñānacakṣuṣā । avaśyaṃ vinayādhānaṃ kāryamadya mayā tava ॥5॥
html:
sthiraṃ vāpi calaṃ vāpi jāne tvāṃ jñānacakṣuṣā ।
avaśyaṃ vinayādhānaṃ kāryamadya mayā tava ॥5॥
slp1: sTiraM vApi calaM vApi jAne tvAM jYAnacakzuzA । avaSyaM vinayADAnaM kAryamadya mayA tava ॥5॥
author: jamadagniruvāca ।

text: aparāhṇe nimeṣārdhaṃ tiṣṭhasi tvaṃ divākara । tatra vetsyāmi sūrya tvāṃ na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥6॥
html:
aparāhṇe nimeṣārdhaṃ tiṣṭhasi tvaṃ divākara ।
tatra vetsyāmi sūrya tvāṃ na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥6॥
slp1: aparAhRe nimezArDaM tizWasi tvaM divAkara । tatra vetsyAmi sUrya tvAM na me'trAsti vicAraRA ॥6॥

text: asaṃśayaṃ māṃ viprarṣe vetsyase dhanvināṃ vara । apakāriṇaṃ tu māṃ viddhi bhagavañśaraṇāgatam ॥7॥
html:
asaṃśayaṃ māṃ viprarṣe vetsyase dhanvināṃ vara ।
apakāriṇaṃ tu māṃ viddhi bhagavañśaraṇāgatam ॥7॥
slp1: asaMSayaM mAM viprarze vetsyase DanvinAM vara । apakAriRaM tu mAM vidDi BagavaYSaraRAgatam ॥7॥
author: sūrya uvāca ।

text: tataḥ prahasya bhagavāñjamadagniruvāca tam । na bhīḥ sūrya tvayā kāryā praṇipātagato hyasi ॥8॥
html:
tataḥ prahasya bhagavāñjamadagniruvāca tam ।
na bhīḥ sūrya tvayā kāryā praṇipātagato hyasi ॥8॥
slp1: tataH prahasya BagavAYjamadagniruvAca tam । na BIH sUrya tvayA kAryA praRipAtagato hyasi ॥8॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇeṣvārjavaṃ yacca sthairyaṃ ca dharaṇītale । saumyatāṃ caiva somasya gāmbhīryaṃ varuṇasya ca ॥9॥
html:
brāhmaṇeṣvārjavaṃ yacca sthairyaṃ ca dharaṇītale ।
saumyatāṃ caiva somasya gāmbhīryaṃ varuṇasya ca ॥9॥
slp1: brAhmaRezvArjavaM yacca sTEryaM ca DaraRItale । sOmyatAM cEva somasya gAmBIryaM varuRasya ca ॥9॥

text: dīptimagneḥ prabhāṃ meroḥ pratāpaṃ tapanasya ca । etānyatikramedyo vai sa hanyāccharaṇāgatam ॥10॥
html:
dīptimagneḥ prabhāṃ meroḥ pratāpaṃ tapanasya ca ।
etānyatikramedyo vai sa hanyāccharaṇāgatam ॥10॥
slp1: dIptimagneH praBAM meroH pratApaM tapanasya ca । etAnyatikramedyo vE sa hanyAcCaraRAgatam ॥10॥

text: bhavetsa gurutalpī ca brahmahā ca tathā bhavet । surāpānaṃ ca kuryātsa yo hanyāccharaṇāgatam ॥11॥
html:
bhavetsa gurutalpī ca brahmahā ca tathā bhavet ।
surāpānaṃ ca kuryātsa yo hanyāccharaṇāgatam ॥11॥
slp1: Bavetsa gurutalpI ca brahmahA ca taTA Bavet । surApAnaM ca kuryAtsa yo hanyAcCaraRAgatam ॥11॥

text: etasya tvapanītasya samādhiṃ tāta cintaya । yathā sukhagamaḥ panthā bhavettvadraśmitāpitaḥ ॥12॥
html:
etasya tvapanītasya samādhiṃ tāta cintaya ।
yathā sukhagamaḥ panthā bhavettvadraśmitāpitaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: etasya tvapanItasya samADiM tAta cintaya । yaTA suKagamaH panTA BavettvadraSmitApitaH ॥12॥

text: etāvaduktvā sa tadā tūṣṇīmāsīdbhṛgūdvahaḥ । atha sūryo dadau tasmai chatropānahamāśu vai ॥13॥
html:
etāvaduktvā sa tadā tūṣṇīmāsīdbhṛgūdvahaḥ ।
atha sūryo dadau tasmai chatropānahamāśu vai ॥13॥
slp1: etAvaduktvA sa tadA tUzRImAsIdBfgUdvahaH । aTa sUryo dadO tasmE CatropAnahamASu vE ॥13॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: maharṣe śirasastrāṇaṃ chatraṃ madraśmivāraṇam । pratigṛhṇīṣva padbhyāṃ ca trāṇārthaṃ carmapāduke ॥14॥
html:
maharṣe śirasastrāṇaṃ chatraṃ madraśmivāraṇam ।
pratigṛhṇīṣva padbhyāṃ ca trāṇārthaṃ carmapāduke ॥14॥
slp1: maharze SirasastrARaM CatraM madraSmivAraRam । pratigfhRIzva padByAM ca trARArTaM carmapAduke ॥14॥
author: sūrya uvāca ।

text: adyaprabhṛti caivaitalloke sampracariṣyati । puṇyadāneṣu sarveṣu paramakṣayyameva ca ॥15॥
html:
adyaprabhṛti caivaitalloke sampracariṣyati ।
puṇyadāneṣu sarveṣu paramakṣayyameva ca ॥15॥
slp1: adyapraBfti cEvEtalloke sampracarizyati । puRyadAnezu sarvezu paramakzayyameva ca ॥15॥

text: upānacchatrametadvai sūryeṇeha pravartitam । puṇyametadabhikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhārata ॥16॥
html:
upānacchatrametadvai sūryeṇeha pravartitam ।
puṇyametadabhikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhārata ॥16॥
slp1: upAnacCatrametadvE sUryeReha pravartitam । puRyametadaBiKyAtaM trizu lokezu BArata ॥16॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tasmātprayaccha viprebhyaśchatropānahamuttamam । dharmaste sumahānbhāvī na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥17॥
html:
tasmātprayaccha viprebhyaśchatropānahamuttamam ।
dharmaste sumahānbhāvī na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥17॥
slp1: tasmAtprayacCa vipreByaSCatropAnahamuttamam । Darmaste sumahAnBAvI na me'trAsti vicAraRA ॥17॥

text: chatraṃ hi bharataśreṣṭha yaḥ pradadyāddvijātaye । śubhraṃ śataśalākaṃ vai sa pretya sukhamedhate ॥18॥
html:
chatraṃ hi bharataśreṣṭha yaḥ pradadyāddvijātaye ।
śubhraṃ śataśalākaṃ vai sa pretya sukhamedhate ॥18॥
slp1: CatraM hi BarataSrezWa yaH pradadyAddvijAtaye । SuBraM SataSalAkaM vE sa pretya suKameDate ॥18॥

text: sa śakraloke vasati pūjyamāno dvijātibhiḥ । apsarobhiśca satataṃ devaiśca bharatarṣabha ॥19॥
html:
sa śakraloke vasati pūjyamāno dvijātibhiḥ ।
apsarobhiśca satataṃ devaiśca bharatarṣabha ॥19॥
slp1: sa Sakraloke vasati pUjyamAno dvijAtiBiH । apsaroBiSca satataM devESca BaratarzaBa ॥19॥

text: dahyamānāya viprāya yaḥ prayacchatyupānahau । snātakāya mahābāho saṃśitāya dvijātaye ॥20॥
html:
dahyamānāya viprāya yaḥ prayacchatyupānahau ।
snātakāya mahābāho saṃśitāya dvijātaye ॥20॥
slp1: dahyamAnAya viprAya yaH prayacCatyupAnahO । snAtakAya mahAbAho saMSitAya dvijAtaye ॥20॥

text: so'pi lokānavāpnoti daivatairabhipūjitān । goloke sa mudā yukto vasati pretya bhārata ॥21॥
html:
so'pi lokānavāpnoti daivatairabhipūjitān ।
goloke sa mudā yukto vasati pretya bhārata ॥21॥
slp1: so'pi lokAnavApnoti dEvatEraBipUjitAn । goloke sa mudA yukto vasati pretya BArata ॥21॥

text: etatte bharataśreṣṭha mayā kārtsnyena kīrtitam । chatropānahadānasya phalaṃ bharatasattama] ॥22॥
html:
etatte bharataśreṣṭha mayā kārtsnyena kīrtitam ।
chatropānahadānasya phalaṃ bharatasattama] ॥22॥
slp1: etatte BarataSrezWa mayA kArtsnyena kIrtitam । CatropAnahadAnasya PalaM Baratasattama] ॥22॥

text: ārāmāṇāṃ taḍāgānāṃ yatphalaṃ kurunandana । tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatto'dya bharatarṣabha ॥1॥
html:
ārāmāṇāṃ taḍāgānāṃ yatphalaṃ kurunandana ।
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatto'dya bharatarṣabha ॥1॥
slp1: ArAmARAM taqAgAnAM yatPalaM kurunandana । tadahaM SrotumicCAmi tvatto'dya BaratarzaBa ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: supradarśā vanavatī citradhātuvibhūṣitā । upetā sarvabījaiśca śreṣṭhā bhūmirihocyate ॥2॥
html:
supradarśā vanavatī citradhātuvibhūṣitā ।
upetā sarvabījaiśca śreṣṭhā bhūmirihocyate ॥2॥
slp1: supradarSA vanavatI citraDAtuviBUzitA । upetA sarvabIjESca SrezWA BUmirihocyate ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tasyāḥ kṣetraviśeṣaṃ ca taḍāgānāṃ niveśanam । audakāni ca sarvāṇi pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ ॥3॥
html:
tasyāḥ kṣetraviśeṣaṃ ca taḍāgānāṃ niveśanam ।
audakāni ca sarvāṇi pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: tasyAH kzetraviSezaM ca taqAgAnAM niveSanam । OdakAni ca sarvARi pravakzyAmyanupUrvaSaH ॥3॥

text: taḍāgānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi kṛtānāṃ cāpi ye guṇāḥ । triṣu lokeṣu sarvatra pūjito yastaḍāgavān ॥4॥
html:
taḍāgānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi kṛtānāṃ cāpi ye guṇāḥ ।
triṣu lokeṣu sarvatra pūjito yastaḍāgavān ॥4॥
slp1: taqAgAnAM ca vakzyAmi kftAnAM cApi ye guRAH । trizu lokezu sarvatra pUjito yastaqAgavAn ॥4॥

text: atha vā mitrasadanaṃ maitraṃ mitravivardhanam । kīrtisañjananaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ taḍāgānāṃ niveśanam ॥5॥
html:
atha vā mitrasadanaṃ maitraṃ mitravivardhanam ।
kīrtisañjananaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ taḍāgānāṃ niveśanam ॥5॥
slp1: aTa vA mitrasadanaM mEtraM mitravivarDanam । kIrtisaYjananaM SrezWaM taqAgAnAM niveSanam ॥5॥

text: dharmasyārthasya kāmasya phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । taḍāgaṃ sukṛtaṃ deśe kṣetrameva mahāśrayam ॥6॥
html:
dharmasyārthasya kāmasya phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।
taḍāgaṃ sukṛtaṃ deśe kṣetrameva mahāśrayam ॥6॥
slp1: DarmasyArTasya kAmasya PalamAhurmanIziRaH । taqAgaM sukftaM deSe kzetrameva mahASrayam ॥6॥

text: caturvidhānāṃ bhūtānāṃ taḍāgamupalakṣayet । taḍāgāni ca sarvāṇi diśanti śriyamuttamām ॥7॥
html:
caturvidhānāṃ bhūtānāṃ taḍāgamupalakṣayet ।
taḍāgāni ca sarvāṇi diśanti śriyamuttamām ॥7॥
slp1: caturviDAnAM BUtAnAM taqAgamupalakzayet । taqAgAni ca sarvARi diSanti SriyamuttamAm ॥7॥

text: devā manuṣyā gandharvāḥ pitaroragarākṣasāḥ । sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni saṃśrayanti jalāśayam ॥8॥
html:
devā manuṣyā gandharvāḥ pitaroragarākṣasāḥ ।
sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni saṃśrayanti jalāśayam ॥8॥
slp1: devA manuzyA ganDarvAH pitaroragarAkzasAH । sTAvarARi ca BUtAni saMSrayanti jalASayam ॥8॥

text: tasmāttāṃste pravakṣyāmi taḍāge ye guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ । yā ca tatra phalāvāptirṛṣibhiḥ samudāhṛtā ॥9॥
html:
tasmāttāṃste pravakṣyāmi taḍāge ye guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
yā ca tatra phalāvāptirṛṣibhiḥ samudāhṛtā ॥9॥
slp1: tasmAttAMste pravakzyAmi taqAge ye guRAH smftAH । yA ca tatra PalAvAptirfziBiH samudAhftA ॥9॥

text: varṣamātre taḍāge tu salilaṃ yasya tiṣṭhati । agnihotraphalaṃ tasya phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥10॥
html:
varṣamātre taḍāge tu salilaṃ yasya tiṣṭhati ।
agnihotraphalaṃ tasya phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: varzamAtre taqAge tu salilaM yasya tizWati । agnihotraPalaM tasya PalamAhurmanIziRaH ॥10॥

text: śaratkāle tu salilaṃ taḍāge yasya tiṣṭhati । gosahasrasya sa pretya labhate phalamuttamam ॥11॥
html:
śaratkāle tu salilaṃ taḍāge yasya tiṣṭhati ।
gosahasrasya sa pretya labhate phalamuttamam ॥11॥
slp1: SaratkAle tu salilaM taqAge yasya tizWati । gosahasrasya sa pretya laBate Palamuttamam ॥11॥

text: hemantakāle salilaṃ taḍāge yasya tiṣṭhati । sa vai bahusuvarṇasya yajñasya labhate phalam ॥12॥
html:
hemantakāle salilaṃ taḍāge yasya tiṣṭhati ।
sa vai bahusuvarṇasya yajñasya labhate phalam ॥12॥
slp1: hemantakAle salilaM taqAge yasya tizWati । sa vE bahusuvarRasya yajYasya laBate Palam ॥12॥

text: yasya vai śaiśire kāle taḍāge salilaṃ bhavet । agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥13॥
html:
yasya vai śaiśire kāle taḍāge salilaṃ bhavet ।
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: yasya vE SESire kAle taqAge salilaM Bavet । agnizwomasya yajYasya PalamAhurmanIziRaH ॥13॥

text: taḍāgaṃ sukṛtaṃ yasya vasante tu mahāśrayam । atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ sa samupāśnute ॥14॥
html:
taḍāgaṃ sukṛtaṃ yasya vasante tu mahāśrayam ।
atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ sa samupāśnute ॥14॥
slp1: taqAgaM sukftaM yasya vasante tu mahASrayam । atirAtrasya yajYasya PalaM sa samupASnute ॥14॥

text: nidāghakāle pānīyaṃ taḍāge yasya tiṣṭhati । vājapeyasamaṃ tasya phalaṃ vai munayo viduḥ ॥15॥
html:
nidāghakāle pānīyaṃ taḍāge yasya tiṣṭhati ।
vājapeyasamaṃ tasya phalaṃ vai munayo viduḥ ॥15॥
slp1: nidAGakAle pAnIyaM taqAge yasya tizWati । vAjapeyasamaM tasya PalaM vE munayo viduH ॥15॥

text: sa kulaṃ tārayetsarvaṃ yasya khāte jalāśaye । gāvaḥ pibanti pānīyaṃ sādhavaśca narāḥ sadā ॥16॥
html:
sa kulaṃ tārayetsarvaṃ yasya khāte jalāśaye ।
gāvaḥ pibanti pānīyaṃ sādhavaśca narāḥ sadā ॥16॥
slp1: sa kulaM tArayetsarvaM yasya KAte jalASaye । gAvaH pibanti pAnIyaM sADavaSca narAH sadA ॥16॥

text: taḍāge yasya gāvastu pibanti tṛṣitā jalam । mṛgapakṣimanuṣyāśca so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥17॥
html:
taḍāge yasya gāvastu pibanti tṛṣitā jalam ।
mṛgapakṣimanuṣyāśca so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥17॥
slp1: taqAge yasya gAvastu pibanti tfzitA jalam । mfgapakzimanuzyASca so'SvameDaPalaM laBet ॥17॥

text: yatpibanti jalaṃ tatra snāyante viśramanti ca । taḍāgadasya tatsarvaṃ pretyānantyāya kalpate ॥18॥
html:
yatpibanti jalaṃ tatra snāyante viśramanti ca ।
taḍāgadasya tatsarvaṃ pretyānantyāya kalpate ॥18॥
slp1: yatpibanti jalaM tatra snAyante viSramanti ca । taqAgadasya tatsarvaM pretyAnantyAya kalpate ॥18॥

text: durlabhaṃ salilaṃ tāta viśeṣeṇa paratra vai । pānīyasya pradānena prītirbhavati śāśvatī ॥19॥
html:
durlabhaṃ salilaṃ tāta viśeṣeṇa paratra vai ।
pānīyasya pradānena prītirbhavati śāśvatī ॥19॥
slp1: durlaBaM salilaM tAta viSezeRa paratra vE । pAnIyasya pradAnena prItirBavati SASvatI ॥19॥

text: tilāndadata pānīyaṃ dīpāndadata jāgrata । jñātibhiḥ saha modadhvametatpreteṣu durlabham ॥20॥
html:
tilāndadata pānīyaṃ dīpāndadata jāgrata ।
jñātibhiḥ saha modadhvametatpreteṣu durlabham ॥20॥
slp1: tilAndadata pAnIyaM dIpAndadata jAgrata । jYAtiBiH saha modaDvametatpretezu durlaBam ॥20॥

text: sarvadānairgurutaraṃ sarvadānairviśiṣyate । pānīyaṃ naraśārdūla tasmāddātavyameva hi ॥21॥
html:
sarvadānairgurutaraṃ sarvadānairviśiṣyate ।
pānīyaṃ naraśārdūla tasmāddātavyameva hi ॥21॥
slp1: sarvadAnErgurutaraM sarvadAnErviSizyate । pAnIyaM naraSArdUla tasmAddAtavyameva hi ॥21॥

text: evametattaḍāgeṣu kīrtitaṃ phalamuttamam । ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi vṛkṣāṇāmapi ropaṇe ॥22॥
html:
evametattaḍāgeṣu kīrtitaṃ phalamuttamam ।
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi vṛkṣāṇāmapi ropaṇe ॥22॥
slp1: evametattaqAgezu kIrtitaM Palamuttamam । ata UrDvaM pravakzyAmi vfkzARAmapi ropaRe ॥22॥

text: sthāvarāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ jātayaḥ ṣaṭprakīrtitāḥ । vṛkṣagulmalatāvallyastvaksārāstṛṇajātayaḥ ॥23॥
html:
sthāvarāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ jātayaḥ ṣaṭprakīrtitāḥ ।
vṛkṣagulmalatāvallyastvaksārāstṛṇajātayaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: sTAvarARAM ca BUtAnAM jAtayaH zawprakIrtitAH । vfkzagulmalatAvallyastvaksArAstfRajAtayaH ॥23॥

text: etā jātyastu vṛkṣāṇāṃ teṣāṃ rope guṇāstvime । kīrtiśca mānuṣe loke pretya caiva phalaṃ śubham ॥24॥
html:
etā jātyastu vṛkṣāṇāṃ teṣāṃ rope guṇāstvime ।
kīrtiśca mānuṣe loke pretya caiva phalaṃ śubham ॥24॥
slp1: etA jAtyastu vfkzARAM tezAM rope guRAstvime । kIrtiSca mAnuze loke pretya cEva PalaM SuBam ॥24॥

text: labhate nāma loke ca pitṛbhiśca mahīyate । devalokagatasyāpi nāma tasya na naśyati ॥25॥
html:
labhate nāma loke ca pitṛbhiśca mahīyate ।
devalokagatasyāpi nāma tasya na naśyati ॥25॥
slp1: laBate nAma loke ca pitfBiSca mahIyate । devalokagatasyApi nAma tasya na naSyati ॥25॥

text: atītānāgate cobhe pitṛvaṃśaṃ ca bhārata । tārayedvṛkṣaropī ca tasmādvṛkṣānpraropayet ॥26॥
html:
atītānāgate cobhe pitṛvaṃśaṃ ca bhārata ।
tārayedvṛkṣaropī ca tasmādvṛkṣānpraropayet ॥26॥
slp1: atItAnAgate coBe pitfvaMSaM ca BArata । tArayedvfkzaropI ca tasmAdvfkzAnpraropayet ॥26॥

text: tasya putrā bhavantyete pādapā nātra saṃśayaḥ । paralokagataḥ svargaṃ lokāṃścāpnoti so'vyayān ॥27॥
html:
tasya putrā bhavantyete pādapā nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
paralokagataḥ svargaṃ lokāṃścāpnoti so'vyayān ॥27॥
slp1: tasya putrA Bavantyete pAdapA nAtra saMSayaH । paralokagataH svargaM lokAMScApnoti so'vyayAn ॥27॥

text: puṣpaiḥ suragaṇānvṛkṣāḥ phalaiścāpi tathā pitṝn । chāyayā cātithīṃstāta pūjayanti mahīruhāḥ ॥28॥
html:
puṣpaiḥ suragaṇānvṛkṣāḥ phalaiścāpi tathā pitṝn ।
chāyayā cātithīṃstāta pūjayanti mahīruhāḥ ॥28॥
slp1: puzpEH suragaRAnvfkzAH PalEScApi taTA pitFn । CAyayA cAtiTIMstAta pUjayanti mahIruhAH ॥28॥

text: kinnaroragarakṣāṃsi devagandharvamānavāḥ । tathā ṛṣigaṇāścaiva saṃśrayanti mahīruhān ॥29॥
html:
kinnaroragarakṣāṃsi devagandharvamānavāḥ ।
tathā ṛṣigaṇāścaiva saṃśrayanti mahīruhān ॥29॥
slp1: kinnaroragarakzAMsi devaganDarvamAnavAH । taTA fzigaRAScEva saMSrayanti mahIruhAn ॥29॥

text: puṣpitāḥ phalavantaśca tarpayantīha mānavān । vṛkṣadaṃ putravadvṛkṣāstārayanti paratra ca ॥30॥
html:
puṣpitāḥ phalavantaśca tarpayantīha mānavān ।
vṛkṣadaṃ putravadvṛkṣāstārayanti paratra ca ॥30॥
slp1: puzpitAH PalavantaSca tarpayantIha mAnavAn । vfkzadaM putravadvfkzAstArayanti paratra ca ॥30॥

text: tasmāttaḍāge vṛkṣā vai ropyāḥ śreyorthinā sadā । putravatparipālyāśca putrāste dharmataḥ smṛtāḥ ॥31॥
html:
tasmāttaḍāge vṛkṣā vai ropyāḥ śreyorthinā sadā ।
putravatparipālyāśca putrāste dharmataḥ smṛtāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tasmAttaqAge vfkzA vE ropyAH SreyorTinA sadA । putravatparipAlyASca putrAste DarmataH smftAH ॥31॥

text: taḍāgakṛdvṛkṣaropī iṣṭayajñaśca yo dvijaḥ । ete svarge mahīyante ye cānye satyavādinaḥ ॥32॥
html:
taḍāgakṛdvṛkṣaropī iṣṭayajñaśca yo dvijaḥ ।
ete svarge mahīyante ye cānye satyavādinaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: taqAgakfdvfkzaropI izwayajYaSca yo dvijaH । ete svarge mahIyante ye cAnye satyavAdinaH ॥32॥

text: tasmāttaḍāgaṃ kurvīta ārāmāṃścaiva ropayet । yajecca vividhairyajñaiḥ satyaṃ ca satataṃ vadet] ॥33॥
html:
tasmāttaḍāgaṃ kurvīta ārāmāṃścaiva ropayet ।
yajecca vividhairyajñaiḥ satyaṃ ca satataṃ vadet] ॥33॥
slp1: tasmAttaqAgaM kurvIta ArAmAMScEva ropayet । yajecca viviDEryajYEH satyaM ca satataM vadet] ॥33॥

text: gārhasthyaṃ dharmamakhilaṃ prabrūhi bharatarṣabha । ṛddhimāpnoti kiṃ kṛtvā manuṣya iha pārthiva ॥1॥
html:
gārhasthyaṃ dharmamakhilaṃ prabrūhi bharatarṣabha ।
ṛddhimāpnoti kiṃ kṛtvā manuṣya iha pārthiva ॥1॥
slp1: gArhasTyaM DarmamaKilaM prabrUhi BaratarzaBa । fdDimApnoti kiM kftvA manuzya iha pArTiva ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ janādhipa । vāsudevasya saṃvādaṃ pṛthivyāścaiva bhārata ॥2॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ janādhipa ।
vāsudevasya saṃvādaṃ pṛthivyāścaiva bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi purAvfttaM janADipa । vAsudevasya saMvAdaM pfTivyAScEva BArata ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: saṃstūya pṛthivīṃ devīṃ vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān । papraccha bharataśreṣṭha yadetatpṛcchase'dya mām ॥3॥
html:
saṃstūya pṛthivīṃ devīṃ vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān ।
papraccha bharataśreṣṭha yadetatpṛcchase'dya mām ॥3॥
slp1: saMstUya pfTivIM devIM vAsudevaH pratApavAn । papracCa BarataSrezWa yadetatpfcCase'dya mAm ॥3॥

text: gārhasthyaṃ dharmamāśritya mayā vā madvidhena vā । kimavaśyaṃ dhare kāryaṃ kiṃ vā kṛtvā sukhī bhavet ॥4॥
html:
gārhasthyaṃ dharmamāśritya mayā vā madvidhena vā ।
kimavaśyaṃ dhare kāryaṃ kiṃ vā kṛtvā sukhī bhavet ॥4॥
slp1: gArhasTyaM DarmamASritya mayA vA madviDena vA । kimavaSyaM Dare kAryaM kiM vA kftvA suKI Bavet ॥4॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā manuṣyāścaiva mādhava । ijyāścaivārcanīyāśca yathā caivaṃ nibodha me ॥5॥
html:
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā manuṣyāścaiva mādhava ।
ijyāścaivārcanīyāśca yathā caivaṃ nibodha me ॥5॥
slp1: fzayaH pitaro devA manuzyAScEva mADava । ijyAScEvArcanIyASca yaTA cEvaM niboDa me ॥5॥
author: pṛthivyuvāca ।

text: sadā yajñena devāṃśca ātithyena ca mānavān । chandataśca yathānityamarhānyuñjīta nityaśaḥ । tena hyṛṣigaṇāḥ prītā bhavanti madhusūdana ॥6॥
html:
sadā yajñena devāṃśca ātithyena ca mānavān ।
chandataśca yathānityamarhānyuñjīta nityaśaḥ ।
tena hyṛṣigaṇāḥ prītā bhavanti madhusūdana ॥6॥
slp1: sadA yajYena devAMSca AtiTyena ca mAnavAn । CandataSca yaTAnityamarhAnyuYjIta nityaSaH । tena hyfzigaRAH prItA Bavanti maDusUdana ॥6॥

text: nityamagniṃ paricaredabhuktvā balikarma ca । kuryāttathaiva devā vai prīyante madhusūdana ॥7॥
html:
nityamagniṃ paricaredabhuktvā balikarma ca ।
kuryāttathaiva devā vai prīyante madhusūdana ॥7॥
slp1: nityamagniM paricaredaBuktvA balikarma ca । kuryAttaTEva devA vE prIyante maDusUdana ॥7॥

text: kuryādaharahaḥ śrāddhamannādyenodakena vā । payomūlaphalairvāpi pitṝṇāṃ prītimāharan ॥8॥
html:
kuryādaharahaḥ śrāddhamannādyenodakena vā ।
payomūlaphalairvāpi pitṝṇāṃ prītimāharan ॥8॥
slp1: kuryAdaharahaH SrAdDamannAdyenodakena vA । payomUlaPalErvApi pitFRAM prItimAharan ॥8॥

text: siddhānnādvaiśvadevaṃ vai kuryādagnau yathāvidhi । agnīṣomaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ dhānvantaryamanantaram ॥9॥
html:
siddhānnādvaiśvadevaṃ vai kuryādagnau yathāvidhi ।
agnīṣomaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ dhānvantaryamanantaram ॥9॥
slp1: sidDAnnAdvESvadevaM vE kuryAdagnO yaTAviDi । agnIzomaM vESvadevaM DAnvantaryamanantaram ॥9॥

text: prajānāṃ pataye caiva pṛthagghomo vidhīyate । tathaiva cānupūrvyeṇa balikarma prayojayet ॥10॥
html:
prajānāṃ pataye caiva pṛthagghomo vidhīyate ।
tathaiva cānupūrvyeṇa balikarma prayojayet ॥10॥
slp1: prajAnAM pataye cEva pfTagGomo viDIyate । taTEva cAnupUrvyeRa balikarma prayojayet ॥10॥

text: dakṣiṇāyāṃ yamāyeha pratīcyāṃ varuṇāya ca । somāya cāpyudīcyāṃ vai vāstumadhye dvijātaye ॥11॥
html:
dakṣiṇāyāṃ yamāyeha pratīcyāṃ varuṇāya ca ।
somāya cāpyudīcyāṃ vai vāstumadhye dvijātaye ॥11॥
slp1: dakziRAyAM yamAyeha pratIcyAM varuRAya ca । somAya cApyudIcyAM vE vAstumaDye dvijAtaye ॥11॥

text: dhanvantareḥ prāgudīcyāṃ prācyāṃ śakrāya mādhava । manorvai iti ca prāhurbaliṃ dvāre gṛhasya vai । marudbhyo devatābhyaśca balimantargṛhe haret ॥12॥
html:
dhanvantareḥ prāgudīcyāṃ prācyāṃ śakrāya mādhava ।
manorvai iti ca prāhurbaliṃ dvāre gṛhasya vai ।
marudbhyo devatābhyaśca balimantargṛhe haret ॥12॥
slp1: DanvantareH prAgudIcyAM prAcyAM SakrAya mADava । manorvE iti ca prAhurbaliM dvAre gfhasya vE । marudByo devatAByaSca balimantargfhe haret ॥12॥

text: tathaiva viśvedevebhyo balimākāśato haret । niśācarebhyo bhūtebhyo baliṃ naktaṃ tathā haret ॥13॥
html:
tathaiva viśvedevebhyo balimākāśato haret ।
niśācarebhyo bhūtebhyo baliṃ naktaṃ tathā haret ॥13॥
slp1: taTEva viSvedeveByo balimAkASato haret । niSAcareByo BUteByo baliM naktaM taTA haret ॥13॥

text: evaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ samyagdadyādbhikṣāṃ dvijātaye । alābhe brāhmaṇasyāgnāvagramutkṣipya nikṣipet ॥14॥
html:
evaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ samyagdadyādbhikṣāṃ dvijātaye ।
alābhe brāhmaṇasyāgnāvagramutkṣipya nikṣipet ॥14॥
slp1: evaM kftvA baliM samyagdadyAdBikzAM dvijAtaye । alABe brAhmaRasyAgnAvagramutkzipya nikzipet ॥14॥

text: yadā śrāddhaṃ pitṛbhyaśca dātumiccheta mānavaḥ । tadā paścātprakurvīta nivṛtte śrāddhakarmaṇi ॥15॥
html:
yadā śrāddhaṃ pitṛbhyaśca dātumiccheta mānavaḥ ।
tadā paścātprakurvīta nivṛtte śrāddhakarmaṇi ॥15॥
slp1: yadA SrAdDaM pitfByaSca dAtumicCeta mAnavaH । tadA paScAtprakurvIta nivftte SrAdDakarmaRi ॥15॥

text: pitṝnsantarpayitvā tu baliṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ । vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryātpaścādbrāhmaṇavācanam ॥16॥
html:
pitṝnsantarpayitvā tu baliṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ ।
vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryātpaścādbrāhmaṇavācanam ॥16॥
slp1: pitFnsantarpayitvA tu baliM kuryAdviDAnataH । vESvadevaM tataH kuryAtpaScAdbrAhmaRavAcanam ॥16॥

text: tato'nnenāvaśeṣeṇa bhojayedatithīnapi । arcāpūrvaṃ mahārāja tataḥ prīṇāti mānuṣān ॥17॥
html:
tato'nnenāvaśeṣeṇa bhojayedatithīnapi ।
arcāpūrvaṃ mahārāja tataḥ prīṇāti mānuṣān ॥17॥
slp1: tato'nnenAvaSezeRa BojayedatiTInapi । arcApUrvaM mahArAja tataH prIRAti mAnuzAn ॥17॥

text: anityaṃ hi sthito yasmāttasmādatithirucyate ॥18॥
html: anityaṃ hi sthito yasmāttasmādatithirucyate ॥18॥
slp1: anityaM hi sTito yasmAttasmAdatiTirucyate ॥18॥

text: ācāryasya pituścaiva sakhyurāptasya cātitheḥ । idamasti gṛhe mahyamiti nityaṃ nivedayet ॥19॥
html:
ācāryasya pituścaiva sakhyurāptasya cātitheḥ ।
idamasti gṛhe mahyamiti nityaṃ nivedayet ॥19॥
slp1: AcAryasya pituScEva saKyurAptasya cAtiTeH । idamasti gfhe mahyamiti nityaM nivedayet ॥19॥

text: te yadvadeyustatkuryāditi dharmo vidhīyate । gṛhasthaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇa śiṣṭāśī ca sadā bhavet ॥20॥
html:
te yadvadeyustatkuryāditi dharmo vidhīyate ।
gṛhasthaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇa śiṣṭāśī ca sadā bhavet ॥20॥
slp1: te yadvadeyustatkuryAditi Darmo viDIyate । gfhasTaH puruzaH kfzRa SizwASI ca sadA Bavet ॥20॥

text: rājartvijaṃ snātakaṃ ca guruṃ śvaśurameva ca । arcayenmadhuparkeṇa parisaṃvatsaroṣitān ॥21॥
html:
rājartvijaṃ snātakaṃ ca guruṃ śvaśurameva ca ।
arcayenmadhuparkeṇa parisaṃvatsaroṣitān ॥21॥
slp1: rAjartvijaM snAtakaM ca guruM SvaSurameva ca । arcayenmaDuparkeRa parisaMvatsarozitAn ॥21॥

text: śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca vayobhyaścāvapedbhuvi । vaiśvadevaṃ hi nāmaitatsāyamprātarvidhīyate ॥22॥
html:
śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca vayobhyaścāvapedbhuvi ।
vaiśvadevaṃ hi nāmaitatsāyamprātarvidhīyate ॥22॥
slp1: SvaByaSca SvapaceByaSca vayoByaScAvapedBuvi । vESvadevaM hi nAmEtatsAyamprAtarviDIyate ॥22॥

text: etāṃstu dharmāngārhasthānyaḥ kuryādanasūyakaḥ । sa iharddhiṃ parāṃ prāpya pretya nāke mahīyate ॥23॥
html:
etāṃstu dharmāngārhasthānyaḥ kuryādanasūyakaḥ ।
sa iharddhiṃ parāṃ prāpya pretya nāke mahīyate ॥23॥
slp1: etAMstu DarmAngArhasTAnyaH kuryAdanasUyakaH । sa ihardDiM parAM prApya pretya nAke mahIyate ॥23॥

text: iti bhūmervacaḥ śrutvā vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān । tathā cakāra satataṃ tvamapyevaṃ samācara ॥24॥
html:
iti bhūmervacaḥ śrutvā vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān ।
tathā cakāra satataṃ tvamapyevaṃ samācara ॥24॥
slp1: iti BUmervacaH SrutvA vAsudevaH pratApavAn । taTA cakAra satataM tvamapyevaM samAcara ॥24॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: evaṃ gṛhasthadharmaṃ tvaṃ cetayāno narādhipa । ihaloke yaśaḥ prāpya pretya svargamavāpsyasi] ॥25॥
html:
evaṃ gṛhasthadharmaṃ tvaṃ cetayāno narādhipa ।
ihaloke yaśaḥ prāpya pretya svargamavāpsyasi] ॥25॥
slp1: evaM gfhasTaDarmaM tvaM cetayAno narADipa । ihaloke yaSaH prApya pretya svargamavApsyasi] ॥25॥

text: ālokadānaṃ nāmaitatkīdṛśaṃ bharatarṣabha । kathametatsamutpannaṃ phalaṃ cātra bravīhi me ॥1॥
html:
ālokadānaṃ nāmaitatkīdṛśaṃ bharatarṣabha ।
kathametatsamutpannaṃ phalaṃ cātra bravīhi me ॥1॥
slp1: AlokadAnaM nAmEtatkIdfSaM BaratarzaBa । kaTametatsamutpannaM PalaM cAtra bravIhi me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । manoḥ prajāpatervādaṃ suvarṇasya ca bhārata ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
manoḥ prajāpatervādaṃ suvarṇasya ca bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । manoH prajApatervAdaM suvarRasya ca BArata ॥2॥

text: tapasvī kaścidabhavatsuvarṇo nāma nāmataḥ । varṇato hemavarṇaḥ sa suvarṇa iti paprathe ॥3॥
html:
tapasvī kaścidabhavatsuvarṇo nāma nāmataḥ ।
varṇato hemavarṇaḥ sa suvarṇa iti paprathe ॥3॥
slp1: tapasvI kaScidaBavatsuvarRo nAma nAmataH । varRato hemavarRaH sa suvarRa iti papraTe ॥3॥

text: kulaśīlaguṇopetaḥ svādhyāye ca paraṃ gataḥ । bahūnsvavaṃśaprabhavānsamatītaḥ svakairguṇaiḥ ॥4॥
html:
kulaśīlaguṇopetaḥ svādhyāye ca paraṃ gataḥ ।
bahūnsvavaṃśaprabhavānsamatītaḥ svakairguṇaiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: kulaSIlaguRopetaH svADyAye ca paraM gataH । bahUnsvavaMSapraBavAnsamatItaH svakErguREH ॥4॥

text: sa kadācinmanuṃ vipro dadarśopasasarpa ca । kuśalapraśnamanyonyaṃ tau ca tatra pracakratuḥ ॥5॥
html:
sa kadācinmanuṃ vipro dadarśopasasarpa ca ।
kuśalapraśnamanyonyaṃ tau ca tatra pracakratuḥ ॥5॥
slp1: sa kadAcinmanuM vipro dadarSopasasarpa ca । kuSalapraSnamanyonyaM tO ca tatra pracakratuH ॥5॥

text: tatastau siddhasaṅkalpau merau kāñcanaparvate । ramaṇīye śilāpṛṣṭhe sahitau saṃnyaṣīdatām ॥6॥
html:
tatastau siddhasaṅkalpau merau kāñcanaparvate ।
ramaṇīye śilāpṛṣṭhe sahitau saṃnyaṣīdatām ॥6॥
slp1: tatastO sidDasaNkalpO merO kAYcanaparvate । ramaRIye SilApfzWe sahitO saMnyazIdatAm ॥6॥

text: tatra tau kathayāmāstāṃ kathā nānāvidhāśrayāḥ । brahmarṣidevadaityānāṃ purāṇānāṃ mahātmanām ॥7॥
html:
tatra tau kathayāmāstāṃ kathā nānāvidhāśrayāḥ ।
brahmarṣidevadaityānāṃ purāṇānāṃ mahātmanām ॥7॥
slp1: tatra tO kaTayAmAstAM kaTA nAnAviDASrayAH । brahmarzidevadEtyAnAM purARAnAM mahAtmanAm ॥7॥

text: suvarṇastvabravīdvākyaṃ manuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ prabhum । hitārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ praśnaṃ me vaktumarhasi ॥8॥
html:
suvarṇastvabravīdvākyaṃ manuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ prabhum ।
hitārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ praśnaṃ me vaktumarhasi ॥8॥
slp1: suvarRastvabravIdvAkyaM manuM svAyamBuvaM praBum । hitArTaM sarvaBUtAnAM praSnaM me vaktumarhasi ॥8॥

text: sumanobhiryadijyante daivatāni prajeśvara । kimetatkathamutpannaṃ phalayogaṃ ca śaṃsa me ॥9॥
html:
sumanobhiryadijyante daivatāni prajeśvara ।
kimetatkathamutpannaṃ phalayogaṃ ca śaṃsa me ॥9॥
slp1: sumanoBiryadijyante dEvatAni prajeSvara । kimetatkaTamutpannaM PalayogaM ca SaMsa me ॥9॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । śukrasya ca baleścaiva saṃvādaṃ vai samāgame ॥10॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
śukrasya ca baleścaiva saṃvādaṃ vai samāgame ॥10॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । Sukrasya ca baleScEva saMvAdaM vE samAgame ॥10॥
author: manuruvāca ।

text: balervairocanasyeha trailokyamanuśāsataḥ । samīpamājagāmāśu śukro bhṛgukulodvahaḥ ॥11॥
html:
balervairocanasyeha trailokyamanuśāsataḥ ।
samīpamājagāmāśu śukro bhṛgukulodvahaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: balervErocanasyeha trElokyamanuSAsataH । samIpamAjagAmASu Sukro BfgukulodvahaH ॥11॥

text: tamarghyādibhirabhyarcya bhārgavaṃ so'surādhipaḥ । niṣasādāsane paścādvidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaḥ ॥12॥
html:
tamarghyādibhirabhyarcya bhārgavaṃ so'surādhipaḥ ।
niṣasādāsane paścādvidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tamarGyAdiBiraByarcya BArgavaM so'surADipaH । nizasAdAsane paScAdviDivadBUridakziRaH ॥12॥

text: katheyamabhavattatra yā tvayā parikīrtitā । sumanodhūpadīpānāṃ sampradāne phalaṃ prati ॥13॥
html:
katheyamabhavattatra yā tvayā parikīrtitā ।
sumanodhūpadīpānāṃ sampradāne phalaṃ prati ॥13॥
slp1: kaTeyamaBavattatra yA tvayA parikIrtitA । sumanoDUpadIpAnAM sampradAne PalaM prati ॥13॥

text: tataḥ papraccha daityendraḥ kavīndraṃ praśnamuttamam । sumanodhūpadīpānāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ brahmavittama । pradānasya dvijaśreṣṭha tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥14॥
html:
tataḥ papraccha daityendraḥ kavīndraṃ praśnamuttamam ।
sumanodhūpadīpānāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ brahmavittama ।
pradānasya dvijaśreṣṭha tadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥14॥
slp1: tataH papracCa dEtyendraH kavIndraM praSnamuttamam । sumanoDUpadIpAnAM kiM PalaM brahmavittama । pradAnasya dvijaSrezWa tadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥14॥

text: tapaḥ pūrvaṃ samutpannaṃ dharmastasmādanantaram । etasminnantare caiva vīrudoṣadhya eva ca ॥15॥
html:
tapaḥ pūrvaṃ samutpannaṃ dharmastasmādanantaram ।
etasminnantare caiva vīrudoṣadhya eva ca ॥15॥
slp1: tapaH pUrvaM samutpannaM DarmastasmAdanantaram । etasminnantare cEva vIrudozaDya eva ca ॥15॥
author: śukra uvāca ।

text: somasyātmā ca bahudhā sambhūtaḥ pṛthivītale । amṛtaṃ ca viṣaṃ caiva yāścānyāstulyajātayaḥ ॥16॥
html:
somasyātmā ca bahudhā sambhūtaḥ pṛthivītale ।
amṛtaṃ ca viṣaṃ caiva yāścānyāstulyajātayaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: somasyAtmA ca bahuDA samBUtaH pfTivItale । amftaM ca vizaM cEva yAScAnyAstulyajAtayaH ॥16॥

text: amṛtaṃ manasaḥ prītiṃ sadyaḥ puṣṭiṃ dadāti ca । mano glapayate tīvraṃ viṣaṃ gandhena sarvaśaḥ ॥17॥
html:
amṛtaṃ manasaḥ prītiṃ sadyaḥ puṣṭiṃ dadāti ca ।
mano glapayate tīvraṃ viṣaṃ gandhena sarvaśaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: amftaM manasaH prItiM sadyaH puzwiM dadAti ca । mano glapayate tIvraM vizaM ganDena sarvaSaH ॥17॥

text: amṛtaṃ maṅgalaṃ viddhi mahadviṣamamaṅgalam । oṣadhyo hyamṛtaṃ sarvaṃ viṣaṃ tejo'gnisambhavam ॥18॥
html:
amṛtaṃ maṅgalaṃ viddhi mahadviṣamamaṅgalam ।
oṣadhyo hyamṛtaṃ sarvaṃ viṣaṃ tejo'gnisambhavam ॥18॥
slp1: amftaM maNgalaM vidDi mahadvizamamaNgalam । ozaDyo hyamftaM sarvaM vizaM tejo'gnisamBavam ॥18॥

text: mano hlādayate yasmācchriyaṃ cāpi dadhāti ha । tasmātsumanasaḥ proktā naraiḥ sukṛtakarmabhiḥ ॥19॥
html:
mano hlādayate yasmācchriyaṃ cāpi dadhāti ha ।
tasmātsumanasaḥ proktā naraiḥ sukṛtakarmabhiḥ ॥19॥
slp1: mano hlAdayate yasmAcCriyaM cApi daDAti ha । tasmAtsumanasaH proktA narEH sukftakarmaBiH ॥19॥

text: devatābhyaḥ sumanaso yo dadāti naraḥ śuciḥ । tasmātsumanasaḥ proktā yasmāttuṣyanti devatāḥ ॥20॥
html:
devatābhyaḥ sumanaso yo dadāti naraḥ śuciḥ ।
tasmātsumanasaḥ proktā yasmāttuṣyanti devatāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: devatAByaH sumanaso yo dadAti naraH SuciH । tasmAtsumanasaH proktA yasmAttuzyanti devatAH ॥20॥

text: yaṃ yamuddiśya dīyerandevaṃ sumanasaḥ prabho । maṅgalārthaṃ sa tenāsya prīto bhavati daityapa ॥21॥
html:
yaṃ yamuddiśya dīyerandevaṃ sumanasaḥ prabho ।
maṅgalārthaṃ sa tenāsya prīto bhavati daityapa ॥21॥
slp1: yaM yamuddiSya dIyerandevaM sumanasaH praBo । maNgalArTaM sa tenAsya prIto Bavati dEtyapa ॥21॥

text: jñeyāstūgrāśca saumyāśca tejasvinyaśca tāḥ pṛthak । oṣadhyo bahuvīryāśca bahurūpāstathaiva ca ॥22॥
html:
jñeyāstūgrāśca saumyāśca tejasvinyaśca tāḥ pṛthak ।
oṣadhyo bahuvīryāśca bahurūpāstathaiva ca ॥22॥
slp1: jYeyAstUgrASca sOmyASca tejasvinyaSca tAH pfTak । ozaDyo bahuvIryASca bahurUpAstaTEva ca ॥22॥

text: yajñiyānāṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāmayajñiyānnibodha me । āsurāṇi ca mālyāni daivatebhyo hitāni ca ॥23॥
html:
yajñiyānāṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāmayajñiyānnibodha me ।
āsurāṇi ca mālyāni daivatebhyo hitāni ca ॥23॥
slp1: yajYiyAnAM ca vfkzARAmayajYiyAnniboDa me । AsurARi ca mAlyAni dEvateByo hitAni ca ॥23॥

text: rākṣasānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca yakṣāṇāṃ ca tathā priyāḥ । pitṝṇāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca kāntā yāstvanupūrvaśaḥ ॥24॥
html:
rākṣasānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca yakṣāṇāṃ ca tathā priyāḥ ।
pitṝṇāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca kāntā yāstvanupūrvaśaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: rAkzasAnAM surARAM ca yakzARAM ca taTA priyAH । pitFRAM mAnuzARAM ca kAntA yAstvanupUrvaSaH ॥24॥

text: vanyā grāmyāśceha tathā kṛṣṭoptāḥ parvatāśrayāḥ । akaṇṭakāḥ kaṇṭakinyo gandharūparasānvitāḥ ॥25॥
html:
vanyā grāmyāśceha tathā kṛṣṭoptāḥ parvatāśrayāḥ ।
akaṇṭakāḥ kaṇṭakinyo gandharūparasānvitāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: vanyA grAmyASceha taTA kfzwoptAH parvatASrayAH । akaRwakAH kaRwakinyo ganDarUparasAnvitAH ॥25॥

text: dvividho hi smṛto gandha iṣṭo'niṣṭaśca puṣpajaḥ । iṣṭagandhāni devānāṃ puṣpāṇīti vibhāvayet ॥26॥
html:
dvividho hi smṛto gandha iṣṭo'niṣṭaśca puṣpajaḥ ।
iṣṭagandhāni devānāṃ puṣpāṇīti vibhāvayet ॥26॥
slp1: dviviDo hi smfto ganDa izwo'nizwaSca puzpajaH । izwaganDAni devAnAM puzpARIti viBAvayet ॥26॥

text: akaṇṭakānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ śvetaprāyāśca varṇataḥ । teṣāṃ puṣpāṇi devānāmiṣṭāni satataṃ prabho ॥27॥
html:
akaṇṭakānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ śvetaprāyāśca varṇataḥ ।
teṣāṃ puṣpāṇi devānāmiṣṭāni satataṃ prabho ॥27॥
slp1: akaRwakAnAM vfkzARAM SvetaprAyASca varRataH । tezAM puzpARi devAnAmizwAni satataM praBo ॥27॥

text: jalajāni ca mālyāni padmādīni ca yāni ca । gandharvanāgayakṣebhyastāni dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ॥28॥
html:
jalajāni ca mālyāni padmādīni ca yāni ca ।
gandharvanāgayakṣebhyastāni dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: jalajAni ca mAlyAni padmAdIni ca yAni ca । ganDarvanAgayakzeByastAni dadyAdvicakzaRaH ॥28॥

text: oṣadhyo raktapuṣpāśca kaṭukāḥ kaṇṭakānvitāḥ । śatrūṇāmabhicārārthamatharvasu nidarśitāḥ ॥29॥
html:
oṣadhyo raktapuṣpāśca kaṭukāḥ kaṇṭakānvitāḥ ।
śatrūṇāmabhicārārthamatharvasu nidarśitāḥ ॥29॥
slp1: ozaDyo raktapuzpASca kawukAH kaRwakAnvitAH । SatrURAmaBicArArTamaTarvasu nidarSitAH ॥29॥

text: tīkṣṇavīryāstu bhūtānāṃ durālambhāḥ sakaṇṭakāḥ । raktabhūyiṣṭhavarṇāśca kṛṣṇāścaivopahārayet ॥30॥
html:
tīkṣṇavīryāstu bhūtānāṃ durālambhāḥ sakaṇṭakāḥ ।
raktabhūyiṣṭhavarṇāśca kṛṣṇāścaivopahārayet ॥30॥
slp1: tIkzRavIryAstu BUtAnAM durAlamBAH sakaRwakAH । raktaBUyizWavarRASca kfzRAScEvopahArayet ॥30॥

text: manohṛdayanandinyo vimarde madhurāśca yāḥ । cārurūpāḥ sumanaso mānuṣāṇāṃ smṛtā vibho ॥31॥
html:
manohṛdayanandinyo vimarde madhurāśca yāḥ ।
cārurūpāḥ sumanaso mānuṣāṇāṃ smṛtā vibho ॥31॥
slp1: manohfdayanandinyo vimarde maDurASca yAH । cArurUpAH sumanaso mAnuzARAM smftA viBo ॥31॥

text: na tu śmaśānasambhūtā na devāyatanodbhavāḥ । saṃnayetpuṣṭiyukteṣu vivāheṣu rahaḥsu ca ॥32॥
html:
na tu śmaśānasambhūtā na devāyatanodbhavāḥ ।
saṃnayetpuṣṭiyukteṣu vivāheṣu rahaḥsu ca ॥32॥
slp1: na tu SmaSAnasamBUtA na devAyatanodBavAH । saMnayetpuzwiyuktezu vivAhezu rahaHsu ca ॥32॥

text: girisānuruhāḥ saumyā devānāmupapādayet । prokṣitābhyukṣitāḥ saumyā yathāyogaṃ yathāsmṛti ॥33॥
html:
girisānuruhāḥ saumyā devānāmupapādayet ।
prokṣitābhyukṣitāḥ saumyā yathāyogaṃ yathāsmṛti ॥33॥
slp1: girisAnuruhAH sOmyA devAnAmupapAdayet । prokzitAByukzitAH sOmyA yaTAyogaM yaTAsmfti ॥33॥

text: gandhena devāstuṣyanti darśanādyakṣarākṣasāḥ । nāgāḥ samupabhogena tribhiretaistu mānuṣāḥ ॥34॥
html:
gandhena devāstuṣyanti darśanādyakṣarākṣasāḥ ।
nāgāḥ samupabhogena tribhiretaistu mānuṣāḥ ॥34॥
slp1: ganDena devAstuzyanti darSanAdyakzarAkzasAH । nAgAH samupaBogena triBiretEstu mAnuzAH ॥34॥

text: sadyaḥ prīṇāti devānvai te prītā bhāvayantyuta । saṅkalpasiddhā martyānāmīpsitaiśca manorathaiḥ ॥35॥
html:
sadyaḥ prīṇāti devānvai te prītā bhāvayantyuta ।
saṅkalpasiddhā martyānāmīpsitaiśca manorathaiḥ ॥35॥
slp1: sadyaH prIRAti devAnvE te prItA BAvayantyuta । saNkalpasidDA martyAnAmIpsitESca manoraTEH ॥35॥

text: devāḥ prīṇanti satataṃ mānitā mānayanti ca । avajñātāvadhūtāśca nirdahantyadhamānnarān ॥36॥
html:
devāḥ prīṇanti satataṃ mānitā mānayanti ca ।
avajñātāvadhūtāśca nirdahantyadhamānnarān ॥36॥
slp1: devAH prIRanti satataM mAnitA mAnayanti ca । avajYAtAvaDUtASca nirdahantyaDamAnnarAn ॥36॥

text: ataūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi dhūpadānavidhau phalam । dhūpāṃśca vividhānsādhūnasādhūṃśca nibodha me ॥37॥
html:
ataūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi dhūpadānavidhau phalam ।
dhūpāṃśca vividhānsādhūnasādhūṃśca nibodha me ॥37॥
slp1: ataUrDvaM pravakzyAmi DUpadAnaviDO Palam । DUpAMSca viviDAnsADUnasADUMSca niboDa me ॥37॥

text: niryāsaḥ saralaścaiva kṛtrimaścaiva te trayaḥ । iṣṭāniṣṭo bhavedgandhastanme vistarataḥ śṛṇu ॥38॥
html:
niryāsaḥ saralaścaiva kṛtrimaścaiva te trayaḥ ।
iṣṭāniṣṭo bhavedgandhastanme vistarataḥ śṛṇu ॥38॥
slp1: niryAsaH saralaScEva kftrimaScEva te trayaH । izwAnizwo BavedganDastanme vistarataH SfRu ॥38॥

text: niryāsāḥ sallakīvarjyā devānāṃ dayitāstu te । gugguluḥ pravarasteṣāṃ sarveṣāmiti niścayaḥ ॥39॥
html:
niryāsāḥ sallakīvarjyā devānāṃ dayitāstu te ।
gugguluḥ pravarasteṣāṃ sarveṣāmiti niścayaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: niryAsAH sallakIvarjyA devAnAM dayitAstu te । gugguluH pravarastezAM sarvezAmiti niScayaH ॥39॥

text: aguruḥ sāriṇāṃ śreṣṭho yakṣarākṣasabhoginām । daityānāṃ sallakījaśca kāṅkṣito yaśca tadvidhaḥ ॥40॥
html:
aguruḥ sāriṇāṃ śreṣṭho yakṣarākṣasabhoginām ।
daityānāṃ sallakījaśca kāṅkṣito yaśca tadvidhaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: aguruH sAriRAM SrezWo yakzarAkzasaBoginAm । dEtyAnAM sallakIjaSca kANkzito yaSca tadviDaH ॥40॥

text: atha sarjarasādīnāṃ gandhaiḥ pārthivadāravaiḥ । phāṇitāsavasaṃyuktairmanuṣyāṇāṃ vidhīyate ॥41॥
html:
atha sarjarasādīnāṃ gandhaiḥ pārthivadāravaiḥ ।
phāṇitāsavasaṃyuktairmanuṣyāṇāṃ vidhīyate ॥41॥
slp1: aTa sarjarasAdInAM ganDEH pArTivadAravEH । PARitAsavasaMyuktErmanuzyARAM viDIyate ॥41॥

text: devadānavabhūtānāṃ sadyastuṣṭikaraḥ smṛtaḥ । ye'nye vaihārikāste tu mānuṣāṇāmiti smṛtāḥ ॥42॥
html:
devadānavabhūtānāṃ sadyastuṣṭikaraḥ smṛtaḥ ।
ye'nye vaihārikāste tu mānuṣāṇāmiti smṛtāḥ ॥42॥
slp1: devadAnavaBUtAnAM sadyastuzwikaraH smftaH । ye'nye vEhArikAste tu mAnuzARAmiti smftAH ॥42॥

text: ya evoktāḥ sumanasāṃ pradāne guṇahetavaḥ । dhūpeṣvapi parijñeyāsta eva prītivardhanāḥ ॥43॥
html:
ya evoktāḥ sumanasāṃ pradāne guṇahetavaḥ ।
dhūpeṣvapi parijñeyāsta eva prītivardhanāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: ya evoktAH sumanasAM pradAne guRahetavaH । DUpezvapi parijYeyAsta eva prItivarDanAH ॥43॥

text: dīpadāne pravakṣyāmi phalayogamanuttamam । yathā yena yadā caiva pradeyā yādṛśāśca te ॥44॥
html:
dīpadāne pravakṣyāmi phalayogamanuttamam ।
yathā yena yadā caiva pradeyā yādṛśāśca te ॥44॥
slp1: dIpadAne pravakzyAmi Palayogamanuttamam । yaTA yena yadA cEva pradeyA yAdfSASca te ॥44॥

text: jyotistejaḥ prakāśaścāpyūrdhvagaṃ cāpi varṇyate । pradānaṃ tejasāṃ tasmāttejo vardhayate nṛṇām ॥45॥
html:
jyotistejaḥ prakāśaścāpyūrdhvagaṃ cāpi varṇyate ।
pradānaṃ tejasāṃ tasmāttejo vardhayate nṛṇām ॥45॥
slp1: jyotistejaH prakASaScApyUrDvagaM cApi varRyate । pradAnaM tejasAM tasmAttejo varDayate nfRAm ॥45॥

text: andhaṃ tamastamisraṃ ca dakṣiṇāyanameva ca । uttarāyaṇametasmājjyotirdānaṃ praśasyate ॥46॥
html:
andhaṃ tamastamisraṃ ca dakṣiṇāyanameva ca ।
uttarāyaṇametasmājjyotirdānaṃ praśasyate ॥46॥
slp1: anDaM tamastamisraM ca dakziRAyanameva ca । uttarAyaRametasmAjjyotirdAnaM praSasyate ॥46॥

text: yasmādūrdhvagametattu tamasaścaiva bheṣajam । tasmādūrdhvagaterdātā bhavediti viniścayaḥ ॥47॥
html:
yasmādūrdhvagametattu tamasaścaiva bheṣajam ।
tasmādūrdhvagaterdātā bhavediti viniścayaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: yasmAdUrDvagametattu tamasaScEva Bezajam । tasmAdUrDvagaterdAtA Bavediti viniScayaH ॥47॥

text: devāstejasvino yasmātprabhāvantaḥ prakāśakāḥ । tāmasā rākṣasāśceti tasmāddīpaḥ pradīyate ॥48॥
html:
devāstejasvino yasmātprabhāvantaḥ prakāśakāḥ ।
tāmasā rākṣasāśceti tasmāddīpaḥ pradīyate ॥48॥
slp1: devAstejasvino yasmAtpraBAvantaH prakASakAH । tAmasA rAkzasASceti tasmAddIpaH pradIyate ॥48॥

text: ālokadānāccakṣuṣmānprabhāyukto bhavennaraḥ । tāndattvā nopahiṃseta na harennopanāśayet ॥49॥
html:
ālokadānāccakṣuṣmānprabhāyukto bhavennaraḥ ।
tāndattvā nopahiṃseta na harennopanāśayet ॥49॥
slp1: AlokadAnAccakzuzmAnpraBAyukto BavennaraH । tAndattvA nopahiMseta na harennopanASayet ॥49॥

text: dīpahartā bhavedandhastamogatirasuprabhaḥ । dīpapradaḥ svargaloke dīpamālī virājate ॥50॥
html:
dīpahartā bhavedandhastamogatirasuprabhaḥ ।
dīpapradaḥ svargaloke dīpamālī virājate ॥50॥
slp1: dIpahartA BavedanDastamogatirasupraBaH । dIpapradaH svargaloke dIpamAlI virAjate ॥50॥

text: haviṣā prathamaḥ kalpo dvitīyastvauṣadhīrasaiḥ । vasāmedosthiniryāsairna kāryaḥ puṣṭimicchatā ॥51॥
html:
haviṣā prathamaḥ kalpo dvitīyastvauṣadhīrasaiḥ ।
vasāmedosthiniryāsairna kāryaḥ puṣṭimicchatā ॥51॥
slp1: havizA praTamaH kalpo dvitIyastvOzaDIrasEH । vasAmedosTiniryAsErna kAryaH puzwimicCatA ॥51॥

text: giriprapāte gahane caityasthāne catuṣpathe । dīpadātā bhavennityaṃ ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ॥52॥
html:
giriprapāte gahane caityasthāne catuṣpathe ।
dīpadātā bhavennityaṃ ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: giriprapAte gahane cEtyasTAne catuzpaTe । dIpadAtA BavennityaM ya icCedBUtimAtmanaH ॥52॥

text: kuloddyoto viśuddhātmā prakāśatvaṃ ca gacchati । jyotiṣāṃ caiva sālokyaṃ dīpadātā naraḥ sadā ॥53॥
html:
kuloddyoto viśuddhātmā prakāśatvaṃ ca gacchati ।
jyotiṣāṃ caiva sālokyaṃ dīpadātā naraḥ sadā ॥53॥
slp1: kuloddyoto viSudDAtmA prakASatvaM ca gacCati । jyotizAM cEva sAlokyaM dIpadAtA naraH sadA ॥53॥

text: balikarmasu vakṣyāmi guṇānkarmaphalodayān । devayakṣoraganṛṇāṃ bhūtānāmatha rakṣasām ॥54॥
html:
balikarmasu vakṣyāmi guṇānkarmaphalodayān ।
devayakṣoraganṛṇāṃ bhūtānāmatha rakṣasām ॥54॥
slp1: balikarmasu vakzyAmi guRAnkarmaPalodayAn । devayakzoraganfRAM BUtAnAmaTa rakzasAm ॥54॥

text: yeṣāṃ nāgrabhujo viprā devatātithibālakāḥ । rākṣasāneva tānviddhi nirvaṣaṭkāramaṅgalān ॥55॥
html:
yeṣāṃ nāgrabhujo viprā devatātithibālakāḥ ।
rākṣasāneva tānviddhi nirvaṣaṭkāramaṅgalān ॥55॥
slp1: yezAM nAgraBujo viprA devatAtiTibAlakAH । rAkzasAneva tAnvidDi nirvazawkAramaNgalAn ॥55॥

text: tasmādagraṃ prayaccheta devebhyaḥ pratipūjitam । śirasā praṇataścāpi haredbalimatandritaḥ ॥56॥
html:
tasmādagraṃ prayaccheta devebhyaḥ pratipūjitam ।
śirasā praṇataścāpi haredbalimatandritaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: tasmAdagraM prayacCeta deveByaH pratipUjitam । SirasA praRataScApi haredbalimatandritaH ॥56॥

text: gṛhyā hi devatā nityamāśaṃsanti gṛhātsadā । bāhyāścāgantavo ye'nye yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ ॥57॥
html:
gṛhyā hi devatā nityamāśaṃsanti gṛhātsadā ।
bāhyāścāgantavo ye'nye yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ ॥57॥
slp1: gfhyA hi devatA nityamASaMsanti gfhAtsadA । bAhyAScAgantavo ye'nye yakzarAkzasapannagAH ॥57॥

text: ito dattena jīvanti devatāḥ pitarastathā । te prītāḥ prīṇayantyetānāyuṣā yaśasā dhanaiḥ ॥58॥
html:
ito dattena jīvanti devatāḥ pitarastathā ।
te prītāḥ prīṇayantyetānāyuṣā yaśasā dhanaiḥ ॥58॥
slp1: ito dattena jIvanti devatAH pitarastaTA । te prItAH prIRayantyetAnAyuzA yaSasA DanEH ॥58॥

text: balayaḥ saha puṣpaistu devānāmupahārayet । dadhidrapsayutāḥ puṇyāḥ sugandhāḥ priyadarśanāḥ ॥59॥
html:
balayaḥ saha puṣpaistu devānāmupahārayet ।
dadhidrapsayutāḥ puṇyāḥ sugandhāḥ priyadarśanāḥ ॥59॥
slp1: balayaH saha puzpEstu devAnAmupahArayet । daDidrapsayutAH puRyAH suganDAH priyadarSanAH ॥59॥

text: kāryā rudhiramāṃsāḍhyā balayo yakṣarakṣasām । surāsavapuraskārā lājollepanabhūṣitāḥ ॥60॥
html:
kāryā rudhiramāṃsāḍhyā balayo yakṣarakṣasām ।
surāsavapuraskārā lājollepanabhūṣitāḥ ॥60॥
slp1: kAryA ruDiramAMsAQyA balayo yakzarakzasAm । surAsavapuraskArA lAjollepanaBUzitAH ॥60॥

text: nāgānāṃ dayitā nityaṃ padmotpalavimiśritāḥ । tilānguḍasusampannānbhūtānāmupahārayet ॥61॥
html:
nāgānāṃ dayitā nityaṃ padmotpalavimiśritāḥ ।
tilānguḍasusampannānbhūtānāmupahārayet ॥61॥
slp1: nAgAnAM dayitA nityaM padmotpalavimiSritAH । tilAnguqasusampannAnBUtAnAmupahArayet ॥61॥

text: agradātāgrabhogī syādbalavarṇasamanvitaḥ । tasmādagraṃ prayaccheta devebhyaḥ pratipūjitam ॥62॥
html:
agradātāgrabhogī syādbalavarṇasamanvitaḥ ।
tasmādagraṃ prayaccheta devebhyaḥ pratipūjitam ॥62॥
slp1: agradAtAgraBogI syAdbalavarRasamanvitaH । tasmAdagraM prayacCeta deveByaH pratipUjitam ॥62॥

text: jvalatyaharaho veśma yāścāsya gṛhadevatāḥ । tāḥ pūjyā bhūtikāmena prasṛtāgrapradāyinā ॥63॥
html:
jvalatyaharaho veśma yāścāsya gṛhadevatāḥ ।
tāḥ pūjyā bhūtikāmena prasṛtāgrapradāyinā ॥63॥
slp1: jvalatyaharaho veSma yAScAsya gfhadevatAH । tAH pUjyA BUtikAmena prasftAgrapradAyinA ॥63॥

text: ityetadasurendrāya kāvyaḥ provāca bhārgavaḥ । suvarṇāya manuḥ prāha suvarṇo nāradāya ca ॥64॥
html:
ityetadasurendrāya kāvyaḥ provāca bhārgavaḥ ।
suvarṇāya manuḥ prāha suvarṇo nāradāya ca ॥64॥
slp1: ityetadasurendrAya kAvyaH provAca BArgavaH । suvarRAya manuH prAha suvarRo nAradAya ca ॥64॥

text: nārado'pi mayi prāha guṇānetānmahādyute । tvamapyetadviditveha sarvamācara putraka] ॥65॥
html:
nārado'pi mayi prāha guṇānetānmahādyute ।
tvamapyetadviditveha sarvamācara putraka] ॥65॥
slp1: nArado'pi mayi prAha guRAnetAnmahAdyute । tvamapyetadviditveha sarvamAcara putraka] ॥65॥

text: śrutaṃ me bharataśreṣṭha puṣpadhūpapradāyinām । phalaṃ balividhāne ca tadbhūyo vaktumarhasi ॥1॥
html:
śrutaṃ me bharataśreṣṭha puṣpadhūpapradāyinām ।
phalaṃ balividhāne ca tadbhūyo vaktumarhasi ॥1॥
slp1: SrutaM me BarataSrezWa puzpaDUpapradAyinAm । PalaM baliviDAne ca tadBUyo vaktumarhasi ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: dhūpapradānasya phalaṃ pradīpasya tathaiva ca । balayaśca kimarthaṃ vai kṣipyante gṛhamedhibhiḥ ॥2॥
html:
dhūpapradānasya phalaṃ pradīpasya tathaiva ca ।
balayaśca kimarthaṃ vai kṣipyante gṛhamedhibhiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: DUpapradAnasya PalaM pradIpasya taTEva ca । balayaSca kimarTaM vE kzipyante gfhameDiBiH ॥2॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । nahuṣaṃ prati saṃvādamagastyasya bhṛgostathā ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
nahuṣaṃ prati saṃvādamagastyasya bhṛgostathā ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । nahuzaM prati saMvAdamagastyasya BfgostaTA ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: nahuṣo hi mahārāja rājarṣiḥ sumahātapāḥ । devarājyamanuprāptaḥ sukṛteneha karmaṇā ॥4॥
html:
nahuṣo hi mahārāja rājarṣiḥ sumahātapāḥ ।
devarājyamanuprāptaḥ sukṛteneha karmaṇā ॥4॥
slp1: nahuzo hi mahArAja rAjarziH sumahAtapAH । devarAjyamanuprAptaH sukfteneha karmaRA ॥4॥

text: tatrāpi prayato rājannahuṣastridive vasan । mānuṣīścaiva divyāśca kurvāṇo vividhāḥ kriyāḥ ॥5॥
html:
tatrāpi prayato rājannahuṣastridive vasan ।
mānuṣīścaiva divyāśca kurvāṇo vividhāḥ kriyāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tatrApi prayato rAjannahuzastridive vasan । mAnuzIScEva divyASca kurvARo viviDAH kriyAH ॥5॥

text: mānuṣyastatra sarvāḥ sma kriyāstasya mahātmanaḥ । pravṛttāstridive rājandivyāścaiva sanātanāḥ ॥6॥
html:
mānuṣyastatra sarvāḥ sma kriyāstasya mahātmanaḥ ।
pravṛttāstridive rājandivyāścaiva sanātanāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: mAnuzyastatra sarvAH sma kriyAstasya mahAtmanaH । pravfttAstridive rAjandivyAScEva sanAtanAH ॥6॥

text: agnikāryāṇi samidhaḥ kuśāḥ sumanasastathā । balayaścānnalājābhirdhūpanaṃ dīpakarma ca ॥7॥
html:
agnikāryāṇi samidhaḥ kuśāḥ sumanasastathā ।
balayaścānnalājābhirdhūpanaṃ dīpakarma ca ॥7॥
slp1: agnikAryARi samiDaH kuSAH sumanasastaTA । balayaScAnnalAjABirDUpanaM dIpakarma ca ॥7॥

text: sarvaṃ tasya gṛhe rājñaḥ prāvartata mahātmanaḥ । japayajñānmanoyajñāṃstridive'pi cakāra saḥ ॥8॥
html:
sarvaṃ tasya gṛhe rājñaḥ prāvartata mahātmanaḥ ।
japayajñānmanoyajñāṃstridive'pi cakāra saḥ ॥8॥
slp1: sarvaM tasya gfhe rAjYaH prAvartata mahAtmanaH । japayajYAnmanoyajYAMstridive'pi cakAra saH ॥8॥

text: daivatānyarcayaṃścāpi vidhivatsa sureśvaraḥ । sarvāṇyeva yathānyāyaṃ yathāpūrvamarindama ॥9॥
html:
daivatānyarcayaṃścāpi vidhivatsa sureśvaraḥ ।
sarvāṇyeva yathānyāyaṃ yathāpūrvamarindama ॥9॥
slp1: dEvatAnyarcayaMScApi viDivatsa sureSvaraH । sarvARyeva yaTAnyAyaM yaTApUrvamarindama ॥9॥

text: athendrasya bhaviṣyatvādahaṅkārastamāviśat । sarvāścaiva kriyāstasya paryahīyanta bhūpate ॥10॥
html:
athendrasya bhaviṣyatvādahaṅkārastamāviśat ।
sarvāścaiva kriyāstasya paryahīyanta bhūpate ॥10॥
slp1: aTendrasya BavizyatvAdahaNkArastamAviSat । sarvAScEva kriyAstasya paryahIyanta BUpate ॥10॥

text: sa ṛṣīnvāhayāmāsa varadānamadānvitaḥ । parihīnakriyaścāpi durbalatvamupeyivān ॥11॥

slp1: sa fzInvAhayAmAsa varadAnamadAnvitaH । parihInakriyaScApi durbalatvamupeyivAn ॥11॥

text: tasya vāhayataḥ kālo munimukhyāṃstapodhanān । ahaṅkārābhibhūtasya sumahānatyavartata ॥12॥
html:
tasya vāhayataḥ kālo munimukhyāṃstapodhanān ।
ahaṅkārābhibhūtasya sumahānatyavartata ॥12॥
slp1: tasya vAhayataH kAlo munimuKyAMstapoDanAn । ahaNkArABiBUtasya sumahAnatyavartata ॥12॥

text: atha paryāyaśa ṛṣīnvāhanāyopacakrame । paryāyaścāpyagastyasya samapadyata bhārata ॥13॥
html:
atha paryāyaśa ṛṣīnvāhanāyopacakrame ।
paryāyaścāpyagastyasya samapadyata bhārata ॥13॥
slp1: aTa paryAyaSa fzInvAhanAyopacakrame । paryAyaScApyagastyasya samapadyata BArata ॥13॥

text: athāgamya mahātejā bhṛgurbrahmavidāṃ varaḥ । agastyamāśramasthaṃ vai samupetyedamabravīt ॥14॥
html:
athāgamya mahātejā bhṛgurbrahmavidāṃ varaḥ ।
agastyamāśramasthaṃ vai samupetyedamabravīt ॥14॥
slp1: aTAgamya mahAtejA BfgurbrahmavidAM varaH । agastyamASramasTaM vE samupetyedamabravIt ॥14॥

text: evaṃ vayamasatkāraṃ devendrasyāsya durmateḥ । nahuṣasya kimarthaṃ vai marṣayāma mahāmune ॥15॥
html:

slp1: evaM vayamasatkAraM devendrasyAsya durmateH । nahuzasya kimarTaM vE marzayAma mahAmune ॥15॥

text: kathameṣa mayā śakyaḥ śaptuṃ yasya mahāmune । varadena varo datto bhavato viditaśca saḥ ॥16॥
html:
kathameṣa mayā śakyaḥ śaptuṃ yasya mahāmune ।
varadena varo datto bhavato viditaśca saḥ ॥16॥
slp1: kaTameza mayA SakyaH SaptuM yasya mahAmune । varadena varo datto Bavato viditaSca saH ॥16॥

text: yo me dṛṣṭipathaṃ gacchetsa me vaśyo bhavediti । ityanena varo devādyācito gacchatā divam ॥17॥
html:
yo me dṛṣṭipathaṃ gacchetsa me vaśyo bhavediti ।

slp1: yo me dfzwipaTaM gacCetsa me vaSyo Bavediti । ityanena varo devAdyAcito gacCatA divam ॥17॥

html:
evaṃ na dagdhaḥ sa mayā bhavatā ca na saṃśayaḥ ।
anyenāpyṛṣimukhyena na śapto na ca pātitaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: evaM na dagDaH sa mayA BavatA ca na saMSayaH । anyenApyfzimuKyena na Sapto na ca pAtitaH ॥18॥

text: amṛtaṃ caiva pānāya dattamasmai purā vibho । mahātmane tadarthaṃ ca nāsmābhirvinipātyate ॥19॥
html:
