slp1: amftaM cEva pAnAya dattamasmE purA viBo । mahAtmane tadarTaM ca nAsmABirvinipAtyate ॥19॥

text: prāyacchata varaṃ devaḥ prajānāṃ duḥkhakārakam । dvijeṣvadharmayuktāni sa karoti narādhamaḥ ॥20॥
html:
prāyacchata varaṃ devaḥ prajānāṃ duḥkhakārakam ।
dvijeṣvadharmayuktāni sa karoti narādhamaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: prAyacCata varaM devaH prajAnAM duHKakArakam । dvijezvaDarmayuktAni sa karoti narADamaH ॥20॥

text: atra yatprāptakālaṃ nastadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara । bhavāṃścāpi yathā brūyātkurvīmahi tathā vayam ॥21॥
html:
atra yatprāptakālaṃ nastadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara ।
bhavāṃścāpi yathā brūyātkurvīmahi tathā vayam ॥21॥
slp1: atra yatprAptakAlaM nastadbrUhi vadatAM vara । BavAMScApi yaTA brUyAtkurvImahi taTA vayam ॥21॥

text: pitāmahaniyogena bhavantamahamāgataḥ । pratikartuṃ balavati nahuṣe darpamāsthite ॥22॥
html:
pitāmahaniyogena bhavantamahamāgataḥ ।

slp1: pitAmahaniyogena BavantamahamAgataH । pratikartuM balavati nahuze darpamAsTite ॥22॥

text: adya hi tvā sudurbuddhī rathe yokṣyati devarāṭ । adyainamahamudvṛttaṃ kariṣye'nindramojasā ॥23॥
html:
adya hi tvā sudurbuddhī rathe yokṣyati devarāṭ ।
adyainamahamudvṛttaṃ kariṣye'nindramojasā ॥23॥
slp1: adya hi tvA sudurbudDI raTe yokzyati devarAw । adyEnamahamudvfttaM karizye'nindramojasA ॥23॥

html:
adyendraṃ sthāpayiṣyāmi paśyataste śatakratum ।

slp1: adyendraM sTApayizyAmi paSyataste Satakratum । saYcAlya pApakarmARamindrasTAnAtsudurmatim ॥24॥

text: adya cāsau kudevendrastvāṃ padā dharṣayiṣyati । daivopahatacittatvādātmanāśāya mandadhīḥ ॥25॥
html:
adya cāsau kudevendrastvāṃ padā dharṣayiṣyati ।
daivopahatacittatvādātmanāśāya mandadhīḥ ॥25॥
slp1: adya cAsO kudevendrastvAM padA Darzayizyati । dEvopahatacittatvAdAtmanASAya mandaDIH ॥25॥

text: vyutkrāntadharmaṃ tamahaṃ dharṣaṇāmarṣito bhṛśam । ahirbhavasveti ruṣā śapsye pāpaṃ dvijadruham ॥26॥
html:
vyutkrāntadharmaṃ tamahaṃ dharṣaṇāmarṣito bhṛśam ।
ahirbhavasveti ruṣā śapsye pāpaṃ dvijadruham ॥26॥
slp1: vyutkrAntaDarmaM tamahaM DarzaRAmarzito BfSam । ahirBavasveti ruzA Sapsye pApaM dvijadruham ॥26॥

text: tata enaṃ sudurbuddhiṃ dhikśabdābhihatatviṣam । dharaṇyāṃ pātayiṣyāmi prekṣataste mahāmune ॥27॥
html:
tata enaṃ sudurbuddhiṃ dhikśabdābhihatatviṣam ।
dharaṇyāṃ pātayiṣyāmi prekṣataste mahāmune ॥27॥
slp1: tata enaM sudurbudDiM DikSabdABihatatvizam । DaraRyAM pAtayizyAmi prekzataste mahAmune ॥27॥

html:
nahuṣaṃ pāpakarmāṇamaiśvaryabalamohitam ।
yathā ca rocate tubhyaṃ tathā kartāsmyahaṃ mune ॥28॥
slp1: nahuzaM pApakarmARamESvaryabalamohitam । yaTA ca rocate tuByaM taTA kartAsmyahaM mune ॥28॥

text: evamuktastu bhṛguṇā maitrāvaruṇiravyayaḥ । agastyaḥ paramaprīto babhūva vigatajvaraḥ] ॥29॥
html:
evamuktastu bhṛguṇā maitrāvaruṇiravyayaḥ ।
agastyaḥ paramaprīto babhūva vigatajvaraḥ] ॥29॥
slp1: evamuktastu BfguRA mEtrAvaruRiravyayaH । agastyaH paramaprIto baBUva vigatajvaraH] ॥29॥

text: kathaṃ sa vai vipannaśca kathaṃ vai pātito bhuvi । kathaṃ cānindratāṃ prāptastadbhavānvaktumarhati ॥1॥
html:

slp1: kaTaM sa vE vipannaSca kaTaM vE pAtito Buvi । kaTaM cAnindratAM prAptastadBavAnvaktumarhati ॥1॥

text: evaṃ tayoḥ saṃvadatoḥ kriyāstasya mahātmanaḥ । sarvā evābhyavartanta yā divyā yāśca mānuṣāḥ ॥2॥
html:
evaṃ tayoḥ saṃvadatoḥ kriyāstasya mahātmanaḥ ।
sarvā evābhyavartanta yā divyā yāśca mānuṣāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: evaM tayoH saMvadatoH kriyAstasya mahAtmanaH । sarvA evAByavartanta yA divyA yASca mAnuzAH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tathaiva dīpadānāni sarvopakaraṇāni ca । balikarma ca yaccānyadutsekāśca pṛthagvidhāḥ । sarvāstasya samutpannā devarājño mahātmanaḥ ॥3॥
html:
tathaiva dīpadānāni sarvopakaraṇāni ca ।
balikarma ca yaccānyadutsekāśca pṛthagvidhāḥ ।
sarvāstasya samutpannā devarājño mahātmanaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: taTEva dIpadAnAni sarvopakaraRAni ca । balikarma ca yaccAnyadutsekASca pfTagviDAH । sarvAstasya samutpannA devarAjYo mahAtmanaH ॥3॥

text: devaloke nṛloke ca sadācārā budhaiḥ smṛtāḥ । te cedbhavanti rājendra ṛdhyante gṛhamedhinaḥ । dhūpapradānairdīpaiśca namaskāraistathaiva ca ॥4॥
html:
devaloke nṛloke ca sadācārā budhaiḥ smṛtāḥ ।
te cedbhavanti rājendra ṛdhyante gṛhamedhinaḥ ।
dhūpapradānairdīpaiśca namaskāraistathaiva ca ॥4॥
slp1: devaloke nfloke ca sadAcArA buDEH smftAH । te cedBavanti rAjendra fDyante gfhameDinaH । DUpapradAnErdIpESca namaskArEstaTEva ca ॥4॥

text: yathā siddhasya cānnasya dvijāyāgraṃ pradīyate । balayaśca gṛhoddeśe ataḥ prīyanti devatāḥ ॥5॥
html:
yathā siddhasya cānnasya dvijāyāgraṃ pradīyate ।
balayaśca gṛhoddeśe ataḥ prīyanti devatāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: yaTA sidDasya cAnnasya dvijAyAgraM pradIyate । balayaSca gfhoddeSe ataH prIyanti devatAH ॥5॥

text: yathā ca gṛhiṇastoṣo bhavedvai balikarmaṇā । tathā śataguṇā prītirdevatānāṃ sma jāyate ॥6॥
html:
yathā ca gṛhiṇastoṣo bhavedvai balikarmaṇā ।
tathā śataguṇā prītirdevatānāṃ sma jāyate ॥6॥
slp1: yaTA ca gfhiRastozo BavedvE balikarmaRA । taTA SataguRA prItirdevatAnAM sma jAyate ॥6॥

text: evaṃ dhūpapradānaṃ ca dīpadānaṃ ca sādhavaḥ । praśaṃsanti namaskārairyuktamātmaguṇāvaham ॥7॥
html:
evaṃ dhūpapradānaṃ ca dīpadānaṃ ca sādhavaḥ ।
praśaṃsanti namaskārairyuktamātmaguṇāvaham ॥7॥
slp1: evaM DUpapradAnaM ca dIpadAnaM ca sADavaH । praSaMsanti namaskArEryuktamAtmaguRAvaham ॥7॥

text: snānenādbhiśca yatkarma kriyate vai vipaścitā । namaskāraprayuktena tena prīyanti devatāḥ । gṛhyāśca devatāḥ sarvāḥ prīyante vidhinārcitāḥ ॥8॥
html:
snānenādbhiśca yatkarma kriyate vai vipaścitā ।
namaskāraprayuktena tena prīyanti devatāḥ ।
gṛhyāśca devatāḥ sarvāḥ prīyante vidhinārcitāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: snAnenAdBiSca yatkarma kriyate vE vipaScitA । namaskAraprayuktena tena prIyanti devatAH । gfhyASca devatAH sarvAH prIyante viDinArcitAH ॥8॥

text: ityetāṃ buddhimāsthāya nahuṣaḥ sa nareśvaraḥ । surendratvaṃ mahatprāpya kṛtavānetadadbhutam ॥9॥
html:
ityetāṃ buddhimāsthāya nahuṣaḥ sa nareśvaraḥ ।
surendratvaṃ mahatprāpya kṛtavānetadadbhutam ॥9॥
slp1: ityetAM budDimAsTAya nahuzaH sa nareSvaraH । surendratvaM mahatprApya kftavAnetadadButam ॥9॥

text: kasyacittvatha kālasya bhāgyakṣaya upasthite । sarvametadavajñāya na cakāraitadīdṛśam ॥10॥
html:
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhāgyakṣaya upasthite ।
sarvametadavajñāya na cakāraitadīdṛśam ॥10॥
slp1: kasyacittvaTa kAlasya BAgyakzaya upasTite । sarvametadavajYAya na cakArEtadIdfSam ॥10॥

text: tataḥ sa parihīṇo'bhūtsurendro balikarmataḥ । dhūpadīpodakavidhiṃ na yathāvaccakāra ha । tato'sya yajñaviṣayo rakṣobhiḥ paryabādhyata ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ sa parihīṇo'bhūtsurendro balikarmataḥ ।
dhūpadīpodakavidhiṃ na yathāvaccakāra ha ।
tato'sya yajñaviṣayo rakṣobhiḥ paryabādhyata ॥11॥
slp1: tataH sa parihIRo'BUtsurendro balikarmataH । DUpadIpodakaviDiM na yaTAvaccakAra ha । tato'sya yajYavizayo rakzoBiH paryabADyata ॥11॥

text: athāgastyamṛṣiśreṣṭhaṃ vāhanāyājuhāva ha । drutaṃ sarasvatīkūlātsmayanniva mahābalaḥ ॥12॥
html:
athāgastyamṛṣiśreṣṭhaṃ vāhanāyājuhāva ha ।
drutaṃ sarasvatīkūlātsmayanniva mahābalaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: aTAgastyamfziSrezWaM vAhanAyAjuhAva ha । drutaM sarasvatIkUlAtsmayanniva mahAbalaH ॥12॥

text: tato bhṛgurmahātejā maitrāvaruṇimabravīt । nimīlayasva nayane jaṭā yāvadviśāmi te ॥13॥
html:
tato bhṛgurmahātejā maitrāvaruṇimabravīt ।
nimīlayasva nayane jaṭā yāvadviśāmi te ॥13॥
slp1: tato BfgurmahAtejA mEtrAvaruRimabravIt । nimIlayasva nayane jawA yAvadviSAmi te ॥13॥

text: sthāṇubhūtasya tasyātha jaṭāḥ prāviśadacyutaḥ । bhṛguḥ sa sumahātejāḥ pātanāya nṛpasya ha ॥14॥
html:
sthāṇubhūtasya tasyātha jaṭāḥ prāviśadacyutaḥ ।
bhṛguḥ sa sumahātejāḥ pātanāya nṛpasya ha ॥14॥
slp1: sTARuBUtasya tasyATa jawAH prAviSadacyutaH । BfguH sa sumahAtejAH pAtanAya nfpasya ha ॥14॥

text: tataḥ sa devarāṭprāptastamṛṣiṃ vāhanāya vai । tato'gastyaḥ surapatiṃ vākyamāha viśāṃ pate ॥15॥
html:
tataḥ sa devarāṭprāptastamṛṣiṃ vāhanāya vai ।
tato'gastyaḥ surapatiṃ vākyamāha viśāṃ pate ॥15॥
slp1: tataH sa devarAwprAptastamfziM vAhanAya vE । tato'gastyaH surapatiM vAkyamAha viSAM pate ॥15॥

text: yojayasvendra māṃ kṣipraṃ kaṃ ca deśaṃ vahāmi te । yatra vakṣyasi tatra tvāṃ nayiṣyāmi surādhipa ॥16॥
html:
yojayasvendra māṃ kṣipraṃ kaṃ ca deśaṃ vahāmi te ।
yatra vakṣyasi tatra tvāṃ nayiṣyāmi surādhipa ॥16॥
slp1: yojayasvendra mAM kzipraM kaM ca deSaM vahAmi te । yatra vakzyasi tatra tvAM nayizyAmi surADipa ॥16॥

text: ityukto nahuṣastena yojayāmāsa taṃ munim । bhṛgustasya jaṭāsaṃstho babhūva hṛṣito bhṛśam ॥17॥
html:
ityukto nahuṣastena yojayāmāsa taṃ munim ।
bhṛgustasya jaṭāsaṃstho babhūva hṛṣito bhṛśam ॥17॥
slp1: ityukto nahuzastena yojayAmAsa taM munim । Bfgustasya jawAsaMsTo baBUva hfzito BfSam ॥17॥

text: na cāpi darśanaṃ tasya cakāra sa bhṛgustadā । varadānaprabhāvajño nahuṣasya mahātmanaḥ ॥18॥
html:
na cāpi darśanaṃ tasya cakāra sa bhṛgustadā ।
varadānaprabhāvajño nahuṣasya mahātmanaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: na cApi darSanaM tasya cakAra sa BfgustadA । varadAnapraBAvajYo nahuzasya mahAtmanaH ॥18॥

text: na cukopa sa cāgastyo yukto'pi nahuṣeṇa vai । taṃ tu rājā pratodena codayāmāsa bhārata ॥19॥
html:
na cukopa sa cāgastyo yukto'pi nahuṣeṇa vai ।
taṃ tu rājā pratodena codayāmāsa bhārata ॥19॥
slp1: na cukopa sa cAgastyo yukto'pi nahuzeRa vE । taM tu rAjA pratodena codayAmAsa BArata ॥19॥

text: na cukopa sa dharmātmā tataḥ pādena devarāṭ । agastyasya tadā kruddho vāmenābhyahanacchiraḥ ॥20॥
html:
na cukopa sa dharmātmā tataḥ pādena devarāṭ ।
agastyasya tadā kruddho vāmenābhyahanacchiraḥ ॥20॥
slp1: na cukopa sa DarmAtmA tataH pAdena devarAw । agastyasya tadA krudDo vAmenAByahanacCiraH ॥20॥

text: tasmiñśirasyabhihate sa jaṭāntargato bhṛguḥ । śaśāpa balavatkruddho nahuṣaṃ pāpacetasam ॥21॥
html:
tasmiñśirasyabhihate sa jaṭāntargato bhṛguḥ ।
śaśāpa balavatkruddho nahuṣaṃ pāpacetasam ॥21॥
slp1: tasmiYSirasyaBihate sa jawAntargato BfguH । SaSApa balavatkrudDo nahuzaM pApacetasam ॥21॥

text: yasmātpadāhanaḥ krodhācchirasīmaṃ mahāmunim । tasmādāśu mahīṃ gaccha sarpo bhūtvā sudurmate ॥22॥
html:
yasmātpadāhanaḥ krodhācchirasīmaṃ mahāmunim ।
tasmādāśu mahīṃ gaccha sarpo bhūtvā sudurmate ॥22॥
slp1: yasmAtpadAhanaH kroDAcCirasImaM mahAmunim । tasmAdASu mahIM gacCa sarpo BUtvA sudurmate ॥22॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena sarpo bhūtvā papāta ha । adṛṣṭenātha bhṛguṇā bhūtale bharatarṣabha ॥23॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena sarpo bhūtvā papāta ha ।
adṛṣṭenātha bhṛguṇā bhūtale bharatarṣabha ॥23॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa tadA tena sarpo BUtvA papAta ha । adfzwenATa BfguRA BUtale BaratarzaBa ॥23॥

text: bhṛguṃ hi yadi so'drākṣīnnahuṣaḥ pṛthivīpate । na sa śakto'bhaviṣyadvai pātane tasya tejasā ॥24॥
html:
bhṛguṃ hi yadi so'drākṣīnnahuṣaḥ pṛthivīpate ।
na sa śakto'bhaviṣyadvai pātane tasya tejasā ॥24॥
slp1: BfguM hi yadi so'drAkzInnahuzaH pfTivIpate । na sa Sakto'BavizyadvE pAtane tasya tejasA ॥24॥

text: sa tu taistaiḥ pradānaiśca tapobhirniyamaistathā । patito'pi mahārāja bhūtale smṛtimānabhūt । prasādayāmāsa bhṛguṃ śāpānto me bhavediti ॥25॥
html:
sa tu taistaiḥ pradānaiśca tapobhirniyamaistathā ।
patito'pi mahārāja bhūtale smṛtimānabhūt ।
prasādayāmāsa bhṛguṃ śāpānto me bhavediti ॥25॥
slp1: sa tu tEstEH pradAnESca tapoBirniyamEstaTA । patito'pi mahArAja BUtale smftimAnaBUt । prasAdayAmAsa BfguM SApAnto me Bavediti ॥25॥

text: tato'gastyaḥ kṛpāviṣṭaḥ prāsādayata taṃ bhṛgum । śāpāntārthaṃ mahārāja sa ca prādātkṛpānvitaḥ ॥26॥
html:
tato'gastyaḥ kṛpāviṣṭaḥ prāsādayata taṃ bhṛgum ।
śāpāntārthaṃ mahārāja sa ca prādātkṛpānvitaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tato'gastyaH kfpAvizwaH prAsAdayata taM Bfgum । SApAntArTaM mahArAja sa ca prAdAtkfpAnvitaH ॥26॥

text: rājā yudhiṣṭhiro nāma bhaviṣyati kurūdvahaḥ । sa tvāṃ mokṣayitā śāpādityuktvāntaradhīyata ॥27॥
html:
rājā yudhiṣṭhiro nāma bhaviṣyati kurūdvahaḥ ।
sa tvāṃ mokṣayitā śāpādityuktvāntaradhīyata ॥27॥
slp1: rAjA yuDizWiro nAma Bavizyati kurUdvahaH । sa tvAM mokzayitA SApAdityuktvAntaraDIyata ॥27॥
author: bhṛguruvāca ।

text: agastyo'pi mahātejāḥ kṛtvā kāryaṃ śatakratoḥ । svamāśramapadaṃ prāyātpūjyamāno dvijātibhiḥ ॥28॥
html:
agastyo'pi mahātejāḥ kṛtvā kāryaṃ śatakratoḥ ।
svamāśramapadaṃ prāyātpūjyamāno dvijātibhiḥ ॥28॥
slp1: agastyo'pi mahAtejAH kftvA kAryaM SatakratoH । svamASramapadaM prAyAtpUjyamAno dvijAtiBiH ॥28॥

text: nahuṣo'pi tvayā rājaṃstasmācchāpātsamuddhṛtaḥ । jagāma brahmasadanaṃ paśyataste janādhipa ॥29॥
html:
nahuṣo'pi tvayā rājaṃstasmācchāpātsamuddhṛtaḥ ।
jagāma brahmasadanaṃ paśyataste janādhipa ॥29॥
slp1: nahuzo'pi tvayA rAjaMstasmAcCApAtsamudDftaH । jagAma brahmasadanaM paSyataste janADipa ॥29॥

text: tadā tu pātayitvā taṃ nahuṣaṃ bhūtale bhṛguḥ । jagāma brahmasadanaṃ brahmaṇe ca nyavedayat ॥30॥
html:
tadā tu pātayitvā taṃ nahuṣaṃ bhūtale bhṛguḥ ।
jagāma brahmasadanaṃ brahmaṇe ca nyavedayat ॥30॥
slp1: tadA tu pAtayitvA taM nahuzaM BUtale BfguH । jagAma brahmasadanaM brahmaRe ca nyavedayat ॥30॥

text: tataḥ śakraṃ samānāyya devānāha pitāmahaḥ । varadānānmama surā nahuṣo rājyamāptavān । sa cāgastyena kruddhena bhraṃśito bhūtalaṃ gataḥ ॥31॥
html:
tataḥ śakraṃ samānāyya devānāha pitāmahaḥ ।
varadānānmama surā nahuṣo rājyamāptavān ।
sa cāgastyena kruddhena bhraṃśito bhūtalaṃ gataḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tataH SakraM samAnAyya devAnAha pitAmahaH । varadAnAnmama surA nahuzo rAjyamAptavAn । sa cAgastyena krudDena BraMSito BUtalaM gataH ॥31॥

text: na ca śakyaṃ vinā rājñā surā vartayituṃ kvacit । tasmādayaṃ punaḥ śakro devarājye'bhiṣicyatām ॥32॥
html:
na ca śakyaṃ vinā rājñā surā vartayituṃ kvacit ।
tasmādayaṃ punaḥ śakro devarājye'bhiṣicyatām ॥32॥
slp1: na ca SakyaM vinA rAjYA surA vartayituM kvacit । tasmAdayaM punaH Sakro devarAjye'BizicyatAm ॥32॥

text: evaṃ sambhāṣamāṇaṃ tu devāḥ pārtha pitāmaham । evamastviti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ pratyūcuste pitāmaham ॥33॥
html:
evaṃ sambhāṣamāṇaṃ tu devāḥ pārtha pitāmaham ।
evamastviti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ pratyūcuste pitāmaham ॥33॥
slp1: evaM samBAzamARaM tu devAH pArTa pitAmaham । evamastviti saMhfzwAH pratyUcuste pitAmaham ॥33॥

text: so'bhiṣikto bhagavatā devarājyena vāsavaḥ । brahmaṇā rājaśārdūla yathāpūrvaṃ vyarocata ॥34॥
html:
so'bhiṣikto bhagavatā devarājyena vāsavaḥ ।
brahmaṇā rājaśārdūla yathāpūrvaṃ vyarocata ॥34॥
slp1: so'Bizikto BagavatA devarAjyena vAsavaH । brahmaRA rAjaSArdUla yaTApUrvaM vyarocata ॥34॥

text: evametatpurāvṛttaṃ nahuṣasya vyatikramāt । sa ca taireva saṃsiddho nahuṣaḥ karmabhiḥ punaḥ ॥35॥
html:
evametatpurāvṛttaṃ nahuṣasya vyatikramāt ।
sa ca taireva saṃsiddho nahuṣaḥ karmabhiḥ punaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: evametatpurAvfttaM nahuzasya vyatikramAt । sa ca tEreva saMsidDo nahuzaH karmaBiH punaH ॥35॥

text: tasmāddīpāḥ pradātavyāḥ sāyaṃ vai gṛhamedhibhiḥ । divyaṃ cakṣuravāpnoti pretya dīpapradāyakaḥ । pūrṇacandrapratīkāśā dīpadāśca bhavantyuta ॥36॥
html:
tasmāddīpāḥ pradātavyāḥ sāyaṃ vai gṛhamedhibhiḥ ।
divyaṃ cakṣuravāpnoti pretya dīpapradāyakaḥ ।
pūrṇacandrapratīkāśā dīpadāśca bhavantyuta ॥36॥
slp1: tasmAddIpAH pradAtavyAH sAyaM vE gfhameDiBiH । divyaM cakzuravApnoti pretya dIpapradAyakaH । pUrRacandrapratIkASA dIpadASca Bavantyuta ॥36॥

text: yāvadakṣinimeṣāṇi jvalate tāvatīḥ samāḥ । rūpavāndhanavāṃścāpi naro bhavati dīpadaḥ] ॥37॥
html:
yāvadakṣinimeṣāṇi jvalate tāvatīḥ samāḥ ।
rūpavāndhanavāṃścāpi naro bhavati dīpadaḥ] ॥37॥
slp1: yAvadakzinimezARi jvalate tAvatIH samAH । rUpavAnDanavAMScApi naro Bavati dIpadaH] ॥37॥

text: brāhmaṇasvāni ye mandā haranti bharatarṣabha । nṛśaṃsakāriṇo mūḍhāḥ kva te gacchanti mānavāḥ ॥1॥
html:
brāhmaṇasvāni ye mandā haranti bharatarṣabha ।
nṛśaṃsakāriṇo mūḍhāḥ kva te gacchanti mānavāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: brAhmaRasvAni ye mandA haranti BaratarzaBa । nfSaMsakAriRo mUQAH kva te gacCanti mAnavAH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । caṇḍālasya ca saṃvādaṃ kṣatrabandhośca bhārata ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
caṇḍālasya ca saṃvādaṃ kṣatrabandhośca bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । caRqAlasya ca saMvAdaM kzatrabanDoSca BArata ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: vṛddharūpo'si caṇḍāla bālavacca viceṣṭase । śvakharāṇāṃ rajaḥsevī kasmādudvijase gavām ॥3॥
html:
vṛddharūpo'si caṇḍāla bālavacca viceṣṭase ।
śvakharāṇāṃ rajaḥsevī kasmādudvijase gavām ॥3॥
slp1: vfdDarUpo'si caRqAla bAlavacca vicezwase । SvaKarARAM rajaHsevI kasmAdudvijase gavAm ॥3॥
author: rājanya uvāca ।

text: sādhubhirgarhitaṃ karma caṇḍālasya vidhīyate । kasmādgorajasā dhvastamapāṃ kuṇḍe niṣiñcasi ॥4॥
html:
sādhubhirgarhitaṃ karma caṇḍālasya vidhīyate ।
kasmādgorajasā dhvastamapāṃ kuṇḍe niṣiñcasi ॥4॥
slp1: sADuBirgarhitaM karma caRqAlasya viDIyate । kasmAdgorajasA DvastamapAM kuRqe niziYcasi ॥4॥

text: brāhmaṇasya gavāṃ rājanhriyatīnāṃ rajaḥ purā । somamuddhvaṃsayāmāsa taṃ somaṃ ye'pibandvijāḥ ॥5॥
html:
brāhmaṇasya gavāṃ rājanhriyatīnāṃ rajaḥ purā ।
somamuddhvaṃsayāmāsa taṃ somaṃ ye'pibandvijāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: brAhmaRasya gavAM rAjanhriyatInAM rajaH purA । somamudDvaMsayAmAsa taM somaM ye'pibandvijAH ॥5॥
author: caṇḍāla uvāca ।

text: dīkṣitaśca sa rājāpi kṣipraṃ narakamāviśat । saha tairyājakaiḥ sarvairbrahmasvamupajīvya tat ॥6॥
html:
dīkṣitaśca sa rājāpi kṣipraṃ narakamāviśat ।
saha tairyājakaiḥ sarvairbrahmasvamupajīvya tat ॥6॥
slp1: dIkzitaSca sa rAjApi kzipraM narakamAviSat । saha tEryAjakEH sarvErbrahmasvamupajIvya tat ॥6॥

text: ye'pi tatrāpibankṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi ca mānavāḥ । brāhmaṇāḥ saharājanyāḥ sarve narakamāviśan ॥7॥
html:
ye'pi tatrāpibankṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi ca mānavāḥ ।
brāhmaṇāḥ saharājanyāḥ sarve narakamāviśan ॥7॥
slp1: ye'pi tatrApibankzIraM GftaM daDi ca mAnavAH । brAhmaRAH saharAjanyAH sarve narakamAviSan ॥7॥

text: jaghnustāḥ payasā putrāṃstathā pautrānvidhunvatīḥ । paśūnavekṣamāṇāśca sādhuvṛttena dampatī ॥8॥
html:
jaghnustāḥ payasā putrāṃstathā pautrānvidhunvatīḥ ।
paśūnavekṣamāṇāśca sādhuvṛttena dampatī ॥8॥
slp1: jaGnustAH payasA putrAMstaTA pOtrAnviDunvatIH । paSUnavekzamARASca sADuvfttena dampatI ॥8॥

text: ahaṃ tatrāvasaṃ rājanbrahmacārī jitendriyaḥ । tāsāṃ me rajasā dhvastaṃ bhaikṣamāsīnnarādhipa ॥9॥
html:
ahaṃ tatrāvasaṃ rājanbrahmacārī jitendriyaḥ ।
tāsāṃ me rajasā dhvastaṃ bhaikṣamāsīnnarādhipa ॥9॥
slp1: ahaM tatrAvasaM rAjanbrahmacArI jitendriyaH । tAsAM me rajasA DvastaM BEkzamAsInnarADipa ॥9॥

text: caṇḍālo'haṃ tato rājanbhuktvā tadabhavaṃ mṛtaḥ । brahmasvahārī ca nṛpaḥ so'pratiṣṭhāṃ gatiṃ yayau ॥10॥
html:
caṇḍālo'haṃ tato rājanbhuktvā tadabhavaṃ mṛtaḥ ।
brahmasvahārī ca nṛpaḥ so'pratiṣṭhāṃ gatiṃ yayau ॥10॥
slp1: caRqAlo'haM tato rAjanBuktvA tadaBavaM mftaH । brahmasvahArI ca nfpaH so'pratizWAM gatiM yayO ॥10॥

text: tasmāddharenna viprasvaṃ kadācidapi kiñcana । brahmasvarajasā dhvastaṃ bhuktvā māṃ paśya yādṛśam ॥11॥
html:
tasmāddharenna viprasvaṃ kadācidapi kiñcana ।
brahmasvarajasā dhvastaṃ bhuktvā māṃ paśya yādṛśam ॥11॥
slp1: tasmAdDarenna viprasvaM kadAcidapi kiYcana । brahmasvarajasA DvastaM BuktvA mAM paSya yAdfSam ॥11॥

text: tasmātsomo'pyavikreyaḥ puruṣeṇa vipaścitā । vikrayaṃ hīha somasya garhayanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥12॥
html:
tasmātsomo'pyavikreyaḥ puruṣeṇa vipaścitā ।
vikrayaṃ hīha somasya garhayanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tasmAtsomo'pyavikreyaH puruzeRa vipaScitA । vikrayaM hIha somasya garhayanti manIziRaH ॥12॥

text: ye cainaṃ krīṇate rājanye ca vikrīṇate janāḥ । te tu vaivasvataṃ prāpya rauravaṃ yānti sarvaśaḥ ॥13॥
html:
ye cainaṃ krīṇate rājanye ca vikrīṇate janāḥ ।
te tu vaivasvataṃ prāpya rauravaṃ yānti sarvaśaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: ye cEnaM krIRate rAjanye ca vikrIRate janAH । te tu vEvasvataM prApya rOravaM yAnti sarvaSaH ॥13॥

text: somaṃ tu rajasā dhvastaṃ vikrīyādbuddhipūrvakam । śrotriyo vārdhuṣī bhūtvā cirarātrāya naśyati । narakaṃ triṃśataṃ prāpya śvaviṣṭhāmupajīvati ॥14॥
html:
somaṃ tu rajasā dhvastaṃ vikrīyādbuddhipūrvakam ।
śrotriyo vārdhuṣī bhūtvā cirarātrāya naśyati ।
narakaṃ triṃśataṃ prāpya śvaviṣṭhāmupajīvati ॥14॥
slp1: somaM tu rajasA DvastaM vikrIyAdbudDipUrvakam । Srotriyo vArDuzI BUtvA cirarAtrAya naSyati । narakaM triMSataM prApya SvavizWAmupajIvati ॥14॥

text: śvacaryāmatimānaṃ ca sakhidāreṣu viplavam । tulayādhārayaddharmo hyatimāno'tiricyate ॥15॥
html:
śvacaryāmatimānaṃ ca sakhidāreṣu viplavam ।
tulayādhārayaddharmo hyatimāno'tiricyate ॥15॥
slp1: SvacaryAmatimAnaM ca saKidArezu viplavam । tulayADArayadDarmo hyatimAno'tiricyate ॥15॥

text: śvānaṃ vai pāpinaṃ paśya vivarṇaṃ hariṇaṃ kṛśam । atimānena bhūtānāmimāṃ gatimupāgatam ॥16॥
html:
śvānaṃ vai pāpinaṃ paśya vivarṇaṃ hariṇaṃ kṛśam ।
atimānena bhūtānāmimāṃ gatimupāgatam ॥16॥
slp1: SvAnaM vE pApinaM paSya vivarRaM hariRaM kfSam । atimAnena BUtAnAmimAM gatimupAgatam ॥16॥

text: ahaṃ vai vipule jātaḥ kule dhanasamanvite । anyasmiñjanmani vibho jñānavijñānapāragaḥ ॥17॥
html:
ahaṃ vai vipule jātaḥ kule dhanasamanvite ।
anyasmiñjanmani vibho jñānavijñānapāragaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: ahaM vE vipule jAtaH kule Danasamanvite । anyasmiYjanmani viBo jYAnavijYAnapAragaH ॥17॥

text: abhavaṃ tatra jānāno hyetāndoṣānmadāttadā । saṃrabdha eva bhūtānāṃ pṛṣṭhamāṃsānyabhakṣayam ॥18॥
html:
abhavaṃ tatra jānāno hyetāndoṣānmadāttadā ।
saṃrabdha eva bhūtānāṃ pṛṣṭhamāṃsānyabhakṣayam ॥18॥
slp1: aBavaM tatra jAnAno hyetAndozAnmadAttadA । saMrabDa eva BUtAnAM pfzWamAMsAnyaBakzayam ॥18॥

text: so'haṃ tena ca vṛttena bhojanena ca tena vai । imāmavasthāṃ samprāptaḥ paśya kālasya paryayam ॥19॥
html:
so'haṃ tena ca vṛttena bhojanena ca tena vai ।
imāmavasthāṃ samprāptaḥ paśya kālasya paryayam ॥19॥
slp1: so'haM tena ca vfttena Bojanena ca tena vE । imAmavasTAM samprAptaH paSya kAlasya paryayam ॥19॥

text: ādīptamiva cailāntaṃ bhramarairiva cārditam । dhāvamānaṃ susaṃrabdhaṃ paśya māṃ rajasānvitam ॥20॥
html:
ādīptamiva cailāntaṃ bhramarairiva cārditam ।
dhāvamānaṃ susaṃrabdhaṃ paśya māṃ rajasānvitam ॥20॥
slp1: AdIptamiva cElAntaM BramarEriva cArditam । DAvamAnaM susaMrabDaM paSya mAM rajasAnvitam ॥20॥

text: svādhyāyaistu mahatpāpaṃ taranti gṛhamedhinaḥ । dānaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiścāpi yathā prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥21॥
html:
svādhyāyaistu mahatpāpaṃ taranti gṛhamedhinaḥ ।
dānaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiścāpi yathā prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: svADyAyEstu mahatpApaM taranti gfhameDinaH । dAnEH pfTagviDEScApi yaTA prAhurmanIziRaH ॥21॥

text: tathā pāpakṛtaṃ vipramāśramasthaṃ mahīpate । sarvasaṅgavinirmuktaṃ chandāṃsyuttārayantyuta ॥22॥
html:
tathā pāpakṛtaṃ vipramāśramasthaṃ mahīpate ।
sarvasaṅgavinirmuktaṃ chandāṃsyuttārayantyuta ॥22॥
slp1: taTA pApakftaM vipramASramasTaM mahIpate । sarvasaNgavinirmuktaM CandAMsyuttArayantyuta ॥22॥

text: ahaṃ tu pāpayonyāṃ vai prasūtaḥ kṣatriyarṣabha । niścayaṃ nādhigacchāmi kathaṃ mucyeyamityuta ॥23॥
html:
ahaṃ tu pāpayonyāṃ vai prasūtaḥ kṣatriyarṣabha ।
niścayaṃ nādhigacchāmi kathaṃ mucyeyamityuta ॥23॥
slp1: ahaM tu pApayonyAM vE prasUtaH kzatriyarzaBa । niScayaM nADigacCAmi kaTaM mucyeyamityuta ॥23॥

text: jātismaratvaṃ tu mama kenacitpūrvakarmaṇā । śubhena yena mokṣaṃ vai prāptumicchāmyahaṃ nṛpa ॥24॥
html:
jātismaratvaṃ tu mama kenacitpūrvakarmaṇā ।
śubhena yena mokṣaṃ vai prāptumicchāmyahaṃ nṛpa ॥24॥
slp1: jAtismaratvaM tu mama kenacitpUrvakarmaRA । SuBena yena mokzaM vE prAptumicCAmyahaM nfpa ॥24॥

text: tvamimaṃ me prapannāya saṃśayaṃ brūhi pṛcchate । caṇḍālatvātkathamahaṃ mucyeyamiti sattama ॥25॥
html:
tvamimaṃ me prapannāya saṃśayaṃ brūhi pṛcchate ।
caṇḍālatvātkathamahaṃ mucyeyamiti sattama ॥25॥
slp1: tvamimaM me prapannAya saMSayaM brUhi pfcCate । caRqAlatvAtkaTamahaM mucyeyamiti sattama ॥25॥

text: caṇḍāla pratijānīhi yena mokṣamavāpsyasi । brāhmaṇārthe tyajanprāṇāngatimiṣṭāmavāpsyasi ॥26॥
html:
caṇḍāla pratijānīhi yena mokṣamavāpsyasi ।
brāhmaṇārthe tyajanprāṇāngatimiṣṭāmavāpsyasi ॥26॥
slp1: caRqAla pratijAnIhi yena mokzamavApsyasi । brAhmaRArTe tyajanprARAngatimizwAmavApsyasi ॥26॥
author: rājanya uvāca ।

text: dattvā śarīraṃ kravyādbhyo raṇāgnau dvijahetukam । hutvā prāṇānpramokṣaste nānyathā mokṣamarhasi ॥27॥
html:
dattvā śarīraṃ kravyādbhyo raṇāgnau dvijahetukam ।
hutvā prāṇānpramokṣaste nānyathā mokṣamarhasi ॥27॥
slp1: dattvA SarIraM kravyAdByo raRAgnO dvijahetukam । hutvA prARAnpramokzaste nAnyaTA mokzamarhasi ॥27॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa tadā rājanbrahmasvārthe parantapa । hutvā raṇamukhe prāṇāngatimiṣṭāmavāpa ha ॥28॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa tadā rājanbrahmasvārthe parantapa ।
hutvā raṇamukhe prāṇāngatimiṣṭāmavāpa ha ॥28॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa tadA rAjanbrahmasvArTe parantapa । hutvA raRamuKe prARAngatimizwAmavApa ha ॥28॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tasmādrakṣyaṃ tvayā putra brahmasvaṃ bharatarṣabha । yadīcchasi mahābāho śāśvatīṃ gatimuttamām] ॥29॥
html:
tasmādrakṣyaṃ tvayā putra brahmasvaṃ bharatarṣabha ।
yadīcchasi mahābāho śāśvatīṃ gatimuttamām] ॥29॥
slp1: tasmAdrakzyaM tvayA putra brahmasvaM BaratarzaBa । yadIcCasi mahAbAho SASvatIM gatimuttamAm] ॥29॥

text: eko lokaḥ sukṛtināṃ sarve tvāho pitāmaha । uta tatrāpi nānātvaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
eko lokaḥ sukṛtināṃ sarve tvāho pitāmaha ।
uta tatrāpi nānātvaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: eko lokaH sukftinAM sarve tvAho pitAmaha । uta tatrApi nAnAtvaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: karmabhiḥ pārtha nānātvaṃ lokānāṃ yānti mānavāḥ । puṇyānpuṇyakṛto yānti pāpānpāpakṛto janāḥ ॥2॥
html:
karmabhiḥ pārtha nānātvaṃ lokānāṃ yānti mānavāḥ ।
puṇyānpuṇyakṛto yānti pāpānpāpakṛto janāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: karmaBiH pArTa nAnAtvaM lokAnAM yAnti mAnavAH । puRyAnpuRyakfto yAnti pApAnpApakfto janAH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gautamasya munestāta saṃvādaṃ vāsavasya ca ॥3॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
gautamasya munestāta saṃvādaṃ vāsavasya ca ॥3॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । gOtamasya munestAta saMvAdaM vAsavasya ca ॥3॥

text: brāhmaṇo gautamaḥ kaścinmṛdurdānto jitendriyaḥ । mahāvane hastiśiśuṃ paridyūnamamātṛkam ॥4॥
html:
brāhmaṇo gautamaḥ kaścinmṛdurdānto jitendriyaḥ ।
mahāvane hastiśiśuṃ paridyūnamamātṛkam ॥4॥
slp1: brAhmaRo gOtamaH kaScinmfdurdAnto jitendriyaH । mahAvane hastiSiSuM paridyUnamamAtfkam ॥4॥

text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvayāmāsa sānukrośo dhṛtavrataḥ । sa tu dīrgheṇa kālena babhūvātibalo mahān ॥5॥
html:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvayāmāsa sānukrośo dhṛtavrataḥ ।
sa tu dīrgheṇa kālena babhūvātibalo mahān ॥5॥
slp1: taM dfzwvA jIvayAmAsa sAnukroSo DftavrataH । sa tu dIrGeRa kAlena baBUvAtibalo mahAn ॥5॥

text: taṃ prabhinnaṃ mahānāgaṃ prasrutaṃ sarvato madam । dhṛtarāṣṭrasya rūpeṇa śakro jagrāha hastinam ॥6॥
html:
taṃ prabhinnaṃ mahānāgaṃ prasrutaṃ sarvato madam ।
dhṛtarāṣṭrasya rūpeṇa śakro jagrāha hastinam ॥6॥
slp1: taM praBinnaM mahAnAgaM prasrutaM sarvato madam । DftarAzwrasya rUpeRa Sakro jagrAha hastinam ॥6॥

text: hriyamāṇaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā gautamaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ । abhyabhāṣata rājānaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ mahātapāḥ ॥7॥
html:
hriyamāṇaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā gautamaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ।
abhyabhāṣata rājānaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ mahātapāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: hriyamARaM tu taM dfzwvA gOtamaH saMSitavrataH । aByaBAzata rAjAnaM DftarAzwraM mahAtapAH ॥7॥

text: mā me hārṣīrhastinaṃ putramenaṃ duḥkhātpuṣṭaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrākṛtajña । mitraṃ satāṃ saptapadaṃ vadanti mitradroho naiva rājanspṛśettvām ॥8॥
html:
mā me hārṣīrhastinaṃ putramenaṃ duḥkhātpuṣṭaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrākṛtajña ।
mitraṃ satāṃ saptapadaṃ vadanti mitradroho naiva rājanspṛśettvām ॥8॥
slp1: mA me hArzIrhastinaM putramenaM duHKAtpuzwaM DftarAzwrAkftajYa । mitraM satAM saptapadaM vadanti mitradroho nEva rAjanspfSettvAm ॥8॥

text: idhmodakapradātāraṃ śūnyapālakamāśrame । vinītamācāryakule suyuktaṃ gurukarmaṇi ॥9॥
html:
idhmodakapradātāraṃ śūnyapālakamāśrame ।
vinītamācāryakule suyuktaṃ gurukarmaṇi ॥9॥
slp1: iDmodakapradAtAraM SUnyapAlakamASrame । vinItamAcAryakule suyuktaM gurukarmaRi ॥9॥

text: śiṣṭaṃ dāntaṃ kṛtajñaṃ ca priyaṃ ca satataṃ mama । na me vikrośato rājanhartumarhasi kuñjaram ॥10॥
html:
śiṣṭaṃ dāntaṃ kṛtajñaṃ ca priyaṃ ca satataṃ mama ।
na me vikrośato rājanhartumarhasi kuñjaram ॥10॥
slp1: SizwaM dAntaM kftajYaM ca priyaM ca satataM mama । na me vikroSato rAjanhartumarhasi kuYjaram ॥10॥

text: gavāṃ sahasraṃ bhavate dadāmi dāsīśataṃ niṣkaśatāni pañca । anyacca vittaṃ vividhaṃ maharṣe kiṃ brāhmaṇasyeha gajena kṛtyam ॥11॥
html:
gavāṃ sahasraṃ bhavate dadāmi dāsīśataṃ niṣkaśatāni pañca ।
anyacca vittaṃ vividhaṃ maharṣe kiṃ brāhmaṇasyeha gajena kṛtyam ॥11॥
slp1: gavAM sahasraM Bavate dadAmi dAsISataM nizkaSatAni paYca । anyacca vittaM viviDaM maharze kiM brAhmaRasyeha gajena kftyam ॥11॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: tvāmeva gāvo'bhi bhavantu rājandāsyaḥ saniṣkā vividhaṃ ca ratnam । anyacca vittaṃ vividhaṃ narendra kiṃ brāhmaṇasyeha dhanena kṛtyam ॥12॥
html:
tvāmeva gāvo'bhi bhavantu rājandāsyaḥ saniṣkā vividhaṃ ca ratnam ।
anyacca vittaṃ vividhaṃ narendra kiṃ brāhmaṇasyeha dhanena kṛtyam ॥12॥
slp1: tvAmeva gAvo'Bi Bavantu rAjandAsyaH sanizkA viviDaM ca ratnam । anyacca vittaM viviDaM narendra kiM brAhmaRasyeha Danena kftyam ॥12॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ hastibhirnāsti kṛtyaṃ rājanyānāṃ nāgakulāni vipra । svaṃ vāhanaṃ nayato nāstyadharmo nāgaśreṣṭhādgautamāsmānnivarta ॥13॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ hastibhirnāsti kṛtyaṃ rājanyānāṃ nāgakulāni vipra ।
svaṃ vāhanaṃ nayato nāstyadharmo nāgaśreṣṭhādgautamāsmānnivarta ॥13॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM hastiBirnAsti kftyaM rAjanyAnAM nAgakulAni vipra । svaM vAhanaM nayato nAstyaDarmo nAgaSrezWAdgOtamAsmAnnivarta ॥13॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: yatra preto nandati puṇyakarmā yatra pretaḥ śocati pāpakarmā । vaivasvatasya sadane mahātmanastatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥14॥
html:
yatra preto nandati puṇyakarmā yatra pretaḥ śocati pāpakarmā ।
vaivasvatasya sadane mahātmanastatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥14॥
slp1: yatra preto nandati puRyakarmA yatra pretaH Socati pApakarmA । vEvasvatasya sadane mahAtmanastatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥14॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: ye niṣkriyā nāstikāḥ śraddadhānāḥ pāpātmāna indriyārthe niviṣṭāḥ । yamasya te yātanāṃ prāpnuvanti paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥15॥
html:
ye niṣkriyā nāstikāḥ śraddadhānāḥ pāpātmāna indriyārthe niviṣṭāḥ ।
yamasya te yātanāṃ prāpnuvanti paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥15॥
slp1: ye nizkriyA nAstikAH SraddaDAnAH pApAtmAna indriyArTe nivizwAH । yamasya te yAtanAM prApnuvanti paraM gantA DftarAzwro na tatra ॥15॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: vaivasvatī saṃyamanī janānāṃ yatrānṛtaṃ nocyate yatra satyam । yatrābalā balinaṃ yātayanti tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥16॥
html:
vaivasvatī saṃyamanī janānāṃ yatrānṛtaṃ nocyate yatra satyam ।
yatrābalā balinaṃ yātayanti tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥16॥
slp1: vEvasvatI saMyamanI janAnAM yatrAnftaM nocyate yatra satyam । yatrAbalA balinaM yAtayanti tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥16॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: jyeṣṭhāṃ svasāraṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca guruṃ yathā mānayantaścaranti । tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥17॥
html:
jyeṣṭhāṃ svasāraṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca guruṃ yathā mānayantaścaranti ।
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥17॥
slp1: jyezWAM svasAraM pitaraM mAtaraM ca guruM yaTA mAnayantaScaranti । taTAviDAnAmeza loko maharze paraM gantA DftarAzwro na tatra ॥17॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: mandākinī vaiśravaṇasya rājño mahābhogā bhogijanapraveśyā । gandharvayakṣairapsarobhiśca juṣṭā tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥18॥
html:
mandākinī vaiśravaṇasya rājño mahābhogā bhogijanapraveśyā ।
gandharvayakṣairapsarobhiśca juṣṭā tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥18॥
slp1: mandAkinI vESravaRasya rAjYo mahABogA BogijanapraveSyA । ganDarvayakzErapsaroBiSca juzwA tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥18॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: atithivratāḥ suvratā ye janā vai pratiśrayaṃ dadati brāhmaṇebhyaḥ । śiṣṭāśinaḥ saṃvibhajyāśritāṃśca mandākinīṃ te'pi vibhūṣayanti ॥19॥
html:
atithivratāḥ suvratā ye janā vai pratiśrayaṃ dadati brāhmaṇebhyaḥ ।
śiṣṭāśinaḥ saṃvibhajyāśritāṃśca mandākinīṃ te'pi vibhūṣayanti ॥19॥
slp1: atiTivratAH suvratA ye janA vE pratiSrayaM dadati brAhmaReByaH । SizwASinaH saMviBajyASritAMSca mandAkinIM te'pi viBUzayanti ॥19॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: meroragre yadvanaṃ bhāti ramyaṃ supuṣpitaṃ kinnaragītajuṣṭam । sudarśanā yatra jambūrviśālā tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥20॥
html:
meroragre yadvanaṃ bhāti ramyaṃ supuṣpitaṃ kinnaragītajuṣṭam ।
sudarśanā yatra jambūrviśālā tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥20॥
slp1: meroragre yadvanaM BAti ramyaM supuzpitaM kinnaragItajuzwam । sudarSanA yatra jambUrviSAlA tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥20॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: ye brāhmaṇā mṛdavaḥ satyaśīlā bahuśrutāḥ sarvabhūtābhirāmāḥ । ye'dhīyante setihāsaṃ purāṇaṃ madhvāhutyā juhvati ca dvijebhyaḥ ॥21॥
html:
ye brāhmaṇā mṛdavaḥ satyaśīlā bahuśrutāḥ sarvabhūtābhirāmāḥ ।
ye'dhīyante setihāsaṃ purāṇaṃ madhvāhutyā juhvati ca dvijebhyaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: ye brAhmaRA mfdavaH satyaSIlA bahuSrutAH sarvaBUtABirAmAH । ye'DIyante setihAsaM purARaM maDvAhutyA juhvati ca dvijeByaH ॥21॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra । yadvidyate viditaṃ sthānamasti tadbrūhi tvaṃ tvarito hyeṣa yāmi ॥22॥
html:
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ।
yadvidyate viditaṃ sthānamasti tadbrūhi tvaṃ tvarito hyeṣa yāmi ॥22॥
slp1: taTAviDAnAmeza loko maharze paraM gantA DftarAzwro na tatra । yadvidyate viditaM sTAnamasti tadbrUhi tvaM tvarito hyeza yAmi ॥22॥

text: supuṣpitaṃ kinnararājajuṣṭaṃ priyaṃ vanaṃ nandanaṃ nāradasya । gandharvāṇāmapsarasāṃ ca sadma tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥23॥
html:
supuṣpitaṃ kinnararājajuṣṭaṃ priyaṃ vanaṃ nandanaṃ nāradasya ।
gandharvāṇāmapsarasāṃ ca sadma tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥23॥
slp1: supuzpitaM kinnararAjajuzwaM priyaM vanaM nandanaM nAradasya । ganDarvARAmapsarasAM ca sadma tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥23॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: ye nṛttagītakuśalā janāḥ sadā hyayācamānāḥ sahitāścaranti । tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥24॥
html:
ye nṛttagītakuśalā janāḥ sadā hyayācamānāḥ sahitāścaranti ।
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥24॥
slp1: ye nfttagItakuSalA janAH sadA hyayAcamAnAH sahitAScaranti । taTAviDAnAmeza loko maharze paraM gantA DftarAzwro na tatra ॥24॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: yatrottarāḥ kuravo bhānti ramyā devaiḥ sārdhaṃ modamānā narendra । yatrāgniyaunāśca vasanti viprā hyayonayaḥ parvatayonayaśca ॥25॥
html:
yatrottarāḥ kuravo bhānti ramyā devaiḥ sārdhaṃ modamānā narendra ।
yatrāgniyaunāśca vasanti viprā hyayonayaḥ parvatayonayaśca ॥25॥
slp1: yatrottarAH kuravo BAnti ramyA devEH sArDaM modamAnA narendra । yatrAgniyOnASca vasanti viprA hyayonayaH parvatayonayaSca ॥25॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: yatra śakro varṣati sarvakāmānyatra striyaḥ kāmacārāścaranti । yatra cerṣyā nāsti nārīnarāṇāṃ tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥26॥
html:
yatra śakro varṣati sarvakāmānyatra striyaḥ kāmacārāścaranti ।
yatra cerṣyā nāsti nārīnarāṇāṃ tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥26॥
slp1: yatra Sakro varzati sarvakAmAnyatra striyaH kAmacArAScaranti । yatra cerzyA nAsti nArInarARAM tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥26॥

text: ye sarvabhūteṣu nivṛttakāmā amāṃsādā nyastadaṇḍāścaranti । na hiṃsanti sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ ye sarvabhūtātmabhūtāḥ ॥27॥
html:
ye sarvabhūteṣu nivṛttakāmā amāṃsādā nyastadaṇḍāścaranti ।
na hiṃsanti sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ ye sarvabhūtātmabhūtāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: ye sarvaBUtezu nivfttakAmA amAMsAdA nyastadaRqAScaranti । na hiMsanti sTAvaraM jaNgamaM ca BUtAnAM ye sarvaBUtAtmaBUtAH ॥27॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: nirāśiṣo nirmamā vītarāgā lābhālābhe tulyanindāpraśaṃsāḥ । tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥28॥
html:
nirāśiṣo nirmamā vītarāgā lābhālābhe tulyanindāpraśaṃsāḥ ।
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥28॥
slp1: nirASizo nirmamA vItarAgA lABAlABe tulyanindApraSaMsAH । taTAviDAnAmeza loko maharze paraM gantA DftarAzwro na tatra ॥28॥

text: tataḥ paraṃ bhānti lokāḥ sanātanāḥ supuṇyagandhā nirmalā vītaśokāḥ । somasya rājñaḥ sadane mahātmanastatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥29॥
html:
tataḥ paraṃ bhānti lokāḥ sanātanāḥ supuṇyagandhā nirmalā vītaśokāḥ ।
somasya rājñaḥ sadane mahātmanastatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥29॥
slp1: tataH paraM BAnti lokAH sanAtanAH supuRyaganDA nirmalA vItaSokAH । somasya rAjYaH sadane mahAtmanastatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥29॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: ye dānaśīlā na pratigṛhṇate sadā na cāpyarthānādadate parebhyaḥ । yeṣāmadeyamarhate nāsti kiñcitsarvātithyāḥ suprasādā janāśca ॥30॥
html:
ye dānaśīlā na pratigṛhṇate sadā na cāpyarthānādadate parebhyaḥ ।
yeṣāmadeyamarhate nāsti kiñcitsarvātithyāḥ suprasādā janāśca ॥30॥
slp1: ye dAnaSIlA na pratigfhRate sadA na cApyarTAnAdadate pareByaH । yezAmadeyamarhate nAsti kiYcitsarvAtiTyAH suprasAdA janASca ॥30॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: ye kṣantāro nābhijalpanti cānyāñśaktā bhūtvā satataṃ puṇyaśīlāḥ । tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥31॥
html:
ye kṣantāro nābhijalpanti cānyāñśaktā bhūtvā satataṃ puṇyaśīlāḥ ।
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥31॥
slp1: ye kzantAro nABijalpanti cAnyAYSaktA BUtvA satataM puRyaSIlAH । taTAviDAnAmeza loko maharze paraM gantA DftarAzwro na tatra ॥31॥

text: tataḥ paraṃ bhānti lokāḥ sanātanā virajaso vitamaskā viśokāḥ । ādityasya sumahāntaḥ suvṛttāstatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥32॥
html:
tataḥ paraṃ bhānti lokāḥ sanātanā virajaso vitamaskā viśokāḥ ।
ādityasya sumahāntaḥ suvṛttāstatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥32॥
slp1: tataH paraM BAnti lokAH sanAtanA virajaso vitamaskA viSokAH । Adityasya sumahAntaH suvfttAstatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥32॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: svādhyāyaśīlā guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāstapasvinaḥ suvratāḥ satyasandhāḥ । ācāryāṇāmapratikūlabhāṣiṇo nityotthitā gurukarmasvacodyāḥ ॥33॥
html:
svādhyāyaśīlā guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāstapasvinaḥ suvratāḥ satyasandhāḥ ।
ācāryāṇāmapratikūlabhāṣiṇo nityotthitā gurukarmasvacodyāḥ ॥33॥
slp1: svADyAyaSIlA guruSuSrUzaRe ratAstapasvinaH suvratAH satyasanDAH । AcAryARAmapratikUlaBAziRo nityotTitA gurukarmasvacodyAH ॥33॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe viśuddhānāṃ bhāvitavāṅmatīnām । satye sthitānāṃ vedavidāṃ mahātmanāṃ paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥34॥
html:
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe viśuddhānāṃ bhāvitavāṅmatīnām ।
satye sthitānāṃ vedavidāṃ mahātmanāṃ paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥34॥
slp1: taTAviDAnAmeza loko maharze viSudDAnAM BAvitavANmatInAm । satye sTitAnAM vedavidAM mahAtmanAM paraM gantA DftarAzwro na tatra ॥34॥

text: tataḥ pare bhānti lokāḥ sanātanāḥ supuṇyagandhā virajā viśokāḥ । varuṇasya rājñaḥ sadane mahātmanastatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥35॥
html:
tataḥ pare bhānti lokāḥ sanātanāḥ supuṇyagandhā virajā viśokāḥ ।
varuṇasya rājñaḥ sadane mahātmanastatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥35॥
slp1: tataH pare BAnti lokAH sanAtanAH supuRyaganDA virajA viSokAH । varuRasya rAjYaH sadane mahAtmanastatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥35॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: cāturmāsyairye yajante janāḥ sadā tatheṣṭīnāṃ daśaśataṃ prāpnuvanti । ye cāgnihotraṃ juhvati śraddadhānā yathānyāyaṃ trīṇi varṣāṇi viprāḥ ॥36॥
html:
cāturmāsyairye yajante janāḥ sadā tatheṣṭīnāṃ daśaśataṃ prāpnuvanti ।
ye cāgnihotraṃ juhvati śraddadhānā yathānyāyaṃ trīṇi varṣāṇi viprāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: cAturmAsyErye yajante janAH sadA taTezwInAM daSaSataM prApnuvanti । ye cAgnihotraM juhvati SraddaDAnA yaTAnyAyaM trIRi varzARi viprAH ॥36॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: svadāriṇāṃ dharmadhure mahātmanāṃ yathocite vartmani susthitānām । dharmātmanāmudvahatāṃ gatiṃ tāṃ paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥37॥
html:
svadāriṇāṃ dharmadhure mahātmanāṃ yathocite vartmani susthitānām ।
dharmātmanāmudvahatāṃ gatiṃ tāṃ paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥37॥
slp1: svadAriRAM DarmaDure mahAtmanAM yaTocite vartmani susTitAnAm । DarmAtmanAmudvahatAM gatiM tAM paraM gantA DftarAzwro na tatra ॥37॥

text: indrasya lokā virajā viśokā duranvayāḥ kāṅkṣitā mānavānām । tasyāhaṃ te bhavane bhūritejaso rājannimaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥38॥
html:
indrasya lokā virajā viśokā duranvayāḥ kāṅkṣitā mānavānām ।
tasyāhaṃ te bhavane bhūritejaso rājannimaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥38॥
slp1: indrasya lokA virajA viSokA duranvayAH kANkzitA mAnavAnAm । tasyAhaM te Bavane BUritejaso rAjannimaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥38॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: śatavarṣajīvī yaśca śūro manuṣyo vedādhyāyī yaśca yajvāpramattaḥ । ete sarve śakralokaṃ vrajanti paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥39॥
html:
śatavarṣajīvī yaśca śūro manuṣyo vedādhyāyī yaśca yajvāpramattaḥ ।
ete sarve śakralokaṃ vrajanti paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥39॥
slp1: SatavarzajIvI yaSca SUro manuzyo vedADyAyI yaSca yajvApramattaH । ete sarve SakralokaM vrajanti paraM gantA DftarAzwro na tatra ॥39॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: prājāpatyāḥ santi lokā mahānto nākasya pṛṣṭhe puṣkalā vītaśokāḥ । manīṣitāḥ sarvalokodbhavānāṃ tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥40॥
html:
prājāpatyāḥ santi lokā mahānto nākasya pṛṣṭhe puṣkalā vītaśokāḥ ।
manīṣitāḥ sarvalokodbhavānāṃ tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥40॥
slp1: prAjApatyAH santi lokA mahAnto nAkasya pfzWe puzkalA vItaSokAH । manIzitAH sarvalokodBavAnAM tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥40॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: ye rājāno rājasūyābhiṣiktā dharmātmāno rakṣitāraḥ prajānām । ye cāśvamedhāvabhṛthāplutāṅgāsteṣāṃ lokā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥41॥
html:
ye rājāno rājasūyābhiṣiktā dharmātmāno rakṣitāraḥ prajānām ।
ye cāśvamedhāvabhṛthāplutāṅgāsteṣāṃ lokā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra ॥41॥
slp1: ye rAjAno rAjasUyABiziktA DarmAtmAno rakzitAraH prajAnAm । ye cASvameDAvaBfTAplutANgAstezAM lokA DftarAzwro na tatra ॥41॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: tataḥ paraṃ bhānti lokāḥ sanātanāḥ supuṇyagandhā virajā vītaśokāḥ । tasminnahaṃ durlabhe tvāpradhṛṣye gavāṃ loke hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥42॥
html:
tataḥ paraṃ bhānti lokāḥ sanātanāḥ supuṇyagandhā virajā vītaśokāḥ ।
tasminnahaṃ durlabhe tvāpradhṛṣye gavāṃ loke hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥42॥
slp1: tataH paraM BAnti lokAH sanAtanAH supuRyaganDA virajA vItaSokAH । tasminnahaM durlaBe tvApraDfzye gavAM loke hastinaM yAtayizye ॥42॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: yo gosahasrī śatadaḥ samāṃ samāṃ yo gośatī daśa dadyācca śaktyā । tathā daśabhyo yaśca dadyādihaikāṃ pañcabhyo vā dānaśīlastathaikām ॥43॥
html:
yo gosahasrī śatadaḥ samāṃ samāṃ yo gośatī daśa dadyācca śaktyā ।
tathā daśabhyo yaśca dadyādihaikāṃ pañcabhyo vā dānaśīlastathaikām ॥43॥
slp1: yo gosahasrI SatadaH samAM samAM yo goSatI daSa dadyAcca SaktyA । taTA daSaByo yaSca dadyAdihEkAM paYcaByo vA dAnaSIlastaTEkAm ॥43॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: ye jīryante brahmacaryeṇa viprā brāhmīṃ vācaṃ parirakṣanti caiva । manasvinastīrthayātrāparāyaṇāste tatra modanti gavāṃ vimāne ॥44॥
html:
ye jīryante brahmacaryeṇa viprā brāhmīṃ vācaṃ parirakṣanti caiva ।
manasvinastīrthayātrāparāyaṇāste tatra modanti gavāṃ vimāne ॥44॥
slp1: ye jIryante brahmacaryeRa viprA brAhmIM vAcaM parirakzanti cEva । manasvinastIrTayAtrAparAyaRAste tatra modanti gavAM vimAne ॥44॥

text: prabhāsaṃ mānasaṃ puṇyaṃ puṣkarāṇi mahatsaraḥ । puṇyaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ bāhudāṃ karatoyinīm ॥45॥
html:
prabhāsaṃ mānasaṃ puṇyaṃ puṣkarāṇi mahatsaraḥ ।
puṇyaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ bāhudāṃ karatoyinīm ॥45॥
slp1: praBAsaM mAnasaM puRyaM puzkarARi mahatsaraH । puRyaM ca nEmizaM tIrTaM bAhudAM karatoyinIm ॥45॥

text: gayāṃ gayaśiraścaiva vipāśāṃ sthūlavālukām । tūṣṇīṅgaṅgāṃ daśagaṅgāṃ mahāhradamathāpi ca ॥46॥
html:
gayāṃ gayaśiraścaiva vipāśāṃ sthūlavālukām ।
tūṣṇīṅgaṅgāṃ daśagaṅgāṃ mahāhradamathāpi ca ॥46॥
slp1: gayAM gayaSiraScEva vipASAM sTUlavAlukAm । tUzRINgaNgAM daSagaNgAM mahAhradamaTApi ca ॥46॥

text: gautamīṃ kauśikīṃ pākāṃ mahātmāno dhṛtavratāḥ । sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyau yamunāṃ ye prayānti ca ॥47॥
html:
gautamīṃ kauśikīṃ pākāṃ mahātmāno dhṛtavratāḥ ।
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyau yamunāṃ ye prayānti ca ॥47॥
slp1: gOtamIM kOSikIM pAkAM mahAtmAno DftavratAH । sarasvatIdfzadvatyO yamunAM ye prayAnti ca ॥47॥

text: tatra te divyasaṃsthānā divyamālyadharāḥ śivāḥ । prayānti puṇyagandhāḍhyā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra vai ॥48॥
html:
tatra te divyasaṃsthānā divyamālyadharāḥ śivāḥ ।
prayānti puṇyagandhāḍhyā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra vai ॥48॥
slp1: tatra te divyasaMsTAnA divyamAlyaDarAH SivAH । prayAnti puRyaganDAQyA DftarAzwro na tatra vE ॥48॥

text: yatra śītabhayaṃ nāsti na coṣṇabhayamaṇvapi । na kṣutpipāse na glānirna duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ tathā ॥49॥
html:
yatra śītabhayaṃ nāsti na coṣṇabhayamaṇvapi ।
na kṣutpipāse na glānirna duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ tathā ॥49॥
slp1: yatra SItaBayaM nAsti na cozRaBayamaRvapi । na kzutpipAse na glAnirna duHKaM na suKaM taTA ॥49॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: na dveṣyo na priyaḥ kaścinna bandhurna ripustathā । na jarāmaraṇe vāpi na puṇyaṃ na ca pātakam ॥50॥
html:
na dveṣyo na priyaḥ kaścinna bandhurna ripustathā ।
na jarāmaraṇe vāpi na puṇyaṃ na ca pātakam ॥50॥
slp1: na dvezyo na priyaH kaScinna banDurna ripustaTA । na jarAmaraRe vApi na puRyaM na ca pAtakam ॥50॥

text: tasminvirajasi sphīte prajñāsattvavyavasthite । svayambhubhavane puṇye hastinaṃ me yatiṣyati ॥51॥
html:
tasminvirajasi sphīte prajñāsattvavyavasthite ।
svayambhubhavane puṇye hastinaṃ me yatiṣyati ॥51॥
slp1: tasminvirajasi sPIte prajYAsattvavyavasTite । svayamBuBavane puRye hastinaM me yatizyati ॥51॥

text: nirmuktāḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo kṛtātmāno yatavratāḥ । adhyātmayogasaṃsthāne yuktāḥ svargagatiṃ gatāḥ ॥52॥
html:
nirmuktāḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo kṛtātmāno yatavratāḥ ।
adhyātmayogasaṃsthāne yuktāḥ svargagatiṃ gatāḥ ॥52॥
slp1: nirmuktAH sarvasaNgeByo kftAtmAno yatavratAH । aDyAtmayogasaMsTAne yuktAH svargagatiM gatAH ॥52॥
author: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ।

text: te brahmabhavanaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnuvantīha sāttvikāḥ । na tatra dhṛtarāṣṭraste śakyo draṣṭuṃ mahāmune ॥53॥
html:
te brahmabhavanaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnuvantīha sāttvikāḥ ।
na tatra dhṛtarāṣṭraste śakyo draṣṭuṃ mahāmune ॥53॥
slp1: te brahmaBavanaM puRyaM prApnuvantIha sAttvikAH । na tatra DftarAzwraste Sakyo drazwuM mahAmune ॥53॥

text: rathantaraṃ yatra bṛhacca gīyate yatra vedī puṇḍarīkaiḥ stṛṇoti । yatropayāti haribhiḥ somapīthī tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥54॥
html:
rathantaraṃ yatra bṛhacca gīyate yatra vedī puṇḍarīkaiḥ stṛṇoti ।
yatropayāti haribhiḥ somapīthī tatra tvāhaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye ॥54॥
slp1: raTantaraM yatra bfhacca gIyate yatra vedI puRqarIkEH stfRoti । yatropayAti hariBiH somapITI tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayizye ॥54॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: budhyāmi tvāṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ śatakratuṃ vyatikramantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā । kaccinna vācā vṛjinaṃ kadā cidakārṣaṃ te manaso'bhiṣaṅgāt ॥55॥
html:
budhyāmi tvāṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ śatakratuṃ vyatikramantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā ।
kaccinna vācā vṛjinaṃ kadā cidakārṣaṃ te manaso'bhiṣaṅgāt ॥55॥
slp1: buDyAmi tvAM vftrahaRaM SatakratuM vyatikramantaM BuvanAni viSvA । kaccinna vAcA vfjinaM kadA cidakArzaM te manaso'BizaNgAt ॥55॥

text: yasmādimaṃ lokapathaṃ prajānāmanvāgamaṃ padavāde gajasya । tasmādbhavānpraṇataṃ mānuśāstu bravīṣi yattatkaravāṇi sarvam ॥56॥
html:
yasmādimaṃ lokapathaṃ prajānāmanvāgamaṃ padavāde gajasya ।
tasmādbhavānpraṇataṃ mānuśāstu bravīṣi yattatkaravāṇi sarvam ॥56॥
slp1: yasmAdimaM lokapaTaM prajAnAmanvAgamaM padavAde gajasya । tasmAdBavAnpraRataM mAnuSAstu bravIzi yattatkaravARi sarvam ॥56॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: śvetaṃ kareṇuṃ mama putranāgaṃ yaṃ me'hārṣīrdaśavarṣāṇi bālam । yo me vane vasato'bhūddvitīyastameva me dehi surendra nāgam ॥57॥
html:
śvetaṃ kareṇuṃ mama putranāgaṃ yaṃ me'hārṣīrdaśavarṣāṇi bālam ।
yo me vane vasato'bhūddvitīyastameva me dehi surendra nāgam ॥57॥
slp1: SvetaM kareRuM mama putranAgaM yaM me'hArzIrdaSavarzARi bAlam । yo me vane vasato'BUddvitIyastameva me dehi surendra nAgam ॥57॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: ayaṃ sutaste dvijamukhya nāgaścāghrāyate tvāmabhivīkṣamāṇaḥ । pādau ca te nāsikayopajighrate śreyo mama dhyāhi namaśca te'stu ॥58॥
html:
ayaṃ sutaste dvijamukhya nāgaścāghrāyate tvāmabhivīkṣamāṇaḥ ।
pādau ca te nāsikayopajighrate śreyo mama dhyāhi namaśca te'stu ॥58॥
slp1: ayaM sutaste dvijamuKya nAgaScAGrAyate tvAmaBivIkzamARaH । pAdO ca te nAsikayopajiGrate Sreyo mama DyAhi namaSca te'stu ॥58॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: śivaṃ sadaiveha surendra tubhyaṃ dhyāyāmi pūjāṃ ca sadā prayuñje । mamāpi tvaṃ śakra śivaṃ dadasva tvayā dattaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi nāgam ॥59॥
html:
śivaṃ sadaiveha surendra tubhyaṃ dhyāyāmi pūjāṃ ca sadā prayuñje ।
mamāpi tvaṃ śakra śivaṃ dadasva tvayā dattaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi nāgam ॥59॥
slp1: SivaM sadEveha surendra tuByaM DyAyAmi pUjAM ca sadA prayuYje । mamApi tvaM Sakra SivaM dadasva tvayA dattaM pratigfhRAmi nAgam ॥59॥
author: gautama uvāca ।

text: yeṣāṃ vedā nihitā vai guhāyāṃ manīṣiṇāṃ sattvavatāṃ mahātmanām । teṣāṃ tvayaikena mahātmanāsmi buddhastasmātprītimāṃste'hamadya ॥60॥
html:
yeṣāṃ vedā nihitā vai guhāyāṃ manīṣiṇāṃ sattvavatāṃ mahātmanām ।
teṣāṃ tvayaikena mahātmanāsmi buddhastasmātprītimāṃste'hamadya ॥60॥
slp1: yezAM vedA nihitA vE guhAyAM manIziRAM sattvavatAM mahAtmanAm । tezAM tvayEkena mahAtmanAsmi budDastasmAtprItimAMste'hamadya ॥60॥
author: śakra uvāca ।

text: hantaihi brāhmaṇa kṣipraṃ saha putreṇa hastinā । prāpnuhi tvaṃ śubhāṁllokānahnāya ca cirāya ca ॥61॥
html:
hantaihi brāhmaṇa kṣipraṃ saha putreṇa hastinā ।
prāpnuhi tvaṃ śubhāṁllokānahnāya ca cirāya ca ॥61॥
slp1: hantEhi brAhmaRa kzipraM saha putreRa hastinA । prApnuhi tvaM SuBAṁllokAnahnAya ca cirAya ca ॥61॥

text: sa gautamaṃ puraskṛtya saha putreṇa hastinā । divamācakrame vajrī sadbhiḥ saha durāsadam] ॥62॥
html:
sa gautamaṃ puraskṛtya saha putreṇa hastinā ।
divamācakrame vajrī sadbhiḥ saha durāsadam] ॥62॥
slp1: sa gOtamaM puraskftya saha putreRa hastinA । divamAcakrame vajrI sadBiH saha durAsadam] ॥62॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dānaṃ bahuvidhākāraṃ śāntiḥ satyamahiṃsatā । svadāratuṣṭiścoktā te phalaṃ dānasya caiva yat ॥1॥
html:
dānaṃ bahuvidhākāraṃ śāntiḥ satyamahiṃsatā ।
svadāratuṣṭiścoktā te phalaṃ dānasya caiva yat ॥1॥
slp1: dAnaM bahuviDAkAraM SAntiH satyamahiMsatA । svadAratuzwiScoktA te PalaM dAnasya cEva yat ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: pitāmahasya viditaṃ kimanyatra tapobalāt । tapaso yatparaṃ te'dya tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥2॥
html:
pitāmahasya viditaṃ kimanyatra tapobalāt ।
tapaso yatparaṃ te'dya tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥2॥
slp1: pitAmahasya viditaM kimanyatra tapobalAt । tapaso yatparaM te'dya tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥2॥

text: tapaḥ pracakṣate yāvattāvallokā yudhiṣṭhira । mataṃ mama tu kaunteya tapo nānaśanātparam ॥3॥
html:
tapaḥ pracakṣate yāvattāvallokā yudhiṣṭhira ।
mataṃ mama tu kaunteya tapo nānaśanātparam ॥3॥
slp1: tapaH pracakzate yAvattAvallokA yuDizWira । mataM mama tu kOnteya tapo nAnaSanAtparam ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । bhagīrathasya saṃvādaṃ brahmaṇaśca mahātmanaḥ ॥4॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
bhagīrathasya saṃvādaṃ brahmaṇaśca mahātmanaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । BagIraTasya saMvAdaM brahmaRaSca mahAtmanaH ॥4॥

text: atītya suralokaṃ ca gavāṃ lokaṃ ca bhārata । ṛṣilokaṃ ca so'gacchadbhagīratha iti śrutiḥ ॥5॥
html:
atītya suralokaṃ ca gavāṃ lokaṃ ca bhārata ।
ṛṣilokaṃ ca so'gacchadbhagīratha iti śrutiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: atItya suralokaM ca gavAM lokaM ca BArata । fzilokaM ca so'gacCadBagIraTa iti SrutiH ॥5॥

text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa vacaḥ prāha brahmā rājanbhagīratham । kathaṃ bhagīrathāgāstvamimaṃ deśaṃ durāsadam ॥6॥
html:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa vacaḥ prāha brahmā rājanbhagīratham ।
kathaṃ bhagīrathāgāstvamimaṃ deśaṃ durāsadam ॥6॥
slp1: taM dfzwvA sa vacaH prAha brahmA rAjanBagIraTam । kaTaM BagIraTAgAstvamimaM deSaM durAsadam ॥6॥

text: na hi devā na gandharvā na manuṣyā bhagīratha । āyāntyataptatapasaḥ kathaṃ vai tvamihāgataḥ ॥7॥
html:
na hi devā na gandharvā na manuṣyā bhagīratha ।
āyāntyataptatapasaḥ kathaṃ vai tvamihāgataḥ ॥7॥
slp1: na hi devA na ganDarvA na manuzyA BagIraTa । AyAntyataptatapasaH kaTaM vE tvamihAgataH ॥7॥

text: niḥśaṅkamannamadadaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śataṃ sahasrāṇi sadaiva dānam । brāhmaṃ vrataṃ nityamāsthāya viddhi na tvevāhaṃ tasya phalādihāgām ॥8॥
html:
niḥśaṅkamannamadadaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śataṃ sahasrāṇi sadaiva dānam ।
brāhmaṃ vrataṃ nityamāsthāya viddhi na tvevāhaṃ tasya phalādihāgām ॥8॥
slp1: niHSaNkamannamadadaM brAhmaReByaH SataM sahasrARi sadEva dAnam । brAhmaM vrataM nityamAsTAya vidDi na tvevAhaM tasya PalAdihAgAm ॥8॥
author: bhagīratha uvāca ।

text: daśaikarātrāndaśa pañcarātrānekādaśaikādaśakānkratūṃśca । jyotiṣṭomānāṃ ca śataṃ yadiṣṭaṃ phalena tenāpi ca nāgato'ham ॥9॥
html:
daśaikarātrāndaśa pañcarātrānekādaśaikādaśakānkratūṃśca ।
jyotiṣṭomānāṃ ca śataṃ yadiṣṭaṃ phalena tenāpi ca nāgato'ham ॥9॥
slp1: daSEkarAtrAndaSa paYcarAtrAnekAdaSEkAdaSakAnkratUMSca । jyotizwomAnAM ca SataM yadizwaM Palena tenApi ca nAgato'ham ॥9॥

text: yaccāvasaṃ jāhnavītīranityaḥ śataṃ samāstapyamānastapo'ham । adāṃ ca tatrāśvatarīsahasraṃ nārīpuraṃ na ca tenāhamāgām ॥10॥
html:
yaccāvasaṃ jāhnavītīranityaḥ śataṃ samāstapyamānastapo'ham ।
adāṃ ca tatrāśvatarīsahasraṃ nārīpuraṃ na ca tenāhamāgām ॥10॥
slp1: yaccAvasaM jAhnavItIranityaH SataM samAstapyamAnastapo'ham । adAM ca tatrASvatarIsahasraM nArIpuraM na ca tenAhamAgAm ॥10॥

text: daśāyutāni cāśvānāmayutāni ca viṃśatim । puṣkareṣu dvijātibhyaḥ prādāṃ gāśca sahasraśaḥ ॥11॥
html:
daśāyutāni cāśvānāmayutāni ca viṃśatim ।
puṣkareṣu dvijātibhyaḥ prādāṃ gāśca sahasraśaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: daSAyutAni cASvAnAmayutAni ca viMSatim । puzkarezu dvijAtiByaH prAdAM gASca sahasraSaH ॥11॥

text: suvarṇacandroḍupadhāriṇīnāṃ kanyottamānāmadadaṃ sragviṇīnām । ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāṇi vibhūṣitānāṃ jāmbūnadairābharaṇairna tena ॥12॥
html:
suvarṇacandroḍupadhāriṇīnāṃ kanyottamānāmadadaṃ sragviṇīnām ।
ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāṇi vibhūṣitānāṃ jāmbūnadairābharaṇairna tena ॥12॥
slp1: suvarRacandroqupaDAriRInAM kanyottamAnAmadadaM sragviRInAm । zazwiM sahasrARi viBUzitAnAM jAmbUnadErABaraRErna tena ॥12॥

text: daśārbudānyadadaṃ gosavejyāsvekaikaśo daśa gā lokanātha । samānavatsāḥ payasā samanvitāḥ suvarṇakāṃsyopaduhā na tena ॥13॥
html:
daśārbudānyadadaṃ gosavejyāsvekaikaśo daśa gā lokanātha ।
samānavatsāḥ payasā samanvitāḥ suvarṇakāṃsyopaduhā na tena ॥13॥
slp1: daSArbudAnyadadaM gosavejyAsvekEkaSo daSa gA lokanATa । samAnavatsAH payasA samanvitAH suvarRakAMsyopaduhA na tena ॥13॥

text: aptoryāmeṣu niyatamekaikasmindaśādadam । gṛṣṭīnāṃ kṣīradātrīṇāṃ rohiṇīnāṃ na tena ca ॥14॥
html:
aptoryāmeṣu niyatamekaikasmindaśādadam ।
gṛṣṭīnāṃ kṣīradātrīṇāṃ rohiṇīnāṃ na tena ca ॥14॥
slp1: aptoryAmezu niyatamekEkasmindaSAdadam । gfzwInAM kzIradAtrIRAM rohiRInAM na tena ca ॥14॥

text: dogdhrīṇāṃ vai gavāṃ caiva prayutāni daśaiva ha । prādāṃ daśaguṇaṃ brahmanna ca tenāhamāgataḥ ॥15॥
html:
dogdhrīṇāṃ vai gavāṃ caiva prayutāni daśaiva ha ।
prādāṃ daśaguṇaṃ brahmanna ca tenāhamāgataḥ ॥15॥
slp1: dogDrIRAM vE gavAM cEva prayutAni daSEva ha । prAdAM daSaguRaM brahmanna ca tenAhamAgataH ॥15॥

text: vājināṃ bāhlijātānāmayutānyadadaṃ daśa । karkāṇāṃ hemamālānāṃ na ca tenāhamāgataḥ ॥16॥
html:
vājināṃ bāhlijātānāmayutānyadadaṃ daśa ।
karkāṇāṃ hemamālānāṃ na ca tenāhamāgataḥ ॥16॥
slp1: vAjinAM bAhlijAtAnAmayutAnyadadaM daSa । karkARAM hemamAlAnAM na ca tenAhamAgataH ॥16॥

text: koṭīśca kāñcanasyāṣṭau prādāṃ brahmandaśa tvaham । ekaikasminkratau tena phalenāhaṃ na cāgataḥ ॥17॥
html:
koṭīśca kāñcanasyāṣṭau prādāṃ brahmandaśa tvaham ।
ekaikasminkratau tena phalenāhaṃ na cāgataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: kowISca kAYcanasyAzwO prAdAM brahmandaSa tvaham । ekEkasminkratO tena PalenAhaM na cAgataH ॥17॥

text: vājināṃ śyāmakarṇānāṃ haritānāṃ pitāmaha । prādāṃ hemasrajāṃ brahmankoṭīrdaśa ca sapta ca ॥18॥
html:
vājināṃ śyāmakarṇānāṃ haritānāṃ pitāmaha ।
prādāṃ hemasrajāṃ brahmankoṭīrdaśa ca sapta ca ॥18॥
slp1: vAjinAM SyAmakarRAnAM haritAnAM pitAmaha । prAdAM hemasrajAM brahmankowIrdaSa ca sapta ca ॥18॥

text: īṣādantānmahākāyānkāñcanasragvibhūṣitān । patnīmataḥ sahasrāṇi prāyacchaṃ daśa sapta ca ॥19॥
html:
īṣādantānmahākāyānkāñcanasragvibhūṣitān ।
patnīmataḥ sahasrāṇi prāyacchaṃ daśa sapta ca ॥19॥
slp1: IzAdantAnmahAkAyAnkAYcanasragviBUzitAn । patnImataH sahasrARi prAyacCaM daSa sapta ca ॥19॥

text: alaṅkṛtānāṃ deveśa divyaiḥ kanakabhūṣaṇaiḥ । rathānāṃ kāñcanāṅgānāṃ sahasrāṇyadadaṃ daśa । sapta cānyāni yuktāni vājibhiḥ samalaṅkṛtaiḥ ॥20॥
html:
alaṅkṛtānāṃ deveśa divyaiḥ kanakabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
rathānāṃ kāñcanāṅgānāṃ sahasrāṇyadadaṃ daśa ।
sapta cānyāni yuktāni vājibhiḥ samalaṅkṛtaiḥ ॥20॥
slp1: alaNkftAnAM deveSa divyEH kanakaBUzaREH । raTAnAM kAYcanANgAnAM sahasrARyadadaM daSa । sapta cAnyAni yuktAni vAjiBiH samalaNkftEH ॥20॥

text: dakṣiṇāvayavāḥ kecidvedairye samprakīrtitāḥ । vājapeyeṣu daśasu prādāṃ tenāpi nāpyaham ॥21॥
html:
dakṣiṇāvayavāḥ kecidvedairye samprakīrtitāḥ ।
vājapeyeṣu daśasu prādāṃ tenāpi nāpyaham ॥21॥
slp1: dakziRAvayavAH kecidvedErye samprakIrtitAH । vAjapeyezu daSasu prAdAM tenApi nApyaham ॥21॥

text: śakratulyaprabhāvānāmijyayā vikrameṇa ca । sahasraṃ niṣkakaṇṭhānāmadadaṃ dakṣiṇāmaham ॥22॥
html:
śakratulyaprabhāvānāmijyayā vikrameṇa ca ।
sahasraṃ niṣkakaṇṭhānāmadadaṃ dakṣiṇāmaham ॥22॥
slp1: SakratulyapraBAvAnAmijyayA vikrameRa ca । sahasraM nizkakaRWAnAmadadaM dakziRAmaham ॥22॥

text: vijitya nṛpatīnsarvānmakhairiṣṭvā pitāmaha । aṣṭabhyo rājasūyebhyo na ca tenāhamāgataḥ ॥23॥
html:
vijitya nṛpatīnsarvānmakhairiṣṭvā pitāmaha ।
aṣṭabhyo rājasūyebhyo na ca tenāhamāgataḥ ॥23॥
slp1: vijitya nfpatInsarvAnmaKErizwvA pitAmaha । azwaByo rAjasUyeByo na ca tenAhamAgataH ॥23॥

text: srotaśca yāvadgaṅgāyāśchannamāsījjagatpate । dakṣiṇābhiḥ pravṛttābhirmama nāgāṃ ca tatkṛte ॥24॥
html:
srotaśca yāvadgaṅgāyāśchannamāsījjagatpate ।
dakṣiṇābhiḥ pravṛttābhirmama nāgāṃ ca tatkṛte ॥24॥
slp1: srotaSca yAvadgaNgAyASCannamAsIjjagatpate । dakziRABiH pravfttABirmama nAgAM ca tatkfte ॥24॥

text: vājināṃ ca sahasre dve suvarṇaśatabhūṣite । varaṃ grāmaśataṃ cāhamekaikasya tridhādadam । tapasvī niyatāhāraḥ śamamāsthāya vāgyataḥ ॥25॥
html:
vājināṃ ca sahasre dve suvarṇaśatabhūṣite ।
varaṃ grāmaśataṃ cāhamekaikasya tridhādadam ।
tapasvī niyatāhāraḥ śamamāsthāya vāgyataḥ ॥25॥
slp1: vAjinAM ca sahasre dve suvarRaSataBUzite । varaM grAmaSataM cAhamekEkasya triDAdadam । tapasvI niyatAhAraH SamamAsTAya vAgyataH ॥25॥

text: dīrghakālaṃ himavati gaṅgāyāśca durutsahām । mūrdhnā dhārāṃ mahādevaḥ śirasā yāmadhārayat । na tenāpyahamāgacchaṃ phaleneha pitāmaha ॥26॥
html:
dīrghakālaṃ himavati gaṅgāyāśca durutsahām ।
mūrdhnā dhārāṃ mahādevaḥ śirasā yāmadhārayat ।
na tenāpyahamāgacchaṃ phaleneha pitāmaha ॥26॥
slp1: dIrGakAlaM himavati gaNgAyASca durutsahAm । mUrDnA DArAM mahAdevaH SirasA yAmaDArayat । na tenApyahamAgacCaM Paleneha pitAmaha ॥26॥

text: śamyākṣepairayajaṃ yacca devānsadyaskānāmayutaiścāpi yattat । trayodaśadvādaśāhāṃśca deva sapauṇḍarīkānna ca teṣāṃ phalena ॥27॥
html:
śamyākṣepairayajaṃ yacca devānsadyaskānāmayutaiścāpi yattat ।
trayodaśadvādaśāhāṃśca deva sapauṇḍarīkānna ca teṣāṃ phalena ॥27॥
slp1: SamyAkzepErayajaM yacca devAnsadyaskAnAmayutEScApi yattat । trayodaSadvAdaSAhAMSca deva sapORqarIkAnna ca tezAM Palena ॥27॥

text: aṣṭau sahasrāṇi kakudmināmahaṃ śuklarṣabhāṇāmadadaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ । ekaikaṃ vai kāñcanaṃ śṛṅgamebhyaḥ patnīścaiṣāmadadaṃ niṣkakaṇṭhīḥ ॥28॥
html:
aṣṭau sahasrāṇi kakudmināmahaṃ śuklarṣabhāṇāmadadaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ ।
ekaikaṃ vai kāñcanaṃ śṛṅgamebhyaḥ patnīścaiṣāmadadaṃ niṣkakaṇṭhīḥ ॥28॥
slp1: azwO sahasrARi kakudminAmahaM SuklarzaBARAmadadaM brAhmaReByaH । ekEkaM vE kAYcanaM SfNgameByaH patnIScEzAmadadaM nizkakaRWIH ॥28॥

text: hiraṇyaratnanicitānadadaṃ ratnaparvatān । dhanadhānyasamṛddhāṃśca grāmāñśatasahasraśaḥ ॥29॥
html:
hiraṇyaratnanicitānadadaṃ ratnaparvatān ।
dhanadhānyasamṛddhāṃśca grāmāñśatasahasraśaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: hiraRyaratnanicitAnadadaM ratnaparvatAn । DanaDAnyasamfdDAMSca grAmAYSatasahasraSaH ॥29॥

text: śataṃ śatānāṃ gṛṣṭīnāmadadaṃ cāpyatandritaḥ । iṣṭvānekairmahāyajñairbrāhmaṇebhyo na tena ca ॥30॥
html:
śataṃ śatānāṃ gṛṣṭīnāmadadaṃ cāpyatandritaḥ ।
iṣṭvānekairmahāyajñairbrāhmaṇebhyo na tena ca ॥30॥
slp1: SataM SatAnAM gfzwInAmadadaM cApyatandritaH । izwvAnekErmahAyajYErbrAhmaReByo na tena ca ॥30॥

text: ekādaśāhairayajaṃ sadakṣiṇairdvirdvādaśāhairaśvamedhaiśca deva । ārkāyaṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiśca brahmaṃsteṣāṃ phaleneha na cāgato'smi ॥31॥
html:
ekādaśāhairayajaṃ sadakṣiṇairdvirdvādaśāhairaśvamedhaiśca deva ।
ārkāyaṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiśca brahmaṃsteṣāṃ phaleneha na cāgato'smi ॥31॥
slp1: ekAdaSAhErayajaM sadakziRErdvirdvAdaSAhEraSvameDESca deva । ArkAyaREH zoqaSaBiSca brahmaMstezAM Paleneha na cAgato'smi ॥31॥

text: niṣkaikakaṇṭhamadadaṃ yojanāyataṃ tadvistīrṇaṃ kāñcanapādapānām । vanaṃ cūtānāṃ ratnavibhūṣitānāṃ na caiva teṣāmāgato'haṃ phalena ॥32॥
html:
niṣkaikakaṇṭhamadadaṃ yojanāyataṃ tadvistīrṇaṃ kāñcanapādapānām ।
vanaṃ cūtānāṃ ratnavibhūṣitānāṃ na caiva teṣāmāgato'haṃ phalena ॥32॥
slp1: nizkEkakaRWamadadaM yojanAyataM tadvistIrRaM kAYcanapAdapAnAm । vanaM cUtAnAM ratnaviBUzitAnAM na cEva tezAmAgato'haM Palena ॥32॥

text: turāyaṇaṃ hi vratamapradhṛṣyamakrodhano'karavaṃ triṃśato'bdān । śataṃ gavāmaṣṭa śatāni caiva dine dine hyadadaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ ॥33॥
html:
turāyaṇaṃ hi vratamapradhṛṣyamakrodhano'karavaṃ triṃśato'bdān ।
śataṃ gavāmaṣṭa śatāni caiva dine dine hyadadaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: turAyaRaM hi vratamapraDfzyamakroDano'karavaM triMSato'bdAn । SataM gavAmazwa SatAni cEva dine dine hyadadaM brAhmaReByaH ॥33॥

text: payasvinīnāmatha rohiṇīnāṃ tathaiva cāpyanaḍuhāṃ lokanātha । prādāṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sureśa nehāgatastena phalena cāham ॥34॥
html:
payasvinīnāmatha rohiṇīnāṃ tathaiva cāpyanaḍuhāṃ lokanātha ।
prādāṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sureśa nehāgatastena phalena cāham ॥34॥
slp1: payasvinInAmaTa rohiRInAM taTEva cApyanaquhAM lokanATa । prAdAM nityaM brAhmaReByaH sureSa nehAgatastena Palena cAham ॥34॥

text: triṃśadagnimahaṃ brahmannayajaṃ yacca nityadā । aṣṭābhiḥ sarvamedhaiśca naramedhaiśca saptabhiḥ ॥35॥
html:
triṃśadagnimahaṃ brahmannayajaṃ yacca nityadā ।
aṣṭābhiḥ sarvamedhaiśca naramedhaiśca saptabhiḥ ॥35॥
slp1: triMSadagnimahaM brahmannayajaM yacca nityadA । azwABiH sarvameDESca narameDESca saptaBiH ॥35॥

text: daśabhirviśvajidbhiśca śatairaṣṭādaśottaraiḥ । na caiva teṣāṃ deveśa phalenāhamihāgataḥ ॥36॥
html:
daśabhirviśvajidbhiśca śatairaṣṭādaśottaraiḥ ।
na caiva teṣāṃ deveśa phalenāhamihāgataḥ ॥36॥
slp1: daSaBirviSvajidBiSca SatErazwAdaSottarEH । na cEva tezAM deveSa PalenAhamihAgataH ॥36॥

text: sarayvāṃ bāhudāyāṃ ca gaṅgāyāmatha naimiṣe । gavāṃ śatānāmayutamadadaṃ na ca tena vai ॥37॥
html:
sarayvāṃ bāhudāyāṃ ca gaṅgāyāmatha naimiṣe ।
gavāṃ śatānāmayutamadadaṃ na ca tena vai ॥37॥
slp1: sarayvAM bAhudAyAM ca gaNgAyAmaTa nEmize । gavAM SatAnAmayutamadadaM na ca tena vE ॥37॥

text: indreṇa guhyaṃ nihitaṃ vai guhāyāṃ yadbhārgavastapasehābhyavindat । jājvalyamānamuśanastejaseha tatsādhayāmāsamahaṃ vareṇyam ॥38॥
html:
indreṇa guhyaṃ nihitaṃ vai guhāyāṃ yadbhārgavastapasehābhyavindat ।
jājvalyamānamuśanastejaseha tatsādhayāmāsamahaṃ vareṇyam ॥38॥
slp1: indreRa guhyaM nihitaM vE guhAyAM yadBArgavastapasehAByavindat । jAjvalyamAnamuSanastejaseha tatsADayAmAsamahaM vareRyam ॥38॥

text: tato me brāhmaṇāstuṣṭāstasminkarmaṇi sādhite । sahasramṛṣayaścāsanye vai tatra samāgatāḥ । uktastairasmi gaccha tvaṃ brahmalokamiti prabho ॥39॥
html:
tato me brāhmaṇāstuṣṭāstasminkarmaṇi sādhite ।
sahasramṛṣayaścāsanye vai tatra samāgatāḥ ।
uktastairasmi gaccha tvaṃ brahmalokamiti prabho ॥39॥
slp1: tato me brAhmaRAstuzwAstasminkarmaRi sADite । sahasramfzayaScAsanye vE tatra samAgatAH । uktastErasmi gacCa tvaM brahmalokamiti praBo ॥39॥

text: prītenoktaḥ sahasreṇa brāhmaṇānāmahaṃ prabho । imaṃ lokamanuprāpto mā bhūtte'tra vicāraṇā ॥40॥
html:
prītenoktaḥ sahasreṇa brāhmaṇānāmahaṃ prabho ।
imaṃ lokamanuprāpto mā bhūtte'tra vicāraṇā ॥40॥
slp1: prItenoktaH sahasreRa brAhmaRAnAmahaM praBo । imaM lokamanuprApto mA BUtte'tra vicAraRA ॥40॥

text: kāmaṃ yathāvadvihitaṃ vidhātrā pṛṣṭena vācyaṃ tu mayā yathāvat । tapo hi nānyaccānaśanānmataṃ me namo'stu te devavara prasīda ॥41॥
html:
kāmaṃ yathāvadvihitaṃ vidhātrā pṛṣṭena vācyaṃ tu mayā yathāvat ।
tapo hi nānyaccānaśanānmataṃ me namo'stu te devavara prasīda ॥41॥
slp1: kAmaM yaTAvadvihitaM viDAtrA pfzwena vAcyaM tu mayA yaTAvat । tapo hi nAnyaccAnaSanAnmataM me namo'stu te devavara prasIda ॥41॥

text: ityuktavantaṃ taṃ brahmā rājānaṃ sma bhagīratham । pūjayāmāsa pūjārhaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā] ॥42॥
html:
ityuktavantaṃ taṃ brahmā rājānaṃ sma bhagīratham ।
pūjayāmāsa pūjārhaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā] ॥42॥
slp1: ityuktavantaM taM brahmA rAjAnaM sma BagIraTam । pUjayAmAsa pUjArhaM viDidfzwena karmaRA] ॥42॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śatāyuruktaḥ puruṣaḥ śatavīryaśca vaidike । kasmānmriyante puruṣā bālā api pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
śatāyuruktaḥ puruṣaḥ śatavīryaśca vaidike ।
kasmānmriyante puruṣā bālā api pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: SatAyuruktaH puruzaH SatavIryaSca vEdike । kasmAnmriyante puruzA bAlA api pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: āyuṣmānkena bhavati svalpāyurvāpi mānavaḥ । kena vā labhate kīrtiṃ kena vā labhate śriyam ॥2॥
html:
āyuṣmānkena bhavati svalpāyurvāpi mānavaḥ ।
kena vā labhate kīrtiṃ kena vā labhate śriyam ॥2॥
slp1: AyuzmAnkena Bavati svalpAyurvApi mAnavaH । kena vA laBate kIrtiM kena vA laBate Sriyam ॥2॥

text: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa japairhomaistathauṣadhaiḥ । janmanā yadi vācārāttanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥3॥
html:
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa japairhomaistathauṣadhaiḥ ।
janmanā yadi vācārāttanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥3॥
slp1: tapasA brahmacaryeRa japErhomEstaTOzaDEH । janmanA yadi vAcArAttanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥3॥

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvamanupṛcchasi । alpāyuryena bhavati dīrghāyurvāpi mānavaḥ ॥4॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvamanupṛcchasi ।
alpāyuryena bhavati dīrghāyurvāpi mānavaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi yanmAM tvamanupfcCasi । alpAyuryena Bavati dIrGAyurvApi mAnavaH ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yena vā labhate kīrtiṃ yena vā labhate śriyam । yathā ca vartanpuruṣaḥ śreyasā samprayujyate ॥5॥
html:
yena vā labhate kīrtiṃ yena vā labhate śriyam ।
yathā ca vartanpuruṣaḥ śreyasā samprayujyate ॥5॥
slp1: yena vA laBate kIrtiM yena vA laBate Sriyam । yaTA ca vartanpuruzaH SreyasA samprayujyate ॥5॥

text: ācārāllabhate hyāyurācārāllabhate śriyam । ācārātkīrtimāpnoti puruṣaḥ pretya ceha ca ॥6॥
html:
ācārāllabhate hyāyurācārāllabhate śriyam ।
ācārātkīrtimāpnoti puruṣaḥ pretya ceha ca ॥6॥
slp1: AcArAllaBate hyAyurAcArAllaBate Sriyam । AcArAtkIrtimApnoti puruzaH pretya ceha ca ॥6॥

text: durācāro hi puruṣo nehāyurvindate mahat । trasanti yasmādbhūtāni tathā paribhavanti ca ॥7॥
html:
durācāro hi puruṣo nehāyurvindate mahat ।
trasanti yasmādbhūtāni tathā paribhavanti ca ॥7॥
slp1: durAcAro hi puruzo nehAyurvindate mahat । trasanti yasmAdBUtAni taTA pariBavanti ca ॥7॥

text: tasmātkuryādihācāraṃ ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ । api pāpaśarīrasya ācāro hantyalakṣaṇam ॥8॥
html:
tasmātkuryādihācāraṃ ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ।
api pāpaśarīrasya ācāro hantyalakṣaṇam ॥8॥
slp1: tasmAtkuryAdihAcAraM ya icCedBUtimAtmanaH । api pApaSarIrasya AcAro hantyalakzaRam ॥8॥

text: ācāralakṣaṇo dharmaḥ santaścācāralakṣaṇāḥ । sādhūnāṃ ca yathā vṛttametadācāralakṣaṇam ॥9॥
html:
ācāralakṣaṇo dharmaḥ santaścācāralakṣaṇāḥ ।
sādhūnāṃ ca yathā vṛttametadācāralakṣaṇam ॥9॥
slp1: AcAralakzaRo DarmaH santaScAcAralakzaRAH । sADUnAM ca yaTA vfttametadAcAralakzaRam ॥9॥

text: apyadṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ vāpi puruṣaṃ dharmacāriṇam । bhūtikarmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ taṃ janāḥ kurvate priyam ॥10॥
html:
apyadṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ vāpi puruṣaṃ dharmacāriṇam ।
bhūtikarmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ taṃ janāḥ kurvate priyam ॥10॥
slp1: apyadfzwaM SrutaM vApi puruzaM DarmacAriRam । BUtikarmARi kurvARaM taM janAH kurvate priyam ॥10॥

text: ye nāstikā niṣkriyāśca guruśāstrātilaṅghinaḥ । adharmajñā durācārāste bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ ॥11॥
html:
ye nāstikā niṣkriyāśca guruśāstrātilaṅghinaḥ ।
adharmajñā durācārāste bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: ye nAstikA nizkriyASca guruSAstrAtilaNGinaH । aDarmajYA durAcArAste Bavanti gatAyuzaH ॥11॥

text: viśīlā bhinnamaryādā nityaṃ saṅkīrṇamaithunāḥ । alpāyuṣo bhavantīha narā nirayagāminaḥ ॥12॥
html:
viśīlā bhinnamaryādā nityaṃ saṅkīrṇamaithunāḥ ।
alpāyuṣo bhavantīha narā nirayagāminaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: viSIlA BinnamaryAdA nityaM saNkIrRamETunAH । alpAyuzo BavantIha narA nirayagAminaH ॥12॥

text: sarvalakṣaṇahīno'pi samudācāravānnaraḥ । śraddadhāno'nasūyaśca śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvati ॥13॥
html:
sarvalakṣaṇahīno'pi samudācāravānnaraḥ ।
śraddadhāno'nasūyaśca śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvati ॥13॥
slp1: sarvalakzaRahIno'pi samudAcAravAnnaraH । SraddaDAno'nasUyaSca SataM varzARi jIvati ॥13॥

text: akrodhanaḥ satyavādī bhūtānāmavihiṃsakaḥ । anasūyurajihmaśca śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvati ॥14॥
html:
akrodhanaḥ satyavādī bhūtānāmavihiṃsakaḥ ।
anasūyurajihmaśca śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvati ॥14॥
slp1: akroDanaH satyavAdI BUtAnAmavihiMsakaH । anasUyurajihmaSca SataM varzARi jIvati ॥14॥

text: loṣṭamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ । nityocchiṣṭaḥ saṅkusuko nehāyurvindate mahat ॥15॥
html:
loṣṭamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ ।
nityocchiṣṭaḥ saṅkusuko nehāyurvindate mahat ॥15॥
slp1: lozwamardI tfRacCedI naKaKAdI ca yo naraH । nityocCizwaH saNkusuko nehAyurvindate mahat ॥15॥

text: brāhme muhūrte budhyeta dharmārthau cānucintayet । utthāyācamya tiṣṭheta pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥16॥
html:
brāhme muhūrte budhyeta dharmārthau cānucintayet ।
utthāyācamya tiṣṭheta pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥16॥
slp1: brAhme muhUrte buDyeta DarmArTO cAnucintayet । utTAyAcamya tizWeta pUrvAM sanDyAM kftAYjaliH ॥16॥

text: evamevāparāṃ sandhyāṃ samupāsīta vāgyataḥ । nekṣetādityamudyantaṃ nāstaṃ yāntaṃ kadācana ॥17॥
html:
evamevāparāṃ sandhyāṃ samupāsīta vāgyataḥ ।
nekṣetādityamudyantaṃ nāstaṃ yāntaṃ kadācana ॥17॥
slp1: evamevAparAM sanDyAM samupAsIta vAgyataH । nekzetAdityamudyantaM nAstaM yAntaM kadAcana ॥17॥

text: ṛṣayo dīrghasandhyatvāddīrghamāyuravāpnuvan । tasmāttiṣṭhetsadā pūrvāṃ paścimāṃ caiva vāgyataḥ ॥18॥
html:
ṛṣayo dīrghasandhyatvāddīrghamāyuravāpnuvan ।
tasmāttiṣṭhetsadā pūrvāṃ paścimāṃ caiva vāgyataḥ ॥18॥
slp1: fzayo dIrGasanDyatvAddIrGamAyuravApnuvan । tasmAttizWetsadA pUrvAM paScimAM cEva vAgyataH ॥18॥

text: ye ca pūrvāmupāsante dvijāḥ sandhyāṃ na paścimām । sarvāṃstāndhārmiko rājā śūdrakarmāṇi kārayet ॥19॥
html:
ye ca pūrvāmupāsante dvijāḥ sandhyāṃ na paścimām ।
sarvāṃstāndhārmiko rājā śūdrakarmāṇi kārayet ॥19॥
slp1: ye ca pUrvAmupAsante dvijAH sanDyAM na paScimAm । sarvAMstAnDArmiko rAjA SUdrakarmARi kArayet ॥19॥

text: paradārā na gantavyāḥ sarvavarṇeṣu karhicit । na hīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke kiñcana vidyate । yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāropasevanam ॥20॥
html:
paradārā na gantavyāḥ sarvavarṇeṣu karhicit ।
na hīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke kiñcana vidyate ।
yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāropasevanam ॥20॥
slp1: paradArA na gantavyAH sarvavarRezu karhicit । na hIdfSamanAyuzyaM loke kiYcana vidyate । yAdfSaM puruzasyeha paradAropasevanam ॥20॥

text: prasādhanaṃ ca keśānāmañjanaṃ dantadhāvanam । pūrvāhṇa eva kurvīta devatānāṃ ca pūjanam ॥21॥
html:
prasādhanaṃ ca keśānāmañjanaṃ dantadhāvanam ।
pūrvāhṇa eva kurvīta devatānāṃ ca pūjanam ॥21॥
slp1: prasADanaM ca keSAnAmaYjanaM dantaDAvanam । pUrvAhRa eva kurvIta devatAnAM ca pUjanam ॥21॥

text: purīṣamūtre nodīkṣennādhitiṣṭhetkadācana । udakyayā ca sambhāṣāṃ na kurvīta kadācana ॥22॥
html:
purīṣamūtre nodīkṣennādhitiṣṭhetkadācana ।
udakyayā ca sambhāṣāṃ na kurvīta kadācana ॥22॥
slp1: purIzamUtre nodIkzennADitizWetkadAcana । udakyayA ca samBAzAM na kurvIta kadAcana ॥22॥

text: notsṛjeta purīṣaṃ ca kṣetre grāmasya cāntike । ubhe mūtrapurīṣe tu nāpsu kuryātkadācana ॥23॥
html:
notsṛjeta purīṣaṃ ca kṣetre grāmasya cāntike ।
ubhe mūtrapurīṣe tu nāpsu kuryātkadācana ॥23॥
slp1: notsfjeta purIzaM ca kzetre grAmasya cAntike । uBe mUtrapurIze tu nApsu kuryAtkadAcana ॥23॥

text: prāṅmukho nityamaśnīyādvāgyato'nnamakutsayan । praskandayecca manasā bhuktvā cāgnimupaspṛśet ॥24॥
html:
prāṅmukho nityamaśnīyādvāgyato'nnamakutsayan ।
praskandayecca manasā bhuktvā cāgnimupaspṛśet ॥24॥
slp1: prANmuKo nityamaSnIyAdvAgyato'nnamakutsayan । praskandayecca manasA BuktvA cAgnimupaspfSet ॥24॥

text: āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte yaśasyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ । dhanyaṃ paścānmukho bhuṅkte ṛtaṃ bhuṅkte udaṅmukhaḥ ॥25॥
html:
āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte yaśasyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ।
dhanyaṃ paścānmukho bhuṅkte ṛtaṃ bhuṅkte udaṅmukhaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: AyuzyaM prANmuKo BuNkte yaSasyaM dakziRAmuKaH । DanyaM paScAnmuKo BuNkte ftaM BuNkte udaNmuKaH ॥25॥

text: nādhitiṣṭhettuṣāñjātu keśabhasmakapālikāḥ । anyasya cāpyupasthānaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet ॥26॥
html:
nādhitiṣṭhettuṣāñjātu keśabhasmakapālikāḥ ।
anyasya cāpyupasthānaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet ॥26॥
slp1: nADitizWettuzAYjAtu keSaBasmakapAlikAH । anyasya cApyupasTAnaM dUrataH parivarjayet ॥26॥

text: śāntihomāṃśca kurvīta sāvitrāṇi ca kārayet । niṣaṇṇaścāpi khādeta na tu gacchankathañcana ॥27॥
html:
śāntihomāṃśca kurvīta sāvitrāṇi ca kārayet ।
niṣaṇṇaścāpi khādeta na tu gacchankathañcana ॥27॥
slp1: SAntihomAMSca kurvIta sAvitrARi ca kArayet । nizaRRaScApi KAdeta na tu gacCankaTaYcana ॥27॥

text: mūtraṃ na tiṣṭhatā kāryaṃ na bhasmani na govraje ॥28॥
html: mūtraṃ na tiṣṭhatā kāryaṃ na bhasmani na govraje ॥28॥
slp1: mUtraM na tizWatA kAryaM na Basmani na govraje ॥28॥

text: ārdrapādastu bhuñjīta nārdrapādastu saṃviśet । ārdrapādastu bhuñjāno varṣāṇāṃ jīvate śatam ॥29॥
html:
ārdrapādastu bhuñjīta nārdrapādastu saṃviśet ।
ārdrapādastu bhuñjāno varṣāṇāṃ jīvate śatam ॥29॥
slp1: ArdrapAdastu BuYjIta nArdrapAdastu saMviSet । ArdrapAdastu BuYjAno varzARAM jIvate Satam ॥29॥

text: trīṇi tejāṃsi nocchiṣṭa ālabheta kadācana । agniṃ gāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva tathāsyāyurna riṣyate ॥30॥
html:
trīṇi tejāṃsi nocchiṣṭa ālabheta kadācana ।
agniṃ gāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva tathāsyāyurna riṣyate ॥30॥
slp1: trIRi tejAMsi nocCizwa AlaBeta kadAcana । agniM gAM brAhmaRaM cEva taTAsyAyurna rizyate ॥30॥

text: trīṇi tejāṃsi nocchiṣṭa udīkṣeta kadācana । sūryācandramasau caiva nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ ॥31॥
html:
trīṇi tejāṃsi nocchiṣṭa udīkṣeta kadācana ।
sūryācandramasau caiva nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: trIRi tejAMsi nocCizwa udIkzeta kadAcana । sUryAcandramasO cEva nakzatrARi ca sarvaSaH ॥31॥

text: ūrdhvaṃ prāṇā hyutkrāmanti yūnaḥ sthavira āyati । pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ punastānpratipadyate ॥32॥
html:
ūrdhvaṃ prāṇā hyutkrāmanti yūnaḥ sthavira āyati ।
pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ punastānpratipadyate ॥32॥
slp1: UrDvaM prARA hyutkrAmanti yUnaH sTavira Ayati । pratyutTAnABivAdAByAM punastAnpratipadyate ॥32॥

text: abhivādayeta vṛddhāṃśca āsanaṃ caiva dāpayet । kṛtāñjalirupāsīta gacchantaṃ pṛṣṭhato'nviyāt ॥33॥
html:
abhivādayeta vṛddhāṃśca āsanaṃ caiva dāpayet ।
kṛtāñjalirupāsīta gacchantaṃ pṛṣṭhato'nviyāt ॥33॥
slp1: aBivAdayeta vfdDAMSca AsanaM cEva dApayet । kftAYjalirupAsIta gacCantaM pfzWato'nviyAt ॥33॥

text: na cāsītāsane bhinne bhinnaṃ kāṃsyaṃ ca varjayet । naikavastreṇa bhoktavyaṃ na nagnaḥ snātumarhati । svaptavyaṃ naiva nagnena na cocchiṣṭo'pi saṃviśet ॥34॥
html:
na cāsītāsane bhinne bhinnaṃ kāṃsyaṃ ca varjayet ।
naikavastreṇa bhoktavyaṃ na nagnaḥ snātumarhati ।
svaptavyaṃ naiva nagnena na cocchiṣṭo'pi saṃviśet ॥34॥
slp1: na cAsItAsane Binne BinnaM kAMsyaM ca varjayet । nEkavastreRa BoktavyaM na nagnaH snAtumarhati । svaptavyaM nEva nagnena na cocCizwo'pi saMviSet ॥34॥

text: ucchiṣṭo na spṛśecchīrṣaṃ sarve prāṇāstadāśrayāḥ । keśagrahānprahārāṃśca śirasyetānvivarjayet ॥35॥
html:
ucchiṣṭo na spṛśecchīrṣaṃ sarve prāṇāstadāśrayāḥ ।
keśagrahānprahārāṃśca śirasyetānvivarjayet ॥35॥
slp1: ucCizwo na spfSecCIrzaM sarve prARAstadASrayAH । keSagrahAnprahArAMSca SirasyetAnvivarjayet ॥35॥

text: na pāṇibhyāmubhābhyāṃ ca kaṇḍūyejjātu vai śiraḥ । na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥ snāyāttathāsyāyurna riṣyate ॥36॥
html:
na pāṇibhyāmubhābhyāṃ ca kaṇḍūyejjātu vai śiraḥ ।
na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥ snāyāttathāsyāyurna riṣyate ॥36॥
slp1: na pARiByAmuBAByAM ca kaRqUyejjAtu vE SiraH । na cABIkzRaM SiraH snAyAttaTAsyAyurna rizyate ॥36॥

text: śiraḥsnātaśca tailena nāṅgaṃ kiñcidupaspṛśet । tilapiṣṭaṃ na cāśnīyāttathāyurvindate mahat ॥37॥
html:
śiraḥsnātaśca tailena nāṅgaṃ kiñcidupaspṛśet ।
tilapiṣṭaṃ na cāśnīyāttathāyurvindate mahat ॥37॥
slp1: SiraHsnAtaSca tElena nANgaM kiYcidupaspfSet । tilapizwaM na cASnIyAttaTAyurvindate mahat ॥37॥

text: nādhyāpayettathocchiṣṭo nādhīyīta kadācana । vāte ca pūtigandhe ca manasāpi na cintayet ॥38॥
html:
nādhyāpayettathocchiṣṭo nādhīyīta kadācana ।
vāte ca pūtigandhe ca manasāpi na cintayet ॥38॥
slp1: nADyApayettaTocCizwo nADIyIta kadAcana । vAte ca pUtiganDe ca manasApi na cintayet ॥38॥

text: atra gāthā yamodgītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ । āyurasya nikṛntāmi prajāmasyādade tathā ॥39॥
html:
atra gāthā yamodgītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ ।
āyurasya nikṛntāmi prajāmasyādade tathā ॥39॥
slp1: atra gATA yamodgItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH । Ayurasya nikfntAmi prajAmasyAdade taTA ॥39॥

text: ya ucchiṣṭaḥ pravadati svādhyāyaṃ cādhigacchati । yaścānadhyāyakāle'pi mohādabhyasyati dvijaḥ । tasmādyukto'pyanadhyāye nādhīyīta kadācana ॥40॥
html:
ya ucchiṣṭaḥ pravadati svādhyāyaṃ cādhigacchati ।
yaścānadhyāyakāle'pi mohādabhyasyati dvijaḥ ।
tasmādyukto'pyanadhyāye nādhīyīta kadācana ॥40॥
slp1: ya ucCizwaH pravadati svADyAyaM cADigacCati । yaScAnaDyAyakAle'pi mohAdaByasyati dvijaH । tasmAdyukto'pyanaDyAye nADIyIta kadAcana ॥40॥

text: pratyādityaṃ pratyanilaṃ prati gāṃ ca prati dvijān । ye mehanti ca panthānaṃ te bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ ॥41॥
html:
pratyādityaṃ pratyanilaṃ prati gāṃ ca prati dvijān ।
ye mehanti ca panthānaṃ te bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: pratyAdityaM pratyanilaM prati gAM ca prati dvijAn । ye mehanti ca panTAnaM te Bavanti gatAyuzaH ॥41॥

text: ubhe mūtrapurīṣe tu divā kuryādudaṅmukhaḥ । dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau tathāsyāyurna riṣyate ॥42॥
html:
ubhe mūtrapurīṣe tu divā kuryādudaṅmukhaḥ ।
dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau tathāsyāyurna riṣyate ॥42॥
slp1: uBe mUtrapurIze tu divA kuryAdudaNmuKaH । dakziRABimuKo rAtrO taTAsyAyurna rizyate ॥42॥

text: trīnkṛśānnāvajānīyāddīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ । brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ sarpaṃ sarve hyāśīviṣāstrayaḥ ॥43॥
html:
trīnkṛśānnāvajānīyāddīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ ।
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ sarpaṃ sarve hyāśīviṣāstrayaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: trInkfSAnnAvajAnIyAddIrGamAyurjijIvizuH । brAhmaRaM kzatriyaM sarpaM sarve hyASIvizAstrayaH ॥43॥

text: dahatyāśīviṣaḥ kruddho yāvatpaśyati cakṣuṣā । kṣatriyo'pi dahetkruddho yāvatspṛśati tejasā ॥44॥
html:
dahatyāśīviṣaḥ kruddho yāvatpaśyati cakṣuṣā ।
kṣatriyo'pi dahetkruddho yāvatspṛśati tejasā ॥44॥
slp1: dahatyASIvizaH krudDo yAvatpaSyati cakzuzA । kzatriyo'pi dahetkrudDo yAvatspfSati tejasA ॥44॥

text: brāhmaṇastu kulaṃ hanyāddhyānenāvekṣitena ca । tasmādetattrayaṃ yatnādupaseveta paṇḍitaḥ ॥45॥
html:
brāhmaṇastu kulaṃ hanyāddhyānenāvekṣitena ca ।
tasmādetattrayaṃ yatnādupaseveta paṇḍitaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: brAhmaRastu kulaM hanyAdDyAnenAvekzitena ca । tasmAdetattrayaM yatnAdupaseveta paRqitaH ॥45॥

text: guruṇā vairanirbandho na kartavyaḥ kadācana । anumānyaḥ prasādyaśca guruḥ kruddho yudhiṣṭhira ॥46॥
html:
guruṇā vairanirbandho na kartavyaḥ kadācana ।
anumānyaḥ prasādyaśca guruḥ kruddho yudhiṣṭhira ॥46॥
slp1: guruRA vEranirbanDo na kartavyaH kadAcana । anumAnyaH prasAdyaSca guruH krudDo yuDizWira ॥46॥

text: samyaṅmithyāpravṛtte'pi vartitavyaṃ gurāviha । gurunindā dahatyāyurmanuṣyāṇāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ॥47॥
html:
samyaṅmithyāpravṛtte'pi vartitavyaṃ gurāviha ।
gurunindā dahatyāyurmanuṣyāṇāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: samyaNmiTyApravftte'pi vartitavyaM gurAviha । gurunindA dahatyAyurmanuzyARAM na saMSayaH ॥47॥

text: dūrādāvasathānmūtraṃ dūrātpādāvasecanam । ucchiṣṭotsarjanaṃ caiva dūre kāryaṃ hitaiṣiṇā ॥48॥
html:
dūrādāvasathānmūtraṃ dūrātpādāvasecanam ।
ucchiṣṭotsarjanaṃ caiva dūre kāryaṃ hitaiṣiṇā ॥48॥
slp1: dUrAdAvasaTAnmUtraM dUrAtpAdAvasecanam । ucCizwotsarjanaM cEva dUre kAryaM hitEziRA ॥48॥

text: nātikalpaṃ nātisāyaṃ na ca madhyandine sthite । nājñātaiḥ saha gaccheta naiko na vṛṣalaiḥ saha ॥49॥
html:
nātikalpaṃ nātisāyaṃ na ca madhyandine sthite ।
nājñātaiḥ saha gaccheta naiko na vṛṣalaiḥ saha ॥49॥
slp1: nAtikalpaM nAtisAyaM na ca maDyandine sTite । nAjYAtEH saha gacCeta nEko na vfzalEH saha ॥49॥

text: panthā deyo brāhmaṇāya gobhyo rājabhya eva ca । vṛddhāya bhārataptāya garbhiṇyai durbalāya ca ॥50॥
html:
panthā deyo brāhmaṇāya gobhyo rājabhya eva ca ।
vṛddhāya bhārataptāya garbhiṇyai durbalāya ca ॥50॥
slp1: panTA deyo brAhmaRAya goByo rAjaBya eva ca । vfdDAya BArataptAya garBiRyE durbalAya ca ॥50॥

text: pradakṣiṇaṃ ca kurvīta parijñātānvanaspatīn । catuṣpathānprakurvīta sarvāneva pradakṣiṇān ॥51॥
html:
pradakṣiṇaṃ ca kurvīta parijñātānvanaspatīn ।
catuṣpathānprakurvīta sarvāneva pradakṣiṇān ॥51॥
slp1: pradakziRaM ca kurvIta parijYAtAnvanaspatIn । catuzpaTAnprakurvIta sarvAneva pradakziRAn ॥51॥

text: madhyandine niśākāle madhyarātre ca sarvadā । catuṣpathānna seveta ubhe sandhye tathaiva ca ॥52॥
html:
madhyandine niśākāle madhyarātre ca sarvadā ।
catuṣpathānna seveta ubhe sandhye tathaiva ca ॥52॥
slp1: maDyandine niSAkAle maDyarAtre ca sarvadA । catuzpaTAnna seveta uBe sanDye taTEva ca ॥52॥

text: upānahau ca vastraṃ ca dhṛtamanyairna dhārayet । brahmacārī ca nityaṃ syātpādaṃ pādena nākramet ॥53॥
html:
upānahau ca vastraṃ ca dhṛtamanyairna dhārayet ।
brahmacārī ca nityaṃ syātpādaṃ pādena nākramet ॥53॥
slp1: upAnahO ca vastraM ca DftamanyErna DArayet । brahmacArI ca nityaM syAtpAdaM pAdena nAkramet ॥53॥

text: amāvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ । aṣṭamyāṃ sarvapakṣāṇāṃ brahmacārī sadā bhavet ॥54॥
html:
amāvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ।
aṣṭamyāṃ sarvapakṣāṇāṃ brahmacārī sadā bhavet ॥54॥
slp1: amAvAsyAM pOrRamAsyAM caturdaSyAM ca sarvaSaH । azwamyAM sarvapakzARAM brahmacArI sadA Bavet ॥54॥

text: vṛthā māṃsaṃ na khādeta pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca । ākrośaṃ parivādaṃ ca paiśunyaṃ ca vivarjayet ॥55॥
html:
vṛthā māṃsaṃ na khādeta pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca ।
ākrośaṃ parivādaṃ ca paiśunyaṃ ca vivarjayet ॥55॥
