slp1: vfTA mAMsaM na KAdeta pfzWamAMsaM taTEva ca । AkroSaM parivAdaM ca pESunyaM ca vivarjayet ॥55॥

text: nāruntudaḥ syānna nṛśaṃsavādī na hīnataḥ paramabhyādadīta । yayāsya vācā para udvijeta na tāṃ vadedruśatīṃ pāpalokyām ॥56॥
html:
nāruntudaḥ syānna nṛśaṃsavādī na hīnataḥ paramabhyādadīta ।
yayāsya vācā para udvijeta na tāṃ vadedruśatīṃ pāpalokyām ॥56॥
slp1: nAruntudaH syAnna nfSaMsavAdI na hInataH paramaByAdadIta । yayAsya vAcA para udvijeta na tAM vadedruSatIM pApalokyAm ॥56॥

text: vāksāyakā vadanānniṣpatanti yairāhataḥ śocati rātryahāni । parasya nāmarmasu te patanti tānpaṇḍito nāvasṛjetpareṣu ॥57॥
html:
vāksāyakā vadanānniṣpatanti yairāhataḥ śocati rātryahāni ।
parasya nāmarmasu te patanti tānpaṇḍito nāvasṛjetpareṣu ॥57॥
slp1: vAksAyakA vadanAnnizpatanti yErAhataH Socati rAtryahAni । parasya nAmarmasu te patanti tAnpaRqito nAvasfjetparezu ॥57॥

text: rohate sāyakairviddhaṃ vanaṃ paraśunā hatam । vācā duruktaṃ bībhatsaṃ na saṃrohati vākkṣatam ॥58॥
html:
rohate sāyakairviddhaṃ vanaṃ paraśunā hatam ।
vācā duruktaṃ bībhatsaṃ na saṃrohati vākkṣatam ॥58॥
slp1: rohate sAyakErvidDaM vanaM paraSunA hatam । vAcA duruktaM bIBatsaM na saMrohati vAkkzatam ॥58॥

text: hīnāṅgānatiriktāṅgānvidyāhīnānvayodhikān । rūpadraviṇahīnāṃśca sattvahīnāṃśca nākṣipet ॥59॥
html:
hīnāṅgānatiriktāṅgānvidyāhīnānvayodhikān ।
rūpadraviṇahīnāṃśca sattvahīnāṃśca nākṣipet ॥59॥
slp1: hInANgAnatiriktANgAnvidyAhInAnvayoDikAn । rUpadraviRahInAMSca sattvahInAMSca nAkzipet ॥59॥

text: nāstikyaṃ vedanindāṃ ca devatānāṃ ca kutsanam । dveṣastambhābhimānāṃśca taikṣṇyaṃ ca parivarjayet ॥60॥
html:
nāstikyaṃ vedanindāṃ ca devatānāṃ ca kutsanam ।
dveṣastambhābhimānāṃśca taikṣṇyaṃ ca parivarjayet ॥60॥
slp1: nAstikyaM vedanindAM ca devatAnAM ca kutsanam । dvezastamBABimAnAMSca tEkzRyaM ca parivarjayet ॥60॥

text: parasya daṇḍaṃ nodyacchetkroddho nainaṃ nipātayet । anyatra putrācchiṣyādvā śikṣārthaṃ tāḍanaṃ smṛtam ॥61॥
html:
parasya daṇḍaṃ nodyacchetkroddho nainaṃ nipātayet ।
anyatra putrācchiṣyādvā śikṣārthaṃ tāḍanaṃ smṛtam ॥61॥
slp1: parasya daRqaM nodyacCetkrodDo nEnaM nipAtayet । anyatra putrAcCizyAdvA SikzArTaM tAqanaM smftam ॥61॥

text: na brāhmaṇānparivadennakṣatrāṇi na nirdiśet । tithiṃ pakṣasya na brūyāttathāsyāyurna riṣyate ॥62॥
html:
na brāhmaṇānparivadennakṣatrāṇi na nirdiśet ।
tithiṃ pakṣasya na brūyāttathāsyāyurna riṣyate ॥62॥
slp1: na brAhmaRAnparivadennakzatrARi na nirdiSet । tiTiM pakzasya na brUyAttaTAsyAyurna rizyate ॥62॥

text: kṛtvā mūtrapurīṣe tu rathyāmākramya vā punaḥ । pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuryātsvādhyāye bhojane tathā ॥63॥
html:
kṛtvā mūtrapurīṣe tu rathyāmākramya vā punaḥ ।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuryātsvādhyāye bhojane tathā ॥63॥
slp1: kftvA mUtrapurIze tu raTyAmAkramya vA punaH । pAdaprakzAlanaM kuryAtsvADyAye Bojane taTA ॥63॥

text: trīṇi devāḥ pavitrāṇi brāhmaṇānāmakalpayan । adṛṣṭamadbhirnirṇiktaṃ yacca vācā praśasyate ॥64॥
html:
trīṇi devāḥ pavitrāṇi brāhmaṇānāmakalpayan ।
adṛṣṭamadbhirnirṇiktaṃ yacca vācā praśasyate ॥64॥
slp1: trIRi devAH pavitrARi brAhmaRAnAmakalpayan । adfzwamadBirnirRiktaM yacca vAcA praSasyate ॥64॥

text: saṃyāvaṃ kṛsaraṃ māṃsaṃ śaṣkulī pāyasaṃ tathā । ātmārthaṃ na prakartavyaṃ devārthaṃ tu prakalpayet ॥65॥
html:
saṃyāvaṃ kṛsaraṃ māṃsaṃ śaṣkulī pāyasaṃ tathā ।
ātmārthaṃ na prakartavyaṃ devārthaṃ tu prakalpayet ॥65॥
slp1: saMyAvaM kfsaraM mAMsaM SazkulI pAyasaM taTA । AtmArTaM na prakartavyaM devArTaM tu prakalpayet ॥65॥

text: nityamagniṃ paricaredbhikṣāṃ dadyācca nityadā । vāgyato dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca nityameva samācaret । na cābhyuditaśāyī syātprāyaścittī tathā bhavet ॥66॥
html:
nityamagniṃ paricaredbhikṣāṃ dadyācca nityadā ।
vāgyato dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca nityameva samācaret ।
na cābhyuditaśāyī syātprāyaścittī tathā bhavet ॥66॥
slp1: nityamagniM paricaredBikzAM dadyAcca nityadA । vAgyato dantakAzWaM ca nityameva samAcaret । na cAByuditaSAyI syAtprAyaScittI taTA Bavet ॥66॥

text: mātāpitaramutthāya pūrvamevābhivādayet । ācāryamatha vāpyenaṃ tathāyurvindate mahat ॥67॥
html:
mātāpitaramutthāya pūrvamevābhivādayet ।
ācāryamatha vāpyenaṃ tathāyurvindate mahat ॥67॥
slp1: mAtApitaramutTAya pUrvamevABivAdayet । AcAryamaTa vApyenaM taTAyurvindate mahat ॥67॥

text: varjayeddantakāṣṭhāni varjanīyāni nityaśaḥ । bhakṣayecchāstradṛṣṭāni parvasvapi ca varjayet ॥68॥
html:
varjayeddantakāṣṭhāni varjanīyāni nityaśaḥ ।
bhakṣayecchāstradṛṣṭāni parvasvapi ca varjayet ॥68॥
slp1: varjayeddantakAzWAni varjanIyAni nityaSaH । BakzayecCAstradfzwAni parvasvapi ca varjayet ॥68॥

text: udaṅmukhaśca satataṃ śaucaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ ॥69॥
html: udaṅmukhaśca satataṃ śaucaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ ॥69॥
slp1: udaNmuKaSca satataM SOcaM kuryAtsamAhitaH ॥69॥

text: akṛtvā devatāpūjāṃ nānyaṃ gacchetkadācana । anyatra tu guruṃ vṛddhaṃ dhārmikaṃ vā vicakṣaṇam ॥70॥
html:
akṛtvā devatāpūjāṃ nānyaṃ gacchetkadācana ।
anyatra tu guruṃ vṛddhaṃ dhārmikaṃ vā vicakṣaṇam ॥70॥
slp1: akftvA devatApUjAM nAnyaM gacCetkadAcana । anyatra tu guruM vfdDaM DArmikaM vA vicakzaRam ॥70॥

text: avalokyo na cādarśo malino buddhimattaraiḥ । na cājñātāṃ striyaṃ gacchedgarbhiṇīṃ vā kadācana ॥71॥
html:
avalokyo na cādarśo malino buddhimattaraiḥ ।
na cājñātāṃ striyaṃ gacchedgarbhiṇīṃ vā kadācana ॥71॥
slp1: avalokyo na cAdarSo malino budDimattarEH । na cAjYAtAM striyaM gacCedgarBiRIM vA kadAcana ॥71॥

text: udakśirā na svapeta tathā pratyakśirā na ca । prākśirāstu svapedvidvānatha vā dakṣiṇāśirāḥ ॥72॥
html:
udakśirā na svapeta tathā pratyakśirā na ca ।
prākśirāstu svapedvidvānatha vā dakṣiṇāśirāḥ ॥72॥
slp1: udakSirA na svapeta taTA pratyakSirA na ca । prAkSirAstu svapedvidvAnaTa vA dakziRASirAH ॥72॥

text: na bhagne nāvadīrṇe vā śayane prasvapeta ca । nāntardhāne na saṃyukte na ca tiryakkadācana ॥73॥
html:
na bhagne nāvadīrṇe vā śayane prasvapeta ca ।
nāntardhāne na saṃyukte na ca tiryakkadācana ॥73॥
slp1: na Bagne nAvadIrRe vA Sayane prasvapeta ca । nAntarDAne na saMyukte na ca tiryakkadAcana ॥73॥

text: na nagnaḥ karhicitsnāyānna niśāyāṃ kadācana । snātvā ca nāvamṛjyeta gātrāṇi suvicakṣaṇaḥ ॥74॥
html:
na nagnaḥ karhicitsnāyānna niśāyāṃ kadācana ।
snātvā ca nāvamṛjyeta gātrāṇi suvicakṣaṇaḥ ॥74॥
slp1: na nagnaH karhicitsnAyAnna niSAyAM kadAcana । snAtvA ca nAvamfjyeta gAtrARi suvicakzaRaH ॥74॥

text: na cānulimpedasnātvā snātvā vāso na nirdhunet । ārdra eva tu vāsāṃsi nityaṃ seveta mānavaḥ । srajaśca nāvakarṣeta na bahirdhārayeta ca ॥75॥
html:
na cānulimpedasnātvā snātvā vāso na nirdhunet ।
ārdra eva tu vāsāṃsi nityaṃ seveta mānavaḥ ।
srajaśca nāvakarṣeta na bahirdhārayeta ca ॥75॥
slp1: na cAnulimpedasnAtvA snAtvA vAso na nirDunet । Ardra eva tu vAsAMsi nityaM seveta mAnavaH । srajaSca nAvakarzeta na bahirDArayeta ca ॥75॥

text: raktamālyaṃ na dhāryaṃ syācchuklaṃ dhāryaṃ tu paṇḍitaiḥ । varjayitvā tu kamalaṃ tathā kuvalayaṃ vibho ॥76॥
html:
raktamālyaṃ na dhāryaṃ syācchuklaṃ dhāryaṃ tu paṇḍitaiḥ ।
varjayitvā tu kamalaṃ tathā kuvalayaṃ vibho ॥76॥
slp1: raktamAlyaM na DAryaM syAcCuklaM DAryaM tu paRqitEH । varjayitvA tu kamalaM taTA kuvalayaM viBo ॥76॥

text: raktaṃ śirasi dhāryaṃ tu tathā vāneyamityapi । kāñcanī caiva yā mālā na sā duṣyati karhicit । snātasya varṇakaṃ nityamārdraṃ dadyādviśāṃ pate ॥77॥
html:
raktaṃ śirasi dhāryaṃ tu tathā vāneyamityapi ।
kāñcanī caiva yā mālā na sā duṣyati karhicit ।
snātasya varṇakaṃ nityamārdraṃ dadyādviśāṃ pate ॥77॥
slp1: raktaM Sirasi DAryaM tu taTA vAneyamityapi । kAYcanI cEva yA mAlA na sA duzyati karhicit । snAtasya varRakaM nityamArdraM dadyAdviSAM pate ॥77॥

text: viparyayaṃ na kurvīta vāsaso buddhimānnaraḥ । tathā nānyadhṛtaṃ dhāryaṃ na cāpadaśameva ca ॥78॥
html:
viparyayaṃ na kurvīta vāsaso buddhimānnaraḥ ।
tathā nānyadhṛtaṃ dhāryaṃ na cāpadaśameva ca ॥78॥
slp1: viparyayaM na kurvIta vAsaso budDimAnnaraH । taTA nAnyaDftaM DAryaM na cApadaSameva ca ॥78॥

text: anyadeva bhavedvāsaḥ śayanīye narottama । anyadrathyāsu devānāmarcāyāmanyadeva hi ॥79॥
html:
anyadeva bhavedvāsaḥ śayanīye narottama ।
anyadrathyāsu devānāmarcāyāmanyadeva hi ॥79॥
slp1: anyadeva BavedvAsaH SayanIye narottama । anyadraTyAsu devAnAmarcAyAmanyadeva hi ॥79॥

text: priyaṅgucandanābhyāṃ ca bilvena tagareṇa ca । pṛthagevānulimpeta kesareṇa ca buddhimān ॥80॥
html:
priyaṅgucandanābhyāṃ ca bilvena tagareṇa ca ।
pṛthagevānulimpeta kesareṇa ca buddhimān ॥80॥
slp1: priyaNgucandanAByAM ca bilvena tagareRa ca । pfTagevAnulimpeta kesareRa ca budDimAn ॥80॥

text: upavāsaṃ ca kurvīta snātaḥ śuciralaṅkṛtaḥ । parvakāleṣu sarveṣu brahmacārī sadā bhavet ॥81॥
html:
upavāsaṃ ca kurvīta snātaḥ śuciralaṅkṛtaḥ ।
parvakāleṣu sarveṣu brahmacārī sadā bhavet ॥81॥
slp1: upavAsaM ca kurvIta snAtaH SuciralaNkftaH । parvakAlezu sarvezu brahmacArI sadA Bavet ॥81॥

text: nālīḍhayā parihataṃ bhakṣayīta kadācana । tathā noddhṛtasārāṇi prekṣatāṃ nāpradāya ca ॥82॥
html:
nālīḍhayā parihataṃ bhakṣayīta kadācana ।
tathā noddhṛtasārāṇi prekṣatāṃ nāpradāya ca ॥82॥
slp1: nAlIQayA parihataM BakzayIta kadAcana । taTA nodDftasArARi prekzatAM nApradAya ca ॥82॥

text: na sannikṛṣṭo medhāvī nāśucirna ca satsu ca । pratiṣiddhānna dharmeṣu bhakṣānbhuñjīta pṛṣṭhataḥ ॥83॥
html:
na sannikṛṣṭo medhāvī nāśucirna ca satsu ca ।
pratiṣiddhānna dharmeṣu bhakṣānbhuñjīta pṛṣṭhataḥ ॥83॥
slp1: na sannikfzwo meDAvI nASucirna ca satsu ca । pratizidDAnna Darmezu BakzAnBuYjIta pfzWataH ॥83॥

text: pippalaṃ ca vaṭaṃ caiva śaṇaśākaṃ tathaiva ca । udumbaraṃ na khādecca bhavārthī puruṣottamaḥ ॥84॥
html:
pippalaṃ ca vaṭaṃ caiva śaṇaśākaṃ tathaiva ca ।
udumbaraṃ na khādecca bhavārthī puruṣottamaḥ ॥84॥
slp1: pippalaM ca vawaM cEva SaRaSAkaM taTEva ca । udumbaraM na KAdecca BavArTI puruzottamaH ॥84॥

text: ājaṃ gavyaṃ ca yanmāṃsaṃ māyūraṃ caiva varjayet । varjayecchuṣkamāṃsaṃ ca tathā paryuṣitaṃ ca yat ॥85॥
html:
ājaṃ gavyaṃ ca yanmāṃsaṃ māyūraṃ caiva varjayet ।
varjayecchuṣkamāṃsaṃ ca tathā paryuṣitaṃ ca yat ॥85॥
slp1: AjaM gavyaM ca yanmAMsaM mAyUraM cEva varjayet । varjayecCuzkamAMsaM ca taTA paryuzitaM ca yat ॥85॥

text: na pāṇau lavaṇaṃ vidvānprāśnīyānna ca rātriṣu । dadhisaktūnna bhuñjīta vṛthāmāṃsaṃ ca varjayet ॥86॥
html:
na pāṇau lavaṇaṃ vidvānprāśnīyānna ca rātriṣu ।
dadhisaktūnna bhuñjīta vṛthāmāṃsaṃ ca varjayet ॥86॥
slp1: na pARO lavaRaM vidvAnprASnIyAnna ca rAtrizu । daDisaktUnna BuYjIta vfTAmAMsaM ca varjayet ॥86॥

text: vālena tu na bhuñjīta paraśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca । sāyaṃ prātaśca bhuñjīta nāntarāle samāhitaḥ ॥87॥
html:
vālena tu na bhuñjīta paraśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca ।
sāyaṃ prātaśca bhuñjīta nāntarāle samāhitaḥ ॥87॥
slp1: vAlena tu na BuYjIta paraSrAdDaM taTEva ca । sAyaM prAtaSca BuYjIta nAntarAle samAhitaH ॥87॥

text: vāgyato naikavastraśca nāsaṃviṣṭaḥ kadācana । bhūmau sadaiva nāśnīyānnānāsīno na śabdavat ॥88॥
html:
vāgyato naikavastraśca nāsaṃviṣṭaḥ kadācana ।
bhūmau sadaiva nāśnīyānnānāsīno na śabdavat ॥88॥
slp1: vAgyato nEkavastraSca nAsaMvizwaH kadAcana । BUmO sadEva nASnIyAnnAnAsIno na Sabdavat ॥88॥

text: toyapūrvaṃ pradāyānnamatithibhyo viśāṃ pate । paścādbhuñjīta medhāvī na cāpyanyamanā naraḥ ॥89॥
html:
toyapūrvaṃ pradāyānnamatithibhyo viśāṃ pate ।
paścādbhuñjīta medhāvī na cāpyanyamanā naraḥ ॥89॥
slp1: toyapUrvaM pradAyAnnamatiTiByo viSAM pate । paScAdBuYjIta meDAvI na cApyanyamanA naraH ॥89॥

text: samānamekapaṅktyāṃ tu bhojyamannaṃ nareśvara । viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ bhuṅkte yo'pradāya suhṛjjane ॥90॥
html:
samānamekapaṅktyāṃ tu bhojyamannaṃ nareśvara ।
viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ bhuṅkte yo'pradāya suhṛjjane ॥90॥
slp1: samAnamekapaNktyAM tu BojyamannaM nareSvara । vizaM hAlAhalaM BuNkte yo'pradAya suhfjjane ॥90॥

text: pānīyaṃ pāyasaṃ sarpirdadhisaktumadhūnyapi । nirasya śeṣameteṣāṃ na pradeyaṃ tu kasyacit ॥91॥
html:
pānīyaṃ pāyasaṃ sarpirdadhisaktumadhūnyapi ।
nirasya śeṣameteṣāṃ na pradeyaṃ tu kasyacit ॥91॥
slp1: pAnIyaM pAyasaM sarpirdaDisaktumaDUnyapi । nirasya SezametezAM na pradeyaM tu kasyacit ॥91॥

text: bhuñjāno manujavyāghra naiva śaṅkāṃ samācaret । dadhi cāpyanupānaṃ vai na kartavyaṃ bhavārthinā ॥92॥
html:
bhuñjāno manujavyāghra naiva śaṅkāṃ samācaret ।
dadhi cāpyanupānaṃ vai na kartavyaṃ bhavārthinā ॥92॥
slp1: BuYjAno manujavyAGra nEva SaNkAM samAcaret । daDi cApyanupAnaM vE na kartavyaM BavArTinA ॥92॥

text: ācamya caiva hastena parisrāvya tathodakam । aṅguṣṭhaṃ caraṇasyātha dakṣiṇasyāvasecayet ॥93॥
html:
ācamya caiva hastena parisrāvya tathodakam ।
aṅguṣṭhaṃ caraṇasyātha dakṣiṇasyāvasecayet ॥93॥
slp1: Acamya cEva hastena parisrAvya taTodakam । aNguzWaM caraRasyATa dakziRasyAvasecayet ॥93॥

text: pāṇiṃ mūrdhni samādhāya spṛṣṭvā cāgniṃ samāhitaḥ । jñātiśraiṣṭhyamavāpnoti prayogakuśalo naraḥ ॥94॥
html:
pāṇiṃ mūrdhni samādhāya spṛṣṭvā cāgniṃ samāhitaḥ ।
jñātiśraiṣṭhyamavāpnoti prayogakuśalo naraḥ ॥94॥
slp1: pARiM mUrDni samADAya spfzwvA cAgniM samAhitaH । jYAtiSrEzWyamavApnoti prayogakuSalo naraH ॥94॥

text: adbhiḥ prāṇānsamālabhya nābhiṃ pāṇitalena ca । spṛśaṃścaiva pratiṣṭheta na cāpyārdreṇa pāṇinā ॥95॥
html:
adbhiḥ prāṇānsamālabhya nābhiṃ pāṇitalena ca ।
spṛśaṃścaiva pratiṣṭheta na cāpyārdreṇa pāṇinā ॥95॥
slp1: adBiH prARAnsamAlaBya nABiM pARitalena ca । spfSaMScEva pratizWeta na cApyArdreRa pARinA ॥95॥

text: aṅguṣṭhasyāntarāle ca brāhmaṃ tīrthamudāhṛtam । kaniṣṭhikāyāḥ paścāttu devatīrthamihocyate ॥96॥
html:
aṅguṣṭhasyāntarāle ca brāhmaṃ tīrthamudāhṛtam ।
kaniṣṭhikāyāḥ paścāttu devatīrthamihocyate ॥96॥
slp1: aNguzWasyAntarAle ca brAhmaM tIrTamudAhftam । kanizWikAyAH paScAttu devatIrTamihocyate ॥96॥

text: aṅguṣṭhasya ca yanmadhyaṃ pradeśinyāśca bhārata । tena pitryāṇi kurvīta spṛṣṭvāpo nyāyatastathā ॥97॥
html:
aṅguṣṭhasya ca yanmadhyaṃ pradeśinyāśca bhārata ।
tena pitryāṇi kurvīta spṛṣṭvāpo nyāyatastathā ॥97॥
slp1: aNguzWasya ca yanmaDyaM pradeSinyASca BArata । tena pitryARi kurvIta spfzwvApo nyAyatastaTA ॥97॥

text: parāpavādaṃ na brūyānnāpriyaṃ ca kadācana । na manyuḥ kaścidutpādyaḥ puruṣeṇa bhavārthinā ॥98॥
html:
parāpavādaṃ na brūyānnāpriyaṃ ca kadācana ।
na manyuḥ kaścidutpādyaḥ puruṣeṇa bhavārthinā ॥98॥
slp1: parApavAdaM na brUyAnnApriyaM ca kadAcana । na manyuH kaScidutpAdyaH puruzeRa BavArTinA ॥98॥

text: patitaistu kathāṃ neccheddarśanaṃ cāpi varjayet । saṃsargaṃ ca na gaccheta tathāyurvindate mahat ॥99॥
html:
patitaistu kathāṃ neccheddarśanaṃ cāpi varjayet ।
saṃsargaṃ ca na gaccheta tathāyurvindate mahat ॥99॥
slp1: patitEstu kaTAM necCeddarSanaM cApi varjayet । saMsargaM ca na gacCeta taTAyurvindate mahat ॥99॥

text: na divā maithunaṃ gacchenna kanyāṃ na ca bandhakīm । na cāsnātāṃ striyaṃ gacchettathāyurvindate mahat ॥100॥
html:
na divā maithunaṃ gacchenna kanyāṃ na ca bandhakīm ।
na cāsnātāṃ striyaṃ gacchettathāyurvindate mahat ॥100॥
slp1: na divA mETunaM gacCenna kanyAM na ca banDakIm । na cAsnAtAM striyaM gacCettaTAyurvindate mahat ॥100॥

text: sve sve tīrthe samācamya kārye samupakalpite । triḥ pītvāpo dviḥ pramṛjya kṛtaśauco bhavennaraḥ ॥101॥
html:
sve sve tīrthe samācamya kārye samupakalpite ।

slp1: sve sve tIrTe samAcamya kArye samupakalpite । triH pItvApo dviH pramfjya kftaSOco BavennaraH ॥101॥

text: indriyāṇi sakṛtspṛśya trirabhyukṣya ca mānavaḥ । kurvīta pitryaṃ daivaṃ ca vedadṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥102॥
html:

slp1: indriyARi sakftspfSya triraByukzya ca mAnavaH । kurvIta pitryaM dEvaM ca vedadfzwena karmaRA ॥102॥

text: brāhmaṇārthe ca yacchaucaṃ tacca me śṛṇu kaurava । pravṛttaṃ ca hitaṃ coktvā bhojanādyantayostathā ॥103॥
html:
brāhmaṇārthe ca yacchaucaṃ tacca me śṛṇu kaurava ।

slp1: brAhmaRArTe ca yacCOcaM tacca me SfRu kOrava । pravfttaM ca hitaM coktvA BojanAdyantayostaTA ॥103॥

slp1: sarvaSOcezu brAhmeRa tIrTena samupaspfSet । nizWIvya tu taTA kzutvA spfSyApo hi SucirBavet ॥104॥

slp1: gfhe pArAvatA DanyAH SukASca sahasArikAH । gfhezvete na pApAya taTA vE tElapAyikAH ॥106॥

text: uddīpakāśca gṛdhrāśca kapotā bhramarāstathā । niviśeyuryadā tatra śāntimeva tadācaret ॥107॥

text: amaṅgalyāni caitāni tathākrośo mahātmanām । mahātmanāṃ ca guhyāni na vaktavyāni karhicit ॥108॥
html:

slp1: amaNgalyAni cEtAni taTAkroSo mahAtmanAm । mahAtmanAM ca guhyAni na vaktavyAni karhicit ॥108॥

html:

slp1: agamyASca na gacCeta rAjapatnIH saKIstaTA । vEdyAnAM bAlavfdDAnAM BftyAnAM ca yuDizWira ॥109॥

bandhūnāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tathā śāraṇikasya ca ।

slp1: banDUnAM brAhmaRAnAM ca taTA SAraRikasya ca । sambanDinAM ca rAjendra taTAyurvindate mahat ॥110॥

text: brāhmaṇasthapatibhyāṃ ca nirmitaṃ yanniveśanam । tadāvasetsadā prājño bhavārthī manujeśvara ॥111॥
html:
brāhmaṇasthapatibhyāṃ ca nirmitaṃ yanniveśanam ।

slp1: brAhmaRasTapatiByAM ca nirmitaM yanniveSanam । tadAvasetsadA prAjYo BavArTI manujeSvara ॥111॥

text: sandhyāyāṃ na svapedrājanvidyāṃ na ca samācaret । na bhuñjīta ca medhāvī tathāyurvindate mahat ॥112॥
html:
sandhyāyāṃ na svapedrājanvidyāṃ na ca samācaret ।

slp1: sanDyAyAM na svapedrAjanvidyAM na ca samAcaret । na BuYjIta ca meDAvI taTAyurvindate mahat ॥112॥

text: naktaṃ na kuryātpitryāṇi bhuktvā caiva prasādhanam । pānīyasya kriyā naktaṃ na kāryā bhūtimicchatā ॥113॥
html:
naktaṃ na kuryātpitryāṇi bhuktvā caiva prasādhanam ।
pānīyasya kriyā naktaṃ na kāryā bhūtimicchatā ॥113॥
slp1: naktaM na kuryAtpitryARi BuktvA cEva prasADanam । pAnIyasya kriyA naktaM na kAryA BUtimicCatA ॥113॥

text: varjanīyāśca vai nityaṃ saktavo niśi bhārata । śeṣāṇi cāvadātāni pānīyaṃ caiva bhojane ॥114॥
html:
varjanīyāśca vai nityaṃ saktavo niśi bhārata ।
śeṣāṇi cāvadātāni pānīyaṃ caiva bhojane ॥114॥
slp1: varjanIyASca vE nityaM saktavo niSi BArata । SezARi cAvadAtAni pAnIyaM cEva Bojane ॥114॥

text: sauhityaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ rātrau naiva samācaret । dvijacchedaṃ na kurvīta bhuktvā na ca samācaret ॥115॥
html:
sauhityaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ rātrau naiva samācaret ।
dvijacchedaṃ na kurvīta bhuktvā na ca samācaret ॥115॥
slp1: sOhityaM ca na kartavyaM rAtrO nEva samAcaret । dvijacCedaM na kurvIta BuktvA na ca samAcaret ॥115॥

text: mahākulaprasūtāṃ ca praśastāṃ lakṣaṇaistathā । vayaḥsthāṃ ca mahāprājña kanyāmāvoḍhumarhati ॥116॥
html:
mahākulaprasūtāṃ ca praśastāṃ lakṣaṇaistathā ।
vayaḥsthāṃ ca mahāprājña kanyāmāvoḍhumarhati ॥116॥
slp1: mahAkulaprasUtAM ca praSastAM lakzaREstaTA । vayaHsTAM ca mahAprAjYa kanyAmAvoQumarhati ॥116॥

text: apatyamutpādya tataḥ pratiṣṭhāpya kulaṃ tathā । putrāḥ pradeyā jñāneṣu kuladharmeṣu bhārata ॥117॥
html:
apatyamutpādya tataḥ pratiṣṭhāpya kulaṃ tathā ।
putrāḥ pradeyā jñāneṣu kuladharmeṣu bhārata ॥117॥
slp1: apatyamutpAdya tataH pratizWApya kulaM taTA । putrAH pradeyA jYAnezu kulaDarmezu BArata ॥117॥

text: kanyā cotpādya dātavyā kulaputrāya dhīmate । putrā niveśyāśca kulādbhṛtyā labhyāśca bhārata ॥118॥
html:
kanyā cotpādya dātavyā kulaputrāya dhīmate ।

text: śiraḥsnāto'tha kurvīta daivaṃ pitryamathāpi ca । nakṣatre na ca kurvīta yasmiñjāto bhavennaraḥ । na proṣṭhapadayoḥ kāryaṃ tathāgneye ca bhārata ॥119॥
html:
śiraḥsnāto'tha kurvīta daivaṃ pitryamathāpi ca ।
nakṣatre na ca kurvīta yasmiñjāto bhavennaraḥ ।
na proṣṭhapadayoḥ kāryaṃ tathāgneye ca bhārata ॥119॥
slp1: SiraHsnAto'Ta kurvIta dEvaM pitryamaTApi ca । nakzatre na ca kurvIta yasmiYjAto BavennaraH । na prozWapadayoH kAryaM taTAgneye ca BArata ॥119॥

text: dāruṇeṣu ca sarveṣu pratyahaṃ ca vivarjayet । jyotiṣe yāni coktāni tāni sarvāṇi varjayet ॥120॥
html:
dāruṇeṣu ca sarveṣu pratyahaṃ ca vivarjayet ।
jyotiṣe yāni coktāni tāni sarvāṇi varjayet ॥120॥
slp1: dAruRezu ca sarvezu pratyahaM ca vivarjayet । jyotize yAni coktAni tAni sarvARi varjayet ॥120॥

text: prāṅmukhaḥ śmaśrukarmāṇi kārayeta samāhitaḥ । udaṅmukho vā rājendra tathāyurvindate mahat ॥121॥
html:
prāṅmukhaḥ śmaśrukarmāṇi kārayeta samāhitaḥ ।
udaṅmukho vā rājendra tathāyurvindate mahat ॥121॥
slp1: prANmuKaH SmaSrukarmARi kArayeta samAhitaH । udaNmuKo vA rAjendra taTAyurvindate mahat ॥121॥

text: parivādaṃ na ca brūyātpareṣāmātmanastathā । parivādo na dharmāya procyate bharatarṣabha ॥122॥

text: varjayedvyaṅginīṃ nārīṃ tathā kanyāṃ narottama । samārṣāṃ vyaṅgitāṃ caiva mātuḥ svakulajāṃ tathā ॥123॥
html:

text: vṛddhāṃ pravrajitāṃ caiva tathaiva ca pativratām । tathātikṛṣṇavarṇāṃ ca varṇotkṛṣṭāṃ ca varjayet ॥124॥

text: ayoniṃ ca viyoniṃ ca na gaccheta vicakṣaṇaḥ । piṅgalāṃ kuṣṭhinīṃ nārīṃ na tvamāvoḍhumarhasi ॥125॥

text: apasmārikule jātāṃ nihīnāṃ caiva varjayet । śvitriṇāṃ ca kule jātāṃ trayāṇāṃ manujeśvara ॥126॥

text: agnīnutpādya yatnena kriyāḥ suvihitāśca yāḥ । vedeṣu brāhmaṇaiḥ proktāstāśca sarvāḥ samācaret ॥129॥

text: na cerṣyā strīṣu kartavyā dārā rakṣyāśca sarvaśaḥ । anāyuṣyā bhavedīrṣyā tasmādīrṣyāṃ vivarjayet ॥130॥

slp1: na cerzyA strIzu kartavyA dArA rakzyASca sarvaSaH । anAyuzyA BavedIrzyA tasmAdIrzyAM vivarjayet ॥130॥

html:

slp1: na cEkena parivrAjyaM na gantavyaM taTA niSi । anAgatAyAM sanDyAyAM paScimAyAM gfhe vaset ॥136॥

slp1: mAtuH piturgurURAM ca kAryamevAnuSAsanam । hitaM vApyahitaM vApi na vicAryaM nararzaBa ॥137॥

html:

html:

html:

slp1: purARamitihAsASca taTAKyAnAni yAni ca । mahAtmanAM ca caritaM SrotavyaM nityameva te ॥141॥

text: patnīṃ rajasvalāṃ caiva nābhigacchenna cāhvayet । snātāṃ caturthe divase rātrau gacchedvicakṣaṇaḥ ॥142॥
html:

slp1: patnIM rajasvalAM cEva nABigacCenna cAhvayet । snAtAM caturTe divase rAtrO gacCedvicakzaRaH ॥142॥

text: pañcame divase nārī ṣaṣṭhe'hani pumānbhavet । etena vidhinā patnīmupagaccheta paṇḍitaḥ ॥143॥
html:
pañcame divase nārī ṣaṣṭhe'hani pumānbhavet ।
etena vidhinā patnīmupagaccheta paṇḍitaḥ ॥143॥
slp1: paYcame divase nArI zazWe'hani pumAnBavet । etena viDinA patnImupagacCeta paRqitaH ॥143॥

text: jñātisambandhimitrāṇi pūjanīyāni nityaśaḥ । yaṣṭavyaṃ ca yathāśakti yajñairvividhadakṣiṇaiḥ । ataūrdhvamaraṇyaṃ ca sevitavyaṃ narādhipa ॥144॥
html:
jñātisambandhimitrāṇi pūjanīyāni nityaśaḥ ।
yaṣṭavyaṃ ca yathāśakti yajñairvividhadakṣiṇaiḥ ।
ataūrdhvamaraṇyaṃ ca sevitavyaṃ narādhipa ॥144॥
slp1: jYAtisambanDimitrARi pUjanIyAni nityaSaH । yazwavyaM ca yaTASakti yajYErviviDadakziREH । ataUrDvamaraRyaM ca sevitavyaM narADipa ॥144॥

text: eṣa te lakṣaṇoddeśa āyuṣyāṇāṃ prakīrtitaḥ । śeṣastraividyavṛddhebhyaḥ pratyāhāryo yudhiṣṭhira ॥145॥
html:
eṣa te lakṣaṇoddeśa āyuṣyāṇāṃ prakīrtitaḥ ।
śeṣastraividyavṛddhebhyaḥ pratyāhāryo yudhiṣṭhira ॥145॥
slp1: eza te lakzaRoddeSa AyuzyARAM prakIrtitaH । SezastrEvidyavfdDeByaH pratyAhAryo yuDizWira ॥145॥

text: ācāro bhūtijanana ācāraḥ kīrtivardhanaḥ । ācārādvardhate hyāyurācāro hantyalakṣaṇam ॥146॥
html:
ācāro bhūtijanana ācāraḥ kīrtivardhanaḥ ।
ācārādvardhate hyāyurācāro hantyalakṣaṇam ॥146॥
slp1: AcAro BUtijanana AcAraH kIrtivarDanaH । AcArAdvarDate hyAyurAcAro hantyalakzaRam ॥146॥

text: āgamānāṃ hi sarveṣāmācāraḥ śreṣṭha ucyate । ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmādāyurvivardhate ॥147॥
html:
āgamānāṃ hi sarveṣāmācāraḥ śreṣṭha ucyate ।
ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmādāyurvivardhate ॥147॥
slp1: AgamAnAM hi sarvezAmAcAraH SrezWa ucyate । AcArapraBavo Darmo DarmAdAyurvivarDate ॥147॥

text: etadyaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat । anukampatā sarvavarṇānbrahmaṇā samudāhṛtam] ॥148॥
html:
etadyaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat ।
anukampatā sarvavarṇānbrahmaṇā samudāhṛtam] ॥148॥
slp1: etadyaSasyamAyuzyaM svargyaM svastyayanaM mahat । anukampatA sarvavarRAnbrahmaRA samudAhftam] ॥148॥

text: yathā jyeṣṭhaḥ kaniṣṭheṣu vartate bharatarṣabha । kaniṣṭhāśca yathā jyeṣṭhe varteraṃstadbravīhi me ॥1॥
html:
yathā jyeṣṭhaḥ kaniṣṭheṣu vartate bharatarṣabha ।
kaniṣṭhāśca yathā jyeṣṭhe varteraṃstadbravīhi me ॥1॥
slp1: yaTA jyezWaH kanizWezu vartate BaratarzaBa । kanizWASca yaTA jyezWe varteraMstadbravIhi me ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: jyeṣṭhavattāta vartasva jyeṣṭho hi satataṃ bhavān । gurorgarīyasī vṛttiryā cecchiṣyasya bhārata ॥2॥
html:
jyeṣṭhavattāta vartasva jyeṣṭho hi satataṃ bhavān ।
gurorgarīyasī vṛttiryā cecchiṣyasya bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: jyezWavattAta vartasva jyezWo hi satataM BavAn । gurorgarIyasI vfttiryA cecCizyasya BArata ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: na gurāvakṛtaprajñe śakyaṃ śiṣyeṇa vartitum । gurorhi dīrghadarśitvaṃ yattacchiṣyasya bhārata ॥3॥
html:
na gurāvakṛtaprajñe śakyaṃ śiṣyeṇa vartitum ।
gurorhi dīrghadarśitvaṃ yattacchiṣyasya bhārata ॥3॥
slp1: na gurAvakftaprajYe SakyaM SizyeRa vartitum । gurorhi dIrGadarSitvaM yattacCizyasya BArata ॥3॥

text: andhaḥ syādandhavelāyāṃ jaḍaḥ syādapi vā budhaḥ । parihāreṇa tadbrūyādyasteṣāṃ syādvyatikramaḥ ॥4॥
html:
andhaḥ syādandhavelāyāṃ jaḍaḥ syādapi vā budhaḥ ।
parihāreṇa tadbrūyādyasteṣāṃ syādvyatikramaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: anDaH syAdanDavelAyAM jaqaH syAdapi vA buDaH । parihAreRa tadbrUyAdyastezAM syAdvyatikramaH ॥4॥

text: pratyakṣaṃ bhinnahṛdayā bhedayeyuḥ kṛtaṃ narāḥ । śriyābhitaptāḥ kaunteya bhedakāmāstathārayaḥ ॥5॥
html:
pratyakṣaṃ bhinnahṛdayā bhedayeyuḥ kṛtaṃ narāḥ ।
śriyābhitaptāḥ kaunteya bhedakāmāstathārayaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: pratyakzaM BinnahfdayA BedayeyuH kftaM narAH । SriyABitaptAH kOnteya BedakAmAstaTArayaH ॥5॥

text: jyeṣṭhaḥ kulaṃ vardhayati vināśayati vā punaḥ । hanti sarvamapi jyeṣṭhaḥ kulaṃ yatrāvajāyate ॥6॥
html:
jyeṣṭhaḥ kulaṃ vardhayati vināśayati vā punaḥ ।
hanti sarvamapi jyeṣṭhaḥ kulaṃ yatrāvajāyate ॥6॥
slp1: jyezWaH kulaM varDayati vinASayati vA punaH । hanti sarvamapi jyezWaH kulaM yatrAvajAyate ॥6॥

text: atha yo vinikurvīta jyeṣṭho bhrātā yavīyasaḥ । ajyeṣṭhaḥ syādabhāgaśca niyamyo rājabhiśca saḥ ॥7॥
html:
atha yo vinikurvīta jyeṣṭho bhrātā yavīyasaḥ ।
ajyeṣṭhaḥ syādabhāgaśca niyamyo rājabhiśca saḥ ॥7॥
slp1: aTa yo vinikurvIta jyezWo BrAtA yavIyasaH । ajyezWaH syAdaBAgaSca niyamyo rAjaBiSca saH ॥7॥

text: nikṛtī hi naro lokānpāpāngacchatyasaṃśayam । vidulasyeva tatpuṣpaṃ moghaṃ janayituḥ smṛtam ॥8॥
html:
nikṛtī hi naro lokānpāpāngacchatyasaṃśayam ।
vidulasyeva tatpuṣpaṃ moghaṃ janayituḥ smṛtam ॥8॥
slp1: nikftI hi naro lokAnpApAngacCatyasaMSayam । vidulasyeva tatpuzpaM moGaM janayituH smftam ॥8॥

text: sarvānarthaḥ kule yatra jāyate pāpapūruṣaḥ । akīrtiṃ janayatyeva kīrtimantardadhāti ca ॥9॥
html:
sarvānarthaḥ kule yatra jāyate pāpapūruṣaḥ ।
akīrtiṃ janayatyeva kīrtimantardadhāti ca ॥9॥
slp1: sarvAnarTaH kule yatra jAyate pApapUruzaH । akIrtiM janayatyeva kIrtimantardaDAti ca ॥9॥

text: sarve cāpi vikarmasthā bhāgaṃ nārhanti sodarāḥ । nāpradāya kaniṣṭhebhyo jyeṣṭhaḥ kurvīta yautakam ॥10॥
html:
sarve cāpi vikarmasthā bhāgaṃ nārhanti sodarāḥ ।
nāpradāya kaniṣṭhebhyo jyeṣṭhaḥ kurvīta yautakam ॥10॥
slp1: sarve cApi vikarmasTA BAgaM nArhanti sodarAH । nApradAya kanizWeByo jyezWaH kurvIta yOtakam ॥10॥

text: anujaṃ hi piturdāyo jaṅghāśramaphalo'dhvagaḥ । svayamīhitalabdhaṃ tu nākāmo dātumarhati ॥11॥
html:
anujaṃ hi piturdāyo jaṅghāśramaphalo'dhvagaḥ ।
svayamīhitalabdhaṃ tu nākāmo dātumarhati ॥11॥
slp1: anujaM hi piturdAyo jaNGASramaPalo'DvagaH । svayamIhitalabDaM tu nAkAmo dAtumarhati ॥11॥

text: bhrātṝṇāmavibhaktānāmutthānamapi cetsaha । na putrabhāgaṃ viṣamaṃ pitā dadyātkathañcana ॥12॥
html:
bhrātṝṇāmavibhaktānāmutthānamapi cetsaha ।
na putrabhāgaṃ viṣamaṃ pitā dadyātkathañcana ॥12॥
slp1: BrAtFRAmaviBaktAnAmutTAnamapi cetsaha । na putraBAgaM vizamaM pitA dadyAtkaTaYcana ॥12॥

text: na jyeṣṭhānavamanyeta duṣkṛtaḥ sukṛto'pi vā । yadi strī yadyavarajaḥ śreyaḥ paśyettathācaret । dharmaṃ hi śreya ityāhuriti dharmavido viduḥ ॥13॥
html:
na jyeṣṭhānavamanyeta duṣkṛtaḥ sukṛto'pi vā ।
yadi strī yadyavarajaḥ śreyaḥ paśyettathācaret ।
dharmaṃ hi śreya ityāhuriti dharmavido viduḥ ॥13॥
slp1: na jyezWAnavamanyeta duzkftaH sukfto'pi vA । yadi strI yadyavarajaH SreyaH paSyettaTAcaret । DarmaM hi Sreya ityAhuriti Darmavido viduH ॥13॥

text: daśācāryānupādhyāya upādhyāyānpitā daśa । daśa caiva pitṝnmātā sarvāṃ vā pṛthivīmapi ॥14॥
html:
daśācāryānupādhyāya upādhyāyānpitā daśa ।
daśa caiva pitṝnmātā sarvāṃ vā pṛthivīmapi ॥14॥
slp1: daSAcAryAnupADyAya upADyAyAnpitA daSa । daSa cEva pitFnmAtA sarvAM vA pfTivImapi ॥14॥

text: gauraveṇābhibhavati nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ । mātā garīyasī yacca tenaitāṃ manyate janaḥ ॥15॥
html:
gauraveṇābhibhavati nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ ।
mātā garīyasī yacca tenaitāṃ manyate janaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: gOraveRABiBavati nAsti mAtfsamo guruH । mAtA garIyasI yacca tenEtAM manyate janaH ॥15॥

text: jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitṛsamo mṛte pitari bhārata । sa hyeṣāṃ vṛttidātā syātsa caitānparipālayet ॥16॥
html:
jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitṛsamo mṛte pitari bhārata ।
sa hyeṣāṃ vṛttidātā syātsa caitānparipālayet ॥16॥
slp1: jyezWo BrAtA pitfsamo mfte pitari BArata । sa hyezAM vfttidAtA syAtsa cEtAnparipAlayet ॥16॥

text: kaniṣṭhāstaṃ namasyeransarve chandānuvartinaḥ । tameva copajīveranyathaiva pitaraṃ tathā ॥17॥
html:
kaniṣṭhāstaṃ namasyeransarve chandānuvartinaḥ ।
tameva copajīveranyathaiva pitaraṃ tathā ॥17॥
slp1: kanizWAstaM namasyeransarve CandAnuvartinaH । tameva copajIveranyaTEva pitaraM taTA ॥17॥

text: śarīrametau sṛjataḥ pitā mātā ca bhārata । ācāryaśāstā yā jātiḥ sā satyā sājarāmarā ॥18॥
html:
śarīrametau sṛjataḥ pitā mātā ca bhārata ।
ācāryaśāstā yā jātiḥ sā satyā sājarāmarā ॥18॥
slp1: SarIrametO sfjataH pitA mAtA ca BArata । AcAryaSAstA yA jAtiH sA satyA sAjarAmarA ॥18॥

text: jyeṣṭhā mātṛsamā cāpi bhaginī bharatarṣabha । bhrāturbhāryā ca tadvatsyādyasyā bālye stanaṃ pibet] ॥19॥
html:
jyeṣṭhā mātṛsamā cāpi bhaginī bharatarṣabha ।
bhrāturbhāryā ca tadvatsyādyasyā bālye stanaṃ pibet] ॥19॥
slp1: jyezWA mAtfsamA cApi BaginI BaratarzaBa । BrAturBAryA ca tadvatsyAdyasyA bAlye stanaM pibet] ॥19॥

text: sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ mlecchānāṃ ca pitāmaha । upavāse matiriyaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca na vidmahe ॥1॥
html:
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ mlecchānāṃ ca pitāmaha ।
upavāse matiriyaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca na vidmahe ॥1॥
slp1: sarvezAmeva varRAnAM mlecCAnAM ca pitAmaha । upavAse matiriyaM kAraRaM ca na vidmahe ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: brahmakṣatreṇa niyamāścartavyā iti naḥ śrutam । upavāse kathaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtyamasti pitāmaha ॥2॥
html:
brahmakṣatreṇa niyamāścartavyā iti naḥ śrutam ।
upavāse kathaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtyamasti pitāmaha ॥2॥
slp1: brahmakzatreRa niyamAScartavyA iti naH Srutam । upavAse kaTaM tezAM kftyamasti pitAmaha ॥2॥

text: niyamaṃ copavāsānāṃ sarveṣāṃ brūhi pārthiva । avāpnoti gatiṃ kāṃ ca upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ॥3॥
html:
niyamaṃ copavāsānāṃ sarveṣāṃ brūhi pārthiva ।
avāpnoti gatiṃ kāṃ ca upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: niyamaM copavAsAnAM sarvezAM brUhi pArTiva । avApnoti gatiM kAM ca upavAsaparAyaRaH ॥3॥

text: upavāsaḥ paraṃ puṇyamupavāsaḥ parāyaṇam । upoṣyeha naraśreṣṭha kiṃ phalaṃ pratipadyate ॥4॥
html:
upavāsaḥ paraṃ puṇyamupavāsaḥ parāyaṇam ।
upoṣyeha naraśreṣṭha kiṃ phalaṃ pratipadyate ॥4॥
slp1: upavAsaH paraM puRyamupavAsaH parAyaRam । upozyeha naraSrezWa kiM PalaM pratipadyate ॥4॥

text: adharmānmucyate kena dharmamāpnoti vai katham । svargaṃ puṇyaṃ ca labhate kathaṃ bharatasattama ॥5॥
html:
adharmānmucyate kena dharmamāpnoti vai katham ।
svargaṃ puṇyaṃ ca labhate kathaṃ bharatasattama ॥5॥
slp1: aDarmAnmucyate kena DarmamApnoti vE kaTam । svargaM puRyaM ca laBate kaTaM Baratasattama ॥5॥

text: upoṣya cāpi kiṃ tena pradeyaṃ syānnarādhipa । dharmeṇa ca sukhānarthāṁllabhedyena bravīhi tam ॥6॥
html:
upoṣya cāpi kiṃ tena pradeyaṃ syānnarādhipa ।
dharmeṇa ca sukhānarthāṁllabhedyena bravīhi tam ॥6॥
slp1: upozya cApi kiM tena pradeyaM syAnnarADipa । DarmeRa ca suKAnarTAṁllaBedyena bravIhi tam ॥6॥

text: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ kaunteyaṃ dharmajñaṃ dharmatattvavit । dharmaputramidaṃ vākyaṃ bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo'bravīt ॥7॥
html:
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ kaunteyaṃ dharmajñaṃ dharmatattvavit ।
dharmaputramidaṃ vākyaṃ bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo'bravīt ॥7॥
slp1: evaM bruvARaM kOnteyaM DarmajYaM Darmatattvavit । DarmaputramidaM vAkyaM BIzmaH SAntanavo'bravIt ॥7॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: idaṃ khalu mahārāja śrutamāsītpurātanam । upavāsavidhau śreṣṭhā ye guṇā bharatarṣabha ॥8॥
html:
idaṃ khalu mahārāja śrutamāsītpurātanam ।
upavāsavidhau śreṣṭhā ye guṇā bharatarṣabha ॥8॥
slp1: idaM Kalu mahArAja SrutamAsItpurAtanam । upavAsaviDO SrezWA ye guRA BaratarzaBa ॥8॥

text: prājāpatyaṃ hyaṅgirasaṃ pṛṣṭavānasmi bhārata । yathā māṃ tvaṃ tathaivāhaṃ pṛṣṭavāṃstaṃ tapodhanam ॥9॥
html:
prājāpatyaṃ hyaṅgirasaṃ pṛṣṭavānasmi bhārata ।
yathā māṃ tvaṃ tathaivāhaṃ pṛṣṭavāṃstaṃ tapodhanam ॥9॥
slp1: prAjApatyaM hyaNgirasaM pfzwavAnasmi BArata । yaTA mAM tvaM taTEvAhaM pfzwavAMstaM tapoDanam ॥9॥

text: praśnametaṃ mayā pṛṣṭo bhagavānagnisambhavaḥ । upavāsavidhiṃ puṇyamācaṣṭa bharatarṣabha ॥10॥
html:
praśnametaṃ mayā pṛṣṭo bhagavānagnisambhavaḥ ।
upavāsavidhiṃ puṇyamācaṣṭa bharatarṣabha ॥10॥
slp1: praSnametaM mayA pfzwo BagavAnagnisamBavaH । upavAsaviDiM puRyamAcazwa BaratarzaBa ॥10॥

text: brahmakṣatre trirātraṃ tu vihitaṃ kurunandana । dvistrirātramathaivātra nirdiṣṭaṃ puruṣarṣabha ॥11॥
html:
brahmakṣatre trirātraṃ tu vihitaṃ kurunandana ।
dvistrirātramathaivātra nirdiṣṭaṃ puruṣarṣabha ॥11॥
slp1: brahmakzatre trirAtraM tu vihitaM kurunandana । dvistrirAtramaTEvAtra nirdizwaM puruzarzaBa ॥11॥
author: aṅgirā uvāca ।

text: vaiśyaśūdrau tu yau mohādupavāsaṃ prakurvate । trirātraṃ dvistrirātraṃ vā tayoḥ puṣṭirna vidyate ॥12॥
html:
vaiśyaśūdrau tu yau mohādupavāsaṃ prakurvate ।
trirātraṃ dvistrirātraṃ vā tayoḥ puṣṭirna vidyate ॥12॥
slp1: vESyaSUdrO tu yO mohAdupavAsaM prakurvate । trirAtraM dvistrirAtraM vA tayoH puzwirna vidyate ॥12॥

text: caturthabhaktakṣapaṇaṃ vaiśyaśūdre vidhīyate । trirātraṃ na tu dharmajñairvihitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ ॥13॥
html:
caturthabhaktakṣapaṇaṃ vaiśyaśūdre vidhīyate ।
trirātraṃ na tu dharmajñairvihitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ ॥13॥
slp1: caturTaBaktakzapaRaM vESyaSUdre viDIyate । trirAtraM na tu DarmajYErvihitaM brahmavAdiBiH ॥13॥

text: pañcamyāṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca bhārata । kṣamāvānrūpasampannaḥ śrutavāṃścaiva jāyate ॥14॥
html:
pañcamyāṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca bhārata ।
kṣamāvānrūpasampannaḥ śrutavāṃścaiva jāyate ॥14॥
slp1: paYcamyAM cEva zazWyAM ca pOrRamAsyAM ca BArata । kzamAvAnrUpasampannaH SrutavAMScEva jAyate ॥14॥

text: nānapatyo bhavetprājño daridro vā kadācana । yajiṣṇuḥ pañcamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kṣapedyo bhojayeddvijān ॥15॥
html:
nānapatyo bhavetprājño daridro vā kadācana ।
yajiṣṇuḥ pañcamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kṣapedyo bhojayeddvijān ॥15॥
slp1: nAnapatyo BavetprAjYo daridro vA kadAcana । yajizRuH paYcamIM zazWIM kzapedyo BojayeddvijAn ॥15॥

text: aṣṭamīmatha kaunteya śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm । upoṣya vyādhirahito vīryavānabhijāyate ॥16॥
html:
aṣṭamīmatha kaunteya śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm ।
upoṣya vyādhirahito vīryavānabhijāyate ॥16॥
slp1: azwamImaTa kOnteya Suklapakze caturdaSIm । upozya vyADirahito vIryavAnaBijAyate ॥16॥

text: mārgaśīrṣaṃ tu yo māsamekabhaktena saṅkṣipet । bhojayecca dvijānbhaktyā sa mucyedvyādhikilbiṣaiḥ ॥17॥
html:
mārgaśīrṣaṃ tu yo māsamekabhaktena saṅkṣipet ।
bhojayecca dvijānbhaktyā sa mucyedvyādhikilbiṣaiḥ ॥17॥
slp1: mArgaSIrzaM tu yo mAsamekaBaktena saNkzipet । Bojayecca dvijAnBaktyA sa mucyedvyADikilbizEH ॥17॥

text: sarvakalyāṇasampūrṇaḥ sarvauṣadhisamanvitaḥ । kṛṣibhāgī bahudhano bahuputraśca jāyate ॥18॥
html:
sarvakalyāṇasampūrṇaḥ sarvauṣadhisamanvitaḥ ।
kṛṣibhāgī bahudhano bahuputraśca jāyate ॥18॥
slp1: sarvakalyARasampUrRaH sarvOzaDisamanvitaH । kfziBAgI bahuDano bahuputraSca jAyate ॥18॥

text: pauṣamāsaṃ tu kaunteya bhaktenaikena yaḥ kṣapet । subhago darśanīyaśca yaśobhāgī ca jāyate ॥19॥
html:
pauṣamāsaṃ tu kaunteya bhaktenaikena yaḥ kṣapet ।
subhago darśanīyaśca yaśobhāgī ca jāyate ॥19॥
slp1: pOzamAsaM tu kOnteya BaktenEkena yaH kzapet । suBago darSanIyaSca yaSoBAgI ca jAyate ॥19॥

text: pitṛbhakto māghamāsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet । śrīmatkule jñātimadhye sa mahattvaṃ prapadyate ॥20॥
html:
pitṛbhakto māghamāsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet ।
śrīmatkule jñātimadhye sa mahattvaṃ prapadyate ॥20॥
slp1: pitfBakto mAGamAsamekaBaktena yaH kzapet । SrImatkule jYAtimaDye sa mahattvaM prapadyate ॥20॥

text: bhagadaivaṃ tu yo māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet । strīṣu vallabhatāṃ yāti vaśyāścāsya bhavanti tāḥ ॥21॥
html:
bhagadaivaṃ tu yo māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet ।
strīṣu vallabhatāṃ yāti vaśyāścāsya bhavanti tāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: BagadEvaM tu yo mAsamekaBaktena yaH kzapet । strIzu vallaBatAM yAti vaSyAScAsya Bavanti tAH ॥21॥

text: caitraṃ tu niyato māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet । suvarṇamaṇimuktāḍhye kule mahati jāyate ॥22॥
html:
caitraṃ tu niyato māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet ।
suvarṇamaṇimuktāḍhye kule mahati jāyate ॥22॥
slp1: cEtraM tu niyato mAsamekaBaktena yaH kzapet । suvarRamaRimuktAQye kule mahati jAyate ॥22॥

text: nistaredekabhaktena vaiśākhaṃ yo jitendriyaḥ । naro vā yadi vā nārī jñātīnāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ vrajet ॥23॥
html:
nistaredekabhaktena vaiśākhaṃ yo jitendriyaḥ ।
naro vā yadi vā nārī jñātīnāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ vrajet ॥23॥
slp1: nistaredekaBaktena vESAKaM yo jitendriyaH । naro vA yadi vA nArI jYAtInAM SrezWatAM vrajet ॥23॥

text: jyeṣṭhāmūlaṃ tu yo māsamekabhaktena saṅkṣapet । aiśvaryamatulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pumānstrī vābhijāyate ॥24॥
html:
jyeṣṭhāmūlaṃ tu yo māsamekabhaktena saṅkṣapet ।
aiśvaryamatulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pumānstrī vābhijāyate ॥24॥
slp1: jyezWAmUlaM tu yo mAsamekaBaktena saNkzapet । ESvaryamatulaM SrezWaM pumAnstrI vABijAyate ॥24॥

text: āṣāḍhamekabhaktena sthitvā māsamatandritaḥ । bahudhānyo bahudhano bahuputraśca jāyate ॥25॥
html:
āṣāḍhamekabhaktena sthitvā māsamatandritaḥ ।
bahudhānyo bahudhano bahuputraśca jāyate ॥25॥
slp1: AzAQamekaBaktena sTitvA mAsamatandritaH । bahuDAnyo bahuDano bahuputraSca jAyate ॥25॥

text: śrāvaṇaṃ niyato māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet । yatra tatrābhiṣekeṇa yujyate jñātivardhanaḥ ॥26॥
html:
śrāvaṇaṃ niyato māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet ।
yatra tatrābhiṣekeṇa yujyate jñātivardhanaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: SrAvaRaM niyato mAsamekaBaktena yaH kzapet । yatra tatrABizekeRa yujyate jYAtivarDanaH ॥26॥

text: prauṣṭhapadaṃ tu yo māsamekāhāro bhavennaraḥ । dhanāḍhyaṃ sphītamacalamaiśvaryaṃ pratipadyate ॥27॥
html:
prauṣṭhapadaṃ tu yo māsamekāhāro bhavennaraḥ ।
dhanāḍhyaṃ sphītamacalamaiśvaryaṃ pratipadyate ॥27॥
slp1: prOzWapadaM tu yo mAsamekAhAro BavennaraH । DanAQyaM sPItamacalamESvaryaM pratipadyate ॥27॥

text: tathaivāśvayujaṃ māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet । prajāvānvāhanāḍhyaśca bahuputraśca jāyate ॥28॥
html:
tathaivāśvayujaṃ māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣapet ।
prajāvānvāhanāḍhyaśca bahuputraśca jāyate ॥28॥
slp1: taTEvASvayujaM mAsamekaBaktena yaH kzapet । prajAvAnvAhanAQyaSca bahuputraSca jAyate ॥28॥

text: kārttikaṃ tu naro māsaṃ yaḥ kuryādekabhojanam । śūraśca bahubhāryaśca kīrtimāṃścaiva jāyate ॥29॥
html:
kārttikaṃ tu naro māsaṃ yaḥ kuryādekabhojanam ।
śūraśca bahubhāryaśca kīrtimāṃścaiva jāyate ॥29॥
slp1: kArttikaM tu naro mAsaM yaH kuryAdekaBojanam । SUraSca bahuBAryaSca kIrtimAMScEva jAyate ॥29॥

text: iti māsā naravyāghra kṣapatāṃ parikīrtitāḥ । tithīnāṃ niyamā ye tu śṛṇu tānapi pārthiva ॥30॥
html:
iti māsā naravyāghra kṣapatāṃ parikīrtitāḥ ।
tithīnāṃ niyamā ye tu śṛṇu tānapi pārthiva ॥30॥
slp1: iti mAsA naravyAGra kzapatAM parikIrtitAH । tiTInAM niyamA ye tu SfRu tAnapi pArTiva ॥30॥

text: pakṣe pakṣe gate yastu bhaktamaśnāti bhārata । gavāḍhyo bahuputraśca dīrghāyuśca sa jāyate ॥31॥
html:
pakṣe pakṣe gate yastu bhaktamaśnāti bhārata ।
gavāḍhyo bahuputraśca dīrghāyuśca sa jāyate ॥31॥
slp1: pakze pakze gate yastu BaktamaSnAti BArata । gavAQyo bahuputraSca dIrGAyuSca sa jAyate ॥31॥

text: māsi māsi trirātrāṇi kṛtvā varṣāṇi dvādaśa । gaṇādhipatyaṃ prāpnoti niḥsapatnamanāvilam ॥32॥
html:
māsi māsi trirātrāṇi kṛtvā varṣāṇi dvādaśa ।
gaṇādhipatyaṃ prāpnoti niḥsapatnamanāvilam ॥32॥
slp1: mAsi mAsi trirAtrARi kftvA varzARi dvAdaSa । gaRADipatyaM prApnoti niHsapatnamanAvilam ॥32॥

text: ete tu niyamāḥ sarve kartavyāḥ śarado daśa । dve cānye bharataśreṣṭha pravṛttimanuvartatā ॥33॥
html:
ete tu niyamāḥ sarve kartavyāḥ śarado daśa ।
dve cānye bharataśreṣṭha pravṛttimanuvartatā ॥33॥
slp1: ete tu niyamAH sarve kartavyAH Sarado daSa । dve cAnye BarataSrezWa pravfttimanuvartatA ॥33॥

text: yastu prātastathā sāyaṃ bhuñjāno nāntarā pibet । ahiṃsānirato nityaṃ juhvāno jātavedasam ॥34॥
html:
yastu prātastathā sāyaṃ bhuñjāno nāntarā pibet ।
ahiṃsānirato nityaṃ juhvāno jātavedasam ॥34॥
slp1: yastu prAtastaTA sAyaM BuYjAno nAntarA pibet । ahiMsAnirato nityaM juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥34॥

text: ṣaḍbhiḥ sa varṣairnṛpate sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ । agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ॥35॥
html:
ṣaḍbhiḥ sa varṣairnṛpate sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: zaqBiH sa varzErnfpate siDyate nAtra saMSayaH । agnizwomasya yajYasya PalaM prApnoti mAnavaH ॥35॥

text: adhivāse so'psarasāṃ nṛtyagītavinādite । taptakāñcanavarṇābhaṃ vimānamadhirohati ॥36॥
html:
adhivāse so'psarasāṃ nṛtyagītavinādite ।
taptakāñcanavarṇābhaṃ vimānamadhirohati ॥36॥
slp1: aDivAse so'psarasAM nftyagItavinAdite । taptakAYcanavarRABaM vimAnamaDirohati ॥36॥

text: pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu brahmaloke mahīyate । tatkṣayādiha cāgamya māhātmyaṃ pratipadyate ॥37॥
html:
pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu brahmaloke mahīyate ।
tatkṣayādiha cāgamya māhātmyaṃ pratipadyate ॥37॥
slp1: pUrRaM varzasahasraM tu brahmaloke mahIyate । tatkzayAdiha cAgamya mAhAtmyaM pratipadyate ॥37॥

text: yastu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇamekāhāro bhavennaraḥ । atirātrasya yajñasya sa phalaṃ samupāśnute ॥38॥
html:
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇamekāhāro bhavennaraḥ ।
atirātrasya yajñasya sa phalaṃ samupāśnute ॥38॥
slp1: yastu saMvatsaraM pUrRamekAhAro BavennaraH । atirAtrasya yajYasya sa PalaM samupASnute ॥38॥

text: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi svarge ca sa mahīyate । tatkṣayādiha cāgamya māhātmyaṃ pratipadyate ॥39॥
html:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi svarge ca sa mahīyate ।
tatkṣayādiha cāgamya māhātmyaṃ pratipadyate ॥39॥
slp1: daSavarzasahasrARi svarge ca sa mahIyate । tatkzayAdiha cAgamya mAhAtmyaM pratipadyate ॥39॥

text: yastu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ caturthaṃ bhaktamaśnute । ahiṃsānirato nityaṃ satyavāṅniyatendriyaḥ ॥40॥
html:
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ caturthaṃ bhaktamaśnute ।
ahiṃsānirato nityaṃ satyavāṅniyatendriyaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: yastu saMvatsaraM pUrRaM caturTaM BaktamaSnute । ahiMsAnirato nityaM satyavANniyatendriyaH ॥40॥

text: vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ vai samupāśnute । triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi svarge ca sa mahīyate ॥41॥
html:
vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ vai samupāśnute ।
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi svarge ca sa mahīyate ॥41॥
slp1: vAjapeyasya yajYasya PalaM vE samupASnute । triMSadvarzasahasrARi svarge ca sa mahIyate ॥41॥

text: ṣaṣṭhe kāle tu kaunteya naraḥ saṃvatsaraṃ kṣapet । aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ॥42॥
html:
ṣaṣṭhe kāle tu kaunteya naraḥ saṃvatsaraṃ kṣapet ।
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: zazWe kAle tu kOnteya naraH saMvatsaraM kzapet । aSvameDasya yajYasya PalaM prApnoti mAnavaH ॥42॥

text: cakravākaprayuktena vimānena sa gacchati । catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ॥43॥
html:
cakravākaprayuktena vimānena sa gacchati ।
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ॥43॥
slp1: cakravAkaprayuktena vimAnena sa gacCati । catvAriMSatsahasrARi varzARAM divi modate ॥43॥

text: aṣṭamena tu bhaktena jīvansaṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa । gavāmayasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ॥44॥
html:
aṣṭamena tu bhaktena jīvansaṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa ।
gavāmayasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: azwamena tu Baktena jIvansaMvatsaraM nfpa । gavAmayasya yajYasya PalaM prApnoti mAnavaH ॥44॥

text: haṃsasārasayuktena vimānena sa gacchati । pañcāśataṃ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ॥45॥
html:
haṃsasārasayuktena vimānena sa gacchati ।
pañcāśataṃ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ॥45॥
slp1: haMsasArasayuktena vimAnena sa gacCati । paYcASataM sahasrARi varzARAM divi modate ॥45॥

text: pakṣe pakṣe gate rājanyo'śnīyādvarṣameva tu । ṣaṇmāsānaśanaṃ tasya bhagavānaṅgirābravīt । ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇi divamāvasate ca saḥ ॥46॥
html:
pakṣe pakṣe gate rājanyo'śnīyādvarṣameva tu ।
ṣaṇmāsānaśanaṃ tasya bhagavānaṅgirābravīt ।
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇi divamāvasate ca saḥ ॥46॥
slp1: pakze pakze gate rAjanyo'SnIyAdvarzameva tu । zaRmAsAnaSanaM tasya BagavAnaNgirAbravIt । zazwiM varzasahasrARi divamAvasate ca saH ॥46॥

text: vīṇānāṃ vallakīnāṃ ca veṇūnāṃ ca viśāṃ pate । sughoṣairmadhuraiḥ śabdaiḥ suptaḥ sa pratibodhyate ॥47॥
html:
vīṇānāṃ vallakīnāṃ ca veṇūnāṃ ca viśāṃ pate ।
sughoṣairmadhuraiḥ śabdaiḥ suptaḥ sa pratibodhyate ॥47॥
slp1: vIRAnAM vallakInAM ca veRUnAM ca viSAM pate । suGozErmaDurEH SabdEH suptaH sa pratiboDyate ॥47॥

text: saṃvatsaramihaikaṃ tu māsi māsi pibetpayaḥ । phalaṃ viśvajitastāta prāpnoti sa naro nṛpa ॥48॥
html:
saṃvatsaramihaikaṃ tu māsi māsi pibetpayaḥ ।
phalaṃ viśvajitastāta prāpnoti sa naro nṛpa ॥48॥
slp1: saMvatsaramihEkaM tu mAsi mAsi pibetpayaH । PalaM viSvajitastAta prApnoti sa naro nfpa ॥48॥

text: siṃhavyāghraprayuktena vimānena sa gacchati । saptatiṃ ca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ॥49॥
html:
siṃhavyāghraprayuktena vimānena sa gacchati ।
saptatiṃ ca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ॥49॥
slp1: siMhavyAGraprayuktena vimAnena sa gacCati । saptatiM ca sahasrARi varzARAM divi modate ॥49॥

text: māsādūrdhvaṃ naravyāghra nopavāso vidhīyate । vidhiṃ tvanaśanasyāhuḥ pārtha dharmavido janāḥ ॥50॥
html:
māsādūrdhvaṃ naravyāghra nopavāso vidhīyate ।
vidhiṃ tvanaśanasyāhuḥ pārtha dharmavido janāḥ ॥50॥
slp1: mAsAdUrDvaM naravyAGra nopavAso viDIyate । viDiM tvanaSanasyAhuH pArTa Darmavido janAH ॥50॥

text: anārto vyādhirahito gacchedanaśanaṃ tu yaḥ । pade pade yajñaphalaṃ sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ॥51॥
html:
anārto vyādhirahito gacchedanaśanaṃ tu yaḥ ।
pade pade yajñaphalaṃ sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: anArto vyADirahito gacCedanaSanaM tu yaH । pade pade yajYaPalaM sa prApnoti na saMSayaH ॥51॥

text: divaṃ haṃsaprayuktena vimānena sa gacchati । śataṃ cāpsarasaḥ kanyā ramayantyapi taṃ naram ॥52॥
html:
divaṃ haṃsaprayuktena vimānena sa gacchati ।
śataṃ cāpsarasaḥ kanyā ramayantyapi taṃ naram ॥52॥
slp1: divaM haMsaprayuktena vimAnena sa gacCati । SataM cApsarasaH kanyA ramayantyapi taM naram ॥52॥

text: ārto vā vyādhito vāpi gacchedanaśanaṃ tu yaḥ । śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ modate divi sa prabho । kāñcīnūpuraśabdena suptaścaiva prabodhyate ॥53॥
html:
ārto vā vyādhito vāpi gacchedanaśanaṃ tu yaḥ ।
śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ modate divi sa prabho ।
kāñcīnūpuraśabdena suptaścaiva prabodhyate ॥53॥
slp1: Arto vA vyADito vApi gacCedanaSanaM tu yaH । SataM varzasahasrARAM modate divi sa praBo । kAYcInUpuraSabdena suptaScEva praboDyate ॥53॥

text: sahasrahaṃsasaṃyukte vimāne somavarcasi । sa gatvā strīśatākīrṇe ramate bharatarṣabha ॥54॥
html:
sahasrahaṃsasaṃyukte vimāne somavarcasi ।
sa gatvā strīśatākīrṇe ramate bharatarṣabha ॥54॥
slp1: sahasrahaMsasaMyukte vimAne somavarcasi । sa gatvA strISatAkIrRe ramate BaratarzaBa ॥54॥

text: kṣīṇasyāpyāyanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kṣatasya kṣatarohaṇam । vyādhitasyauṣadhagrāmaḥ kruddhasya ca prasādanam ॥55॥
html:
kṣīṇasyāpyāyanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kṣatasya kṣatarohaṇam ।
vyādhitasyauṣadhagrāmaḥ kruddhasya ca prasādanam ॥55॥
slp1: kzIRasyApyAyanaM dfzwaM kzatasya kzatarohaRam । vyADitasyOzaDagrAmaH krudDasya ca prasAdanam ॥55॥

text: duḥkhitasyārthamānābhyāṃ dravyāṇāṃ pratipādanam । na caite svargakāmasya rocante sukhamedhasaḥ ॥56॥
html:
duḥkhitasyārthamānābhyāṃ dravyāṇāṃ pratipādanam ।
na caite svargakāmasya rocante sukhamedhasaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: duHKitasyArTamAnAByAM dravyARAM pratipAdanam । na cEte svargakAmasya rocante suKameDasaH ॥56॥

text: ataḥ sa kāmasaṃyukto vimāne hemasannibhe । ramate strīśatākīrṇe puruṣo'laṅkṛtaḥ śubhe ॥57॥
html:
ataḥ sa kāmasaṃyukto vimāne hemasannibhe ।
ramate strīśatākīrṇe puruṣo'laṅkṛtaḥ śubhe ॥57॥
slp1: ataH sa kAmasaMyukto vimAne hemasanniBe । ramate strISatAkIrRe puruzo'laNkftaH SuBe ॥57॥

text: svasthaḥ saphalasaṅkalpaḥ sukhī vigatakalmaṣaḥ । anaśnandehamutsṛjya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ॥58॥
html:
svasthaḥ saphalasaṅkalpaḥ sukhī vigatakalmaṣaḥ ।
anaśnandehamutsṛjya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: svasTaH saPalasaNkalpaH suKI vigatakalmazaH । anaSnandehamutsfjya PalaM prApnoti mAnavaH ॥58॥

text: bālasūryapratīkāśe vimāne hemavarcasi । vaiḍūryamuktākhacite vīṇāmurajanādite ॥59॥
html:
bālasūryapratīkāśe vimāne hemavarcasi ।
vaiḍūryamuktākhacite vīṇāmurajanādite ॥59॥
slp1: bAlasUryapratIkASe vimAne hemavarcasi । vEqUryamuktAKacite vIRAmurajanAdite ॥59॥

text: patākādīpikākīrṇe divyaghaṇṭāninādite । strīsahasrānucarite sa naraḥ sukhamedhate ॥60॥
html:
patākādīpikākīrṇe divyaghaṇṭāninādite ।
strīsahasrānucarite sa naraḥ sukhamedhate ॥60॥
slp1: patAkAdIpikAkIrRe divyaGaRwAninAdite । strIsahasrAnucarite sa naraH suKameDate ॥60॥

text: yāvanti romakūpāṇi tasya gātreṣu pāṇḍava । tāvantyeva sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ॥61॥
html:
yāvanti romakūpāṇi tasya gātreṣu pāṇḍava ।
tāvantyeva sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ॥61॥
slp1: yAvanti romakUpARi tasya gAtrezu pARqava । tAvantyeva sahasrARi varzARAM divi modate ॥61॥

text: nāsti vedātparaṃ śāstraṃ nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ । na dharmātparamo lābhastapo nānaśanātparam ॥62॥
html:
nāsti vedātparaṃ śāstraṃ nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ ।
na dharmātparamo lābhastapo nānaśanātparam ॥62॥
slp1: nAsti vedAtparaM SAstraM nAsti mAtfsamo guruH । na DarmAtparamo lABastapo nAnaSanAtparam ॥62॥

text: brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ divi ceha ca । upavāsaistathā tulyaṃ tapaḥkarma na vidyate ॥63॥
html:
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ divi ceha ca ।
upavāsaistathā tulyaṃ tapaḥkarma na vidyate ॥63॥
slp1: brAhmaReByaH paraM nAsti pAvanaM divi ceha ca । upavAsEstaTA tulyaM tapaHkarma na vidyate ॥63॥

text: upoṣya vidhivaddevāstridivaṃ pratipedire । ṛṣayaśca parāṃ siddhimupavāsairavāpnuvan ॥64॥
html:
upoṣya vidhivaddevāstridivaṃ pratipedire ।
ṛṣayaśca parāṃ siddhimupavāsairavāpnuvan ॥64॥
slp1: upozya viDivaddevAstridivaM pratipedire । fzayaSca parAM sidDimupavAsEravApnuvan ॥64॥

text: divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā । kṣāntamekena bhaktena tena vipratvamāgataḥ ॥65॥
html:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā ।
kṣāntamekena bhaktena tena vipratvamāgataḥ ॥65॥
slp1: divyaM varzasahasraM hi viSvAmitreRa DImatA । kzAntamekena Baktena tena vipratvamAgataH ॥65॥

text: cyavano jamadagniśca vasiṣṭho gautamo bhṛguḥ । sarva eva divaṃ prāptāḥ kṣamāvanto maharṣayaḥ ॥66॥
html:
cyavano jamadagniśca vasiṣṭho gautamo bhṛguḥ ।
sarva eva divaṃ prāptāḥ kṣamāvanto maharṣayaḥ ॥66॥
slp1: cyavano jamadagniSca vasizWo gOtamo BfguH । sarva eva divaM prAptAH kzamAvanto maharzayaH ॥66॥

text: idamaṅgirasā pūrvaṃ maharṣibhyaḥ pradarśitam । yaḥ pradarśayate nityaṃ na sa duḥkhamavāpnute ॥67॥
html:
idamaṅgirasā pūrvaṃ maharṣibhyaḥ pradarśitam ।
yaḥ pradarśayate nityaṃ na sa duḥkhamavāpnute ॥67॥
slp1: idamaNgirasA pUrvaM maharziByaH pradarSitam । yaH pradarSayate nityaM na sa duHKamavApnute ॥67॥

text: imaṃ tu kaunteya yathākramaṃ vidhiṃ pravartitaṃ hyaṅgirasā maharṣiṇā । paṭheta yo vai śṛṇuyācca nityadā na vidyate tasya narasya kilbiṣam ॥68॥
html:
imaṃ tu kaunteya yathākramaṃ vidhiṃ pravartitaṃ hyaṅgirasā maharṣiṇā ।
paṭheta yo vai śṛṇuyācca nityadā na vidyate tasya narasya kilbiṣam ॥68॥
slp1: imaM tu kOnteya yaTAkramaM viDiM pravartitaM hyaNgirasA maharziRA । paWeta yo vE SfRuyAcca nityadA na vidyate tasya narasya kilbizam ॥68॥

text: vimucyate cāpi sa sarvasaṅkarairna cāsya doṣairabhibhūyate manaḥ । viyonijānāṃ ca vijānate rutaṃ dhruvāṃ ca kīrtiṃ labhate narottamaḥ] ॥69॥
html:
vimucyate cāpi sa sarvasaṅkarairna cāsya doṣairabhibhūyate manaḥ ।
viyonijānāṃ ca vijānate rutaṃ dhruvāṃ ca kīrtiṃ labhate narottamaḥ] ॥69॥
slp1: vimucyate cApi sa sarvasaNkarErna cAsya dozEraBiBUyate manaH । viyonijAnAM ca vijAnate rutaM DruvAM ca kIrtiM laBate narottamaH] ॥69॥

text: pitāmahena vidhivadyajñāḥ proktā mahātmanā । guṇāścaiṣāṃ yathātattvaṃ pretya ceha ca sarvaśaḥ ॥1॥
html:
pitāmahena vidhivadyajñāḥ proktā mahātmanā ।
guṇāścaiṣāṃ yathātattvaṃ pretya ceha ca sarvaśaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmahena viDivadyajYAH proktA mahAtmanA । guRAScEzAM yaTAtattvaM pretya ceha ca sarvaSaH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: na te śakyā daridreṇa yajñāḥ prāptuṃ pitāmaha । bahūpakaraṇā yajñā nānāsambhāravistarāḥ ॥2॥
html:
na te śakyā daridreṇa yajñāḥ prāptuṃ pitāmaha ।
bahūpakaraṇā yajñā nānāsambhāravistarāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: na te SakyA daridreRa yajYAH prAptuM pitAmaha । bahUpakaraRA yajYA nAnAsamBAravistarAH ॥2॥

text: pārthivai rājaputrairvā śakyāḥ prāptuṃ pitāmaha । nārthanyūnairavaguṇairekātmabhirasaṃhataiḥ ॥3॥
html:
pārthivai rājaputrairvā śakyāḥ prāptuṃ pitāmaha ।
nārthanyūnairavaguṇairekātmabhirasaṃhataiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: pArTivE rAjaputrErvA SakyAH prAptuM pitAmaha । nArTanyUnEravaguRErekAtmaBirasaMhatEH ॥3॥

text: yo daridrairapi vidhiḥ śakyaḥ prāptuṃ sadā bhavet । tulyo yajñaphalairetaistanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥4॥
html:
yo daridrairapi vidhiḥ śakyaḥ prāptuṃ sadā bhavet ।
tulyo yajñaphalairetaistanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥4॥
slp1: yo daridrErapi viDiH SakyaH prAptuM sadA Bavet । tulyo yajYaPalEretEstanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥4॥

text: idamaṅgirasā proktamupavāsaphalātmakam । vidhiṃ yajñaphalaistulyaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
html:
idamaṅgirasā proktamupavāsaphalātmakam ।
vidhiṃ yajñaphalaistulyaṃ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
slp1: idamaNgirasA proktamupavAsaPalAtmakam । viDiM yajYaPalEstulyaM tanniboDa yuDizWira ॥5॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yastu kalyaṃ tathā sāyaṃ bhuñjāno nāntarā pibet । ahiṃsānirato nityaṃ juhvāno jātavedasam ॥6॥
html:
yastu kalyaṃ tathā sāyaṃ bhuñjāno nāntarā pibet ।
ahiṃsānirato nityaṃ juhvāno jātavedasam ॥6॥
slp1: yastu kalyaM taTA sAyaM BuYjAno nAntarA pibet । ahiMsAnirato nityaM juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥6॥

text: ṣaḍbhireva tu varṣaiḥ sa sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ । taptakāñcanavarṇaṃ ca vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ ॥7॥
html:
ṣaḍbhireva tu varṣaiḥ sa sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
taptakāñcanavarṇaṃ ca vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ ॥7॥
slp1: zaqBireva tu varzEH sa siDyate nAtra saMSayaH । taptakAYcanavarRaM ca vimAnaM laBate naraH ॥7॥

text: devastrīṇāmadhīvāse nṛtyagītaninādite । prājāpatye vasetpadmaṃ varṣāṇāmagnisaṃnibhe ॥8॥
html:
devastrīṇāmadhīvāse nṛtyagītaninādite ।
prājāpatye vasetpadmaṃ varṣāṇāmagnisaṃnibhe ॥8॥
slp1: devastrIRAmaDIvAse nftyagItaninAdite । prAjApatye vasetpadmaM varzARAmagnisaMniBe ॥8॥

text: trīṇi varṣāṇi yaḥ prāśetsatataṃ tvekabhojanam । dharmapatnīrato nityamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ॥9॥
html:
trīṇi varṣāṇi yaḥ prāśetsatataṃ tvekabhojanam ।
dharmapatnīrato nityamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ॥9॥
slp1: trIRi varzARi yaH prASetsatataM tvekaBojanam । DarmapatnIrato nityamagnizwomaPalaM laBet ॥9॥

text: dvitīye divase yastu prāśnīyādekabhojanam । sadā dvādaśamāsāṃstu juhvāno jātavedasam । yajñaṃ bahusuvarṇaṃ vā vāsavapriyamāharet ॥10॥
html:
dvitīye divase yastu prāśnīyādekabhojanam ।
sadā dvādaśamāsāṃstu juhvāno jātavedasam ।
yajñaṃ bahusuvarṇaṃ vā vāsavapriyamāharet ॥10॥
slp1: dvitIye divase yastu prASnIyAdekaBojanam । sadA dvAdaSamAsAMstu juhvAno jAtavedasam । yajYaM bahusuvarRaM vA vAsavapriyamAharet ॥10॥

text: satyavāgdānaśīlaśca brahmaṇyaścānasūyakaḥ । kṣānto dānto jitakrodhaḥ sa gacchati parāṃ gatim ॥11॥
html:
satyavāgdānaśīlaśca brahmaṇyaścānasūyakaḥ ।
kṣānto dānto jitakrodhaḥ sa gacchati parāṃ gatim ॥11॥
slp1: satyavAgdAnaSIlaSca brahmaRyaScAnasUyakaH । kzAnto dAnto jitakroDaH sa gacCati parAM gatim ॥11॥

text: pāṇḍurābhrapratīkāśe vimāne haṃsalakṣaṇe । dve samāpte tataḥ padme so'psarobhirvasetsaha ॥12॥
html:
pāṇḍurābhrapratīkāśe vimāne haṃsalakṣaṇe ।
dve samāpte tataḥ padme so'psarobhirvasetsaha ॥12॥
slp1: pARqurABrapratIkASe vimAne haMsalakzaRe । dve samApte tataH padme so'psaroBirvasetsaha ॥12॥

text: tṛtīye divase yastu prāśnīyādekabhojanam । sadā dvādaśamāsāṃstu juhvāno jātavedasam ॥13॥
html:
tṛtīye divase yastu prāśnīyādekabhojanam ।
sadā dvādaśamāsāṃstu juhvāno jātavedasam ॥13॥
slp1: tftIye divase yastu prASnIyAdekaBojanam । sadA dvAdaSamAsAMstu juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥13॥

text: atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam । mayūrahaṃsasaṃyuktaṃ vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ ॥14॥
html:
atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ।
mayūrahaṃsasaṃyuktaṃ vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ ॥14॥
slp1: atirAtrasya yajYasya PalaM prApnotyanuttamam । mayUrahaMsasaMyuktaM vimAnaM laBate naraH ॥14॥

text: saptarṣīṇāṃ sadā loke so'psarobhirvasetsaha । nivartanaṃ ca tatrāsya trīṇi padmāni vai viduḥ ॥15॥
html:
saptarṣīṇāṃ sadā loke so'psarobhirvasetsaha ।
nivartanaṃ ca tatrāsya trīṇi padmāni vai viduḥ ॥15॥
slp1: saptarzIRAM sadA loke so'psaroBirvasetsaha । nivartanaM ca tatrAsya trIRi padmAni vE viduH ॥15॥

text: divase yaścaturthe tu prāśnīyādekabhojanam । sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥16॥
html:
divase yaścaturthe tu prāśnīyādekabhojanam ।
sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥16॥
slp1: divase yaScaturTe tu prASnIyAdekaBojanam । sadA dvAdaSamAsAnvE juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥16॥

text: vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam । indrakanyābhirūḍhaṃ ca vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ ॥17॥
html:
vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ।
indrakanyābhirūḍhaṃ ca vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ ॥17॥
slp1: vAjapeyasya yajYasya PalaM prApnotyanuttamam । indrakanyABirUQaM ca vimAnaM laBate naraH ॥17॥

text: sāgarasya ca paryante vāsavaṃ lokamāvaset । devarājasya ca krīḍāṃ nityakālamavekṣate ॥18॥
html:
sāgarasya ca paryante vāsavaṃ lokamāvaset ।
devarājasya ca krīḍāṃ nityakālamavekṣate ॥18॥
slp1: sAgarasya ca paryante vAsavaM lokamAvaset । devarAjasya ca krIqAM nityakAlamavekzate ॥18॥

text: divase pañcame yastu prāśnīyādekabhojanam । sadā dvādaśamāsāṃstu juhvāno jātavedasam ॥19॥
html:
divase pañcame yastu prāśnīyādekabhojanam ।
sadā dvādaśamāsāṃstu juhvāno jātavedasam ॥19॥
slp1: divase paYcame yastu prASnIyAdekaBojanam । sadA dvAdaSamAsAMstu juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥19॥

text: alubdhaḥ satyavādī ca brahmaṇyaścāvihiṃsakaḥ । anasūyurapāpastho dvādaśāhaphalaṃ labhet ॥20॥
html:
alubdhaḥ satyavādī ca brahmaṇyaścāvihiṃsakaḥ ।
anasūyurapāpastho dvādaśāhaphalaṃ labhet ॥20॥
slp1: alubDaH satyavAdI ca brahmaRyaScAvihiMsakaH । anasUyurapApasTo dvAdaSAhaPalaM laBet ॥20॥

text: jāmbūnadamayaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ haṃsalakṣaṇam । sūryamālāsamābhāsamārohetpāṇḍuraṃ gṛham ॥21॥
html:
jāmbūnadamayaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ haṃsalakṣaṇam ।
sūryamālāsamābhāsamārohetpāṇḍuraṃ gṛham ॥21॥
slp1: jAmbUnadamayaM divyaM vimAnaM haMsalakzaRam । sUryamAlAsamABAsamArohetpARquraM gfham ॥21॥

text: āvartanāni catvāri tathā padmāni dvādaśa । śarāgniparimāṇaṃ ca tatrāsau vasate sukham ॥22॥
html:
āvartanāni catvāri tathā padmāni dvādaśa ।
śarāgniparimāṇaṃ ca tatrāsau vasate sukham ॥22॥
slp1: AvartanAni catvAri taTA padmAni dvAdaSa । SarAgniparimARaM ca tatrAsO vasate suKam ॥22॥

text: divase yastu ṣaṣṭhe vai muniḥ prāśeta bhojanam । sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥23॥
html:
divase yastu ṣaṣṭhe vai muniḥ prāśeta bhojanam ।
sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥23॥
slp1: divase yastu zazWe vE muniH prASeta Bojanam । sadA dvAdaSamAsAnvE juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥23॥

text: sadā triṣavaṇasnāyī brahmacāryanasūyakaḥ । gavāmayasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ॥24॥
html:
sadā triṣavaṇasnāyī brahmacāryanasūyakaḥ ।
gavāmayasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ॥24॥
slp1: sadA trizavaRasnAyI brahmacAryanasUyakaH । gavAmayasya yajYasya PalaM prApnotyanuttamam ॥24॥

text: agnijvālāsamābhāsaṃ haṃsabarhiṇasevitam । śātakumbhamayaṃ yuktaṃ sādhayedyānamuttamam ॥25॥
html:
agnijvālāsamābhāsaṃ haṃsabarhiṇasevitam ।
śātakumbhamayaṃ yuktaṃ sādhayedyānamuttamam ॥25॥
slp1: agnijvAlAsamABAsaM haMsabarhiRasevitam । SAtakumBamayaM yuktaM sADayedyAnamuttamam ॥25॥

text: tathaivāpsarasāmaṅke prasuptaḥ pratibudhyate । nūpurāṇāṃ ninādena mekhalānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ ॥26॥
html:
tathaivāpsarasāmaṅke prasuptaḥ pratibudhyate ।
nūpurāṇāṃ ninādena mekhalānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: taTEvApsarasAmaNke prasuptaH pratibuDyate । nUpurARAM ninAdena meKalAnAM ca nisvanEH ॥26॥

text: koṭīsahasraṃ varṣāṇāṃ trīṇi koṭiśatāni ca । padmānyaṣṭādaśa tathā patāke dve tathaiva ca ॥27॥
html:
koṭīsahasraṃ varṣāṇāṃ trīṇi koṭiśatāni ca ।
padmānyaṣṭādaśa tathā patāke dve tathaiva ca ॥27॥
slp1: kowIsahasraM varzARAM trIRi kowiSatAni ca । padmAnyazwAdaSa taTA patAke dve taTEva ca ॥27॥

text: ayutāni ca pañcāśadṛkṣacarmaśatasya ca । lomnāṃ pramāṇena samaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ॥28॥
html:
ayutāni ca pañcāśadṛkṣacarmaśatasya ca ।
lomnāṃ pramāṇena samaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ॥28॥
slp1: ayutAni ca paYcASadfkzacarmaSatasya ca । lomnAM pramARena samaM brahmaloke mahIyate ॥28॥

text: divase saptame yastu prāśnīyādekabhojanam । sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥29॥
html:
divase saptame yastu prāśnīyādekabhojanam ।
sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥29॥
slp1: divase saptame yastu prASnIyAdekaBojanam । sadA dvAdaSamAsAnvE juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥29॥

text: sarasvatīṃ gopayāno brahmacaryaṃ samācaran । sumanovarṇakaṃ caiva madhumāṃsaṃ ca varjayet ॥30॥
html:
sarasvatīṃ gopayāno brahmacaryaṃ samācaran ।
sumanovarṇakaṃ caiva madhumāṃsaṃ ca varjayet ॥30॥
slp1: sarasvatIM gopayAno brahmacaryaM samAcaran । sumanovarRakaM cEva maDumAMsaM ca varjayet ॥30॥

text: puruṣo marutāṃ lokamindralokaṃ ca gacchati । tatra tatra ca siddhārtho devakanyābhiruhyate ॥31॥
html:
puruṣo marutāṃ lokamindralokaṃ ca gacchati ।
tatra tatra ca siddhārtho devakanyābhiruhyate ॥31॥
slp1: puruzo marutAM lokamindralokaM ca gacCati । tatra tatra ca sidDArTo devakanyABiruhyate ॥31॥

text: phalaṃ bahusuvarṇasya yajñasya labhate naraḥ । saṅkhyāmatiguṇāṃ cāpi teṣu lokeṣu modate ॥32॥
html:
phalaṃ bahusuvarṇasya yajñasya labhate naraḥ ।
saṅkhyāmatiguṇāṃ cāpi teṣu lokeṣu modate ॥32॥
slp1: PalaM bahusuvarRasya yajYasya laBate naraH । saNKyAmatiguRAM cApi tezu lokezu modate ॥32॥

text: yastu saṃvatsaraṃ kṣānto bhuṅkte'hanyaṣṭame naraḥ । devakāryaparo nityaṃ juhvāno jātavedasam ॥33॥
html:
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ kṣānto bhuṅkte'hanyaṣṭame naraḥ ।
devakāryaparo nityaṃ juhvāno jātavedasam ॥33॥
slp1: yastu saMvatsaraM kzAnto BuNkte'hanyazwame naraH । devakAryaparo nityaM juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥33॥

text: pauṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam । padmavarṇanibhaṃ caiva vimānamadhirohati ॥34॥
html:
pauṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ।
padmavarṇanibhaṃ caiva vimānamadhirohati ॥34॥
slp1: pORqarIkasya yajYasya PalaM prApnotyanuttamam । padmavarRaniBaM cEva vimAnamaDirohati ॥34॥

text: kṛṣṇāḥ kanakagauryaśca nāryaḥ śyāmāstathāparāḥ । vayorūpavilāsinyo labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥35॥
html:
kṛṣṇāḥ kanakagauryaśca nāryaḥ śyāmāstathāparāḥ ।
vayorūpavilāsinyo labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: kfzRAH kanakagOryaSca nAryaH SyAmAstaTAparAH । vayorUpavilAsinyo laBate nAtra saMSayaH ॥35॥

text: yastu saṃvatsaraṃ bhuṅkte navame navame'hani । sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥36॥
html:
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ bhuṅkte navame navame'hani ।
sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥36॥
slp1: yastu saMvatsaraM BuNkte navame navame'hani । sadA dvAdaSamAsAnvE juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥36॥

text: aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ । puṇḍarīkaprakāśaṃ ca vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ ॥37॥
html:
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ।
puṇḍarīkaprakāśaṃ ca vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ ॥37॥
slp1: aSvameDasya yajYasya PalaM prApnoti mAnavaH । puRqarIkaprakASaM ca vimAnaM laBate naraH ॥37॥

text: dīptasūryāgnitejobhirdivyamālābhireva ca । nīyate rudrakanyābhiḥ so'ntarikṣaṃ sanātanam ॥38॥
html:
dīptasūryāgnitejobhirdivyamālābhireva ca ।
nīyate rudrakanyābhiḥ so'ntarikṣaṃ sanātanam ॥38॥
slp1: dIptasUryAgnitejoBirdivyamAlABireva ca । nIyate rudrakanyABiH so'ntarikzaM sanAtanam ॥38॥

text: aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ kalpameva ca । koṭīśatasahasraṃ ca teṣu lokeṣu modate ॥39॥
html:
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ kalpameva ca ।
koṭīśatasahasraṃ ca teṣu lokeṣu modate ॥39॥
slp1: azwAdaSasahasrARi varzARAM kalpameva ca । kowISatasahasraM ca tezu lokezu modate ॥39॥

text: yastu saṃvatsaraṃ bhuṅkte daśāhe vai gate gate । sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥40॥
html:
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ bhuṅkte daśāhe vai gate gate ।
sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥40॥
slp1: yastu saMvatsaraM BuNkte daSAhe vE gate gate । sadA dvAdaSamAsAnvE juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥40॥

text: brahmakanyāniveśe ca sarvabhūtamanohare । aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ॥41॥
html:
brahmakanyāniveśe ca sarvabhūtamanohare ।
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ॥41॥
slp1: brahmakanyAniveSe ca sarvaBUtamanohare । aSvameDasahasrasya PalaM prApnotyanuttamam ॥41॥

text: rūpavatyaśca taṃ kanyā ramayanti sadā naram । nīlotpalanibhairvarṇai raktotpalanibhaistathā ॥42॥
html:
rūpavatyaśca taṃ kanyā ramayanti sadā naram ।
nīlotpalanibhairvarṇai raktotpalanibhaistathā ॥42॥
slp1: rUpavatyaSca taM kanyA ramayanti sadA naram । nIlotpalaniBErvarRE raktotpalaniBEstaTA ॥42॥

text: vimānaṃ maṇḍalāvartamāvartagahanāvṛtam । sāgarormipratīkāśaṃ sādhayedyānamuttamam ॥43॥
html:
vimānaṃ maṇḍalāvartamāvartagahanāvṛtam ।
sāgarormipratīkāśaṃ sādhayedyānamuttamam ॥43॥
slp1: vimAnaM maRqalAvartamAvartagahanAvftam । sAgarormipratIkASaM sADayedyAnamuttamam ॥43॥

text: vicitramaṇimālābhirnāditaṃ śaṅkhapuṣkaraiḥ । sphāṭikairvajrasāraiśca stambhaiḥ sukṛtavedikam । ārohati mahadyānaṃ haṃsasārasavāhanam ॥44॥
html:
vicitramaṇimālābhirnāditaṃ śaṅkhapuṣkaraiḥ ।
sphāṭikairvajrasāraiśca stambhaiḥ sukṛtavedikam ।
ārohati mahadyānaṃ haṃsasārasavāhanam ॥44॥
slp1: vicitramaRimAlABirnAditaM SaNKapuzkarEH । sPAwikErvajrasArESca stamBEH sukftavedikam । Arohati mahadyAnaM haMsasArasavAhanam ॥44॥

text: ekādaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ । sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥45॥
html:
ekādaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ ।
sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥45॥
slp1: ekAdaSe tu divase yaH prApte prASate haviH । sadA dvAdaSamAsAnvE juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥45॥

text: parastriyo nābhilaṣedvācātha manasāpi vā । anṛtaṃ ca na bhāṣeta mātāpitroḥ kṛte'pi vā ॥46॥
html:
parastriyo nābhilaṣedvācātha manasāpi vā ।
anṛtaṃ ca na bhāṣeta mātāpitroḥ kṛte'pi vā ॥46॥
slp1: parastriyo nABilazedvAcATa manasApi vA । anftaM ca na BAzeta mAtApitroH kfte'pi vA ॥46॥

text: abhigacchenmahādevaṃ vimānasthaṃ mahābalam । svayambhuvaṃ ca paśyeta vimānaṃ samupasthitam ॥47॥
html:
abhigacchenmahādevaṃ vimānasthaṃ mahābalam ।
svayambhuvaṃ ca paśyeta vimānaṃ samupasthitam ॥47॥
slp1: aBigacCenmahAdevaM vimAnasTaM mahAbalam । svayamBuvaM ca paSyeta vimAnaM samupasTitam ॥47॥

text: kumāryaḥ kāñcanābhāsā rūpavatyo nayanti tam । rudrāṇāṃ tamadhīvāsaṃ divi divyaṃ manoharam ॥48॥
html:
kumāryaḥ kāñcanābhāsā rūpavatyo nayanti tam ।
rudrāṇāṃ tamadhīvāsaṃ divi divyaṃ manoharam ॥48॥
slp1: kumAryaH kAYcanABAsA rUpavatyo nayanti tam । rudrARAM tamaDIvAsaM divi divyaM manoharam ॥48॥

text: varṣāṇyaparimeyāni yugāntamapi cāvaset । koṭīśatasahasraṃ ca daśa koṭiśatāni ca ॥49॥
html:
varṣāṇyaparimeyāni yugāntamapi cāvaset ।
koṭīśatasahasraṃ ca daśa koṭiśatāni ca ॥49॥
slp1: varzARyaparimeyAni yugAntamapi cAvaset । kowISatasahasraM ca daSa kowiSatAni ca ॥49॥

text: rudraṃ nityaṃ praṇamate devadānavasammatam । sa tasmai darśanaṃ prāpto divase divase bhavet ॥50॥
html:
rudraṃ nityaṃ praṇamate devadānavasammatam ।
sa tasmai darśanaṃ prāpto divase divase bhavet ॥50॥
slp1: rudraM nityaM praRamate devadAnavasammatam । sa tasmE darSanaM prApto divase divase Bavet ॥50॥

text: divase dvādaśe yastu prāpte vai prāśate haviḥ । sadā dvādaśamāsānvai sarvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥51॥
html:
divase dvādaśe yastu prāpte vai prāśate haviḥ ।
sadā dvādaśamāsānvai sarvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥51॥
slp1: divase dvAdaSe yastu prApte vE prASate haviH । sadA dvAdaSamAsAnvE sarvameDaPalaM laBet ॥51॥

text: ādityairdvādaśaistasya vimānaṃ saṃvidhīyate । maṇimuktāpravālaiśca mahārhairupaśobhitam ॥52॥
html:
ādityairdvādaśaistasya vimānaṃ saṃvidhīyate ।
maṇimuktāpravālaiśca mahārhairupaśobhitam ॥52॥
slp1: AdityErdvAdaSEstasya vimAnaM saMviDIyate । maRimuktApravAlESca mahArhErupaSoBitam ॥52॥

text: haṃsamālāparikṣiptaṃ nāgavīthīsamākulam । mayūraiścakravākaiśca kūjadbhirupaśobhitam ॥53॥
html:
haṃsamālāparikṣiptaṃ nāgavīthīsamākulam ।
mayūraiścakravākaiśca kūjadbhirupaśobhitam ॥53॥
slp1: haMsamAlAparikziptaM nAgavITIsamAkulam । mayUrEScakravAkESca kUjadBirupaSoBitam ॥53॥

text: aṭṭairmahadbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ brahmaloke pratiṣṭhitam । nityamāvasate rājannaranārīsamāvṛtam । ṛṣirevaṃ mahābhāgastvaṅgirāḥ prāha dharmavit ॥54॥
html:
aṭṭairmahadbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ brahmaloke pratiṣṭhitam ।
nityamāvasate rājannaranārīsamāvṛtam ।
ṛṣirevaṃ mahābhāgastvaṅgirāḥ prāha dharmavit ॥54॥
slp1: awwErmahadBiH saMyuktaM brahmaloke pratizWitam । nityamAvasate rAjannaranArIsamAvftam । fzirevaM mahABAgastvaNgirAH prAha Darmavit ॥54॥

text: trayodaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ । sadā dvādaśa māsānvai devasatraphalaṃ labhet ॥55॥
html:
trayodaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ ।
sadā dvādaśa māsānvai devasatraphalaṃ labhet ॥55॥
slp1: trayodaSe tu divase yaH prApte prASate haviH । sadA dvAdaSa mAsAnvE devasatraPalaM laBet ॥55॥

text: raktapadmodayaṃ nāma vimānaṃ sādhayennaraḥ । jātarūpaprayuktaṃ ca ratnasañcayabhūṣitam ॥56॥
html:
raktapadmodayaṃ nāma vimānaṃ sādhayennaraḥ ।
jātarūpaprayuktaṃ ca ratnasañcayabhūṣitam ॥56॥
slp1: raktapadmodayaM nAma vimAnaM sADayennaraH । jAtarUpaprayuktaM ca ratnasaYcayaBUzitam ॥56॥

text: devakanyābhirākīrṇaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitam । puṇyagandhodayaṃ divyaṃ vāyavyairupaśobhitam ॥57॥
html:
devakanyābhirākīrṇaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitam ।
puṇyagandhodayaṃ divyaṃ vāyavyairupaśobhitam ॥57॥
slp1: devakanyABirAkIrRaM divyABaraRaBUzitam । puRyaganDodayaM divyaM vAyavyErupaSoBitam ॥57॥

text: tatra śaṅkupatākaṃ ca yugāntaṃ kalpameva ca । ayutāyutaṃ tathā padmaṃ samudraṃ ca tathā vaset ॥58॥
html:
tatra śaṅkupatākaṃ ca yugāntaṃ kalpameva ca ।
ayutāyutaṃ tathā padmaṃ samudraṃ ca tathā vaset ॥58॥
slp1: tatra SaNkupatAkaM ca yugAntaM kalpameva ca । ayutAyutaM taTA padmaM samudraM ca taTA vaset ॥58॥

text: gītagandharvaghoṣaiśca bherīpaṇavanisvanaiḥ । sadā pramuditastābhirdevakanyābhirīḍyate ॥59॥
html:
gītagandharvaghoṣaiśca bherīpaṇavanisvanaiḥ ।
sadā pramuditastābhirdevakanyābhirīḍyate ॥59॥
slp1: gItaganDarvaGozESca BerIpaRavanisvanEH । sadA pramuditastABirdevakanyABirIqyate ॥59॥

text: caturdaśe tu divase yaḥ pūrṇe prāśate haviḥ । sadā dvādaśa māsānvai mahāmedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥60॥
html:
caturdaśe tu divase yaḥ pūrṇe prāśate haviḥ ।
sadā dvādaśa māsānvai mahāmedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥60॥
slp1: caturdaSe tu divase yaH pUrRe prASate haviH । sadA dvAdaSa mAsAnvE mahAmeDaPalaM laBet ॥60॥

text: anirdeśyavayorūpā devakanyāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ । mṛṣṭataptāṅgadadharā vimānairanuyānti tam ॥61॥
html:
anirdeśyavayorūpā devakanyāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ ।
mṛṣṭataptāṅgadadharā vimānairanuyānti tam ॥61॥
slp1: anirdeSyavayorUpA devakanyAH svalaNkftAH । mfzwataptANgadaDarA vimAnEranuyAnti tam ॥61॥

text: kalahaṃsavinirghoṣairnūpurāṇāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ । kāñcīnāṃ ca samutkarṣaistatra tatra vibodhyate ॥62॥
html:
kalahaṃsavinirghoṣairnūpurāṇāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ ।
kāñcīnāṃ ca samutkarṣaistatra tatra vibodhyate ॥62॥
slp1: kalahaMsavinirGozErnUpurARAM ca nisvanEH । kAYcInAM ca samutkarzEstatra tatra viboDyate ॥62॥

text: devakanyānivāse ca tasminvasati mānavaḥ । jāhnavīvālukākīrṇe pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ ॥63॥
html:
devakanyānivāse ca tasminvasati mānavaḥ ।
jāhnavīvālukākīrṇe pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ ॥63॥
slp1: devakanyAnivAse ca tasminvasati mAnavaH । jAhnavIvAlukAkIrRe pUrRaM saMvatsaraM naraH ॥63॥

text: yastu pakṣe gate bhuṅkte ekabhaktaṃ jitendriyaḥ । sadā dādaśa māsāṃstu juhvāno jātavedasam । rājasūyasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ॥64॥
html:
yastu pakṣe gate bhuṅkte ekabhaktaṃ jitendriyaḥ ।
sadā dādaśa māsāṃstu juhvāno jātavedasam ।
rājasūyasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam ॥64॥
slp1: yastu pakze gate BuNkte ekaBaktaM jitendriyaH । sadA dAdaSa mAsAMstu juhvAno jAtavedasam । rAjasUyasahasrasya PalaM prApnotyanuttamam ॥64॥

text: yānamārohate nityaṃ haṃsabarhiṇasevitam । maṇimaṇḍalakaiścitraṃ jātarūpasamāvṛtam ॥65॥
html:
yānamārohate nityaṃ haṃsabarhiṇasevitam ।
maṇimaṇḍalakaiścitraṃ jātarūpasamāvṛtam ॥65॥
slp1: yAnamArohate nityaM haMsabarhiRasevitam । maRimaRqalakEScitraM jAtarUpasamAvftam ॥65॥

text: divyābharaṇaśobhābhirvarastrībhiralaṅkṛtam । ekastambhaṃ caturdvāraṃ saptabhaumaṃ sumaṅgalam । vaijayantīsahasraiśca śobhitaṃ gītanisvanaiḥ ॥66॥
html:
divyābharaṇaśobhābhirvarastrībhiralaṅkṛtam ।
ekastambhaṃ caturdvāraṃ saptabhaumaṃ sumaṅgalam ।
vaijayantīsahasraiśca śobhitaṃ gītanisvanaiḥ ॥66॥
slp1: divyABaraRaSoBABirvarastrIBiralaNkftam । ekastamBaM caturdvAraM saptaBOmaM sumaNgalam । vEjayantIsahasrESca SoBitaM gItanisvanEH ॥66॥

text: divyaṃ divyaguṇopetaṃ vimānamadhirohati । maṇimuktāpravālaiśca bhūṣitaṃ vaidyutaprabham । vasedyugasahasraṃ ca khaḍgakuñjaravāhanaḥ ॥67॥
html:
divyaṃ divyaguṇopetaṃ vimānamadhirohati ।
maṇimuktāpravālaiśca bhūṣitaṃ vaidyutaprabham ।
vasedyugasahasraṃ ca khaḍgakuñjaravāhanaḥ ॥67॥
slp1: divyaM divyaguRopetaM vimAnamaDirohati । maRimuktApravAlESca BUzitaM vEdyutapraBam । vasedyugasahasraM ca KaqgakuYjaravAhanaH ॥67॥

text: ṣoḍaśe divase yastu samprāpte prāśate haviḥ । sadā dvādaśa māsānvai somayajñaphalaṃ labhet ॥68॥
html:
ṣoḍaśe divase yastu samprāpte prāśate haviḥ ।
sadā dvādaśa māsānvai somayajñaphalaṃ labhet ॥68॥
slp1: zoqaSe divase yastu samprApte prASate haviH । sadA dvAdaSa mAsAnvE somayajYaPalaM laBet ॥68॥

text: somakanyānivāseṣu so'dhyāvasati nityadā । saumyagandhānuliptaśca kāmacāragatirbhavet ॥69॥
html:
somakanyānivāseṣu so'dhyāvasati nityadā ।
saumyagandhānuliptaśca kāmacāragatirbhavet ॥69॥
slp1: somakanyAnivAsezu so'DyAvasati nityadA । sOmyaganDAnuliptaSca kAmacAragatirBavet ॥69॥

text: sudarśanābhirnārībhirmadhurābhistathaiva ca । arcyate vai vimānasthaḥ kāmabhogaiśca sevyate ॥70॥
html:
sudarśanābhirnārībhirmadhurābhistathaiva ca ।
arcyate vai vimānasthaḥ kāmabhogaiśca sevyate ॥70॥
slp1: sudarSanABirnArIBirmaDurABistaTEva ca । arcyate vE vimAnasTaH kAmaBogESca sevyate ॥70॥

text: phalaṃ padmaśataprakhyaṃ mahākalpaṃ daśādhikam । āvartanāni catvāri sāgare yātyasau naraḥ ॥71॥
html:
phalaṃ padmaśataprakhyaṃ mahākalpaṃ daśādhikam ।
āvartanāni catvāri sāgare yātyasau naraḥ ॥71॥
slp1: PalaM padmaSatapraKyaM mahAkalpaM daSADikam । AvartanAni catvAri sAgare yAtyasO naraH ॥71॥

text: divase saptadaśame yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ । sadā dvādaśa māsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥72॥
html:
divase saptadaśame yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ ।
sadā dvādaśa māsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam ॥72॥
slp1: divase saptadaSame yaH prApte prASate haviH । sadA dvAdaSa mAsAnvE juhvAno jAtavedasam ॥72॥

text: sthānaṃ vāruṇamaindraṃ ca raudraṃ caivādhigacchati । mārutauśanase caiva brahmalokaṃ ca gacchati ॥73॥
html:
sthānaṃ vāruṇamaindraṃ ca raudraṃ caivādhigacchati ।
mārutauśanase caiva brahmalokaṃ ca gacchati ॥73॥
slp1: sTAnaM vAruRamEndraM ca rOdraM cEvADigacCati । mArutOSanase cEva brahmalokaM ca gacCati ॥73॥

text: tatra daivatakanyābhirāsanenopacaryate । bhūrbhuvaṃ cāpi devarṣiṃ viśvarūpamavekṣate ॥74॥
html:
tatra daivatakanyābhirāsanenopacaryate ।
bhūrbhuvaṃ cāpi devarṣiṃ viśvarūpamavekṣate ॥74॥
slp1: tatra dEvatakanyABirAsanenopacaryate । BUrBuvaM cApi devarziM viSvarUpamavekzate ॥74॥

divyo divyena vapuṣā bhrājamāna ivāmaraḥ ॥119॥
slp1: BogavAMstejasA yukto vESvAnarasamapraBaH । divyo divyena vapuzA BrAjamAna ivAmaraH ॥119॥

text: vasūnāṃ marutāṃ caiva sādhyānāmaśvinostathā । rudrāṇāṃ ca tathā lokānbrahmalokaṃ ca gacchati ॥120॥
html:
vasūnāṃ marutāṃ caiva sādhyānāmaśvinostathā ।
rudrāṇāṃ ca tathā lokānbrahmalokaṃ ca gacchati ॥120॥
slp1: vasUnAM marutAM cEva sADyAnAmaSvinostaTA । rudrARAM ca taTA lokAnbrahmalokaM ca gacCati ॥120॥

text: yastu māse gate bhuṅkte ekabhaktaṃ śamātmakaḥ । sadā dvādaśa māsānvai brahmalokamavāpnuyāt ॥121॥
html:
yastu māse gate bhuṅkte ekabhaktaṃ śamātmakaḥ ।
sadā dvādaśa māsānvai brahmalokamavāpnuyāt ॥121॥
slp1: yastu mAse gate BuNkte ekaBaktaM SamAtmakaH । sadA dvAdaSa mAsAnvE brahmalokamavApnuyAt ॥121॥

text: sudhārasakṛtāhāraḥ śrīmānsarvamanoharaḥ । tejasā vapuṣā lakṣmyā bhrājate raśmivāniva ॥122॥
html:
sudhārasakṛtāhāraḥ śrīmānsarvamanoharaḥ ।
tejasā vapuṣā lakṣmyā bhrājate raśmivāniva ॥122॥
slp1: suDArasakftAhAraH SrImAnsarvamanoharaH । tejasA vapuzA lakzmyA BrAjate raSmivAniva ॥122॥

text: divyamālyāmbaradharo divyagandhānulepanaḥ । sukheṣvabhirato yogī duḥkhānāmavijānakaḥ ॥123॥
html:
divyamālyāmbaradharo divyagandhānulepanaḥ ।
sukheṣvabhirato yogī duḥkhānāmavijānakaḥ ॥123॥
slp1: divyamAlyAmbaraDaro divyaganDAnulepanaH । suKezvaBirato yogI duHKAnAmavijAnakaH ॥123॥

text: svayamprabhābhirnārībhirvimānastho mahīyate । rudradevarṣikanyābhiḥ satataṃ cābhipūjyate ॥124॥
html:
svayamprabhābhirnārībhirvimānastho mahīyate ।
rudradevarṣikanyābhiḥ satataṃ cābhipūjyate ॥124॥
slp1: svayampraBABirnArIBirvimAnasTo mahIyate । rudradevarzikanyABiH satataM cABipUjyate ॥124॥

text: nānāvidhasurūpābhirnānārāgābhireva ca । nānāmadhurabhāṣābhirnānāratibhireva ca ॥125॥
html:
nānāvidhasurūpābhirnānārāgābhireva ca ।
nānāmadhurabhāṣābhirnānāratibhireva ca ॥125॥
slp1: nAnAviDasurUpABirnAnArAgABireva ca । nAnAmaDuraBAzABirnAnAratiBireva ca ॥125॥

text: vimāne nagarākāre sūryavatsūryasannibhe । pṛṣṭhataḥ somasaṅkāśe udakcaivābhrasannibhe ॥126॥
html:
vimāne nagarākāre sūryavatsūryasannibhe ।
pṛṣṭhataḥ somasaṅkāśe udakcaivābhrasannibhe ॥126॥
slp1: vimAne nagarAkAre sUryavatsUryasanniBe । pfzWataH somasaNkASe udakcEvABrasanniBe ॥126॥

text: dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu raktābhe adhastānnīlamaṇḍale । ūrdhvaṃ citrābhisaṅkāśe naiko vasati pūjitaḥ ॥127॥
html:
dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu raktābhe adhastānnīlamaṇḍale ।
ūrdhvaṃ citrābhisaṅkāśe naiko vasati pūjitaḥ ॥127॥
slp1: dakziRAyAM tu raktABe aDastAnnIlamaRqale । UrDvaM citrABisaNkASe nEko vasati pUjitaH ॥127॥

text: yāvadvarṣasahasraṃ tu jambūdvīpe pravarṣati । tāvatsaṃvatsarāḥ proktā brahmalokasya dhīmataḥ ॥128॥
html:
yāvadvarṣasahasraṃ tu jambūdvīpe pravarṣati ।
tāvatsaṃvatsarāḥ proktā brahmalokasya dhīmataḥ ॥128॥
slp1: yAvadvarzasahasraM tu jambUdvIpe pravarzati । tAvatsaMvatsarAH proktA brahmalokasya DImataH ॥128॥

text: vipruṣaścaiva yāvantyo nipatanti nabhastalāt । varṣāsu varṣatastāvannivasatyamaraprabhaḥ ॥129॥
html:
vipruṣaścaiva yāvantyo nipatanti nabhastalāt ।
varṣāsu varṣatastāvannivasatyamaraprabhaḥ ॥129॥
slp1: vipruzaScEva yAvantyo nipatanti naBastalAt । varzAsu varzatastAvannivasatyamarapraBaH ॥129॥

text: māsopavāsī varṣaistu daśabhiḥ svargamuttamam । maharṣitvamathāsādya saśarīragatirbhavet ॥130॥
html:
māsopavāsī varṣaistu daśabhiḥ svargamuttamam ।
maharṣitvamathāsādya saśarīragatirbhavet ॥130॥
slp1: mAsopavAsI varzEstu daSaBiH svargamuttamam । maharzitvamaTAsAdya saSarIragatirBavet ॥130॥

text: munirdānto jitakrodho jitaśiśnodaraḥ sadā । juhvannagnīṃśca niyataḥ sandhyopāsanasevitā ॥131॥
html:
munirdānto jitakrodho jitaśiśnodaraḥ sadā ।
juhvannagnīṃśca niyataḥ sandhyopāsanasevitā ॥131॥
slp1: munirdAnto jitakroDo jitaSiSnodaraH sadA । juhvannagnIMSca niyataH sanDyopAsanasevitA ॥131॥

text: bahubhirniyamairevaṃ māsānaśnāti yo naraḥ । abhrāvakāśaśīlaśca tasya vāso nirucyate ॥132॥
html:
bahubhirniyamairevaṃ māsānaśnāti yo naraḥ ।
abhrāvakāśaśīlaśca tasya vāso nirucyate ॥132॥
slp1: bahuBirniyamErevaM mAsAnaSnAti yo naraH । aBrAvakASaSIlaSca tasya vAso nirucyate ॥132॥

text: divaṃ gatvā śarīreṇa svena rājanyathāmaraḥ । svargaṃ puṇyaṃ yathākāmamupabhuṅkte yathāvidhi ॥133॥
html:
divaṃ gatvā śarīreṇa svena rājanyathāmaraḥ ।
svargaṃ puṇyaṃ yathākāmamupabhuṅkte yathāvidhi ॥133॥
slp1: divaM gatvA SarIreRa svena rAjanyaTAmaraH । svargaM puRyaM yaTAkAmamupaBuNkte yaTAviDi ॥133॥

text: eṣa te bharataśreṣṭha yajñānāṃ vidhiruttamaḥ । vyākhyāto hyānupūrvyeṇa upavāsaphalātmakaḥ ॥134॥
html:
eṣa te bharataśreṣṭha yajñānāṃ vidhiruttamaḥ ।
vyākhyāto hyānupūrvyeṇa upavāsaphalātmakaḥ ॥134॥
slp1: eza te BarataSrezWa yajYAnAM viDiruttamaH । vyAKyAto hyAnupUrvyeRa upavAsaPalAtmakaH ॥134॥

text: daridrairmanujaiḥ pārtha prāpyaṃ yajñaphalaṃ yathā । upavāsamimaṃ kṛtvā gacchecca paramāṃ gatim । devadvijātipūjāyāṃ rato bharatasattama ॥135॥
html:
daridrairmanujaiḥ pārtha prāpyaṃ yajñaphalaṃ yathā ।
upavāsamimaṃ kṛtvā gacchecca paramāṃ gatim ।
devadvijātipūjāyāṃ rato bharatasattama ॥135॥
slp1: daridrErmanujEH pArTa prApyaM yajYaPalaM yaTA । upavAsamimaM kftvA gacCecca paramAM gatim । devadvijAtipUjAyAM rato Baratasattama ॥135॥

text: upavāsavidhistveṣa vistareṇa prakīrtitaḥ । niyateṣvapramatteṣu śaucavatsu mahātmasu ॥136॥
html:
upavāsavidhistveṣa vistareṇa prakīrtitaḥ ।
niyateṣvapramatteṣu śaucavatsu mahātmasu ॥136॥
slp1: upavAsaviDistveza vistareRa prakIrtitaH । niyatezvapramattezu SOcavatsu mahAtmasu ॥136॥

text: dambhadrohanivṛtteṣu kṛtabuddhiṣu bhārata । acaleṣvaprakampeṣu mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ] ॥137॥
html:
dambhadrohanivṛtteṣu kṛtabuddhiṣu bhārata ।
acaleṣvaprakampeṣu mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ] ॥137॥
slp1: damBadrohanivfttezu kftabudDizu BArata । acalezvaprakampezu mA te BUdatra saMSayaH] ॥137॥

text: yadvaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ tadbravīhi pitāmaha । yatra vai paramaṃ śaucaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
html:
yadvaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ tadbravīhi pitāmaha ।
yatra vai paramaṃ śaucaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
slp1: yadvaraM sarvatIrTAnAM tadbravIhi pitAmaha । yatra vE paramaM SOcaM tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sarvāṇi khalu tīrthāni guṇavanti manīṣiṇām । yattu tīrthaṃ ca śaucaṃ ca tanme śṛṇu samāhitaḥ ॥2॥
html:
sarvāṇi khalu tīrthāni guṇavanti manīṣiṇām ।
yattu tīrthaṃ ca śaucaṃ ca tanme śṛṇu samāhitaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: sarvARi Kalu tIrTAni guRavanti manIziRAm । yattu tIrTaM ca SOcaM ca tanme SfRu samAhitaH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: agādhe vimale śuddhe satyatoye dhṛtihrade । snātavyaṃ mānase tīrthe sattvamālambya śāśvatam ॥3॥
html:
agādhe vimale śuddhe satyatoye dhṛtihrade ।
snātavyaṃ mānase tīrthe sattvamālambya śāśvatam ॥3॥
slp1: agADe vimale SudDe satyatoye Dftihrade । snAtavyaM mAnase tIrTe sattvamAlambya SASvatam ॥3॥

text: tīrthaśaucamanarthitvamārdavaṃ satyamārjavam । ahiṃsā sarvabhūtānāmānṛśaṃsyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ ॥4॥
html:
tīrthaśaucamanarthitvamārdavaṃ satyamārjavam ।
ahiṃsā sarvabhūtānāmānṛśaṃsyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tIrTaSOcamanarTitvamArdavaM satyamArjavam । ahiMsA sarvaBUtAnAmAnfSaMsyaM damaH SamaH ॥4॥

text: nirmamā nirahaṅkārā nirdvandvā niṣparigrahāḥ । śucayastīrthabhūtāste ye bhaikṣamupabhuñjate ॥5॥
html:
nirmamā nirahaṅkārā nirdvandvā niṣparigrahāḥ ।
śucayastīrthabhūtāste ye bhaikṣamupabhuñjate ॥5॥
