slp1: nirmamA nirahaNkArA nirdvandvA nizparigrahAH । SucayastIrTaBUtAste ye BEkzamupaBuYjate ॥5॥

text: tattvavittvanahambuddhistīrthaṃ paramamucyate । śaucalakṣaṇametatte sarvatraivānvavekṣaṇam ॥6॥
html:
tattvavittvanahambuddhistīrthaṃ paramamucyate ।
śaucalakṣaṇametatte sarvatraivānvavekṣaṇam ॥6॥
slp1: tattvavittvanahambudDistIrTaM paramamucyate । SOcalakzaRametatte sarvatrEvAnvavekzaRam ॥6॥

text: rajastamaḥ sattvamatho yeṣāṃ nirdhautamātmanaḥ । śaucāśauce na te saktāḥ svakāryaparimārgiṇaḥ ॥7॥
html:
rajastamaḥ sattvamatho yeṣāṃ nirdhautamātmanaḥ ।
śaucāśauce na te saktāḥ svakāryaparimārgiṇaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: rajastamaH sattvamaTo yezAM nirDOtamAtmanaH । SOcASOce na te saktAH svakAryaparimArgiRaH ॥7॥

text: sarvatyāgeṣvabhiratāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ । śaucena vṛttaśaucārthāste tīrthāḥ śucayaśca te ॥8॥
html:
sarvatyāgeṣvabhiratāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ ।
śaucena vṛttaśaucārthāste tīrthāḥ śucayaśca te ॥8॥
slp1: sarvatyAgezvaBiratAH sarvajYAH sarvadarSinaH । SOcena vfttaSOcArTAste tIrTAH SucayaSca te ॥8॥

text: nodakaklinnagātrastu snāta ityabhidhīyate । sa snāto yo damasnātaḥ sabāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ ॥9॥
html:
nodakaklinnagātrastu snāta ityabhidhīyate ।
sa snāto yo damasnātaḥ sabāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ ॥9॥
slp1: nodakaklinnagAtrastu snAta ityaBiDIyate । sa snAto yo damasnAtaH sabAhyAByantaraH SuciH ॥9॥

text: atīteṣvanapekṣā ye prāpteṣvartheṣu nirmamāḥ । śaucameva paraṃ teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ notpadyate spṛhā ॥10॥
html:
atīteṣvanapekṣā ye prāpteṣvartheṣu nirmamāḥ ।
śaucameva paraṃ teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ notpadyate spṛhā ॥10॥
slp1: atItezvanapekzA ye prAptezvarTezu nirmamAH । SOcameva paraM tezAM yezAM notpadyate spfhA ॥10॥

text: prajñānaṃ śaucameveha śarīrasya viśeṣataḥ । tathā niṣkiñcanatvaṃ ca manasaśca prasannatā ॥11॥
html:
prajñānaṃ śaucameveha śarīrasya viśeṣataḥ ।
tathā niṣkiñcanatvaṃ ca manasaśca prasannatā ॥11॥
slp1: prajYAnaM SOcameveha SarIrasya viSezataH । taTA nizkiYcanatvaM ca manasaSca prasannatA ॥11॥

text: vṛttaśaucaṃ manaḥśaucaṃ tīrthaśaucaṃ paraṃ hitam । jñānotpannaṃ ca yacchaucaṃ tacchaucaṃ paramaṃ matam ॥12॥
html:
vṛttaśaucaṃ manaḥśaucaṃ tīrthaśaucaṃ paraṃ hitam ।
jñānotpannaṃ ca yacchaucaṃ tacchaucaṃ paramaṃ matam ॥12॥
slp1: vfttaSOcaM manaHSOcaM tIrTaSOcaM paraM hitam । jYAnotpannaM ca yacCOcaM tacCOcaM paramaM matam ॥12॥

text: manasātha pradīpena brahmajñānabalena ca । snātā ye mānase tīrthe tajjñāḥ kṣetrajñadarśinaḥ ॥13॥
html:
manasātha pradīpena brahmajñānabalena ca ।
snātā ye mānase tīrthe tajjñāḥ kṣetrajñadarśinaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: manasATa pradIpena brahmajYAnabalena ca । snAtA ye mAnase tIrTe tajjYAH kzetrajYadarSinaH ॥13॥

text: samāropitaśaucastu nityaṃ bhāvasamanvitaḥ । kevalaṃ guṇasampannaḥ śucireva naraḥ sadā ॥14॥
html:
samāropitaśaucastu nityaṃ bhāvasamanvitaḥ ।
kevalaṃ guṇasampannaḥ śucireva naraḥ sadā ॥14॥
slp1: samAropitaSOcastu nityaM BAvasamanvitaH । kevalaM guRasampannaH Sucireva naraH sadA ॥14॥

text: śarīrasthāni tīrthāni proktānyetāni bhārata । pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyāni śṛṇu tānyapi ॥15॥
html:
śarīrasthāni tīrthāni proktānyetāni bhārata ।
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyāni śṛṇu tānyapi ॥15॥
slp1: SarIrasTAni tIrTAni proktAnyetAni BArata । pfTivyAM yAni tIrTAni puRyAni SfRu tAnyapi ॥15॥

text: yathā śarīrasyoddeśāḥ śucayaḥ parinirmitāḥ । tathā pṛthivyā bhāgāśca puṇyāni salilāni ca ॥16॥
html:
yathā śarīrasyoddeśāḥ śucayaḥ parinirmitāḥ ।
tathā pṛthivyā bhāgāśca puṇyāni salilāni ca ॥16॥
slp1: yaTA SarIrasyoddeSAH SucayaH parinirmitAH । taTA pfTivyA BAgASca puRyAni salilAni ca ॥16॥

text: prārthanāccaiva tīrthasya snānācca pitṛtarpaṇāt । dhunanti pāpaṃ tīrtheṣu pūtā yānti divaṃ sukham ॥17॥
html:
prārthanāccaiva tīrthasya snānācca pitṛtarpaṇāt ।
dhunanti pāpaṃ tīrtheṣu pūtā yānti divaṃ sukham ॥17॥
slp1: prArTanAccEva tIrTasya snAnAcca pitftarpaRAt । Dunanti pApaM tIrTezu pUtA yAnti divaM suKam ॥17॥

text: parigrahācca sādhūnāṃ pṛthivyāścaiva tejasā । atīva puṇyāste bhāgāḥ salilasya ca tejasā ॥18॥
html:
parigrahācca sādhūnāṃ pṛthivyāścaiva tejasā ।
atīva puṇyāste bhāgāḥ salilasya ca tejasā ॥18॥
slp1: parigrahAcca sADUnAM pfTivyAScEva tejasA । atIva puRyAste BAgAH salilasya ca tejasA ॥18॥

text: manasaśca pṛthivyāśca puṇyatīrthāstathāpare । ubhayoreva yaḥ snātaḥ sa siddhiṃ śīghramāpnuyāt ॥19॥
html:
manasaśca pṛthivyāśca puṇyatīrthāstathāpare ।
ubhayoreva yaḥ snātaḥ sa siddhiṃ śīghramāpnuyāt ॥19॥
slp1: manasaSca pfTivyASca puRyatIrTAstaTApare । uBayoreva yaH snAtaH sa sidDiM SIGramApnuyAt ॥19॥

text: yathā balaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ kriyā vā balavarjitā । neha sādhayate kāryaṃ samāyuktastu sidhyati ॥20॥
html:
yathā balaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ kriyā vā balavarjitā ।
neha sādhayate kāryaṃ samāyuktastu sidhyati ॥20॥
slp1: yaTA balaM kriyAhInaM kriyA vA balavarjitA । neha sADayate kAryaM samAyuktastu siDyati ॥20॥

text: evaṃ śarīraśaucena tīrthaśaucena cānvitaḥ । tataḥ siddhimavāpnoti dvividhaṃ śaucamuttamam] ॥21॥
html:
evaṃ śarīraśaucena tīrthaśaucena cānvitaḥ ।
tataḥ siddhimavāpnoti dvividhaṃ śaucamuttamam] ॥21॥
slp1: evaM SarIraSOcena tIrTaSOcena cAnvitaH । tataH sidDimavApnoti dviviDaM SOcamuttamam] ॥21॥

text: pitāmaha mahābāho sarvaśāstraviśārada । śrotumicchāmi martyānāṃ saṃsāravidhimuttamam ॥1॥
html:
pitāmaha mahābāho sarvaśāstraviśārada ।
śrotumicchāmi martyānāṃ saṃsāravidhimuttamam ॥1॥
slp1: pitAmaha mahAbAho sarvaSAstraviSArada । SrotumicCAmi martyAnAM saMsAraviDimuttamam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kena vṛttena rājendra vartamānā narā yudhi । prāpnuvantyuttamaṃ svargaṃ kathaṃ ca narakaṃ nṛpa ॥2॥
html:
kena vṛttena rājendra vartamānā narā yudhi ।
prāpnuvantyuttamaṃ svargaṃ kathaṃ ca narakaṃ nṛpa ॥2॥
slp1: kena vfttena rAjendra vartamAnA narA yuDi । prApnuvantyuttamaM svargaM kaTaM ca narakaM nfpa ॥2॥

text: mṛtaṃ śarīramutsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ janāḥ । prayāntyamuṃ lokamitaḥ ko vai tānanugacchati ॥3॥
html:
mṛtaṃ śarīramutsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ janāḥ ।
prayāntyamuṃ lokamitaḥ ko vai tānanugacchati ॥3॥
slp1: mftaM SarIramutsfjya kAzWalozwasamaM janAH । prayAntyamuM lokamitaH ko vE tAnanugacCati ॥3॥

text: asāvāyāti bhagavānbṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ । pṛcchainaṃ sumahābhāgametadguhyaṃ sanātanam ॥4॥
html:
asāvāyāti bhagavānbṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ।
pṛcchainaṃ sumahābhāgametadguhyaṃ sanātanam ॥4॥
slp1: asAvAyAti BagavAnbfhaspatirudAraDIH । pfcCEnaM sumahABAgametadguhyaM sanAtanam ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: naitadanyena śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ kenacidadya vai । vaktā bṛhaspatisamo na hyanyo vidyate kvacit ॥5॥
html:
naitadanyena śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ kenacidadya vai ।
vaktā bṛhaspatisamo na hyanyo vidyate kvacit ॥5॥
slp1: nEtadanyena SakyaM hi vaktuM kenacidadya vE । vaktA bfhaspatisamo na hyanyo vidyate kvacit ॥5॥

text: tayoḥ saṃvadatorevaṃ pārthagāṅgeyayostadā । ājagāma viśuddhātmā bhagavānsa bṛhaspatiḥ ॥6॥
html:
tayoḥ saṃvadatorevaṃ pārthagāṅgeyayostadā ।
ājagāma viśuddhātmā bhagavānsa bṛhaspatiḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tayoH saMvadatorevaM pArTagANgeyayostadA । AjagAma viSudDAtmA BagavAnsa bfhaspatiH ॥6॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tato rājā samutthāya dhṛtarāṣṭrapurogamaḥ । pūjāmanupamāṃ cakre sarve te ca sabhāsadaḥ ॥7॥
html:
tato rājā samutthāya dhṛtarāṣṭrapurogamaḥ ।
pūjāmanupamāṃ cakre sarve te ca sabhāsadaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: tato rAjA samutTAya DftarAzwrapurogamaH । pUjAmanupamAM cakre sarve te ca saBAsadaH ॥7॥

text: tato dharmasuto rājā bhagavantaṃ bṛhaspatim । upagamya yathānyāyaṃ praśnaṃ papraccha suvrataḥ ॥8॥
html:
tato dharmasuto rājā bhagavantaṃ bṛhaspatim ।
upagamya yathānyāyaṃ praśnaṃ papraccha suvrataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tato Darmasuto rAjA BagavantaM bfhaspatim । upagamya yaTAnyAyaM praSnaM papracCa suvrataH ॥8॥

text: bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada । martyasya kaḥ sahāyo vai pitā mātā suto guruḥ ॥9॥
html:
bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada ।
martyasya kaḥ sahāyo vai pitā mātā suto guruḥ ॥9॥
slp1: BagavansarvaDarmajYa sarvaSAstraviSArada । martyasya kaH sahAyo vE pitA mAtA suto guruH ॥9॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mṛtaṃ śarīramutsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ janāḥ । gacchantyamutralokaṃ vai ka enamanugacchati ॥10॥
html:
mṛtaṃ śarīramutsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ janāḥ ।
gacchantyamutralokaṃ vai ka enamanugacchati ॥10॥
slp1: mftaM SarIramutsfjya kAzWalozwasamaM janAH । gacCantyamutralokaM vE ka enamanugacCati ॥10॥

text: ekaḥ prasūto rājendra jantureko vinaśyati । ekastarati durgāṇi gacchatyekaśca durgatim ॥11॥
html:
ekaḥ prasūto rājendra jantureko vinaśyati ।
ekastarati durgāṇi gacchatyekaśca durgatim ॥11॥
slp1: ekaH prasUto rAjendra jantureko vinaSyati । ekastarati durgARi gacCatyekaSca durgatim ॥11॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: asahāyaḥ pitā mātā tathā bhrātā suto guruḥ । jñātisambandhivargaśca mitravargastathaiva ca ॥12॥
html:
asahāyaḥ pitā mātā tathā bhrātā suto guruḥ ।
jñātisambandhivargaśca mitravargastathaiva ca ॥12॥
slp1: asahAyaH pitA mAtA taTA BrAtA suto guruH । jYAtisambanDivargaSca mitravargastaTEva ca ॥12॥

text: mṛtaṃ śarīramutsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ janāḥ । muhūrtamupatiṣṭhanti tato yānti parāṅmukhāḥ । taistaccharīramutsṛṣṭaṃ dharma eko'nugacchati ॥13॥
html:
mṛtaṃ śarīramutsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ janāḥ ।
muhūrtamupatiṣṭhanti tato yānti parāṅmukhāḥ ।
taistaccharīramutsṛṣṭaṃ dharma eko'nugacchati ॥13॥
slp1: mftaM SarIramutsfjya kAzWalozwasamaM janAH । muhUrtamupatizWanti tato yAnti parANmuKAH । tEstacCarIramutsfzwaM Darma eko'nugacCati ॥13॥

text: tasmāddharmaḥ sahāyārthe sevitavyaḥ sadā nṛbhiḥ । prāṇī dharmasamāyukto gacchate svargatiṃ parām । tathaivādharmasaṃyukto narakāyopapadyate ॥14॥
html:
tasmāddharmaḥ sahāyārthe sevitavyaḥ sadā nṛbhiḥ ।
prāṇī dharmasamāyukto gacchate svargatiṃ parām ।
tathaivādharmasaṃyukto narakāyopapadyate ॥14॥
slp1: tasmAdDarmaH sahAyArTe sevitavyaH sadA nfBiH । prARI DarmasamAyukto gacCate svargatiM parAm । taTEvADarmasaMyukto narakAyopapadyate ॥14॥

text: tasmānnyāyāgatairarthairdharmaṃ seveta paṇḍitaḥ । dharma eko manuṣyāṇāṃ sahāyaḥ pāralaukikaḥ ॥15॥
html:
tasmānnyāyāgatairarthairdharmaṃ seveta paṇḍitaḥ ।
dharma eko manuṣyāṇāṃ sahāyaḥ pāralaukikaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tasmAnnyAyAgatErarTErDarmaM seveta paRqitaH । Darma eko manuzyARAM sahAyaH pAralOkikaH ॥15॥

text: lobhānmohādanukrośādbhayādvāpyabahuśrutaḥ । naraḥ karotyakāryāṇi parārthe lobhamohitaḥ ॥16॥
html:
lobhānmohādanukrośādbhayādvāpyabahuśrutaḥ ।
naraḥ karotyakāryāṇi parārthe lobhamohitaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: loBAnmohAdanukroSAdBayAdvApyabahuSrutaH । naraH karotyakAryARi parArTe loBamohitaH ॥16॥

text: dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca tritayaṃ jīvite phalam । etattrayamavāptavyamadharmaparivarjitam ॥17॥
html:
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca tritayaṃ jīvite phalam ।
etattrayamavāptavyamadharmaparivarjitam ॥17॥
slp1: DarmaScArTaSca kAmaSca tritayaM jIvite Palam । etattrayamavAptavyamaDarmaparivarjitam ॥17॥

text: śrutaṃ bhagavato vākyaṃ dharmayuktaṃ paraṃ hitam । śarīravicayaṃ jñātuṃ buddhistu mama jāyate ॥18॥
html:
śrutaṃ bhagavato vākyaṃ dharmayuktaṃ paraṃ hitam ।
śarīravicayaṃ jñātuṃ buddhistu mama jāyate ॥18॥
slp1: SrutaM Bagavato vAkyaM DarmayuktaM paraM hitam । SarIravicayaM jYAtuM budDistu mama jAyate ॥18॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mṛtaṃ śarīrarahitaṃ sūkṣmamavyaktatāṃ gatam । acakṣurviṣayaṃ prāptaṃ kathaṃ dharmo'nugacchati ॥19॥
html:
mṛtaṃ śarīrarahitaṃ sūkṣmamavyaktatāṃ gatam ।
acakṣurviṣayaṃ prāptaṃ kathaṃ dharmo'nugacchati ॥19॥
slp1: mftaM SarIrarahitaM sUkzmamavyaktatAM gatam । acakzurvizayaM prAptaM kaTaM Darmo'nugacCati ॥19॥

text: pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam । buddhirātmā ca sahitā dharmaṃ paśyanti nityadā ॥20॥
html:
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam ।
buddhirātmā ca sahitā dharmaṃ paśyanti nityadā ॥20॥
slp1: pfTivI vAyurAkASamApo jyotiSca paYcamam । budDirAtmA ca sahitA DarmaM paSyanti nityadA ॥20॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: prāṇināmiha sarveṣāṃ sākṣibhūtāni cāniśam । etaiśca sa ha dharmo'pi taṃ jīvamanugacchati ॥21॥
html:
prāṇināmiha sarveṣāṃ sākṣibhūtāni cāniśam ।
etaiśca sa ha dharmo'pi taṃ jīvamanugacchati ॥21॥
slp1: prARinAmiha sarvezAM sAkziBUtAni cAniSam । etESca sa ha Darmo'pi taM jIvamanugacCati ॥21॥

text: tvagasthimāṃsaṃ śukraṃ ca śoṇitaṃ ca mahāmate । śarīraṃ varjayantyete jīvitena vivarjitam ॥22॥
html:
tvagasthimāṃsaṃ śukraṃ ca śoṇitaṃ ca mahāmate ।
śarīraṃ varjayantyete jīvitena vivarjitam ॥22॥
slp1: tvagasTimAMsaM SukraM ca SoRitaM ca mahAmate । SarIraM varjayantyete jIvitena vivarjitam ॥22॥

text: tato dharmasamāyuktaḥ sa jīvaḥ sukhamedhate । iha loke pare caiva kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te ॥23॥
html:
tato dharmasamāyuktaḥ sa jīvaḥ sukhamedhate ।
iha loke pare caiva kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te ॥23॥
slp1: tato DarmasamAyuktaH sa jIvaH suKameDate । iha loke pare cEva kiM BUyaH kaTayAmi te ॥23॥

text: anudarśitaṃ bhagavatā yathā dharmo'nugacchati । etattu jñātumicchāmi kathaṃ retaḥ pravartate ॥24॥
html:
anudarśitaṃ bhagavatā yathā dharmo'nugacchati ।
etattu jñātumicchāmi kathaṃ retaḥ pravartate ॥24॥
slp1: anudarSitaM BagavatA yaTA Darmo'nugacCati । etattu jYAtumicCAmi kaTaM retaH pravartate ॥24॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: annamaśnanti ye devāḥ śarīrasthā nareśvara । pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotirmanastathā ॥25॥
html:
annamaśnanti ye devāḥ śarīrasthā nareśvara ।
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotirmanastathā ॥25॥
slp1: annamaSnanti ye devAH SarIrasTA nareSvara । pfTivI vAyurAkASamApo jyotirmanastaTA ॥25॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: tatastṛpteṣu rājendra teṣu bhūteṣu pañcasu । manaḥṣaṣṭheṣu śuddhātmanretaḥ sampadyate mahat ॥26॥
html:
tatastṛpteṣu rājendra teṣu bhūteṣu pañcasu ।
manaḥṣaṣṭheṣu śuddhātmanretaḥ sampadyate mahat ॥26॥
slp1: tatastfptezu rAjendra tezu BUtezu paYcasu । manaHzazWezu SudDAtmanretaH sampadyate mahat ॥26॥

text: tato garbhaḥ sambhavati strīpuṃsoḥ pārtha saṅgame । etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥27॥
html:
tato garbhaḥ sambhavati strīpuṃsoḥ pārtha saṅgame ।
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥27॥
slp1: tato garBaH samBavati strIpuMsoH pArTa saNgame । etatte sarvamAKyAtaM kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi ॥27॥

text: ākhyātametadbhavatā garbhaḥ sañjāyate yathā । yathā jātastu puruṣaḥ prapadyati taducyatām ॥28॥
html:
ākhyātametadbhavatā garbhaḥ sañjāyate yathā ।
yathā jātastu puruṣaḥ prapadyati taducyatām ॥28॥
slp1: AKyAtametadBavatA garBaH saYjAyate yaTA । yaTA jAtastu puruzaH prapadyati taducyatAm ॥28॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: āsannamātraḥ satataṃ tairbhūtairabhibhūyate । vipramuktaśca tairbhūtaiḥ punaryātyaparāṃ gatim । sa tu bhūtasamāyuktaḥ prāpnute jīva eva ha ॥29॥
html:
āsannamātraḥ satataṃ tairbhūtairabhibhūyate ।
vipramuktaśca tairbhūtaiḥ punaryātyaparāṃ gatim ।
sa tu bhūtasamāyuktaḥ prāpnute jīva eva ha ॥29॥
slp1: AsannamAtraH satataM tErBUtEraBiBUyate । vipramuktaSca tErBUtEH punaryAtyaparAM gatim । sa tu BUtasamAyuktaH prApnute jIva eva ha ॥29॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: tato'sya karma paśyanti śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham । devatāḥ pañcabhūtasthāḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥30॥
html:
tato'sya karma paśyanti śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham ।
devatāḥ pañcabhūtasthāḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥30॥
slp1: tato'sya karma paSyanti SuBaM vA yadi vASuBam । devatAH paYcaBUtasTAH kiM BUyaH SrotumicCasi ॥30॥

text: tvagasthimāṃsamutsṛjya taiśca bhūtairvivarjitaḥ । jīvaḥ sa bhagavankvasthaḥ sukhaduḥkhe samaśnute ॥31॥
html:
tvagasthimāṃsamutsṛjya taiśca bhūtairvivarjitaḥ ।
jīvaḥ sa bhagavankvasthaḥ sukhaduḥkhe samaśnute ॥31॥
slp1: tvagasTimAMsamutsfjya tESca BUtErvivarjitaH । jIvaH sa BagavankvasTaH suKaduHKe samaSnute ॥31॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: jīvo dharmasamāyuktaḥ śīghraṃ retastvamāgataḥ । strīṇāṃ puṣpaṃ samāsādya sūte kālena bhārata ॥32॥
html:
jīvo dharmasamāyuktaḥ śīghraṃ retastvamāgataḥ ।
strīṇāṃ puṣpaṃ samāsādya sūte kālena bhārata ॥32॥
slp1: jIvo DarmasamAyuktaH SIGraM retastvamAgataH । strIRAM puzpaM samAsAdya sUte kAlena BArata ॥32॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: yamasya puruṣaiḥ kleśaṃ yamasya puruṣairvadham । duḥkhaṃ saṃsāracakraṃ ca naraḥ kleśaṃ ca vindati ॥33॥
html:
yamasya puruṣaiḥ kleśaṃ yamasya puruṣairvadham ।
duḥkhaṃ saṃsāracakraṃ ca naraḥ kleśaṃ ca vindati ॥33॥
slp1: yamasya puruzEH kleSaM yamasya puruzErvaDam । duHKaM saMsAracakraM ca naraH kleSaM ca vindati ॥33॥

text: ihaloke ca sa prāṇī janmaprabhṛti pārthiva । svakṛtaṃ karma vai bhuṅkte dharmasya phalamāśritaḥ ॥34॥
html:
ihaloke ca sa prāṇī janmaprabhṛti pārthiva ।
svakṛtaṃ karma vai bhuṅkte dharmasya phalamāśritaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: ihaloke ca sa prARI janmapraBfti pArTiva । svakftaM karma vE BuNkte Darmasya PalamASritaH ॥34॥

text: yadi dharmaṃ yathāśakti janmaprabhṛti sevate । tataḥ sa puruṣo bhūtvā sevate nityadā sukham ॥35॥
html:
yadi dharmaṃ yathāśakti janmaprabhṛti sevate ।
tataḥ sa puruṣo bhūtvā sevate nityadā sukham ॥35॥
slp1: yadi DarmaM yaTASakti janmapraBfti sevate । tataH sa puruzo BUtvA sevate nityadA suKam ॥35॥

text: athāntarā tu dharmasya adharmamupasevate । sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ sa jīvo'pyadhigacchati ॥36॥
html:
athāntarā tu dharmasya adharmamupasevate ।
sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ sa jīvo'pyadhigacchati ॥36॥
slp1: aTAntarA tu Darmasya aDarmamupasevate । suKasyAnantaraM duHKaM sa jIvo'pyaDigacCati ॥36॥

text: adharmeṇa samāyukto yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ । mahadduḥkhaṃ samāsādya tiryagyonau prajāyate ॥37॥
html:
adharmeṇa samāyukto yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ ।
mahadduḥkhaṃ samāsādya tiryagyonau prajāyate ॥37॥
slp1: aDarmeRa samAyukto yamasya vizayaM gataH । mahadduHKaM samAsAdya tiryagyonO prajAyate ॥37॥

text: karmaṇā yena yeneha yasyāṃ yonau prajāyate । jīvo mohasamāyuktastanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥38॥
html:
karmaṇā yena yeneha yasyāṃ yonau prajāyate ।
jīvo mohasamāyuktastanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥38॥
slp1: karmaRA yena yeneha yasyAM yonO prajAyate । jIvo mohasamAyuktastanme nigadataH SfRu ॥38॥

text: yadetaducyate śāstre setihāse sacchandasi । yamasya viṣayaṃ ghoraṃ martyo lokaḥ prapadyate ॥39॥
html:
yadetaducyate śāstre setihāse sacchandasi ।
yamasya viṣayaṃ ghoraṃ martyo lokaḥ prapadyate ॥39॥
slp1: yadetaducyate SAstre setihAse sacCandasi । yamasya vizayaM GoraM martyo lokaH prapadyate ॥39॥

text: adhītya caturo vedāndvijo mohasamanvitaḥ । patitātpratigṛhyātha kharayonau prajāyate ॥40॥
html:
adhītya caturo vedāndvijo mohasamanvitaḥ ।
patitātpratigṛhyātha kharayonau prajāyate ॥40॥
slp1: aDItya caturo vedAndvijo mohasamanvitaH । patitAtpratigfhyATa KarayonO prajAyate ॥40॥

text: kharo jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata । kharo mṛto balīvardaḥ sapta varṣāṇi jīvati ॥41॥
html:
kharo jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata ।
kharo mṛto balīvardaḥ sapta varṣāṇi jīvati ॥41॥
slp1: Karo jIvati varzARi daSa paYca ca BArata । Karo mfto balIvardaH sapta varzARi jIvati ॥41॥

text: balīvardo mṛtaścāpi jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ । brahmarakṣastu trīnmāsāṃstato jāyati brāhmaṇaḥ ॥42॥
html:
balīvardo mṛtaścāpi jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ ।
brahmarakṣastu trīnmāsāṃstato jāyati brāhmaṇaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: balIvardo mftaScApi jAyate brahmarAkzasaH । brahmarakzastu trInmAsAMstato jAyati brAhmaRaH ॥42॥

text: patitaṃ yājayitvā tu kṛmiyonau prajāyate । tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata ॥43॥
html:
patitaṃ yājayitvā tu kṛmiyonau prajāyate ।
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata ॥43॥
slp1: patitaM yAjayitvA tu kfmiyonO prajAyate । tatra jIvati varzARi daSa paYca ca BArata ॥43॥

text: kṛmibhāvātpramuktastu tato jāyati gardabhaḥ । gardabhaḥ pañca varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi sūkaraḥ । śvā varṣamekaṃ bhavati tato jāyati mānavaḥ ॥44॥
html:
kṛmibhāvātpramuktastu tato jāyati gardabhaḥ ।
gardabhaḥ pañca varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi sūkaraḥ ।
śvā varṣamekaṃ bhavati tato jāyati mānavaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: kfmiBAvAtpramuktastu tato jAyati gardaBaH । gardaBaH paYca varzARi paYca varzARi sUkaraH । SvA varzamekaM Bavati tato jAyati mAnavaH ॥44॥

text: upādhyāyasya yaḥ pāpaṃ śiṣyaḥ kuryādabuddhimān । sa jīva iha saṃsārāṃstrīnāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ॥45॥
html:
upādhyāyasya yaḥ pāpaṃ śiṣyaḥ kuryādabuddhimān ।
sa jīva iha saṃsārāṃstrīnāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: upADyAyasya yaH pApaM SizyaH kuryAdabudDimAn । sa jIva iha saMsArAMstrInApnoti na saMSayaH ॥45॥

text: prākśvā bhavati rājendra tataḥ kravyāttataḥ kharaḥ । tataḥ pretaḥ parikliṣṭaḥ paścājjāyati brāhmaṇaḥ ॥46॥
html:
prākśvā bhavati rājendra tataḥ kravyāttataḥ kharaḥ ।
tataḥ pretaḥ parikliṣṭaḥ paścājjāyati brāhmaṇaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: prAkSvA Bavati rAjendra tataH kravyAttataH KaraH । tataH pretaH pariklizwaH paScAjjAyati brAhmaRaH ॥46॥

text: manasāpi gurorbhāryāṃ yaḥ śiṣyo yāti pāpakṛt । so'dhamānyāti saṃsārānadharmeṇeha cetasā ॥47॥
html:
manasāpi gurorbhāryāṃ yaḥ śiṣyo yāti pāpakṛt ।
so'dhamānyāti saṃsārānadharmeṇeha cetasā ॥47॥
slp1: manasApi gurorBAryAM yaH Sizyo yAti pApakft । so'DamAnyAti saMsArAnaDarmeReha cetasA ॥47॥

text: śvayonau tu sa sambhūtastrīṇi varṣāṇi jīvati । tatrāpi nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ kṛmiyonau prajāyate ॥48॥
html:
śvayonau tu sa sambhūtastrīṇi varṣāṇi jīvati ।
tatrāpi nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ kṛmiyonau prajāyate ॥48॥
slp1: SvayonO tu sa samBUtastrIRi varzARi jIvati । tatrApi niDanaM prAptaH kfmiyonO prajAyate ॥48॥

text: kṛmibhāvamanuprāpto varṣamekaṃ sa jīvati । tatastu nidhanaṃ prāpya brahmayonau prajāyate ॥49॥
html:
kṛmibhāvamanuprāpto varṣamekaṃ sa jīvati ।
tatastu nidhanaṃ prāpya brahmayonau prajāyate ॥49॥
slp1: kfmiBAvamanuprApto varzamekaM sa jIvati । tatastu niDanaM prApya brahmayonO prajAyate ॥49॥

text: yadi putrasamaṃ śiṣyaṃ gururhanyādakāraṇe । ātmanaḥ kāmakāreṇa so'pi haṃsaḥ prajāyate ॥50॥
html:
yadi putrasamaṃ śiṣyaṃ gururhanyādakāraṇe ।
ātmanaḥ kāmakāreṇa so'pi haṃsaḥ prajāyate ॥50॥
slp1: yadi putrasamaM SizyaM gururhanyAdakAraRe । AtmanaH kAmakAreRa so'pi haMsaH prajAyate ॥50॥

text: pitaraṃ mātaraṃ vāpi yastu putro'vamanyate । so'pi rājanmṛto jantuḥ pūrvaṃ jāyati gardabhaḥ ॥51॥
html:
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ vāpi yastu putro'vamanyate ।
so'pi rājanmṛto jantuḥ pūrvaṃ jāyati gardabhaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: pitaraM mAtaraM vApi yastu putro'vamanyate । so'pi rAjanmfto jantuH pUrvaM jAyati gardaBaH ॥51॥

text: kharo jīvati māsāṃstu daśa śvā ca caturdaśa । biḍālaḥ sapta māsāṃstu tato jāyati mānavaḥ ॥52॥
html:
kharo jīvati māsāṃstu daśa śvā ca caturdaśa ।
biḍālaḥ sapta māsāṃstu tato jāyati mānavaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: Karo jIvati mAsAMstu daSa SvA ca caturdaSa । biqAlaH sapta mAsAMstu tato jAyati mAnavaH ॥52॥

text: mātāpitaramākruśya sārikaḥ samprajāyate । tāḍayitvā tu tāveva jāyate kacchapo nṛpa ॥53॥
html:
mātāpitaramākruśya sārikaḥ samprajāyate ।
tāḍayitvā tu tāveva jāyate kacchapo nṛpa ॥53॥
slp1: mAtApitaramAkruSya sArikaH samprajAyate । tAqayitvA tu tAveva jAyate kacCapo nfpa ॥53॥

text: kacchapo daśa varṣāṇi trīṇi varṣāṇi śalyakaḥ । vyālo bhūtvā tu ṣaṇmāsāṃstato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥54॥
html:
kacchapo daśa varṣāṇi trīṇi varṣāṇi śalyakaḥ ।
vyālo bhūtvā tu ṣaṇmāsāṃstato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: kacCapo daSa varzARi trIRi varzARi SalyakaH । vyAlo BUtvA tu zaRmAsAMstato jAyati mAnuzaH ॥54॥

text: bhartṛpiṇḍamupāśnanyo rājadviṣṭāni sevate । so'pi mohasamāpanno mṛto jāyati vānaraḥ ॥55॥
html:
bhartṛpiṇḍamupāśnanyo rājadviṣṭāni sevate ।
so'pi mohasamāpanno mṛto jāyati vānaraḥ ॥55॥
slp1: BartfpiRqamupASnanyo rAjadvizwAni sevate । so'pi mohasamApanno mfto jAyati vAnaraH ॥55॥

text: vānaro daśa varṣāṇi trīṇi varṣāṇi mūṣakaḥ । śvā bhūtvā cātha ṣaṇmāsāṃstato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥56॥
html:
vānaro daśa varṣāṇi trīṇi varṣāṇi mūṣakaḥ ।
śvā bhūtvā cātha ṣaṇmāsāṃstato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: vAnaro daSa varzARi trIRi varzARi mUzakaH । SvA BUtvA cATa zaRmAsAMstato jAyati mAnuzaH ॥56॥

text: nyāsāpahartā tu naro yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ । saṃsārāṇāṃ śataṃ gatvā kṛmiyonau prajāyate ॥57॥
html:
nyāsāpahartā tu naro yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ ।
saṃsārāṇāṃ śataṃ gatvā kṛmiyonau prajāyate ॥57॥
slp1: nyAsApahartA tu naro yamasya vizayaM gataH । saMsArARAM SataM gatvA kfmiyonO prajAyate ॥57॥

text: tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata । duṣkṛtasya kṣayaṃ gatvā tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥58॥
html:
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata ।
duṣkṛtasya kṣayaṃ gatvā tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥58॥
slp1: tatra jIvati varzARi daSa paYca ca BArata । duzkftasya kzayaM gatvA tato jAyati mAnuzaH ॥58॥

text: asūyako naraścāpi mṛto jāyati śārṅgakaḥ । viśvāsahartā tu naro mīno jāyati durmatiḥ ॥59॥
html:
asūyako naraścāpi mṛto jāyati śārṅgakaḥ ।
viśvāsahartā tu naro mīno jāyati durmatiḥ ॥59॥
slp1: asUyako naraScApi mfto jAyati SArNgakaH । viSvAsahartA tu naro mIno jAyati durmatiH ॥59॥

text: bhūtvā mīno'ṣṭa varṣāṇi mṛgo jāyati bhārata । mṛgastu caturo māsāṃstataśchāgaḥ prajāyate ॥60॥
html:
bhūtvā mīno'ṣṭa varṣāṇi mṛgo jāyati bhārata ।
mṛgastu caturo māsāṃstataśchāgaḥ prajāyate ॥60॥
slp1: BUtvA mIno'zwa varzARi mfgo jAyati BArata । mfgastu caturo mAsAMstataSCAgaH prajAyate ॥60॥

text: chāgastu nidhanaṃ prāpya pūrṇe saṃvatsare tataḥ । kīṭaḥ sañjāyate jantustato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥61॥
html:
chāgastu nidhanaṃ prāpya pūrṇe saṃvatsare tataḥ ।
kīṭaḥ sañjāyate jantustato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥61॥
slp1: CAgastu niDanaM prApya pUrRe saMvatsare tataH । kIwaH saYjAyate jantustato jAyati mAnuzaH ॥61॥

text: dhānyānyavāṃstilānmāṣānkulatthānsarṣapāṃścaṇān । kalāyānatha mudgāṃśca godhūmānatasīstathā ॥62॥
html:
dhānyānyavāṃstilānmāṣānkulatthānsarṣapāṃścaṇān ।
kalāyānatha mudgāṃśca godhūmānatasīstathā ॥62॥
slp1: DAnyAnyavAMstilAnmAzAnkulatTAnsarzapAMScaRAn । kalAyAnaTa mudgAMSca goDUmAnatasIstaTA ॥62॥

text: sasyasyānyasya hartā ca mohājjanturacetanaḥ । sa jāyate mahārāja mūṣako nirapatrapaḥ ॥63॥
html:
sasyasyānyasya hartā ca mohājjanturacetanaḥ ।
sa jāyate mahārāja mūṣako nirapatrapaḥ ॥63॥
slp1: sasyasyAnyasya hartA ca mohAjjanturacetanaH । sa jAyate mahArAja mUzako nirapatrapaH ॥63॥

text: tataḥ pretya mahārāja punarjāyati sūkaraḥ । sūkaro jātamātrastu rogeṇa mriyate nṛpa ॥64॥
html:
tataḥ pretya mahārāja punarjāyati sūkaraḥ ।
sūkaro jātamātrastu rogeṇa mriyate nṛpa ॥64॥
slp1: tataH pretya mahArAja punarjAyati sUkaraH । sUkaro jAtamAtrastu rogeRa mriyate nfpa ॥64॥

text: śvā tato jāyate mūḍhaḥ karmaṇā tena pārthiva । śvā bhūtvā pañca varṣāṇi tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥65॥
html:
śvā tato jāyate mūḍhaḥ karmaṇā tena pārthiva ।
śvā bhūtvā pañca varṣāṇi tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥65॥
slp1: SvA tato jAyate mUQaH karmaRA tena pArTiva । SvA BUtvA paYca varzARi tato jAyati mAnuzaH ॥65॥

text: paradārābhimarśaṃ tu kṛtvā jāyati vai vṛkaḥ । śvā sṛgālastato gṛdhro vyālaḥ kaṅko bakastathā ॥66॥
html:
paradārābhimarśaṃ tu kṛtvā jāyati vai vṛkaḥ ।
śvā sṛgālastato gṛdhro vyālaḥ kaṅko bakastathā ॥66॥
slp1: paradArABimarSaM tu kftvA jAyati vE vfkaH । SvA sfgAlastato gfDro vyAlaH kaNko bakastaTA ॥66॥

text: bhrāturbhāryāṃ tu durbuddhiryo dharṣayati mohitaḥ । puṃskokilatvamāpnoti so'pi saṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa ॥67॥
html:
bhrāturbhāryāṃ tu durbuddhiryo dharṣayati mohitaḥ ।
puṃskokilatvamāpnoti so'pi saṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa ॥67॥
slp1: BrAturBAryAM tu durbudDiryo Darzayati mohitaH । puMskokilatvamApnoti so'pi saMvatsaraM nfpa ॥67॥

text: sakhibhāryāṃ gurorbhāryāṃ rājabhāryāṃ tathaiva ca । pradharṣayitvā kāmādyo mṛto jāyati sūkaraḥ ॥68॥
html:
sakhibhāryāṃ gurorbhāryāṃ rājabhāryāṃ tathaiva ca ।
pradharṣayitvā kāmādyo mṛto jāyati sūkaraḥ ॥68॥
slp1: saKiBAryAM gurorBAryAM rAjaBAryAM taTEva ca । praDarzayitvA kAmAdyo mfto jAyati sUkaraH ॥68॥

text: sūkaraḥ pañca varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi śvāvidhaḥ । pipīlakastu ṣaṇmāsānkīṭaḥ syānmāsameva ca । etānāsādya saṃsārānkṛmiyonau prajāyate ॥69॥
html:
sūkaraḥ pañca varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi śvāvidhaḥ ।
pipīlakastu ṣaṇmāsānkīṭaḥ syānmāsameva ca ।
etānāsādya saṃsārānkṛmiyonau prajāyate ॥69॥
slp1: sUkaraH paYca varzARi paYca varzARi SvAviDaH । pipIlakastu zaRmAsAnkIwaH syAnmAsameva ca । etAnAsAdya saMsArAnkfmiyonO prajAyate ॥69॥

text: tatra jīvati māsāṃstu kṛmiyonau trayodaśa । tato'dharmakṣayaṃ kṛtvā punarjāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥70॥
html:
tatra jīvati māsāṃstu kṛmiyonau trayodaśa ।
tato'dharmakṣayaṃ kṛtvā punarjāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥70॥
slp1: tatra jIvati mAsAMstu kfmiyonO trayodaSa । tato'DarmakzayaM kftvA punarjAyati mAnuzaH ॥70॥

text: upasthite vivāhe tu dāne yajñe'pi vābhibho । mohātkaroti yo vighnaṃ sa mṛto jāyate kṛmiḥ ॥71॥
html:
upasthite vivāhe tu dāne yajñe'pi vābhibho ।
mohātkaroti yo vighnaṃ sa mṛto jāyate kṛmiḥ ॥71॥
slp1: upasTite vivAhe tu dAne yajYe'pi vABiBo । mohAtkaroti yo viGnaM sa mfto jAyate kfmiH ॥71॥

text: kṛmirjīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata । adharmasya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥72॥
html:
kṛmirjīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata ।
adharmasya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥72॥
slp1: kfmirjIvati varzARi daSa paYca ca BArata । aDarmasya kzayaM kftvA tato jAyati mAnuzaH ॥72॥

text: pūrvaṃ dattvā tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dvitīye samprayacchati । so'pi rājanmṛto jantuḥ kṛmiyonau prajāyate ॥73॥
html:
pūrvaṃ dattvā tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dvitīye samprayacchati ।
so'pi rājanmṛto jantuḥ kṛmiyonau prajāyate ॥73॥
slp1: pUrvaM dattvA tu yaH kanyAM dvitIye samprayacCati । so'pi rAjanmfto jantuH kfmiyonO prajAyate ॥73॥

text: tatra jīvati varṣāṇi trayodaśa yudhiṣṭhira । adharmasaṅkṣaye yuktastato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥74॥
html:
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi trayodaśa yudhiṣṭhira ।
adharmasaṅkṣaye yuktastato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥74॥
slp1: tatra jIvati varzARi trayodaSa yuDizWira । aDarmasaNkzaye yuktastato jAyati mAnuzaH ॥74॥

text: devakāryamupākṛtya pitṛkāryamathāpi ca । anirvāpya samaśnanvai tato jāyati vāyasaḥ ॥75॥
html:
devakāryamupākṛtya pitṛkāryamathāpi ca ।
anirvāpya samaśnanvai tato jāyati vāyasaḥ ॥75॥
slp1: devakAryamupAkftya pitfkAryamaTApi ca । anirvApya samaSnanvE tato jAyati vAyasaH ॥75॥

text: vāyaso daśa varṣāṇi tato jāyati kukkuṭaḥ । jāyate lavakaścāpi māsaṃ tasmāttu mānuṣaḥ ॥76॥
html:
vāyaso daśa varṣāṇi tato jāyati kukkuṭaḥ ।
jāyate lavakaścāpi māsaṃ tasmāttu mānuṣaḥ ॥76॥
slp1: vAyaso daSa varzARi tato jAyati kukkuwaH । jAyate lavakaScApi mAsaM tasmAttu mAnuzaH ॥76॥

text: jyeṣṭhaṃ pitṛsamaṃ cāpi bhrātaraṃ yo'vamanyate । so'pi mṛtyumupāgamya krauñcayonau prajāyate ॥77॥
html:
jyeṣṭhaṃ pitṛsamaṃ cāpi bhrātaraṃ yo'vamanyate ।
so'pi mṛtyumupāgamya krauñcayonau prajāyate ॥77॥
slp1: jyezWaM pitfsamaM cApi BrAtaraM yo'vamanyate । so'pi mftyumupAgamya krOYcayonO prajAyate ॥77॥

text: krauñco jīvati māsāṃstu daśa dvau sapta pañca ca । tato nidhanamāpanno mānuṣatvamupāśnute ॥78॥
html:
krauñco jīvati māsāṃstu daśa dvau sapta pañca ca ।
tato nidhanamāpanno mānuṣatvamupāśnute ॥78॥
slp1: krOYco jIvati mAsAMstu daSa dvO sapta paYca ca । tato niDanamApanno mAnuzatvamupASnute ॥78॥

text: vṛṣalo brāhmaṇīṃ gatvā kṛmiyonau prajāyate । tatrāpatyaṃ samutpādya tato jāyati mūṣakaḥ ॥79॥
html:
vṛṣalo brāhmaṇīṃ gatvā kṛmiyonau prajāyate ।
tatrāpatyaṃ samutpādya tato jāyati mūṣakaḥ ॥79॥
slp1: vfzalo brAhmaRIM gatvA kfmiyonO prajAyate । tatrApatyaM samutpAdya tato jAyati mUzakaH ॥79॥

text: kṛtaghnastu mṛto rājanyamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ । yamasya viṣaye kruddhairvadhaṃ prāpnoti dāruṇam ॥80॥
html:
kṛtaghnastu mṛto rājanyamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ ।
yamasya viṣaye kruddhairvadhaṃ prāpnoti dāruṇam ॥80॥
slp1: kftaGnastu mfto rAjanyamasya vizayaM gataH । yamasya vizaye krudDErvaDaM prApnoti dAruRam ॥80॥

text: paṭṭisaṃ mudgaraṃ śūlamagnikumbhaṃ ca dāruṇam । asipatravanaṃ ghoraṃ vālukāṃ kūṭaśālmalīm ॥81॥
html:
paṭṭisaṃ mudgaraṃ śūlamagnikumbhaṃ ca dāruṇam ।
asipatravanaṃ ghoraṃ vālukāṃ kūṭaśālmalīm ॥81॥
slp1: pawwisaM mudgaraM SUlamagnikumBaM ca dAruRam । asipatravanaM GoraM vAlukAM kUwaSAlmalIm ॥81॥

text: etāścānyāśca bahvīḥ sa yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ । yātanāḥ prāpya tatrogrāstato vadhyati bhārata ॥82॥
html:
etāścānyāśca bahvīḥ sa yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ ।
yātanāḥ prāpya tatrogrāstato vadhyati bhārata ॥82॥
slp1: etAScAnyASca bahvIH sa yamasya vizayaM gataH । yAtanAH prApya tatrogrAstato vaDyati BArata ॥82॥

text: saṃsāracakramāsādya kṛmiyonau prajāyate । kṛmirbhavati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata । tato garbhaṃ samāsādya tatraiva mriyate śiśuḥ ॥83॥
html:
saṃsāracakramāsādya kṛmiyonau prajāyate ।
kṛmirbhavati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata ।
tato garbhaṃ samāsādya tatraiva mriyate śiśuḥ ॥83॥
slp1: saMsAracakramAsAdya kfmiyonO prajAyate । kfmirBavati varzARi daSa paYca ca BArata । tato garBaM samAsAdya tatrEva mriyate SiSuH ॥83॥

text: tato garbhaśatairjanturbahubhiḥ samprajāyate । saṃsārāṃśca bahūngatvā tatastiryakprajāyate ॥84॥
html:
tato garbhaśatairjanturbahubhiḥ samprajāyate ।
saṃsārāṃśca bahūngatvā tatastiryakprajāyate ॥84॥
slp1: tato garBaSatErjanturbahuBiH samprajAyate । saMsArAMSca bahUngatvA tatastiryakprajAyate ॥84॥

text: mṛto duḥkhamanuprāpya bahuvarṣagaṇāniha । apunarbhāvasaṃyuktastataḥ kūrmaḥ prajāyate ॥85॥
html:
mṛto duḥkhamanuprāpya bahuvarṣagaṇāniha ।
apunarbhāvasaṃyuktastataḥ kūrmaḥ prajāyate ॥85॥
slp1: mfto duHKamanuprApya bahuvarzagaRAniha । apunarBAvasaMyuktastataH kUrmaH prajAyate ॥85॥

text: aśastraṃ puruṣaṃ hatvā saśastraḥ puruṣādhamaḥ । arthārthī yadi vā vairī sa mṛto jāyate kharaḥ ॥86॥
html:
aśastraṃ puruṣaṃ hatvā saśastraḥ puruṣādhamaḥ ।
arthārthī yadi vā vairī sa mṛto jāyate kharaḥ ॥86॥
slp1: aSastraM puruzaM hatvA saSastraH puruzADamaH । arTArTI yadi vA vErI sa mfto jAyate KaraH ॥86॥

text: kharo jīvati varṣe dve tataḥ śastreṇa vadhyate । sa mṛto mṛgayonau tu nityodvigno'bhijāyate ॥87॥
html:
kharo jīvati varṣe dve tataḥ śastreṇa vadhyate ।
sa mṛto mṛgayonau tu nityodvigno'bhijāyate ॥87॥
slp1: Karo jIvati varze dve tataH SastreRa vaDyate । sa mfto mfgayonO tu nityodvigno'BijAyate ॥87॥

text: mṛgo vadhyati śastreṇa gate saṃvatsare tu saḥ । hato mṛgastato mīnaḥ so'pi jālena badhyate ॥88॥
html:
mṛgo vadhyati śastreṇa gate saṃvatsare tu saḥ ।
hato mṛgastato mīnaḥ so'pi jālena badhyate ॥88॥
slp1: mfgo vaDyati SastreRa gate saMvatsare tu saH । hato mfgastato mInaH so'pi jAlena baDyate ॥88॥

text: māse caturthe samprāpte śvāpadaḥ samprajāyate । śvāpado daśa varṣāṇi dvīpī varṣāṇi pañca ca ॥89॥
html:
māse caturthe samprāpte śvāpadaḥ samprajāyate ।
śvāpado daśa varṣāṇi dvīpī varṣāṇi pañca ca ॥89॥
slp1: mAse caturTe samprApte SvApadaH samprajAyate । SvApado daSa varzARi dvIpI varzARi paYca ca ॥89॥

text: tatastu nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ kālaparyāyacoditaḥ । adharmasya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥90॥
html:
tatastu nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ kālaparyāyacoditaḥ ।
adharmasya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥90॥
slp1: tatastu niDanaM prAptaH kAlaparyAyacoditaH । aDarmasya kzayaM kftvA tato jAyati mAnuzaH ॥90॥

text: striyaṃ hatvā tu durbuddhiryamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ । bahūnkleśānsamāsādya saṃsārāṃścaiva viṃśatim ॥91॥
html:
striyaṃ hatvā tu durbuddhiryamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ ।
bahūnkleśānsamāsādya saṃsārāṃścaiva viṃśatim ॥91॥
slp1: striyaM hatvA tu durbudDiryamasya vizayaM gataH । bahUnkleSAnsamAsAdya saMsArAMScEva viMSatim ॥91॥

text: tataḥ paścānmahārāja kṛmiyonau prajāyate । kṛmirviṃśativarṣāṇi bhūtvā jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥92॥
html:
tataḥ paścānmahārāja kṛmiyonau prajāyate ।
kṛmirviṃśativarṣāṇi bhūtvā jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥92॥
slp1: tataH paScAnmahArAja kfmiyonO prajAyate । kfmirviMSativarzARi BUtvA jAyati mAnuzaH ॥92॥

text: bhojanaṃ corayitvā tu makṣikā jāyate naraḥ । makṣikāsaṅghavaśago bahūnmāsānbhavatyuta । tataḥ pāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā mānuṣatvamavāpnute ॥93॥
html:
bhojanaṃ corayitvā tu makṣikā jāyate naraḥ ।
makṣikāsaṅghavaśago bahūnmāsānbhavatyuta ।
tataḥ pāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā mānuṣatvamavāpnute ॥93॥
slp1: BojanaM corayitvA tu makzikA jAyate naraH । makzikAsaNGavaSago bahUnmAsAnBavatyuta । tataH pApakzayaM kftvA mAnuzatvamavApnute ॥93॥

text: vādyaṃ hṛtvā tu puruṣo maśakaḥ samprajāyate । tathā piṇyākasammiśramaśanaṃ corayennaraḥ । sa jāyate babhrusamo dāruṇo mūṣako naraḥ ॥94॥
html:
vādyaṃ hṛtvā tu puruṣo maśakaḥ samprajāyate ।
tathā piṇyākasammiśramaśanaṃ corayennaraḥ ।
sa jāyate babhrusamo dāruṇo mūṣako naraḥ ॥94॥
slp1: vAdyaM hftvA tu puruzo maSakaH samprajAyate । taTA piRyAkasammiSramaSanaM corayennaraH । sa jAyate baBrusamo dAruRo mUzako naraH ॥94॥

text: lavaṇaṃ corayitvā tu cīrīvākaḥ prajāyate । dadhi hṛtvā bakaścāpi plavo matsyānasaṃskṛtān ॥95॥
html:
lavaṇaṃ corayitvā tu cīrīvākaḥ prajāyate ।
dadhi hṛtvā bakaścāpi plavo matsyānasaṃskṛtān ॥95॥
slp1: lavaRaM corayitvA tu cIrIvAkaH prajAyate । daDi hftvA bakaScApi plavo matsyAnasaMskftAn ॥95॥

text: corayitvā payaścāpi balākā samprajāyate । yastu corayate tailaṃ tailapāyī prajāyate । corayitvā tu durbuddhirmadhu daṃśaḥ prajāyate ॥96॥
html:
corayitvā payaścāpi balākā samprajāyate ।
yastu corayate tailaṃ tailapāyī prajāyate ।
corayitvā tu durbuddhirmadhu daṃśaḥ prajāyate ॥96॥
slp1: corayitvA payaScApi balAkA samprajAyate । yastu corayate tElaM tElapAyI prajAyate । corayitvA tu durbudDirmaDu daMSaH prajAyate ॥96॥

text: ayo hṛtvā tu durbuddhirvāyaso jāyate naraḥ । pāyasaṃ corayitvā tu tittiritvamavāpnute ॥97॥
html:
ayo hṛtvā tu durbuddhirvāyaso jāyate naraḥ ।
pāyasaṃ corayitvā tu tittiritvamavāpnute ॥97॥
slp1: ayo hftvA tu durbudDirvAyaso jAyate naraH । pAyasaM corayitvA tu tittiritvamavApnute ॥97॥

text: hṛtvā paiṣṭamapūpaṃ ca kumbholūkaḥ prajāyate । phalaṃ vā mūlakaṃ hṛtvā apūpaṃ vā pipīlikaḥ ॥98॥
html:
hṛtvā paiṣṭamapūpaṃ ca kumbholūkaḥ prajāyate ।
phalaṃ vā mūlakaṃ hṛtvā apūpaṃ vā pipīlikaḥ ॥98॥
slp1: hftvA pEzwamapUpaM ca kumBolUkaH prajAyate । PalaM vA mUlakaM hftvA apUpaM vA pipIlikaH ॥98॥

text: kāṃsyaṃ hṛtvā tu durbuddhirhārīto jāyate naraḥ । rājataṃ bhājanaṃ hṛtvā kapotaḥ samprajāyate ॥99॥
html:
kāṃsyaṃ hṛtvā tu durbuddhirhārīto jāyate naraḥ ।
rājataṃ bhājanaṃ hṛtvā kapotaḥ samprajāyate ॥99॥
slp1: kAMsyaM hftvA tu durbudDirhArIto jAyate naraH । rAjataM BAjanaM hftvA kapotaH samprajAyate ॥99॥

text: hṛtvā tu kāñcanaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ kṛmiyonau prajāyate । krauñcaḥ kārpāsikaṃ hṛtvā mṛto jāyati mānavaḥ ॥100॥
html:
hṛtvā tu kāñcanaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ kṛmiyonau prajāyate ।
krauñcaḥ kārpāsikaṃ hṛtvā mṛto jāyati mānavaḥ ॥100॥
slp1: hftvA tu kAYcanaM BARqaM kfmiyonO prajAyate । krOYcaH kArpAsikaM hftvA mfto jAyati mAnavaH ॥100॥

text: corayitvā naraḥ paṭṭaṃ tvāvikaṃ vāpi bhārata । kṣaumaṃ ca vastramādāya śaśo jantuḥ prajāyate ॥101॥
html:
corayitvā naraḥ paṭṭaṃ tvāvikaṃ vāpi bhārata ।
kṣaumaṃ ca vastramādāya śaśo jantuḥ prajāyate ॥101॥
slp1: corayitvA naraH pawwaM tvAvikaM vApi BArata । kzOmaM ca vastramAdAya SaSo jantuH prajAyate ॥101॥

text: varṇānhṛtvā tu puruṣo mṛto jāyati barhiṇaḥ । hṛtvā raktāni vastrāṇi jāyate jīvajīvakaḥ ॥102॥
html:
varṇānhṛtvā tu puruṣo mṛto jāyati barhiṇaḥ ।
hṛtvā raktāni vastrāṇi jāyate jīvajīvakaḥ ॥102॥
slp1: varRAnhftvA tu puruzo mfto jAyati barhiRaH । hftvA raktAni vastrARi jAyate jIvajIvakaH ॥102॥

text: varṇakādīṃstathā gandhāṃścorayitvā tu mānavaḥ । chucchundaritvamāpnoti rājaṁllobhaparāyaṇaḥ ॥103॥
html:
varṇakādīṃstathā gandhāṃścorayitvā tu mānavaḥ ।
chucchundaritvamāpnoti rājaṁllobhaparāyaṇaḥ ॥103॥
slp1: varRakAdIMstaTA ganDAMScorayitvA tu mAnavaH । CucCundaritvamApnoti rAjaṁlloBaparAyaRaH ॥103॥

text: viśvāsena tu nikṣiptaṃ yo nihnavati mānavaḥ । sa gatāsurnarastādṛṅmatsyayonau prajāyate ॥104॥
html:
viśvāsena tu nikṣiptaṃ yo nihnavati mānavaḥ ।
sa gatāsurnarastādṛṅmatsyayonau prajāyate ॥104॥
slp1: viSvAsena tu nikziptaM yo nihnavati mAnavaH । sa gatAsurnarastAdfNmatsyayonO prajAyate ॥104॥

text: matsyayonimanuprāpya mṛto jāyati mānuṣaḥ । mānuṣatvamanuprāpya kṣīṇāyurupapadyate ॥105॥
html:
matsyayonimanuprāpya mṛto jāyati mānuṣaḥ ।
mānuṣatvamanuprāpya kṣīṇāyurupapadyate ॥105॥
slp1: matsyayonimanuprApya mfto jAyati mAnuzaH । mAnuzatvamanuprApya kzIRAyurupapadyate ॥105॥

text: pāpāni tu naraḥ kṛtvā tiryagjāyati bhārata । na cātmanaḥ pramāṇaṃ te dharmaṃ jānanti kiñcana ॥106॥
html:
pāpāni tu naraḥ kṛtvā tiryagjāyati bhārata ।
na cātmanaḥ pramāṇaṃ te dharmaṃ jānanti kiñcana ॥106॥
slp1: pApAni tu naraH kftvA tiryagjAyati BArata । na cAtmanaH pramARaM te DarmaM jAnanti kiYcana ॥106॥

text: ye pāpāni narāḥ kṛtvā nirasyanti vrataiḥ sadā । sukhaduḥkhasamāyuktā vyādhitāste bhavantyuta ॥107॥
html:
ye pāpāni narāḥ kṛtvā nirasyanti vrataiḥ sadā ।
sukhaduḥkhasamāyuktā vyādhitāste bhavantyuta ॥107॥
slp1: ye pApAni narAH kftvA nirasyanti vratEH sadA । suKaduHKasamAyuktA vyADitAste Bavantyuta ॥107॥

text: asaṃvāsāḥ prajāyante mlecchāścāpi na saṃśayaḥ । narāḥ pāpasamācārā lobhamohasamanvitāḥ ॥108॥
html:
asaṃvāsāḥ prajāyante mlecchāścāpi na saṃśayaḥ ।
narāḥ pāpasamācārā lobhamohasamanvitāḥ ॥108॥
slp1: asaMvAsAH prajAyante mlecCAScApi na saMSayaH । narAH pApasamAcArA loBamohasamanvitAH ॥108॥

text: varjayanti ca pāpāni janmaprabhṛti ye narāḥ । arogā rūpavantaste dhaninaśca bhavantyuta ॥109॥
html:
varjayanti ca pāpāni janmaprabhṛti ye narāḥ ।
arogā rūpavantaste dhaninaśca bhavantyuta ॥109॥
slp1: varjayanti ca pApAni janmapraBfti ye narAH । arogA rUpavantaste DaninaSca Bavantyuta ॥109॥

text: striyo'pyetena kalpena kṛtvā pāpamavāpnuyuḥ । eteṣāmeva jantūnāṃ patnītvamupayānti tāḥ ॥110॥
html:
striyo'pyetena kalpena kṛtvā pāpamavāpnuyuḥ ।
eteṣāmeva jantūnāṃ patnītvamupayānti tāḥ ॥110॥
slp1: striyo'pyetena kalpena kftvA pApamavApnuyuH । etezAmeva jantUnAM patnItvamupayAnti tAH ॥110॥

text: parasvaharaṇe doṣāḥ sarva eva prakīrtitāḥ । etadvai leśamātreṇa kathitaṃ te mayānagha । aparasminkathāyoge bhūyaḥ śroṣyasi bhārata ॥111॥
html:
parasvaharaṇe doṣāḥ sarva eva prakīrtitāḥ ।
etadvai leśamātreṇa kathitaṃ te mayānagha ।
aparasminkathāyoge bhūyaḥ śroṣyasi bhārata ॥111॥
slp1: parasvaharaRe dozAH sarva eva prakIrtitAH । etadvE leSamAtreRa kaTitaM te mayAnaGa । aparasminkaTAyoge BUyaH Srozyasi BArata ॥111॥

text: etanmayā mahārāja brahmaṇo vadataḥ purā । surarṣīṇāṃ śrutaṃ madhye pṛṣṭaścāpi yathātatham ॥112॥
html:
etanmayā mahārāja brahmaṇo vadataḥ purā ।
surarṣīṇāṃ śrutaṃ madhye pṛṣṭaścāpi yathātatham ॥112॥
slp1: etanmayA mahArAja brahmaRo vadataH purA । surarzIRAM SrutaM maDye pfzwaScApi yaTAtaTam ॥112॥

text: mayāpi tava kārtsnyena yathāvadanuvarṇitam । etacchrutvā mahārāja dharme kuru manaḥ sadā] ॥113॥
html:
mayāpi tava kārtsnyena yathāvadanuvarṇitam ।
etacchrutvā mahārāja dharme kuru manaḥ sadā] ॥113॥
slp1: mayApi tava kArtsnyena yaTAvadanuvarRitam । etacCrutvA mahArAja Darme kuru manaH sadA] ॥113॥

text: adharmasya gatirbrahmankathitā me tvayānagha । dharmasya tu gatiṃ śrotumicchāmi vadatāṃ vara । kṛtvā karmāṇi pāpāni kathaṃ yānti śubhāṃ gatim ॥1॥
html:
adharmasya gatirbrahmankathitā me tvayānagha ।
dharmasya tu gatiṃ śrotumicchāmi vadatāṃ vara ।
kṛtvā karmāṇi pāpāni kathaṃ yānti śubhāṃ gatim ॥1॥
slp1: aDarmasya gatirbrahmankaTitA me tvayAnaGa । Darmasya tu gatiM SrotumicCAmi vadatAM vara । kftvA karmARi pApAni kaTaM yAnti SuBAM gatim ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: kṛtvā pāpāni karmāṇi adharmavaśamāgataḥ । manasā viparītena nirayaṃ pratipadyate ॥2॥
html:
kṛtvā pāpāni karmāṇi adharmavaśamāgataḥ ।
manasā viparītena nirayaṃ pratipadyate ॥2॥
slp1: kftvA pApAni karmARi aDarmavaSamAgataH । manasA viparItena nirayaM pratipadyate ॥2॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: mohādadharmaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā punaḥ samanutapyate । manaḥsamādhisaṃyukto na sa seveta duṣkṛtam ॥3॥
html:
mohādadharmaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā punaḥ samanutapyate ।
manaḥsamādhisaṃyukto na sa seveta duṣkṛtam ॥3॥
slp1: mohAdaDarmaM yaH kftvA punaH samanutapyate । manaHsamADisaMyukto na sa seveta duzkftam ॥3॥

text: yathā yathā naraḥ samyagadharmamanubhāṣate । samāhitena manasā vimucyati tathā tathā । bhujaṅga iva nirmokātpūrvabhuktājjarānvitāt ॥4॥
html:
yathā yathā naraḥ samyagadharmamanubhāṣate ।
samāhitena manasā vimucyati tathā tathā ।
bhujaṅga iva nirmokātpūrvabhuktājjarānvitāt ॥4॥
slp1: yaTA yaTA naraH samyagaDarmamanuBAzate । samAhitena manasA vimucyati taTA taTA । BujaNga iva nirmokAtpUrvaBuktAjjarAnvitAt ॥4॥

text: adattvāpi pradānāni vividhāni samāhitaḥ । manaḥsamādhisaṃyuktaḥ sugatiṃ pratipadyate ॥5॥
html:
adattvāpi pradānāni vividhāni samāhitaḥ ।
manaḥsamādhisaṃyuktaḥ sugatiṃ pratipadyate ॥5॥
slp1: adattvApi pradAnAni viviDAni samAhitaH । manaHsamADisaMyuktaH sugatiM pratipadyate ॥5॥

text: pradānāni tu vakṣyāmi yāni dattvā yudhiṣṭhira । naraḥ kṛtvāpyakāryāṇi tadā dharmeṇa yujyate ॥6॥
html:
pradānāni tu vakṣyāmi yāni dattvā yudhiṣṭhira ।
naraḥ kṛtvāpyakāryāṇi tadā dharmeṇa yujyate ॥6॥
slp1: pradAnAni tu vakzyAmi yAni dattvA yuDizWira । naraH kftvApyakAryARi tadA DarmeRa yujyate ॥6॥

text: sarveṣāmeva dānānāmannaṃ śreṣṭhamudāhṛtam । pūrvamannaṃ pradātavyamṛjunā dharmamicchatā ॥7॥
html:
sarveṣāmeva dānānāmannaṃ śreṣṭhamudāhṛtam ।
pūrvamannaṃ pradātavyamṛjunā dharmamicchatā ॥7॥
slp1: sarvezAmeva dAnAnAmannaM SrezWamudAhftam । pUrvamannaM pradAtavyamfjunA DarmamicCatA ॥7॥

text: prāṇā hyannaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tasmājjantuśca jāyate । anne pratiṣṭhitā lokāstasmādannaṃ prakāśate ॥8॥
html:
prāṇā hyannaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tasmājjantuśca jāyate ।
anne pratiṣṭhitā lokāstasmādannaṃ prakāśate ॥8॥
slp1: prARA hyannaM manuzyARAM tasmAjjantuSca jAyate । anne pratizWitA lokAstasmAdannaM prakASate ॥8॥

text: annameva praśaṃsanti devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ । annasya hi pradānena svargamāpnoti kauśikaḥ ॥9॥
html:
annameva praśaṃsanti devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ ।
annasya hi pradānena svargamāpnoti kauśikaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: annameva praSaMsanti devarzipitfmAnavAH । annasya hi pradAnena svargamApnoti kOSikaH ॥9॥

text: nyāyalabdhaṃ pradātavyaṃ dvijebhyo hyannamuttamam । svādhyāyasamupetebhyaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā ॥10॥
html:
nyāyalabdhaṃ pradātavyaṃ dvijebhyo hyannamuttamam ।
svādhyāyasamupetebhyaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā ॥10॥
slp1: nyAyalabDaM pradAtavyaM dvijeByo hyannamuttamam । svADyAyasamupeteByaH prahfzwenAntarAtmanA ॥10॥

text: yasya hyannamupāśnanti brāhmaṇānāṃ śatā daśa । hṛṣṭena manasā dattaṃ na sa tiryaggatirbhavet ॥11॥
html:
yasya hyannamupāśnanti brāhmaṇānāṃ śatā daśa ।
hṛṣṭena manasā dattaṃ na sa tiryaggatirbhavet ॥11॥
slp1: yasya hyannamupASnanti brAhmaRAnAM SatA daSa । hfzwena manasA dattaM na sa tiryaggatirBavet ॥11॥

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi daśa bhojya nararṣabha । naro'dharmātpramucyeta pāpeṣvabhirataḥ sadā ॥12॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi daśa bhojya nararṣabha ।
naro'dharmātpramucyeta pāpeṣvabhirataḥ sadā ॥12॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM sahasrARi daSa Bojya nararzaBa । naro'DarmAtpramucyeta pApezvaBirataH sadA ॥12॥

text: bhaikṣeṇānnaṃ samāhṛtya vipro vedapuraskṛtaḥ । svādhyāyanirate vipre dattveha sukhamedhate ॥13॥
html:
bhaikṣeṇānnaṃ samāhṛtya vipro vedapuraskṛtaḥ ।
svādhyāyanirate vipre dattveha sukhamedhate ॥13॥
slp1: BEkzeRAnnaM samAhftya vipro vedapuraskftaH । svADyAyanirate vipre dattveha suKameDate ॥13॥

text: ahiṃsanbrāhmaṇaṃ nityaṃ nyāyena paripālya ca । kṣatriyastarasā prāptamannaṃ yo vai prayacchati ॥14॥
html:
ahiṃsanbrāhmaṇaṃ nityaṃ nyāyena paripālya ca ।
kṣatriyastarasā prāptamannaṃ yo vai prayacchati ॥14॥
slp1: ahiMsanbrAhmaRaM nityaM nyAyena paripAlya ca । kzatriyastarasA prAptamannaM yo vE prayacCati ॥14॥

text: dvijebhyo vedavṛddhebhyaḥ prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ । tenāpohati dharmātmā duṣkṛtaṃ karma pāṇḍava ॥15॥
html:
dvijebhyo vedavṛddhebhyaḥ prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ ।
tenāpohati dharmātmā duṣkṛtaṃ karma pāṇḍava ॥15॥
slp1: dvijeByo vedavfdDeByaH prayataH susamAhitaH । tenApohati DarmAtmA duzkftaM karma pARqava ॥15॥

text: ṣaḍbhāgapariśuddhaṃ ca kṛṣerbhāgamupārjitam । vaiśyo dadaddvijātibhyaḥ pāpebhyaḥ parimucyate ॥16॥
html:
ṣaḍbhāgapariśuddhaṃ ca kṛṣerbhāgamupārjitam ।
vaiśyo dadaddvijātibhyaḥ pāpebhyaḥ parimucyate ॥16॥
slp1: zaqBAgapariSudDaM ca kfzerBAgamupArjitam । vESyo dadaddvijAtiByaH pApeByaH parimucyate ॥16॥

text: avāpya prāṇasandehaṃ kārkaśyena samārjitam । annaṃ dattvā dvijātibhyaḥ śūdraḥ pāpātpramucyate ॥17॥
html:
avāpya prāṇasandehaṃ kārkaśyena samārjitam ।
annaṃ dattvā dvijātibhyaḥ śūdraḥ pāpātpramucyate ॥17॥
slp1: avApya prARasandehaM kArkaSyena samArjitam । annaM dattvA dvijAtiByaH SUdraH pApAtpramucyate ॥17॥

text: aurasena balenānnamarjayitvāvihiṃsakaḥ । yaḥ prayacchati viprebhyo na sa durgāṇi sevate ॥18॥
html:
aurasena balenānnamarjayitvāvihiṃsakaḥ ।
yaḥ prayacchati viprebhyo na sa durgāṇi sevate ॥18॥
slp1: Orasena balenAnnamarjayitvAvihiMsakaH । yaH prayacCati vipreByo na sa durgARi sevate ॥18॥

text: nyāyenāvāptamannaṃ tu naro lobhavivarjitaḥ । dvijebhyo vedavṛddhebhyo dattvā pāpātpramucyate ॥19॥
html:
nyāyenāvāptamannaṃ tu naro lobhavivarjitaḥ ।
dvijebhyo vedavṛddhebhyo dattvā pāpātpramucyate ॥19॥
slp1: nyAyenAvAptamannaM tu naro loBavivarjitaH । dvijeByo vedavfdDeByo dattvA pApAtpramucyate ॥19॥

text: annamūrjaskaraṃ loke dattvorjasvī bhavennaraḥ । satāṃ panthānamāśritya sarvapāpātpramucyate ॥20॥
html:
annamūrjaskaraṃ loke dattvorjasvī bhavennaraḥ ।
satāṃ panthānamāśritya sarvapāpātpramucyate ॥20॥
slp1: annamUrjaskaraM loke dattvorjasvI BavennaraH । satAM panTAnamASritya sarvapApAtpramucyate ॥20॥

text: dānakṛdbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ । te sma prāṇasya dātārastebhyo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥21॥
html:
dānakṛdbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ ।
te sma prāṇasya dātārastebhyo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: dAnakfdBiH kftaH panTA yena yAnti manIziRaH । te sma prARasya dAtArasteByo DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥21॥

text: sarvāvasthaṃ manuṣyeṇa nyāyenānnamupārjitam । kāryaṃ pātragataṃ nityamannaṃ hi paramā gatiḥ ॥22॥
html:
sarvāvasthaṃ manuṣyeṇa nyāyenānnamupārjitam ।
kāryaṃ pātragataṃ nityamannaṃ hi paramā gatiḥ ॥22॥
slp1: sarvAvasTaM manuzyeRa nyAyenAnnamupArjitam । kAryaM pAtragataM nityamannaM hi paramA gatiH ॥22॥

text: annasya hi pradānena naro durgaṃ na sevate । tasmādannaṃ pradātavyamanyāyaparivarjitam ॥23॥
html:
annasya hi pradānena naro durgaṃ na sevate ।
tasmādannaṃ pradātavyamanyāyaparivarjitam ॥23॥
slp1: annasya hi pradAnena naro durgaM na sevate । tasmAdannaM pradAtavyamanyAyaparivarjitam ॥23॥

text: yatedbrāhmaṇapūrvaṃ hi bhoktumannaṃ gṛhī sadā । avandhyaṃ divasaṃ kuryādannadānena mānavaḥ ॥24॥
html:
yatedbrāhmaṇapūrvaṃ hi bhoktumannaṃ gṛhī sadā ।
avandhyaṃ divasaṃ kuryādannadānena mānavaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: yatedbrAhmaRapUrvaM hi BoktumannaM gfhI sadA । avanDyaM divasaM kuryAdannadAnena mAnavaH ॥24॥

text: bhojayitvā daśaśataṃ naro vedavidāṃ nṛpa । nyāyaviddharmaviduṣāmitihāsavidāṃ tathā ॥25॥
html:
bhojayitvā daśaśataṃ naro vedavidāṃ nṛpa ।
nyāyaviddharmaviduṣāmitihāsavidāṃ tathā ॥25॥
slp1: BojayitvA daSaSataM naro vedavidAM nfpa । nyAyavidDarmaviduzAmitihAsavidAM taTA ॥25॥

text: na yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ saṃsārāṃśca na sevate । sarvakāmasamāyuktaḥ pretya cāpyaśnute phalam ॥26॥
html:
na yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ saṃsārāṃśca na sevate ।
sarvakāmasamāyuktaḥ pretya cāpyaśnute phalam ॥26॥
slp1: na yAti narakaM GoraM saMsArAMSca na sevate । sarvakAmasamAyuktaH pretya cApyaSnute Palam ॥26॥

text: evaṃ sukhasamāyukto ramate vigatajvaraḥ । rūpavānkīrtimāṃścaiva dhanavāṃścopapadyate ॥27॥
html:
evaṃ sukhasamāyukto ramate vigatajvaraḥ ।
rūpavānkīrtimāṃścaiva dhanavāṃścopapadyate ॥27॥
slp1: evaM suKasamAyukto ramate vigatajvaraH । rUpavAnkIrtimAMScEva DanavAMScopapadyate ॥27॥

text: etatte sarvamākhyātamannadānaphalaṃ mahat । mūlametaddhi dharmāṇāṃ pradānasya ca bhārata] ॥28॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātamannadānaphalaṃ mahat ।
mūlametaddhi dharmāṇāṃ pradānasya ca bhārata] ॥28॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtamannadAnaPalaM mahat । mUlametadDi DarmARAM pradAnasya ca BArata] ॥28॥

text: ahiṃsā vaidikaṃ karma dhyānamindriyasaṃyamaḥ । tapo'tha guruśuśrūṣā kiṃ śreyaḥ puruṣaṃ prati ॥1॥
html:
ahiṃsā vaidikaṃ karma dhyānamindriyasaṃyamaḥ ।
tapo'tha guruśuśrūṣā kiṃ śreyaḥ puruṣaṃ prati ॥1॥
slp1: ahiMsA vEdikaM karma DyAnamindriyasaMyamaH । tapo'Ta guruSuSrUzA kiM SreyaH puruzaM prati ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sarvāṇyetāni dharmasya pṛthagdvārāṇi sarvaśaḥ । śṛṇu saṅkīrtyamānāni ṣaḍeva bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
html:
sarvāṇyetāni dharmasya pṛthagdvārāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।
śṛṇu saṅkīrtyamānāni ṣaḍeva bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
slp1: sarvARyetAni Darmasya pfTagdvArARi sarvaSaH । SfRu saNkIrtyamAnAni zaqeva BaratarzaBa ॥2॥
author: bṛhaspatiruvāca ।

text: hanta niḥśreyasaṃ jantorahaṃ vakṣyāmyanuttamam । ahiṃsāpāśrayaṃ dharmaṃ yaḥ sādhayati vai naraḥ ॥3॥
html:
hanta niḥśreyasaṃ jantorahaṃ vakṣyāmyanuttamam ।
ahiṃsāpāśrayaṃ dharmaṃ yaḥ sādhayati vai naraḥ ॥3॥
slp1: hanta niHSreyasaM jantorahaM vakzyAmyanuttamam । ahiMsApASrayaM DarmaM yaH sADayati vE naraH ॥3॥

text: trīndoṣānsarvabhūteṣu nidhāya puruṣaḥ sadā । kāmakrodhau ca saṃyamya tataḥ siddhimavāpnute ॥4॥
html:
trīndoṣānsarvabhūteṣu nidhāya puruṣaḥ sadā ।
kāmakrodhau ca saṃyamya tataḥ siddhimavāpnute ॥4॥
slp1: trIndozAnsarvaBUtezu niDAya puruzaH sadA । kAmakroDO ca saMyamya tataH sidDimavApnute ॥4॥

text: ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni daṇḍena vinihanti yaḥ । ātmanaḥ sukhamanvicchanna sa pretya sukhī bhavet ॥5॥
html:
ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni daṇḍena vinihanti yaḥ ।
ātmanaḥ sukhamanvicchanna sa pretya sukhī bhavet ॥5॥
slp1: ahiMsakAni BUtAni daRqena vinihanti yaH । AtmanaH suKamanvicCanna sa pretya suKI Bavet ॥5॥

text: ātmopamaśca bhūteṣu yo vai bhavati pūruṣaḥ । nyastadaṇḍo jitakrodhaḥ sa pretya sukhamedhate ॥6॥
html:
ātmopamaśca bhūteṣu yo vai bhavati pūruṣaḥ ।
nyastadaṇḍo jitakrodhaḥ sa pretya sukhamedhate ॥6॥
slp1: AtmopamaSca BUtezu yo vE Bavati pUruzaH । nyastadaRqo jitakroDaH sa pretya suKameDate ॥6॥

text: sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya sarvabhūtāni paśyataḥ । devāpi mārge muhyanti apadasya padaiṣiṇaḥ ॥7॥
html:
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya sarvabhūtāni paśyataḥ ।
devāpi mārge muhyanti apadasya padaiṣiṇaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: sarvaBUtAtmaBUtasya sarvaBUtAni paSyataH । devApi mArge muhyanti apadasya padEziRaH ॥7॥

text: na tatparasya sandadyātpratikūlaṃ yadātmanaḥ । eṣa saṅkṣepato dharmaḥ kāmādanyaḥ pravartate ॥8॥
html:
na tatparasya sandadyātpratikūlaṃ yadātmanaḥ ।
eṣa saṅkṣepato dharmaḥ kāmādanyaḥ pravartate ॥8॥
slp1: na tatparasya sandadyAtpratikUlaM yadAtmanaH । eza saNkzepato DarmaH kAmAdanyaH pravartate ॥8॥

text: pratyākhyāne ca dāne ca sukhaduḥkhe priyāpriye । ātmaupamyena puruṣaḥ samādhimadhigacchati ॥9॥
html:
pratyākhyāne ca dāne ca sukhaduḥkhe priyāpriye ।
ātmaupamyena puruṣaḥ samādhimadhigacchati ॥9॥
slp1: pratyAKyAne ca dAne ca suKaduHKe priyApriye । AtmOpamyena puruzaH samADimaDigacCati ॥9॥

text: yathā paraḥ prakramate'pareṣu tathāparaḥ prakramate parasmin । eṣaiva te'stūpamā jīvaloke yathā dharmo naipuṇenopadiṣṭaḥ ॥10॥
html:
yathā paraḥ prakramate'pareṣu tathāparaḥ prakramate parasmin ।
eṣaiva te'stūpamā jīvaloke yathā dharmo naipuṇenopadiṣṭaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yaTA paraH prakramate'parezu taTAparaH prakramate parasmin । ezEva te'stUpamA jIvaloke yaTA Darmo nEpuRenopadizwaH ॥10॥

text: ityuktvā taṃ suragururdharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram । divamācakrame dhīmānpaśyatāmeva nastadā] ॥11॥
html:
ityuktvā taṃ suragururdharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram ।
divamācakrame dhīmānpaśyatāmeva nastadā] ॥11॥
slp1: ityuktvA taM suragururDarmarAjaM yuDizWiram । divamAcakrame DImAnpaSyatAmeva nastadA] ॥11॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā śaratalpe pitāmaham । punareva mahātejāḥ papraccha vadatāṃ varam ॥1॥
html:
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā śaratalpe pitāmaham ।
punareva mahātejāḥ papraccha vadatāṃ varam ॥1॥
slp1: tato yuDizWiro rAjA Saratalpe pitAmaham । punareva mahAtejAH papracCa vadatAM varam ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: ṛṣayo brāhmaṇā devāḥ praśaṃsanti mahāmate । ahiṃsālakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ vedaprāmāṇyadarśanāt ॥2॥
html:
ṛṣayo brāhmaṇā devāḥ praśaṃsanti mahāmate ।
ahiṃsālakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ vedaprāmāṇyadarśanāt ॥2॥
slp1: fzayo brAhmaRA devAH praSaMsanti mahAmate । ahiMsAlakzaRaM DarmaM vedaprAmARyadarSanAt ॥2॥

text: karmaṇā manujaḥ kurvanhiṃsāṃ pārthivasattama । vācā ca manasā caiva kathaṃ duḥkhātpramucyate ॥3॥
html:
karmaṇā manujaḥ kurvanhiṃsāṃ pārthivasattama ।
vācā ca manasā caiva kathaṃ duḥkhātpramucyate ॥3॥
slp1: karmaRA manujaH kurvanhiMsAM pArTivasattama । vAcA ca manasA cEva kaTaM duHKAtpramucyate ॥3॥

text: caturvidheyaṃ nirdiṣṭā ahiṃsā brahmavādibhiḥ । eṣaikato'pi vibhraṣṭā na bhavatyarisūdana ॥4॥
html:
caturvidheyaṃ nirdiṣṭā ahiṃsā brahmavādibhiḥ ।
eṣaikato'pi vibhraṣṭā na bhavatyarisūdana ॥4॥
slp1: caturviDeyaM nirdizwA ahiMsA brahmavAdiBiH । ezEkato'pi viBrazwA na BavatyarisUdana ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yathā sarvaścatuṣpādastribhiḥ pādairna tiṣṭhati । tathaiveyaṃ mahīpāla procyate kāraṇaistribhiḥ ॥5॥
html:
yathā sarvaścatuṣpādastribhiḥ pādairna tiṣṭhati ।
tathaiveyaṃ mahīpāla procyate kāraṇaistribhiḥ ॥5॥
slp1: yaTA sarvaScatuzpAdastriBiH pAdErna tizWati । taTEveyaM mahIpAla procyate kAraREstriBiH ॥5॥

text: yathā nāgapade'nyāni padāni padagāminām । sarvāṇyevāpidhīyante padajātāni kauñjare । evaṃ lokeṣvahiṃsā tu nirdiṣṭā dharmataḥ parā ॥6॥
html:
yathā nāgapade'nyāni padāni padagāminām ।
sarvāṇyevāpidhīyante padajātāni kauñjare ।
evaṃ lokeṣvahiṃsā tu nirdiṣṭā dharmataḥ parā ॥6॥
slp1: yaTA nAgapade'nyAni padAni padagAminAm । sarvARyevApiDIyante padajAtAni kOYjare । evaM lokezvahiMsA tu nirdizwA DarmataH parA ॥6॥

text: karmaṇā lipyate janturvācā ca manasaiva ca ॥7॥
html: karmaṇā lipyate janturvācā ca manasaiva ca ॥7॥
slp1: karmaRA lipyate janturvAcA ca manasEva ca ॥7॥

text: pūrvaṃ tu manasā tyaktvā tathā vācātha karmaṇā । trikāraṇaṃ tu nirdiṣṭaṃ śrūyate brahmavādibhiḥ ॥8॥
html:
pūrvaṃ tu manasā tyaktvā tathā vācātha karmaṇā ।
trikāraṇaṃ tu nirdiṣṭaṃ śrūyate brahmavādibhiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: pUrvaM tu manasA tyaktvA taTA vAcATa karmaRA । trikAraRaM tu nirdizwaM SrUyate brahmavAdiBiH ॥8॥

text: manovāci tathāsvāde doṣā hyeṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ । na bhakṣayantyato māṃsaṃ tapoyuktā manīṣiṇaḥ ॥9॥
html:
manovāci tathāsvāde doṣā hyeṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।
na bhakṣayantyato māṃsaṃ tapoyuktā manīṣiṇaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: manovAci taTAsvAde dozA hyezu pratizWitAH । na Bakzayantyato mAMsaM tapoyuktA manIziRaH ॥9॥

text: doṣāṃstu bhakṣaṇe rājanmāṃsasyeha nibodha me । putramāṃsopamaṃ jānankhādate yo vicetanaḥ ॥10॥
html:
doṣāṃstu bhakṣaṇe rājanmāṃsasyeha nibodha me ।
putramāṃsopamaṃ jānankhādate yo vicetanaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: dozAMstu BakzaRe rAjanmAMsasyeha niboDa me । putramAMsopamaM jAnanKAdate yo vicetanaH ॥10॥

text: mātāpitṛsamāyoge putratvaṃ jāyate yathā । rasaṃ ca prati jihvāyāḥ prajñānaṃ jāyate tathā । tathā śāstreṣu niyataṃ rāgo hyāsvāditādbhavet ॥11॥
html:
mātāpitṛsamāyoge putratvaṃ jāyate yathā ।
rasaṃ ca prati jihvāyāḥ prajñānaṃ jāyate tathā ।
tathā śāstreṣu niyataṃ rāgo hyāsvāditādbhavet ॥11॥
slp1: mAtApitfsamAyoge putratvaM jAyate yaTA । rasaM ca prati jihvAyAH prajYAnaM jAyate taTA । taTA SAstrezu niyataM rAgo hyAsvAditAdBavet ॥11॥

text: asaṃskṛtāḥ saṃskṛtāśca lavaṇālavaṇāstathā । prajñāyante yathā bhāvāstathā cittaṃ nirudhyate ॥12॥
html:
asaṃskṛtāḥ saṃskṛtāśca lavaṇālavaṇāstathā ।
prajñāyante yathā bhāvāstathā cittaṃ nirudhyate ॥12॥
slp1: asaMskftAH saMskftASca lavaRAlavaRAstaTA । prajYAyante yaTA BAvAstaTA cittaM niruDyate ॥12॥

text: bherīśaṅkhamṛdaṅgādyāṃstantrīśabdāṃśca puṣkalān । niṣeviṣyanti vai mandā māṃsabhakṣāḥ kathaṃ narāḥ ॥13॥
html:
bherīśaṅkhamṛdaṅgādyāṃstantrīśabdāṃśca puṣkalān ।
niṣeviṣyanti vai mandā māṃsabhakṣāḥ kathaṃ narāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: BerISaNKamfdaNgAdyAMstantrISabdAMSca puzkalAn । nizevizyanti vE mandA mAMsaBakzAH kaTaM narAH ॥13॥

text: acintitamanuddiṣṭamasaṅkalpitameva ca । rasaṃ gṛddhyābhibhūtā vai praśaṃsanti phalārthinaḥ । praśaṃsā hyeva māṃsasya doṣakarmaphalānvitā ॥14॥
html:
acintitamanuddiṣṭamasaṅkalpitameva ca ।
rasaṃ gṛddhyābhibhūtā vai praśaṃsanti phalārthinaḥ ।
praśaṃsā hyeva māṃsasya doṣakarmaphalānvitā ॥14॥
slp1: acintitamanuddizwamasaNkalpitameva ca । rasaM gfdDyABiBUtA vE praSaMsanti PalArTinaH । praSaMsA hyeva mAMsasya dozakarmaPalAnvitA ॥14॥

text: jīvitaṃ hi parityajya bahavaḥ sādhavo janāḥ । svamāṃsaiḥ paramāṃsāni paripālya divaṃ gatāḥ ॥15॥
html:
jīvitaṃ hi parityajya bahavaḥ sādhavo janāḥ ।
svamāṃsaiḥ paramāṃsāni paripālya divaṃ gatāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: jIvitaM hi parityajya bahavaH sADavo janAH । svamAMsEH paramAMsAni paripAlya divaM gatAH ॥15॥

text: evameṣā mahārāja caturbhiḥ kāraṇairvṛtā । ahiṃsā tava nirdiṣṭā sarvadharmārthasaṃhitā] ॥16॥
html:
evameṣā mahārāja caturbhiḥ kāraṇairvṛtā ।
ahiṃsā tava nirdiṣṭā sarvadharmārthasaṃhitā] ॥16॥
slp1: evamezA mahArAja caturBiH kAraRErvftA । ahiMsA tava nirdizwA sarvaDarmArTasaMhitA] ॥16॥

text: ahiṃsā paramo dharma ityuktaṃ bahuśastvayā । śrāddheṣu ca bhavānāha pitṝnāmiṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥1॥
html:
ahiṃsā paramo dharma ityuktaṃ bahuśastvayā ।
śrāddheṣu ca bhavānāha pitṝnāmiṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: ahiMsA paramo Darma ityuktaM bahuSastvayA । SrAdDezu ca BavAnAha pitFnAmizakANkziRaH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: māṃsairbahuvidhaiḥ proktastvayā śrāddhavidhiḥ purā । ahatvā ca kuto māṃsamevametadvirudhyate ॥2॥
html:
māṃsairbahuvidhaiḥ proktastvayā śrāddhavidhiḥ purā ।
ahatvā ca kuto māṃsamevametadvirudhyate ॥2॥
slp1: mAMsErbahuviDEH proktastvayA SrAdDaviDiH purA । ahatvA ca kuto mAMsamevametadviruDyate ॥2॥

text: jāto naḥ saṃśayo dharme māṃsasya parivarjane । doṣo bhakṣayataḥ kaḥ syātkaścābhakṣayato guṇaḥ ॥3॥
html:
jāto naḥ saṃśayo dharme māṃsasya parivarjane ।
doṣo bhakṣayataḥ kaḥ syātkaścābhakṣayato guṇaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: jAto naH saMSayo Darme mAMsasya parivarjane । dozo BakzayataH kaH syAtkaScABakzayato guRaH ॥3॥

text: hatvā bhakṣayato vāpi pareṇopahṛtasya vā । hanyādvā yaḥ parasyārthe krītvā vā bhakṣayennaraḥ ॥4॥
html:
hatvā bhakṣayato vāpi pareṇopahṛtasya vā ।
hanyādvā yaḥ parasyārthe krītvā vā bhakṣayennaraḥ ॥4॥
slp1: hatvA Bakzayato vApi pareRopahftasya vA । hanyAdvA yaH parasyArTe krItvA vA BakzayennaraH ॥4॥

text: etadicchāmi tattvena kathyamānaṃ tvayānagha । niścayena cikīrṣāmi dharmametaṃ sanātanam ॥5॥
html:
etadicchāmi tattvena kathyamānaṃ tvayānagha ।
niścayena cikīrṣāmi dharmametaṃ sanātanam ॥5॥
slp1: etadicCAmi tattvena kaTyamAnaM tvayAnaGa । niScayena cikIrzAmi DarmametaM sanAtanam ॥5॥

text: kathamāyuravāpnoti kathaṃ bhavati sattvavān । kathamavyaṅgatāmeti lakṣaṇyo jāyate katham ॥6॥
html:
kathamāyuravāpnoti kathaṃ bhavati sattvavān ।
kathamavyaṅgatāmeti lakṣaṇyo jāyate katham ॥6॥
slp1: kaTamAyuravApnoti kaTaM Bavati sattvavAn । kaTamavyaNgatAmeti lakzaRyo jAyate kaTam ॥6॥

text: māṃsasya bhakṣaṇe rājanyo'dharmaḥ kurupuṅgava । taṃ me śṛṇu yathātattvaṃ yaścāsya vidhiruttamaḥ ॥7॥
html:
māṃsasya bhakṣaṇe rājanyo'dharmaḥ kurupuṅgava ।
taṃ me śṛṇu yathātattvaṃ yaścāsya vidhiruttamaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: mAMsasya BakzaRe rAjanyo'DarmaH kurupuNgava । taM me SfRu yaTAtattvaM yaScAsya viDiruttamaH ॥7॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: rūpamavyaṅgatāmāyurbuddhiṃ sattvaṃ balaṃ smṛtim । prāptukāmairnarairhiṃsā varjitā vai kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥8॥
html:
rūpamavyaṅgatāmāyurbuddhiṃ sattvaṃ balaṃ smṛtim ।
prāptukāmairnarairhiṃsā varjitā vai kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: rUpamavyaNgatAmAyurbudDiM sattvaM balaM smftim । prAptukAmErnarErhiMsA varjitA vE kftAtmaBiH ॥8॥

text: ṛṣīṇāmatra saṃvādo bahuśaḥ kurupuṅgava । babhūva teṣāṃ tu mataṃ yattacchṛṇu yudhiṣṭhira ॥9॥
html:
ṛṣīṇāmatra saṃvādo bahuśaḥ kurupuṅgava ।
babhūva teṣāṃ tu mataṃ yattacchṛṇu yudhiṣṭhira ॥9॥
slp1: fzIRAmatra saMvAdo bahuSaH kurupuNgava । baBUva tezAM tu mataM yattacCfRu yuDizWira ॥9॥

text: yo yajetāśvamedhena māsi māsi yatavrataḥ । varjayenmadhu māṃsaṃ ca samametadyudhiṣṭhira ॥10॥
html:
yo yajetāśvamedhena māsi māsi yatavrataḥ ।
varjayenmadhu māṃsaṃ ca samametadyudhiṣṭhira ॥10॥
slp1: yo yajetASvameDena mAsi mAsi yatavrataH । varjayenmaDu mAMsaM ca samametadyuDizWira ॥10॥

text: saptarṣayo vālakhilyāstathaiva ca marīcipāḥ । amāṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ rājanpraśaṃsanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
saptarṣayo vālakhilyāstathaiva ca marīcipāḥ ।
amāṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ rājanpraśaṃsanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: saptarzayo vAlaKilyAstaTEva ca marIcipAH । amAMsaBakzaRaM rAjanpraSaMsanti manIziRaH ॥11॥

text: na bhakṣayati yo māṃsaṃ na hanyānna ca ghātayet । taṃ mitraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ manuḥ svāyambhuvo'bravīt ॥12॥
html:
na bhakṣayati yo māṃsaṃ na hanyānna ca ghātayet ।
taṃ mitraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ manuḥ svāyambhuvo'bravīt ॥12॥
slp1: na Bakzayati yo mAMsaM na hanyAnna ca GAtayet । taM mitraM sarvaBUtAnAM manuH svAyamBuvo'bravIt ॥12॥

text: adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ viśvāsyaḥ sarvajantuṣu । sādhūnāṃ sammato nityaṃ bhavenmāṃsasya varjanāt ॥13॥
html:
adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ viśvāsyaḥ sarvajantuṣu ।
sādhūnāṃ sammato nityaṃ bhavenmāṃsasya varjanāt ॥13॥
slp1: aDfzyaH sarvaBUtAnAM viSvAsyaH sarvajantuzu । sADUnAM sammato nityaM BavenmAMsasya varjanAt ॥13॥

text: svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayitumicchati । nāradaḥ prāha dharmātmā niyataṃ so'vasīdati ॥14॥
html:
svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayitumicchati ।
nāradaḥ prāha dharmātmā niyataṃ so'vasīdati ॥14॥
slp1: svamAMsaM paramAMsena yo varDayitumicCati । nAradaH prAha DarmAtmA niyataM so'vasIdati ॥14॥

text: dadāti yajate cāpi tapasvī ca bhavatyapi । madhumāṃsanivṛttyeti prāhaivaṃ sa bṛhaspatiḥ ॥15॥
html:
dadāti yajate cāpi tapasvī ca bhavatyapi ।
madhumāṃsanivṛttyeti prāhaivaṃ sa bṛhaspatiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: dadAti yajate cApi tapasvI ca Bavatyapi । maDumAMsanivfttyeti prAhEvaM sa bfhaspatiH ॥15॥

text: māsi māsyaśvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ । na khādati ca yo māṃsaṃ samametanmataṃ mama ॥16॥
html:
māsi māsyaśvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ ।
na khādati ca yo māṃsaṃ samametanmataṃ mama ॥16॥
slp1: mAsi mAsyaSvameDena yo yajeta SataM samAH । na KAdati ca yo mAMsaM samametanmataM mama ॥16॥

text: sadā yajati satreṇa sadā dānaṃ prayacchati । sadā tapasvī bhavati madhumāṃsasya varjanāt ॥17॥
html:
sadā yajati satreṇa sadā dānaṃ prayacchati ।
sadā tapasvī bhavati madhumāṃsasya varjanāt ॥17॥
slp1: sadA yajati satreRa sadA dAnaM prayacCati । sadA tapasvI Bavati maDumAMsasya varjanAt ॥17॥

text: sarve vedā na tatkuryuḥ sarvayajñāśca bhārata । yo bhakṣayitvā māṃsāni paścādapi nivartate ॥18॥
html:
sarve vedā na tatkuryuḥ sarvayajñāśca bhārata ।
yo bhakṣayitvā māṃsāni paścādapi nivartate ॥18॥
slp1: sarve vedA na tatkuryuH sarvayajYASca BArata । yo BakzayitvA mAMsAni paScAdapi nivartate ॥18॥

text: duṣkaraṃ hi rasajñena māṃsasya parivarjanam । cartuṃ vratamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvaprāṇyabhayapradam ॥19॥
html:
duṣkaraṃ hi rasajñena māṃsasya parivarjanam ।
cartuṃ vratamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvaprāṇyabhayapradam ॥19॥
slp1: duzkaraM hi rasajYena mAMsasya parivarjanam । cartuM vratamidaM SrezWaM sarvaprARyaBayapradam ॥19॥

text: sarvabhūteṣu yo vidvāndadātyabhayadakṣiṇām । dātā bhavati loke sa prāṇānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥20॥
html:
sarvabhūteṣu yo vidvāndadātyabhayadakṣiṇām ।
dātā bhavati loke sa prāṇānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: sarvaBUtezu yo vidvAndadAtyaBayadakziRAm । dAtA Bavati loke sa prARAnAM nAtra saMSayaH ॥20॥

text: evaṃ vai paramaṃ dharmaṃ praśaṃsanti manīṣiṇaḥ । prāṇā yathātmano'bhīṣṭā bhūtānāmapi te tathā ॥21॥
html:
evaṃ vai paramaṃ dharmaṃ praśaṃsanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।
prāṇā yathātmano'bhīṣṭā bhūtānāmapi te tathā ॥21॥
slp1: evaM vE paramaM DarmaM praSaMsanti manIziRaH । prARA yaTAtmano'BIzwA BUtAnAmapi te taTA ॥21॥

text: ātmaupamyena gantavyaṃ buddhimadbhirmahātmabhiḥ । mṛtyuto bhayamastīti viduṣāṃ bhūtimicchatām ॥22॥
html:
ātmaupamyena gantavyaṃ buddhimadbhirmahātmabhiḥ ।
mṛtyuto bhayamastīti viduṣāṃ bhūtimicchatām ॥22॥
slp1: AtmOpamyena gantavyaM budDimadBirmahAtmaBiH । mftyuto BayamastIti viduzAM BUtimicCatAm ॥22॥

text: kiṃ punarhanyamānānāṃ tarasā jīvitārthinām । arogāṇāmapāpānāṃ pāpairmāṃsopajīvibhiḥ ॥23॥
html:
kiṃ punarhanyamānānāṃ tarasā jīvitārthinām ।
arogāṇāmapāpānāṃ pāpairmāṃsopajīvibhiḥ ॥23॥
slp1: kiM punarhanyamAnAnAM tarasA jIvitArTinAm । arogARAmapApAnAM pApErmAMsopajIviBiH ॥23॥

text: tasmādviddhi mahārāja māṃsasya parivarjanam । dharmasyāyatanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svargasya ca sukhasya ca ॥24॥
html:
tasmādviddhi mahārāja māṃsasya parivarjanam ।
dharmasyāyatanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svargasya ca sukhasya ca ॥24॥
slp1: tasmAdvidDi mahArAja mAMsasya parivarjanam । DarmasyAyatanaM SrezWaM svargasya ca suKasya ca ॥24॥

text: ahiṃsā paramo dharmastathāhiṃsā paraṃ tapaḥ । ahiṃsā paramaṃ satyaṃ tato dharmaḥ pravartate ॥25॥
html:
ahiṃsā paramo dharmastathāhiṃsā paraṃ tapaḥ ।
ahiṃsā paramaṃ satyaṃ tato dharmaḥ pravartate ॥25॥
slp1: ahiMsA paramo DarmastaTAhiMsA paraM tapaH । ahiMsA paramaM satyaM tato DarmaH pravartate ॥25॥

text: na hi māṃsaṃ tṛṇātkāṣṭhādupalādvāpi jāyate । hatvā jantuṃ tato māṃsaṃ tasmāddoṣo'sya bhakṣaṇe ॥26॥
html:
na hi māṃsaṃ tṛṇātkāṣṭhādupalādvāpi jāyate ।
hatvā jantuṃ tato māṃsaṃ tasmāddoṣo'sya bhakṣaṇe ॥26॥
slp1: na hi mAMsaM tfRAtkAzWAdupalAdvApi jAyate । hatvA jantuM tato mAMsaM tasmAddozo'sya BakzaRe ॥26॥

text: svāhāsvadhāmṛtabhujo devāḥ satyārjavapriyāḥ । kravyādānrākṣasānviddhi jihmānṛtaparāyaṇān ॥27॥
html:
svāhāsvadhāmṛtabhujo devāḥ satyārjavapriyāḥ ।
kravyādānrākṣasānviddhi jihmānṛtaparāyaṇān ॥27॥
slp1: svAhAsvaDAmftaBujo devAH satyArjavapriyAH । kravyAdAnrAkzasAnvidDi jihmAnftaparAyaRAn ॥27॥

text: kāntāreṣvatha ghoreṣu durgeṣu gahaneṣu ca । rātrāvahani sandhyāsu catvareṣu sabhāsu ca । amāṃsabhakṣaṇe rājanbhayamante na gacchati ॥28॥
html:
kāntāreṣvatha ghoreṣu durgeṣu gahaneṣu ca ।
rātrāvahani sandhyāsu catvareṣu sabhāsu ca ।
amāṃsabhakṣaṇe rājanbhayamante na gacchati ॥28॥
slp1: kAntArezvaTa Gorezu durgezu gahanezu ca । rAtrAvahani sanDyAsu catvarezu saBAsu ca । amAMsaBakzaRe rAjanBayamante na gacCati ॥28॥

text: yadi cetkhādako na syānna tadā ghātako bhavet । ghātakaḥ khādakārthāya taṃ ghātayati vai naraḥ ॥29॥
html:
yadi cetkhādako na syānna tadā ghātako bhavet ।
ghātakaḥ khādakārthāya taṃ ghātayati vai naraḥ ॥29॥
slp1: yadi cetKAdako na syAnna tadA GAtako Bavet । GAtakaH KAdakArTAya taM GAtayati vE naraH ॥29॥

text: abhakṣyametaditi vā iti hiṃsā nivartate । khādakārthamato hiṃsā mṛgādīnāṃ pravartate ॥30॥
html:
abhakṣyametaditi vā iti hiṃsā nivartate ।
khādakārthamato hiṃsā mṛgādīnāṃ pravartate ॥30॥
slp1: aBakzyametaditi vA iti hiMsA nivartate । KAdakArTamato hiMsA mfgAdInAM pravartate ॥30॥

text: yasmādgrasati caivāyurhiṃsakānāṃ mahādyute । tasmādvivarjayenmāṃsaṃ ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ॥31॥
html:
yasmādgrasati caivāyurhiṃsakānāṃ mahādyute ।
tasmādvivarjayenmāṃsaṃ ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: yasmAdgrasati cEvAyurhiMsakAnAM mahAdyute । tasmAdvivarjayenmAMsaM ya icCedBUtimAtmanaH ॥31॥

text: trātāraṃ nādhigacchanti raudrāḥ prāṇivihiṃsakāḥ । udvejanīyā bhūtānāṃ yathā vyālamṛgāstathā ॥32॥
html:
trātāraṃ nādhigacchanti raudrāḥ prāṇivihiṃsakāḥ ।
udvejanīyā bhūtānāṃ yathā vyālamṛgāstathā ॥32॥
slp1: trAtAraM nADigacCanti rOdrAH prARivihiMsakAH । udvejanIyA BUtAnAM yaTA vyAlamfgAstaTA ॥32॥

text: lobhādvā buddhimohādvā balavīryārthameva ca । saṃsargādvātha pāpānāmadharmarucitā nṛṇām ॥33॥
html:
lobhādvā buddhimohādvā balavīryārthameva ca ।
saṃsargādvātha pāpānāmadharmarucitā nṛṇām ॥33॥
slp1: loBAdvA budDimohAdvA balavIryArTameva ca । saMsargAdvATa pApAnAmaDarmarucitA nfRAm ॥33॥

text: svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayitumicchati । udvignavāse vasati yatratatrābhijāyate ॥34॥
html:
svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayitumicchati ।
udvignavāse vasati yatratatrābhijāyate ॥34॥
slp1: svamAMsaM paramAMsena yo varDayitumicCati । udvignavAse vasati yatratatrABijAyate ॥34॥

text: dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat । māṃsasyābhakṣaṇaṃ prāhurniyatāḥ paramarṣayaḥ ॥35॥
html:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat ।
māṃsasyābhakṣaṇaṃ prāhurniyatāḥ paramarṣayaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: DanyaM yaSasyamAyuzyaM svargyaM svastyayanaM mahat । mAMsasyABakzaRaM prAhurniyatAH paramarzayaH ॥35॥

text: idaṃ tu khalu kaunteya śrutamāsītpurā mayā । mārkaṇḍeyasya vadato ye doṣā māṃsabhakṣaṇe ॥36॥
html:
idaṃ tu khalu kaunteya śrutamāsītpurā mayā ।
mārkaṇḍeyasya vadato ye doṣā māṃsabhakṣaṇe ॥36॥
slp1: idaM tu Kalu kOnteya SrutamAsItpurA mayA । mArkaRqeyasya vadato ye dozA mAMsaBakzaRe ॥36॥

text: yo hi khādati māṃsāni prāṇināṃ jīvitārthinām । hatānāṃ vā mṛtānāṃ vā yathā hantā tathaiva saḥ ॥37॥
html:
yo hi khādati māṃsāni prāṇināṃ jīvitārthinām ।
hatānāṃ vā mṛtānāṃ vā yathā hantā tathaiva saḥ ॥37॥
slp1: yo hi KAdati mAMsAni prARinAM jIvitArTinAm । hatAnAM vA mftAnAM vA yaTA hantA taTEva saH ॥37॥

text: dhanena krāyako hanti khādakaścopabhogataḥ । ghātako vadhabandhābhyāmityeṣa trividho vadhaḥ ॥38॥
html:
dhanena krāyako hanti khādakaścopabhogataḥ ।
ghātako vadhabandhābhyāmityeṣa trividho vadhaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: Danena krAyako hanti KAdakaScopaBogataH । GAtako vaDabanDAByAmityeza triviDo vaDaH ॥38॥

text: akhādannanumodaṃśca bhāvadoṣeṇa mānavaḥ । yo'numanyeta hantavyaṃ so'pi doṣeṇa lipyate ॥39॥
html:
akhādannanumodaṃśca bhāvadoṣeṇa mānavaḥ ।
yo'numanyeta hantavyaṃ so'pi doṣeṇa lipyate ॥39॥
slp1: aKAdannanumodaMSca BAvadozeRa mAnavaH । yo'numanyeta hantavyaM so'pi dozeRa lipyate ॥39॥

text: adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmāyuṣmānnīrujaḥ sukhī । bhavatyabhakṣayanmāṃsaṃ dayāvānprāṇināmiha ॥40॥
html:
adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmāyuṣmānnīrujaḥ sukhī ।
bhavatyabhakṣayanmāṃsaṃ dayāvānprāṇināmiha ॥40॥
slp1: aDfzyaH sarvaBUtAnAmAyuzmAnnIrujaH suKI । BavatyaBakzayanmAMsaM dayAvAnprARinAmiha ॥40॥

text: hiraṇyadānairgodānairbhūmidānaiśca sarvaśaḥ । māṃsasyābhakṣaṇe dharmo viśiṣṭaḥ syāditi śrutiḥ ॥41॥
html:
hiraṇyadānairgodānairbhūmidānaiśca sarvaśaḥ ।
māṃsasyābhakṣaṇe dharmo viśiṣṭaḥ syāditi śrutiḥ ॥41॥
slp1: hiraRyadAnErgodAnErBUmidAnESca sarvaSaH । mAMsasyABakzaRe Darmo viSizwaH syAditi SrutiH ॥41॥

text: aprokṣitaṃ vṛthāmāṃsaṃ vidhihīnaṃ na bhakṣayet । bhakṣayannirayaṃ yāti naro nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ॥42॥
html:
aprokṣitaṃ vṛthāmāṃsaṃ vidhihīnaṃ na bhakṣayet ।
bhakṣayannirayaṃ yāti naro nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ॥42॥
slp1: aprokzitaM vfTAmAMsaM viDihInaM na Bakzayet । BakzayannirayaM yAti naro nAstyatra saMSayaH ॥42॥

text: prokṣitābhyukṣitaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā brāhmaṇakāmyayā । alpadoṣamiha jñeyaṃ viparīte tu lipyate ॥43॥
html:
prokṣitābhyukṣitaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā brāhmaṇakāmyayā ।
alpadoṣamiha jñeyaṃ viparīte tu lipyate ॥43॥
slp1: prokzitAByukzitaM mAMsaM taTA brAhmaRakAmyayA । alpadozamiha jYeyaM viparIte tu lipyate ॥43॥

text: khādakasya kṛte jantuṃ yo hanyātpuruṣādhamaḥ । mahādoṣakarastatra khādako na tu ghātakaḥ ॥44॥
html:
khādakasya kṛte jantuṃ yo hanyātpuruṣādhamaḥ ।
mahādoṣakarastatra khādako na tu ghātakaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: KAdakasya kfte jantuM yo hanyAtpuruzADamaH । mahAdozakarastatra KAdako na tu GAtakaH ॥44॥

text: ijyāyajñaśrutikṛtairyo mārgairabudho janaḥ । hanyājjantuṃ māṃsagṛddhrī sa vai narakabhāṅnaraḥ ॥45॥
html:
ijyāyajñaśrutikṛtairyo mārgairabudho janaḥ ।
hanyājjantuṃ māṃsagṛddhrī sa vai narakabhāṅnaraḥ ॥45॥
slp1: ijyAyajYaSrutikftEryo mArgErabuDo janaH । hanyAjjantuM mAMsagfdDrI sa vE narakaBANnaraH ॥45॥

text: bhakṣayitvā tu yo māṃsaṃ paścādapi nivartate । tasyāpi sumahāndharmo yaḥ pāpādvinivartate ॥46॥
html:
bhakṣayitvā tu yo māṃsaṃ paścādapi nivartate ।
tasyāpi sumahāndharmo yaḥ pāpādvinivartate ॥46॥
slp1: BakzayitvA tu yo mAMsaM paScAdapi nivartate । tasyApi sumahAnDarmo yaH pApAdvinivartate ॥46॥

text: āhartā cānumantā ca viśastā krayavikrayī । saṃskartā copabhoktā ca ghātakāḥ sarva eva te ॥47॥
html:
āhartā cānumantā ca viśastā krayavikrayī ।
saṃskartā copabhoktā ca ghātakāḥ sarva eva te ॥47॥
slp1: AhartA cAnumantA ca viSastA krayavikrayI । saMskartA copaBoktA ca GAtakAH sarva eva te ॥47॥

text: idamanyattu vakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ vidhinirmitam । purāṇamṛṣibhirjuṣṭaṃ vedeṣu pariniścitam ॥48॥
html:
idamanyattu vakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ vidhinirmitam ।
purāṇamṛṣibhirjuṣṭaṃ vedeṣu pariniścitam ॥48॥
slp1: idamanyattu vakzyAmi pramARaM viDinirmitam । purARamfziBirjuzwaM vedezu pariniScitam ॥48॥

text: pravṛttilakṣaṇe dharme phalārthibhirabhidrute । yathoktaṃ rājaśārdūla na tu tanmokṣakāṅkṣiṇām ॥49॥
html:
pravṛttilakṣaṇe dharme phalārthibhirabhidrute ।
yathoktaṃ rājaśārdūla na tu tanmokṣakāṅkṣiṇām ॥49॥
slp1: pravfttilakzaRe Darme PalArTiBiraBidrute । yaToktaM rAjaSArdUla na tu tanmokzakANkziRAm ॥49॥

text: haviryatsaṃskṛtaṃ mantraiḥ prokṣitābhyukṣitaṃ śuci । vedoktena pramāṇena pitṝṇāṃ prakriyāsu ca । ato'nyathā vṛthāmāṃsamabhakṣyaṃ manurabravīt ॥50॥
html:
haviryatsaṃskṛtaṃ mantraiḥ prokṣitābhyukṣitaṃ śuci ।
vedoktena pramāṇena pitṝṇāṃ prakriyāsu ca ।
ato'nyathā vṛthāmāṃsamabhakṣyaṃ manurabravīt ॥50॥
slp1: haviryatsaMskftaM mantrEH prokzitAByukzitaM Suci । vedoktena pramARena pitFRAM prakriyAsu ca । ato'nyaTA vfTAmAMsamaBakzyaM manurabravIt ॥50॥

text: asvargyamayaśasyaṃ ca rakṣovadbharatarṣabha । vidhinā hi narāḥ pūrvaṃ māṃsaṃ rājannabhakṣayan ॥51॥
html:
asvargyamayaśasyaṃ ca rakṣovadbharatarṣabha ।
vidhinā hi narāḥ pūrvaṃ māṃsaṃ rājannabhakṣayan ॥51॥
slp1: asvargyamayaSasyaM ca rakzovadBaratarzaBa । viDinA hi narAH pUrvaM mAMsaM rAjannaBakzayan ॥51॥

text: ya icchetpuruṣo'tyantamātmānaṃ nirupadravam । sa varjayeta māṃsāni prāṇināmiha sarvaśaḥ ॥52॥
html:
ya icchetpuruṣo'tyantamātmānaṃ nirupadravam ।
sa varjayeta māṃsāni prāṇināmiha sarvaśaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: ya icCetpuruzo'tyantamAtmAnaM nirupadravam । sa varjayeta mAMsAni prARinAmiha sarvaSaH ॥52॥

text: śrūyate hi purākalpe nṛṇāṃ vrīhimayaḥ paśuḥ । yenāyajanta yajvānaḥ puṇyalokaparāyaṇāḥ ॥53॥
html:
śrūyate hi purākalpe nṛṇāṃ vrīhimayaḥ paśuḥ ।
yenāyajanta yajvānaḥ puṇyalokaparāyaṇāḥ ॥53॥
slp1: SrUyate hi purAkalpe nfRAM vrIhimayaH paSuH । yenAyajanta yajvAnaH puRyalokaparAyaRAH ॥53॥

text: ṛṣibhiḥ saṃśayaṃ pṛṣṭo vasuścedipatiḥ purā । abhakṣyamiti māṃsaṃ sa prāha bhakṣyamiti prabho ॥54॥
html:
ṛṣibhiḥ saṃśayaṃ pṛṣṭo vasuścedipatiḥ purā ।
abhakṣyamiti māṃsaṃ sa prāha bhakṣyamiti prabho ॥54॥
slp1: fziBiH saMSayaM pfzwo vasuScedipatiH purA । aBakzyamiti mAMsaM sa prAha Bakzyamiti praBo ॥54॥

text: ākāśānmedinīṃ prāptastataḥ sa pṛthivīpatiḥ । etadeva punaścoktvā viveśa dharaṇītalam ॥55॥
html:
ākāśānmedinīṃ prāptastataḥ sa pṛthivīpatiḥ ।
etadeva punaścoktvā viveśa dharaṇītalam ॥55॥
slp1: AkASAnmedinIM prAptastataH sa pfTivIpatiH । etadeva punaScoktvA viveSa DaraRItalam ॥55॥

text: prajānāṃ hitakāmena tvagastyena mahātmanā । āraṇyāḥ sarvadaivatyāḥ prokṣitāstapasā mṛgāḥ ॥56॥
html:
prajānāṃ hitakāmena tvagastyena mahātmanā ।
āraṇyāḥ sarvadaivatyāḥ prokṣitāstapasā mṛgāḥ ॥56॥
slp1: prajAnAM hitakAmena tvagastyena mahAtmanA । AraRyAH sarvadEvatyAH prokzitAstapasA mfgAH ॥56॥

text: kriyā hyevaṃ na hīyante pitṛdaivatasaṃśritāḥ । prīyante pitaraścaiva nyāyato māṃsatarpitāḥ ॥57॥
html:
kriyā hyevaṃ na hīyante pitṛdaivatasaṃśritāḥ ।
prīyante pitaraścaiva nyāyato māṃsatarpitāḥ ॥57॥
slp1: kriyA hyevaM na hIyante pitfdEvatasaMSritAH । prIyante pitaraScEva nyAyato mAMsatarpitAH ॥57॥

text: idaṃ tu śṛṇu rājendra kīrtyamānaṃ mayānagha । abhakṣaṇe sarvasukhaṃ māṃsasya manujādhipa ॥58॥
html:
idaṃ tu śṛṇu rājendra kīrtyamānaṃ mayānagha ।
abhakṣaṇe sarvasukhaṃ māṃsasya manujādhipa ॥58॥
slp1: idaM tu SfRu rAjendra kIrtyamAnaM mayAnaGa । aBakzaRe sarvasuKaM mAMsasya manujADipa ॥58॥

text: yastu varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tapastapyetsudāruṇam । yaścaikaṃ varjayenmāṃsaṃ samametanmataṃ mama ॥59॥
html:
yastu varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tapastapyetsudāruṇam ।
yaścaikaṃ varjayenmāṃsaṃ samametanmataṃ mama ॥59॥
slp1: yastu varzaSataM pUrRaM tapastapyetsudAruRam । yaScEkaM varjayenmAMsaM samametanmataM mama ॥59॥

text: kaumude tu viśeṣeṇa śuklapakṣe narādhipa । varjayetsarvamāṃsāni dharmo hyatra vidhīyate ॥60॥
html:
kaumude tu viśeṣeṇa śuklapakṣe narādhipa ।
varjayetsarvamāṃsāni dharmo hyatra vidhīyate ॥60॥
slp1: kOmude tu viSezeRa Suklapakze narADipa । varjayetsarvamAMsAni Darmo hyatra viDIyate ॥60॥

text: caturo vārṣikānmāsānyo māṃsaṃ parivarjayet । catvāri bhadrāṇyāpnoti kīrtimāyuryaśo balam ॥61॥
html:
caturo vārṣikānmāsānyo māṃsaṃ parivarjayet ।
catvāri bhadrāṇyāpnoti kīrtimāyuryaśo balam ॥61॥
slp1: caturo vArzikAnmAsAnyo mAMsaM parivarjayet । catvAri BadrARyApnoti kIrtimAyuryaSo balam ॥61॥

text: atha vā māsamapyekaṃ sarvamāṃsānyabhakṣayan । atītya sarvaduḥkhāni sukhī jīvennirāmayaḥ ॥62॥
html:
atha vā māsamapyekaṃ sarvamāṃsānyabhakṣayan ।
atītya sarvaduḥkhāni sukhī jīvennirāmayaḥ ॥62॥
slp1: aTa vA mAsamapyekaM sarvamAMsAnyaBakzayan । atItya sarvaduHKAni suKI jIvennirAmayaH ॥62॥

text: ye varjayanti māṃsāni māsaśaḥ pakṣaśo'pi vā । teṣāṃ hiṃsānivṛttānāṃ brahmaloko vidhīyate ॥63॥
html:
ye varjayanti māṃsāni māsaśaḥ pakṣaśo'pi vā ।
teṣāṃ hiṃsānivṛttānāṃ brahmaloko vidhīyate ॥63॥
slp1: ye varjayanti mAMsAni mAsaSaH pakzaSo'pi vA । tezAM hiMsAnivfttAnAM brahmaloko viDIyate ॥63॥

text: māṃsaṃ tu kaumudaṃ pakṣaṃ varjitaṃ pārtha rājabhiḥ । sarvabhūtātmabhūtaistairvijñātārthaparāvaraiḥ ॥64॥
html:
māṃsaṃ tu kaumudaṃ pakṣaṃ varjitaṃ pārtha rājabhiḥ ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtaistairvijñātārthaparāvaraiḥ ॥64॥
slp1: mAMsaM tu kOmudaM pakzaM varjitaM pArTa rAjaBiH । sarvaBUtAtmaBUtEstErvijYAtArTaparAvarEH ॥64॥

text: nābhāgenāmbarīṣeṇa gayena ca mahātmanā । āyuṣā cānaraṇyena dilīparaghupūrubhiḥ ॥65॥
html:
nābhāgenāmbarīṣeṇa gayena ca mahātmanā ।
āyuṣā cānaraṇyena dilīparaghupūrubhiḥ ॥65॥
slp1: nABAgenAmbarIzeRa gayena ca mahAtmanA । AyuzA cAnaraRyena dilIparaGupUruBiH ॥65॥

text: kārtavīryāniruddhābhyāṃ nahuṣeṇa yayātinā । nṛgeṇa viṣvagaśvena tathaiva śaśabindunā । yuvanāśvena ca tathā śibinauśīnareṇa ca ॥66॥
html:
kārtavīryāniruddhābhyāṃ nahuṣeṇa yayātinā ।
nṛgeṇa viṣvagaśvena tathaiva śaśabindunā ।
yuvanāśvena ca tathā śibinauśīnareṇa ca ॥66॥
slp1: kArtavIryAnirudDAByAM nahuzeRa yayAtinA । nfgeRa vizvagaSvena taTEva SaSabindunA । yuvanASvena ca taTA SibinOSInareRa ca ॥66॥

text: śyenacitreṇa rājendra somakena vṛkeṇa ca । raivatena rantidevena vasunā sṛñjayena ca ॥67॥
html:
śyenacitreṇa rājendra somakena vṛkeṇa ca ।
raivatena rantidevena vasunā sṛñjayena ca ॥67॥
slp1: SyenacitreRa rAjendra somakena vfkeRa ca । rEvatena rantidevena vasunA sfYjayena ca ॥67॥

text: duḥṣantena karūṣeṇa rāmālarkanalaistathā । virūpāśvena niminā janakena ca dhīmatā ॥68॥
html:
duḥṣantena karūṣeṇa rāmālarkanalaistathā ।
virūpāśvena niminā janakena ca dhīmatā ॥68॥
slp1: duHzantena karUzeRa rAmAlarkanalEstaTA । virUpASvena niminA janakena ca DImatA ॥68॥

text: silena pṛthunā caiva vīrasenena caiva ha । ikṣvākuṇā śambhunā ca śvetena sagareṇa ca ॥69॥
html:
silena pṛthunā caiva vīrasenena caiva ha ।
ikṣvākuṇā śambhunā ca śvetena sagareṇa ca ॥69॥
slp1: silena pfTunA cEva vIrasenena cEva ha । ikzvAkuRA SamBunA ca Svetena sagareRa ca ॥69॥

text: etaiścānyaiśca rājendra purā māṃsaṃ na bhakṣitam । śāradaṃ kaumudaṃ māsaṃ tataste svargamāpnuvan ॥70॥
html:
etaiścānyaiśca rājendra purā māṃsaṃ na bhakṣitam ।
śāradaṃ kaumudaṃ māsaṃ tataste svargamāpnuvan ॥70॥
slp1: etEScAnyESca rAjendra purA mAMsaM na Bakzitam । SAradaM kOmudaM mAsaM tataste svargamApnuvan ॥70॥

text: brahmaloke ca tiṣṭhanti jvalamānāḥ śriyānvitāḥ । upāsyamānā gandharvaiḥ strīsahasrasamanvitāḥ ॥71॥
html:
brahmaloke ca tiṣṭhanti jvalamānāḥ śriyānvitāḥ ।
upāsyamānā gandharvaiḥ strīsahasrasamanvitāḥ ॥71॥
