slp1: brahmaloke ca tizWanti jvalamAnAH SriyAnvitAH । upAsyamAnA ganDarvEH strIsahasrasamanvitAH ॥71॥

text: tadetaduttamaṃ dharmamahiṃsālakṣaṇaṃ śubham । ye caranti mahātmāno nākapṛṣṭhe vasanti te ॥72॥
html:
tadetaduttamaṃ dharmamahiṃsālakṣaṇaṃ śubham ।
ye caranti mahātmāno nākapṛṣṭhe vasanti te ॥72॥
slp1: tadetaduttamaM DarmamahiMsAlakzaRaM SuBam । ye caranti mahAtmAno nAkapfzWe vasanti te ॥72॥

text: madhu māṃsaṃ ca ye nityaṃ varjayantīha dhārmikāḥ । janmaprabhṛti madyaṃ ca sarve te munayaḥ smṛtāḥ । viśiṣṭatāṃ jñātiṣu ca labhante nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥73॥
html:
madhu māṃsaṃ ca ye nityaṃ varjayantīha dhārmikāḥ ।
janmaprabhṛti madyaṃ ca sarve te munayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।
viśiṣṭatāṃ jñātiṣu ca labhante nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥73॥
slp1: maDu mAMsaM ca ye nityaM varjayantIha DArmikAH । janmapraBfti madyaM ca sarve te munayaH smftAH । viSizwatAM jYAtizu ca laBante nAtra saMSayaH ॥73॥

text: āpannaścāpado mucyedbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt । mucyettathāturo rogādduḥkhānmucyeta duḥkhitaḥ ॥74॥
html:
āpannaścāpado mucyedbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt ।
mucyettathāturo rogādduḥkhānmucyeta duḥkhitaḥ ॥74॥
slp1: ApannaScApado mucyedbadDo mucyeta banDanAt । mucyettaTAturo rogAdduHKAnmucyeta duHKitaH ॥74॥

text: tiryagyoniṃ na gaccheta rūpavāṃśca bhavennaraḥ । buddhimānvai kuruśreṣṭha prāpnuyācca mahadyaśaḥ ॥75॥
html:
tiryagyoniṃ na gaccheta rūpavāṃśca bhavennaraḥ ।
buddhimānvai kuruśreṣṭha prāpnuyācca mahadyaśaḥ ॥75॥
slp1: tiryagyoniM na gacCeta rUpavAMSca BavennaraH । budDimAnvE kuruSrezWa prApnuyAcca mahadyaSaH ॥75॥

text: etatte kathitaṃ rājanmāṃsasya parivarjane । pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca vidhānamṛṣinirmitam] ॥76॥
html:
etatte kathitaṃ rājanmāṃsasya parivarjane ।
pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca vidhānamṛṣinirmitam] ॥76॥
slp1: etatte kaTitaM rAjanmAMsasya parivarjane । pravfttO ca nivfttO ca viDAnamfzinirmitam] ॥76॥

text: ime vai mānavā loke bhṛśaṃ māṃsasya gṛddhinaḥ । visṛjya bhakṣānvividhānyathā rakṣogaṇāstathā ॥1॥
html:
ime vai mānavā loke bhṛśaṃ māṃsasya gṛddhinaḥ ।
visṛjya bhakṣānvividhānyathā rakṣogaṇāstathā ॥1॥
slp1: ime vE mAnavA loke BfSaM mAMsasya gfdDinaH । visfjya BakzAnviviDAnyaTA rakzogaRAstaTA ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: nāpūpānvividhākārāñśākāni vividhāni ca । ṣāḍavānrasayogāṃśca tathecchanti yathāmiṣam ॥2॥
html:
nāpūpānvividhākārāñśākāni vividhāni ca ।
ṣāḍavānrasayogāṃśca tathecchanti yathāmiṣam ॥2॥
slp1: nApUpAnviviDAkArAYSAkAni viviDAni ca । zAqavAnrasayogAMSca taTecCanti yaTAmizam ॥2॥

text: tatra me buddhiratraiva visarge parimuhyate । na manye rasataḥ kiñcinmāṃsato'stīha kiñcana ॥3॥
html:
tatra me buddhiratraiva visarge parimuhyate ।
na manye rasataḥ kiñcinmāṃsato'stīha kiñcana ॥3॥
slp1: tatra me budDiratrEva visarge parimuhyate । na manye rasataH kiYcinmAMsato'stIha kiYcana ॥3॥

text: tadicchāmi guṇāñśrotuṃ māṃsasyābhakṣaṇe'pi vā । bhakṣaṇe caiva ye doṣāstāṃścaiva puruṣarṣabha ॥4॥
html:
tadicchāmi guṇāñśrotuṃ māṃsasyābhakṣaṇe'pi vā ।
bhakṣaṇe caiva ye doṣāstāṃścaiva puruṣarṣabha ॥4॥
slp1: tadicCAmi guRAYSrotuM mAMsasyABakzaRe'pi vA । BakzaRe cEva ye dozAstAMScEva puruzarzaBa ॥4॥

text: sarvaṃ tattvena dharmajña yathāvadiha dharmataḥ । kiṃ vā bhakṣyamabhakṣyaṃ vā sarvametadvadasva me ॥5॥
html:
sarvaṃ tattvena dharmajña yathāvadiha dharmataḥ ।
kiṃ vā bhakṣyamabhakṣyaṃ vā sarvametadvadasva me ॥5॥
slp1: sarvaM tattvena DarmajYa yaTAvadiha DarmataH । kiM vA BakzyamaBakzyaM vA sarvametadvadasva me ॥5॥

text: evametanmahābāho yathā vadasi bhārata । na māṃsātparamatrānyadrasato vidyate bhuvi ॥6॥
html:
evametanmahābāho yathā vadasi bhārata ।
na māṃsātparamatrānyadrasato vidyate bhuvi ॥6॥
slp1: evametanmahAbAho yaTA vadasi BArata । na mAMsAtparamatrAnyadrasato vidyate Buvi ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kṣatakṣīṇābhitaptānāṃ grāmyadharmaratāśca ye । adhvanā karśitānāṃ ca na māṃsādvidyate param ॥7॥
html:
kṣatakṣīṇābhitaptānāṃ grāmyadharmaratāśca ye ।
adhvanā karśitānāṃ ca na māṃsādvidyate param ॥7॥
slp1: kzatakzIRABitaptAnAM grAmyaDarmaratASca ye । aDvanA karSitAnAM ca na mAMsAdvidyate param ॥7॥

text: sadyo vardhayati prāṇānpuṣṭimagryāṃ dadāti ca । na bhakṣo'bhyadhikaḥ kaścinmāṃsādasti parantapa ॥8॥
html:
sadyo vardhayati prāṇānpuṣṭimagryāṃ dadāti ca ।
na bhakṣo'bhyadhikaḥ kaścinmāṃsādasti parantapa ॥8॥
slp1: sadyo varDayati prARAnpuzwimagryAM dadAti ca । na Bakzo'ByaDikaH kaScinmAMsAdasti parantapa ॥8॥

text: vivarjane tu bahavo guṇāḥ kauravanandana । ye bhavanti manuṣyāṇāṃ tānme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥9॥
html:
vivarjane tu bahavo guṇāḥ kauravanandana ।
ye bhavanti manuṣyāṇāṃ tānme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥9॥
slp1: vivarjane tu bahavo guRAH kOravanandana । ye Bavanti manuzyARAM tAnme nigadataH SfRu ॥9॥

text: svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsairyo vivardhayitumicchati । nāsti kṣudratarastasmānna nṛśaṃsataro naraḥ ॥10॥
html:
svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsairyo vivardhayitumicchati ।
nāsti kṣudratarastasmānna nṛśaṃsataro naraḥ ॥10॥
slp1: svamAMsaM paramAMsEryo vivarDayitumicCati । nAsti kzudratarastasmAnna nfSaMsataro naraH ॥10॥

text: na hi prāṇātpriyataraṃ loke kiñcana vidyate । tasmāddayāṃ naraḥ kuryādyathātmani tathā pare ॥11॥
html:
na hi prāṇātpriyataraṃ loke kiñcana vidyate ।
tasmāddayāṃ naraḥ kuryādyathātmani tathā pare ॥11॥
slp1: na hi prARAtpriyataraM loke kiYcana vidyate । tasmAddayAM naraH kuryAdyaTAtmani taTA pare ॥11॥

text: śukrācca tāta sambhūtirmāṃsasyeha na saṃśayaḥ । bhakṣaṇe tu mahāndoṣo vadhena saha kalpate ॥12॥
html:
śukrācca tāta sambhūtirmāṃsasyeha na saṃśayaḥ ।
bhakṣaṇe tu mahāndoṣo vadhena saha kalpate ॥12॥
slp1: SukrAcca tAta samBUtirmAMsasyeha na saMSayaH । BakzaRe tu mahAndozo vaDena saha kalpate ॥12॥

text: ahiṃsālakṣaṇo dharma iti vedavido viduḥ । yadahiṃsraṃ bhavetkarma tatkuryādātmavānnaraḥ ॥13॥
html:
ahiṃsālakṣaṇo dharma iti vedavido viduḥ ।
yadahiṃsraṃ bhavetkarma tatkuryādātmavānnaraḥ ॥13॥
slp1: ahiMsAlakzaRo Darma iti vedavido viduH । yadahiMsraM Bavetkarma tatkuryAdAtmavAnnaraH ॥13॥

text: pitṛdaivatayajñeṣu prokṣitaṃ havirucyate । vidhinā vedadṛṣṭena tadbhuktveha na duṣyati ॥14॥
html:
pitṛdaivatayajñeṣu prokṣitaṃ havirucyate ।
vidhinā vedadṛṣṭena tadbhuktveha na duṣyati ॥14॥
slp1: pitfdEvatayajYezu prokzitaM havirucyate । viDinA vedadfzwena tadBuktveha na duzyati ॥14॥

text: yajñārthe paśavaḥ sṛṣṭā ityapi śrūyate śrutiḥ । ato'nyathā pravṛttānāṃ rākṣaso vidhirucyate ॥15॥
html:
yajñārthe paśavaḥ sṛṣṭā ityapi śrūyate śrutiḥ ।
ato'nyathā pravṛttānāṃ rākṣaso vidhirucyate ॥15॥
slp1: yajYArTe paSavaH sfzwA ityapi SrUyate SrutiH । ato'nyaTA pravfttAnAM rAkzaso viDirucyate ॥15॥

text: kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu yo dṛṣṭo vidhistamapi me śṛṇu । vīryeṇopārjitaṃ māṃsaṃ yathā khādanna duṣyati ॥16॥
html:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu yo dṛṣṭo vidhistamapi me śṛṇu ।
vīryeṇopārjitaṃ māṃsaṃ yathā khādanna duṣyati ॥16॥
slp1: kzatriyARAM tu yo dfzwo viDistamapi me SfRu । vIryeRopArjitaM mAMsaM yaTA KAdanna duzyati ॥16॥

text: āraṇyāḥ sarvadaivatyāḥ prokṣitāḥ sarvaśo mṛgāḥ । agastyena purā rājanmṛgayā yena pūjyate ॥17॥
html:
āraṇyāḥ sarvadaivatyāḥ prokṣitāḥ sarvaśo mṛgāḥ ।
agastyena purā rājanmṛgayā yena pūjyate ॥17॥
slp1: AraRyAH sarvadEvatyAH prokzitAH sarvaSo mfgAH । agastyena purA rAjanmfgayA yena pUjyate ॥17॥

text: nātmānamaparityajya mṛgayā nāma vidyate । samatāmupasaṅgamya rūpaṃ hanyānna vā nṛpa ॥18॥
html:
nātmānamaparityajya mṛgayā nāma vidyate ।
samatāmupasaṅgamya rūpaṃ hanyānna vā nṛpa ॥18॥
slp1: nAtmAnamaparityajya mfgayA nAma vidyate । samatAmupasaNgamya rUpaM hanyAnna vA nfpa ॥18॥

text: ato rājarṣayaḥ sarve mṛgayāṃ yānti bhārata । lipyante na hi doṣeṇa na caitatpātakaṃ viduḥ ॥19॥
html:
ato rājarṣayaḥ sarve mṛgayāṃ yānti bhārata ।
lipyante na hi doṣeṇa na caitatpātakaṃ viduḥ ॥19॥
slp1: ato rAjarzayaH sarve mfgayAM yAnti BArata । lipyante na hi dozeRa na cEtatpAtakaM viduH ॥19॥

text: na hi tatparamaṃ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca । yatsarveṣviha lokeṣu dayā kauravanandana ॥20॥
html:
na hi tatparamaṃ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca ।
yatsarveṣviha lokeṣu dayā kauravanandana ॥20॥
slp1: na hi tatparamaM kiYcidiha loke paratra ca । yatsarvezviha lokezu dayA kOravanandana ॥20॥

text: na bhayaṃ vidyate jātu narasyeha dayāvataḥ । dayāvatāmime lokāḥ pare cāpi tapasvinām ॥21॥
html:
na bhayaṃ vidyate jātu narasyeha dayāvataḥ ।
dayāvatāmime lokāḥ pare cāpi tapasvinām ॥21॥
slp1: na BayaM vidyate jAtu narasyeha dayAvataH । dayAvatAmime lokAH pare cApi tapasvinAm ॥21॥

text: abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ । abhayaṃ tasya bhūtāni dadatītyanuśuśrumaḥ ॥22॥
html:
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ।
abhayaṃ tasya bhūtāni dadatītyanuśuśrumaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: aBayaM sarvaBUteByo yo dadAti dayAparaH । aBayaM tasya BUtAni dadatItyanuSuSrumaH ॥22॥

text: kṣataṃ ca skhalitaṃ caiva patitaṃ kliṣṭamāhatam । sarvabhūtāni rakṣanti sameṣu viṣameṣu ca ॥23॥
html:
kṣataṃ ca skhalitaṃ caiva patitaṃ kliṣṭamāhatam ।
sarvabhūtāni rakṣanti sameṣu viṣameṣu ca ॥23॥
slp1: kzataM ca sKalitaM cEva patitaM klizwamAhatam । sarvaBUtAni rakzanti samezu vizamezu ca ॥23॥

text: nainaṃ vyālamṛgā ghnanti na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ । mucyante bhayakāleṣu mokṣayanti ca ye parān ॥24॥
html:
nainaṃ vyālamṛgā ghnanti na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ ।
mucyante bhayakāleṣu mokṣayanti ca ye parān ॥24॥
slp1: nEnaM vyAlamfgA Gnanti na piSAcA na rAkzasAH । mucyante BayakAlezu mokzayanti ca ye parAn ॥24॥

text: prāṇadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati । na hyātmanaḥ priyataraḥ kaścidastīti niścitam ॥25॥
html:
prāṇadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।
na hyātmanaḥ priyataraḥ kaścidastīti niścitam ॥25॥
slp1: prARadAnAtparaM dAnaM na BUtaM na Bavizyati । na hyAtmanaH priyataraH kaScidastIti niScitam ॥25॥

text: aniṣṭaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ maraṇaṃ nāma bhārata । mṛtyukāle hi bhūtānāṃ sadyo jāyati vepathuḥ ॥26॥
html:
aniṣṭaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ maraṇaṃ nāma bhārata ।
mṛtyukāle hi bhūtānāṃ sadyo jāyati vepathuḥ ॥26॥
slp1: anizwaM sarvaBUtAnAM maraRaM nAma BArata । mftyukAle hi BUtAnAM sadyo jAyati vepaTuH ॥26॥

text: jātijanmajarāduḥkhe nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare । jantavaḥ parivartante maraṇādudvijanti ca ॥27॥
html:
jātijanmajarāduḥkhe nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ।
jantavaḥ parivartante maraṇādudvijanti ca ॥27॥
slp1: jAtijanmajarAduHKe nityaM saMsArasAgare । jantavaH parivartante maraRAdudvijanti ca ॥27॥

text: garbhavāseṣu pacyante kṣārāmlakaṭukai rasaiḥ । mūtraśleṣmapurīṣāṇāṃ sparśaiśca bhṛśadāruṇaiḥ ॥28॥
html:
garbhavāseṣu pacyante kṣārāmlakaṭukai rasaiḥ ।
mūtraśleṣmapurīṣāṇāṃ sparśaiśca bhṛśadāruṇaiḥ ॥28॥
slp1: garBavAsezu pacyante kzArAmlakawukE rasEH । mUtraSlezmapurIzARAM sparSESca BfSadAruREH ॥28॥

text: jātāścāpyavaśāstatra bhidyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ । pāṭyamānāśca dṛśyante vivaśā māṃsagṛddhinaḥ ॥29॥
html:
jātāścāpyavaśāstatra bhidyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
pāṭyamānāśca dṛśyante vivaśā māṃsagṛddhinaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: jAtAScApyavaSAstatra BidyamAnAH punaH punaH । pAwyamAnASca dfSyante vivaSA mAMsagfdDinaH ॥29॥

text: kumbhīpāke ca pacyante tāṃ tāṃ yonimupāgatāḥ । ākramya māryamāṇāśca bhrāmyante vai punaḥ punaḥ ॥30॥
html:
kumbhīpāke ca pacyante tāṃ tāṃ yonimupāgatāḥ ।
ākramya māryamāṇāśca bhrāmyante vai punaḥ punaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: kumBIpAke ca pacyante tAM tAM yonimupAgatAH । Akramya mAryamARASca BrAmyante vE punaH punaH ॥30॥

text: nātmano'sti priyataraḥ pṛthivyāmanusṛtya ha । tasmātprāṇiṣu sarveṣu dayāvānātmavānbhavet ॥31॥
html:
nātmano'sti priyataraḥ pṛthivyāmanusṛtya ha ।
tasmātprāṇiṣu sarveṣu dayāvānātmavānbhavet ॥31॥
slp1: nAtmano'sti priyataraH pfTivyAmanusftya ha । tasmAtprARizu sarvezu dayAvAnAtmavAnBavet ॥31॥

text: sarvamāṃsāni yo rājanyāvajjīvaṃ na bhakṣayet । svarge sa vipulaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥32॥
html:
sarvamāṃsāni yo rājanyāvajjīvaṃ na bhakṣayet ।
svarge sa vipulaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: sarvamAMsAni yo rAjanyAvajjIvaM na Bakzayet । svarge sa vipulaM sTAnaM prApnuyAnnAtra saMSayaH ॥32॥

text: ye bhakṣayanti māṃsāni bhūtānāṃ jīvitaiṣiṇām । bhakṣyante te'pi tairbhūtairiti me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ॥33॥
html:
ye bhakṣayanti māṃsāni bhūtānāṃ jīvitaiṣiṇām ।
bhakṣyante te'pi tairbhūtairiti me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: ye Bakzayanti mAMsAni BUtAnAM jIvitEziRAm । Bakzyante te'pi tErBUtEriti me nAsti saMSayaH ॥33॥

text: māṃ sa bhakṣayate yasmādbhakṣayiṣye tamapyaham । etanmāṃsasya māṃsatvamato budhyasva bhārata ॥34॥
html:
māṃ sa bhakṣayate yasmādbhakṣayiṣye tamapyaham ।
etanmāṃsasya māṃsatvamato budhyasva bhārata ॥34॥
slp1: mAM sa Bakzayate yasmAdBakzayizye tamapyaham । etanmAMsasya mAMsatvamato buDyasva BArata ॥34॥

text: ghātako vadhyate nityaṃ tathā vadhyeta bandhakaḥ । ākroṣṭākruśyate rājandveṣṭā dveṣyatvamāpnute ॥35॥
html:
ghātako vadhyate nityaṃ tathā vadhyeta bandhakaḥ ।
ākroṣṭākruśyate rājandveṣṭā dveṣyatvamāpnute ॥35॥
slp1: GAtako vaDyate nityaM taTA vaDyeta banDakaH । AkrozwAkruSyate rAjandvezwA dvezyatvamApnute ॥35॥

text: yena yena śarīreṇa yadyatkarma karoti yaḥ । tena tena śarīreṇa tattatphalamupāśnute ॥36॥
html:
yena yena śarīreṇa yadyatkarma karoti yaḥ ।
tena tena śarīreṇa tattatphalamupāśnute ॥36॥
slp1: yena yena SarIreRa yadyatkarma karoti yaH । tena tena SarIreRa tattatPalamupASnute ॥36॥

text: ahiṃsā paramo dharmastathāhiṃsā paro damaḥ । ahiṃsā paramaṃ dānamahiṃsā paramaṃ tapaḥ ॥37॥
html:
ahiṃsā paramo dharmastathāhiṃsā paro damaḥ ।
ahiṃsā paramaṃ dānamahiṃsā paramaṃ tapaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: ahiMsA paramo DarmastaTAhiMsA paro damaH । ahiMsA paramaM dAnamahiMsA paramaM tapaH ॥37॥

text: ahiṃsā paramo yajñastathāhiṃsā paraṃ balam । ahiṃsā paramaṃ mitramahiṃsā paramaṃ sukham । ahiṃsā paramaṃ satyamahiṃsā paramaṃ śrutam ॥38॥
html:
ahiṃsā paramo yajñastathāhiṃsā paraṃ balam ।
ahiṃsā paramaṃ mitramahiṃsā paramaṃ sukham ।
ahiṃsā paramaṃ satyamahiṃsā paramaṃ śrutam ॥38॥
slp1: ahiMsA paramo yajYastaTAhiMsA paraM balam । ahiMsA paramaM mitramahiMsA paramaM suKam । ahiMsA paramaM satyamahiMsA paramaM Srutam ॥38॥

text: sarvayajñeṣu vā dānaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu cāplutam । sarvadānaphalaṃ vāpi naitattulyamahiṃsayā ॥39॥
html:
sarvayajñeṣu vā dānaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu cāplutam ।
sarvadānaphalaṃ vāpi naitattulyamahiṃsayā ॥39॥
slp1: sarvayajYezu vA dAnaM sarvatIrTezu cAplutam । sarvadAnaPalaM vApi nEtattulyamahiMsayA ॥39॥

text: ahiṃsrasya tapo'kṣayyamahiṃsro yajate sadā । ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā mātā yathā pitā ॥40॥
html:
ahiṃsrasya tapo'kṣayyamahiṃsro yajate sadā ।
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā mātā yathā pitā ॥40॥
slp1: ahiMsrasya tapo'kzayyamahiMsro yajate sadA । ahiMsraH sarvaBUtAnAM yaTA mAtA yaTA pitA ॥40॥

text: etatphalamahiṃsāyā bhūyaśca kurupuṅgava । na hi śakyā guṇā vaktumiha varṣaśatairapi] ॥41॥
html:
etatphalamahiṃsāyā bhūyaśca kurupuṅgava ।
na hi śakyā guṇā vaktumiha varṣaśatairapi] ॥41॥
slp1: etatPalamahiMsAyA BUyaSca kurupuNgava । na hi SakyA guRA vaktumiha varzaSatErapi] ॥41॥

text: akāmāśca sakāmāśca hatā ye'sminmahāhave । kāṃ yoniṃ pratipannāste tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
akāmāśca sakāmāśca hatā ye'sminmahāhave ।
kāṃ yoniṃ pratipannāste tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: akAmASca sakAmASca hatA ye'sminmahAhave । kAM yoniM pratipannAste tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: duḥkhaṃ prāṇaparityāgaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ mahāmṛdhe । jānāmi tattvaṃ dharmajña prāṇatyāgaṃ suduṣkaram ॥2॥
html:
duḥkhaṃ prāṇaparityāgaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ mahāmṛdhe ।
jānāmi tattvaṃ dharmajña prāṇatyāgaṃ suduṣkaram ॥2॥
slp1: duHKaM prARaparityAgaH puruzARAM mahAmfDe । jAnAmi tattvaM DarmajYa prARatyAgaM suduzkaram ॥2॥

text: samṛddhe vāsamṛddhe vā śubhe vā yadi vāśubhe । kāraṇaṃ tatra me brūhi sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ ॥3॥
html:
samṛddhe vāsamṛddhe vā śubhe vā yadi vāśubhe ।
kāraṇaṃ tatra me brūhi sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: samfdDe vAsamfdDe vA SuBe vA yadi vASuBe । kAraRaM tatra me brUhi sarvajYo hyasi me mataH ॥3॥

text: samṛddhe vāsamṛddhe vā śubhe vā yadi vāśubhe । saṃsāre'sminsamājātāḥ prāṇinaḥ pṛthivīpate ॥4॥
html:
samṛddhe vāsamṛddhe vā śubhe vā yadi vāśubhe ।
saṃsāre'sminsamājātāḥ prāṇinaḥ pṛthivīpate ॥4॥
slp1: samfdDe vAsamfdDe vA SuBe vA yadi vASuBe । saMsAre'sminsamAjAtAH prARinaH pfTivIpate ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: niratā yena bhāvena tatra me śṛṇu kāraṇam । samyakcāyamanupraśnastvayoktaśca yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
html:
niratā yena bhāvena tatra me śṛṇu kāraṇam ।
samyakcāyamanupraśnastvayoktaśca yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
slp1: niratA yena BAvena tatra me SfRu kAraRam । samyakcAyamanupraSnastvayoktaSca yuDizWira ॥5॥

text: atra te vartayiṣyāmi purāvṛttamidaṃ nṛpa । dvaipāyanasya saṃvādaṃ kīṭasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥6॥
html:
atra te vartayiṣyāmi purāvṛttamidaṃ nṛpa ।
dvaipāyanasya saṃvādaṃ kīṭasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥6॥
slp1: atra te vartayizyAmi purAvfttamidaM nfpa । dvEpAyanasya saMvAdaM kIwasya ca yuDizWira ॥6॥

text: brahmabhūtaścaranvipraḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ purā । dadarśa kīṭaṃ dhāvantaṃ śīghraṃ śakaṭavartmani ॥7॥
html:
brahmabhūtaścaranvipraḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ purā ।
dadarśa kīṭaṃ dhāvantaṃ śīghraṃ śakaṭavartmani ॥7॥
slp1: brahmaBUtaScaranvipraH kfzRadvEpAyanaH purA । dadarSa kIwaM DAvantaM SIGraM Sakawavartmani ॥7॥

text: gatijñaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ rutajñaśca śarīriṇām । sarvajñaḥ sarvato dṛṣṭvā kīṭaṃ vacanamabravīt ॥8॥
html:
gatijñaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ rutajñaśca śarīriṇām ।
sarvajñaḥ sarvato dṛṣṭvā kīṭaṃ vacanamabravīt ॥8॥
slp1: gatijYaH sarvaBUtAnAM rutajYaSca SarIriRAm । sarvajYaH sarvato dfzwvA kIwaM vacanamabravIt ॥8॥

text: kīṭa santrastarūpo'si tvaritaścaiva lakṣyase । kva dhāvasi tadācakṣva kutaste bhayamāgatam ॥9॥
html:
kīṭa santrastarūpo'si tvaritaścaiva lakṣyase ।
kva dhāvasi tadācakṣva kutaste bhayamāgatam ॥9॥
slp1: kIwa santrastarUpo'si tvaritaScEva lakzyase । kva DAvasi tadAcakzva kutaste BayamAgatam ॥9॥

text: śakaṭasyāsya mahato ghoṣaṃ śrutvā bhayaṃ mama । āgataṃ vai mahābuddhe svana eṣa hi dāruṇaḥ । śrūyate na sa māṃ hanyāditi tasmādapākrame ॥10॥
html:
śakaṭasyāsya mahato ghoṣaṃ śrutvā bhayaṃ mama ।
āgataṃ vai mahābuddhe svana eṣa hi dāruṇaḥ ।
śrūyate na sa māṃ hanyāditi tasmādapākrame ॥10॥
slp1: SakawasyAsya mahato GozaM SrutvA BayaM mama । AgataM vE mahAbudDe svana eza hi dAruRaH । SrUyate na sa mAM hanyAditi tasmAdapAkrame ॥10॥
author: kīṭa uvāca ।

text: śvasatāṃ ca śṛṇomyevaṃ goputrāṇāṃ pracodyatām । vahatāṃ sumahābhāraṃ sannikarṣe svanaṃ prabho । nṛṇāṃ ca saṃvāhayatāṃ śrūyate vividhaḥ svanaḥ ॥11॥
html:
śvasatāṃ ca śṛṇomyevaṃ goputrāṇāṃ pracodyatām ।
vahatāṃ sumahābhāraṃ sannikarṣe svanaṃ prabho ।
nṛṇāṃ ca saṃvāhayatāṃ śrūyate vividhaḥ svanaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: SvasatAM ca SfRomyevaM goputrARAM pracodyatAm । vahatAM sumahABAraM sannikarze svanaM praBo । nfRAM ca saMvAhayatAM SrUyate viviDaH svanaH ॥11॥

text: soḍhumasmadvidhenaiṣa na śakyaḥ kīṭayoninā । tasmādapakramāmyeṣa bhayādasmātsudāruṇāt ॥12॥
html:
soḍhumasmadvidhenaiṣa na śakyaḥ kīṭayoninā ।
tasmādapakramāmyeṣa bhayādasmātsudāruṇāt ॥12॥
slp1: soQumasmadviDenEza na SakyaH kIwayoninA । tasmAdapakramAmyeza BayAdasmAtsudAruRAt ॥12॥

text: duḥkhaṃ hi mṛtyurbhūtānāṃ jīvitaṃ ca sudurlabham । ato bhītaḥ palāyāmi gaccheyaṃ nāsukhaṃ sukhāt ॥13॥
html:
duḥkhaṃ hi mṛtyurbhūtānāṃ jīvitaṃ ca sudurlabham ।
ato bhītaḥ palāyāmi gaccheyaṃ nāsukhaṃ sukhāt ॥13॥
slp1: duHKaM hi mftyurBUtAnAM jIvitaM ca sudurlaBam । ato BItaH palAyAmi gacCeyaM nAsuKaM suKAt ॥13॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa tu taṃ prāha kutaḥ kīṭa sukhaṃ tava । maraṇaṃ te sukhaṃ manye tiryagyonau hi vartase ॥14॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa tu taṃ prāha kutaḥ kīṭa sukhaṃ tava ।
maraṇaṃ te sukhaṃ manye tiryagyonau hi vartase ॥14॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa tu taM prAha kutaH kIwa suKaM tava । maraRaM te suKaM manye tiryagyonO hi vartase ॥14॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: śabdaṃ sparśaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ bhogāṃścoccāvacānbahūn । nābhijānāsi kīṭa tvaṃ śreyo maraṇameva te ॥15॥
html:
śabdaṃ sparśaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ bhogāṃścoccāvacānbahūn ।
nābhijānāsi kīṭa tvaṃ śreyo maraṇameva te ॥15॥
slp1: SabdaM sparSaM rasaM ganDaM BogAMScoccAvacAnbahUn । nABijAnAsi kIwa tvaM Sreyo maraRameva te ॥15॥

text: sarvatra nirato jīva itīhāpi sukhaṃ mama । cetayāmi mahāprājña tasmādicchāmi jīvitum ॥16॥
html:
sarvatra nirato jīva itīhāpi sukhaṃ mama ।
cetayāmi mahāprājña tasmādicchāmi jīvitum ॥16॥
slp1: sarvatra nirato jIva itIhApi suKaM mama । cetayAmi mahAprAjYa tasmAdicCAmi jIvitum ॥16॥
author: kīṭa uvāca ।

text: ihāpi viṣayaḥ sarvo yathādehaṃ pravartitaḥ । mānuṣāstiryagāścaiva pṛthagbhogā viśeṣataḥ ॥17॥
html:
ihāpi viṣayaḥ sarvo yathādehaṃ pravartitaḥ ।
mānuṣāstiryagāścaiva pṛthagbhogā viśeṣataḥ ॥17॥
slp1: ihApi vizayaH sarvo yaTAdehaM pravartitaH । mAnuzAstiryagAScEva pfTagBogA viSezataH ॥17॥

text: ahamāsaṃ manuṣyo vai śūdro bahudhanaḥ purā । abrahmaṇyo nṛśaṃsaśca kadaryo vṛddhijīvanaḥ ॥18॥
html:
ahamāsaṃ manuṣyo vai śūdro bahudhanaḥ purā ।
abrahmaṇyo nṛśaṃsaśca kadaryo vṛddhijīvanaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: ahamAsaM manuzyo vE SUdro bahuDanaH purA । abrahmaRyo nfSaMsaSca kadaryo vfdDijIvanaH ॥18॥

text: vāktīkṣṇo nikṛtiprajño moṣṭā viśvasya sarvaśaḥ । mithaḥkṛto'panidhanaḥ parasvaharaṇe rataḥ ॥19॥
html:
vāktīkṣṇo nikṛtiprajño moṣṭā viśvasya sarvaśaḥ ।
mithaḥkṛto'panidhanaḥ parasvaharaṇe rataḥ ॥19॥
slp1: vAktIkzRo nikftiprajYo mozwA viSvasya sarvaSaH । miTaHkfto'paniDanaH parasvaharaRe rataH ॥19॥

text: bhṛtyātithijanaścāpi gṛhe paryuṣito mayā । mātsaryātsvādukāmena nṛśaṃsena bubhūṣatā ॥20॥
html:
bhṛtyātithijanaścāpi gṛhe paryuṣito mayā ।
mātsaryātsvādukāmena nṛśaṃsena bubhūṣatā ॥20॥
slp1: BftyAtiTijanaScApi gfhe paryuzito mayA । mAtsaryAtsvAdukAmena nfSaMsena buBUzatA ॥20॥

text: devārthaṃ pitṛyajñārthamannaṃ śraddhākṛtaṃ mayā । na dattamarthakāmena deyamannaṃ punāti ha ॥21॥
html:
devārthaṃ pitṛyajñārthamannaṃ śraddhākṛtaṃ mayā ।
na dattamarthakāmena deyamannaṃ punāti ha ॥21॥
slp1: devArTaM pitfyajYArTamannaM SradDAkftaM mayA । na dattamarTakAmena deyamannaM punAti ha ॥21॥

text: guptaṃ śaraṇamāśritya bhayeṣu śaraṇāgatāḥ । akasmānno bhayāttyaktā na ca trātābhayaiṣiṇaḥ ॥22॥
html:
guptaṃ śaraṇamāśritya bhayeṣu śaraṇāgatāḥ ।
akasmānno bhayāttyaktā na ca trātābhayaiṣiṇaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: guptaM SaraRamASritya Bayezu SaraRAgatAH । akasmAnno BayAttyaktA na ca trAtABayEziRaH ॥22॥

text: dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ priyāndārānyānaṃ vāsastathādbhutam । śriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā manuṣyāṇāmasūyāmi nirarthakam ॥23॥
html:
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ priyāndārānyānaṃ vāsastathādbhutam ।
śriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā manuṣyāṇāmasūyāmi nirarthakam ॥23॥
slp1: DanaM DAnyaM priyAndArAnyAnaM vAsastaTAdButam । SriyaM dfzwvA manuzyARAmasUyAmi nirarTakam ॥23॥

text: īrṣyuḥ parasukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā ātatāyyabubhūṣakaḥ । trivargahantā cānyeṣāmātmakāmānuvartakaḥ ॥24॥
html:
īrṣyuḥ parasukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā ātatāyyabubhūṣakaḥ ।
trivargahantā cānyeṣāmātmakāmānuvartakaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: IrzyuH parasuKaM dfzwvA AtatAyyabuBUzakaH । trivargahantA cAnyezAmAtmakAmAnuvartakaH ॥24॥

text: nṛśaṃsaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ purā karma kṛtaṃ mayā । smṛtvā tadanutapye'haṃ tyaktvā priyamivātmajam ॥25॥
html:
nṛśaṃsaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ purā karma kṛtaṃ mayā ।
smṛtvā tadanutapye'haṃ tyaktvā priyamivātmajam ॥25॥
slp1: nfSaMsaguRaBUyizWaM purA karma kftaM mayA । smftvA tadanutapye'haM tyaktvA priyamivAtmajam ॥25॥

text: śubhānāmapi jānāmi kṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalam । mātā ca pūjitā vṛddhā brāhmaṇaścārcito mayā ॥26॥
html:
śubhānāmapi jānāmi kṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalam ।
mātā ca pūjitā vṛddhā brāhmaṇaścārcito mayā ॥26॥
slp1: SuBAnAmapi jAnAmi kftAnAM karmaRAM Palam । mAtA ca pUjitA vfdDA brAhmaRaScArcito mayA ॥26॥

text: sakṛjjātiguṇopetaḥ saṅgatyā gṛhamāgataḥ । atithiḥ pūjito brahmaṃstena māṃ nājahātsmṛtiḥ ॥27॥
html:
sakṛjjātiguṇopetaḥ saṅgatyā gṛhamāgataḥ ।
atithiḥ pūjito brahmaṃstena māṃ nājahātsmṛtiḥ ॥27॥
slp1: sakfjjAtiguRopetaH saNgatyA gfhamAgataH । atiTiH pUjito brahmaMstena mAM nAjahAtsmftiH ॥27॥

text: karmaṇā tena caivāhaṃ sukhāśāmiha lakṣaye । tacchrotumahamicchāmi tvattaḥ śreyastapodhana] ॥28॥
html:
karmaṇā tena caivāhaṃ sukhāśāmiha lakṣaye ।
tacchrotumahamicchāmi tvattaḥ śreyastapodhana] ॥28॥
slp1: karmaRA tena cEvAhaM suKASAmiha lakzaye । tacCrotumahamicCAmi tvattaH SreyastapoDana] ॥28॥

text: śubhena karmaṇā yadvai tiryagyonau na muhyase । mamaiva kīṭa tatkarma yena tvaṃ na pramuhyase ॥1॥
html:
śubhena karmaṇā yadvai tiryagyonau na muhyase ।
mamaiva kīṭa tatkarma yena tvaṃ na pramuhyase ॥1॥
slp1: SuBena karmaRA yadvE tiryagyonO na muhyase । mamEva kIwa tatkarma yena tvaM na pramuhyase ॥1॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: ahaṃ hi darśanādeva tārayāmi tapobalāt । tapobalāddhi balavadbalamanyanna vidyate ॥2॥
html:
ahaṃ hi darśanādeva tārayāmi tapobalāt ।
tapobalāddhi balavadbalamanyanna vidyate ॥2॥
slp1: ahaM hi darSanAdeva tArayAmi tapobalAt । tapobalAdDi balavadbalamanyanna vidyate ॥2॥

text: jānāmi pāpaiḥ svakṛtairgataṃ tvāṃ kīṭa kīṭatām । avāpsyasi paraṃ dharmaṃ dharmastho yadi manyase ॥3॥
html:
jānāmi pāpaiḥ svakṛtairgataṃ tvāṃ kīṭa kīṭatām ।
avāpsyasi paraṃ dharmaṃ dharmastho yadi manyase ॥3॥
slp1: jAnAmi pApEH svakftErgataM tvAM kIwa kIwatAm । avApsyasi paraM DarmaM DarmasTo yadi manyase ॥3॥

text: karma bhūmikṛtaṃ devā bhuñjate tiryagāśca ye । dharmādapi manuṣyeṣu kāmo'rthaśca yathā guṇaiḥ ॥4॥
html:
karma bhūmikṛtaṃ devā bhuñjate tiryagāśca ye ।
dharmādapi manuṣyeṣu kāmo'rthaśca yathā guṇaiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: karma BUmikftaM devA BuYjate tiryagASca ye । DarmAdapi manuzyezu kAmo'rTaSca yaTA guREH ॥4॥

text: vāgbuddhipāṇipādaiścāpyupetasya vipaścitaḥ । kiṃ hīyate manuṣyasya mandasyāpi hi jīvataḥ ॥5॥
html:
vāgbuddhipāṇipādaiścāpyupetasya vipaścitaḥ ।
kiṃ hīyate manuṣyasya mandasyāpi hi jīvataḥ ॥5॥
slp1: vAgbudDipARipAdEScApyupetasya vipaScitaH । kiM hIyate manuzyasya mandasyApi hi jIvataH ॥5॥

text: jīvanhi kurute pūjāṃ viprāgryaḥ śaśisūryayoḥ । bruvannapi kathāṃ puṇyāṃ tatra kīṭa tvameṣyasi ॥6॥
html:
jīvanhi kurute pūjāṃ viprāgryaḥ śaśisūryayoḥ ।
bruvannapi kathāṃ puṇyāṃ tatra kīṭa tvameṣyasi ॥6॥
slp1: jIvanhi kurute pUjAM viprAgryaH SaSisUryayoH । bruvannapi kaTAM puRyAM tatra kIwa tvamezyasi ॥6॥

text: guṇabhūtāni bhūtāni tatra tvamupabhokṣyase । tatra te'haṃ vineṣyāmi brahmatvaṃ yatra cecchasi ॥7॥
html:
guṇabhūtāni bhūtāni tatra tvamupabhokṣyase ।
tatra te'haṃ vineṣyāmi brahmatvaṃ yatra cecchasi ॥7॥
slp1: guRaBUtAni BUtAni tatra tvamupaBokzyase । tatra te'haM vinezyAmi brahmatvaM yatra cecCasi ॥7॥

text: sa tatheti pratiśrutya kīṭo vartmanyatiṣṭhata । tamṛṣiṃ draṣṭumagamatsarvāsvanyāsu yoniṣu ॥8॥
html:
sa tatheti pratiśrutya kīṭo vartmanyatiṣṭhata ।
tamṛṣiṃ draṣṭumagamatsarvāsvanyāsu yoniṣu ॥8॥
slp1: sa taTeti pratiSrutya kIwo vartmanyatizWata । tamfziM drazwumagamatsarvAsvanyAsu yonizu ॥8॥

text: śvāvidgodhāvarāhāṇāṃ tathaiva mṛgapakṣiṇām । śvapākavaiśyaśūdrāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca yoniṣu ॥9॥
html:
śvāvidgodhāvarāhāṇāṃ tathaiva mṛgapakṣiṇām ।
śvapākavaiśyaśūdrāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca yoniṣu ॥9॥
slp1: SvAvidgoDAvarAhARAM taTEva mfgapakziRAm । SvapAkavESyaSUdrARAM kzatriyARAM ca yonizu ॥9॥

text: sa kīṭetyevamābhāṣya ṛṣiṇā satyavādinā । pratismṛtyātha jagrāha pādau mūrdhnā kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥10॥
html:
sa kīṭetyevamābhāṣya ṛṣiṇā satyavādinā ।
pratismṛtyātha jagrāha pādau mūrdhnā kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥10॥
slp1: sa kIwetyevamABAzya fziRA satyavAdinA । pratismftyATa jagrAha pAdO mUrDnA kftAYjaliH ॥10॥

text: idaṃ tadatulaṃ sthānamīpsitaṃ daśabhirguṇaiḥ । yadahaṃ prāpya kīṭatvamāgato rājaputratām ॥11॥
html:
idaṃ tadatulaṃ sthānamīpsitaṃ daśabhirguṇaiḥ ।
yadahaṃ prāpya kīṭatvamāgato rājaputratām ॥11॥
slp1: idaM tadatulaM sTAnamIpsitaM daSaBirguREH । yadahaM prApya kIwatvamAgato rAjaputratAm ॥11॥
author: kīṭa uvāca ।

text: vahanti māmatibalāḥ kuñjarā hemamālinaḥ । syandaneṣu ca kāmbojā yuktāḥ paramavājinaḥ ॥12॥
html:
vahanti māmatibalāḥ kuñjarā hemamālinaḥ ।
syandaneṣu ca kāmbojā yuktāḥ paramavājinaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: vahanti mAmatibalAH kuYjarA hemamAlinaH । syandanezu ca kAmbojA yuktAH paramavAjinaH ॥12॥

text: uṣṭrāśvatarayuktāni yānāni ca vahanti mām । sabāndhavaḥ sahāmātyaścāśnāmi piśitaudanam ॥13॥
html:
uṣṭrāśvatarayuktāni yānāni ca vahanti mām ।
sabāndhavaḥ sahāmātyaścāśnāmi piśitaudanam ॥13॥
slp1: uzwrASvatarayuktAni yAnAni ca vahanti mAm । sabAnDavaH sahAmAtyaScASnAmi piSitOdanam ॥13॥

text: gṛheṣu sunivāseṣu sukheṣu śayaneṣu ca । parārdhyeṣu mahābhāga svapāmīha supūjitaḥ ॥14॥
html:
gṛheṣu sunivāseṣu sukheṣu śayaneṣu ca ।
parārdhyeṣu mahābhāga svapāmīha supūjitaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: gfhezu sunivAsezu suKezu Sayanezu ca । parArDyezu mahABAga svapAmIha supUjitaH ॥14॥

text: sarveṣvapararātreṣu sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ । stuvanti māṃ yathā devaṃ mahendraṃ priyavādinaḥ ॥15॥
html:
sarveṣvapararātreṣu sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ ।
stuvanti māṃ yathā devaṃ mahendraṃ priyavādinaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: sarvezvapararAtrezu sUtamAgaDabandinaH । stuvanti mAM yaTA devaM mahendraM priyavAdinaH ॥15॥

text: prasādātsatyasandhasya bhavato'mitatejasaḥ । yadahaṃ kīṭatāṃ prāpya samprāpto rājaputratām ॥16॥
html:
prasādātsatyasandhasya bhavato'mitatejasaḥ ।
yadahaṃ kīṭatāṃ prāpya samprāpto rājaputratām ॥16॥
slp1: prasAdAtsatyasanDasya Bavato'mitatejasaH । yadahaM kIwatAM prApya samprApto rAjaputratAm ॥16॥

text: namaste'stu mahāprājña kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām । tvattapobalanirdiṣṭamidaṃ hyadhigataṃ mayā ॥17॥
html:
namaste'stu mahāprājña kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām ।
tvattapobalanirdiṣṭamidaṃ hyadhigataṃ mayā ॥17॥
slp1: namaste'stu mahAprAjYa kiM karomi praSADi mAm । tvattapobalanirdizwamidaM hyaDigataM mayA ॥17॥

text: arcito'haṃ tvayā rājanvāgbhiradya yadṛcchayā । adya te kīṭatāṃ prāpya smṛtirjātājugupsitā ॥18॥
html:
arcito'haṃ tvayā rājanvāgbhiradya yadṛcchayā ।
adya te kīṭatāṃ prāpya smṛtirjātājugupsitā ॥18॥
slp1: arcito'haM tvayA rAjanvAgBiradya yadfcCayA । adya te kIwatAM prApya smftirjAtAjugupsitA ॥18॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: na tu nāśo'sti pāpasya yattvayopacitaṃ purā । śūdreṇārthapradhānena nṛśaṃsenātatāyinā ॥19॥
html:
na tu nāśo'sti pāpasya yattvayopacitaṃ purā ।
śūdreṇārthapradhānena nṛśaṃsenātatāyinā ॥19॥
slp1: na tu nASo'sti pApasya yattvayopacitaM purA । SUdreRArTapraDAnena nfSaMsenAtatAyinA ॥19॥

text: mama te darśanaṃ prāptaṃ taccaiva sukṛtaṃ purā । tiryagyonau sma jātena mama cāpyarcanāttathā ॥20॥
html:
mama te darśanaṃ prāptaṃ taccaiva sukṛtaṃ purā ।
tiryagyonau sma jātena mama cāpyarcanāttathā ॥20॥
slp1: mama te darSanaM prAptaM taccEva sukftaM purA । tiryagyonO sma jAtena mama cApyarcanAttaTA ॥20॥

text: itastvaṃ rājaputratvādbrāhmaṇyaṃ samavāpsyasi । gobrāhmaṇakṛte prāṇānhutvātmīyānraṇājire ॥21॥
html:
itastvaṃ rājaputratvādbrāhmaṇyaṃ samavāpsyasi ।
gobrāhmaṇakṛte prāṇānhutvātmīyānraṇājire ॥21॥
slp1: itastvaM rAjaputratvAdbrAhmaRyaM samavApsyasi । gobrAhmaRakfte prARAnhutvAtmIyAnraRAjire ॥21॥

text: rājaputrasukhaṃ prāpya ṛtūṃścaivāptadakṣiṇān । atha modiṣyase svarge brahmabhūto'vyayaḥ sukhī ॥22॥
html:
rājaputrasukhaṃ prāpya ṛtūṃścaivāptadakṣiṇān ।
atha modiṣyase svarge brahmabhūto'vyayaḥ sukhī ॥22॥
slp1: rAjaputrasuKaM prApya ftUMScEvAptadakziRAn । aTa modizyase svarge brahmaBUto'vyayaH suKI ॥22॥

text: tiryagyonyāḥ śūdratāmabhyupaiti śūdro vaiśyatvaṃ kṣatriyatvaṃ ca vaiśyaḥ । vṛttaślāghī kṣatriyo brāhmaṇatvaṃ svargaṃ puṇyaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sādhuvṛttaḥ] ॥23॥
html:
tiryagyonyāḥ śūdratāmabhyupaiti śūdro vaiśyatvaṃ kṣatriyatvaṃ ca vaiśyaḥ ।
vṛttaślāghī kṣatriyo brāhmaṇatvaṃ svargaṃ puṇyaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sādhuvṛttaḥ] ॥23॥
slp1: tiryagyonyAH SUdratAmaByupEti SUdro vESyatvaM kzatriyatvaM ca vESyaH । vfttaSlAGI kzatriyo brAhmaRatvaM svargaM puRyaM brAhmaRaH sADuvfttaH] ॥23॥

text: kṣatradharmamanuprāptaḥ smaranneva sa vīryavān । tyaktvā sa kīṭatāṃ rājaṃścacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ ॥1॥
html:
kṣatradharmamanuprāptaḥ smaranneva sa vīryavān ।
tyaktvā sa kīṭatāṃ rājaṃścacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: kzatraDarmamanuprAptaH smaranneva sa vIryavAn । tyaktvA sa kIwatAM rAjaMScacAra vipulaM tapaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tasya dharmārthaviduṣo dṛṣṭvā tadvipulaṃ tapaḥ । ājagāma dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastadā ॥2॥
html:
tasya dharmārthaviduṣo dṛṣṭvā tadvipulaṃ tapaḥ ।
ājagāma dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastadā ॥2॥
slp1: tasya DarmArTaviduzo dfzwvA tadvipulaM tapaH । AjagAma dvijaSrezWaH kfzRadvEpAyanastadA ॥2॥

text: kṣātraṃ caiva vrataṃ kīṭa bhūtānāṃ paripālanam । kṣātraṃ caiva vrataṃ dhyāyaṃstato vipratvameṣyasi ॥3॥
html:
kṣātraṃ caiva vrataṃ kīṭa bhūtānāṃ paripālanam ।
kṣātraṃ caiva vrataṃ dhyāyaṃstato vipratvameṣyasi ॥3॥
slp1: kzAtraM cEva vrataM kIwa BUtAnAM paripAlanam । kzAtraM cEva vrataM DyAyaMstato vipratvamezyasi ॥3॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: pāhi sarvāḥ prajāḥ samyakśubhāśubhavidātmavān । śubhaiḥ saṃvibhajankāmairaśubhānāṃ ca pāvanaiḥ ॥4॥
html:
pāhi sarvāḥ prajāḥ samyakśubhāśubhavidātmavān ।
śubhaiḥ saṃvibhajankāmairaśubhānāṃ ca pāvanaiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: pAhi sarvAH prajAH samyakSuBASuBavidAtmavAn । SuBEH saMviBajankAmEraSuBAnAM ca pAvanEH ॥4॥

text: ātmavānbhava suprītaḥ svadharmacaraṇe rataḥ । kṣātrīṃ tanuṃ samutsṛjya tato vipratvameṣyasi ॥5॥
html:
ātmavānbhava suprītaḥ svadharmacaraṇe rataḥ ।
kṣātrīṃ tanuṃ samutsṛjya tato vipratvameṣyasi ॥5॥
slp1: AtmavAnBava suprItaH svaDarmacaraRe rataH । kzAtrIM tanuM samutsfjya tato vipratvamezyasi ॥5॥

text: so'thāraṇyamabhipretya punareva yudhiṣṭhira । maharṣervacanaṃ śrutvā prajā dharmeṇa pālya ca ॥6॥
html:
so'thāraṇyamabhipretya punareva yudhiṣṭhira ।
maharṣervacanaṃ śrutvā prajā dharmeṇa pālya ca ॥6॥
slp1: so'TAraRyamaBipretya punareva yuDizWira । maharzervacanaM SrutvA prajA DarmeRa pAlya ca ॥6॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: acireṇaiva kālena kīṭaḥ pārthivasattama । prajāpālanadharmeṇa pretya vipratvamāgataḥ ॥7॥
html:
acireṇaiva kālena kīṭaḥ pārthivasattama ।
prajāpālanadharmeṇa pretya vipratvamāgataḥ ॥7॥
slp1: acireREva kAlena kIwaH pArTivasattama । prajApAlanaDarmeRa pretya vipratvamAgataH ॥7॥

text: tatastaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā punareva mahāyaśāḥ । ājagāma mahāprājñaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastadā ॥8॥
html:
tatastaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā punareva mahāyaśāḥ ।
ājagāma mahāprājñaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastadā ॥8॥
slp1: tatastaM brAhmaRaM dfzwvA punareva mahAyaSAH । AjagAma mahAprAjYaH kfzRadvEpAyanastadA ॥8॥

text: bho bho viprarṣabha śrīmanmā vyathiṣṭhāḥ kathañcana । śubhakṛcchubhayonīṣu pāpakṛtpāpayoniṣu । upapadyati dharmajña yathādharmaṃ yathāgamam ॥9॥
html:
bho bho viprarṣabha śrīmanmā vyathiṣṭhāḥ kathañcana ।
śubhakṛcchubhayonīṣu pāpakṛtpāpayoniṣu ।
upapadyati dharmajña yathādharmaṃ yathāgamam ॥9॥
slp1: Bo Bo viprarzaBa SrImanmA vyaTizWAH kaTaYcana । SuBakfcCuBayonIzu pApakftpApayonizu । upapadyati DarmajYa yaTADarmaM yaTAgamam ॥9॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: tasmānmṛtyubhayātkīṭa mā vyathiṣṭhāḥ kathañcana । dharmalopādbhayaṃ te syāttasmāddharmaṃ carottamam ॥10॥
html:
tasmānmṛtyubhayātkīṭa mā vyathiṣṭhāḥ kathañcana ।
dharmalopādbhayaṃ te syāttasmāddharmaṃ carottamam ॥10॥
slp1: tasmAnmftyuBayAtkIwa mA vyaTizWAH kaTaYcana । DarmalopAdBayaM te syAttasmAdDarmaM carottamam ॥10॥

text: sukhātsukhataraṃ prāpto bhagavaṃstvatkṛte hyaham । dharmamūlāṃ śriyaṃ prāpya pāpmā naṣṭa ihādya me ॥11॥
html:
sukhātsukhataraṃ prāpto bhagavaṃstvatkṛte hyaham ।
dharmamūlāṃ śriyaṃ prāpya pāpmā naṣṭa ihādya me ॥11॥
slp1: suKAtsuKataraM prApto BagavaMstvatkfte hyaham । DarmamUlAM SriyaM prApya pApmA nazwa ihAdya me ॥11॥
author: kīṭa uvāca ।

text: bhagavadvacanātkīṭo brāhmaṇyaṃ prāpya durlabham । akarotpṛthivīṃ rājanyajñayūpaśatāṅkitām । tataḥ sālokyamagamadbrahmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ ॥12॥
html:
bhagavadvacanātkīṭo brāhmaṇyaṃ prāpya durlabham ।
akarotpṛthivīṃ rājanyajñayūpaśatāṅkitām ।
tataḥ sālokyamagamadbrahmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: BagavadvacanAtkIwo brAhmaRyaM prApya durlaBam । akarotpfTivIM rAjanyajYayUpaSatANkitAm । tataH sAlokyamagamadbrahmaRo brahmavittamaH ॥12॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: avāpa ca paraṃ kīṭaḥ pārtha brahma sanātanam । svakarmaphalanirvṛttaṃ vyāsasya vacanāttadā ॥13॥
html:
avāpa ca paraṃ kīṭaḥ pārtha brahma sanātanam ।
svakarmaphalanirvṛttaṃ vyāsasya vacanāttadā ॥13॥
slp1: avApa ca paraM kIwaH pArTa brahma sanAtanam । svakarmaPalanirvfttaM vyAsasya vacanAttadA ॥13॥

text: te'pi yasmātsvabhāvena hatāḥ kṣatriyapuṅgavāḥ । samprāptāste gatiṃ puṇyāṃ tasmānmā śoca putraka] ॥14॥
html:
te'pi yasmātsvabhāvena hatāḥ kṣatriyapuṅgavāḥ ।
samprāptāste gatiṃ puṇyāṃ tasmānmā śoca putraka] ॥14॥
slp1: te'pi yasmAtsvaBAvena hatAH kzatriyapuNgavAH । samprAptAste gatiM puRyAM tasmAnmA Soca putraka] ॥14॥

text: vidyā tapaśca dānaṃ ca kimeteṣāṃ viśiṣyate । pṛcchāmi tvā satāṃ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
html:
vidyā tapaśca dānaṃ ca kimeteṣāṃ viśiṣyate ।
pṛcchāmi tvā satāṃ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
slp1: vidyA tapaSca dAnaM ca kimetezAM viSizyate । pfcCAmi tvA satAM SrezWa tanme brUhi pitAmaha ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । maitreyasya ca saṃvādaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya ca ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
maitreyasya ca saṃvādaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya ca ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । mEtreyasya ca saMvAdaM kfzRadvEpAyanasya ca ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kṛṣṇadvaipāyano rājannajñātacaritaṃ caran । vārāṇasyāmupātiṣṭhanmaitreyaṃ svairiṇīkule ॥3॥
html:
kṛṣṇadvaipāyano rājannajñātacaritaṃ caran ।
vārāṇasyāmupātiṣṭhanmaitreyaṃ svairiṇīkule ॥3॥
slp1: kfzRadvEpAyano rAjannajYAtacaritaM caran । vArARasyAmupAtizWanmEtreyaM svEriRIkule ॥3॥

text: tamupasthitamāsīnaṃ jñātvā sa munisattamam । arcitvā bhojayāmāsa maitreyo'śanamuttamam ॥4॥
html:
tamupasthitamāsīnaṃ jñātvā sa munisattamam ।
arcitvā bhojayāmāsa maitreyo'śanamuttamam ॥4॥
slp1: tamupasTitamAsInaM jYAtvA sa munisattamam । arcitvA BojayAmAsa mEtreyo'Sanamuttamam ॥4॥

text: tadannamuttamaṃ bhuktvā guṇavatsārvakāmikam । pratiṣṭhamāno'smayata prītaḥ kṛṣṇo mahāmanāḥ ॥5॥
html:
tadannamuttamaṃ bhuktvā guṇavatsārvakāmikam ।
pratiṣṭhamāno'smayata prītaḥ kṛṣṇo mahāmanāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: tadannamuttamaM BuktvA guRavatsArvakAmikam । pratizWamAno'smayata prItaH kfzRo mahAmanAH ॥5॥

text: tamutsmayantaṃ samprekṣya maitreyaḥ kṛṣṇamabravīt । kāraṇaṃ brūhi dharmātmanyo'smayiṣṭhāḥ kutaśca te । tapasvino dhṛtimataḥ pramodaḥ samupāgataḥ ॥6॥
html:
tamutsmayantaṃ samprekṣya maitreyaḥ kṛṣṇamabravīt ।
kāraṇaṃ brūhi dharmātmanyo'smayiṣṭhāḥ kutaśca te ।
tapasvino dhṛtimataḥ pramodaḥ samupāgataḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tamutsmayantaM samprekzya mEtreyaH kfzRamabravIt । kAraRaM brUhi DarmAtmanyo'smayizWAH kutaSca te । tapasvino DftimataH pramodaH samupAgataH ॥6॥

text: etatpṛcchāmi te vidvannabhivādya praṇamya ca । ātmanaśca tapobhāgyaṃ mahābhāgyaṃ tathaiva ca ॥7॥
html:
etatpṛcchāmi te vidvannabhivādya praṇamya ca ।
ātmanaśca tapobhāgyaṃ mahābhāgyaṃ tathaiva ca ॥7॥
slp1: etatpfcCAmi te vidvannaBivAdya praRamya ca । AtmanaSca tapoBAgyaM mahABAgyaM taTEva ca ॥7॥

text: pṛthagācaratastāta pṛthagātmani cātmanoḥ । alpāntaramahaṃ manye viśiṣṭamapi vā tvayā ॥8॥
html:
pṛthagācaratastāta pṛthagātmani cātmanoḥ ।
alpāntaramahaṃ manye viśiṣṭamapi vā tvayā ॥8॥
slp1: pfTagAcaratastAta pfTagAtmani cAtmanoH । alpAntaramahaM manye viSizwamapi vA tvayA ॥8॥

text: aticchedātivādābhyāṃ smayo'yaṃ samupāgataḥ । asatyaṃ vedavacanaṃ kasmādvedo'nṛtaṃ vadet ॥9॥
html:
aticchedātivādābhyāṃ smayo'yaṃ samupāgataḥ ।
asatyaṃ vedavacanaṃ kasmādvedo'nṛtaṃ vadet ॥9॥
slp1: aticCedAtivAdAByAM smayo'yaM samupAgataH । asatyaM vedavacanaM kasmAdvedo'nftaM vadet ॥9॥
author: vyāsa uvāca ।

text: trīṇyeva tu padānyāhuḥ puruṣasyottamaṃ vratam । na druhyeccaiva dadyācca satyaṃ caiva paraṃ vadet । idānīṃ caiva naḥ kṛtyaṃ purastācca paraṃ smṛtam ॥10॥
html:
trīṇyeva tu padānyāhuḥ puruṣasyottamaṃ vratam ।
na druhyeccaiva dadyācca satyaṃ caiva paraṃ vadet ।
idānīṃ caiva naḥ kṛtyaṃ purastācca paraṃ smṛtam ॥10॥
slp1: trIRyeva tu padAnyAhuH puruzasyottamaM vratam । na druhyeccEva dadyAcca satyaM cEva paraM vadet । idAnIM cEva naH kftyaM purastAcca paraM smftam ॥10॥

text: alpo'pi tādṛśo dāyo bhavatyuta mahāphalaḥ । tṛṣitāya ca yaddattaṃ hṛdayenānasūyatā ॥11॥
html:
alpo'pi tādṛśo dāyo bhavatyuta mahāphalaḥ ।
tṛṣitāya ca yaddattaṃ hṛdayenānasūyatā ॥11॥
slp1: alpo'pi tAdfSo dAyo Bavatyuta mahAPalaH । tfzitAya ca yaddattaM hfdayenAnasUyatA ॥11॥

text: tṛṣitastṛṣitāya tvaṃ dattvaitadaśanaṃ mama । ajaiṣīrmahato lokānmahāyajñairivābhibho । ato dānapavitreṇa prīto'smi tapasaiva ca ॥12॥
html:
tṛṣitastṛṣitāya tvaṃ dattvaitadaśanaṃ mama ।
ajaiṣīrmahato lokānmahāyajñairivābhibho ।
ato dānapavitreṇa prīto'smi tapasaiva ca ॥12॥
slp1: tfzitastfzitAya tvaM dattvEtadaSanaM mama । ajEzIrmahato lokAnmahAyajYErivABiBo । ato dAnapavitreRa prIto'smi tapasEva ca ॥12॥

text: puṇyasyaiva hi te gandhaḥ puṇyasyaiva ca darśanam । puṇyaśca vāti gandhaste manye karmavidhānataḥ ॥13॥
html:
puṇyasyaiva hi te gandhaḥ puṇyasyaiva ca darśanam ।
puṇyaśca vāti gandhaste manye karmavidhānataḥ ॥13॥
slp1: puRyasyEva hi te ganDaH puRyasyEva ca darSanam । puRyaSca vAti ganDaste manye karmaviDAnataH ॥13॥

text: adhikaṃ mārjanāttāta tathaivāpyanulepanāt । śubhaṃ sarvapavitrebhyo dānameva paraṃ bhavet ॥14॥
html:
adhikaṃ mārjanāttāta tathaivāpyanulepanāt ।
śubhaṃ sarvapavitrebhyo dānameva paraṃ bhavet ॥14॥
slp1: aDikaM mArjanAttAta taTEvApyanulepanAt । SuBaM sarvapavitreByo dAnameva paraM Bavet ॥14॥

text: yānīmānyuttamānīha vedoktāni praśaṃsasi । teṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ dānamiti me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ॥15॥
html:
yānīmānyuttamānīha vedoktāni praśaṃsasi ।
teṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ dānamiti me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: yAnImAnyuttamAnIha vedoktAni praSaMsasi । tezAM SrezWatamaM dAnamiti me nAsti saMSayaH ॥15॥

text: dānakṛdbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ । te hi prāṇasya dātārasteṣu dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥16॥
html:
dānakṛdbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ ।
te hi prāṇasya dātārasteṣu dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: dAnakfdBiH kftaH panTA yena yAnti manIziRaH । te hi prARasya dAtArastezu DarmaH pratizWitaH ॥16॥

text: yathā vedāḥ svadhītāśca yathā cendriyasaṃyamaḥ । sarvatyāgo yathā ceha tathā dānamanuttamam ॥17॥
html:
yathā vedāḥ svadhītāśca yathā cendriyasaṃyamaḥ ।
sarvatyāgo yathā ceha tathā dānamanuttamam ॥17॥
slp1: yaTA vedAH svaDItASca yaTA cendriyasaMyamaH । sarvatyAgo yaTA ceha taTA dAnamanuttamam ॥17॥

text: tvaṃ hi tāta sukhādeva sukhameṣyasi śobhanam । sukhātsukhataraprāptimāpnute matimānnaraḥ ॥18॥
html:
tvaṃ hi tāta sukhādeva sukhameṣyasi śobhanam ।
sukhātsukhataraprāptimāpnute matimānnaraḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tvaM hi tAta suKAdeva suKamezyasi SoBanam । suKAtsuKataraprAptimApnute matimAnnaraH ॥18॥

text: tannaḥ pratyakṣamevedamupalabdhamasaṃśayam । śrīmantamāpnuvantyarthā dānaṃ yajñastathā sukham ॥19॥
html:
tannaḥ pratyakṣamevedamupalabdhamasaṃśayam ।
śrīmantamāpnuvantyarthā dānaṃ yajñastathā sukham ॥19॥
slp1: tannaH pratyakzamevedamupalabDamasaMSayam । SrImantamApnuvantyarTA dAnaM yajYastaTA suKam ॥19॥

text: sukhādeva paraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhādanyatparaṃ sukham । dṛśyate hi mahāprājña niyataṃ vai svabhāvataḥ ॥20॥
html:
sukhādeva paraṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhādanyatparaṃ sukham ।
dṛśyate hi mahāprājña niyataṃ vai svabhāvataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: suKAdeva paraM duHKaM duHKAdanyatparaM suKam । dfSyate hi mahAprAjYa niyataM vE svaBAvataH ॥20॥

text: trividhānīha vṛttāni narasyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । puṇyamanyatpāpamanyanna puṇyaṃ na ca pāpakam ॥21॥
html:
trividhānīha vṛttāni narasyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।
puṇyamanyatpāpamanyanna puṇyaṃ na ca pāpakam ॥21॥
slp1: triviDAnIha vfttAni narasyAhurmanIziRaH । puRyamanyatpApamanyanna puRyaM na ca pApakam ॥21॥

text: evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca maitreyaḥ karmapūjakaḥ । atyantaṃ śrīmati kule jātaḥ prājño bahuśrutaḥ ॥1॥

text: asaṃśayaṃ mahāprājña yathaivāttha tathaiva tat । anujñātastu bhavatā kiñcidbrūyāmahaṃ vibho ॥2॥

text: nirdoṣaṃ nirmalaṃ caiva vacanaṃ dānasaṃhitam । vidyātapobhyāṃ hi bhavānbhāvitātmā na saṃśayaḥ ॥4॥
html:

text: evamuktaḥ sa bhagavānmaitreyaṃ pratyabhāṣata । diṣṭyaivaṃ tvaṃ vijānāsi diṣṭyā te buddhirīdṛśī । loko hyayaṃ guṇāneva bhūyiṣṭhaṃ sma praśaṃsati ॥1॥

slp1: na tvamalpena tapasA dAnena niyamena vA । imaM lokamanuprAptA tasmAttattvaM vadasva me ॥6॥

text: iti pṛṣṭā sumanayā madhuraṃ cāruhāsinī । śāṇḍilī nibhṛtaṃ vākyaṃ sumanāmidamabravīt ॥7॥
html:
iti pṛṣṭā sumanayā madhuraṃ cāruhāsinī ।
śāṇḍilī nibhṛtaṃ vākyaṃ sumanāmidamabravīt ॥7॥
slp1: iti pfzwA sumanayA maDuraM cAruhAsinI । SARqilI niBftaM vAkyaM sumanAmidamabravIt ॥7॥

text: nāhaṃ kāṣāyavasanā nāpi valkaladhāriṇī । na ca muṇḍā na jaṭilā bhūtvā devatvamāgatā ॥8॥
html:
nāhaṃ kāṣāyavasanā nāpi valkaladhāriṇī ।
na ca muṇḍā na jaṭilā bhūtvā devatvamāgatā ॥8॥
slp1: nAhaM kAzAyavasanA nApi valkalaDAriRI । na ca muRqA na jawilA BUtvA devatvamAgatA ॥8॥

text: ahitāni ca vākyāni sarvāṇi paruṣāṇi ca । apramattā ca bhartāraṃ kadācinnāhamabruvam ॥9॥
html:
ahitāni ca vākyāni sarvāṇi paruṣāṇi ca ।

slp1: ahitAni ca vAkyAni sarvARi paruzARi ca । apramattA ca BartAraM kadAcinnAhamabruvam ॥9॥

text: devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjane । apramattā sadāyuktā śvaśrūśvaśuravartinī ॥10॥
html:
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjane ।

slp1: devatAnAM pitFRAM ca brAhmaRAnAM ca pUjane । apramattA sadAyuktA SvaSrUSvaSuravartinI ॥10॥

text: paiśunye na pravartāmi na mamaitanmanogatam । advāre na ca tiṣṭhāmi ciraṃ na kathayāmi ca ॥11॥

text: asadvā hasitaṃ kiñcidahitaṃ vāpi karmaṇā । rahasyamarahasyaṃ vā na pravartāmi sarvathā ॥12॥

text: kāryārthe nirgataṃ cāpi bhartāraṃ gṛhamāgatam । āsanenopasaṃyojya pūjayāmi samāhitā ॥13॥
html:

text: yadyacca nābhijānāti yadbhojyaṃ nābhinandati । bhakṣyaṃ vāpyatha vā lehyaṃ tatsarvaṃ varjayāmyaham ॥14॥
html:

slp1: yadyacca nABijAnAti yadBojyaM nABinandati । BakzyaM vApyaTa vA lehyaM tatsarvaM varjayAmyaham ॥14॥

text: kuṭumbārthe samānītaṃ yatkiñcitkāryameva tu । prātarutthāya tatsarvaṃ kārayāmi karomi ca ॥15॥
html:

slp1: kuwumbArTe samAnItaM yatkiYcitkAryameva tu । prAtarutTAya tatsarvaM kArayAmi karomi ca ॥15॥

text: pravāsaṃ yadi me bhartā yāti kāryeṇa kenacit । maṅgalairbahubhiryuktā bhavāmi niyatā sadā ॥16॥
html:
pravāsaṃ yadi me bhartā yāti kāryeṇa kenacit ।

slp1: pravAsaM yadi me BartA yAti kAryeRa kenacit । maNgalErbahuBiryuktA BavAmi niyatA sadA ॥16॥

text: añjanaṃ rocanāṃ caiva snānaṃ mālyānulepanam । prasādhanaṃ ca niṣkrānte nābhinandāmi bhartari ॥17॥
html:
añjanaṃ rocanāṃ caiva snānaṃ mālyānulepanam ।

slp1: aYjanaM rocanAM cEva snAnaM mAlyAnulepanam । prasADanaM ca nizkrAnte nABinandAmi Bartari ॥17॥

text: notthāpayāmi bhartāraṃ sukhasuptamahaṃ sadā । ātureṣvapi kāryeṣu tena tuṣyati me manaḥ ॥18॥
html:
notthāpayāmi bhartāraṃ sukhasuptamahaṃ sadā ।

slp1: notTApayAmi BartAraM suKasuptamahaM sadA । Aturezvapi kAryezu tena tuzyati me manaH ॥18॥

html:
nāyāsayāmi bhartāraṃ kuṭumbārthe ca sarvadā ।

slp1: nAyAsayAmi BartAraM kuwumbArTe ca sarvadA । guptaguhyA sadA cAsmi susammfzwaniveSanA ॥19॥

text: imaṃ dharmapathaṃ nārī pālayantī samāhitā । arundhatīva nārīṇāṃ svargaloke mahīyate ॥20॥

slp1: imaM DarmapaTaM nArI pAlayantI samAhitA । arunDatIva nArIRAM svargaloke mahIyate ॥20॥

text: etadākhyāya sā devī sumanāyai tapasvinī । patidharmaṃ mahābhāgā jagāmādarśanaṃ tadā ॥21॥

slp1: etadAKyAya sA devI sumanAyE tapasvinI । patiDarmaM mahABAgA jagAmAdarSanaM tadA ॥21॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: yaścedaṃ pāṇḍavākhyānaṃ paṭhetparvaṇi parvaṇi । sa devalokaṃ samprāpya nandane susukhaṃ vaset] ॥22॥

yaścedaṃ pāṇḍavākhyānaṃ paṭhetparvaṇi parvaṇi ।

slp1: yaScedaM pARqavAKyAnaM paWetparvaRi parvaRi । sa devalokaM samprApya nandane susuKaM vaset] ॥22॥

text: sāmnā vāpi pradāne vā jyāyaḥ kiṃ bhavato matam । prabrūhi bharataśreṣṭha yadatra vyatiricyate ॥1॥

prabrūhi bharataśreṣṭha yadatra vyatiricyate ॥1॥
slp1: sAmnA vApi pradAne vA jyAyaH kiM Bavato matam । prabrUhi BarataSrezWa yadatra vyatiricyate ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: sāmnā prasādyate kaściddānena ca tathāparaḥ । puruṣaḥ prakṛtiṃ jñātvā tayorekataraṃ bhajet ॥2॥
html:
sāmnā prasādyate kaściddānena ca tathāparaḥ ।

slp1: sAmnA prasAdyate kaSciddAnena ca taTAparaH । puruzaH prakftiM jYAtvA tayorekataraM Bajet ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: guṇāṃstu śṛṇu me rājansāntvasya bharatarṣabha । dāruṇānyapi bhūtāni sāntvenārādhayedyathā ॥3॥
html:

slp1: guRAMstu SfRu me rAjansAntvasya BaratarzaBa । dAruRAnyapi BUtAni sAntvenArADayedyaTA ॥3॥

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । gṛhītvā rakṣasā mukto dvijātiḥ kānane yathā ॥4॥

text: rakṣastu vācā sampūjya praśnaṃ papraccha taṃ dvijam । mokṣyase brūhi me praśnaṃ kenāsmi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ ॥7॥

slp1: rakzastu vAcA sampUjya praSnaM papracCa taM dvijam । mokzyase brUhi me praSnaM kenAsmi hariRaH kfSaH ॥7॥

text: muhūrtamatha sañcintya brāhmaṇastasya rakṣasaḥ । ābhirgāthābhiravyagraḥ praśnaṃ pratijagāda ha ॥8॥

text: videśastho vilokastho vinā nūnaṃ suhṛjjanaiḥ । viṣayānatulānbhuṅkṣe tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ ॥9॥

html:

slp1: DarmyamarTaM ca kAle ca deSe cABihitaM vacaH । na pratizWati te nUnaM tenAsi hariRaH kfSaH ॥33॥

html:

text: pitāmaha mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada । āgamairbahubhiḥ sphīto bhavānnaḥ prathitaḥ kule ॥1॥

text: ayaṃ ca kālaḥ samprāpto durlabhajñātibāndhavaḥ । śāstā ca na hi naḥ kaścittvāmṛte bharatarṣabha ॥3॥

text: yadi te'hamanugrāhyo bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito'nagha । vaktumarhasi naḥ praśnaṃ yattvāṃ pṛcchāmi pārthiva ॥4॥

text: asya caiva samakṣaṃ tvaṃ pārthivānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ । bhrātṝṇāṃ ca priyārthaṃ me snehādbhāṣitumarhasi ॥6॥

text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā snehādāgatasambhramaḥ । bhīṣmo bhāgīrathīputra idaṃ vacanamabravīt ॥7॥

text: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi kathāmatimanoramām । asya viṣṇoḥ purā rājanprabhāvo'yaṃ mayā śrutaḥ ॥8॥

text: tato viṣṇurvanaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirdagdhamarikarśanaḥ । saumyairdṛṣṭinipātaistatpunaḥ prakṛtimānayat ॥20॥

text: tadadbhutamacintyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā munigaṇastadā । vismito hṛṣṭalomā ca babhūvāsrāvilekṣaṇaḥ ॥22॥

text: bhavānvisṛjate lokānbhavānsaṃharate punaḥ । bhavāñśītaṃ bhavānuṣṇaṃ bhavāneva pravarṣati ॥26॥

text: pṛthivyāṃ yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca । teṣāṃ pitā tvaṃ mātā ca prabhuḥ prabhava eva ca ॥27॥

pṛthivyāṃ yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ।

text: etanno vismayakaraṃ praśaṃsa madhusūdana । tvamevārhasi kalyāṇa vaktuṃ vahnervinirgamam ॥28॥

html:
tato vigatasantrāsā vayamapyarikarśana ।
yacchrutaṃ yacca dṛṣṭaṃ nastatpravakṣyāmahe hare ॥29॥
slp1: tato vigatasantrAsA vayamapyarikarSana । yacCrutaM yacca dfzwaM nastatpravakzyAmahe hare ॥29॥

text: etattadvaiṣṇavaṃ tejo mama vaktrādviniḥsṛtam । kṛṣṇavartmā yugāntābho yenāyaṃ mathito giriḥ ॥30॥
html:
etattadvaiṣṇavaṃ tejo mama vaktrādviniḥsṛtam ।
kṛṣṇavartmā yugāntābho yenāyaṃ mathito giriḥ ॥30॥
slp1: etattadvEzRavaM tejo mama vaktrAdviniHsftam । kfzRavartmA yugAntABo yenAyaM maTito giriH ॥30॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: ṛṣayaścārtimāpannā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ । bhavanto vyathitāścāsandevakalpāstapodhanāḥ ॥31॥
html:
ṛṣayaścārtimāpannā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ ।
bhavanto vyathitāścāsandevakalpāstapodhanāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: fzayaScArtimApannA jitakroDA jitendriyAH । Bavanto vyaTitAScAsandevakalpAstapoDanAH ॥31॥

text: vratacaryāparītasya tapasvivratasevayā । mama vahniḥ samudbhūto na vai vyathitumarhatha ॥32॥
html:
vratacaryāparītasya tapasvivratasevayā ।
mama vahniḥ samudbhūto na vai vyathitumarhatha ॥32॥
slp1: vratacaryAparItasya tapasvivratasevayA । mama vahniH samudBUto na vE vyaTitumarhaTa ॥32॥

text: vrataṃ cartumihāyātastvahaṃ girimimaṃ śubham । putraṃ cātmasamaṃ vīrye tapasā sraṣṭumāgataḥ ॥33॥
html:
vrataṃ cartumihāyātastvahaṃ girimimaṃ śubham ।
putraṃ cātmasamaṃ vīrye tapasā sraṣṭumāgataḥ ॥33॥
slp1: vrataM cartumihAyAtastvahaM girimimaM SuBam । putraM cAtmasamaM vIrye tapasA srazwumAgataH ॥33॥

text: tato mamātmā yo dehe so'gnirbhūtvā viniḥsṛtaḥ । gataśca varadaṃ draṣṭuṃ sarvalokapitāmaham ॥34॥
html:
tato mamātmā yo dehe so'gnirbhūtvā viniḥsṛtaḥ ।
gataśca varadaṃ draṣṭuṃ sarvalokapitāmaham ॥34॥
slp1: tato mamAtmA yo dehe so'gnirBUtvA viniHsftaH । gataSca varadaM drazwuM sarvalokapitAmaham ॥34॥

text: tena cātmānuśiṣṭo me putratve munisattamāḥ । tejaso'rdhena putraste bhaviteti vṛṣadhvajaḥ ॥35॥
html:
tena cātmānuśiṣṭo me putratve munisattamāḥ ।
tejaso'rdhena putraste bhaviteti vṛṣadhvajaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: tena cAtmAnuSizwo me putratve munisattamAH । tejaso'rDena putraste Baviteti vfzaDvajaH ॥35॥

text: so'yaṃ vahnirupāgamya pādamūle mamāntikam । śiṣyavatparicaryātha śāntaḥ prakṛtimāgataḥ ॥36॥
html:
so'yaṃ vahnirupāgamya pādamūle mamāntikam ।
śiṣyavatparicaryātha śāntaḥ prakṛtimāgataḥ ॥36॥
slp1: so'yaM vahnirupAgamya pAdamUle mamAntikam । SizyavatparicaryATa SAntaH prakftimAgataH ॥36॥

text: etadasya rahasyaṃ vaḥ padmanābhasya dhīmataḥ । mayā premṇā samākhyātaṃ na bhīḥ kāryā tapodhanāḥ ॥37॥
html:
etadasya rahasyaṃ vaḥ padmanābhasya dhīmataḥ ।
mayā premṇā samākhyātaṃ na bhīḥ kāryā tapodhanāḥ ॥37॥
slp1: etadasya rahasyaM vaH padmanABasya DImataH । mayA premRA samAKyAtaM na BIH kAryA tapoDanAH ॥37॥

text: sarvatra gatiravyagrā bhavatāṃ dīrghadarśanāḥ । tapasvivratasandīptā jñānavijñānaśobhitāḥ ॥38॥
html:
sarvatra gatiravyagrā bhavatāṃ dīrghadarśanāḥ ।
tapasvivratasandīptā jñānavijñānaśobhitāḥ ॥38॥
slp1: sarvatra gatiravyagrA BavatAM dIrGadarSanAH । tapasvivratasandIptA jYAnavijYAnaSoBitAH ॥38॥

text: yacchrutaṃ yacca vo dṛṣṭaṃ divi vā yadi vā bhuvi । āścaryaṃ paramaṃ kiñcittadbhavanto bruvantu me ॥39॥
html:
yacchrutaṃ yacca vo dṛṣṭaṃ divi vā yadi vā bhuvi ।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ kiñcittadbhavanto bruvantu me ॥39॥
slp1: yacCrutaM yacca vo dfzwaM divi vA yadi vA Buvi । AScaryaM paramaM kiYcittadBavanto bruvantu me ॥39॥

text: tasyāmṛtanikāśasya vāṅmadhorasti me spṛhā । bhavadbhiḥ kathitasyeha tapovananivāsibhiḥ ॥40॥
html:
tasyāmṛtanikāśasya vāṅmadhorasti me spṛhā ।
bhavadbhiḥ kathitasyeha tapovananivāsibhiḥ ॥40॥
slp1: tasyAmftanikASasya vANmaDorasti me spfhA । BavadBiH kaTitasyeha tapovananivAsiBiH ॥40॥

text: yadyapyahamadṛṣṭaṃ vā divyamadbhutadarśanam । divi vā bhuvi vā kiñcitpaśyāmyamaladarśanāḥ ॥41॥
html:
yadyapyahamadṛṣṭaṃ vā divyamadbhutadarśanam ।
divi vā bhuvi vā kiñcitpaśyāmyamaladarśanāḥ ॥41॥
slp1: yadyapyahamadfzwaM vA divyamadButadarSanam । divi vA Buvi vA kiYcitpaSyAmyamaladarSanAH ॥41॥

text: prakṛtiḥ sā mama parā na kvacitpratihanyate । na cātmagatamaiśvaryamāścaryaṃ pratibhāti me ॥42॥
html:
prakṛtiḥ sā mama parā na kvacitpratihanyate ।
na cātmagatamaiśvaryamāścaryaṃ pratibhāti me ॥42॥
slp1: prakftiH sA mama parA na kvacitpratihanyate । na cAtmagatamESvaryamAScaryaM pratiBAti me ॥42॥

text: śraddheyaḥ kathito hyarthaḥ sajjanaśravaṇaṃ gataḥ । ciraṃ tiṣṭhati medinyāṃ śaile lekhyamivārpitam ॥43॥
html:
śraddheyaḥ kathito hyarthaḥ sajjanaśravaṇaṃ gataḥ ।
ciraṃ tiṣṭhati medinyāṃ śaile lekhyamivārpitam ॥43॥
slp1: SradDeyaH kaTito hyarTaH sajjanaSravaRaM gataH । ciraM tizWati medinyAM SEle leKyamivArpitam ॥43॥

text: tadahaṃ sajjanamukhānniḥsṛtaṃ tatsamāgame । kathayiṣyāmyaharaharbuddhidīpakaraṃ nṛṇām ॥44॥
html:
tadahaṃ sajjanamukhānniḥsṛtaṃ tatsamāgame ।
kathayiṣyāmyaharaharbuddhidīpakaraṃ nṛṇām ॥44॥
slp1: tadahaM sajjanamuKAnniHsftaM tatsamAgame । kaTayizyAmyaharaharbudDidIpakaraM nfRAm ॥44॥

text: tato munigaṇāḥ sarve praśritāḥ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau । netraiḥ padmadalaprakhyairapaśyanta janārdanam ॥45॥
html:
tato munigaṇāḥ sarve praśritāḥ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau ।
netraiḥ padmadalaprakhyairapaśyanta janārdanam ॥45॥
slp1: tato munigaRAH sarve praSritAH kfzRasaMniDO । netrEH padmadalapraKyErapaSyanta janArdanam ॥45॥

text: vardhayantastathaivānye pūjayantastathāpare । vāgbhirṛgbhūṣitārthābhiḥ stuvanto madhusūdanam ॥46॥
html:
vardhayantastathaivānye pūjayantastathāpare ।
vāgbhirṛgbhūṣitārthābhiḥ stuvanto madhusūdanam ॥46॥
slp1: varDayantastaTEvAnye pUjayantastaTApare । vAgBirfgBUzitArTABiH stuvanto maDusUdanam ॥46॥

text: tato munigaṇāḥ sarve nāradaṃ devadarśanam । tadā niyojayāmāsurvacane vākyakovidam ॥47॥
html:
tato munigaṇāḥ sarve nāradaṃ devadarśanam ।
tadā niyojayāmāsurvacane vākyakovidam ॥47॥
slp1: tato munigaRAH sarve nAradaM devadarSanam । tadA niyojayAmAsurvacane vAkyakovidam ॥47॥

text: yadāścaryamacintyaṃ ca girau himavati prabho । anubhūtaṃ munigaṇaistīrthayātrāparāyaṇaiḥ ॥48॥
html:
yadāścaryamacintyaṃ ca girau himavati prabho ।
anubhūtaṃ munigaṇaistīrthayātrāparāyaṇaiḥ ॥48॥
slp1: yadAScaryamacintyaM ca girO himavati praBo । anuBUtaM munigaREstIrTayAtrAparAyaREH ॥48॥

text: tadbhavānṛṣisaṅghasya hitārthaṃ sarvacoditaḥ । yathādṛṣṭaṃ hṛṣīkeśe sarvamākhyātumarhati ॥49॥
html:
tadbhavānṛṣisaṅghasya hitārthaṃ sarvacoditaḥ ।
yathādṛṣṭaṃ hṛṣīkeśe sarvamākhyātumarhati ॥49॥
slp1: tadBavAnfzisaNGasya hitArTaM sarvacoditaH । yaTAdfzwaM hfzIkeSe sarvamAKyAtumarhati ॥49॥

text: evamuktaḥ sa munibhirnārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ । kathayāmāsa devarṣiḥ pūrvavṛttāṃ kathāṃ śubhām] ॥50॥
html:
evamuktaḥ sa munibhirnārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।
kathayāmāsa devarṣiḥ pūrvavṛttāṃ kathāṃ śubhām] ॥50॥
slp1: evamuktaH sa muniBirnArado BagavAnfziH । kaTayAmAsa devarziH pUrvavfttAM kaTAM SuBAm] ॥50॥

text: tato nārāyaṇasuhṛnnārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ । śaṅkarasyomayā sārdhaṃ saṃvādaṃ pratyabhāṣata ॥1॥
html:
tato nārāyaṇasuhṛnnārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।
śaṅkarasyomayā sārdhaṃ saṃvādaṃ pratyabhāṣata ॥1॥
slp1: tato nArAyaRasuhfnnArado BagavAnfziH । SaNkarasyomayA sArDaM saMvAdaM pratyaBAzata ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tapaścacāra dharmātmā vṛṣabhāṅkaḥ sureśvaraḥ । puṇye girau himavati siddhacāraṇasevite ॥2॥
html:
tapaścacāra dharmātmā vṛṣabhāṅkaḥ sureśvaraḥ ।
puṇye girau himavati siddhacāraṇasevite ॥2॥
slp1: tapaScacAra DarmAtmA vfzaBANkaH sureSvaraH । puRye girO himavati sidDacAraRasevite ॥2॥

text: nānauṣadhiyute ramye nānāpuṣpasamākule । apsarogaṇasaṅkīrṇe bhūtasaṅghaniṣevite ॥3॥
html:
nānauṣadhiyute ramye nānāpuṣpasamākule ।
apsarogaṇasaṅkīrṇe bhūtasaṅghaniṣevite ॥3॥
slp1: nAnOzaDiyute ramye nAnApuzpasamAkule । apsarogaRasaNkIrRe BUtasaNGanizevite ॥3॥

text: tatra devo mudā yukto bhūtasaṅghaśatairvṛtaḥ । nānārūpairvirūpaiśca divyairadbhutadarśanaiḥ ॥4॥
html:
tatra devo mudā yukto bhūtasaṅghaśatairvṛtaḥ ।
nānārūpairvirūpaiśca divyairadbhutadarśanaiḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tatra devo mudA yukto BUtasaNGaSatErvftaH । nAnArUpErvirUpESca divyEradButadarSanEH ॥4॥

text: siṃhavyāghragajaprakhyaiḥ sarvajātisamanvitaiḥ । kroṣṭukadvīpivadanairṛkṣarṣabhamukhaistathā ॥5॥
html:
siṃhavyāghragajaprakhyaiḥ sarvajātisamanvitaiḥ ।
kroṣṭukadvīpivadanairṛkṣarṣabhamukhaistathā ॥5॥
slp1: siMhavyAGragajapraKyEH sarvajAtisamanvitEH । krozwukadvIpivadanErfkzarzaBamuKEstaTA ॥5॥

text: ulūkavadanairbhīmaiḥ śyenabhāsamukhaistathā । nānāvarṇamṛgaprakhyaiḥ sarvajātisamanvayaiḥ । kinnarairdevagandharvairyakṣabhūtagaṇaistathā ॥6॥
html:
ulūkavadanairbhīmaiḥ śyenabhāsamukhaistathā ।
nānāvarṇamṛgaprakhyaiḥ sarvajātisamanvayaiḥ ।
kinnarairdevagandharvairyakṣabhūtagaṇaistathā ॥6॥
slp1: ulUkavadanErBImEH SyenaBAsamuKEstaTA । nAnAvarRamfgapraKyEH sarvajAtisamanvayEH । kinnarErdevaganDarvEryakzaBUtagaREstaTA ॥6॥

text: divyapuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣitam । divyacandanasaṃyuktaṃ divyadhūpena dhūpitam । tatsado vṛṣabhāṅkasya divyavāditranāditam ॥7॥
html:
divyapuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣitam ।
divyacandanasaṃyuktaṃ divyadhūpena dhūpitam ।
tatsado vṛṣabhāṅkasya divyavāditranāditam ॥7॥
slp1: divyapuzpasamAkIrRaM divyamAlAviBUzitam । divyacandanasaMyuktaM divyaDUpena DUpitam । tatsado vfzaBANkasya divyavAditranAditam ॥7॥

text: mṛdaṅgapaṇavodghuṣṭaṃ śaṅkhabherīnināditam । nṛtyadbhirbhūtasaṅghaiśca barhiṇaiśca samantataḥ ॥8॥
html:
mṛdaṅgapaṇavodghuṣṭaṃ śaṅkhabherīnināditam ।
nṛtyadbhirbhūtasaṅghaiśca barhiṇaiśca samantataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: mfdaNgapaRavodGuzwaM SaNKaBerIninAditam । nftyadBirBUtasaNGESca barhiRESca samantataH ॥8॥

text: pranṛttāpsarasaṃ divyaṃ divyastrīgaṇasevitam । dṛṣṭikāntamanirdeśyaṃ divyamadbhutadarśanam ॥9॥
html:
pranṛttāpsarasaṃ divyaṃ divyastrīgaṇasevitam ।
dṛṣṭikāntamanirdeśyaṃ divyamadbhutadarśanam ॥9॥
slp1: pranfttApsarasaM divyaM divyastrIgaRasevitam । dfzwikAntamanirdeSyaM divyamadButadarSanam ॥9॥

text: sa giristapasā tasya bhūteśasya vyarocata ॥10॥
html: sa giristapasā tasya bhūteśasya vyarocata ॥10॥
slp1: sa giristapasA tasya BUteSasya vyarocata ॥10॥

text: svādhyāyaparamairviprairbrahmaghoṣairvināditaḥ । ṣaṭpadairupagītaiśca mādhavāpratimo giriḥ ॥11॥
html:
svādhyāyaparamairviprairbrahmaghoṣairvināditaḥ ।
ṣaṭpadairupagītaiśca mādhavāpratimo giriḥ ॥11॥
slp1: svADyAyaparamErviprErbrahmaGozErvinAditaH । zawpadErupagItESca mADavApratimo giriH ॥11॥

text: taṃ mahotsavasaṅkāśaṃ bhīmarūpadharaṃ punaḥ । dṛṣṭvā munigaṇasyāsītparā prītirjanārdana ॥12॥
html:
taṃ mahotsavasaṅkāśaṃ bhīmarūpadharaṃ punaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā munigaṇasyāsītparā prītirjanārdana ॥12॥
slp1: taM mahotsavasaNkASaM BImarUpaDaraM punaH । dfzwvA munigaRasyAsItparA prItirjanArdana ॥12॥

text: munayaśca mahābhāgāḥ siddhāścaivordhvaretasaḥ । maruto vasavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥13॥
html:
munayaśca mahābhāgāḥ siddhāścaivordhvaretasaḥ ।
maruto vasavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: munayaSca mahABAgAH sidDAScEvorDvaretasaH । maruto vasavaH sADyA viSvedevAH sanAtanAH ॥13॥

text: yakṣā nāgāḥ piśācāśca lokapālā hutāśanāḥ । bhāvāśca sarve nyagbhūtāstatraivāsansamāgatāḥ ॥14॥
html:
yakṣā nāgāḥ piśācāśca lokapālā hutāśanāḥ ।
bhāvāśca sarve nyagbhūtāstatraivāsansamāgatāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: yakzA nAgAH piSAcASca lokapAlA hutASanAH । BAvASca sarve nyagBUtAstatrEvAsansamAgatAH ॥14॥

text: ṛtavaḥ sarvapuṣpaiśca vyakiranta mahādbhutaiḥ । oṣadhyo jvalamānāśca dyotayanti sma tadvanam ॥15॥
html:
ṛtavaḥ sarvapuṣpaiśca vyakiranta mahādbhutaiḥ ।
oṣadhyo jvalamānāśca dyotayanti sma tadvanam ॥15॥
slp1: ftavaH sarvapuzpESca vyakiranta mahAdButEH । ozaDyo jvalamAnASca dyotayanti sma tadvanam ॥15॥

text: vihagāśca mudā yuktāḥ prānṛtyanvyanadaṃśca ha । giripṛṣṭheṣu ramyeṣu vyāharanto janapriyāḥ ॥16॥
html:
vihagāśca mudā yuktāḥ prānṛtyanvyanadaṃśca ha ।
giripṛṣṭheṣu ramyeṣu vyāharanto janapriyāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: vihagASca mudA yuktAH prAnftyanvyanadaMSca ha । giripfzWezu ramyezu vyAharanto janapriyAH ॥16॥

text: tatra devo giritaṭe divyadhātuvibhūṣite । paryaṅka iva vibhrājannupaviṣṭo mahāmanāḥ ॥17॥
html:
tatra devo giritaṭe divyadhātuvibhūṣite ।
paryaṅka iva vibhrājannupaviṣṭo mahāmanāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: tatra devo giritawe divyaDAtuviBUzite । paryaNka iva viBrAjannupavizwo mahAmanAH ॥17॥

text: vyāghracarmāmbaradharaḥ siṃhacarmottaracchadaḥ । vyālayajñopavītī ca lohitāṅgadabhūṣaṇaḥ ॥18॥
html:
vyāghracarmāmbaradharaḥ siṃhacarmottaracchadaḥ ।
vyālayajñopavītī ca lohitāṅgadabhūṣaṇaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: vyAGracarmAmbaraDaraH siMhacarmottaracCadaH । vyAlayajYopavItI ca lohitANgadaBUzaRaH ॥18॥

text: hariśmaśrurjaṭī bhīmo bhayakartā suradviṣām । abhayaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhaktānāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ॥19॥
html:
hariśmaśrurjaṭī bhīmo bhayakartā suradviṣām ।
abhayaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhaktānāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: hariSmaSrurjawI BImo BayakartA suradvizAm । aBayaH sarvaBUtAnAM BaktAnAM vfzaBaDvajaH ॥19॥

text: dṛṣṭvā tamṛṣayaḥ sarve śirobhiravanīṃ gatāḥ । vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ kṣāntā vigatakalmaṣāḥ ॥20॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā tamṛṣayaḥ sarve śirobhiravanīṃ gatāḥ ।
vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ kṣāntā vigatakalmaṣāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: dfzwvA tamfzayaH sarve SiroBiravanIM gatAH । vimuktAH sarvapApeByaH kzAntA vigatakalmazAH ॥20॥

text: tasya bhūtapateḥ sthānaṃ bhīmarūpadharaṃ babhau । apradhṛṣyataraṃ caiva mahoragasamākulam ॥21॥
html:
tasya bhūtapateḥ sthānaṃ bhīmarūpadharaṃ babhau ।
apradhṛṣyataraṃ caiva mahoragasamākulam ॥21॥
slp1: tasya BUtapateH sTAnaM BImarUpaDaraM baBO । apraDfzyataraM cEva mahoragasamAkulam ॥21॥

text: kṣaṇenaivābhavatsarvamadbhutaṃ madhusūdana । tatsado vṛṣabhāṅkasya bhīmarūpadharaṃ babhau ॥22॥
html:
kṣaṇenaivābhavatsarvamadbhutaṃ madhusūdana ।
tatsado vṛṣabhāṅkasya bhīmarūpadharaṃ babhau ॥22॥
slp1: kzaRenEvABavatsarvamadButaM maDusUdana । tatsado vfzaBANkasya BImarUpaDaraM baBO ॥22॥

text: tamabhyayācchailasutā bhūtastrīgaṇasaṃvṛtā । haratulyāmbaradharā samānavratacāriṇī ॥23॥
html:
tamabhyayācchailasutā bhūtastrīgaṇasaṃvṛtā ।
haratulyāmbaradharā samānavratacāriṇī ॥23॥
slp1: tamaByayAcCElasutA BUtastrIgaRasaMvftA । haratulyAmbaraDarA samAnavratacAriRI ॥23॥

text: bibhratī kalaśaṃ raukmaṃ sarvatīrthajalodbhavam । girisravābhiḥ puṇyābhiḥ sarvato'nugatā śubhā ॥24॥
html:
bibhratī kalaśaṃ raukmaṃ sarvatīrthajalodbhavam ।
girisravābhiḥ puṇyābhiḥ sarvato'nugatā śubhā ॥24॥
slp1: biBratI kalaSaM rOkmaM sarvatIrTajalodBavam । girisravABiH puRyABiH sarvato'nugatA SuBA ॥24॥

text: puṣpavṛṣṭyābhivarṣantī gandhairbahuvidhaistathā । sevantī himavatpārśvaṃ harapārśvamupāgamat ॥25॥
html:
puṣpavṛṣṭyābhivarṣantī gandhairbahuvidhaistathā ।
sevantī himavatpārśvaṃ harapārśvamupāgamat ॥25॥
slp1: puzpavfzwyABivarzantI ganDErbahuviDEstaTA । sevantI himavatpArSvaM harapArSvamupAgamat ॥25॥

text: tataḥ smayantī pāṇibhyāṃ narmārthaṃ cārudarśanā । haranetre śubhe devī sahasā sā samāvṛṇot ॥26॥
html:
tataḥ smayantī pāṇibhyāṃ narmārthaṃ cārudarśanā ।
haranetre śubhe devī sahasā sā samāvṛṇot ॥26॥
slp1: tataH smayantI pARiByAM narmArTaM cArudarSanA । haranetre SuBe devI sahasA sA samAvfRot ॥26॥

text: saṃvṛtābhyāṃ tu netrābhyāṃ tamobhūtamacetanam । nirhomaṃ nirvaṣaṭkāraṃ tatsadaḥ sahasābhavat ॥27॥
html:
saṃvṛtābhyāṃ tu netrābhyāṃ tamobhūtamacetanam ।
nirhomaṃ nirvaṣaṭkāraṃ tatsadaḥ sahasābhavat ॥27॥
slp1: saMvftAByAM tu netrAByAM tamoBUtamacetanam । nirhomaM nirvazawkAraM tatsadaH sahasABavat ॥27॥

text: janaśca vimanāḥ sarvo bhayatrāsasamanvitaḥ । nimīlite bhūtapatau naṣṭasūrya ivābhavat ॥28॥
html:
janaśca vimanāḥ sarvo bhayatrāsasamanvitaḥ ।
nimīlite bhūtapatau naṣṭasūrya ivābhavat ॥28॥
slp1: janaSca vimanAH sarvo BayatrAsasamanvitaH । nimIlite BUtapatO nazwasUrya ivABavat ॥28॥

text: tato vitimiro lokaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata । jvālā ca mahatī dīptā lalāṭāttasya niḥsṛtā ॥29॥
html:
tato vitimiro lokaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata ।
jvālā ca mahatī dīptā lalāṭāttasya niḥsṛtā ॥29॥
slp1: tato vitimiro lokaH kzaRena samapadyata । jvAlA ca mahatI dIptA lalAwAttasya niHsftA ॥29॥

text: tṛtīyaṃ cāsya sambhūtaṃ netramādityasaṃnibham । yugāntasadṛśaṃ dīptaṃ yenāsau mathito giriḥ ॥30॥
html:
tṛtīyaṃ cāsya sambhūtaṃ netramādityasaṃnibham ।
yugāntasadṛśaṃ dīptaṃ yenāsau mathito giriḥ ॥30॥
slp1: tftIyaM cAsya samBUtaM netramAdityasaMniBam । yugAntasadfSaM dIptaM yenAsO maTito giriH ॥30॥

text: tato girisutā dṛṣṭvā dīptāgnisadṛśekṣaṇam । haraṃ praṇamya śirasā dadarśāyatalocanā ॥31॥
html:
tato girisutā dṛṣṭvā dīptāgnisadṛśekṣaṇam ।
haraṃ praṇamya śirasā dadarśāyatalocanā ॥31॥
slp1: tato girisutA dfzwvA dIptAgnisadfSekzaRam । haraM praRamya SirasA dadarSAyatalocanA ॥31॥

text: dahyamāne vane tasminsaśālasaraladrume । sacandanavane ramye divyauṣadhividīpite ॥32॥
html:
dahyamāne vane tasminsaśālasaraladrume ।
sacandanavane ramye divyauṣadhividīpite ॥32॥
slp1: dahyamAne vane tasminsaSAlasaraladrume । sacandanavane ramye divyOzaDividIpite ॥32॥

text: mṛgayūthairdrutairbhītairharapārśvamupāgataiḥ । śaraṇaṃ cāpyavindadbhistatsadaḥ saṅkulaṃ babhau ॥33॥
html:
mṛgayūthairdrutairbhītairharapārśvamupāgataiḥ ।
śaraṇaṃ cāpyavindadbhistatsadaḥ saṅkulaṃ babhau ॥33॥
slp1: mfgayUTErdrutErBItErharapArSvamupAgatEH । SaraRaM cApyavindadBistatsadaH saNkulaM baBO ॥33॥

text: tato nabhaḥspṛśajvālo vidyullolārcirujjvalaḥ । dvādaśādityasadṛśo yugāntāgnirivāparaḥ ॥34॥
html:
tato nabhaḥspṛśajvālo vidyullolārcirujjvalaḥ ।
dvādaśādityasadṛśo yugāntāgnirivāparaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: tato naBaHspfSajvAlo vidyullolArcirujjvalaH । dvAdaSAdityasadfSo yugAntAgnirivAparaH ॥34॥

text: kṣaṇena tena dagdhaḥ sa himavānabhavannagaḥ । sadhātuśikharābhogo dīnadagdhavanauṣadhiḥ ॥35॥
html:
kṣaṇena tena dagdhaḥ sa himavānabhavannagaḥ ।
sadhātuśikharābhogo dīnadagdhavanauṣadhiḥ ॥35॥
slp1: kzaRena tena dagDaH sa himavAnaBavannagaH । saDAtuSiKarABogo dInadagDavanOzaDiH ॥35॥

text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā mathitaṃ śailaṃ śailarājasutā tataḥ । bhagavantaṃ prapannā sā sāñjalipragrahā sthitā ॥36॥
html:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mathitaṃ śailaṃ śailarājasutā tataḥ ।
bhagavantaṃ prapannā sā sāñjalipragrahā sthitā ॥36॥
slp1: taM dfzwvA maTitaM SElaM SElarAjasutA tataH । BagavantaM prapannA sA sAYjalipragrahA sTitA ॥36॥

text: umāṃ śarvastadā dṛṣṭvā strībhāvāgatamārdavām । piturdainyamanicchantīṃ prītyāpaśyattato girim ॥37॥
html:
umāṃ śarvastadā dṛṣṭvā strībhāvāgatamārdavām ।
piturdainyamanicchantīṃ prītyāpaśyattato girim ॥37॥
slp1: umAM SarvastadA dfzwvA strIBAvAgatamArdavAm । piturdEnyamanicCantIM prItyApaSyattato girim ॥37॥

text: tato'bhavatpunaḥ sarvaḥ prakṛtisthaḥ sudarśanaḥ । prahṛṣṭavihagaścaiva prapuṣpitavanadrumaḥ ॥38॥
html:
tato'bhavatpunaḥ sarvaḥ prakṛtisthaḥ sudarśanaḥ ।
prahṛṣṭavihagaścaiva prapuṣpitavanadrumaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: tato'BavatpunaH sarvaH prakftisTaH sudarSanaH । prahfzwavihagaScEva prapuzpitavanadrumaH ॥38॥

text: prakṛtisthaṃ giriṃ dṛṣṭvā prītā devī maheśvaram । uvāca sarvabhūtānāṃ patiṃ patimaninditā ॥39॥
html:
prakṛtisthaṃ giriṃ dṛṣṭvā prītā devī maheśvaram ।
uvāca sarvabhūtānāṃ patiṃ patimaninditā ॥39॥
slp1: prakftisTaM giriM dfzwvA prItA devI maheSvaram । uvAca sarvaBUtAnAM patiM patimaninditA ॥39॥

text: bhagavansarvabhūteśa śūlapāṇe mahāvrata । saṃśayo me mahāñjātastaṃ me vyākhyātumarhasi ॥40॥
html:
bhagavansarvabhūteśa śūlapāṇe mahāvrata ।
saṃśayo me mahāñjātastaṃ me vyākhyātumarhasi ॥40॥
slp1: BagavansarvaBUteSa SUlapARe mahAvrata । saMSayo me mahAYjAtastaM me vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥40॥

text: kimarthaṃ te lalāṭe vai tṛtīyaṃ netramutthitam । kimarthaṃ ca girirdagdhaḥ sapakṣigaṇakānanaḥ ॥41॥
html:
kimarthaṃ te lalāṭe vai tṛtīyaṃ netramutthitam ।
kimarthaṃ ca girirdagdhaḥ sapakṣigaṇakānanaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: kimarTaM te lalAwe vE tftIyaM netramutTitam । kimarTaM ca girirdagDaH sapakzigaRakAnanaH ॥41॥

text: kimarthaṃ ca punardeva prakṛtisthaḥ kṣaṇātkṛtaḥ । tathaiva drumasañchannaḥ kṛto'yaṃ te maheśvara ॥42॥
html:
kimarthaṃ ca punardeva prakṛtisthaḥ kṣaṇātkṛtaḥ ।
tathaiva drumasañchannaḥ kṛto'yaṃ te maheśvara ॥42॥
slp1: kimarTaM ca punardeva prakftisTaH kzaRAtkftaH । taTEva drumasaYCannaH kfto'yaM te maheSvara ॥42॥

text: netre me saṃvṛte devi tvayā bālyādanindite । naṣṭālokastato lokaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata ॥43॥
html:
netre me saṃvṛte devi tvayā bālyādanindite ।
naṣṭālokastato lokaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata ॥43॥
slp1: netre me saMvfte devi tvayA bAlyAdanindite । nazwAlokastato lokaH kzaRena samapadyata ॥43॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: naṣṭāditye tathā loke tamobhūte nagātmaje । tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ dīptaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ te rakṣatā prajāḥ ॥44॥
html:
naṣṭāditye tathā loke tamobhūte nagātmaje ।
tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ dīptaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ te rakṣatā prajāḥ ॥44॥
slp1: nazwAditye taTA loke tamoBUte nagAtmaje । tftIyaM locanaM dIptaM sfzwaM te rakzatA prajAH ॥44॥

text: tasya cākṣṇo mahattejo yenāyaṃ mathito giriḥ । tvatpriyārthaṃ ca me devi prakṛtisthaḥ kṣaṇātkṛtaḥ ॥45॥
html:
tasya cākṣṇo mahattejo yenāyaṃ mathito giriḥ ।
tvatpriyārthaṃ ca me devi prakṛtisthaḥ kṣaṇātkṛtaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: tasya cAkzRo mahattejo yenAyaM maTito giriH । tvatpriyArTaM ca me devi prakftisTaH kzaRAtkftaH ॥45॥

text: bhagavankena te vaktraṃ candravatpriyadarśanam । pūrvaṃ tathaiva śrīkāntamuttaraṃ paścimaṃ tathā ॥46॥
html:
bhagavankena te vaktraṃ candravatpriyadarśanam ।
pūrvaṃ tathaiva śrīkāntamuttaraṃ paścimaṃ tathā ॥46॥
slp1: Bagavankena te vaktraM candravatpriyadarSanam । pUrvaM taTEva SrIkAntamuttaraM paScimaM taTA ॥46॥
author: umovāca ।

text: dakṣiṇaṃ ca mukhaṃ raudraṃ kenordhvaṃ kapilā jaṭāḥ । kena kaṇṭhaśca te nīlo barhibarhanibhaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥47॥
html:
dakṣiṇaṃ ca mukhaṃ raudraṃ kenordhvaṃ kapilā jaṭāḥ ।
kena kaṇṭhaśca te nīlo barhibarhanibhaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: dakziRaM ca muKaM rOdraM kenorDvaM kapilA jawAH । kena kaRWaSca te nIlo barhibarhaniBaH kftaH ॥47॥

text: haste caitatpinākaṃ te satataṃ kena tiṣṭhati । jaṭilo brahmacārī ca kimarthamasi nityadā ॥48॥
html:
haste caitatpinākaṃ te satataṃ kena tiṣṭhati ।
jaṭilo brahmacārī ca kimarthamasi nityadā ॥48॥
slp1: haste cEtatpinAkaM te satataM kena tizWati । jawilo brahmacArI ca kimarTamasi nityadA ॥48॥

text: etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ sarvaṃ vada bhūtapate'nagha । sadharmacāriṇī cāhaṃ bhaktā ceti vṛṣadhvaja ॥49॥
html:
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ sarvaṃ vada bhūtapate'nagha ।
sadharmacāriṇī cāhaṃ bhaktā ceti vṛṣadhvaja ॥49॥
slp1: etaM me saMSayaM sarvaM vada BUtapate'naGa । saDarmacAriRI cAhaM BaktA ceti vfzaDvaja ॥49॥

text: evamuktaḥ sa bhagavāñśailaputryā pinākadhṛk । tasyā vṛttyā ca buddhyā ca prītimānabhavatprabhuḥ ॥50॥
html:
evamuktaḥ sa bhagavāñśailaputryā pinākadhṛk ।
tasyā vṛttyā ca buddhyā ca prītimānabhavatprabhuḥ ॥50॥
slp1: evamuktaH sa BagavAYSElaputryA pinAkaDfk । tasyA vfttyA ca budDyA ca prItimAnaBavatpraBuH ॥50॥

text: tatastāmabravīddevaḥ subhage śrūyatāmiti । hetubhiryairmamaitāni rūpāṇi rucirānane] ॥51॥
html:
tatastāmabravīddevaḥ subhage śrūyatāmiti ।
hetubhiryairmamaitāni rūpāṇi rucirānane] ॥51॥
slp1: tatastAmabravIddevaH suBage SrUyatAmiti । hetuBiryErmamEtAni rUpARi rucirAnane] ॥51॥

text: tilottamā nāma purā brahmaṇā yoṣiduttamā । tilaṃ tilaṃ samuddhṛtya ratnānāṃ nirmitā śubhā ॥1॥
html:
tilottamā nāma purā brahmaṇā yoṣiduttamā ।
tilaṃ tilaṃ samuddhṛtya ratnānāṃ nirmitā śubhā ॥1॥
slp1: tilottamA nAma purA brahmaRA yoziduttamA । tilaM tilaM samudDftya ratnAnAM nirmitA SuBA ॥1॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: sābhyagacchata māṃ devi rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi । pradakṣiṇaṃ lobhayantī māṃ śubhe rucirānanā ॥2॥
html:
sābhyagacchata māṃ devi rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ lobhayantī māṃ śubhe rucirānanā ॥2॥
slp1: sAByagacCata mAM devi rUpeRApratimA Buvi । pradakziRaM loBayantI mAM SuBe rucirAnanA ॥2॥

text: yato yataḥ sā sudatī māmupādhāvadantike । tatastato mukhaṃ cāru mama devi vinirgatam ॥3॥
html:
yato yataḥ sā sudatī māmupādhāvadantike ।
tatastato mukhaṃ cāru mama devi vinirgatam ॥3॥
slp1: yato yataH sA sudatI mAmupADAvadantike । tatastato muKaM cAru mama devi vinirgatam ॥3॥

text: tāṃ didṛkṣurahaṃ yogāccaturmūrtitvamāgataḥ । caturmukhaśca saṃvṛtto darśayanyogamātmanaḥ ॥4॥
html:
tāṃ didṛkṣurahaṃ yogāccaturmūrtitvamāgataḥ ।
caturmukhaśca saṃvṛtto darśayanyogamātmanaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tAM didfkzurahaM yogAccaturmUrtitvamAgataH । caturmuKaSca saMvftto darSayanyogamAtmanaH ॥4॥

text: pūrveṇa vadanenāhamindratvamanuśāsmi ha । uttareṇa tvayā sārdhaṃ ramāmyahamanindite ॥5॥
html:
pūrveṇa vadanenāhamindratvamanuśāsmi ha ।
uttareṇa tvayā sārdhaṃ ramāmyahamanindite ॥5॥
slp1: pUrveRa vadanenAhamindratvamanuSAsmi ha । uttareRa tvayA sArDaM ramAmyahamanindite ॥5॥

text: paścimaṃ me mukhaṃ saumyaṃ sarvaprāṇisukhāvaham । dakṣiṇaṃ bhīmasaṅkāśaṃ raudraṃ saṃharati prajāḥ ॥6॥
html:
paścimaṃ me mukhaṃ saumyaṃ sarvaprāṇisukhāvaham ।
dakṣiṇaṃ bhīmasaṅkāśaṃ raudraṃ saṃharati prajāḥ ॥6॥
slp1: paScimaM me muKaM sOmyaM sarvaprARisuKAvaham । dakziRaM BImasaNkASaM rOdraM saMharati prajAH ॥6॥

text: jaṭilo brahmacārī ca lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā । devakāryārthasiddhyarthaṃ pinākaṃ me kare sthitam ॥7॥
html:
jaṭilo brahmacārī ca lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।
devakāryārthasiddhyarthaṃ pinākaṃ me kare sthitam ॥7॥
slp1: jawilo brahmacArI ca lokAnAM hitakAmyayA । devakAryArTasidDyarTaM pinAkaM me kare sTitam ॥7॥

text: indreṇa ca purā vajraṃ kṣiptaṃ śrīkāṅkṣiṇā mama । dagdhvā kaṇṭhaṃ tu tadyātaṃ tena śrīkaṇṭhatā mama ॥8॥
html:
indreṇa ca purā vajraṃ kṣiptaṃ śrīkāṅkṣiṇā mama ।
dagdhvā kaṇṭhaṃ tu tadyātaṃ tena śrīkaṇṭhatā mama ॥8॥
slp1: indreRa ca purA vajraM kziptaM SrIkANkziRA mama । dagDvA kaRWaM tu tadyAtaM tena SrIkaRWatA mama ॥8॥

text: vāhaneṣu prabhūteṣu śrīmatsvanyeṣu satsu te । kathaṃ govṛṣabho deva vāhanatvamupāgataḥ ॥9॥
html:
vāhaneṣu prabhūteṣu śrīmatsvanyeṣu satsu te ।
kathaṃ govṛṣabho deva vāhanatvamupāgataḥ ॥9॥
slp1: vAhanezu praBUtezu SrImatsvanyezu satsu te । kaTaM govfzaBo deva vAhanatvamupAgataH ॥9॥
author: umovāca ।

text: surabhīṃ sasṛje brahmāmṛtadhenuṃ payomucam । sā sṛṣṭā bahudhā jātā kṣaramāṇā payo'mṛtam ॥10॥
html:
surabhīṃ sasṛje brahmāmṛtadhenuṃ payomucam ।
sā sṛṣṭā bahudhā jātā kṣaramāṇā payo'mṛtam ॥10॥
slp1: suraBIM sasfje brahmAmftaDenuM payomucam । sA sfzwA bahuDA jAtA kzaramARA payo'mftam ॥10॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: tasyā vatsamukhotsṛṣṭaḥ pheno madgātramāgataḥ । tato dagdhā mayā gāvo nānāvarṇatvamāgatāḥ ॥11॥
html:
tasyā vatsamukhotsṛṣṭaḥ pheno madgātramāgataḥ ।
tato dagdhā mayā gāvo nānāvarṇatvamāgatāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: tasyA vatsamuKotsfzwaH Peno madgAtramAgataH । tato dagDA mayA gAvo nAnAvarRatvamAgatAH ॥11॥

text: tato'haṃ lokaguruṇā śamaṃ nīto'rthavedinā । vṛṣaṃ cemaṃ dhvajārthaṃ me dadau vāhanameva ca ॥12॥
html:
tato'haṃ lokaguruṇā śamaṃ nīto'rthavedinā ।
vṛṣaṃ cemaṃ dhvajārthaṃ me dadau vāhanameva ca ॥12॥
slp1: tato'haM lokaguruRA SamaM nIto'rTavedinA । vfzaM cemaM DvajArTaM me dadO vAhanameva ca ॥12॥

text: nivāsā bahurūpāste viśvarūpaguṇānvitāḥ । tāṃśca santyajya bhagavañśmaśāne ramase katham ॥13॥
html:
nivāsā bahurūpāste viśvarūpaguṇānvitāḥ ।
tāṃśca santyajya bhagavañśmaśāne ramase katham ॥13॥
slp1: nivAsA bahurUpAste viSvarUpaguRAnvitAH । tAMSca santyajya BagavaYSmaSAne ramase kaTam ॥13॥
author: umovāca ।

text: keśāsthikalile bhīme kapālaghaṭasaṅkule । gṛdhragomāyukalile citāgniśatasaṅkule ॥14॥
html:
keśāsthikalile bhīme kapālaghaṭasaṅkule ।
gṛdhragomāyukalile citāgniśatasaṅkule ॥14॥
slp1: keSAsTikalile BIme kapAlaGawasaNkule । gfDragomAyukalile citAgniSatasaNkule ॥14॥

text: aśucau māṃsakalile vasāśoṇitakardame । vinikīrṇāmiṣacaye śivānādavinādite ॥15॥
html:
aśucau māṃsakalile vasāśoṇitakardame ।
vinikīrṇāmiṣacaye śivānādavinādite ॥15॥
slp1: aSucO mAMsakalile vasASoRitakardame । vinikIrRAmizacaye SivAnAdavinAdite ॥15॥

text: medhyānveṣī mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ vicarāmi niśāsvaham । na ca medhyataraṃ kiñcicchmaśānādiha vidyate ॥16॥
html:
medhyānveṣī mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ vicarāmi niśāsvaham ।
na ca medhyataraṃ kiñcicchmaśānādiha vidyate ॥16॥
slp1: meDyAnvezI mahIM kftsnAM vicarAmi niSAsvaham । na ca meDyataraM kiYcicCmaSAnAdiha vidyate ॥16॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: tena me sarvavāsānāṃ śmaśāne ramate manaḥ । nyagrodhaśākhāsañchanne nirbhuktasragvibhūṣite ॥17॥
html:
tena me sarvavāsānāṃ śmaśāne ramate manaḥ ।
nyagrodhaśākhāsañchanne nirbhuktasragvibhūṣite ॥17॥
slp1: tena me sarvavAsAnAM SmaSAne ramate manaH । nyagroDaSAKAsaYCanne nirBuktasragviBUzite ॥17॥

text: tatra caiva ramante me bhūtasaṅghāḥ śubhānane । na ca bhūtagaṇairdevi vināhaṃ vastumutsahe ॥18॥
html:
tatra caiva ramante me bhūtasaṅghāḥ śubhānane ।
na ca bhūtagaṇairdevi vināhaṃ vastumutsahe ॥18॥
slp1: tatra cEva ramante me BUtasaNGAH SuBAnane । na ca BUtagaRErdevi vinAhaM vastumutsahe ॥18॥

text: eṣa vāso hi me medhyaḥ svargīyaśca mato hi me । puṇyaḥ paramakaścaiva medhyakāmairupāsyate ॥19॥
html:
eṣa vāso hi me medhyaḥ svargīyaśca mato hi me ।
puṇyaḥ paramakaścaiva medhyakāmairupāsyate ॥19॥
slp1: eza vAso hi me meDyaH svargIyaSca mato hi me । puRyaH paramakaScEva meDyakAmErupAsyate ॥19॥

text: bhagavansarvabhūteśa sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara । pinākapāṇe varada saṃśayo me mahānayam ॥20॥
html:
bhagavansarvabhūteśa sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara ।
pinākapāṇe varada saṃśayo me mahānayam ॥20॥
slp1: BagavansarvaBUteSa sarvaDarmaBftAM vara । pinAkapARe varada saMSayo me mahAnayam ॥20॥
author: umovāca ।

text: ayaṃ munigaṇaḥ sarvastapastapa iti prabho । taponveṣakaro loke bhramate vividhākṛtiḥ ॥21॥
html:
ayaṃ munigaṇaḥ sarvastapastapa iti prabho ।
taponveṣakaro loke bhramate vividhākṛtiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: ayaM munigaRaH sarvastapastapa iti praBo । taponvezakaro loke Bramate viviDAkftiH ॥21॥

text: asya caivarṣisaṅghasya mama ca priyakāmyayā । etaṃ mameha sandehaṃ vaktumarhasyarindama ॥22॥
html:
asya caivarṣisaṅghasya mama ca priyakāmyayā ।
etaṃ mameha sandehaṃ vaktumarhasyarindama ॥22॥
slp1: asya cEvarzisaNGasya mama ca priyakAmyayA । etaM mameha sandehaM vaktumarhasyarindama ॥22॥

text: dharmaḥ kiṃlakṣaṇaḥ proktaḥ kathaṃ vācarituṃ naraiḥ । śakyo dharmamavindadbhirdharmajña vada me prabho ॥23॥
html:
dharmaḥ kiṃlakṣaṇaḥ proktaḥ kathaṃ vācarituṃ naraiḥ ।
śakyo dharmamavindadbhirdharmajña vada me prabho ॥23॥
slp1: DarmaH kiMlakzaRaH proktaH kaTaM vAcarituM narEH । Sakyo DarmamavindadBirDarmajYa vada me praBo ॥23॥

text: tato munigaṇaḥ sarvastāṃ devīṃ pratyapūjayat । vāgbhirṛgbhūṣitārthābhiḥ stavaiścārthavidāṃ vara ॥24॥
html:
tato munigaṇaḥ sarvastāṃ devīṃ pratyapūjayat ।
vāgbhirṛgbhūṣitārthābhiḥ stavaiścārthavidāṃ vara ॥24॥
slp1: tato munigaRaH sarvastAM devIM pratyapUjayat । vAgBirfgBUzitArTABiH stavEScArTavidAM vara ॥24॥
author: nārada uvāca ।

text: ahiṃsā satyavacanaṃ sarvabhūtānukampanam । śamo dānaṃ yathāśakti gārhasthyo dharma uttamaḥ ॥25॥
html:
ahiṃsā satyavacanaṃ sarvabhūtānukampanam ।
śamo dānaṃ yathāśakti gārhasthyo dharma uttamaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: ahiMsA satyavacanaM sarvaBUtAnukampanam । Samo dAnaM yaTASakti gArhasTyo Darma uttamaH ॥25॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: paradāreṣvasaṅkalpo nyāsastrīparirakṣaṇam । adattādānaviramo madhumāṃsasya varjanam ॥26॥
html:
paradāreṣvasaṅkalpo nyāsastrīparirakṣaṇam ।
adattādānaviramo madhumāṃsasya varjanam ॥26॥
slp1: paradArezvasaNkalpo nyAsastrIparirakzaRam । adattAdAnaviramo maDumAMsasya varjanam ॥26॥

text: eṣa pañcavidho dharmo bahuśākhaḥ sukhodayaḥ । dehibhirdharmaparamaiḥ kartavyo dharmasañcayaḥ ॥27॥
html:
eṣa pañcavidho dharmo bahuśākhaḥ sukhodayaḥ ।
dehibhirdharmaparamaiḥ kartavyo dharmasañcayaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: eza paYcaviDo Darmo bahuSAKaH suKodayaH । dehiBirDarmaparamEH kartavyo DarmasaYcayaH ॥27॥

text: bhagavansaṃśayaṃ pṛṣṭastaṃ me vyākhyātumarhasi । cāturvarṇyasya yo dharmaḥ sve sve varṇe guṇāvahaḥ ॥28॥
html:
bhagavansaṃśayaṃ pṛṣṭastaṃ me vyākhyātumarhasi ।
cāturvarṇyasya yo dharmaḥ sve sve varṇe guṇāvahaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: BagavansaMSayaM pfzwastaM me vyAKyAtumarhasi । cAturvarRyasya yo DarmaH sve sve varRe guRAvahaH ॥28॥
author: umovāca ।

text: brāhmaṇe kīdṛśo dharmaḥ kṣatriye kīdṛśo bhavet । vaiśye kiṃlakṣaṇo dharmaḥ śūdre kiṃlakṣaṇo bhavet ॥29॥
html:
brāhmaṇe kīdṛśo dharmaḥ kṣatriye kīdṛśo bhavet ।
vaiśye kiṃlakṣaṇo dharmaḥ śūdre kiṃlakṣaṇo bhavet ॥29॥
slp1: brAhmaRe kIdfSo DarmaH kzatriye kIdfSo Bavet । vESye kiMlakzaRo DarmaH SUdre kiMlakzaRo Bavet ॥29॥

text: nyāyataste mahābhāge saṃśayaḥ samudīritaḥ । bhūmidevā mahābhāgāḥ sadā loke dvijātayaḥ ॥30॥
html:
nyāyataste mahābhāge saṃśayaḥ samudīritaḥ ।
bhūmidevā mahābhāgāḥ sadā loke dvijātayaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: nyAyataste mahABAge saMSayaH samudIritaH । BUmidevA mahABAgAH sadA loke dvijAtayaH ॥30॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: upavāsaḥ sadā dharmo brāhmaṇasya na saṃśayaḥ । sa hi dharmārthamutpanno brahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥31॥
html:
upavāsaḥ sadā dharmo brāhmaṇasya na saṃśayaḥ ।
sa hi dharmārthamutpanno brahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥31॥
slp1: upavAsaH sadA Darmo brAhmaRasya na saMSayaH । sa hi DarmArTamutpanno brahmaBUyAya kalpate ॥31॥
