text: tasya dharmakriyā devi vratacaryā ca nyāyataḥ । tathopanayanaṃ caiva dvijāyaivopapadyate ॥32॥
html:
tasya dharmakriyā devi vratacaryā ca nyāyataḥ ।
tathopanayanaṃ caiva dvijāyaivopapadyate ॥32॥
slp1: tasya DarmakriyA devi vratacaryA ca nyAyataH । taTopanayanaM cEva dvijAyEvopapadyate ॥32॥

text: gurudaivatapūjārthaṃ svādhyāyābhyasanātmakaḥ । dehibhirdharmaparamaiścartavyo dharmasambhavaḥ ॥33॥
html:
gurudaivatapūjārthaṃ svādhyāyābhyasanātmakaḥ ।
dehibhirdharmaparamaiścartavyo dharmasambhavaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: gurudEvatapUjArTaM svADyAyAByasanAtmakaH । dehiBirDarmaparamEScartavyo DarmasamBavaH ॥33॥

text: bhagavansaṃśayo me'tra taṃ me vyākhyātumarhasi । cāturvarṇyasya dharmaṃ hi naipuṇyena prakīrtaya ॥34॥
html:
bhagavansaṃśayo me'tra taṃ me vyākhyātumarhasi ।
cāturvarṇyasya dharmaṃ hi naipuṇyena prakīrtaya ॥34॥
slp1: BagavansaMSayo me'tra taM me vyAKyAtumarhasi । cAturvarRyasya DarmaM hi nEpuRyena prakIrtaya ॥34॥
author: umovāca ।

text: rahasyaśravaṇaṃ dharmo vedavrataniṣevaṇam । vratacaryāparo dharmo gurupādaprasādanam ॥35॥
html:
rahasyaśravaṇaṃ dharmo vedavrataniṣevaṇam ।
vratacaryāparo dharmo gurupādaprasādanam ॥35॥
slp1: rahasyaSravaRaM Darmo vedavratanizevaRam । vratacaryAparo Darmo gurupAdaprasAdanam ॥35॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: bhaikṣacaryāparo dharmo dharmo nityopavāsitā । nityasvādhyāyitā dharmo brahmacaryāśramastathā ॥36॥
html:
bhaikṣacaryāparo dharmo dharmo nityopavāsitā ।
nityasvādhyāyitā dharmo brahmacaryāśramastathā ॥36॥
slp1: BEkzacaryAparo Darmo Darmo nityopavAsitA । nityasvADyAyitA Darmo brahmacaryASramastaTA ॥36॥

text: guruṇā tvabhyanujñātaḥ samāvarteta vai dvijaḥ । vindetānantaraṃ bhāryāmanurūpāṃ yathāvidhi ॥37॥
html:
guruṇā tvabhyanujñātaḥ samāvarteta vai dvijaḥ ।
vindetānantaraṃ bhāryāmanurūpāṃ yathāvidhi ॥37॥
slp1: guruRA tvaByanujYAtaH samAvarteta vE dvijaH । vindetAnantaraM BAryAmanurUpAM yaTAviDi ॥37॥

text: śūdrānnavarjanaṃ dharmastathā satpathasevanam । dharmo nityopavāsitvaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tathaiva ca ॥38॥
html:
śūdrānnavarjanaṃ dharmastathā satpathasevanam ।
dharmo nityopavāsitvaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tathaiva ca ॥38॥
slp1: SUdrAnnavarjanaM DarmastaTA satpaTasevanam । Darmo nityopavAsitvaM brahmacaryaM taTEva ca ॥38॥

text: āhitāgniradhīyāno juhvānaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ । vighasāśī yatāhāro gṛhasthaḥ satyavākśuciḥ ॥39॥
html:
āhitāgniradhīyāno juhvānaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ ।
vighasāśī yatāhāro gṛhasthaḥ satyavākśuciḥ ॥39॥
slp1: AhitAgniraDIyAno juhvAnaH saMyatendriyaH । viGasASI yatAhAro gfhasTaH satyavAkSuciH ॥39॥

text: atithivratatā dharmo dharmastretāgnidhāraṇam । iṣṭīśca paśubandhāṃśca vidhipūrvaṃ samācaret ॥40॥
html:
atithivratatā dharmo dharmastretāgnidhāraṇam ।
iṣṭīśca paśubandhāṃśca vidhipūrvaṃ samācaret ॥40॥
slp1: atiTivratatA Darmo DarmastretAgniDAraRam । izwISca paSubanDAMSca viDipUrvaM samAcaret ॥40॥

text: yajñaśca paramo dharmastathāhiṃsā ca dehiṣu । apūrvabhojanaṃ dharmo vighasāśitvameva ca ॥41॥
html:
yajñaśca paramo dharmastathāhiṃsā ca dehiṣu ।
apūrvabhojanaṃ dharmo vighasāśitvameva ca ॥41॥
slp1: yajYaSca paramo DarmastaTAhiMsA ca dehizu । apUrvaBojanaM Darmo viGasASitvameva ca ॥41॥

text: bhukte parijane paścādbhojanaṃ dharma ucyate । brāhmaṇasya gṛhasthasya śrotriyasya viśeṣataḥ ॥42॥
html:
bhukte parijane paścādbhojanaṃ dharma ucyate ।
brāhmaṇasya gṛhasthasya śrotriyasya viśeṣataḥ ॥42॥
slp1: Bukte parijane paScAdBojanaM Darma ucyate । brAhmaRasya gfhasTasya Srotriyasya viSezataH ॥42॥

text: dampatyoḥ samaśīlatvaṃ dharmaśca gṛhamedhinām । gṛhyāṇāṃ caiva devānāṃ nityaṃ puṣpabalikriyā ॥43॥
html:
dampatyoḥ samaśīlatvaṃ dharmaśca gṛhamedhinām ।
gṛhyāṇāṃ caiva devānāṃ nityaṃ puṣpabalikriyā ॥43॥
slp1: dampatyoH samaSIlatvaM DarmaSca gfhameDinAm । gfhyARAM cEva devAnAM nityaM puzpabalikriyA ॥43॥

text: nityopalepanaṃ dharmastathā nityopavāsitā । susaṃmṛṣṭopalipte ca sājyadhūmodgame gṛhe ॥44॥
html:
nityopalepanaṃ dharmastathā nityopavāsitā ।
susaṃmṛṣṭopalipte ca sājyadhūmodgame gṛhe ॥44॥
slp1: nityopalepanaM DarmastaTA nityopavAsitA । susaMmfzwopalipte ca sAjyaDUmodgame gfhe ॥44॥

text: eṣa dvijajane dharmo gārhasthyo lokadhāraṇaḥ । dvijātīnāṃ satāṃ nityaṃ sadaivaiṣa pravartate ॥45॥
html:
eṣa dvijajane dharmo gārhasthyo lokadhāraṇaḥ ।
dvijātīnāṃ satāṃ nityaṃ sadaivaiṣa pravartate ॥45॥
slp1: eza dvijajane Darmo gArhasTyo lokaDAraRaH । dvijAtInAM satAM nityaM sadEvEza pravartate ॥45॥

text: yastu kṣatragato devi tvayā dharma udīritaḥ । tamahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi taṃ me śṛṇu samāhitā ॥46॥
html:
yastu kṣatragato devi tvayā dharma udīritaḥ ।
tamahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi taṃ me śṛṇu samāhitā ॥46॥
slp1: yastu kzatragato devi tvayA Darma udIritaH । tamahaM te pravakzyAmi taM me SfRu samAhitA ॥46॥

text: kṣatriyasya smṛto dharmaḥ prajāpālanamāditaḥ । nirdiṣṭaphalabhoktā hi rājā dharmeṇa yujyate ॥47॥
html:
kṣatriyasya smṛto dharmaḥ prajāpālanamāditaḥ ।
nirdiṣṭaphalabhoktā hi rājā dharmeṇa yujyate ॥47॥
slp1: kzatriyasya smfto DarmaH prajApAlanamAditaH । nirdizwaPalaBoktA hi rAjA DarmeRa yujyate ॥47॥

text: prajāḥ pālayate yo hi dharmeṇa manujādhipaḥ । tasya dharmārjitā lokāḥ prajāpālanasañcitāḥ ॥48॥
html:
prajāḥ pālayate yo hi dharmeṇa manujādhipaḥ ।
tasya dharmārjitā lokāḥ prajāpālanasañcitāḥ ॥48॥
slp1: prajAH pAlayate yo hi DarmeRa manujADipaH । tasya DarmArjitA lokAH prajApAlanasaYcitAH ॥48॥

text: tatra rājñaḥ paro dharmo damaḥ svādhyāya eva ca । agnihotraparispando dānādhyayanameva ca ॥49॥
html:
tatra rājñaḥ paro dharmo damaḥ svādhyāya eva ca ।
agnihotraparispando dānādhyayanameva ca ॥49॥
slp1: tatra rAjYaH paro Darmo damaH svADyAya eva ca । agnihotraparispando dAnADyayanameva ca ॥49॥

text: yajñopavītadhāraṇaṃ yajño dharmakriyāstathā । bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇaṃ dharmaḥ kṛte karmaṇyamoghatā ॥50॥
html:
yajñopavītadhāraṇaṃ yajño dharmakriyāstathā ।
bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇaṃ dharmaḥ kṛte karmaṇyamoghatā ॥50॥
slp1: yajYopavItaDAraRaM yajYo DarmakriyAstaTA । BftyAnAM BaraRaM DarmaH kfte karmaRyamoGatA ॥50॥

text: samyagdaṇḍe sthitirdharmo dharmo vedakratukriyāḥ । vyavahārasthitirdharmaḥ satyavākyaratistathā ॥51॥
html:
samyagdaṇḍe sthitirdharmo dharmo vedakratukriyāḥ ।
vyavahārasthitirdharmaḥ satyavākyaratistathā ॥51॥
slp1: samyagdaRqe sTitirDarmo Darmo vedakratukriyAH । vyavahArasTitirDarmaH satyavAkyaratistaTA ॥51॥

text: ārtahastaprado rājā pretya ceha mahīyate । gobrāhmaṇārthe vikrāntaḥ saṅgrāme nidhanaṃ gataḥ । aśvamedhajitāṁllokānprāpnoti tridivālaye ॥52॥
html:
ārtahastaprado rājā pretya ceha mahīyate ।
gobrāhmaṇārthe vikrāntaḥ saṅgrāme nidhanaṃ gataḥ ।
aśvamedhajitāṁllokānprāpnoti tridivālaye ॥52॥
slp1: Artahastaprado rAjA pretya ceha mahIyate । gobrAhmaRArTe vikrAntaH saNgrAme niDanaM gataH । aSvameDajitAṁllokAnprApnoti tridivAlaye ॥52॥

text: vaiśyasya satataṃ dharmaḥ pāśupālyaṃ kṛṣistathā । agnihotraparispando dānādhyayanameva ca ॥53॥
html:
vaiśyasya satataṃ dharmaḥ pāśupālyaṃ kṛṣistathā ।
agnihotraparispando dānādhyayanameva ca ॥53॥
slp1: vESyasya satataM DarmaH pASupAlyaM kfzistaTA । agnihotraparispando dAnADyayanameva ca ॥53॥

text: vāṇijyaṃ satpathasthānamātithyaṃ praśamo damaḥ । viprāṇāṃ svāgataṃ tyāgo vaiśyadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥54॥
html:
vāṇijyaṃ satpathasthānamātithyaṃ praśamo damaḥ ।
viprāṇāṃ svāgataṃ tyāgo vaiśyadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥54॥
slp1: vARijyaM satpaTasTAnamAtiTyaM praSamo damaH । viprARAM svAgataM tyAgo vESyaDarmaH sanAtanaH ॥54॥

text: tilāngandhānrasāṃścaiva na vikrīṇīta vai kvacit । vaṇikpathamupāsīno vaiśyaḥ satpathamāśritaḥ ॥55॥
html:
tilāngandhānrasāṃścaiva na vikrīṇīta vai kvacit ।
vaṇikpathamupāsīno vaiśyaḥ satpathamāśritaḥ ॥55॥
slp1: tilAnganDAnrasAMScEva na vikrIRIta vE kvacit । vaRikpaTamupAsIno vESyaH satpaTamASritaH ॥55॥

text: sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti yathārhataḥ । śūdradharmaḥ paro nityaṃ śuśrūṣā ca dvijātiṣu ॥56॥
html:
sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti yathārhataḥ ।
śūdradharmaḥ paro nityaṃ śuśrūṣā ca dvijātiṣu ॥56॥
slp1: sarvAtiTyaM trivargasya yaTASakti yaTArhataH । SUdraDarmaH paro nityaM SuSrUzA ca dvijAtizu ॥56॥

text: sa śūdraḥ saṃśitatapāḥ satyasandho jitendriyaḥ । śuśrūṣannatithiṃ prāptaṃ tapaḥ sañcinute mahat ॥57॥
html:
sa śūdraḥ saṃśitatapāḥ satyasandho jitendriyaḥ ।
śuśrūṣannatithiṃ prāptaṃ tapaḥ sañcinute mahat ॥57॥
slp1: sa SUdraH saMSitatapAH satyasanDo jitendriyaH । SuSrUzannatiTiM prAptaM tapaH saYcinute mahat ॥57॥

text: tyaktahiṃsaḥ śubhācāro devatādvijapūjakaḥ । śūdro dharmaphalairiṣṭaiḥ samprayujyeta buddhimān ॥58॥
html:
tyaktahiṃsaḥ śubhācāro devatādvijapūjakaḥ ।
śūdro dharmaphalairiṣṭaiḥ samprayujyeta buddhimān ॥58॥
slp1: tyaktahiMsaH SuBAcAro devatAdvijapUjakaH । SUdro DarmaPalErizwEH samprayujyeta budDimAn ॥58॥

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ cāturvarṇyasya śobhane । ekaikasyeha subhage kimanyacchrotumicchasi] ॥59॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ cāturvarṇyasya śobhane ।
ekaikasyeha subhage kimanyacchrotumicchasi] ॥59॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM cAturvarRyasya SoBane । ekEkasyeha suBage kimanyacCrotumicCasi] ॥59॥

text: uktāstvayā pṛthagdharmāścāturvarṇyahitāḥ śubhāḥ । sarvavyāpī tu yo dharmo bhagavaṃstaṃ bravīhi me ॥1॥
html:
uktāstvayā pṛthagdharmāścāturvarṇyahitāḥ śubhāḥ ।
sarvavyāpī tu yo dharmo bhagavaṃstaṃ bravīhi me ॥1॥
slp1: uktAstvayA pfTagDarmAScAturvarRyahitAH SuBAH । sarvavyApI tu yo Darmo BagavaMstaM bravIhi me ॥1॥
author: umovāca ।

text: brāhmaṇā lokasāreṇa sṛṣṭā dhātrā guṇārthinā । lokāṃstārayituṃ kṛtsnānmartyeṣu kṣitidevatāḥ ॥2॥
html:
brāhmaṇā lokasāreṇa sṛṣṭā dhātrā guṇārthinā ।
lokāṃstārayituṃ kṛtsnānmartyeṣu kṣitidevatāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: brAhmaRA lokasAreRa sfzwA DAtrA guRArTinA । lokAMstArayituM kftsnAnmartyezu kzitidevatAH ॥2॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: teṣāmimaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmakarmaphalodayam । brāhmaṇeṣu hi yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ paramo mataḥ ॥3॥
html:
teṣāmimaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmakarmaphalodayam ।
brāhmaṇeṣu hi yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ paramo mataḥ ॥3॥
slp1: tezAmimaM pravakzyAmi DarmakarmaPalodayam । brAhmaRezu hi yo DarmaH sa DarmaH paramo mataH ॥3॥

text: ime tu lokadharmārthaṃ trayaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā । pṛthivyāḥ sarjane nityaṃ sṛṣṭāstānapi me śṛṇu ॥4॥
html:
ime tu lokadharmārthaṃ trayaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā ।
pṛthivyāḥ sarjane nityaṃ sṛṣṭāstānapi me śṛṇu ॥4॥
slp1: ime tu lokaDarmArTaM trayaH sfzwAH svayamBuvA । pfTivyAH sarjane nityaM sfzwAstAnapi me SfRu ॥4॥

text: vedoktaḥ paramo dharmaḥ smṛtiśāstragato'paraḥ । śiṣṭācīrṇaḥ paraḥ proktastrayo dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥5॥
html:
vedoktaḥ paramo dharmaḥ smṛtiśāstragato'paraḥ ।
śiṣṭācīrṇaḥ paraḥ proktastrayo dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: vedoktaH paramo DarmaH smftiSAstragato'paraH । SizwAcIrRaH paraH proktastrayo DarmAH sanAtanAH ॥5॥

text: traividyo brāhmaṇo vidvānna cādhyayanajīvanaḥ । trikarmā triparikrānto maitra eṣa smṛto dvijaḥ ॥6॥
html:
traividyo brāhmaṇo vidvānna cādhyayanajīvanaḥ ।
trikarmā triparikrānto maitra eṣa smṛto dvijaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: trEvidyo brAhmaRo vidvAnna cADyayanajIvanaH । trikarmA triparikrAnto mEtra eza smfto dvijaH ॥6॥

text: ṣaḍimāni tu karmāṇi provāca bhuvaneśvaraḥ । vṛttyarthaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vai śṛṇu tāni samāhitā ॥7॥
html:
ṣaḍimāni tu karmāṇi provāca bhuvaneśvaraḥ ।
vṛttyarthaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vai śṛṇu tāni samāhitā ॥7॥
slp1: zaqimAni tu karmARi provAca BuvaneSvaraH । vfttyarTaM brAhmaRAnAM vE SfRu tAni samAhitA ॥7॥

text: yajanaṃ yājanaṃ caiva tathā dānapratigrahau । adhyāpanamadhītaṃ ca ṣaṭkarmā dharmabhāgdvijaḥ ॥8॥
html:
yajanaṃ yājanaṃ caiva tathā dānapratigrahau ।
adhyāpanamadhītaṃ ca ṣaṭkarmā dharmabhāgdvijaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yajanaM yAjanaM cEva taTA dAnapratigrahO । aDyApanamaDItaM ca zawkarmA DarmaBAgdvijaH ॥8॥

text: nityasvādhyāyatā dharmo dharmo yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ । dānaṃ praśasyate cāsya yathāśakti yathāvidhi ॥9॥
html:
nityasvādhyāyatā dharmo dharmo yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
dānaṃ praśasyate cāsya yathāśakti yathāvidhi ॥9॥
slp1: nityasvADyAyatA Darmo Darmo yajYaH sanAtanaH । dAnaM praSasyate cAsya yaTASakti yaTAviDi ॥9॥

text: ayaṃ tu paramo dharmaḥ pravṛttaḥ satsu nityaśaḥ । gṛhasthatā viśuddhānāṃ dharmasya nicayo mahān ॥10॥
html:
ayaṃ tu paramo dharmaḥ pravṛttaḥ satsu nityaśaḥ ।
gṛhasthatā viśuddhānāṃ dharmasya nicayo mahān ॥10॥
slp1: ayaM tu paramo DarmaH pravfttaH satsu nityaSaH । gfhasTatA viSudDAnAM Darmasya nicayo mahAn ॥10॥

text: pañcayajñaviśuddhātmā satyavāganasūyakaḥ । dātā brāhmaṇasatkartā susammṛṣṭaniveśanaḥ ॥11॥
html:
pañcayajñaviśuddhātmā satyavāganasūyakaḥ ।
dātā brāhmaṇasatkartā susammṛṣṭaniveśanaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: paYcayajYaviSudDAtmA satyavAganasUyakaH । dAtA brAhmaRasatkartA susammfzwaniveSanaH ॥11॥

text: amānī ca sadājihmaḥ snigdhavāṇīpradastathā । atithyabhyāgataratiḥ śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ ॥12॥
html:
amānī ca sadājihmaḥ snigdhavāṇīpradastathā ।
atithyabhyāgataratiḥ śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: amAnI ca sadAjihmaH snigDavARIpradastaTA । atiTyaByAgataratiH SezAnnakftaBojanaH ॥12॥

text: pādyamarghyaṃ yathānyāyamāsanaṃ śayanaṃ tathā । dīpaṃ pratiśrayaṃ cāpi yo dadāti sa dhārmikaḥ ॥13॥
html:
pādyamarghyaṃ yathānyāyamāsanaṃ śayanaṃ tathā ।
dīpaṃ pratiśrayaṃ cāpi yo dadāti sa dhārmikaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: pAdyamarGyaM yaTAnyAyamAsanaM SayanaM taTA । dIpaM pratiSrayaM cApi yo dadAti sa DArmikaH ॥13॥

text: prātarutthāya cācamya bhojanenopamantrya ca । satkṛtyānuvrajedyaśca tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥14॥
html:
prātarutthāya cācamya bhojanenopamantrya ca ।
satkṛtyānuvrajedyaśca tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: prAtarutTAya cAcamya Bojanenopamantrya ca । satkftyAnuvrajedyaSca tasya DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥14॥

text: sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti divāniśam । śūdradharmaḥ samākhyātastrivarṇaparicāraṇam ॥15॥
html:
sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya yathāśakti divāniśam ।
śūdradharmaḥ samākhyātastrivarṇaparicāraṇam ॥15॥
slp1: sarvAtiTyaM trivargasya yaTASakti divAniSam । SUdraDarmaH samAKyAtastrivarRaparicAraRam ॥15॥

text: pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo gṛhastheṣu vidhīyate । tamahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvabhūtahitaṃ śubham ॥16॥
html:
pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo gṛhastheṣu vidhīyate ।
tamahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvabhūtahitaṃ śubham ॥16॥
slp1: pravfttilakzaRo Darmo gfhasTezu viDIyate । tamahaM kIrtayizyAmi sarvaBUtahitaM SuBam ॥16॥

text: dātavyamasakṛcchaktyā yaṣṭavyamasakṛttathā । puṣṭikarmavidhānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ॥17॥
html:
dātavyamasakṛcchaktyā yaṣṭavyamasakṛttathā ।
puṣṭikarmavidhānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ॥17॥
slp1: dAtavyamasakfcCaktyA yazwavyamasakfttaTA । puzwikarmaviDAnaM ca kartavyaM BUtimicCatA ॥17॥

text: dharmeṇārthaḥ samāhāryo dharmalabdhaṃ tridhā dhanam । kartavyaṃ dharmaparamaṃ mānavena prayatnataḥ ॥18॥
html:
dharmeṇārthaḥ samāhāryo dharmalabdhaṃ tridhā dhanam ।
kartavyaṃ dharmaparamaṃ mānavena prayatnataḥ ॥18॥
slp1: DarmeRArTaH samAhAryo DarmalabDaM triDA Danam । kartavyaM DarmaparamaM mAnavena prayatnataH ॥18॥

text: ekenāṃśena dharmārthaścartavyo bhūtimicchatā । ekenāṃśena kāmārtha ekamaṃśaṃ vivardhayet ॥19॥
html:
ekenāṃśena dharmārthaścartavyo bhūtimicchatā ।
ekenāṃśena kāmārtha ekamaṃśaṃ vivardhayet ॥19॥
slp1: ekenAMSena DarmArTaScartavyo BUtimicCatA । ekenAMSena kAmArTa ekamaMSaM vivarDayet ॥19॥

text: nivṛttilakṣaṇastvanyo dharmo mokṣa iti smṛtaḥ । tasya vṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu me devi tattvataḥ ॥20॥
html:
nivṛttilakṣaṇastvanyo dharmo mokṣa iti smṛtaḥ ।
tasya vṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu me devi tattvataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: nivfttilakzaRastvanyo Darmo mokza iti smftaH । tasya vfttiM pravakzyAmi SfRu me devi tattvataH ॥20॥

text: sarvabhūtadayā dharmo na caikagrāmavāsitā । āśāpāśavimokṣaśca śasyate mokṣakāṅkṣiṇām ॥21॥
html:
sarvabhūtadayā dharmo na caikagrāmavāsitā ।
āśāpāśavimokṣaśca śasyate mokṣakāṅkṣiṇām ॥21॥
slp1: sarvaBUtadayA Darmo na cEkagrAmavAsitA । ASApASavimokzaSca Sasyate mokzakANkziRAm ॥21॥

text: na kuṇḍyāṃ nodake saṅgo na vāsasi na cāsane । na tridaṇḍe na śayane nāgnau na śaraṇālaye ॥22॥
html:
na kuṇḍyāṃ nodake saṅgo na vāsasi na cāsane ।
na tridaṇḍe na śayane nāgnau na śaraṇālaye ॥22॥
slp1: na kuRqyAM nodake saNgo na vAsasi na cAsane । na tridaRqe na Sayane nAgnO na SaraRAlaye ॥22॥

text: adhyātmagatacitto yastanmanāstatparāyaṇaḥ । yukto yogaṃ prati sadā pratisaṅkhyānameva ca ॥23॥
html:
adhyātmagatacitto yastanmanāstatparāyaṇaḥ ।
yukto yogaṃ prati sadā pratisaṅkhyānameva ca ॥23॥
slp1: aDyAtmagatacitto yastanmanAstatparAyaRaH । yukto yogaM prati sadA pratisaNKyAnameva ca ॥23॥

text: vṛkṣamūlaśayo nityaṃ śūnyāgāraniveśanaḥ । nadīpulinaśāyī ca nadītīraratiśca yaḥ ॥24॥
html:
vṛkṣamūlaśayo nityaṃ śūnyāgāraniveśanaḥ ।
nadīpulinaśāyī ca nadītīraratiśca yaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: vfkzamUlaSayo nityaM SUnyAgAraniveSanaH । nadIpulinaSAyI ca nadItIraratiSca yaH ॥24॥

text: vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgeṣu snehabandheṣu ca dvijaḥ । ātmanyevātmano bhāvaṃ samāsajyāṭati dvijaḥ ॥25॥
html:
vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgeṣu snehabandheṣu ca dvijaḥ ।
ātmanyevātmano bhāvaṃ samāsajyāṭati dvijaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: vimuktaH sarvasaNgezu snehabanDezu ca dvijaH । AtmanyevAtmano BAvaM samAsajyAwati dvijaH ॥25॥

text: sthāṇubhūto nirāhāro mokṣadṛṣṭena karmaṇā । parivrajati yo yuktastasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥26॥
html:
sthāṇubhūto nirāhāro mokṣadṛṣṭena karmaṇā ।
parivrajati yo yuktastasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥26॥
slp1: sTARuBUto nirAhAro mokzadfzwena karmaRA । parivrajati yo yuktastasya DarmaH sanAtanaH ॥26॥

text: na caikatra cirāsakto na caikagrāmagocaraḥ । yukto hyaṭati nirmukto na caikapulineśayaḥ ॥27॥
html:
na caikatra cirāsakto na caikagrāmagocaraḥ ।
yukto hyaṭati nirmukto na caikapulineśayaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: na cEkatra cirAsakto na cEkagrAmagocaraH । yukto hyawati nirmukto na cEkapulineSayaH ॥27॥

text: eṣa mokṣavidāṃ dharmo vedoktaḥ satpathaḥ satām । yo mārgamanuyātīmaṃ padaṃ tasya na vidyate ॥28॥
html:
eṣa mokṣavidāṃ dharmo vedoktaḥ satpathaḥ satām ।
yo mārgamanuyātīmaṃ padaṃ tasya na vidyate ॥28॥
slp1: eza mokzavidAM Darmo vedoktaH satpaTaH satAm । yo mArgamanuyAtImaM padaM tasya na vidyate ॥28॥

text: caturvidhā bhikṣavaste kuṭīcarakṛtodakaḥ । haṃsaḥ paramahaṃsaśca yo yaḥ paścātsa uttamaḥ ॥29॥
html:
caturvidhā bhikṣavaste kuṭīcarakṛtodakaḥ ।
haṃsaḥ paramahaṃsaśca yo yaḥ paścātsa uttamaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: caturviDA Bikzavaste kuwIcarakftodakaH । haMsaH paramahaMsaSca yo yaH paScAtsa uttamaH ॥29॥

text: ataḥ parataraṃ nāsti nādharaṃ na tiro'grataḥ । aduḥkhamasukhaṃ saumyamajarāmaramavyayam ॥30॥
html:
ataḥ parataraṃ nāsti nādharaṃ na tiro'grataḥ ।
aduḥkhamasukhaṃ saumyamajarāmaramavyayam ॥30॥
slp1: ataH parataraM nAsti nADaraM na tiro'grataH । aduHKamasuKaM sOmyamajarAmaramavyayam ॥30॥

text: gārhasthyo mokṣadharmaśca sajjanācaritastvayā । bhāṣito martyalokasya mārgaḥ śreyaskaro mahān ॥31॥
html:
gārhasthyo mokṣadharmaśca sajjanācaritastvayā ।
bhāṣito martyalokasya mārgaḥ śreyaskaro mahān ॥31॥
slp1: gArhasTyo mokzaDarmaSca sajjanAcaritastvayA । BAzito martyalokasya mArgaH Sreyaskaro mahAn ॥31॥
author: umovāca ।

text: ṛṣidharmaṃ tu dharmajña śrotumicchāmyanuttamam । spṛhā bhavati me nityaṃ tapovananivāsiṣu ॥32॥
html:
ṛṣidharmaṃ tu dharmajña śrotumicchāmyanuttamam ।
spṛhā bhavati me nityaṃ tapovananivāsiṣu ॥32॥
slp1: fziDarmaM tu DarmajYa SrotumicCAmyanuttamam । spfhA Bavati me nityaM tapovananivAsizu ॥32॥

text: ājyadhūmodbhavo gandho ruṇaddhīva tapovanam । taṃ dṛṣṭvā me manaḥ prītaṃ maheśvara sadā bhavet ॥33॥
html:
ājyadhūmodbhavo gandho ruṇaddhīva tapovanam ।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā me manaḥ prītaṃ maheśvara sadā bhavet ॥33॥
slp1: AjyaDUmodBavo ganDo ruRadDIva tapovanam । taM dfzwvA me manaH prItaM maheSvara sadA Bavet ॥33॥

text: etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ deva munidharmakṛtaṃ vibho । sarvadharmārthatattvajña devadeva vadasva me । nikhilena mayā pṛṣṭaṃ mahādeva yathātatham ॥34॥
html:
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ deva munidharmakṛtaṃ vibho ।
sarvadharmārthatattvajña devadeva vadasva me ।
nikhilena mayā pṛṣṭaṃ mahādeva yathātatham ॥34॥
slp1: etaM me saMSayaM deva muniDarmakftaM viBo । sarvaDarmArTatattvajYa devadeva vadasva me । niKilena mayA pfzwaM mahAdeva yaTAtaTam ॥34॥

text: hanta te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi munidharmamanuttamam । yaṃ kṛtvā munayo yānti siddhiṃ svatapasā śubhe ॥35॥
html:
hanta te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi munidharmamanuttamam ।
yaṃ kṛtvā munayo yānti siddhiṃ svatapasā śubhe ॥35॥
slp1: hanta te'haM pravakzyAmi muniDarmamanuttamam । yaM kftvA munayo yAnti sidDiM svatapasA SuBe ॥35॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: phenapānāmṛṣīṇāṃ yo dharmo dharmavidāṃ sadā । taṃ me śṛṇu mahābhāge dharmajñe dharmamāditaḥ ॥36॥
html:
phenapānāmṛṣīṇāṃ yo dharmo dharmavidāṃ sadā ।
taṃ me śṛṇu mahābhāge dharmajñe dharmamāditaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: PenapAnAmfzIRAM yo Darmo DarmavidAM sadA । taM me SfRu mahABAge DarmajYe DarmamAditaH ॥36॥

text: uñchanti satataṃ tasminbrāhmaṃ phenotkaraṃ śubham । amṛtaṃ brahmaṇā pītaṃ madhuraṃ prasṛtaṃ divi ॥37॥
html:
uñchanti satataṃ tasminbrāhmaṃ phenotkaraṃ śubham ।
amṛtaṃ brahmaṇā pītaṃ madhuraṃ prasṛtaṃ divi ॥37॥
slp1: uYCanti satataM tasminbrAhmaM PenotkaraM SuBam । amftaM brahmaRA pItaM maDuraM prasftaM divi ॥37॥

text: eṣa teṣāṃ viśuddhānāṃ phenapānāṃ tapodhane । dharmacaryākṛto mārgo vālakhilyagaṇe śṛṇu ॥38॥
html:
eṣa teṣāṃ viśuddhānāṃ phenapānāṃ tapodhane ।
dharmacaryākṛto mārgo vālakhilyagaṇe śṛṇu ॥38॥
slp1: eza tezAM viSudDAnAM PenapAnAM tapoDane । DarmacaryAkfto mArgo vAlaKilyagaRe SfRu ॥38॥

text: vālakhilyāstapaḥsiddhā munayaḥ sūryamaṇḍale । uñchamuñchanti dharmajñāḥ śākunīṃ vṛttimāsthitāḥ ॥39॥
html:
vālakhilyāstapaḥsiddhā munayaḥ sūryamaṇḍale ।
uñchamuñchanti dharmajñāḥ śākunīṃ vṛttimāsthitāḥ ॥39॥
slp1: vAlaKilyAstapaHsidDA munayaH sUryamaRqale । uYCamuYCanti DarmajYAH SAkunIM vfttimAsTitAH ॥39॥

text: mṛganirmokavasanāścīravalkalavāsasaḥ । nirdvandvāḥ satpathaṃ prāptā vālakhilyāstapodhanāḥ ॥40॥
html:
mṛganirmokavasanāścīravalkalavāsasaḥ ।
nirdvandvāḥ satpathaṃ prāptā vālakhilyāstapodhanāḥ ॥40॥
slp1: mfganirmokavasanAScIravalkalavAsasaH । nirdvandvAH satpaTaM prAptA vAlaKilyAstapoDanAH ॥40॥

text: aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāste sveṣvaṅgeṣu vyavasthitāḥ । tapaścaraṇamīhante teṣāṃ dharmaphalaṃ mahat ॥41॥
html:
aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāste sveṣvaṅgeṣu vyavasthitāḥ ।
tapaścaraṇamīhante teṣāṃ dharmaphalaṃ mahat ॥41॥
slp1: aNguzWaparvamAtrAste svezvaNgezu vyavasTitAH । tapaScaraRamIhante tezAM DarmaPalaM mahat ॥41॥

text: te suraiḥ samatāṃ yānti surakāryārthasiddhaye । dyotayanto diśaḥ sarvāstapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ ॥42॥
html:
te suraiḥ samatāṃ yānti surakāryārthasiddhaye ।
dyotayanto diśaḥ sarvāstapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ ॥42॥
slp1: te surEH samatAM yAnti surakAryArTasidDaye । dyotayanto diSaH sarvAstapasA dagDakilbizAH ॥42॥

text: ye tvanye śuddhamanaso dayādharmaparāyaṇāḥ । santaścakracarāḥ puṇyāḥ somalokacarāśca ye ॥43॥
html:
ye tvanye śuddhamanaso dayādharmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
santaścakracarāḥ puṇyāḥ somalokacarāśca ye ॥43॥
slp1: ye tvanye SudDamanaso dayADarmaparAyaRAH । santaScakracarAH puRyAH somalokacarASca ye ॥43॥

text: pitṛlokasamīpasthāsta uñchanti yathāvidhi । samprakṣālāśmakuṭṭāśca dantolūkhalinastathā ॥44॥
html:
pitṛlokasamīpasthāsta uñchanti yathāvidhi ।
samprakṣālāśmakuṭṭāśca dantolūkhalinastathā ॥44॥
slp1: pitflokasamIpasTAsta uYCanti yaTAviDi । samprakzAlASmakuwwASca dantolUKalinastaTA ॥44॥

text: somapānāṃ ca devānāmūṣmapāṇāṃ tathaiva ca । uñchanti ye samīpasthāḥ svabhāvaniyatendriyāḥ ॥45॥
html:
somapānāṃ ca devānāmūṣmapāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ।
uñchanti ye samīpasthāḥ svabhāvaniyatendriyāḥ ॥45॥
slp1: somapAnAM ca devAnAmUzmapARAM taTEva ca । uYCanti ye samIpasTAH svaBAvaniyatendriyAH ॥45॥

text: teṣāmagnipariṣyandaḥ pitṛdevārcanaṃ tathā । yajñānāṃ cāpi pañcānāṃ yajanaṃ dharma ucyate ॥46॥
html:
teṣāmagnipariṣyandaḥ pitṛdevārcanaṃ tathā ।
yajñānāṃ cāpi pañcānāṃ yajanaṃ dharma ucyate ॥46॥
slp1: tezAmagniparizyandaH pitfdevArcanaM taTA । yajYAnAM cApi paYcAnAM yajanaM Darma ucyate ॥46॥

text: eṣa cakracarairdevi devalokacarairdvijaiḥ । ṛṣidharmaḥ sadā cīrṇo yo'nyastamapi me śṛṇu ॥47॥
html:
eṣa cakracarairdevi devalokacarairdvijaiḥ ।
ṛṣidharmaḥ sadā cīrṇo yo'nyastamapi me śṛṇu ॥47॥
slp1: eza cakracarErdevi devalokacarErdvijEH । fziDarmaH sadA cIrRo yo'nyastamapi me SfRu ॥47॥

text: sarveṣvevarṣidharmeṣu jeya ātmā jitendriyaḥ । kāmakrodhau tataḥ paścājjetavyāviti me matiḥ ॥48॥
html:
sarveṣvevarṣidharmeṣu jeya ātmā jitendriyaḥ ।
kāmakrodhau tataḥ paścājjetavyāviti me matiḥ ॥48॥
slp1: sarvezvevarziDarmezu jeya AtmA jitendriyaH । kAmakroDO tataH paScAjjetavyAviti me matiH ॥48॥

text: agnihotraparispando dharmarātrisamāsanam । somayajñābhyanujñānaṃ pañcamī yajñadakṣiṇā ॥49॥
html:
agnihotraparispando dharmarātrisamāsanam ।
somayajñābhyanujñānaṃ pañcamī yajñadakṣiṇā ॥49॥
slp1: agnihotraparispando DarmarAtrisamAsanam । somayajYAByanujYAnaM paYcamI yajYadakziRA ॥49॥

text: nityaṃ yajñakriyā dharmaḥ pitṛdevārcane ratiḥ । sarvātithyaṃ ca kartavyamannenoñchārjitena vai ॥50॥
html:
nityaṃ yajñakriyā dharmaḥ pitṛdevārcane ratiḥ ।
sarvātithyaṃ ca kartavyamannenoñchārjitena vai ॥50॥
slp1: nityaM yajYakriyA DarmaH pitfdevArcane ratiH । sarvAtiTyaM ca kartavyamannenoYCArjitena vE ॥50॥

text: nivṛttirupabhogasya gorasānāṃ ca vai ratiḥ । sthaṇḍile śayanaṃ yogaḥ śākaparṇaniṣevaṇam ॥51॥
html:
nivṛttirupabhogasya gorasānāṃ ca vai ratiḥ ।
sthaṇḍile śayanaṃ yogaḥ śākaparṇaniṣevaṇam ॥51॥
slp1: nivfttirupaBogasya gorasAnAM ca vE ratiH । sTaRqile SayanaM yogaH SAkaparRanizevaRam ॥51॥

text: phalamūlāśanaṃ vāyurāpaḥ śaivalabhakṣaṇam । ṛṣīṇāṃ niyamā hyete yairjayantyajitāṃ gatim ॥52॥
html:
phalamūlāśanaṃ vāyurāpaḥ śaivalabhakṣaṇam ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ niyamā hyete yairjayantyajitāṃ gatim ॥52॥
slp1: PalamUlASanaM vAyurApaH SEvalaBakzaRam । fzIRAM niyamA hyete yErjayantyajitAM gatim ॥52॥

text: vidhūme nyastamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane । atītapātrasañcāre kāle vigatabhaikṣake ॥53॥
html:
vidhūme nyastamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane ।
atītapātrasañcāre kāle vigatabhaikṣake ॥53॥
slp1: viDUme nyastamusale vyaNgAre Buktavajjane । atItapAtrasaYcAre kAle vigataBEkzake ॥53॥

text: atithiṃ kāṅkṣamāṇo vai śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ । satyadharmaratiḥ kṣānto munidharmeṇa yujyate ॥54॥
html:
atithiṃ kāṅkṣamāṇo vai śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ ।
satyadharmaratiḥ kṣānto munidharmeṇa yujyate ॥54॥
slp1: atiTiM kANkzamARo vE SezAnnakftaBojanaH । satyaDarmaratiH kzAnto muniDarmeRa yujyate ॥54॥

text: na stambhī na ca mānī yo na pramatto na vismitaḥ । mitrāmitrasamo maitro yaḥ sa dharmaviduttamaḥ] ॥55॥
html:
na stambhī na ca mānī yo na pramatto na vismitaḥ ।
mitrāmitrasamo maitro yaḥ sa dharmaviduttamaḥ] ॥55॥
slp1: na stamBI na ca mAnI yo na pramatto na vismitaH । mitrAmitrasamo mEtro yaH sa DarmaviduttamaH] ॥55॥

text: deśeṣu ramaṇīyeṣu girīṇāṃ nirjhareṣu ca । sravantīnāṃ ca kuñjeṣu parvatopavaneṣu ca ॥1॥
html:
deśeṣu ramaṇīyeṣu girīṇāṃ nirjhareṣu ca ।
sravantīnāṃ ca kuñjeṣu parvatopavaneṣu ca ॥1॥
slp1: deSezu ramaRIyezu girIRAM nirJarezu ca । sravantInAM ca kuYjezu parvatopavanezu ca ॥1॥
author: umovāca ।

text: deśeṣu ca vicitreṣu phalavatsu samāhitāḥ । mūlavatsu ca deśeṣu vasanti niyatavratāḥ ॥2॥
html:
deśeṣu ca vicitreṣu phalavatsu samāhitāḥ ।
mūlavatsu ca deśeṣu vasanti niyatavratāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: deSezu ca vicitrezu Palavatsu samAhitAH । mUlavatsu ca deSezu vasanti niyatavratAH ॥2॥

text: teṣāmapi vidhiṃ puṇyaṃ śrotumicchāmi śaṅkara । vānaprastheṣu deveśa svaśarīropajīviṣu ॥3॥
html:
teṣāmapi vidhiṃ puṇyaṃ śrotumicchāmi śaṅkara ।
vānaprastheṣu deveśa svaśarīropajīviṣu ॥3॥
slp1: tezAmapi viDiM puRyaM SrotumicCAmi SaNkara । vAnaprasTezu deveSa svaSarIropajIvizu ॥3॥

text: vānaprastheṣu yo dharmastaṃ me śṛṇu samāhitā । śrutvā caikamanā devi dharmabuddhiparā bhava ॥4॥
html:
vānaprastheṣu yo dharmastaṃ me śṛṇu samāhitā ।
śrutvā caikamanā devi dharmabuddhiparā bhava ॥4॥
slp1: vAnaprasTezu yo DarmastaM me SfRu samAhitA । SrutvA cEkamanA devi DarmabudDiparA Bava ॥4॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: saṃsiddhairniyataiḥ sadbhirvanavāsamupāgataiḥ । vānaprasthairidaṃ karma kartavyaṃ śṛṇu yādṛśam ॥5॥
html:
saṃsiddhairniyataiḥ sadbhirvanavāsamupāgataiḥ ।
vānaprasthairidaṃ karma kartavyaṃ śṛṇu yādṛśam ॥5॥
slp1: saMsidDErniyatEH sadBirvanavAsamupAgatEH । vAnaprasTEridaM karma kartavyaM SfRu yAdfSam ॥5॥

text: trikālamabhiṣekārthaḥ pitṛdevārcanaṃ kriyā । agnihotraparispanda iṣṭihomavidhistathā ॥6॥
html:
trikālamabhiṣekārthaḥ pitṛdevārcanaṃ kriyā ।
agnihotraparispanda iṣṭihomavidhistathā ॥6॥
slp1: trikAlamaBizekArTaH pitfdevArcanaM kriyA । agnihotraparispanda izwihomaviDistaTA ॥6॥

text: nīvāragrahaṇaṃ caiva phalamūlaniṣevaṇam । iṅgudairaṇḍatailānāṃ snehārthaṃ ca niṣevaṇam ॥7॥
html:
nīvāragrahaṇaṃ caiva phalamūlaniṣevaṇam ।
iṅgudairaṇḍatailānāṃ snehārthaṃ ca niṣevaṇam ॥7॥
slp1: nIvAragrahaRaM cEva PalamUlanizevaRam । iNgudEraRqatElAnAM snehArTaM ca nizevaRam ॥7॥

text: yogacaryākṛtaiḥ siddhaiḥ kāmakrodhavivarjanam । vīraśayyāmupāsadbhirvīrasthānopasevibhiḥ ॥8॥
html:
yogacaryākṛtaiḥ siddhaiḥ kāmakrodhavivarjanam ।
vīraśayyāmupāsadbhirvīrasthānopasevibhiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yogacaryAkftEH sidDEH kAmakroDavivarjanam । vIraSayyAmupAsadBirvIrasTAnopaseviBiH ॥8॥

text: yuktairyogavahaiḥ sadbhirgrīṣme pañcatapaistathā । maṇḍūkayoganiyatairyathānyāyaniṣevibhiḥ ॥9॥
html:
yuktairyogavahaiḥ sadbhirgrīṣme pañcatapaistathā ।
maṇḍūkayoganiyatairyathānyāyaniṣevibhiḥ ॥9॥
slp1: yuktEryogavahEH sadBirgrIzme paYcatapEstaTA । maRqUkayoganiyatEryaTAnyAyanizeviBiH ॥9॥

text: vīrāsanagatairnityaṃ sthaṇḍile śayanaistathā । śītayogo'gniyogaśca cartavyo dharmabuddhibhiḥ ॥10॥
html:
vīrāsanagatairnityaṃ sthaṇḍile śayanaistathā ।
śītayogo'gniyogaśca cartavyo dharmabuddhibhiḥ ॥10॥
slp1: vIrAsanagatErnityaM sTaRqile SayanEstaTA । SItayogo'gniyogaSca cartavyo DarmabudDiBiH ॥10॥

text: abbhakṣairvāyubhakṣaiśca śaivālottarabhojanaiḥ । aśmakuṭṭaistathā dāntaiḥ samprakṣālaistathāparaiḥ ॥11॥
html:
abbhakṣairvāyubhakṣaiśca śaivālottarabhojanaiḥ ।
aśmakuṭṭaistathā dāntaiḥ samprakṣālaistathāparaiḥ ॥11॥
slp1: abBakzErvAyuBakzESca SEvAlottaraBojanEH । aSmakuwwEstaTA dAntEH samprakzAlEstaTAparEH ॥11॥

text: cīravalkalasaṃvītairmṛgacarmanivāsibhiḥ । kāryā yātrā yathākālaṃ yathādharmaṃ yathāvidhi ॥12॥
html:
cīravalkalasaṃvītairmṛgacarmanivāsibhiḥ ।
kāryā yātrā yathākālaṃ yathādharmaṃ yathāvidhi ॥12॥
slp1: cIravalkalasaMvItErmfgacarmanivAsiBiH । kAryA yAtrA yaTAkAlaM yaTADarmaM yaTAviDi ॥12॥

text: vananityairvanacarairvanapairvanagocaraiḥ । vanaṃ gurumivāsādya vastavyaṃ vanajīvibhiḥ ॥13॥
html:
vananityairvanacarairvanapairvanagocaraiḥ ।
vanaṃ gurumivāsādya vastavyaṃ vanajīvibhiḥ ॥13॥
slp1: vananityErvanacarErvanapErvanagocarEH । vanaM gurumivAsAdya vastavyaM vanajIviBiH ॥13॥

text: teṣāṃ homakriyā dharmaḥ pañcayajñaniṣevaṇam । nāgapañcamayajñasya vedoktasyānupālanam ॥14॥
html:
teṣāṃ homakriyā dharmaḥ pañcayajñaniṣevaṇam ।
nāgapañcamayajñasya vedoktasyānupālanam ॥14॥
slp1: tezAM homakriyA DarmaH paYcayajYanizevaRam । nAgapaYcamayajYasya vedoktasyAnupAlanam ॥14॥

text: aṣṭamīyajñaparatā cāturmāsyaniṣevaṇam । paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yo yajño nityayajñastathaiva ca ॥15॥
html:
aṣṭamīyajñaparatā cāturmāsyaniṣevaṇam ।
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yo yajño nityayajñastathaiva ca ॥15॥
slp1: azwamIyajYaparatA cAturmAsyanizevaRam । pOrRamAsyAM tu yo yajYo nityayajYastaTEva ca ॥15॥

text: vimuktā dārasaṃyogairvimuktāḥ sarvasaṅkaraiḥ । vimuktāḥ sarvapāpaiśca caranti munayo vane ॥16॥
html:
vimuktā dārasaṃyogairvimuktāḥ sarvasaṅkaraiḥ ।
vimuktāḥ sarvapāpaiśca caranti munayo vane ॥16॥
slp1: vimuktA dArasaMyogErvimuktAH sarvasaNkarEH । vimuktAH sarvapApESca caranti munayo vane ॥16॥

text: srugbhāṇḍaparamā nityaṃ tretāgniśaraṇāḥ sadā । santaḥ satpathanityā ye te yānti paramāṃ gatim ॥17॥
html:
srugbhāṇḍaparamā nityaṃ tretāgniśaraṇāḥ sadā ।
santaḥ satpathanityā ye te yānti paramāṃ gatim ॥17॥
slp1: srugBARqaparamA nityaM tretAgniSaraRAH sadA । santaH satpaTanityA ye te yAnti paramAM gatim ॥17॥

text: brahmalokaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ somalokaṃ ca śāśvatam । gacchanti munayaḥ siddhā ṛṣidharmavyapāśrayāt ॥18॥
html:
brahmalokaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ somalokaṃ ca śāśvatam ।
gacchanti munayaḥ siddhā ṛṣidharmavyapāśrayāt ॥18॥
slp1: brahmalokaM mahApuRyaM somalokaM ca SASvatam । gacCanti munayaH sidDA fziDarmavyapASrayAt ॥18॥

text: eṣa dharmo mayā devi vānaprasthāśritaḥ śubhaḥ । vistareṇārthasampanno yathāsthūlamudāhṛtaḥ ॥19॥
html:
eṣa dharmo mayā devi vānaprasthāśritaḥ śubhaḥ ।
vistareṇārthasampanno yathāsthūlamudāhṛtaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: eza Darmo mayA devi vAnaprasTASritaH SuBaH । vistareRArTasampanno yaTAsTUlamudAhftaH ॥19॥

text: bhagavandevadeveśa sarvabhūtanamaskṛta । yo dharmo munisaṅghasya siddhivādeṣu taṃ vada ॥20॥
html:
bhagavandevadeveśa sarvabhūtanamaskṛta ।
yo dharmo munisaṅghasya siddhivādeṣu taṃ vada ॥20॥
slp1: BagavandevadeveSa sarvaBUtanamaskfta । yo Darmo munisaNGasya sidDivAdezu taM vada ॥20॥
author: umovāca ।

text: siddhivādeṣu saṃsiddhāstathā vananivāsinaḥ । svairiṇo dārasaṃyuktāsteṣāṃ dharmaḥ kathaṃ smṛtaḥ ॥21॥
html:
siddhivādeṣu saṃsiddhāstathā vananivāsinaḥ ।
svairiṇo dārasaṃyuktāsteṣāṃ dharmaḥ kathaṃ smṛtaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: sidDivAdezu saMsidDAstaTA vananivAsinaH । svEriRo dArasaMyuktAstezAM DarmaH kaTaM smftaH ॥21॥

text: svairiṇastāpasā devi sarve dāravihāriṇaḥ । teṣāṃ mauṇḍyaṃ kaṣāyaśca vāsarātriśca kāraṇam ॥22॥
html:
svairiṇastāpasā devi sarve dāravihāriṇaḥ ।
teṣāṃ mauṇḍyaṃ kaṣāyaśca vāsarātriśca kāraṇam ॥22॥
slp1: svEriRastApasA devi sarve dAravihAriRaH । tezAM mORqyaM kazAyaSca vAsarAtriSca kAraRam ॥22॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: trikālamabhiṣekaśca hotraṃ tvṛṣikṛtaṃ mahat । samādhiḥ satpathasthānaṃ yathoditaniṣevaṇam ॥23॥
html:
trikālamabhiṣekaśca hotraṃ tvṛṣikṛtaṃ mahat ।
samādhiḥ satpathasthānaṃ yathoditaniṣevaṇam ॥23॥
slp1: trikAlamaBizekaSca hotraM tvfzikftaM mahat । samADiH satpaTasTAnaM yaToditanizevaRam ॥23॥

text: ye ca te pūrvakathitā dharmā vananivāsinām । yadi sevanti dharmāṃstānāpnuvanti tapaḥphalam ॥24॥
html:
ye ca te pūrvakathitā dharmā vananivāsinām ।
yadi sevanti dharmāṃstānāpnuvanti tapaḥphalam ॥24॥
slp1: ye ca te pUrvakaTitA DarmA vananivAsinAm । yadi sevanti DarmAMstAnApnuvanti tapaHPalam ॥24॥

text: ye ca dampatidharmāṇaḥ svadāraniyatendriyāḥ । caranti vidhidṛṣṭaṃ tadṛtukālābhigāminaḥ ॥25॥
html:
ye ca dampatidharmāṇaḥ svadāraniyatendriyāḥ ।
caranti vidhidṛṣṭaṃ tadṛtukālābhigāminaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: ye ca dampatiDarmARaH svadAraniyatendriyAH । caranti viDidfzwaM tadftukAlABigAminaH ॥25॥

text: teṣāmṛṣikṛto dharmo dharmiṇāmupapadyate । na kāmakārātkāmo'nyaḥ saṃsevyo dharmadarśibhiḥ ॥26॥
html:
teṣāmṛṣikṛto dharmo dharmiṇāmupapadyate ।
na kāmakārātkāmo'nyaḥ saṃsevyo dharmadarśibhiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: tezAmfzikfto Darmo DarmiRAmupapadyate । na kAmakArAtkAmo'nyaH saMsevyo DarmadarSiBiH ॥26॥

text: sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ samyagdadātyabhayadakṣiṇām । hiṃsāroṣavimuktātmā sa vai dharmeṇa yujyate ॥27॥
html:
sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ samyagdadātyabhayadakṣiṇām ।
hiṃsāroṣavimuktātmā sa vai dharmeṇa yujyate ॥27॥
slp1: sarvaBUtezu yaH samyagdadAtyaBayadakziRAm । hiMsArozavimuktAtmA sa vE DarmeRa yujyate ॥27॥

text: sarvabhūtānukampī yaḥ sarvabhūtārjavavrataḥ । sarvabhūtātmabhūtaśca sa vai dharmeṇa yujyate ॥28॥
html:
sarvabhūtānukampī yaḥ sarvabhūtārjavavrataḥ ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtaśca sa vai dharmeṇa yujyate ॥28॥
slp1: sarvaBUtAnukampI yaH sarvaBUtArjavavrataH । sarvaBUtAtmaBUtaSca sa vE DarmeRa yujyate ॥28॥

text: sarvavedeṣu vā snānaṃ sarvabhūteṣu cārjavam । ubhe ete same syātāmārjavaṃ vā viśiṣyate ॥29॥
html:
sarvavedeṣu vā snānaṃ sarvabhūteṣu cārjavam ।
ubhe ete same syātāmārjavaṃ vā viśiṣyate ॥29॥
slp1: sarvavedezu vA snAnaM sarvaBUtezu cArjavam । uBe ete same syAtAmArjavaM vA viSizyate ॥29॥

text: ārjavaṃ dharma ityāhuradharmo jihma ucyate । ārjaveneha saṃyukto naro dharmeṇa yujyate ॥30॥
html:
ārjavaṃ dharma ityāhuradharmo jihma ucyate ।
ārjaveneha saṃyukto naro dharmeṇa yujyate ॥30॥
slp1: ArjavaM Darma ityAhuraDarmo jihma ucyate । Arjaveneha saMyukto naro DarmeRa yujyate ॥30॥

text: ārjavo bhuvane nityaṃ vasatyamarasannidhau । tasmādārjavanityaḥ syādya iccheddharmamātmanaḥ ॥31॥
html:
ārjavo bhuvane nityaṃ vasatyamarasannidhau ।
tasmādārjavanityaḥ syādya iccheddharmamātmanaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: Arjavo Buvane nityaM vasatyamarasanniDO । tasmAdArjavanityaH syAdya icCedDarmamAtmanaH ॥31॥

text: kṣānto dānto jitakrodho dharmabhūto'vihiṃsakaḥ । dharme ratamanā nityaṃ naro dharmeṇa yujyate ॥32॥
html:
kṣānto dānto jitakrodho dharmabhūto'vihiṃsakaḥ ।
dharme ratamanā nityaṃ naro dharmeṇa yujyate ॥32॥
slp1: kzAnto dAnto jitakroDo DarmaBUto'vihiMsakaH । Darme ratamanA nityaM naro DarmeRa yujyate ॥32॥

text: vyapetatandro dharmātmā śakyā satpathamāśritaḥ । cāritraparamo buddho brahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥33॥
html:
vyapetatandro dharmātmā śakyā satpathamāśritaḥ ।
cāritraparamo buddho brahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥33॥
slp1: vyapetatandro DarmAtmA SakyA satpaTamASritaH । cAritraparamo budDo brahmaBUyAya kalpate ॥33॥

text: āśramābhiratā deva tāpasā ye tapodhanāḥ । dīptimantaḥ kayā caiva caryayātha bhavanti te ॥34॥
html:
āśramābhiratā deva tāpasā ye tapodhanāḥ ।
dīptimantaḥ kayā caiva caryayātha bhavanti te ॥34॥
slp1: ASramABiratA deva tApasA ye tapoDanAH । dIptimantaH kayA cEva caryayATa Bavanti te ॥34॥
author: umovāca ।

text: rājāno rājaputrāśca nirdhanā vā mahādhanāḥ । karmaṇā kena bhagavanprāpnuvanti mahāphalam ॥35॥
html:
rājāno rājaputrāśca nirdhanā vā mahādhanāḥ ।
karmaṇā kena bhagavanprāpnuvanti mahāphalam ॥35॥
slp1: rAjAno rAjaputrASca nirDanA vA mahADanAH । karmaRA kena BagavanprApnuvanti mahAPalam ॥35॥

text: nityaṃ sthānamupāgamya divyacandanarūṣitāḥ । kena vā karmaṇā deva bhavanti vanagocarāḥ ॥36॥
html:
nityaṃ sthānamupāgamya divyacandanarūṣitāḥ ।
kena vā karmaṇā deva bhavanti vanagocarāḥ ॥36॥
slp1: nityaM sTAnamupAgamya divyacandanarUzitAH । kena vA karmaRA deva Bavanti vanagocarAH ॥36॥

text: etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ deva tapaścaryāgataṃ śubham । śaṃsa sarvamaśeṣeṇa tryakṣa tripuranāśana ॥37॥
html:
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ deva tapaścaryāgataṃ śubham ।
śaṃsa sarvamaśeṣeṇa tryakṣa tripuranāśana ॥37॥
slp1: etaM me saMSayaM deva tapaScaryAgataM SuBam । SaMsa sarvamaSezeRa tryakza tripuranASana ॥37॥

text: upavāsavratairdāntā ahiṃsrāḥ satyavādinaḥ । saṃsiddhāḥ pretya gandharvaiḥ saha modantyanāmayāḥ ॥38॥
html:
upavāsavratairdāntā ahiṃsrāḥ satyavādinaḥ ।
saṃsiddhāḥ pretya gandharvaiḥ saha modantyanāmayāḥ ॥38॥
slp1: upavAsavratErdAntA ahiMsrAH satyavAdinaH । saMsidDAH pretya ganDarvEH saha modantyanAmayAH ॥38॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: maṇḍūkayogaśayano yathāsthānaṃ yathāvidhi । dīkṣāṃ carati dharmātmā sa nāgaiḥ saha modate ॥39॥
html:
maṇḍūkayogaśayano yathāsthānaṃ yathāvidhi ।
dīkṣāṃ carati dharmātmā sa nāgaiḥ saha modate ॥39॥
slp1: maRqUkayogaSayano yaTAsTAnaM yaTAviDi । dIkzAM carati DarmAtmA sa nAgEH saha modate ॥39॥

text: śaṣpaṃ mṛgamukhotsṛṣṭaṃ yo mṛgaiḥ saha sevate । dīkṣito vai mudā yuktaḥ sa gacchatyamarāvatīm ॥40॥
html:
śaṣpaṃ mṛgamukhotsṛṣṭaṃ yo mṛgaiḥ saha sevate ।
dīkṣito vai mudā yuktaḥ sa gacchatyamarāvatīm ॥40॥
slp1: SazpaM mfgamuKotsfzwaM yo mfgEH saha sevate । dIkzito vE mudA yuktaH sa gacCatyamarAvatIm ॥40॥

text: śaivālaṃ śīrṇaparṇaṃ vā tadvrato yo niṣevate । śītayogavaho nityaṃ sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim ॥41॥
html:
śaivālaṃ śīrṇaparṇaṃ vā tadvrato yo niṣevate ।
śītayogavaho nityaṃ sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim ॥41॥
slp1: SEvAlaM SIrRaparRaM vA tadvrato yo nizevate । SItayogavaho nityaM sa gacCetparamAM gatim ॥41॥

text: vāyubhakṣo'mbubhakṣo vā phalamūlāśano'pi vā । yakṣeṣvaiśvaryamādhāya modate'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ॥42॥
html:
vāyubhakṣo'mbubhakṣo vā phalamūlāśano'pi vā ।
yakṣeṣvaiśvaryamādhāya modate'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ॥42॥
slp1: vAyuBakzo'mbuBakzo vA PalamUlASano'pi vA । yakzezvESvaryamADAya modate'psarasAM gaREH ॥42॥

text: agniyogavaho grīṣme vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā । cīrtvā dvādaśa varṣāṇi rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ ॥43॥
html:
agniyogavaho grīṣme vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ।
cīrtvā dvādaśa varṣāṇi rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: agniyogavaho grIzme viDidfzwena karmaRA । cIrtvA dvAdaSa varzARi rAjA Bavati pArTivaH ॥43॥

text: āhāraniyamaṃ kṛtvā munirdvādaśavārṣikam । maruṃ saṃsādhya yatnena rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ ॥44॥
html:
āhāraniyamaṃ kṛtvā munirdvādaśavārṣikam ।
maruṃ saṃsādhya yatnena rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ ॥44॥
slp1: AhAraniyamaM kftvA munirdvAdaSavArzikam । maruM saMsADya yatnena rAjA Bavati pArTivaH ॥44॥

text: sthaṇḍile śuddhamākāśaṃ parigṛhya samantataḥ । praviśya ca mudā yukto dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm ॥45॥
html:
sthaṇḍile śuddhamākāśaṃ parigṛhya samantataḥ ।
praviśya ca mudā yukto dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm ॥45॥
slp1: sTaRqile SudDamAkASaM parigfhya samantataH । praviSya ca mudA yukto dIkzAM dvAdaSavArzikIm ॥45॥

text: sthaṇḍilasya phalānyāhuryānāni śayanāni ca । gṛhāṇi ca mahārhāṇi candraśubhrāṇi bhāmini ॥46॥
html:
sthaṇḍilasya phalānyāhuryānāni śayanāni ca ।
gṛhāṇi ca mahārhāṇi candraśubhrāṇi bhāmini ॥46॥
slp1: sTaRqilasya PalAnyAhuryAnAni SayanAni ca । gfhARi ca mahArhARi candraSuBrARi BAmini ॥46॥

text: ātmānamupajīvanyo niyato niyatāśanaḥ । dehaṃ vānaśane tyaktvā sa svargaṃ samupāśnute ॥47॥
html:
ātmānamupajīvanyo niyato niyatāśanaḥ ।
dehaṃ vānaśane tyaktvā sa svargaṃ samupāśnute ॥47॥
slp1: AtmAnamupajIvanyo niyato niyatASanaH । dehaM vAnaSane tyaktvA sa svargaM samupASnute ॥47॥

text: ātmānamupajīvanyo dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm । tyaktvā mahārṇave dehaṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamaśnute ॥48॥
html:
ātmānamupajīvanyo dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm ।
tyaktvā mahārṇave dehaṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamaśnute ॥48॥
slp1: AtmAnamupajIvanyo dIkzAM dvAdaSavArzikIm । tyaktvA mahArRave dehaM vAruRaM lokamaSnute ॥48॥

text: ātmānamupajīvanyo dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm । aśmanā caraṇau bhittvā guhyakeṣu sa modate ॥49॥
html:
ātmānamupajīvanyo dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm ।
aśmanā caraṇau bhittvā guhyakeṣu sa modate ॥49॥
slp1: AtmAnamupajIvanyo dIkzAM dvAdaSavArzikIm । aSmanA caraRO BittvA guhyakezu sa modate ॥49॥

text: sādhayitvātmanātmānaṃ nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ । cīrtvā dvādaśa varṣāṇi dīkṣāmekāṃ manogatām । svargalokamavāpnoti devaiśca saha modate ॥50॥
html:
sādhayitvātmanātmānaṃ nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ ।
cīrtvā dvādaśa varṣāṇi dīkṣāmekāṃ manogatām ।
svargalokamavāpnoti devaiśca saha modate ॥50॥
slp1: sADayitvAtmanAtmAnaM nirdvandvo nizparigrahaH । cIrtvA dvAdaSa varzARi dIkzAmekAM manogatAm । svargalokamavApnoti devESca saha modate ॥50॥

text: ātmānamupajīvanyo dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm । hutvāgnau dehamutsṛjya vahniloke mahīyate ॥51॥
html:
ātmānamupajīvanyo dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm ।
hutvāgnau dehamutsṛjya vahniloke mahīyate ॥51॥
slp1: AtmAnamupajIvanyo dIkzAM dvAdaSavArzikIm । hutvAgnO dehamutsfjya vahniloke mahIyate ॥51॥

text: yastu devi yathānyāyaṃ dīkṣito niyato dvijaḥ । ātmanyātmānamādhāya nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ ॥52॥
html:
yastu devi yathānyāyaṃ dīkṣito niyato dvijaḥ ।
ātmanyātmānamādhāya nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ ॥52॥
slp1: yastu devi yaTAnyAyaM dIkzito niyato dvijaH । AtmanyAtmAnamADAya nirdvandvo nizparigrahaH ॥52॥

text: cīrtvā dvādaśa varṣāṇi dīkṣāmekāṃ manogatām । araṇīsahitaṃ skandhe baddhvā gacchatyanāvṛtaḥ ॥53॥
html:
cīrtvā dvādaśa varṣāṇi dīkṣāmekāṃ manogatām ।
araṇīsahitaṃ skandhe baddhvā gacchatyanāvṛtaḥ ॥53॥
slp1: cIrtvA dvAdaSa varzARi dIkzAmekAM manogatAm । araRIsahitaM skanDe badDvA gacCatyanAvftaH ॥53॥

text: vīrādhvānamanā nityaṃ vīrāsanaratastathā । vīrasthāyī ca satataṃ sa vīragatimāpnuyāt ॥54॥
html:
vīrādhvānamanā nityaṃ vīrāsanaratastathā ।
vīrasthāyī ca satataṃ sa vīragatimāpnuyāt ॥54॥
slp1: vIrADvAnamanA nityaM vIrAsanaratastaTA । vIrasTAyI ca satataM sa vIragatimApnuyAt ॥54॥

text: sa śakralokago nityaṃ sarvakāmapuraskṛtaḥ । divyapuṣpasamākīrṇo divyacandanabhūṣitaḥ । sukhaṃ vasati dharmātmā divi devagaṇaiḥ saha ॥55॥
html:
sa śakralokago nityaṃ sarvakāmapuraskṛtaḥ ।
divyapuṣpasamākīrṇo divyacandanabhūṣitaḥ ।
sukhaṃ vasati dharmātmā divi devagaṇaiḥ saha ॥55॥
slp1: sa Sakralokago nityaM sarvakAmapuraskftaH । divyapuzpasamAkIrRo divyacandanaBUzitaH । suKaM vasati DarmAtmA divi devagaREH saha ॥55॥

text: vīralokagato vīro vīrayogavahaḥ sadā । sattvasthaḥ sarvamutsṛjya dīkṣito niyataḥ śuciḥ । vīrādhvānaṃ prapadyedyastasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥56॥
html:
vīralokagato vīro vīrayogavahaḥ sadā ।
sattvasthaḥ sarvamutsṛjya dīkṣito niyataḥ śuciḥ ।
vīrādhvānaṃ prapadyedyastasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥56॥
slp1: vIralokagato vIro vIrayogavahaH sadA । sattvasTaH sarvamutsfjya dIkzito niyataH SuciH । vIrADvAnaM prapadyedyastasya lokAH sanAtanAH ॥56॥

text: kāmagena vimānena sa vai carati cchandataḥ । śakralokagataḥ śrīmānmodate ca nirāmayaḥ] ॥57॥
html:
kāmagena vimānena sa vai carati cchandataḥ ।
śakralokagataḥ śrīmānmodate ca nirāmayaḥ] ॥57॥
slp1: kAmagena vimAnena sa vE carati cCandataH । SakralokagataH SrImAnmodate ca nirAmayaH] ॥57॥

text: bhagavanbhaganetraghna pūṣṇo daśanapātana । dakṣakratuhara tryakṣa saṃśayo me mahānayam ॥1॥
html:
bhagavanbhaganetraghna pūṣṇo daśanapātana ।
dakṣakratuhara tryakṣa saṃśayo me mahānayam ॥1॥
slp1: BagavanBaganetraGna pUzRo daSanapAtana । dakzakratuhara tryakza saMSayo me mahAnayam ॥1॥
author: umovāca ।

text: cāturvarṇyaṃ bhagavatā pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayambhuvā । kena karmavipākena vaiśyo gacchati śūdratām ॥2॥
html:
cāturvarṇyaṃ bhagavatā pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayambhuvā ।
kena karmavipākena vaiśyo gacchati śūdratām ॥2॥
slp1: cAturvarRyaM BagavatA pUrvaM sfzwaM svayamBuvA । kena karmavipAkena vESyo gacCati SUdratAm ॥2॥

text: vaiśyo vā kṣatriyaḥ kena dvijo vā kṣatriyo bhavet । pratilomaḥ kathaṃ deva śakyo dharmo niṣevitum ॥3॥
html:
vaiśyo vā kṣatriyaḥ kena dvijo vā kṣatriyo bhavet ।
pratilomaḥ kathaṃ deva śakyo dharmo niṣevitum ॥3॥
slp1: vESyo vA kzatriyaH kena dvijo vA kzatriyo Bavet । pratilomaH kaTaM deva Sakyo Darmo nizevitum ॥3॥

text: kena vā karmaṇā vipraḥ śūdrayonau prajāyate । kṣatriyaḥ śūdratāmeti kena vā karmaṇā vibho ॥4॥
html:
kena vā karmaṇā vipraḥ śūdrayonau prajāyate ।
kṣatriyaḥ śūdratāmeti kena vā karmaṇā vibho ॥4॥
slp1: kena vA karmaRA vipraH SUdrayonO prajAyate । kzatriyaH SUdratAmeti kena vA karmaRA viBo ॥4॥

text: etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ deva vada bhūtapate'nagha । trayo varṇāḥ prakṛtyeha kathaṃ brāhmaṇyamāpnuyuḥ ॥5॥
html:
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ deva vada bhūtapate'nagha ।
trayo varṇāḥ prakṛtyeha kathaṃ brāhmaṇyamāpnuyuḥ ॥5॥
slp1: etaM me saMSayaM deva vada BUtapate'naGa । trayo varRAH prakftyeha kaTaM brAhmaRyamApnuyuH ॥5॥

text: brāhmaṇyaṃ devi duṣprāpaṃ nisargādbrāhmaṇaḥ śubhe । kṣatriyo vaiśyaśūdrau vā nisargāditi me matiḥ ॥6॥
html:
brāhmaṇyaṃ devi duṣprāpaṃ nisargādbrāhmaṇaḥ śubhe ।
kṣatriyo vaiśyaśūdrau vā nisargāditi me matiḥ ॥6॥
slp1: brAhmaRyaM devi duzprApaM nisargAdbrAhmaRaH SuBe । kzatriyo vESyaSUdrO vA nisargAditi me matiH ॥6॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: karmaṇā duṣkṛteneha sthānādbhraśyati vai dvijaḥ । jyeṣṭhaṃ varṇamanuprāpya tasmādrakṣeta vai dvijaḥ ॥7॥
html:
karmaṇā duṣkṛteneha sthānādbhraśyati vai dvijaḥ ।
jyeṣṭhaṃ varṇamanuprāpya tasmādrakṣeta vai dvijaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: karmaRA duzkfteneha sTAnAdBraSyati vE dvijaH । jyezWaM varRamanuprApya tasmAdrakzeta vE dvijaH ॥7॥

text: sthito brāhmaṇadharmeṇa brāhmaṇyamupajīvati । kṣatriyo vātha vaiśyo vā brahmabhūyāya gacchati ॥8॥
html:
sthito brāhmaṇadharmeṇa brāhmaṇyamupajīvati ।
kṣatriyo vātha vaiśyo vā brahmabhūyāya gacchati ॥8॥
slp1: sTito brAhmaRaDarmeRa brAhmaRyamupajIvati । kzatriyo vATa vESyo vA brahmaBUyAya gacCati ॥8॥

text: yastu vipratvamutsṛjya kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ niṣevate । brāhmaṇyātsa paribhraṣṭaḥ kṣatrayonau prajāyate ॥9॥
html:
yastu vipratvamutsṛjya kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ niṣevate ।
brāhmaṇyātsa paribhraṣṭaḥ kṣatrayonau prajāyate ॥9॥
slp1: yastu vipratvamutsfjya kzAtraM DarmaM nizevate । brAhmaRyAtsa pariBrazwaH kzatrayonO prajAyate ॥9॥

text: vaiśyakarma ca yo vipro lobhamohavyapāśrayaḥ । brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya karotyalpamatiḥ sadā ॥10॥
html:
vaiśyakarma ca yo vipro lobhamohavyapāśrayaḥ ।
brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya karotyalpamatiḥ sadā ॥10॥
slp1: vESyakarma ca yo vipro loBamohavyapASrayaH । brAhmaRyaM durlaBaM prApya karotyalpamatiH sadA ॥10॥

text: sa dvijo vaiśyatāmeti vaiśyo vā śūdratāmiyāt । svadharmātpracyuto viprastataḥ śūdratvamāpnute ॥11॥
html:
sa dvijo vaiśyatāmeti vaiśyo vā śūdratāmiyāt ।
svadharmātpracyuto viprastataḥ śūdratvamāpnute ॥11॥
slp1: sa dvijo vESyatAmeti vESyo vA SUdratAmiyAt । svaDarmAtpracyuto viprastataH SUdratvamApnute ॥11॥

text: tatrāsau nirayaṃ prāpto varṇabhraṣṭo bahiṣkṛtaḥ । brahmalokaparibhraṣṭaḥ śūdraḥ samupajāyate ॥12॥
html:
tatrāsau nirayaṃ prāpto varṇabhraṣṭo bahiṣkṛtaḥ ।
brahmalokaparibhraṣṭaḥ śūdraḥ samupajāyate ॥12॥
slp1: tatrAsO nirayaM prApto varRaBrazwo bahizkftaH । brahmalokapariBrazwaH SUdraH samupajAyate ॥12॥

text: kṣatriyo vā mahābhāge vaiśyo vā dharmacāriṇi । svāni karmāṇyapāhāya śūdrakarmāṇi sevate ॥13॥
html:
kṣatriyo vā mahābhāge vaiśyo vā dharmacāriṇi ।
svāni karmāṇyapāhāya śūdrakarmāṇi sevate ॥13॥
slp1: kzatriyo vA mahABAge vESyo vA DarmacAriRi । svAni karmARyapAhAya SUdrakarmARi sevate ॥13॥

text: svasthānātsa paribhraṣṭo varṇasaṅkaratāṃ gataḥ । brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdratvaṃ yāti tādṛśaḥ ॥14॥
html:
svasthānātsa paribhraṣṭo varṇasaṅkaratāṃ gataḥ ।
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdratvaṃ yāti tādṛśaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: svasTAnAtsa pariBrazwo varRasaNkaratAM gataH । brAhmaRaH kzatriyo vESyaH SUdratvaM yAti tAdfSaH ॥14॥

text: yastu śuddhaḥ svadharmeṇa jñānavijñānavāñśuciḥ । dharmajño dharmanirataḥ sa dharmaphalamaśnute ॥15॥
html:
yastu śuddhaḥ svadharmeṇa jñānavijñānavāñśuciḥ ।
dharmajño dharmanirataḥ sa dharmaphalamaśnute ॥15॥
slp1: yastu SudDaH svaDarmeRa jYAnavijYAnavAYSuciH । DarmajYo DarmanirataH sa DarmaPalamaSnute ॥15॥

text: idaṃ caivāparaṃ devi brahmaṇā samudīritam । adhyātmaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ sadbhirdharmakāmairniṣevyate ॥16॥
html:
idaṃ caivāparaṃ devi brahmaṇā samudīritam ।
adhyātmaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ sadbhirdharmakāmairniṣevyate ॥16॥
slp1: idaM cEvAparaM devi brahmaRA samudIritam । aDyAtmaM nEzWikaM sadBirDarmakAmErnizevyate ॥16॥

text: ugrānnaṃ garhitaṃ devi gaṇānnaṃ śrāddhasūtakam । ghuṣṭānnaṃ naiva bhoktavyaṃ śūdrānnaṃ naiva karhicit ॥17॥
html:
ugrānnaṃ garhitaṃ devi gaṇānnaṃ śrāddhasūtakam ।
ghuṣṭānnaṃ naiva bhoktavyaṃ śūdrānnaṃ naiva karhicit ॥17॥
slp1: ugrAnnaM garhitaM devi gaRAnnaM SrAdDasUtakam । GuzwAnnaM nEva BoktavyaM SUdrAnnaM nEva karhicit ॥17॥

text: śūdrānnaṃ garhitaṃ devi devadevairmahātmabhiḥ । pitāmahamukhotsṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇamiti me matiḥ ॥18॥
html:
śūdrānnaṃ garhitaṃ devi devadevairmahātmabhiḥ ।
pitāmahamukhotsṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇamiti me matiḥ ॥18॥
slp1: SUdrAnnaM garhitaM devi devadevErmahAtmaBiH । pitAmahamuKotsfzwaM pramARamiti me matiH ॥18॥

text: śūdrānnenāvaśeṣeṇa jaṭhare yo mriyeta vai । āhitāgnistathā yajvā sa śūdragatibhāgbhavet ॥19॥
html:
śūdrānnenāvaśeṣeṇa jaṭhare yo mriyeta vai ।
āhitāgnistathā yajvā sa śūdragatibhāgbhavet ॥19॥
slp1: SUdrAnnenAvaSezeRa jaWare yo mriyeta vE । AhitAgnistaTA yajvA sa SUdragatiBAgBavet ॥19॥

text: tena śūdrānnaśeṣeṇa brahmasthānādapākṛtaḥ । brāhmaṇaḥ śūdratāmeti nāsti tatra vicāraṇā ॥20॥
html:
tena śūdrānnaśeṣeṇa brahmasthānādapākṛtaḥ ।
brāhmaṇaḥ śūdratāmeti nāsti tatra vicāraṇā ॥20॥
slp1: tena SUdrAnnaSezeRa brahmasTAnAdapAkftaH । brAhmaRaH SUdratAmeti nAsti tatra vicAraRA ॥20॥

text: yasyānnenāvaśeṣeṇa jaṭhare yo mriyeta vai । tāṃ tāṃ yoniṃ vrajedvipro yasyānnamupajīvati ॥21॥
html:
yasyānnenāvaśeṣeṇa jaṭhare yo mriyeta vai ।
tāṃ tāṃ yoniṃ vrajedvipro yasyānnamupajīvati ॥21॥
slp1: yasyAnnenAvaSezeRa jaWare yo mriyeta vE । tAM tAM yoniM vrajedvipro yasyAnnamupajIvati ॥21॥

text: brāhmaṇatvaṃ śubhaṃ prāpya durlabhaṃ yo'vamanyate । abhojyānnāni cāśnāti sa dvijatvātpateta vai ॥22॥
html:
brāhmaṇatvaṃ śubhaṃ prāpya durlabhaṃ yo'vamanyate ।
abhojyānnāni cāśnāti sa dvijatvātpateta vai ॥22॥
slp1: brAhmaRatvaM SuBaM prApya durlaBaM yo'vamanyate । aBojyAnnAni cASnAti sa dvijatvAtpateta vE ॥22॥

text: surāpo brahmahā kṣudraścauro bhagnavrato'śuciḥ । svādhyāyavarjitaḥ pāpo lubdho naikṛtikaḥ śaṭhaḥ ॥23॥
html:
surāpo brahmahā kṣudraścauro bhagnavrato'śuciḥ ।
svādhyāyavarjitaḥ pāpo lubdho naikṛtikaḥ śaṭhaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: surApo brahmahA kzudraScOro Bagnavrato'SuciH । svADyAyavarjitaH pApo lubDo nEkftikaH SaWaH ॥23॥

text: avratī vṛṣalībhartā kuṇḍāśī somavikrayī । nihīnasevī vipro hi patati brahmayonitaḥ ॥24॥
html:
avratī vṛṣalībhartā kuṇḍāśī somavikrayī ।
nihīnasevī vipro hi patati brahmayonitaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: avratI vfzalIBartA kuRqASI somavikrayI । nihInasevI vipro hi patati brahmayonitaH ॥24॥

text: gurutalpī gurudveṣī gurukutsāratiśca yaḥ । brahmadviṭcāpi patati brāhmaṇo brahmayonitaḥ ॥25॥
html:
gurutalpī gurudveṣī gurukutsāratiśca yaḥ ।
brahmadviṭcāpi patati brāhmaṇo brahmayonitaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: gurutalpI gurudvezI gurukutsAratiSca yaH । brahmadviwcApi patati brAhmaRo brahmayonitaH ॥25॥

text: ebhistu karmabhirdevi śubhairācaritaistathā । śūdro brāhmaṇatāṃ gacchedvaiśyaḥ kṣatriyatāṃ vrajet ॥26॥
html:
ebhistu karmabhirdevi śubhairācaritaistathā ।
śūdro brāhmaṇatāṃ gacchedvaiśyaḥ kṣatriyatāṃ vrajet ॥26॥
slp1: eBistu karmaBirdevi SuBErAcaritEstaTA । SUdro brAhmaRatAM gacCedvESyaH kzatriyatAM vrajet ॥26॥

text: śūdrakarmāṇi sarvāṇi yathānyāyaṃ yathāvidhi । śuśrūṣāṃ paricaryāṃ ca jyeṣṭhe varṇe prayatnataḥ । kuryādavimanāḥ śūdraḥ satataṃ satpathe sthitaḥ ॥27॥
html:
śūdrakarmāṇi sarvāṇi yathānyāyaṃ yathāvidhi ।
śuśrūṣāṃ paricaryāṃ ca jyeṣṭhe varṇe prayatnataḥ ।
kuryādavimanāḥ śūdraḥ satataṃ satpathe sthitaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: SUdrakarmARi sarvARi yaTAnyAyaM yaTAviDi । SuSrUzAM paricaryAM ca jyezWe varRe prayatnataH । kuryAdavimanAH SUdraH satataM satpaTe sTitaH ॥27॥

text: daivatadvijasatkartā sarvātithyakṛtavrataḥ । ṛtukālābhigāmī ca niyato niyatāśanaḥ ॥28॥
html:
daivatadvijasatkartā sarvātithyakṛtavrataḥ ।
ṛtukālābhigāmī ca niyato niyatāśanaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: dEvatadvijasatkartA sarvAtiTyakftavrataH । ftukAlABigAmI ca niyato niyatASanaH ॥28॥

text: caukṣaścaukṣajanānveṣī śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ । vṛthāmāṃsānyabhuñjānaḥ śūdro vaiśyatvamṛcchati ॥29॥
html:
caukṣaścaukṣajanānveṣī śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ ।
vṛthāmāṃsānyabhuñjānaḥ śūdro vaiśyatvamṛcchati ॥29॥
slp1: cOkzaScOkzajanAnvezI SezAnnakftaBojanaH । vfTAmAMsAnyaBuYjAnaH SUdro vESyatvamfcCati ॥29॥

text: ṛtavāganahaṃvādī nirdvandvaḥ śamakovidaḥ । yajate nityayajñaiśca svādhyāyaparamaḥ śuciḥ ॥30॥
html:
ṛtavāganahaṃvādī nirdvandvaḥ śamakovidaḥ ।
yajate nityayajñaiśca svādhyāyaparamaḥ śuciḥ ॥30॥
slp1: ftavAganahaMvAdI nirdvandvaH SamakovidaH । yajate nityayajYESca svADyAyaparamaH SuciH ॥30॥

text: dānto brāhmaṇasatkartā sarvavarṇabubhūṣakaḥ । gṛhasthavratamātiṣṭhandvikālakṛtabhojanaḥ ॥31॥
html:
dānto brāhmaṇasatkartā sarvavarṇabubhūṣakaḥ ।
gṛhasthavratamātiṣṭhandvikālakṛtabhojanaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: dAnto brAhmaRasatkartA sarvavarRabuBUzakaH । gfhasTavratamAtizWandvikAlakftaBojanaH ॥31॥

text: śeṣāśī vijitāhāro niṣkāmo nirahaṃvadaḥ । agnihotramupāsaṃśca juhvānaśca yathāvidhi ॥32॥
html:
śeṣāśī vijitāhāro niṣkāmo nirahaṃvadaḥ ।
agnihotramupāsaṃśca juhvānaśca yathāvidhi ॥32॥
slp1: SezASI vijitAhAro nizkAmo nirahaMvadaH । agnihotramupAsaMSca juhvAnaSca yaTAviDi ॥32॥

text: sarvātithyamupātiṣṭhañśeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ । tretāgnimantravihito vaiśyo bhavati vai yadi । sa vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyakule śucau mahati jāyate ॥33॥
html:
sarvātithyamupātiṣṭhañśeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ ।
tretāgnimantravihito vaiśyo bhavati vai yadi ।
sa vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyakule śucau mahati jāyate ॥33॥
slp1: sarvAtiTyamupAtizWaYSezAnnakftaBojanaH । tretAgnimantravihito vESyo Bavati vE yadi । sa vESyaH kzatriyakule SucO mahati jAyate ॥33॥

text: sa vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyo jāto janmaprabhṛti saṃskṛtaḥ । upanīto vrataparo dvijo bhavati satkṛtaḥ ॥34॥
html:
sa vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyo jāto janmaprabhṛti saṃskṛtaḥ ।
upanīto vrataparo dvijo bhavati satkṛtaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: sa vESyaH kzatriyo jAto janmapraBfti saMskftaH । upanIto vrataparo dvijo Bavati satkftaH ॥34॥

text: dadāti yajate yajñaiḥ saṃskṛtairāptadakṣiṇaiḥ । adhīte svargamanvicchaṃstretāgniśaraṇaḥ sadā ॥35॥
html:
dadāti yajate yajñaiḥ saṃskṛtairāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ।
adhīte svargamanvicchaṃstretāgniśaraṇaḥ sadā ॥35॥
slp1: dadAti yajate yajYEH saMskftErAptadakziREH । aDIte svargamanvicCaMstretAgniSaraRaH sadA ॥35॥

text: ārtahastaprado nityaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan । satyaḥ satyāni kurute nityaṃ yaḥ sukhadarśanaḥ ॥36॥
html:
ārtahastaprado nityaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ।
satyaḥ satyāni kurute nityaṃ yaḥ sukhadarśanaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: Artahastaprado nityaM prajA DarmeRa pAlayan । satyaH satyAni kurute nityaM yaH suKadarSanaH ॥36॥

text: dharmadaṇḍo na nirdaṇḍo dharmakāryānuśāsakaḥ । yantritaḥ kāryakaraṇe ṣaḍbhāgakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ ॥37॥
html:
dharmadaṇḍo na nirdaṇḍo dharmakāryānuśāsakaḥ ।
yantritaḥ kāryakaraṇe ṣaḍbhāgakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: DarmadaRqo na nirdaRqo DarmakAryAnuSAsakaH । yantritaH kAryakaraRe zaqBAgakftalakzaRaH ॥37॥

text: grāmyadharmānna seveta svacchandenārthakovidaḥ । ṛtukāle tu dharmātmā patnīṃ seveta nityadā ॥38॥
html:
grāmyadharmānna seveta svacchandenārthakovidaḥ ।
ṛtukāle tu dharmātmā patnīṃ seveta nityadā ॥38॥
slp1: grAmyaDarmAnna seveta svacCandenArTakovidaH । ftukAle tu DarmAtmA patnIM seveta nityadA ॥38॥

text: sarvopavāsī niyataḥ svādhyāyaparamaḥ śuciḥ । barhiṣkāntarite nityaṃ śayāno'gnigṛhe sadā ॥39॥
html:
sarvopavāsī niyataḥ svādhyāyaparamaḥ śuciḥ ।
barhiṣkāntarite nityaṃ śayāno'gnigṛhe sadā ॥39॥
slp1: sarvopavAsI niyataH svADyAyaparamaH SuciH । barhizkAntarite nityaM SayAno'gnigfhe sadA ॥39॥

text: sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya kurvāṇaḥ sumanāḥ sadā । śūdrāṇāṃ cānnakāmānāṃ nityaṃ siddhamiti bruvan ॥40॥
html:
sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya kurvāṇaḥ sumanāḥ sadā ।
śūdrāṇāṃ cānnakāmānāṃ nityaṃ siddhamiti bruvan ॥40॥
slp1: sarvAtiTyaM trivargasya kurvARaH sumanAH sadA । SUdrARAM cAnnakAmAnAM nityaM sidDamiti bruvan ॥40॥

text: svārthādvā yadi vā kāmānna kiñcidupalakṣayet । pitṛdevātithikṛte sādhanaṃ kurute ca yaḥ ॥41॥
html:
svārthādvā yadi vā kāmānna kiñcidupalakṣayet ।
pitṛdevātithikṛte sādhanaṃ kurute ca yaḥ ॥41॥
slp1: svArTAdvA yadi vA kAmAnna kiYcidupalakzayet । pitfdevAtiTikfte sADanaM kurute ca yaH ॥41॥

text: svaveśmani yathānyāyamupāste bhaikṣameva ca । trikālamagnihotraṃ ca juhvāno vai yathāvidhi ॥42॥
html:
svaveśmani yathānyāyamupāste bhaikṣameva ca ।
trikālamagnihotraṃ ca juhvāno vai yathāvidhi ॥42॥
slp1: svaveSmani yaTAnyAyamupAste BEkzameva ca । trikAlamagnihotraM ca juhvAno vE yaTAviDi ॥42॥

text: gobrāhmaṇahitārthāya raṇe cābhimukho hataḥ । tretāgnimantrapūtaṃ vā samāviśya dvijo bhavet ॥43॥
html:
gobrāhmaṇahitārthāya raṇe cābhimukho hataḥ ।
tretāgnimantrapūtaṃ vā samāviśya dvijo bhavet ॥43॥
slp1: gobrAhmaRahitArTAya raRe cABimuKo hataH । tretAgnimantrapUtaM vA samAviSya dvijo Bavet ॥43॥

text: jñānavijñānasampannaḥ saṃskṛto vedapāragaḥ । vipro bhavati dharmātmā kṣatriyaḥ svena karmaṇā ॥44॥
html:
jñānavijñānasampannaḥ saṃskṛto vedapāragaḥ ।
vipro bhavati dharmātmā kṣatriyaḥ svena karmaṇā ॥44॥
slp1: jYAnavijYAnasampannaH saMskfto vedapAragaH । vipro Bavati DarmAtmA kzatriyaH svena karmaRA ॥44॥

text: etaiḥ karmaphalairdevi nyūnajātikulodbhavaḥ । śūdro'pyāgamasampanno dvijo bhavati saṃskṛtaḥ ॥45॥
html:
etaiḥ karmaphalairdevi nyūnajātikulodbhavaḥ ।
śūdro'pyāgamasampanno dvijo bhavati saṃskṛtaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: etEH karmaPalErdevi nyUnajAtikulodBavaH । SUdro'pyAgamasampanno dvijo Bavati saMskftaH ॥45॥

text: brāhmaṇo vāpyasadvṛttaḥ sarvasaṅkarabhojanaḥ । brāhmaṇyaṃ puṇyamutsṛjya śūdro bhavati tādṛśaḥ ॥46॥
html:
brāhmaṇo vāpyasadvṛttaḥ sarvasaṅkarabhojanaḥ ।
brāhmaṇyaṃ puṇyamutsṛjya śūdro bhavati tādṛśaḥ ॥46॥
slp1: brAhmaRo vApyasadvfttaH sarvasaNkaraBojanaH । brAhmaRyaM puRyamutsfjya SUdro Bavati tAdfSaH ॥46॥

text: karmabhiḥ śucibhirdevi śuddhātmā vijitendriyaḥ । śūdro'pi dvijavatsevya iti brahmābravītsvayam ॥47॥
html:
karmabhiḥ śucibhirdevi śuddhātmā vijitendriyaḥ ।
śūdro'pi dvijavatsevya iti brahmābravītsvayam ॥47॥
slp1: karmaBiH SuciBirdevi SudDAtmA vijitendriyaH । SUdro'pi dvijavatsevya iti brahmAbravItsvayam ॥47॥

text: svabhāvakarma ca śubhaṃ yatra śūdre'pi tiṣṭhati । viśuddhaḥ sa dvijātirvai vijñeya iti me matiḥ ॥48॥
html:
svabhāvakarma ca śubhaṃ yatra śūdre'pi tiṣṭhati ।
viśuddhaḥ sa dvijātirvai vijñeya iti me matiḥ ॥48॥
slp1: svaBAvakarma ca SuBaM yatra SUdre'pi tizWati । viSudDaH sa dvijAtirvE vijYeya iti me matiH ॥48॥

text: na yonirnāpi saṃskāro na śrutaṃ na ca sannatiḥ । kāraṇāni dvijatvasya vṛttameva tu kāraṇam ॥49॥
html:
na yonirnāpi saṃskāro na śrutaṃ na ca sannatiḥ ।
kāraṇāni dvijatvasya vṛttameva tu kāraṇam ॥49॥
slp1: na yonirnApi saMskAro na SrutaM na ca sannatiH । kAraRAni dvijatvasya vfttameva tu kAraRam ॥49॥

text: sarvo'yaṃ brāhmaṇo loke vṛttena tu vidhīyate । vṛtte sthitaśca suśroṇi brāhmaṇatvaṃ nigacchati ॥50॥
html:
sarvo'yaṃ brāhmaṇo loke vṛttena tu vidhīyate ।
vṛtte sthitaśca suśroṇi brāhmaṇatvaṃ nigacchati ॥50॥
slp1: sarvo'yaM brAhmaRo loke vfttena tu viDIyate । vftte sTitaSca suSroRi brAhmaRatvaM nigacCati ॥50॥

text: brāhmaḥ svabhāvaḥ kalyāṇi samaḥ sarvatra me matiḥ । nirguṇaṃ nirmalaṃ brahma yatra tiṣṭhati sa dvijaḥ ॥51॥
html:
brāhmaḥ svabhāvaḥ kalyāṇi samaḥ sarvatra me matiḥ ।
nirguṇaṃ nirmalaṃ brahma yatra tiṣṭhati sa dvijaḥ ॥51॥
slp1: brAhmaH svaBAvaH kalyARi samaH sarvatra me matiH । nirguRaM nirmalaM brahma yatra tizWati sa dvijaH ॥51॥

text: ete yoniphalā devi sthānabhāganidarśakāḥ । svayaṃ ca varadenoktā brahmaṇā sṛjatā prajāḥ ॥52॥
html:
ete yoniphalā devi sthānabhāganidarśakāḥ ।
svayaṃ ca varadenoktā brahmaṇā sṛjatā prajāḥ ॥52॥
slp1: ete yoniPalA devi sTAnaBAganidarSakAH । svayaM ca varadenoktA brahmaRA sfjatA prajAH ॥52॥

text: brāhmaṇo hi mahatkṣetraṃ loke carati pādavat । yattatra bījaṃ vapati sā kṛṣiḥ pāralaukikī ॥53॥
html:
brāhmaṇo hi mahatkṣetraṃ loke carati pādavat ।
yattatra bījaṃ vapati sā kṛṣiḥ pāralaukikī ॥53॥
slp1: brAhmaRo hi mahatkzetraM loke carati pAdavat । yattatra bIjaM vapati sA kfziH pAralOkikI ॥53॥

text: mitāśinā sadā bhāvyaṃ satpathālambinā sadā । brāhmamārgamatikramya vartitavyaṃ bubhūṣatā ॥54॥
html:
mitāśinā sadā bhāvyaṃ satpathālambinā sadā ।
brāhmamārgamatikramya vartitavyaṃ bubhūṣatā ॥54॥
slp1: mitASinA sadA BAvyaM satpaTAlambinA sadA । brAhmamArgamatikramya vartitavyaM buBUzatA ॥54॥

text: saṃhitādhyāyinā bhāvyaṃ gṛhe vai gṛhamedhinā । nityaṃ svādhyāyayuktena dānādhyayanajīvinā ॥55॥
html:
saṃhitādhyāyinā bhāvyaṃ gṛhe vai gṛhamedhinā ।
nityaṃ svādhyāyayuktena dānādhyayanajīvinā ॥55॥
slp1: saMhitADyAyinA BAvyaM gfhe vE gfhameDinA । nityaM svADyAyayuktena dAnADyayanajIvinA ॥55॥

text: evambhūto hi yo vipraḥ satataṃ satpathe sthitaḥ । āhitāgniradhīyāno brahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥56॥
html:
evambhūto hi yo vipraḥ satataṃ satpathe sthitaḥ ।
āhitāgniradhīyāno brahmabhūyāya kalpate ॥56॥
slp1: evamBUto hi yo vipraH satataM satpaTe sTitaH । AhitAgniraDIyAno brahmaBUyAya kalpate ॥56॥

text: brāhmaṇyameva samprāpya rakṣitavyaṃ yatātmabhiḥ । yonipratigrahādānaiḥ karmabhiśca śucismite ॥57॥
html:
brāhmaṇyameva samprāpya rakṣitavyaṃ yatātmabhiḥ ।
yonipratigrahādānaiḥ karmabhiśca śucismite ॥57॥
slp1: brAhmaRyameva samprApya rakzitavyaM yatAtmaBiH । yonipratigrahAdAnEH karmaBiSca Sucismite ॥57॥

text: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yathā śūdro bhaveddvijaḥ । brāhmaṇo vā cyuto dharmādyathā śūdratvamāpnute] ॥58॥
html:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yathā śūdro bhaveddvijaḥ ।
brāhmaṇo vā cyuto dharmādyathā śūdratvamāpnute] ॥58॥
slp1: etatte sarvamAKyAtaM yaTA SUdro BaveddvijaH । brAhmaRo vA cyuto DarmAdyaTA SUdratvamApnute] ॥58॥

text: bhagavansarvabhūteśa surāsuranamaskṛta । dharmādharme nṛṇāṃ deva brūhi me saṃśayaṃ vibho ॥1॥
html:
bhagavansarvabhūteśa surāsuranamaskṛta ।
dharmādharme nṛṇāṃ deva brūhi me saṃśayaṃ vibho ॥1॥
slp1: BagavansarvaBUteSa surAsuranamaskfta । DarmADarme nfRAM deva brUhi me saMSayaM viBo ॥1॥
author: umovāca ।

text: karmaṇā manasā vācā trividhaṃ hi naraḥ sadā । badhyate bandhanaiḥ pāśairmucyate'pyatha vā punaḥ ॥2॥
html:
karmaṇā manasā vācā trividhaṃ hi naraḥ sadā ।
badhyate bandhanaiḥ pāśairmucyate'pyatha vā punaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: karmaRA manasA vAcA triviDaM hi naraH sadA । baDyate banDanEH pASErmucyate'pyaTa vA punaH ॥2॥

text: kena śīlena vā deva karmaṇā kīdṛśena vā । samācārairguṇairvākyaiḥ svargaṃ yāntīha mānavāḥ ॥3॥
html:
kena śīlena vā deva karmaṇā kīdṛśena vā ।
samācārairguṇairvākyaiḥ svargaṃ yāntīha mānavāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: kena SIlena vA deva karmaRA kIdfSena vA । samAcArErguRErvAkyEH svargaM yAntIha mAnavAH ॥3॥

text: devi dharmārthatattvajñe satyanitye dame rate । sarvaprāṇihitaḥ praśnaḥ śrūyatāṃ buddhivardhanaḥ ॥4॥
html:
devi dharmārthatattvajñe satyanitye dame rate ।
sarvaprāṇihitaḥ praśnaḥ śrūyatāṃ buddhivardhanaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: devi DarmArTatattvajYe satyanitye dame rate । sarvaprARihitaH praSnaH SrUyatAM budDivarDanaH ॥4॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: satyadharmaratāḥ santaḥ sarvalipsāvivarjitāḥ । nādharmeṇa na dharmeṇa badhyante chinnasaṃśayāḥ ॥5॥
html:
satyadharmaratāḥ santaḥ sarvalipsāvivarjitāḥ ।
nādharmeṇa na dharmeṇa badhyante chinnasaṃśayāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: satyaDarmaratAH santaH sarvalipsAvivarjitAH । nADarmeRa na DarmeRa baDyante CinnasaMSayAH ॥5॥

text: pralayotpattitattvajñāḥ sarvajñāḥ samadarśinaḥ । vītarāgā vimucyante puruṣāḥ sarvabandhanaiḥ ॥6॥
html:
pralayotpattitattvajñāḥ sarvajñāḥ samadarśinaḥ ।
vītarāgā vimucyante puruṣāḥ sarvabandhanaiḥ ॥6॥
slp1: pralayotpattitattvajYAH sarvajYAH samadarSinaH । vItarAgA vimucyante puruzAH sarvabanDanEH ॥6॥

text: karmaṇā manasā vācā ye na hiṃsanti kiñcana । ye na sajjanti kasmiṃścidbadhyante te na karmabhiḥ ॥7॥
html:
karmaṇā manasā vācā ye na hiṃsanti kiñcana ।
ye na sajjanti kasmiṃścidbadhyante te na karmabhiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: karmaRA manasA vAcA ye na hiMsanti kiYcana । ye na sajjanti kasmiMScidbaDyante te na karmaBiH ॥7॥

text: prāṇātipātādviratāḥ śīlavanto dayānvitāḥ । tulyadveṣyapriyā dāntā mucyante karmabandhanaiḥ ॥8॥
html:
prāṇātipātādviratāḥ śīlavanto dayānvitāḥ ।
tulyadveṣyapriyā dāntā mucyante karmabandhanaiḥ ॥8॥
slp1: prARAtipAtAdviratAH SIlavanto dayAnvitAH । tulyadvezyapriyA dAntA mucyante karmabanDanEH ॥8॥

text: sarvabhūtadayāvanto viśvāsyāḥ sarvajantuṣu । tyaktahiṃsāsamācārāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥9॥
html:
sarvabhūtadayāvanto viśvāsyāḥ sarvajantuṣu ।
tyaktahiṃsāsamācārāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sarvaBUtadayAvanto viSvAsyAH sarvajantuzu । tyaktahiMsAsamAcArAste narAH svargagAminaH ॥9॥

text: parasve nirmamā nityaṃ paradāravivarjakāḥ । dharmalabdhārthabhoktāraste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥10॥
html:
parasve nirmamā nityaṃ paradāravivarjakāḥ ।
dharmalabdhārthabhoktāraste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: parasve nirmamA nityaM paradAravivarjakAH । DarmalabDArTaBoktAraste narAH svargagAminaH ॥10॥

text: mātṛvatsvasṛvaccaiva nityaṃ duhitṛvacca ye । paradāreṣu vartante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥11॥
html:
mātṛvatsvasṛvaccaiva nityaṃ duhitṛvacca ye ।
paradāreṣu vartante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: mAtfvatsvasfvaccEva nityaM duhitfvacca ye । paradArezu vartante te narAH svargagAminaH ॥11॥

text: stainyānnivṛttāḥ satataṃ santuṣṭāḥ svadhanena ca । svabhāgyānyupajīvanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥12॥
html:
stainyānnivṛttāḥ satataṃ santuṣṭāḥ svadhanena ca ।
svabhāgyānyupajīvanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: stEnyAnnivfttAH satataM santuzwAH svaDanena ca । svaBAgyAnyupajIvanti te narAH svargagAminaH ॥12॥

text: svadāraniratā ye ca ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ । agrāmyasukhabhogāśca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥13॥
html:
svadāraniratā ye ca ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ ।
agrāmyasukhabhogāśca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: svadAraniratA ye ca ftukAlABigAminaH । agrAmyasuKaBogASca te narAH svargagAminaH ॥13॥

text: paradāreṣu ye nityaṃ cāritrāvṛtalocanāḥ । yatendriyāḥ śīlaparāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥14॥
html:
paradāreṣu ye nityaṃ cāritrāvṛtalocanāḥ ।
yatendriyāḥ śīlaparāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: paradArezu ye nityaM cAritrAvftalocanAH । yatendriyAH SIlaparAste narAH svargagAminaH ॥14॥

text: eṣa devakṛto mārgaḥ sevitavyaḥ sadā naraiḥ । akaṣāyakṛtaścaiva mārgaḥ sevyaḥ sadā budhaiḥ ॥15॥
html:
eṣa devakṛto mārgaḥ sevitavyaḥ sadā naraiḥ ।
akaṣāyakṛtaścaiva mārgaḥ sevyaḥ sadā budhaiḥ ॥15॥
slp1: eza devakfto mArgaH sevitavyaH sadA narEH । akazAyakftaScEva mArgaH sevyaH sadA buDEH ॥15॥

text: dānadharmatapoyuktaḥ śīlaśaucadayātmakaḥ । vṛttyarthaṃ dharmahetorvā sevitavyaḥ sadā naraiḥ । svargavāsamabhīpsadbhirna sevyastvata uttaraḥ ॥16॥
html:
dānadharmatapoyuktaḥ śīlaśaucadayātmakaḥ ।
vṛttyarthaṃ dharmahetorvā sevitavyaḥ sadā naraiḥ ।
svargavāsamabhīpsadbhirna sevyastvata uttaraḥ ॥16॥
slp1: dAnaDarmatapoyuktaH SIlaSOcadayAtmakaH । vfttyarTaM DarmahetorvA sevitavyaH sadA narEH । svargavAsamaBIpsadBirna sevyastvata uttaraH ॥16॥

text: vācātha badhyate yena mucyate'pyatha vā punaḥ । tāni karmāṇi me deva vada bhūtapate'nagha ॥17॥
html:
vācātha badhyate yena mucyate'pyatha vā punaḥ ।
tāni karmāṇi me deva vada bhūtapate'nagha ॥17॥
slp1: vAcATa baDyate yena mucyate'pyaTa vA punaH । tAni karmARi me deva vada BUtapate'naGa ॥17॥
author: umovāca ।

text: ātmahetoḥ parārthe vā narmahāsyāśrayāttathā । ye mṛṣā na vadantīha te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥18॥
html:
ātmahetoḥ parārthe vā narmahāsyāśrayāttathā ।
ye mṛṣā na vadantīha te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: AtmahetoH parArTe vA narmahAsyASrayAttaTA । ye mfzA na vadantIha te narAH svargagAminaH ॥18॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: vṛttyarthaṃ dharmahetorvā kāmakārāttathaiva ca । anṛtaṃ ye na bhāṣante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥19॥
html:
vṛttyarthaṃ dharmahetorvā kāmakārāttathaiva ca ।
anṛtaṃ ye na bhāṣante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: vfttyarTaM DarmahetorvA kAmakArAttaTEva ca । anftaM ye na BAzante te narAH svargagAminaH ॥19॥

text: ślakṣṇāṃ vāṇīṃ nirābādhāṃ madhurāṃ pāpavarjitām । svāgatenābhibhāṣante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥20॥
html:
ślakṣṇāṃ vāṇīṃ nirābādhāṃ madhurāṃ pāpavarjitām ।
svāgatenābhibhāṣante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: SlakzRAM vARIM nirAbADAM maDurAM pApavarjitAm । svAgatenABiBAzante te narAH svargagAminaH ॥20॥

text: kaṭukāṃ ye na bhāṣante paruṣāṃ niṣṭhurāṃ giram । apaiśunyaratāḥ santaste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥21॥
html:
kaṭukāṃ ye na bhāṣante paruṣāṃ niṣṭhurāṃ giram ।
apaiśunyaratāḥ santaste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: kawukAM ye na BAzante paruzAM nizWurAM giram । apESunyaratAH santaste narAH svargagAminaH ॥21॥

text: piśunāṃ ye na bhāṣante mitrabhedakarīṃ giram । ṛtāṃ maitrīṃ prabhāṣante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥22॥
html:
piśunāṃ ye na bhāṣante mitrabhedakarīṃ giram ।
ṛtāṃ maitrīṃ prabhāṣante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: piSunAM ye na BAzante mitraBedakarIM giram । ftAM mEtrIM praBAzante te narAH svargagAminaH ॥22॥

text: varjayanti sadā sūcyaṃ paradrohaṃ ca mānavāḥ । sarvabhūtasamā dāntāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥23॥
html:
varjayanti sadā sūcyaṃ paradrohaṃ ca mānavāḥ ।
sarvabhūtasamā dāntāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: varjayanti sadA sUcyaM paradrohaM ca mAnavAH । sarvaBUtasamA dAntAste narAH svargagAminaH ॥23॥

text: śaṭhapralāpādviratā viruddhaparivarjakāḥ । saumyapralāpino nityaṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥24॥
html:
śaṭhapralāpādviratā viruddhaparivarjakāḥ ।
saumyapralāpino nityaṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: SaWapralApAdviratA virudDaparivarjakAH । sOmyapralApino nityaM te narAH svargagAminaH ॥24॥

text: na kopādvyāharante ye vācaṃ hṛdayadāraṇīm । sāntvaṃ vadanti kruddhāpi te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥25॥
html:
na kopādvyāharante ye vācaṃ hṛdayadāraṇīm ।
sāntvaṃ vadanti kruddhāpi te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: na kopAdvyAharante ye vAcaM hfdayadAraRIm । sAntvaM vadanti krudDApi te narAH svargagAminaH ॥25॥

text: eṣa vāṇīkṛto devi dharmaḥ sevyaḥ sadā naraiḥ । śubhaḥ satyaguṇo nityaṃ varjanīyā mṛṣā budhaiḥ ॥26॥
html:
eṣa vāṇīkṛto devi dharmaḥ sevyaḥ sadā naraiḥ ।
śubhaḥ satyaguṇo nityaṃ varjanīyā mṛṣā budhaiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: eza vARIkfto devi DarmaH sevyaH sadA narEH । SuBaH satyaguRo nityaM varjanIyA mfzA buDEH ॥26॥

text: manasā badhyate yena karmaṇā puruṣaḥ sadā । tanme brūhi mahābhāga devadeva pinākadhṛk ॥27॥
html:
manasā badhyate yena karmaṇā puruṣaḥ sadā ।
tanme brūhi mahābhāga devadeva pinākadhṛk ॥27॥
slp1: manasA baDyate yena karmaRA puruzaH sadA । tanme brUhi mahABAga devadeva pinAkaDfk ॥27॥
author: umovāca ।

text: mānaseneha dharmeṇa saṃyuktāḥ puruṣāḥ sadā । svargaṃ gacchanti kalyāṇi tanme kīrtayataḥ śṛṇu ॥28॥
html:
mānaseneha dharmeṇa saṃyuktāḥ puruṣāḥ sadā ।
svargaṃ gacchanti kalyāṇi tanme kīrtayataḥ śṛṇu ॥28॥
slp1: mAnaseneha DarmeRa saMyuktAH puruzAH sadA । svargaM gacCanti kalyARi tanme kIrtayataH SfRu ॥28॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: duṣpraṇītena manasā duṣpraṇītatarākṛtiḥ । badhyate mānavo yena śṛṇu cānyacchubhānane ॥29॥
html:
duṣpraṇītena manasā duṣpraṇītatarākṛtiḥ ।
badhyate mānavo yena śṛṇu cānyacchubhānane ॥29॥
slp1: duzpraRItena manasA duzpraRItatarAkftiH । baDyate mAnavo yena SfRu cAnyacCuBAnane ॥29॥

text: araṇye vijane nyastaṃ parasvaṃ vīkṣya ye narāḥ । manasāpi na hiṃsanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥30॥
html:
araṇye vijane nyastaṃ parasvaṃ vīkṣya ye narāḥ ।
manasāpi na hiṃsanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥30॥
slp1: araRye vijane nyastaM parasvaM vIkzya ye narAH । manasApi na hiMsanti te narAH svargagAminaH ॥30॥

text: grāme gṛhe vā yaddravyaṃ pārakyaṃ vijane sthitam । nābhinandanti vai nityaṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥31॥
html:
grāme gṛhe vā yaddravyaṃ pārakyaṃ vijane sthitam ।
nābhinandanti vai nityaṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: grAme gfhe vA yaddravyaM pArakyaM vijane sTitam । nABinandanti vE nityaM te narAH svargagAminaH ॥31॥

text: tathaiva paradārānye kāmavṛttānrahogatān । manasāpi na hiṃsanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥32॥
html:
tathaiva paradārānye kāmavṛttānrahogatān ।
manasāpi na hiṃsanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: taTEva paradArAnye kAmavfttAnrahogatAn । manasApi na hiMsanti te narAH svargagAminaH ॥32॥

text: śatruṃ mitraṃ ca ye nityaṃ tulyena manasā narāḥ । bhajanti maitrāḥ saṅgamya te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥33॥
html:
śatruṃ mitraṃ ca ye nityaṃ tulyena manasā narāḥ ।
bhajanti maitrāḥ saṅgamya te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: SatruM mitraM ca ye nityaM tulyena manasA narAH । Bajanti mEtrAH saNgamya te narAH svargagAminaH ॥33॥

text: śrutavanto dayāvantaḥ śucayaḥ satyasaṅgarāḥ । svairarthaiḥ parisantuṣṭāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥34॥
html:
śrutavanto dayāvantaḥ śucayaḥ satyasaṅgarāḥ ।
svairarthaiḥ parisantuṣṭāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥34॥
slp1: Srutavanto dayAvantaH SucayaH satyasaNgarAH । svErarTEH parisantuzwAste narAH svargagAminaH ॥34॥

text: avairā ye tvanāyāsā maitracittaparāḥ sadā । sarvabhūtadayāvantaste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥35॥
html:
avairā ye tvanāyāsā maitracittaparāḥ sadā ।
sarvabhūtadayāvantaste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥35॥
slp1: avErA ye tvanAyAsA mEtracittaparAH sadA । sarvaBUtadayAvantaste narAH svargagAminaH ॥35॥

text: śraddhāvanto dayāvantaścokṣāścokṣajanapriyāḥ । dharmādharmavido nityaṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥36॥
html:
śraddhāvanto dayāvantaścokṣāścokṣajanapriyāḥ ।
dharmādharmavido nityaṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: SradDAvanto dayAvantaScokzAScokzajanapriyAH । DarmADarmavido nityaM te narAH svargagAminaH ॥36॥

text: śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ phalasañcaye । vipākajñāśca ye devi te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥37॥
html:
śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ phalasañcaye ।
vipākajñāśca ye devi te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: SuBAnAmaSuBAnAM ca karmaRAM PalasaYcaye । vipAkajYASca ye devi te narAH svargagAminaH ॥37॥

text: nyāyopetā guṇopetā devadvijaparāḥ sadā । samatāṃ samanuprāptāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥38॥
html:
nyāyopetā guṇopetā devadvijaparāḥ sadā ।
samatāṃ samanuprāptāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥38॥
slp1: nyAyopetA guRopetA devadvijaparAH sadA । samatAM samanuprAptAste narAH svargagAminaH ॥38॥

text: śubhaiḥ karmaphalairdevi mayaite parikīrtitāḥ । svargamārgopagā bhūyaḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ॥39॥
html:
śubhaiḥ karmaphalairdevi mayaite parikīrtitāḥ ।
svargamārgopagā bhūyaḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ॥39॥
slp1: SuBEH karmaPalErdevi mayEte parikIrtitAH । svargamArgopagA BUyaH kimanyacCrotumicCasi ॥39॥

text: mahānme saṃśayaḥ kaścinmartyānprati maheśvara । tasmāttaṃ naipuṇenādya mamākhyātuṃ tvamarhasi ॥40॥
html:
mahānme saṃśayaḥ kaścinmartyānprati maheśvara ।
tasmāttaṃ naipuṇenādya mamākhyātuṃ tvamarhasi ॥40॥
slp1: mahAnme saMSayaH kaScinmartyAnprati maheSvara । tasmAttaM nEpuRenAdya mamAKyAtuM tvamarhasi ॥40॥
author: umovāca ।

text: kenāyurlabhate dīrghaṃ karmaṇā puruṣaḥ prabho । tapasā vāpi deveśa kenāyurlabhate mahat ॥41॥
html:
kenāyurlabhate dīrghaṃ karmaṇā puruṣaḥ prabho ।
tapasā vāpi deveśa kenāyurlabhate mahat ॥41॥
slp1: kenAyurlaBate dIrGaM karmaRA puruzaH praBo । tapasA vApi deveSa kenAyurlaBate mahat ॥41॥

text: kṣīṇāyuḥ kena bhavati karmaṇā bhuvi mānavaḥ । vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ deva vaktumarhasyanindita ॥42॥
html:
kṣīṇāyuḥ kena bhavati karmaṇā bhuvi mānavaḥ ।
vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ deva vaktumarhasyanindita ॥42॥
slp1: kzIRAyuH kena Bavati karmaRA Buvi mAnavaH । vipAkaM karmaRAM deva vaktumarhasyanindita ॥42॥

text: apare ca mahābhogā mandabhogāstathāpare । akulīnāstathā cānye kulīnāśca tathāpare ॥43॥
html:
apare ca mahābhogā mandabhogāstathāpare ।
akulīnāstathā cānye kulīnāśca tathāpare ॥43॥
slp1: apare ca mahABogA mandaBogAstaTApare । akulInAstaTA cAnye kulInASca taTApare ॥43॥

text: durdarśāḥ kecidābhānti narāḥ kāṣṭhamayā iva । priyadarśāstathā cānye darśanādeva mānavāḥ ॥44॥
html:
durdarśāḥ kecidābhānti narāḥ kāṣṭhamayā iva ।
priyadarśāstathā cānye darśanādeva mānavāḥ ॥44॥
slp1: durdarSAH kecidABAnti narAH kAzWamayA iva । priyadarSAstaTA cAnye darSanAdeva mAnavAH ॥44॥

text: duṣprajñāḥ kecidābhānti kecidābhānti paṇḍitāḥ । mahāprajñāstathaivānye jñānavijñānadarśinaḥ ॥45॥
html:
duṣprajñāḥ kecidābhānti kecidābhānti paṇḍitāḥ ।
mahāprajñāstathaivānye jñānavijñānadarśinaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: duzprajYAH kecidABAnti kecidABAnti paRqitAH । mahAprajYAstaTEvAnye jYAnavijYAnadarSinaH ॥45॥

text: alpābādhāstathā kecinmahābādhāstathāpare । dṛśyante puruṣā deva tanme śaṃsitumarhasi ॥46॥
html:
alpābādhāstathā kecinmahābādhāstathāpare ।
dṛśyante puruṣā deva tanme śaṃsitumarhasi ॥46॥
slp1: alpAbADAstaTA kecinmahAbADAstaTApare । dfSyante puruzA deva tanme SaMsitumarhasi ॥46॥

text: hanta te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi devi karmaphalodayam । martyaloke narāḥ sarve yena svaṃ bhuñjate phalam ॥47॥
html:
hanta te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi devi karmaphalodayam ।
martyaloke narāḥ sarve yena svaṃ bhuñjate phalam ॥47॥
slp1: hanta te'haM pravakzyAmi devi karmaPalodayam । martyaloke narAH sarve yena svaM BuYjate Palam ॥47॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: prāṇātipātī yo raudro daṇḍahastodyatastathā । nityamudyatadaṇḍaśca hanti bhūtagaṇānnaraḥ ॥48॥
html:
prāṇātipātī yo raudro daṇḍahastodyatastathā ।
nityamudyatadaṇḍaśca hanti bhūtagaṇānnaraḥ ॥48॥
slp1: prARAtipAtI yo rOdro daRqahastodyatastaTA । nityamudyatadaRqaSca hanti BUtagaRAnnaraH ॥48॥

text: nirdayaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ nityamudvegakārakaḥ । api kīṭapipīlānāmaśaraṇyaḥ sunirghṛṇaḥ ॥49॥
html:
nirdayaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ nityamudvegakārakaḥ ।
api kīṭapipīlānāmaśaraṇyaḥ sunirghṛṇaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: nirdayaH sarvaBUtAnAM nityamudvegakArakaH । api kIwapipIlAnAmaSaraRyaH sunirGfRaH ॥49॥

text: evambhūto naro devi nirayaṃ pratipadyate । viparītastu dharmātmā rūpavānabhijāyate ॥50॥
html:
evambhūto naro devi nirayaṃ pratipadyate ।
viparītastu dharmātmā rūpavānabhijāyate ॥50॥
slp1: evamBUto naro devi nirayaM pratipadyate । viparItastu DarmAtmA rUpavAnaBijAyate ॥50॥

text: nirayaṃ yāti hiṃsātmā yāti svargamahiṃsakaḥ । yātanāṃ niraye raudrāṃ sa kṛcchrāṃ labhate naraḥ ॥51॥
html:
nirayaṃ yāti hiṃsātmā yāti svargamahiṃsakaḥ ।
yātanāṃ niraye raudrāṃ sa kṛcchrāṃ labhate naraḥ ॥51॥
slp1: nirayaM yAti hiMsAtmA yAti svargamahiMsakaH । yAtanAM niraye rOdrAM sa kfcCrAM laBate naraH ॥51॥

text: atha cennirayāttasmātsamuttarati karhicit । mānuṣyaṃ labhate cāpi hīnāyustatra jāyate ॥52॥
html:
atha cennirayāttasmātsamuttarati karhicit ।
mānuṣyaṃ labhate cāpi hīnāyustatra jāyate ॥52॥
slp1: aTa cennirayAttasmAtsamuttarati karhicit । mAnuzyaM laBate cApi hInAyustatra jAyate ॥52॥

text: pāpena karmaṇā devi baddho hiṃsāratirnaraḥ । apriyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hīnāyurupajāyate ॥53॥
html:
pāpena karmaṇā devi baddho hiṃsāratirnaraḥ ।
apriyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hīnāyurupajāyate ॥53॥
slp1: pApena karmaRA devi badDo hiMsAratirnaraH । apriyaH sarvaBUtAnAM hInAyurupajAyate ॥53॥

text: yastu śuklābhijātīyaḥ prāṇighātavivarjakaḥ । nikṣiptadaṇḍo nirdaṇḍo na hinasti kadācana ॥54॥
html:
yastu śuklābhijātīyaḥ prāṇighātavivarjakaḥ ।
nikṣiptadaṇḍo nirdaṇḍo na hinasti kadācana ॥54॥
slp1: yastu SuklABijAtIyaH prARiGAtavivarjakaH । nikziptadaRqo nirdaRqo na hinasti kadAcana ॥54॥

text: na ghātayati no hanti ghnantaṃ naivānumodate । sarvabhūteṣu sasneho yathātmani tathāpare ॥55॥
html:
na ghātayati no hanti ghnantaṃ naivānumodate ।
sarvabhūteṣu sasneho yathātmani tathāpare ॥55॥
slp1: na GAtayati no hanti GnantaM nEvAnumodate । sarvaBUtezu sasneho yaTAtmani taTApare ॥55॥

text: īdṛśaḥ puruṣotkarṣo devi devatvamaśnute । upapannānsukhānbhogānupāśnāti mudā yutaḥ ॥56॥
html:
īdṛśaḥ puruṣotkarṣo devi devatvamaśnute ।
upapannānsukhānbhogānupāśnāti mudā yutaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: IdfSaH puruzotkarzo devi devatvamaSnute । upapannAnsuKAnBogAnupASnAti mudA yutaH ॥56॥

text: atha cenmānuṣe loke kadācidupapadyate । tatra dīrghāyurutpannaḥ sa naraḥ sukhamedhate ॥57॥
html:
atha cenmānuṣe loke kadācidupapadyate ।
tatra dīrghāyurutpannaḥ sa naraḥ sukhamedhate ॥57॥
slp1: aTa cenmAnuze loke kadAcidupapadyate । tatra dIrGAyurutpannaH sa naraH suKameDate ॥57॥

text: evaṃ dīrghāyuṣāṃ mārgaḥ suvṛttānāṃ sukarmaṇām । prāṇihiṃsāvimokṣeṇa brahmaṇā samudīritaḥ] ॥58॥
html:
evaṃ dīrghāyuṣāṃ mārgaḥ suvṛttānāṃ sukarmaṇām ।
prāṇihiṃsāvimokṣeṇa brahmaṇā samudīritaḥ] ॥58॥
slp1: evaM dIrGAyuzAM mArgaH suvfttAnAM sukarmaRAm । prARihiMsAvimokzeRa brahmaRA samudIritaH] ॥58॥

text: kiṃśīlāḥ kiṃsamācārāḥ puruṣāḥ kaiśca karmabhiḥ । svargaṃ samabhipadyante sampradānena kena vā ॥1॥
html:
kiṃśīlāḥ kiṃsamācārāḥ puruṣāḥ kaiśca karmabhiḥ ।
svargaṃ samabhipadyante sampradānena kena vā ॥1॥
slp1: kiMSIlAH kiMsamAcArAH puruzAH kESca karmaBiH । svargaM samaBipadyante sampradAnena kena vA ॥1॥
author: umovāca ।

text: dātā brāhmaṇasatkartā dīnāndhakṛpaṇādiṣu । bhakṣyabhojyānnapānānāṃ vāsasāṃ ca pradāyakaḥ ॥2॥
html:
dātā brāhmaṇasatkartā dīnāndhakṛpaṇādiṣu ।
bhakṣyabhojyānnapānānāṃ vāsasāṃ ca pradāyakaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: dAtA brAhmaRasatkartA dInAnDakfpaRAdizu । BakzyaBojyAnnapAnAnAM vAsasAM ca pradAyakaH ॥2॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: pratiśrayānsabhāḥ kūpānprapāḥ puṣkariṇīstathā । naityakāni ca sarvāṇi kimicchakamatīva ca ॥3॥
html:
pratiśrayānsabhāḥ kūpānprapāḥ puṣkariṇīstathā ।
