naityakāni ca sarvāṇi kimicchakamatīva ca ॥3॥
slp1: pratiSrayAnsaBAH kUpAnprapAH puzkariRIstaTA । nEtyakAni ca sarvARi kimicCakamatIva ca ॥3॥

text: āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ dhanaṃ ratnaṃ gṛhāṃstathā । sasyajātāni sarvāṇi gāḥ kṣetrāṇyatha yoṣitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ dhanaṃ ratnaṃ gṛhāṃstathā ।
sasyajātāni sarvāṇi gāḥ kṣetrāṇyatha yoṣitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: AsanaM SayanaM yAnaM DanaM ratnaM gfhAMstaTA । sasyajAtAni sarvARi gAH kzetrARyaTa yozitaH ॥4॥

text: supratītamanā nityaṃ yaḥ prayacchati mānavaḥ । evambhūto mṛto devi devaloke'bhijāyate ॥5॥
html:
supratītamanā nityaṃ yaḥ prayacchati mānavaḥ ।
evambhūto mṛto devi devaloke'bhijāyate ॥5॥
slp1: supratItamanA nityaM yaH prayacCati mAnavaH । evamBUto mfto devi devaloke'BijAyate ॥5॥

text: tatroṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān । sahāpsarobhirmudito ramitvā nandanādiṣu ॥6॥
html:
tatroṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān ।
sahāpsarobhirmudito ramitvā nandanādiṣu ॥6॥
slp1: tatrozya suciraM kAlaM BuktvA BogAnanuttamAn । sahApsaroBirmudito ramitvA nandanAdizu ॥6॥

text: tasmātsvargāccyuto lokānmānuṣeṣūpajāyate । mahābhoge kule devi dhanadhānyasamācite ॥7॥
html:
tasmātsvargāccyuto lokānmānuṣeṣūpajāyate ।
mahābhoge kule devi dhanadhānyasamācite ॥7॥
slp1: tasmAtsvargAccyuto lokAnmAnuzezUpajAyate । mahABoge kule devi DanaDAnyasamAcite ॥7॥

text: tatra kāmaguṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samupeto mudā yutaḥ । mahābhogo mahākośo dhanī bhavati mānavaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tatra kāmaguṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samupeto mudā yutaḥ ।
mahābhogo mahākośo dhanī bhavati mānavaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tatra kAmaguREH sarvEH samupeto mudA yutaH । mahABogo mahAkoSo DanI Bavati mAnavaH ॥8॥

text: ete devi mahābhogāḥ prāṇino dānaśīlinaḥ । brahmaṇā vai purā proktāḥ sarvasya priyadarśanāḥ ॥9॥
html:
ete devi mahābhogāḥ prāṇino dānaśīlinaḥ ।
brahmaṇā vai purā proktāḥ sarvasya priyadarśanāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: ete devi mahABogAH prARino dAnaSIlinaH । brahmaRA vE purA proktAH sarvasya priyadarSanAH ॥9॥

text: apare mānavā devi pradānakṛpaṇā dvijaiḥ । yācitā na prayacchanti vidyamāne'pyabuddhayaḥ ॥10॥
html:
apare mānavā devi pradānakṛpaṇā dvijaiḥ ।
yācitā na prayacchanti vidyamāne'pyabuddhayaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: apare mAnavA devi pradAnakfpaRA dvijEH । yAcitA na prayacCanti vidyamAne'pyabudDayaH ॥10॥

text: dīnāndhakṛpaṇāndṛṣṭvā bhikṣukānatithīnapi । yācyamānā nivartante jihvālobhasamanvitāḥ ॥11॥
html:
dīnāndhakṛpaṇāndṛṣṭvā bhikṣukānatithīnapi ।
yācyamānā nivartante jihvālobhasamanvitāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: dInAnDakfpaRAndfzwvA BikzukAnatiTInapi । yAcyamAnA nivartante jihvAloBasamanvitAH ॥11॥

text: na dhanāni na vāsāṃsi na bhogānna ca kāñcanam । na gāvo nānnavikṛtiṃ prayacchanti kadācana ॥12॥
html:
na dhanāni na vāsāṃsi na bhogānna ca kāñcanam ।
na gāvo nānnavikṛtiṃ prayacchanti kadācana ॥12॥
slp1: na DanAni na vAsAMsi na BogAnna ca kAYcanam । na gAvo nAnnavikftiM prayacCanti kadAcana ॥12॥

text: apravṛttāstu ye lubdhā nāstikā dānavarjitāḥ । evambhūtā narā devi nirayaṃ yāntyabuddhayaḥ ॥13॥
html:
apravṛttāstu ye lubdhā nāstikā dānavarjitāḥ ।
evambhūtā narā devi nirayaṃ yāntyabuddhayaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: apravfttAstu ye lubDA nAstikA dAnavarjitAH । evamBUtA narA devi nirayaM yAntyabudDayaH ॥13॥

text: te cenmanuṣyatāṃ yānti yadā kālasya paryayāt । dhanarikte kule janma labhante svalpabuddhayaḥ ॥14॥
html:
te cenmanuṣyatāṃ yānti yadā kālasya paryayāt ।
dhanarikte kule janma labhante svalpabuddhayaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: te cenmanuzyatAM yAnti yadA kAlasya paryayAt । Danarikte kule janma laBante svalpabudDayaH ॥14॥

text: kṣutpipāsāparītāśca sarvabhogabahiṣkṛtāḥ । nirāśāḥ sarvabhogebhyo jīvantyadhamajīvikām ॥15॥
html:
kṣutpipāsāparītāśca sarvabhogabahiṣkṛtāḥ ।
nirāśāḥ sarvabhogebhyo jīvantyadhamajīvikām ॥15॥
slp1: kzutpipAsAparItASca sarvaBogabahizkftAH । nirASAH sarvaBogeByo jIvantyaDamajIvikAm ॥15॥

text: alpabhogakule jātā alpabhogaratā narāḥ । anena karmaṇā devi bhavantyadhanino narāḥ ॥16॥
html:
alpabhogakule jātā alpabhogaratā narāḥ ।
anena karmaṇā devi bhavantyadhanino narāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: alpaBogakule jAtA alpaBogaratA narAH । anena karmaRA devi BavantyaDanino narAH ॥16॥

text: apare stambhino nityaṃ māninaḥ pāpato ratāḥ । āsanārhasya ye pīṭhaṃ na prayacchantyacetasaḥ ॥17॥
html:
apare stambhino nityaṃ māninaḥ pāpato ratāḥ ।
āsanārhasya ye pīṭhaṃ na prayacchantyacetasaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: apare stamBino nityaM mAninaH pApato ratAH । AsanArhasya ye pIWaM na prayacCantyacetasaH ॥17॥

text: mārgārhasya ca ye mārgaṃ na yacchantyalpabuddhayaḥ । pādyārhasya ca ye pādyaṃ na dadatyalpabuddhayaḥ ॥18॥
html:
mārgārhasya ca ye mārgaṃ na yacchantyalpabuddhayaḥ ।
pādyārhasya ca ye pādyaṃ na dadatyalpabuddhayaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: mArgArhasya ca ye mArgaM na yacCantyalpabudDayaH । pAdyArhasya ca ye pAdyaM na dadatyalpabudDayaH ॥18॥

text: arghārhānna ca satkārairarcayanti yathāvidhi । arghyamācamanīyaṃ vā na yacchantyalpabuddhayaḥ ॥19॥
html:
arghārhānna ca satkārairarcayanti yathāvidhi ।
arghyamācamanīyaṃ vā na yacchantyalpabuddhayaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: arGArhAnna ca satkArErarcayanti yaTAviDi । arGyamAcamanIyaM vA na yacCantyalpabudDayaH ॥19॥

text: guruṃ cābhigataṃ premṇā guruvanna bubhūṣate । abhimānapravṛttena lobhena samavasthitāḥ ॥20॥
html:
guruṃ cābhigataṃ premṇā guruvanna bubhūṣate ।
abhimānapravṛttena lobhena samavasthitāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: guruM cABigataM premRA guruvanna buBUzate । aBimAnapravfttena loBena samavasTitAH ॥20॥

text: sammānyāṃścāvamanyante vṛddhānparibhavanti ca । evaṃvidhā narā devi sarve nirayagāminaḥ ॥21॥
html:
sammānyāṃścāvamanyante vṛddhānparibhavanti ca ।
evaṃvidhā narā devi sarve nirayagāminaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: sammAnyAMScAvamanyante vfdDAnpariBavanti ca । evaMviDA narA devi sarve nirayagAminaH ॥21॥

text: te vai yadi narāstasmānnirayāduttaranti vai । varṣapūgaistato janma labhante kutsite kule ॥22॥
html:
te vai yadi narāstasmānnirayāduttaranti vai ।
varṣapūgaistato janma labhante kutsite kule ॥22॥
slp1: te vE yadi narAstasmAnnirayAduttaranti vE । varzapUgEstato janma laBante kutsite kule ॥22॥

text: śvapākapulkasādīnāṃ kutsitānāmacetasām । kuleṣu teṣu jāyante guruvṛddhāpacāyinaḥ ॥23॥
html:
śvapākapulkasādīnāṃ kutsitānāmacetasām ।
kuleṣu teṣu jāyante guruvṛddhāpacāyinaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: SvapAkapulkasAdInAM kutsitAnAmacetasAm । kulezu tezu jAyante guruvfdDApacAyinaH ॥23॥

text: na stambhī na ca mānī yo devatādvijapūjakaḥ । lokapūjyo namaskartā praśrito madhuraṃ vadan ॥24॥
html:
na stambhī na ca mānī yo devatādvijapūjakaḥ ।
lokapūjyo namaskartā praśrito madhuraṃ vadan ॥24॥
slp1: na stamBI na ca mAnI yo devatAdvijapUjakaH । lokapUjyo namaskartA praSrito maDuraM vadan ॥24॥

text: sarvavarṇapriyakaraḥ sarvabhūtahitaḥ sadā । adveṣī sumukhaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdhavāṇīpradaḥ sadā ॥25॥
html:
sarvavarṇapriyakaraḥ sarvabhūtahitaḥ sadā ।
adveṣī sumukhaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdhavāṇīpradaḥ sadā ॥25॥
slp1: sarvavarRapriyakaraH sarvaBUtahitaH sadA । advezI sumuKaH SlakzRaH snigDavARIpradaH sadA ॥25॥

text: svāgatenaiva sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāmavihiṃsakaḥ । yathārhasatkriyāpūrvamarcayannupatiṣṭhati ॥26॥
html:
svāgatenaiva sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāmavihiṃsakaḥ ।
yathārhasatkriyāpūrvamarcayannupatiṣṭhati ॥26॥
slp1: svAgatenEva sarvezAM BUtAnAmavihiMsakaH । yaTArhasatkriyApUrvamarcayannupatizWati ॥26॥

text: mārgārhāya dadanmārgaṃ guruṃ guruvadarcayan । atithipragraharatastathābhyāgatapūjakaḥ ॥27॥
html:
mārgārhāya dadanmārgaṃ guruṃ guruvadarcayan ।
atithipragraharatastathābhyāgatapūjakaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: mArgArhAya dadanmArgaM guruM guruvadarcayan । atiTipragraharatastaTAByAgatapUjakaH ॥27॥

text: evambhūto naro devi svargatiṃ pratipadyate । tato mānuṣatāṃ prāpya viśiṣṭakulajo bhavet ॥28॥
html:
evambhūto naro devi svargatiṃ pratipadyate ।
tato mānuṣatāṃ prāpya viśiṣṭakulajo bhavet ॥28॥
slp1: evamBUto naro devi svargatiM pratipadyate । tato mAnuzatAM prApya viSizwakulajo Bavet ॥28॥

text: tatrāsau vipulairbhogaiḥ sarvaratnasamāyutaḥ । yathārhadātā cārheṣu dharmacaryāparo bhavet ॥29॥
html:
tatrāsau vipulairbhogaiḥ sarvaratnasamāyutaḥ ।
yathārhadātā cārheṣu dharmacaryāparo bhavet ॥29॥
slp1: tatrAsO vipulErBogEH sarvaratnasamAyutaH । yaTArhadAtA cArhezu DarmacaryAparo Bavet ॥29॥

text: sammataḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ । svakarmaphalamāpnoti svayameva naraḥ sadā ॥30॥
html:
sammataḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ ।
svakarmaphalamāpnoti svayameva naraḥ sadā ॥30॥
slp1: sammataH sarvaBUtAnAM sarvalokanamaskftaH । svakarmaPalamApnoti svayameva naraH sadA ॥30॥

text: udāttakulajātīya udāttābhijanaḥ sadā । eṣa dharmo mayā prokto vidhātrā svayamīritaḥ ॥31॥
html:
udāttakulajātīya udāttābhijanaḥ sadā ।
eṣa dharmo mayā prokto vidhātrā svayamīritaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: udAttakulajAtIya udAttABijanaH sadA । eza Darmo mayA prokto viDAtrA svayamIritaH ॥31॥

text: yastu raudrasamācāraḥ sarvasattvabhayaṅkaraḥ । hastābhyāṃ yadi vā padbhyāṃ rajjvā daṇḍena vā punaḥ ॥32॥
html:
yastu raudrasamācāraḥ sarvasattvabhayaṅkaraḥ ।
hastābhyāṃ yadi vā padbhyāṃ rajjvā daṇḍena vā punaḥ ॥32॥
slp1: yastu rOdrasamAcAraH sarvasattvaBayaNkaraH । hastAByAM yadi vA padByAM rajjvA daRqena vA punaH ॥32॥

text: loṣṭaiḥ stambhairupāyairvā jantūnbādhati śobhane । hiṃsārthaṃ nikṛtiprajñaḥ prodvejayati caiva ha ॥33॥
html:
loṣṭaiḥ stambhairupāyairvā jantūnbādhati śobhane ।
hiṃsārthaṃ nikṛtiprajñaḥ prodvejayati caiva ha ॥33॥
slp1: lozwEH stamBErupAyErvA jantUnbADati SoBane । hiMsArTaM nikftiprajYaH prodvejayati cEva ha ॥33॥

text: upakrāmati jantūṃśca udvegajananaḥ sadā । evaṃśīlasamācāro nirayaṃ pratipadyate ॥34॥
html:
upakrāmati jantūṃśca udvegajananaḥ sadā ।
evaṃśīlasamācāro nirayaṃ pratipadyate ॥34॥
slp1: upakrAmati jantUMSca udvegajananaH sadA । evaMSIlasamAcAro nirayaM pratipadyate ॥34॥

text: sa cenmānuṣatāṃ gacchedyadi kālasya paryayāt । bahvābādhaparikliṣṭe so'dhame jāyate kule ॥35॥
html:
sa cenmānuṣatāṃ gacchedyadi kālasya paryayāt ।
bahvābādhaparikliṣṭe so'dhame jāyate kule ॥35॥
slp1: sa cenmAnuzatAM gacCedyadi kAlasya paryayAt । bahvAbADapariklizwe so'Dame jAyate kule ॥35॥

text: lokadveṣyo'dhamaḥ puṃsāṃ svayaṃ karmakṛtaiḥ phalaiḥ । eṣa devi manuṣyeṣu boddhavyo jñātibandhuṣu ॥36॥
html:
lokadveṣyo'dhamaḥ puṃsāṃ svayaṃ karmakṛtaiḥ phalaiḥ ।
eṣa devi manuṣyeṣu boddhavyo jñātibandhuṣu ॥36॥
slp1: lokadvezyo'DamaH puMsAM svayaM karmakftEH PalEH । eza devi manuzyezu bodDavyo jYAtibanDuzu ॥36॥

text: aparaḥ sarvabhūtāni dayāvānanupaśyati । maitradṛṣṭiḥ pitṛsamo nirvairo niyatendriyaḥ ॥37॥
html:
aparaḥ sarvabhūtāni dayāvānanupaśyati ।
maitradṛṣṭiḥ pitṛsamo nirvairo niyatendriyaḥ ॥37॥
slp1: aparaH sarvaBUtAni dayAvAnanupaSyati । mEtradfzwiH pitfsamo nirvEro niyatendriyaH ॥37॥

text: nodvejayati bhūtāni na vihiṃsayate tathā । hastapādaiḥ suniyatairviśvāsyaḥ sarvajantuṣu ॥38॥
html:
nodvejayati bhūtāni na vihiṃsayate tathā ।
hastapādaiḥ suniyatairviśvāsyaḥ sarvajantuṣu ॥38॥
slp1: nodvejayati BUtAni na vihiMsayate taTA । hastapAdEH suniyatErviSvAsyaH sarvajantuzu ॥38॥

text: na rajjvā na ca daṇḍena na loṣṭairnāyudhena ca । udvejayati bhūtāni ślakṣṇakarmā dayāparaḥ ॥39॥
html:
na rajjvā na ca daṇḍena na loṣṭairnāyudhena ca ।
udvejayati bhūtāni ślakṣṇakarmā dayāparaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: na rajjvA na ca daRqena na lozwErnAyuDena ca । udvejayati BUtAni SlakzRakarmA dayAparaH ॥39॥

text: evaṃśīlasamācāraḥ svarge samupajāyate । tatrāsau bhavane divye mudā vasati devavat ॥40॥
html:
evaṃśīlasamācāraḥ svarge samupajāyate ।
tatrāsau bhavane divye mudā vasati devavat ॥40॥
slp1: evaMSIlasamAcAraH svarge samupajAyate । tatrAsO Bavane divye mudA vasati devavat ॥40॥

text: sa cetkarmakṣayānmartyo manuṣyeṣūpajāyate । alpābādho nirītīkaḥ sa jātaḥ sukhamedhate ॥41॥
html:
sa cetkarmakṣayānmartyo manuṣyeṣūpajāyate ।
alpābādho nirītīkaḥ sa jātaḥ sukhamedhate ॥41॥
slp1: sa cetkarmakzayAnmartyo manuzyezUpajAyate । alpAbADo nirItIkaH sa jAtaH suKameDate ॥41॥

text: sukhabhāgī nirāyāso nirudvegaḥ sadā naraḥ । eṣa devi satāṃ mārgo bādhā yatra na vidyate ॥42॥
html:
sukhabhāgī nirāyāso nirudvegaḥ sadā naraḥ ।
eṣa devi satāṃ mārgo bādhā yatra na vidyate ॥42॥
slp1: suKaBAgI nirAyAso nirudvegaH sadA naraH । eza devi satAM mArgo bADA yatra na vidyate ॥42॥

text: ime manuṣyā dṛśyante ūhāpohaviśāradāḥ । jñānavijñānasampannāḥ prajñāvanto'rthakovidāḥ । duṣprajñāścāpare deva jñānavijñānavarjitāḥ ॥43॥
html:
ime manuṣyā dṛśyante ūhāpohaviśāradāḥ ।
jñānavijñānasampannāḥ prajñāvanto'rthakovidāḥ ।
duṣprajñāścāpare deva jñānavijñānavarjitāḥ ॥43॥
slp1: ime manuzyA dfSyante UhApohaviSAradAH । jYAnavijYAnasampannAH prajYAvanto'rTakovidAH । duzprajYAScApare deva jYAnavijYAnavarjitAH ॥43॥
author: umovāca ।

text: kena karmavipākena prajñāvānpuruṣo bhavet । alpaprajño virūpākṣa kathaṃ bhavati mānavaḥ । etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chinddhi sarvadharmavidāṃ vara ॥44॥
html:
kena karmavipākena prajñāvānpuruṣo bhavet ।
alpaprajño virūpākṣa kathaṃ bhavati mānavaḥ ।
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chinddhi sarvadharmavidāṃ vara ॥44॥
slp1: kena karmavipAkena prajYAvAnpuruzo Bavet । alpaprajYo virUpAkza kaTaM Bavati mAnavaH । etaM me saMSayaM CindDi sarvaDarmavidAM vara ॥44॥

text: jātyandhāścāpare deva rogārtāścāpare tathā । narāḥ klībāśca dṛśyante kāraṇaṃ brūhi tatra vai ॥45॥
html:
jātyandhāścāpare deva rogārtāścāpare tathā ।
narāḥ klībāśca dṛśyante kāraṇaṃ brūhi tatra vai ॥45॥
slp1: jAtyanDAScApare deva rogArtAScApare taTA । narAH klIbASca dfSyante kAraRaM brUhi tatra vE ॥45॥

text: brāhmaṇānvedaviduṣaḥ siddhāndharmavidastathā । paripṛcchantyaharahaḥ kuśalākuśalaṃ tathā ॥46॥
html:
brāhmaṇānvedaviduṣaḥ siddhāndharmavidastathā ।
paripṛcchantyaharahaḥ kuśalākuśalaṃ tathā ॥46॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnvedaviduzaH sidDAnDarmavidastaTA । paripfcCantyaharahaH kuSalAkuSalaM taTA ॥46॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: varjayantyaśubhaṃ karma sevamānāḥ śubhaṃ tathā । labhante svargatiṃ nityamiha loke sukhaṃ tathā ॥47॥
html:
varjayantyaśubhaṃ karma sevamānāḥ śubhaṃ tathā ।
labhante svargatiṃ nityamiha loke sukhaṃ tathā ॥47॥
slp1: varjayantyaSuBaM karma sevamAnAH SuBaM taTA । laBante svargatiM nityamiha loke suKaM taTA ॥47॥

text: sa cenmānuṣatāṃ yāti medhāvī tatra jāyate । śrutaṃ prajñānugaṃ cāsya kalyāṇamupajāyate ॥48॥
html:
sa cenmānuṣatāṃ yāti medhāvī tatra jāyate ।
śrutaṃ prajñānugaṃ cāsya kalyāṇamupajāyate ॥48॥
slp1: sa cenmAnuzatAM yAti meDAvI tatra jAyate । SrutaM prajYAnugaM cAsya kalyARamupajAyate ॥48॥

text: paradāreṣu ye mūḍhāścakṣurduṣṭaṃ prayuñjate । tena duṣṭasvabhāvena jātyandhāste bhavanti ha ॥49॥
html:
paradāreṣu ye mūḍhāścakṣurduṣṭaṃ prayuñjate ।
tena duṣṭasvabhāvena jātyandhāste bhavanti ha ॥49॥
slp1: paradArezu ye mUQAScakzurduzwaM prayuYjate । tena duzwasvaBAvena jAtyanDAste Bavanti ha ॥49॥

text: manasā tu praduṣṭena nagnāṃ paśyanti ye striyam । rogārtāste bhavantīha narā duṣkṛtakarmiṇaḥ ॥50॥
html:
manasā tu praduṣṭena nagnāṃ paśyanti ye striyam ।
rogārtāste bhavantīha narā duṣkṛtakarmiṇaḥ ॥50॥
slp1: manasA tu praduzwena nagnAM paSyanti ye striyam । rogArtAste BavantIha narA duzkftakarmiRaH ॥50॥

text: ye tu mūḍhā durācārā viyonau maithune ratāḥ । puruṣeṣu suduṣprajñāḥ klībatvamupayānti te ॥51॥
html:
ye tu mūḍhā durācārā viyonau maithune ratāḥ ।
puruṣeṣu suduṣprajñāḥ klībatvamupayānti te ॥51॥
slp1: ye tu mUQA durAcArA viyonO mETune ratAH । puruzezu suduzprajYAH klIbatvamupayAnti te ॥51॥

text: paśūṃśca ye bandhayanti ye caiva gurutalpagāḥ । prakīrṇamaithunā ye ca klībā jāyanti te narāḥ ॥52॥
html:
paśūṃśca ye bandhayanti ye caiva gurutalpagāḥ ।
prakīrṇamaithunā ye ca klībā jāyanti te narāḥ ॥52॥
slp1: paSUMSca ye banDayanti ye cEva gurutalpagAH । prakIrRamETunA ye ca klIbA jAyanti te narAH ॥52॥

text: sāvadyaṃ kiṃ nu vai karma niravadyaṃ tathaiva ca । śreyaḥ kurvannavāpnoti mānavo devasattama ॥53॥
html:
sāvadyaṃ kiṃ nu vai karma niravadyaṃ tathaiva ca ।
śreyaḥ kurvannavāpnoti mānavo devasattama ॥53॥
slp1: sAvadyaM kiM nu vE karma niravadyaM taTEva ca । SreyaH kurvannavApnoti mAnavo devasattama ॥53॥
author: umovāca ।

text: śreyāṃsaṃ mārgamātiṣṭhansadā yaḥ pṛcchate dvijān । dharmānveṣī guṇākāṅkṣī sa svargaṃ samupāśnute ॥54॥
html:
śreyāṃsaṃ mārgamātiṣṭhansadā yaḥ pṛcchate dvijān ।
dharmānveṣī guṇākāṅkṣī sa svargaṃ samupāśnute ॥54॥
slp1: SreyAMsaM mArgamAtizWansadA yaH pfcCate dvijAn । DarmAnvezI guRAkANkzI sa svargaM samupASnute ॥54॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: yadi mānuṣatāṃ devi kadācitsa nigacchati । medhāvī dhāraṇāyuktaḥ prājñastatrābhijāyate ॥55॥
html:
yadi mānuṣatāṃ devi kadācitsa nigacchati ।
medhāvī dhāraṇāyuktaḥ prājñastatrābhijāyate ॥55॥
slp1: yadi mAnuzatAM devi kadAcitsa nigacCati । meDAvI DAraRAyuktaH prAjYastatrABijAyate ॥55॥

text: eṣa devi satāṃ dharmo mantavyo bhūtikārakaḥ । nṛṇāṃ hitārthāya tava mayā vai samudāhṛtaḥ ॥56॥
html:
eṣa devi satāṃ dharmo mantavyo bhūtikārakaḥ ।
nṛṇāṃ hitārthāya tava mayā vai samudāhṛtaḥ ॥56॥
slp1: eza devi satAM Darmo mantavyo BUtikArakaH । nfRAM hitArTAya tava mayA vE samudAhftaH ॥56॥

text: apare svalpavijñānā dharmavidveṣiṇo narāḥ । brāhmaṇānvedaviduṣo necchanti parisarpitum ॥57॥
html:
apare svalpavijñānā dharmavidveṣiṇo narāḥ ।
brāhmaṇānvedaviduṣo necchanti parisarpitum ॥57॥
slp1: apare svalpavijYAnA DarmavidveziRo narAH । brAhmaRAnvedaviduzo necCanti parisarpitum ॥57॥
author: umovāca ।

text: vratavanto narāḥ kecicchraddhādamaparāyaṇāḥ । avratā bhraṣṭaniyamāstathānye rākṣasopamāḥ ॥58॥
html:
vratavanto narāḥ kecicchraddhādamaparāyaṇāḥ ।
avratā bhraṣṭaniyamāstathānye rākṣasopamāḥ ॥58॥
slp1: vratavanto narAH kecicCradDAdamaparAyaRAH । avratA BrazwaniyamAstaTAnye rAkzasopamAH ॥58॥

text: yajvānaśca tathaivānye nirhomāśca tathāpare । kena karmavipākena bhavantīha vadasva me ॥59॥
html:
yajvānaśca tathaivānye nirhomāśca tathāpare ।
kena karmavipākena bhavantīha vadasva me ॥59॥
slp1: yajvAnaSca taTEvAnye nirhomASca taTApare । kena karmavipAkena BavantIha vadasva me ॥59॥

text: āgamāllokadharmāṇāṃ maryādāḥ pūrvanirmitāḥ । prāmāṇyenānuvartante dṛśyante hi dṛḍhavratāḥ ॥60॥
html:
āgamāllokadharmāṇāṃ maryādāḥ pūrvanirmitāḥ ।
prāmāṇyenānuvartante dṛśyante hi dṛḍhavratāḥ ॥60॥
slp1: AgamAllokaDarmARAM maryAdAH pUrvanirmitAH । prAmARyenAnuvartante dfSyante hi dfQavratAH ॥60॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: adharmaṃ dharmamityāhurye ca mohavaśaṃ gatāḥ । avratā naṣṭamaryādāste proktā brahmarākṣasāḥ ॥61॥
html:
adharmaṃ dharmamityāhurye ca mohavaśaṃ gatāḥ ।
avratā naṣṭamaryādāste proktā brahmarākṣasāḥ ॥61॥
slp1: aDarmaM DarmamityAhurye ca mohavaSaM gatAH । avratA nazwamaryAdAste proktA brahmarAkzasAH ॥61॥

text: te cetkālakṛtodyogātsambhavantīha mānuṣāḥ । nirhomā nirvaṣaṭkārāste bhavanti narādhamāḥ ॥62॥
html:
te cetkālakṛtodyogātsambhavantīha mānuṣāḥ ।
nirhomā nirvaṣaṭkārāste bhavanti narādhamāḥ ॥62॥
slp1: te cetkAlakftodyogAtsamBavantIha mAnuzAH । nirhomA nirvazawkArAste Bavanti narADamAH ॥62॥

text: eṣa devi mayā sarvaḥ saṃśayacchedanāya te । kuśalākuśalo nṝṇāṃ vyākhyāto dharmasāgaraḥ] ॥63॥
html:
eṣa devi mayā sarvaḥ saṃśayacchedanāya te ।
kuśalākuśalo nṝṇāṃ vyākhyāto dharmasāgaraḥ] ॥63॥
slp1: eza devi mayA sarvaH saMSayacCedanAya te । kuSalAkuSalo nFRAM vyAKyAto DarmasAgaraH] ॥63॥

text: parāvarajñe dharmajñe tapovananivāsini । sādhvi subhru sukeśānte himavatparvatātmaje ॥1॥
html:
parāvarajñe dharmajñe tapovananivāsini ।
sādhvi subhru sukeśānte himavatparvatātmaje ॥1॥
slp1: parAvarajYe DarmajYe tapovananivAsini । sADvi suBru sukeSAnte himavatparvatAtmaje ॥1॥
author: maheśvara uvāca ।

text: dakṣe śamadamopete nirmame dharmacāriṇi । pṛcchāmi tvāṃ varārohe pṛṣṭā vada mamepsitam ॥2॥
html:
dakṣe śamadamopete nirmame dharmacāriṇi ।

text: sahadharmacarī me tvaṃ samaśīlā samavratā । samānasāravīryā ca tapastīvraṃ kṛtaṃ ca te । tvayā hyukto viśeṣeṇa pramāṇatvamupaiṣyati ॥7॥

text: tava sarvaḥ suviditaḥ strīdharmaḥ śāśvataḥ śubhe । tasmādaśeṣato brūhi strīdharmaṃ vistareṇa me ॥10॥
html:

agnikāryaparā nityaṃ sadā puṣpabalipradā ।
devatātithibhṛtyānāṃ nirupya patinā saha ॥45॥
slp1: agnikAryaparA nityaM sadA puzpabalipradA । devatAtiTiBftyAnAM nirupya patinA saha ॥45॥

text: śeṣānnamupabhuñjānā yathānyāyaṃ yathāvidhi । tuṣṭapuṣṭajanā nityaṃ nārī dharmeṇa yujyate ॥46॥
html:
śeṣānnamupabhuñjānā yathānyāyaṃ yathāvidhi ।
tuṣṭapuṣṭajanā nityaṃ nārī dharmeṇa yujyate ॥46॥
slp1: SezAnnamupaBuYjAnA yaTAnyAyaM yaTAviDi । tuzwapuzwajanA nityaM nArI DarmeRa yujyate ॥46॥

text: śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau toṣayantī guṇānvitā । mātāpitṛparā nityaṃ yā nārī sā tapodhanā ॥47॥
html:
śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau toṣayantī guṇānvitā ।
mātāpitṛparā nityaṃ yā nārī sā tapodhanā ॥47॥
slp1: SvaSrUSvaSurayoH pAdO tozayantI guRAnvitA । mAtApitfparA nityaM yA nArI sA tapoDanA ॥47॥

text: brāhmaṇāndurbalānāthāndīnāndhakṛpaṇāṃstathā । bibhartyannena yā nārī sā pativratabhāginī ॥48॥
html:
brāhmaṇāndurbalānāthāndīnāndhakṛpaṇāṃstathā ।
bibhartyannena yā nārī sā pativratabhāginī ॥48॥
slp1: brAhmaRAndurbalAnATAndInAnDakfpaRAMstaTA । biBartyannena yA nArI sA pativrataBAginI ॥48॥

text: vrataṃ carati yā nityaṃ duścaraṃ laghusattvayā । paticittā patihitā sā pativratabhāginī ॥49॥
html:
vrataṃ carati yā nityaṃ duścaraṃ laghusattvayā ।
paticittā patihitā sā pativratabhāginī ॥49॥
slp1: vrataM carati yA nityaM duScaraM laGusattvayA । paticittA patihitA sA pativrataBAginI ॥49॥

text: puṇyametattapaścaiva svargaścaiṣa sanātanaḥ । yā nārī bhartṛparamā bhavedbhartṛvratā śivā ॥50॥
html:
puṇyametattapaścaiva svargaścaiṣa sanātanaḥ ।
yā nārī bhartṛparamā bhavedbhartṛvratā śivā ॥50॥
slp1: puRyametattapaScEva svargaScEza sanAtanaH । yA nArI BartfparamA BavedBartfvratA SivA ॥50॥

text: patirhi devo nārīṇāṃ patirbandhuḥ patirgatiḥ । patyā samā gatirnāsti daivataṃ vā yathā patiḥ ॥51॥
html:
patirhi devo nārīṇāṃ patirbandhuḥ patirgatiḥ ।
patyā samā gatirnāsti daivataṃ vā yathā patiḥ ॥51॥
slp1: patirhi devo nArIRAM patirbanDuH patirgatiH । patyA samA gatirnAsti dEvataM vA yaTA patiH ॥51॥

text: patiprasādaḥ svargo vā tulyo nāryā na vā bhavet । ahaṃ svargaṃ na hīccheyaṃ tvayyaprīte maheśvara ॥52॥
html:
patiprasādaḥ svargo vā tulyo nāryā na vā bhavet ।
ahaṃ svargaṃ na hīccheyaṃ tvayyaprīte maheśvara ॥52॥
slp1: patiprasAdaH svargo vA tulyo nAryA na vA Bavet । ahaM svargaM na hIcCeyaM tvayyaprIte maheSvara ॥52॥

text: yadyakāryamadharmaṃ vā yadi vā prāṇanāśanam । patirbrūyāddaridro vā vyādhito vā kathañcana ॥53॥
html:
yadyakāryamadharmaṃ vā yadi vā prāṇanāśanam ।
patirbrūyāddaridro vā vyādhito vā kathañcana ॥53॥
slp1: yadyakAryamaDarmaM vA yadi vA prARanASanam । patirbrUyAddaridro vA vyADito vA kaTaYcana ॥53॥

text: āpanno ripusaṃstho vā brahmaśāpārdito'pi vā । āpaddharmānanuprekṣya tatkāryamaviśaṅkayā ॥54॥
html:
āpanno ripusaṃstho vā brahmaśāpārdito'pi vā ।
āpaddharmānanuprekṣya tatkāryamaviśaṅkayā ॥54॥
slp1: Apanno ripusaMsTo vA brahmaSApArdito'pi vA । ApadDarmAnanuprekzya tatkAryamaviSaNkayA ॥54॥

text: eṣa deva mayā proktaḥ strīdharmo vacanāttava । yā tvevambhāvinī nārī sā bhaveddharmabhāginī ॥55॥
html:
eṣa deva mayā proktaḥ strīdharmo vacanāttava ।
yā tvevambhāvinī nārī sā bhaveddharmabhāginī ॥55॥
slp1: eza deva mayA proktaH strIDarmo vacanAttava । yA tvevamBAvinI nArI sA BavedDarmaBAginI ॥55॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa tu deveśaḥ pratipūjya gireḥ sutām । lokānvisarjayāmāsa sarvairanucaraiḥ saha ॥56॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa tu deveśaḥ pratipūjya gireḥ sutām ।
lokānvisarjayāmāsa sarvairanucaraiḥ saha ॥56॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa tu deveSaH pratipUjya gireH sutAm । lokAnvisarjayAmAsa sarvEranucarEH saha ॥56॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tato yayurbhūtagaṇāḥ saritaśca yathāgatam । gandharvāpsarasaścaiva praṇamya śirasā bhavam] ॥57॥
html:
tato yayurbhūtagaṇāḥ saritaśca yathāgatam ।
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva praṇamya śirasā bhavam] ॥57॥
slp1: tato yayurBUtagaRAH saritaSca yaTAgatam । ganDarvApsarasaScEva praRamya SirasA Bavam] ॥57॥

text: śrutvā dharmānaśeṣeṇa pāvanāni ca sarvaśaḥ । yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śāntanavaṃ punarevābhyabhāṣata ॥1॥
html:
śrutvā dharmānaśeṣeṇa pāvanāni ca sarvaśaḥ ।
yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śāntanavaṃ punarevābhyabhāṣata ॥1॥
slp1: SrutvA DarmAnaSezeRa pAvanAni ca sarvaSaH । yuDizWiraH SAntanavaM punarevAByaBAzata ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: kimekaṃ daivataṃ loke kiṃ vāpyekaṃ parāyaṇam । stuvantaḥ kaṃ kamarcantaḥ prāpnuyurmānavāḥ śubham ॥2॥
html:
kimekaṃ daivataṃ loke kiṃ vāpyekaṃ parāyaṇam ।
stuvantaḥ kaṃ kamarcantaḥ prāpnuyurmānavāḥ śubham ॥2॥
slp1: kimekaM dEvataM loke kiM vApyekaM parAyaRam । stuvantaH kaM kamarcantaH prApnuyurmAnavAH SuBam ॥2॥

text: ko dharmaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ bhavataḥ paramo mataḥ । kiṃ japanmucyate janturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt ॥3॥
html:
ko dharmaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ bhavataḥ paramo mataḥ ।
kiṃ japanmucyate janturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt ॥3॥
slp1: ko DarmaH sarvaDarmARAM BavataH paramo mataH । kiM japanmucyate janturjanmasaMsArabanDanAt ॥3॥

text: jagatprabhuṃ devadevamanantaṃ puruṣottamam । stuvannāmasahasreṇa puruṣaḥ satatotthitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
jagatprabhuṃ devadevamanantaṃ puruṣottamam ।
stuvannāmasahasreṇa puruṣaḥ satatotthitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: jagatpraBuM devadevamanantaM puruzottamam । stuvannAmasahasreRa puruzaH satatotTitaH ॥4॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: tameva cārcayannityaṃ bhaktyā puruṣamavyayam । dhyāyanstuvannamasyaṃśca yajamānastameva ca ॥5॥
html:
tameva cārcayannityaṃ bhaktyā puruṣamavyayam ।
dhyāyanstuvannamasyaṃśca yajamānastameva ca ॥5॥
slp1: tameva cArcayannityaM BaktyA puruzamavyayam । DyAyanstuvannamasyaMSca yajamAnastameva ca ॥5॥

text: anādinidhanaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram । lokādhyakṣaṃ stuvannityaṃ sarvaduḥkhātigo bhavet ॥6॥
html:
anādinidhanaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram ।
lokādhyakṣaṃ stuvannityaṃ sarvaduḥkhātigo bhavet ॥6॥
slp1: anAdiniDanaM vizRuM sarvalokamaheSvaram । lokADyakzaM stuvannityaM sarvaduHKAtigo Bavet ॥6॥

text: brahmaṇyaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ lokānāṃ kīrtivardhanam । lokanāthaṃ mahadbhūtaṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam ॥7॥
html:
brahmaṇyaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ lokānāṃ kīrtivardhanam ।
lokanāthaṃ mahadbhūtaṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam ॥7॥
slp1: brahmaRyaM sarvaDarmajYaM lokAnAM kIrtivarDanam । lokanATaM mahadBUtaM sarvaBUtaBavodBavam ॥7॥

text: eṣa me sarvadharmāṇāṃ dharmo'dhikatamo mataḥ । yadbhaktyā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ stavairarcennaraḥ sadā ॥8॥
html:
eṣa me sarvadharmāṇāṃ dharmo'dhikatamo mataḥ ।
yadbhaktyā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ stavairarcennaraḥ sadā ॥8॥
slp1: eza me sarvaDarmARAM Darmo'Dikatamo mataH । yadBaktyA puRqarIkAkzaM stavErarcennaraH sadA ॥8॥

text: paramaṃ yo mahattejaḥ paramaṃ yo mahattapaḥ । paramaṃ yo mahadbrahma paramaṃ yaḥ parāyaṇam ॥9॥
html:
paramaṃ yo mahattejaḥ paramaṃ yo mahattapaḥ ।
paramaṃ yo mahadbrahma paramaṃ yaḥ parāyaṇam ॥9॥
slp1: paramaM yo mahattejaH paramaM yo mahattapaH । paramaM yo mahadbrahma paramaM yaH parAyaRam ॥9॥

text: pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yo maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam । daivataṃ devatānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ yo'vyayaḥ pitā ॥10॥
html:
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yo maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam ।
daivataṃ devatānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ yo'vyayaḥ pitā ॥10॥
slp1: pavitrARAM pavitraM yo maNgalAnAM ca maNgalam । dEvataM devatAnAM ca BUtAnAM yo'vyayaH pitA ॥10॥

text: yataḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhavantyādiyugāgame । yasmiṃśca pralayaṃ yānti punareva yugakṣaye ॥11॥
html:
yataḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhavantyādiyugāgame ।
yasmiṃśca pralayaṃ yānti punareva yugakṣaye ॥11॥
slp1: yataH sarvARi BUtAni BavantyAdiyugAgame । yasmiMSca pralayaM yAnti punareva yugakzaye ॥11॥

text: tasya lokapradhānasya jagannāthasya bhūpate । viṣṇornāmasahasraṃ me śṛṇu pāpabhayāpaham ॥12॥
html:
tasya lokapradhānasya jagannāthasya bhūpate ।
viṣṇornāmasahasraṃ me śṛṇu pāpabhayāpaham ॥12॥
slp1: tasya lokapraDAnasya jagannATasya BUpate । vizRornAmasahasraM me SfRu pApaBayApaham ॥12॥

text: yāni nāmāni gauṇāni vikhyātāni mahātmanaḥ । ṛṣibhiḥ parigītāni tāni vakṣyāmi bhūtaye ॥13॥
html:
yāni nāmāni gauṇāni vikhyātāni mahātmanaḥ ।
ṛṣibhiḥ parigītāni tāni vakṣyāmi bhūtaye ॥13॥
slp1: yAni nAmAni gORAni viKyAtAni mahAtmanaH । fziBiH parigItAni tAni vakzyAmi BUtaye ॥13॥

text: viśvaṃ viṣṇurvaṣaṭkāro bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ । bhūtakṛdbhūtabhṛdbhāvo bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ॥14॥
html:
viśvaṃ viṣṇurvaṣaṭkāro bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ ।
bhūtakṛdbhūtabhṛdbhāvo bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: viSvaM vizRurvazawkAro BUtaBavyaBavatpraBuH । BUtakfdBUtaBfdBAvo BUtAtmA BUtaBAvanaH ॥14॥

text: pūtātmā paramātmā ca muktānāṃ paramā gatiḥ । avyayaḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣī kṣetrajño'kṣara eva ca ॥15॥
html:
pūtātmā paramātmā ca muktānāṃ paramā gatiḥ ।
avyayaḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣī kṣetrajño'kṣara eva ca ॥15॥
slp1: pUtAtmA paramAtmA ca muktAnAM paramA gatiH । avyayaH puruzaH sAkzI kzetrajYo'kzara eva ca ॥15॥

text: yogo yogavidāṃ netā pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ । nārasiṃhavapuḥ śrīmānkeśavaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥16॥
html:
yogo yogavidāṃ netā pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ ।
nārasiṃhavapuḥ śrīmānkeśavaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: yogo yogavidAM netA praDAnapuruzeSvaraH । nArasiMhavapuH SrImAnkeSavaH puruzottamaH ॥16॥

text: sarvaḥ śarvaḥ śivaḥ sthāṇurbhūtādirnidhiravyayaḥ । sambhavo bhāvano bhartā prabhavaḥ prabhurīśvaraḥ ॥17॥
html:
sarvaḥ śarvaḥ śivaḥ sthāṇurbhūtādirnidhiravyayaḥ ।
sambhavo bhāvano bhartā prabhavaḥ prabhurīśvaraḥ ॥17॥
slp1: sarvaH SarvaH SivaH sTARurBUtAdirniDiravyayaH । samBavo BAvano BartA praBavaH praBurISvaraH ॥17॥

text: svayambhūḥ śambhurādityaḥ puṣkarākṣo mahāsvanaḥ । anādinidhano dhātā vidhātā dhāturuttamaḥ ॥18॥
html:
svayambhūḥ śambhurādityaḥ puṣkarākṣo mahāsvanaḥ ।
anādinidhano dhātā vidhātā dhāturuttamaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: svayamBUH SamBurAdityaH puzkarAkzo mahAsvanaH । anAdiniDano DAtA viDAtA DAturuttamaH ॥18॥

text: aprameyo hṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābho'maraprabhuḥ । viśvakarmā manustvaṣṭā sthaviṣṭhaḥ sthaviro dhruvaḥ ॥19॥
html:
aprameyo hṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābho'maraprabhuḥ ।
viśvakarmā manustvaṣṭā sthaviṣṭhaḥ sthaviro dhruvaḥ ॥19॥
slp1: aprameyo hfzIkeSaH padmanABo'marapraBuH । viSvakarmA manustvazwA sTavizWaH sTaviro DruvaH ॥19॥

text: agrāhyaḥ śāśvataḥ kṛṣṇo lohitākṣaḥ pratardanaḥ । prabhūtastrikakubdhāma pavitraṃ maṅgalaṃ param ॥20॥
html:
agrāhyaḥ śāśvataḥ kṛṣṇo lohitākṣaḥ pratardanaḥ ।
prabhūtastrikakubdhāma pavitraṃ maṅgalaṃ param ॥20॥
slp1: agrAhyaH SASvataH kfzRo lohitAkzaH pratardanaH । praBUtastrikakubDAma pavitraM maNgalaM param ॥20॥

text: īśānaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇo jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ prajāpatiḥ । hiraṇyagarbho bhūgarbho mādhavo madhusūdanaḥ ॥21॥
html:
īśānaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇo jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।
hiraṇyagarbho bhūgarbho mādhavo madhusūdanaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: ISAnaH prARadaH prARo jyezWaH SrezWaH prajApatiH । hiraRyagarBo BUgarBo mADavo maDusUdanaH ॥21॥

text: īśvaro vikramī dhanvī medhāvī vikramaḥ kramaḥ । anuttamo durādharṣaḥ kṛtajñaḥ kṛtirātmavān ॥22॥
html:
īśvaro vikramī dhanvī medhāvī vikramaḥ kramaḥ ।
anuttamo durādharṣaḥ kṛtajñaḥ kṛtirātmavān ॥22॥
slp1: ISvaro vikramI DanvI meDAvI vikramaH kramaH । anuttamo durADarzaH kftajYaH kftirAtmavAn ॥22॥

text: sureśaḥ śaraṇaṃ śarma viśvaretāḥ prajābhavaḥ । ahaḥ saṃvatsaro vyālaḥ pratyayaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ ॥23॥
html:
sureśaḥ śaraṇaṃ śarma viśvaretāḥ prajābhavaḥ ।
ahaḥ saṃvatsaro vyālaḥ pratyayaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: sureSaH SaraRaM Sarma viSvaretAH prajABavaH । ahaH saMvatsaro vyAlaH pratyayaH sarvadarSanaH ॥23॥

text: ajaḥ sarveśvaraḥ siddhaḥ siddhiḥ sarvādiracyutaḥ । vṛṣākapirameyātmā sarvayogaviniḥsṛtaḥ ॥24॥
html:
ajaḥ sarveśvaraḥ siddhaḥ siddhiḥ sarvādiracyutaḥ ।
vṛṣākapirameyātmā sarvayogaviniḥsṛtaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: ajaH sarveSvaraH sidDaH sidDiH sarvAdiracyutaH । vfzAkapirameyAtmA sarvayogaviniHsftaH ॥24॥

text: vasurvasumanāḥ satyaḥ samātmā sammitaḥ samaḥ । amoghaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo vṛṣakarmā vṛṣākṛtiḥ ॥25॥
html:
vasurvasumanāḥ satyaḥ samātmā sammitaḥ samaḥ ।
amoghaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo vṛṣakarmā vṛṣākṛtiḥ ॥25॥
slp1: vasurvasumanAH satyaH samAtmA sammitaH samaH । amoGaH puRqarIkAkzo vfzakarmA vfzAkftiH ॥25॥

text: rudro bahuśirā babhrurviśvayoniḥ śuciśravāḥ । amṛtaḥ śāśvataḥ sthāṇurvarāroho mahātapāḥ ॥26॥
html:
rudro bahuśirā babhrurviśvayoniḥ śuciśravāḥ ।
amṛtaḥ śāśvataḥ sthāṇurvarāroho mahātapāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: rudro bahuSirA baBrurviSvayoniH SuciSravAH । amftaH SASvataH sTARurvarAroho mahAtapAH ॥26॥

text: sarvagaḥ sarvavidbhānurviṣvakseno janārdanaḥ । vedo vedavidavyaṅgo vedāṅgo vedavitkaviḥ ॥27॥
html:
sarvagaḥ sarvavidbhānurviṣvakseno janārdanaḥ ।
vedo vedavidavyaṅgo vedāṅgo vedavitkaviḥ ॥27॥
slp1: sarvagaH sarvavidBAnurvizvakseno janArdanaH । vedo vedavidavyaNgo vedANgo vedavitkaviH ॥27॥

text: lokādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣo dharmādhyakṣaḥ kṛtākṛtaḥ । caturātmā caturvyūhaścaturdaṃṣṭraścaturbhujaḥ ॥28॥
html:
lokādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣo dharmādhyakṣaḥ kṛtākṛtaḥ ।
caturātmā caturvyūhaścaturdaṃṣṭraścaturbhujaḥ ॥28॥
slp1: lokADyakzaH surADyakzo DarmADyakzaH kftAkftaH । caturAtmA caturvyUhaScaturdaMzwraScaturBujaH ॥28॥

text: bhrājiṣṇurbhojanaṃ bhoktā sahiṣṇurjagadādijaḥ । anagho vijayo jetā viśvayoniḥ punarvasuḥ ॥29॥
html:
bhrājiṣṇurbhojanaṃ bhoktā sahiṣṇurjagadādijaḥ ।
anagho vijayo jetā viśvayoniḥ punarvasuḥ ॥29॥
slp1: BrAjizRurBojanaM BoktA sahizRurjagadAdijaH । anaGo vijayo jetA viSvayoniH punarvasuH ॥29॥

text: upendro vāmanaḥ prāṃśuramoghaḥ śucirūrjitaḥ । atīndraḥ saṅgrahaḥ sargo dhṛtātmā niyamo yamaḥ ॥30॥
html:
