slp1: akrUraH peSalo dakzo dakziRaH kzamiRAM varaH । vidvattamo vItaBayaH puRyaSravaRakIrtanaH ॥111॥

text: uttāraṇo duṣkṛtihā puṇyo duḥsvapnanāśanaḥ । vīrahā rakṣaṇaḥ santo jīvanaḥ paryavasthitaḥ ॥112॥
html:
uttāraṇo duṣkṛtihā puṇyo duḥsvapnanāśanaḥ ।
vīrahā rakṣaṇaḥ santo jīvanaḥ paryavasthitaḥ ॥112॥
slp1: uttAraRo duzkftihA puRyo duHsvapnanASanaH । vIrahA rakzaRaH santo jIvanaH paryavasTitaH ॥112॥

text: anantarūpo'nantaśrīrjitamanyurbhayāpahaḥ । caturasro gabhīrātmā vidiśo vyādiśo diśaḥ ॥113॥
html:
anantarūpo'nantaśrīrjitamanyurbhayāpahaḥ ।
caturasro gabhīrātmā vidiśo vyādiśo diśaḥ ॥113॥
slp1: anantarUpo'nantaSrIrjitamanyurBayApahaH । caturasro gaBIrAtmA vidiSo vyAdiSo diSaH ॥113॥

text: anādirbhūrbhuvo lakṣmīḥ suvīro rucirāṅgadaḥ । janano janajanmādirbhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ ॥114॥
html:
anādirbhūrbhuvo lakṣmīḥ suvīro rucirāṅgadaḥ ।
janano janajanmādirbhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ ॥114॥
slp1: anAdirBUrBuvo lakzmIH suvIro rucirANgadaH । janano janajanmAdirBImo BImaparAkramaH ॥114॥

text: ādhāranilayo dhātā puṣpahāsaḥ prajāgaraḥ । ūrdhvagaḥ satpathācāraḥ prāṇadaḥ praṇavaḥ paṇaḥ ॥115॥
html:
ādhāranilayo dhātā puṣpahāsaḥ prajāgaraḥ ।
ūrdhvagaḥ satpathācāraḥ prāṇadaḥ praṇavaḥ paṇaḥ ॥115॥
slp1: ADAranilayo DAtA puzpahAsaH prajAgaraH । UrDvagaH satpaTAcAraH prARadaH praRavaH paRaH ॥115॥

text: pramāṇaṃ prāṇanilayaḥ prāṇakṛtprāṇajīvanaḥ । tattvaṃ tattvavidekātmā janmamṛtyujarātigaḥ ॥116॥
html:
pramāṇaṃ prāṇanilayaḥ prāṇakṛtprāṇajīvanaḥ ।
tattvaṃ tattvavidekātmā janmamṛtyujarātigaḥ ॥116॥
slp1: pramARaM prARanilayaH prARakftprARajIvanaH । tattvaM tattvavidekAtmA janmamftyujarAtigaH ॥116॥

text: bhūrbhuvaḥ svastarustāraḥ savitā prapitāmahaḥ । yajño yajñapatiryajvā yajñāṅgo yajñavāhanaḥ ॥117॥
html:
bhūrbhuvaḥ svastarustāraḥ savitā prapitāmahaḥ ।
yajño yajñapatiryajvā yajñāṅgo yajñavāhanaḥ ॥117॥
slp1: BUrBuvaH svastarustAraH savitA prapitAmahaH । yajYo yajYapatiryajvA yajYANgo yajYavAhanaH ॥117॥

text: yajñabhṛdyajñakṛdyajñī yajñabhugyajñasādhanaḥ । yajñāntakṛdyajñaguhyamannamannāda eva ca ॥118॥
html:
yajñabhṛdyajñakṛdyajñī yajñabhugyajñasādhanaḥ ।
yajñāntakṛdyajñaguhyamannamannāda eva ca ॥118॥
slp1: yajYaBfdyajYakfdyajYI yajYaBugyajYasADanaH । yajYAntakfdyajYaguhyamannamannAda eva ca ॥118॥

text: ātmayoniḥ svayañjāto vaikhānaḥ sāmagāyanaḥ । devakīnandanaḥ sraṣṭā kṣitīśaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ ॥119॥
html:
ātmayoniḥ svayañjāto vaikhānaḥ sāmagāyanaḥ ।
devakīnandanaḥ sraṣṭā kṣitīśaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ ॥119॥
slp1: AtmayoniH svayaYjAto vEKAnaH sAmagAyanaH । devakInandanaH srazwA kzitISaH pApanASanaH ॥119॥

text: śaṅkhabhṛnnandakī cakrī śārṅgadhanvā gadādharaḥ । rathāṅgapāṇirakṣobhyaḥ sarvapraharaṇāyudhaḥ ॥120॥
html:
śaṅkhabhṛnnandakī cakrī śārṅgadhanvā gadādharaḥ ।
rathāṅgapāṇirakṣobhyaḥ sarvapraharaṇāyudhaḥ ॥120॥
slp1: SaNKaBfnnandakI cakrI SArNgaDanvA gadADaraH । raTANgapARirakzoByaH sarvapraharaRAyuDaH ॥120॥

text: itīdaṃ kīrtanīyasya keśavasya mahātmanaḥ । nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ divyānāmaśeṣeṇa prakīrtitam ॥121॥
html:
itīdaṃ kīrtanīyasya keśavasya mahātmanaḥ ।
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ divyānāmaśeṣeṇa prakīrtitam ॥121॥
slp1: itIdaM kIrtanIyasya keSavasya mahAtmanaH । nAmnAM sahasraM divyAnAmaSezeRa prakIrtitam ॥121॥

text: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ yaścāpi parikīrtayet । nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyātkiñcitso'mutreha ca mānavaḥ ॥122॥
html:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ yaścāpi parikīrtayet ।
nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyātkiñcitso'mutreha ca mānavaḥ ॥122॥
slp1: ya idaM SfRuyAnnityaM yaScApi parikIrtayet । nASuBaM prApnuyAtkiYcitso'mutreha ca mAnavaH ॥122॥

text: vedāntago brāhmaṇaḥ syātkṣatriyo vijayī bhavet । vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhaḥ syācchūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt ॥123॥
html:
vedāntago brāhmaṇaḥ syātkṣatriyo vijayī bhavet ।
vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhaḥ syācchūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt ॥123॥
slp1: vedAntago brAhmaRaH syAtkzatriyo vijayI Bavet । vESyo DanasamfdDaH syAcCUdraH suKamavApnuyAt ॥123॥

text: dharmārthī prāpnuyāddharmamarthārthī cārthamāpnuyāt । kāmānavāpnuyātkāmī prajārthī cāpnuyātprajāḥ ॥124॥
html:
dharmārthī prāpnuyāddharmamarthārthī cārthamāpnuyāt ।
kāmānavāpnuyātkāmī prajārthī cāpnuyātprajāḥ ॥124॥
slp1: DarmArTI prApnuyAdDarmamarTArTI cArTamApnuyAt । kAmAnavApnuyAtkAmI prajArTI cApnuyAtprajAH ॥124॥

text: bhaktimānyaḥ sadotthāya śucistadgatamānasaḥ । sahasraṃ vāsudevasya nāmnāmetatprakīrtayet ॥125॥
html:
bhaktimānyaḥ sadotthāya śucistadgatamānasaḥ ।
sahasraṃ vāsudevasya nāmnāmetatprakīrtayet ॥125॥
slp1: BaktimAnyaH sadotTAya SucistadgatamAnasaH । sahasraM vAsudevasya nAmnAmetatprakIrtayet ॥125॥

text: yaśaḥ prāpnoti vipulaṃ jñātiprādhānyameva ca । acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti śreyaścāpnotyanuttamam ॥126॥
html:
yaśaḥ prāpnoti vipulaṃ jñātiprādhānyameva ca ।
acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti śreyaścāpnotyanuttamam ॥126॥
slp1: yaSaH prApnoti vipulaM jYAtiprADAnyameva ca । acalAM SriyamApnoti SreyaScApnotyanuttamam ॥126॥

text: na bhayaṃ kvacidāpnoti vīryaṃ tejaśca vindati । bhavatyarogo dyutimānbalarūpaguṇānvitaḥ ॥127॥
html:
na bhayaṃ kvacidāpnoti vīryaṃ tejaśca vindati ।
bhavatyarogo dyutimānbalarūpaguṇānvitaḥ ॥127॥
slp1: na BayaM kvacidApnoti vIryaM tejaSca vindati । Bavatyarogo dyutimAnbalarUpaguRAnvitaH ॥127॥

text: rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt । bhayānmucyeta bhītaśca mucyetāpanna āpadaḥ ॥128॥
html:
rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt ।
bhayānmucyeta bhītaśca mucyetāpanna āpadaḥ ॥128॥
slp1: rogArto mucyate rogAdbadDo mucyeta banDanAt । BayAnmucyeta BItaSca mucyetApanna ApadaH ॥128॥

text: durgāṇyatitaratyāśu puruṣaḥ puruṣottamam । stuvannāmasahasreṇa nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ ॥129॥
html:
durgāṇyatitaratyāśu puruṣaḥ puruṣottamam ।
stuvannāmasahasreṇa nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ ॥129॥
slp1: durgARyatitaratyASu puruzaH puruzottamam । stuvannAmasahasreRa nityaM BaktisamanvitaH ॥129॥

text: vāsudevāśrayo martyo vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ । sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā yāti brahma sanātanam ॥130॥
html:
vāsudevāśrayo martyo vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ ।
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā yāti brahma sanātanam ॥130॥
slp1: vAsudevASrayo martyo vAsudevaparAyaRaH । sarvapApaviSudDAtmA yAti brahma sanAtanam ॥130॥

text: na vāsudevabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit । janmamṛtyujarāvyādhibhayaṃ vāpyupajāyate ॥131॥
html:
na vāsudevabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit ।
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhibhayaṃ vāpyupajāyate ॥131॥
slp1: na vAsudevaBaktAnAmaSuBaM vidyate kvacit । janmamftyujarAvyADiBayaM vApyupajAyate ॥131॥

text: imaṃ stavamadhīyānaḥ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ । yujyetātmasukhakṣāntiśrīdhṛtismṛtikīrtibhiḥ ॥132॥
html:
imaṃ stavamadhīyānaḥ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ ।
yujyetātmasukhakṣāntiśrīdhṛtismṛtikīrtibhiḥ ॥132॥
slp1: imaM stavamaDIyAnaH SradDABaktisamanvitaH । yujyetAtmasuKakzAntiSrIDftismftikIrtiBiH ॥132॥

text: na krodho na ca mātsaryaṃ na lobho nāśubhā matiḥ । bhavanti kṛtapuṇyānāṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame ॥133॥
html:
na krodho na ca mātsaryaṃ na lobho nāśubhā matiḥ ।
bhavanti kṛtapuṇyānāṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame ॥133॥
slp1: na kroDo na ca mAtsaryaM na loBo nASuBA matiH । Bavanti kftapuRyAnAM BaktAnAM puruzottame ॥133॥

text: dyauḥ sacandrārkanakṣatrā khaṃ diśo bhūrmahodadhiḥ । vāsudevasya vīryeṇa vidhṛtāni mahātmanaḥ ॥134॥
html:
dyauḥ sacandrārkanakṣatrā khaṃ diśo bhūrmahodadhiḥ ।
vāsudevasya vīryeṇa vidhṛtāni mahātmanaḥ ॥134॥
slp1: dyOH sacandrArkanakzatrA KaM diSo BUrmahodaDiH । vAsudevasya vIryeRa viDftAni mahAtmanaH ॥134॥

text: sasurāsuragandharvaṃ sayakṣoragarākṣasam । jagadvaśe vartatedaṃ kṛṣṇasya sacarācaram ॥135॥
html:
sasurāsuragandharvaṃ sayakṣoragarākṣasam ।
jagadvaśe vartatedaṃ kṛṣṇasya sacarācaram ॥135॥
slp1: sasurAsuraganDarvaM sayakzoragarAkzasam । jagadvaSe vartatedaM kfzRasya sacarAcaram ॥135॥

text: indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ sattvaṃ tejo balaṃ dhṛtiḥ । vāsudevātmakānyāhuḥ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajña eva ca ॥136॥
html:
indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ sattvaṃ tejo balaṃ dhṛtiḥ ।
vāsudevātmakānyāhuḥ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajña eva ca ॥136॥
slp1: indriyARi mano budDiH sattvaM tejo balaM DftiH । vAsudevAtmakAnyAhuH kzetraM kzetrajYa eva ca ॥136॥

text: sarvāgamānāmācāraḥ prathamaṃ parikalpyate । ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmasya prabhuracyutaḥ ॥137॥
html:
sarvāgamānāmācāraḥ prathamaṃ parikalpyate ।
ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmasya prabhuracyutaḥ ॥137॥
slp1: sarvAgamAnAmAcAraH praTamaM parikalpyate । AcArapraBavo Darmo Darmasya praBuracyutaH ॥137॥

text: ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā mahābhūtāni dhātavaḥ । jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ cedaṃ jagannārāyaṇodbhavam ॥138॥
html:
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā mahābhūtāni dhātavaḥ ।
jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ cedaṃ jagannārāyaṇodbhavam ॥138॥
slp1: fzayaH pitaro devA mahABUtAni DAtavaH । jaNgamAjaNgamaM cedaM jagannArAyaRodBavam ॥138॥

text: yogo jñānaṃ tathā sāṅkhyaṃ vidyāḥ śilpāni karma ca । vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vijñānametatsarvaṃ janārdanāt ॥139॥
html:
yogo jñānaṃ tathā sāṅkhyaṃ vidyāḥ śilpāni karma ca ।
vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vijñānametatsarvaṃ janārdanāt ॥139॥
slp1: yogo jYAnaM taTA sANKyaM vidyAH SilpAni karma ca । vedAH SAstrARi vijYAnametatsarvaM janArdanAt ॥139॥

text: eko viṣṇurmahadbhūtaṃ pṛthagbhūtānyanekaśaḥ । trīṁllokānvyāpya bhūtātmā bhuṅkte viśvabhugavyayaḥ ॥140॥
html:
eko viṣṇurmahadbhūtaṃ pṛthagbhūtānyanekaśaḥ ।
trīṁllokānvyāpya bhūtātmā bhuṅkte viśvabhugavyayaḥ ॥140॥
slp1: eko vizRurmahadBUtaM pfTagBUtAnyanekaSaH । trIṁllokAnvyApya BUtAtmA BuNkte viSvaBugavyayaH ॥140॥

text: imaṃ stavaṃ bhagavato viṣṇorvyāsena kīrtitam । paṭhedya icchetpuruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptuṃ sukhāni ca ॥141॥
html:
imaṃ stavaṃ bhagavato viṣṇorvyāsena kīrtitam ।
paṭhedya icchetpuruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptuṃ sukhāni ca ॥141॥
slp1: imaM stavaM Bagavato vizRorvyAsena kIrtitam । paWedya icCetpuruzaH SreyaH prAptuM suKAni ca ॥141॥

text: viśveśvaramajaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayam । bhajanti ye puṣkarākṣaṃ na te yānti parābhavam] ॥142॥
html:
viśveśvaramajaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayam ।
bhajanti ye puṣkarākṣaṃ na te yānti parābhavam] ॥142॥
slp1: viSveSvaramajaM devaM jagataH praBavApyayam । Bajanti ye puzkarAkzaM na te yAnti parABavam] ॥142॥

text: ke pūjyāḥ ke namaskāryāḥ kathaṃ varteta keṣu ca । kimācāraḥ kīdṛśeṣu pitāmaha na riṣyate ॥1॥
html:
ke pūjyāḥ ke namaskāryāḥ kathaṃ varteta keṣu ca ।
kimācāraḥ kīdṛśeṣu pitāmaha na riṣyate ॥1॥
slp1: ke pUjyAH ke namaskAryAH kaTaM varteta kezu ca । kimAcAraH kIdfSezu pitAmaha na rizyate ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: brāhmaṇānāṃ paribhavaḥ sādayedapi devatāḥ । brāhmaṇānāṃ namaskartā yudhiṣṭhira na riṣyate ॥2॥
html:
brāhmaṇānāṃ paribhavaḥ sādayedapi devatāḥ ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ namaskartā yudhiṣṭhira na riṣyate ॥2॥
slp1: brAhmaRAnAM pariBavaH sAdayedapi devatAH । brAhmaRAnAM namaskartA yuDizWira na rizyate ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: te pūjyāste namaskāryā vartethāsteṣu putravat । te hi lokānimānsarvāndhārayanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥3॥
html:
te pūjyāste namaskāryā vartethāsteṣu putravat ।
te hi lokānimānsarvāndhārayanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: te pUjyAste namaskAryA varteTAstezu putravat । te hi lokAnimAnsarvAnDArayanti manIziRaH ॥3॥

text: brāhmaṇāḥ sarvalokānāṃ mahānto dharmasetavaḥ । dhanatyāgābhirāmāśca vāksaṃyamaratāśca ye ॥4॥
html:
brāhmaṇāḥ sarvalokānāṃ mahānto dharmasetavaḥ ।
dhanatyāgābhirāmāśca vāksaṃyamaratāśca ye ॥4॥
slp1: brAhmaRAH sarvalokAnAM mahAnto DarmasetavaH । DanatyAgABirAmASca vAksaMyamaratASca ye ॥4॥

text: ramaṇīyāśca bhūtānāṃ nidhānaṃ ca dhṛtavratāḥ । praṇetāraśca lokānāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ ca yaśasvinaḥ ॥5॥
html:
ramaṇīyāśca bhūtānāṃ nidhānaṃ ca dhṛtavratāḥ ।
praṇetāraśca lokānāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ ca yaśasvinaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: ramaRIyASca BUtAnAM niDAnaM ca DftavratAH । praRetAraSca lokAnAM SAstrARAM ca yaSasvinaH ॥5॥

text: tapo yeṣāṃ dhanaṃ nityaṃ vākcaiva vipulaṃ balam । prabhavaścāpi dharmāṇāṃ dharmajñāḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ ॥6॥
html:
tapo yeṣāṃ dhanaṃ nityaṃ vākcaiva vipulaṃ balam ।
prabhavaścāpi dharmāṇāṃ dharmajñāḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: tapo yezAM DanaM nityaM vAkcEva vipulaM balam । praBavaScApi DarmARAM DarmajYAH sUkzmadarSinaH ॥6॥

text: dharmakāmāḥ sthitā dharme sukṛtairdharmasetavaḥ । yānupāśritya jīvanti prajāḥ sarvāścaturvidhāḥ ॥7॥
html:
dharmakāmāḥ sthitā dharme sukṛtairdharmasetavaḥ ।
yānupāśritya jīvanti prajāḥ sarvāścaturvidhāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: DarmakAmAH sTitA Darme sukftErDarmasetavaH । yAnupASritya jIvanti prajAH sarvAScaturviDAH ॥7॥

text: panthānaḥ sarvanetāro yajñavāhāḥ sanātanāḥ । pitṛpaitāmahīṃ gurvīmudvahanti dhuraṃ sadā ॥8॥
html:
panthānaḥ sarvanetāro yajñavāhāḥ sanātanāḥ ।
pitṛpaitāmahīṃ gurvīmudvahanti dhuraṃ sadā ॥8॥
slp1: panTAnaH sarvanetAro yajYavAhAH sanAtanAH । pitfpEtAmahIM gurvImudvahanti DuraM sadA ॥8॥

text: dhuri ye nāvasīdanti viṣame sadgavā iva । pitṛdevātithimukhā havyakavyāgrabhojinaḥ ॥9॥
html:
dhuri ye nāvasīdanti viṣame sadgavā iva ।
pitṛdevātithimukhā havyakavyāgrabhojinaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: Duri ye nAvasIdanti vizame sadgavA iva । pitfdevAtiTimuKA havyakavyAgraBojinaH ॥9॥

text: bhojanādeva ye lokāṃstrāyante mahato bhayāt । dīpāḥ sarvasya lokasya cakṣuścakṣuṣmatāmapi ॥10॥
html:
bhojanādeva ye lokāṃstrāyante mahato bhayāt ।
dīpāḥ sarvasya lokasya cakṣuścakṣuṣmatāmapi ॥10॥
slp1: BojanAdeva ye lokAMstrAyante mahato BayAt । dIpAH sarvasya lokasya cakzuScakzuzmatAmapi ॥10॥

text: sarvaśilpādinidhayo nipuṇāḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ । gatijñāḥ sarvabhūtānāmadhyātmagaticintakāḥ ॥11॥
html:
sarvaśilpādinidhayo nipuṇāḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ ।
gatijñāḥ sarvabhūtānāmadhyātmagaticintakāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: sarvaSilpAdiniDayo nipuRAH sUkzmadarSinaH । gatijYAH sarvaBUtAnAmaDyAtmagaticintakAH ॥11॥

text: ādimadhyāvasānānāṃ jñātāraśchinnasaṃśayāḥ । parāvaraviśeṣajñā gantāraḥ paramāṃ gatim ॥12॥
html:
ādimadhyāvasānānāṃ jñātāraśchinnasaṃśayāḥ ।
parāvaraviśeṣajñā gantāraḥ paramāṃ gatim ॥12॥
slp1: AdimaDyAvasAnAnAM jYAtAraSCinnasaMSayAH । parAvaraviSezajYA gantAraH paramAM gatim ॥12॥

text: vimuktā dhutapāpmāno nirdvandvā niṣparigrahāḥ । mānārhā mānitā nityaṃ jñānavidbhirmahātmabhiḥ ॥13॥
html:
vimuktā dhutapāpmāno nirdvandvā niṣparigrahāḥ ।
mānārhā mānitā nityaṃ jñānavidbhirmahātmabhiḥ ॥13॥
slp1: vimuktA DutapApmAno nirdvandvA nizparigrahAH । mAnArhA mAnitA nityaM jYAnavidBirmahAtmaBiH ॥13॥

text: candane malapaṅke ca bhojane'bhojane samāḥ । samaṃ yeṣāṃ dukūlaṃ ca śāṇakṣaumājināni ca ॥14॥
html:
candane malapaṅke ca bhojane'bhojane samāḥ ।
samaṃ yeṣāṃ dukūlaṃ ca śāṇakṣaumājināni ca ॥14॥
slp1: candane malapaNke ca Bojane'Bojane samAH । samaM yezAM dukUlaM ca SARakzOmAjinAni ca ॥14॥

text: tiṣṭheyurapyabhuñjānā bahūni divasānyapi । śoṣayeyuśca gātrāṇi svādhyāyaiḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ ॥15॥
html:
tiṣṭheyurapyabhuñjānā bahūni divasānyapi ।
śoṣayeyuśca gātrāṇi svādhyāyaiḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: tizWeyurapyaBuYjAnA bahUni divasAnyapi । SozayeyuSca gAtrARi svADyAyEH saMyatendriyAH ॥15॥

text: adaivaṃ daivataṃ kuryurdaivataṃ cāpyadaivatam । lokānanyānsṛjeyuśca lokapālāṃśca kopitāḥ ॥16॥
html:
adaivaṃ daivataṃ kuryurdaivataṃ cāpyadaivatam ।
lokānanyānsṛjeyuśca lokapālāṃśca kopitāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: adEvaM dEvataM kuryurdEvataM cApyadEvatam । lokAnanyAnsfjeyuSca lokapAlAMSca kopitAH ॥16॥

text: apeyaḥ sāgaro yeṣāmabhiśāpānmahātmanām । yeṣāṃ kopāgniradyāpi daṇḍake nopaśāmyati ॥17॥
html:
apeyaḥ sāgaro yeṣāmabhiśāpānmahātmanām ।
yeṣāṃ kopāgniradyāpi daṇḍake nopaśāmyati ॥17॥
slp1: apeyaH sAgaro yezAmaBiSApAnmahAtmanAm । yezAM kopAgniradyApi daRqake nopaSAmyati ॥17॥

text: devānāmapi ye devāḥ kāraṇaṃ kāraṇasya ca । pramāṇasya pramāṇaṃ ca kastānabhibhavedbudhaḥ ॥18॥
html:
devānāmapi ye devāḥ kāraṇaṃ kāraṇasya ca ।
pramāṇasya pramāṇaṃ ca kastānabhibhavedbudhaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: devAnAmapi ye devAH kAraRaM kAraRasya ca । pramARasya pramARaM ca kastAnaBiBavedbuDaH ॥18॥

text: yeṣāṃ vṛddhaśca bālaśca sarvaḥ sammānamarhati । tapovidyāviśeṣāttu mānayanti parasparam ॥19॥
html:
yeṣāṃ vṛddhaśca bālaśca sarvaḥ sammānamarhati ।
tapovidyāviśeṣāttu mānayanti parasparam ॥19॥
slp1: yezAM vfdDaSca bAlaSca sarvaH sammAnamarhati । tapovidyAviSezAttu mAnayanti parasparam ॥19॥

text: avidvānbrāhmaṇo devaḥ pātraṃ vai pāvanaṃ mahat । vidvānbhūyastaro devaḥ pūrṇasāgarasannibhaḥ ॥20॥
html:
avidvānbrāhmaṇo devaḥ pātraṃ vai pāvanaṃ mahat ।
vidvānbhūyastaro devaḥ pūrṇasāgarasannibhaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: avidvAnbrAhmaRo devaH pAtraM vE pAvanaM mahat । vidvAnBUyastaro devaH pUrRasAgarasanniBaH ॥20॥

text: avidvāṃścaiva vidvāṃśca brāhmaṇo daivataṃ mahat । praṇītaścāpraṇītaśca yathāgnirdaivataṃ mahat ॥21॥
html:
avidvāṃścaiva vidvāṃśca brāhmaṇo daivataṃ mahat ।
praṇītaścāpraṇītaśca yathāgnirdaivataṃ mahat ॥21॥
slp1: avidvAMScEva vidvAMSca brAhmaRo dEvataM mahat । praRItaScApraRItaSca yaTAgnirdEvataM mahat ॥21॥

text: śmaśāne hyapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati । haviryajñeṣu ca vahanbhūya evābhiśobhate ॥22॥
html:
śmaśāne hyapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati ।
haviryajñeṣu ca vahanbhūya evābhiśobhate ॥22॥
slp1: SmaSAne hyapi tejasvI pAvako nEva duzyati । haviryajYezu ca vahanBUya evABiSoBate ॥22॥

text: evaṃ yadyapyaniṣṭeṣu vartate sarvakarmasu । sarvathā brāhmaṇo mānyo daivataṃ viddhi tatparam] ॥23॥
html:
evaṃ yadyapyaniṣṭeṣu vartate sarvakarmasu ।
sarvathā brāhmaṇo mānyo daivataṃ viddhi tatparam] ॥23॥
slp1: evaM yadyapyanizwezu vartate sarvakarmasu । sarvaTA brAhmaRo mAnyo dEvataM vidDi tatparam] ॥23॥

text: kāṃ tu brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā janādhipa । kaṃ vā karmodayaṃ matvā tānarcasi mahāmate ॥1॥
html:
kāṃ tu brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā janādhipa ।
kaṃ vā karmodayaṃ matvā tānarcasi mahāmate ॥1॥
slp1: kAM tu brAhmaRapUjAyAM vyuzwiM dfzwvA janADipa । kaM vA karmodayaM matvA tAnarcasi mahAmate ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam । pavanasya ca saṃvādamarjunasya ca bhārata ॥2॥
html:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
pavanasya ca saṃvādamarjunasya ca bhārata ॥2॥
slp1: atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam । pavanasya ca saMvAdamarjunasya ca BArata ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: sahasrabhujabhṛcchrīmānkārtavīryo'bhavatprabhuḥ । asya lokasya sarvasya māhiṣmatyāṃ mahābalaḥ ॥3॥
html:
sahasrabhujabhṛcchrīmānkārtavīryo'bhavatprabhuḥ ।
asya lokasya sarvasya māhiṣmatyāṃ mahābalaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: sahasraBujaBfcCrImAnkArtavIryo'BavatpraBuH । asya lokasya sarvasya mAhizmatyAM mahAbalaH ॥3॥

text: sa tu ratnākaravatīṃ sadvīpāṃ sāgarāmbarām । śaśāsa sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ haihayaḥ satyavikramaḥ ॥4॥
html:
sa tu ratnākaravatīṃ sadvīpāṃ sāgarāmbarām ।
śaśāsa sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ haihayaḥ satyavikramaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: sa tu ratnAkaravatIM sadvIpAM sAgarAmbarAm । SaSAsa sarvAM pfTivIM hEhayaH satyavikramaH ॥4॥

text: svavittaṃ tena dattaṃ tu dattātreyāya kāraṇe । kṣatradharmaṃ puraskṛtya vinayaṃ śrutameva ca ॥5॥
html:
svavittaṃ tena dattaṃ tu dattātreyāya kāraṇe ।
kṣatradharmaṃ puraskṛtya vinayaṃ śrutameva ca ॥5॥
slp1: svavittaM tena dattaM tu dattAtreyAya kAraRe । kzatraDarmaM puraskftya vinayaM Srutameva ca ॥5॥

text: ārādhayāmāsa ca taṃ kṛtavīryātmajo munim । nyamantrayata saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sa dvijaśca varaistribhiḥ ॥6॥
html:
ārādhayāmāsa ca taṃ kṛtavīryātmajo munim ।
nyamantrayata saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sa dvijaśca varaistribhiḥ ॥6॥
slp1: ArADayAmAsa ca taM kftavIryAtmajo munim । nyamantrayata saMhfzwaH sa dvijaSca varEstriBiH ॥6॥

text: sa varaiśchanditastena nṛpo vacanamabravīt । sahasrabāhurbhūyāṃ vai camūmadhye gṛhe'nyathā ॥7॥
html:
sa varaiśchanditastena nṛpo vacanamabravīt ।
sahasrabāhurbhūyāṃ vai camūmadhye gṛhe'nyathā ॥7॥
slp1: sa varESCanditastena nfpo vacanamabravIt । sahasrabAhurBUyAM vE camUmaDye gfhe'nyaTA ॥7॥

text: mama bāhusahasraṃ tu paśyantāṃ sainikā raṇe । vikrameṇa mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ jayeyaṃ vipulavrata । tāṃ ca dharmeṇa samprāpya pālayeyamatandritaḥ ॥8॥
html:
mama bāhusahasraṃ tu paśyantāṃ sainikā raṇe ।
vikrameṇa mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ jayeyaṃ vipulavrata ।
tāṃ ca dharmeṇa samprāpya pālayeyamatandritaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: mama bAhusahasraM tu paSyantAM sEnikA raRe । vikrameRa mahIM kftsnAM jayeyaM vipulavrata । tAM ca DarmeRa samprApya pAlayeyamatandritaH ॥8॥

text: caturthaṃ tu varaṃ yāce tvāmahaṃ dvijasattama । taṃ mamānugrahakṛte dātumarhasyanindita । anuśāsantu māṃ santo mithyāvṛttaṃ tadāśrayam ॥9॥
html:
caturthaṃ tu varaṃ yāce tvāmahaṃ dvijasattama ।
taṃ mamānugrahakṛte dātumarhasyanindita ।
anuśāsantu māṃ santo mithyāvṛttaṃ tadāśrayam ॥9॥
slp1: caturTaM tu varaM yAce tvAmahaM dvijasattama । taM mamAnugrahakfte dAtumarhasyanindita । anuSAsantu mAM santo miTyAvfttaM tadASrayam ॥9॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa dvijaḥ prāha tathāstviti narādhipam । evaṃ samabhavaṃstasya varāste dīptatejasaḥ ॥10॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa dvijaḥ prāha tathāstviti narādhipam ।
evaṃ samabhavaṃstasya varāste dīptatejasaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa dvijaH prAha taTAstviti narADipam । evaM samaBavaMstasya varAste dIptatejasaH ॥10॥

text: tataḥ sa rathamāsthāya jvalanārkasamadyutiḥ । abravīdvīryasammohātko nvasti sadṛśo mayā । vīryadhairyayaśaḥśaucairvikrameṇaujasāpi vā ॥11॥
html:
tataḥ sa rathamāsthāya jvalanārkasamadyutiḥ ।
abravīdvīryasammohātko nvasti sadṛśo mayā ।
vīryadhairyayaśaḥśaucairvikrameṇaujasāpi vā ॥11॥
slp1: tataH sa raTamAsTAya jvalanArkasamadyutiH । abravIdvIryasammohAtko nvasti sadfSo mayA । vIryaDEryayaSaHSOcErvikrameROjasApi vA ॥11॥

text: tadvākyānte cāntarikṣe vāguvācāśarīriṇī । na tvaṃ mūḍha vijānīṣe brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyādvaram । sahito brāhmaṇeneha kṣatriyo rakṣati prajāḥ ॥12॥
html:
tadvākyānte cāntarikṣe vāguvācāśarīriṇī ।
na tvaṃ mūḍha vijānīṣe brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyādvaram ।
sahito brāhmaṇeneha kṣatriyo rakṣati prajāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tadvAkyAnte cAntarikze vAguvAcASarIriRI । na tvaM mUQa vijAnIze brAhmaRaM kzatriyAdvaram । sahito brAhmaReneha kzatriyo rakzati prajAH ॥12॥

text: kuryāṃ bhūtāni tuṣṭo'haṃ kruddho nāśaṃ tathā naye । karmaṇā manasā vācā na matto'sti varo dvijaḥ ॥13॥
html:
kuryāṃ bhūtāni tuṣṭo'haṃ kruddho nāśaṃ tathā naye ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā na matto'sti varo dvijaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: kuryAM BUtAni tuzwo'haM krudDo nASaM taTA naye । karmaRA manasA vAcA na matto'sti varo dvijaH ॥13॥
author: arjuna uvāca ।

text: pūrvo brahmottaro vādo dvitīyaḥ kṣatriyottaraḥ । tvayoktau yau tu tau hetū viśeṣastvatra dṛśyate ॥14॥
html:
pūrvo brahmottaro vādo dvitīyaḥ kṣatriyottaraḥ ।
tvayoktau yau tu tau hetū viśeṣastvatra dṛśyate ॥14॥
slp1: pUrvo brahmottaro vAdo dvitIyaH kzatriyottaraH । tvayoktO yO tu tO hetU viSezastvatra dfSyate ॥14॥

text: brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśritāḥ kṣatraṃ na kṣatraṃ brāhmaṇāśritam । śritānbrahmopadhā viprāḥ khādanti kṣatriyānbhuvi ॥15॥
html:
brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśritāḥ kṣatraṃ na kṣatraṃ brāhmaṇāśritam ।
śritānbrahmopadhā viprāḥ khādanti kṣatriyānbhuvi ॥15॥
slp1: brAhmaRAH saMSritAH kzatraM na kzatraM brAhmaRASritam । SritAnbrahmopaDA viprAH KAdanti kzatriyAnBuvi ॥15॥

text: kṣatriyeṣvāśrito dharmaḥ prajānāṃ paripālanam । kṣatrādvṛttirbrāhmaṇānāṃ taiḥ kathaṃ brāhmaṇo varaḥ ॥16॥
html:
kṣatriyeṣvāśrito dharmaḥ prajānāṃ paripālanam ।
kṣatrādvṛttirbrāhmaṇānāṃ taiḥ kathaṃ brāhmaṇo varaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: kzatriyezvASrito DarmaH prajAnAM paripAlanam । kzatrAdvfttirbrAhmaRAnAM tEH kaTaM brAhmaRo varaH ॥16॥

text: sarvabhūtapradhānāṃstānbhaikṣavṛttīnahaṃ sadā । ātmasambhāvitānviprānsthāpayāmyātmano vaśe ॥17॥
html:
sarvabhūtapradhānāṃstānbhaikṣavṛttīnahaṃ sadā ।
ātmasambhāvitānviprānsthāpayāmyātmano vaśe ॥17॥
slp1: sarvaBUtapraDAnAMstAnBEkzavfttInahaM sadA । AtmasamBAvitAnviprAnsTApayAmyAtmano vaSe ॥17॥

text: kathitaṃ hyanayā satyaṃ gāyatryā kanyayā divi । vijeṣyāmyavaśānsarvānbrāhmaṇāṃścarmavāsasaḥ ॥18॥
html:
kathitaṃ hyanayā satyaṃ gāyatryā kanyayā divi ।
vijeṣyāmyavaśānsarvānbrāhmaṇāṃścarmavāsasaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: kaTitaM hyanayA satyaM gAyatryA kanyayA divi । vijezyAmyavaSAnsarvAnbrAhmaRAMScarmavAsasaH ॥18॥

text: na ca māṃ cyāvayedrāṣṭrāttriṣu lokeṣu kaścana । devo vā mānuṣo vāpi tasmājjyeṣṭho dvijādaham ॥19॥
html:
na ca māṃ cyāvayedrāṣṭrāttriṣu lokeṣu kaścana ।
devo vā mānuṣo vāpi tasmājjyeṣṭho dvijādaham ॥19॥
slp1: na ca mAM cyAvayedrAzwrAttrizu lokezu kaScana । devo vA mAnuzo vApi tasmAjjyezWo dvijAdaham ॥19॥

text: adya brahmottaraṃ lokaṃ kariṣye kṣatriyottaram । na hi me saṃyuge kaścitsoḍhumutsahate balam ॥20॥
html:
adya brahmottaraṃ lokaṃ kariṣye kṣatriyottaram ।
na hi me saṃyuge kaścitsoḍhumutsahate balam ॥20॥
slp1: adya brahmottaraM lokaM karizye kzatriyottaram । na hi me saMyuge kaScitsoQumutsahate balam ॥20॥

text: arjunasya vacaḥ śrutvā vitrastābhūnniśācarī । athainamantarikṣasthastato vāyurabhāṣata ॥21॥
html:
arjunasya vacaḥ śrutvā vitrastābhūnniśācarī ।
athainamantarikṣasthastato vāyurabhāṣata ॥21॥
slp1: arjunasya vacaH SrutvA vitrastABUnniSAcarI । aTEnamantarikzasTastato vAyuraBAzata ॥21॥

text: tyajainaṃ kaluṣaṃ bhāvaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo namaskuru । eteṣāṃ kurvataḥ pāpaṃ rāṣṭrakṣobho hi te bhavet ॥22॥
html:
tyajainaṃ kaluṣaṃ bhāvaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo namaskuru ।
eteṣāṃ kurvataḥ pāpaṃ rāṣṭrakṣobho hi te bhavet ॥22॥
slp1: tyajEnaM kaluzaM BAvaM brAhmaReByo namaskuru । etezAM kurvataH pApaM rAzwrakzoBo hi te Bavet ॥22॥

text: atha vā tvāṃ mahīpāla śamayiṣyanti vai dvijāḥ । nirasiṣyanti vā rāṣṭrāddhatotsāhaṃ mahābalāḥ ॥23॥
html:
atha vā tvāṃ mahīpāla śamayiṣyanti vai dvijāḥ ।
nirasiṣyanti vā rāṣṭrāddhatotsāhaṃ mahābalāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: aTa vA tvAM mahIpAla Samayizyanti vE dvijAH । nirasizyanti vA rAzwrAdDatotsAhaM mahAbalAH ॥23॥

text: taṃ rājā kastvamityāha tatastaṃ prāha mārutaḥ । vāyurvai devadūto'smi hitaṃ tvāṃ prabravīmyaham ॥24॥
html:
taṃ rājā kastvamityāha tatastaṃ prāha mārutaḥ ।
vāyurvai devadūto'smi hitaṃ tvāṃ prabravīmyaham ॥24॥
slp1: taM rAjA kastvamityAha tatastaM prAha mArutaH । vAyurvE devadUto'smi hitaM tvAM prabravImyaham ॥24॥

text: aho tvayādya vipreṣu bhaktirāgaḥ pradarśitaḥ । yādṛśaṃ pṛthivī bhūtaṃ tādṛśaṃ brūhi vai dvijam ॥25॥
html:
aho tvayādya vipreṣu bhaktirāgaḥ pradarśitaḥ ।
yādṛśaṃ pṛthivī bhūtaṃ tādṛśaṃ brūhi vai dvijam ॥25॥
slp1: aho tvayAdya viprezu BaktirAgaH pradarSitaH । yAdfSaM pfTivI BUtaM tAdfSaM brUhi vE dvijam ॥25॥
author: arjuna uvāca ।

text: vāyorvā sadṛśaṃ kiñcidbrūhi tvaṃ brāhmaṇottamam । apāṃ vai sadṛśaṃ brūhi sūryasya nabhaso'pi vā] ॥26॥
html:
vāyorvā sadṛśaṃ kiñcidbrūhi tvaṃ brāhmaṇottamam ।
apāṃ vai sadṛśaṃ brūhi sūryasya nabhaso'pi vā] ॥26॥
slp1: vAyorvA sadfSaM kiYcidbrUhi tvaM brAhmaRottamam । apAM vE sadfSaM brUhi sUryasya naBaso'pi vA] ॥26॥

text: śṛṇu mūḍha guṇānkāṃścidbrāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām । ye tvayā kīrtitā rājaṃstebhyo'tha brāhmaṇo varaḥ ॥1॥
html:
śṛṇu mūḍha guṇānkāṃścidbrāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ।
ye tvayā kīrtitā rājaṃstebhyo'tha brāhmaṇo varaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: SfRu mUQa guRAnkAMScidbrAhmaRAnAM mahAtmanAm । ye tvayA kIrtitA rAjaMsteByo'Ta brAhmaRo varaH ॥1॥
author: vāyuruvāca ।

text: tyaktvā mahītvaṃ bhūmistu spardhayāṅganṛpasya ha । nāśaṃ jagāma tāṃ vipro vyaṣṭambhayata kaśyapaḥ ॥2॥
html:
tyaktvā mahītvaṃ bhūmistu spardhayāṅganṛpasya ha ।
nāśaṃ jagāma tāṃ vipro vyaṣṭambhayata kaśyapaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: tyaktvA mahItvaM BUmistu sparDayANganfpasya ha । nASaM jagAma tAM vipro vyazwamBayata kaSyapaH ॥2॥

text: akṣayā brāhmaṇā rājandivi ceha ca nityadā । apibattejasā hyāpaḥ svayamevāṅgirāḥ purā ॥3॥
html:
akṣayā brāhmaṇā rājandivi ceha ca nityadā ।
apibattejasā hyāpaḥ svayamevāṅgirāḥ purā ॥3॥
slp1: akzayA brAhmaRA rAjandivi ceha ca nityadA । apibattejasA hyApaH svayamevANgirAH purA ॥3॥

text: sa tāḥ pibankṣīramiva nātṛpyata mahātapāḥ । apūrayanmahaughena mahīṃ sarvāṃ ca pārthiva ॥4॥
html:
sa tāḥ pibankṣīramiva nātṛpyata mahātapāḥ ।
apūrayanmahaughena mahīṃ sarvāṃ ca pārthiva ॥4॥
slp1: sa tAH pibankzIramiva nAtfpyata mahAtapAH । apUrayanmahOGena mahIM sarvAM ca pArTiva ॥4॥

text: tasminnahaṃ ca kruddhe vai jagattyaktvā tato gataḥ । vyatiṣṭhamagnihotre ca ciramaṅgiraso bhayāt ॥5॥
html:
tasminnahaṃ ca kruddhe vai jagattyaktvā tato gataḥ ।
vyatiṣṭhamagnihotre ca ciramaṅgiraso bhayāt ॥5॥
slp1: tasminnahaM ca krudDe vE jagattyaktvA tato gataH । vyatizWamagnihotre ca ciramaNgiraso BayAt ॥5॥

text: abhiśaptaśca bhagavāngautamena purandaraḥ । ahalyāṃ kāmayāno vai dharmārthaṃ ca na hiṃsitaḥ ॥6॥
html:
abhiśaptaśca bhagavāngautamena purandaraḥ ।
ahalyāṃ kāmayāno vai dharmārthaṃ ca na hiṃsitaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: aBiSaptaSca BagavAngOtamena purandaraH । ahalyAM kAmayAno vE DarmArTaM ca na hiMsitaH ॥6॥

text: tathā samudro nṛpate pūrṇo mṛṣṭena vāriṇā । brāhmaṇairabhiśaptaḥ saṁllavaṇodaḥ kṛto vibho ॥7॥
html:
tathā samudro nṛpate pūrṇo mṛṣṭena vāriṇā ।
brāhmaṇairabhiśaptaḥ saṁllavaṇodaḥ kṛto vibho ॥7॥
slp1: taTA samudro nfpate pUrRo mfzwena vAriRA । brAhmaREraBiSaptaH saṁllavaRodaH kfto viBo ॥7॥

text: suvarṇavarṇo nirdhūmaḥ saṃhatordhvaśikhaḥ kaviḥ । kruddhenāṅgirasā śapto guṇairetairvivarjitaḥ ॥8॥
html:
suvarṇavarṇo nirdhūmaḥ saṃhatordhvaśikhaḥ kaviḥ ।
kruddhenāṅgirasā śapto guṇairetairvivarjitaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: suvarRavarRo nirDUmaH saMhatorDvaSiKaH kaviH । krudDenANgirasA Sapto guREretErvivarjitaH ॥8॥

text: marutaścūrṇitānpaśya ye'hasanta mahodadhim । suvarṇadhāriṇā nityamavaśaptā dvijātinā ॥9॥
html:
marutaścūrṇitānpaśya ye'hasanta mahodadhim ।
suvarṇadhāriṇā nityamavaśaptā dvijātinā ॥9॥
slp1: marutaScUrRitAnpaSya ye'hasanta mahodaDim । suvarRaDAriRA nityamavaSaptA dvijAtinA ॥9॥

text: samo na tvaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ viddhi narādhipa । garbhasthānbrāhmaṇānsamyaṅnamasyati kila prabhuḥ ॥10॥
html:
samo na tvaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ viddhi narādhipa ।
garbhasthānbrāhmaṇānsamyaṅnamasyati kila prabhuḥ ॥10॥
slp1: samo na tvaM dvijAtiByaH SrezWaM vidDi narADipa । garBasTAnbrAhmaRAnsamyaNnamasyati kila praBuH ॥10॥

text: daṇḍakānāṃ mahadrājyaṃ brāhmaṇena vināśitam । tālajaṅghaṃ mahatkṣatramaurveṇaikena nāśitam ॥11॥
html:
daṇḍakānāṃ mahadrājyaṃ brāhmaṇena vināśitam ।
tālajaṅghaṃ mahatkṣatramaurveṇaikena nāśitam ॥11॥
slp1: daRqakAnAM mahadrAjyaM brAhmaRena vinASitam । tAlajaNGaM mahatkzatramOrveREkena nASitam ॥11॥

text: tvayā ca vipulaṃ rājyaṃ balaṃ dharmaḥ śrutaṃ tathā । dattātreyaprasādena prāptaṃ paramadurlabham ॥12॥
html:
tvayā ca vipulaṃ rājyaṃ balaṃ dharmaḥ śrutaṃ tathā ।
dattātreyaprasādena prāptaṃ paramadurlabham ॥12॥
slp1: tvayA ca vipulaM rAjyaM balaM DarmaH SrutaM taTA । dattAtreyaprasAdena prAptaM paramadurlaBam ॥12॥

text: agniṃ tvaṃ yajase nityaṃ kasmādarjuna brāhmaṇam । sa hi sarvasya lokasya havyavāṭkiṃ na vetsi tam ॥13॥
html:
agniṃ tvaṃ yajase nityaṃ kasmādarjuna brāhmaṇam ।
sa hi sarvasya lokasya havyavāṭkiṃ na vetsi tam ॥13॥
slp1: agniM tvaM yajase nityaM kasmAdarjuna brAhmaRam । sa hi sarvasya lokasya havyavAwkiM na vetsi tam ॥13॥

text: atha vā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhamanu bhūtānupālakam । kartāraṃ jīvalokasya kasmājjānanvimuhyase ॥14॥
html:
atha vā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhamanu bhūtānupālakam ।
kartāraṃ jīvalokasya kasmājjānanvimuhyase ॥14॥
slp1: aTa vA brAhmaRaSrezWamanu BUtAnupAlakam । kartAraM jIvalokasya kasmAjjAnanvimuhyase ॥14॥

text: tathā prajāpatirbrahmā avyaktaḥ prabhavāpyayaḥ । yenedaṃ nikhilaṃ viśvaṃ janitaṃ sthāvaraṃ caram ॥15॥
html:
tathā prajāpatirbrahmā avyaktaḥ prabhavāpyayaḥ ।
yenedaṃ nikhilaṃ viśvaṃ janitaṃ sthāvaraṃ caram ॥15॥
slp1: taTA prajApatirbrahmA avyaktaH praBavApyayaH । yenedaM niKilaM viSvaM janitaM sTAvaraM caram ॥15॥

text: aṇḍajātaṃ tu brahmāṇaṃ kecidicchantyapaṇḍitāḥ । aṇḍādbhinnādbabhuḥ śailā diśo'mbhaḥ pṛthivī divam ॥16॥
html:
aṇḍajātaṃ tu brahmāṇaṃ kecidicchantyapaṇḍitāḥ ।
aṇḍādbhinnādbabhuḥ śailā diśo'mbhaḥ pṛthivī divam ॥16॥
slp1: aRqajAtaM tu brahmARaM kecidicCantyapaRqitAH । aRqAdBinnAdbaBuH SElA diSo'mBaH pfTivI divam ॥16॥

text: draṣṭavyaṃ naitadevaṃ hi kathaṃ jyāyastamo hi saḥ । smṛtamākāśamaṇḍaṃ tu tasmājjātaḥ pitāmahaḥ ॥17॥
html:
draṣṭavyaṃ naitadevaṃ hi kathaṃ jyāyastamo hi saḥ ।
smṛtamākāśamaṇḍaṃ tu tasmājjātaḥ pitāmahaḥ ॥17॥
slp1: drazwavyaM nEtadevaM hi kaTaM jyAyastamo hi saH । smftamAkASamaRqaM tu tasmAjjAtaH pitAmahaH ॥17॥

text: tiṣṭhetkathamiti brūhi na kiñciddhi tadā bhavet । ahaṅkāra iti proktaḥ sarvatejogataḥ prabhuḥ ॥18॥
html:
tiṣṭhetkathamiti brūhi na kiñciddhi tadā bhavet ।
ahaṅkāra iti proktaḥ sarvatejogataḥ prabhuḥ ॥18॥
slp1: tizWetkaTamiti brUhi na kiYcidDi tadA Bavet । ahaNkAra iti proktaH sarvatejogataH praBuH ॥18॥

text: nāstyaṇḍamasti tu brahmā sa rājaṁllokabhāvanaḥ । ityuktaḥ sa tadā tūṣṇīmabhūdvāyustamabravīt] ॥19॥
html:
nāstyaṇḍamasti tu brahmā sa rājaṁllokabhāvanaḥ ।
ityuktaḥ sa tadā tūṣṇīmabhūdvāyustamabravīt] ॥19॥
slp1: nAstyaRqamasti tu brahmA sa rAjaṁllokaBAvanaH । ityuktaH sa tadA tUzRImaBUdvAyustamabravIt] ॥19॥

text: imāṃ bhūmiṃ brāhmaṇebhyo ditsurvai dakṣiṇāṃ purā । aṅgo nāma nṛpo rājaṃstataścintāṃ mahī yayau ॥1॥
html:
imāṃ bhūmiṃ brāhmaṇebhyo ditsurvai dakṣiṇāṃ purā ।
aṅgo nāma nṛpo rājaṃstataścintāṃ mahī yayau ॥1॥
slp1: imAM BUmiM brAhmaReByo ditsurvE dakziRAM purA । aNgo nAma nfpo rAjaMstataScintAM mahI yayO ॥1॥
author: vāyuruvāca ।

text: dhāraṇīṃ sarvabhūtānāmayaṃ prāpya varo nṛpaḥ । kathamicchati māṃ dātuṃ dvijebhyo brahmaṇaḥ sutām ॥2॥
html:
dhāraṇīṃ sarvabhūtānāmayaṃ prāpya varo nṛpaḥ ।
kathamicchati māṃ dātuṃ dvijebhyo brahmaṇaḥ sutām ॥2॥
slp1: DAraRIM sarvaBUtAnAmayaM prApya varo nfpaH । kaTamicCati mAM dAtuM dvijeByo brahmaRaH sutAm ॥2॥

text: sāhaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyāmi bhūmitvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam । ayaṃ sarāṣṭro nṛpatirmā bhūditi tato'gamat ॥3॥
html:
sāhaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyāmi bhūmitvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam ।
ayaṃ sarāṣṭro nṛpatirmā bhūditi tato'gamat ॥3॥
slp1: sAhaM tyaktvA gamizyAmi BUmitvaM brahmaRaH padam । ayaM sarAzwro nfpatirmA BUditi tato'gamat ॥3॥

text: tatastāṃ kaśyapo dṛṣṭvā vrajantīṃ pṛthivīṃ tadā । praviveśa mahīṃ sadyo muktvātmānaṃ samāhitaḥ ॥4॥
html:
tatastāṃ kaśyapo dṛṣṭvā vrajantīṃ pṛthivīṃ tadā ।
praviveśa mahīṃ sadyo muktvātmānaṃ samāhitaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: tatastAM kaSyapo dfzwvA vrajantIM pfTivIM tadA । praviveSa mahIM sadyo muktvAtmAnaM samAhitaH ॥4॥

text: ruddhā sā sarvato jajñe tṛṇauṣadhisamanvitā । dharmottarā naṣṭabhayā bhūmirāsīttato nṛpa ॥5॥
html:
ruddhā sā sarvato jajñe tṛṇauṣadhisamanvitā ।
dharmottarā naṣṭabhayā bhūmirāsīttato nṛpa ॥5॥
slp1: rudDA sA sarvato jajYe tfROzaDisamanvitA । DarmottarA nazwaBayA BUmirAsIttato nfpa ॥5॥

text: evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi divyāni vipulavrataḥ । triṃśataṃ kaśyapo rājanbhūmirāsīdatandritaḥ ॥6॥
html:
evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi divyāni vipulavrataḥ ।
triṃśataṃ kaśyapo rājanbhūmirāsīdatandritaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: evaM varzasahasrARi divyAni vipulavrataH । triMSataM kaSyapo rAjanBUmirAsIdatandritaH ॥6॥

text: athāgamya mahārāja namaskṛtya ca kaśyapam । pṛthivī kāśyapī jajñe sutā tasya mahātmanaḥ ॥7॥
html:
athāgamya mahārāja namaskṛtya ca kaśyapam ।
pṛthivī kāśyapī jajñe sutā tasya mahātmanaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: aTAgamya mahArAja namaskftya ca kaSyapam । pfTivI kASyapI jajYe sutA tasya mahAtmanaH ॥7॥

text: eṣa rājannīdṛśo vai brāhmaṇaḥ kaśyapo'bhavat । anyaṃ prabrūhi vāpi tvaṃ kaśyapātkṣatriyaṃ varam ॥8॥
html:
eṣa rājannīdṛśo vai brāhmaṇaḥ kaśyapo'bhavat ।
anyaṃ prabrūhi vāpi tvaṃ kaśyapātkṣatriyaṃ varam ॥8॥
slp1: eza rAjannIdfSo vE brAhmaRaH kaSyapo'Bavat । anyaM prabrUhi vApi tvaM kaSyapAtkzatriyaM varam ॥8॥

text: tūṣṇīṃ babhūva nṛpatiḥ pavanastvabravītpunaḥ । śṛṇu rājannutathyasya jātasyāṅgirase kule ॥9॥
html:
tūṣṇīṃ babhūva nṛpatiḥ pavanastvabravītpunaḥ ।
śṛṇu rājannutathyasya jātasyāṅgirase kule ॥9॥
slp1: tUzRIM baBUva nfpatiH pavanastvabravItpunaH । SfRu rAjannutaTyasya jAtasyANgirase kule ॥9॥

text: bhadrā somasya duhitā rūpeṇa paramā matā । tasyāstulyaṃ patiṃ soma utathyaṃ samapaśyata ॥10॥
html:
bhadrā somasya duhitā rūpeṇa paramā matā ।
tasyāstulyaṃ patiṃ soma utathyaṃ samapaśyata ॥10॥
slp1: BadrA somasya duhitA rUpeRa paramA matA । tasyAstulyaM patiM soma utaTyaM samapaSyata ॥10॥

text: sā ca tīvraṃ tapastepe mahābhāgā yaśasvinī । utathyaṃ tu mahābhāgaṃ tatkṛte'varayattadā ॥11॥
html:
sā ca tīvraṃ tapastepe mahābhāgā yaśasvinī ।
utathyaṃ tu mahābhāgaṃ tatkṛte'varayattadā ॥11॥
slp1: sA ca tIvraM tapastepe mahABAgA yaSasvinI । utaTyaM tu mahABAgaM tatkfte'varayattadA ॥11॥

text: tata āhūya sotathyaṃ dadāvatra yaśasvinīm । bhāryārthe sa ca jagrāha vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇa ॥12॥
html:
tata āhūya sotathyaṃ dadāvatra yaśasvinīm ।
bhāryārthe sa ca jagrāha vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇa ॥12॥
slp1: tata AhUya sotaTyaM dadAvatra yaSasvinIm । BAryArTe sa ca jagrAha viDivadBUridakziRa ॥12॥

text: tāṃ tvakāmayata śrīmānvaruṇaḥ pūrvameva ha । sa cāgamya vanaprasthaṃ yamunāyāṃ jahāra tām ॥13॥
html:
tāṃ tvakāmayata śrīmānvaruṇaḥ pūrvameva ha ।
sa cāgamya vanaprasthaṃ yamunāyāṃ jahāra tām ॥13॥
slp1: tAM tvakAmayata SrImAnvaruRaH pUrvameva ha । sa cAgamya vanaprasTaM yamunAyAM jahAra tAm ॥13॥

text: jaleśvarastu hṛtvā tāmanayatsvapuraṃ prati । paramādbhutasaṅkāśaṃ ṣaṭsahasraśatahradam ॥14॥
html:
jaleśvarastu hṛtvā tāmanayatsvapuraṃ prati ।
paramādbhutasaṅkāśaṃ ṣaṭsahasraśatahradam ॥14॥
slp1: jaleSvarastu hftvA tAmanayatsvapuraM prati । paramAdButasaNkASaM zawsahasraSatahradam ॥14॥

text: na hi ramyataraṃ kiñcittasmādanyatpurottamam । prāsādairapsarobhiśca divyaiḥ kāmaiśca śobhitam । tatra devastayā sārdhaṃ reme rājañjaleśvaraḥ ॥15॥
html:
na hi ramyataraṃ kiñcittasmādanyatpurottamam ।
prāsādairapsarobhiśca divyaiḥ kāmaiśca śobhitam ।
tatra devastayā sārdhaṃ reme rājañjaleśvaraḥ ॥15॥
slp1: na hi ramyataraM kiYcittasmAdanyatpurottamam । prAsAdErapsaroBiSca divyEH kAmESca SoBitam । tatra devastayA sArDaM reme rAjaYjaleSvaraH ॥15॥

text: athākhyātamutathyāya tataḥ patnyavamardanam ॥16॥
html: athākhyātamutathyāya tataḥ patnyavamardanam ॥16॥
slp1: aTAKyAtamutaTyAya tataH patnyavamardanam ॥16॥

text: tacchrutvā nāradātsarvamutathyo nāradaṃ tadā । provāca gaccha brūhi tvaṃ varuṇaṃ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ । madvākyānmuñca me bhāryāṃ kasmādvā hṛtavānasi ॥17॥
html:
tacchrutvā nāradātsarvamutathyo nāradaṃ tadā ।
provāca gaccha brūhi tvaṃ varuṇaṃ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ ।
madvākyānmuñca me bhāryāṃ kasmādvā hṛtavānasi ॥17॥
slp1: tacCrutvA nAradAtsarvamutaTyo nAradaM tadA । provAca gacCa brUhi tvaM varuRaM paruzaM vacaH । madvAkyAnmuYca me BAryAM kasmAdvA hftavAnasi ॥17॥

text: lokapālo'si lokānāṃ na lokasya vilopakaḥ । somena dattā bhāryā me tvayā cāpahṛtādya vai ॥18॥
html:
lokapālo'si lokānāṃ na lokasya vilopakaḥ ।
somena dattā bhāryā me tvayā cāpahṛtādya vai ॥18॥
slp1: lokapAlo'si lokAnAM na lokasya vilopakaH । somena dattA BAryA me tvayA cApahftAdya vE ॥18॥

text: ityukto vacanāttasya nāradena jaleśvaraḥ । muñca bhāryāmutathyasyetyatha taṃ varuṇo'bravīt । mamaiṣā supriyā bhāryā naināmutsraṣṭumutsahe ॥19॥
html:
ityukto vacanāttasya nāradena jaleśvaraḥ ।
muñca bhāryāmutathyasyetyatha taṃ varuṇo'bravīt ।
mamaiṣā supriyā bhāryā naināmutsraṣṭumutsahe ॥19॥
slp1: ityukto vacanAttasya nAradena jaleSvaraH । muYca BAryAmutaTyasyetyaTa taM varuRo'bravIt । mamEzA supriyA BAryA nEnAmutsrazwumutsahe ॥19॥

text: ityukto varuṇenātha nāradaḥ prāpya taṃ munim । utathyamabravīdvākyaṃ nātihṛṣṭamanā iva ॥20॥
html:
ityukto varuṇenātha nāradaḥ prāpya taṃ munim ।
utathyamabravīdvākyaṃ nātihṛṣṭamanā iva ॥20॥
slp1: ityukto varuRenATa nAradaH prApya taM munim । utaTyamabravIdvAkyaM nAtihfzwamanA iva ॥20॥

text: gale gṛhītvā kṣipto'smi varuṇena mahāmune । na prayacchati te bhāryāṃ yatte kāryaṃ kuruṣva tat ॥21॥
html:
gale gṛhītvā kṣipto'smi varuṇena mahāmune ।
na prayacchati te bhāryāṃ yatte kāryaṃ kuruṣva tat ॥21॥
slp1: gale gfhItvA kzipto'smi varuRena mahAmune । na prayacCati te BAryAM yatte kAryaM kuruzva tat ॥21॥

text: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā kruddhaḥ prājvaladaṅgirāḥ । apibattejasā vāri viṣṭabhya sumahātapāḥ ॥22॥
html:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā kruddhaḥ prājvaladaṅgirāḥ ।
apibattejasā vāri viṣṭabhya sumahātapāḥ ॥22॥
slp1: nAradasya vacaH SrutvA krudDaH prAjvaladaNgirAH । apibattejasA vAri vizwaBya sumahAtapAH ॥22॥

text: pīyamāne ca sarvasmiṃstoye vai salileśvaraḥ । suhṛdbhiḥ kṣipyamāṇo'pi naivāmuñcata tāṃ tadā ॥23॥
html:
pīyamāne ca sarvasmiṃstoye vai salileśvaraḥ ।
suhṛdbhiḥ kṣipyamāṇo'pi naivāmuñcata tāṃ tadā ॥23॥
slp1: pIyamAne ca sarvasmiMstoye vE salileSvaraH । suhfdBiH kzipyamARo'pi nEvAmuYcata tAM tadA ॥23॥

text: tataḥ kruddho'bravīdbhūmimutathyo brāhmaṇottamaḥ । darśayasva sthalaṃ bhadre ṣaṭsahasraśatahradam ॥24॥
html:
tataḥ kruddho'bravīdbhūmimutathyo brāhmaṇottamaḥ ।
darśayasva sthalaṃ bhadre ṣaṭsahasraśatahradam ॥24॥
slp1: tataH krudDo'bravIdBUmimutaTyo brAhmaRottamaH । darSayasva sTalaM Badre zawsahasraSatahradam ॥24॥

text: tatastadiriṇaṃ jātaṃ samudraścāpasarpitaḥ । tasmāddeśānnadīṃ caiva provācāsau dvijottamaḥ ॥25॥
html:
tatastadiriṇaṃ jātaṃ samudraścāpasarpitaḥ ।
tasmāddeśānnadīṃ caiva provācāsau dvijottamaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: tatastadiriRaM jAtaM samudraScApasarpitaH । tasmAddeSAnnadIM cEva provAcAsO dvijottamaH ॥25॥

text: adṛśyā gaccha bhīru tvaṃ sarasvati maruṃ prati । apuṇya eṣa bhavatu deśastyaktastvayā śubhe ॥26॥
html:
adṛśyā gaccha bhīru tvaṃ sarasvati maruṃ prati ।
apuṇya eṣa bhavatu deśastyaktastvayā śubhe ॥26॥
slp1: adfSyA gacCa BIru tvaM sarasvati maruM prati । apuRya eza Bavatu deSastyaktastvayA SuBe ॥26॥

text: tasminsañcūrṇite deśe bhadrāmādāya vāripaḥ । adadāccharaṇaṃ gatvā bhāryāmāṅgirasāya vai ॥27॥
html:
tasminsañcūrṇite deśe bhadrāmādāya vāripaḥ ।
adadāccharaṇaṃ gatvā bhāryāmāṅgirasāya vai ॥27॥
slp1: tasminsaYcUrRite deSe BadrAmAdAya vAripaH । adadAcCaraRaM gatvA BAryAmANgirasAya vE ॥27॥

text: pratigṛhya tu tāṃ bhāryāmutathyaḥ sumanābhavat । mumoca ca jagadduḥkhādvaruṇaṃ caiva haihaya ॥28॥
html:
pratigṛhya tu tāṃ bhāryāmutathyaḥ sumanābhavat ।
mumoca ca jagadduḥkhādvaruṇaṃ caiva haihaya ॥28॥
slp1: pratigfhya tu tAM BAryAmutaTyaH sumanABavat । mumoca ca jagadduHKAdvaruRaM cEva hEhaya ॥28॥

text: tataḥ sa labdhvā tāṃ bhāryāṃ varuṇaṃ prāha dharmavit । utathyaḥ sumahātejā yattacchṛṇu narādhipa ॥29॥
html:
tataḥ sa labdhvā tāṃ bhāryāṃ varuṇaṃ prāha dharmavit ।
utathyaḥ sumahātejā yattacchṛṇu narādhipa ॥29॥
slp1: tataH sa labDvA tAM BAryAM varuRaM prAha Darmavit । utaTyaH sumahAtejA yattacCfRu narADipa ॥29॥

text: mayaiṣā tapasā prāptā krośataste jalādhipa । ityuktvā tāmupādāya svameva bhavanaṃ yayau ॥30॥
html:
mayaiṣā tapasā prāptā krośataste jalādhipa ।
ityuktvā tāmupādāya svameva bhavanaṃ yayau ॥30॥
slp1: mayEzA tapasA prAptA kroSataste jalADipa । ityuktvA tAmupAdAya svameva BavanaM yayO ॥30॥

text: eṣa rājannīdṛśo vai utathyo brāhmaṇarṣabhaḥ । bravīmyahaṃ brūhi vā tvamutathyātkṣatriyaṃ varam] ॥31॥
html:
eṣa rājannīdṛśo vai utathyo brāhmaṇarṣabhaḥ ।
bravīmyahaṃ brūhi vā tvamutathyātkṣatriyaṃ varam] ॥31॥
slp1: eza rAjannIdfSo vE utaTyo brAhmaRarzaBaH । bravImyahaM brUhi vA tvamutaTyAtkzatriyaM varam] ॥31॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa tadā tūṣṇīmabhūdvāyustato'bravīt । śṛṇu rājannagastyasya māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇasya ha ॥1॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa tadā tūṣṇīmabhūdvāyustato'bravīt ।
śṛṇu rājannagastyasya māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇasya ha ॥1॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa tadA tUzRImaBUdvAyustato'bravIt । SfRu rAjannagastyasya mAhAtmyaM brAhmaRasya ha ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: asurairnirjitā devā nirutsāhāśca te kṛtāḥ । yajñāścaiṣāṃ hṛtāḥ sarve pitṛbhyaśca svadhā tathā ॥2॥
html:
asurairnirjitā devā nirutsāhāśca te kṛtāḥ ।
yajñāścaiṣāṃ hṛtāḥ sarve pitṛbhyaśca svadhā tathā ॥2॥
slp1: asurErnirjitA devA nirutsAhASca te kftAH । yajYAScEzAM hftAH sarve pitfByaSca svaDA taTA ॥2॥

text: karmejyā mānavānāṃ ca dānavairhaihayarṣabha । bhraṣṭaiśvaryāstato devāśceruḥ pṛthvīmiti śrutiḥ ॥3॥
html:
karmejyā mānavānāṃ ca dānavairhaihayarṣabha ।
bhraṣṭaiśvaryāstato devāśceruḥ pṛthvīmiti śrutiḥ ॥3॥
slp1: karmejyA mAnavAnAM ca dAnavErhEhayarzaBa । BrazwESvaryAstato devASceruH pfTvImiti SrutiH ॥3॥

text: tataḥ kadācitte rājandīptamādityavarcasam । dadṛśustejasā yuktamagastyaṃ vipulavratam ॥4॥
html:
tataḥ kadācitte rājandīptamādityavarcasam ।
dadṛśustejasā yuktamagastyaṃ vipulavratam ॥4॥
slp1: tataH kadAcitte rAjandIptamAdityavarcasam । dadfSustejasA yuktamagastyaM vipulavratam ॥4॥

text: abhivādya ca taṃ devā dṛṣṭvā ca yaśasā vṛtam । idamūcurmahātmānaṃ vākyaṃ kāle janādhipa ॥5॥
html:
abhivādya ca taṃ devā dṛṣṭvā ca yaśasā vṛtam ।
idamūcurmahātmānaṃ vākyaṃ kāle janādhipa ॥5॥
slp1: aBivAdya ca taM devA dfzwvA ca yaSasA vftam । idamUcurmahAtmAnaM vAkyaM kAle janADipa ॥5॥

text: dānavairyudhi bhagnāḥ sma tathaiśvaryācca bhraṃśitāḥ । tadasmānno bhayāttīvrāttrāhi tvaṃ munipuṅgava ॥6॥
html:
dānavairyudhi bhagnāḥ sma tathaiśvaryācca bhraṃśitāḥ ।
tadasmānno bhayāttīvrāttrāhi tvaṃ munipuṅgava ॥6॥
slp1: dAnavEryuDi BagnAH sma taTESvaryAcca BraMSitAH । tadasmAnno BayAttIvrAttrAhi tvaM munipuNgava ॥6॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa tadā devairagastyaḥ kupito'bhavat । prajajvāla ca tejasvī kālāgniriva saṅkṣaye ॥7॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa tadā devairagastyaḥ kupito'bhavat ।
prajajvāla ca tejasvī kālāgniriva saṅkṣaye ॥7॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa tadA devEragastyaH kupito'Bavat । prajajvAla ca tejasvI kAlAgniriva saNkzaye ॥7॥

text: tena dīptāṃśujālena nirdagdhā dānavāstadā । antarikṣānmahārāja nyapatanta sahasraśaḥ ॥8॥
html:
tena dīptāṃśujālena nirdagdhā dānavāstadā ।
antarikṣānmahārāja nyapatanta sahasraśaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: tena dIptAMSujAlena nirdagDA dAnavAstadA । antarikzAnmahArAja nyapatanta sahasraSaH ॥8॥

text: dahyamānāstu te daityāstasyāgastyasya tejasā । ubhau lokau parityajya yayuḥ kāṣṭhāṃ sma dakṣiṇām ॥9॥
html:
dahyamānāstu te daityāstasyāgastyasya tejasā ।
ubhau lokau parityajya yayuḥ kāṣṭhāṃ sma dakṣiṇām ॥9॥
slp1: dahyamAnAstu te dEtyAstasyAgastyasya tejasA । uBO lokO parityajya yayuH kAzWAM sma dakziRAm ॥9॥

text: balistu yajate yajñamaśvamedhaṃ mahīṃ gataḥ । ye'nye svasthā mahīsthāśca te na dagdhā mahāsurāḥ ॥10॥
html:
balistu yajate yajñamaśvamedhaṃ mahīṃ gataḥ ।
ye'nye svasthā mahīsthāśca te na dagdhā mahāsurāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: balistu yajate yajYamaSvameDaM mahIM gataH । ye'nye svasTA mahIsTASca te na dagDA mahAsurAH ॥10॥

text: tato lokāḥ punaḥ prāptāḥ suraiḥ śāntaṃ ca tadrajaḥ । athainamabruvandevā bhūmiṣṭhānasurāñjahi ॥11॥
html:
tato lokāḥ punaḥ prāptāḥ suraiḥ śāntaṃ ca tadrajaḥ ।
athainamabruvandevā bhūmiṣṭhānasurāñjahi ॥11॥
slp1: tato lokAH punaH prAptAH surEH SAntaM ca tadrajaH । aTEnamabruvandevA BUmizWAnasurAYjahi ॥11॥

text: ityukta āha devānsa na śaknomi mahīgatān । dagdhuṃ tapo hi kṣīyenme dhakṣyāmīti ca pārthiva ॥12॥
html:
ityukta āha devānsa na śaknomi mahīgatān ।
dagdhuṃ tapo hi kṣīyenme dhakṣyāmīti ca pārthiva ॥12॥
slp1: ityukta Aha devAnsa na Saknomi mahIgatAn । dagDuM tapo hi kzIyenme DakzyAmIti ca pArTiva ॥12॥

text: evaṃ dagdhā bhagavatā dānavāḥ svena tejasā । agastyena tadā rājaṃstapasā bhāvitātmanā ॥13॥
html:
evaṃ dagdhā bhagavatā dānavāḥ svena tejasā ।
agastyena tadā rājaṃstapasā bhāvitātmanā ॥13॥
slp1: evaM dagDA BagavatA dAnavAH svena tejasA । agastyena tadA rAjaMstapasA BAvitAtmanA ॥13॥

text: īdṛśaścāpyagastyo hi kathitaste mayānagha । bravīmyahaṃ brūhi vā tvamagastyātkṣatriyaṃ varam ॥14॥
html:
īdṛśaścāpyagastyo hi kathitaste mayānagha ।
bravīmyahaṃ brūhi vā tvamagastyātkṣatriyaṃ varam ॥14॥
slp1: IdfSaScApyagastyo hi kaTitaste mayAnaGa । bravImyahaM brUhi vA tvamagastyAtkzatriyaM varam ॥14॥

text: ityuktaḥ sa tadā tūṣṇīmabhūdvāyustato'bravīt । śṛṇu rājanvasiṣṭhasya mukhyaṃ karma yaśasvinaḥ ॥15॥
html:
ityuktaḥ sa tadā tūṣṇīmabhūdvāyustato'bravīt ।
śṛṇu rājanvasiṣṭhasya mukhyaṃ karma yaśasvinaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: ityuktaH sa tadA tUzRImaBUdvAyustato'bravIt । SfRu rAjanvasizWasya muKyaM karma yaSasvinaH ॥15॥

text: ādityāḥ satramāsanta saro vai mānasaṃ prati । vasiṣṭhaṃ manasā gatvā śrutvā tatrāsya gocaram ॥16॥
html:
ādityāḥ satramāsanta saro vai mānasaṃ prati ।
vasiṣṭhaṃ manasā gatvā śrutvā tatrāsya gocaram ॥16॥
slp1: AdityAH satramAsanta saro vE mAnasaM prati । vasizWaM manasA gatvA SrutvA tatrAsya gocaram ॥16॥

text: yajamānāṃstu tāndṛṣṭvā vyagrāndīkṣānukarśitān । hantumicchanti śailābhāḥ khalino nāma dānavāḥ ॥17॥
html:
yajamānāṃstu tāndṛṣṭvā vyagrāndīkṣānukarśitān ।
hantumicchanti śailābhāḥ khalino nāma dānavāḥ ॥17॥
slp1: yajamAnAMstu tAndfzwvA vyagrAndIkzAnukarSitAn । hantumicCanti SElABAH Kalino nAma dAnavAH ॥17॥

text: adūrāttu tatasteṣāṃ brahmadattavaraṃ saraḥ । hatā hatā vai te tatra jīvantyāplutya dānavāḥ ॥18॥
html:
adūrāttu tatasteṣāṃ brahmadattavaraṃ saraḥ ।
hatā hatā vai te tatra jīvantyāplutya dānavāḥ ॥18॥
slp1: adUrAttu tatastezAM brahmadattavaraM saraH । hatA hatA vE te tatra jIvantyAplutya dAnavAH ॥18॥

text: te pragṛhya mahāghorānparvatānparighāndrumān । vikṣobhayantaḥ salilamutthitāḥ śatayojanam ॥19॥
html:
te pragṛhya mahāghorānparvatānparighāndrumān ।
vikṣobhayantaḥ salilamutthitāḥ śatayojanam ॥19॥
slp1: te pragfhya mahAGorAnparvatAnpariGAndrumAn । vikzoBayantaH salilamutTitAH Satayojanam ॥19॥

text: abhyadravanta devāṃste sahasrāṇi daśaiva ha । tatastairarditā devāḥ śaraṇaṃ vāsavaṃ yayuḥ ॥20॥
html:
abhyadravanta devāṃste sahasrāṇi daśaiva ha ।
tatastairarditā devāḥ śaraṇaṃ vāsavaṃ yayuḥ ॥20॥
slp1: aByadravanta devAMste sahasrARi daSEva ha । tatastErarditA devAH SaraRaM vAsavaM yayuH ॥20॥

text: sa ca tairvyathitaḥ śakro vasiṣṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau । tato'bhayaṃ dadau tebhyo vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ ॥21॥
html:
sa ca tairvyathitaḥ śakro vasiṣṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।
tato'bhayaṃ dadau tebhyo vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ ॥21॥
slp1: sa ca tErvyaTitaH Sakro vasizWaM SaraRaM yayO । tato'BayaM dadO teByo vasizWo BagavAnfziH ॥21॥

text: tathā tānduḥkhitāñjānannānṛśaṃsyaparo muniḥ । ayatnenādahatsarvānkhalinaḥ svena tejasā ॥22॥
html:
tathā tānduḥkhitāñjānannānṛśaṃsyaparo muniḥ ।
ayatnenādahatsarvānkhalinaḥ svena tejasā ॥22॥
slp1: taTA tAnduHKitAYjAnannAnfSaMsyaparo muniH । ayatnenAdahatsarvAnKalinaH svena tejasA ॥22॥

text: kailāsaṃ prasthitāṃ cāpi nadīṃ gaṅgāṃ mahātapāḥ । ānayattatsaro divyaṃ tayā bhinnaṃ ca tatsaraḥ ॥23॥
html:
kailāsaṃ prasthitāṃ cāpi nadīṃ gaṅgāṃ mahātapāḥ ।
ānayattatsaro divyaṃ tayā bhinnaṃ ca tatsaraḥ ॥23॥
slp1: kElAsaM prasTitAM cApi nadIM gaNgAM mahAtapAH । Anayattatsaro divyaM tayA BinnaM ca tatsaraH ॥23॥

text: saro bhinnaṃ tayā nadyā sarayūḥ sā tato'bhavat । hatāśca khalino yatra sa deśaḥ khalino'bhavat ॥24॥
html:
saro bhinnaṃ tayā nadyā sarayūḥ sā tato'bhavat ।
hatāśca khalino yatra sa deśaḥ khalino'bhavat ॥24॥
slp1: saro BinnaM tayA nadyA sarayUH sA tato'Bavat । hatASca Kalino yatra sa deSaH Kalino'Bavat ॥24॥

text: evaṃ sendrā vasiṣṭhena rakṣitāstridivaukasaḥ । brahmadattavarāścaiva hatā daityā mahātmanā ॥25॥
html:
evaṃ sendrā vasiṣṭhena rakṣitāstridivaukasaḥ ।
brahmadattavarāścaiva hatā daityā mahātmanā ॥25॥
slp1: evaM sendrA vasizWena rakzitAstridivOkasaH । brahmadattavarAScEva hatA dEtyA mahAtmanA ॥25॥

text: etatkarma vasiṣṭhasya kathitaṃ te mayānagha । bravīmyahaṃ brūhi vā tvaṃ vasiṣṭhātkṣatriyaṃ varam] ॥26॥
html:
etatkarma vasiṣṭhasya kathitaṃ te mayānagha ।
bravīmyahaṃ brūhi vā tvaṃ vasiṣṭhātkṣatriyaṃ varam] ॥26॥
slp1: etatkarma vasizWasya kaTitaM te mayAnaGa । bravImyahaM brUhi vA tvaM vasizWAtkzatriyaM varam] ॥26॥

text: ityuktastvarjunastūṣṇīmabhūdvāyustamabravīt । śṛṇu me haihayaśreṣṭha karmātreḥ sumahātmanaḥ ॥1॥
html:
ityuktastvarjunastūṣṇīmabhūdvāyustamabravīt ।
śṛṇu me haihayaśreṣṭha karmātreḥ sumahātmanaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: ityuktastvarjunastUzRImaBUdvAyustamabravIt । SfRu me hEhayaSrezWa karmAtreH sumahAtmanaH ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ghore tamasyayudhyanta sahitā devadānavāḥ । avidhyata śaraistatra svarbhānuḥ somabhāskarau ॥2॥
html:
ghore tamasyayudhyanta sahitā devadānavāḥ ।
avidhyata śaraistatra svarbhānuḥ somabhāskarau ॥2॥
slp1: Gore tamasyayuDyanta sahitA devadAnavAH । aviDyata SarEstatra svarBAnuH somaBAskarO ॥2॥

text: atha te tamasā grastā nihanyante sma dānavaiḥ । devā nṛpatiśārdūla sahaiva balibhistadā ॥3॥
html:
atha te tamasā grastā nihanyante sma dānavaiḥ ।
devā nṛpatiśārdūla sahaiva balibhistadā ॥3॥
slp1: aTa te tamasA grastA nihanyante sma dAnavEH । devA nfpatiSArdUla sahEva baliBistadA ॥3॥

text: asurairvadhyamānāste kṣīṇaprāṇā divaukasaḥ । apaśyanta tapasyantamatriṃ vipraṃ mahāvane ॥4॥
html:
asurairvadhyamānāste kṣīṇaprāṇā divaukasaḥ ।
apaśyanta tapasyantamatriṃ vipraṃ mahāvane ॥4॥
slp1: asurErvaDyamAnAste kzIRaprARA divOkasaH । apaSyanta tapasyantamatriM vipraM mahAvane ॥4॥

text: athainamabruvandevāḥ śāntakrodhaṃ jitendriyam । asurairiṣubhirviddhau candrādityāvimāvubhau ॥5॥
html:
athainamabruvandevāḥ śāntakrodhaṃ jitendriyam ।
asurairiṣubhirviddhau candrādityāvimāvubhau ॥5॥
slp1: aTEnamabruvandevAH SAntakroDaM jitendriyam । asurErizuBirvidDO candrAdityAvimAvuBO ॥5॥

text: vayaṃ vadhyāmahe cāpi śatrubhistamasāvṛte । nādhigacchāma śāntiṃ ca bhayāttrāyasva naḥ prabho ॥6॥
html:
vayaṃ vadhyāmahe cāpi śatrubhistamasāvṛte ।
nādhigacchāma śāntiṃ ca bhayāttrāyasva naḥ prabho ॥6॥
slp1: vayaM vaDyAmahe cApi SatruBistamasAvfte । nADigacCAma SAntiM ca BayAttrAyasva naH praBo ॥6॥

text: kathaṃ rakṣāmi bhavataste'bruvaṃścandramā bhava । timiraghnaśca savitā dasyuhā caiva no bhava ॥7॥
html:
kathaṃ rakṣāmi bhavataste'bruvaṃścandramā bhava ।
timiraghnaśca savitā dasyuhā caiva no bhava ॥7॥
slp1: kaTaM rakzAmi Bavataste'bruvaMScandramA Bava । timiraGnaSca savitA dasyuhA cEva no Bava ॥7॥

text: evamuktastadātristu tamonudabhavacchaśī । apaśyatsaumyabhāvaṃ ca sūryasya pratidarśanam ॥8॥
html:
evamuktastadātristu tamonudabhavacchaśī ।
apaśyatsaumyabhāvaṃ ca sūryasya pratidarśanam ॥8॥
slp1: evamuktastadAtristu tamonudaBavacCaSI । apaSyatsOmyaBAvaM ca sUryasya pratidarSanam ॥8॥

text: dṛṣṭvā nātiprabhaṃ somaṃ tathā sūryaṃ ca pārthiva । prakāśamakarodatristapasā svena saṃyuge ॥9॥
html:
dṛṣṭvā nātiprabhaṃ somaṃ tathā sūryaṃ ca pārthiva ।
prakāśamakarodatristapasā svena saṃyuge ॥9॥
slp1: dfzwvA nAtipraBaM somaM taTA sUryaM ca pArTiva । prakASamakarodatristapasA svena saMyuge ॥9॥

text: jagadvitimiraṃ cāpi pradīptamakarottadā । vyajayacchatrusaṅghāṃśca devānāṃ svena tejasā ॥10॥
html:
jagadvitimiraṃ cāpi pradīptamakarottadā ।
vyajayacchatrusaṅghāṃśca devānāṃ svena tejasā ॥10॥
slp1: jagadvitimiraM cApi pradIptamakarottadA । vyajayacCatrusaNGAMSca devAnAM svena tejasA ॥10॥

text: atriṇā dahyamānāṃstāndṛṣṭvā devā mahāsurān । parākramaiste'pi tadā vyatyaghnannatrirakṣitāḥ ॥11॥
html:
atriṇā dahyamānāṃstāndṛṣṭvā devā mahāsurān ।
parākramaiste'pi tadā vyatyaghnannatrirakṣitāḥ ॥11॥
slp1: atriRA dahyamAnAMstAndfzwvA devA mahAsurAn । parAkramEste'pi tadA vyatyaGnannatrirakzitAH ॥11॥

text: udbhāsitaśca savitā devāstrātā hatāsurāḥ । atriṇā tvatha somatvaṃ kṛtamuttamatejasā ॥12॥
html:
udbhāsitaśca savitā devāstrātā hatāsurāḥ ।
atriṇā tvatha somatvaṃ kṛtamuttamatejasā ॥12॥
slp1: udBAsitaSca savitA devAstrAtA hatAsurAH । atriRA tvaTa somatvaM kftamuttamatejasA ॥12॥

text: advitīyena muninā japatā carmavāsasā । phalabhakṣeṇa rājarṣe paśya karmātriṇā kṛtam ॥13॥
html:
advitīyena muninā japatā carmavāsasā ।
phalabhakṣeṇa rājarṣe paśya karmātriṇā kṛtam ॥13॥
slp1: advitIyena muninA japatA carmavAsasA । PalaBakzeRa rAjarze paSya karmAtriRA kftam ॥13॥

text: tasyāpi vistareṇoktaṃ karmātreḥ sumahātmanaḥ । bravīmyahaṃ brūhi vā tvamatritaḥ kṣatriyaṃ varam ॥14॥
html:
tasyāpi vistareṇoktaṃ karmātreḥ sumahātmanaḥ ।
bravīmyahaṃ brūhi vā tvamatritaḥ kṣatriyaṃ varam ॥14॥
slp1: tasyApi vistareRoktaM karmAtreH sumahAtmanaH । bravImyahaM brUhi vA tvamatritaH kzatriyaM varam ॥14॥

text: ityuktastvarjunastūṣṇīmabhūdvāyustamabravīt । śṛṇu rājanmahatkarma cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ ॥15॥
html:
ityuktastvarjunastūṣṇīmabhūdvāyustamabravīt ।
śṛṇu rājanmahatkarma cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: ityuktastvarjunastUzRImaBUdvAyustamabravIt । SfRu rAjanmahatkarma cyavanasya mahAtmanaH ॥15॥

text: aśvinoḥ pratisaṃśrutya cyavanaḥ pākaśāsanam । provāca sahitaṃ devaiḥ somapāvaśvinau kuru ॥16॥
html:
aśvinoḥ pratisaṃśrutya cyavanaḥ pākaśāsanam ।
provāca sahitaṃ devaiḥ somapāvaśvinau kuru ॥16॥
slp1: aSvinoH pratisaMSrutya cyavanaH pAkaSAsanam । provAca sahitaM devEH somapAvaSvinO kuru ॥16॥

text: asmābhirvarjitāvetau bhavetāṃ somapau katham । devairna sammitāvetau tasmānmaivaṃ vadasva naḥ ॥17॥
html:
asmābhirvarjitāvetau bhavetāṃ somapau katham ।
devairna sammitāvetau tasmānmaivaṃ vadasva naḥ ॥17॥
slp1: asmABirvarjitAvetO BavetAM somapO kaTam । devErna sammitAvetO tasmAnmEvaM vadasva naH ॥17॥
author: indra uvāca ।

text: aśvibhyāṃ saha necchāmaḥ pātuṃ somaṃ mahāvrata । pibantvanye yathākāmaṃ nāhaṃ pātumihotsahe ॥18॥
html:
aśvibhyāṃ saha necchāmaḥ pātuṃ somaṃ mahāvrata ।
pibantvanye yathākāmaṃ nāhaṃ pātumihotsahe ॥18॥
slp1: aSviByAM saha necCAmaH pAtuM somaM mahAvrata । pibantvanye yaTAkAmaM nAhaM pAtumihotsahe ॥18॥

text: na cetkariṣyasi vaco mayoktaṃ balasūdana । mayā pramathitaḥ sadyaḥ somaṃ pāsyasi vai makhe ॥19॥
html:
na cetkariṣyasi vaco mayoktaṃ balasūdana ।
mayā pramathitaḥ sadyaḥ somaṃ pāsyasi vai makhe ॥19॥
slp1: na cetkarizyasi vaco mayoktaM balasUdana । mayA pramaTitaH sadyaH somaM pAsyasi vE maKe ॥19॥
author: cyavana uvāca ।

text: tataḥ karma samārabdhaṃ hitāya sahasāśvinoḥ । cyavanena tato mantrairabhibhūtāḥ surābhavan ॥20॥
html:
tataḥ karma samārabdhaṃ hitāya sahasāśvinoḥ ।
cyavanena tato mantrairabhibhūtāḥ surābhavan ॥20॥
slp1: tataH karma samArabDaM hitAya sahasASvinoH । cyavanena tato mantrEraBiBUtAH surABavan ॥20॥

text: tattu karma samārabdhaṃ dṛṣṭvendraḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ । udyamya vipulaṃ śailaṃ cyavanaṃ samupādravat । tathā vajreṇa bhagavānamarṣākulalocanaḥ ॥21॥
html:
tattu karma samārabdhaṃ dṛṣṭvendraḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ।
udyamya vipulaṃ śailaṃ cyavanaṃ samupādravat ।
tathā vajreṇa bhagavānamarṣākulalocanaḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tattu karma samArabDaM dfzwvendraH kroDamUrCitaH । udyamya vipulaM SElaM cyavanaM samupAdravat । taTA vajreRa BagavAnamarzAkulalocanaH ॥21॥

text: tamāpatantaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva cyavanastapasānvitaḥ । adbhiḥ siktvāstambhayattaṃ savajraṃ sahaparvatam ॥22॥
html:
tamāpatantaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva cyavanastapasānvitaḥ ।
adbhiḥ siktvāstambhayattaṃ savajraṃ sahaparvatam ॥22॥
slp1: tamApatantaM dfzwvEva cyavanastapasAnvitaH । adBiH siktvAstamBayattaM savajraM sahaparvatam ॥22॥

text: athendrasya mahāghoraṃ so'sṛjacchatrumeva ha । madaṃ mantrāhutimayaṃ vyāditāsyaṃ mahāmuniḥ ॥23॥
html:
athendrasya mahāghoraṃ so'sṛjacchatrumeva ha ।
madaṃ mantrāhutimayaṃ vyāditāsyaṃ mahāmuniḥ ॥23॥
slp1: aTendrasya mahAGoraM so'sfjacCatrumeva ha । madaM mantrAhutimayaM vyAditAsyaM mahAmuniH ॥23॥

text: tasya dantasahasraṃ tu babhūva śatayojanam । dviyojanaśatāstasya daṃṣṭrāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ । hanustasyābhavadbhūmāvekaścāsyāspṛśaddivam ॥24॥
html:
tasya dantasahasraṃ tu babhūva śatayojanam ।
dviyojanaśatāstasya daṃṣṭrāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ ।
hanustasyābhavadbhūmāvekaścāsyāspṛśaddivam ॥24॥
slp1: tasya dantasahasraM tu baBUva Satayojanam । dviyojanaSatAstasya daMzwrAH paramadAruRAH । hanustasyABavadBUmAvekaScAsyAspfSaddivam ॥24॥

text: jihvāmūle sthitāstasya sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ । timerāsyamanuprāptā yathā matsyā mahārṇave ॥25॥
html:
jihvāmūle sthitāstasya sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ।
timerāsyamanuprāptā yathā matsyā mahārṇave ॥25॥
slp1: jihvAmUle sTitAstasya sarve devAH savAsavAH । timerAsyamanuprAptA yaTA matsyA mahArRave ॥25॥

text: te sammantrya tato devā madasyāsyagatāstadā । abruvansahitāḥ śakraṃ praṇamāsmai dvijātaye । aśvibhyāṃ saha somaṃ ca pibāmo vigatajvarāḥ ॥26॥
html:
te sammantrya tato devā madasyāsyagatāstadā ।
abruvansahitāḥ śakraṃ praṇamāsmai dvijātaye ।
aśvibhyāṃ saha somaṃ ca pibāmo vigatajvarāḥ ॥26॥
slp1: te sammantrya tato devA madasyAsyagatAstadA । abruvansahitAH SakraM praRamAsmE dvijAtaye । aSviByAM saha somaM ca pibAmo vigatajvarAH ॥26॥

text: tataḥ sa praṇataḥ śakraścakāra cyavanasya tat । cyavanaḥ kṛtavāṃstau cāpyaśvinau somapīthinau ॥27॥
html:
tataḥ sa praṇataḥ śakraścakāra cyavanasya tat ।
cyavanaḥ kṛtavāṃstau cāpyaśvinau somapīthinau ॥27॥
slp1: tataH sa praRataH SakraScakAra cyavanasya tat । cyavanaH kftavAMstO cApyaSvinO somapITinO ॥27॥

text: tataḥ pratyāharatkarma madaṃ ca vyabhajanmuniḥ । akṣeṣu mṛgayāyāṃ ca pāne strīṣu ca vīryavān ॥28॥
html:
tataḥ pratyāharatkarma madaṃ ca vyabhajanmuniḥ ।
akṣeṣu mṛgayāyāṃ ca pāne strīṣu ca vīryavān ॥28॥
slp1: tataH pratyAharatkarma madaM ca vyaBajanmuniH । akzezu mfgayAyAM ca pAne strIzu ca vIryavAn ॥28॥

text: etairdoṣairnaro rājankṣayaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ । tasmādetānnaro nityaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet ॥29॥
html:
etairdoṣairnaro rājankṣayaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ ।
tasmādetānnaro nityaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet ॥29॥
slp1: etErdozErnaro rAjankzayaM yAti na saMSayaH । tasmAdetAnnaro nityaM dUrataH parivarjayet ॥29॥

text: etatte cyavanasyāpi karma rājanprakīrtitam । bravīmyahaṃ brūhi vā tvaṃ cyavanātkṣatriyaṃ varam] ॥30॥
html:
etatte cyavanasyāpi karma rājanprakīrtitam ।
bravīmyahaṃ brūhi vā tvaṃ cyavanātkṣatriyaṃ varam] ॥30॥
slp1: etatte cyavanasyApi karma rAjanprakIrtitam । bravImyahaM brUhi vA tvaM cyavanAtkzatriyaM varam] ॥30॥

text: tūṣṇīmāsīdarjunastu pavanastvabravītpunaḥ । śṛṇu me brāhmaṇeṣveva mukhyaṃ karma janādhipa ॥1॥
html:
tūṣṇīmāsīdarjunastu pavanastvabravītpunaḥ ।
śṛṇu me brāhmaṇeṣveva mukhyaṃ karma janādhipa ॥1॥
slp1: tUzRImAsIdarjunastu pavanastvabravItpunaH । SfRu me brAhmaRezveva muKyaM karma janADipa ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: madasyāsyamanuprāptā yadā sendrā divaukasaḥ । tadeyaṃ cyavaneneha hṛtā teṣāṃ vasundharā ॥2॥
html:
madasyāsyamanuprāptā yadā sendrā divaukasaḥ ।
tadeyaṃ cyavaneneha hṛtā teṣāṃ vasundharā ॥2॥
slp1: madasyAsyamanuprAptA yadA sendrA divOkasaH । tadeyaM cyavaneneha hftA tezAM vasunDarA ॥2॥

text: ubhau lokau hṛtau matvā te devā duḥkhitābhavan । śokārtāśca mahātmānaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ॥3॥
html:
ubhau lokau hṛtau matvā te devā duḥkhitābhavan ।
śokārtāśca mahātmānaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ॥3॥
slp1: uBO lokO hftO matvA te devA duHKitABavan । SokArtASca mahAtmAnaM brahmARaM SaraRaM yayuH ॥3॥

text: madāsyavyatiṣiktānāmasmākaṃ lokapūjita । cyavanena hṛtā bhūmiḥ kapaiścāpi divaṃ prabho ॥4॥
html:
madāsyavyatiṣiktānāmasmākaṃ lokapūjita ।
cyavanena hṛtā bhūmiḥ kapaiścāpi divaṃ prabho ॥4॥
slp1: madAsyavyatiziktAnAmasmAkaM lokapUjita । cyavanena hftA BUmiH kapEScApi divaM praBo ॥4॥
author: devā ūcuḥ ।

text: gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ viprānāśu sendrā divaukasaḥ । prasādya tānubhau lokāvavāpsyatha yathā purā ॥5॥
html:
gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ viprānāśu sendrā divaukasaḥ ।
prasādya tānubhau lokāvavāpsyatha yathā purā ॥5॥
slp1: gacCaDvaM SaraRaM viprAnASu sendrA divOkasaH । prasAdya tAnuBO lokAvavApsyaTa yaTA purA ॥5॥
author: brahmovāca ।

text: te yayuḥ śaraṇaṃ viprāṃsta ūcuḥ kāñjayāmahe । ityuktāste dvijānprāhurjayateha kapāniti । bhūgatānhi vijetāro vayamityeva pārthiva ॥6॥
html:
te yayuḥ śaraṇaṃ viprāṃsta ūcuḥ kāñjayāmahe ।
ityuktāste dvijānprāhurjayateha kapāniti ।
bhūgatānhi vijetāro vayamityeva pārthiva ॥6॥
slp1: te yayuH SaraRaM viprAMsta UcuH kAYjayAmahe । ityuktAste dvijAnprAhurjayateha kapAniti । BUgatAnhi vijetAro vayamityeva pArTiva ॥6॥

text: tataḥ karma samārabdhaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ kapanāśanam । tacchrutvā preṣito dūto brāhmaṇebhyo dhanī kapaiḥ ॥7॥
html:
tataḥ karma samārabdhaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ kapanāśanam ।
tacchrutvā preṣito dūto brāhmaṇebhyo dhanī kapaiḥ ॥7॥
slp1: tataH karma samArabDaM brAhmaREH kapanASanam । tacCrutvA prezito dUto brAhmaReByo DanI kapEH ॥7॥

text: sa ca tānbrāhmaṇānāha dhanī kapavaco yathā । bhavadbhiḥ sadṛśāḥ sarve kapāḥ kimiha vartate ॥8॥
html:
sa ca tānbrāhmaṇānāha dhanī kapavaco yathā ।
bhavadbhiḥ sadṛśāḥ sarve kapāḥ kimiha vartate ॥8॥
slp1: sa ca tAnbrAhmaRAnAha DanI kapavaco yaTA । BavadBiH sadfSAH sarve kapAH kimiha vartate ॥8॥

text: sarve vedavidaḥ prājñāḥ sarve ca kratuyājinaḥ । sarve satyavratāścaiva sarve tulyā maharṣibhiḥ ॥9॥
html:
sarve vedavidaḥ prājñāḥ sarve ca kratuyājinaḥ ।
sarve satyavratāścaiva sarve tulyā maharṣibhiḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sarve vedavidaH prAjYAH sarve ca kratuyAjinaH । sarve satyavratAScEva sarve tulyA maharziBiH ॥9॥

text: śrīścaiva ramate teṣu dhārayanti śriyaṃ ca te । vṛthā dārānna gacchanti vṛthāmāṃsaṃ na bhuñjate ॥10॥
html:
śrīścaiva ramate teṣu dhārayanti śriyaṃ ca te ।
vṛthā dārānna gacchanti vṛthāmāṃsaṃ na bhuñjate ॥10॥
slp1: SrIScEva ramate tezu DArayanti SriyaM ca te । vfTA dArAnna gacCanti vfTAmAMsaM na BuYjate ॥10॥

text: dīptamagniṃ juhvati ca gurūṇāṃ vacane sthitāḥ । sarve ca niyatātmāno bālānāṃ saṃvibhāginaḥ ॥11॥
html:
dīptamagniṃ juhvati ca gurūṇāṃ vacane sthitāḥ ।
sarve ca niyatātmāno bālānāṃ saṃvibhāginaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: dIptamagniM juhvati ca gurURAM vacane sTitAH । sarve ca niyatAtmAno bAlAnAM saMviBAginaH ॥11॥

text: upetya śakaṭairyānti na sevanti rajasvalām । abhuktavatsu nāśnanti divā caiva na śerate ॥12॥
html:
upetya śakaṭairyānti na sevanti rajasvalām ।
abhuktavatsu nāśnanti divā caiva na śerate ॥12॥
slp1: upetya SakawEryAnti na sevanti rajasvalAm । aBuktavatsu nASnanti divA cEva na Serate ॥12॥

text: etaiścānyaiśca bahubhirguṇairyuktānkathaṃ kapān । vijeṣyatha nivartadhvaṃ nivṛttānāṃ śubhaṃ hi vaḥ ॥13॥
html:
etaiścānyaiśca bahubhirguṇairyuktānkathaṃ kapān ।
vijeṣyatha nivartadhvaṃ nivṛttānāṃ śubhaṃ hi vaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: etEScAnyESca bahuBirguREryuktAnkaTaM kapAn । vijezyaTa nivartaDvaM nivfttAnAM SuBaM hi vaH ॥13॥

text: kapānvayaṃ vijeṣyāmo ye devāste vayaṃ smṛtāḥ । tasmādvadhyāḥ kapāsmākaṃ dhaninyāhi yathāgatam ॥14॥
html:
kapānvayaṃ vijeṣyāmo ye devāste vayaṃ smṛtāḥ ।
tasmādvadhyāḥ kapāsmākaṃ dhaninyāhi yathāgatam ॥14॥
slp1: kapAnvayaM vijezyAmo ye devAste vayaM smftAH । tasmAdvaDyAH kapAsmAkaM DaninyAhi yaTAgatam ॥14॥
author: brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ ।

text: dhanī gatvā kapānāha na vo viprāḥ priyaṅkarāḥ । gṛhītvāstrāṇyatho viprānkapāḥ sarve samādravan ॥15॥
html:
dhanī gatvā kapānāha na vo viprāḥ priyaṅkarāḥ ।
gṛhītvāstrāṇyatho viprānkapāḥ sarve samādravan ॥15॥
slp1: DanI gatvA kapAnAha na vo viprAH priyaNkarAH । gfhItvAstrARyaTo viprAnkapAH sarve samAdravan ॥15॥

text: samudagradhvajāndṛṣṭvā kapānsarve dvijātayaḥ । vyasṛjañjvalitānagnīnkapānāṃ prāṇanāśanān ॥16॥
html:
samudagradhvajāndṛṣṭvā kapānsarve dvijātayaḥ ।
vyasṛjañjvalitānagnīnkapānāṃ prāṇanāśanān ॥16॥
slp1: samudagraDvajAndfzwvA kapAnsarve dvijAtayaH । vyasfjaYjvalitAnagnInkapAnAM prARanASanAn ॥16॥

text: brahmasṛṣṭā havyabhujaḥ kapānbhuktvā sanātanāḥ । nabhasīva yathābhrāṇi vyarājanta narādhipa । praśaśaṃsurdvijāṃścaiva brahmāṇaṃ ca yaśasvinam ॥17॥
html:
brahmasṛṣṭā havyabhujaḥ kapānbhuktvā sanātanāḥ ।
nabhasīva yathābhrāṇi vyarājanta narādhipa ।
praśaśaṃsurdvijāṃścaiva brahmāṇaṃ ca yaśasvinam ॥17॥
slp1: brahmasfzwA havyaBujaH kapAnBuktvA sanAtanAH । naBasIva yaTABrARi vyarAjanta narADipa । praSaSaMsurdvijAMScEva brahmARaM ca yaSasvinam ॥17॥

text: teṣāṃ tejastathā vīryaṃ devānāṃ vavṛdhe tataḥ । avāpnuvaṃścāmaratvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pūjitam ॥18॥
html:
teṣāṃ tejastathā vīryaṃ devānāṃ vavṛdhe tataḥ ।
avāpnuvaṃścāmaratvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pūjitam ॥18॥
slp1: tezAM tejastaTA vIryaM devAnAM vavfDe tataH । avApnuvaMScAmaratvaM trizu lokezu pUjitam ॥18॥

text: ityuktavacanaṃ vāyumarjunaḥ pratyabhāṣata । pratipūjya mahābāho yattacchṛṇu narādhipa ॥19॥
html:
ityuktavacanaṃ vāyumarjunaḥ pratyabhāṣata ।
pratipūjya mahābāho yattacchṛṇu narādhipa ॥19॥
slp1: ityuktavacanaM vAyumarjunaH pratyaBAzata । pratipUjya mahAbAho yattacCfRu narADipa ॥19॥

text: jīvāmyahaṃ brāhmaṇārthe sarvathā satataṃ prabho । brahmaṇe brāhmaṇebhyaśca praṇamāmi ca nityaśaḥ ॥20॥
html:
jīvāmyahaṃ brāhmaṇārthe sarvathā satataṃ prabho ।

text: brāhmaṇānarcase rājansatataṃ saṃśitavratān । kaṃ tu karmodayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tānarcasi narādhipa ॥1॥

text: kāṃ vā brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāvrata । tānarcasi mahābāho sarvametadvadasva me ॥2॥

slp1: kAM vA brAhmaRapUjAyAM vyuzwiM dfzwvA mahAvrata । tAnarcasi mahAbAho sarvametadvadasva me ॥2॥

text: eṣa te keśavaḥ sarvamākhyāsyati mahāmatiḥ । vyuṣṭiṃ brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ dṛṣṭavyuṣṭirmahāvrataḥ ॥3॥
html:
eṣa te keśavaḥ sarvamākhyāsyati mahāmatiḥ ।
vyuṣṭiṃ brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ dṛṣṭavyuṣṭirmahāvrataḥ ॥3॥

text: balaṃ śrotre vāṅmanaścakṣuṣī ca jñānaṃ tathā na viśuddhaṃ mamādya । dehanyāso nāticirānmato me na cātitūrṇaṃ savitādya yāti ॥4॥
html:

text: uktā dharmā ye purāṇe mahānto brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃ ca । paurāṇaṃ ye daṇḍamupāsate ca śeṣaṃ kṛṣṇādupaśikṣasva pārtha ॥5॥
html:
uktā dharmā ye purāṇe mahānto brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃ ca ।
paurāṇaṃ ye daṇḍamupāsate ca śeṣaṃ kṛṣṇādupaśikṣasva pārtha ॥5॥
slp1: uktA DarmA ye purARe mahAnto brAhmaRAnAM kzatriyARAM viSAM ca । pOrARaM ye daRqamupAsate ca SezaM kfzRAdupaSikzasva pArTa ॥5॥

text: ahaṃ hyenaṃ vedmi tattvena kṛṣṇaṃ yo'yaṃ hi yaccāsya balaṃ purāṇam । ameyātmā keśavaḥ kauravendra so'yaṃ dharmaṃ vakṣyati saṃśayeṣu ॥6॥
html:
ahaṃ hyenaṃ vedmi tattvena kṛṣṇaṃ yo'yaṃ hi yaccāsya balaṃ purāṇam ।
ameyātmā keśavaḥ kauravendra so'yaṃ dharmaṃ vakṣyati saṃśayeṣu ॥6॥

text: kṛṣṇaḥ pṛthvīmasṛjatkhaṃ divaṃ ca varāho'yaṃ bhīmabalaḥ purāṇaḥ । asya cādho'thāntarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca diśaścatasraḥ pradiśaścatasraḥ । sṛṣṭistathaiveyamanuprasūtā sa nirmame viśvamidaṃ purāṇam ॥7॥
html:
kṛṣṇaḥ pṛthvīmasṛjatkhaṃ divaṃ ca varāho'yaṃ bhīmabalaḥ purāṇaḥ ।
asya cādho'thāntarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca diśaścatasraḥ pradiśaścatasraḥ ।
sṛṣṭistathaiveyamanuprasūtā sa nirmame viśvamidaṃ purāṇam ॥7॥
slp1: kfzRaH pfTvImasfjatKaM divaM ca varAho'yaM BImabalaH purARaH । asya cADo'TAntarikzaM divaM ca diSaScatasraH pradiSaScatasraH । sfzwistaTEveyamanuprasUtA sa nirmame viSvamidaM purARam ॥7॥

text: asya nābhyāṃ puṣkaraṃ samprasūtaṃ yatrotpannaḥ svayamevāmitaujāḥ । yenācchinnaṃ tattamaḥ pārtha ghoraṃ yattattiṣṭhatyarṇavaṃ tarjayānam ॥8॥

yenācchinnaṃ tattamaḥ pārtha ghoraṃ yattattiṣṭhatyarṇavaṃ tarjayānam ॥8॥

text: kṛte yuge dharma āsītsamagrastretākāle jñānamanuprapannaḥ । balaṃ tvāsīddvāpare pārtha kṛṣṇaḥ kalāvadharmaḥ kṣitimājagāma ॥9॥

text: sa pūrvadevo nijaghāna daityānsa pūrvadevaśca babhūva samrāṭ । sa bhūtānāṃ bhāvano bhūtabhavyaḥ sa viśvasyāsya jagataścāpi goptā ॥10॥

sa bhūtānāṃ bhāvano bhūtabhavyaḥ sa viśvasyāsya jagataścāpi goptā ॥10॥

text: yadā dharmo glāyati vai surāṇāṃ tadā kṛṣṇo jāyate mānuṣeṣu । dharme sthitvā sa tu vai bhāvitātmā parāṃśca lokānaparāṃśca yāti ॥11॥

text: tyājyāṃstyaktvāthāsurāṇāṃ vadhāya kāryākārye kāraṇaṃ caiva pārtha । kṛtaṃ kariṣyatkriyate ca devo muhuḥ somaṃ viddhi ca śakrametam ॥12॥

text: sa viśvakarmā sa ca viśvarūpaḥ sa viśvabhṛdviśvasṛgviśvajicca । sa śūlabhṛcchoṇitabhṛtkarālastaṃ karmabhirviditaṃ vai stuvanti ॥13॥

text: taṃ gandharvā apsarasaśca nityamupatiṣṭhante vibudhānāṃ śatāni । taṃ rākṣasāśca parisaṃvahante rāyaspoṣaḥ sa vijigīṣurekaḥ ॥14॥

text: tamadhvare śaṃsitāraḥ stuvanti rathantare sāmagāśca stuvanti । taṃ brāhmaṇā brahmamantraiḥ stuvanti tasmai haviradhvaryavaḥ kalpayanti ॥15॥

text: sa paurāṇīṃ brahmaguhāṃ praviṣṭo mahīsatraṃ bhāratāgre dadarśa । sa caiva gāmuddadhārāgryakarmā vikṣobhya daityānuragāndānavāṃśca ॥16॥

text: tasya bhakṣānvividhānvedayanti tamevājau vāhanaṃ vedayanti । tasyāntarikṣaṃ pṛthivī divaṃ ca sarvaṃ vaśe tiṣṭhati śāśvatasya ॥17॥

text: sa kumbharetāḥ sasṛje purāṇaṃ yatrotpannamṛṣimāhurvasiṣṭham । sa mātariśvā vibhuraśvavājī sa raśmimānsavitā cādidevaḥ ॥18॥

text: tenāsurā vijitāḥ sarva eva tasya vikrāntairvijitānīha trīṇi । sa devānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ tamevāhuryajñavidāṃ vitānam ॥19॥

text: sa eva kālaṃ vibhajannudeti tasyottaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cāyane dve । tasyaivordhvaṃ tiryagadhaścaranti gabhastayo medinīṃ tāpayantaḥ ॥20॥

text: taṃ brāhmaṇā vedavido juṣanti tasyādityo bhāmupayujya bhāti । sa māsi māsyadhvarakṛdvidhatte tamadhvare vedavidaḥ paṭhanti ॥21॥

text: sa ekayukcakramidaṃ trinābhi saptāśvayuktaṃ vahate vai tridhāmā । mahātejāḥ sarvagaḥ sarvasiṃhaḥ kṛṣṇo lokāndhārayate tathaikaḥ । aśnannanaśnaṃśca tathaiva dhīraḥ kṛṣṇaṃ sadā pārtha kartāramehi ॥22॥

mahātejāḥ sarvagaḥ sarvasiṃhaḥ kṛṣṇo lokāndhārayate tathaikaḥ ।

text: saṃvatsaraḥ sa ṛtuḥ so'rdhamāsaḥ so'horātraḥ sa kalā vai sa kāṣṭhāḥ । mātrā muhūrtāśca lavāḥ kṣaṇāśca viṣvaksene sarvametatpratīhi ॥30॥
html:
saṃvatsaraḥ sa ṛtuḥ so'rdhamāsaḥ so'horātraḥ sa kalā vai sa kāṣṭhāḥ ।
mātrā muhūrtāśca lavāḥ kṣaṇāśca viṣvaksene sarvametatpratīhi ॥30॥
slp1: saMvatsaraH sa ftuH so'rDamAsaH so'horAtraH sa kalA vE sa kAzWAH । mAtrA muhUrtASca lavAH kzaRASca vizvaksene sarvametatpratIhi ॥30॥

text: candrādityau grahanakṣatratārāḥ sarvāṇi darśānyatha paurṇamāsyaḥ । nakṣatrayogā ṛtavaśca pārtha viṣvaksenātsarvametatprasūtam ॥31॥
html:
candrādityau grahanakṣatratārāḥ sarvāṇi darśānyatha paurṇamāsyaḥ ।
nakṣatrayogā ṛtavaśca pārtha viṣvaksenātsarvametatprasūtam ॥31॥
slp1: candrAdityO grahanakzatratArAH sarvARi darSAnyaTa pOrRamAsyaH । nakzatrayogA ftavaSca pArTa vizvaksenAtsarvametatprasUtam ॥31॥

text: rudrādityā vasavo'thāśvinau ca sādhyā viśve marutāṃ ṣaḍgaṇāśca । prajāpatirdevamātāditiśca sarve kṛṣṇādṛṣayaścaiva sapta ॥32॥
html:
rudrādityā vasavo'thāśvinau ca sādhyā viśve marutāṃ ṣaḍgaṇāśca ।
prajāpatirdevamātāditiśca sarve kṛṣṇādṛṣayaścaiva sapta ॥32॥
slp1: rudrAdityA vasavo'TASvinO ca sADyA viSve marutAM zaqgaRASca । prajApatirdevamAtAditiSca sarve kfzRAdfzayaScEva sapta ॥32॥

text: vāyurbhūtvā vikṣipate ca viśvamagnirbhūtvā dahate viśvarūpaḥ । āpo bhūtvā majjayate ca sarvaṃ brahmā bhūtvā sṛjate viśvasaṅghān ॥33॥
html:
vāyurbhūtvā vikṣipate ca viśvamagnirbhūtvā dahate viśvarūpaḥ ।
āpo bhūtvā majjayate ca sarvaṃ brahmā bhūtvā sṛjate viśvasaṅghān ॥33॥
slp1: vAyurBUtvA vikzipate ca viSvamagnirBUtvA dahate viSvarUpaH । Apo BUtvA majjayate ca sarvaM brahmA BUtvA sfjate viSvasaNGAn ॥33॥

text: vedyaṃ ca yadvedayate ca vedānvidhiśca yaścāśrayate vidheyān । dharme ca vede ca bale ca sarvaṃ carācaraṃ keśavaṃ tvaṃ pratīhi ॥34॥
html:
vedyaṃ ca yadvedayate ca vedānvidhiśca yaścāśrayate vidheyān ।
dharme ca vede ca bale ca sarvaṃ carācaraṃ keśavaṃ tvaṃ pratīhi ॥34॥
slp1: vedyaM ca yadvedayate ca vedAnviDiSca yaScASrayate viDeyAn । Darme ca vede ca bale ca sarvaM carAcaraM keSavaM tvaM pratIhi ॥34॥

text: jyotirbhūtaḥ paramo'sau purastātprakāśayanprabhayā viśvarūpaḥ । apaḥ sṛṣṭvā hyātmabhūrātmayoniḥ purākarotsarvamevātha viśvam ॥35॥
html:
jyotirbhūtaḥ paramo'sau purastātprakāśayanprabhayā viśvarūpaḥ ।
apaḥ sṛṣṭvā hyātmabhūrātmayoniḥ purākarotsarvamevātha viśvam ॥35॥
slp1: jyotirBUtaH paramo'sO purastAtprakASayanpraBayA viSvarUpaH । apaH sfzwvA hyAtmaBUrAtmayoniH purAkarotsarvamevATa viSvam ॥35॥

text: ṛtūnutpātānvividhānyadbhutāni meghānvidyutsarvamairāvataṃ ca । sarvaṃ kṛṣṇātsthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca viśvākhyātādviṣṇumenaṃ pratīhi ॥36॥
html:
ṛtūnutpātānvividhānyadbhutāni meghānvidyutsarvamairāvataṃ ca ।
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇātsthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca viśvākhyātādviṣṇumenaṃ pratīhi ॥36॥
slp1: ftUnutpAtAnviviDAnyadButAni meGAnvidyutsarvamErAvataM ca । sarvaM kfzRAtsTAvaraM jaNgamaM ca viSvAKyAtAdvizRumenaM pratIhi ॥36॥

text: viśvāvāsaṃ nirguṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ jīvabhūtaṃ vadanti । tataḥ pradyumnamaniruddhaṃ caturthamājñāpayatyātmayonirmahātmā ॥37॥
html:
viśvāvāsaṃ nirguṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ jīvabhūtaṃ vadanti ।
tataḥ pradyumnamaniruddhaṃ caturthamājñāpayatyātmayonirmahātmā ॥37॥
slp1: viSvAvAsaM nirguRaM vAsudevaM saNkarzaRaM jIvaBUtaM vadanti । tataH pradyumnamanirudDaM caturTamAjYApayatyAtmayonirmahAtmA ॥37॥

text: sa pañcadhā pañcajanopapannaṃ sañcodayanviśvamidaṃ sisṛkṣuḥ । tataścakārāvanimārutau ca khaṃ jyotirāpaśca tathaiva pārtha ॥38॥
html:
sa pañcadhā pañcajanopapannaṃ sañcodayanviśvamidaṃ sisṛkṣuḥ ।
tataścakārāvanimārutau ca khaṃ jyotirāpaśca tathaiva pārtha ॥38॥
slp1: sa paYcaDA paYcajanopapannaM saYcodayanviSvamidaM sisfkzuH । tataScakArAvanimArutO ca KaM jyotirApaSca taTEva pArTa ॥38॥

text: sa sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caivametaccaturvidhaṃ lokamimaṃ ca kṛtvā । tato bhūmiṃ vyadadhātpañcabījāṃ dyauḥ pṛthivyāṃ dhāsyati bhūri vāri । tena viśvaṃ kṛtametaddhi rājansa jīvayatyātmanaivātmayoniḥ ॥39॥
html:
sa sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caivametaccaturvidhaṃ lokamimaṃ ca kṛtvā ।
tato bhūmiṃ vyadadhātpañcabījāṃ dyauḥ pṛthivyāṃ dhāsyati bhūri vāri ।
tena viśvaṃ kṛtametaddhi rājansa jīvayatyātmanaivātmayoniḥ ॥39॥
slp1: sa sTAvaraM jaNgamaM cEvametaccaturviDaM lokamimaM ca kftvA । tato BUmiM vyadaDAtpaYcabIjAM dyOH pfTivyAM DAsyati BUri vAri । tena viSvaM kftametadDi rAjansa jIvayatyAtmanEvAtmayoniH ॥39॥

text: tato devānasurānmānuṣāṃśca lokānṛṣīṃścātha pitṝnprajāśca । samāsena vividhānprāṇilokānsarvānsadā bhūtapatiḥ sisṛkṣuḥ ॥40॥
html:
tato devānasurānmānuṣāṃśca lokānṛṣīṃścātha pitṝnprajāśca ।
samāsena vividhānprāṇilokānsarvānsadā bhūtapatiḥ sisṛkṣuḥ ॥40॥
slp1: tato devAnasurAnmAnuzAMSca lokAnfzIMScATa pitFnprajASca । samAsena viviDAnprARilokAnsarvAnsadA BUtapatiH sisfkzuH ॥40॥

text: śubhāśubhaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca viṣvaksenātsarvametatpratīhi । yadvartate yacca bhaviṣyatīha sarvametatkeśavaṃ tvaṃ pratīhi ॥41॥
html:
śubhāśubhaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca viṣvaksenātsarvametatpratīhi ।
yadvartate yacca bhaviṣyatīha sarvametatkeśavaṃ tvaṃ pratīhi ॥41॥
slp1: SuBASuBaM sTAvaraM jaNgamaM ca vizvaksenAtsarvametatpratIhi । yadvartate yacca BavizyatIha sarvametatkeSavaM tvaM pratIhi ॥41॥

text: mṛtyuścaiva prāṇināmantakāle sākṣātkṛṣṇaḥ śāśvato dharmavāhaḥ । bhūtaṃ ca yacceha na vidma kiṃ cidviṣvaksenātsarvametatpratīhi ॥42॥
html:
mṛtyuścaiva prāṇināmantakāle sākṣātkṛṣṇaḥ śāśvato dharmavāhaḥ ।
bhūtaṃ ca yacceha na vidma kiṃ cidviṣvaksenātsarvametatpratīhi ॥42॥
slp1: mftyuScEva prARinAmantakAle sAkzAtkfzRaH SASvato DarmavAhaH । BUtaM ca yacceha na vidma kiM cidvizvaksenAtsarvametatpratIhi ॥42॥

text: yatpraśastaṃ ca lokeṣu puṇyaṃ yacca śubhāśubham । tatsarvaṃ keśavo'cintyo viparītamato bhavet ॥43॥
html:
yatpraśastaṃ ca lokeṣu puṇyaṃ yacca śubhāśubham ।
tatsarvaṃ keśavo'cintyo viparītamato bhavet ॥43॥
slp1: yatpraSastaM ca lokezu puRyaM yacca SuBASuBam । tatsarvaM keSavo'cintyo viparItamato Bavet ॥43॥

text: etādṛśaḥ keśavo'yaṃ svayambhūrnārāyaṇaḥ paramaścāvyayaśca । madhyaṃ cāsya jagatastasthuṣaśca sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prabhavaścāpyayaśca] ॥44॥
html:
etādṛśaḥ keśavo'yaṃ svayambhūrnārāyaṇaḥ paramaścāvyayaśca ।
madhyaṃ cāsya jagatastasthuṣaśca sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prabhavaścāpyayaśca] ॥44॥
slp1: etAdfSaH keSavo'yaM svayamBUrnArAyaRaH paramaScAvyayaSca । maDyaM cAsya jagatastasTuzaSca sarvezAM BUtAnAM praBavaScApyayaSca] ॥44॥

text: brūhi brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tvaṃ madhusūdana । vettā tvamasya cārthasya veda tvāṃ hi pitāmahaḥ ॥1॥
html:
brūhi brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ tvaṃ madhusūdana ।
vettā tvamasya cārthasya veda tvāṃ hi pitāmahaḥ ॥1॥
slp1: brUhi brAhmaRapUjAyAM vyuzwiM tvaM maDusUdana । vettA tvamasya cArTasya veda tvAM hi pitAmahaH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājandvijānāṃ bharatarṣabha । yathātattvena vadato guṇānme kurusattama ॥2॥
html:
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājandvijānāṃ bharatarṣabha ।
yathātattvena vadato guṇānme kurusattama ॥2॥
slp1: SfRuzvAvahito rAjandvijAnAM BaratarzaBa । yaTAtattvena vadato guRAnme kurusattama ॥2॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: pradyumnaḥ paripapraccha brāhmaṇaiḥ parikopitaḥ । kiṃ phalaṃ brāhmaṇeṣvasti pūjāyāṃ madhusūdana । īśvarasya satastasya iha caiva paratra ca ॥3॥
html:
pradyumnaḥ paripapraccha brāhmaṇaiḥ parikopitaḥ ।
kiṃ phalaṃ brāhmaṇeṣvasti pūjāyāṃ madhusūdana ।
īśvarasya satastasya iha caiva paratra ca ॥3॥
slp1: pradyumnaH paripapracCa brAhmaREH parikopitaH । kiM PalaM brAhmaRezvasti pUjAyAM maDusUdana । ISvarasya satastasya iha cEva paratra ca ॥3॥

text: sadā dvijātīnsampūjya kiṃ phalaṃ tatra mānada । etadbrūhi pitaḥ sarvaṃ sumahānsaṃśayo'tra me ॥4॥
html:
sadā dvijātīnsampūjya kiṃ phalaṃ tatra mānada ।
etadbrūhi pitaḥ sarvaṃ sumahānsaṃśayo'tra me ॥4॥
slp1: sadA dvijAtInsampUjya kiM PalaM tatra mAnada । etadbrUhi pitaH sarvaM sumahAnsaMSayo'tra me ॥4॥

text: ityuktavacanastena pradyumnena tadā tvaham । pratyabruvaṃ mahārāja yattacchṛṇu samāhitaḥ ॥5॥
html:
ityuktavacanastena pradyumnena tadā tvaham ।
pratyabruvaṃ mahārāja yattacchṛṇu samāhitaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: ityuktavacanastena pradyumnena tadA tvaham । pratyabruvaM mahArAja yattacCfRu samAhitaH ॥5॥

text: vyuṣṭiṃ brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ raukmiṇeya nibodha me । ete hi somarājāna īśvarāḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ॥6॥
html:
vyuṣṭiṃ brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ raukmiṇeya nibodha me ।
ete hi somarājāna īśvarāḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ॥6॥
slp1: vyuzwiM brAhmaRapUjAyAM rOkmiReya niboDa me । ete hi somarAjAna ISvarAH suKaduHKayoH ॥6॥

text: asmiṁlloke raukmiṇeya tathāmuṣmiṃśca putraka । brāhmaṇapramukhaṃ saukhyaṃ na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥7॥
html:
asmiṁlloke raukmiṇeya tathāmuṣmiṃśca putraka ।
brāhmaṇapramukhaṃ saukhyaṃ na me'trāsti vicāraṇā ॥7॥
slp1: asmiṁlloke rOkmiReya taTAmuzmiMSca putraka । brAhmaRapramuKaM sOKyaM na me'trAsti vicAraRA ॥7॥

text: brāhmaṇapramukhaṃ vīryamāyuḥ kīrtiryaśo balam । lokā lokeśvarāścaiva sarve brāhmaṇapūrvakāḥ ॥8॥
html:
brāhmaṇapramukhaṃ vīryamāyuḥ kīrtiryaśo balam ।
lokā lokeśvarāścaiva sarve brāhmaṇapūrvakāḥ ॥8॥
slp1: brAhmaRapramuKaM vIryamAyuH kIrtiryaSo balam । lokA lokeSvarAScEva sarve brAhmaRapUrvakAH ॥8॥

text: tatkathaṃ nādriyeyaṃ vai īśvaro'smīti putraka । mā te manyurmahābāho bhavatvatra dvijānprati ॥9॥
html:
tatkathaṃ nādriyeyaṃ vai īśvaro'smīti putraka ।
mā te manyurmahābāho bhavatvatra dvijānprati ॥9॥
slp1: tatkaTaM nAdriyeyaM vE ISvaro'smIti putraka । mA te manyurmahAbAho Bavatvatra dvijAnprati ॥9॥

text: brāhmaṇo hi mahadbhūtamasmiṁlloke paratra ca । bhasma kuryurjagadidaṃ kruddhāḥ pratyakṣadarśinaḥ ॥10॥
html:
brāhmaṇo hi mahadbhūtamasmiṁlloke paratra ca ।
bhasma kuryurjagadidaṃ kruddhāḥ pratyakṣadarśinaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: brAhmaRo hi mahadBUtamasmiṁlloke paratra ca । Basma kuryurjagadidaM krudDAH pratyakzadarSinaH ॥10॥

text: anyānapi sṛjeyuśca lokāṁllokeśvarāṃstathā । kathaṃ teṣu na varteya samyagjñānātsutejasaḥ ॥11॥
html:
anyānapi sṛjeyuśca lokāṁllokeśvarāṃstathā ।
kathaṃ teṣu na varteya samyagjñānātsutejasaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: anyAnapi sfjeyuSca lokAṁllokeSvarAMstaTA । kaTaM tezu na varteya samyagjYAnAtsutejasaH ॥11॥

text: avasanmadgṛhe tāta brāhmaṇo haripiṅgalaḥ । cīravāsā bilvadaṇḍī dīrghaśmaśrunakhādimān । dīrghebhyaśca manuṣyebhyaḥ pramāṇādadhiko bhuvi ॥12॥
html:
avasanmadgṛhe tāta brāhmaṇo haripiṅgalaḥ ।
cīravāsā bilvadaṇḍī dīrghaśmaśrunakhādimān ।
dīrghebhyaśca manuṣyebhyaḥ pramāṇādadhiko bhuvi ॥12॥
slp1: avasanmadgfhe tAta brAhmaRo haripiNgalaH । cIravAsA bilvadaRqI dIrGaSmaSrunaKAdimAn । dIrGeByaSca manuzyeByaH pramARAdaDiko Buvi ॥12॥

text: sa sma sañcarate lokānye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ । imā gāthā gāyamānaścatvareṣu sabhāsu ca ॥13॥
html:
sa sma sañcarate lokānye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ।
imā gāthā gāyamānaścatvareṣu sabhāsu ca ॥13॥
slp1: sa sma saYcarate lokAnye divyA ye ca mAnuzAH । imA gATA gAyamAnaScatvarezu saBAsu ca ॥13॥

text: durvāsasaṃ vāsayetko brāhmaṇaṃ satkṛtaṃ gṛhe । paribhāṣāṃ ca me śrutvā ko nu dadyātpratiśrayam । yo māṃ kaścidvāsayeta na sa māṃ kopayediha ॥14॥
html:
durvāsasaṃ vāsayetko brāhmaṇaṃ satkṛtaṃ gṛhe ।
paribhāṣāṃ ca me śrutvā ko nu dadyātpratiśrayam ।
yo māṃ kaścidvāsayeta na sa māṃ kopayediha ॥14॥
