slp1: durvAsasaM vAsayetko brAhmaRaM satkftaM gfhe । pariBAzAM ca me SrutvA ko nu dadyAtpratiSrayam । yo mAM kaScidvAsayeta na sa mAM kopayediha ॥14॥

text: taṃ sma nādriyate kaścittato'haṃ tamavāsayam ॥15॥
html: taṃ sma nādriyate kaścittato'haṃ tamavāsayam ॥15॥
slp1: taM sma nAdriyate kaScittato'haM tamavAsayam ॥15॥

text: sa sma bhuṅkte sahasrāṇāṃ bahūnāmannamekadā । ekadā smālpakaṃ bhuṅkte na vaiti ca punargṛhān ॥16॥
html:
sa sma bhuṅkte sahasrāṇāṃ bahūnāmannamekadā ।
ekadā smālpakaṃ bhuṅkte na vaiti ca punargṛhān ॥16॥
slp1: sa sma BuNkte sahasrARAM bahUnAmannamekadA । ekadA smAlpakaM BuNkte na vEti ca punargfhAn ॥16॥

text: akasmācca prahasati tathākasmātpraroditi । na cāsya vayasā tulyaḥ pṛthivyāmabhavattadā ॥17॥
html:
akasmācca prahasati tathākasmātpraroditi ।
na cāsya vayasā tulyaḥ pṛthivyāmabhavattadā ॥17॥
slp1: akasmAcca prahasati taTAkasmAtpraroditi । na cAsya vayasA tulyaH pfTivyAmaBavattadA ॥17॥

text: so'smadāvasathaṃ gatvā śayyāścāstaraṇāni ca । kanyāścālaṅkṛtā dagdhvā tato vyapagataḥ svayam ॥18॥
html:
so'smadāvasathaṃ gatvā śayyāścāstaraṇāni ca ।
kanyāścālaṅkṛtā dagdhvā tato vyapagataḥ svayam ॥18॥
slp1: so'smadAvasaTaM gatvA SayyAScAstaraRAni ca । kanyAScAlaNkftA dagDvA tato vyapagataH svayam ॥18॥

text: atha māmabravīdbhūyaḥ sa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ । kṛṣṇa pāyasamicchāmi bhoktumityeva satvaraḥ ॥19॥
html:
atha māmabravīdbhūyaḥ sa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ।
kṛṣṇa pāyasamicchāmi bhoktumityeva satvaraḥ ॥19॥
slp1: aTa mAmabravIdBUyaH sa muniH saMSitavrataH । kfzRa pAyasamicCAmi Boktumityeva satvaraH ॥19॥

text: sadaiva tu mayā tasya cittajñena gṛhe janaḥ । sarvāṇyevānnapānāni bhakṣyāścoccāvacāstathā । bhavantu satkṛtānīti pūrvameva pracoditaḥ ॥20॥
html:
sadaiva tu mayā tasya cittajñena gṛhe janaḥ ।
sarvāṇyevānnapānāni bhakṣyāścoccāvacāstathā ।
bhavantu satkṛtānīti pūrvameva pracoditaḥ ॥20॥
slp1: sadEva tu mayA tasya cittajYena gfhe janaH । sarvARyevAnnapAnAni BakzyAScoccAvacAstaTA । Bavantu satkftAnIti pUrvameva pracoditaH ॥20॥

text: tato'haṃ jvalamānaṃ vai pāyasaṃ pratyavedayam । tadbhuktvaiva tu sa kṣipraṃ tato vacanamabravīt । kṣipramaṅgāni limpasva pāyaseneti sa sma ha ॥21॥
html:
tato'haṃ jvalamānaṃ vai pāyasaṃ pratyavedayam ।
tadbhuktvaiva tu sa kṣipraṃ tato vacanamabravīt ।
kṣipramaṅgāni limpasva pāyaseneti sa sma ha ॥21॥
slp1: tato'haM jvalamAnaM vE pAyasaM pratyavedayam । tadBuktvEva tu sa kzipraM tato vacanamabravIt । kzipramaNgAni limpasva pAyaseneti sa sma ha ॥21॥

text: avimṛśyaiva ca tataḥ kṛtavānasmi tattathā । tenocchiṣṭena gātrāṇi śiraścaivābhyamṛkṣayam ॥22॥
html:
avimṛśyaiva ca tataḥ kṛtavānasmi tattathā ।
tenocchiṣṭena gātrāṇi śiraścaivābhyamṛkṣayam ॥22॥
slp1: avimfSyEva ca tataH kftavAnasmi tattaTA । tenocCizwena gAtrARi SiraScEvAByamfkzayam ॥22॥

text: sa dadarśa tadābhyāśe mātaraṃ te śubhānanām । tāmapi smayamānaḥ sa pāyasenābhyalepayat ॥23॥
html:
sa dadarśa tadābhyāśe mātaraṃ te śubhānanām ।
tāmapi smayamānaḥ sa pāyasenābhyalepayat ॥23॥
slp1: sa dadarSa tadAByASe mAtaraM te SuBAnanAm । tAmapi smayamAnaH sa pAyasenAByalepayat ॥23॥

text: muniḥ pāyasadigdhāṅgīṃ rathe tūrṇamayojayat । tamāruhya rathaṃ caiva niryayau sa gṛhānmama ॥24॥
html:
muniḥ pāyasadigdhāṅgīṃ rathe tūrṇamayojayat ।
tamāruhya rathaṃ caiva niryayau sa gṛhānmama ॥24॥
slp1: muniH pAyasadigDANgIM raTe tUrRamayojayat । tamAruhya raTaM cEva niryayO sa gfhAnmama ॥24॥

text: agnivarṇo jvalandhīmānsa dvijo rathadhuryavat । pratodenātudadbālāṃ rukmiṇīṃ mama paśyataḥ ॥25॥
html:
agnivarṇo jvalandhīmānsa dvijo rathadhuryavat ।
pratodenātudadbālāṃ rukmiṇīṃ mama paśyataḥ ॥25॥
slp1: agnivarRo jvalanDImAnsa dvijo raTaDuryavat । pratodenAtudadbAlAM rukmiRIM mama paSyataH ॥25॥

text: na ca me stokamapyāsīdduḥkhamīrṣyākṛtaṃ tadā । tataḥ sa rājamārgeṇa mahatā niryayau bahiḥ ॥26॥
html:
na ca me stokamapyāsīdduḥkhamīrṣyākṛtaṃ tadā ।
tataḥ sa rājamārgeṇa mahatā niryayau bahiḥ ॥26॥
slp1: na ca me stokamapyAsIdduHKamIrzyAkftaM tadA । tataH sa rAjamArgeRa mahatA niryayO bahiH ॥26॥

text: taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ dāśārhā jātamanyavaḥ । tatrājalpanmithaḥ kecitsamābhāṣya parasparam ॥27॥
html:
taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ dāśārhā jātamanyavaḥ ।
tatrājalpanmithaḥ kecitsamābhāṣya parasparam ॥27॥
slp1: taddfzwvA mahadAScaryaM dASArhA jAtamanyavaH । tatrAjalpanmiTaH kecitsamABAzya parasparam ॥27॥

text: brāhmaṇā eva jāyerannānyo varṇaḥ kathañcana । ko hyenaṃ rathamāsthāya jīvedanyaḥ pumāniha ॥28॥
html:
brāhmaṇā eva jāyerannānyo varṇaḥ kathañcana ।
ko hyenaṃ rathamāsthāya jīvedanyaḥ pumāniha ॥28॥
slp1: brAhmaRA eva jAyerannAnyo varRaH kaTaYcana । ko hyenaM raTamAsTAya jIvedanyaH pumAniha ॥28॥

text: āśīviṣaviṣaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ tatastīkṣṇataraṃ viṣam । brahmāśīviṣadagdhasya nāsti kaściccikitsakaḥ ॥29॥
html:
āśīviṣaviṣaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ tatastīkṣṇataraṃ viṣam ।
brahmāśīviṣadagdhasya nāsti kaściccikitsakaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: ASIvizavizaM tIkzRaM tatastIkzRataraM vizam । brahmASIvizadagDasya nAsti kaSciccikitsakaH ॥29॥

text: tasminvrajati durdharṣe prāskhaladrukmiṇī pathi । tāṃ nāmarṣayata śrīmāṃstatastūrṇamacodayat ॥30॥
html:
tasminvrajati durdharṣe prāskhaladrukmiṇī pathi ।
tāṃ nāmarṣayata śrīmāṃstatastūrṇamacodayat ॥30॥
slp1: tasminvrajati durDarze prAsKaladrukmiRI paTi । tAM nAmarzayata SrImAMstatastUrRamacodayat ॥30॥

text: tataḥ paramasaṅkruddho rathātpraskandya sa dvijaḥ । padātirutpathenaiva prādhāvaddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ॥31॥
html:
tataḥ paramasaṅkruddho rathātpraskandya sa dvijaḥ ।
padātirutpathenaiva prādhāvaddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ॥31॥
slp1: tataH paramasaNkrudDo raTAtpraskandya sa dvijaH । padAtirutpaTenEva prADAvaddakziRAmuKaH ॥31॥

text: tamutpathena dhāvantamanvadhāvaṃ dvijottamam । tathaiva pāyasādigdhaḥ prasīda bhagavanniti ॥32॥
html:
tamutpathena dhāvantamanvadhāvaṃ dvijottamam ।
tathaiva pāyasādigdhaḥ prasīda bhagavanniti ॥32॥
slp1: tamutpaTena DAvantamanvaDAvaM dvijottamam । taTEva pAyasAdigDaH prasIda Bagavanniti ॥32॥

text: tato vilokya tejasvī brāhmaṇo māmuvāca ha । jitaḥ krodhastvayā kṛṣṇa prakṛtyaiva mahābhuja ॥33॥
html:
tato vilokya tejasvī brāhmaṇo māmuvāca ha ।
jitaḥ krodhastvayā kṛṣṇa prakṛtyaiva mahābhuja ॥33॥
slp1: tato vilokya tejasvI brAhmaRo mAmuvAca ha । jitaH kroDastvayA kfzRa prakftyEva mahABuja ॥33॥

text: na te'parādhamiha vai dṛṣṭavānasmi suvrata । prīto'smi tava govinda vṛṇu kāmānyathepsitān । prasannasya ca me tāta paśya vyuṣṭiryathāvidhā ॥34॥
html:
na te'parādhamiha vai dṛṣṭavānasmi suvrata ।
prīto'smi tava govinda vṛṇu kāmānyathepsitān ।
prasannasya ca me tāta paśya vyuṣṭiryathāvidhā ॥34॥
slp1: na te'parADamiha vE dfzwavAnasmi suvrata । prIto'smi tava govinda vfRu kAmAnyaTepsitAn । prasannasya ca me tAta paSya vyuzwiryaTAviDA ॥34॥

text: yāvadeva manuṣyāṇāmanne bhāvo bhaviṣyati । yathaivānne tathā teṣāṃ tvayi bhāvo bhaviṣyati ॥35॥
html:
yāvadeva manuṣyāṇāmanne bhāvo bhaviṣyati ।
yathaivānne tathā teṣāṃ tvayi bhāvo bhaviṣyati ॥35॥
slp1: yAvadeva manuzyARAmanne BAvo Bavizyati । yaTEvAnne taTA tezAM tvayi BAvo Bavizyati ॥35॥

text: yāvacca puṇyā lokeṣu tvayi kīrtirbhaviṣyati । triṣu lokeṣu tāvacca vaiśiṣṭyaṃ pratipatsyase । supriyaḥ sarvalokasya bhaviṣyasi janārdana ॥36॥
html:
yāvacca puṇyā lokeṣu tvayi kīrtirbhaviṣyati ।
triṣu lokeṣu tāvacca vaiśiṣṭyaṃ pratipatsyase ।
supriyaḥ sarvalokasya bhaviṣyasi janārdana ॥36॥
slp1: yAvacca puRyA lokezu tvayi kIrtirBavizyati । trizu lokezu tAvacca vESizwyaM pratipatsyase । supriyaH sarvalokasya Bavizyasi janArdana ॥36॥

text: yatte bhinnaṃ ca dagdhaṃ ca yacca kiñcidvināśitam । sarvaṃ tathaiva draṣṭāsi viśiṣṭaṃ vā janārdana ॥37॥
html:
yatte bhinnaṃ ca dagdhaṃ ca yacca kiñcidvināśitam ।
sarvaṃ tathaiva draṣṭāsi viśiṣṭaṃ vā janārdana ॥37॥
slp1: yatte BinnaM ca dagDaM ca yacca kiYcidvinASitam । sarvaM taTEva drazwAsi viSizwaM vA janArdana ॥37॥

text: yāvadetatpraliptaṃ te gātreṣu madhusūdana । ato mṛtyubhayaṃ nāsti yāvadicchā tavācyuta ॥38॥
html:
yāvadetatpraliptaṃ te gātreṣu madhusūdana ।
ato mṛtyubhayaṃ nāsti yāvadicchā tavācyuta ॥38॥
slp1: yAvadetatpraliptaM te gAtrezu maDusUdana । ato mftyuBayaM nAsti yAvadicCA tavAcyuta ॥38॥

text: na tu pādatale lipte kasmātte putrakādya vai । naitanme priyamityeva sa māṃ prīto'bravīttadā । ityukto'haṃ śarīraṃ svamapaśyaṃ śrīsamāyutam ॥39॥
html:
na tu pādatale lipte kasmātte putrakādya vai ।
naitanme priyamityeva sa māṃ prīto'bravīttadā ।
ityukto'haṃ śarīraṃ svamapaśyaṃ śrīsamāyutam ॥39॥
slp1: na tu pAdatale lipte kasmAtte putrakAdya vE । nEtanme priyamityeva sa mAM prIto'bravIttadA । ityukto'haM SarIraM svamapaSyaM SrIsamAyutam ॥39॥

text: rukmiṇīṃ cābravītprītaḥ sarvastrīṇāṃ varaṃ yaśaḥ । kīrtiṃ cānuttamāṃ loke samavāpsyasi śobhane ॥40॥
html:
rukmiṇīṃ cābravītprītaḥ sarvastrīṇāṃ varaṃ yaśaḥ ।
kīrtiṃ cānuttamāṃ loke samavāpsyasi śobhane ॥40॥
slp1: rukmiRIM cAbravItprItaH sarvastrIRAM varaM yaSaH । kIrtiM cAnuttamAM loke samavApsyasi SoBane ॥40॥

text: na tvāṃ jarā vā rogo vā vaivarṇyaṃ cāpi bhāmini । sprakṣyanti puṇyagandhā ca kṛṣṇamārādhayiṣyasi ॥41॥
html:
na tvāṃ jarā vā rogo vā vaivarṇyaṃ cāpi bhāmini ।
sprakṣyanti puṇyagandhā ca kṛṣṇamārādhayiṣyasi ॥41॥
slp1: na tvAM jarA vA rogo vA vEvarRyaM cApi BAmini । sprakzyanti puRyaganDA ca kfzRamArADayizyasi ॥41॥

text: ṣoḍaśānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ vadhūnāṃ keśavasya ha । variṣṭhā sahalokyā ca keśavasya bhaviṣyasi ॥42॥
html:
ṣoḍaśānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ vadhūnāṃ keśavasya ha ।
variṣṭhā sahalokyā ca keśavasya bhaviṣyasi ॥42॥
slp1: zoqaSAnAM sahasrARAM vaDUnAM keSavasya ha । varizWA sahalokyA ca keSavasya Bavizyasi ॥42॥

text: tava mātaramityuktvā tato māṃ punarabravīt । prasthitaḥ sumahātejā durvāsā vahnivajjvalan ॥43॥
html:
tava mātaramityuktvā tato māṃ punarabravīt ।
prasthitaḥ sumahātejā durvāsā vahnivajjvalan ॥43॥
slp1: tava mAtaramityuktvA tato mAM punarabravIt । prasTitaH sumahAtejA durvAsA vahnivajjvalan ॥43॥

text: eṣaiva te buddhirastu brāhmaṇānprati keśava । ityuktvā sa tadā putra tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥44॥
html:
eṣaiva te buddhirastu brāhmaṇānprati keśava ।
ityuktvā sa tadā putra tatraivāntaradhīyata ॥44॥
slp1: ezEva te budDirastu brAhmaRAnprati keSava । ityuktvA sa tadA putra tatrEvAntaraDIyata ॥44॥

text: tasminnantarhite cāhamupāṃśuvratamādiśam । yatkiñcidbrāhmaṇo brūyātsarvaṃ kuryāmiti prabho ॥45॥
html:
tasminnantarhite cāhamupāṃśuvratamādiśam ।
yatkiñcidbrāhmaṇo brūyātsarvaṃ kuryāmiti prabho ॥45॥
slp1: tasminnantarhite cAhamupAMSuvratamAdiSam । yatkiYcidbrAhmaRo brUyAtsarvaM kuryAmiti praBo ॥45॥

text: etadvratamahaṃ kṛtvā mātrā te saha putraka । tataḥ paramahṛṣṭātmā prāviśaṃ gṛhameva ca ॥46॥
html:
etadvratamahaṃ kṛtvā mātrā te saha putraka ।
tataḥ paramahṛṣṭātmā prāviśaṃ gṛhameva ca ॥46॥
slp1: etadvratamahaM kftvA mAtrA te saha putraka । tataH paramahfzwAtmA prAviSaM gfhameva ca ॥46॥

text: praviṣṭamātraśca gṛhe sarvaṃ paśyāmi tannavam । yadbhinnaṃ yacca vai dagdhaṃ tena vipreṇa putraka ॥47॥
html:
praviṣṭamātraśca gṛhe sarvaṃ paśyāmi tannavam ।
yadbhinnaṃ yacca vai dagdhaṃ tena vipreṇa putraka ॥47॥
slp1: pravizwamAtraSca gfhe sarvaM paSyAmi tannavam । yadBinnaM yacca vE dagDaM tena vipreRa putraka ॥47॥

text: tato'haṃ vismayaṃ prāptaḥ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā navaṃ dṛḍham । apūjayaṃ ca manasā raukmiṇeya dvijaṃ tadā ॥48॥
html:
tato'haṃ vismayaṃ prāptaḥ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā navaṃ dṛḍham ।
apūjayaṃ ca manasā raukmiṇeya dvijaṃ tadā ॥48॥
slp1: tato'haM vismayaM prAptaH sarvaM dfzwvA navaM dfQam । apUjayaM ca manasA rOkmiReya dvijaM tadA ॥48॥

text: ityahaṃ raukmiṇeyasya pṛcchato bharatarṣabha । māhātmyaṃ dvijamukhyasya sarvamākhyātavāṃstadā ॥49॥
html:
ityahaṃ raukmiṇeyasya pṛcchato bharatarṣabha ।
māhātmyaṃ dvijamukhyasya sarvamākhyātavāṃstadā ॥49॥
slp1: ityahaM rOkmiReyasya pfcCato BaratarzaBa । mAhAtmyaM dvijamuKyasya sarvamAKyAtavAMstadA ॥49॥

text: tathā tvamapi kaunteya brāhmaṇānsatataṃ prabho । pūjayasva mahābhāgānvāgbhirdānaiśca nityadā ॥50॥
html:
tathā tvamapi kaunteya brāhmaṇānsatataṃ prabho ।
pūjayasva mahābhāgānvāgbhirdānaiśca nityadā ॥50॥
slp1: taTA tvamapi kOnteya brAhmaRAnsatataM praBo । pUjayasva mahABAgAnvAgBirdAnESca nityadA ॥50॥

text: evaṃ vyuṣṭimahaṃ prāpto brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādajām । yacca māmāha bhīṣmo'yaṃ tatsatyaṃ bharatarṣabha] ॥51॥
html:
evaṃ vyuṣṭimahaṃ prāpto brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādajām ।
yacca māmāha bhīṣmo'yaṃ tatsatyaṃ bharatarṣabha] ॥51॥
slp1: evaM vyuzwimahaM prApto brAhmaRAnAM prasAdajAm । yacca mAmAha BIzmo'yaM tatsatyaM BaratarzaBa] ॥51॥

text: durvāsasaḥ prasādātte yattadā madhusūdana । avāptamiha vijñānaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
html:
durvāsasaḥ prasādātte yattadā madhusūdana ।
avāptamiha vijñānaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
slp1: durvAsasaH prasAdAtte yattadA maDusUdana । avAptamiha vijYAnaM tanme vyAKyAtumarhasi ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: mahābhāgyaṃ ca yattasya nāmāni ca mahātmanaḥ । tattvato jñātumicchāmi sarvaṃ matimatāṃ vara ॥2॥
html:
mahābhāgyaṃ ca yattasya nāmāni ca mahātmanaḥ ।
tattvato jñātumicchāmi sarvaṃ matimatāṃ vara ॥2॥
slp1: mahABAgyaM ca yattasya nAmAni ca mahAtmanaH । tattvato jYAtumicCAmi sarvaM matimatAM vara ॥2॥

text: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi namaskṛtvā kapardine । yadavāptaṃ mahārāja śreyo yaccārjitaṃ yaśaḥ ॥3॥
html:
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi namaskṛtvā kapardine ।
yadavāptaṃ mahārāja śreyo yaccārjitaṃ yaśaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: hanta te kaTayizyAmi namaskftvA kapardine । yadavAptaM mahArAja Sreyo yaccArjitaM yaSaH ॥3॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: prayataḥ prātarutthāya yadadhīye viśāṃ pate । prāñjaliḥ śatarudrīyaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥4॥
html:
prayataḥ prātarutthāya yadadhīye viśāṃ pate ।
prāñjaliḥ śatarudrīyaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ॥4॥
slp1: prayataH prAtarutTAya yadaDIye viSAM pate । prAYjaliH SatarudrIyaM tanme nigadataH SfRu ॥4॥

text: prajāpatistatsasṛje tapaso'nte mahātapāḥ । śaṅkarastvasṛjattāta prajāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ॥5॥
html:
prajāpatistatsasṛje tapaso'nte mahātapāḥ ।
śaṅkarastvasṛjattāta prajāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: prajApatistatsasfje tapaso'nte mahAtapAH । SaNkarastvasfjattAta prajAH sTAvarajaNgamAH ॥5॥

text: nāsti kiñcitparaṃ bhūtaṃ mahādevādviśāṃ pate । iha triṣvapi lokeṣu bhūtānāṃ prabhavo hi saḥ ॥6॥
html:
nāsti kiñcitparaṃ bhūtaṃ mahādevādviśāṃ pate ।
iha triṣvapi lokeṣu bhūtānāṃ prabhavo hi saḥ ॥6॥
slp1: nAsti kiYcitparaM BUtaM mahAdevAdviSAM pate । iha trizvapi lokezu BUtAnAM praBavo hi saH ॥6॥

text: na caivotsahate sthātuṃ kaścidagre mahātmanaḥ । na hi bhūtaṃ samaṃ tena triṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥7॥
html:
na caivotsahate sthātuṃ kaścidagre mahātmanaḥ ।
na hi bhūtaṃ samaṃ tena triṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥7॥
slp1: na cEvotsahate sTAtuM kaScidagre mahAtmanaH । na hi BUtaM samaM tena trizu lokezu vidyate ॥7॥

text: gandhenāpi hi saṅgrāme tasya kruddhasya śatravaḥ । visañjñā hatabhūyiṣṭhā vepanti ca patanti ca ॥8॥
html:
gandhenāpi hi saṅgrāme tasya kruddhasya śatravaḥ ।
visañjñā hatabhūyiṣṭhā vepanti ca patanti ca ॥8॥
slp1: ganDenApi hi saNgrAme tasya krudDasya SatravaH । visaYjYA hataBUyizWA vepanti ca patanti ca ॥8॥

text: ghoraṃ ca ninadaṃ tasya parjanyaninadopamam । śrutvā vidīryeddhṛdayaṃ devānāmapi saṃyuge ॥9॥
html:
ghoraṃ ca ninadaṃ tasya parjanyaninadopamam ।
śrutvā vidīryeddhṛdayaṃ devānāmapi saṃyuge ॥9॥
slp1: GoraM ca ninadaM tasya parjanyaninadopamam । SrutvA vidIryedDfdayaM devAnAmapi saMyuge ॥9॥

text: yāṃśca ghoreṇa rūpeṇa paśyetkruddhaḥ pinākadhṛk । na surā nāsurā loke na gandharvā na pannagāḥ । kupite sukhamedhante tasminnapi guhāgatāḥ ॥10॥
html:
yāṃśca ghoreṇa rūpeṇa paśyetkruddhaḥ pinākadhṛk ।
na surā nāsurā loke na gandharvā na pannagāḥ ।
kupite sukhamedhante tasminnapi guhāgatāḥ ॥10॥
slp1: yAMSca GoreRa rUpeRa paSyetkrudDaH pinAkaDfk । na surA nAsurA loke na ganDarvA na pannagAH । kupite suKameDante tasminnapi guhAgatAH ॥10॥

text: prajāpateśca dakṣasya yajato vitate kratau । vivyādha kupito yajñaṃ nirbhayastu bhavastadā । dhanuṣā bāṇamutsṛjya saghoṣaṃ vinanāda ca ॥11॥
html:
prajāpateśca dakṣasya yajato vitate kratau ।
vivyādha kupito yajñaṃ nirbhayastu bhavastadā ।
dhanuṣā bāṇamutsṛjya saghoṣaṃ vinanāda ca ॥11॥
slp1: prajApateSca dakzasya yajato vitate kratO । vivyADa kupito yajYaM nirBayastu BavastadA । DanuzA bARamutsfjya saGozaM vinanAda ca ॥11॥

text: te na śarma kutaḥ śāntiṃ viṣādaṃ lebhire surāḥ । vidrute sahasā yajñe kupite ca maheśvare ॥12॥
html:
te na śarma kutaḥ śāntiṃ viṣādaṃ lebhire surāḥ ।
vidrute sahasā yajñe kupite ca maheśvare ॥12॥
slp1: te na Sarma kutaH SAntiM vizAdaM leBire surAH । vidrute sahasA yajYe kupite ca maheSvare ॥12॥

text: tena jyātalaghoṣeṇa sarve lokāḥ samākulāḥ । babhūvuravaśāḥ pārtha viṣeduśca surāsurāḥ ॥13॥
html:
tena jyātalaghoṣeṇa sarve lokāḥ samākulāḥ ।
babhūvuravaśāḥ pārtha viṣeduśca surāsurāḥ ॥13॥
slp1: tena jyAtalaGozeRa sarve lokAH samAkulAH । baBUvuravaSAH pArTa vizeduSca surAsurAH ॥13॥

text: āpaścukṣubhire caiva cakampe ca vasundharā । vyadravangirayaścāpi dyauḥ paphāla ca sarvaśaḥ ॥14॥
html:
āpaścukṣubhire caiva cakampe ca vasundharā ।
vyadravangirayaścāpi dyauḥ paphāla ca sarvaśaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: ApaScukzuBire cEva cakampe ca vasunDarA । vyadravangirayaScApi dyOH paPAla ca sarvaSaH ॥14॥

text: andhena tamasā lokāḥ prāvṛtā na cakāśire । pranaṣṭā jyotiṣāṃ bhāśca saha sūryeṇa bhārata ॥15॥
html:
andhena tamasā lokāḥ prāvṛtā na cakāśire ।
pranaṣṭā jyotiṣāṃ bhāśca saha sūryeṇa bhārata ॥15॥
slp1: anDena tamasA lokAH prAvftA na cakASire । pranazwA jyotizAM BASca saha sUryeRa BArata ॥15॥

text: bhṛśaṃ bhītāstataḥ śāntiṃ cakruḥ svastyayanāni ca । ṛṣayaḥ sarvabhūtānāmātmanaśca hitaiṣiṇaḥ ॥16॥
html:
bhṛśaṃ bhītāstataḥ śāntiṃ cakruḥ svastyayanāni ca ।
ṛṣayaḥ sarvabhūtānāmātmanaśca hitaiṣiṇaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: BfSaM BItAstataH SAntiM cakruH svastyayanAni ca । fzayaH sarvaBUtAnAmAtmanaSca hitEziRaH ॥16॥

text: tataḥ so'bhyadravaddevānkruddho raudraparākramaḥ । bhagasya nayane kruddhaḥ prahāreṇa vyaśātayat ॥17॥
html:
tataḥ so'bhyadravaddevānkruddho raudraparākramaḥ ।
bhagasya nayane kruddhaḥ prahāreṇa vyaśātayat ॥17॥
slp1: tataH so'ByadravaddevAnkrudDo rOdraparAkramaH । Bagasya nayane krudDaH prahAreRa vyaSAtayat ॥17॥

text: pūṣāṇaṃ cābhidudrāva pareṇa vapuṣānvitaḥ । puroḍāśaṃ bhakṣayato daśanānvai vyaśātayat ॥18॥
html:
pūṣāṇaṃ cābhidudrāva pareṇa vapuṣānvitaḥ ।
puroḍāśaṃ bhakṣayato daśanānvai vyaśātayat ॥18॥
slp1: pUzARaM cABidudrAva pareRa vapuzAnvitaH । puroqASaM Bakzayato daSanAnvE vyaSAtayat ॥18॥

text: tataḥ praṇemurdevāste vepamānāḥ sma śaṅkaram । punaśca sandadhe rudro dīptaṃ suniśitaṃ śaram ॥19॥
html:
tataḥ praṇemurdevāste vepamānāḥ sma śaṅkaram ।
punaśca sandadhe rudro dīptaṃ suniśitaṃ śaram ॥19॥
slp1: tataH praRemurdevAste vepamAnAH sma SaNkaram । punaSca sandaDe rudro dIptaM suniSitaM Saram ॥19॥

text: rudrasya vikramaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ । tataḥ prasādayāmāsuḥ śarvaṃ te vibudhottamāḥ ॥20॥
html:
rudrasya vikramaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ।
tataḥ prasādayāmāsuḥ śarvaṃ te vibudhottamāḥ ॥20॥
slp1: rudrasya vikramaM dfzwvA BItA devAH saharziBiH । tataH prasAdayAmAsuH SarvaM te vibuDottamAH ॥20॥

text: jepuśca śatarudrīyaṃ devāḥ kṛtvāñjaliṃ tataḥ । saṃstūyamānastridaśaiḥ prasasāda maheśvaraḥ ॥21॥
html:
jepuśca śatarudrīyaṃ devāḥ kṛtvāñjaliṃ tataḥ ।
saṃstūyamānastridaśaiḥ prasasāda maheśvaraḥ ॥21॥
slp1: jepuSca SatarudrIyaM devAH kftvAYjaliM tataH । saMstUyamAnastridaSEH prasasAda maheSvaraH ॥21॥

text: rudrasya bhāgaṃ yajñe ca viśiṣṭaṃ te tvakalpayan । bhayena tridaśā rājañśaraṇaṃ ca prapedire ॥22॥
html:
rudrasya bhāgaṃ yajñe ca viśiṣṭaṃ te tvakalpayan ।
bhayena tridaśā rājañśaraṇaṃ ca prapedire ॥22॥
slp1: rudrasya BAgaM yajYe ca viSizwaM te tvakalpayan । Bayena tridaSA rAjaYSaraRaM ca prapedire ॥22॥

text: tena caivātikopena sa yajñaḥ sandhito'bhavat । yadyaccāpi hataṃ tatra tattathaiva pradīyate ॥23॥
html:
tena caivātikopena sa yajñaḥ sandhito'bhavat ।
yadyaccāpi hataṃ tatra tattathaiva pradīyate ॥23॥
slp1: tena cEvAtikopena sa yajYaH sanDito'Bavat । yadyaccApi hataM tatra tattaTEva pradIyate ॥23॥

text: asurāṇāṃ purāṇyāsaṃstrīṇi vīryavatāṃ divi । āyasaṃ rājataṃ caiva sauvarṇamaparaṃ tathā ॥24॥
html:
asurāṇāṃ purāṇyāsaṃstrīṇi vīryavatāṃ divi ।
āyasaṃ rājataṃ caiva sauvarṇamaparaṃ tathā ॥24॥
slp1: asurARAM purARyAsaMstrIRi vIryavatAM divi । AyasaM rAjataM cEva sOvarRamaparaM taTA ॥24॥

text: nāśakattāni maghavā bhettuṃ sarvāyudhairapi । atha sarve'marā rudraṃ jagmuḥ śaraṇamarditāḥ ॥25॥
html:
nāśakattāni maghavā bhettuṃ sarvāyudhairapi ।
atha sarve'marā rudraṃ jagmuḥ śaraṇamarditāḥ ॥25॥
slp1: nASakattAni maGavA BettuM sarvAyuDErapi । aTa sarve'marA rudraM jagmuH SaraRamarditAH ॥25॥

text: tata ūcurmahātmāno devāḥ sarve samāgatāḥ । rudra raudrā bhaviṣyanti paśavaḥ sarvakarmasu । jahi daityānsaha purairlokāṃstrāyasva mānada ॥26॥
html:
tata ūcurmahātmāno devāḥ sarve samāgatāḥ ।
rudra raudrā bhaviṣyanti paśavaḥ sarvakarmasu ।
jahi daityānsaha purairlokāṃstrāyasva mānada ॥26॥
slp1: tata UcurmahAtmAno devAH sarve samAgatAH । rudra rOdrA Bavizyanti paSavaH sarvakarmasu । jahi dEtyAnsaha purErlokAMstrAyasva mAnada ॥26॥

text: sa tathoktastathetyuktvā viṣṇuṃ kṛtvā śarottamam । śalyamagniṃ tathā kṛtvā puṅkhaṃ vaivasvataṃ yamam । vedānkṛtvā dhanuḥ sarvāñjyāṃ ca sāvitrimuttamām ॥27॥
html:
sa tathoktastathetyuktvā viṣṇuṃ kṛtvā śarottamam ।
śalyamagniṃ tathā kṛtvā puṅkhaṃ vaivasvataṃ yamam ।
vedānkṛtvā dhanuḥ sarvāñjyāṃ ca sāvitrimuttamām ॥27॥
slp1: sa taToktastaTetyuktvA vizRuM kftvA Sarottamam । SalyamagniM taTA kftvA puNKaM vEvasvataM yamam । vedAnkftvA DanuH sarvAYjyAM ca sAvitrimuttamAm ॥27॥

text: devānrathavaraṃ kṛtvā viniyujya ca sarvaśaḥ । triparvaṇā triśalyena tena tāni bibheda saḥ ॥28॥
html:
devānrathavaraṃ kṛtvā viniyujya ca sarvaśaḥ ।
triparvaṇā triśalyena tena tāni bibheda saḥ ॥28॥
slp1: devAnraTavaraM kftvA viniyujya ca sarvaSaH । triparvaRA triSalyena tena tAni biBeda saH ॥28॥

text: śareṇādityavarṇena kālāgnisamatejasā । te'surāḥ sapurāstatra dagdhā rudreṇa bhārata ॥29॥
html:
śareṇādityavarṇena kālāgnisamatejasā ।
te'surāḥ sapurāstatra dagdhā rudreṇa bhārata ॥29॥
slp1: SareRAdityavarRena kAlAgnisamatejasA । te'surAH sapurAstatra dagDA rudreRa BArata ॥29॥

text: taṃ caivāṅkagataṃ dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ pañcaśikhaṃ punaḥ । umā jijñāsamānā vai ko'yamityabravīttadā ॥30॥
html:
taṃ caivāṅkagataṃ dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ pañcaśikhaṃ punaḥ ।
umā jijñāsamānā vai ko'yamityabravīttadā ॥30॥
slp1: taM cEvANkagataM dfzwvA bAlaM paYcaSiKaM punaH । umA jijYAsamAnA vE ko'yamityabravIttadA ॥30॥

text: asūyataśca śakrasya vajreṇa prahariṣyataḥ । savajraṃ stambhayāmāsa taṃ bāhuṃ parighopamam ॥31॥
html:
asūyataśca śakrasya vajreṇa prahariṣyataḥ ।
savajraṃ stambhayāmāsa taṃ bāhuṃ parighopamam ॥31॥
slp1: asUyataSca Sakrasya vajreRa praharizyataH । savajraM stamBayAmAsa taM bAhuM pariGopamam ॥31॥

text: na sambubudhire cainaṃ devāstaṃ bhuvaneśvaram । saprajāpatayaḥ sarve tasminmumuhurīśvare ॥32॥
html:
na sambubudhire cainaṃ devāstaṃ bhuvaneśvaram ।
saprajāpatayaḥ sarve tasminmumuhurīśvare ॥32॥
slp1: na sambubuDire cEnaM devAstaM BuvaneSvaram । saprajApatayaH sarve tasminmumuhurISvare ॥32॥

text: tato dhyātvātha bhagavānbrahmā tamamitaujasam । ayaṃ śreṣṭha iti jñātvā vavande tamumāpatim ॥33॥
html:
tato dhyātvātha bhagavānbrahmā tamamitaujasam ।
ayaṃ śreṣṭha iti jñātvā vavande tamumāpatim ॥33॥
slp1: tato DyAtvATa BagavAnbrahmA tamamitOjasam । ayaM SrezWa iti jYAtvA vavande tamumApatim ॥33॥

text: tataḥ prasādayāmāsurumāṃ rudraṃ ca te surāḥ । babhūva sa tadā bāhurbalahanturyathā purā ॥34॥
html:
tataḥ prasādayāmāsurumāṃ rudraṃ ca te surāḥ ।
babhūva sa tadā bāhurbalahanturyathā purā ॥34॥
slp1: tataH prasAdayAmAsurumAM rudraM ca te surAH । baBUva sa tadA bAhurbalahanturyaTA purA ॥34॥

text: sa cāpi brāhmaṇo bhūtvā durvāsā nāma vīryavān । dvāravatyāṃ mama gṛhe ciraṃ kālamupāvasat ॥35॥
html:
sa cāpi brāhmaṇo bhūtvā durvāsā nāma vīryavān ।
dvāravatyāṃ mama gṛhe ciraṃ kālamupāvasat ॥35॥
slp1: sa cApi brAhmaRo BUtvA durvAsA nAma vIryavAn । dvAravatyAM mama gfhe ciraM kAlamupAvasat ॥35॥

text: viprakārānprayuṅkte sma subahūnmama veśmani । tānudāratayā cāhamakṣamaṃ tasya duḥsaham ॥36॥
html:
viprakārānprayuṅkte sma subahūnmama veśmani ।
tānudāratayā cāhamakṣamaṃ tasya duḥsaham ॥36॥
slp1: viprakArAnprayuNkte sma subahUnmama veSmani । tAnudAratayA cAhamakzamaM tasya duHsaham ॥36॥

text: sa devendraśca vāyuśca so'śvinau sa ca vidyutaḥ । sa candramāḥ sa ceśānaḥ sa sūryo varuṇaśca saḥ ॥37॥
html:
sa devendraśca vāyuśca so'śvinau sa ca vidyutaḥ ।
sa candramāḥ sa ceśānaḥ sa sūryo varuṇaśca saḥ ॥37॥
slp1: sa devendraSca vAyuSca so'SvinO sa ca vidyutaH । sa candramAH sa ceSAnaH sa sUryo varuRaSca saH ॥37॥

text: sa kālaḥ so'ntako mṛtyuḥ sa tamo rātryahāni ca । māsārdhamāsā ṛtavaḥ sandhye saṃvatsaraśca saḥ ॥38॥
html:
sa kālaḥ so'ntako mṛtyuḥ sa tamo rātryahāni ca ।
māsārdhamāsā ṛtavaḥ sandhye saṃvatsaraśca saḥ ॥38॥
slp1: sa kAlaH so'ntako mftyuH sa tamo rAtryahAni ca । mAsArDamAsA ftavaH sanDye saMvatsaraSca saH ॥38॥

text: sa dhātā sa vidhātā ca viśvakarmā sa sarvavit । nakṣatrāṇi diśaścaiva pradiśo'tha grahāstathā । viśvamūrtirameyātmā bhagavānamitadyutiḥ ॥39॥
html:
sa dhātā sa vidhātā ca viśvakarmā sa sarvavit ।
nakṣatrāṇi diśaścaiva pradiśo'tha grahāstathā ।
viśvamūrtirameyātmā bhagavānamitadyutiḥ ॥39॥
slp1: sa DAtA sa viDAtA ca viSvakarmA sa sarvavit । nakzatrARi diSaScEva pradiSo'Ta grahAstaTA । viSvamUrtirameyAtmA BagavAnamitadyutiH ॥39॥

text: ekadhā ca dvidhā caiva bahudhā ca sa eva ca । śatadhā sahasradhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā ॥40॥
html:
ekadhā ca dvidhā caiva bahudhā ca sa eva ca ।
śatadhā sahasradhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā ॥40॥
slp1: ekaDA ca dviDA cEva bahuDA ca sa eva ca । SataDA sahasraDA cEva taTA SatasahasraDA ॥40॥

text: īdṛśaḥ sa mahādevo bhūyaśca bhagavānataḥ । na hi śakyā guṇā vaktumapi varṣaśatairapi] ॥41॥
html:
īdṛśaḥ sa mahādevo bhūyaśca bhagavānataḥ ।
na hi śakyā guṇā vaktumapi varṣaśatairapi] ॥41॥
slp1: IdfSaH sa mahAdevo BUyaSca BagavAnataH । na hi SakyA guRA vaktumapi varzaSatErapi] ॥41॥

text: yudhiṣṭhira mahābāho mahābhāgyaṃ mahātmanaḥ । rudrāya bahurūpāya bahunāmne nibodha me ॥1॥
html:
yudhiṣṭhira mahābāho mahābhāgyaṃ mahātmanaḥ ।
rudrāya bahurūpāya bahunāmne nibodha me ॥1॥
slp1: yuDizWira mahAbAho mahABAgyaM mahAtmanaH । rudrAya bahurUpAya bahunAmne niboDa me ॥1॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: vadantyagniṃ mahādevaṃ tathā sthāṇuṃ maheśvaram । ekākṣaṃ tryambakaṃ caiva viśvarūpaṃ śivaṃ tathā ॥2॥
html:
vadantyagniṃ mahādevaṃ tathā sthāṇuṃ maheśvaram ।
ekākṣaṃ tryambakaṃ caiva viśvarūpaṃ śivaṃ tathā ॥2॥
slp1: vadantyagniM mahAdevaM taTA sTARuM maheSvaram । ekAkzaM tryambakaM cEva viSvarUpaM SivaM taTA ॥2॥

text: dve tanū tasya devasya vedajñā brāhmaṇā viduḥ । ghorāmanyāṃ śivāmanyāṃ te tanū bahudhā punaḥ ॥3॥
html:
dve tanū tasya devasya vedajñā brāhmaṇā viduḥ ।
ghorāmanyāṃ śivāmanyāṃ te tanū bahudhā punaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: dve tanU tasya devasya vedajYA brAhmaRA viduH । GorAmanyAM SivAmanyAM te tanU bahuDA punaH ॥3॥

text: ugrā ghorā tanūryāsya so'gnirvidyutsa bhāskaraḥ । śivā saumyā ca yā tasya dharmastvāpo'tha candramāḥ ॥4॥
html:
ugrā ghorā tanūryāsya so'gnirvidyutsa bhāskaraḥ ।
śivā saumyā ca yā tasya dharmastvāpo'tha candramāḥ ॥4॥
slp1: ugrA GorA tanUryAsya so'gnirvidyutsa BAskaraH । SivA sOmyA ca yA tasya DarmastvApo'Ta candramAH ॥4॥

text: ātmano'rdhaṃ tu tasyāgnirucyate bharatarṣabha । brahmacaryaṃ caratyeṣa śivā yāsya tanustathā ॥5॥
html:
ātmano'rdhaṃ tu tasyāgnirucyate bharatarṣabha ।
brahmacaryaṃ caratyeṣa śivā yāsya tanustathā ॥5॥
slp1: Atmano'rDaM tu tasyAgnirucyate BaratarzaBa । brahmacaryaM caratyeza SivA yAsya tanustaTA ॥5॥

text: yāsya ghoratamā mūrtirjagatsaṃharate tayā । īśvaratvānmahattvācca maheśvara iti smṛtaḥ ॥6॥
html:
yāsya ghoratamā mūrtirjagatsaṃharate tayā ।
īśvaratvānmahattvācca maheśvara iti smṛtaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: yAsya GoratamA mUrtirjagatsaMharate tayA । ISvaratvAnmahattvAcca maheSvara iti smftaH ॥6॥

text: yannirdahati yattīkṣṇo yadugro yatpratāpavān । māṃsaśoṇitamajjādo yattato rudra ucyate ॥7॥
html:
yannirdahati yattīkṣṇo yadugro yatpratāpavān ।
māṃsaśoṇitamajjādo yattato rudra ucyate ॥7॥
slp1: yannirdahati yattIkzRo yadugro yatpratApavAn । mAMsaSoRitamajjAdo yattato rudra ucyate ॥7॥

text: devānāṃ sumahānyacca yaccāsya viṣayo mahān । yacca viśvaṃ mahatpāti mahādevastataḥ smṛtaḥ ॥8॥
html:
devānāṃ sumahānyacca yaccāsya viṣayo mahān ।
yacca viśvaṃ mahatpāti mahādevastataḥ smṛtaḥ ॥8॥
slp1: devAnAM sumahAnyacca yaccAsya vizayo mahAn । yacca viSvaM mahatpAti mahAdevastataH smftaH ॥8॥

text: samedhayati yannityaṃ sarvārthānsarvakarmabhiḥ । śivamicchanmanuṣyāṇāṃ tasmādeṣa śivaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥9॥
html:
samedhayati yannityaṃ sarvārthānsarvakarmabhiḥ ।
śivamicchanmanuṣyāṇāṃ tasmādeṣa śivaḥ smṛtaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: sameDayati yannityaM sarvArTAnsarvakarmaBiH । SivamicCanmanuzyARAM tasmAdeza SivaH smftaH ॥9॥

text: dahatyūrdhvaṃ sthito yacca prāṇotpattiḥ sthitiśca yat । sthiraliṅgaśca yannityaṃ tasmātsthāṇuriti smṛtaḥ ॥10॥
html:
dahatyūrdhvaṃ sthito yacca prāṇotpattiḥ sthitiśca yat ।
sthiraliṅgaśca yannityaṃ tasmātsthāṇuriti smṛtaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: dahatyUrDvaM sTito yacca prARotpattiH sTitiSca yat । sTiraliNgaSca yannityaM tasmAtsTARuriti smftaH ॥10॥

text: yadasya bahudhā rūpaṃ bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavattathā । sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva bahurūpastataḥ smṛtaḥ ॥11॥
html:
yadasya bahudhā rūpaṃ bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavattathā ।
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva bahurūpastataḥ smṛtaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: yadasya bahuDA rUpaM BUtaM BavyaM BavattaTA । sTAvaraM jaNgamaM cEva bahurUpastataH smftaH ॥11॥

text: dhūmraṃ rūpaṃ ca yattasya dhūrjaṭītyata ucyate । viśve devāśca yattasminviśvarūpastataḥ smṛtaḥ ॥12॥
html:
dhūmraṃ rūpaṃ ca yattasya dhūrjaṭītyata ucyate ।
viśve devāśca yattasminviśvarūpastataḥ smṛtaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: DUmraM rUpaM ca yattasya DUrjawItyata ucyate । viSve devASca yattasminviSvarUpastataH smftaH ॥12॥

text: sahasrākṣo'yutākṣo vā sarvatokṣimayo'pi vā । cakṣuṣaḥ prabhavastejo nāstyanto'thāsya cakṣuṣām ॥13॥
html:
sahasrākṣo'yutākṣo vā sarvatokṣimayo'pi vā ।
cakṣuṣaḥ prabhavastejo nāstyanto'thāsya cakṣuṣām ॥13॥
slp1: sahasrAkzo'yutAkzo vA sarvatokzimayo'pi vA । cakzuzaH praBavastejo nAstyanto'TAsya cakzuzAm ॥13॥

text: sarvathā yatpaśūnpāti taiśca yadramate punaḥ । teṣāmadhipatiryacca tasmātpaśupatiḥ smṛtaḥ ॥14॥
html:
sarvathā yatpaśūnpāti taiśca yadramate punaḥ ।
teṣāmadhipatiryacca tasmātpaśupatiḥ smṛtaḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sarvaTA yatpaSUnpAti tESca yadramate punaH । tezAmaDipatiryacca tasmAtpaSupatiH smftaH ॥14॥

text: nityena brahmacaryeṇa liṅgamasya yadā sthitam । mahayantyasya lokāśca maheśvara iti smṛtaḥ ॥15॥
html:
nityena brahmacaryeṇa liṅgamasya yadā sthitam ।
mahayantyasya lokāśca maheśvara iti smṛtaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: nityena brahmacaryeRa liNgamasya yadA sTitam । mahayantyasya lokASca maheSvara iti smftaH ॥15॥

text: vigrahaṃ pūjayedyo vai liṅgaṃ vāpi mahātmanaḥ । liṅgaṃ pūjayitā nityaṃ mahatīṃ śriyamaśnute ॥16॥
html:
vigrahaṃ pūjayedyo vai liṅgaṃ vāpi mahātmanaḥ ।
liṅgaṃ pūjayitā nityaṃ mahatīṃ śriyamaśnute ॥16॥
slp1: vigrahaM pUjayedyo vE liNgaM vApi mahAtmanaH । liNgaM pUjayitA nityaM mahatIM SriyamaSnute ॥16॥

text: ṛṣayaścāpi devāśca gandharvāpsarasastathā । liṅgamevārcayanti sma yattadūrdhvaṃ samāsthitam ॥17॥
html:
ṛṣayaścāpi devāśca gandharvāpsarasastathā ।
liṅgamevārcayanti sma yattadūrdhvaṃ samāsthitam ॥17॥
slp1: fzayaScApi devASca ganDarvApsarasastaTA । liNgamevArcayanti sma yattadUrDvaM samAsTitam ॥17॥

text: pūjyamāne tatastasminmodate sa maheśvaraḥ । sukhaṃ dadāti prītātmā bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ॥18॥
html:
pūjyamāne tatastasminmodate sa maheśvaraḥ ।
sukhaṃ dadāti prītātmā bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ॥18॥
slp1: pUjyamAne tatastasminmodate sa maheSvaraH । suKaM dadAti prItAtmA BaktAnAM BaktavatsalaH ॥18॥

text: eṣa eva śmaśāneṣu devo vasati nityaśaḥ । yajante taṃ janāstatra vīrasthānaniṣeviṇam ॥19॥
html:
eṣa eva śmaśāneṣu devo vasati nityaśaḥ ।
yajante taṃ janāstatra vīrasthānaniṣeviṇam ॥19॥
slp1: eza eva SmaSAnezu devo vasati nityaSaH । yajante taM janAstatra vIrasTAnanizeviRam ॥19॥

text: viṣamasthaḥ śarīreṣu sa mṛtyuḥ prāṇināmiha । sa ca vāyuḥ śarīreṣu prāṇo'pānaḥ śarīriṇām ॥20॥
html:
viṣamasthaḥ śarīreṣu sa mṛtyuḥ prāṇināmiha ।
sa ca vāyuḥ śarīreṣu prāṇo'pānaḥ śarīriṇām ॥20॥
slp1: vizamasTaH SarIrezu sa mftyuH prARinAmiha । sa ca vAyuH SarIrezu prARo'pAnaH SarIriRAm ॥20॥

text: tasya ghorāṇi rūpāṇi dīptāni ca bahūni ca । loke yānyasya pūjyante viprāstāni vidurbudhāḥ ॥21॥
html:
tasya ghorāṇi rūpāṇi dīptāni ca bahūni ca ।
loke yānyasya pūjyante viprāstāni vidurbudhāḥ ॥21॥
slp1: tasya GorARi rUpARi dIptAni ca bahUni ca । loke yAnyasya pUjyante viprAstAni vidurbuDAH ॥21॥

text: nāmadheyāni vedeṣu bahūnyasya yathārthataḥ । nirucyante mahattvācca vibhutvātkarmabhistathā ॥22॥
html:
nāmadheyāni vedeṣu bahūnyasya yathārthataḥ ।
nirucyante mahattvācca vibhutvātkarmabhistathā ॥22॥
slp1: nAmaDeyAni vedezu bahUnyasya yaTArTataH । nirucyante mahattvAcca viButvAtkarmaBistaTA ॥22॥

text: vede cāsya vidurviprāḥ śatarudrīyamuttamam । vyāsādanantaraṃ yaccāpyupasthānaṃ mahātmanaḥ ॥23॥
html:
vede cāsya vidurviprāḥ śatarudrīyamuttamam ।
vyāsādanantaraṃ yaccāpyupasthānaṃ mahātmanaḥ ॥23॥
slp1: vede cAsya vidurviprAH SatarudrIyamuttamam । vyAsAdanantaraM yaccApyupasTAnaM mahAtmanaH ॥23॥

text: pradātā sarvalokānāṃ viśvaṃ cāpyucyate mahat । jyeṣṭhabhūtaṃ vadantyenaṃ brāhmaṇā ṛṣayo'pare ॥24॥
html:
pradātā sarvalokānāṃ viśvaṃ cāpyucyate mahat ।
jyeṣṭhabhūtaṃ vadantyenaṃ brāhmaṇā ṛṣayo'pare ॥24॥
slp1: pradAtA sarvalokAnAM viSvaM cApyucyate mahat । jyezWaBUtaM vadantyenaM brAhmaRA fzayo'pare ॥24॥

text: prathamo hyeṣa devānāṃ mukhādagnirajāyata । grahairbahuvidhaiḥ prāṇānsaṃruddhānutsṛjatyapi ॥25॥
html:
prathamo hyeṣa devānāṃ mukhādagnirajāyata ।
grahairbahuvidhaiḥ prāṇānsaṃruddhānutsṛjatyapi ॥25॥
slp1: praTamo hyeza devAnAM muKAdagnirajAyata । grahErbahuviDEH prARAnsaMrudDAnutsfjatyapi ॥25॥

text: sa mocayati puṇyātmā śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatān । āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ vittaṃ kāmāṃśca puṣkalān ॥26॥
html:
sa mocayati puṇyātmā śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatān ।
āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ vittaṃ kāmāṃśca puṣkalān ॥26॥
slp1: sa mocayati puRyAtmA SaraRyaH SaraRAgatAn । AyurArogyamESvaryaM vittaM kAmAMSca puzkalAn ॥26॥

text: sa dadāti manuṣyebhyaḥ sa evākṣipate punaḥ । śakrādiṣu ca deveṣu tasya caiśvaryamucyate ॥27॥
html:
sa dadāti manuṣyebhyaḥ sa evākṣipate punaḥ ।
śakrādiṣu ca deveṣu tasya caiśvaryamucyate ॥27॥
slp1: sa dadAti manuzyeByaH sa evAkzipate punaH । SakrAdizu ca devezu tasya cESvaryamucyate ॥27॥

text: sa evābhyadhiko nityaṃ trailokyasya śubhāśubhe । aiśvaryāccaiva kāmānāmīśvaraḥ punarucyate ॥28॥
html:
sa evābhyadhiko nityaṃ trailokyasya śubhāśubhe ।
aiśvaryāccaiva kāmānāmīśvaraḥ punarucyate ॥28॥
slp1: sa evAByaDiko nityaM trElokyasya SuBASuBe । ESvaryAccEva kAmAnAmISvaraH punarucyate ॥28॥

text: maheśvaraśca lokānāṃ mahatāmīśvaraśca saḥ । bahubhirvividhai rūpairviśvaṃ vyāptamidaṃ jagat । tasya devasya yadvaktraṃ samudre vaḍavāmukham] ॥29॥
html:
maheśvaraśca lokānāṃ mahatāmīśvaraśca saḥ ।
bahubhirvividhai rūpairviśvaṃ vyāptamidaṃ jagat ।
tasya devasya yadvaktraṃ samudre vaḍavāmukham] ॥29॥
slp1: maheSvaraSca lokAnAM mahatAmISvaraSca saH । bahuBirviviDE rUpErviSvaM vyAptamidaM jagat । tasya devasya yadvaktraM samudre vaqavAmuKam] ॥29॥

text: ityuktavati vākyaṃ tu kṛṣṇe devakinandane । bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ bhūyaḥ paryapṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥1॥
html:
ityuktavati vākyaṃ tu kṛṣṇe devakinandane ।
bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ bhūyaḥ paryapṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥1॥
slp1: ityuktavati vAkyaM tu kfzRe devakinandane । BIzmaM SAntanavaM BUyaH paryapfcCadyuDizWiraH ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: nirṇaye vā mahābuddhe sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara । pratyakṣamāgamo veti kiṃ tayoḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavet ॥2॥
html:
nirṇaye vā mahābuddhe sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara ।
pratyakṣamāgamo veti kiṃ tayoḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavet ॥2॥
slp1: nirRaye vA mahAbudDe sarvaDarmaBftAM vara । pratyakzamAgamo veti kiM tayoH kAraRaM Bavet ॥2॥

text: nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ kaściditi me vartate matiḥ । śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te prājña samyaktvamanupṛcchasi ॥3॥
html:
nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ kaściditi me vartate matiḥ ।
śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te prājña samyaktvamanupṛcchasi ॥3॥
slp1: nAstyatra saMSayaH kaSciditi me vartate matiH । SfRu vakzyAmi te prAjYa samyaktvamanupfcCasi ॥3॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: saṃśayaḥ sugamo rājannirṇayastvatra durgamaḥ । dṛṣṭaṃ śrutamanantaṃ hi yatra saṃśayadarśanam ॥4॥
html:
saṃśayaḥ sugamo rājannirṇayastvatra durgamaḥ ।
dṛṣṭaṃ śrutamanantaṃ hi yatra saṃśayadarśanam ॥4॥
slp1: saMSayaH sugamo rAjannirRayastvatra durgamaH । dfzwaM SrutamanantaM hi yatra saMSayadarSanam ॥4॥

text: pratyakṣaṃ kāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ hetukāḥ prājñamāninaḥ । nāstītyevaṃ vyavasyanti satyaṃ saṃśayameva ca । tadayuktaṃ vyavasyanti bālāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ ॥5॥
html:
pratyakṣaṃ kāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ hetukāḥ prājñamāninaḥ ।
nāstītyevaṃ vyavasyanti satyaṃ saṃśayameva ca ।
tadayuktaṃ vyavasyanti bālāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: pratyakzaM kAraRaM dfzwaM hetukAH prAjYamAninaH । nAstItyevaM vyavasyanti satyaM saMSayameva ca । tadayuktaM vyavasyanti bAlAH paRqitamAninaH ॥5॥

text: atha cenmanyase caikaṃ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ bhavediti । śakyaṃ dīrgheṇa kālena yuktenātandritena ca । prāṇayātrāmanekāṃ ca kalpayānena bhārata ॥6॥
html:
atha cenmanyase caikaṃ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ bhavediti ।
śakyaṃ dīrgheṇa kālena yuktenātandritena ca ।
prāṇayātrāmanekāṃ ca kalpayānena bhārata ॥6॥
slp1: aTa cenmanyase cEkaM kAraRaM kiM Bavediti । SakyaM dIrGeRa kAlena yuktenAtandritena ca । prARayAtrAmanekAM ca kalpayAnena BArata ॥6॥

text: tatpareṇaiva nānyena śakyaṃ hyetattu kāraṇam । hetūnāmantamāsādya vipulaṃ jñānamuttamam । jyotiḥ sarvasya lokasya vipulaṃ pratipadyate ॥7॥
html:
tatpareṇaiva nānyena śakyaṃ hyetattu kāraṇam ।
hetūnāmantamāsādya vipulaṃ jñānamuttamam ।
jyotiḥ sarvasya lokasya vipulaṃ pratipadyate ॥7॥
slp1: tatpareREva nAnyena SakyaM hyetattu kAraRam । hetUnAmantamAsAdya vipulaM jYAnamuttamam । jyotiH sarvasya lokasya vipulaM pratipadyate ॥7॥

text: tattvenāgamanaṃ rājanhetvantagamanaṃ tathā । agrāhyamanibaddhaṃ ca vācaḥ samparivarjanam ॥8॥
html:
tattvenāgamanaṃ rājanhetvantagamanaṃ tathā ।
agrāhyamanibaddhaṃ ca vācaḥ samparivarjanam ॥8॥
slp1: tattvenAgamanaM rAjanhetvantagamanaM taTA । agrAhyamanibadDaM ca vAcaH samparivarjanam ॥8॥

text: pratyakṣaṃ lokataḥ siddhaṃ lokāścāgamapūrvakāḥ । śiṣṭācāro bahuvidho brūhi tanme pitāmaha ॥9॥
html:
pratyakṣaṃ lokataḥ siddhaṃ lokāścāgamapūrvakāḥ ।
śiṣṭācāro bahuvidho brūhi tanme pitāmaha ॥9॥
slp1: pratyakzaM lokataH sidDaM lokAScAgamapUrvakAH । SizwAcAro bahuviDo brUhi tanme pitAmaha ॥9॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: dharmasya hriyamāṇasya balavadbhirdurātmabhiḥ । saṃsthā yatnairapi kṛtā kālena paribhidyate ॥10॥
html:
dharmasya hriyamāṇasya balavadbhirdurātmabhiḥ ।
saṃsthā yatnairapi kṛtā kālena paribhidyate ॥10॥
slp1: Darmasya hriyamARasya balavadBirdurAtmaBiH । saMsTA yatnErapi kftA kAlena pariBidyate ॥10॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: adharmā dharmarūpeṇa tṛṇaiḥ kūpā ivāvṛtāḥ । tatastairbhidyate vṛttaṃ śṛṇu caiva yudhiṣṭhira ॥11॥
html:
adharmā dharmarūpeṇa tṛṇaiḥ kūpā ivāvṛtāḥ ।
tatastairbhidyate vṛttaṃ śṛṇu caiva yudhiṣṭhira ॥11॥
slp1: aDarmA DarmarUpeRa tfREH kUpA ivAvftAH । tatastErBidyate vfttaM SfRu cEva yuDizWira ॥11॥

text: avṛttyā ye ca bhindanti śrutatyāgaparāyaṇāḥ । dharmavidveṣiṇo mandā ityuktasteṣu saṃśayaḥ ॥12॥
html:
avṛttyā ye ca bhindanti śrutatyāgaparāyaṇāḥ ।
dharmavidveṣiṇo mandā ityuktasteṣu saṃśayaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: avfttyA ye ca Bindanti SrutatyAgaparAyaRAH । DarmavidveziRo mandA ityuktastezu saMSayaH ॥12॥

text: atṛpyantastu sādhūnāṃ ya evāgamabuddhayaḥ । paramityeva santuṣṭāstānupāssva ca pṛccha ca ॥13॥
html:
atṛpyantastu sādhūnāṃ ya evāgamabuddhayaḥ ।
paramityeva santuṣṭāstānupāssva ca pṛccha ca ॥13॥
slp1: atfpyantastu sADUnAM ya evAgamabudDayaH । paramityeva santuzwAstAnupAssva ca pfcCa ca ॥13॥

text: kāmārthau pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā lobhamohānusāriṇau । dharma ityeva sambuddhāstānupāssva ca pṛccha ca ॥14॥
html:
kāmārthau pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā lobhamohānusāriṇau ।
dharma ityeva sambuddhāstānupāssva ca pṛccha ca ॥14॥
slp1: kAmArTO pfzWataH kftvA loBamohAnusAriRO । Darma ityeva sambudDAstAnupAssva ca pfcCa ca ॥14॥

text: na teṣāṃ bhidyate vṛttaṃ yajñasvādhyāyakarmabhiḥ । ācāraḥ kāraṇaṃ caiva dharmaścaiva trayaṃ punaḥ ॥15॥
html:
na teṣāṃ bhidyate vṛttaṃ yajñasvādhyāyakarmabhiḥ ।
ācāraḥ kāraṇaṃ caiva dharmaścaiva trayaṃ punaḥ ॥15॥
slp1: na tezAM Bidyate vfttaM yajYasvADyAyakarmaBiH । AcAraH kAraRaM cEva DarmaScEva trayaM punaH ॥15॥

text: punareveha me buddhiḥ saṃśaye parimuhyate । apāre mārgamāṇasya paraṃ tīramapaśyataḥ ॥16॥
html:
punareveha me buddhiḥ saṃśaye parimuhyate ।
apāre mārgamāṇasya paraṃ tīramapaśyataḥ ॥16॥
slp1: punareveha me budDiH saMSaye parimuhyate । apAre mArgamARasya paraM tIramapaSyataH ॥16॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: vedāḥ pratyakṣamācāraḥ pramāṇaṃ tattrayaṃ yadi । pṛthaktvaṃ labhyate caiṣāṃ dharmaścaikastrayaṃ katham ॥17॥
html:
vedāḥ pratyakṣamācāraḥ pramāṇaṃ tattrayaṃ yadi ।
pṛthaktvaṃ labhyate caiṣāṃ dharmaścaikastrayaṃ katham ॥17॥
slp1: vedAH pratyakzamAcAraH pramARaM tattrayaM yadi । pfTaktvaM laByate cEzAM DarmaScEkastrayaM kaTam ॥17॥

text: dharmasya hriyamāṇasya balavadbhirdurātmabhiḥ । yadyevaṃ manyase rājaṃstridhā dharmavicāraṇā ॥18॥
html:
dharmasya hriyamāṇasya balavadbhirdurātmabhiḥ ।
yadyevaṃ manyase rājaṃstridhā dharmavicāraṇā ॥18॥
slp1: Darmasya hriyamARasya balavadBirdurAtmaBiH । yadyevaM manyase rAjaMstriDA DarmavicAraRA ॥18॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: eka eveti jānīhi tridhā tasya pradarśanam । pṛthaktve caiva me buddhistrayāṇāmapi vai tathā ॥19॥
html:
eka eveti jānīhi tridhā tasya pradarśanam ।
pṛthaktve caiva me buddhistrayāṇāmapi vai tathā ॥19॥
slp1: eka eveti jAnIhi triDA tasya pradarSanam । pfTaktve cEva me budDistrayARAmapi vE taTA ॥19॥

text: ukto mārgastrayāṇāṃ ca tattathaiva samācara । jijñāsā tu na kartavyā dharmasya paritarkaṇāt ॥20॥
html:
ukto mārgastrayāṇāṃ ca tattathaiva samācara ।
jijñāsā tu na kartavyā dharmasya paritarkaṇāt ॥20॥
slp1: ukto mArgastrayARAM ca tattaTEva samAcara । jijYAsA tu na kartavyA Darmasya paritarkaRAt ॥20॥

text: sadaiva bharataśreṣṭha mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ । andho jaḍa ivāśaṅko yadbravīmi tadācara ॥21॥
html:
sadaiva bharataśreṣṭha mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ ।
andho jaḍa ivāśaṅko yadbravīmi tadācara ॥21॥
slp1: sadEva BarataSrezWa mA te BUdatra saMSayaH । anDo jaqa ivASaNko yadbravImi tadAcara ॥21॥

text: ahiṃsā satyamakrodho dānametaccatuṣṭayam । ajātaśatro sevasva dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ॥22॥
html:
ahiṃsā satyamakrodho dānametaccatuṣṭayam ।
ajātaśatro sevasva dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ॥22॥
slp1: ahiMsA satyamakroDo dAnametaccatuzwayam । ajAtaSatro sevasva Darma eza sanAtanaH ॥22॥

text: brāhmaṇeṣu ca vṛttiryā pitṛpaitāmahocitā । tāmanvehi mahābāho svargasyaite hi deśikāḥ ॥23॥
html:
brāhmaṇeṣu ca vṛttiryā pitṛpaitāmahocitā ।
tāmanvehi mahābāho svargasyaite hi deśikāḥ ॥23॥
slp1: brAhmaRezu ca vfttiryA pitfpEtAmahocitA । tAmanvehi mahAbAho svargasyEte hi deSikAH ॥23॥

text: pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ vai yaḥ kuryādabudho naraḥ । na sa pramāṇatāmarho vivādajanano hi saḥ ॥24॥
html:
pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ vai yaḥ kuryādabudho naraḥ ।
na sa pramāṇatāmarho vivādajanano hi saḥ ॥24॥
slp1: pramARamapramARaM vE yaH kuryAdabuDo naraH । na sa pramARatAmarho vivAdajanano hi saH ॥24॥

text: brāhmaṇāneva sevasva satkṛtya bahumanya ca । eteṣveva tvime lokāḥ kṛtsnā iti nibodha tān] ॥25॥
html:
brāhmaṇāneva sevasva satkṛtya bahumanya ca ।
eteṣveva tvime lokāḥ kṛtsnā iti nibodha tān] ॥25॥
slp1: brAhmaRAneva sevasva satkftya bahumanya ca । etezveva tvime lokAH kftsnA iti niboDa tAn] ॥25॥

text: ye ca dharmamasūyanti ye cainaṃ paryupāsate । bravītu bhagavānetatkva te gacchanti tādṛśāḥ ॥1॥
html:
ye ca dharmamasūyanti ye cainaṃ paryupāsate ।
bravītu bhagavānetatkva te gacchanti tādṛśāḥ ॥1॥
slp1: ye ca DarmamasUyanti ye cEnaM paryupAsate । bravItu BagavAnetatkva te gacCanti tAdfSAH ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: rajasā tamasā caiva samavastīrṇacetasaḥ । narakaṃ pratipadyante dharmavidveṣiṇo narāḥ ॥2॥
html:
rajasā tamasā caiva samavastīrṇacetasaḥ ।
narakaṃ pratipadyante dharmavidveṣiṇo narāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: rajasA tamasA cEva samavastIrRacetasaH । narakaM pratipadyante DarmavidveziRo narAH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: ye tu dharmaṃ mahārāja satataṃ paryupāsate । satyārjavaparāḥ santaste vai svargabhujo narāḥ ॥3॥
html:
ye tu dharmaṃ mahārāja satataṃ paryupāsate ।
satyārjavaparāḥ santaste vai svargabhujo narāḥ ॥3॥
slp1: ye tu DarmaM mahArAja satataM paryupAsate । satyArjavaparAH santaste vE svargaBujo narAH ॥3॥

text: dharma eva ratisteṣāmācāryopāsanādbhavet । devalokaṃ prapadyante ye dharmaṃ paryupāsate ॥4॥
html:
dharma eva ratisteṣāmācāryopāsanādbhavet ।
devalokaṃ prapadyante ye dharmaṃ paryupāsate ॥4॥
slp1: Darma eva ratistezAmAcAryopAsanAdBavet । devalokaM prapadyante ye DarmaM paryupAsate ॥4॥

text: manuṣyā yadi vā devāḥ śarīramupatāpya vai । dharmiṇaḥ sukhamedhante lobhadveṣavivarjitāḥ ॥5॥
html:
manuṣyā yadi vā devāḥ śarīramupatāpya vai ।
dharmiṇaḥ sukhamedhante lobhadveṣavivarjitāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: manuzyA yadi vA devAH SarIramupatApya vE । DarmiRaH suKameDante loBadvezavivarjitAH ॥5॥

text: prathamaṃ brahmaṇaḥ putraṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । dharmiṇaḥ paryupāsante phalaṃ pakvamivāśayaḥ ॥6॥
html:
prathamaṃ brahmaṇaḥ putraṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।
dharmiṇaḥ paryupāsante phalaṃ pakvamivāśayaḥ ॥6॥
slp1: praTamaM brahmaRaH putraM DarmamAhurmanIziRaH । DarmiRaH paryupAsante PalaM pakvamivASayaH ॥6॥

text: asatāṃ kīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ sādhavaḥ kiṃ ca kurvate । bravītu me bhavānetatsanto'santaśca kīdṛśāḥ ॥7॥
html:
asatāṃ kīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ sādhavaḥ kiṃ ca kurvate ।
bravītu me bhavānetatsanto'santaśca kīdṛśāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: asatAM kIdfSaM rUpaM sADavaH kiM ca kurvate । bravItu me BavAnetatsanto'santaSca kIdfSAH ॥7॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: durācārāśca durdharṣā durmukhāścāpyasādhavaḥ । sādhavaḥ śīlasampannāḥ śiṣṭācārasya lakṣaṇam ॥8॥
html:
durācārāśca durdharṣā durmukhāścāpyasādhavaḥ ।
sādhavaḥ śīlasampannāḥ śiṣṭācārasya lakṣaṇam ॥8॥
slp1: durAcArASca durDarzA durmuKAScApyasADavaH । sADavaH SIlasampannAH SizwAcArasya lakzaRam ॥8॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: rājamārge gavāṃ madhye goṣṭhamadhye ca dharmiṇaḥ । nopasevanti rājendra sargaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ ॥9॥
html:
rājamārge gavāṃ madhye goṣṭhamadhye ca dharmiṇaḥ ।
nopasevanti rājendra sargaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ ॥9॥
slp1: rAjamArge gavAM maDye gozWamaDye ca DarmiRaH । nopasevanti rAjendra sargaM mUtrapurIzayoH ॥9॥

text: pañcānāmaśanaṃ dattvā śeṣamaśnanti sādhavaḥ । na jalpanti ca bhuñjānā na nidrāntyārdrapāṇayaḥ ॥10॥
html:
pañcānāmaśanaṃ dattvā śeṣamaśnanti sādhavaḥ ।
na jalpanti ca bhuñjānā na nidrāntyārdrapāṇayaḥ ॥10॥
slp1: paYcAnAmaSanaM dattvA SezamaSnanti sADavaH । na jalpanti ca BuYjAnA na nidrAntyArdrapARayaH ॥10॥

text: citrabhānumanaḍvāhaṃ devaṃ goṣṭhaṃ catuṣpatham । brāhmaṇaṃ dhārmikaṃ caityaṃ te kurvanti pradakṣiṇam ॥11॥
html:
citrabhānumanaḍvāhaṃ devaṃ goṣṭhaṃ catuṣpatham ।
brāhmaṇaṃ dhārmikaṃ caityaṃ te kurvanti pradakṣiṇam ॥11॥
slp1: citraBAnumanaqvAhaM devaM gozWaM catuzpaTam । brAhmaRaM DArmikaM cEtyaM te kurvanti pradakziRam ॥11॥

text: vṛddhānāṃ bhārataptānāṃ strīṇāṃ bālāturasya ca । brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ rājñāṃ panthānaṃ dadate ca te ॥12॥
html:
vṛddhānāṃ bhārataptānāṃ strīṇāṃ bālāturasya ca ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ rājñāṃ panthānaṃ dadate ca te ॥12॥
slp1: vfdDAnAM BArataptAnAM strIRAM bAlAturasya ca । brAhmaRAnAM gavAM rAjYAM panTAnaM dadate ca te ॥12॥

text: atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca । tathā śaraṇakāmānāṃ goptā syātsvāgatapradaḥ ॥13॥
html:
atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca ।
tathā śaraṇakāmānāṃ goptā syātsvāgatapradaḥ ॥13॥
slp1: atiTInAM ca sarvezAM prezyARAM svajanasya ca । taTA SaraRakAmAnAM goptA syAtsvAgatapradaH ॥13॥

text: sāyaṃ prātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam । nāntarā bhojanaṃ dṛṣṭamupavāsavidhirhi saḥ ॥14॥
html:
sāyaṃ prātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam ।
nāntarā bhojanaṃ dṛṣṭamupavāsavidhirhi saḥ ॥14॥
slp1: sAyaM prAtarmanuzyARAmaSanaM devanirmitam । nAntarA BojanaM dfzwamupavAsaviDirhi saH ॥14॥

text: homakāle yathā vahniḥ kālameva pratīkṣate । ṛtukāle tathā nārī ṛtumeva pratīkṣate । na cānyāṃ gacchate yastu brahmacaryaṃ hi tatsmṛtam ॥15॥
html:
homakāle yathā vahniḥ kālameva pratīkṣate ।
ṛtukāle tathā nārī ṛtumeva pratīkṣate ।
na cānyāṃ gacchate yastu brahmacaryaṃ hi tatsmṛtam ॥15॥
slp1: homakAle yaTA vahniH kAlameva pratIkzate । ftukAle taTA nArI ftumeva pratIkzate । na cAnyAM gacCate yastu brahmacaryaM hi tatsmftam ॥15॥

text: amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇā gāva ityetattrayamekataḥ । tasmādgobrāhmaṇaṃ nityamarcayeta yathāvidhi ॥16॥
html:
amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇā gāva ityetattrayamekataḥ ।
tasmādgobrāhmaṇaṃ nityamarcayeta yathāvidhi ॥16॥
slp1: amftaM brAhmaRA gAva ityetattrayamekataH । tasmAdgobrAhmaRaM nityamarcayeta yaTAviDi ॥16॥

text: yajuṣā saṃskṛtaṃ māṃsamupabhuñjanna duṣyati । pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ vṛthāmāṃsaṃ putramāṃsaṃ ca tatsamam ॥17॥
html:
yajuṣā saṃskṛtaṃ māṃsamupabhuñjanna duṣyati ।
pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ vṛthāmāṃsaṃ putramāṃsaṃ ca tatsamam ॥17॥
slp1: yajuzA saMskftaM mAMsamupaBuYjanna duzyati । pfzWamAMsaM vfTAmAMsaM putramAMsaM ca tatsamam ॥17॥

text: svadeśe paradeśe vāpyatithiṃ nopavāsayet । karma vai saphalaṃ kṛtvā gurūṇāṃ pratipādayet ॥18॥
html:
svadeśe paradeśe vāpyatithiṃ nopavāsayet ।
karma vai saphalaṃ kṛtvā gurūṇāṃ pratipādayet ॥18॥
slp1: svadeSe paradeSe vApyatiTiM nopavAsayet । karma vE saPalaM kftvA gurURAM pratipAdayet ॥18॥

text: gurubhya āsanaṃ deyamabhivādyābhipūjya ca । gurūnabhyarcya vardhante āyuṣā yaśasā śriyā ॥19॥
html:
gurubhya āsanaṃ deyamabhivādyābhipūjya ca ।
gurūnabhyarcya vardhante āyuṣā yaśasā śriyā ॥19॥
slp1: guruBya AsanaM deyamaBivAdyABipUjya ca । gurUnaByarcya varDante AyuzA yaSasA SriyA ॥19॥

text: vṛddhānnātivadejjātu na ca sampreṣayedapi । nāsīnaḥ syātsthiteṣvevamāyurasya na riṣyate ॥20॥
html:
vṛddhānnātivadejjātu na ca sampreṣayedapi ।
nāsīnaḥ syātsthiteṣvevamāyurasya na riṣyate ॥20॥
slp1: vfdDAnnAtivadejjAtu na ca samprezayedapi । nAsInaH syAtsTitezvevamAyurasya na rizyate ॥20॥

text: na nagnāmīkṣate nārīṃ na vidvānpuruṣānapi । maithunaṃ satataṃ guptamāhāraṃ ca samācaret ॥21॥
html:
na nagnāmīkṣate nārīṃ na vidvānpuruṣānapi ।
maithunaṃ satataṃ guptamāhāraṃ ca samācaret ॥21॥
slp1: na nagnAmIkzate nArIM na vidvAnpuruzAnapi । mETunaM satataM guptamAhAraM ca samAcaret ॥21॥

text: tīrthānāṃ guravastīrthaṃ śucīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ śuci । darśanānāṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ santoṣaḥ paramaṃ sukham ॥22॥
html:
tīrthānāṃ guravastīrthaṃ śucīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ śuci ।
darśanānāṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ santoṣaḥ paramaṃ sukham ॥22॥
slp1: tIrTAnAM guravastIrTaM SucInAM hfdayaM Suci । darSanAnAM paraM jYAnaM santozaH paramaM suKam ॥22॥

text: sāyaṃ prātaśca vṛddhānāṃ śṛṇuyātpuṣkalā giraḥ । śrutamāpnoti hi naraḥ satataṃ vṛddhasevayā ॥23॥
html:
sāyaṃ prātaśca vṛddhānāṃ śṛṇuyātpuṣkalā giraḥ ।
śrutamāpnoti hi naraḥ satataṃ vṛddhasevayā ॥23॥
slp1: sAyaM prAtaSca vfdDAnAM SfRuyAtpuzkalA giraH । SrutamApnoti hi naraH satataM vfdDasevayA ॥23॥

text: svādhyāye bhojane caiva dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇimuddharet । yacchedvāṅmanasī nityamindriyāṇāṃ ca vibhramam ॥24॥
html:
svādhyāye bhojane caiva dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇimuddharet ।
yacchedvāṅmanasī nityamindriyāṇāṃ ca vibhramam ॥24॥
slp1: svADyAye Bojane cEva dakziRaM pARimudDaret । yacCedvANmanasI nityamindriyARAM ca viBramam ॥24॥

text: saṃskṛtaṃ pāyasaṃ nityaṃ yavāgūṃ kṛsaraṃ haviḥ । aṣṭakāḥ pitṛdaivatyā vṛddhānāmabhipūjanam ॥25॥
html:
saṃskṛtaṃ pāyasaṃ nityaṃ yavāgūṃ kṛsaraṃ haviḥ ।
aṣṭakāḥ pitṛdaivatyā vṛddhānāmabhipūjanam ॥25॥
slp1: saMskftaM pAyasaM nityaM yavAgUM kfsaraM haviH । azwakAH pitfdEvatyA vfdDAnAmaBipUjanam ॥25॥

text: śmaśrukarmaṇi maṅgalyaṃ kṣutānāmabhinandanam । vyādhitānāṃ ca sarveṣāmāyuṣaḥ pratinandanam ॥26॥
html:
śmaśrukarmaṇi maṅgalyaṃ kṣutānāmabhinandanam ।
vyādhitānāṃ ca sarveṣāmāyuṣaḥ pratinandanam ॥26॥
slp1: SmaSrukarmaRi maNgalyaM kzutAnAmaBinandanam । vyADitAnAM ca sarvezAmAyuzaH pratinandanam ॥26॥

text: na jātu tvamiti brūyādāpanno'pi mahattaram । tvaṅkāro vā vadho veti vidvatsu na viśiṣyate । avarāṇāṃ samānānāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ ca samācaret ॥27॥
html:
na jātu tvamiti brūyādāpanno'pi mahattaram ।
tvaṅkāro vā vadho veti vidvatsu na viśiṣyate ।
avarāṇāṃ samānānāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ ca samācaret ॥27॥
slp1: na jAtu tvamiti brUyAdApanno'pi mahattaram । tvaNkAro vA vaDo veti vidvatsu na viSizyate । avarARAM samAnAnAM SizyARAM ca samAcaret ॥27॥

text: pāpamācakṣate nityaṃ hṛdayaṃ pāpakarmiṇām । jñānapūrvaṃ vinaśyanti gūhamānā mahājane ॥28॥
html:
pāpamācakṣate nityaṃ hṛdayaṃ pāpakarmiṇām ।
jñānapūrvaṃ vinaśyanti gūhamānā mahājane ॥28॥
slp1: pApamAcakzate nityaM hfdayaM pApakarmiRAm । jYAnapUrvaM vinaSyanti gUhamAnA mahAjane ॥28॥

text: jñānapūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma cchādayante hyasādhavaḥ । na māṃ manuṣyāḥ paśyanti na māṃ paśyanti devatāḥ । pāpenābhihataḥ pāpaḥ pāpamevābhijāyate ॥29॥
html:
jñānapūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma cchādayante hyasādhavaḥ ।
na māṃ manuṣyāḥ paśyanti na māṃ paśyanti devatāḥ ।
pāpenābhihataḥ pāpaḥ pāpamevābhijāyate ॥29॥
slp1: jYAnapUrvaM kftaM karma cCAdayante hyasADavaH । na mAM manuzyAH paSyanti na mAM paSyanti devatAH । pApenABihataH pApaH pApamevABijAyate ॥29॥

text: yathā vārdhuṣiko vṛddhiṃ dehabhede pratīkṣate । dharmeṇāpihitaṃ pāpaṃ dharmamevābhivardhayet ॥30॥
html:
yathā vārdhuṣiko vṛddhiṃ dehabhede pratīkṣate ।
dharmeṇāpihitaṃ pāpaṃ dharmamevābhivardhayet ॥30॥
slp1: yaTA vArDuziko vfdDiM dehaBede pratIkzate । DarmeRApihitaM pApaM DarmamevABivarDayet ॥30॥

text: yathā lavaṇamambhobhirāplutaṃ pravilīyate । prāyaścittahataṃ pāpaṃ tathā sadyaḥ praṇaśyati ॥31॥
html:
yathā lavaṇamambhobhirāplutaṃ pravilīyate ।
prāyaścittahataṃ pāpaṃ tathā sadyaḥ praṇaśyati ॥31॥
slp1: yaTA lavaRamamBoBirAplutaM pravilIyate । prAyaScittahataM pApaM taTA sadyaH praRaSyati ॥31॥

text: tasmātpāpaṃ na gūheta gūhamānaṃ vivardhate । kṛtvā tu sādhuṣvākhyeyaṃ te tatpraśamayantyuta ॥32॥
html:
tasmātpāpaṃ na gūheta gūhamānaṃ vivardhate ।
kṛtvā tu sādhuṣvākhyeyaṃ te tatpraśamayantyuta ॥32॥
slp1: tasmAtpApaM na gUheta gUhamAnaM vivarDate । kftvA tu sADuzvAKyeyaM te tatpraSamayantyuta ॥32॥

text: āśayā sañcitaṃ dravyaṃ yatkāle nopabhujyate । anye caitatprapadyante viyoge tasya dehinaḥ ॥33॥
html:
āśayā sañcitaṃ dravyaṃ yatkāle nopabhujyate ।
anye caitatprapadyante viyoge tasya dehinaḥ ॥33॥
slp1: ASayA saYcitaM dravyaM yatkAle nopaBujyate । anye cEtatprapadyante viyoge tasya dehinaH ॥33॥

text: mānasaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ । tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtāni dharmameva samāsate ॥34॥
html:
mānasaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।
tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtāni dharmameva samāsate ॥34॥
slp1: mAnasaM sarvaBUtAnAM DarmamAhurmanIziRaH । tasmAtsarvARi BUtAni Darmameva samAsate ॥34॥

text: eka eva careddharmaṃ na dharmadhvajiko bhavet । dharmavāṇijakā hyete ye dharmamupabhuñjate ॥35॥
html:
eka eva careddharmaṃ na dharmadhvajiko bhavet ।
dharmavāṇijakā hyete ye dharmamupabhuñjate ॥35॥
slp1: eka eva caredDarmaM na DarmaDvajiko Bavet । DarmavARijakA hyete ye DarmamupaBuYjate ॥35॥

text: arceddevānadambhena sevetāmāyayā gurūn । nidhiṃ nidadhyātpāratryaṃ yātrārthaṃ dānaśabditam] ॥36॥
html:
arceddevānadambhena sevetāmāyayā gurūn ।
nidhiṃ nidadhyātpāratryaṃ yātrārthaṃ dānaśabditam] ॥36॥
slp1: arceddevAnadamBena sevetAmAyayA gurUn । niDiM nidaDyAtpAratryaM yAtrArTaM dAnaSabditam] ॥36॥

text: nābhāgadheyaḥ prāpnoti dhanaṃ subalavānapi । bhāgadheyānvitastvarthānkṛśo bālaśca vindati ॥1॥
html:
nābhāgadheyaḥ prāpnoti dhanaṃ subalavānapi ।
bhāgadheyānvitastvarthānkṛśo bālaśca vindati ॥1॥
slp1: nABAgaDeyaH prApnoti DanaM subalavAnapi । BAgaDeyAnvitastvarTAnkfSo bAlaSca vindati ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: nālābhakāle labhate prayatne'pi kṛte sati । lābhakāle'prayatnena labhate vipulaṃ dhanam । kṛtayatnāphalāścaiva dṛśyante śataśo narāḥ ॥2॥
html:
nālābhakāle labhate prayatne'pi kṛte sati ।
lābhakāle'prayatnena labhate vipulaṃ dhanam ।
kṛtayatnāphalāścaiva dṛśyante śataśo narāḥ ॥2॥
slp1: nAlABakAle laBate prayatne'pi kfte sati । lABakAle'prayatnena laBate vipulaM Danam । kftayatnAPalAScEva dfSyante SataSo narAH ॥2॥

text: yadi yatno bhavenmartyaḥ sa sarvaṃ phalamāpnuyāt । nālabhyaṃ copalabhyeta nṛṇāṃ bharatasattama ॥3॥
html:
yadi yatno bhavenmartyaḥ sa sarvaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ।
nālabhyaṃ copalabhyeta nṛṇāṃ bharatasattama ॥3॥
slp1: yadi yatno BavenmartyaH sa sarvaM PalamApnuyAt । nAlaByaM copalaByeta nfRAM Baratasattama ॥3॥

text: yadā prayatnaṃ kṛtavāndṛśyate hyaphalo naraḥ । mārgannayaśatairarthānamārgaṃścāparaḥ sukhī ॥4॥
html:
yadā prayatnaṃ kṛtavāndṛśyate hyaphalo naraḥ ।
mārgannayaśatairarthānamārgaṃścāparaḥ sukhī ॥4॥
slp1: yadA prayatnaM kftavAndfSyate hyaPalo naraH । mArgannayaSatErarTAnamArgaMScAparaH suKI ॥4॥

text: akāryamasakṛtkṛtvā dṛśyante hyadhanā narāḥ । dhanayuktāstvadharmasthā dṛśyante cāpare janāḥ ॥5॥
html:
akāryamasakṛtkṛtvā dṛśyante hyadhanā narāḥ ।
dhanayuktāstvadharmasthā dṛśyante cāpare janāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: akAryamasakftkftvA dfSyante hyaDanA narAH । DanayuktAstvaDarmasTA dfSyante cApare janAH ॥5॥

text: adhītya nītiṃ yasmācca nītiyukto na dṛśyate । anabhijñaśca sācivyaṃ gamitaḥ kena hetunā । vidyāyukto hyavidyaśca dhanavāndurgatastathā ॥6॥
html:
adhītya nītiṃ yasmācca nītiyukto na dṛśyate ।
anabhijñaśca sācivyaṃ gamitaḥ kena hetunā ।
vidyāyukto hyavidyaśca dhanavāndurgatastathā ॥6॥
slp1: aDItya nItiM yasmAcca nItiyukto na dfSyate । anaBijYaSca sAcivyaM gamitaH kena hetunA । vidyAyukto hyavidyaSca DanavAndurgatastaTA ॥6॥

text: yadi vidyāmupāśritya naraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt । na vidvānvidyayā hīnaṃ vṛttyarthamupasaṃśrayet ॥7॥
html:
yadi vidyāmupāśritya naraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt ।
na vidvānvidyayā hīnaṃ vṛttyarthamupasaṃśrayet ॥7॥
slp1: yadi vidyAmupASritya naraH suKamavApnuyAt । na vidvAnvidyayA hInaM vfttyarTamupasaMSrayet ॥7॥

text: yathā pipāsāṃ jayati puruṣaḥ prāpya vai jalam । dṛṣṭārtho vidyayāpyevamavidyāṃ prajahennaraḥ ॥8॥
html:
yathā pipāsāṃ jayati puruṣaḥ prāpya vai jalam ।
dṛṣṭārtho vidyayāpyevamavidyāṃ prajahennaraḥ ॥8॥
slp1: yaTA pipAsAM jayati puruzaH prApya vE jalam । dfzwArTo vidyayApyevamavidyAM prajahennaraH ॥8॥

text: nāprāptakālo mriyate viddhaḥ śaraśatairapi । tṛṇāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati ॥9॥
html:
nāprāptakālo mriyate viddhaḥ śaraśatairapi ।
tṛṇāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati ॥9॥
slp1: nAprAptakAlo mriyate vidDaH SaraSatErapi । tfRAgreRApi saMspfzwaH prAptakAlo na jIvati ॥9॥

text: īhamānaḥ samārambhānyadi nāsādayeddhanam । ugraṃ tapaḥ samārohenna hyanuptaṃ prarohati ॥10॥
html:
īhamānaḥ samārambhānyadi nāsādayeddhanam ।
ugraṃ tapaḥ samārohenna hyanuptaṃ prarohati ॥10॥
slp1: IhamAnaH samAramBAnyadi nAsAdayedDanam । ugraM tapaH samArohenna hyanuptaM prarohati ॥10॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: dānena bhogī bhavati medhāvī vṛddhasevayā । ahiṃsayā ca dīrghāyuriti prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥11॥
html:
dānena bhogī bhavati medhāvī vṛddhasevayā ।
ahiṃsayā ca dīrghāyuriti prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: dAnena BogI Bavati meDAvI vfdDasevayA । ahiMsayA ca dIrGAyuriti prAhurmanIziRaH ॥11॥

text: tasmāddadyānna yāceta pūjayeddhārmikānapi । svābhāṣī priyakṛcchuddhaḥ sarvasattvāvihiṃsakaḥ ॥12॥
html:
tasmāddadyānna yāceta pūjayeddhārmikānapi ।
svābhāṣī priyakṛcchuddhaḥ sarvasattvāvihiṃsakaḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tasmAddadyAnna yAceta pUjayedDArmikAnapi । svABAzI priyakfcCudDaH sarvasattvAvihiMsakaH ॥12॥

text: yadā pramāṇaprabhavaḥ svabhāvaśca sukhāsukhe । maśakīṭapipīlānāṃ sthiro bhava yudhiṣṭhira] ॥13॥
html:
yadā pramāṇaprabhavaḥ svabhāvaśca sukhāsukhe ।
maśakīṭapipīlānāṃ sthiro bhava yudhiṣṭhira] ॥13॥
slp1: yadA pramARapraBavaH svaBAvaSca suKAsuKe । maSakIwapipIlAnAM sTiro Bava yuDizWira] ॥13॥

text: kāryate yacca kriyate saccāsacca kṛtaṃ tataḥ । tatrāśvasīta satkṛtvā asatkṛtvā na viśvaset ॥1॥
html:
kāryate yacca kriyate saccāsacca kṛtaṃ tataḥ ।
tatrāśvasīta satkṛtvā asatkṛtvā na viśvaset ॥1॥
slp1: kAryate yacca kriyate saccAsacca kftaM tataH । tatrASvasIta satkftvA asatkftvA na viSvaset ॥1॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: kāla evātra kālena nigrahānugrahau dadat । buddhimāviśya bhūtānāṃ dharmārtheṣu pravartate ॥2॥
html:
kāla evātra kālena nigrahānugrahau dadat ।
buddhimāviśya bhūtānāṃ dharmārtheṣu pravartate ॥2॥
slp1: kAla evAtra kAlena nigrahAnugrahO dadat । budDimAviSya BUtAnAM DarmArTezu pravartate ॥2॥

text: yadā tvasya bhavedbuddhirdharmyā cārthapradarśinī । tadāśvasīta dharmātmādṛḍhabuddhirna viśvaset ॥3॥
html:
yadā tvasya bhavedbuddhirdharmyā cārthapradarśinī ।
tadāśvasīta dharmātmādṛḍhabuddhirna viśvaset ॥3॥
slp1: yadA tvasya BavedbudDirDarmyA cArTapradarSinI । tadASvasIta DarmAtmAdfQabudDirna viSvaset ॥3॥

text: etāvanmātrametaddhi bhūtānāṃ prājñalakṣaṇam । kālayukto'pyubhayaviccheṣamarthaṃ samācaret ॥4॥
html:
etāvanmātrametaddhi bhūtānāṃ prājñalakṣaṇam ।
kālayukto'pyubhayaviccheṣamarthaṃ samācaret ॥4॥
slp1: etAvanmAtrametadDi BUtAnAM prAjYalakzaRam । kAlayukto'pyuBayavicCezamarTaM samAcaret ॥4॥

text: yathā hyupasthitaiśvaryāḥ pūjayante narā narān । evamevātmanātmānaṃ pūjayantīha dhārmikāḥ ॥5॥
html:
yathā hyupasthitaiśvaryāḥ pūjayante narā narān ।
evamevātmanātmānaṃ pūjayantīha dhārmikāḥ ॥5॥
slp1: yaTA hyupasTitESvaryAH pUjayante narA narAn । evamevAtmanAtmAnaM pUjayantIha DArmikAH ॥5॥

text: na hyadharmatayā dharmaṃ dadyātkālaḥ kathañcana । tasmādviśuddhamātmānaṃ jānīyāddharmacāriṇam ॥6॥
html:
na hyadharmatayā dharmaṃ dadyātkālaḥ kathañcana ।
tasmādviśuddhamātmānaṃ jānīyāddharmacāriṇam ॥6॥
slp1: na hyaDarmatayA DarmaM dadyAtkAlaH kaTaYcana । tasmAdviSudDamAtmAnaM jAnIyAdDarmacAriRam ॥6॥

text: spraṣṭumapyasamartho hi jvalantamiva pāvakam । adharmaḥ satato dharmaṃ kālena parirakṣitam ॥7॥
html:
spraṣṭumapyasamartho hi jvalantamiva pāvakam ।
adharmaḥ satato dharmaṃ kālena parirakṣitam ॥7॥
slp1: sprazwumapyasamarTo hi jvalantamiva pAvakam । aDarmaH satato DarmaM kAlena parirakzitam ॥7॥

text: kāryāvetau hi kālena dharmo hi vijayāvahaḥ । trayāṇāmapi lokānāmālokakaraṇo bhavet ॥8॥
html:
kāryāvetau hi kālena dharmo hi vijayāvahaḥ ।
trayāṇāmapi lokānāmālokakaraṇo bhavet ॥8॥
slp1: kAryAvetO hi kAlena Darmo hi vijayAvahaH । trayARAmapi lokAnAmAlokakaraRo Bavet ॥8॥

text: tatra kaścinnayetprājño gṛhītvaiva kare naram । uhyamānaḥ sa dharmeṇa dharme bahubhayacchale] ॥9॥
html:
tatra kaścinnayetprājño gṛhītvaiva kare naram ।
uhyamānaḥ sa dharmeṇa dharme bahubhayacchale] ॥9॥
slp1: tatra kaScinnayetprAjYo gfhItvEva kare naram । uhyamAnaH sa DarmeRa Darme bahuBayacCale] ॥9॥

text: kiṃ śreyaḥ puruṣasyeha kiṃ kurvansukhamedhate । vipāpmā ca bhavetkena kiṃ vā kalmaṣanāśanam ॥1॥
html:
kiṃ śreyaḥ puruṣasyeha kiṃ kurvansukhamedhate ।
vipāpmā ca bhavetkena kiṃ vā kalmaṣanāśanam ॥1॥
slp1: kiM SreyaH puruzasyeha kiM kurvansuKameDate । vipApmA ca Bavetkena kiM vA kalmazanASanam ॥1॥
author: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ।

text: ayaṃ daivatavaṃśo vai ṛṣivaṃśasamanvitaḥ । dvisandhyaṃ paṭhitaḥ putra kalmaṣāpaharaḥ paraḥ ॥2॥
html:
ayaṃ daivatavaṃśo vai ṛṣivaṃśasamanvitaḥ ।
dvisandhyaṃ paṭhitaḥ putra kalmaṣāpaharaḥ paraḥ ॥2॥
slp1: ayaM dEvatavaMSo vE fzivaMSasamanvitaH । dvisanDyaM paWitaH putra kalmazApaharaH paraH ॥2॥
author: bhīṣma uvāca ।

text: devāsuragururdevaḥ sarvabhūtanamaskṛtaḥ । acintyo'thāpyanirdeśyaḥ sarvaprāṇo hyayonijaḥ ॥3॥
html:
devāsuragururdevaḥ sarvabhūtanamaskṛtaḥ ।
acintyo'thāpyanirdeśyaḥ sarvaprāṇo hyayonijaḥ ॥3॥
slp1: devAsuragururdevaH sarvaBUtanamaskftaH । acintyo'TApyanirdeSyaH sarvaprARo hyayonijaH ॥3॥

text: pitāmaho jagannāthaḥ sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ satī । vedabhūratha kartā ca viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥4॥
html:
pitāmaho jagannāthaḥ sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ satī ।
vedabhūratha kartā ca viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥4॥
slp1: pitAmaho jagannATaH sAvitrI brahmaRaH satI । vedaBUraTa kartA ca vizRurnArAyaRaH praBuH ॥4॥

text: umāpatirvirūpākṣaḥ skandaḥ senāpatistathā । viśākho hutabhugvāyuścandrādityau prabhākarau ॥5॥
html:
umāpatirvirūpākṣaḥ skandaḥ senāpatistathā ।
viśākho hutabhugvāyuścandrādityau prabhākarau ॥5॥
slp1: umApatirvirUpAkzaH skandaH senApatistaTA । viSAKo hutaBugvAyuScandrAdityO praBAkarO ॥5॥

text: śakraḥ śacīpatirdevo yamo dhūmorṇayā saha । varuṇaḥ saha gauryā ca saha ṛddhyā dhaneśvaraḥ ॥6॥
html:
śakraḥ śacīpatirdevo yamo dhūmorṇayā saha ।
varuṇaḥ saha gauryā ca saha ṛddhyā dhaneśvaraḥ ॥6॥
slp1: SakraH SacIpatirdevo yamo DUmorRayA saha । varuRaH saha gOryA ca saha fdDyA DaneSvaraH ॥6॥

text: saumyā gauḥ surabhirdevī viśravāśca mahānṛṣiḥ । ṣaṭkālaḥ sāgaro gaṅgā sravantyo'tha marudgaṇāḥ ॥7॥
html:
saumyā gauḥ surabhirdevī viśravāśca mahānṛṣiḥ ।
ṣaṭkālaḥ sāgaro gaṅgā sravantyo'tha marudgaṇāḥ ॥7॥
slp1: sOmyA gOH suraBirdevI viSravASca mahAnfziH । zawkAlaH sAgaro gaNgA sravantyo'Ta marudgaRAH ॥7॥

text: vālakhilyāstapaḥsiddhāḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastathā । nāradaḥ parvataścaiva viśvāvasurhahāhuhūḥ ॥8॥
html:
vālakhilyāstapaḥsiddhāḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastathā ।
nāradaḥ parvataścaiva viśvāvasurhahāhuhūḥ ॥8॥
slp1: vAlaKilyAstapaHsidDAH kfzRadvEpAyanastaTA । nAradaH parvataScEva viSvAvasurhahAhuhUH ॥8॥

text: tumbaruścitrasenaśca devadūtaśca viśrutaḥ । devakanyā mahābhāgā divyāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ॥9॥
html:
tumbaruścitrasenaśca devadūtaśca viśrutaḥ ।
devakanyā mahābhāgā divyāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: tumbaruScitrasenaSca devadUtaSca viSrutaH । devakanyA mahABAgA divyAScApsarasAM gaRAH ॥9॥

text: urvaśī menakā rambhā miśrakeśī alambuṣā । viśvācī ca ghṛtācī ca pañcacūḍā tilottamā ॥10॥
html:
urvaśī menakā rambhā miśrakeśī alambuṣā ।
viśvācī ca ghṛtācī ca pañcacūḍā tilottamā ॥10॥
slp1: urvaSI menakA ramBA miSrakeSI alambuzA । viSvAcI ca GftAcI ca paYcacUqA tilottamA ॥10॥

text: ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sāśvinaḥ pitaro'pi ca । dharmaḥ satyaṃ tapo dīkṣā vyavasāyaḥ pitāmahaḥ ॥11॥
html:
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sāśvinaḥ pitaro'pi ca ।
dharmaḥ satyaṃ tapo dīkṣā vyavasāyaḥ pitāmahaḥ ॥11॥
slp1: AdityA vasavo rudrAH sASvinaH pitaro'pi ca । DarmaH satyaM tapo dIkzA vyavasAyaH pitAmahaH ॥11॥

text: śarvaryo divasāścaiva mārīcaḥ kaśyapastathā । śukro bṛhaspatirbhaumo budho rāhuḥ śanaiścaraḥ ॥12॥
html:
śarvaryo divasāścaiva mārīcaḥ kaśyapastathā ।
śukro bṛhaspatirbhaumo budho rāhuḥ śanaiścaraḥ ॥12॥
slp1: Sarvaryo divasAScEva mArIcaH kaSyapastaTA । Sukro bfhaspatirBOmo buDo rAhuH SanEScaraH ॥12॥

text: nakṣatrāṇyṛtavaścaiva māsāḥ sandhyāḥ savatsarāḥ । vainateyāḥ samudrāśca kadrujāḥ pannagāstathā ॥13॥
html:
nakṣatrāṇyṛtavaścaiva māsāḥ sandhyāḥ savatsarāḥ ।
vainateyāḥ samudrāśca kadrujāḥ pannagāstathā ॥13॥
slp1: nakzatrARyftavaScEva mAsAH sanDyAH savatsarAH । vEnateyAH samudrASca kadrujAH pannagAstaTA ॥13॥

text: śatadrūśca vipāśā ca candrabhāgā sarasvatī । sindhuśca devikā caiva puṣkaraṃ tīrthameva ca ॥14॥
html:
śatadrūśca vipāśā ca candrabhāgā sarasvatī ।
sindhuśca devikā caiva puṣkaraṃ tīrthameva ca ॥14॥
slp1: SatadrUSca vipASA ca candraBAgA sarasvatI । sinDuSca devikA cEva puzkaraM tIrTameva ca ॥14॥

text: gaṅgā mahānadī caiva kapilā narmadā tathā । kampunā ca viśalyā ca karatoyāmbuvāhinī ॥15॥
html:
gaṅgā mahānadī caiva kapilā narmadā tathā ।
kampunā ca viśalyā ca karatoyāmbuvāhinī ॥15॥
slp1: gaNgA mahAnadI cEva kapilA narmadA taTA । kampunA ca viSalyA ca karatoyAmbuvAhinI ॥15॥

text: sarayūrgaṇḍakī caiva lohityaśca mahānadaḥ । tāmrāruṇā vetravatī parṇāśā gautamī tathā ॥16॥
html:
sarayūrgaṇḍakī caiva lohityaśca mahānadaḥ ।
tāmrāruṇā vetravatī parṇāśā gautamī tathā ॥16॥
slp1: sarayUrgaRqakI cEva lohityaSca mahAnadaH । tAmrAruRA vetravatI parRASA gOtamI taTA ॥16॥

text: godāvarī ca veṇṇā ca kṛṣṇaveṇā tathādrijā । dṛṣadvatī ca kāverī vaṅkṣurmandākinī tathā ॥17॥
html:
godāvarī ca veṇṇā ca kṛṣṇaveṇā tathādrijā ।
dṛṣadvatī ca kāverī vaṅkṣurmandākinī tathā ॥17॥
slp1: godAvarI ca veRRA ca kfzRaveRA taTAdrijA । dfzadvatI ca kAverI vaNkzurmandAkinI taTA ॥17॥

text: prayāgaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca puṇyaṃ naimiṣameva ca । tacca viśveśvarasthānaṃ yatra tadvimalaṃ saraḥ ॥18॥
html:
prayāgaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca puṇyaṃ naimiṣameva ca ।
tacca viśveśvarasthānaṃ yatra tadvimalaṃ saraḥ ॥18॥
slp1: prayAgaM ca praBAsaM ca puRyaM nEmizameva ca । tacca viSveSvarasTAnaM yatra tadvimalaM saraH ॥18॥

text: puṇyatīrthaiśca kalilaṃ kurukṣetraṃ prakīrtitam । sindhūttamaṃ tapodānaṃ jambūmārgamathāpi ca ॥19॥
html:
puṇyatīrthaiśca kalilaṃ kurukṣetraṃ prakīrtitam ।
sindhūttamaṃ tapodānaṃ jambūmārgamathāpi ca ॥19॥
slp1: puRyatIrTESca kalilaM kurukzetraM prakIrtitam । sinDUttamaM tapodAnaM jambUmArgamaTApi ca ॥19॥

text: hiraṇvatī vitastā ca tathaivekṣumatī nadī । vedasmṛtirvaidasinī malavāsāśca nadyapi ॥20॥
html:
hiraṇvatī vitastā ca tathaivekṣumatī nadī ।
vedasmṛtirvaidasinī malavāsāśca nadyapi ॥20॥
slp1: hiraRvatI vitastA ca taTEvekzumatI nadI । vedasmftirvEdasinI malavAsASca nadyapi ॥20॥

text: bhūmibhāgāstathā puṇyā gaṅgādvāramathāpi ca । ṛṣikulyāstathā medhyā nadī citrapathā tathā ॥21॥
html:
bhūmibhāgāstathā puṇyā gaṅgādvāramathāpi ca ।
ṛṣikulyāstathā medhyā nadī citrapathā tathā ॥21॥
slp1: BUmiBAgAstaTA puRyA gaNgAdvAramaTApi ca । fzikulyAstaTA meDyA nadI citrapaTA taTA ॥21॥

text: kauśikī yamunā sītā tathā carmaṇvatī nadī । nadī bhīmarathī caiva bāhudā ca mahānadī । mahendravāṇī tridivā nīlikā ca sarasvatī ॥22॥
html:
kauśikī yamunā sītā tathā carmaṇvatī nadī ।
nadī bhīmarathī caiva bāhudā ca mahānadī ।
mahendravāṇī tridivā nīlikā ca sarasvatī ॥22॥
slp1: kOSikI yamunA sItA taTA carmaRvatI nadI । nadI BImaraTI cEva bAhudA ca mahAnadI । mahendravARI tridivA nIlikA ca sarasvatI ॥22॥

text: nandā cāparanandā ca tathā tīrthaṃ mahāhradam । gayātha phalgutīrthaṃ ca dharmāraṇyaṃ surairvṛtam ॥23॥
html:
nandā cāparanandā ca tathā tīrthaṃ mahāhradam ।
gayātha phalgutīrthaṃ ca dharmāraṇyaṃ surairvṛtam ॥23॥
slp1: nandA cAparanandA ca taTA tIrTaM mahAhradam । gayATa PalgutIrTaM ca DarmAraRyaM surErvftam ॥23॥

text: tathā devanadī puṇyā saraśca brahmanirmitam । puṇyaṃ trilokavikhyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam ॥24॥
html:
tathā devanadī puṇyā saraśca brahmanirmitam ।
puṇyaṃ trilokavikhyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam ॥24॥
slp1: taTA devanadI puRyA saraSca brahmanirmitam । puRyaM trilokaviKyAtaM sarvapApaharaM Sivam ॥24॥

text: himavānparvataścaiva divyauṣadhisamanvitaḥ । vindhyo dhātuvicitrāṅgastīrthavānauṣadhānvitaḥ ॥25॥
html:
himavānparvataścaiva divyauṣadhisamanvitaḥ ।
vindhyo dhātuvicitrāṅgastīrthavānauṣadhānvitaḥ ॥25॥
slp1: himavAnparvataScEva divyOzaDisamanvitaH । vinDyo DAtuvicitrANgastIrTavAnOzaDAnvitaH ॥25॥

text: merurmahendro malayaḥ śvetaśca rajatācitaḥ । śṛṅgavānmandaro nīlo niṣadho dardurastathā ॥26॥
html:
merurmahendro malayaḥ śvetaśca rajatācitaḥ ।
śṛṅgavānmandaro nīlo niṣadho dardurastathā ॥26॥
slp1: merurmahendro malayaH SvetaSca rajatAcitaH । SfNgavAnmandaro nIlo nizaDo dardurastaTA ॥26॥

text: citrakūṭo'ñjanābhaśca parvato gandhamādanaḥ । puṇyaḥ somagiriścaiva tathaivānye mahīdharāḥ । diśaśca vidiśaścaiva kṣitiḥ sarve mahīruhāḥ ॥27॥
html:
citrakūṭo'ñjanābhaśca parvato gandhamādanaḥ ।
puṇyaḥ somagiriścaiva tathaivānye mahīdharāḥ ।
diśaśca vidiśaścaiva kṣitiḥ sarve mahīruhāḥ ॥27॥
slp1: citrakUwo'YjanABaSca parvato ganDamAdanaH । puRyaH somagiriScEva taTEvAnye mahIDarAH । diSaSca vidiSaScEva kzitiH sarve mahIruhAH ॥27॥

text: viśvedevā nabhaścaiva nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā । pāntu vaḥ satataṃ devāḥ kīrtitākīrtitā mayā ॥28॥
html:
viśvedevā nabhaścaiva nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā ।
pāntu vaḥ satataṃ devāḥ kīrtitākīrtitā mayā ॥28॥
slp1: viSvedevA naBaScEva nakzatrARi grahAstaTA । pAntu vaH satataM devAH kIrtitAkIrtitA mayA ॥28॥

text: kīrtayāno naro hyetānmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ । stuvaṃśca pratinandaṃśca mucyate sarvato bhayāt । sarvasaṅkarapāpebhyo devatāstavanandakaḥ ॥29॥
html:
kīrtayāno naro hyetānmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ।
stuvaṃśca pratinandaṃśca mucyate sarvato bhayāt ।
sarvasaṅkarapāpebhyo devatāstavanandakaḥ ॥29॥
slp1: kIrtayAno naro hyetAnmucyate sarvakilbizEH । stuvaMSca pratinandaMSca mucyate sarvato BayAt । sarvasaNkarapApeByo devatAstavanandakaH ॥29॥

text: devatānantaraṃ viprāṃstapaḥsiddhāṃstapodhikān । kīrtitānkīrtayiṣyāmi sarvapāpapramocanān ॥30॥
html:
devatānantaraṃ viprāṃstapaḥsiddhāṃstapodhikān ।
kīrtitānkīrtayiṣyāmi sarvapāpapramocanān ॥30॥
slp1: devatAnantaraM viprAMstapaHsidDAMstapoDikAn । kIrtitAnkIrtayizyAmi sarvapApapramocanAn ॥30॥

text: yavakrīto'tha raibhyaśca kakṣīvānauśijastathā । bhṛgvaṅgirāstathā kaṇvo medhātithiratha prabhuḥ । barhī ca guṇasampannaḥ prācīṃ diśamupāśritāḥ ॥31॥
html:
yavakrīto'tha raibhyaśca kakṣīvānauśijastathā ।
bhṛgvaṅgirāstathā kaṇvo medhātithiratha prabhuḥ ।
barhī ca guṇasampannaḥ prācīṃ diśamupāśritāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: yavakrIto'Ta rEByaSca kakzIvAnOSijastaTA । BfgvaNgirAstaTA kaRvo meDAtiTiraTa praBuH । barhI ca guRasampannaH prAcIM diSamupASritAH ॥31॥

text: bhadrāṃ diśaṃ mahābhāgā ulmucuḥ pramucustathā । mumucuśca mahābhāgaḥ svastyātreyaśca vīryavān ॥32॥
html:
bhadrāṃ diśaṃ mahābhāgā ulmucuḥ pramucustathā ।
mumucuśca mahābhāgaḥ svastyātreyaśca vīryavān ॥32॥
slp1: BadrAM diSaM mahABAgA ulmucuH pramucustaTA । mumucuSca mahABAgaH svastyAtreyaSca vIryavAn ॥32॥

text: mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putrastathāgastyaḥ pratāpavān । dṛḍhāyuścordhvabāhuśca viśrutāvṛṣisattamau ॥33॥
html:
mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putrastathāgastyaḥ pratāpavān ।
dṛḍhāyuścordhvabāhuśca viśrutāvṛṣisattamau ॥33॥
slp1: mitrAvaruRayoH putrastaTAgastyaH pratApavAn । dfQAyuScorDvabAhuSca viSrutAvfzisattamO ॥33॥

text: paścimāṃ diśamāśritya ya edhante nibodha tān । uṣadguḥ saha sodaryaiḥ parivyādhaśca vīryavān ॥34॥
html:
paścimāṃ diśamāśritya ya edhante nibodha tān ।
uṣadguḥ saha sodaryaiḥ parivyādhaśca vīryavān ॥34॥
slp1: paScimAM diSamASritya ya eDante niboDa tAn । uzadguH saha sodaryEH parivyADaSca vIryavAn ॥34॥

text: ṛṣirdīrghatamāścaiva gautamaḥ kaśyapastathā । ekataśca dvitaścaiva tritaścaiva maharṣayaḥ । atreḥ putraśca dharmātmā tathā sārasvataḥ prabhuḥ ॥35॥
html:
ṛṣirdīrghatamāścaiva gautamaḥ kaśyapastathā ।
ekataśca dvitaścaiva tritaścaiva maharṣayaḥ ।
atreḥ putraśca dharmātmā tathā sārasvataḥ prabhuḥ ॥35॥
slp1: fzirdIrGatamAScEva gOtamaH kaSyapastaTA । ekataSca dvitaScEva tritaScEva maharzayaH । atreH putraSca DarmAtmA taTA sArasvataH praBuH ॥35॥

text: uttarāṃ diśamāśritya ya edhante nibodha tān । atrirvasiṣṭhaḥ śaktiśca pārāśaryaśca vīryavān ॥36॥
html:
uttarāṃ diśamāśritya ya edhante nibodha tān ।
atrirvasiṣṭhaḥ śaktiśca pārāśaryaśca vīryavān ॥36॥
slp1: uttarAM diSamASritya ya eDante niboDa tAn । atrirvasizWaH SaktiSca pArASaryaSca vIryavAn ॥36॥

text: viśvāmitro bharadvājo jamadagnistathaiva ca । ṛcīkapautro rāmaśca ṛṣirauddālakistathā ॥37॥
html:
viśvāmitro bharadvājo jamadagnistathaiva ca ।
ṛcīkapautro rāmaśca ṛṣirauddālakistathā ॥37॥
slp1: viSvAmitro BaradvAjo jamadagnistaTEva ca । fcIkapOtro rAmaSca fzirOddAlakistaTA ॥37॥

text: śvetaketuḥ kohalaśca vipulo devalastathā । devaśarmā ca dhaumyaśca hastikāśyapa eva ca ॥38॥
html:
śvetaketuḥ kohalaśca vipulo devalastathā ।
devaśarmā ca dhaumyaśca hastikāśyapa eva ca ॥38॥
slp1: SvetaketuH kohalaSca vipulo devalastaTA । devaSarmA ca DOmyaSca hastikASyapa eva ca ॥38॥

text: lomaśo nāciketaśca lomaharṣaṇa eva ca । ṛṣirugraśravāścaiva bhārgavaścyavanastathā ॥39॥
html:
lomaśo nāciketaśca lomaharṣaṇa eva ca ।
ṛṣirugraśravāścaiva bhārgavaścyavanastathā ॥39॥
slp1: lomaSo nAciketaSca lomaharzaRa eva ca । fzirugraSravAScEva BArgavaScyavanastaTA ॥39॥

text: eṣa vai samavāyaste ṛṣidevasamanvitaḥ । ādyaḥ prakīrtito rājansarvapāpapramocanaḥ ॥40॥
html:
eṣa vai samavāyaste ṛṣidevasamanvitaḥ ।
ādyaḥ prakīrtito rājansarvapāpapramocanaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: eza vE samavAyaste fzidevasamanvitaH । AdyaH prakIrtito rAjansarvapApapramocanaH ॥40॥

text: nṛgo yayātirnahuṣo yaduḥ pūruśca vīryavān । dhundhumāro dilīpaśca sagaraśca pratāpavān ॥41॥
html:
nṛgo yayātirnahuṣo yaduḥ pūruśca vīryavān ।
dhundhumāro dilīpaśca sagaraśca pratāpavān ॥41॥
slp1: nfgo yayAtirnahuzo yaduH pUruSca vIryavAn । DunDumAro dilIpaSca sagaraSca pratApavAn ॥41॥

text: kṛśāśvo yauvanāśvaśca citrāśvaḥ satyavāṃstathā । duḥṣanto bharataścaiva cakravartī mahāyaśāḥ ॥42॥
html:
kṛśāśvo yauvanāśvaśca citrāśvaḥ satyavāṃstathā ।
duḥṣanto bharataścaiva cakravartī mahāyaśāḥ ॥42॥
slp1: kfSASvo yOvanASvaSca citrASvaH satyavAMstaTA । duHzanto BarataScEva cakravartI mahAyaSAH ॥42॥

text: yavano janakaścaiva tathā dṛḍharatho nṛpaḥ । raghurnaravaraścaiva tathā daśaratho nṛpaḥ ॥43॥
html:
yavano janakaścaiva tathā dṛḍharatho nṛpaḥ ।
raghurnaravaraścaiva tathā daśaratho nṛpaḥ ॥43॥
slp1: yavano janakaScEva taTA dfQaraTo nfpaH । raGurnaravaraScEva taTA daSaraTo nfpaH ॥43॥

text: rāmo rākṣasahā vīraḥ śaśabindurbhagīrathaḥ । hariścandro maruttaśca jahnurjāhnavisevitā ॥44॥
html:
rāmo rākṣasahā vīraḥ śaśabindurbhagīrathaḥ ।
hariścandro maruttaśca jahnurjāhnavisevitā ॥44॥
slp1: rAmo rAkzasahA vIraH SaSabindurBagIraTaH । hariScandro maruttaSca jahnurjAhnavisevitA ॥44॥

text: mahodayo hyalarkaśca ailaścaiva narādhipaḥ । karandhamo naraśreṣṭhaḥ kadhmoraśca narādhipaḥ ॥45॥
html:
mahodayo hyalarkaśca ailaścaiva narādhipaḥ ।
karandhamo naraśreṣṭhaḥ kadhmoraśca narādhipaḥ ॥45॥
slp1: mahodayo hyalarkaSca ElaScEva narADipaH । karanDamo naraSrezWaH kaDmoraSca narADipaH ॥45॥

text: dakṣo'mbarīṣaḥ kukuro ravataśca mahāyaśāḥ । mucukundaśca rājarṣirmitrabhānuḥ priyaṅkaraḥ ॥46॥
html:
dakṣo'mbarīṣaḥ kukuro ravataśca mahāyaśāḥ ।
mucukundaśca rājarṣirmitrabhānuḥ priyaṅkaraḥ ॥46॥
slp1: dakzo'mbarIzaH kukuro ravataSca mahAyaSAH । mucukundaSca rAjarzirmitraBAnuH priyaNkaraH ॥46॥

text: trasadasyustathā rājā śveto rājarṣisattamaḥ । mahābhiṣaśca vikhyāto nimirājastathāṣṭakaḥ ॥47॥
html:
trasadasyustathā rājā śveto rājarṣisattamaḥ ।
mahābhiṣaśca vikhyāto nimirājastathāṣṭakaḥ ॥47॥
slp1: trasadasyustaTA rAjA Sveto rAjarzisattamaH । mahABizaSca viKyAto nimirAjastaTAzwakaH ॥47॥

text: āyuḥ kṣupaśca rājarṣiḥ kakṣeyuśca narādhipaḥ । śibirauśīnaraścaiva gayaścaiva narādhipaḥ ॥48॥
html:
āyuḥ kṣupaśca rājarṣiḥ kakṣeyuśca narādhipaḥ ।
śibirauśīnaraścaiva gayaścaiva narādhipaḥ ॥48॥
slp1: AyuH kzupaSca rAjarziH kakzeyuSca narADipaH । SibirOSInaraScEva gayaScEva narADipaH ॥48॥

text: pratardano divodāsaḥ saudāsaḥ kosaleśvaraḥ । ailo nalaśca rājarṣirmanuścaiva prajāpatiḥ ॥49॥
html:
pratardano divodāsaḥ saudāsaḥ kosaleśvaraḥ ।
ailo nalaśca rājarṣirmanuścaiva prajāpatiḥ ॥49॥
slp1: pratardano divodAsaH sOdAsaH kosaleSvaraH । Elo nalaSca rAjarzirmanuScEva prajApatiH ॥49॥

text: havidhraśca pṛṣadhraśca pratīpaḥ śantanustathā । kakṣasenaśca rājarṣirye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ ॥50॥
html:
havidhraśca pṛṣadhraśca pratīpaḥ śantanustathā ।
kakṣasenaśca rājarṣirye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ ॥50॥
slp1: haviDraSca pfzaDraSca pratIpaH SantanustaTA । kakzasenaSca rAjarzirye cAnye nAnukIrtitAH ॥50॥

text: mā vighnaṃ mā ca me pāpaṃ mā ca me paripanthinaḥ । dhruvo jayo me nityaṃ syātparatra ca parā gatiḥ] ॥51॥
html:
mā vighnaṃ mā ca me pāpaṃ mā ca me paripanthinaḥ ।
dhruvo jayo me nityaṃ syātparatra ca parā gatiḥ] ॥51॥
slp1: mA viGnaM mA ca me pApaM mA ca me paripanTinaH । Druvo jayo me nityaM syAtparatra ca parA gatiH] ॥51॥

text: tūṣṇīmbhūte tadā bhīṣme paṭe citramivārpitam । muhūrtamiva ca dhyātvā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ । nṛpaṃ śayānaṃ gāṅgeyamidamāha vacastadā ॥1॥
html:
tūṣṇīmbhūte tadā bhīṣme paṭe citramivārpitam ।
muhūrtamiva ca dhyātvā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ ।
nṛpaṃ śayānaṃ gāṅgeyamidamāha vacastadā ॥1॥
slp1: tUzRImBUte tadA BIzme pawe citramivArpitam । muhUrtamiva ca DyAtvA vyAsaH satyavatIsutaH । nfpaM SayAnaM gANgeyamidamAha vacastadA ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: rājanprakṛtimāpannaḥ kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । sahito bhrātṛbhiḥ sarvaiḥ pārthivaiścānuyāyibhiḥ ॥2॥
html:
rājanprakṛtimāpannaḥ kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
sahito bhrātṛbhiḥ sarvaiḥ pārthivaiścānuyāyibhiḥ ॥2॥
slp1: rAjanprakftimApannaH kururAjo yuDizWiraH । sahito BrAtfBiH sarvEH pArTivEScAnuyAyiBiH ॥2॥

text: upāste tvāṃ naravyāghra saha kṛṣṇena dhīmatā । tamimaṃ purayānāya tvamanujñātumarhasi ॥3॥
html:
upāste tvāṃ naravyāghra saha kṛṣṇena dhīmatā ।
tamimaṃ purayānāya tvamanujñātumarhasi ॥3॥
slp1: upAste tvAM naravyAGra saha kfzRena DImatA । tamimaM purayAnAya tvamanujYAtumarhasi ॥3॥

text: evamukto bhagavatā vyāsena pṛthivīpatiḥ । yudhiṣṭhiraṃ sahāmātyamanujajñe nadīsutaḥ ॥4॥
html:
evamukto bhagavatā vyāsena pṛthivīpatiḥ ।
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ sahāmātyamanujajñe nadīsutaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: evamukto BagavatA vyAsena pfTivIpatiH । yuDizWiraM sahAmAtyamanujajYe nadIsutaH ॥4॥

text: uvāca cainaṃ madhuraṃ tataḥ śāntanavo nṛpaḥ । praviśasva puraṃ rājanvyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥5॥
html:
uvāca cainaṃ madhuraṃ tataḥ śāntanavo nṛpaḥ ।
praviśasva puraṃ rājanvyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥5॥
slp1: uvAca cEnaM maDuraM tataH SAntanavo nfpaH । praviSasva puraM rAjanvyetu te mAnaso jvaraH ॥5॥

text: yajasva vividhairyajñairbahvannaiḥ svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ । yayātiriva rājendra śraddhādamapuraḥsaraḥ ॥6॥
html:
yajasva vividhairyajñairbahvannaiḥ svāptadakṣiṇaiḥ ।
yayātiriva rājendra śraddhādamapuraḥsaraḥ ॥6॥
slp1: yajasva viviDEryajYErbahvannEH svAptadakziREH । yayAtiriva rAjendra SradDAdamapuraHsaraH ॥6॥

text: kṣatradharmarataḥ pārtha pitṝndevāṃśca tarpaya । śreyasā yokṣyase caiva vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥7॥
html:
kṣatradharmarataḥ pārtha pitṝndevāṃśca tarpaya ।
śreyasā yokṣyase caiva vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥7॥
slp1: kzatraDarmarataH pArTa pitFndevAMSca tarpaya । SreyasA yokzyase cEva vyetu te mAnaso jvaraH ॥7॥

text: rañjayasva prajāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtīḥ parisāntvaya । suhṛdaḥ phalasatkārairabhyarcaya yathārhataḥ ॥8॥
html:
rañjayasva prajāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtīḥ parisāntvaya ।
suhṛdaḥ phalasatkārairabhyarcaya yathārhataḥ ॥8॥
slp1: raYjayasva prajAH sarvAH prakftIH parisAntvaya । suhfdaH PalasatkArEraByarcaya yaTArhataH ॥8॥

text: anu tvāṃ tāta jīvantu mitrāṇi suhṛdastathā । caityasthāne sthitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ phalavantamiva dvijāḥ ॥9॥
html:
anu tvāṃ tāta jīvantu mitrāṇi suhṛdastathā ।
caityasthāne sthitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ phalavantamiva dvijāḥ ॥9॥
slp1: anu tvAM tAta jIvantu mitrARi suhfdastaTA । cEtyasTAne sTitaM vfkzaM Palavantamiva dvijAH ॥9॥

text: āgantavyaṃ ca bhavatā samaye mama pārthiva । vinivṛtte dinakare pravṛtte cottarāyaṇe ॥10॥
html:
āgantavyaṃ ca bhavatā samaye mama pārthiva ।
vinivṛtte dinakare pravṛtte cottarāyaṇe ॥10॥
slp1: AgantavyaM ca BavatA samaye mama pArTiva । vinivftte dinakare pravftte cottarAyaRe ॥10॥
