text: tathetyuktvā tu kaunteyaḥ so'bhivādya pitāmaham । prayayau saparīvāro nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam ॥11॥
html:
tathetyuktvā tu kaunteyaḥ so'bhivādya pitāmaham ।
prayayau saparīvāro nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam ॥11॥
slp1: taTetyuktvA tu kOnteyaH so'BivAdya pitAmaham । prayayO saparIvAro nagaraM nAgasAhvayam ॥11॥

text: dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ puraskṛtya gāndhārīṃ ca pativratām । saha tairṛṣibhiḥ sarvairbhrātṛbhiḥ keśavena ca ॥12॥
html:
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ puraskṛtya gāndhārīṃ ca pativratām ।
saha tairṛṣibhiḥ sarvairbhrātṛbhiḥ keśavena ca ॥12॥
slp1: DftarAzwraM puraskftya gAnDArIM ca pativratAm । saha tErfziBiH sarvErBrAtfBiH keSavena ca ॥12॥

text: paurajānapadaiścaiva mantrivṛddhaiśca pārthivaḥ । praviveśa kuruśreṣṭha puraṃ vāraṇasāhvayam] ॥13॥
html:
paurajānapadaiścaiva mantrivṛddhaiśca pārthivaḥ ।
praviveśa kuruśreṣṭha puraṃ vāraṇasāhvayam] ॥13॥
slp1: pOrajAnapadEScEva mantrivfdDESca pArTivaH । praviveSa kuruSrezWa puraM vAraRasAhvayam] ॥13॥

text: tataḥ kuntīsuto rājā paurajānapadaṃ janam । pūjayitvā yathānyāyamanujajñe gṛhānprati ॥1॥
html:
tataḥ kuntīsuto rājā paurajānapadaṃ janam ।
pūjayitvā yathānyāyamanujajñe gṛhānprati ॥1॥
slp1: tataH kuntIsuto rAjA pOrajAnapadaM janam । pUjayitvA yaTAnyAyamanujajYe gfhAnprati ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: sāntvayāmāsa nārīśca hatavīrā hateśvarāḥ । vipulairarthadānaiśca tadā pāṇḍusuto nṛpaḥ ॥2॥
html:
sāntvayāmāsa nārīśca hatavīrā hateśvarāḥ ।
vipulairarthadānaiśca tadā pāṇḍusuto nṛpaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: sAntvayAmAsa nArISca hatavIrA hateSvarAH । vipulErarTadAnESca tadA pARqusuto nfpaH ॥2॥

text: so'bhiṣikto mahāprājñaḥ prāpya rājyaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । avasthāpya naraśreṣṭhaḥ sarvāḥ svaprakṛtīstadā ॥3॥
html:
so'bhiṣikto mahāprājñaḥ prāpya rājyaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
avasthāpya naraśreṣṭhaḥ sarvāḥ svaprakṛtīstadā ॥3॥
slp1: so'Bizikto mahAprAjYaH prApya rAjyaM yuDizWiraH । avasTApya naraSrezWaH sarvAH svaprakftIstadA ॥3॥

text: dvijebhyo balamukhyebhyo naigamebhyaśca sarvaśaḥ । pratigṛhyāśiṣo mukhyāstadā dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ॥4॥
html:
dvijebhyo balamukhyebhyo naigamebhyaśca sarvaśaḥ ।
pratigṛhyāśiṣo mukhyāstadā dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ॥4॥
slp1: dvijeByo balamuKyeByo nEgameByaSca sarvaSaH । pratigfhyASizo muKyAstadA DarmaBftAM varaH ॥4॥

text: uṣitvā śarvarīḥ śrīmānpañcāśannagarottame । samayaṃ kauravāgryasya sasmāra puruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥5॥
html:
uṣitvā śarvarīḥ śrīmānpañcāśannagarottame ।
samayaṃ kauravāgryasya sasmāra puruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥5॥
slp1: uzitvA SarvarIH SrImAnpaYcASannagarottame । samayaM kOravAgryasya sasmAra puruzarzaBaH ॥5॥

text: sa niryayau gajapurādyājakaiḥ parivāritaḥ । dṛṣṭvā nivṛttamādityaṃ pravṛttaṃ cottarāyaṇam ॥6॥
html:
sa niryayau gajapurādyājakaiḥ parivāritaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā nivṛttamādityaṃ pravṛttaṃ cottarāyaṇam ॥6॥
slp1: sa niryayO gajapurAdyAjakEH parivAritaH । dfzwvA nivfttamAdityaM pravfttaM cottarAyaRam ॥6॥

text: ghṛtaṃ mālyaṃ ca gandhāṃśca kṣaumāṇi ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । candanāgarumukhyāni tathā kālāgarūṇi ca ॥7॥
html:
ghṛtaṃ mālyaṃ ca gandhāṃśca kṣaumāṇi ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
candanāgarumukhyāni tathā kālāgarūṇi ca ॥7॥
slp1: GftaM mAlyaM ca ganDAMSca kzOmARi ca yuDizWiraH । candanAgarumuKyAni taTA kAlAgarURi ca ॥7॥

text: prasthāpya pūrvaṃ kaunteyo bhīṣmasaṃsādhanāya vai । mālyāni ca mahārhāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥8॥
html:
prasthāpya pūrvaṃ kaunteyo bhīṣmasaṃsādhanāya vai ।
mālyāni ca mahārhāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥8॥
slp1: prasTApya pUrvaM kOnteyo BIzmasaMsADanAya vE । mAlyAni ca mahArhARi ratnAni viviDAni ca ॥8॥

text: dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ puraskṛtya gāndhārīṃ ca yaśasvinīm । mātaraṃ ca pṛthāṃ dhīmānbhrātṝṃśca puruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥9॥
html:
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ puraskṛtya gāndhārīṃ ca yaśasvinīm ।
mātaraṃ ca pṛthāṃ dhīmānbhrātṝṃśca puruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥9॥
slp1: DftarAzwraM puraskftya gAnDArIM ca yaSasvinIm । mAtaraM ca pfTAM DImAnBrAtFMSca puruzarzaBaH ॥9॥

text: janārdanenānugato vidureṇa ca dhīmatā । yuyutsunā ca kauravyo yuyudhānena cābhibho ॥10॥
html:
janārdanenānugato vidureṇa ca dhīmatā ।
yuyutsunā ca kauravyo yuyudhānena cābhibho ॥10॥
slp1: janArdanenAnugato vidureRa ca DImatA । yuyutsunA ca kOravyo yuyuDAnena cABiBo ॥10॥

text: mahatā rājabhogyena paribarheṇa saṃvṛtaḥ । stūyamāno mahārāja bhīṣmasyāgnīnanuvrajan ॥11॥
html:
mahatā rājabhogyena paribarheṇa saṃvṛtaḥ ।
stūyamāno mahārāja bhīṣmasyāgnīnanuvrajan ॥11॥
slp1: mahatA rAjaBogyena paribarheRa saMvftaH । stUyamAno mahArAja BIzmasyAgnInanuvrajan ॥11॥

text: niścakrāma purāttasmādyathā devapatistathā । āsasāda kurukṣetre tataḥ śāntanavaṃ nṛpam ॥12॥
html:
niścakrāma purāttasmādyathā devapatistathā ।
āsasāda kurukṣetre tataḥ śāntanavaṃ nṛpam ॥12॥
slp1: niScakrAma purAttasmAdyaTA devapatistaTA । AsasAda kurukzetre tataH SAntanavaM nfpam ॥12॥

text: upāsyamānaṃ vyāsena pārāśaryeṇa dhīmatā । nāradena ca rājarṣe devalenāsitena ca ॥13॥
html:
upāsyamānaṃ vyāsena pārāśaryeṇa dhīmatā ।
nāradena ca rājarṣe devalenāsitena ca ॥13॥
slp1: upAsyamAnaM vyAsena pArASaryeRa DImatA । nAradena ca rAjarze devalenAsitena ca ॥13॥

text: hataśiṣṭairnṛpaiścānyairnānādeśasamāgataiḥ । rakṣibhiśca mahātmānaṃ rakṣyamāṇaṃ samantataḥ ॥14॥
html:
hataśiṣṭairnṛpaiścānyairnānādeśasamāgataiḥ ।
rakṣibhiśca mahātmānaṃ rakṣyamāṇaṃ samantataḥ ॥14॥
slp1: hataSizwErnfpEScAnyErnAnAdeSasamAgatEH । rakziBiSca mahAtmAnaM rakzyamARaM samantataH ॥14॥

text: śayānaṃ vīraśayane dadarśa nṛpatistataḥ । tato rathādavārohadbhrātṛbhiḥ saha dharmarāṭ ॥15॥
html:
śayānaṃ vīraśayane dadarśa nṛpatistataḥ ।
tato rathādavārohadbhrātṛbhiḥ saha dharmarāṭ ॥15॥
slp1: SayAnaM vIraSayane dadarSa nfpatistataH । tato raTAdavArohadBrAtfBiH saha DarmarAw ॥15॥

text: abhivādyātha kaunteyaḥ pitāmahamarindamam । dvaipāyanādīnviprāṃśca taiśca pratyabhinanditaḥ ॥16॥
html:
abhivādyātha kaunteyaḥ pitāmahamarindamam ।
dvaipāyanādīnviprāṃśca taiśca pratyabhinanditaḥ ॥16॥
slp1: aBivAdyATa kOnteyaH pitAmahamarindamam । dvEpAyanAdInviprAMSca tESca pratyaBinanditaH ॥16॥

text: ṛtvigbhirbrahmakalpaiśca bhrātṛbhiśca sahācyutaḥ । āsādya śaratalpasthamṛṣibhiḥ parivāritam ॥17॥
html:
ṛtvigbhirbrahmakalpaiśca bhrātṛbhiśca sahācyutaḥ ।
āsādya śaratalpasthamṛṣibhiḥ parivāritam ॥17॥
slp1: ftvigBirbrahmakalpESca BrAtfBiSca sahAcyutaH । AsAdya SaratalpasTamfziBiH parivAritam ॥17॥

text: abravīdbharataśreṣṭhaṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ । bhrātṛbhiḥ saha kauravya śayānaṃ nimnagāsutam ॥18॥
html:
abravīdbharataśreṣṭhaṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।
bhrātṛbhiḥ saha kauravya śayānaṃ nimnagāsutam ॥18॥
slp1: abravIdBarataSrezWaM DarmarAjo yuDizWiraH । BrAtfBiH saha kOravya SayAnaM nimnagAsutam ॥18॥

text: yudhiṣṭhiro'haṃ nṛpate namaste jāhnavīsuta । śṛṇoṣi cenmahābāho brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ॥19॥
html:
yudhiṣṭhiro'haṃ nṛpate namaste jāhnavīsuta ।
śṛṇoṣi cenmahābāho brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ॥19॥
slp1: yuDizWiro'haM nfpate namaste jAhnavIsuta । SfRozi cenmahAbAho brUhi kiM karavARi te ॥19॥

text: prāpto'smi samaye rājannagnīnādāya te vibho । ācāryā brāhmaṇāścaiva ṛtvijo bhrātaraśca me ॥20॥
html:
prāpto'smi samaye rājannagnīnādāya te vibho ।
ācāryā brāhmaṇāścaiva ṛtvijo bhrātaraśca me ॥20॥
slp1: prApto'smi samaye rAjannagnInAdAya te viBo । AcAryA brAhmaRAScEva ftvijo BrAtaraSca me ॥20॥

text: putraśca te mahātejā dhṛtarāṣṭro janeśvaraḥ । upasthitaḥ sahāmātyo vāsudevaśca vīryavān ॥21॥
html:
putraśca te mahātejā dhṛtarāṣṭro janeśvaraḥ ।
upasthitaḥ sahāmātyo vāsudevaśca vīryavān ॥21॥
slp1: putraSca te mahAtejA DftarAzwro janeSvaraH । upasTitaH sahAmAtyo vAsudevaSca vIryavAn ॥21॥

text: hataśiṣṭāśca rājānaḥ sarve ca kurujāṅgalāḥ । tānpaśya kuruśārdūla samunmīlaya locane ॥22॥
html:
hataśiṣṭāśca rājānaḥ sarve ca kurujāṅgalāḥ ।
tānpaśya kuruśārdūla samunmīlaya locane ॥22॥
slp1: hataSizwASca rAjAnaH sarve ca kurujANgalAH । tAnpaSya kuruSArdUla samunmIlaya locane ॥22॥

text: yacceha kiñcitkartavyaṃ tatsarvaṃ prāpitaṃ mayā । yathoktaṃ bhavatā kāle sarvameva ca tatkṛtam ॥23॥
html:
yacceha kiñcitkartavyaṃ tatsarvaṃ prāpitaṃ mayā ।
yathoktaṃ bhavatā kāle sarvameva ca tatkṛtam ॥23॥
slp1: yacceha kiYcitkartavyaM tatsarvaM prApitaM mayA । yaToktaM BavatA kAle sarvameva ca tatkftam ॥23॥

text: evamuktastu gāṅgeyaḥ kuntīputreṇa dhīmatā । dadarśa bhāratānsarvānsthitānsamparivārya tam ॥24॥
html:
evamuktastu gāṅgeyaḥ kuntīputreṇa dhīmatā ।
dadarśa bhāratānsarvānsthitānsamparivārya tam ॥24॥
slp1: evamuktastu gANgeyaH kuntIputreRa DImatA । dadarSa BAratAnsarvAnsTitAnsamparivArya tam ॥24॥

text: tataścalavalirbhīṣmaḥ pragṛhya vipulaṃ bhujam । oghameghasvano vāgmī kāle vacanamabravīt ॥25॥
html:
tataścalavalirbhīṣmaḥ pragṛhya vipulaṃ bhujam ।
oghameghasvano vāgmī kāle vacanamabravīt ॥25॥
slp1: tataScalavalirBIzmaH pragfhya vipulaM Bujam । oGameGasvano vAgmI kAle vacanamabravIt ॥25॥

text: diṣṭyā prāpto'si kaunteya sahāmātyo yudhiṣṭhira । parivṛtto hi bhagavānsahasrāṃśurdivākaraḥ ॥26॥
html:
diṣṭyā prāpto'si kaunteya sahāmātyo yudhiṣṭhira ।
parivṛtto hi bhagavānsahasrāṃśurdivākaraḥ ॥26॥
slp1: dizwyA prApto'si kOnteya sahAmAtyo yuDizWira । parivftto hi BagavAnsahasrAMSurdivAkaraH ॥26॥

text: aṣṭapañcāśataṃ rātryaḥ śayānasyādya me gatāḥ । śareṣu niśitāgreṣu yathā varṣaśataṃ tathā ॥27॥
html:
aṣṭapañcāśataṃ rātryaḥ śayānasyādya me gatāḥ ।
śareṣu niśitāgreṣu yathā varṣaśataṃ tathā ॥27॥
slp1: azwapaYcASataM rAtryaH SayAnasyAdya me gatAH । Sarezu niSitAgrezu yaTA varzaSataM taTA ॥27॥

text: māgho'yaṃ samanuprāpto māsaḥ puṇyo yudhiṣṭhira । tribhāgaśeṣaḥ pakṣo'yaṃ śuklo bhavitumarhati ॥28॥
html:
māgho'yaṃ samanuprāpto māsaḥ puṇyo yudhiṣṭhira ।
tribhāgaśeṣaḥ pakṣo'yaṃ śuklo bhavitumarhati ॥28॥
slp1: mAGo'yaM samanuprApto mAsaH puRyo yuDizWira । triBAgaSezaH pakzo'yaM Suklo Bavitumarhati ॥28॥

text: evamuktvā tu gāṅgeyo dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram । dhṛtarāṣṭramathāmantrya kāle vacanamabravīt ॥29॥
html:
evamuktvā tu gāṅgeyo dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram ।
dhṛtarāṣṭramathāmantrya kāle vacanamabravīt ॥29॥
slp1: evamuktvA tu gANgeyo DarmaputraM yuDizWiram । DftarAzwramaTAmantrya kAle vacanamabravIt ॥29॥

text: rājanviditadharmo'si sunirṇītārthasaṃśayaḥ । bahuśrutā hi te viprā bahavaḥ paryupāsitāḥ ॥30॥
html:
rājanviditadharmo'si sunirṇītārthasaṃśayaḥ ।
bahuśrutā hi te viprā bahavaḥ paryupāsitāḥ ॥30॥
slp1: rAjanviditaDarmo'si sunirRItArTasaMSayaH । bahuSrutA hi te viprA bahavaH paryupAsitAH ॥30॥

text: vedaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi dharmāṃśca manujeśvara । vedāṃśca caturaḥ sāṅgānnikhilenāvabudhyase ॥31॥
html:
vedaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi dharmāṃśca manujeśvara ।
vedāṃśca caturaḥ sāṅgānnikhilenāvabudhyase ॥31॥
slp1: vedaSAstrARi sarvARi DarmAMSca manujeSvara । vedAMSca caturaH sANgAnniKilenAvabuDyase ॥31॥

text: na śocitavyaṃ kauravya bhavitavyaṃ hi tattathā । śrutaṃ devarahasyaṃ te kṛṣṇadvaipāyanādapi ॥32॥
html:
na śocitavyaṃ kauravya bhavitavyaṃ hi tattathā ।
śrutaṃ devarahasyaṃ te kṛṣṇadvaipāyanādapi ॥32॥
slp1: na SocitavyaM kOravya BavitavyaM hi tattaTA । SrutaM devarahasyaM te kfzRadvEpAyanAdapi ॥32॥

text: yathā pāṇḍoḥ sutā rājaṃstathaiva tava dharmataḥ । tānpālaya sthito dharme guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratān ॥33॥
html:
yathā pāṇḍoḥ sutā rājaṃstathaiva tava dharmataḥ ।
tānpālaya sthito dharme guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratān ॥33॥
slp1: yaTA pARqoH sutA rAjaMstaTEva tava DarmataH । tAnpAlaya sTito Darme guruSuSrUzaRe ratAn ॥33॥

text: dharmarājo hi śuddhātmā nideśe sthāsyate tava । ānṛśaṃsyaparaṃ hyenaṃ jānāmi guruvatsalam ॥34॥
html:
dharmarājo hi śuddhātmā nideśe sthāsyate tava ।
ānṛśaṃsyaparaṃ hyenaṃ jānāmi guruvatsalam ॥34॥
slp1: DarmarAjo hi SudDAtmA nideSe sTAsyate tava । AnfSaMsyaparaM hyenaM jAnAmi guruvatsalam ॥34॥

text: tava putrā durātmānaḥ krodhalobhaparāyaṇāḥ । īrṣyābhibhūtā durvṛttāstānna śocitumarhasi ॥35॥
html:
tava putrā durātmānaḥ krodhalobhaparāyaṇāḥ ।
īrṣyābhibhūtā durvṛttāstānna śocitumarhasi ॥35॥
slp1: tava putrA durAtmAnaH kroDaloBaparAyaRAH । IrzyABiBUtA durvfttAstAnna Socitumarhasi ॥35॥

text: etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ manīṣiṇam । vāsudevaṃ mahābāhumabhyabhāṣata kauravaḥ ॥36॥
html:
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ manīṣiṇam ।
vāsudevaṃ mahābāhumabhyabhāṣata kauravaḥ ॥36॥
slp1: etAvaduktvA vacanaM DftarAzwraM manIziRam । vAsudevaM mahAbAhumaByaBAzata kOravaH ॥36॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: bhagavandevadeveśa surāsuranamaskṛta । trivikrama namaste'stu śaṅkhacakragadādhara ॥37॥
html:
bhagavandevadeveśa surāsuranamaskṛta ।
trivikrama namaste'stu śaṅkhacakragadādhara ॥37॥
slp1: BagavandevadeveSa surAsuranamaskfta । trivikrama namaste'stu SaNKacakragadADara ॥37॥

text: anujānīhi māṃ kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama । rakṣyāśca te pāṇḍaveyā bhavānhyeṣāṃ parāyaṇam ॥38॥
html:
anujānīhi māṃ kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama ।
rakṣyāśca te pāṇḍaveyā bhavānhyeṣāṃ parāyaṇam ॥38॥
slp1: anujAnIhi mAM kfzRa vEkuRWa puruzottama । rakzyASca te pARqaveyA BavAnhyezAM parAyaRam ॥38॥

text: uktavānasmi durbuddhiṃ mandaṃ duryodhanaṃ purā । yataḥ kṛṣṇastato dharmo yato dharmastato jayaḥ ॥39॥
html:
uktavānasmi durbuddhiṃ mandaṃ duryodhanaṃ purā ।
yataḥ kṛṣṇastato dharmo yato dharmastato jayaḥ ॥39॥
slp1: uktavAnasmi durbudDiM mandaM duryoDanaM purA । yataH kfzRastato Darmo yato Darmastato jayaH ॥39॥

text: vāsudevena tīrthena putra saṃśāmya pāṇḍavaiḥ । sandhānasya paraḥ kālastaveti ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥40॥
html:
vāsudevena tīrthena putra saṃśāmya pāṇḍavaiḥ ।
sandhānasya paraḥ kālastaveti ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥40॥
slp1: vAsudevena tIrTena putra saMSAmya pARqavEH । sanDAnasya paraH kAlastaveti ca punaH punaH ॥40॥

text: na ca me tadvaco mūḍhaḥ kṛtavānsa sumandadhīḥ । ghātayitveha pṛthivīṃ tataḥ sa nidhanaṃ gataḥ ॥41॥
html:
na ca me tadvaco mūḍhaḥ kṛtavānsa sumandadhīḥ ।
ghātayitveha pṛthivīṃ tataḥ sa nidhanaṃ gataḥ ॥41॥
slp1: na ca me tadvaco mUQaH kftavAnsa sumandaDIH । GAtayitveha pfTivIM tataH sa niDanaM gataH ॥41॥

text: tvāṃ ca jānāmyahaṃ vīra purāṇamṛṣisattamam । nareṇa sahitaṃ devaṃ badaryāṃ suciroṣitam ॥42॥
html:
tvāṃ ca jānāmyahaṃ vīra purāṇamṛṣisattamam ।
nareṇa sahitaṃ devaṃ badaryāṃ suciroṣitam ॥42॥
slp1: tvAM ca jAnAmyahaM vIra purARamfzisattamam । nareRa sahitaM devaM badaryAM sucirozitam ॥42॥

text: tathā me nāradaḥ prāha vyāsaśca sumahātapāḥ । naranārāyaṇāvetau sambhūtau manujeṣviti ॥43॥
html:
tathā me nāradaḥ prāha vyāsaśca sumahātapāḥ ।
naranārāyaṇāvetau sambhūtau manujeṣviti ॥43॥
slp1: taTA me nAradaH prAha vyAsaSca sumahAtapAH । naranArAyaRAvetO samBUtO manujezviti ॥43॥

text: anujānāmi bhīṣma tvāṃ vasūnāpnuhi pārthiva । na te'sti vṛjinaṃ kiñcinmayā dṛṣṭaṃ mahādyute ॥44॥
html:
anujānāmi bhīṣma tvāṃ vasūnāpnuhi pārthiva ।
na te'sti vṛjinaṃ kiñcinmayā dṛṣṭaṃ mahādyute ॥44॥
slp1: anujAnAmi BIzma tvAM vasUnApnuhi pArTiva । na te'sti vfjinaM kiYcinmayA dfzwaM mahAdyute ॥44॥
author: vāsudeva uvāca ।

text: pitṛbhakto'si rājarṣe mārkaṇḍeya ivāparaḥ । tena mṛtyustava vaśe sthito bhṛtya ivānataḥ ॥45॥
html:
pitṛbhakto'si rājarṣe mārkaṇḍeya ivāparaḥ ।
tena mṛtyustava vaśe sthito bhṛtya ivānataḥ ॥45॥
slp1: pitfBakto'si rAjarze mArkaRqeya ivAparaH । tena mftyustava vaSe sTito Bftya ivAnataH ॥45॥

text: evamuktastu gāṅgeyaḥ pāṇḍavānidamabravīt । dhṛtarāṣṭramukhāṃścāpi sarvānsasuhṛdastathā ॥46॥
html:
evamuktastu gāṅgeyaḥ pāṇḍavānidamabravīt ।
dhṛtarāṣṭramukhāṃścāpi sarvānsasuhṛdastathā ॥46॥
slp1: evamuktastu gANgeyaH pARqavAnidamabravIt । DftarAzwramuKAMScApi sarvAnsasuhfdastaTA ॥46॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: prāṇānutsraṣṭumicchāmi tanmānujñātumarhatha । satye prayatitavyaṃ vaḥ satyaṃ hi paramaṃ balam ॥47॥
html:
prāṇānutsraṣṭumicchāmi tanmānujñātumarhatha ।
satye prayatitavyaṃ vaḥ satyaṃ hi paramaṃ balam ॥47॥
slp1: prARAnutsrazwumicCAmi tanmAnujYAtumarhaTa । satye prayatitavyaM vaH satyaM hi paramaM balam ॥47॥

text: ānṛśaṃsyaparairbhāvyaṃ sadaiva niyatātmabhiḥ । brahmaṇyairdharmaśīlaiśca taponītyaiśca bhārata ॥48॥
html:
ānṛśaṃsyaparairbhāvyaṃ sadaiva niyatātmabhiḥ ।
brahmaṇyairdharmaśīlaiśca taponītyaiśca bhārata ॥48॥
slp1: AnfSaMsyaparErBAvyaM sadEva niyatAtmaBiH । brahmaRyErDarmaSIlESca taponItyESca BArata ॥48॥

text: ityuktvā suhṛdaḥ sarvānsampariṣvajya caiva ha । punarevābravīddhīmānyudhiṣṭhiramidaṃ vacaḥ ॥49॥
html:
ityuktvā suhṛdaḥ sarvānsampariṣvajya caiva ha ।
punarevābravīddhīmānyudhiṣṭhiramidaṃ vacaḥ ॥49॥
slp1: ityuktvA suhfdaH sarvAnsamparizvajya cEva ha । punarevAbravIdDImAnyuDizWiramidaM vacaH ॥49॥

text: brāhmaṇāścaiva te nityaṃ prājñāścaiva viśeṣataḥ । ācāryā ṛtvijaścaiva pūjanīyā narādhipa] ॥50॥
html:
brāhmaṇāścaiva te nityaṃ prājñāścaiva viśeṣataḥ ।
ācāryā ṛtvijaścaiva pūjanīyā narādhipa] ॥50॥
slp1: brAhmaRAScEva te nityaM prAjYAScEva viSezataH । AcAryA ftvijaScEva pUjanIyA narADipa] ॥50॥

text: evamuktvā kurūnsarvānbhīṣmaḥ śāntanavastadā । tūṣṇīṃ babhūva kauravyaḥ sa muhūrtamarindama ॥1॥
html:
evamuktvā kurūnsarvānbhīṣmaḥ śāntanavastadā ।
tūṣṇīṃ babhūva kauravyaḥ sa muhūrtamarindama ॥1॥
slp1: evamuktvA kurUnsarvAnBIzmaH SAntanavastadA । tUzRIM baBUva kOravyaH sa muhUrtamarindama ॥1॥
author: vaiśampāyana uvāca ।

text: dhārayāmāsa cātmānaṃ dhāraṇāsu yathākramam । tasyordhvamagamanprāṇāḥ sanniruddhā mahātmanaḥ ॥2॥
html:
dhārayāmāsa cātmānaṃ dhāraṇāsu yathākramam ।
tasyordhvamagamanprāṇāḥ sanniruddhā mahātmanaḥ ॥2॥
slp1: DArayAmAsa cAtmAnaM DAraRAsu yaTAkramam । tasyorDvamagamanprARAH sannirudDA mahAtmanaH ॥2॥

text: idamāścaryamāsīcca madhye teṣāṃ mahātmanām । yadyanmuñcati gātrāṇāṃ sa śantanusutastadā । tattadviśalyaṃ bhavati yogayuktasya tasya vai ॥3॥
html:
idamāścaryamāsīcca madhye teṣāṃ mahātmanām ।
yadyanmuñcati gātrāṇāṃ sa śantanusutastadā ।
tattadviśalyaṃ bhavati yogayuktasya tasya vai ॥3॥
slp1: idamAScaryamAsIcca maDye tezAM mahAtmanAm । yadyanmuYcati gAtrARAM sa SantanusutastadA । tattadviSalyaM Bavati yogayuktasya tasya vE ॥3॥

text: kṣaṇena prekṣatāṃ teṣāṃ viśalyaḥ so'bhavattadā । taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve vāsudevapurogamāḥ । saha tairmunibhiḥ sarvaistadā vyāsādibhirnṛpa ॥4॥
html:
kṣaṇena prekṣatāṃ teṣāṃ viśalyaḥ so'bhavattadā ।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve vāsudevapurogamāḥ ।
saha tairmunibhiḥ sarvaistadā vyāsādibhirnṛpa ॥4॥
slp1: kzaRena prekzatAM tezAM viSalyaH so'BavattadA । taM dfzwvA vismitAH sarve vAsudevapurogamAH । saha tErmuniBiH sarvEstadA vyAsAdiBirnfpa ॥4॥

text: sanniruddhastu tenātmā sarveṣvāyataneṣu vai । jagāma bhittvā mūrdhānaṃ divamabhyutpapāta ca ॥5॥
html:
sanniruddhastu tenātmā sarveṣvāyataneṣu vai ।
jagāma bhittvā mūrdhānaṃ divamabhyutpapāta ca ॥5॥
slp1: sannirudDastu tenAtmA sarvezvAyatanezu vE । jagAma BittvA mUrDAnaM divamaByutpapAta ca ॥5॥

text: maholkeva ca bhīṣmasya mūrdhadeśājjanādhipa । niḥsṛtyākāśamāviśya kṣaṇenāntaradhīyata ॥6॥
html:
maholkeva ca bhīṣmasya mūrdhadeśājjanādhipa ।
niḥsṛtyākāśamāviśya kṣaṇenāntaradhīyata ॥6॥
slp1: maholkeva ca BIzmasya mUrDadeSAjjanADipa । niHsftyAkASamAviSya kzaRenAntaraDIyata ॥6॥

text: evaṃ sa nṛpaśārdūla nṛpaḥ śāntanavastadā । samayujyata lokaiḥ svairbharatānāṃ kulodvahaḥ ॥7॥
html:
evaṃ sa nṛpaśārdūla nṛpaḥ śāntanavastadā ।
samayujyata lokaiḥ svairbharatānāṃ kulodvahaḥ ॥7॥
slp1: evaM sa nfpaSArdUla nfpaH SAntanavastadA । samayujyata lokEH svErBaratAnAM kulodvahaH ॥7॥

text: tatastvādāya dārūṇi gandhāṃśca vividhānbahūn । citāṃ cakrurmahātmānaḥ pāṇḍavā vidurastathā । yuyutsuścāpi kauravyaḥ prekṣakāstvitare'bhavan ॥8॥
html:
tatastvādāya dārūṇi gandhāṃśca vividhānbahūn ।
citāṃ cakrurmahātmānaḥ pāṇḍavā vidurastathā ।
yuyutsuścāpi kauravyaḥ prekṣakāstvitare'bhavan ॥8॥
slp1: tatastvAdAya dArURi ganDAMSca viviDAnbahUn । citAM cakrurmahAtmAnaH pARqavA vidurastaTA । yuyutsuScApi kOravyaH prekzakAstvitare'Bavan ॥8॥

text: yudhiṣṭhirastu gāṅgeyaṃ viduraśca mahāmatiḥ । chādayāmāsaturubhau kṣaumairmālyaiśca kauravam ॥9॥
html:
yudhiṣṭhirastu gāṅgeyaṃ viduraśca mahāmatiḥ ।
chādayāmāsaturubhau kṣaumairmālyaiśca kauravam ॥9॥
slp1: yuDizWirastu gANgeyaM viduraSca mahAmatiH । CAdayAmAsaturuBO kzOmErmAlyESca kOravam ॥9॥

text: dhārayāmāsa tasyātha yuyutsuśchatramuttamam । cāmaravyajane śubhre bhīmasenārjunāvubhau । uṣṇīṣe paryagṛhṇītāṃ mādrīputrāvubhau tadā ॥10॥
html:
dhārayāmāsa tasyātha yuyutsuśchatramuttamam ।
cāmaravyajane śubhre bhīmasenārjunāvubhau ।
uṣṇīṣe paryagṛhṇītāṃ mādrīputrāvubhau tadā ॥10॥
slp1: DArayAmAsa tasyATa yuyutsuSCatramuttamam । cAmaravyajane SuBre BImasenArjunAvuBO । uzRIze paryagfhRItAM mAdrIputrAvuBO tadA ॥10॥

text: striyaḥ kauravanāthasya bhīṣmaṃ kurukulodbhavam । tālavṛntānyupādāya paryavījansamantataḥ ॥11॥
html:
striyaḥ kauravanāthasya bhīṣmaṃ kurukulodbhavam ।
tālavṛntānyupādāya paryavījansamantataḥ ॥11॥
slp1: striyaH kOravanATasya BIzmaM kurukulodBavam । tAlavfntAnyupAdAya paryavIjansamantataH ॥11॥

text: tato'sya vidhivaccakruḥ pitṛmedhaṃ mahātmanaḥ । yājakā juhuvuścāgniṃ jaguḥ sāmāni sāmagāḥ ॥12॥
html:
tato'sya vidhivaccakruḥ pitṛmedhaṃ mahātmanaḥ ।
yājakā juhuvuścāgniṃ jaguḥ sāmāni sāmagāḥ ॥12॥
slp1: tato'sya viDivaccakruH pitfmeDaM mahAtmanaH । yAjakA juhuvuScAgniM jaguH sAmAni sAmagAH ॥12॥

text: tataścandanakāṣṭhaiśca tathā kāleyakairapi । kālāgaruprabhṛtibhirgandhaiścoccāvacaistathā ॥13॥
html:
tataścandanakāṣṭhaiśca tathā kāleyakairapi ।
kālāgaruprabhṛtibhirgandhaiścoccāvacaistathā ॥13॥
slp1: tataScandanakAzWESca taTA kAleyakErapi । kAlAgarupraBftiBirganDEScoccAvacEstaTA ॥13॥

text: samavacchādya gāṅgeyaṃ prajvālya ca hutāśanam । apasavyamakurvanta dhṛtarāṣṭramukhā nṛpāḥ ॥14॥
html:
samavacchādya gāṅgeyaṃ prajvālya ca hutāśanam ।
apasavyamakurvanta dhṛtarāṣṭramukhā nṛpāḥ ॥14॥
slp1: samavacCAdya gANgeyaM prajvAlya ca hutASanam । apasavyamakurvanta DftarAzwramuKA nfpAH ॥14॥

text: saṃskṛtya ca kuruśreṣṭhaṃ gāṅgeyaṃ kurusattamāḥ । jagmurbhāgīrathītīramṛṣijuṣṭaṃ kurūdvahāḥ ॥15॥
html:
saṃskṛtya ca kuruśreṣṭhaṃ gāṅgeyaṃ kurusattamāḥ ।
jagmurbhāgīrathītīramṛṣijuṣṭaṃ kurūdvahāḥ ॥15॥
slp1: saMskftya ca kuruSrezWaM gANgeyaM kurusattamAH । jagmurBAgIraTItIramfzijuzwaM kurUdvahAH ॥15॥

text: anugamyamānā vyāsena nāradenāsitena ca । kṛṣṇena bharatastrībhirye ca paurāḥ samāgatāḥ ॥16॥
html:
anugamyamānā vyāsena nāradenāsitena ca ।
kṛṣṇena bharatastrībhirye ca paurāḥ samāgatāḥ ॥16॥
slp1: anugamyamAnA vyAsena nAradenAsitena ca । kfzRena BaratastrIBirye ca pOrAH samAgatAH ॥16॥

text: udakaṃ cakrire caiva gāṅgeyasya mahātmanaḥ । vidhivatkṣatriyaśreṣṭhāḥ sa ca sarvo janastadā ॥17॥
html:
udakaṃ cakrire caiva gāṅgeyasya mahātmanaḥ ।
vidhivatkṣatriyaśreṣṭhāḥ sa ca sarvo janastadā ॥17॥
slp1: udakaM cakrire cEva gANgeyasya mahAtmanaH । viDivatkzatriyaSrezWAH sa ca sarvo janastadA ॥17॥

text: tato bhāgīrathī devī tanayasyodake kṛte । utthāya salilāttasmādrudatī śokalālasā ॥18॥
html:
tato bhāgīrathī devī tanayasyodake kṛte ।
utthāya salilāttasmādrudatī śokalālasā ॥18॥
slp1: tato BAgIraTI devI tanayasyodake kfte । utTAya salilAttasmAdrudatI SokalAlasA ॥18॥

text: paridevayatī tatra kauravānabhyabhāṣata । nibodhata yathāvṛttamucyamānaṃ mayānaghāḥ ॥19॥
html:
paridevayatī tatra kauravānabhyabhāṣata ।
nibodhata yathāvṛttamucyamānaṃ mayānaghāḥ ॥19॥
slp1: paridevayatI tatra kOravAnaByaBAzata । niboData yaTAvfttamucyamAnaM mayAnaGAH ॥19॥

text: rājavṛttena sampannaḥ prajñayābhijanena ca । satkartā kuruvṛddhānāṃ pitṛbhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ ॥20॥
html:
rājavṛttena sampannaḥ prajñayābhijanena ca ।
satkartā kuruvṛddhānāṃ pitṛbhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ ॥20॥
slp1: rAjavfttena sampannaH prajYayABijanena ca । satkartA kuruvfdDAnAM pitfBakto dfQavrataH ॥20॥

text: jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa purā yo na parājitaḥ । divyairastrairmahāvīryaḥ sa hato'dya śikhaṇḍinā ॥21॥
html:
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa purā yo na parājitaḥ ।
divyairastrairmahāvīryaḥ sa hato'dya śikhaṇḍinā ॥21॥
slp1: jAmadagnyena rAmeRa purA yo na parAjitaH । divyErastrErmahAvIryaH sa hato'dya SiKaRqinA ॥21॥

text: aśmasāramayaṃ nūnaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama pārthivāḥ । apaśyantyāḥ priyaṃ putraṃ yatra dīryati me'dya vai ॥22॥
html:
aśmasāramayaṃ nūnaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama pārthivāḥ ।
apaśyantyāḥ priyaṃ putraṃ yatra dīryati me'dya vai ॥22॥
slp1: aSmasAramayaM nUnaM hfdayaM mama pArTivAH । apaSyantyAH priyaM putraM yatra dIryati me'dya vE ॥22॥

text: sametaṃ pārthivaṃ kṣatraṃ kāśipuryāṃ svayaṃvare । vijityaikarathenājau kanyāstā yo jahāra ha ॥23॥
html:
sametaṃ pārthivaṃ kṣatraṃ kāśipuryāṃ svayaṃvare ।
vijityaikarathenājau kanyāstā yo jahāra ha ॥23॥
slp1: sametaM pArTivaM kzatraM kASipuryAM svayaMvare । vijityEkaraTenAjO kanyAstA yo jahAra ha ॥23॥

text: yasya nāsti bale tulyaḥ pṛthivyāmapi kaścana । hataṃ śikhaṇḍinā śrutvā yanna dīryati me manaḥ ॥24॥
html:
yasya nāsti bale tulyaḥ pṛthivyāmapi kaścana ।
hataṃ śikhaṇḍinā śrutvā yanna dīryati me manaḥ ॥24॥
slp1: yasya nAsti bale tulyaH pfTivyAmapi kaScana । hataM SiKaRqinA SrutvA yanna dIryati me manaH ॥24॥

text: jāmadagnyaḥ kurukṣetre yudhi yena mahātmanā । pīḍito nātiyatnena nihataḥ sa śikhaṇḍinā ॥25॥
html:
jāmadagnyaḥ kurukṣetre yudhi yena mahātmanā ।
pīḍito nātiyatnena nihataḥ sa śikhaṇḍinā ॥25॥
slp1: jAmadagnyaH kurukzetre yuDi yena mahAtmanA । pIqito nAtiyatnena nihataH sa SiKaRqinA ॥25॥

text: evaṃvidhaṃ bahu tadā vilapantīṃ mahānadīm । āśvāsayāmāsa tadā sāmnā dāmodaro vibhuḥ ॥26॥
html:
evaṃvidhaṃ bahu tadā vilapantīṃ mahānadīm ।
āśvāsayāmāsa tadā sāmnā dāmodaro vibhuḥ ॥26॥
slp1: evaMviDaM bahu tadA vilapantIM mahAnadIm । ASvAsayAmAsa tadA sAmnA dAmodaro viBuH ॥26॥

text: samāśvasihi bhadre tvaṃ mā śucaḥ śubhadarśane । gataḥ sa paramāṃ siddhiṃ tava putro na saṃśayaḥ ॥27॥
html:
samāśvasihi bhadre tvaṃ mā śucaḥ śubhadarśane ।
gataḥ sa paramāṃ siddhiṃ tava putro na saṃśayaḥ ॥27॥
slp1: samASvasihi Badre tvaM mA SucaH SuBadarSane । gataH sa paramAM sidDiM tava putro na saMSayaH ॥27॥

text: vasureṣa mahātejāḥ śāpadoṣeṇa śobhane । manuṣyatāmanuprāpto nainaṃ śocitumarhasi ॥28॥
html:
vasureṣa mahātejāḥ śāpadoṣeṇa śobhane ।
manuṣyatāmanuprāpto nainaṃ śocitumarhasi ॥28॥
slp1: vasureza mahAtejAH SApadozeRa SoBane । manuzyatAmanuprApto nEnaM Socitumarhasi ॥28॥

text: sa eṣa kṣatradharmeṇa yudhyamāno raṇājire । dhanañjayena nihato naiṣa nunnaḥ śikhaṇḍinā ॥29॥
html:
sa eṣa kṣatradharmeṇa yudhyamāno raṇājire ।
dhanañjayena nihato naiṣa nunnaḥ śikhaṇḍinā ॥29॥
slp1: sa eza kzatraDarmeRa yuDyamAno raRAjire । DanaYjayena nihato nEza nunnaH SiKaRqinA ॥29॥

text: bhīṣmaṃ hi kuruśārdūlamudyateṣuṃ mahāraṇe । na śaktaḥ saṃyuge hantuṃ sākṣādapi śatakratuḥ ॥30॥
html:
bhīṣmaṃ hi kuruśārdūlamudyateṣuṃ mahāraṇe ।
na śaktaḥ saṃyuge hantuṃ sākṣādapi śatakratuḥ ॥30॥
slp1: BIzmaM hi kuruSArdUlamudyatezuM mahAraRe । na SaktaH saMyuge hantuM sAkzAdapi SatakratuH ॥30॥

text: svacchandena sutastubhyaṃ gataḥ svargaṃ śubhānane । na śaktāḥ syurnihantuṃ hi raṇe taṃ sarvadevatāḥ ॥31॥
html:
svacchandena sutastubhyaṃ gataḥ svargaṃ śubhānane ।
na śaktāḥ syurnihantuṃ hi raṇe taṃ sarvadevatāḥ ॥31॥
slp1: svacCandena sutastuByaM gataH svargaM SuBAnane । na SaktAH syurnihantuM hi raRe taM sarvadevatAH ॥31॥

text: tasmānmā tvaṃ saricchreṣṭhe śocasva kurunandanam । vasūneṣa gato devi putraste vijvarā bhava ॥32॥
html:
tasmānmā tvaṃ saricchreṣṭhe śocasva kurunandanam ।
vasūneṣa gato devi putraste vijvarā bhava ॥32॥
slp1: tasmAnmA tvaM saricCrezWe Socasva kurunandanam । vasUneza gato devi putraste vijvarA Bava ॥32॥

text: ityuktā sā tu kṛṣṇena vyāsena ca saridvarā । tyaktvā śokaṃ mahārāja svaṃ vāryavatatāra ha ॥33॥
html:
ityuktā sā tu kṛṣṇena vyāsena ca saridvarā ।
tyaktvā śokaṃ mahārāja svaṃ vāryavatatāra ha ॥33॥
slp1: ityuktA sA tu kfzRena vyAsena ca saridvarA । tyaktvA SokaM mahArAja svaM vAryavatatAra ha ॥33॥

text: satkṛtya te tāṃ saritaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇamukhā nṛpāḥ ।34.1
